vehicleCollection.en:
With more power, the sporty version of the third-gen TT took a good thing and made it even better.(

When the third-generation Audi TT bowed at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show, the design direction stayed consistent with the first two generation models, meaning it still possessed a sporty, round look. Still, a new front fascia, highlighted by a one-piece grille and R8-like headlights, ensured that this was not the same TT as before.

Despite riding on a 37mm longer wheelbase than its predecessor, the new TT’s overall length was shortened by 8mm, making it slightly smaller. Its compact size accentuated the car’s amazing agility, provided in part by a new, lighter Audi Space Frame, which helped decrease the curb weight of the third-gen car by 50kg.

The TTS sports model came with a turbocharged 2.0-liter TFSI inline-4 tuned to produce 314ps and 38.7kgm of torque (specs of the German-market model). The powerplant came mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox that sent power to all four wheels via Audi’s renown quattro system. With the lighter body and increased engine output, the new TT was faster than before, racing from zero to <100km/h> in a scant 4.7 seconds and reaching a restricted top speed of <250km/h>. The Audi Magnetic Ride variable damper system came as standard equipment, while a dual clutch semi-automatic S Tronic transmission with launch control was available as an option.
vehicleCollection.zh:
简洁又不乏动力。第三代TT的跑车级别车型。

第三代奥迪TT在2014年日内瓦车展上首次亮相。与第一代过渡到第二代时一样，这款车的车型经历了彻底的改动，但承袭了上一代的设计理念。圆顶双门轿车的整体轮廓得以保留，但前端变得更为紧凑，不仅增大了前端的单框格栅，还采用了类似R8的大灯。

许多车在经历车型变更后会变大（轴距增加 37mm），但是这款车型的总长缩短了10mm，宽度减少8mm，相较之前的版本变得更为小巧。车底盘的材质也进行了重新规划，采用了铝钢混合的设计，并应用奥迪空间框架结构，使其在搭载相同引擎的前提下，相比上一代轻了50kg。

车内饰沿袭了前代的简约设计，但用12.3英寸TFT显示屏替换了原本的仪表盘。车载导航地图与其他信息都显示在“虚拟座舱”系统中。

TTS竞赛车型搭载了 2.0 缸内直喷 4缸直列涡轮引擎，德国国内车型经调校后可提供314ps的输出和38.7kgm扭矩。结合6档手动变速箱与四驱系统后，这款车的0-<100km/h>加速时间达到了4.7 秒，最高时速可达<250km/h>。标准配备了奥迪磁流变减震器，而带有起步控制系统的双离合半自动S Tronic变速箱则是选装件。

catch.en: With more power, the sporty version of the third-gen TT took a good thing and made it even better.(
catch.zh: 简洁又不乏动力。第三代TT的跑车级别车型。

long.en:
When the third-generation Audi TT bowed at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show, the design direction stayed consistent with the first two generation models, meaning it still possessed a sporty, round look. Still, a new front fascia, highlighted by a one-piece grille and R8-like headlights, ensured that this was not the same TT as before.

Despite riding on a 37mm longer wheelbase than its predecessor, the new TT’s overall length was shortened by 8mm, making it slightly smaller. Its compact size accentuated the car’s amazing agility, provided in part by a new, lighter Audi Space Frame, which helped decrease the curb weight of the third-gen car by 50kg.

The TTS sports model came with a turbocharged 2.0-liter TFSI inline-4 tuned to produce 314ps and 38.7kgm of torque (specs of the German-market model). The powerplant came mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox that sent power to all four wheels via Audi’s renown quattro system. With the lighter body and increased engine output, the new TT was faster than before, racing from zero to <100km/h> in a scant 4.7 seconds and reaching a restricted top speed of <250km/h>. The Audi Magnetic Ride variable damper system came as standard equipment, while a dual clutch semi-automatic S Tronic transmission with launch control was available as an option.

brandCentral.en:
Audi was the first auto manufacturer to race a hybrid
at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The cutting-edge technology of that revolutionary machine
was implemented on the Audi Vision Gran Turismo.

A rear-mounted turbocharged 3.4-liter V-6 teams with electric
motors that power the front wheels.

Combined, the total output is rated at an astounding 1295ps.

With that much power on tap, it'll not just keep up with LMP1
race cars, it might just leave them in the dust.
brandCentral.zh:
Audi是第一家使用混动车型参加勒芒比赛的制造商。

他们为此赛事专门开发的技术在Audi Vision Gran Turismo
身上得到了充分的彰显。

它的后置3.4L V6涡轮增压引擎可以与电机完美配合，为前
轮提供驱动力。

引擎和电机总共可以输出让人望而生畏的1295ps动力。

这套组合的实力足可以与任何LMP1赛车匹敌。

vehicleCollection.en:
Taking cues from its IMSA race cars, this Vision Gran Turismo machine represents the future of Audi.

The Audi Vision Gran Turismo, developed by Audi Design exclusively for the "Vision Gran Turismo" competition and launched on the 15th anniversary of the series, came in both hybrid and fully-electric versions. Launched on the 15th anniversary of Gran Turismo, these exciting race machines offer a look into the future of motorsports.

The hybrid Audi Vision Gran Turismo is equipped with e-tron quattro, making it all-wheel-drive. It borrows the same technology as the 2012 Le Mans-winning race car, which featured motor-driven front wheels and a conventional rear-wheel setup. The front wheels of the Audi Vision Gran Turismo is powered by a 400 kW (544ps) motor (MGU-K) that recovers energy when braking. The rear tires are powered by a turbocharged 3.4-liter V-6 that produces 550 kW (748ps), making total output an impressive 950 kW (1292ps), which is more than many of today's LMP1 hybrid racers. It comes mated to a sequential 7-speed gearbox actuated by paddles on the steering wheel. The weight-to-power ratio for the Audi Vision Gran Turismo is less than one kilogram per horsepower.

The new race car is reminiscent of the Audi 90 IMSA GTO, which thrilled fans in the North American IMSA GTO racing series in 1989 with drivers such as Hans-Joachim Stuck, Walter Röhrl, Hurley Haywood and Scott Goodyear. The car was far ahead of its time, thanks to its combination of lightweight construction, a powerful turbocharged inline-5 engine, and quattro all-wheel-drive.

You can tell the all-electric version from the hybrid by the wheels: the former comes with 18-inchers all around, while the hybrid race car has 20-inch wheels in front with 21-inch examples at the rear.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆Vision Gran Turismo继承了国际汽车运动协会赛事车辆的精髓，代表着奥迪的未来。

跑车浪漫旅愿景”大赛于跑车浪漫旅十五周年之际举行，奥迪Vision Gran Turismo是完全由奥迪设计专为此赛事中的模拟赛车而设计的。数字版有两个版本：混合动力版和纯电动车版。

奥迪Vision Gran Turismo混合动力版结合了V6涡轮引擎和电动前轴。这款车使你可以在虚拟的竞速赛和锦标赛中与其他跑车浪漫旅愿景概念赛车和混合动力车型一较高下。

这款赛车有意识地采用了奥迪90 IMSA GTO的设计元素，奥迪Sport车队在1989年的北美国际汽车运动协会GTO系列赛中曾凭借此车令车迷们为之疯狂，汉斯·乔吉姆·斯塔克、沃尔特·罗尔、赫尔利·海伍德和斯科特·古德耶尔等车手都曾驾驶此车。此车采用了坚固的轻量化构造，搭配强劲的五缸涡轮引擎和四轮驱动，在当时远远领先时代。

奥迪Vision Gran Turismo采用了全时四轮驱动；确切地说，是e-tron四轮驱动系统。奥迪于2012年在赫赫有名的24小时勒芒耐力赛上取得混合动力引擎赛车的首次胜利，参赛的车辆采用电力驱动的前轴和传统动力驱动的后轴。

奥迪Vision Gran Turismo的前轴由544ps（400千瓦）的动能电机提供动力，在刹车时可以回收能量。后部采用马力748ps（550千瓦）的3.4升V6涡轮增压引擎，因此这辆混合动力赛车的整车马力达到了1292ps（950千瓦），甚至超过了现代勒芒原型车1级混合动力赛车的性能。

此车拥有许多赛车梦寐以求的重量马力比：小于每马力一千克。

此车配备的序列式7档赛车变速箱与其强大的马力相得益彰，并采用方向盘上的摇杆来变档。全电动版本采用的是18英寸的车轮，混合动力赛车则在前轮采用20英寸的U轮，后轮则为21英寸的车轮。

usedCar.en:
The A112 Abarth may be small, but it has a proven
reputation as being one exciting car to drive.

What everyone loves about it is the feel of its engine.

You might think at first that the OHV 4-cylinder is a bit tame.

But once you get behind the wheel, you'll be impressed.

The final model pumped out 70ps, which is quite adequate
when you consider the car weighs only 700kg.

It just goes to show that the Italians are capable of producing
fun compacts and not just glorious high-priced exotics.
usedCar.zh:
A112 Abarth可能比较娇小，
但以驾驶体验刺激而闻名。

尤其是引擎感经常受到表扬。

以顶置阀门四缸引擎车来说，
可能设计上有些复古。

但性能却是无可匹敌。

最终车型具备高达70ps的马力，这对
一辆重量只有700kg的车来说完全足够。

绝对是意大利汽车工艺的优秀典范。

vehicleCollection.en:
The original hot hatch, with excellent power and agile handling, paved the way for a new genre.

Introduced in 1971, the A112 Abarth is widely regarded as the original hot hatch. Built on the ultra-compact Autobianchi A112 platform, the A112 Abarth was a nimble 3-door hatchback, measuring just 3230mm in length and 1480mm in width.

The car was tuned by Abarth, which had just been acquired by the FIAT Group. The prototype featured a heavily modified version of the base 903cc OHV inline-4 engine, with displacement increased to 982cc, resulting in 108ps. This allowed the car to reach a top speed of <208km/h>.

The production model retained the 982cc engine, but it was detuned to 58ps to enhance everyday usability. Despite the decrease, it still produced 20 percent more power than the base engine.

Abarth continued to make numerous improvements to the A112's performance. In 1975, engine displacement was increased to 1050cc, boosting output to 71ps. In 1979, the transmission was upgraded from a 4-speed to a 5-speed unit,

Although production ceased in 1985, the car remains a favorite among enthusiasts for its uniquely spirited and energetic character.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款以高动力操控性而著称的车型是所有小钢炮的先驱。"

A112阿巴斯于1971年首次亮相，这款运动车型通常也被公认为是最初的高性能掀背车型。此车是以超紧凑的奥托比安希A112为基础开发的，这款三门掀背车的长度只有3230mm，宽度也只有1480mm。

负责调校这款车的是刚刚被菲亚特集团收购的阿巴斯公司。原型车使用的引擎是以903cc直列四缸OHV引擎为基础的大幅改进版本，排量增加到了982cc，可以产生108ps的动力。这使得该车的最高速度达到了<208km/h>。

为了保证最优性能和效率，量产车型上仍然采用了排量为982cc的引擎，不过只能产出58ps的动力，但相比原版引擎仍然增加了20%的功率。

在此之后，阿巴斯针对A112的运动性能进行了持续、大量的改进。1975年，引擎的排量扩大到1050cc，以产生最大71ps的动力。1979年，变速器从4速改为5速。

虽然在1985年就已早早停产，但时至今日，它仍因其无与伦比的活力而受到车迷的喜爱。

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The BAC Mono is one gorgeous piece of engineering.

 It's a great example of exceptional industrial design.

 Every detail is beautifully executed
with functional forms and fresh graphics.

 Its inspiration comes from single-seat formula cars.

It's a serious road and track machine that is
designed to extract the maximum out of the driver and car.

The serious aerodynamics are played out visually.

 Take a look at the fuselage.

It tapers to the rear with the large side intakes
and routes the air through and over the back spoiler/wing.

I also love how the engineering is approached.

It comes equipped with push-rod front suspension shocks,
and the rear suspension arms on full display.

This car is indeed an impressive example of
how form can follow function.

 It is truly a highly technical,
clever design language that is beautifully done!
dialogues.zh:
BAC Mono是一辆工程学的奇迹、

一件出类拔萃的工业设计样本……

它的设计灵感来自于单座方程式赛车。

每一处细节都精雕细琢……
采用功能至上的部件和极致简洁的贴花，

这是一辆货真价实的公路和赛道机器，
所有设计只为让驾驶者和车辆都发挥出全部潜力。

严谨的空气动力学设计毫不掩饰地呈现在眼前。

以车身为例，

车身两侧从前向后逐渐收窄，露出硕大的侧进气口，
以便引导气流从车后部的上方通过。

它在工程上的处理方式也是我很欣赏的。

它配备了推杆式前悬挂减震……

而后悬挂臂则直接裸露在外。

brandCentral.en:
BAC is a newcomer to the sports car manufacturing scene, but
this British car maker has already developed a following.

The car that shot it to prominence was the single-seat Mono,
which has the look of a race car, but was totally street-legal.

It came powered by a naturally-aspirated 2.3-liter inline-4
that produced about 300ps.

With a curb weight of only 580kg, it had the power-to-weight
ratio that was comparable to a formula racer.

In fact, the lucky people who've driven say it
it feels like an F3 car!
brandCentral.zh:
BAC是跑车制造领域中的新人，不过这家英国车厂已经在
全世界范围内聚拢了大量粉丝。

这辆单座的Mono是一部无比杰出的机器，帮助这家车厂进
一步巩固了他们的地位。

是的，它看上去仿佛是专为比赛所设计的，但出人意料
的是，它完全符合道路行驶的法规。

它结合了580kg的极低重量和300ps的超强动力输出。

懂行的人都说，它的驾驶感受非常类似Formula 3赛车！

vehicleCollection.en:
Simple yet effective, this single-seat sports car is reminiscent of formula cars from a bygone era.

The BAC Mono, a sports car produced by British manufacturer Briggs Automotive Company since 2009, was the realization of the Briggs brothers' vision of "a road vehicle that offers the most authentic and pure driving experience possible while implementing the very latest in racing technology."

The car's most notable element was its formula car-style single seat design. However, unlike modern formula cars that are typically built on a carbon monocoque, the BAC Mono employed a more classical tubular frame design with a carbon-fiber body shell. Both the front and rear suspensions consisted of a double wishbone pushrod design.

The engine, situated behind the driver, came in the form of a Cosworth-tuned Ford Duratec 2.5-liter inline-4 that produced 309ps and 31.4kgm. It came mated to a race-specification 6-speed sequential transmission.

The BAC Mono was a remarkably lightweight car, tipping the scales at a very lean 580kg, making its performance on par with F3 Formula racers of its day. Its performance numbers were awe-inspiring: a zero-to-60-mph time of 2.8 seconds and a top speed of <274km/h>.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款单座跑车在简洁中蕴藏着吸引力，让人想起上一个时代的方程式赛车。

BAC Mono是一辆由英国制造商布里格斯汽车公司从2009年起推出的跑车。布里格斯兄弟二人长期从事量产汽车的设计和开发工作。这款BAC Mono是他们打造“最纯正驾驶体验，同时应用最新赛车技术的公路车型”理念的现实产物。

其最引人瞩目的特点当属参照方程式赛车样式设计的单座布局。不过，和现代方程式赛车采用碳纤维单体车壳的设计略有不同，BAC Mono选择了更为传统的管状框架设计和碳纤维车体外壳。其前后悬挂都采用了双横臂推杆设计。

安置于驾驶者身后的引擎是一部调校后的考斯沃斯 2.5升直列4缸福特多丽耐动力单元，可以输出309ps的动力和31.4kgm的扭矩，并通过赛车规格的6速序列式变速箱传递至轮上。

这款车仅重580kg，性能可以和F3赛车媲美，0-60英里/小时加速仅需2.8秒，最大速度高达<274km/h>。

usedCar.en:
Also known as the E9, this fabulous BMW coupe was introduced
in the 1960s.

This CSL version was based on the 3.0 CS. And as the letter "L"
suggests, it was lighter, by 200kg.

The change was made to homologate the car for
the European Touring Championship.

While it might not look all that different from a 3.0 CS at
first glance, the doors and hood are actually aluminum.{
usedCar.zh:
这款神话般的BMW coupé也被称为E9，
于1960年代首度亮相。

这辆CSL衍生版基于3.0 CS，
但是比它还轻200kg。

这对于欧洲房车锦标赛的赛事认证
来说是必需品质。

一眼看去可能在外形上和3.0 CS没有
差异，但车门和引擎盖实际上是铝制的。

vehicleCollection.en:
This lightweight model of the 3.0 CS was stripped of all creature comforts to maximize performance.

BMW followed up its popular 2800 CS, introduced in 1968, with the 3.0 CS luxury sports coupe three years later.

The 2800 CS wore the body of the 1965 2000 C, but possessed a longer front overhang to make room for a 2.8-liter inline-6, replacing the 2000C's four-cylinder engine. With the 3.0 CS, BMW enlarged the engine, known as the "Big Six," to 3.0 liters, resulting in 180ps and 26.0kgm of torque. To offset the power increase, BMW fitted 4-wheel disc brakes to the 3.0 CS.

Such a car would make for an excellent race car, BMW concluded, so when the 3.0 CS took to the track, a special lightweight homologation version was offered, one that weighed 200kg less than the base model. This car was called the 3.0 CSL with the "L" standing for "leicht," which means lightweight in German.
vehicleCollection.zh:
3.0 CS sports coupé的轻量化版本，去除了所有多余的配置，以最大限度地提高赛道性能。

1971年首次亮相的宝马3.0 CS是基于1968年的2800 CS研发的豪华双门轿跑。

2800 CS系列车型沿用了1965年的4缸版2000 C车身，并将前车身加大加宽，放进了一台实力强劲的直列6缸引擎。

宝马3.0 CS可以看作是2800 CS的后继车款，排量从2.8升提高到了3.0升，可输出180ps/26.0kgm。为了应对动力的提升，四轮均配备了碟刹。

之后，宝马又决定让这台高性能的6缸轿跑到赛车场上一展身手。通过对整车组件进行全面减重，最终完成了符合赛事认证的版本。它比原版CS轻了足有200千克，最后被定名为3.0 CSL（L是德语单词“轻量”的首字母），并投放市场。

This magnificent BMW continued the company's long tradition

vehicleCollection.en:
This lightweight model of the BMW 3.0 CS was developed to compete in touring car racing.

The BMW 3.0 CS, a luxury sports coupe developed from the 2800 CS, which was released in 1968, picked up where the 2800 CS left off.

Powering the original 2800CS was a 2.8-liter inline-6 that was called "the Big Six." For the 3.0 CS, engine displacement was increased to 3.0 liters, increasing power to 180ps/26.0kgm. To improve stopping power, BMW equipped the 3.0 CS with 4-wheel disc brakes.

The car's performance was so exceptional that BMW decided to take the Big Six racing, so it built a homologation model with significantly reduced weight. This version, called the 3.0 CSL (the "L" stood for "leicht," which in English means "light"), weighed 200 kg less than the base CS, making it an absolute road rocket.

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
BMW's EV brand began with the "i."

The company offered two products, an urban commuter,
the i3, and the super high-performance i8.

Both models utilized different power sources, and
each expressed itself with its own form language.

They're quite alluring, no?

Particularly the i3, in addition to the proportions
defined by packaging necessities...

The car is eye-catching, even when it's driving
around town.

The interior also uses sustainable environmental materials.
Everything about the car is thorough.

This kind of approach serves the role of making the user
highly conscious of the environment.

That's why this design is so important. A gold star!
dialogues.zh:
宝马的电动车都以“i”字母起头。

其电动车品牌主打两款产品：作为都市通勤车的i3，
和拥有超强性能的i8。

这两个型号采用了不同的动力源，
而且都以独特的外形设计语言表达出自己的定位。

两辆车是不是都非常诱人？

尤其是这辆i3，在内饰布局和配置上下了不少功夫，
留足了空间……

即便是在城市里驾驶，它也能非常吸睛。

它的内饰采用了可持续环保材料。
此车的一切都透露着缜密、周全。

这样的做法有助于令用户对环保产生深刻的认识。

正因如此，这份独到的设计才显得至关重要。
值得给它颁发一颗金星勋章！

vehicleCollection.en:
BMW’s first mass-produced production vehicle has a sports-car heart.

BMW established the "i" line specifically to market its alternative-energy vehicles, including EVs and plug-in hybrids. The first example to be offered by the German company with the "i" designation was the i3 in 2013.

In a word, the i3's styling is futuristic, complete with a unique shape and clamshell doors. The car is just under 4m in length, 1.8m width, 1.6m height, and weighs a mere 1195kg, which is a testament to the engineers who made it a priority to keep the car's curb weight down. They accomplished this by extensively using carbon-fiber in the cabin and incorporating as much aluminum as possible in the chassis. The lithium-ion batteries are placed at the center of the vehicle to optimize handling balance.

The motor produces 170ps and 25.5kgm of torque, sending power to the rear wheels. The i3 runs from zero to <60km/h> in just 3.7 and to <100km/h> in 7.2 seconds. Top speed is rated at more than <150km/h>. Because electric motors can deliver peak torque instantaneously, the i3 feels like a supercar when you launch it from a standstill.

At full charge, the i3 possesses a 160km range, and on the ECO PRO mode with minimal air conditioning and other power saving tricks, it can go up to 200km. For those who may suffer from range anxiety, a 647cc 2-cylinder gasoline engine can extend the i3's driving range to a maximum of 300km.
vehicleCollection.zh:
宝马的第一款市售电动车，拥有跑车级别的加速性能。

i3是宝马在2013年发布的电动车，也是首款投入量产的宝马i系车。i系是宝马专为电动车和插电式混合动力车等新能源车型而建立的子品牌。

车的外形是具有未来感的厢式旅行车设计，采用对开式车门。车体尺寸约为4m长、1.8m宽，1.6m高，重量仅有1195kg，相对于通常较重的电动车而言属于相当出色的规格。这要归功于注重轻量化的车体结构：采用碳纤维增强复合材料制成的座舱搭配铝合金底盘。锂离子电池安放在车身底部的底盘中央，后置电机驱动后轮。

电机可提供170ps输出与25.5kgm扭矩。从静止状态加速到<60km/h>仅需3.7秒，而0-<100km/h>加速只需7.2秒，最高时速超过<150km/h>。这样的性能完全不逊于标准内燃机汽车。得益于电机可从0转每分开始提供最大扭矩的特点，这款车的加速表现不亚于当代的跑车。

在充满电的情况下，这款车的续航里程可达160km，而开启进阶节能模式禁用空调与其他耗能设备后，续航里程可延长至200km。若担心续航距离，还可以安装647立方厘米双缸引擎延长续航距离，从而将这款车的续航里程上限提升至300km。

catch.en: BMW’s first mass-produced production vehicle has a sports-car heart.
catch.zh: 宝马的第一款市售电动车，拥有跑车级别的加速性能。

long.en:
BMW established the "i" line specifically to market its alternative-energy vehicles, including EVs and plug-in hybrids. The first example to be offered by the German company with the "i" designation was the i3 in 2013.

In a word, the i3's styling is futuristic, complete with a unique shape and clamshell doors. The car is just under 4m in length, 1.8m width, 1.6m height, and weighs a mere 1195kg, which is a testament to the engineers who made it a priority to keep the car's curb weight down. They accomplished this by extensively using carbon-fiber in the cabin and incorporating as much aluminum as possible in the chassis. The lithium-ion batteries are placed at the center of the vehicle to optimize handling balance.

The motor produces 170ps and 25.5kgm of torque, sending power to the rear wheels. The i3 runs from zero to <60km/h> in just 3.7 and to <100km/h> in 7.2 seconds. Top speed is rated at more than <150km/h>. Because electric motors can deliver peak torque instantaneously, the i3 feels like a supercar when you launch it from a standstill.

At full charge, the i3 possesses a 160km range, and on the ECO PRO mode with minimal air conditioning and other power saving tricks, it can go up to 200km. For those who may suffer from range anxiety, a 647cc 2-cylinder gasoline engine can extend the i3's driving range to a maximum of 300km.

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
The 1999 Le Mans 24 Hours was one of those races
that stays with you.

Factory teams from the world’s biggest automakers arrived with
everything to prove, fighting for victory in an all-out war.

When the checkered flag fell, it was BMW’s V12 LMR prototype
that stood above them all.

It was BMW’s first overall win at the legendary 24-hour classic.

Now, some 20 years later, BMW has returned to the top category
with a machine built for the modern era...

...with this BMW M Hybrid V8!

The car made its presence felt, scoring a 1-2 finish at the 10th
round of the 2024 IMSA SportsCar Championship in Indianapolis...

It also took a hypercar class victory in
the World Endurance Championship.

There’s no doubt about it:
This machine has proven it belongs on the world stage.
dialogues.zh:
1999年的勒芒24小时耐力赛堪称经典之战。

全球各大顶尖汽车制造商的厂队使出浑身解数，
全力角逐总冠军的殊荣。

而最终登顶的则是宝马的V12 LMR原型车。

这也是宝马首次登顶这一传奇的24小时耐力赛。

时隔二十余年，这一德系劲旅宣布重返顶级组别行列……

携宝马M Hybrid V8强势归来！

这台车在2024年国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛第10站
印第安纳波利斯分站中强势包揽冠亚军，

还在世界耐力锦标赛中斩获超级跑车组别冠军。

毫无疑问，这台竞速机器已然在世界舞台证明了自身实力。

brandCentral.en:
Le Mans Daytona h (LMDh) regulations were introduced in 2023
to reduce the cost of prototype sports-car racing.

Under the new rules, BMW introduced the M Hybrid V8, a machine
intended to succeed the V12 LMR that won Le Mans in 1999.

While its oversized kidney grille gives it the look of a BMW road
car, the illuminated headlight outlines lend it a futuristic edge.

BMW selected a chassis built by Dallara, and power came from
a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8 derived from BMW’s DTM program.

TThe M Hybrid V8 appeared in the IMSA Championship in 2023, and
the FIA World Endurance Championship the following year.

In 2025, it scored a 1-2 finish at the eighth IMSA race and took
2nd place at Imola in the World Endurance Championship.

It also has served as the base for BMW Art Cars, but there’s
still plenty more to come from it on the track.
brandCentral.zh:
勒芒-戴通纳混合动力规则于2023年引入，
旨在降低原型跑车的赛事成本。

根据该规则，宝马推出了M Hybrid V8，期望它
能成为1999年勒芒冠军车型V12 LMR的继任者。

宽大的双肾形格栅赋予了它宝马公路车的神韵，
而激光光纤照明技术勾勒的头灯轮廓则充满未来感。

宝马选择了达拉拉制造的底盘，并配备了一台
4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，基于德国房车大师赛所使用的动力单元。

M Hybrid V8于2023年在国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛中首次亮相，
次年便征战世界耐力锦标赛。

2025年，M Hybrid V8在赛季第八场国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛中包揽冠亚军，
并在世界耐力锦标赛第二站伊莫拉站中夺得第二名。

它还被选为了宝马艺术车项目的创作载体。
不过，它在赛道上的传奇才刚刚开始！

vehicleCollection.en:
A new category sports prototype that carries the lineage of the celebrated V12 LMR.

The BMW M Hybrid V8 was a cutting-edge prototype car developed to the Le Mans Daytona h (LMDh) specifications. Its Dallara-built carbon-fiber monocoque came powered by a DTM-derived P66/3, a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8 engine paired with a hybrid system. Producing a combined system output of 680ps, this power unit blended the thunder of internal combustion with the instantaneous response of electric assistance, delivering performance worthy of the M badge.

The wide kidney grilles of the front fascia created an unmistakable presence, identifying it as a BMW at a single glance. Outlined with laser lighting, these grilles reflected the brand’s heritage and forward-thinking technology while also maximizing aerodynamics and cooling in a form of functional beauty.

During the 2025 season, the BMW M Hybrid V8 competed in both the IMSA SportsCar Championship and FIA World Endurance Championship wearing a distinctive digital mosaic livery. In the eighth round of the IMSA season at Road America, the car dominated the field with a one-two finish, further establishing BMW’s reputation in the GTP class. Meanwhile, in the WEC, it demonstrated strong pace at circuits such as Imola while competing at the very highest level of endurance racing.

Although it carried forward the spirit of celebrated prototypes like the V12 LMR, hybrid technology allowed this machine to become a flagship pointing toward a new era of performance. Tradition, innovation and the drive to win—this car brought them all together.
vehicleCollection.zh:
参与全新组别的原型跑车，继承传奇车型V12 LMR血脉。

宝马M Hybrid V8是一款按照“勒芒-戴通纳混合动力”规格打造的尖端原型赛车。它采用由达拉拉制造的碳纤维单体车身，搭载源自德国房车大师赛的“P66/3”4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，使用混合动力配置。这套动力单元的总系统输出功率可达680ps，它将内燃机的强劲轰鸣与电动辅助的瞬时响应融为一体，造就了不愧于其M标识的赛道级性能。

前脸宽大的双肾形格栅营造出威严的气场，让人一眼便能认出这是一辆宝马。格栅内嵌激光有源光纤灯组的造型设计既传承品牌传统，又融入前瞻科技，并在实现功能之美的同时，将空气动力学与冷却性能发挥到极致。

2025赛季，宝马M Hybrid V8披上数字马赛克涂装，征战国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛与国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛。在国际汽车运动协会跑车锦标赛第八站美国之路赛道上，该车统治全场，一举包揽冠亚军，为宝马在原型车组别中赢得了声誉。与此同时，在世界耐力锦标赛赛场上，它在伊莫拉等分站赛中表现强势，于耐力赛的巅峰舞台上展开激烈竞逐。

尽管它传承了大量来自V12 LMR等传奇原型车的基因，但混合动力技术才是它开辟全新时代，成为一代旗舰的关键。传统、变革与求胜之心，于此车集于一身。

brandCentral.en:
This is the M2 Competition, an upgraded variant of the
compact, powerful rear-wheel drive M2.

BMW's M models are considered very special by racing
fans all over the world.

This is because they're developed by BMW M, BMW's dedicated
motorsport subsidiary.

Their cars trace their ancestry back to legendary sports
cars of the 1970s, such as the BMW 3.0 CSL and BMW M1.

The M2 Competition features a straight-six twin turbo S55B
engine, developed by BMW M.

The car's cooling systems, brakes and body rigidity are
also a step up on the base M2.

Of all the M2 series retail models, this is the one that'll
provide the best experience on the track.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一台M2 Competition，是基于动力强劲的
紧凑型后驱车M2升级而来的改款车型。

BMW的M系列在全世界车迷的心目中有着十分特别的地位。

因为它们都是由BMW专门从事
赛车运动的子公司BMW M公司所开发的。

他们所制造的赛车的血统可以追溯到二十世纪七十年代的
传奇赛车身上，例如BMW 3.0 CSL和BMW M1。

M2 Competition采用由BMW M开发的直列六缸双涡轮增压S55B引擎。

此车的冷却系统、刹车和车身刚度
也是基于原版M2升级而来。

在所有M2系列零售车型中，这一款在赛道上的体验是最出色的。

vehicleCollection.en:
A hardboiled FR that hides the power of a demon in its compact body.

The BMW 2 Series coupe is a popular high-performance rear-wheel-drive compact car. The BMW M2 Competition is the extreme version that fills the same engine compartment with a 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged inline-6 "S55" engine from the M3 and M4.

What you'll notice first is the car's captivating bodywork. With its bulging over fenders, the exterior is the embodiment of speed. Although it measures only 4475mm in length, it's actually about the same size as the E36 M3. Whether in the city or on winding backroads, the car displays an incredible sense of control, as if it was an extension of the driver's body.

The S55 engine delivers a maximum power output of 410ps with 56.1kgm peak torque. Even up against BMW's long history of high-performance inline-6 engines, this model has an exceptional high-revving nature, and as the boost builds its explosive power emerges.

No compromises have been made to the running gear either. To reduce unsprung weight, the aluminum suspension components have been specially tuned for spirited driving. Meanwhile, the torque vectoring "Active M Differential" ensures the car turns exactly where you want it to.

Now that the M3 and M4 have moved to a higher segment, this car may be the ideal expression of BMW's "Ulitmate Driving Machine."
vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆在紧凑车身下隐藏着恶魔般动力的彪悍前置后驱车。"

宝马2系双门跑车是一款非常受欢迎的高性能、后轮驱动的紧凑型车型。宝马M2 Competition是一台极限跑车，它在同样的发动机舱中塞下了一台M3和M4所用的3升双涡轮增压直列6缸“S55 ”发动机。

你第一眼注意到的肯定是这美妙的车体。凭借其隆起的挡泥板，它的速度无可匹敌。虽然这台车只有4475mm长，但它的尺寸大约与E36 M3相同。无论是在城市里还是在蜿蜒的小路上，这辆车都可以提供一种令人难以置信的操控感，缔造人车合一的感受。

S55的最大功率为410ps，最大扭力为56.1kgm。即使与宝马历史悠久的高性能直列6缸发动机相比，该型引擎也具有出色的高转速性能。达到高转速后，它的超强马力也会随之展现。

而这一强大的动力并未使这辆车在传动装置组上做出任何妥协。为了减少簧下重量，这辆车的铝制悬架部件经过了专门的调整。同时，控制扭矩矢量的“主动M差速器”会确保这辆车能随心所欲地准确转向。

现在，由于M3和M4已经进入了一个更高的层级，这款车可能就是宝马“纯粹驾驶乐趣”的完美体现了吧。

宝马2系双门跑车是一款非常受欢迎的高性能、后轮驱动的紧凑型车型。宝马M2 Competition是一台极限跑车，它在同样的发动机舱中塞下了一台M3和M4所用的3升双涡轮增压直列6缸“S55 ”发动机。

你第一眼注意到的肯定是这美妙的车体。凭借其隆起的挡泥板，它的速度无可匹敌。虽然这台车只有4475mm长，但它的尺寸大约与E36 M3相同。无论是在城市里还是在蜿蜒的小路上，这辆车都可以提供一种令人难以置信的操控感，缔造人车合一的感受。

S55的最大功率为410ps，最大扭力为56.1kgm。即使与宝马历史悠久的高性能直列6缸发动机相比，该型引擎也具有出色的高转速性能。达到高转速后，它的超强马力也会随之展现。

而这一强大的动力并未使这辆车在传动装置组上做出任何妥协。为了减少簧下重量，这辆车的铝制悬架部件经过了专门的调整。同时，控制扭矩矢量的“主动M差速器”会确保这辆车能随心所欲地准确转向。

现在，由于M3和M4已经进入了一个更高的层级，这款车可能就是宝马“纯粹驾驶乐趣”的完美体现了吧。

usedCar.en:
The BMW M3 has represented the ultimate sports sedan/coupe
in the marketplace since it was created in 1989.

This car here started it all, the first-gen M3 dubbed the E30.

BMW's motorsports division fine-tuned every inch of this car—
engine, suspension, body—to make it perform better.

This homologation model was born out of a desire to triumph
in Gr.A category racing.

Though its design might seem simple, you'll realize its
potent nature once you get behind the steering wheel.
usedCar.zh:
毫无疑问，BMW M3被认为是世界上最好的
RWD跑车之一。

这款车型是第一代E30 M3。

室内赛车专家BMW M精细调整了每个细节：
引擎、悬挂系统和车身，同时也没有忘记性能。

这款赛事认证车型的诞生就是为了在
Gr.A类赛车中取得胜利。

虽然设计看上去比较简单，挑剃的爱车人士
却可以立即识别而出，也喜欢它带来的感受。

vehicleCollection.en:
A virtual race car for the street, this homologation model once claimed victory in the DTM.

The first BMW M3 appeared in 1985, and it represented a high-performance version of the popular 3 Series (E30) that could also be used for touring car racing.

At first, the M3 only came in 2-door form, with wider treads and sporty fender flares. Also, front and rear spoilers were added, aggressive side skirts were installed and the angle of the C-pillar and rear window were revised to create a car that looked much meaner than the stock 3 Series. These body modifications also resulted in a better Cd of 0.38 (from 0.33). Under the hood was a special 2.3-liter DOHC inline-4 that produced 195ps and 23.4kgm of torque.

The race-spec model was introduced in 1987. From the onset, it dominated the DTM, winning five of the first 10 races. That same year, the M3 Evolution was released with even better aerodynamics and a 210ps engine. In 1988, output was increased to 220ps for the M3 Evolution II. In 1989 the final model of the E30 M3, called the M3 Sports Evolution, appeared, equipped with a larger engine (2.5 liters) that produced 238ps/24.5kgm.
vehicleCollection.zh:
曾在德国房车大师赛中屡获殊荣的赛事认证车型。微微鼓起的挡泥板正是其性能的见证。

第一款宝马M3诞生于1985年。这是一款由宝马M设计，基于E303系列车款开发的公路车型，用于参加房车赛事。

车体基于双门家用轿车，车身得到加宽，翼子板同样也进行了调整。从前后扰流板到侧裙，乃至C柱的角度和后车窗都进行了改进，车尾箱也被抬高。这些调整让车体的阻尼系数从0.38降低到了0.33。驱动车身的是一台2.3升顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎，最大动力输出为195ps，最大扭矩为23.4kgm。

竞速车型于1987年引入，并在德国房车大师赛中展现出了统治级的实力，在10站比赛中赢下了5场。在赛车运动行业声名鹊起的同时，同一个规格的公路车型也在不断的改进之中。

同一年，M3进化版上市，空气动力学造型得到了进一步的优化，引擎动力也提升到了210ps。1988年推出的M3进化版II的引擎动力进一步提高到了220ps。而到了1989年，E30系列M3的最终型号上市，称为M3运动进化版，配备排量更大、依据赛车标准设计的2.5升引擎，动力输出为238ps/24.5kgm，同时推出的还有专用的前后扰流板。

usedCar.en:
Whether you're looking to cruise around town or refine your track
skills, the M3 E36 was the ideal car for driving enthusiasts.

The M3 legacy began with the iconic first-generation E30,
designed for Group A homologation.

But it's the second-gen E36 that truly cemented the model's
reputation for performance.

This iteration introduced BMW's now-legendary inline-6 engine.

Even more enticing, this particular model came from
a later release after a series of refinements.

The combination of the 3.2-liter inline-6 mated to a 6-speed
manual gearbox made it a favorite among sports-car fans.

After all, it offered power and precision at the low revs,
and exceptional notes at the high.
usedCar.zh:
无论是市内道路驾驶还是提升赛道技艺，M3 E36都是
您的理想之选。

M3系列以其传奇的首代E30车型而闻名，那是一款为满
足A组别赛事规则而生产的认证车型。

而这里介绍的是第二代E36车型。

正是从这一代起，M3开启了搭载BMW引以为傲的直列6缸
引擎的先河。

值得一提的是，它属于该系列的后期产品，经过了小幅
改款后推出。

它配备了经过扩容的3.2L直列6缸引擎，搭配6速手动变
速箱，因此广受欢迎。

这样的组合在低转速区间就能提供充沛动力和精准控制，
而在高转速时更能呈现出令人陶醉的引擎咆哮声。@

vehicleCollection.en:
From race car to luxury grand tourer, the second-generation M3.

The second-generation M3 was introduced in 1992, two years after the debut of its base model, the third-generation 3-Series, codenamed E36.

The original E30 M3 was a racing homologation model, extensively modified from the standard 3-Series. In contrast, the E36 M3 shifted towards the direction of a grand tourer, featuring a more mature appearance with understated aerodynamic components.

Despite this shift, performance remained its central focus. The 3.0-liter inline-6 engine produced 286ps with 32.7kgm of torque. With this powerful engine, the car accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in just six seconds and reach a top speed of <250km/h>, limited by a speed governor.

A minor model update in 1995 introduced a 3.2-liter engine, boosting output to 321ps and 35.7kgm of torque. This update also included the replacement of the 5-speed manual transmission with a 6-speed unit and several chassis enhancements to improve handling. In 1997, a 6-speed semi-automatic transmission was introduced.

The E36 M3 significantly elevated the line's reputation as a road car, while the feel and sound of its inline-6 powerplant were celebrated as delightful and enduring features.
vehicleCollection.zh:
3.2升的第二代M3：从赛车到豪华旅行车。

第二代M3发布于1992年，比它的基础车型第三代“E36”3系晚了足足两年。

第一代的“E30”M3其实是一款赛车认证车型，对标准的3系车型进行了大刀阔斧的改装。而E36 M3的设计理念则截然不同，走向了豪华跑车的方向。它采用了更加成熟的外观，配备了低调的空气动力学部件。

不过，性能依然是设计中考量的重要因素。这款车配备了一款3升直列6缸引擎，功率达到286ps，扭矩为32.7kgm。以这款引擎为核心，此车能在短短6秒内从静止加速到<100km/h>，并继续加速，直至达到<250km/h>的速度限制。

在1995年接受小改款后，车系阵容引入了一款3.2升引擎，输出达到321ps和35.7kgm的扭矩，并且将5速手动变速箱换成了6速，同时对底盘进行了多项调整以提升整体操控性能。1997年，又引入了一款6速半自动变速箱车型。

E36 M3显著提升了M3系列作为公路车的形象，其直列6缸引擎的动力感和轰鸣声被誉为一大享受，在推出后的多年里一直是亮点所在。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
If you're seeking thrills that only a German GT car
can offer, then the BMW M3 is for you!

This E46 M3 came powered by a mighty S54B inline-6.

This engine delivered high revs and a power output that was
simply out of this world.

It is without a doubt an icon among icons.

The E46 also exhibited the exceptional FR handling that drivers
have come to expect in BMW cars.

Indeed, more and more people will be singing its praises
in the years to come, you'll see.
dialogues.zh:
如果你追求只有跑车引擎才能提供的刺激感，
那么选BMW M3系列肯定没错！

这款E46 M3搭载S54B直列六缸引擎……

产生的极高转速和强大的动力输出，简直让你感觉飞出天际。

这款车毫无疑问是经典中的经典。

E46也展现出了BMW跑车向来优异的
前置后驱操控性能。

可以肯定的是，
会有越来越多的人迷上这款车。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
The styling of this car is a continuation
of the BMW 2002 and represents

the last 3 Series with BMW's traditional design language.

It looks as if the designers employed obvious themes and
executed them in an obvious manner, but the car still looks good.

For example, one thing that makes this design effective is...

...the front overhang when viewed from the rear-quarter angle.

It's almost non-existent.
You can hardly see it.

Both the engineers and designers understood
the importance of proportions.

This design can only happen when planned from the early stages.

It may look simple, but it's not so easily accomplished
on a mass-produced vehicle..
dialogues.zh:
这款车延续了2002款的风格，
在BMW的传统设计语言下竭力展现最新一代3系的风貌。

我感觉，设计师们最初就定下了张扬肆意的调子，
在呈现时更是不遗余力，最终的效果也非常出彩。

比如说，它有个非常精妙的设计……

……如果你从斜后方角度观察车头前悬部分，

你会发现几乎看不到，
仿佛它不存在一样。

这代表BMW的工程师和设计师们对车身比例研究得很透彻。

要实现这一点，必须在开发前期就将之纳入规划。

这是一件知易行难的事，在打造一款量产车时，
能实现这样的成果确实难能可贵。.

brandCentral.en:
Like its predecessors, the third generation BMW M3
is a quintessential example of a FR sports car.

Its naturally aspirated straight-six engine is highly tuned,
producing more than 100ps per litre of displacement.

A truly exceptional piece of machinery, it's hailed as the
fastest, most powerful straight-six engine in the world.

With a compact, stylish body and a very fine engine indeed,
this car has only grown more magnificent with age.
brandCentral.zh:
与其前辈一样，第三代BMW M3是前置后驱跑车的典型代表。

其自然进气的直列六缸引擎经过高度调校，每升排量的
动力输出超过了100ps。

这是一台真正出类拔萃的机器，被誉为世界上最快、最
强大的直列六缸引擎。

通过紧凑、时尚的车身和极其优秀的发动机，BMW造就出
了一台历久弥新的好车。

usedCar.en:
This third-generation E46 M3 remains one of the best-loved
models since BMW created the "M" division in 1972.

It came with an inline-6 under its hood, produced and
tuned by the company's motorsports division.

The engine was flawlessly matched to the chassis,
which combined, resulted in excellent handling.

Not only was it a capable performer, it was a great
touring car as well.
usedCar.zh:
第三代E46 M3是二手车市场上最炙手可热
的车型。

它所搭载的定制直列六缸引擎由BMW M
生产，属于该公司的室内赛车系列。

这次工程技术上的胜利爆发出大鸣大放的马力，
产生出的引擎声使人精神为之一振。

其紧凑的车身在当时也相当时尚。

vehicleCollection.en:
Featuring BMW's high-revving engine technology, this sports car represented the epitome of the E46 3 Series.

In 2000, BMW redefined its super sports coupe, the M3, by placing a 3.2-liter DOHC inline-6 under its hood. Based on the E46 3 Series that underwent a full model change in 1998, the new M3 pumped out a fierce 343ps at 7900rpm and a hearty 37.2kgm of torque at 4900rpm. This meant that this amazing machine achieved more than #100ps per liter when the engine spun to its 7900rpm redline. What really brought the motor to life was the M3’s new gearbox. Initially, it came equipped with a Getrag 6-speed manual, but later BMW added the SMG II, the company’s prize two-pedal (twin-clutch) semi-automatic transmission.

In developing the new M3’s chassis, BMW followed its credo of “the suspension must always be faster than the engine.” BMW engineers took the base E46 chassis and solidified each section, giving the car rock-solid stability throughout. The suspension was retuned to compensate for the M3’s added power.

In 2003, a lightweight version of this coupe was introduced, boasting even more performance than the base car, thanks mainly to a leaner body. The M3CSL tipped the scales at 1400kg, about 100kg less than the base model with the inline-6 pumping out 360ps at 7900rpm and 37.8kgm of torque at 4900rpm.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款跑车采用了宝马的高转速引擎技术，堪称E46 3系的巅峰之作。

2000年推出的第三代M3是基于E46底盘的3系车型中的顶级性能车，后者刚刚在1998年完成了一次大改款。

在制造这款车的时候，来自专业打造小批量性能车的宝马M部门的专业人士们讨论最多的自然是动力单元。这台3.2升直列6缸引擎，每公升排量可输出超过100ps，最大动力输出343ps/7900rpm，最大扭矩37.2kgm/4900rpm，俨然成为了以高转速引擎技术闻名于世的宝马的看家引擎。最初的第三代车型仅装备了格特拉克制造的6速手动变速箱，后续又增加了SMG-II变速箱，这是一款宝马开发的双踏板手动“序列式手动变速箱”的改良版本。

在2003年，M3的轻量化运动轿跑版本加入了产品线，全方位应用创新减重技术，包括一次性削减100kg的碳纤维车顶，将基础款的1570kg减到了仅有1400kg。与此同时，引擎性能也得到了提升，马力和扭矩分别增加到了360ps/7900rpm和37.8kgm/4900rpm。综合各项改进后，M3 CSL的整车重量马力比达到了<3.85kg/ps>，远远低于基础车型的<4.55kg/ps>。就一台主打性能的乘用车来说，这个数据可谓一鸣惊人了。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
This E92 M3 is the fourth instalment in the BMW
M3 series that began with the E30.

Its pride is in its engine...

As it is the only generation of M3 to haul a howling V8.

At the time of its development, BMW was powering its other
cars with V10 engines built for F1 racing...

But the sense of speed and torque achieved by
this high-precision V8 are not to be sniffed at.

What’s more, you'll be surprised at how light it is
compared to its straight-six predecessor.

Indeed, this incredible car is worth having for
its engine alone!
dialogues.zh:
这款E92 M3是BMW M3车系
继E30后的第四款车。

这款车最引以为傲的是其引擎……

是M3系列中唯一搭载高亢V8引擎的一代车型。

在研发这款车型时，BMW仍采用V10引擎
打造其他F1比赛的车型……

但是，这台高精度V8引擎所实现的速度和扭矩
不容小觑。

更令人惊讶的是，相比于其前代搭载的直列六缸引擎，
这具引擎是如此轻巧。

确实，单纯就冲那引擎，
这款突破想象的车型就值得拥有！

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
This is a design that tried to break away from
the previous design language of BMW.

The shapes created by my former classmate
Chris Bangle when he was at BMW...

Were interesting and exciting in the eyes of a designer.

This M3 also began moving away from the authentic
proportions of an FR vehicle.

However, the surface treatment is fresh and interesting.
Even seeing it now, it's not bad at all.

This is one of the cars that represented
the change in flow of BMW design.
dialogues.zh:
这辆车的设计在尝试摆脱BMW之前的设计语言，带来革新。

它是由我从前的同学
克里斯·班格尔在BMW工作时所设计的……

在设计师眼中，这些设计元素非常有趣，非常激动人心。

此外，这辆M3开始从车身配比上与传统前置后驱车分道扬镳。

其车身外观的处理也非常新颖有趣。
即便从现在的眼光来看也丝毫不过时。

可以说，这是一台反映了BMW设计思路演变的车。\

brandCentral.en:
The highlight of this fourth-generation BMW M3
was its naturally-aspirated V-8 engine.

It was the first engine of its kind in an M3. With an 8400rpm
redline, it packed a potent high-end punch.

If you want to know what a race car for the street feels like,
then be sure to take a drive in this thing.
brandCentral.zh:
这款第四代BMW M3的亮点是一台自然进气的V8引擎。

这是M3上首次使用此类引擎。其转速红线高达8400rpm，冲击
力着实强劲！

如果您喜欢引擎转速飙升、发出轰鸣的快感，您肯定会
爱上它在赛道上表现出来的强劲动力。

usedCar.en:
This fourth generation M3 was the first in its series to
utilise a naturally-aspirated V8 engine.

And what an engine it is!

Its redline is an astonishing 8400rpm!

Much of the technological know-how used in its construction
was developed from BMW's F1 activities in the 2000s.

Indeed, its metallic sonics are more reminiscent of
a race car than a production model.

While its power does not surpass that of the most recent
models, it is nevertheless formidable and fun to drive.
usedCar.zh:
第四代M3是该系列中首次搭载
自然吸气V8引擎的车型。

这引擎可不得了！

它的转速红线竟然达到了8400rpm！

这款引擎的许多技术都来自BMW在2000年代
于F1赛事中积累的经验。

因此，它发出的金属声浪更接近赛车，
而非量产车。

虽然这辆车的动力不如最新的
型号，它依然是一辆充满驾驶乐趣的车。[

vehicleCollection.en:
Based on the E92 3 Series coupe, this 4th-gen M3 featured a 420ps V8.

The M3 has represented the top-of-the-line model in BMW's popular 3-Series lineup since the very beginning. The car's performance is tuned by the company's M division, which specializes in taking stock BMW cars and making them virtually race ready. With the M3, tweaks have traditionally been performed on the engine, suspension and aerodynamic parts. The history of the M brand dates back to 1985, and the car represented here is the fourth-generation M3, based on the latest 3-Series Coupe, the E92.

The E92 M3 measured 4620mm long, 1805mm wide and 1425mm high, and rode on a wheelbase of 2760mm. Several years ago, the M3's engine evolved from a 4-cylinder unit to a 6-cylinder in order to keep up with the growing engine power of other performance cars, especially those that competed in touring car races. For this model, BMW took things even further by mounting a 420ps 4-liter V8 under the hood.

The car's dimensions were larger than the previous model, but this M3 was lighter, thanks to a high-strength carbon-fiber roof, which helped in lowering the car's center of gravity, and aluminum for the suspension parts to reduce weight. As a result, the M3 tipped the scales at a lean 1630kg.

Despite being created for the company's motorsports activities, the M3 came laden with the latest technology, including a 7-speed M DCT with Drivelogic (double clutch transmission), Variable M differential lock and M Dynamic Mode.
vehicleCollection.zh:
配备420psV8引擎的第四代M3，基于E92 3系双门跑车开发。

本质上来说，M3是一台由宝马的运动赛车部门M针对引擎、悬挂和空气动力学部件进行过专门调校的3系车。

这辆M3长4620mm，宽1805mm，高1425mm，轴距为2760mm。为了跟进房车赛引入大功率引擎的规则，M3在此之前已经将4缸引擎升级成了6缸引擎。而这款车显然走得更远，换上了一颗4升V8引擎，带来420ps的动力。车顶被换成了高强度碳纤维材质，以抵消（因为车身尺寸增加而带来的）额外重量。这样的做法对降低车身重心也有好处。轻量化零件在车身的其他部分也有应用，例如铝制悬挂组件等。最终的车重为1630kg，0-<100km/h>的加速时间是4.8秒。

尽管这是一款为参加赛事而打造的车型，其公路版本却五脏俱全：配有真皮座椅、搭载驾驶逻辑技术的7速M双离合变速箱、可变M型运动差速锁和M动态模式等M专属配置。

brandCentral.en:
As the name suggests, the M3 GT is a race car based on
the venerable M3.

It was developed for the FIA GT2 category, which allows cars
to be significantly modified.

Under its hood was a tuned V-8 that pumped out 500ps,
which represents a slight increase from the base car.

It also weighed a lot less than the road car, thanks to
the copious use of carbon-fiber in the body panels.

The combination proved successful as it took the overall title
at the Nürburgring 24 Hours in 2010.
brandCentral.zh:
M3 GT是一款在M3车系中脱颖而出的赛车车型，

针对国际汽联GT2类别量身定做——该赛事类别允许对汽车进行
重大改装……

此车装备有经过特殊调校的V8引擎，能够产生500ps的动力——
比其第四代基础车型更上一层楼。

更重要的是，由于车身大量使用了碳纤维板件，车重较
其前代车型大幅下降。

在2010年纽博格林24小时耐力赛上，这台车不负众望，加
冕了总冠军……

vehicleCollection.en:
BMW's M3 GT2 raced in premier endurance contests including the ALMS and ILMC series as well as the 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

While the first-generation BMW M3 (E30) was a special model created specifically to pass homologation requirements for Group A touring cars, from the second-generation and on, they were sold solely as high-performance models of the 3 Series. For the fourth-generation model (E92), two racing M3s that conformed to GT4 and GT2 FIA regulations were introduced. The GT2 car (which allowed more modifications), called the "M3 GT2," was the fastest M3 ever developed to date.

The street version of the E92 M3 was slightly larger than the previous model (E46) and 80kg heavier at 1630kg. To counteract the extra weight, BMW swapped the old M3 engine, a 3.2-liter inline-6, to a 4.0-liter V-8, which increased power output from 343ps to a whopping 420ps.

Using this car as the foundation, the M3 GT2 added carbon-fiber body parts, including the front and rear fenders, hood, trunk lid, and both bumpers, allowing the race-ready car to tip the scales at a lean 1245kg. The GT2 is also 110mm wider, and with a revised front bumper that incorporates air dams for better ventilation and intake, not to mention the addition of a large rear wing, the car possesses greatly improved aerodynamics. As for the engine, with a 30.1mm restrictor installed, it produces more than 500ps and 50kgm of torque.

BMW entered this car in the ALMS and ILMC series in the 2010 race season. The car dominated the GT Class of the ALMS, and achieved overall victories at the Nürburgring 24 hour race as well as the ILMC Zhuhai 1000km.
vehicleCollection.zh:
基于M3开发的竞赛车型，在纽博格林24小时耐力赛、亚洲勒芒系列赛和勒芒洲际大奖赛中屡有斩获。

除了第一代的E30系列M3是宝马专为通过房车赛A组别赛事认证而制造的特殊车型，自第二代起的M3车型均为对外出售的3系高性能版本。在此之外，宝马仍在基于后续几代M3打造专用的竞赛车型。

到了第四代的E92平台时，宝马共准备了两辆M3赛车，分别对应国际汽联的GT2和GT4规则。其中根据GT2规则打造的M3 GT2接受了多项改装，成为了有史以来最快的M3。

相比上一代的E46，街道版本的E92 M3尺寸更大，重量也增加了80kg，车重达到了1630kg。但动力单元也从3.2升的V6引擎升级到了4.0升的V8引擎，将标准版E46 M3的343PS直接拉升到了420PS。

在街道版的基础之上，M3 GT2又将前后轮拱、引擎盖、行李箱盖、前后保险杠等部件全部换成了碳纤维材质，把车身重量削减到了1245kg。在将前后轮拱罩外拓后，车身宽度又增加了110mm。宝马在前保险杠处整合了空气阻尼技术，后段则加上了巨大的尾翼，完成了这辆赛车的最终形态。加装了30.1mm限制器后，这套V8动力单元可以输出超过500ps和50kgm的扭矩。

2010赛季，宝马将这辆赛车带到了亚洲勒芒系列赛、勒芒洲际大奖赛和其他24小时耐力赛中。它在亚洲勒芒系列赛的GT组别中展现出统治级的表现，并在纽博格林24小时耐力赛上和勒芒洲际大奖赛的珠海1,000公里赛中取得了全面胜利。

dialogues.en:
There's nothing like an M car from BMW. The first-generation M3
is mostly associated with racing.

The final model was this "Sport Evolution," which was quite
popular.

It is distinguished by its upgraded 2.5-liter engine
and rear spoilers.

At first glance, the mods may seem slight, but
those in the know will tell you otherwise.

Oh yeah, these cars were impressive indeed.

Not too many of the original M3s were produced, so you can
expect their prices will increase with time.
dialogues.zh:
哦，一辆BMW M系列的车……
第一代M3最适合拿来竞赛了。

这款“Sport Evolution”是最终型号，备受欢迎。

这款车的特点是升级过的2.5L引擎以及尾部扰流板。

乍一看，好像只是些细微改动，但实则不然。

呵呵！实际上这车型深藏不露……

这款车的产量不多，所以价格
只会不断往上涨。

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
In the 1980s, there was a very unique phenomenon in the history
of automotive design. It was a time when the "boxy" style...

...was surely at its peak.

Blister fenders were the result of an attempt to marry
round tires to a square body design.

This style is one of the defining symbols of this era.

The polyhedron body of the car here is minimalistic.

But despite its abstract form, its intonation is limited,
and the exterior styling exudes extreme passion and excitement.

And because the car is seemingly pressed into an inorganic shape,
the end effect is one that's relatively prominent.<next id=2001706 type
dialogues.zh:
在1980年代，汽车设计的历史上掀起了一股非常独特的浪潮。

“四四方方”的设计理念在当时大行其道。

这部分微微鼓起的挡泥板就是这种思路的产物
——设计师们试图将轮胎的圆形和车身的方形轮廓融合起来。

这样的造型代表了那个年代的显著象征之一。

多边形车身非常抽象、简约。

虽然发出的音浪不大，
但成功通过外立面表达出了强烈的热情和兴奋感。

粗看下，这台车像是一团被捏合而成的无机物，
呈现出相对抢眼的最终效果。~

usedCar.en:
The BMW M3 is truly an ultimate driving machine.

The Sport Evolution of the first-gen model was really special.

It was homologated for the Deutsche Tourenwagen
Masters.

The displacement of the engine was increased to 2.5 liters.

It also sported a custom spoiler and other aerodynamic parts
that made it look meaner than the stock M3.

If you're looking for a classic front-engine/rear-wheel-drive
touring car, you won't find many better than this one.
usedCar.zh:
第一代M3是最受欢迎的宝马汽车之一...

而Sport Evolution则是其格外引人瞩目的一个版本。

该车型经由德国房车大师赛认证。

其引擎排量在M3基础上被增加到2.5L。

它在外观上也有一些改变，例如，它配备
的专属定制扰流器使它看起来和普通的M3略有不同。

大部分M3系列车型都很受欢迎，而其中这款车型，事实证明，
在众多M3车型中尤为热门。?

vehicleCollection.en:
This highly modified homologation version of the E30 3 Series served as a small hint of what was to come from BMW.(

The first BMW M3 appeared in 1985, and it represented a high-performance version of the popular 3 Series (E30) that could also be used for touring car racing.

At first, the M3 only came in 2-door form, with wider treads and sporty fender flares. Also, front and rear spoilers were added, aggressive side skirts were installed and the angle of the C-pillar and rear window were revised to create a car that looked much meaner than the stock 3 Series. These body modifications also resulted in a better Cd of 0.38 (from 0.33). Under the hood was a special 2.3-liter DOHC inline-4 that produced 195ps and 23.4kgm of torque.

The race-spec model was introduced in 1987. From the onset, it dominated the DTM, winning five of the first 10 races. That same year, the M3 Evolution was released with even better aerodynamics and a 210ps engine. In 1988, output was increased to 220ps for the M3 Evolution II. In 1989 the final model of the E30 M3, called the M3 Sports Evolution, appeared, equipped with a larger engine (2.5 liters) that produced 238ps/24.5kgm.
vehicleCollection.zh:
E30，一代传奇的开始。这款E30 3系认证车型经过了大幅改造。+

第一款宝马M3诞生于1985年。这是一款由宝马M设计，基于E303系列车款开发的公路车型，用于参加房车赛事。

车体基于双门家用轿车，车身得到加宽，翼子板同样也进行了调整。从前后扰流板到侧裙，乃至C柱的角度和后车窗都进行了改进，车尾箱也被抬高。这些调整让车体的阻尼系数从0.38降低到了0.33。驱动车身的是一台2.3升顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎，最大动力输出为195ps，最大扭矩为23.4kgm。

竞速车型于1987年引入，并在德国房车大师赛中展现出了统治级的实力，在10站比赛中赢下了5场。在赛车运动行业声名鹊起的同时，同一个规格的公路车型也在不断的改进之中。

同一年，M3进化版上市，空气动力学造型得到了进一步的优化，引擎动力也提升到了210ps。1988年推出的M3进化版II的引擎动力进一步提高到了220ps。而到了1989年，E30系列M3的最终型号上市，称为M3运动进化版，配备排量更大、依据赛车标准设计的2.5升引擎，动力输出为238ps/24.5kgm，同时推出的还有专用的前后扰流板。

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
I have a soft spot for the M3.

I was involved on the first E30 M3...

...while I was working on the beginning of the E36.

Today, the 3 Series coupe is known as the 4 Series,
and the M3 became M4.

I still prefer the old M3 naming, however.

This car here is the most purposefully designed BMW...

...that possesses the true spirit of the M-performance package.

It has the right amount of details like front air intakes
that cool the brakes...

...to side air-outlets with the M accent.

It has an extremely athletic look
that exemplifies sporty and elegant design.
dialogues.zh:
我对M3情有独钟。

当我们开始开发E36系列的时候……

我还同时承担了E30 M3的开发工作。

现在，3系的双门轿跑车已经被BMW改称为“4系”，
M3也跟着变成了“M4”。

但我仍然喜欢M3。

它是目的性最明确的BMW……

其设计主旨与M性能套件的运动精神完全契合。

细节上的配置也相当到位，例如冷却刹车的前进气口……

以及带有“M”系凌厉风格的侧面进气风道。

仿佛一位穿上设计师品牌运动外套的运动员，
集运动和时尚优雅于一身。

Today, the 3 Series coupe is known as the 4 Series,

In 2013, the BMW 4 Series was created to serve as the coupe
version of the company's popular 3 Series sedan.

Therefore, the M4 represented the top-of-the-line performance
version, taking the place of the M3 coupe.

Released in 2014, the M4 had rear-wheel drive...

...and came powered by a turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6.

This powerful front-mounted engine cranked out 431ps
and 56.1kgm of torque!
brandCentral.zh:
在2013年，BMW 4系作为3系双门车型的迭代品牌而诞生。

M4则是4系车型中的高性能版本，同时也是M3的继任者。

此车于2014年发布，是一款后轮驱动的跑车……

该车配备了3L涡轮增压直列六缸引擎，

vehicleCollection.en:
The BMW M4 becomes the 2-door version of the daunting M3.

In the summer of 2013, BMW established the new “4 Series” line to separate the 2-door offerings of the 3 Series from the 4-doors. This meant that the extremely performance-minded M3 coupe now went by the name, M4.

While the name had changed, the spirit of the M3 was left totally intact. The M4’s exterior featured a menacing face with large air inlets in the front bumpers and a flowing roofline that hinted at the car’s awesome performance. When seen from its profile, the M4 is visually characterized by traditional BMW proportions—a sleek hood, long wheelbase and short front overhang. The characteristic M gill incorporated the Air Breather, which together with the Air Curtain within the front apron, served to ventilate the wheel arches and facilitate better airflow values.

Underneath the aluminum hood of the M4 was the M TwinPower Turbo engine. This turbocharged inline-6 produced 431ps, which allowed the lean 1497kg-car to go from zero to <100km/h> in just 4.1 seconds. Also, the combination of the active M differential, the adaptive M suspension, and the M specific DSC ensured that the M4 retained the handling prowess expected of all cars that wore the M badge.
vehicleCollection.zh:
从起步加速到<100km/h>仅需4.1秒。传奇M系列的高性能车型。

2013年夏天，宝马将3系双门轿跑车与敞篷车独立出来，作为全新的4系。伴随这项变更，曾经的高性能3系宝马M3双门轿跑车重生为宝马M4双门轿跑车。

在标志性的M系铝制引擎盖之下，咆哮着M双涡管单涡轮增压6缸直列式引擎，让宝马M4双门轿跑车能在仅仅4.1秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速。

全新的宝马M4双门轿跑车结合了高转速自然吸气引擎与涡轮增压技术的优势，可谓是“装备齐全的运动员”。这款车在敏捷、活力与动力之间取得了完美平衡。整车轻量化的设计将车重降至1497kg，为同级车树立了新标杆。

主动式M差速器，自适应M式悬挂以及M系专用动态稳定控制系统相结合，保证了完美的操控性，提供了极致的驾驶体验。

车头的大型进气孔、流线型车身以及赛车型的低车尾，清楚地体现出这款车的强劲动力。典型的宝马车身比——长引擎盖、长轴距、靠后车舱和短小的前悬一应俱全，即便在静止状态，也能制造出十足的动感。

平滑的曲面碳纤维车顶不仅为这款车带来强烈的动感，也增添了几分高雅精致的气息。标志性的M系栅格内装有通风装置，与前裙板中的气幕一起为车轮拱罩通风，增加气流量。

车前裙板装配了3个大进气孔，外形气势十足，也为高性能的引擎提供了足量空气用于散热。多面切割的外壳、精密的曲面以及出众的视觉深度造就了宝马M4双门轿跑车的整体视觉印象：对速度的渴望，以及征服道路的欲望。

brandCentral.en:
The BMW M4 served as the base model for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car.

While the M4 was already a great handling car to begin with,
we made it even better by tuning the suspension system.

That said, we retained the predictability of the original car,
which makes it an enjoyable ride for drivers of all levels.
brandCentral.zh:
BMW M4是这辆跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别原创赛车的基础车型。

和大部分BMW一样，它非常擅长过弯，原本就非常出色的
稳定性更是得到了进一步提升。

无论驾驶水平高低，所有车手都会觉得这款前置后驱赛
车易于上手。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Gran Turismo original Gr.4 race car maximizes the performance of the M4.!

In the summer of 2013, BMW shuffled its lineup by placing the 3 Series coupe and convertible under the new 4 Series umbrella. This meant that the BMW M3 coupe was now known as the M4. Despite the name change, the car was still the same high-performance enthusiast machine as before.

Underneath the aluminum hood with the slight bulge resided a twin-turbocharged inline-6 that allowed the car to run from zero to <100km/h> in just 4.1 seconds. This was possible, thanks in part to the M4’s remarkably low curb weight of 1497kg, which set new standards in its class. The M4’s lightweight nature also contributed to its agility, as did the car’s active M differential, adaptive M suspension, and the M specific DSC.

The M4 could be distinguished from the standard 4 Series models by its large air inlets in the front and the racing inspired low rear end. The characteristic M gill incorporates the Air Breather, which together with the Air Curtain within the front apron serves to ventilate the wheel arches and facilitate better airflow. The rest of the M4’s design can be classified as “customary BMW,” such as a sleek hood, long wheelbase and a short front overhang.

Despite the new designation, this performance car will always be a favorite among enthusiasts because it remains a true driver’s car.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

This Gran Turismo Gr.4 original racing car is based on
the BMW M4.

Outwardly, it looks like an M Performance Edition, but comes
with spoilers, a bonnet pin, and other modifications.

Its design is reminiscent of the safety cars that can be
seen at any number of races today.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原创跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车以BMW M4为基础。

其他调校件的M Performance Edition。

其设计让人联想到如今在任何一场比赛中都能看到的安
全车。

Whether it's called the M3 or M4, it doesn't matter. What's important is that this performance car will always be a favorite among enthusiasts because it's a true driver’s car.

This machine is a special model designed by Gran Turismo to recreate the image of safety cars used in races like the Moto GP.
long.zh:
2013年夏天，宝马将3系双门轿跑车与敞篷车独立出来，作为全新的4系。伴随这项变更，曾经的高性能3系宝马M3双门轿跑车重生为宝马M4双门轿跑车。

在标志性的M系铝制引擎盖之下，咆哮着M双涡管单涡轮增压6缸直列式引擎，让宝马M4双门轿跑车能在仅仅4.1秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速。

全新的宝马M4双门轿跑车结合了高转速自然吸气引擎与涡轮增压技术的优势，可谓是“装备齐全的运动员”。这款车在敏捷、活力与动力之间取得了完美平衡。整车轻量化的设计将车重降至1497kg，为同级车树立了新标杆。

主动式M差速器，自适应M式悬挂以及M系专用动态稳定控制系统相结合，保证了完美的操控性，提供了极致的驾驶体验。

车头的大型进气孔、流线型车身以及赛车型的低车尾，清楚地体现出这款车的强劲动力。典型的宝马车身比——长引擎盖、长轴距、靠后车舱和短小的前悬一应俱全，即便在静止状态，也能制造出十足的动感。

平滑的曲面碳纤维车顶不仅为这款车带来强烈的动感，也增添了几分高雅精致的气息。标志性的M系栅格内装有通风装置，与前裙板中的气幕一起为车轮拱罩通风，增加气流量。

车前裙板装配了3个大进气孔，外形气势十足，也为高性能的引擎提供了足量空气用于散热。多面切割的外壳、精密的曲面以及出众的视觉深度造就了宝马M4双门轿跑车的整体视觉印象：对速度的渴望，以及征服道路的欲望。

这款车是专为跑车浪漫旅设计的特殊车型，用于重现世界摩托车锦标赛等赛事中出现的安全车形象。

vehicleCollection.en:
The car driven by Kazunori Yamauchi in the 2016 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

BMW introduced the race spec M6, dubbed the M6 GT3, at the 2015 Frankfurt Motor Show. The company announced that the car would participate in the FIA-GT3 class in 2016, replacing the Z4 GT3 that contested in the same category since 2010.

Despite being in the same class, the M6 GT3 is significantly larger than the Z4 GT3, measuring about 5m in length and more than 2m wide. Its wheelbase is not only longer than the Z4 GT3, but it's also 5cm longer than the production model. This allows the M6 GT3 to be more stable at high speed and through corners than its predecessor.

The car's wide fenders, aerodynamic front and rear bumper, and high rear wing not only make the car look menacingly beautiful, they provide gobs of downforce, which is essential to a race car.

The M6 GT3 is very lean, thanks in part to a body that's made of mostly carbon fiber. The body structure has been reinforced, and the suspension has been totally tweaked from that of the production M6. Under the hood is a 4.4-liter V-8 with the Twin Power Turbo, with various reinforcements and modifications that results in 585ps.

One of the race teams to compete with the M6 GT3 was Walkenhorst Motorsports of Germany. This team usually found themselves at the top of the running order in the highly competitive VLN endurance series. In the 24 Hours of Nürburgring, “Gran Turismo” series producer, Kazunori Yamauchi, joined the team and helped pilot the M6 GT3 to 22nd place overall.
vehicleCollection.zh:
山内一典在2016年纽博格林赛道24小时耐力赛中驾驶的赛车。

在2015年秋天的法兰克福车展上，宝马公布了竞赛级M6，并宣布在2016年，这款名为M6 GT3的新款车将开始参加国际汽联-GT3类赛事。

M6 GT3取代了自2010年起就开始参加国际汽联-GT3类赛事的Z4 GT3。与小巧的Z4 GT3相比，这款车相当庞大，长约5m，宽度超过2m。车的轴距不仅比Z4 GT3长，也比量产版车型长5cm，以优化直道的稳定性与操控性。

车身四角的挡泥板很宽，前后保险杠以及高尾翼的设计也参考了空气动力学原理，规格上满足了超级跑车的所有要求，同时又保留了M6美丽的造型。

这款车和量产版M6差异较大，车身几乎全部为碳纤维材质，车架结构也经过加固，悬挂系统完全重做。搭载的4.4升V8双涡管单涡轮增压引擎经过多处强化与改装，可提供585ps的动力输出。

这款车于2016年初开始与各豪强车队共同征战赛道，这其中就包括常年在VLN系列耐力赛中名列前茅，实力强劲的德国瓦尔肯霍斯特汽车运动s车队。跑车浪漫旅系列的制作人山内一典也曾驾驶M6 GT3与这支车队一同征战纽博格林24小时赛，并最终位列第22名。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
When designing a race car, the natural impulse
is to build something small and light.

But this M6 GT3 breaks the mold, with a total length that is
5cm longer than that of the production model.

The wheelbase has also been extended.

Many wondered if the extra length of the car would
diminish its handling ability.

That concern was wiped clean when racers first
drove the car.

They praised it for its precise balance and
smooth turning feel.

And their findings were soon backed up by results.

The M6 GT3 drove to a magnificent win on
the narrow Macao GP circuit in 2018.

At the wheel then was Japanese touring-car
ace Seiji Ara.

It was a truly incredible race to behold.
*
dialogues.zh:
说到赛车设计，人们很自然地会想到小而轻的竞速机器。

但是这辆M6 GT3却反其道而行之——
它的车身长度比量产车型还要长出5cm！

它的轴距嘛，当然也很长！

这样的设计让人不由地担心起它的过弯能力来。

然而，开过它的车手却不是这么说的……

他们对车辆的精确操控和平顺过弯能力赞不绝口。

你还是不相信？

那我告诉你一个事实，日本房车赛传奇车手荒圣治驾驶着它

于2018年在狭窄的澳门大奖赛赛道上
取得了一场辉煌的胜利……

这是一场令人难以置信的比赛，精彩程度令人叹为观止！

A powerful GT3 race machine with a 4.4-liter twin-turbocharged V8.

The M6 GT3 is very lean, thanks in part to a body that's made of mostly carbon fiber. The body structure has been reinforced, and the suspension has been totally tweaked from that of the production M6. conversation.en:
Ah, this is the "long nose/long tail" McLaren F1 GTR,
which made its debut in 1997.

Its engine was built by BMW Motorsport.

While the McLaren F1 won the overall title
at the 1995 Le Mans 24 Hours…

...the Porsche 911 GT1 took the win
the following year.

Desperate to reclaim its title, McLaren set to work
on this 1997 F1 GTR race car.

Its effective aerodynamic design suggests that this car was
designed to blast down the long straights of Le Mans.

Alas, it fell just shy of accomplishing its goal in 1997,
finishing in 2nd place behind the Porsche.

Two years later, BMW settled the score in a way
with its own Le Mans victory.

But that’s a story for another day.
conversation.zh:
啊，这就是1997年首次亮相的“长鼻”+“长尾”
迈凯伦F1 GTR，

它的发动机来自宝马赛车运动。

虽然迈凯伦F1在1995年勒芒24小时耐力赛中
取得了胜利……

但第二年就被保时捷911 GT1抢走了冠军宝座。

不愿服输的迈凯伦开始着手打造这辆1997款F1 GTR赛车。

通过其高度特化的空气动力学设计不难看出，
它是为了在勒芒的大直道上跑出最高速度而生的。

令人遗憾的是，它在1997年的比赛中并没能跟上
保时捷的速度，最终屈居第二……

两年后，宝马亲手拿下了勒芒冠军，某种程度上算是报
了一箭之仇！

关于这个故事，我们就留到下次再讲了。

collection.en:
McLaren's founder, Bruce McLaren, always wanted to produce
a road car that would rival the best in the world.

In 1969, he drew up plans to produce road-going cars that
were essentially slightly modified Can-Am race machines.

These were called the M6GT and M12GT.

However, they never amounted to much...

...with only a few prototypes created.

His dream was finally realized in the 1990s with perhaps the
greatest sports car of all time.

Designed by Gordon Murray and equippercar.

Thith the company's
racing know-how, the McLaren F1 road car was born.

The car shown here is the McLaren F1 GTR, a race version of
the legendary road car.
　
The stock F1 was so powerful that for Le Mans, the engine had to
be detuned from 618 HP to 592 HP to comply with regulations.

The McLaren F1 powerplant was built by BMW...

...which allowed the F1 GTR to also be raced by
BMW's works teams.

It has become one of the most popular of the F1 collection
of BMW works racers.
collection.zh:
迈凯伦的创始人布鲁斯·迈凯伦一直想要进军公路车领域。

1969年，他们就计划推出公路车款。本质上则是经过
少许改装的加拿大-美国挑战杯赛车。

它们是M6GT和M12GT。

然而，这个项目只制造了几辆原型车……

直到20世纪90年代，他的梦想才通过戈登·穆雷设计的……

可合法上路的“迈凯伦F1”的诞生而真正实现。

迈凯伦F1至今仍然被许多人认为是世上最好的超级跑车。

这辆迈凯伦F1 GTR是迈凯伦F1的赛车版本。

原有的F1性能太过强大，以至于在参加勒芒比赛时，
必须将动力从636ps下调到600ps，才能参赛。

迈凯伦F1引擎是由宝马制造的……

F1 GTR也顺理成章地成为了宝马车厂车队的比赛座驾。

我们在这里看到的FINA涂装版本不但以美艳而闻名，
更是备受宝马赛车运动最受欢迎的跑车之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
This F1 GTR race car took many racing titles around the world, including the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

Established in 1965, Formula 1 team McLaren has become one of the most recognized names in the glamorous sport, with an image almost equal to that of Ferrari. Whereas Ferrari branched out into manufacturing production cars, McLaren's activities were all race-oriented. That changed with the introduction of the McLaren F1, a car designed by Gordon Murray and powered by a BMW engine.

The concept of the F1 was a "Formula 1 race car for the road," and because it possessed such high levels of performance, its duties weren't restricted to only the public road. The car saw lots of action as a racer, partly because McLaren was promoting the racing version of the F1, the F1 GTR, as aggressively as it was the road car.

For the F1 GTR, McLaren added a front spoiler lip and rear wing to enhance downforce. BMW provided the car's V12, mounted amidships, with power rated at more than the stock version's 627 ps.

To say that the F1 GTR's maiden race was a success would be a dire understatement. In the 1995 24 Hours of Le Mans, the F1 GTR won its class, as well as placing 3rd, 4th and 5th. It kept on winning all over the world and is still considered today as one of the greatest GT race cars in history.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆F1 GTR在勒芒和全球各地的多项GT赛事中都拿下了桂冠。!

成立于1965年的一级方程式车厂迈凯伦慢慢成为了一支能与久负盛名的法拉利一级方程式车队比肩的资深车队。但仍然有一样东西是法拉利拥有，而迈凯伦没有的—那就是一台原厂生产、可以合法上路的跑车。出于这个原因，迈凯伦请求天才设计师戈登·穆雷协助开发出了迈凯伦F1。

这是一台拥有一级方程式赛车内核，但可以在公路上合法行驶的跑车。

迈凯伦自然不会错过将这台大功率机器带到赛道上，炫耀其卓越性能的机会。迈凯伦随即开发了竞赛车型F1 GTR，并提供给各家车队参赛。

F1 GTR的车身上增加了前唇扰流板和尾翼，离地间隙进一步降低，车身重量则较常规版本的1134千克继续下探。由宝马赛车部门提供的V12引擎在调校后可以提供远超公路版627ps的强大动力。轮胎的尺寸从17寸增加到18寸，刹车系统则安装了碳刹车盘。

这款F1在发布后技惊四座。在1995年的勒芒24小时耐力赛中，由雅尼克-达尔马斯、关谷正德和J.J.莱赫托驾驶的F1 GTR夺去了最后的胜利，而第3、4、5名也成为了迈凯伦的囊中之物。1995和1996年的英国GT锦标赛更是成为F1逞威的高光时刻。

在欧洲以外地区的GT赛事中，F1 GTR的表现也同样活跃。在1996年全日本GT锦标赛中，大卫·布拉汉姆和约翰·尼尔森搭档取得了系列赛冠军。1997年，F1的产品线中又增加了一款长尾版车型，重点提高了空气动力学的表现。在随后的数年间，直至2003赛季结束，F1 GTR都在持续不断地代表私人车队参加各项赛事，赢取前排位置。

brandCentral.en:
Inspired by the BMWs that made waves in the touring car
championships of the 1970s...

...this BMW Vision Gran Turismo is sure to remind you
of those classic race cars of yesteryear.

BMW's own design team was responsible
for bringing this creation to life.

Under the hood is a powerful turbocharged 3.0-liter
inline-6 engine.

And, as you might expect, this FR model has a
perfect 50/50 front/rear weight distribution.

Believe it or not, this road racer weighs a mere
1180kg!
brandCentral.zh:
BMW Vision Gran Turismo的设计灵感来自于那些在70年代的
房车锦标赛中大包大揽的BMW……

看到它，您会不由得想起昔日的经典房车。

在意料之内，这一愿景很快就在BMW自己的设计团队的手
下化为了现实。

在它的引擎盖下，装载着一个3L直列六缸涡轮增压引擎。

您可以想见，这款前置后驱车型同样拥有完美的50:50轴负
荷分配。

还有，这款公路赛车的重量仅有1180kg！是不是很难以置信？

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate road racer that draws its heritage from the glorious touring cars of the '70s.

Following in the tradition of successful BMW touring cars of the 1970s, the BMW design team has created an uncompromising road racer for the modern era.

Crisp proportions and a dynamic silhouette give the BMW Vision Gran Turismo the appearance that it's in constant motion, even when standing still. Front and rear spoilers provide optimum downforce, while the various carbon fiber pieces found throughout the car's body have been designed to reduce drag and keep curb weight at a minimum. The car tips the scales at a lean 1180kg, with the weight distributed 50:50, front and rear.

Under the hood is a powerful twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 that delivers a maximum power of 404 kW/549ps between 6200rpm and 7300rpm. Peak torque comes at 680 Nm/69kgm at a low 1900rpm. A sequential 6-speed transmission, operated by gearshift paddles on the steering wheel, distributes engine power to the driven rear axle.

The car's M paint scheme pays homage to the company's past successes in touring-car racing, while the bold styling language points to what may lie ahead.
vehicleCollection.zh:
终极公路赛车，汲取了70年代著名房车的传承。

1970年代宝马在房车界大获成功。为延续这项传统，宝马设计团队打造了一台精工细作的现代公路赛车。

干练的造型比例和富于动感的整体轮廓，即使处于静止不动的状态，宝马Vision Gran Turismo的造型也透出十足的速度感。车的前后扰流板确保了下压力能保持在理想值，设计上也考虑到了空气传导，借以降低风阻，还采用了碳纤维降低了车体总重。

车身涂装采用宝马M系车标的配色以表现空气的流动感，使人回忆起宝马在赛车运动上的成功。

宝马Vision Gran Turismo上采用的技术与其精益求精的设计同样出众。强劲的3升6缸直列式引擎搭配M 双涡管单涡轮增压技术，在6200rpm到7300rpm转速下可达到404 千瓦/549ps的最高输出。转速达到1900rpm时即可达到69kgm的峰值扭矩。序列式6档变速箱可通过方向盘上的换挡拨片操作，将引擎动力分配至后传动轴。

宝马Vision Gran Turismo拥有杰出的性能特性，车体仅重1180公斤，前后轴荷比也接近完美的50:50。

brandCentral.en:
The long nose and short deck proportions have long been
a benchmark of sports-car design.

If you were to ask enthusiasts to name a recent BMW that embodies
this ideal, many would point to the 2003 Z4, a true masterpiece.

The successor to the Z3, it came powered by only an inline-6,
making it feel somewhat more prestigious in comparison.

Its elegant body was penned by American designer Chris Bangle,
and it is distinguished by the Z-shaped curve on its sides.

Despite being a convertible, the Z4 stays true to BMW’s values,
with 50/50 weight distribution and triple the rigidity of the Z3.

A race version competed at the Nürburgring 24h,
making it one of those rare cars that looks as good as it goes.
brandCentral.zh:
长车鼻短车身”比例一直是理想的跑车设计。

如果要在BMW近年来推出的杰作中找出一个最佳案例，
最众望所归的答案就是2003年推出的敞篷车型Z4。

作为Z3的后继车型，它仅推出直列6缸引擎版本，相比
之下，更加彰显尊崇和信仰。

它优雅的车身出自美国设计师克里斯·班格尔之手，
车身侧面的Z字线条尤为别致吸睛。

尽管是一款敞篷车，但Z4拥有纯正的BMW血统，其车重
分配比例接近50/50，车身刚度可达Z3的三倍。

不仅如此，它的赛车规格版本参与过纽博格林24小时耐力赛。
毫无疑问，这是一辆外观与驾驶性能并重的稀有车型。

usedCar.en:
Are you looking for a convertible with elegance and performance?
If so, the first-gen BMW Z4 is the car for you!

The successor to the Z3, it only came equipped with an inline-6,
which replaced its predecessor's 4-cylinder engine.

Its long hood exudes plenty of grace—the car's silhouette
embraces the term "long nose/short deck proportions."

True to BMW tradition, it embodies the brand's hallmark traits of
optimal weight distribution and enhanced structural rigidity.

The Z4’s suspension builds on the design refined in the E46,
and its 231ps inline-6 engine embodies BMW refinement.

Having proven its mettle at the Nürburgring 24 Hours, the Z4
earns its reputation as a top-tier machine by any standard!
usedCar.zh:
想要寻找一款优雅与操控性并重的敞篷车吗？那么这辆
第一代BMW Z4就是你梦寐以求的车型！

作为Z3的后继车型，它摒弃了前任的4缸引擎，改用
更强大的直列6缸。

它的长引擎盖本身便是一件美轮美奂的设计精品，
懂行的人都称其为“长车鼻短车身”比例。

身为一台BMW，它拥有品牌一脉相承的所有标志性特点，
并在车重分配和车身刚度上更进一步。

Z4的悬挂基于一款已在E46车型上久经考验的设计，
6汽缸做功时带来顺畅丝滑的体验，输出可达231ps。

Z4还曾参加过纽博格林24小时耐力赛，从各个维度来说
都堪称是“精妙绝伦”。

vehicleCollection.en:
An elegant convertible with an inline-6 engine lurking under its elongated hood.+

At the 2002 Paris Motor Show, BMW unveiled the convertible Z4 sports car, which replaced the Z3. At first, the engine lineup included a 2.5-liter and 3.0-liter inline-6, a step up in class in comparison to the Z3 which started out with only a 4-cylinder powerplant.

The design unmistakably showcased the distinctive styling philosophy of Chris Bangle, BMW's chief designer at the time. The flowing lines and the signature "Z"-shaped press line in front of the doors were design elements that instantly distinguished the car.

With an entirely new chassis and body developed from the platform level, the Z4 achieved near-perfect front/rear weight distribution of 50.3/49.7. What was also notable was that although it was 25kg lighter, the Z4 boasted three times the twisting rigidity of its predecessor.

The suspension setup—featuring struts at the front and a multilink configuration at the rear—was carried over from the E46 3 Series. This decision was driven by the fact that extensive testing had already been completed, ensuring a smoother and more efficient development process for the Z4. No compromises were made in incorporating cutting-edge technologies, including BMW's first electric power steering system, DTC (Dynamic Traction Control), an enhancement to the traction control system, and DDC (Dynamic Drive Control), which adjusted steering feel and throttle response to suit either sporty or normal driving modes. The Z4 offered a variety of transmission options: manual, automatic, and a semi-automatic gearbox called SMG.

Like the Z3, the Z4 was manufactured at BMW's Spartanburg plant in South Carolina, USA. The motorsport version of the Z4 has been participating in prestigious events, such as the 24 Hours of Nürburgring.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一款优雅的敞篷车。前部的长引擎盖下安装了一部直列六缸引擎。

在2002年的巴黎车展上，Z3的后续车型，敞篷跑车Z4首次亮相。首发的可选引擎版本就包括2.5升和3升直列6缸，相比于首发仅提供4缸引擎的前代Z3提升了一个档次。

其车身的造型设计反映出宝马首席设计师克里斯·班戈那强烈的个人风格。流畅的曲线和车门前方的Z字形冲压线是该车型最具辨识度的显著特征。

底盘和车身都按照平台级规格全新设计开发，实现了极佳的前后配重比，为50.3比49.7。与Z3相比，它的扭转刚度翻了三番，而车重却轻了25kg，这是非常令人叹服的数据。

这款车的基础版悬挂系统继承自当时的3系（E46），前轮使用了支柱式独立悬挂，而后轮使用了多连杆系统。据说采用这个思路是因为这套悬挂系统已经通过测试，非常成熟，能够确保新车型的开发过程更顺利。此外，宝马还毫不吝啬地应用了其研发部门的最新技术，包括宝马的首款电动助力转向系统，牵引力控制系统辅助功能——DTC，以及支持普通模式与运动模式切换，改变操控风格与油门响应关系的动态驾驶控制系统——DDC。变速箱方面提供了手动档、自动档，以及被简称为SMG的序列式半自动变速器三个版本。

和Z3一样，此次的新车型也在位于美国南卡罗来纳州的斯帕坦堡工厂生产。基于这款Z4开发的赛车版本活跃在多项赛事中，例如纽博格林24小时耐力赛。-

这款车的基础版悬挂系统继承自当时的3系（E46），前轮使用了支柱式独立悬挂，而后轮使用了多连杆系统。据说采用这个思路是因为这套悬挂系统已经通过测试，非常成熟，能够确保新车型的开发过程更顺利。此外，宝马还毫不吝啬地应用了其研发部门的最新技术，包括宝马的首款电动助力转向系统，牵引力控制系统辅助功能——DTC，以及支持普通模式与运动模式切换，改变操控风格与油门响应关系的动态驾驶控制系统——DDC。变速箱方面提供了手动档、自动档，以及被简称为SMG的序列式半自动变速器三个版本。

和Z3一样，此次的新车型也在位于美国南卡罗来纳州的斯帕坦堡工厂生产。基于这款Z4开发的赛车版本活跃在多项赛事中，例如纽博格林24小时耐力赛。-

One thing that racing enthusiasts love about BMW...

Is their long-standing commitment to developing
customer racing cars like this one here.

When a new production car is released, a race-ready
model can be expected to follow soon after.

This Z4 GT3 made its biggest impression...

At endurance races like the Nürburgring 24 Hours...

Where it was driven by BMW works drivers
Bruno Spengler and Timo Glock.

Part of what makes BMW so cool is that they can be
assertive without coming off as conceited.

They exude that sort of confidence that just lets
the facts speak for themselves.

vehicleCollection.en:
Starting the 2011 24 Hours of Spa from the 49th position on the grid, this BMW Z4 GT3 crossed the finish line in a remarkable 2nd place.:

The FIA-GT racing versions of the E85/E86 BMW Z4 were immensely popular with race teams, especially privateers.

The second-generation E89-based GT3 machines started racing in 2010. Because the production Z4 was only sold as a convertible starting in 2009, the GT3 race car was converted into a coupe by omitting the opening and closing mechanism of the power hard top. A large front spoiler and rear wing, along with flared front and rear fenders provided gobs of downforce without any added weight. The hood, roof, wing, and the front and rear fenders were made of carbon fiber, making the car 300kg lighter at 1200kg.

Under the hood, the Z4’s stock inline-6 was swapped in favor of the E92 M3’s fire-breathing 4.0-liter V8 that came mated to a 6-speed sequential gearbox. The ECU of this engine was reprogrammed to produce 480ps. New competition-grade ABS brakes provided the stopping power, and the front axle was redesigned for added performance and durability.

The 2011 model pushed the envelope even further as the fenders were widened and the entire body was upgraded to improve the car’s aerodynamics. Also, engine displacement was increased to 4.4 liters, bumping power up to 515ps. The 6-speed sequential gearbox was updated to incorporate paddle shifters.

The transformed Z4 GT3 won two races in the FIA-GT3 championships in 2011, and in the two 24-hour races at the Nürburgring and Spa, it placed second overall. The car showed, and continues to show, superb performance in races with high levels of competition.
vehicleCollection.zh:
纽博格林赛道和斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道24小时耐力赛亚军。赛车典范，从最艰巨的战斗中脱颖而出。

自E85/E86款宝马Z4起，宝马赛车部门就一直在研发国际汽联-GT规格的赛车。世界各地的私人赛车手都会驾驶这些车辆参加GT赛事。

以E89为原型的第二代GT3赛车于2010年起开始进入赛场。在2009年亮相的量产型Z4，则只售卖敞篷款，不再提供跑车版与双门轿车版。相应地，GT3赛车也摒弃了车顶开关机制，直接将车顶固定。车上还安装了大型前扰流板与尾翼，并拓宽了前后挡泥板。引擎盖、车顶、前后挡泥板与尾翼都由碳纤维增强复合材制成，使车重成功减轻300kg，达到1200kg。

引擎也从直6引擎换为E92 M3所搭载的4升V8引擎，配合调校好的电子控制单元单元可输出480ps。车上还装载了6档序列式变速器，以及竞赛级防抱死刹车系统和全新设计的前轴。即使是沿用了现有的设计，这款车也进行了相当大胆的改动。

2011款还进行了另一项重大革新。车的挡泥板进一步加宽，整个车体也添加了更多细节来减小空气阻力。同时，引擎排气量也提升至4.4升，意味着这款车的功率到达515ps。6档序列式变速箱也进行了升级，升级为换挡拨片。

2011款Z4 GT3同年在国际汽联-GT3锦标赛中2次拔得头筹，在纽博格林24小时耐力赛与斯帕24小时耐力赛中也都位居次席。这款车在高级别赛事中展现出了相当卓越的性能。

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
This is the car that made Henrik Fisker famous!
It’s truly a modern 507!

There's a lot I like about it.

First, I like how it pushes BMW's emotional envelope.

It almost has a handmade look...

It reflects a more human approach to design.

It’s really quite wonderful!

It’s a more emotional, artistic approach that
embraces imperfections as character!

And, if anything, the Z8 is full of character.
dialogues.zh:
这辆车让亨里克·菲斯克声名鹊起！
你可以说，它就是现代版的507了！

我喜欢它的地方有很多。

首先，我喜欢它把宝马感性的一面发挥到了极致。

它的外观给人一种手工打造的质感……

反映出一种更有人情味的设计方法。

它有着极强的表现力！

这是一种更感性、更艺术的设计方法，
接纳不完美，并把它转化为车的个性！

倒不如说，这台Z8全身上下都散发着强烈的个性！

vehicleCollection.en:
BMW's contemporary Z8 roadster has the distinction of being one of James Bond's rare non-British vehicles.

Announced in 1999, the Z8 was a luxury open-top sports car that took its roots from the legendary BMW 507 of the 1950s (of which only 252 cars were ever made). The car drew additional attention when its gorgeous sheet metal was revealed for the first time, as the Bond car in the 19th "007" movie, "The World is Not Enough."

While the Z8 is a production car, it was positioned as a very special model in the BMW lineup, and they spared no expense in its creation. The basic structure of the car starts by combining an extruded aluminum space frame with aluminum paneling, an expensive undertaking that requires precision craftsmanship. The long-nose, short deck layout, electric soft top, and retro-modern style employing a variety of classical details, is the work of legendary designer Henrik Fisker who would later work on the Aston Martin DB9, before going on to create his own hybrid car company.

Its design motif is consistent through to its interior, recreating the metallic interior panels of the 507 with composite panels and center gauges. Meanwhile, fine leather is utilized unsparingly to create an interior fit for the very best of luxury cars. Mechanically, it borrows its engine from the high-performance E39 M5 sedan, a 4941 cc V8 producing 400ps/51.0kgm, and also shares the 6-speed manual transmission, front MacPherson strut and rear integral-arm aluminum suspension. Because the car is 150kg lighter than the E39 M5 at 1630kg, 0-<100km/h> is a brisk 4.7 seconds, which made it the fastest BMW of its day.
vehicleCollection.zh:
质量和性能均属顶尖的敞篷跑车，拥有“邦德座驾”的殊荣。

豪华敞篷跑车Z8于1999年发布，其设计灵感来自20世纪50年代的宝马传奇车型507（只有252辆面世）。前者在第19部007电影《黑日危机》中充当邦德的座驾，首次向全世界展示自己的风采，吸睛无数。

Z8虽然是一款量产车，但它在宝马中的定位非常特殊，在设计和制造时都不计投入。这款车的基础结构结合了挤压铝型材空间车架与全铝面板，不仅造价昂贵，而且要求更精良的工艺。长车头/短车尾的布局、电动软顶和融入多种经典细节的复古风格都出自设计师亨利克·菲斯克的手笔，这位大师后来又设计出了阿斯顿马丁DB9，之后还开创了自己的混动汽车公司。

复古的设计品味同样延续到了车身内部，通过复合板和位于正中央的仪表盘，Z8重现了507的金属内饰。车内还大量应用高品质皮革来打造奢华感。在机械方面，Z8采用了来自高性能E39 M5轿车的引擎，这是一台能够产生400ps和51.0kgm扭矩的4941cc V8引擎，以及同样来自E39 M5的6速手动变速箱、麦弗逊前悬挂和一体式铝制后悬臂。Z8比1650kg重的E39 M5轿车轻了约150kg，因此从起步加速到<100km/h>的时间也被压缩到了4.7秒，成为了当时最快的宝马车型。

long.en:
Announced in 1999, the Z8 was a luxury open-top sports car that took its roots from the legendary BMW 507 of the 1950s (of which only 252 cars were ever made). The car drew additional attention when its gorgeous sheet metal was revealed for the first time, as the Bond car in the 19th "007" movie, "The World is Not Enough."

While the Z8 is a production car, it was positioned as a very special model in the BMW lineup, and they spared no expense in its creation. The basic structure of the car starts by combining an extruded aluminum space frame with aluminum paneling, an expensive undertaking that requires precision craftsmanship. The long-nose, short deck layout, electric soft top, and retro-modern style employing a variety of classical details, is the work of legendary designer Henrik Fisker who would later work on the Aston Martin DB9, before going on to create his own hybrid car company.

Its design motif is consistent through to its interior, recreating the metallic interior panels of the 507 with composite panels and center gauges. Meanwhile, fine leather is utilized unsparingly to create an interior fit for the very best of luxury cars. Mechanically, it borrows its engine from the high-performance E39 M5 sedan, a 4941 cc V8 producing 400ps/51.0kgm, and also shares the 6-speed manual transmission, front MacPherson strut and rear integral-arm aluminum suspension. Because the car is 150kg lighter than the E39 M5 at 1630kg, 0-<100km/h> is a brisk 4.7 seconds, which made it the fastest BMW of its day.
long.zh:
豪华敞篷跑车Z8于1999年发布，其设计灵感来自20世纪50年代的宝马传奇车型507（只有252辆面世）。前者在第19部007电影《黑日危机》中充当邦德的座驾，首次向全世界展示自己的风采，吸睛无数。

Z8虽然是一款量产车，但它在宝马中的定位非常特殊，在设计和制造时都不计投入。这款车的基础结构结合了挤压铝型材空间车架与全铝面板，不仅造价昂贵，而且要求更精良的工艺。长车头/短车尾的布局、电动软顶和融入多种经典细节的复古风格都出自设计师亨利克·菲斯克的手笔，这位大师后来又设计出了阿斯顿马丁DB9，之后还开创了自己的混动汽车公司。

复古的设计品味同样延续到了车身内部，通过复合板和位于正中央的仪表盘，Z8重现了507的金属内饰。车内还大量应用高品质皮革来打造奢华感。在机械方面，Z8采用了来自高性能E39 M5轿车的引擎，这是一台能够产生400ps和51.0kgm扭矩的4941cc V8引擎，以及同样来自E39 M5的6速手动变速箱、麦弗逊前悬挂和一体式铝制后悬臂。Z8比1650kg重的E39 M5轿车轻了约150kg，因此从起步加速到<100km/h>的时间也被压缩到了4.7秒，成为了当时最快的宝马车型。

dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
The large air intakes placed on the side of the body are
reminiscent of elegant French styling of the 1930s.

However, I sense it is slightly mismatched with the
wild example of the coda tronca body style.

In the Veyron, the intakes are placed there
to improve aerodynamics.

They make the sides look a bit like a French carrosserie
or the Delage D6 of Henri Labourdette.

This is a beautiful flamboyant French design, one where
the function-defining form to travel at 400km...

Makes modern-day Bugattis so alluring, don't you think?

It's my fondest hope that they always remain
sublime and pure.*
dialogues.zh:
位于车身两侧的大号进气口令人回忆起1930年代
的那些优雅法国车造型。

不过我总感觉这种风格和“coda tronca”（断尾）
的设计有些不搭。

在Veyron上，在这里设计进气口是为了提升空气动力学性能。

这样的设计让侧面的外观向法式车身靠拢，
又有点类似亨利·拉布戴特的Delage D6。

美观到有些浮夸的法系设计，
外加能够达到400km极速的超跑定位……

让现代版本的Bugatti充满了魅力，对吧？

在此致以我最美好的愿望，希望他们可以
永远保持卓越和纯粹。
