brandCentral.en:
Unveiled in 2016, the Bugatti Chiron was developed
as the successor to the Veyron.

The line that runs over the centre of the body
is a nod to the famous Type 57 Atlantic.

Priding itself on a chassis strong enough to compete
against the top-tier racing cars at Le Mans...

This super sportscar is powered by an 8L
quad-turbocharged W16 engine.

It has a maximum output of a whopping 1500ps!
brandCentral.zh:
布加迪Chiron于2016年公布，是作为布加迪Veryron的
后继车型而开发的。

贯穿车身的中轴线是对鼎鼎大名的
Type 57 Atlantic的致敬。

这辆超级跑车配有足以与勒芒顶尖赛车
相媲美的高强度底盘……

由一台8升四涡轮增压的W16引擎驱动。

它的最大输出功率可达到巨大的1500ps！

vehicleCollection.en:
The successor to the ultra-high-performance Veyron.

The Chiron is a super sports car unveiled by Bugatti in 2016. This limited production model was introduced as a follow-up to the Veyron, with only 500 units available worldwide.

The exterior featured large C-shaped lines that encircled the cabin and also served as air intakes. The body possessed an accentuated centerline inspired by the Type 57 Atlantic Coupe that increased straight-line stability.

The carbon-fiber chassis provided the same level of rigidity as an LMP1 race car and housed the Veyron's quad-turbo 8.0-liter W-16 engine, which was extensively tuned to produce 1500ps and 163.1kgm of torque.

The car ran from 0-<100km/h> in 2.5 seconds, and a pre-production prototype was able to reach a maximum speed of <490.48km/h>.

In 2018, the Chiron Sport was introduced with an improved chassis weighing 18kg less than the original. In 2019, the limited edition "Chiron Sport 110 ans Bugatti" was released to celebrate the 110th anniversary of Bugatti. Only 20 of them were made.
vehicleCollection.zh:
超高性能跑车布加迪Veryron的后继者。

Chiron是布加迪于2016年推出的一款超级跑车。这款限量跑车是布加迪Veryron的后续型号，全球仅出售500台。

其外形设计采用大型C字形线条包围整个驾驶舱，同时还用作进气口。此外它还借鉴Type 57 Atlantic Coupe那强调中轴线的贯穿设计，以提升直道的稳定性。

其碳纤维底盘可以提供等同于勒芒原型车1级赛车的刚性，在上面则搭载了一部8升W16四涡轮增压引擎。从布加迪Veryron那一代算起，这款引擎经过了多次调校，可以输出1500ps的最大动力和163.1kgm的最大扭矩。

这辆车可以在2.5秒内完成0-<100km/h>加速，其前期生产原型甚至可以实现<490.48km/h>的极速。

在2018年，布加迪推出了Chiron Sport，它的底盘得到了优化，比原始型号轻了18kg。在2019年，为了庆祝品牌的110周年，布加迪又推出了限量版“Chiron Sport 110 ans Bugatti”，并且仅制造了20辆。)

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
From its GP machines to the Royales, Bugatti pushed the
automobile horizon in many directions in the pre-war era.

Especially in regard to design, Jean Bugatti
of the Bugatti family...

Ensured that the company's cars were dynamic in nature and
possessed originality that was recognizable at a glance.

However, at the same time, the cars also combined a certain
sublimeness and acceptance of classic aesthetics.

Even the Veyron's styling suggested that it was one
level apart from its rivals from Modena, Italy.

The traditional wedge-shaped formula was
completely discarded...

While the roofline and fenders were presented in natural
harmony, flowing down to the rear of the car.

The car's elegant lines are uninterrupted, running smoothly
around its body—a joy to trace with your eyes.

The styling expresses a euphoric art nouveau expression
It makes me respect Jean Bugatti all the more.
dialogues.zh:
从GP赛车再到皇家，布加迪在二战前
就将汽车的边界向各个方向大幅扩展。

特别是在设计上，布加迪家族的让·布加迪……

负责确保这家公司的所有汽车都拥有动感的本质和
一目了然的原创性。

与此同时，布加迪推出的车也结合了威严感
以及对传统美学的接纳。

这辆布加迪Veryron的风格设计就表现出了它与
来自意大利摩德纳的竞争对手的截然不同。

它彻底地弃用了传统的楔形车身设计……

从车顶到挡泥板的线条自然而和谐，
流泻到车尾。

从一而终的优雅线条沿车身顺滑地向后延伸，
带动你的眼神去追寻，赏心悦目。

这种造型风格表达了一种幸福、陶醉感的新艺术派理念。
也让我对让·布加迪更加肃然起敬。

brandCentral.en:
The 2005 Veyron was many car enthusiasts' introduction to
the Bugatti brand.

It was the first commercially available car produced by the
company since its revival in 1998!

The elegant proportions of its design are complemented by
the car's 8L midship W16 engine.

This engine can generate more than 1000ps of power,
allowing the car to reach speeds of over <400km/h>!

Only 400 of these cars were ever made, with production
ceasing in 2015.
brandCentral.zh:
2005布加迪Veryron或许是许多汽车爱好者接触到布加迪品牌的契机。

这是该公司自1998年重生以来生产出的第一款商业化车型！

颀长且优雅的车身比例与8升的W16中置引擎配合无间。

这款引擎可以产生超过1000ps的动力，将汽车的时速推到<400km/h>！

在2015年停产之前，布加迪Veryron总共只生产了400辆。|

vehicleCollection.en:
With a little help from a special key, this remarkable automobile reached speeds of over <375km/h>.

It is one of the most fabled marques in the history of the automobile. Ettore Bugatti’s cars were so technologically advanced in the 1930s that they remained quite competitive in numerous racing categories... for about two decades. Imagine a contemporary Formula 1 team or sports car trying to make that claim. But the new Bugatti Veyron created by German car maker Volkswagen was without question the single greatest supercar of the modern era.

Its quad-turbo, 8.0-liter, W-16 engine produced a mind-numbing 1001 ps at 6000 rpm. Its transmission was an ultra-smooth, quick-shifting 7-speed DSG developed exclusively to the Veyron. Its performance numbers were downright scary, with a 0-<100 km/h> time of 2.5 seconds and a 0-<300 km/h> dash in 16.7 seconds. Its braking was also impressive, coming to a stop from <100 km/h> in a distance of 31.4 m and only 2.3 seconds.

Then there’s the price: 1 million Euros (about $1.4 million).

The Veyron was capable of such high speed, said to be over 250 mph, that the vehicle’s ride height and rear wing angles changed in three positions: standard, top speed, and handling mode. To enter the top speed mode enabling speeds of over <375 km/h>, a special separate key needed to be inserted when the car was at a standstill.

Everything about the Veyron, its price, performance, limited quantity and top speed, was completely over-the-top. That’s why it rested atop the pinnacle of the super exotic car universe when it went on sale.
vehicleCollection.zh:
利用特殊的钥匙，令这辆令人难以置信的野兽达到<375km/h>。

顶级高档超跑，这就是布加迪Veryron的定义。这款车的生产模型在2005年东京车展上展出的同时，厂家也宣布将在未来5年内限量生产最多300台。

布加迪是一家诞生于1909年的传奇跑车生产商。1998年，大众集团收购了布加迪品牌与生产权，并研发出了Veryron。该车计划在布加迪的诞生地法国莫尔塞姆投入生产。

Veryron引人注目之处不止其外观，还有高的离谱的85万英镑标价，1001ps的动力输出以及令人难以置信的<407km/h>最高时速。

8升W16引擎装载了4个涡轮增压器，能在6000rpm转速下提供1001ps动力输出。变速箱采用专为Veryron打造的DSG双离合7档变速箱。

车身设计出自大众设计中心，由碳纤维和铝合金制成，以便最高时速超过402公里/小时。车高和尾翼角度可在3种驾驶模式中切换：标准模式、极速模式与操控模式。进入极速模式可将最高时速提升至<375km/h>以上，而为此必须在驻车静止状态下插入一把特殊的独立钥匙。

这款车的0-<100km/h>加速时间为2.5秒，0-<300km/h>加速时间为16.7秒，而<100km/h>-<0km/h>减速只需2.3秒即可完成，刹车距离只有31.4m。据说这款车需要长约12km的直路才能达到402公里/小时的时速。这款车的一切，包括价格、参数配置、产量与最高时速，都象征着独一无二的极致。这正是Veryron位居梦幻级超跑巅峰的原因。

long.en:
It is one of the most fabled marques in the history of the automobile. Ettore Bugatti’s cars were so technologically advanced in the 1930s that they remained quite competitive in numerous racing categories... for about two decades. Imagine a contemporary Formula 1 team or sports car trying to make that claim. But the new Bugatti Veyron created by German car maker Volkswagen was without question the single greatest supercar of the modern era.

Its quad-turbo, 8.0-liter, W-16 engine produced a mind-numbing 1001 ps at 6000 rpm. Its transmission was an ultra-smooth, quick-shifting 7-speed DSG developed exclusively to the Veyron. Its performance numbers were downright scary, with a 0-<100 km/h> time of 2.5 seconds and a 0-<300 km/h> dash in 16.7 seconds. Its braking was also impressive, coming to a stop from <100 km/h> in a distance of 31.4 m and only 2.3 seconds.

Then there’s the price: 1 million Euros (about $1.4 million).

The Veyron was capable of such high speed, said to be over 250 mph, that the vehicle’s ride height and rear wing angles changed in three positions: standard, top speed, and handling mode. To enter the top speed mode enabling speeds of over <375 km/h>, a special separate key needed to be inserted when the car was at a standstill.

vehicleCollection.en:
A dream machine made to be the pinnacle of race cars and a true Bugatti.

Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo is a project as realistic as possible for Bugatti fans to introduce a thoroughbred Bugatti to the virtual world. The result is a symbiosis of technology, tradition and aesthetics, where every design feature has an actual purpose.

The Bugatti designers drew their inspiration from the brand's racing tradition. Bugatti enjoyed great success in racing in the 1920s and 1930s. Historical inspiration for the modern virtual race car came, in particular, from the Bugatti Type 57 Tank and its victories in the 24 Hours of Le Mans races in 1937 and 1939.

The design of the Vision Gran Turismo shows at first glance that Bugatti DNA meets cutting-edge racing technology. Marked by large convex surfaces in contrast with concave transitions and strong lines, the proportions of the vehicle are uncompromisingly athletic and designed for maximum performance. The designers have unmistakably integrated key features of the Bugatti design DNA into the virtual race car's design with every vehicle component having a real performance function. The horseshoe on the front grille acts as a support for the front splitter. The center fin, which derives from the legendary Type 57 SC Atlantic, makes an important contribution to the car's dynamic stability and accommodates the kinematic system for the rear wing, which controls the air brake and the drag reduction system (DRS). The architecture of the interior continues the clean lines of the exterior. Every aspect of the interior is geared to racing.

The virtual race car was developed in close collaboration with the Bugatti engineers and is based on modern racing technology and aerodynamic analyses. To attain the performance goals, the Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo is driven by a W16 engine, which delivers the engine power of 1230 kW (1650 BHP) and 1580 Nm (61.1 kgfm) to all four wheels. The engineers have calculated that the Bugtti Vision Gran Turismo can drive at over 400 km/h (250 mph) on four setions o the virtual Le Mans track reaching an verall max speed of 47.59 km/h (278 mph). 

The ugatti Vision Gran Turiso is te ultimate rae car, and at te same time a true Bugatti.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.1 regulatons by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
布加迪梦幻赛车，力争立于赛车之巅。

布加迪跑车浪漫旅愿景项目专为布加迪粉丝准备，力求尽可能逼真地在虚拟世界中重现血统纯正的布加迪。其结果便是技术、传统与美学的结合，每一处设计都有其实际意义。

布加迪的设计师们从品牌的竞赛传统中汲取了灵感。上世纪二三十年代，布加迪在比赛中获得巨大成功。这款虚拟现代赛车从历史中获得的灵感，来自于布加迪Type 57 Tank，以及它在1937年和1939年勒芒24小时耐力赛中的夺冠经历。

人们一眼就能看出，跑车浪漫旅愿景的设计是布加迪基因与尖端赛车技术的完美融合。硕大的凸面车壳与其上的凹陷过渡和硬朗线条形成鲜明对比，车身造型比例充满刚毅的运动感，而每一处设计都是为了追求极致的性能。设计师们将布加迪设计基因中的核心特征准确地融入这款虚拟赛车的设计中，车上的每一个部件都具有实际的功能。前栅格上的U型结构支撑着前定风翼。源于传奇赛车Type 57 SC Atlantic的中鳍，是维持车体动态稳定的重要一环，其内部还装有控制减速板与减阻系统（车手评级S）的尾翼运动系统。车体的内部构造沿用了外部设计中的简洁线条，每一处细节都为比赛而设计。

这款基于现代赛车技术与空气动力学分析的虚拟赛车是与布加迪工程师紧密合作共同开发的成果。为达到性能目标，布加迪Vision Gran Turismo搭载了W16引擎，并将其产生的1650匹马力和161.1公斤力米的扭矩传导至所有四个轮子。据工程师计算，布加迪Vision Gran Turismo在虚拟勒芒赛道上的四个分段中最高时速可超过400公里，而全段最高时速可达447.59公里。

布加迪Vision Gran Turismo是最顶级的赛车，d时也是最正宗的布加迪血统。

*这款车型已按照跑车z漫旅的组别1规则进行过特殊调试。

vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆致敬Type 57 Tank的Vision Gran Turismo象征着布加迪的光辉历史。

布加迪跑车浪漫旅愿景项目专为布加迪粉丝准备，力求尽可能逼真地在虚拟世界中重现血统纯正的布加迪。其结果便是技术、传统与美学的结合，每一处设计都有其实际意义。

布加迪的设计师们从品牌的竞赛传统中汲取了灵感。上世纪二三十年代，布加迪在比赛中获得巨大成功。这款虚拟现代赛车从历史中获得的灵感，来自于布加迪Type 57 Tank，以及它在1937年和1939年勒芒24小时耐力赛中的夺冠经历。

人们一眼就能看出，跑车浪漫旅愿景的设计是布加迪基因与尖端赛车技术的完美融合。硕大的凸面车壳与其上的凹陷过渡和硬朗线条形成鲜明对比，车身造型比例充满刚毅的运动感，而每一处设计都是为了追求极致的性能。设计师们将布加迪设计基因中的核心特征准确地融入这款虚拟赛车的设计中，车上的每一个部件都具有实际的功能。前栅格上的U型结构支撑着前定风翼。源于传奇赛车Type 57 SC Atlantic的中鳍，是维持车体动态稳定的重要一环，其内部还装有控制减速板与减阻系统（车手评级S）的尾翼运动系统。车体的内部构造沿用了外部设计中的简洁线条，每一处细节都为比赛而设计。

这款基于现代赛车技术与空气动力学分析的虚拟赛车是与布加迪工程师紧密合作共同开发的成果。为达到性能目标，布加迪Vision Gran Turismo搭载了W16引擎，并将其产生的1230千瓦（1650 匹马力）动力和161.1公斤立米的扭矩传导至所有四个轮子。据工程师计算，布加迪Vision Gran Turismo在虚拟勒芒赛道上的四个分段中最高时速可超过400 公里/小时，而全段最高速可达447.59 公里/小时。

布加迪Vision Grn Turismo是最顶级的赛车，同时也是最正宗的布加迪血统P2

catch.en: This Vision Gran Turismo machine pays homage to the Type 57 Tank, one of the glorious cars that define Bugatti's history.
catch.zh: 这辆致敬Type 57 Tank的Vision Gran Turismo象征着布加迪的光辉历史。

long.en:
Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo is a project as realistic as possible for Bugatti fans to introduce a thoroughbred Bugatti to the virtual world. The result is a symbiosis of technology, tradition and aesthetics, where every design feature has an actual purpose.

The Bugatti designers drew their inspiration from the brand's racing tradition. Bugatti enjoyed great success in racing in the 1920s and 1930s. Historical inspiration for the modern virtual race car came, in particular, from the Bugatti Type 57 Tank and its victories in the 24 Hours of Le Mans races in 1937 and 1939.

The design of the Vision Gran Turismo shows at first glance that Bugatti DNA meets cutting-edge racing technology. Marked by large convex surfaces in contrast with concave transitions and strong lines, the proportions of the vehicle are uncompromisingly athletic and designed for maximum performance. The designers have unmistakably integrated key features of the Bugatti design DNA into the virtual race car's design with every vehicle component having a real performance function. The horseshoe on the front grille acts as a support for the front splitter. The center fin, which derives from the legendary Type 57 SC Atlantic, makes an important contribution to the car's dynamic stability and accommodates the kinematic system for the rear wing, which controls the air brake and the drag reduction system (DRS). The architecture of the interior continues the clean lines of the exterior. Every aspect of the interior is geared to racing.

The virtual race car was developed in close collaboration with the Bugatti engineers and is based on modern racing technology and aerodynamic analyses. To attain the performance goals, the Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo is driven by a W16 engine, which delivers the engine power of 1230 kW (1650 BHP) and 1580 Nm (61.1 kgfm) to all four wheels. The engineers have calculated that the Bugtti Vision Gran Turismo can drive at over 400 km/h (250 mph) on four setions o the virtual Le Mans track reaching an verall max speed of 47.59 km/h (278 mph). 

The ugatti Vision Gran Turiso is te ultimate rae car, and at te same time a true Bugatti.

brandCentral.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo is inspired by Bulgari’s
"Aluminum" wristwatch from 1998.

In terms of form, materials and coloring, it perfectly
represents the design and spirit of its namesake.

The "barchetta" body is an archetype of sportiness...

...showcasing the creativity and character of traditional
Italian car design.

It pays homage to the many concept cars of the 1960s and
1970s, the golden age of Italian carrozzerie.

And a pure expression of Bulgari’s timeless design DNA.
brandCentral.zh:
这款Vision Gran Turismo的灵感源自Bulgari
于1998年推出的“Aluminium”腕表。

无论从造型、材质还是色彩上，
它都完美体现了同名产品的设计和精神。

这一“barchetta”车身是典型的跑车造型……

展现了意大利传统汽车设计的创意与个性。

它是对60年代和70年代众多概念车以及意大利
车身制造商的“黄金时代”的致敬……

也是Bulgari永恒经典设计DNA的纯粹体现。

vehicleCollection.en:
A digital concept car infused with the DNA of BVLGARI.

The BVLGARI Aluminium Vision Gran Turismo is a concept car that takes its inspiration from the iconic 1988 BVLGARI Aluminium watch, possessing the same sporty, smart and essential spirit as the time piece.

The shapes, materials, colors, and the overall design language of the car are directly inspired by the form language and spirit of the "Aluminium" watch.

The barchetta body style is defined by a combination of pure and geometrical shapes, which are symbolic of Italian-car tradition of creativity and character, integrating elements of various 1960s and 1970s Italian carrozzeria concept cars. The result is an archetype of sportiness that expresses movement, lightness, and performance in a timeless design that's both unique and undeniably Italian in spirit. The car's expression of style and coolness transcends short-lived trends, and affirms itself as a pure expression of BVLGARI-design DNA.
vehicleCollection.zh:
融入宝格丽血统的数字概念赛车。

宝格丽Aluminium Vision Gran Turismo是一款数字概念赛车，设计灵感来源宝格丽于1998年推出的标志性宝格丽Aluminium腕表，并将相同的理念“运动、智能化和简约，精雕细琢又做工精良”应用到概念赛车上。

这款车的造型、材质、配色和整体设计语言都脱胎于铝腕表的造型语言和理念。

其“小帆船”车身是典型的跑车造型，传递出动感、轻盈和性能的特点。由纯粹的几何形状搭配而成的简约组合，借鉴了上世纪60和70年代黄金时代的意大利“车身制造商”推出的那些经典概念赛车，极具创意和性格，也原汁原味地体现出意大利汽的传统。最后打造出的成品就是一款永恒经典的设计杰作，其创新性的概念精神和对风格以及冷峻的演绎毫无疑问都是独属于意大利的审美风范，远高于那些只能爆红一时的时尚和潮流，以张扬的表达标榜了自己纯正的宝格丽设计血统。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
The granddaddy of lightweight sports cars,
the Seven is a legend among legends.

Its story began in 1957, when the car was
introduced by British automaker Lotus.

Lotus ended production in 1972, but the story did not end there.

Caterham acquired the rights the following year and
continues to build the Seven today.

This Superlight R500 combines a highly tuned engine
wwith a featherweight 500kg body.

Its acceleration feels almost instantaneous, demanding
complete concentration from the driver.

The engine delivers a hard-edged note that seems
to resonate through the entire car.

For anyone seeking the pure thrill of the racetrack,
few cars can match the Superlight R500.
dialogues.zh:
“Seven”作为所有轻量级跑车的鼻祖，
堪称传奇中的传奇。

这一系列的根源最早可以追溯到1957年，
由英国汽车制造商莲花打造。

虽然莲花在1972年停产了“Seven”系列车型……

但凯特汉姆在次年就接过了生产权，并一直生产到现在。

这辆Superlight R500在轻如羽毛的500kg车身中，

搭载了一台精心调校的强大引擎。

其油门几乎是瞬时响应，因此驾驶时可千万别分神。

它那高昂的引擎轰鸣声，能让你从头到脚都感到震颤。

毫无疑问，对于追求赛道刺激感的车迷来说，
这款车就是他们的终极目标。

brandCentral.en:
Carving through a corner with absolute precision
is a joy that captures the very essence of racing.

If there's one brand dedicated to chasing that joy,
it's Caterham, most notably with its iconic 'Seven' series.

This Superlight R500 from 1999 is the ultimate model,
balancing aerodynamics and power in a single package.

The lightest of the Sevens, the R500 weighs in at
a feathery 500kg.

In 2008, it was refitted with a 2L Ford Duratec engine with
266ps of power and ample torque at low-to-mid speeds.

Named for its 500-horsepower-per-tonne power-to-weight ratio,
the R500 can sprint from 0 to <100km/h> in 2.88 seconds.

Rejecting modern driver aids and comforts, it serves as
a constant reminder of what a true sports car should
brandCentral.zh:
以绝对精准的行车线通过弯道，是赛车运动的核心乐趣之一。

如果要找出一个精确捕捉到了这一乐趣的汽车品牌，
Caterham绝对是很好的选择，特别是它经典的“Seven”系列。

这款1999年的Superlight R500是该系列的终极车型，
一站式提供了均衡的空气动力学设计和动力输出。

作为Seven系列中最轻盈的车型，
R500重量仅有500kg，可以说是轻如鸿毛。

在2008年，它换上了一台2升的Ford Duratec引擎，
能够输出266ps的动力，在中低转速下提供充足的扭矩。

该车型的名称R500，来自于其500马力每吨的推重比，
从0到<100km/h>加速仅需2.88秒。

这款拒绝现代辅助驾驶和舒适体验的车型，
一直是纯血跑车中标杆般的存在。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate version of the extremely lightweight Caterham.

In 1973, Caterham Cars secured the rights to manufacture the open-cockpit sports and race car called the Seven from Lotus Cars. In 1996, Caterham Cars decided to take the car's performance to another level with the Seven Superlight.

This new version of the British classic came with a semi-monocoque chassis built from a tubular frame with aluminum paneling. semi-monocoque chassis built from a tubular frame with aluminum paneling.
While it possessed the basic visual cues of the original Seven, the Superlight weighed significantly less than the stock version, from 35kg to 50kg less depending on the engine you chose.

The "R500" version of this car was introduced in 1999. Its name was derived from the car's 500-horsepower-per-ton power-to-weight ratio. The first vehicles were equipped with a Rover K-series engine, but in 2008, Caterham decided to throw a 266ps 2.0-liter Ford Duratec under the hood, giving the R500 supercar-like acceleration: Its zero to <100km/h> came in at 2.88 seconds and top speed was rated at 150 mph.
vehicleCollection.zh:
轻量化Caterham的终极版本。

自从1973年从莲花跑车获得授权生产许可后，卡特汉姆汽车就一直在持续量产一款非常斯巴达式的跑车，名为“七”。1996年，卡特汉姆七超级光在卡特汉姆七的演化史中诞生了。

该车的造型像极了50年代的方程式赛车，有一个由管状车架和铝板构成的半单体式底盘，同时保留了基本的长前鼻和标准七的后轮驱动布局。但正如其名称所示，该车型的重量得到了明显削减。
根据选用的引擎，超级光能比标准车型轻35公斤到50公斤。

而1999年出现的变体车型名字中含有的R500则取自其500马力每吨的推重比，代表极其强劲的马力。最初，此车的动力来自一款罗孚的K型引擎。但从2008年起，后续车型配备上了2升福特多丽耐引擎，输出动力高达266ps。在2012年引入机械增压版本的R600车型前，R500一直在七系列中独占鳌头。它的加速性能甚至超过了许多超级跑车，0-<100km/h>的加速时间只要2.88秒。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Trust me, you’re not likely to forget a car like this.

This is the Chaparral 2J, which was built for
the 1970 Can-Am Series.

What makes it original is found at the rear of the car.

the "fan car.".

Thanks to this ingenious piece of engineering, the car can
take corners at speeds that defy all logic.

这是一台让人过目难忘的车！

这使它看起来好像直接吸在地面上一样。

它甚至能够以违反物理常识的高速过弯……

Chaparral 2J都创下了令人难以置信的单圈记录！

确切地说，它包揽了所有四场比赛的杆位。

dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
I’m a big fan of all things Chaparral.

The Chaparral 2J was the most innovative Chaparral.

It's undoubtedly the most radical racecar
of the legendary CanAm series.

Its wedge-shaped nose, squared off body
and twin fans on the rear...

...instantly made you want to know
what mysteries lay below its skin.

Its design looks more like a scientific test bed
than an agile racecar.

But the Chaparral 2J could
outperform everything.

That's why it was eventually banned from racing
because of its incredible technical advantage.

I would have created a body shape which was more in
keeping with the front-end design...

...or at least painted the center section white.
dialogues.zh:
我是Chaparral所有车型的忠实拥簇。

Chaparral 2J是他们最具创新性的一款车型。

毋庸置疑，它是传奇的美加系列当中最激进的一款赛车。

看着它的楔形车头、方正的车身和车位的两部风扇……

让你不由得对它的性能产生好奇。

从设计上看，它更像是一件“实验品”
而不是一台“赛车”，

但Chaparral 2J的确凭实力做到了藐视所有竞争对手。

这就是为什么它最终被禁止参加比赛的原因——
它的技术优势领先到无以复加。

就个人而言，我更倾向于打造
前后端设计更加一致的车身。

至少，我会将车体中段也涂成白色。

collection.en:
Have you ever considered who had the most influence over
modern racing car technology?

For me, that would be either Colin Chapman or Jim Hall.

Chapman, of course, was the founder of Lotus.
But do you know Jim Hall?

He is the founder of Chaparral Cars,

but also a driver who competed in Formula 1,
as well as being a brilliant engineer.

The most innovative of all the Chaparral cars was
this 1970 2J, aka the “sucker” car.

It featured two fans at the rear of the chassis, which were
a part of a suction system that produced downforce.

Other innovations included an adjustable spoiler and a
two-pedal semi-automatic transmission...

All in all, it’s one of the most outlandish and imaginative
race cars ever produced.

The 2J was undoubtedly Chaparral's greatest achievement,
and lives on in motorsport legend to this day.
collection.zh:
您有没有思考过，谁才是对现代赛车技术影响最大的人物？

我会提名Colin Chapman和Jim Hall。

众所周知，Chapman是
Lotus的创始人，但您知道Jim Hall吗？

他是Chaparral Cars的创始人，

也是一位F1车手，还是一位才华横溢的工程师。

Chaparral最具创新意义的作品是这款1970年的2J，也被称作“吸
尘器”。

它的底盘尾部安装了两个风扇，通过吸力来产生下压力。

它的其他创新设计还包括可调节的扰流板和双踏板半自
动变速箱……

总而言之，这是史上最奇特和最有想象力的赛车之一。

2J毫无疑问是Chaparral最伟大的成就，至今也是赛车运动的一
项传奇。

vehicleCollection.en:
Dubbed by some as "the vacuum cleaner," this car became an American racing icon.+

The 2J may well be the most innovative, wildest racing machine ever created. The car, characterized by its big boxy rear end, entered the 1970 SCCA Can-Am racing series in North America, as the first machine in the series to feature active ground effects... in the form of a giant vacuum.

The Can-Am series was quite unusual as, at the time, there was no rule to limit the amount of horsepower for its race cars. Chaparral boss, Texas oil magnate Jim Hall, pulled a wild card from his sleeve when he created a race car that utilized two engines: one was a 700 ps powerplant to power the car and the other, an air-cooled snowmobile engine that powered a pair of large fans to suck the air flowing underneath the car, thus making it “stick” to the road surface. The area between the sides of the bodywork and the ground were sealed by floating pieces of high-strength Lexan. Nicknamed “The Vacuum Cleaner,” the Chaparral 2J astounded race fans and the other Can-Am drivers alike.

Aside from its odd looks, the 2J often took pole position by several seconds over heady competition that included the previously-dominant McLaren M8D...that is, when it was running. The 2J experienced many mechanical problems in its maiden season, making every race it entered a thrilling event.

Before the start of the 1971 season, the SCCA banned the use of engines used for purposes other than powering the car itself, and the Chaparral 2J was banished from motorsports forever.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款车被戏称为“吸尘器”，曾让整个运动赛车界大吃一惊，成为竞速史上的一个标志。

在1970年的加拿大-美国挑战杯上，Chaparral从挑战最新空气动力学理论的2H车型身上吸取教训，推出了2J车型。从某种程度上说，它甚至比2H还要独特。

放眼赛车运动的世界，它的结构可以说是史无前例。车后方的风扇能抽走行驶过程中从车身下方流过的空气，车身两侧紧贴地面，产生大量的下压力。为了驱动后方的2台风扇，除了通常的引擎外，它还加装了一台风冷两冲程雪上摩托引擎。

因为Chaparral 2J钻了不少规则中的漏洞，因此被人们戏称为“吸尘器”，但它的表现让所有人为之震惊。抛开激进的外表不谈，它表现出的性能堪称顶级。在它面前，就连在先前无可匹敌的迈凯伦M8D也相形见绌。Chaparral 2J在第7轮美国之路赛道和第10轮里弗赛德国际赛道都占据了首发车位。

有些参赛者惧怕如此激进的创新，向美国赛车俱乐部提交投诉。在1971赛季即将开始时，美国赛车俱乐部宣布禁止使用任何非驾驶用途的引擎。Chaparral 2J就此被遗忘在车库中。

经过这次事件，Chaparral失去了对加拿大-美国挑战杯的热情。他们认为凭借常规的设计不可能击败基础扎实的迈凯伦，因此宣布暂时退出加拿大-美国挑战杯和其他所有竞速赛事。

dialogues.en:
This Camaro 1969 Race-Mod is classic on the outside
and modern within.

In other words, it perfectly embodies the spirit of every
great restomod.

It’s based on the legendary Camaro Z28, which was built
to compete in the popular Trans-Am Series of the 1960s.

Now the Camaro Z28 returns as an original custom car,
courtesy of Gran Turismo.

Built to sit lower on the ground, this car is equipped
with a special bumper and a host of new aero parts.

Meanwhile, the back features a large ducktail spoiler
and centre exit exhaust.

As for its engine, it runs on a mighty supercharged V8!

NowI want to see it in action!
*
dialogues.zh:
这辆科迈罗1969 Race-Mod，虽然保留了经典外观，
内里却焕然一新。

可以说，它完美诠释了修复改装车的顶尖水准。

此车的原型车是传奇的科迈罗Z28，
为了征战1960年代风靡一时的泛美房车锦标赛而生。

如今，科迈罗Z28以一款原创定制车的身份荣耀回归，
由《跑车浪漫旅》倾情呈现。

车身姿态经过精心调校，更为低趴，并配备了
专属前保险杠与大量全新空气动力学套件。

车尾则装有一个醒目的大型鸭尾式扰流板，
并采用中置排气布局。

至于它的心脏，则是一台动力磅礴的机械增压V8引擎！

现在，我真想一睹它在赛道上飞驰的风采！

brandCentral.en:
The Chevrolet Camaro is one of the most iconic American cars.
Its first-gen model from 1966 commands near-mythic respect.

This example is a restomod, pairing the spirit of the original
with modern high-performance upgrades.

In terms of presence, this is an intimidating machine. Built low
to the ground, it wears aggressive aero components.

The wide-mouth front bumper enhances cooling, while
chrome trim is blacked out and carbon-clad.

Under the hood sits a supercharged V-8 producing
667ps of power, making it a formidable hot rod.

Its roll-cage interior houses a sequential gearbox
and Alcantara bucket seats with a refined edge.

With its blend of classic style and cutting-edge tech, this
is a special Camaro built to compete in any era.
brandCentral.zh:
雪佛兰科迈罗是美式汽车中最具代表性的车型之一。
该系列于1966年问世的第一代车型至今被车迷奉为神作。

眼前这台车是基于经典车型的修复改装版，
巧妙融合了原版车型的复古氛围感和现代高性能改装。

外观上，这台车显露出威慑力十足的强大气场。
低趴的车身姿态咄咄逼人，展现精良的空气动力学套件。

宽体前杠有效提升了散热效能，原本的镀铬件
则被黑化处理，覆上了碳纤维材质。

引擎盖下，一台机械增压的V8引擎迸发出
667ps的磅礴动力，展现出最狂野的改装车气质。

防滚架座舱内，序列式变速箱与欧缔兰麂皮
桶椅相得益彰，透出精致品位。

经典外观与前沿科技的完美交融，
造就了这台足以在任何时代傲视群雄的非凡科迈罗。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is a restomod of the classic Trans-Am hero Camaro Z28.

Introduced in 1966, the Camaro was created as a pony car to take on Ford’s Mustang, with the high-performance Z28 model developed for homologation for the SCCA’s Trans-Am Series.

The Z28 was released as a hardcore motorsports base model, equipped with a high-revving 302 cubic-inch V-8 engine (approx. 4.9 liters), with no options available for automatic transmissions or air conditioning. One such car under Penske Racing claimed a championship victory in the Trans-Am Series. Such results helped create a new trend of small-displacement, high-revving American V-8s.

Created by Gran Turismo, this “Camaro 1969 Race-Mod” is a modern reinterpretation of the original Camaro Z28. The spirit of classic Trans-Am was carried on in the car’s low stance, with a number of elements added from the restomod movement that enjoyed widespread popularity at events like SEMA. All the chrome trim was stripped from the exterior and replaced with carbon black components. A wide-mouth bumper, large ducktail spoiler, and a center-exit exhaust were also added.

The spartan interior featured a sequential shifter, roll cage, and Alcantara bucket seats. Behind these classical stylings, however, lay the true identity of the beast: a supercharged V-8 engine producing 667ps. The ultimate modern Trans-American race car rebuilt tradition through new technologies.
vehicleCollection.zh:
经典泛美系列赛传奇赛车科迈罗Z28的复原改装。

1966年问世的小马车科迈罗旨在对标福特的Mustang，而其高性能版的Z28车型则是为满足美国跑车俱乐部世界挑战赛“泛美房车系列赛”的赛事认证规定而特别开发。

Z28在发布时的定位是硬核赛车基础车型，配备一台高转速的302立方英寸（约4.9升）V8引擎，但不再支持选配自动变速箱或空调。由潘世奇赛车车队驾驶的上述规格Z28在泛美房车系列赛中成功夺得冠军。这一成绩随即掀起了一场小排量、高转速的美式V8引擎新风潮。

这款“科迈罗1969 Race-Mod”是由《跑车浪漫旅》制作的原创车型，是对初代科迈罗的现代演绎。经典的泛美锦标赛风格在此车的低趴姿态中得以传承，同时融入了许多“经典车修复改装”风潮中出现的元素，这些元素在美国汽车用品改装车展览会等改装盛会上曾风靡一时。车身外部所有镀铬部件都被拆除，以碳黑部件替换。此外，车辆还加装了宽体保险杠、大型鸭尾式扰流板和中置排气系统。

内饰极为精简，配备了序列式变速箱、防滚架和欧缔兰麂皮桶椅。然而，在这些经典复古的外形元素之下，蛰伏着一台机械增压V8引擎，动力高达667ps，这才是这台凶兽的真实本性。这款极致的现代泛美赛车将以其全新技术重建科迈罗当年的辉煌传统。

dialogues.en:
The sixth-generation Camaros were well-built machines,
especially this SS-grade make.

It is equipped with the same 6.2L LT1 engine that was first
introduced in the Corvette.

The handling is nothing short of exceptional, and should
make winding roads a truly thrilling experience.

Honestly, for all it offers, it's really quite reasonably
priced.
dialogues.zh:
第六代Camaros工艺精湛，
特别是这款具备SS等级的制作。

这款车搭载了6.2L LT1引擎，
这款引擎曾首次亮相于Corvette车型上。

其操控性堪称卓越，在蜿蜒起伏之间，
驾驶体验更加刺激。

坦白说，这款车提供的这一切，
确实对得起这个价。

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
The 2016 Camaro was inspired by the original Camaro
of the 1960s.

But in a very fresh, contemporary way.

This iteration of the Camaro placed a greater emphasis on its
wheels, with a wide stance and muscular fender forms.

Many of its shapes, in particular the hood, front end,
and rear were inspired by Corvette design.
dialogues.zh:
这辆2016款Camaro设计灵感来源于1960年代的初代Camaro……

但进行了大刀阔斧的现代化改动，令人耳目一新。

这个版本的Camaro设计重点强调轮毂和
肌肉感十足的挡泥板，展现类似宽体低趴的形态。

车身部位的许多形状，尤其是引擎盖、车头和车尾，
灵感其实都来源于Corvette。

brandCentral.en:
The sixth-generation Chevy Camaro SS is a high-end machine
with a 6.2-liter naturally-aspirated V-8 powerplant.

It pumps out 450ps and more than 60kgm of torque. It also
has custom suspension, 20-inch wheels and Brembo brakes.

This all means that the Camaro SS can really hustle around a race
track and leave more expensive sports cars in the dust.
brandCentral.zh:
第六代Chevy Camaro SS安装有一台6.2L自然进气V8引擎，是一台货
真价实的高性能机器。

它的动力输出最高可超过450ps，而且其前置后驱传动系统
也可以输出高达60kgm的扭矩。

仿佛是对这样的豪华配置还不满足，它甚至还配备了定
制的悬挂系统、20英寸轮胎和Brembo刹车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The sports grade model of the 6th generation Camaro with the 6.2-liter LT1 engine.

The 6th generation model of the Chevy Camaro, America’s legendary sports car, was revealed in the spring of 2015.

The styling followed in the retro-modern design that was highly popular in the market in the last generation. However, the inside of the car received a full makeover. The platform was changed from the "Zeta" platform of the previous model to the "Alpha" platform shared with cars like the Cadillac CTS, but with roughly 70% of its parts developed specifically for the Camaro.

The body utilizes aluminum in various parts, improving the rigidity of the body by 28% and reducing the weight by over 90kg. The suspension mounted on this body was also newly designed, with a multi-link MacPherson strut in the front and a 5 link suspension in the rear.

The biggest news regarding the engine was that a turbocharged 2-liter inline-4 producing 279ps of power and 40.8kgm of torque was added to the lineup. Improvements were also made to the existing 3.6-liter V6, raising both power and torque slightly to 340ps and 39.3kgm respectively. In addition, an LT1 6.2-liter V8, the same engine as in the Corvette, is also available in the lineup, producing 461ps of power and 62.9kgm of torque.

The sports grade model powered by this LT1 is the "SS." It is equipped with 20 inch wheels and Brembo brakes, and in the case of manual transmission models, it comes equipped with active rev matching as well as an optional magnet ride control suspension.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第6代科迈罗的跑车车型，搭载6.2升LT1引擎。

美国传奇跑车雪佛兰科迈罗（雪佛兰科迈罗）的第6代车型于2015年春天正式亮相。

其风格承袭了上一代备受欢迎的现代复古设计，但其内部则彻底改头换面。平台由之前代的“齐塔”平台换为与凯迪拉克CTS等车共用的“阿尔法”平台，但有大约70%的零件是专门为科迈罗打造的。

车身多个部位使用铝制材料，将车身硬度提高了28%，同时还减少了超过90kg的重量。车体搭载的悬挂系统也经过重新设计，前轮装配了麦弗逊多连杆悬架，后轮加装5连杆悬挂。

引擎方面最大的改动在于可选择279ps功率40.8kgm扭矩的2升直列式4汽缸涡轮增压引擎。现有的3.6升V6引擎也得到改进，输出功率与扭矩分别略微提升至340ps和39.3kgm。此外也可选择科尔维特上搭载的、能提供461ps功率和62.9kgm扭矩的LT1 6.2升V8引擎。

搭载LT1引擎的跑车级车型是“SS”，配有20英寸车轮与布雷博刹车；而手动款不仅配备了动态转速匹配系统，还有电磁行车控制悬挂可供选择。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Are you familiar with the term "muscle car?"

They were large American machines from the 1960s known for
their large displacement and enormous power.

The first-generation Camaro Z28 was one of the more notable
models from that era.

Its V-8 engine was developed especially for the Trans Am racing
series, meaning it was highly potent.

Instead having tons of torque like other large-displacement
eengines, it offered plenty of top-end power.

With awesome straight-line speed, the race version of the
Z28 took home several victories in Trans-Am races.

Known as the last of the Z28s, this 1969 model has been
coveted for generations.
dialogues.zh:
你熟悉“肌肉车”吗？

这类车以其大排量和强劲动力而闻名，
是60年代美国跑车文化的典型特征。

第一代Camaro Z28就是在该文化浪潮中诞生的传奇车型之一……

但其专为Trans Am系列赛研发的
V8引擎，也同样令人惊叹。

不像大部分的大排量引擎那样强调扭矩，
而是主打高转速。

不但能在日常行驶中派上用场，还是让Camaro Z28
在Trans Am竞赛获胜的幕后功臣。

这款1969年车型是Z28最后的改款，
其每代车款都令人着迷不已。

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
This is my car!
Seriously, it’s actually in my garage right now.

The 1969 Camaro is a true classic
American muscle car.

The unique grille shape gives the design a wide stance...

... and the character lines on the side of the car gives
this Camaro a feeling of speed.

The most dated area of the design are the wheels.

On my '69 Camaro, I ditched the 14-inch Rally wheels
and installed 17-inch wheels.

It’s a great car to modify, enhance, and race. Trust me, I know.'
dialogues.zh:
它就是我的梦中情车！
不开玩笑，我的车库里现在就停着一辆。

这么说吧，1969 Camaro是纯正血统的美式肌肉车。

其独特的进气格栅设计赋予了它宽阔的车身姿态……

Are you familiar with the term "muscle car?"

They were large American machines from the 1960s known for
their large displacement and enormous power.

The first-generation Camaro Z28 was one of the more notable
models from that era.

Its V-8 engine was developed especially for the Trans Am racing
series, meaning it was highly potent.

Instead having tons of torque like other large-displacement
eengines, it offered plenty of top-end power.

With awesome straight-line speed, the race version of the
Z28 took home several victories in Trans-Am races.

Known as the last of the Z28s, this 1969 model has been
coveted for generations.
conversation.zh:
你熟悉“肌肉车”吗？

这类车以其大排量和强劲动力而闻名，
是60年代美国跑车文化的典型特征。

第一代Camaro Z28就是在该文化浪潮中诞生的传奇车型之一……

但其专为Trans Am系列赛研发的
V8引擎，也同样令人惊叹。

不像大部分的大排量引擎那样强调扭矩，
而是主打高转速。

不但能在日常行驶中派上用场，还是让Camaro Z28
在Trans Am竞赛获胜的幕后功臣。

这款1969年车型是Z28最后的改款，
其每代车款都令人着迷不已。

collection.en:
The 1969 Z28 was the last of the first-generation Camaros
and is considered one of the greatest of them all.

After only three years of production, 700,000 units were sold.

The lineup included 12 different engines,
including inline-6- and V-8-powered variants.

This Z28 represented the top-of-the-line version of
that first-generation model.

It came with a high-revving 5.0-liter V-8,
a 4-speed manual gearbox and power disc brakes.

And the car was distinguished as a Z28 by two wide stripes
that ran the length of its body.

There's an interesting backstory to the Z28's engine, too.

It was actually based on a race engine. The 5.0-liter V-8
was essentially a de-tuned version of the engine...

...originally developed for the Penske Camaro
that competed in the SCCA Trans Am Series.

The Penske Camaro was driven by the legendary American
race driver Mark Donahue.

He won the Trans Am series in both 1968 and 1969.%
collection.zh:
1969 Z28是第一代科迈罗的末期型号，
也被认为是产品线里最出色的车型。

第一代科迈罗仅仅只生产了3年……

它的12种不同引擎配置车型，包括直列6缸
与V8引擎版本，仍销售出了70万辆。

这辆Z28是第一代科迈罗中最典型的代表。

它配备了高转速的5升V8引擎，四速手动变速箱
和效果出众的碟刹……

其经典标志之一便是横穿整个车体的两条宽涂装色带。

哦，它的引擎背后也有一个有趣的小故事。

它实际上是以赛车引擎为基础开发的，
5升引擎的去竞速调校版本。

相当于最初为美国赛车俱乐部泛美系列赛开发，
并搭载到潘斯克科迈罗上参加比赛的那款。

著名的美国赛车手马克·多纳休
曾驾驶一台潘斯克科迈罗……

在1968年和1969年连续两年赢得泛美系列赛。%

vehicleCollection.en:
The Z28 is one of the most popular muscle cars ever, thanks to its good looks and high performance.

The Ford Mustang was a hit compact sports car that took the world by storm. The success of the Mustang was due to its excellent performance, low price, and a effective marketing campaign, so naturally, Ford's main rival, General Motors, was quick to produce a rival. That came in the form of the Chevrolet Camaro that appeared in 1966.

While the Camaro was launched to a plenty of high praise, it could not quite eclipse the sales numbers of the Mustang. So, Chevy decided to up the ante and introduce an even higher-performance version of the car, which it called the Z28. The 302-cu.-in. displacement (5.0 liters) was set to meet the regulations for the Trans-Am racing series. While it did well on the race track, it performed well at dealerships. Chevrolet saw sales of the Camaro increase, thanks to a new halo model that did wonders to the car's image.

The 1969 model is the most popular out of all the Camaros, and the Z28 is the most coveted model, for it truly represents the golden era of American pony cars.
vehicleCollection.zh:
它凭借外观和速度，成为第1代科迈罗系列中最受欢迎的车型。

在那个美国车都信奉“大就是好”、“豪华就是一切”的年代，福特Mustang作为一款紧凑型双门运动跑车却一炮走红。Mustang的成功要归功于高出平均的性能、低廉的价格和完善的广告策略。不过后来有一款车立志要全方位超过Mustang，这就是1966年登场的第1代雪佛兰科迈罗。

它初次上市时吸引了不少关注，但销量并未超过Mustang。为了挽回局面，高性能版的Z28问世了。为符合泛美房车锦标赛的305立方英寸（5000cc）排量标准，它的引擎排量被定为302立方英寸。除了深度调校的引擎，它还拥有一款能让引擎全面发挥性能的底盘。这款为竞速而生的Z28极大提升了科迈罗的竞速形象，也带动了销量。

它在1969年推出的最终车型是科迈罗品牌历史上最受欢迎的车型，也是美国汽车黄金年代的标志。但就算除去这些光环，Z28在各方面也达到了全新的高度，成为很多人梦寐以求的一款车。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
This sixth-generation ZL1 may be the most valuable Camaro
of all time.

Taking its engine from the Corvette Z06, the ZL1 is capable of
an output of over 650ps.

What’s more, this '1LE Package' has been outfitted
for track performance needs.

Incredibly, it completed a lap of the Nürburgring
Nordschleife in 7:16:04!

That's a super-car-level time, mind you!

And yet it's about 1/3 the price of your average super car,
meaning it offers more bang for your buck!
dialogues.zh:
这款第六代ZL1可能有史以来最有价值的Camaro车型了。

ZL1搭载的引擎来自Corvette Z06，能产生超过650ps的功率。

配备了专为赛道性能需求打造的
“1LE套件”。

令人难以置信的是，它以7:16:04的成绩跑完了
纽博格林北侧单圈赛道！

要知道，这可是超跑级别的成绩！

然而，其价格仅是寻常超跑的1/3，
绝对带给你极高的性价比！

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
Everything about The Camaro ZL1 says speed and power.
It’s practically a weapon on wheels.

From its overall stance to its many functional splitters,
wings, and air intakes, this car is track ready!

And the ZL1 Camaro has a wider track
than other Camaros.

Its dark bonnet, grille, headlamps, and full-width splitter
give this car a wide, sinister appearance.

In two-tone colouring, it's all business. Period!
dialogues.zh:
这辆Camaro ZL1的一切设计目的都是为了速度和力量，
它简直就是一件安上了轮子的武器！

从它的整体姿态到各种功能性的定风翼、尾翼和进气口，
都在告诉你——这辆车完全是为赛道打造的！

这辆Camaro ZL1拥有比其他的Camaro型号更宽的轮距。

涂黑的引擎盖、格栅、车头灯和车身等宽定风翼，
让它显得更狰狞、更具威胁性。

它还通过这种撞色设计表明了态度——不废话，只为胜利！

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of the sixth-generation Camaro lived up to the hype, thanks in part to its 659ps LT1 engine.

The sixth-generation Chevrolet Camaro was largely an evolution of the previous model, which effectively combined elements of the original car with modern-day design cues. While its dimensions remained relatively unchanged, the new model weighed in approximately 100kg lighter, making it quicker and more agile than ever before.

The most powerful model in the 2018 Camaro lineup was the ZL1, which came equipped with the LT4 engine, a 5.7-liter V8 lifted from the Corvette Z06. It produced 659ps and 89.8kgm of torque, allowing the pony car to run from 0 to <100km/h> in 3.5 seconds and reach a top speed of <318km/h>.

Chevrolet also offered the “1LE” performance package (as it had since the third-generation model), which gave the car even higher performance. For the 2018 model, this package included a large deflector, a rear wing, a diffuser, a dedicated suspension system, and specially developed tires. The 2018 Camaro Z1 with the 1LE package lapped the Nürburgring in 7 minutes 16.04 seconds, greatly surpassing the performance of your average supercar.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第6代科迈罗的巅峰之作，其装配的LT1引擎可实现659ps的动力，在纽博格林赛道上表现突出。

第6代雪佛兰科迈罗在第5代的基础上进一步现代化，新的时尚复古造型令其广受赞誉。为了提高运动性能，整车重量减少了约100kg。

这一产品线上最强悍的车型莫过于ZL1。它采用了科尔维特Z06的LT4 5.7升V8引擎，输出功率为659ps，扭矩为89.8kgm，0-<100km/h>加速仅需3.5秒，最高速度达<318km/h>。

从第3代车型开始，雪佛兰推出了1LE性能升级包，进一步提升了科迈罗的性能。对于这款2017年公布、2018年发售的车型，它的升级包包含一块大型导流板、尾翼、扩散器、专属悬挂系统，以及专门研发的轮胎。在德国纽博格林赛道，加装了升级包的科迈罗Z1取得了7分16.04秒的好成绩，表现远超一般超跑。

catch.en: This version of the sixth-generation Camaro lived up to the hype, thanks in part to its 659ps LT1 engine.
catch.zh: 第6代科迈罗的巅峰之作，其装配的LT1引擎可实现659ps的动力，在纽博格林赛道上表现突出。

long.en:
The sixth-generation Chevrolet Camaro was largely an evolution of the previous model, which effectively combined elements of the original car with modern-day design cues. While its dimensions remained relatively unchanged, the new model weighed in approximately 100kg lighter, making it quicker and more agile than ever before.

The most powerful model in the 2018 Camaro lineup was the ZL1, which came equipped with the LT4 engine, a 5.7-liter V8 lifted from the Corvette Z06. It produced 659ps and 89.8kgm of torque, allowing the pony car to run from 0 to <100km/h> in 3.5 seconds and reach a top speed of <318km/h>.

Chevrolet also offered the “1LE” performance package (as it had since the third-generation model), which gave the car even higher performance. For the 2018 model, this package included a large deflector, a rear wing, a diffuser, a dedicated suspension system, and specially developed tires. The 2018 Camaro Z1 with the 1LE package lapped the Nürburgring in 7 minutes 16.04 seconds, greatly surpassing the performance of your average supercar.

dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
Building on Chaparral’s history of innovation, the Chaparral
2X expresses an incredible vision of futurity.

True, it’s a major departure from the Chaparral 2J...

But it’s no less radical in its mission.

With wingsuit technology serving as its inspiration,
the Chaparral 2X exhibits unique proportions...

And incorporates moving aerodynamic parts
throughout.

All of its design elements work together...

To give it a dynamic look, even when it’s standing still.

The execution of all of the surfaces and the attention
to detail are truly stunning.
dialogues.zh:
Chaparral 2X是Chaparral车系创新史的继承者，
造型设计充满未来感。

毋庸置疑，它的造型和Chaparral 2J截然不同……

但追逐极限的使命被延续了下来。

以翼装技术为灵感，Chaparral 2X的车身表现出独特的比例……

并在整个车身融入了可动空气动力学部件。

所有设计元素融合到一起后，赋予了它极富动感的外观。

即便静止不动，依然让人感到冲劲与跃动。

另外，他们对车身表面的处理
和对细节的执着都令人叹服。

brandCentral.en:
Chaparral was a maverick company that shook the racing world
in the 1960s.

Time and time again, they pulled off unique feats of
engineering, producing some truly unique race cars.

The Chevrolet Chaparral 2X Vision Gran Turismo is a tribute
to the Chaparral of decades past.

It doesn't just have an unusual body—everything about this
car defies convention!

For starters, it's powered by an innovative laser-based
propulsion system.

And its unusual configuration, which places the driver in a
face-down position, was inspired by the MotoGP experience.

The spirit of Jim Hall, founder of Chaparral, is truly
embodied in this audacious masterpiece!
brandCentral.zh:
Chaparral是一家特立独行的公司，曾在20世纪60年代震撼整个
赛车界。

他们一次又一次地完成了绝无仅有的工程壮举，生产出一
批真正独特的赛车。

Chevrolet Chaparral 2X Vision Gran Turismo是对
Chaparral过去数十年历史的致敬之作。

不止是车身不同寻常——此车的一切都在打破惯例！

首先，此车由创新的激光推进系统提供动力，

而其将驾驶员置于面朝下位置的非常规布局则受到MotoGP的
启发。

Chaparral创始人Jim Hall的创新精神在这件大胆的杰作中得到了真
正的体现。

vehicleCollection.en:
Experience rocket-like speed produced by laser pulse shock waves!

Conceived as a "Garage 56" Le Mans Experimental Prototype, the Chevrolet Chaparral 2X Vision Gran Turismo is a look into the future of motorsports and inspired by the combined sensations of flying in a wing suit and a Moto GP race bike... an experience where the 2X pilot flies around the circuit, headlong, just inches from the race surface. The 2X’s Chevrolet power unit is unlike anything seen on the track before... it literally thrusts itself down the track with laser pulse shock waves generated by an advanced propulsion system from Chevrolet.

The driving position creates one of the most immersive and exciting experiences ever imagined in four wheel motorsports. The vehicle architecture and design take its shape as a result of the "forward flight" driving position, one where the pilot becomes at one with the structure of the car. Once on board, with the canopy retracted to the closed position, the 2X forms a totally unique envelope around the pilot’s outstretched body. Hand and foot controls operate independently and involve all of the frictionless, magnetic bearing wheels. Vehicle acceleration, deceleration and direction is controlled by the movement & physical inputs of the 2X pilot, a true application of four points of control. Braking is handled by a combination of Brembo magnetic re-gen calipers and deployable AeroBrake panels in the 2X bodywork.

The integral BodyFrame is created using a unique "layup schedule" which allows the entire structure to act in unison with the 2X suspension. The main body also incorporates the super-ridged propulsion structure which ensures absolute accuracy of the thrust parabola to the laser pulse cone. The variable positioning of the thrust cone vanes serve to create propulsion and downforce by the simultaneous use of this multi-vane adjustability and a lower Thrut Vectoring panel. The combination of these two technologies allows the Caparral 2X pilot to fine tune downforce to the exact spot on a given cicuit, atually "pressing" the tire’s contact atch onto the track urface and enhancing mechanicalgrip where needed most.

The hevrolet Chaprral 2X Vision ran Turismo. The spirit of Jim Hall’s amazing legacy of motorsport innovation embdied in a bold statement. Oe which will revolutionie th future of Le Mans Eerimental prttyves. Lile nothing yo’ve ewer seen or had before.
vehicleCollection.zh:
体会激光脉冲震荡波带来的火箭般的速度！

在最初的构想中，雪佛兰Chaparral 2X Vision Gran Turismo是勒芒“格拉吉56”组的试验原型车。这款车是对未来赛车运动的展望，而其灵感源自身着翼装飞翔以及驾驶莫托GP摩托的感受……旨在打造一种车手低着头，紧贴赛道地面飞行的体验。2X采用的雪佛兰动力单元和以往我们在赛车上见到的都截然不同……打个比喻，就像是雪佛兰先进的推进系统产生的激光脉冲震荡波驱动着赛车在赛道上飞驰。

置身驾驶席，驾驶者将享受到四轮赛车运动史上前所未有的代入感和刺激体验。车辆的构造和设计使得驾驶位置“前倾”，从而使车手与车体结构融为一体。进入2X座舱后，座舱盖会收缩闭合，形成一个包裹住车手伸展躯体的特殊空间。手脚部的控制器全部采用无摩擦磁轴承轮，可分别独立操作。这款车采用了货真价实的四点控制技术，加减速和转向均由车手的动作与物理输入来控制。刹车通过布雷博磁性再生控制卡钳搭配车体上的展开式气动刹车板实现。

整个车架采用独特的“叠涂法“工艺制作，使整车结构得以与2X悬挂系统协同运作。车辆主体骨架中也加入了超高刚度的推进结构，保证激光脉冲圆锥体的推力抛物线拥有绝对的精度。推力圆锥叶片的可变位置通过调整多个叶片和下方的推力引导板来产生推进力和下压力。这两项技术的结合，让Chaparral 2X的车手可以针对特定赛道上的特定位置精确微调下压力，使轮胎的接地面紧紧“压”在赛道路面上，加强薄弱环节的机械抓地力。

雪佛兰Chaparral 2X Vision Gran Turismo以大胆的方式体现了吉姆·霍尔长久以来对于赛车革新的追求。此车
会为未来的勒芒实验原型车带来史无前例的变革。

dialogues.en:
The 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS is one of the most masculine
cars of the muscle-car era.

Everything about it says 'power', from its bulging shapes
to its muscular fenders...

To its power-dome, cowl-induction bonnet.

I liken the big-block Chevelle SS
to an animal ready to pounce.
dialogues.zh:
这辆1970款Chevrolet Chevelle SS是肌肉车黄金时代
最富肌肉感的车型之一。

从它壮硕的车身轮廓到粗犷的挡泥板……

再到向上隆起、采用风帽导气设计的引擎盖，
每个细节无不散发出一种“动力澎湃”的感觉。

我会将这款大排量的Chevelle SS
比作一只蓄势待发的猛兽。

collection.en:
The 1970 Chevrolet Chevelle SS was Chevrolet's mid-size
muscle car.

The optional LS6 engine provided plenty of performance,
even for a car as big as this.

The 7.4-liter 454 engine was given increased compression,
high-lift cams and special cylinder heads.

Its power rating of 450 HP was likely the highest
catalogued output for any American car at the time.

It was an incredible street machine that could easily surpass
500 HP with very little tuning.
collection.zh:
1970年问世的Chevrolet Chevelle SS是Chevrolet的一款
中型肌肉车，

可选装的大排量LS6引擎提供充沛的动力。

Chevrolet将7.4升的排量发动机的压缩，
与高升程凸轮和特制气缸盖配合，

给出了高达456ps的官方数据。这或许是所有美国车中纸面
动力最高的车了。

这是一辆令人难以置信的公路车，只需稍许调校，就能
让功率输出轻松超越500ps。

vehicleCollection.en:
A massive engine that produced plenty of power made this car a favorite for drag racing.

Introduced as a 1964 model, the Chevelle was Chevrolet's first mid-size model. With an SS sports variant in the lineup, and an option for a 327 cu.-in. high-output V-8 engine, the Chevelle possessed all the hallmarks of a muscle car.

In 1965, the Chevelle SS was transformed into a full-blown high-performance car, equipped with a 396 cu.-in. OHV V-8. From then on, the Chevelle SS was only offered with this 396 cu.-in. unit, drawing a clear line between it and the previous SS.

In 1970, the Chevelle SS was called the most powerful mid-size car in the marketplace. The base engine had been upgraded to 402 cu. in., and the higher grade 427 cu. in. engine was upgraded to 454 cu. in.

The codenames for the two 454 cu.-in.-equipped models were the LS5 and LS6. The former produced 360ps, with a compression ratio of 10.25:1. The latter doled out approximately 456ps, with an increased compression ratio of 11.25:1. It also came with high cams and high-flow headers. This was the most powerful production-model engine in the history of American cars at the time.

The LS6-equipped Chevelle SS 454 was immediately recognized as a very special model, with its high power output that surpassed many road-legal cars. Equipped with a straight exhaust and carburetor settings, it was said to have easily exceeded 500ps and became a force in stock class drag races.

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Ah, 1953—an unforgettable year! That was the year that gave
us the "C1," or first-gen Chevrolet Corvette.

And so began the age of mass-production sports cars
in the United States of America.

While sports cars were already stateside, they were mostly
European—and if not, they were rare and costly.

In other words, a truly "American" sports car had yet to be born.

Then General Motors released the Chevrolet Corvette.

From 1953 on, this roofless 2-seater pretty much underwent
yearly upgrades, each time promising more and more power.

This C1 Corvette is from 1958, and is well-known
for its major design overhaul.

Two headlights became four, and the hood was given
a number of fake louvres.

By the time 1960 rolled around, GM was selling many C1s,
a sign of its enduring popularity.

To this day, the Corvette remainssynonymous with
American sports car culture...

...making it one of the most important sports cars
in automotive history.
dialogues.zh:
啊，1953——令人难忘的一年！
在这一年，“C1”，也就是第一代的雪佛兰科尔维特诞生了。

这也标志着美国量产跑车时代的开端。

虽然当时跑车在美国已不少见，但这些跑车大多数来自欧洲。
而非欧洲跑车车型就更加凤毛麟角，而且价格高昂了。

换句话说，真正“美国”产的跑车还没有诞生。

就在此时，通用汽车发布了雪佛兰科尔维特。

从1953年开始，这辆无顶双座跑车几乎每年都要进行更新，
而且每次的动力都变得愈发强大。

这辆C1科尔维特来自1958年，因其设计上的重大更改而闻名。

两枚大灯增加到四枚，引擎盖上增加了几处伪百叶格栅。

到了1960年，通用汽车的C1产量仍然可观，可见该车型
经久不衰的人气。
直至今日，科尔维特仍然是美国跑车文化的代名词……

这令它成为了汽车历史上最重要的跑车之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
The origin of the American sports car: the glorious first-generation Corvette.

It wasn't until 1953 until America produced its first real sports car. Until then, U.S. roads were replete with stylish, nimble European sports cars imported en masse after World War II. But everything changed when General Motors produced the Chevrolet Corvette.

The new American sports car boasted cutting-edge technology, including fiberglass body panels and a steel backbone frame. It was powerful too, equipped with a 152ps 3.8-liter inline-6 mounted in the 4249mm long, 1773mm wide body. All 1953 Vettes were handmade and only 300 examples were produced.

When this first batch sold out almost instantly, GM set up a new factory in St. Louis the following year to meet demand. As a result, 3,640 Corvettes went into customers' hands that year, 10 times more than the previous year.

While the 1954 model was essentially the same as the original, midway through the model year, the cam profile was changed, and engine output increased to 155ps. In 1958, the Corvette had its first significant facelift, highlighted by a four-headlight front end.
vehicleCollection.zh:
美国跑车的起源，光荣的第一代科尔维特。

在1953年初，美国还没能制造出称得上是“真正”跑车的汽车。当时的美国跑车市场被二战后进口的欧洲跑车所占据。为了改变这一局面，通用汽车在他们的雪佛兰品牌下发布了跑车科尔维特。

第一台科尔维特诞生于1953年。纤维增强塑料面板与钢制骨架的结合让这款车的造型极具科技感和未来感，一举奠定了其作为“美国制造”跑车的地位。长4249mm、宽1773mm的车身中安装了一台152ps、3.8升直列6缸引擎。当年生产的科尔维特几乎全都是手工打造，因此只生产了300辆。

看到最初的300辆汽车瞬间售罄后，通用汽车在第二年，即1954年，将工厂从密歇根州搬到了圣路易斯，并准备进行大规模生产。这一年，他们的产量是上一年的10倍，达到3640辆。

1954款车型的规格与首发款基本相同，但中途他们改变了凸轮外形，令引擎的输出功率提高到了155ps。到了1958款车型，前格栅和车尾的外观设计都有所调整，不过最显著的变化当属新设计的双联圆形头灯。

The daunting Stingray moniker was resurrected with the seventh-generation Chevrolet Corvette.

In 2013, the much-anticipated 7th-generation Corvette was introduced as a 2014 model. What made this car stand out from previous iterations of America’s sports car was that it wore the Stingray badge, which had previously been bestowed upon only the best of the best.

Like the 1963 Sting Ray, the new 'Vette featured cutting-edge technologies, head-turning styling, and heart-pounding performance. With 461ps and 63.6kgm of torque —the optional Performance Exhaust model got you 466ps and 64.3kgm of torque — it’s the most powerful Corvette to date. With the available Z51 Performance Package, the new Stingray ran from 0-60 mph in 3.8 seconds, and showed equally awesome stopping power, coming to a halt from 60 mph in 107 feet. It handled like an exotic, registering 1.03g on the skidpad. Put all those attributes together and the 2014 Corvette Stingray lapped Virginia International Raceway's (VIR) 4.2-mile “Grand Course” in a blistering 2:51.78.

The new Corvette Stingray was built atop an all-new aluminum frame structure and chassis, and powered by a new engine with a slew of cutting-edge technologies. Because the car was developed as a convertible, both the coupe and open-air versions shared the same structure, powertrain, and performance technologies.

Highlights include:

Advanced driver technologies, including a five-position Drive Mode Selector that tailors 12 vehicle attributes to fit the driver's environment, as well as a new 7-speed manual transmission with Active Rev Matching, which anticipates gear selections and matches engine speed for perfect shifts every time.

An all-new 6.2 L LT1 aluminum V-8 engine that combines advanced technologies, including direct injection, Active Fuel Management, continuously variable-valve timing, and an advanced combustion system that delivers mre power while using less fuel.

long.en:
In 2013, the much-anticipated 7th-generation Corvette was introduced as a 2014 model. What made this car stand out from previous iterations of America’s sports car was that it wore the Stingray badge, which had previously been bestowed upon only the best of the best.

With 461ps and 63.6kgm of torque —the optional Performance Exhaust model got you 466ps and 64.3kgm of torque — it’s the most powerful Corvette to date. With the available Z51 Performance Package, the new Stingray ran from 0-60 mph in 3.8 seconds, and showed equally awesome stopping power, coming to a halt from 60 mph in 107 feet. It handled like an exotic, registering 1.03g on the skidpad. Put all those attributes together and the 2014 Corvette Stingray lapped Virginia International Raceway's (VIR) 4.2-mile “Grand Course” in a blistering 2:51.78.

The new Corvette Stingray was built atop an all-new aluminum frame structure and chassis, and powered by a new engine with a slew of cutting-edge technologies. Because the car was developed as a convertible, both the coupe and open-air versions shared the same structure, powertrain, and performance technologies.

Advanced driver technologies, including a five-position Drive Mode Selector that tailors 12 vehicle attributes to fit the driver's environment, as well as a new 7-speed manual transmission with Active Rev Matching, which anticipates gear selections and matches engine speed for perfect shifts every time.

long.en:
In 2013, the much-anticipated 7th-generation Corvette was introduced as a 2014 model. What made this car stand out from previous iterations of America’s sports car was that it wore the Stingray badge, which had previously been bestowed upon only the best of the best.

Like the 1963 Sting Ray, the new 'Vette featured cutting-edge technologies, head-turning styling and heart-pounding performance. With 461ps and 63.6kgm of torque — the optional Performance Exhaust model got you 466ps and 64.3kgm of torque — it’s the most powerful Corvette to date. With the available Z51 Performance Package, the new Stingray ran from 0-60 mph in 3.8 seconds, and showed equally awesome stopping power, coming to a halt from 60 mph in 107 feet. It handled like an exotic, registering 1.03g on the skidpad. Put all those attributes together and the 2014 Corvette Stingray lapped Virginia International Raceway's (VIR) 4.2-mile “Grand Course” in a blistering 2:51.78.

The new Corvette Stingray was built atop an all-new aluminum frame structure and chassis, and powered by a new engine with a slew of cutting-edge technologies. Because the car was developed as a convertible, both the coupe and open-air versions shared the same structure, powertrain and performance technologies.

Highlights include:

Advanced driver technologies, including a five-position Drive Mode Selector that tailors 12 vehicle attributes to fit the driver's environment, as well as a new 7-speed manual transmission with Active Rev Matching, which anticipates gear selections and matches engine speed for perfect shifts every time.

An all-new 6.2 L LT1 aluminum V-8 engine that combines advanced technologies, including direct injection, Active Fuel Management, continuously variable-valve timing, and an advanced combustion system that delivers moe power while using less fuel.

Lightweight materials, including a carbn-fiber hood and roof panel; composite fenders, doors and rear quarter anels; arbon-nano composite underbody panels, nd a new aluminum frme that helps shift weight rearard to achieve near 50/5 weigh balance.

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Here we have a seventh-generation Corvette,
or "C7" for short.

If I'm not mistaken, the C7 made its debut in 2013,
at the North American International Auto Show.

And seeing as how the original Corvette was born in 1953…

...the timing of its release lined up nicely with the Corvette's
60th anniversary.

Even in its basic package, the C7 boasted a powerful
race car engine.

You won't find any European sports car that delivers
so much "bang" for the buck.

If you ask me, I'd say it's a real deal for a sports car!
dialogues.zh:
这是一台第七代Corvette——
简称“C7”。

如果我没记错的话，C7的首次露面是在2013年的底特律车展上。

1953年是初代Corvette诞生的年份……

这辆车亮相的日子正好是那款车的60周年纪念日。

C7连基本版都搭载了一台强劲的赛车引擎。

用同样的价钱，你绝对找不到能出这么大力的欧洲产跑车。

要我说，对于一款跑车而言，这辆车绝对物超所值！

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
The C7 Corvette was inspired by the rich history
of Stingray designs.

That said, it expressed more athleticism in its execution
of those designs.

The entire body is like that of a stingray fish, with its
undulating surfaces and instantly recognizable slope.

And don't forget that piercing front end.

Its bold hood is shrink-wrapped
around a powerful V-8.

Also, its many air intakes and vents manage the flow of
air throughout its incredibly sleek design.?
dialogues.zh:
C7 Corvette的设计从Stingray过往车型的丰富历史中
获取了灵感，

并且在运动感方面取得了突破。

整台车的造型好像一条黄貂鱼，
有着棱角分明的前脸设计……

以及起伏的车身表面和令人过目不忘的倾斜线条。

在隆起的引擎盖下包裹着一台强大的V8引擎，

而无处不在的进气口和风道则巧妙地将气流
导向纤细流畅的车身四周。

long.en:
An all-new seventh generation Corvette emerged in 2013 as a 2014 model, once again wearing the Stingray name. Only a Corvette with the perfect balance of technology, design and performance can wear the iconic Stingray designation.

Like the '63 Sting Ray, the best Corvettes embodied performance leadership, delivering cutting-edge technologies, breathtaking design and awe-inspiring driving experiences. The all-new, 2014 Corvette Stingray continues that tradition, by leveraging modern advancements in design, technology and engineering.

The 2014 Corvette Stingray is the most powerful standard model ever, with 455 HP/460 ft-lb of torque (460 HP/465 ft-lb with optional Performance Exhaust). It is also the most capable standard model ever. Equipped with the available Z51 Performance Package, the new Stingray is capable of accelerating from 0 to 60 mph in 3.8 seconds, braking from 60 to 0 in 107 feet, and sustaining 1.03 g in cornering. Cumulatively, the acceleration, cornering and braking capability of the Corvette Stingray enable it to lap the Virginia International Raceway's (VIR) 4.2-mile “Grand Course” in 2:51.78.

The all-new Corvette Stingray shares only two parts with the previous generation. It incorporates an all-new aluminum frame structure and chassis, a new powertrain and supporting technologies, as well as completely new exterior and interior designs. The Stingray was designed as an open car from the outset, so both coupe and convertible share the same structure, powertrain and performance technologies.

Advanced driver technologies, including a five-position Drive Mode Selector that tailors 12 vehicle attributes to the fit the driver's environment and a new seven-speed manual transmission with Active Rev Matching that anticipates gear selections and matches engine peed for perfect shifts every time.

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
The C7 ZR1 Corvette is the ultimate expression of a
front-engine Corvette's power and bold design.

The ZR1 is sometimes known as ‘The Widebody’.

It’s significantly wider than a standard Corvette Stingray
in order to accommodate its massive tyres.

The ZR1 has very significant air intakes and air exits.

These manage the flow of air and feed the many coolers
in the nose and tail of the car.

Most people love the rear wing.

But I prefer the smaller rear spoiler that was also
available..
dialogues.zh:
这辆C7 ZR1 Corvette是前置引擎Corvette那强大性能
和粗犷设计的终极例证。

这辆ZR1有时也被爱称为“The Widebody”（宽车身）。

为了容纳那套巨大的轮胎，它比
标准款Corvette Stingray要宽出许多。

ZR1同样还配备了巨大的进气口和出气口……

用于引导气流，为车头和车尾的散热器提供风冷降温。

许多人都很喜欢它的尾翼。

不过我个人更喜欢配备尺寸更小的后扰流板。[

brandCentral.en:
The ZR1 is the top of the C7 Corvette range, and an all-time
achievement in FR Corvette construction.

It features a huge supercharged 6.2L V8 engine.

And that engine provides a ton of power: over 750ps,
in fact, along with 98.8kgm of torque.

It also comes with custom front and rear bumpers, and a
large rear spoiler.

The chassis is Chevrolet's finest achievement to date,
and is aerodynamically balanced to perfection.
brandCentral.zh:
这款ZR1是C7 Corvette产品线中最高档的一款，也是所有Corvette
前置后驱车中的最高成就。

它拥有一台体积庞大的机器增压6.2L V8引擎，

可以输出高达750ps的强劲马力，而扭矩也达到了98.8kgm。

它还安装了定制的前后保险杠和一部大型后扰流板。

其底盘应用了Chevrolet迄今为止最先进的科技成果，在空气动
力学方面也达到了完美的平衡。

vehicleCollection.en:
One of the last of the C7 Corvettes and also the most powerful.

The ZR1 is the ultimate-performance version of the Chevrolet Corvette. The seventh-generation C7 Corvettes already had an impressive lineup that included the sporty Z51 and the powerful Z06, but in 2018, as the generation neared its end, the mightiest C7 of all was released in the form of the ZR1.

The ZR1 featured a supercharged 6.2-liter V-8 called the LT5. It was similar in construction to the 659ps LT4 engine in the Z06, but a larger supercharger and the addition of GM's first dual-injection system allowed it to pump out an impressive 765ps and 98.8kgm of torque, which represented a 10-percent increase in output.

The car's aerodynamic parts were developed in conjunction with Pratt & Miller Engineering, known for building racing Corvettes for GT competition. Every component of the car was designed for performance. For example, two different rear wings were developed for the ZR1, one for maximum speed and the other for the fast lap times. When the car was optimized for maximum speed, it was capable of reaching <345.8km/h>.!
vehicleCollection.zh:
C7科尔维特的最后一批车型之一，也是性能最强大的车款。!

ZR1作为雪佛兰科尔维特的高性能版本而闻名于世。第七代C7科尔维特原本就拥有了令人印象深刻的豪华阵容，包括运动型的Z51和动力强劲的Z06，但在2018年，随着这一代产品的寿命接近尾声，最强大的C7终于以ZR1的形态横空出世。

ZR1采用了6.2升V8 LT5机械增压引擎。它的结构与Z06搭载的659ps881牛·米（89.84kgm）的LT4引擎相似，但增压器的容量继续扩大，再加上通用汽车的首个双喷嘴系统，使它能够输出765ps的动力和969牛·米（98.8kgm）的扭矩——性能增加了10%以上。

该车的空气动力学部件是与普拉特与米勒工程公司共同开发的新品，后者因设计制造了用于参加超跑比赛的科尔维特赛车而闻名。他们的关注点始终只有性能——例如，他们为ZR1开发了两种不同的尾翼，一款专为达到最高时速设计，另一款则是为了实现最快的单圈时间。当车辆以最高速度为目标接受优化后，它能够达到<345.8km/h>的极速。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
On the centennial running of the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2023...

...a mid-engine race car claimed a brilliant victory
in the GT AM class...

...an achievement that forever redefined the legacy of
America’s sports car, the Chevrolet Corvette.

Its name—the C8—marked it as the eighth generation of
the storied Corvette.

It was also the first production model to break from tradition,
abandoning the front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout...

...in favor of a mid-engine design transforming the
character of the car.

It proved to be a wise move, as the mid-engine Corvette has since
become a formidable presence in GT racing worldwide.
dialogues.zh:
在2023年勒芒24小时耐力赛百年庆典之际……

这款中置引擎赛车在GT AM组别
取得了辉煌胜利……

极大地改变了“美国跑车”——Chevrolet Corvette的
历史进程。

“C8”彰显了它作为这款标志性车型
第八代产品的身份。

这是首款摒弃传统前置引擎后轮驱动
布局的量产Corvette……

它转而将引擎置于车身中部！

这一明智之举显然取得了成功，因为中置引擎的Corvette
自此成为众多GT赛事中不可小觑的力量。

This eighth-generation C8 certainly took the world by surprise
as the first Corvette to come with a mid-engine layout.

Since the birth of the Vette in 1953, the famed model
had always taken the form as a FR sports car.

While engineers toyed with the possibility of a mid-engine
Corvette since the 1960s...

...it wasn’t until this C8 that they were able to make
this dream a reality.

Combining a naturally-aspirated 6.2-liter V-8 engine
and an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission...

...the new Vette continues tradition with a fire-breathing
traditional OHV powerplant.
brandCentral.zh:
第八代C8做出了出人意料的选择，
带来Corvette系列首款采用中置布局的车型。

自1953年首辆Corvette诞生以来，这一声名斐然的
美国跑车品牌一直保持着前置后驱布局。

虽然工程师们自二十世纪六十年代以来一直不温不火地
尝试打造中置引擎Corvette……

但这一梦想直到C8问世后才变为现实。

此车装备了一台6.2升自然吸气V8引擎，
搭配8速双离合变速箱……

沿用传统的顶置气门底置凸轮轴，使得C8的声浪和气势
感觉都与原本的Corvette一般纯粹。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new generation mid-engine Corvette.

The car often called "America's sports car," the Chevrolet Corvette, saw a drastic change to its layout in 2019. That year came the eighth-generation iteration, which had its powerplant mounted behind the cockpit, making it the first MR Corvette in its history.

The new engine location was evident upon first glance of the car. The Corvette's iconic long nose is now absent, as the cabin was moved far forward, resulting in proportions of a classic mid-engine sports car. Without an engine, the front section serves as a luggage compartment to go along with luggage area behind the engine that's big enough to store a small golf bag.

The car's V-8 engine is a new-generation small-block LT2 developed from the previous generation model C7's LT1 engine. With 6.2 liters of displacement, it produces 502ps/65.0kgm and also features fuel saving features like cylinder deactivation. The only transmission available for the new Corvette is an 8-speed dual-clutch automatic with paddle shifters allowing drivers to select gears manually. The suspension system consists of double wishbones at all four corners with a height adjustable capability to tackle various road surfaces and for aerodynamic purposes.

The driver-centered cockpit features a multifunctional infotainment system with an 8-inch touchscreen. With the engine bay moved to the rear of the cabin, the new generation Corvette has shown itself to be a contender with exceptional performance in GT car racing.
vehicleCollection.zh:
全新一代中置布局科尔维特。

作为全美国产跑车的头号代言人，雪佛兰科尔维特在2019年发生了历史性的变化。第八代科尔维特在这一年推出，并首次采用了中置布局。

这一极富革新性的变化从外观上就能一眼看出来——雪佛兰那标志性的长车鼻不复存在，驾驶舱前移后，整个车身更符合经典的中置布局轮廓。挪走引擎后的前备箱现在改为了储物空间，而引擎后方也有一个足以放下高尔夫球袋的储物区。

作为车辆心脏的V8引擎是一款新一代小缸体LT2，基于前一代C7型号的LT1引擎开发而来。它的排量仍为6.2升，可以输出502ps/65.0kgm的动力与扭矩，此外还采用了例如停缸技术之类的燃油节能功能。这一代的变速箱只留下了8速双离合自动挡一种，不过你还是可以通过安装于方向盘后的换挡拨片来进行手动换挡。悬挂系统则采用了前后双叉臂结构，并结合车头高度抬升系统，可以轻松应对高路缘和其他障碍物。

其以驾驶员为中心的驾驶座包含了一套多功能信息娱乐系统，通过一块8英寸触摸屏进行控制。在将引擎室移动到座舱后部之后，这款新一代科尔维特也在超级跑车领域展现出了卓越的性能，成为一名有力的竞争者。?

brandCentral.en:
The Chevrolet Corvette is, without a doubt, an icon
of American sports car design.

And driving the legendary ‘Vette into the future is
this electrically-powered hypercar, the CX Concept.

Look at its Coke-bottle body, or the slope of its roof...
Doesn’t it remind you of the great Corvettes of old?

Naturally, its styling is rooted in aerodynamic principles,
resulting in marvellous performance on road and track.

But the best part is its novel fan-powered downforce system,
which ensures optimal aerodynamic balance across the car.

An all-wheel-drive electrified car, its 2,000 horsepower
are provided by four electric motors.

Big and bold, it’s a car that’s sure to carry the Corvette
spirit into a new era!
brandCentral.zh:
Chevrolet Corvette毫无疑问是
美国跑车设计的经典象征。

而引领传奇的Corvette驶入未来的正是这款
电动终极跑车——CX Concept。

面对那可乐瓶造型的车身，还有车顶的流线倾斜角度……
你是否会回想起那些经典的老Corvette？

它的造型自然地融入了空气动力学设计理念，
无论在公路还是赛道上都能展现卓越性能。

最精彩的是它的创新风扇下压力系统，
确保了整车的最佳空气动力学平衡。

作为全轮驱动的电力跑车，其四台电机提供了
2000马力的澎湃动力。

大气磅礴、大胆创新，这绝对是一款能将Corvette
精神传承到新时代的汽车！

vehicleCollection.en:
An electric hypercar that offered a glimpse into the future of the Corvette.

The Corvette CX Concept remained unmistakably a Corvette to its core. Engineered for both street and circuit, the Corvette CX Concept represented a futuristic vision of an electrified Corvette hypercar.

From its athletic proportions and aggressive, lunging profile to the cockpit tucked between muscular haunches, every line and surface served a purpose. The design was clean yet purposeful, with refined surfaces flowing seamlessly into a visible structural framework, while the interior prioritized lightness and driver-focused functionality.

The CX Concept featured active aerodynamics, with movable front and rear elements and a finely sculpted underbody, which delivered efficiency on the open road and the race track. A fan-based downforce system with thrust vectoring enabled precise aerodynamic balance between the front and rear. As an all-wheel-drive machine, the CX Concept housed four e-motors integrated into the RESS understructure, delivering more than 2,000 horsepower.[
vehicleCollection.zh:
令人窥见Corvette未来的电动终极跑车。

Corvette CX Concept无疑承载着纯正的Corvette血统。以兼顾街道与赛道的设计理念展现了电动化Corvette终极跑车的未来愿景。

从运动化的车身比例和前倾的动感轮廓，到嵌入力量十足的后轮拱之间的驾驶舱，从简洁精致的车身表面到一体化的可视底盘结构，再到轻量化处理的超实用内饰设计——每一处细节都经过精心雕琢，完全以驾驶者为核心。

CX融合了主动空气动力学技术，包括可调节的前后空力组件和优化的底盘几何设计，既能在街道行驶中提供高效性能，又能在赛道上展现卓越表现。配备推力矢量控制的风扇下压力系统，实现了前后空气动力学的完美平衡。采用全轮驱动系统，四台电机集成到可靠性工程与系统安全底盘结构中，输出功率超过2000马力。

cars.nameEn: Chevrolet Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept
cars.nameZh: Chevrolet Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept

brandCentral.sourceName: Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept
brandCentral.en:
The CX Concept is an electric hypercar that is meant
to carry the legendary Corvette line into the future.

Among its variants is the CX.R Vision Gran Turismo,
a beast that was built to defy the rules of the road.

Developed specifically for track use, it's lighter and more
aerodynamic than its sibling.

Powering its heart are three motors and a twin-turbo V8
that runs on e-fuel, perfect for range and endurance racing.

The car’s interior has been primed for competition, with
minute considerations made for cornering and steering.

Seen from the outside, its yellow and black coat harken
back to its GT racing pedigree.

The ultimate high-performance model, the CX.R is sure
to mark a new era of racing glory for the legendary ‘Vet
brandCentral.zh:
CX Concept是一款电动终极跑车，承载着将传奇
Corvette产品线延续到未来的使命。

CX.R Vision Gran Turismo是其变体车型中的一员，
这是一款为打破道路常规而生的猛兽。

专为赛道驾驶而开发，相比同门车型更轻盈、
空气动力学优势更明显。

其动力核心由三台电机和一台双涡轮V8引擎组成，
采用电子燃料，非常适合长距离和耐力赛事。

车辆内饰完全按竞赛标准打造，过弯和转向操控
都经过精心考量。

从外观来看，黄黑相间的涂装彰显了
其GT赛车的纯正血统。

作为终极高性能车型，CX.R必将为传奇的Corvette
开启赛车荣耀的崭新篇章。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept
vehicleCollection.en:
A futuristic GT racer born from the Corvette lineage.

Designed purely for the racetrack, the Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept pushed the envelope even further. It offered a glimpse into the future of Corvette GT racing.

The Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept possessed a more aggressive aerodynamic package, lower stance, and a lighter build than the standard CX Concept. Underneath, it featured an advanced E-Fuel/Electric hybrid powertrain—two electric motors up front, one at the rear, and a compact, high-revving twin-turbo V-8, delivering both the performance and the efficiency needed for endurance racing.

The interior of the CX.R Vision Gran Turismo was purpose-built for the demands of the race track. Its geometric layout and lightweight seat—with minimal foam trim—offered essential head and neck support to withstand the intense cornering forces expected at racing speeds. The steering wheel featured physical buttons and knobs, ensuring precise control even when wearing racing gloves.

Finished in a striking yellow and black livery, the CX.R Vision Gran Turismo paid tribute to 25 years of Corvette GT racing heritage.
vehicleCollection.zh:
诞生自Corvette车系的未来主义GT赛车。

Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept专为赛道打造，展现了Corvette GT赛车的未来愿景。

Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept采用激进的空气动力学设计，车身姿态更低，重量也比Corvette CX Concept更轻。CX.R VGT使用电子燃料，并搭载一套电动混合动力系统，包括两台前轴电机和一台后轴电机，后者与小排量高转速双涡轮V8引擎组合，为耐力赛事提供卓越性能和续航能力。

CX.R Vision Gran Turismo的内饰完全按照赛道使用需求精心设计。座椅的几何设计和轻量化极简泡沫内饰，能在赛道极限过弯时为车手提供头部和颈部的有效支撑。方向盘采用实体按键和旋钮设计，确保车手戴着赛车手套也能轻松操作。

黄黑相间的涂装传承了Corvette GT赛车25年来一贯的传统。

cars.nameZh: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
This is the legendary 1963 Corvette Sting Ray
‘Split Window’ coupe.

Regarding its name, the ‘Split Window’...

This comes from the very sleek rod in the rear window.

This rod is not only a distinguishing feature...

It also allows the profile of the car to remain
uninterrupted in its flow.

This car is so well-balanced from top to bottom,
and from end to end.

I particularly love the fender shape!

Clearly, it was inspired by the Italian streamliners
of the 1950s.

When I look at the sleek undulating lines of
the 1963 Sting Ray...

It really does remind me of its underwater
namesake!
dialogues.zh:
这是传说中的1963款科尔维特Sting Ray
“Split Window”双门跑车。

“Split Window”这个绰号的由来是指它的后车窗被一根立柱一分为二。

这根独树一帜的立柱……

……让车辆的整体轮廓更加连贯和流畅。

我还特别喜爱它的挡泥板的形状，
其灵感应该来源于1950年代意大利汽车的流线型车身。

这辆车从头到尾、从上到下都充满平衡感，

堪称永恒的经典设计。

每次看到那起伏流畅的车身外形……

……我就不由想起那条生活在水底的流线型生物。

没错，那就是这辆车名字的来源，魔鬼鱼。]

collection.en:
No sports car says 'America' quite like
the Chevrolet Corvette!

This second-generation model, also known as the Sting Ray
was especially popular.

Later versions featuring the L88 racing engine are very
collectable, and regularly sell for over $1 million.

This 1963 coupé is perhaps best known for its split
rear window.

It's a design feature that was only used in the first-year
models because it limited rear visibility.

The one-year 'split window' Sting Rays are hugely popular,
and are among the most collectable Corvettes.
collection.zh:
没有哪款跑车能比Chevrolet Corvette更能体现美国味！

其中，被称为Sting Ray的第二代Corvette车型特别受欢迎。

搭载L88赛车引擎的后期版本非常值得收藏，其售价经常
超过100万美元。

这款1963年的双门硬顶跑车车型最为人称道的是其分体式
后窗。

受限于狭窄的后窗视线，这一设计特征仅仅出现在首发
版车型上，随后就被取消了。

总而言之，搭载了分体式车窗的首发年Sting Ray极其受欢迎，
也是最有收藏价值的Corvette之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
This second-generation Corvette sports car was based on the Stingray race machine.

When you think of American high-performance cars, most prevalent are the mainstream models that mount high-powered engines in coupes and sedans. However, there is one model that continues to be manufactured as a pure sports car: The Chevrolet Corvette.

But even the Corvette didn't start out as a sports car. The first Corvette was more style-focused open-top cruiser than racy roadster and was not given a powerful V8 until 10 years after its debut. The advent of them becoming true sports cars started with the second generation "C2" Corvette.

The aggressive competition-like body based on the first "Sting Ray," the "Corvette Stingray Racer Concept" prototype, was a drastic change from the classic '50s styling of the original. As with the body, the chassis was completely redesigned from the ground up. The high tension ladder frame was given a short wheelbase and 4-wheel independent suspension, in an effort to increase agility and ride composure. Meanwhile the 5.4-liter OHV engine made more than 300ps, and the massive torque produced by the large displacement V8 defined its character. Cloaked in a lightweight fiber-glass (FRP) body, it produced rocket-like acceleration for its day, and the overwhelming level of performance Americans came to love.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第2代科尔维特，基于Stingray Racer打造的一款跑车。

提到美国的高性能车，主流型号往往都是些搭载大马力引擎的双门跑车或轿车。不过有一款车型自始至终都保持着纯粹的跑车身份：雪佛兰科尔维特。

有意思的是，即便是科尔维特，在推出的初期也不是一辆专门的跑车——最初的科尔维特是偏重于外观的敞篷车车型，直到其首次亮相的10年之后才开始配备大马力的V8引擎。真正的跑车车型是从第二代C2科尔维特开始的。

C2的车身基于首款Stingray，也就是科尔维特Sting ray racer概念原型车，从经典的50年代风格摇身一变，换上更激进的竞赛外观。

和车身一样，整个底盘也经过了重新设计。高压梯形车架采用了短轴距设计，并使用了四轮独立悬挂，目的是为了增加车子的灵活性。

其5.4升顶置气门引擎可以输出超过300ps，而且这台大排量V8输出的强大扭矩也定义了它的特征。如此强大的引擎加上纤维增强塑料轻量化后的车身，让这款车拥有火箭一般的加速能力和美国人所钟爱的强大性能。

catch.en: This second-generation Corvette sports car was based on the Stingray race machine.
catch.zh: 第2代科尔维特，基于Stingray Racer打造的一款跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Taking design cues from the Mako Shark II concept, this 3rd-gen Corvette was known for its distinctive character.

A full model change in the autumn of 1967 introduced the new C3 Corvette Stingray as a 1968 model. It was very reminiscent of the Mako Shark II show car, which was shown at the New York International Auto Show in April 1965.

This concept sought to show off the Corvette in a new light, specifically as a grand tourer. Chief designer Bill Mitchell's design ideas were extremely important factors in the achievement of this goal.

Working as Mitchell's right-hand man was a man named Larry Shinoda, a Japanese-American who had worked as a detail designer on the original Stingray. Taking many hints from Mitchell's concepts, Shinoda's image of the next-generation GT car materialized in the form of the Mako Shark II.

With a dynamic, curvaceous exterior, and an interior stuffed with the newest electronic gizmos, it was indeed the Corvette of the future. The essence of this idea was thoroughly incorporated into the street model that was to become the C3 Corvette.

In 1969 the standard engine's displacement was increased from 327 cu. in. to 350 cu. in., but maximum output remained unchanged at 300ps. At the same time, the small-block option changed from the 327 cu- in. L79 to the 350 cu- in. L46, with maximum output again unchanged at 355ps.

Although at the time, there was mention of a big-block Corvette, the small-block engine held the advantage in handling with its lower frontal weight. The epitome of this was the replacement of the top-grade L46 by the 370ps LT1. Available around 1970, this was acclaimed as the best handling of all the C3 Corvette combinations.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第3代科尔维特，出类拔萃的内饰与外形设计均传承自Mako Shark II型的设计理念。

1967年秋季的一次车型大改款为我们带来了全新的1968款C3科尔维特Stingray。此车很容易让人联想起1965年4月在纽约国际车展上展出的“Mako Shark II”展示车型。

这款概念赛车试图以一种新的方式呈现科尔维特，而且是以高性能豪华旅行车的身份登场。首席设计师比尔·米切尔的设计理念对实现这一目标至关重要。

米切尔的得力助手是一位名叫拉里·筱田的日裔美国人，曾担任过初代Stingray的细节设计师。筱田从米切尔的概念方案中得到了许多启示，将自己对下一代GT汽车的印象付诸实践，促成了Mako Shark II的出现。

此车具备动态的、曲线优美的外观，内部则塞满了各种最新的电子仪器，堪称真正来自未来的科尔维特。之后，这一理念的精髓又被彻底吸纳到了公路版本中，就有了C3科尔维特的诞生。

1969年，新车的标准引擎排量从327立方英寸提高到350立方英寸，但最大输出保持不变，仍为300ps。同时，小缸体版的引擎从327立方英寸L79改为350立方英寸L46，最大动力输出也保持在355ps。

尽管当时人们大多在谈论大缸体版科尔维特的动力，但小缸体版因其较低的前端重量而在操控方面占尽优势。人们用脚投票的结果便是370ps的LT1取代了顶级的L46。也因此，在1970年左右上市的LT1也被誉为所有C3科尔维特组合中操控性最佳的一款。.
