你是这辆C3 Corvette的驾驶者吗？

Wait... Is it my imagination, or aren't you

Correct! The name’s Ed Welburn. Nice to meet you!

答对了，我是埃德·韦伯恩。很高兴见到你们！

It's truly an honor to meet you, Mr. Welburn, er, I mean, Ed!

As Vice-President of GM's Global Design, Ed has helped create

埃德先生是通用汽车全球设计中心的副总裁，他为世界
带来了无数款著名的好车。

conversation.speaker: Ed Welburn
conversation.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
conversation.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
conversation.en:
The C3 Corvette Stingray was a major departure
from the C2 Corvette.

It was meant to be something like an accessible
concept car.

The fender shapes are bold, the waist is tight...

And everything, from the pop-up headlights
to the stylish side exhaust...

Are very much like a ‘show car’.

Even the door handles were innovative!

Not only was the interior was inspired
by NASA rocket ships...

But there was a time when all of the astronauts
drove C3 Corvette Stingrays.
conversation.zh:
C3 Corvette Stingray的设计是对C2 Corvette的一场告别。

它设计之初的目标是要成为可以上路的概念车。

前后挡泥板的形状大胆、狂野，中部线条收紧……

从上翻大灯到时尚有型的侧出排气管……

它从头至脚都非常像一辆“展台车”。

甚至连门把手造型都充满创新！

据说，车身内饰的灵感来自于NASA的火箭与飞船……

不仅如此，有一段时间，所有宇航员的座驾
都是C3 Corvette Stingrays。

conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.en: Thank you for that! It was very interesting indeed!"
conversation.zh: 感谢您给我们作了这么精到的讲解！

conversation.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
conversation.en:
There's so much I'd like to speak to you about!
I look forward to seeing you again!
conversation.zh:
不用谢。我希望下次还有机会和你们聊聊。
那么，回见了！

usedCar.en:
The third-generation Corvette, also known as the C3, is one
of the most recognizable American cars in history.

One look and you know immediately that it's a 'Vette, right?

Inspired by the Mako Shark II concept vehicle designed by
Larry Shinoda, the C3 epitomized 1960s and 1970s style.

Under its hood was a no-nonsense V-8, whose displacement
was dependent on the model you chose.

In the 1970s, engine power was reduced to comply with
environmental regulations that resulted from the oil crisis.

But those changes predated this 1969 model, allowing drivers
to enjoy the Corvette C3 the way it was meant to be enjoyed.
usedCar.zh:
第三代Corvette，又称“C3”，是该系列
迄今为止最受欢迎的一款车型。

它的车身采用玻璃纤维增强塑料制成...

克尔维特充分利用这种柔性材料的优势
创造出了绝妙的设计，一经推出便即刻走红。

人们曾将其独特的轮廓比作一个可乐瓶！

在20世纪70年代石油危机期间，为了遵守
环境法规，C3的动力性能遭到了削减。

这款1969年的车型生产于削减之前，因此
鉴赏家们能够尽情享受到这个“美人”全速下的速度与激情。

variants.en:
This third-generation Corvette went by the designation of C3.

Back in the 1960s and 1970s, American V-8 engines
were categorized by their size.

Those with a displacement of 5.7 liters and less were called
"small block" V-8s.

Those with larger displacements were aptly called "big block"
V-8s. In fact, some people still use these terms.

The L46 in this 1969 Corvette C3 was one of the more
famous cars with a "small block" V-8.

It was a high-output engine, which packed around 50 HP
more than standard models.

If you want to really go old school, you can refer to the
engine's size in cubic inches.

In this case, 5.7 liters works out to 350 cubic inches.

Now you know where the "350" in its name comes from!
variants.zh:
这款第三代Chevrolet Corvette也称C3。

美产V8引擎倾向于根据排气量来分类。

排气量5.7L左右的引擎为
“小缸体引擎”...

排气量更大的则称为“大缸体引擎”。

这款1969年的Corvette C3中搭载的L46
引擎是最有名的“小缸体”引擎之一。

属于高马力引擎，比标准车型的马力
高50HP。

顺便一说，引擎排量在美国是用
立方英尺度量的。

5.7L等同于350立方英尺...

这也是车型名称350的出处。

Working as Mitchell's right-hand man was a man named Larry Shinoda, a Japanese-American who had worked as a detail designer on the original Stingray. Taking many hints from Mitchell's concepts, Shinoda's image of the next-generation GT car materialized in the form of the Mako Shark II.

With a dynamic, curvaceous exterior, and an interior stuffed with the newest electronic gizmos, it was indeed the Corvette of the future. The essence of this idea was thoroughly incorporated into the street model that was to become the C3 Corvette.

In 1969 the standard engine's displacement was increased from 327 cu. in. to 350 cu. in., but maximum output remained unchanged at 300ps. At the same time, the small-block option changed from the 327 cu.-in. L79 to the 350 cu.-in. L46, with maximum output again unchanged at 355ps.

Although at the time, there was mention of a big-block Corvette, the small-block engine held the advantage in handling with its lower frontal weight. The epitome of this was the replacement of the top-grade L46 by the 370ps LT1. Available around 1970, this was acclaimed as the best handling of all the C3 Corvette combinations.

1967年秋季的一次车型大改款为我们带来了全新的1968款C3科尔维特Stingray。此车很容易让人联想起1965年4月在纽约国际车展上展出的“Mako Shark II”展示车型。

这款概念赛车试图以一种新的方式呈现科尔维特，而且是以高性能豪华旅行车的身份登场。首席设计师比尔·米切尔的设计理念对实现这一目标至关重要。

米切尔的得力助手是一位名叫拉里·筱田的日裔美国人，曾担任过初代Stingray的细节设计师。筱田从米切尔的概念方案中得到了许多启示，将自己对下一代GT汽车的印象付诸实践，促成了Mako Shark II的出现。

此车具备动态的、曲线优美的外观，内部则塞满了各种最新的电子仪器，堪称真正来自未来的科尔维特。之后，这一理念的精髓又被彻底吸纳到了公路版本中，就有了C3科尔维特的诞生。

1969年，新车的标准引擎排量从327立方英寸提高到350立方英寸，但最大输出保持不变，仍为300ps。同时，小缸体版的引擎从327立方英寸L79改为350立方英寸L46，最大动力输出也保持在355ps。

尽管当时人们大多在谈论大缸体版科尔维特的动力，但小缸体版因其较低的前端重量而在操控方面占尽优势。人们用脚投票的结果便是370ps的LT1取代了顶级的L46。也因此，在1970年左右上市的LT1也被誉为所有C3科尔维特组合中操控性最佳的一款。.

dialogues.en:
The Corvette Stingray Racer had a big influence
on every Corvette that came after it.

It was not designed as a production or concept car,
but as a very serious racecar.

Its design was a radical departure from that of
previous Corvettes.

Many of its shapes, like those characterized by
its beautiful fenders, were inspired by Italian streamliners.

The strong crease that defines the car contributes to
its evocation of speed.

Corvette Stingray Racer的诞生对后世每一台Corvette
都带来了重大影响。

自设计伊始，它的定位就不是一台量产车或概念车，
而是彻彻底底的赛车。

大刀阔斧的设计改动使其与
之前的Corvette大相径庭。

车身多处的造型设计都明显受到早期意大利流线型车身

另外，得益于围绕车身一周的“折缝线”设计，
令它多出了几分速度感。

collection.en:
Let me introduce you to one of the most important cars
in the long history of the Corvette: the Sting Ray Racer.

Corvettes have been raced enthusiastically,
ever since their debut in 1954.

Zora Arkus-Duntov, an engineer and racing driver who
worked for GM, was particularly keen on racing,

and in 1957 he produced the Corvette SS,
the first Corvette built specifically for racing.

Now this Sting Ray Racer is essentially a Corvette SS
with an open-top body.

It's based on drawings by Peter Brock,
who is a renowned designer of GM.

The development of the Sting Ray Racer was commissioned by Bill
Mitchell, who was the new GM Design chief at the time.

The design of the Sting Ray Racer is known for having had
a significant influence on the history of the Corvette,

as another GM designer, Larry Shinoda, refined this design
into the C2 Corvette.
collection.zh:
请允许我向您介绍科尔维特的悠久历史中最重要的车型之一：
Sting Ray Racer。

自1954年首次亮相以来，科尔维特就受到了赛车界的广泛欢迎。

当时为通用汽车工作的工程师兼车手卓拉·阿库斯-丹托
特别热衷于驾驶它参赛。

1957年，他创造了科尔维特SS，
是第一辆专门设计为竞赛用途的科尔维特。

这台Sting Ray Racer本质上是一台采用了敞篷车身的SS。

它的车身设计由GM的著名工程师彼得·布罗克操刀，

赛道版则是在新任通用汽车设计部主管比尔·米切尔监督下研发而来。

Sting Ray Racer的设计显著地影响了科尔维特车系的发展史，

再后来，另一位通用汽车的设计师拉里·篠田又对这一设计
做出了改进，创造出了经典的科尔维特C2。"

vehicleCollection.en:
The '59 concept embodied a styling that swept the world and remains a part of Corvette history.

The first-generation Chevrolet Corvette made its racing debut in 1955, three years after the original street version's release; thus began its long record of success in motorsports. The "Father of the Corvette," Zora Duntov, led these efforts and developed the Corvette SS race car which made its debut in 1957.

Made to look like the Corvette, the underpinnings of the SS were completely different. The shortened tubular frame mounted a 307ps fuel-injected 283-cu.-in. engine, helping the car reach a top speed of <292km/h> in testing. Hopes were high for its racing potential; however, the project came to a grinding halt when the American Automobile Manufacturers Association banned the participation of manufacturers in racing.

The story did not end there, as a rightful heir to the Corvette SS appeared. The Corvette Stingray Racer, codenamed XP-87, inherited the frame and body from the Corvette SS. The final version, created by the newly appointed GM styling chief Bill Mitchell and designer Larry Shinoda, took its visual cues from a blackballed next-generation Corvette prototype. The resulting Stingray Racer entered a variety of races as the private, personal car of Bill Mitchell, and won two consecutive SCCA Class C modified titles in 1959 and 1960.
vehicleCollection.zh:
席卷全球的先进设计风格持续数年，也未见衰减。

于1953年发布的第一代雪佛兰科尔维特帮助雪佛兰在赛车领域获奖无数。接下来计划开发的赛车车型科尔维特SS于1957年首次亮相，其开发工程由“科尔维特之父”佐拉·邓托夫主导。

虽然外观与普通版本的科尔维特相似，但SS的内在结构却完全不同。它是以赛车赛事为目标而设计的，因此采用了截短后的管式车架，搭载一台307ps的燃油助喷283引擎。这款车在测试中跑出了<292km/h>的最高时速。

不过就在同一年，在纳斯卡赛车和其他赛车运动比赛中发生一系列事故后，美国汽车制造商协会发文禁止汽车制造商直接参与比赛，导致开发计划就此搁浅。不过SS后来通过Stingray Racer得到了继承。

Stingray Racer几乎原封不动地沿用了科尔维特SS那覆盖引擎的车架和车身设计。新任命的通用设计部门主管比尔·米切尔和设计师拉里·篠田借鉴了许多来自另一款被否决的科尔维特原型车的外观设计元素，打造出了最终成品。

这款Stingray Racer随后以比尔·米切尔私人赛车的名义参加了一系列的比赛，并在1959年和1960年连续赢得美国赛车俱乐部C级改装车比赛的冠军。

This is a fifth-generation Corvette, called the C5

It was a truly unforgettable chapter in the Corvette's legacy.

It was when a C5-based GT racer known as the "C5-R"...

...achieved a stunning overall victory at the 24 Hours
of Daytona.

Just a few months later, it secured a class
win at Le Mans...

Beloved by many, the C5-R is still considered
among the fastest GT cars in the world!

不仅在戴通纳24小时耐力赛斩获全场总冠军，

这台深受车迷爱戴的C5-R，至今仍是
全球最快的GT赛车之一。

brandCentral.en:
Ask someone to name the greatest American sports car,
and chances are, the answer will be the Corvette.

The model before you is the fifth-generation iteration—known
as the C5—a modern marvel of sports-car engineering.

This particular version revives a storied name: "Z06," a nod to
the second-generation Corvette’s renowned race package.

At its heart lies the LS6 engine—a compact yet formidable
390ps V-8 derived from the legendary LS1.

Naturally, the chassis has been refined, complemented by
competition-grade suspension and brakes.

A close relative of the C5-R race car, this Corvette masterfully
blends heritage with high-performance capability./
brandCentral.zh:
要问最伟大的美国跑车是哪一台，大部分人
都会回答“Corvette”。

在你眼前的就是被称为“C5”的第五代Corvette，
一辆堪称杰作的现代跑车。

更值得一提的是，因为它的型号名称“Z06”来源于第二代
赛车套件，所以还被赋予了“传奇重生”的意义。

其最为人称道的特性无疑是它的LS6动力单元。这款引擎基于
名声赫赫的LS1打造，体积虽小，却有390ps的强大动力。

不消说，它的底盘也得到了强化升级，并配备了
竞赛级悬挂和刹车。

作为“C5-R”的姐妹车型，这款第五代Corvette兼顾了
传统和性能，实在不可多得。

Looking for a true, unapologetically American sports car?
Then look no further, we might have found your ideal car.

The Chevrolet Z06 is a revived legend for the
fifth-generation Corvette.

The Z06 name pays homage to the 1960s C2 race package.

Unveiled in 2001, this reincarnated Z06 builds on the C5 platform
with enhanced suspension and upgraded brakes, and more.

Under the hood is a 5.7-liter V-8 producing 390ps, paired with
weight-reduction measures to sharpen its edge.

Its notchback body sets it apart visually from the base model.
So, are you ready to find out what she’s really made of?
usedCar.zh:
想寻找一款横冲直撞的美式跑车？
巧了，我这里就有一个完美的选择！

这辆Chevrolet Z06是第五代Corvette的重启之作，
也是货真价实的美式跑车代表。

它之所以起这个名字，是为了向1960年代的
C2赛车套件致敬。

这款重生的Z06在2001年首次公开，是一款采用了
升级版悬挂和增强刹车的C5车型。

它由一台390ps马力的5.7升V8引擎提供动力，并辅以
减重设计以及其他多项优化。

掀背车身外形也是这款Z06的显著特征之一。
怎么样？你要不要亲自体验一下它的操控感？?

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line variant of the fifth-generation Corvette revives the classic Z06 moniker.

In 1999, Chevrolet introduced a hardtop variant to the Corvette C5 lineup. It traded the coupe’s removable top and rear hatch for a fixed-roof design, increasing structural stiffness that translated into improved handling and driving dynamics. Further underscoring this intent, opting for the hardtop model automatically bundled the Z51 performance handling package and a 6-speed manual transmission.

Remarkably, despite these upgrades, it was priced below the standard coupe. That's why it became a compelling choice for driving enthusiasts who were drawn to its niche appeal.

From 2001, the hardtop evolved into the Corvette Z06. It was fitted with a 390ps LS6 engine—an enhanced version of the LS1. The Z06 revived a historic nameplate first used for a race-focused option on the second-generation Corvette. The new Z06 was distinguished not only by its reinforced suspension and track-tuned alignment, but also by its use of a full titanium exhaust system—an extraordinary feature for a production car. It was available only with a manual transmission.

However, these high-performance enhancements came at a significant increase in price. The Z06 was the most expensive model in the C5 range, even surpassing the convertible, which made it beyond the reach of many, especially when compared to the more accessible fixed-roof model that preceded it.

Still, the Z06 continued to evolve. In 2002, power output rose to 411ps. Delivering 400ps-plus was unheard of for a small-block V-8 at the time. These milestones helped cement the C5 Z06 as one of the fastest and most formidable mass-production sports cars of its era.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第五代科尔维特产品线中的巅峰之作，让Z06这个经典名字重新问世。

在1999年，一款硬顶车型加入了雪佛兰科尔维特C5的产品线。尽管这一车型移除了双门轿车版本的活动式顶篷和后备箱盖，但也利用新设计中增加的车体刚度优化了驾驶性能。这款硬顶车型还自带Z51操控套件和手动变速箱的升级，这也进一步彰显了厂商对性能的专注。

更重要的是，尽管得到了大量的功能升级强化，新车型的价格依然低于标准的双门轿车车型。难怪尽管定位小众，却依然不乏大量的爱好者对其趋之若鹜。

自2001年起，硬顶科尔维特车型换装了LS1引擎的升级版——拥有390ps动力的LS6引擎，车型编号也随之改为Z06。而Z06这个型号名来源于厂商过去为C2科尔维特提供的一个赛车套件代号。它采用了量产车型中极其罕见的全钛合金排气管，外加强化的悬挂组件和经过特别调校的四轮定位，且仅提供手动变速箱。

然而，与丰富配置相辅相成的，是大幅飙升的售价，使其成为了目前为止最昂贵的车型，甚至超过了敞篷版本的价格。对那些被其刚性更佳的硬顶车身和朴实但强悍的性能所吸引的用户来说，入手难度也水涨船高了。

即便如此，厂商仍然孜孜不倦地为Z06提供进一步升级，在2002年将其最大功率提升到了411ps。能以一部小缸体引擎实现超过400ps，绝对是一项无与伦比的成就，也让它成为了全世界速度最快的量产车之一。

catch.en: The top-of-the-line variant of the fifth-generation Corvette revives the classic Z06 moniker.
catch.zh: 第五代科尔维特产品线中的巅峰之作，让Z06这个经典名字重新问世。

long.en:
In 1999, Chevrolet introduced a hardtop variant to the Corvette C5 lineup. It traded the coupe’s removable top and rear hatch for a fixed-roof design, increasing structural stiffness that translated into improved handling and driving dynamics. Further underscoring this intent, opting for the hardtop model automatically bundled the Z51 performance handling package and a 6-speed manual transmission.

Remarkably, despite these upgrades, it was priced below the standard coupe. That's why it became a compelling choice for driving enthusiasts who were drawn to its niche appeal.

From 2001, the hardtop evolved into the Corvette Z06. It was fitted with a 390ps LS6 engine—an enhanced version of the LS1. The Z06 revived a historic nameplate first used for a race-focused option on the second-generation Corvette. The new Z06 was distinguished not only by its reinforced suspension and track-tuned alignment, but also by its use of a full titanium exhaust system—an extraordinary feature for a production car. It was available only with a manual transmission.

However, these high-performance enhancements came at a significant increase in price. The Z06 was the most expensive model in the C5 range, even surpassing the convertible, which made it beyond the reach of many, especially when compared to the more accessible fixed-roof model that preceded it.

Still, the Z06 continued to evolve. In 2002, power output rose to 411ps. Delivering 400ps-plus was unheard of for a small-block V-8 at the time. These milestones helped cement the C5 Z06 as one of the fastest and most formidable mass-production sports cars of its era.

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
The C4 Corvette ZR-1 is a famously speedy Corvette.

It set seven international and world records in the 1990s.

In fact, its speed record went unmatched for more than
two decades.

The V-8 engine developed in conjunction with Lotus
was truly impressive and high powered...

...producing over 100ps more than the standard model.

All in all, it's a car that's even more valuable than
its price would suggest.
dialogues.zh:
这辆C4 Corvette ZR-1快如闪电的名气谁人不知，谁人不晓。

它在二十世纪九十年代总计创下了7项世界纪录。

事实上，这个无人能及的速度纪录保持了超过20年。

这款车上装载了与Lotus公司一同研制的V8发动机动力强
劲、令人惊艳，

比标准版的动力提高了不止100ps。

我要说的是，它的售价远远不能代表其真正的价值。

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
The C4 Corvette is full of innovations,
both on its inside and outside.

It’s design is a marked departure from the curvier C3,
being more angular and wedge-shaped.

This is evident in the clamshell bonnet
and headlamp construction.

In order to tame its powerful four-valve DOHC engine...

The ZR-1 made use of much wider rear tyres and fenders.

The interior was very much inspired by aircraft design.

Some people say that the C4 Corvette lacks
the ‘soul’ of a Corvette.

But I happen to like it plenty.
dialogues.zh:
C4 Corvette在内部和外部加入了很多创新点。

它有着楔型的车身，更加有棱有角，与C3 Corvette的
波浪状线条相去甚远。

其掀盖式的引擎盖和头灯的结构就是最好的证明。

ZR-1配备了更宽的后胎和后挡泥板……

以便驯服动力强劲的DOHC 4气门引擎。

其内饰的灵感很大程度来源于飞机。

很多人评论说C4 Corvette缺少了一点Corvette的魂。

但我恰好挺喜欢这款车的。

usedCar.en:
The Chevrolet Corvette really came into its own with the C4
model, especially with the ZR-1 performance package.

Its 32-valve V-8 pumped out an impressive 380ps...

...making it as powerful as many V-12-powered supercars of
its day, including the incredible Ferrari Testarossa!

Interestingly, the car was designed by Lotus, which was part of
General Motors at the time, and here's another fun fact:

The C4 ZR-1 was the first Corvette to be equipped with a 6-speed
manual transmission.
usedCar.zh:
现今最强劲的Corvette都发源于这款
第四代Corvette，C4 ZR-1。

它搭载了一台32阀V8 DOHC引擎，马力高达380ps。

这台引擎的马力能与当时名声显赫的
Ferrari Testarossa搭载的V12一比高低！

有趣的是，这台引擎是由当时仍是General Motors子公司的
Lotus所设计的。

C4 ZR-1也是第一款配备了
六速手动变速箱的Corvette。

vehicleCollection.en:
The daunting ZR1 badge on the 4th-gen Corvette assured world-beating performance.

In 1990, a special performance model called the ZR-1 was added to the Corvette lineup. The name ZR-1 referred to the car's option code. Its roots can be traced back to a racing package that was offered from 1970 to 1973.

The parts that went into the ZR-1 were extremely varied, ranging from suspension and wheels to body parts, but the real heart was its engine, the LT5. It matched the standard L98 Corvette engine with 350 cu. in. of displacement, and the same bore and stroke dimensions. However, the cylinder block was made of aluminum and featured 4-valve DOHC cylinder heads co-developed by Chevrolet and Lotus.

This was the first time a DOHC 4-valve engine was fitted to a Corvette. Utilizing the latest combustion logic, the power unleashed by the DOHC heads was astounding. The LT5 pumped out 380ps, compared to the standard 250ps.

But to obtain this special performance, one had to pay a steep price. The car's delivery system was also complicated and took time because the cylinder blocks were cast by a third-party manufacturer, and the engines were assembled by hand by experienced craftsmen.

The price of the standard Corvette coupe was just under $32,000. The ZR-1 option package alone cost an additional $27,000 plus. A year later, the price jumped to $31,000 making it nearly double the price of a standard Corvette. It was rumored that even with such exorbitant prices, the ZR-1 was barely profitable for Chevrolet.

*Please note that the model included in Gran Turismo is the prototype model built in 1989.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款C4科尔维特种类繁多的加配选项正好与他的特殊名号不谋而合。

在1990年，一辆名为ZR-1的特殊高性能车型加入了科尔维特的阵容。ZR-1这几个字母其实代表了一套选装代号，并且一样不少地安装到了这款车型上。ZR-1的设计灵感来自于1970年到1973年期间的推出一套同名赛车改装套件。

ZR-1的改件涉及的部位非常多，从悬挂、轮胎再到车身部件，不过真正的心脏还是那台LT5引擎。这款引擎拥有与L98科尔维特标准版引擎相同的350立方英寸排量，阀门内径和冲程规格也没有变化。唯一不同的是其缸体是铝制的，并且安装了雪佛兰和莲花跑车共同开发的4汽门双顶置凸轮轴气缸盖。

这也是科尔维特首次采用双顶置凸轮轴4气门引擎。这种双顶置凸轮轴气缸盖可以利用最新的内燃逻辑释放出惊人的动力。相比标准车型的250ps，LT5引擎足足挤出了380ps。

与ZR-1的特殊性能相匹配的是它那高昂的价格和限量组装交付体系——引擎缸体交由第三方制造商铸造，引擎本身也由经验丰富的工匠手工组装。

一辆标准的科尔维特双门跑车价格不过32,000美元，而ZR-1的选装套件本身就价值27,000美元。一年之后，这个报价又涨到了31,000美元，让这台车的身价比标准版几乎翻了一倍。但有人指出，即便价格如此高昂，ZR-1依然没有让雪佛兰获得多少盈利。

*请注意，跑车浪漫旅中包含的是1989年制造的原型车。

dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
The C6 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 is low and wide,
with the stance and physique of a body builder.

To accommodate for wide tyres, it has been given
more width than the standard Corvette...

And features more aggressive air vents
in its front fender.

Interestingly, the black roof works to emphasise the
low-and-wide look of the design.

Also, I really like its round taillights!
dialogues.zh:
拥有低矮宽体车身的Chevrolet Corvette C6 ZR1
看上去像一位魁梧的健美运动员。

为了适配更宽的轮胎，它不得不在
标准版Corvette的基础上继续加宽车身……

并在前挡泥板上加入了造型更显凶猛的通风口。

黑色车顶形成了有趣的视觉效果，进一步强调了
低矮和宽阔的外观设计。

另外，我真的很喜欢它的圆形尾灯！

埃德先生，能见到您是我们的荣幸！

埃德先生是通用汽车全球设计中心的副总裁，他为世界
带来了无数款著名的好车。

conversation.en:
The C6 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 is low and wide,
with the stance and physique of a body builder.

To accommodate for wide tyres, it has been given
more width than the standard Corvette...

And features more aggressive air vents
in its front fender.

Interestingly, the black roof works to emphasise the
low-and-wide look of the design.

Also, I really like its round taillights!
conversation.zh:
拥有低矮宽体车身的Chevrolet Corvette C6 ZR1
看上去像一位魁梧的健美运动员。

为了适配更宽的轮胎，它不得不在
标准版Corvette的基础上继续加宽车身……

并在前挡泥板上加入了造型更显凶猛的通风口。

黑色车顶形成了有趣的视觉效果，进一步强调了
低矮和宽阔的外观设计。

另外，我真的很喜欢它的圆形尾灯！

brandCentral.en:
This ZR1 is the most potent version of the sixth-generation
Corvette.

It came with a hand-built and supercharged
V-8 engine that...

...pumped out an impressive 647ps and 80kgm of torque.

This is one flexible engine, with gobs of power coming
throughout the rpm spectrum.

It made waves when it first appeared by beating the
Nissan GT-R's time on the Nürburgring Nordschleife.

And what's really cool about this American sports car
is that it handles as good as it goes straight.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆ZR1是第六代Corvettes中最令人惊艳的一款。

此车拥有一台精心手工打造的机械增压V8引擎。

拥有647ps最高功率输出，以及80kgm扭矩，

在转速范围内产生的动力令人心动！

它的首次亮相就伴随着在纽博格林北侧赛道上击败Nissan GT-R
的大新闻，掀起了阵阵波澜……

ZR1证明了自己不只有动力，操控性也如梦如幻！

usedCar.en:
When it comes to sheer performance, the Corvette C6 ZR1
belongs among the elite supercars in the world.

Not only is the OHV V-8 powerful enough on its own, Chevy
raised the stakes by bolting a supercharger to it!

With power output of 646ps, combined with a lightweight body,
you can imagine how this car went in a straight line.

The suspension system was also upgraded, so its handling
was on par with the supercars of its day.

There's a small window on the hood, providing a view of the
supercharger in all its glory.

Yes, this ZR1 proved that America could still build supercars.
usedCar.zh:
Corvette C6 ZR1的速度至今都称得上是
世界顶级。

给OHV V8引擎安装机械增压器是美国人提升
马力的传统方法。

作为一款在当时鲜见的轻量车，
ZR1依然能输出647ps的马力。

就连经验丰富的车手都对它的加速性能
大吃一惊！

另外，设计师在引擎盖上开小窗口就是为了让你能
瞥见涡轮增压器。

这小细节挺有意思的，你不觉得么？

vehicleCollection.en:
The 6th-gen Corvette ZR1 set one of the fastest lap times ever for a production car at the Nürburgring.

The Chevrolet Corvette has long stood as a thoroughbred American sports car, its design carrying a distinct sense of drama and presence. That appeal allowed it to stand confidently alongside European exotics, including Ferrari. With the introduction of the C6 Z06 in 2005, however, the Corvette was no longer defined by styling alone, firmly establishing itself among the world’s high-performance elite.

The ZR1, unveiled at the 2008 North American International Auto Show, pushed performance even further. Built on the lightweight aluminum and magnesium frame of the Z06, it featured a supercharged 6.2-liter LS9 V-8 producing 647ps at 6500rpm and 83.5kgm of torque at 3800rpm—well beyond the 505ps output of the Z06. Each engine was hand-assembled and paired with a close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission.

The suspension was specially tuned, while carbon-ceramic brakes provided enhanced stopping power. Extensive use of carbon fiber—including the roof, front splitter, and other body components—reduced weight to approximately 1,508 kg. Subtle aerodynamic additions, including a front splitter and rear spoiler, further improved performance. In other words, every possible measure to maximize driving performance was incorporated into this model.

American sports cars were often associated with straight-line speed, but the ZR1 proved its capability on the world stage. It recorded a Nürburgring lap time competitive with the fastest production cars of its era, including the Nissan GT-R. With a top speed of <330km/h>, 0-60mph acceleration in 3.4 seconds, and a quarter-mile time of 11.3 seconds, the ZR1 stands as one of the most formidable Corvettes ever built.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这台高性能版C6科尔维特曾在纽博格林赛道上创下最快圈速纪录。

雪佛兰Corvette是一辆纯种的美国跑车，其外形始终保持着迷人的吸引力，即便是与法拉利超跑同行也不落下风。自从2005年的C6 Z06型号推出以来，这个品牌便不再只以外观著称，而是在性能方面也加入了超级跑车的行列。

在2008年北美国际车展上首次亮相的ZR1甚至还具备了超越法拉利和兰博基尼的性能素质。这款车使用了和Z06相同的高度轻量化铝镁合金车架，但其引擎所输出的马力却远超Z06的505ps。它采用的是机械增压的6.2升V8 LS9引擎，可以输出6500rpm下的647ps马力和3800rpm下的83.5kgm最大扭矩。这款引擎的每个部件都由手工打造，并配有一款6速手动档密齿轮比变速箱。

其悬挂系统经过了特殊调校，刹车也使用了碳化陶瓷刹车碟。其轮拱罩、引擎盖和车顶面板均采用碳纤维材质，将重量降低到了1508公斤。相比之下，特殊设计的前唇扰流板、侧踏板和后扰流板就显得有些质朴了。换言之，一切能够驾驶性能最大化的理念和实践都被运用到了这款车型上。

当说到美国的超级跑车，大部分人都会联想到一辆直线加速赛车，不过这辆ZR1在旧纽博格林赛道上跑出了创纪录的速度，一举超越当时的日产GT-R。ZR1拥有<330km/h>的最大速度，0-60mph（大约100公里/小时）加速时间为3.4秒，完成四分之一英里仅需11.3秒，是有史以来最杰出的Corvette。

catch.zh: 这台高性能版C6科尔维特曾在纽博格林赛道上创下最快圈速纪录。

Chris Holstrom Concepts is a hot rod shop in the Pacific
Northwest that specialises in custom designs.

This car was built using a Chevy Nova as a base...

And features a supercharged V8 normally seen in
the Corvette ZR1.

It's a mighty engine that can produce up to 700ps.

This car won the Gran Turismo Award at the SEMA show, the
largest showcase of custom automobiles in the world.
brandCentral.zh:
Chris Holstrom Concepts是太平洋西北地区的一家改装车店，
专门从事定制改装设计。

这辆车以Chevy Nova为基础打造，

安装有一台Corvette ZR1车型常用的机械增压V8引擎。

这是一台强大的引擎，可以产生高达700ps的动力。

这辆车还在全球最大的定制汽车展——SEMA展会上赢得过
Gran Turismo奖。

vehicleCollection.en:
This monster Nova was a 2013 GT Award winner, equipped with the highest quality performance parts available.

The SEMA show is the world's largest annual custom car show hosted in Las Vegas, Nevada of the U.S every fall. At SEMA every year, Gran Turismo picks out cars that fits the philosophy of Gran Turismo for the "GT Awards". The car that won "Best of Show" in the Gran Turismo Awards of 2013 was this 1967 Chevrolet Nova.

The original Nova is a popular small car of Chevrolet built between the 1960s and 1970s. While there were high performance top grade models powered by V8 engines, at the base is a simple, functional car that was made as a daily driver for youths and families.

The shop who turned this modest family car into a crazy hotrod is Chris Holstrom Concepts, a specialty shop from Washington state. Chris Holstrom stripped the Nova down and started integrating high performance parts to create this Monster Nova.

Under the hood is the LS9, a supercharged 6.2L engine from the Corvette ZR1. Its output has been raised to 700 horsepower, and to withstand this incredible amount of power the rear suspension and differential housing utilize reinforced parts. BAER 6 pot calipers are used for the brakes, and the wheels with continental sport contact 5 tires are forged rims with 18 inches in the front, 19 inches the rear.

There have been no aerodynamic accessories added to the exterior, maintaining the look of a stock model. This is an automotive miracle, fusing together the chic look of the '60s with modern day performance.
vehicleCollection.zh:
2013年GT大奖获胜者，这辆狂野的诺瓦倾尽全力，用上最顶级的部件。

美国汽车用品改装车展览会每年秋季在美国内华达州拉斯维加斯举办，是全球最大的年度改装车展。在每年的美国汽车用品改装车展览会上，跑车浪漫旅都会选出符合跑车浪漫旅理念的车款，并授予“GT大奖”。赢得2013年奖项的是一款1967年的雪佛兰Nova。

原版Nova是雪佛兰在20世纪60至70年代生产的一款极受欢迎的小型汽车。该车型虽然也有采用V8引擎的高性能顶级版，但其标配版是一辆作为年轻人和家庭日常用车而开发的简单实用型汽车。

位于华盛顿州的一家改装专营店克里斯·霍尔斯特罗姆概念将这款朴实的家用车改装成了一款狂野肌肉车。克里斯·霍尔斯特罗姆将Nova拆解后安装上高性能零件，打造出了这款怪兽Nova。

引擎盖下面是来自科尔维特ZR1的6.2升机械增压引擎LS9。这款车的输出被提升到700马力，为了承受住这令人难以置信的动力，后部悬挂和差速器壳都采用了强化件。制动部分采用了BAER 6活塞卡钳，轮胎则采用大陆马Sport Contact 5，前后轮分别使用18英寸和19英寸的轮毂。

车辆外部仍保持原车款的造型，没有添加空气动力学配件。这款奇迹般的改装车成功将60年代的别致外观与现代性能合为一体。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Did you know there was a version of this Citroën BX
built for Group B rally homologation?

They called it the BX 4TC.

Up front, a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.2-liter inline-4
channeled serious power to all four wheels.

The irony? By the time this beast was
finally ready to race...

...Group B was already heading toward extinction.

As a result, it saw action in only a handful of races following
its 1986 debut—the final year of Group B competition.

Still, the BX 4TC, with its enlarged fenders and four auxiliary
rally lights, projected a commanding presence on the track.

It is truly a sight to behold!
dialogues.zh:
雪铁龙BX曾经开发过为满足B组别拉力赛规则
而打造的赛事认证车型，这你知道吗？

这台车被命名为'BX 4TC'。

它搭载的2.2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎纵向安置在车头，
源源不断为四个车轮输送强大的动力。

然而，当这台公路猛兽终于准备好参赛时……

B组别赛事却已走向终点。

所以，在它亮相的1986年，同时也就是B组别最后举办的那一年，
它仅参与了寥寥数场比赛。

尽管如此，这款BX 4TC凭借其加宽的挡泥板
和四盏辅助拉力灯，在赛道上依然威风凛凛。

这台车绝对值得一看！

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
When I hear the name Citroën, the first thing that comes
to mind is this BX.

Who could forget those straight lines, that boxy shape?

Such a unique-looking car could only come from the Italian
design house Bertone!

From the Break station wagon to the sports-car version,
it was also a car rich in variation.

Launched in 1982, it proved to be a lasting success,
staying in production for over a decade.

All told, around 2.3 million units were produced
across the entire lineup!
dialogues.zh:
一听到Citroën，我首先想到的就是这款BX。

有谁会不记得它那笔直的线条和方方正正的造型呢？

而拥有如此独特外观的汽车，毫无疑问只会出自
意大利设计公司Bertone之手！

从Break旅行车到跑车，这款车的衍生车型十分丰富。

1982年问世的BX堪称车坛常青树，生产周期
横跨十余载……

全系产量约达230万台！

Hi! Nice to meet you.

I noticed your cool car and just had to say Hi!(

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.en:
Did you know there was a version of this Citroën BX
built for Group B rally homologation?

They called it the BX 4TC.

Up front, a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.2-liter inline-4
channeled serious power to all four wheels.

The irony? By the time this beast was
finally ready to race...

...Group B was already heading toward extinction.

As a result, it saw action in only a handful of races following
its 1986 debut—the final year of Group B competition.

Still, the BX 4TC, with its enlarged fenders and four auxiliary
rally lights, projected a commanding presence on the track.

It is truly a sight to behold!
conversation.zh:
雪铁龙BX曾经开发过为满足B组别拉力赛规则
而打造的赛事认证车型，这你知道吗？

这台车被命名为'BX 4TC'。

它搭载的2.2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎纵向安置在车头，
源源不断为四个车轮输送强大的动力。

然而，当这台公路猛兽终于准备好参赛时……

B组别赛事却已走向终点。

所以，在它亮相的1986年，同时也就是B组别最后举办的那一年，
它仅参与了寥寥数场比赛。

尽管如此，这款BX 4TC凭借其加宽的挡泥板
和四盏辅助拉力灯，在赛道上依然威风凛凛。

这台车绝对值得一看！

usedCar.en:
Hi there! Looking to buy a car? Might I suggest something
French, maybe with a lot of character?

If that sounds appealing to you, then you can’t go wrong
with this Citroën BX, a mega-hit family car of the 1980s.

The BX is packed with everything the French maker does best.
Why, even its styling recalls that of the storied GS and CX!

But the true jewel in the crown was its hydropneumatic suspension
that was so smooth, it earned the nickname "magic carpet."

Built to carry full loads on long drives, the 19 TRS was a grand
tourer model equipped with a 1.9-liter engine.

The BX’s enduring popularity fueled a 12-year production run,
securing its place as one of France’s automotive greats.
usedCar.zh:
你好！想买车吗？要不要考虑一款法国车，很有个性的那种？

如果这种说法听起来对你有吸引力，那么这辆Citroën BX
绝对不会让你失望，它可是80年代的家用车爆款。

BX集合了这家法国车厂的所有精华。
瞧，它的造型甚至让人想起传奇的GS和CX！

但最美妙的是它的液压气动悬挂系统，
平顺的行驶就像坐在“魔毯”上一样。

19 TRS是为满座长途旅行而生的豪华旅行版本，
搭载1.9升引擎。

BX经久不衰的人气让它连续热销12年，成就了法国汽车
的经典之作。

vehicleCollection.en:
Citroën’s versatile tourer receives a modern makeover.

In 1976, Citroën began a new chapter under the Peugeot umbrella. It left many wondering what defined a Citroën in this new era. The answer came in bold form at the 1982 Paris Auto Salon with the debut of the BX.

The BX was infused with unmistakably Citroën DNA. Drawing inspiration from classics like the GS and CX, it combined their iconic character with clean, assertive lines. Inside, the BX offered a comfortable cabin with generous space for both passengers and luggage. Its striking design was the work of none other than Marcello Gandini, then with the famed Bertone design house.

Great care was also taken beneath the surface. While parts sharing with Peugeot had become common, the BX proudly retained Citroën’s hallmark hydropneumatic suspension. This innovative system replaces conventional coil springs and dampers with a combination of nitrogen gas and hydraulic fluid, allowing the ride height to be adjusted at will.

The BX was offered with a variety of engine options, but the 19 TRS featured here stands out as a grand tourer-style model powered by a 1.9-liter gasoline engine. Although not especially powerful on paper, the engine was well matched to the car’s relatively lightweight, aerodynamic body, making it an ideal companion for long-distance holiday drives.

The BX proved to be a resounding success for Citroën, enjoying a strong 12-year production run. More than just a commercial triumph, it reaffirmed Citroën’s place as a serious contender during a dynamic era of innovation in the French automotive world.
vehicleCollection.zh:
全面的雪铁龙旅行车迎来焕然一新的现代外观

1976年，雪铁龙并入标致汽车集团，业务重新洗牌。这让许多人质疑雪铁龙现在究竟是什么定位，而BX的推出就是为了回答这些问题——它在1982年巴黎车展上首次亮相。

BX充满了无可否认的雪铁龙特色元素。它在彻底现代化的包装中保留了GS和CX等经典雪铁龙车型的形象，以简洁而有力的线条示人。驾驶舱舒适宽敞，行李空间也很充裕。该车设计本身出自当时在博通汽车工作的马塞罗·甘迪尼之手。

在机械结构方面也花费了大量心思。虽然许多车型开始与标致共享越来越多的零部件，但BX采用了品牌标志性的液压气动悬挂系统。该系统使用氮气和油液而非传统的螺旋弹簧和阻尼器，这使得车身离地间隙可以自由调节，同时营造出雪铁龙独特的驾乘感受。

这款车提供多种引擎选择，但这里展示的19 TRS是采用1.9升汽油引擎的豪华旅行车型。虽然引擎不是特别强劲，但得益于相对轻盈和具有空力效应的车身，它能够轻松应对假期长途驾驶。

BX证明了雪铁龙的成功，连续销售了12年。这款车也证明了在法国汽车工业不断创新的时代，雪铁龙仍然是一个有力的竞争者。

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
The soul of a creator reaches out to unknown horizons.

At the point of arrival, new footprints
erase what was there before.

This creative passion will forever be engraved into
people's hearts and never disappear.

These extraordinary creators...their visions have
profoundly shaped the automotive world.

They grab hold of the distant future and pull it in.

They fly in the skies where technology and design are free,
then safely land where their completed car becomes legend.

And the creator becomes a hero.

The designer of the 1955 DS was the Italian,
 Flaminio Bertoni.

Unfortunately, his existence became
widely known only after his passing.]
dialogues.zh:
这是创作者的灵魂在向着未知的边界进行探索。

在抵达之时，新的足迹便抹去了原先的痕迹。

然而，这份创作的激情将永远铭刻在人们心中，
永远不会消失。

这些非凡的创作者，他们的愿景深刻地塑造了汽车世界。

他们抓住遥远的未来，将其带到人们的眼前。

他们自由飞翔在技术和设计的天空中，随着他们安全落下，
因之而生的汽车便成为了传奇。

而创作者则成为了英雄。

1955 DS的设计师是一位意大利人，弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼。

令人扼腕的是，他的声名在故去之后才广泛地为人所知。

collection.en:
Produced by French car company,
Citroën, the DS is a timeless masterpiece.

Citroën was founded in 1919 and has consistently been known for
its advanced technology.

In the '30s, Citroën produced unibody front-wheel-drive machines
while most cars had separate frames and rear-wheel-drive.

The Traction Avant, released in 1934,
sold about 750,000 units before production ended.

The DS model that replaced the Traction Avant was introduced
at the 1955 Paris Salon international car show.

Visitors to the show were wowed by the futuristic body
by Italian sculptor and designer Flaminio Bertoni.

The DS was a mid-size 4-door sedan that sported a sharp-looking
front end and sports-car aerodynamics...

...the result of a body that tapers sharply towards the rear.

Also, the car's mechanics, from the
suspension to the brakes to the transmission...

...was controlled by a proprietary hydraulic system.

The DS you see here is a later model
that shows a few evolutionary design changes.

It also has adaptive headlights that respond to steering inputs.
collection.zh:
DS由法国品牌雪铁龙出品，是跨越时间的永恒设计杰作。

雪铁龙最初建于1919年，从其创业早期开始
便以领先的技术而闻名。

在三十年代，当分体式车架和后轮驱动还是主流的时候，
雪铁龙就生产出了前轮驱动加一体化车壳的汽车。

1934年发布的“牵引前卫”在其生产周期内
创下了75万辆的销售纪录。

作为其后继车型，DS发布于1955年的巴黎沙龙国际车展。

意大利雕塑家、设计师弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼执笔设计的
未来主义车身令观展者们震撼不已。

DS是一辆中型四门轿车，但前半部分线条却十分犀利，
拥有与跑车相当的出色空气动力学性能……

后部车身则呈锥形迅速收拢。

此外，此车的每一套系统，从悬挂到刹车，
再到传动系统……

都通过一套专利的液压系统来控制。

我们这里看到的这一辆DS是后期车型，可以从中
看到b革命性的设计变革。

它还拥有自适应头灯，能随车辆转向而变化
——这是一个超前于时代的点子！

vehicleCollection.en:
A historic vision of the future from France.[

When it comes to front-wheel-drive cars, Citroën has few equals, and the DS can be considered the company's masterpiece, which came laden with the most cutting-edge technologies of the day.

The DS first appeared at the 1955 Salon de l'Automobile. While many other manufacturers were still producing cars in the pre-war style, the DS represented a stunning vision of the future. With its avant-garde aerodynamic body and revolutionary hydropneumatic suspension system, it was nicknamed the "flying saucer." Development was led by André Lefèbvre, while the comparatively large 4.8m long body was the work of Italian designer Flaminio Bertoni, who also worked on the classic 2CV.

With such a forward-thinking design, the DS remained relevant for a long period of time. Along with various equipment and engine upgrades, the car was produced for 20 years. In 1964, the "Pallas" grade that included luxury interior and exterior fixtures was added to the lineup. In 1967, a slight facelift gave the car four round headlights that replaced the two-light scheme.

The DS 21 Pallas, produced from 1969, came powered by a 116.7ps 2.1-liter engine. The large seats and spacious interior remained, and the lightweight car accelerated briskly.

While originally conceived as an everyday passenger vehicle, the DS was also loved as a government vehicle, ambulance and even a taxi. It is one of the most important French cars in automotive history.
vehicleCollection.zh:
畅想未来的法国历史车型。

雪铁龙一直致力于开发前驱车，而这辆采用当时最顶尖科技打造的雪铁龙DS就是他们最引以为傲的杰作。

这款车于1955的巴黎车展上首次亮相。当很多汽车制造商依然在按照战前的设计风格开发汽车时，这款DS却展现了对于未来的惊鸿一瞥。它采用了前卫的空气动力学车身设计和革新性的液压气动悬挂系统，得到了“飞碟”的昵称。这款车的开发由安德雷·勒菲弗主导，而其相对更大的4.8m长车身则由意大利设计师弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼设计，后者也是雪铁龙经典车型2CV的设计师。

如此领先的设计思维，让这款DS的人气经久不衰。通过不断更新装备和引擎升级，它持续生产了足足20年。1964年，DS推出了“Pallas”级车型，加入了奢华的内外饰。然后，这款车又在1967年进行了现代化外观升级，将原本的2盏圆形大灯改为了4盏有罩大灯。

DS 21 Pallas是一款采用2.1L引擎的型号，从1969年开始量产。其保留了大尺寸座椅和宽敞的内部空间，而一台能够输出116.7ps的引擎更是可以从容而优雅地推动它的轻量化车身。

尽管其原本的设计是一款日常代步车，但DS也是非常受欢迎的礼宾车、救护车，甚至经常作为出租车。它是汽车历史上最重要的法国车之一。

由设计师山本卓一出手，按照Gr.4规范对其进行了改造。

其方向盘和显示仪表盘充满了赛车美学。

vehicleCollection.en:
This concept car for the virtual world was developed in collaboration with Citroën.

The GT by Citroën announced at the 2008 Paris Motor Show was the first sports concept car created from a collaboration between Citroën and Gran Turismo. This approach succeeded in establishing an image of a new concept car that does not just end at the show floor. This is because a 21st century sports car imagined by Citroën is accurately expressed in both real and virtual forms.

Based on the GT by Citroën, the GT by Citroën Gr.4 is a race spec car modified for racing in the Gr.4 category.

To meet the Gr.4 regulations in which the range of modifications is limited, the exterior changes are minimal. However, because the original car is already very unique, its sense of presence is overwhelming. The armor-like front and rear fenders and the sharp visage of the fascia that remind the viewer of a medieval Japanese warrior’s mask, are maintained in this model.

The unique aspect of this car is that the modifications to make it a Gr.4 car were performed by none other than Takumi Yamamoto himself, who created the original design for the base car. The 6 variations of the livery and newly added rear wing express the intent of Yamamoto. The addition of required racing equipment such as hood pins, towing hooks, and air jack valves give the car the look of a serious circuit fighting machine.

The interior has also been modified for weight reduction, and the steering wheel and HUD are made in a functional design befitting of a race car. The dashboard material has been changed from copper to carbon, and the HUD displays speed, engine RPM, steering angle, and horizontal Gs to assist the assessment of the car’s state by the drivers on the track.

With its avant-garde styling and performance of a competition machine, the GT by Citroën Gr.4 is a groundbreaking combination of these aspects.
vehicleCollection.zh:
跑车浪漫旅与雪铁龙联合研发的一辆虚拟概念赛车。

在2008年巴黎车展上公布的雪铁龙 GT是雪铁龙与跑车浪漫旅合作开发的首款概念跑车。雪铁龙创想的这种同时以真实与虚拟形式表现21世纪跑车的方法，成功地树立了一个并不仅仅止步于展台的新概念赛车形象。

GT by 雪铁龙组别4是一款以雪铁龙 GT为原型的专用赛车，为参与组别4比赛而进行了改装。

为满足组别4对改装范围的限制，外观改变被限制在了最小程度。然而由于原车本身就已经非常独特，它依旧拥有压倒性的存在感。这一车型拥有盔甲般的正面和后挡板以及外观刚毅的前脸，令人联想到中世纪的日本武士面具。

这款车型的独特之处在于，其改装由原型车的设计者山本卓一亲自操刀。六种不同的涂装和新增的后翼充分表达了山本设计师的意图。此外，由于添加了引擎盖和拖钩以及气阀这样的必需赛车设备，该车型看上去如同一名严肃的赛道杀手。

为减轻重量，该车型的内饰同样进行了改装。方向盘和抬头显示都进行了适用于赛车的功能性设计。仪表盘的材料从铜变更为碳。抬头显示能够显示速度、发动机转速、转向角度和横向重力加速度，以帮助赛道上的车手对赛车状态进行评估。

GT by 雪铁龙组别4将前卫的外观和竞速赛车的出色性能突破性地结合在了一起。

The GT by Citroën was the starting point for this original
Gran Turismo Gr.3 race car.

Takumi Yamamoto, the GT's designer, modified the exterior

The wide fenders with multiple air ducts is one of the

brandCentral.zh:
Citroën GT是这款原创跑车浪漫旅Gr.3级别赛车的基础车型。

GT的设计师山本卓一对原车的外形进行了调整，使其符
合Gr.3的规范。

其中最显著的改动是加宽、外扩的挡泥板和多条风道。

vehicleCollection.en:
This concept car for the virtual world was developed in collaboration with Citroën.

The GT by Citroën announced at the 2008 Paris Motor Show, is a sports concept car in which Citroën and Gran Turismo collaborated for the first time.

The car attracted much attention as a new type of concept car, an expression of real and virtual. And it was in the spring of 2009, that a decision was made to run a racing spec version of this machine in the world of GT.

The exterior was designed by Takumi Yamamoto, the designer who created the original. Many sketches were sent to Polyphony Digital (PDI) day after day, and as a result, the original fenders were widened, and with the addition of air ducts and other aerodynamic parts, the design took an extremely aggressive turn.

Based on this, the details to make it more racing-car like was left to PDI. Details like the hood pins and tow hooks you would normally see on race cars, the valves for the air jacks, and the layout of sponsor stickers, were all set by PDI.

The other major piece of work left to PDI was the design of the interior. The motif was a modern jet fighter, and while being extremely high tech, it is balanced with the gritty feel of a real racing car.

All parts aside from the dashboard have been replaced, and the steering wheel and HUD (heads-up display) are functional in design as befitting a racing car, while still being as eccentric as the exterior. Though not changed in design, the dashboard is made of carbon, instead of copper.

The HUD displays things like speed, engine rpm, steering angle, and horizontal Gs.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
跑车浪漫旅与雪铁龙联合研发的一辆虚拟概念赛车。

在2008年巴黎车展上公布的雪铁龙GT是雪铁龙与跑车浪漫旅合作开发的首款概念跑车。

作为融合真实和虚拟世界的新型概念赛车，这一车型吸引了各界的关注。并于2009年春季决定在GT的数字世界中制作该车型的赛车车型。

外观设计依旧由原型设计师山本卓一操刀。日复一日，无数的草图被送往Polyphony Digital。结果，原有的翼片被拓宽，并增加了空气导管和其他空气动力组件，使得该车的外观设计变得极具攻击性。

适应赛车比赛需要的细节问题交由Polyphony Digital处理。像是引擎盖和拖钩这样的细节和赛车上常见的东西——比如气阀及赞助商标签的布局等设计工作都由Polyphony Digital设计师来完成。

其余由Polyphony Digital负责的工作主要是内饰设计。车内环境和整体感觉令人联想到现代的喷气式战斗机，既有着极致的高科技感，也与真实赛车的质感进行了平衡。

除仪表盘外所有的部件都进行了更换。尽管在设计上并无改动，仪表盘的材料由铜换成了碳。方向盘和抬头显示在功能设计上更适合赛车，同时保有和外观同样的风格。抬头显示能够显示速度、发动机转速、转向角度和横向重力加速度。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
The GT Concept Car by Citroën has a very intriguing design.

Its centre fuselage disappears behind
its very bold fender shapes.

This gives the car a sleek and aggressive look, and helps
to manage air flow and cooling in a unique way.

The windscreen and side glass are like slits, giving the
GT by Citroën a very private, sinister look.
dialogues.zh:
这辆GT by Citroën概念车带来了令人惊诧的设计。

它的车身不着痕迹地消失在极度激进的挡泥板之后。

这种特色让这辆车拥有了利落而极富侵略性的外观，
并以独特的方式辅助了气流引导和散热。

挡风玻璃和车窗玻璃就像是在同一块玻璃上开了缝一般，
让这辆GT by Citroën呈现出既注重隐私，又略带邪恶的外观。

brandCentral.en:
The GT by Citroën, unveiled in 2008, was a collaboration
between Citroën and Gran Turismo.

The car you see here is the road-going version of
the concept.

While the original study was powered by electricity, this one
came equipped with a mid-mounted gasoline V-8.

The body was penned by Takumi Yamamoto, a designer
at Citroën.

The lines of the car suggest the intricacies
of Japanese samurai armor.
brandCentral.zh:
Citroën GT来自于Citroën和跑车浪漫旅的合作项目，于2008年
首次亮相。

这辆车是概念车的公路版本。

原概念车是一台电动车，这款公路车则采用了中置V8引
擎，仍以汽油为燃料。

它是由Citroën的设计师山本卓一设计的。

山本的独特设计从日本的盔甲中汲取了大量的灵感。/

vehicleCollection.en:
From dream to reality, the supercar concept developed by Citroën and Gran Turismo becomes a V8-powered mid-engine sports car.

The GT by Citroën was a concept car created through a collaboration between Citroën and Gran Turismo. It was the hit of the 2008 Paris Motor Show, with many impressed by its avant-garde styling, penned by Citroën designer Takumi Yamamoto.

This super sports car came to life after numerous travels between Japan and France. It went from a show model to a running model, which we called the GT by Citroën Road Car. The major difference between the show car and road car was the former was an electric vehicle with a high-power motor, while the latter came powered by a mid-mounted V-8 engine.

The elegant exterior of the car was largely left intact. The slits between the rounded inner body and outer cowling effectively dissipate heat from the engine, keeping it cool.

Also, the replacement of the heavy, high-capacity drive battery with a smaller gasoline tank made the car much lighter.

A sturdy rear cowl completely covered the engine bay, but it provided extra rigidity, which made the GT by Citroën an awesome handling machine.
vehicleCollection.zh:
化作公路赛车的梦幻概念赛车型，采用中置V8引擎。

2008年巴黎车展上公布的雪铁龙GT是雪铁龙与跑车浪漫旅合作开发的首款概念跑车。在2008年巴黎车展上公布后，该车立刻吸引了各界关注。由雪铁龙设计师山本卓一设计的前卫外观更是大受好评。

这台超级跑车在制作中几经波折，在日本和法国之间往返数次。此次在跑车浪漫旅进行复刻，并将其由展览车型改为公路车型，算是彻底完成了这台雪铁龙GT公路赛车。最大的不同之处是概念赛车采用了大功率电机设计，而在公路赛车款式中则改为使用中置V8引擎的跑车式配置。

如同盔甲般的外形几乎未进行改动，而车体内的圆弧形线条和直线式的整流罩搭配所形成的沟槽，还具有引入空气以便进行冷却与散热的功能。该车在设计上就考虑到了加装高马力大排量引擎的可能性。

不仅如此，装载在概念赛车中的大容量驱动电池被移除，改为容量小得多的小型油箱，以便大幅减轻重量。

这种引擎室被后罩完全遮蔽的做法简单地确保了车身后半部的刚性，打造出超级跑车的操驾感。

2008年巴黎车展上公布的雪铁龙GT是雪铁龙与跑车浪漫旅合作开发的首款概念跑车。在2008年巴黎车展上公布后，该车立刻吸引了各界关注。由雪铁龙设计师山本卓一设计的前卫外观更是大受好评。

这台超级跑车在制作中几经波折，在日本和法国之间往返数次。此次在跑车浪漫旅进行复刻，并将其由展览车型改为公路车型，算是彻底完成了这台雪铁龙GT公路赛车。最大的不同之处是概念赛车采用了大功率电机设计，而在公路赛车款式中则改为使用中置V8引擎的跑车式配置。

如同盔甲般的外形几乎未进行改动，而车体内的圆弧形线条和直线式的整流罩搭配所形成的沟槽，还具有引入空气以便进行冷却与散热的功能。该车在设计上就考虑到了加装高马力大排量引擎的可能性。

不仅如此，装载在概念赛车中的大容量驱动电池被移除，改为容量小得多的小型油箱，以便大幅减轻重量。

这种引擎室被后罩完全遮蔽的做法简单地确保了车身后半部的刚性，打造出超级跑车的操驾感。

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
Here we go!
The Daihatsu Copen makes me smile!

 It is truly a whimsical and fun design!
It says, "Don't take things so seriously!"

 Look at the front with its friendly round
headlamps and a smiling grille!

 The taillights repeat the expression with its round eyes.
And, proportionally, it has a nice stance.

This design here visually puts the wheels on the ends,
making it a look like its ready to pounce!
dialogues.zh:
每当我看到Daihatsu Copen，都会忍不住笑！

这确实算是一个异想天开的有趣设计！
它仿佛在说：“看我萌你一脸！”

前脸这里，是对你开心眨眼的圆形大灯和嘴角上翘的进气格栅！

尾灯也是两颗萌萌的圆眼睛。
它的车身比例相当不错，所以静态效果很出彩。

设计师特意把前后轮距拉远，
让它看起来像是要“猛兽”扑食一般！

brandCentral.en:
Designed to meet Japan's 'kei car' standards, the Copen
is a two-seater convertible with an FF layout.

While it may only sport a 660cc engine, you'd do well to
not underestimate it!

A perfect car for those who like a bit of power, the Copen
also boasts a rigid chassis and precise handling.

Its electrically operated metal roof is also quite the
crowd-pleaser!
brandCentral.zh:
Copen是一款采用前置前驱布局的双座敞篷车，设计上非常
契合日本的“轻型车”标准。

虽然只采用了660cc的引擎，但您最好不要小瞧它！

对于那些对动力稍有追求的人来说，Copen也是一款完美的汽车，
拥有坚固的底盘和精准的操控，

还有电控的金属顶篷，也十分符合大众的审美！

usedCar.en:
The Copen is a prized example of Japan's "kei" sports cars
because of its performance and quality craftsmanship.

Its metal roof could be electronically extended or retracted
at the push of a button.

The 4-cylinder engine set it apart from other "kei cars"
in its class...

...which helped give the car a fun, sporty flavor.

The hum of the little powerplant will sing you a lovely song
when you rev it freely on your favorite mountain road.
usedCar.zh:
由于Copen优良的性能和制造工艺，
它成为了最受人喜爱的日本“Kei”轻型车之一。

这款车还配备了能一键收展的
电动金属车顶。

不同于其他“Kei”型跑车，
它还搭载了一台四缸发动机。

这辆车保准能为你提供既平稳又令人满足的驾驶体验。

在赛道上，
它清脆的引擎声能令你心花怒放。

vehicleCollection.en:
A kei car with a sports car heart, this little convertible was at home on the racetrack.

First shown at the 1999 Tokyo Motor Show, the Daihatsu Kopen, the company's first attempt at a convertible two-seat kei car, was unveiled to positive reviews by the public and media alike. Their response helped push it into production in June 2002 as the Copen.

The Copen was a very different beast from its kei-car predecessors of the 1990s that included the likes of the Mazda AZ-1, Honda Beat and Suzuki Cappuccino. While most kei-cars were merely inexpensively built, the Copen was a well-engineered sporty machine.

It featured a rigid, lightweight body, a well-tuned suspension and upscale features like a stylish MOMO steering wheel and five coats of paint. Additionally, the Copen made use of an "Active Top" electric roof, the first ever for a production kei car as standard equipment. Developed by OASys, a company co-founded by Webasto of Germany and famed Italian automotive design firm Pininfarina, this retractable hardtop could open or close in just 20 seconds. Also adding to the Copen's appeal was an automatic transmission that attracted a new range of buyers that helped propel Copen sales beyond the 40,000-unit mark in 2007.

So popular was the car that Daihatsu began exporting it to overseas markets, including the United Kingdom and Australia, in 2003 in its original form. There, the Copen received an engine upgrade to 1300cc in 2005.
vehicleCollection.zh:
轻型敞篷车，可以参加赛道比赛。

大发工业推出的首款双座敞篷轻型跑车“Kopen”在1999年东京车展上亮相，立即受到参展车迷的热烈欢迎，并在2002年定型为“Copen”进入量产。

这是一款与1990年代马自达AZ-1、本田Beat和铃木Cappuccino风格相似的车型。这些车款是在日本经济泡沫的时代制造的，Copen研发的时代与背景却截然不同。因此大发进行了非常细致的市场宣传，并在细节方面超越了轻型车的常见规格。

Copen由大发总部基地“专家中心”的专有生产线制造，这里聚集了大发集团最优秀的技术人员。该车拥有高强度轻量化的车身，特别调校的悬挂，MOMO方向盘与5层涂装喷漆等高级特性，这些超高的品质使其甚至可以被称作是“豪华车型”。

此外，Copen首次在商用轻型跑车上标配了“主动顶”电动顶蓬。这套敞篷系统由德国的伟巴斯特与意大利的宾尼法利纳共同创办的欧艾希公司研发，可在短短20秒内打开或关闭顶蓬。

该车还提供了自动档车型，扩展了潜在的用户群，使其销量大大超出了原本的预估，仅在2007年内就售出了4万台。

2003年，该车开始出口到英国和澳大利亚，起初，出口车型与日本国内销售的型号几乎完全相同，2005年起则提供了主要面向欧洲市场的1300cc车款。

cars.nameEn: DAIHATSU COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo
cars.nameZh: DAIHATSU COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo

brandCentral.sourceName: DAIHATSU COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.en:
The Daihatsu Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo is a sports model
built to comply with Japanese 'kei car' specifications.

Its engine is limited to 660cc, but produces 150ps of
power—nearly 2.5 times as much as the standard Copen.

The 'RJ' in the name stands for Racing Jacket.

This vehicle stands apart not only because of its aggressive
tuning, but also because of its stylish design.
brandCentral.zh:
Daihatsu Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo是一款
按照日本的“轻型车”规格打造的跑车车型。

虽然引擎排量被限制在660cc，但仍能产生150ps的动力——
这个数据几乎是标准版Copen的2.5倍。

名称中的“RJ”代表赛车夹克。

这辆车的与众不同不仅在于激进的调校，时尚外观设计
也是加分项。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: DAIHATSU COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo
vehicleCollection.en:
A Vision Gran Turismo that represents the potential of kei cars.

Kei vehicles are unique to Japan, where they serve an important role in the country's automotive culture. The vehicles must adhere to many restrictions, mainly in size and engine displacement, but that hasn't stopped many manufacturers to create some amazingly fun-to-drive sporty examples.

Once such car is the Daihatsu Copen, a convertible that can be considered a genuine sport car. The second-generation model, which appeared in 2014, featured a D-Frame body and came powered by a turbocharged 3.0-cylinder engine, complete with variable valve timing. It also had what the company called the Dress-Formation system that allowed body panels to be easily removed and replaced to change the look of the car.

Using this car as a base, the COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo was created to explore the full sporting potential of kei cars. RJ stands for "Racing Jacket," which refers to the car's sporty exterior. The car indeed has the look of a warrior dressed for battle with an oversized front spoiler, rear wing and diffusers. The car's aggressive fender flares adds to the car's "let's get down to business" nature.

By law, the engine's displacement remains 660cc, but boost pressure has been increased to allow the 3.0-cylinder to produce 149ps and 20.6kgm of torque. Also, curb weight has been reduced to just 600kg, giving the car the acceleration pop of bigger sports cars.

In the 1960s, Daihatsu competed in motorsports with the classic P-5. The COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo is meant to carry on that fighting spirit.
vehicleCollection.zh:
代表微型车潜力的Vision Gran Turismo。

微型”车辆规格是日本独有的，它们在日常生活中发挥着重要作用。虽然发动机排量和车身尺寸保持在最低限度，但有许多车型在展示强大性能的同时，也让这部分成为其魅力所在。

其中一款车型是大发Copen，这是一款具有真正跑车潜力的敞篷车。第二代车型于 2014 年首次亮相，采用坚固的“D 型框架”车身结构，配备可变式气门正时的 3 缸涡轮发动机。它还具有俏皮的“流线构造”系统，可以轻松拆卸和更换车身面板，以改变汽车的外观。

以此为基础，COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo努力探索微型车的全部潜力。RJ代表“赛车服”，指的是几乎像盔甲一样的外观，体现了对赛车胜利的期待。

这辆车实际上看起来像一个战士。配备超大前扰流板、尾翼和扩散器的战斗装备，以及增加宽度的挡泥板喇叭口，给人难以置信的形象。

根据微型车的规定，发动机排量仍为660cc，但增压压力已增加到极限，以达到149ps/20.6kgm。此外，车身重量已降低至仅，使该车具备与配备更大发动机的跑车相抗衡的赛车潜力。

在 1960 年代，大发凭借其经典的 P-5 参加赛车运动。COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo是一款延续其战斗精神的雄心勃勃的作品。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
This SF19 was built for Japan’s top formula racing series,
the Super Formula Championship.

The Super Formula is the preeminent formula racing event
in all of Asia…

And is considered the quickest motorsport after F1.

In Super Formula races, drivers tend to show their skill
through overtaking manoeuvres.

By the way, are you familiar with overtaking systems?

It is a system that allows a driver momentarily increases
the flow of fuel to the engine for increased speed!

It requires plenty of control and the utmost technique!

This Honda-powered SF19 conjures up memories
of Alex Palou’s record victory.

Palou later went on to compete in the IndyCar series,
a formula racing series held in the USA.
dialogues.zh:
这辆SF19是为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛
——超级方程式锦标赛而开发的。

放眼整个亚洲，超级方程式都是最卓越的方程式比赛……

也被视为是仅次于F1的最快汽车赛事。

在超级方程式比赛中，车手们倾向于
通过超车来展现个人技巧。

顺带问一句，你对超级方程式的超车系统有了解吗？

它可以通过短暂提高注入引擎的燃料量，以提升车速！

同时也需要车手大量的操控和纯熟的技巧才能驾驭！

这辆本田出品的SF19见证了亚历克斯·帕卢
创下纪录的胜利。

在那之后，帕卢又转战印地系列赛，
那是在美国举办的另一项方程式赛车系列赛。

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.en:
This SF19 was built for Japan’s top formula racing series,
the Super Formula Championship.

The Super Formula is the preeminent formula racing event
in all of Asia…

And is considered the quickest motorsport after F1.

In Super Formula races, drivers tend to show their skill
through overtaking manoeuvres.

By the way, are you familiar with overtaking systems?

It is a system that allows a driver momentarily increases
the flow of fuel to the engine for increased speed!

It requires plenty of control and the utmost technique!

This Honda-powered SF19 conjures up memories
of Alex Palou’s record victory.

Palou later went on to compete in the IndyCar series,
a formula racing series held in the USA.
conversation.zh:
这辆SF19是为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛
——超级方程式锦标赛而开发的。

放眼整个亚洲，超级方程式都是最卓越的方程式比赛……

也被视为是仅次于F1的最快汽车赛事。

在超级方程式比赛中，车手们倾向于
通过超车来展现个人技巧。

顺带问一句，你对超级方程式的超车系统有了解吗？

它可以通过短暂提高注入引擎的燃料量，以提升车速！

同时也需要车手大量的操控和纯熟的技巧才能驾驭！

这辆本田出品的SF19见证了亚历克斯·帕卢
创下纪录的胜利。

在那之后，帕卢又转战印地系列赛，
那是在美国举办的另一项方程式赛车系列赛。

brandCentral.en:
The Dallara SF19 Super Formula was built for Japan's
top-level formula racing series.

The engines used in the Super Formula championship are known
as Nippon Race Engines.

They are turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4s that produce
more than 550ps.

They're supplied by both Toyota and Honda. This particular
car has the Honda engine.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Dallara SF19 Super Formula专为日本最顶级的
方程式赛车赛事所打造。

用于超级方程式锦标赛的引擎统称日本比赛引擎，

都是动力超过550ps马力的2L直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

这些引擎全部由Toyota和Honda提供，这辆车上安装的是一台
Honda引擎。|

vehicleCollection.en:
Both Toyota and Honda provide engines for the Super Formula series. This is the one from Honda.

For the 2019 season, the premiere formula racing series in Japan, the Super Formula Series, announced that it would be using the Dallara SF19 chassis.

As the successor to the SF14 that was used in Super Formula from 2014 to 2018, the SF19 was designed to meet the F1 safety requirements established by the FIA in 2016, including the HALO cockpit protection system. The new chassis also incorporated revisions in its aerodynamics to balance competition and entertainment value, improving stability during close-proximity racing to make passing easier.

The Super Formula series will continue with the NRE (Nippon Race Engine) that was introduced in 2014, a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection, specially developed by Toyota and Honda. Maximum output remains at more than 550ps. Both the Toyota and Honda engines share several components together, including the turbine and ECU, but they still remain bitter rivals as each camp always tries to one-up the other.)
vehicleCollection.zh:
丰田和本田都是超级方程式比赛的引擎供应商，这辆使用的是本田的引擎。

超级方程式系列赛是日本最顶级的方程式赛车赛事，在2019赛季，这项赛事将其赛车的底盘更换为了达拉拉SF19。

SF19是2014到2018年间所采用的SF14的后续型号，同样由意大利的底盘制造商达拉拉所设计。这款新的汽车底盘延续了灵活和轻量化的理念，其设计符合国际汽联在2016年颁布的F1安全要求，包括引入光晕驾驶室保护系统以增强安全性。SF19还融入了空气动力学布局的改进，进一步平衡竞技性和娱乐性，提高了靠近其他车辆时的可操控性，便于超车。

这款车仍然采用了2014年推出的日本比赛引擎——一款带直喷系统的2升涡轮增压直列4缸引擎，由丰田和本田按照同等规范、采用同样的部件（如涡轮和电子控制单元等）特别开发。其最大输出马力依然为550ps，不过两家引擎生产商在规则容许的极小范围内展开着激烈的研发竞赛。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Well, if it isn’t an SF19, built for Japan’s top formula
race series, the Super Formula Championship.

Pop quiz! Do you know who supplies the SF19's
engines?

The answer is: Toyota and Honda.

This machine here is powered by a Toyota engine, and it was
raced by Kazuki Nakajima and Kamui Kobayashi.

That’s right, two racers that Toyota trained
for the F1 Grand Prix!

Although it produces about half the power of an F1 car,
it’s small, light, and possesses great aerodynamics.

Thanks to their F1 experience, the drivers were able
to push the car to its limits.

Nick Cassidy was the series champion when this machine
made its debut in 2019.
dialogues.zh:
哎呀，这不是SF19，专门为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛，
超级方程式锦标赛而打造的赛车吗！

突击小测验！你知道为SF19提供引擎的是哪个厂家吗？

答案就是……丰田和本田！

这一台车里用的是丰田的引擎，
而驾驶它参加比赛的分别是中岛一贵和小林可梦伟。

没错，这两位可都是丰田旗下参加过F1大奖赛的车手！

虽然SF19的动力只有F1赛车的一半，但它也更小巧而轻量，
并且空气动力学性能相当不赖。

得益于两位车手的F1经验，能将此车的潜能发挥到极限。

在SF19亮相的2019年，尼克·卡西迪赢得了当年的系列赛冠军。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
The Super Formula? Of course I know it. It’s a world famous
Japanese formula race series.

The beginning of genuine motorsports in Japan is said
to date back to the 1960s.

The first Japanese Grand Prix was held in 1963.

Back then, the track was dominated by modified road cars,
or "touring cars" to be precise.

Since then, Japan has also slowly crafted its own
formula race scene.

For this to happen, Japanese Grand Prix drivers
had to study abroad...

...at famous race schools in England, where they learned
the ins and outs of formula racing.

After that, they teamed up with Japanese automotive
engineers to develop Japan’s first formula cars.
dialogues.zh:
超级方程式？我当然知道啦。这是一项
全球知名的日本方程式系列赛。

据说日本真正的赛车运动始于二十世纪六十年代。

第一届日本大奖赛在1963年就举办了。

在当时，统治赛道的多是些经过改装的公路车，
或者更准确说是“房车”。

自那时起，日本就一直在逐步地搭建
属于自己的方程式赛车领域。

为了实现这一目的，日本大奖赛的车手们纷纷走出国门……

在英格兰的著名赛车学校学习，并在那里
了解到了方程式赛车的方方面面。

学成归来后，他们便与日本汽车工程师们合作，
打造出了日本的第一款方程式赛车。

brandCentral.en:
The Dallara SF23 Super Formula was built for Japan's
top-level formula racing series.

Debuted in 2023 as the successor to the SF19...

It is distinguished by two major features.

The first feature is its new aerodynamic design, which
promotes more wheel-to-wheel racing.

The second feature is its ‘carbon-neutral’ construction.

As a carbon-neutral racer, the SF23 makes use of
sustainable materials for its tyres and body cowl.

For example, its body cowl is made from low-emission
bio-composite materials.

And its Super Formula series tyres are also eco-friendly,
made from recycled materials.

Like before, power is supplied by both Toyota and Honda.
This car runs on a Honda-made engine.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Dallara SF23 Super Formula是专为日本最顶级的
方程式系列赛所打造。

它首发于2023年，是SF19的后继车型。

这台车有两个非常鲜明的特点：

首先是它全新的空气动力学设计，旨在鼓励
车手们进行短兵相接的竞速。

第二项特点则是“碳中和”构造。

作为一款“碳中和”赛车，SF23的轮胎和车身板材
采用了可持续材料。

比如，其车身板材使用低排放生物复合材料制造。

而其超级方程式系列专用轮胎也采用了可回收材料。

和前代车型一样，这个型号的动力系统由Toyota和Honda
联合提供。此版本安装了一台由Honda制造的引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
The next evolution of Super Formula cars aims to bring sustainability to motorsports

In spring 2023, Japan's top formula race series, Super Formula, saw the debut of the new Dallara SF23 race car.

The SF23 uses a number of new technologies from the "SUPER FORMULA NEXT50" motorsports sustainability project headed by Japan Race Promotion, the organizers of Super Formula.

The body of the SF23, based on the SF19 introduced in 2019, uses bio-composite materials produced by the Bcomp company. This allows a 75-percent reduction in CO2 emissions through the raw materials and construction processes while keeping the same weight and body rigidity as the previous carbon-fiber shell.

The car's tires are provided by Yokohama Rubber, which have also been developed for sustainability and are composed of sustainable materials such as naturally derived polymers and recycled rubbers. Although the Yokohama Carbon Neutral Racing Tires use 33-percent of sustainably sourced materials, they achieve the same handling levels as before. Equipped with these new tires, the SF23 becomes the ideal carbon neutral racing machine as outlined in SUPER FORMULA NEXT50.

To achieve another of the campaign's goals, which is to increase the entertainment value of the Super Formula races, the aerodynamics of the SF23 went through a complete overhaul. The new body allows drivers more opportunity to show off their skills in close quarters than ever before. As for the engines, the teams continue to choose between a Toyota or Honda powerplant.
vehicleCollection.zh:
全新进化的超级方程式赛车旨在为赛车运动提供更高的可持续性。

2023年春季，新款达拉拉SF23超级方程式赛车登上了日本的顶级方程式赛事“超级方程式”的舞台。

SF23采用了由超级方程式主办方日本赛车促进会发起的“超级方程式NEXT50”赛车运动可持续性计划中开发的若干项全新科技。

首先，SF23的车身基于2019年推出的SF19所打造，采用了由比康普公司生产的生物复合材料。这种材料可以让原材料和制造过程中产生的二氧化碳排放量减少75%，同时又保持了与之前的碳纤维车壳相当的车重和车身刚度特性。由优科豪马橡胶供应的比赛级轮胎也是专门针对可持续性所开发的。全新的轮胎采用了多种可持续性材料，如天然衍生聚合物和再生橡胶。尽管使用了33%的可持续来源材料，但这种轮胎可以提供和之前相同的操控性能。在安装了优科豪马碳中和赛车轮胎后，这款车成为了“超级方程式NEXT50”计划中所勾勒的理想中的碳中和赛车。

为了达成另一项“超级方程式NEXT50”目标“提升娱乐性”，这款车的空气动力学设计也进行了全面革新，可以让车手们有更多机会以前所未有的方式在近距离竞速中展现自己的技术。而在引擎方面则没有变化，车队们依然可以在丰田或本田动力单元中进行选择。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
This is the SF23, a car developed for the Super Formula series,
Japan's top-level formula race competition.

All teams participating in Super Formula must use
a race car with the same chassis.

Teams are also restricted to a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine
built by either Toyota or Honda.

That effectively makes Super Formula
a one-make race series.

In such a contest, victory is largely decided by a combination
of individual skill and team strategy.

This is one of the major draws of Japanese
Super Formula races.

Super Formula machines are distinguished by their
aerodynamic design...

...which is meant to limit air resistance at the rear
and sides of the body.

Because these machines are so similar in capability,
the race becomes a test of a driver’s skill.

The SF23 pushes this concept to new heights,
promising more dramatic wheel-to-wheel action!
dialogues.zh:
这辆SF23是专为日本的顶级方程式系列赛事
——超级方程式所打造的赛车。

所有参与超级方程式的车队都必须
使用同一款底盘开发的赛车。

并且，所有车队也只允许采用由丰田或本田所开发的
两款规格一致的2升4缸涡轮增压引擎之一。

因此超级方程式本质上也是一项单一车种方程式赛事。

在这样的比赛中，胜利在很大程度上是由
车手个人和车队策略所共同决定的。

这也是日本超级方程式系列赛的主要魅力之一。

超级方程式赛车拥有非常独特的空气动力学设计……

致力于尽量降低车身两侧和后部的空气阻力。

由于赛车的性能旗鼓相当，因此这项赛事
也成为了车手操控技术的比拼。

到了今年，这款SF23又将这一理^拔高到了全新高度，
保证可以为车迷们带来更激动人心的白刃战场面！
"

brandCentral.en:
The Dallara SF23 Super Formula was built for Japan's
top-level formula racing series.

Debuted in 2023 as the successor to the SF19...

It is distinguished by two major features.

The first feature is its new aerodynamic design, which
promotes more wheel-to-wheel racing.

The second feature is its ‘carbon-neutral’ construction.

As a carbon-neutral racer, the SF23 makes use of
sustainable materials for its tyres and body cowl.

For example, its body cowl is made from low-emission
bio-composite materials.

And its Super Formula series tyres are also eco-friendly,
made from recycled materials.

Like before, power is supplied by both Toyota and Honda.
This car runs on a Toyota-made engine.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Dallara SF23 Super Formula是专为日本最顶级的
方程式系列赛所打造。

它首发于2023年，是SF19的后继车型。

这台车有两个非常鲜明的特点：

首先是它全新的空气动力学设计，旨在鼓励
车手们进行短兵相接的竞速。

第二项特点则是“碳中和”构造。

作为一款“碳中和”赛车，SF23的轮胎和车身板材
采用了可持续材料。

比如，其车身板材使用低排放生物复合材料制造。

而其超级方程式系列专用轮胎也采用了可回收材料。

和前代车型一样，这个型号的动力系统由Toyota和Honda
联合提供。此版本安装了一台由Toyota制造的引擎。

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
What's interesting about this car is that the bodywork was penned
by a young Giugiaro, who was then the chief designer at Ghia.

It seems so simple, it looks to drawn by a single brush stroke,
thus the shape consists of simple lines and surfaces.

A half century later,
the car still looks fresh and alluring.

It shares the same backbone chassis technology as
the original Vallelunga, with a Ford V-8 housed within.

Access to the mid-mounted engine comes
via a butterfly-type rear hatch.

This detail is also particularly interesting and fun. I like it.
dialogues.zh:
这辆车最令人着迷之处全在于它的车身，
这是由Carrozzeria Ghia后来的首席设计师，

当时才初出茅庐的乔盖托·乔治亚罗执笔设计的。

它的外形如此简洁、仿佛是一笔而就，
因此其形状都为简单的线、面所构成。

在半个世纪后的今天，依然有新鲜感和吸引力。

它采用了与其原型Vallelunga相同的脊骨式车架技术，
搭载Ford V8引擎。

掀开鸥翼式的后备箱盖，就可以看到这台中置引擎。

这个细节特别有趣味。我很喜欢。

您不会是儿玉英雄吧，
曾经参与过德国Opel公司的诸多名车的那位设计师？"

collection.en:
Giorgetto Giugiaro is a legend in the world of car design.

He's worked on so many great cars, it would be hard to pick
just one to define him.

But if I had to choose...

...I'd go for the De Tomaso Mangusta, a car he designed
while working for Carrozzeria Ghia.

The Mangusta looks more striking than many of Giugiaro's
later designs.

There's something elegant about its sleek lines. It’s a simple
design, and yet it's glamorous and muscular, too.

The Mangusta bowed in 1966, and only 400 were produced.
It's powered by a Ford overhead valve V-8.

These days they're highly sought-after as early examples
of Giugiaro's genius.
collection.zh:
Giorgetto Giugiaro是汽车设计界的传奇人物。

他曾参与过许多伟大汽车的设计，因此很难只用一款车
来定义他的设计风格。

但如果一定要选的话……

我会选择这台De Tomaso Mangusta，
这是他在为Carrozzeria Ghia工作时设计的车。

与Giugiaro后来的诸多设计相比，Mangusta感觉更抓人眼球。

其流畅顺滑的线条带着几分优雅……设计虽简单，但却
魅力四射，充满力量感。

Mangusta在1966年首次亮相，搭载Ford顶置气门V8引擎，
总共只生产了400辆。

如今，这一车型作为Giugiaro天才设计的早期范例而备受收藏
者追捧。

vehicleCollection.en:
This mid-engine sports car set the stage for the famous Pantera.

De Tomaso introduced its second production sports car, the mid-engine Mangusta, in 1966, after its first offering, the Vallelunga, left many serious drivers wanting for more power. So, instead of going with the Vallelunga's 1.5-liter inline-4, De Tomaso chose to install a Ford V-8 into the new car. North American Mangustas received the 302-cu.-in. engine while other models took on the 289-cu.in. version. Both versions produced 310ps and were mated to a ZF-made 5-speed gearbox.

The car was extremely lightweight, weighing in at a lean 1300kg, which allowed the Mangusta to run to 100km in 6.0 seconds and reach a top speed of <250km/h>.

Although only 401 were made, the combination of the gorgeous Italian bodywork designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro, who was working for Carrozzeria Ghia at the time, and American V-8 power set the stage for the famous De Tomaso Pantera that came along in 1970.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这台中置引擎跑车为声名卓著的Pantera的登场铺平了道路。

采用中置引擎的Mangusta是德托马索的第二款量产跑车，于1966年首次亮相。

他们的上一款车型瓦莱伦加采用了1.5升直列四缸引擎，经实践证明，动力不尽如人意。因此，这款车型使用了在独立项目中开发的改装赛车底盘，并配置了一台福特V8引擎。作为其标准配置，该车采用了可产生310.2ps的289引擎，而美规版本则采用输出（233.2ps）动力的302引擎，两者都搭配了采埃孚制造的5速变速箱。

此车重量只有约1.3吨，最高时速设定为<250km/h>。

均衡且细致的外车壳是由当时为车身制造公司吉亚工作的乔盖托·乔治亚罗所设计的。

虽然这款车型只生产了401辆，但华丽的意大利中置引擎布局与功率强大的美国V8引擎的结合在1970年亮相的Pantera身上得以延续，并且令其大放异彩。

dialogues.speaker: Kim Jones
dialogues.roleEn: Fashion designer; Dior Men artistic director
dialogues.roleZh: 时装设计师 · Dior 男装艺术总监
dialogues.en:
Well it seems like you really enjoy collecting cars?

I tend to collect things I love myself,
so I know exactly how you feel.

I'm the Artistic Director of Dior Men's collections.

And, I'm always thinking about new, novel things.

Recently, I came up with an idea about a new collaboration.

The initial thought came from advertisements
involving cars and Dior from the 1960s to the 1980s.

At the time, Dior had a line of perfume that sponsored races
like the Dakar Rally and the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

And I thought to myself, what if we could combine
the elegant essence of Dior with a legendary sports car?

I was sure it would result in a phenomenal sports car
that would surprise everyone!

And, I had a particular car in mind
that would be perfect for this collaboration.

It was the iconic De Tomaso Mangusta from the 1960s.

The De Tomaso Mangusta
was designed by Giugiao during his years at Carrozzeria Ghia.

He's a genius who entered the world of car design at 17 years
of age, before becoming the chief developer at Ghia at just 27.

I've heard that Giugiaro's father was an artist.

So, I guess the styling ability of Giugiaro
also comes from the artist's lineage in him.

Now, I realized that there's a similarity between the timeless,
classic atmosphere of the Mangusta and the tone of Dior.

Therefore, I selected a slightly conservative, cream color for the
Mangusta, accented with a modest but chic stripe...

...with the “Dior” lettering on the side.

The car number 47 was derived from the year of the
first Dior collection, in 1947...

...and all these ideas came to life in the project with
Gran Turismo, resulting in this very special car.

There's also a some special magic to this Mangusta as well.

I designed a sp2cial racing outfit for the driver of this car.

The suit is yellow, a very iconic color for sports cars.
It stands out, but it's not too flamboyant.
The logo representing Dior uses the classic "CD Diamond"
taken from the same era as the car, from the 1960s and 1970s.

The shoes are from our well known "Diorizon" series.

But the upper side is changed and newly redesigned for driving.

It would make me very happy if this becomes
one of the surprises in yo6r collection!
dialogues.zh:
嗯，看来你们很喜欢收藏汽车？

我也会收藏一些自己喜欢的东西，
所以很能明白你们的感受。

我现在担任迪奥男装系列的艺术总监，

所以我一直在思考新鲜、新奇的事物。

最近，我突然想到了关于一个新合作项目的好点子。

最初的灵感是来源于迪奥在上世纪六十到八十年代间的
汽车合作广告。

当时，迪奥有条香水产品线为达喀尔拉力赛
和勒芒24小时拉力赛等比赛提供了赞助。

于是我就在心里盘算，如果把迪奥的优雅神韵
和一辆传奇跑车相结合会是怎么样的结果？

一定可以打造出一辆划时代的跑车，让所有人惊叹！

我脑海中就浮现出一辆非常适合这个合作项目的汽车。

二十世纪六十年代的标志性名车“德托马索Mangusta”。

德托马索Mangusta Ghia工作时
设计的。

他是一个天才，17岁就进入了汽车设计的世界，
仅27岁就成为了吉亚的首席开发工程师。

我听说乔治亚罗的父亲是一位画家。

所以我猜乔治亚罗的造型设计能力
也来自于他血液中流淌的艺术家基因。

我发觉Mangusta那永恒的、经典的气质
与迪奥的格调之间存在着相似之处。

因此我为它选择了一个稍有+保守的奶油色车身，
搭配低调而又别致的暗金条纹，

然后把“迪奥”字样放在车身的侧面。

车头的数字“47”来自于迪奥品牌首秀的年份，1947年。

我的这些理念在与跑车浪漫旅合作的项目中
成为了现实，造就了这辆非常独特的汽车。

伴随这辆Mangusta而来的还有另一个特别的魔法。

我为它的驾驶者也设了一套特别的赛车装备。

赛车服是黄色的，对于赛车而言是一个经典的颜色。
足够鲜明，但又不过分张扬。
作为代表迪奥的标志，我们选用了经典的“CD菱形纹样”，
与这辆赛车来自同一个年代——上世纪六十和七十年代。

赛车靴来自于我们知名的“Diorizon”系列，

但在踝部以上做了调整，针对车手的需求重新进行了设计。

如果这辆车能成为你那些令人惊艳的藏品之一，
我也会感到非常满足！

collection.en:
The De Tomaso Mangusta is an iconic 1960s sports car.

It is one of car designer Giorgetto Giugiaro's
most legendary creations,

and its value has risen quite a bit in recent years.

Now we have a very interesting chapter
added to the history of the Mangusta.

Introducing a Gran Turismo original, the Mangusta
"Christian Dior."

This car was created in collaboration with
the famous French couture house Christian Dior.

The aim of Dior here was to infuse the sports car
with its elegant brand essence.

The designer who worked on this project is Kim Jones,
Dior Men's Artistic Director

The Mangusta he customized is characterized by its chic body
color and stripe, and the "Dior" signature on its side.

The racing number 47 on the body is also strongly tied
to the history of the Dior Brand.

Last but not least, a special racing suit and helmet
have been designed specifically to accompany this Mangusta!
collection.zh:
omaso Mangusta是一辆标志性的1960年代跑车。

它是设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗最传奇的杰作之一，

其收藏价值也在近年来大幅飙升。

如今，我们又为Mangusta的辉煌历史添加了一段非常有趣的篇章，

为大家带来一款跑车浪漫旅原创车型：
Mangusta“克里斯汀·迪奥”。

这辆车是和知名法国高定时装品牌
克里斯汀·迪奥联手打造的。

由迪奥为这辆跑车注入品牌的优雅血统。

参与本项目开发的设计师是金·琼斯，
他同时也是迪奥男装部门的艺术总监。

这款由他亲手打造的Mangusta拥有雅致的奶油/暗金配色和
条纹图案。当然，车身侧面也不忘打上“迪奥”的标记。

车盖上的47号赛车号码也与
迪奥的品牌历史有着密切的联系。

最重要的是，为了配合这辆Mangusta的发布，
迪奥还特别设计了配套的赛车服和头盔！[

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
In America, the De Tomaso Pantera is still quite popular.

The Pantera is a model originally developed by Ford, but
it strongly possesses Italian supercar qualities.

It was an affordable super car...

So instead of keeping it tucked away for safe keeping, many
owners enjoyed tuning their car to their own tastes.
dialogues.zh:
De Tomaso Pantera在美国依然非常受欢迎。

Pantera车型最初由Ford开发，却拥有多处
强烈的意大利超级跑车特质。

而且是一辆价格相对较为实惠的超跑……

所以许多车主并没有将他们的爱车束之高阁，
而是按照自己的喜好进行改装。

usedCar.en:
The De Tomaso Pantera is a concept car that's not dissimilar
to a road-going Ford GT40.

The Italian maker Carrozzeria Ghia designed the body.

It's equipped with Ford's own 5.7L V8 engine.

The Pantera combines the sleek sensibilities of an Italian
supercar and the raw power of an American muscle car.
usedCar.zh:
De Tomaso Pantera是一款概念车，
与公路版Ford GT40不同。

车身由意大利制造商
Carrozzeria Ghia设计。

它配备Ford自有的5.7L V8引擎。

意大利超跑的优美感与美国肌肉车的
原始动力，两者皆集大成于Pantera。

vehicleCollection.en:
This extremely rare supercar combined vivid Italian design with no-nonsense American power.

The Pantera, a product of the former Italian sports car maker De Tomaso, featured plenty of American engineering under its svelte, exotic bodywork. Co-developed by Ford, under the supervision of then-vice president, Lee Iacocca, the Pantera was meant to rekindle Ford's fire for exotic cars, which was first established by the Ford GT40. To give the car a more European flavor, Iacocca brought in Alejandro de Tomaso to join the project.

Ford wanted to sell the Pantera in large numbers and in order to do so, Iacocca knew it needed to have a low price tag. So despite the expensive, exotic looking bodywork, designed by Tom Tjaarda of Carrozzeria Ghia, it came equipped with a Ford V8 that was suited for mass production.

The mid-engine Pantera made its debut with a 5.8L OHV V8 351 with a CDI that produced 335ps and 45kgm of torque, providing both power and performance equal to or better than its rivals of the day. While it was not powered by its own engine like cars from other Italian brands, it was a project that made perfect sense, taking the best of both worlds from the American and Italian car industries.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款极为稀有的超级跑车融合了意大利的精妙设计和美国的强劲马力。

Pantera是一款引擎中置式超级跑车，是意大利前跑车制造商德托马索的第三个车款。这款车与福特共同开发，是由当时任福特副总裁的李·艾柯卡提出的项目。艾柯卡为了提高品牌形象而启动了这个项目，希望打造一款和初代福特 GT40一样的跑车。正是他邀请到好友，德托马索的创始人阿里詹德罗·德·托马索加入这个项目。

福特的目标是合理控制价格，进而大批量生产销售。因此，尽管从外观上看，这款车是一台不折不扣的意大利超跑，它由车身制造公司吉亚的汽车设计大师汤姆·特嘉达亲自操刀设计，但却采用了适于量产的福特V8引擎和单体车壳。

在首次亮相时，Pantera配备的引擎是带电容二极管点火的5.8升顶置气门V8 351引擎。为节省成本，采用了中置式安装，但该引擎马力可达335ps，扭矩达45kgm，在马力和性能上已经追平或胜过了当时的对手。虽然不像其他意大利品牌一样使用自己的引擎，但这款车由美国和意大利两国汽车行业中的佼佼者联手打造，依然可以称得上意义非凡。

brandCentral.en:
The DeLorean first exploded into the public consciousness
when it featured in the movie Back to the Future.

DMC, the company that built it, was founded by John Z.
DeLorean, a former vice president of General Motors.

Their first and only production model was the DMC-12, and
DeLorean himself oversaw the entire creation process.

DMC lasted less than two years after production began, but
the brand was subsequently acquired by another company.

The DeLorean seen here is the 'Series 2', a remake proposed
by the new DMC.

Its key feature is an improved 200ps engine.
brandCentral.zh:
这款DeLorean凭借电影《回到未来》而为大众熟识，在当时红
极一时。

打造这辆车的DMC公司由前General Motors的副总裁
John Z. DeLorean创立。

DMC-12是他们的第一款，也是唯一一款量产型号，由DeLorean亲自
参与并领导了整个开发过程。

DMC在投产后只存在了短短不到两年的时间。好在品牌之
后被另一家公司收购，才得以存续下来。

这里的这辆DeLorean是“Series 2”，是由新DMC公司提议开发的重
制版，

主打强化动力的200ps引擎。

usedCar.en:
The DeLorean DMC-12 became world famous after it appeared
in the movie "Back to the Future."

This niche car's futuristic look made it the perfect choice
to be converted into a time machine

The car employed an RR layout, similar to that of the Porsche
911, but power from the V-6 was rated at only 130ps.

Later versions would get an improved engine that delivered
up to 200ps.

While the production run of this sports car was short, it
remains one of the most recognized American cars ever.
usedCar.zh:
DeLorean是永恒的经典，
备受世人推崇。

它在电影《回到未来》中强势出镜，
令许多电影发烧友一见倾心。

采用与Porsche 911相同的后置后驱布局，
V6引擎在发售时原本马力只有130ps。

“Series 2”车型采用经过改良的引擎，
将马力升至高达200ps。

绝对能让你的驾驶体验乐趣无穷！{

vehicleCollection.en:
At the request of DeLorean owners, the tuned-up Series 2 was created.

A driving force for Pontiac in the mid-1960s and once vice president of General Motors, John Z. DeLorean made the bold choice of starting his own car company at the end of the 1970s.

DeLorean Motor Company (DMC) was established in Ireland in 1975. Its first serious production model was the DMC-12.

DeLorean's objective was to produce a reasonable, stylish sports car; however, as his new company did not have the expertise to develop such a car, the design of the DMC-12 had to be outsourced.

DeLorean turned to Lotus to develop the chassis, while Italdesign was tasked to pen the exterior and interior styling. The DMC-12 rode on a backbone chassis and came powered by a PRV SOHC V-6 that produced 130ps, but what drew the most attention about the car were its shiny stainless steel body and gull-wing doors.

DeLorean sold 6500 units of the DMC-12 in its first year, but a public scandal and other bad headlines forced the company into bankruptcy in 1983. By this time, 8500 units of the car had been sold.

After the entire inventory of DMC-12s were shipped from Ireland to the U.S., they were managed by a newly established DeLorean Motor Car Company that specialized in tuning the engine to 200ps. These DeLorean cars are referred to as the DMC-12 Series 2.
vehicleCollection.zh:
二代德罗宁，根据车主的要求进行了调校。

约翰Z.德罗宁是庞蒂亚克在1960年代中期的重要推手，这位原通用汽车副总裁在70年代末做出了一个大胆决定，离开通用汽车创立了自己的汽车制造公司。

DMC，也就是德罗宁汽车公司于1975年在爱尔兰正式开业。该公司推出的首款量产车是DMC12。

德罗宁的目标是打造一款价格适中，又风格独特的跑车。由于新创立的DMC尚不具备研发这种汽车的实力，所以德罗宁将DMC-12的设计外包了出去。

最终，底盘的设计由莲花跑车负责，车体外观则交给了Italdesign。因此，底盘最终采用莲花跑车风格的钢制龙骨车架，搭载一台可以输出130ps的后置PRV顶置单凸轮轴V6引擎。此车的不锈钢车体和鸥翼车门引来了众多关注。

DMC-12在首年便售出了创纪录的6500辆，可惜由于爆出丑闻和其他负面新闻报道，公司在1983年被迫宣告破产。此时，DMC-12仅仅只生产了8500辆。

此后，剩余的DMC-12库存被全部运到美国，交给重新组建的DMC公司，该公司将负责德罗宁车的维护保养。应大量德罗宁车主的要求，新公司增设了引擎调校服务，可将引擎动力提升到200ps。于是，配备了调校后引擎的德罗宁又被称作系列2型。,

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
At first glance, it appears to be a normal sedan, but look
inside, and you'll realize that this car was created for speed.

This is the category that's referred to as "muscle cars."

This Challenger R/T is like the Barracuda
because it's smaller in size.

However, the large front opening
and the kicked-up rear quarter...

...are aggressive design cues that match the car's character.

Power is provided by a HEMI engine.

On the hood is a protruding air scoop
called the "Shaker."

When it shakes, it declares the enormous power it possesses.

If you include the optional rear spoiler, the Challenger R/T
is a muscle car that's sure to catch anyone's eye.
dialogues.zh:
如果不仔细看，你会以为它是一辆普通的轿车。
但坐进驾驶舱之后，你就会明白这是一台速度机器。

这个类别的车通常归类为“肌肉车”。

这辆Challenger R/T很像梭鱼，只是尺寸小一号。

不过它那宽大的前脸开口和
拱起的后侧围板……

无不在体现该车极富侵略性的特征。

此车的动力来自一台HEMI引擎。

引擎盖上的进气口又被车迷们戏称为“抖动器”

这个称号来源于它工作时的抖动噪声，
就像在宣告自己的澎湃动力。

如果再装配上车尾扰流板，
Challenger R/T必定会吸引所有人的目光。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展
的评审委员之一。
