collection.en:
This is a 1970 model, first-generation Dodge Challenger.

And it happens to be an R/T series, powered by a 426 Hemi
engine, which features hemispherical combustion chambers.

The 1970 models debuted in 1969, and customers had a choice
between the basic straight-six model and this R/T.

The basic model was classified as a "pony car," while the R/T
was considered a true muscle car.

Relatively few Dodge Challenger R/Ts were produced,
so today they are worth quite a lot.

In fact, I'd go so far as to say that this Hemi R/T is a true
collector's item.
collection.zh:
这是第一代的Dodge Challenger，推出于1970年，

而且它恰好是台R/T版本，由一台426 Hemi引擎驱动。
这是一台使用半球形燃烧室的引擎。

1970年车款在1969年亮相，消费者可在两款车型中进行选择：
基础款的直列6缸版本和这款R/T版本。

基础款的定位是一辆“小马车”，而R/T才是真正的肌肉车。

Dodge Challenger R/T的产量相对较少，
因此它们今天的售价也非常高昂。

实事求是地说，这辆配备了Hemi引擎的R/T敞篷车是一辆真
正值得收藏的珍品！

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-grade model of the Challenger, which impressed with its performance and bold styling.

The first-generation Dodge Challenger debuted in 1970 as a sister car to the Plymouth Barracuda, using the same E-body.

In the mid-1960s, the U.S. featured a variety of popular pony cars (cheap, high-performance and stylish cars), such as the Ford Mustang, Chevrolet Camaro and Pontiac Firebird. The Challenger came at the tail end of this boom.

Despite being a little late to the party, the car was welcomed with open arms by the public, thanks to its attractive styling that was characterized by a flowing silhouette and smooth lines. Designed by Carl Cameron, who had designed the 1966 Charger, the car would retain much of its visual character when the third-generation model would be released 40 years later at the 2006 North American International Auto Show.

The original Challenger came in three trim levels: The 6, the Challenger V8, and Challenger R/T (Road/Track), in both hardtop and convertible versions. In addition, there was the T/A that served as a homologation model for a SCCA Trans-Am race car.
vehicleCollection.zh:
顶级Challenger，用设计抓住了大量用户的心。

第一代道奇Challenger于1970年作为Plymouth Barracuda的姐妹车款上市，被命名为E-body。

车身有硬顶和敞蓬两种可供选择。二十世纪六十年代中期，众多小马车（便宜、高性能、时尚的汽车）纷纷在美国上市，从福特Mustang开始，紧随其后的有雪佛兰科迈罗和庞蒂亚克火鸟等。Challenger上市的时候，正值这股潮流达到顶峰之时，但这款车当时仍然很受大众欢迎。

主要原因之一可能是得益于车辆的造型，其车身轮廓低而锐利，而且具有瓶子一样圆滑的曲线。该车的设计师还设计了1966年款的道奇Charger。这款车的设计后来被用于40年后在2006年北美国际车展上发布的第三代Challenger上。

第一代Challenger的车型包括Challenger 6、Challenger V8和Challenger R/T（公路/赛道）。此外，为了参与美国赛车俱乐部泛美房车锦标赛，还推出了一款T/A型，但R/T型已经是该车商业量产产品线中性能最高的车型了。

catch.en: The top-grade model of the Challenger, which impressed with its performance and bold styling.
catch.zh: 顶级Challenger，用设计抓住了大量用户的心。

long.en:
The first-generation Dodge Challenger debuted in 1970 as a sister car to the Plymouth Barracuda, using the same E-body.

In the mid-1960s, the U.S. featured a variety of popular pony cars (cheap, high-performance and stylish cars), such as the Ford Mustang, Chevrolet Camaro and Pontiac Firebird. The Challenger came at the tail end of this boom.

Despite being a little late to the party, the car was welcomed with open arms by the public, thanks to its attractive styling that was characterized by a flowing silhouette and smooth lines. Designed by Carl Cameron, who had designed the 1966 Charger, the car would retain much of its visual character when the third-generation model would be released 40 years later at the 2006 North American International Auto Show.

The original Challenger came in three trim levels: The 6, the Challenger V8, and Challenger R/T (Road/Track), in both hardtop and convertible versions. In addition, there was the T/A that served as a homologation model for a SCCA Trans-Am race car.
long.zh:
第一代道奇Challenger于1970年作为Plymouth Barracuda的姐妹车款上市，被命名为E-body。

车身有硬顶和敞蓬两种可供选择。二十世纪六十年代中期，众多小马车（便宜、高性能、时尚的汽车）纷纷在美国上市，从福特Mustang开始，紧随其后的有雪佛兰科迈罗和庞蒂亚克火鸟等。Challenger上市的时候，正值这股潮流达到顶峰之时，但这款车当时仍然很受大众欢迎。

主要原因之一可能是得益于车辆的造型，其车身轮廓低而锐利，而且具有瓶子一样圆滑的曲线。该车的设计师还设计了1966年款的道奇Charger。这款车的设计后来被用于40年后在2006年北美国际车展上发布的第三代Challenger上。

第一代Challenger的车型包括Challenger 6、Challenger V8和Challenger R/T（公路/赛道）。此外，为了参与美国赛车俱乐部泛美房车锦标赛，还推出了一款T/A型，但R/T型已经是该车商业量产产品线中性能最高的车型了。

dialogues.en:
The Dodge Challenger SRT Demon is a beast!

It's a "well-executed beast," with a bold and purposeful design
that emphasized functionality!

The SRT Demon is a very intimidating
modern day muscle car...

...with bold fender flares and hood scoops...

...as well as deep-offset wheels that say power—
lots of power!
dialogues.zh:
这辆Dodge Challenger SRT Demon绝对是最凶猛的野兽！

SRT Demon是一辆开发得当的性能机器，
采用了激进但目的明确，强调功能性的设计，

是一辆令人望而生畏的现代肌肉车。

它的挡泥板和引擎盖进气口相当粗犷……

缩小偏距使得轮毂外凸，传递出令人无法抗拒的力量感，
而它也确实拥有与外观匹配的性能！

brandCentral.en:
The Challenger SRT Demon is Dodge’s most menacing
muscle car, no doubt about it.

Inspired by drag racing machines, its specially-tuned
V-8 was capable of pumping out more than 800 hp.

Combine that with its hearty torque figures, this car
accelerated with the best of them.

It reached the quarter-mile mark in just 9.65 seconds!

In fact, this car was so quick that it was banned from
drag racing in North America.

What’s more, Dodge sold performance kits for the Demon
the likes of which you won’t find anywhere else.

It was a modern American muscle car that was truly
in a league of its own.[
brandCentral.zh:
毋庸置疑，Challenger SRT Demon是
Dodge旗下性能最极致的肌肉车。

这款车的设计思路偏重于打造一款直线加速赛车，并采用
一部特殊调校的V8引擎，可以输出超过800 hp的动力。

无论是起步速度还是加速性能，都足以
跻身全球的最前列……

毕竟，它能在9.65秒内跑完400米的距离！

而更令人大跌眼镜的是，因为这辆车的速度实在太快，
以至于在北美被禁止参加直线加速赛。

此外，Dodge还不失时机地推出了Demon性能套件，
而且只此一家，别无分号。

这是一辆现代化的美式肌肉车，
拥有独树一帜的特点和性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
A Demon born simply to run the quarter mile as fast as possible.

The third-generation Dodge Challenger, introduced in 2008 as the true successor to the Challenger muscle car, is known for its various high-performance variants, but the one that stood out was the most powerful version, the SRT Hellcat that made its debut in 2015.

But in 2018. the Hellcat was upstaged by an even more sinister model, the SRT Demon of which only 3,300 units were produced.

This car was developed for the single purpose of winning drag races. The engine, based on the one in the Hellcat, was tuned to produce 852ps on 100 or higher-octane fuel. This allowed the car to boast a zero to 62 mph time of 2.3 seconds and reach the quarter-mile mark of just 9.65. The body featured a full drag-strip setup with no passenger or rear seats included as standard equipment, although they are available as an option.

Adding even more spice to the package was the "Demon Crate," a race parts kit that Dodge sold to buyers for just one dollar extra. The equipment, said to be valued at more than US $6000, included thinner front wheels, a high-octane-tuned ECU for drag racing, air filters and a race-spec instrument panel.

The SRT Demon was banned from racing in stock form by the NHRA (National Hot Rod Association), which said the car was too fast to compete without a roll cage or parachute. The Demon is certain to go down in Dodge history as one of the greatest monsters the company ever produced.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆名副其实的Demon是为了以最快速度跑完四分之一英里而生的。

第三代道奇Challenger于2008年作为肌肉车中的杰作、初代Challenger的继承者而推出。从亮相起，它就以供应多样化的高性能车款而被大家熟知。到了2015年，在当时拥有最强性能的SRT Hellcat揭开了面纱。

然而，产品线中的性能之星要到2018年才姗姗来迟——那就是仅限量生产3300辆的SRT Demon。

这款车是只为直线加速赛而生的性能怪兽。其引擎基于Hellcat型号调校，在使用辛烷值100以上的燃油时可以输出852ps的功率。这款车的实测数据极其惊人，其0-62英里/小时（<100km/h>）加速仅需2.3秒，而跑完四分之一英里也仅需9.65秒。车内也是纯粹的直线竞速赛道配置，完全不提供乘客席和后排座椅，但可以在可选配置中增配。

随车推出的还有赛车改装套件“Demon Crate”，售价是让人惊掉下巴的1美元。套件包括更窄的前轮和为直线加速赛中的高辛烷值汽油而调校的电子控制单元，以及一个空气过滤器和一个比赛规格的仪表板。据说这些配件的总价值超过6000美元。

令人哭笑不得的是，原厂状态的SRT Demon居然被国家改装车协会禁止参加直线加速赛，因为协会认为该车在不安装防滚架或降落伞时车速太快，不适宜参赛。毋庸置疑，这辆Demon是道奇历史上性能最卓越的怪兽之一。

catch.en: A Demon born simply to run the quarter mile as fast as possible.
catch.zh: 这辆名副其实的Demon是为了以最快速度跑完四分之一英里而生的。

collection.en:
Even if you weren't around to experience the muscle car boom
that dominated the American automotive scene in the 1960s...

...I'll bet that your heart skipped a beat whenever
you saw one of them in action in a movie or on the TV.

The 1968 Dodge Charger is one of the great
masterpieces of the American muscle car genre.

The body style alone is enough to turn heads.

The "twin diamond" shape of the profile
is one of the trademarks of the 1968 model.

And of course, you can't have a muscle car
without the muscle.

This Charger is the sportier R/T grade, but it also...

...comes with the 426 Hemi,
Mopar's most powerful engine option available at the time.

If you're building a muscle car collection,
this is one car you can't afford to miss.
collection.zh:
即便没有亲身经历过1960年代震撼了
整个美国汽车行业的肌肉车黄金时代……

但我敢打赌，只要你在影视作品里看到一辆
这样风驰电掣的车，你的心跳也一定会随之而加速。

这辆1968款Dodge Charger堪称
美国肌肉车中最伟大的杰作之一。

双菱形的轮廓是1968款的标志性特征之一，

仅凭车身就足以吸引到所有人的注目。

当然了，如果没有强大的“肌肉”，
那怎么能算是一辆肌肉车呢？

这辆Charger R/T强调运动性，

安装了当时Mopar’能提供的最强大的引擎——426 Hemi动力单元。

如果你有心打造一套肌肉车收藏，那么这辆车绝对不容错过。

vehicleCollection.en:
This true 1960s muscle car is the envy of collectors everywhere.

Introduced by Chrysler in 1966, the Dodge Charger is among the standard bearers of the muscle-car era that dominated the American car scene in the 1960s.

While many other muscle cars were based on compact-class platforms, the Dodge Charger utilized the larger chassis of the mid-size Dodge Coronet.

The Charger could easily be recognized by its stretched 2-door fastback silhouette, but what made the car really garner attention was its large displacement V-8 engine.

In 1968, when the Charger received a minor facelift, one of the most exciting additions was the introduction of the R/T (Road/Track) performance package. The R/T increased the performance of the car by way of an upgraded suspension system and better brakes, as well as the option to get the more powerful 426 Hemi engine.

The 426 Hemi is a 7.0-liter V-8 developed from Dodge's NASCAR race engines. It produced 431ps and 67.71kgm of torque. The Charger R/T 426 Hemi was the fastest model in the 1968 lineup, able to reach 60 mph (approximately <96km/h>) from a standing start in under 6.0 seconds.

It should come as no surprise that the car has since become a collector's item.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一款真正的1960年代肌肉车，令全世界收藏家垂涎不已。

在1960年代那个肌肉车横扫美国汽车领域的黄金时代，克莱斯勒于1966年推出的道奇Charger是最具代表性的肌肉车之一。

当时大部分的肌肉车都是基于紧凑级别平台所打造，然而道奇Charger却不拘一格，采用了来自中级车平台的道奇Coronet。

这辆车的加长双门斜背轮廓非常容易辨认。而且全系车型都搭载了大排量V8引擎，以动力助推了人气暴涨。

Charger在1968年进行了小改款，其中最令人激动万分的升级当属“R/T”（公路/赛道）性能套件。这个标配套件中包括升级的悬挂和刹车，可以显著提升底盘的运动性能。另外还加入了可以将引擎升级到426 Hemi动力单元的选项。

后者是一款根据纳斯卡赛车赛车引擎所衍生开发的7升V8引擎，根据美国汽车工程师学会提供的总功率测量法，这款引擎可以输出431ps的动力和67.71kgm的扭矩。采用了这款引擎的Charger R/T 426 Hemi是1968产品族系中速度最快的型号，可以在6秒内从静止状态加速到60英里/小时（约<96km/h>）。

这款车也顺理成章地成为了最热门的收藏品。

catch.en: This true 1960s muscle car is the envy of collectors everywhere.
catch.zh: 一款真正的1960年代肌肉车，令全世界收藏家垂涎不已。

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
This is a genuine American muscle car that cuts
a distinctive figure on the track.

A mid-size sedan with a super-high horsepower engine...

...it’s more European in its aero parts and suspension
than the first-gen model.

This car is a celebration of American "inclusive design."

It offers supercar-level performance
at an affordable price.

I once drove a Chrysler 300 SRT at Laguna Seca Raceway.

A dream to drive, its wide torque range allowed me to take
the course without frequent gear shifts.
dialogues.zh:
这辆车是一款真正的美式肌肉车，在赛道上
展现出独特的魅力。

作为一辆中型轿车，它搭载着一颗超高马力的引擎……

在空气动力学和悬挂方面比第一代车型融入了
更多欧洲风格，

从而体现了美国“包容性设计”的理念……

以实惠的价格提供了超级跑车级别的性能体验。

我曾在拉古纳-塞卡赛道上驾驶过一辆Chrysler 300 SRT。

宽广的扭矩范围让我能够在赛道上畅快驾驶而无需频繁换挡。
那种驾驶体验如同梦幻。

Does this Dodge Charger SRT belong to you,
by any chance?
conversation.zh: 这台是你的Dodge Charger SRT 吗？

designer who worked for GM, BMW, and Mazda?

He's worked in Europe and America for quite a while now
and is widely known as Tom Matano.!

俣野努先生因参与设计Mazda MX-5 Miata Roadster

conversation.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
conversation.en:
This is a genuine American muscle car that cuts
a distinctive figure on the track.

A mid-size sedan with a super-high horsepower engine...

...it’s more European in its aero parts and suspension
than the first-gen model.

This car is a celebration of American "inclusive design."

It offers supercar-level performance
at an affordable price.

I once drove a Chrysler 300 SRT at Laguna Seca Raceway.

A dream to drive, its wide torque range allowed me to take
the course without frequent gear shifts.
conversation.zh:
这辆车是一款真正的美式肌肉车，在赛道上
展现出独特的魅力。

作为一辆中型轿车，它搭载着一颗超高马力的引擎……

在空气动力学和悬挂方面比第一代车型融入了
更多欧洲风格，

从而体现了美国“包容性设计”的理念……

以实惠的价格提供了超级跑车级别的性能体验。

我曾在拉古纳-塞卡赛道上驾驶过一辆Chrysler 300 SRT。

宽广的扭矩范围让我能够在赛道上畅快驾驶而无需频繁换挡。
那种驾驶体验如同梦幻。

brandCentral.en:
The Dodge Charger SRT is among the world's most
powerful sedans.

With more than 700ps on tap, it can reach speeds
of approximately <330km/h>.

In case you didn't know, the "SRT" in its name stands for
Street and Racing Technology.

It's made up of a group of engineers within Dodge who specialize
in developing high-performance vehicles.

This means that if you see a car with an SRT badge on it, you
might want to think twice before challenging it to a race.
brandCentral.zh:
Dodge Charger SRT是世界上最快的四门轿车之一。

其马力超过了700ps，最高时速可达到近<330km/h>。

您可能不知道，“SRT”代表了“街道和赛车技术”
（Street and Racing Technology）。

这个研发团队专门从事高性能汽车的开发。

不消说，任何名字中带有SRT的车都不容小觑。

vehicleCollection.en:
Dodge pulls no punches with the Charger SRT Hellcat, one of the most potent sedans in the world.

The Dodge Charger has always stood for brute force in the passenger-car segment, ever since the car made its original debut in 1966. Since then, the Charger has been reborn as a 4-door sedan, but with still the same in-your-face brashness of past cars. One particular trim offered an even greater dose of attitude: the Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat.

Back in 2005, the third-generation Charger made its debut after nearly a 20-year absence. Chrysler reintroduced the brand to an eager public, arming the top-of-the-line version with a “Hemi” engine as an ode to powerful Chryslers of the past. The modern-day Charger’s Hemi came in the form of a 477ps 6.4-liter V8.

Sure, that’s a lot of power to some, but not to the engineers at SRT, the high-performance division of Chrysler. In 2014, they supercharged the Hemi, making it into a fire-breathing monster that pumped out a whopping 717ps and 81.6kgm of asphalt-crinkling torque. With a reinforced 8-speed automatic transmission, the new car, called the Charger SRT Hellcat, accelerated to 60 mph in an amazing 3.7 seconds and registered a top speed of <328.3km/h>.

While the Charger SRT Hellcat’s innards were basically the same as those of the 2-door Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat, the sedan version was actually 0.2 seconds faster in the quarter-mile, at 11.0 seconds flat. What’s even more impressive was that this super sedan, which was arguably the fastest 4-door in the world in its day, came at the reasonable price of $63,995.
vehicleCollection.zh:
顶级性能的Charger，速度创下世界纪录。

2014年开售的Charger SRT Hellcat是一款性能极佳的量产车型，即使与诞生于1966年历史悠久的道奇Charger相比也毫不逊色。

第3代Charger于2005年登场，其大胆的设计令人想起过去的肌肉车，还有着象征着高性能克莱斯勒系列的“Hemi”引擎元件。其作为美国的高性能四门轿跑车饱受好评；该车系中甚至还有配备了6.4升Hemi引擎的车型，输出功率可达477ps。

但这些车型还不足以与Hellcat相媲美。由克莱斯勒的高性能开发小组SRT开发，使用机械增压等配件改装6.2升Hemi，令其最大马力可达717ps，最大扭矩达到81.6kgm。搭配强化型的8段AT，从0加速至60英里/小时仅需3.7秒，最高车速可达<328.3km/h>。

在技术方面，其兄弟车型——双门跑车Challenger Hellcat在Charger之前发售。但Charger仅需11秒就能跑完四分之一英里，比Challenger快0.2秒。这些数值甚至能够超越欧洲的车厂对手，成为世界上最快的四门跑车。尽管表现如此出色，该车的价格仅为63,995美元。如此出色的性能和合理的价位令人大吃一惊。

brandCentral.en:
This safety car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on the
Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat.

It features a light bar on the roof, and spotlight-equipped
wing mirrors.

It's also equipped with other specialist equipment, such
as bullbars.

The Charger is actually used as a patrol car by some US
police departments.>
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的安全车基于
Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat开发。

它的车顶上安装了一组灯条，后视镜上安装了聚光灯，

车身上还添加了一些特种装备，如专用防撞保险杠等。

顺带一提，Charger本身就是许多美国城市警察局的警用巡逻车。:

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultra high performance Charger set a world speed record, going 222 mph on the Bonneville Salt Flats.

Unveiled in 2014, the Charger SRT Hellcat is the most powerful production model of the long-running Dodge Charger series, which was first released in 1966.

The third rendition of the Charger was introduced in 2005 as a high-performance sports sedan, but the Hellcat was a different animal altogether. With a 6.2-liter Hemi engine meticulously tuned by SRT — Chrysler's high-performance development team. By adding a supercharger, output was increased to an astounding 717ps with 81.6kgm maximum torque. Coupled to a reinforced 8-speed automatic transmission, the car ran from zero to 60 mph in 3.7 seconds and reached a top speed of <328.3km/h>.

While the car's drivetrain was identical to the Challenger Hellcat, the Charger Hellcat could reach the quarter-mile mark a bit quicker at 11 seconds second flat, 0.2 seconds faster than its stablemate. The version of the Charger Hellcat you see here is an original model created by Gran Turismo.

*This safety car version is an original model created by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款超高性能的Charger创下了全球最高速度纪录。

历史悠久的道奇Charger系列于1966年首次推出，2014年公布的Charger SRT Hellcat是该系列最强大的量产车型。

2005年登场的第3批Charger是全美国性能最强的4门轿车，但Hellcat又比它高出一个级别。克莱斯勒旗下的高性能研发团队SRT精心调校了它的6.2升Hemi引擎，并为它增加了一台机械增压器，把引擎的最大输出提高到惊人的717ps，最大扭矩达81.6kgm。再加上内部强化后的8速自动变速箱，这款车能在3.7秒内完成0-60英里的提速，最高时速达到<328.3km/h>。

虽然它的机械组件和Challenger Hellcat基本相同，但Charger行驶1/4英里只需要11秒整，比Challenger要快0.2秒。这些极限数据也让这台Charger成为欧洲同类车款的有力竞争对手。

*这款安全车是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。

brandCentral.sourceName: SRT Tomahawk GTS-R Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.en:
Dodge's 3 Vision Gran Turismo cars represent the company's
vision for how racing will look in twenty years.

The SRT Tomahawk GTS-R VGT was specially designed for the
racing circuit.

Its V10 engine and pneumatic system are able to produce a
whopping 1500ps!

And did I mention the car only weighs 663kg?

It's so fast the car even comes with a specially designed
G-suit to protect the driver!
brandCentral.zh:
Dodge的3辆Vision Gran Turismo汽车代表了该公司对20年后
赛车行业发展的设想。

SRT Tomahawk GTS-R VGT是专门为赛车场设计的车款。

其V10引擎和气动系统能够产生令人震撼的1500ps动力！

更值得一提的是这辆车的重量仅仅只有663kg！

鉴于这辆车的速度过快，它甚至配备了专门设计的重力加速度
防护服来保护车手！

vehicleCollection.sourceName: SRT Tomahawk GTS-R Vision Gran Turismo
vehicleCollection.en:
A lightweight racing version of the visionary near-future single-seater concept.+

The SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo is an uncompromizing, unrestricted single-seat mid-engine, all-wheel-drive vehicle.

Its main powerplant is a nearly flat, 144-degree 6.98-liter V-10 that produces more than 1000 hp, supported by a pneumatic sub-unit. With four levels of assistance, the pneumatic power unit uses regenerative braking to compress air and store it into two pneumatic cylinders, then releases it when it’s required. This unit is also used for the suspension system.

The handling dynamics of the Tomahawk are enhanced by a continuously active aerodynamic system that deploys multiple pneumatically driven elements, including a rear wing and a secondary front splitter. The Tomahawk’s aerodynamic system reacts to inputs provided by a forward scanning laser system that detects surface changes in front of the car. The computer controls anticipate changes in vehicle ride height, pitch and yaw to adjust the splitter accordingly. The exhaust of the V-10 is routed to the rear diffuser. This accelerates underbody flow at the rear of the car and creates a blown diffuser effect that increases downforce with no negative effect on drag.

The GTS-R is the lightest and race-ready version of the Tomahawk concept. The extreme g-forces resulting from its immense power output, its extremely lightweight nature and enhanced handling are more than what the human body can handle unassisted. Therefore, the driver requires a special racing suit that pressurizes the body to maintain blood flow to the brain. This G-suit uses excess pressurized air from the pneumatic power system, allowing it to quickly react to increasing g-forces.

The Tomahawk GTS-R’s aerodynamics are enhanced with a dual-element version of the active rear wing. The upper element is stored beneath the lower element when it’s not in use or uring high-speed straightaway speed. Each of the four fenders is vented t avoid any high pressure build up in the wheel wells.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一款放眼未来的近未来单座概念的轻量化赛车版本。

SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo是一款毫不妥协、无法受限的单座式中后置引擎，全轮驱动的车。

主动力装置是一台几乎水平对卧的144度6.98升V10引擎，能够产生1,000多马力的动力，还搭配气动式附件提供支持。气动动力单元提供4个级别的辅助，使用再生刹车来压缩空气，存储在2个气动缸中，并需要时进行释放。此气动单元释放的动力也用于悬挂系统。

Tomahawk的操控动力学借助连续主动式空气动力学系统得到了提升，该系统使用了多个气动元件，包括尾翼与前端辅助定风翼。Tomahawk的空气动力系统会根据车体前方的激光扫描系统检测到前方路况变化，并做出反应。计算机控制系统会预测离地间隙、俯仰角和偏航角的变化，并据此调整定风翼。V10引擎将排气引导至后扩散器。这样可加快车辆后部车身底板的空气流动，产生废气扩散器效应，在不减小风阻的情况下提高下压力。

GTS-R是Tomahawk概念赛车中最轻巧且最适合比赛的型号。由于其巨大的动力输出、极致的轻盈和增大的操作抓地力，产生极高的G力，人体在没有辅助的情况下无法承受。因此，车手需要特殊的比赛服来给整个身体加压，以保持血液流向大脑。这种G力比赛服利用来自气动系统多余的压缩空气，能对不断增加的G力快速做出反应。

Tomahawk GTS-R的空气动力套件也升级为主动式尾翼升级为双尾翼，上尾翼在不需要使用或车手要求低风阻/高速操控时，将收到下尾翼的下方。4片挡泥板上均设置了通风孔，以免高压积聚在车轮拱板内。

catch.zh: 一款放眼未来的近未来单座概念的轻量化赛车版本。

brandCentral.sourceName: SRT Tomahawk S Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.en:
Dodge's 3 Vision Gran Turismo cars represent the company's
vision for how racing will look in twenty years.

The SRT Tomahawk S VGT is considered the entry-level model.

Cutting-edge materials like carbon and graphene bring its
weight down to a mere 900kg.

And despite the 'entry-level' tag, the engine is capable of
delivering more than 1000ps!

I'd recommend trying to master this model before moving on
to the two more advanced ones!

Dodge的3辆Vision Gran Turismo汽车代表了该公司对20年后
赛车行业发展的设想。

SRT Tomahawk S VGT是3台车中的入门级车型。

cars.nameEn: Dodge SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo (Gr.1)
cars.nameZh: Dodge SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo (Gr.1)

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.1 race car was based on
the Dodge SRT Tomahawk VGT.

The compressed air system was removed so it conformed to
Gr.1 racing regulations.

Also, a fixed wing and shark fin were added to enhance
the car's aerodynamics.

But the biggest change of all was converting the once-all-wheel
drive car layout to rear-wheel drive.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一辆基于Dodge SRT Tomahawk VGT所打造的Gr.1赛车。

为了符合Gr.1赛事规范，它的空气压缩系统被移除。

另外还加上了固定式尾翼和鲨鱼鳍，以增加空气阻力。

最后，它的传动系统也从四轮驱动更换为后轮驱动。

vehicleCollection.en:
A mid-engine rear-wheel drive version of the Tomahawk for Gr.1 competition.

The SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo is a near-future supercar created by Dodge's in-house tuning department, SRT (Street and Racing Technology). This mean machine features next-generation automobile technologies that includes high-tech materials throughout the chassis and a road-surface-sensing active aerodynamics system. Providing the muscle is a 1000-hp V-10 engine mated to pneumatic power units.

The SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo (Gr.1) adopts the core concepts and dynamic nature of the Tomahawk and modifies them for Gr.1 classification.

This version is based on the race spec GTS-R, the lightest model in the series. After overhauling the body, the stock car’s active aero parts were scrapped in favor of a fixed rear wing and an aero fin mounted aft of the cockpit.

To reduce weight, the pneumatic power units were removed, while the engine was tuned to produce 703ps. The power train layout has also been changed from all-wheel drive to rear-wheel drive to comply with regulations.

While it is no longer capable of extreme speeds that transcends the limits of the human body, its superb handling and aerodynamic control remain intact. In endurance races, this model will no doubt put great fear into your opponents.(
vehicleCollection.zh:
一款专用于组别1竞赛，配备中置引擎及后轮驱动的Tomahawk。

SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo是一款近未来的超级跑车，由道奇的前沿特殊开发团队SRT打造。这个庞然大物是下一代汽车技术的愿景，底盘使用高科技材料，采用路面传感主动空气动力系统，并装有由气动动力单元支持的1,000马力V10引擎。

SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo (组别1) 重新使用Tomahawk的核心概念和动力特征，并将修改成一辆符合跑车浪漫旅组别1组别规范的改装车。

这一版本基于赛车规格GTS-R，即该系列中最轻盈的型号。但在全面改装车身尺寸的过程中，开发人员摒弃了那款车的一大特征，也就是主动空气动力学部件，取而代之的是在车身后方安装了大型固定式尾翼和垂直鳍片。

为了减轻重量，气动动力单元已被移除，V10引擎现已调校为产生703ps的动力。为了遵守法规，动力传动布局也已从全轮驱动改为后轮驱动。

虽然它不再能够以极限速度测试人体极限，但是其卓越的操控性与空气动力学控制系统仍然完好无损。在长距离耐力赛中，这款车型无疑会让对手望而生畏。

vision for how racing will look in twenty years.

usedCar.en:
If you're looking for something that'll give you a sense of what
a muscle car was, then give the Dodge Super Bee a look.

The size of the car was modest compared to its rivals,
billed back then as an "intermediate sedan."

But there was nothing intermediate about its power.
It came with a massive 6.0-liter V-8!

The thing rumbled like thunder when provoked, making the car
one of the fastest of its day.
usedCar.zh:
如果你要寻求纯粹的肌肉车体验，
那么Dodge Super Bee无疑可以满足你。

这款车身稍偏小的
所谓“中型”轿车之下...

隐藏着一个巨大的V8引擎，
排气量高达6L以上！

毋庸赘言，其动力之充足，
不会让车手有丝毫怨言。<

vehicleCollection.en:
A Coronet, equipped with a 7.0-liter V8 Hemi, this was one of the standout cars in the muscle-car era.

The Dodge Super Bee, introduced by Chrysler in 1968, was created to compete in the growing muscle-car marketplace. Priced at the lower end of the segment, the Super Bee was all about performance. It was not equipped with some of the creature comforts that its rivals possessed.

Based on the mid-size Dodge Coronet, the Super Bee was really a rebadged Plymouth Roadrunner, complete with a lightweight 2-door body and exterior design that looked menacing from every angle. In 1969, a convertible version of the car was added to the lineup.

The Super Bee’s performance on the road matched its mean looks, thanks to a powerful engine lineup. The base powerplant was a 340ps 6.8-liter V8, followed by the upgraded version’s 395ps 7.2-liter V8. The top-of-the-line model came with a 431ps 7.0L Hemi. To handle all of this power, Chrysler equipped the car with a reinforced suspension system, a Mopar A833 4-speed manual transmission and high-performance tires.

In 1970, the Super Bee received a facelift that included a two-section grille and a revised chrome bumper. The following year, an all-new Super Bee was introduced; this one was based on the Dodge Charger.
vehicleCollection.zh:
搭载了一台7升的V8 Hemi引擎的Coronet，这辆“超级”车型创下了肌肉车历史。

道奇Super Bee是克莱斯勒在1968年推出的肌肉车。面对为数不少的高价位、高性能车竞品，摈弃了除驾驶性能之外所有修饰的Super Bee以性价比杀出重围，成为了热卖车款。

第一辆Super Bee于1968年初次亮相。这款车基于道奇Coronet开发，但车身改为中等尺寸。最先推出的是重量最轻的双门跑车，紧接着1969年又推出了双门硬顶敞篷车型号。

让Super Bee备受瞩目的是它强大的引擎阵容。这款车只提供高性能引擎配置，包括340ps的6.8升引擎、395ps的7.2升引擎或是431ps的7.0升Hemi引擎。

为了配合其强大的动力，这款车还标配强化加固后的悬挂系统，并可以选择多个专注于跑车驾驶体验的选项和性能套件。虽然这款车拥有一台昂贵的高性能引擎，但几乎所有的可选配件和舒适用途的设备都被省略了。最终呈现在驾驶者眼前的就是这样一台简朴、务实、专为驾驶体验所打造的车型。

在1970年，这款车换掉了镀铬保险杠，并改用双联进气格栅，完成了“改头换面”。在接下来的1971年，这款车又全面升级为了基于Charger的二代型号。

third generation Dodge Viper as its base model.

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation Viper boasted extreme performance that was developed by the SRT division.

For years, Americans had only one real sports car, the Chevrolet Corvette. That all changed when the Dodge Viper arrived on the scene in 1991. The two became immediate rivals, and in a classic battle of one-upmanship, both Chevrolet and Dodge kept trying to outdo one another in an all-out performance race. As a result, both cars became such formidable sports machines that their on-road and on-track prowess eclipsed high-priced European supercars of their day.

In 2012, Dodge kept the tradition going with a new model that would transcend the others that came before it. The 3rd-generation Viper was tuned by the folks at SRT, Chrysler's high-performance factory tuning division. They kept the spirit of the American supercar intact, but raised the performance level so high that even Chevrolet engineers were scratching their respective heads. Built on the square steel space frame as before, this Viper featured aluminum cross bracing that improved rigidity by 50 percent. Also, thanks to the extensive use of lightweight materials such as carbon fiber, the car weighed 45 kg less than the previous model. The heart of the Viper, the massive 8.4-liter V10 powerplant, received new pistons, as well as a new intake, exhaust and engine management system, allowing it to produce 649ps and 83kgm torque. The upper grade GTS was equipped with active suspension.

The new specs allowed the Viper to hit a top speed of <330km/h>, higher than most race cars. When you consider that the price of the 2013 model was still under the $100,000 mark, it's easy to see why many people, even today, regard the Viper as the best bang-for-the-buck supercar of all time.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第三代Viper，获得SRT的极限性能支持。

Viper在美国汽车业中创造了举世瞩目的成就。很长的时间里，科尔维特都是美国超跑市场的唯一选择，但是在1991年，初出茅庐的Viper发起了对科尔维特的挑战并成功将它击败。

这造成了两款车型之间日渐升级的研发竞争，并最终导致了美国跑车性能标准迅速攀升，甚至在某些方面超越了欧洲的主流超跑。因此，第二代Viper于2010年停售的消息招致了众多粉丝的失望情绪。

但是Viper其实并未消亡，其第三代车型于2012年荣耀登场。

第三代的Viper由SRT推出，SRT是克莱斯勒的专属跑车品牌。尽管第三代基本保持了自身的原始理念，它的性能却得到了极大的提升。该平台依然保留了此前所使用的方形钢制空间框架，但是借助铝制十字撑杆，其刚度获得了50%的提升。

通过在各类零件中采用诸如碳纤维等轻量材料，该车的重量较此前减轻了45公斤。前置的V10引擎排量依然是8.4升，但是通过对活塞、进气、排气、以及引擎管理，该引擎现在可产出649ps功率和83kgm扭矩的动力。此高配车型GTS还自配了主动悬挂。

它的最高时速可达<330km/h>。考虑到该车2013款基本版的售价低于10万美元，这款第三代Viper的尖牙和毒液将毋庸置疑地对它的竞争对手产生影响。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
In the transition of automotive design, fenders were originally
just mud flaps that attached to the tires.

Just before and after World War II, fenders started to be
integrated into the bodies.

And eventually the body sides came to be
cut out in the shape of the tires.

In relation to this, the rear fenders of the Viper...

...is structured as a large volume that completely
integrates the fender and doors.

And it shows the enormous traction to accommodate
the 8.0-liter V-10 engine.

It changed the flow and direction of car design, which was
moving towards abstract, multiple surfaces in the 1980s.

The soul of the American car guy is jam packed in these
glamorous fenders.

This is how an American Sports car should be!
dialogues.zh:
在汽车设计的漫长历史中，
挡泥板最初只是用于阻挡掀起的泥土的轮胎挡板。

但到了二战前后，设计师开始将挡泥板与车身融为一体。

为此，车身的侧面被切割出了轮胎的形状。

不过拿那种设计对照一下Viper的后挡泥板！

它们变成了车门的一部分，
更加突出了它相当大的体积……

以此展示出8升V10引擎无比强大的牵引力。

这项设计给80年代原本抽象、几何形的车身设计带来了
新的变化。

Viper在这些迷人的巨型挡泥板里灌注了美国汽车人的灵魂，

这才是美国跑车应该有的样子！

他不仅在汽车制造业三大厂中都任过职，

这款车的竞赛款参加过勒芒
和纽博格林的赛事——它不快才怪呢！

vehicleCollection.en:
With its monstrous levels of power and grip, this venerable machine could arguably be called America's first supercar.

Dodge introduced the Viper concept in 1989 to an awe-struck public to show that Chrysler was capable of producing something that could dethrone the Chevrolet Corvette as America's sports car. America's supercar war officially began in 1992 when Dodge released the 2-seat convertible to the public.

The Viper was as raw as sports cars came, with a loud, powerful engine and wide, menacing body that reminded many of the Shelby Cobra. For some, the car was too over-the-top. Dodge, hearing these comments, produced a fixed-roof version of the Viper called the GTS in 1996. At the same time, a race version of the GTS was also introduced, called the GTS-R. The GTS-R was created to contest in the world's GT races that included Le Mans and the 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

The GTS didn't just get a fixed roof, but also got more power. The massive V10 under its long hood now produced 456ps, as opposed to 400ps in the RT/10 roadster, which made the car quicker off the line.

The aerodynamic shape created by the fixed roof accounted for a better top speed, one that eclipsed the RT/10's top speed of 165mph at 185mph. The GTS's handling was also sharper, thanks to the car's added structural rigidity. The FR (front-engine, rear-wheel-drive) sports car set record-breaking slalom and skidpad records, thanks in part to its meaty tires.

The original Viper was a nostalgic and primitive-feeling sports car. However, with the release of the GTS, the Viper joined the ranks of the supercar.
vehicleCollection.zh:
打破束缚的车型，推动Viper跑车进入超跑领域。

Viper于1989年首次作为概念赛车亮相，并于1992年上市。虽然性能规格非常高，但仍有人诟病其风格太过复古。1996年，这些负面评论随着Viper GTS的诞生而平息，这是一款具有刚性封闭车身的真正跑车，并与双座敞篷跑车划分出明确的界线。

为了真正强调这辆车的跑车取向，在GTS发布的同时，还公布了其赛车版本GTS-R。这是一款量产型赛车，旨在参加勒芒和纽博格林24小时耐力赛等耐力挑战赛，以及全球的其他GT汽车比赛。

GTS的基本机械部件，包括V10引擎、车架和悬挂等，都和RT/10双座敞篷跑车相同。然而引擎的最大输出马力已从400ps升级到了456ps。

虽然GTS的加速性能和RT/10几乎没有太大的区别，但最高时速得到了显著的提高。双门跑车的车身风格拥有很大的优势，使得GTS的最大速度从双座敞篷版的<265km/h>提高到了<298km/h>。

采用封闭式车身后，车身刚度也得到大大改善，在蛇形穿桩和溜滑路试车场上的计时成绩都有明显的提升。此外，封闭式车身还可以省略一些在双座敞篷车上必须采用的加固措施，从而使得车身更轻盈。

原版的Viper是一款带有怀旧和原始情怀的跑车。然而，GTS的发布使得Viper跻身超跑行列。

为了真正强调这辆车的跑车取向，在GTS发布的同时，还公布了其赛车版本GTS-R。这是一款量产型赛车，旨在参加勒芒和纽博格林24小时耐力赛等耐力挑战赛，以及全球的其他GT汽车比赛。

GTS的基本机械部件，包括V10引擎、车架和悬挂等，都和RT/10双座敞篷跑车相同。然而引擎的最大输出马力已从400ps升级到了456ps。

虽然GTS的加速性能和RT/10几乎没有太大的区别，但最高时速得到了显著的提高。双门跑车的车身风格拥有很大的优势，使得GTS的最大速度从双座敞篷版的<265km/h>提高到了<298km/h>。

采用封闭式车身后，车身刚度也得到大大改善，在蛇形穿桩和溜滑路试车场上的计时成绩都有明显的提升。此外，封闭式车身还可以省略一些在双座敞篷车上必须采用的加固措施，从而使得车身更轻盈。

原版的Viper是一款带有怀旧和原始情怀的跑车。然而，GTS的发布使得Viper跻身超跑行列。

brandCentral.en:
The third-generation Dodge Viper was definitely
in a class of its own.

The secret to its enhanced performance was a stronger
chassis with 50 percent more torsional rigidity.

This made it more stable through corners, so it handled better
than its predecessor, which is quite scary if you ask me.
brandCentral.zh:
第三代Dodge Viper的外观设计和驾驶体验自成一派！

它的性能提高秘诀在于更牢固的底盘，将抗扭刚性提升
了足足50%……

这意味着其能为驾驶者提供充足的动力以及精确的操控。

vehicleCollection.en:
This third-generation Viper is now marketed under Dodge's extreme performance SRT brand.

For years, Americans had only one real sports car, the Chevrolet Corvette. That all changed when the Dodge Viper arrived on the scene in 1991. The two became immediate rivals, and in a classic battle of one-upmanship, both Chevrolet and Dodge kept trying to outdo one another in an all-out performance race. As a result, both cars became such formidable sports machines that their on-road and on-track prowess eclipsed high-priced European supercars of their day.

In 2012, Dodge kept the tradition going with a new model that would transcend the others that came before it. The 3rd-generation Viper was tuned by the folks at SRT, Chrysler's high-performance factory tuning division. They kept the spirit of the American supercar intact, but raised the performance level so high that even Chevrolet engineers were scratching their respective heads. Built on the square steel space frame as before, this Viper featured aluminum cross bracing that improved rigidity by 50 percent. Also, thanks to the extensive use of lightweight materials such as carbon fiber, the car weighed 45 kg less than the previous model. The heart of the Viper, the massive 8.4-liter V10 powerplant, received new pistons, as well as a new intake, exhaust and engine management system, allowing it to produce 649ps and 83kgm torque. The upper grade GTS was equipped with active suspension.

The new specs allowed the Viper to hit a top speed of <330km/h>, higher than most race cars. When you consider that the price of the 2013 model was still under the $100,000 mark, it's easy to see why many people, even today, regard the Viper as the best bang-for-the-buck supercar of all time.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第三代Viper，获得SRT的极限性能支持。

Viper在美国汽车业中创造了举世瞩目的成就。很长的时间里，科尔维特都是美国超跑市场的唯一选择，但是在1991年，初出茅庐的Viper发起了对科尔维特的挑战并成功将它击败。

这造成了两款车型之间日渐升级的研发竞争，并最终导致了美国跑车性能标准迅速攀升，甚至在某些方面超越了欧洲的主流超跑。因此，第二代Viper于2010年停售的消息招致了众多粉丝的失望情绪。

但是Viper其实并未消亡，其第三代车型于2012年荣耀登场。

第三代的Viper由SRT推出，SRT是克莱斯勒的专属跑车品牌。尽管第三代基本保持了自身的原始理念，它的性能却得到了极大的提升。该平台依然保留了此前所使用的方形钢制空间框架，但是借助铝制十字撑杆，其刚度获得了50%的提升。

通过在各类零件中采用诸如碳纤维等轻量材料，该车的重量较此前减轻了45公斤。前置的V10引擎排量依然是8.4升，但是通过对活塞、进气、排气、以及引擎管理，该引擎现在可产出649ps功率和83kgm扭矩的动力。此高配车型GTS还自配了主动悬挂。

它的最高时速可达<330km/h>。考虑到该车2013款基本版的售价低于10万美元，这款第三代Viper的尖牙和毒液将毋庸置疑地对它的竞争对手产生影响。

catch.en: This third-generation Viper is now marketed under Dodge's extreme performance SRT brand.
catch.zh: 第三代Viper，获得SRT的极限性能支持。

dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.en:
Designed and built by Chrysler's Advanced Design Studios
over the course of 1988 and ’89...

The Viper was dubbed the ‘second-coming’
of the Shelby Cobra.

It was co-production by then-president Bob Lutz
and designer Tom Gale.

Heralding a new era at the New York Auto Show in 2012,
the SRT GTS-R marked the series’ return to racing.

Distinguished by a long nose and short deck body...

Its flat bottom and wing addition promised dramatically
improved aerodynamics.
dialogues.zh:
这台由Chrysler的高级设计工作室于1988年至1989年

设计和制造的Viper又被称作Shelby Cobra的“再现”。

它是由品牌当时的总裁鲍勃·鲁茨和设计师汤姆·盖尔协手打造。

2012年纽约车展上，Chrysler带着Viper重出江湖，
而SRT GTS-R的命名则代表系列车型回归竞速比赛。

该车具有标志性的长车头和短小平坦的车身……

扁平的底盘和额外的风翼也使得空气动力学效应得到了长足的改进。

brandCentral.en:
The Viper SRT GTS-R served as the starting point for this
FIA GT3 class vehicle.

The car is the product of a collaboration between two of the
leading experts at the top of their respective fields:

Chrysler's high-performance automobile division, SRT, and Riley
Technologies. Together they created a real track monster.

They reduced the car's weight to a mere 1200kg and enhanced
aerodynamics to provide more downforce.

It's a formula that'll always produce results, and this Viper
did not disappoint, running at the top in numerous GT races.
brandCentral.zh:
Viper SRT GTS-R是这辆FIA GT3组别赛车的基础车型。

这台车由两个各自领域内顶尖的专家团队：

Chrysler的高性能汽车部门SRT
以及Riley Technologies携手打造。

总体车重被控制在1200kg以下，空气动力学性能也得到了进
一步加强。

这些改装取得了极大的成功，这辆车在GT赛事中的优异
表现就足以证明！

vehicleCollection.en:
A machine for private racers, carrying on the bloodline of the GTS-R.

The Dodge Viper evolved into its 3rd-generation model at the 2012 New York Motor Show. With the appearance of this iconic American sports car, the development of a GTS-R competition model was also announced, and it became clear that the Viper would return once again to the 24 Hours of Le Mans and the American Le Mans series after a 10 year hiatus. The Viper GT3-R is a GT3 machine created for private teams, based on the GTS-R works machine.

In the development of this machine, SRT, the high performance car development division of Dodge, and Riley Technologies, a major racing constructor in the U.S., worked together to instill the car with their know-how for victory.

The traditional long nosed, short deck body had improved aerodynamics with a flat bottom and the addition of a wing. Weight had also been reduced to 1295kg. The 8.4-liter V10 with a dry sump was powered up to 680ps (507kW) unrestricted, and this power was transferred with a X-Trac 6 speed sequential transmission. It was also equipped with 6 piston front/4 piston rear brake calipers with large diameter discs for stopping power.

The Viper GT3-R was priced at $459,000, with orders received from the latter half of 2013. Its level of performance was already proven in various GT Car races in the U.S. and other parts of the world.
vehicleCollection.zh:
为私人赛车手打造的赛车，延续了GTS-R的血统。

道奇Viper在2012年纽约车展上发布了其第三代车型。随着这台美国标志性的跑车一同登场的，还有GTS-R竞赛车型的开发计划。Viper明确表示会在时隔10年后重返勒芒24小时耐力赛以及美国勒芒系列赛。Viper GT3-R是基于GTS-R车型，并专为私人车队打造的GT3车型。

在开发该车型的过程中，道奇高性能车辆开发部门以及莱利科技（美国的一家大型竞速赛车生产商）通力合作，将他们的获胜理念渗透进了开发过程里。

传统的长前鼻搭配较短的车体，并凭借平底盘和附加的尾翼，提高了该车型的空气动力学性能。该车型的重量也被降低至1295kg（2855磅）。配备干滑油槽的8.4升V10引擎可轻松提供高达680ps（507KW）的功率，而动力通过X-Trac的6档序列式变速箱传递。此车还配备了6个前置活塞及4个后置活塞卡钳，以及大直径碟刹来保障制动力。

Viper GT3-R的售价为45.9万美元，并在2013年下半年开始接受订单。此车的性能水平在美国、以及全球的众多GT竞速赛事中已经得到充分的证明。

brandCentral.en:
This second-generation Viper was released in 2002.

Its 8.4-liter V-10 possessed 400cc more displacement
than the previous model.

This translated to more than 600ps of power!

What's more, it weighed 50kg less than
its predecessor!

It was developed and bred on the Nürburgring test track
in Germany.

This model was a force on many race circuits
around the world.
brandCentral.zh:
这款第二代Viper于2002年发布。

其8.4L V10引擎比第一代车型的排量还要大400cc……

而且动力超过了600ps！

更重要的是，其重量比前一代车型还轻50kg！

此车在纽博格林赛道进行了广泛的测试，充分展现了自
身的实力……

随后，此车在许多欧洲举办的比赛中都取得了成功！

usedCar.en:
The V-10 in the SRT10 Coupe is much more powerful than the
engine used in the first-generation model.

Not only did it have more displacement, it pumped out more
than 600ps, and with enough torque to wrench your neck!

Refinements were made to transform the beast
into a more luxurious sports car.

One of them was making the V-10 rev smoother than before.

Handling is much more stable and reliable as well.

And, the clutch and transmission are also more responsive
than in the previous model.
usedCar.zh:
SRT10 Coupe搭载了一台性能大幅优于
前代引擎的V10引擎。

这台引擎的排量更大，且马力超过了600ps，
使得Viper的名号实至名归。

除此之外，
SRT10还得到了全方位的改进。

它的引擎现在顺畅无比……

操控性更加稳定可靠……

连离合和传动也的响应
也变得更加迅速了！

vehicleCollection.en:
The much-anticipated fixed-roof version of the supercar featured better aerodynamics and lighter weight.

When the original Dodge Viper was introduced in 1992, the sports car world immediately took notice. Its sleek body, mean-looking design and powerful V-10 engine put it on par with the most exotic cars of its day. The breed improved in 2003 with the arrival of the second-generation model, and in 2006 a new model joined the lineup: a hard-top version called the SRT10 Coupe.

The SRT (Street and Racing Technology) in the car's name refers to Chrysler/Dodge's specialty sports division in charge of spicing up the company's vehicles. For the new Viper, it took its 8.3-liter OHV V10 and tuned it so it would produce 517ps and an asphalt-shredding peak torque of 73.96kgm, much more powerful than before.

The crew at SRT also improved the Viper's handling, by lowering the curb weight and testing it on the demanding Nürburgring circuit, not just to take the "America's Sport Car" moniker away from its main rival, the Chevrolet Corvette, but to challenge the likes of Ferrari and Lamborghini, which it succeeded in doing on the world stage.

Though its unique exterior tends to grabs everyone’s attention first, the Dodge Viper remains one of the most powerful and fastest sports car in history.
vehicleCollection.zh:
让大家望眼欲穿的全封闭车身，更加优秀的空气动力学，更轻的车重，换来真正的极速性能。"

随着Viper SRT10在2003年北美国际车展中正式发布，早在1992年就粉墨登场的Viper终于迎来了它的第二代车型。和第一代推出时一样，Viper SRT10在头两年只销售敞篷版本，直到2005年才宣布将在次年推出Viper SRT10轿跑。车名中的SRT对应的是克莱斯勒公司内专门负责研发高性能车款的专业团队。

团队为SRT10准备的V10 顶置气门引擎，排量高达8.3升，可输出517ps，最大扭矩高达73.96kgm，动力输出远超以往。略有不同的是，Viper的顶级速度并非来自强大的动力，而更多得益于它无与伦比的扭矩。

二代车型的车重远远轻于一代产品，自然为操控带来更多助力。克莱斯勒对这款车的市场目标不再是追求直线冲刺的传统美国跑车市场，而是世界级别的超跑市场。他们直接选择在纽博格林进行研发，并与科尔维特在赛道上一较高下。

尽管独特的外观先入为主，抓住了所有人的眼球，但Viper追逐的最终目标是一辆真正的跑车，更轻盈也更强大，在超跑世界中留下浓墨重彩的一笔。

catch.zh: 让大家望眼欲穿的全封闭车身，更加优秀的空气动力学，更轻的车重，换来真正的极速性能。"

long.en:
When the original Dodge Viper was introduced in 1992, the sports car world immediately took notice. Its sleek body, mean-looking design and powerful V-10 engine put it on par with the most exotic cars of its day. The breed improved in 2003 with the arrival of the second-generation model, and in 2006 a new model joined the lineup: a hard-top version called the SRT10 Coupe.

The SRT (Street and Racing Technology) in the car's name refers to Chrysler/Dodge's specialty sports division in charge of spicing up the company's vehicles. For the new Viper, it took its 8.3-liter OHV V10 and tuned it so it would produce 517ps and an asphalt-shredding peak torque of 73.96kgm, much more powerful than before.

The crew at SRT also improved the Viper's handling, by lowering the curb weight and testing it on the demanding Nürburgring circuit, not just to take the "America's Sport Car" moniker away from its main rival, the Chevrolet Corvette, but to challenge the likes of Ferrari and Lamborghini, which it succeeded in doing on the world stage.

Though its unique exterior tends to grabs everyone’s attention first, the Dodge Viper remains one of the most powerful and fastest sports car in history.

dialogues.speaker: Fabio Filippini
dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
The ‘DS’ brand was created by the PSA Group to renew
the unconventional spirit of the legendary Citroën DS19.

And this DS3 was the first car of the brand.

However, there is no similarity or stylistic reference
to the original DS from 1955.

Aiming instead at a French ‘chic’ imaginary, its shapes
are a little complex, with showy decorations.

On the whole, I find the extremely compact and energetic
proportions to be very pleasant.

And the ‘shark fin’ of the central pillar, represents,
I think, its most characteristic design element.
dialogues.zh:
“DS”是由PSA集团创建的新品牌，旨在为传奇的Citroën DS19
打破常规的精神注入新鲜的血液。

这辆DS3是该品牌的第一款车。

然而，该车与1955年的原版DS在风格和设计上毫无传承。

专注于营造一种法式的“别致”印象，因而选择了稍显复杂，
而且外向的华丽装饰。

整体上，我觉得它的车身比例给人以一种
非常紧凑而活力动感的印象，看起来赏心悦目。

我个人认为中柱处的“鲨鱼鳍”是此车最具特色的设计元素。

brandCentral.en:
The DS3 received its name from a line of luxury cars from Citroën
that were marketed from 1955 to 1975.

But the DS3, produced in 2009 to 2016, had very little
in common with those original models.

This car placed performance first, eventually becoming
one of the Continent's most popular hot hatches.

The DS3 Racing version was used as the foundation for the
French company's entry in the World Rally Championship.

A number of engine options were available, but the turbocharged
1.6-liter inline-4 was the most powerful at 200ps.

Development of the car was overseen by Citroën Racing.&
brandCentral.zh:
DS是Citroën设立的豪华品牌，Citroën将其最优质的车型都归于该
品牌名下。

借助这个品牌，这家法国汽车制造商得以以清晰、充分
地展现品牌卓乎不群的设计感。

DS成立于2009年，DS3是其推出的第一款车。

DS3的赛车版本更是成为了世界拉力锦标赛参赛车的基础
车型。

这款前置前驱高性能掀背车的开发工作由Citroën Racing负责。
他当然没有懈怠，这款引擎可以产生超过200ps的动力。

vehicleCollection.en:
A performance car that boasted exceptional quality and a high level of uniqueness.

Citroën's reborn "DS" brand, established in 2009, became a completely independent entity in 2015. This DS3 premium compact car, introduced in 2009, sported unique styling and superior quality, despite the fact that the platform and base mechanism were shared with the C3, which was introduced at the same time.

The DS3 Racing car that was introduced at the 2010 Paris Motor Show was a special model developed by Citroën’s competition department. It came with a turbocharged 1.6-liter direct-injection engine from the DS3 Sport Chic whose power was increased from 156ps and 24.5kgm of torque to 207ps and 28.0kgm of torque. The body was also enhanced, as it sat 30mm wider than the Sport Chic and 15mm lower, via special shocks and springs. The car stopped as it good as it went, thanks to upgraded brakes with 4-piston calipers and larger diameter discs. Also, to differentiate it from other DS3s, the DS3 Racing wore sporty 18-in. wheels and came bathed in a flamboyant paint scheme.

Production was initially set at 1000 units worldwide, but it became so popular that 2000 additional cars were produced.
vehicleCollection.zh:
赢得交口称赞的特殊车型，因为优异的性能、独特的设计和高品质而备受欢迎。

雪铁龙旗下主打奢华的“DS”品牌于2009年正式推出，并在2015年与雪铁龙分离，成为独立品牌。高档紧凑型轿车DS3也是在品牌成立同年官宣的。尽管共享了同期发布的雪铁龙C3车型的平台及基础机制，但DS3将研发重心放在打造独特的造型和提供卓越的品质上。

2010年的巴黎车展上公布的DS3 Racing是由参与世界拉力锦标赛的竞赛部门雪铁龙赛车开发的特殊车型。DS3运动奇客的1.6升直喷式涡轮引擎由156ps/24.5kgm增强至207ps/28.0kgm，并搭载了经过改良的涡轮增压和排气系统。车体进行过彻底调校，将胎面宽度加宽30mm并将离地间隙降低15mm，装备了特殊的减震器和弹簧。刹车系统升级为四个活塞卡钳和大直径刹车碟，轮毂由17英寸改至18英寸。内装和外装均采用了大胆的配色，令此车从其他DS3车型中脱颖而出。

此车型在发布之初，雪铁龙宣称只会在世界范围内限量生产1000台，但由于太受欢迎，在2011年又追加生产了2000台。

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
If my memory serves me right, I used to be called
the Ford Mustang Mach 1.

I’d was dormant for a long time, but when I awoke
everything had changed.

I can't sit still. How I wish to burn rubber,
driving with all my might!

The power my heart pumps is twice what it used to be.

My tires are larger, and my width, increased.

Now I can hardly recall who I am!

Cherished fragments of my former self remain, in my window
shield, headlights, tail, and door.

People say that this is what they love about me.

But I am also a monster, so filled-up with parts that
my heart had to be moved back.

The Mach 40... Yes, that is the name of my new self.
dialogues.zh:
如果我没有记错的话，我曾经被人们称为
“福特Mustang Mach 1”。

我曾在沉寂中度过了很长一段时间，但当我重新苏醒时，
我发现一切都已完全不同。

我不能置身事外。我多么渴望尽情释放自己的力量，
全力行驶，让车轮橡胶冒出阵阵青烟！

我心脏的跳动力量是过去的两倍。

我的轮胎变得更加宽大，我的车身变得更加宽阔。

现在我几乎忘记了自己的本来模样！

代表过去的细微特征只在挡风玻璃、前灯、尾部和车门上得以保留。

人们说这些是他们喜欢我的地方。

但我也变成了一辆动力怪兽，身体里被塞入了各种新的零部件，
以至于我的心脏不得不重新找地方安置。

“Mach 40”……是的，这就是我的新名字。

brandCentral.en:
Are you familiar with the Ford Mustang Mach 1 and GT40?

As the name suggests, the Mach 40 pays tribute to both of
these classic American race cars.

Produced by Eckert's Rod and Custom based in Oregon...

...this company specializes in custom restorations,
even creating original models from other cars.

This car has a fully customized body style of a
1969 Ford Mustang.

And it comes powered by the Ford GT's 5.4-liter V-8 engine,
mounted amidships.

This mesmerizing blend of two classics took home
the 2012 SEMA Gran Turismo Award!
brandCentral.zh:
不知道您是否听过Ford Mustang Mach 1和GT40？

Mach 40正如其名，是对这两款美国经典车型的致敬。

此车由位于俄勒冈州的Eckert's Rod and Custom生产……

这是一家专门从事定制修复工作的改装公司……

其车身是对1969 Ford Mustang的完全定制，

内里是Ford出品一台GT 5.4L V8引擎，采用中置布局……

这款令人着迷的混合改装车获得了2012年美国汽车用品改
装协会大展（SEMA）的Grand Turismo Awards奖！

vehicleCollection.en:
This Mustang, a 2012 GT Award Winner, possessed the heart of a Ford GT.

The Grand Turismo Awards take place every year during the SEMA Show in Las Vegas. In 2012, the GT crew awarded their 10th anniversary prize to a 1969 Ford Mustang customized by Eckert's Rod & Custom.

Based in Oregon, U.S., Eckert's Rod & Custom has worked on the restoration and customization of classic and muscle cars for more than 25 years. Its creation, called the Mach Forty, is a beautifully-restored first-generation Mustang Fastback, with plenty of added attitude underneath its sheet metal. Most of the flawless bodywork was completely rebuilt, and the floor, from the rear seats to the trunk, has been cut out to make room for an engine, making this Mustang a mid-engine sports car.

Ford's supercharged 5.4L V-8 was tuned to pump out 862ps and includes a control fitted inside the cabin that allows the driver to adjust engine output from approximately 608ps to 862ps. To handle the substantial increase in power, the chassis has been thoroughly reinforced, and the Chevrolet Corvette C6's suspension and traction control system have been installed.

Sure, Eckert's Rod & Custom tampered with the Mustang's traditional front-engine/rear-drive formula, but in doing so, it created a car even the most ardent Mustang fan would love.
vehicleCollection.zh:
2012年GT大奖获胜者，这辆令人惊叹的Mustang体内藏着一颗福特GT的心脏。

美国改装车协会车展是美国最大的定制车展之一，并主持颁发跑车浪漫旅年度奖项。2012年，十周年年度奖被颁给了埃克特定制车坊的1969年款福特Mustang。

埃克特定制车坊位于美国俄勒冈，25年来一直从事老爷车和肌肉车的修复和改装。

获奖车辆名为Mach 40，乍一眼看上去可能会被认为是一款修复精美的初代Mustang快背。但既然能够获奖，就代表在外表之下藏有许多看不见的秘密。大部分车身得到了重新搭建，从后排座位到行李箱的地板都被切除，以便留出空间安装重制后的福特GT传动系统，将布局改变为中置引擎式。

5.4升机械增压V8引擎经过改装后最大马力可达到862ps，车内安装的转盘能让马力输出在608ps到862ps之间进行调节。车身经过大量强化，以便承受引擎传来的强劲动力。其他改装部分借用自科尔维特C6的悬挂系统和牵引控制系统。

埃克特定制车坊大胆地将历史上两款著名的福特车型合二为一，完成了一款令人惊叹的作品，当之无愧地获得了十周年年度奖。

dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
The Ferrari Enzo, named after Ferrari’s founder, marked
a radical stylistic change in Ferrari’s history.

It was certainly one of the most iconic sports cars of the 2000s.

Directly inspired by the aerodynamic shapes
of contemporary Formula 1 machines...

...it made a lasting impression with its pointed nose.

Like a jetfighter, driven by functionality and performance,
its intersecting blocks created space for its air intakes.

The cabin was also clearly inspired by aeronautical shapes.

At the rear, there appeared, for the first time,
dual circular taillights...

...which would later be found on the F430
and other subsequent Ferraris.*
dialogues.zh:
以法拉利的创始人命名的法拉利Enzo标志着
法拉利史上的一次激进的设计变革。

它无疑是2000年代最具标志性的跑车之一。

此车的设计直接受到了当代F1赛车的
空气动力学造型启发……

以其尖锐的车鼻给人留下了“凶猛”的印象。

它就像一架喷气式战斗机，注重功能和性能，
互相交错的矩形表面为进气口创造了空间。

车厢设计也明显受到航空器的启发。

在车尾，两侧的双圆形尾灯首次亮相……

这种设计后来也出现在F430及其他后续车型上。<next id=2202009 type=9׾

brandCentral.en:
This Enzo is a special car that celebrated the company's
55th anniversary.

Released in 2002 as a successor to the F40 and F50...

...the Enzo was a mid-engine car with a naturally-aspirated
6.0-liter V-12 that produced 660ps.

Designed by Ken Okuyama, who worked for
Pininfarina at the time...

...the Enzo's front end was modelled after a Formula 1 car.

And if you're wondering about its name,
Enzo Ferrari was the name of the company's founder.
brandCentral.zh:
这款Enzo Ferrari是为庆祝Ferrari公司成立55周年而生产的一款
非常特别的车型。

此车是作为F40和F50的继任者在在2002年发布的……

Enzo采用中置引擎布局，配备6L自然进气V12引擎，能够产
出660ps的动力，

由当时为Pininfarina工作的奥山清行设计……

其车头与一级方程式赛车的车头很相似。

如果您是问车型命名的缘由，那当然是因为恩佐·法拉利
是公司的创始人！

vehicleCollection.en:
Christened with the name of the founder, this car celebrated the company's 55th anniversary and had a limited 399-production run.

The Enzo Ferrari is an ultra premium sports car with a limited production of 399 cars, built in commemoration of the 55th anniversary of Ferrari.

The Enzo was designed by Ken (Kiyoyuki) Okuyama, a Japanese designer in Pininfarina at the time. The highly aerodynamic body is reminiscent of F1 machines of the day. It is notable that not only the body panels, but most of the frame is built of carbon composites.

The 6-liter V12 engine was specially designed for the Enzo, and produces a massive 660ps of power, and 67.04kgm torque. The suspension is double wishbone in front and rear, and combined with Brembo carbon ceramic disc brakes, it can withstand full speed runs on the circuit. With its powerful engine and lightweight body, its maximum speed is in excess of <350km/h>.

Though it mounts the high power engine midship as in the F40 and the F50, it is also given gullwing doors, air conditioning, and a semi automatic transmission called the F1-matic. Measures have been taken against noise and vibration by mounting the engine to the subframe that is buffered by bushings, and it is designed to be more of a road than the F50, which was closer to a pure race car.
vehicleCollection.zh:
作为55周年纪念，总共生产了399辆的限量版。继承了法拉利创始人之名。

Enzo Ferrari是一款超豪华跑车，限量生产399部，是纪念法拉利55周年的车款。

Enzo由当时任职于宾尼法利纳设计公司的日本设计师奥山清行所设计。空气动力学的车身令人想起当时的F1赛车。值得注意的是，不止车身面板，大部分的车体框架都是采用复合碳纤维材料制成的。

Enzo所配备的6升V12引擎是专为这款车而设计的，并能输出660ps的强劲马力和67.04kgm的扭矩。前部和后部采用了双叉臂悬挂，搭配布雷博的碳纤维-陶瓷碟刹，可承受赛道上的全速奔驰。凭借其强大的发动机和轻量化的车身，这款车的最大时速超过<350km/h>。

和F40、F50一样，这款车搭载了大马力的中置式引擎，并且还配备了鸥翼门、空调以及被称为F1-matic的半自动变速箱。引擎被安装在采用轴衬缓冲的副车架上以减少噪音和振动。相比更纯粹的赛车F50，这款车在设计上与公路车更接近。

dialogues.speaker: Fabio Filippini
dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
The Ferrari 250 GT SWB is the 'Mona Lisa' of sport cars!

It brings sportiness, elegance and power into one perfect shape.

This Pininfarina's design...

Is the final word on a pursuit of volume and proportion
that started in 1947 with the Cisitalia 202 Berlinetta.

Compact, dynamic shapes and curved, sinewy surfaces
are expressed as utter purity and elegance.

The car fits a low, gritty front, a set-back cabin,
generous hips and a compact tail...

All into one concentrated ensemble.

It's not unlike...

A painting by da Vinci or a sculpture
by Michelangelo.

That is, it achieves a similarly exceptional level
of perfection and timeless beauty.

It is beauty in its purest and most striking essence!
dialogues.zh:
法拉利250 GT SWB！我愿意将它称为跑车中的“蒙娜丽莎”！

它是运动性、优雅和动力的精髓
在汽车外形上的完美总和。

这个设计方案……

……始于1947年的西斯塔尼亚202双座，
宾尼法利纳将自那以来对体积和比例的探索，都汇萃于此。

紧凑而动感的造型、力量喷涌的曲面……

……带来极致的纯粹和绝对的优雅。

从低矮却坚毅的前脸，到后移的座舱……

从厚实外扩的后轮到收窄的紧凑尾箱……

……同样是那么的纯粹，那么的优雅。

简直能与……

……达芬奇的绘画或米开朗基罗的雕塑相媲美。

它将各种元素浓缩而又均衡地组合在一起，
实现了无可比拟的圆满和永恒之美。

它是美以最纯粹的形式展现……

……是最动人心魄的美之精华！

Ferrari's 250 GT series owes much of its renown to this car,
the 250 GT Berlinetta.

The model was announced by Ferrari in 1959, and marked a
decisive shift away from previous 250s.

One of the most notable differences was the 2400mm wheelbase,
which was 200mm shorter than its predecessors.

This gave the car better handling, and led to the name
"SWB," which stands for "short wheelbase."

The V12 engine was also more powerful,

and driven by great drivers including Stirling Moss,
Graham Hill,
and Carroll Shelby,

 the model proved to be an outstanding success.

The total production of the Ferrari 250 Berlinetta was
around 160 cars in total.

Some of these featured an aluminum body for racing, while
others like this one had steel bodies for street use.
collection.zh:
法拉利的250 GT系列所拥有的知名度很大程度上来自于这款车，
即250 GT Berlinetta。

这款车由法拉利在1959年宣布推出，标志着与以前的250车型风
格的彻底转变。

最明显的差异之一是长为2400毫米的轴距，比前代车型缩
短了近200毫米。

这让该车获得了更好的操控性，并获得了“SWB”这个代表
“短轴距”的名号。

它搭载的V12引擎的功率也更加强大。

当时的大部分伟大车手，例如Stirling Moss、格拉汉姆·希尔，
以及卡罗尔·谢尔比都驾驶过它。

这款出类拔萃的车型在当时取得了巨大成功。

250 Berlinetta大约生产了160辆。

其中一些采用赛车的铝制车身，而另一些则采用公路车
型的钢制车身。*

vehicleCollection.en:
A predecessor to the 250 GTO, this car racked up numerous wins in the world of endurance racing.

Styled by Pininfarina, the 250 GT Berlinetta made its debut at the 1959 Paris Motor Show, equipped with a 3.0-liter 12-cylinder engine that had 250 cc of displacement in each of its cylinders, as the name implied.

There was a definitive difference between this car and previous models. The car's wheelbase, which measured 2600mm long, had been chopped down to 2400mm in order to improve cornering agility. It was also to give it an edge in GT category racing. Years later, the car came to be known as the "250 GT Berlinetta passo corto," or 250 GT Berlinetta SWB (the abbreviation for Short Wheelbase in English) to distinguish this version from previous models.

The 250 GT Berlinetta passo corto began production in 1960, a year after its public unveiling, and came with an all-aluminum racing body, as well as a steel body for road-going models. The 2953cc SOHC V12 produced between 220ps to 280ps, depending on its degree of tuning, and was the first mass production vehicle by Ferrari to be equipped with 4-wheel disc brakes.

The immediate racing success that was to follow was largely attributed to the car's shorter wheelbase: Nearly unstoppable, it won the Tour De France Automobile three years in a row from 1960 to 1962 and the GT category at Le Mans in 1960 and 1961. It also won the Nürburgring 1000km race two years in a row, from 1961 to 1962. Thereafter, the 250 GT passed the baton to the 250 GTO, which was based on the 250 GT Berlinetta passo corto. In the end, only 162 examples of this beautiful grand touring machine were built.
vehicleCollection.zh:
250 GTO的前辈，赢得无数耐力赛奖项。

全新的250 GT Berlinetta于1959年的巴黎车展上公布，它的造型源自宾尼法利纳的设计，名字中的250则来自3.0L 12缸引擎中每个气缸的容积250 cc。

这款车型与早期型号有一个根本性的不同：它把250 GT系列的底盘从传统的2600mm缩短到了2400mm，目的是提升过弯的灵敏性，以在超跑比赛中取得优势。接下来的几年里，它也常常被称为250 GT Berlinetta passo corto，或是250 GT Berlinetta SWB（“短轴距”的英语缩写），以便与早期型号区别开来。

1960年，250 GT Berlinetta passo corto投入生产，有竞速用途的全铝车身版和公路用途的钢车身版可供选择。根据调校，它的2953cc顶置单凸轮轴V12引擎能够输出220ps到280ps区间的动力。它是法拉利第一款采用四轮碟刹的量产车型。

通过缩短底盘获得的性能提升使这台双座在各项比赛中所向披靡。它从1960年到1962年连续3年赢得了环法汽车赛，并在勒芒的GT组别中将1960和1961年的桂冠收入囊中。它还在1961年到1962年连续两次赢得纽博格林1000公里耐力赛。在此之后，它将接力棒交给了自己的升级车型250 GTO。

这款车总共只生产了162辆。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
When comparing it to the classic design of its predecessor...

...the 250 GTO adopted a longer nose, lower stance,
 and a "coda tronca" rear.

Thus, it was designed with aerodynamics strongly in mind.

The front and rear fenders give the car a great sense
of energy and vigor.

The view from the rear-quarter angle is just exquisite.

The car's distinguishing features include...

The three air intakes on the hood and air outlets
on the fenders.

In staying true to Ferrari’s established design language,
while adapting to the rigors of racing...

...the 250 GTO achieved a rare and remarkable equilibrium.

It is precisely this harmony that has made it one of
the more popular Ferrari cars ever created.
dialogues.zh:
与之前的经典短轴距车型相比……

250 GTO不仅采用了更长的车鼻，压低了车身高度，还引入了
被称为断尾的后部设计。

在设计时，空气动力学性能也是其重点考量。

宽大的前后挡泥板营造出了
无与伦比的动感氛围。

从侧后方角度看过去，特别华贵高雅。

无论是引擎盖正前方的三个进气口，
还是后保险杠上突出的排气管，

都让人记忆犹新。

可以说，250 GTO的设计既保留了法拉利的底蕴，
又满足了赛车运动的需求……

实现了难能可贵的平衡。

也正是这份平衡感让这款经典法拉利车型充满魅力，
人气爆棚。

conversation.en:
Perhaps you knew this, but the 250 GTO was built
by Scaglietti, not Pininfarina.

In terms of design, proportions and texture...

It is your typical 1960s Grand Touring car,
in a good way, of course!
conversation.zh:
这辆250 GTO不是由Pininfarina设计的，
而是Scaglietti打造的赛车。

无论是设计主题、车身比例和表面涂装，

都充分体现了1960年代豪华旅行车的精髓。

conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.en: By the way, are you familiar with ‘Scaglietti’?
conversation.zh: 对了，你对“Scaglietti”有了解吗？

conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.en:
That's right! It's an Italian carrozzeria that was famous
for manufacturing Ferrari bodies.

It has been manufacturing racecar
bodies for Ferrari since long ago.

The body of this historic 250 GTO is among the products
that represents Scaglietti's handiwork.
conversation.zh:
很对，这是一家意大利车身制造厂，
以为Ferrari打造车身而打响了名声。

他们很久以前就开始为Ferrari制造赛车车身。

这辆充满历史意义的250 GTO的车身设计
是最能够体现Scaglietti工艺水平的诸多产品之一。.

collection.en:
This 250 GTO is one of the last Ferraris to combine
the characteristics of road cars and racing cars.

It's not the rarest Ferrari of them all, and maybe
there are fairer models around.

But if you like good stories, I'm sure you'll become
fond of this car!

Even if you include the 330 GT and the series 2 cars,
only 39 of these 250 GTOs were built in total.

and each one of them has its own unique tale.

This car, chassis number 3729GT, is a right-hand drive
built for the UK.

It was purchased by Jaguar dealer
and race car driver John Coombs,

and it was originally white but painted red in 1966.

Really famous drivers including Graham Hill, Richie Ginther
and Mike Parkes, drove this car in the UK during the 1960s.

It was later owned and raced by the British racing driver
Jack Sears for several years.

Since 1999 it's been owned by former Microsoft President
and chief operating officer, John Shirley.

The price of this particular car takes this long stored
history into account.
collection.zh:
250 GTO是最后一代混合了公路车与赛车特性的法拉利之一。

它可能不是最稀有的法拉利，也不是外观最动人的，

但如果您对车辆背后的精彩故事感兴趣，那您一定会
喜欢上它！

即使算上330 GT和后续2系列的车，250 GTO也总共只生产了
39辆。

而且每一辆车的背后都有着独特的故事。

我们眼前这辆的底盘编号为3729GT，是一辆针对英国市场制
造的右舵版本。

它被Jaguar经销商和赛车手约翰·库姆斯购入。

原本白色的车身在1966年被涂成红色。

在60年代，包括格拉汉姆·希尔、里奇·金瑟和迈克·帕克斯在内的
多位著名英国车手都曾驾驶过它。

后来有几年它归属于英国赛车手杰克·西尔斯，甚至还参加过比赛。

1999年起，它进入了前微软总裁和首席运营官约翰·雪利的收藏。

显而易见，这台车的售价已经把它漫长且精彩的经历都
换,进去了……

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultra-popular car was built to win the GT Class International Championship title.

When you think of multi-million-dollar classic exotics, the first name that usually comes to mind is Ferrari. And among all the valuable Ferrari cars through history, the 250 GTO stands out as the “collectable Ferrari.” Built in the early 1960s, the 250 GTO, the original Testarossa, made an immediate impact on the world sports car scene.

The “250” in the name indicates its engine displacement of 250cc per cylinder. And the car had 12 cylinders, which meant it was a total displacement of 3.0 liters. The “GTO” stands for Gran Turismo Omologato, a reference to it being a homologation model for GT racing. And as such a name implies, it was introduced in 1962 specifically to win the GT class in international production sports car racing.

The car was based on the agile 250 GT SWB, but with a lighter curb weight. Covering its steel tubular frame was an all-aluminum body, and the nose was long and low in order to boost aerodynamic performance. The rear of the car was characterized by a coda tronca, with bulging rear fenders to allow space for large tires. The ride height of the car is 90mm lower than the SWB. Power comes from a Testarossa engine with a dry oil sump and six carburetors, delivering an output of 300ps. It helped enable the car to reach a top speed of <300km/h>.

Only 39 250 GTOs were ever produced, which by itself was not enough for homologation. But Ferrari stated that the car was simply a variation of the SWB, and once this was accepted, the car started racing in '62. The 250 GTO won the international championship three years in a row.

All 39 of these cars still exist today. The 3729GT included in the game is a right-hand drive model delivered to the UK in '62. It was once raced by a Ferrari semi-works team, and achieved podium finishes in many British races.
vehicleCollection.zh:
为赢得GT组别国际锦标赛而打造的超高人气车型。

对车迷来说，任何一台法拉利都是最想拥有的对象。但250 GTO是一款特别的车，此车问世于60年代早期，当时赛车和公路车之间的界限十分模糊。这款车是当时最受欢迎的车款。

其名称中的“250”是指每个汽缸排量为250cc，12缸共计3升。GTO代表跑车浪漫旅认证车型，是指用于GT比赛的认证车型。如名称所示，该车开发于1962年，用于参加国际量产跑车比赛中的GT级别比赛。

此车基于灵巧的250 GT SWB开发，对其钢管车架进行了轻量化改造。车身为全铝制，车头长而低，以提高空气动力学性能。车尾为“断尾”的形式，后挡泥板加宽并凸起，为大轮胎留出了空间。车辆的行驶高度也降低了90mm。采用带干式润滑油槽和6个渗碳器的Testarossa引擎，马力高达300ps。在8速可用的最终齿轮比中选择最快的组合时，最高时速可达到<300km/h>。

250 GTO一共只生产了39辆，未能满足接受认证的数量。因此法拉利将此车称作250 GT SWB的改款，从而绕过了这一问题。250 GTO通过认证参加比赛后，自1962年起连续三年蝉联了国际系列赛的冠军。

法拉利所生产的39辆车全都保存至今，游戏中的3729GT是1962年交付到英国的右侧驾驶型号。此车曾在一支法拉利半厂商车队中效力，并在一系列英国比赛中登上领奖台。

法拉利所生产的39辆车全都保存至今，游戏中的3729GT是1962年交付到英国的右侧驾驶型号。此车曾在一支法拉利半厂商车队中效力，并在一系列英国比赛中登上领奖台。

The year was 2023.

Ferrari claimed its first-ever overall victory at the

The machine that achieved this remarkable feat was none other
than the Ferrari 296 GT3.

It was a historic race, completed in a record 162 laps.

But the 296 GT3 didn’t just secure the overall win.

All three of the team’s entries finished the race,
a testament to their outstanding reliability.

In the months that followed, the 296 GT3 continued to dominate,
earning victories in endurance races across the globe!

brandCentral.en:
Making its debut in 2022, the mid-engine 296 GTB
was Ferrari’s first V-6 plug-in hybrid.

Praised for its compact dimensions and featherweight
agility, it was a road car built for the track.

The 296 GTB would go on to serve as the foundation for the
296 GT3, successor to the storied 488 GT3.

To meet GT3 regulations, Ferrari replaced the hybrid system
with a pure twin-turbo V-6, producing 591.7 bhp.

Assembly was entrusted to the legendary French outfit Oreca,
which also provided maintenance and after-sales support.

Since its debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona, the 296 GT3
quickly proved itself as a relentless competitor.

By the end of 2024, with 100 victories to its name,
it had become the undisputed star of GT3 racing.
brandCentral.zh:
2022年推出的中置引擎296 GTB是
Ferrari首款V6插电混动跑车。

它以紧凑尺寸与极致轻量化著称，
堪称为赛道而生的公路猛兽。

事实上，296 GTB正是296 GT3的研发基础，
后者接替488 GT3成为新一代战驹。

为使该车符合GT3赛事规范，Ferrari将其混动系统更换为
纯双涡轮V6引擎，输出动力达591.7 BHP。

组装由传奇法国赛车制造商Oreca操刀，
并提供后续维护和售后支持。

自2023年戴通纳24小时赛首秀以来，
296 GT3不断证明其纯正血统，展现出不可撼动的实力。

截至2024年底就已豪取100胜，
当之无愧地成为了GT3赛事的耀眼明星。

vehicleCollection.en:
This elegant GT3 machine is also known as the "Racing Queen.")

Ferrari had long produced racing machines derived from its road-going super sports cars, achieving remarkable results in endurance and GT race championships. The 296 GT3 was one such car to carry on that tradition, developed from the 296 GTB.

As a pure racing machine, the 296 GT3 dispensed with the plug-in hybrid system of the road car, relying solely on a 600-horsepower twin-turbo V-6 engine. This unit employed a 3.0-liter 120-degree V-6, extensively modified for weight reduction and reliability. Drivetrain, cooling components, and aerodynamic parts were all replaced with dedicated race versions.

Unlike earlier racing Ferraris, traditionally constructed by Michelotto, the 296 GT3 was built by legendary race-car specialists Oreca. From chassis construction to assembly and after-sales service, Oreca provided full end-to-end support. The car was first unveiled at the 2022 24 Hours of Spa in July, before making its racing debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona.

The 296 GT3 was not confined to the current international endurance championships; its design continued to evolve toward the future. An Evo version, with enhanced aerodynamic efficiency and improved endurance, had already been announced for the 2026 season.

By blending the sophistication of its road-going sibling with the raw speed of a track machine, the 296 GT3 became the new standard-bearer of Ferrari’s motorsports strategy.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一款被誉为“赛道女王”的优雅GT3赛车。

法拉利基于其公路版超级跑车，研发了多款专业赛车，并在耐力赛与房车锦标赛中屡创佳绩。296 GT3正是承袭这一品牌传统的车型，基于296 GTB平台开发。

作为纯种赛车，296 GT3摒弃了公路版车型的插电混动系统，仅搭载输出600匹马力的V6双涡轮增压引擎。该动力单元采用120度3升V6中后置引擎，经过全面优化改进，专注于实现轻量化与可靠性提升。传动系统、冷却组件以及空气动力学套件均已更换为专用赛车版本。

与米奇洛托打造的经典法拉利赛车不同，这款车型由传奇赛车制造商奥雷卡操刀打造。从底盘制造到整车组装，再到售后服务，奥雷卡提供覆盖全产业链的一站式支持。该车于2022年7月首次亮相斯帕24小时耐力赛，随后在次年2023年的戴通纳24小时耐力赛完成竞技首秀。

296 GT3不仅着眼于当前的国际耐力锦标赛，其设计理念亦持续演进，始终面向未来赛道需求。法拉利已宣布将于2026赛季推出空气动力学与耐久性能全面进阶的Evo版本。

该车完美融合公路版跑车的精湛工艺与赛车的纯粹速度，成为法拉利赛车运动战略的全新标杆。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
The 296 GTB is one of Ferrari’s most iconic GT3 racers.

Its name is derived directly from the numbers associated
with its engine.

Specifically, it features a 2.9-liter displacement
and 6 cylinders.

Combine the two and you get “296."

I’ve heard that Ferrari used a similar naming convention
for several models between 1970 and 1990.

I can’t say exactly how many, but I certainly plan to find out!
dialogues.zh:
296 GTB是Ferrari最具标志性的GT3赛车。

其命名取自引擎的核心参数。

具体而言，该车搭载2.9升排量的6缸引擎。

两者结合便构成了“296”的命名！

我听说，在1970至1990年间，
Ferrari还以类似的方式命名了其他车型。

具体数量我一时说不上来，但我一定会查个明白！

vehicleCollection.en:
Here's a mid-engine sports car with a revolutionary V-6 + PHEV system.

There is a long-standing tradition within the Ferrari line-up in which its super sports models have relied on a mid-mounted V-8s. With a lightweight, high-revving engine placed behind the driver, this layout delivered sharp response and agile maneuverability, and it became emblematic of the brand. The 296 GTB carried forward parts of that legacy while opening the door to new possibilities.

It was the first Ferrari to adopt a twin-turbo V-6 engine. And it was the first time in more than a half century that a V-6 block had been used by the marque—last seen on the 206 and 246 under the Dino name. With a displacement of 2992cc, the engine employed a 120-degree bank angle with IHI turbochargers positioned within the vee.

One of the key reasons behind the move to a V-6 powertrain was the integration of a plug-in hybrid (PHEV) system. Combined with a 123kW electric motor, the system produced a total of 830 horsepower, allowing for blistering acceleration from zero to <100km/h> in just 2.9 seconds. With a top speed of <330km/h>, the 296 GTB offered performance truly worthy of the Ferrari name.

Its design paid homage to the legendary 250 LM of the 1960s, while also being the most compact model in the contemporary Ferrari line-up. The distinctive tunnel-back rear window enhanced both aerodynamics and elegance. Blending the classic mid-engine sports layout with groundbreaking technology, the 296 GTB stood as the epitome of Ferrari’s new generation.
vehicleCollection.zh:
采用革命性V6+插电式混合动力系统的中置布局跑车。

法拉利产品系列秉承一项悠久传统：其超级跑车车型均采用中置V8引擎布局。此布局将轻量化高转速引擎置于驾驶舱后方，带来敏锐的响应特性与卓越的操控性能，现已成为该品牌的标志性特征。296 GTB在延续这一传统精髓的同时，也为新技术的可能性开辟了道路。

首先，296 GTB是法拉利首款搭载V6双涡轮增压引擎的车型。这也意味着V6引擎时隔半个多世纪后首次回归——上一次应用还需追溯至Dino旗下的206与246车型。创新设计的引擎排量达2992cc，采用120度V型夹角结构，并将石川岛播磨重工业涡轮增压器集成于V型夹角空间内。

296 GTB采用V6动力总成的关键因素之一，在于引入了插电式混合动力系统。传统引擎协同这部能产生123千瓦的电机，该系统综合输出功率达830匹马力，仅需2.9秒即可完成0-<100km/h>加速，表现令人惊叹。极速高达<330km/h>，整体性能表现完美契合法拉利品牌精髓。

车身设计致敬1960年代的经典车型250 LM，同时也是当前法拉利产品线中最为紧凑的车型。内凹式后窗设计兼顾空气动力学性能与优雅气质。296 GTB将经典的中置跑车布局与革命性技术相融合，堪称新一代法拉利车型的典范之作。

dialogues.speaker: Fabio Filippini
dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
The 308 can be considered the progenitor of all modern
8-cylinder Ferraris, and the most popular of them all.

And, perhaps it was also the longest-lasting.

 Its production run spanned from 1975 to 1989,
including the derivative version, the 328.

Besides its technical aspects, the car's success came
from an extremely balanced and pure design.

It's almost timeless.

It serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s design
philosophy applied to the cars of the Cavallino.

In fact, it takes up some classical themes from the Dino
246, such as the progressive wave on the two-wheel arches...

...and the iconic side air intake,
but also the dynamic rear pillars.

And, of course, the truncated tail with
four round taillights.

However, all of it was transformed into a very essential
and modern shaping for the time.
dialogues.zh:
308不仅是所有现代8缸法拉利跑车的鼻祖，
而且无疑是所有车款当中最受欢迎的一款。

它可能也是持续量产最久的一款法拉利。

如果将328版本也算进去，
其生产时间足足从1975年延续到1989年。

这都要归功于它纯粹且经得起时代考验的设计。

在评论家口中，它的平衡性同样首屈一指……

还完美诠释了宾尼法利纳的设计理念。

它甚至复兴了Dino 246的经典元素，如外扩的轮拱……

标志性的侧面进气口，动态的C柱……

还包括带有四个圆形尾灯的截断式尾部。

当然，所有这些元素都经过改良，
以适应更加现代化的设计理念。*

conversation.speaker: Fabio Filippini
conversation.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
conversation.en:
The 308 can be considered the progenitor of all modern
8-cylinder Ferraris, and the most popular of them all.

And, perhaps it was also the longest-lasting.

 Its production run spanned from 1975 to 1989,
including the derivative version, the 328.

Besides its technical aspects, the car's success came
from an extremely balanced and pure design.

It's almost timeless.

It serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s design
philosophy applied to the cars of the Cavallino.

In fact, it takes up some classical themes from the Dino
246, such as the progressive wave on the two-wheel arches...

...and the iconic side air intake,
but also the dynamic rear pillars.

And, of course, the truncated tail with
four round taillights.

However, all of it was transformed into a very essential
and modern shaping for the time.

usedCar.en:
The tradition of Ferrari's mid-engine V-8 began with
the 308.

The car's elegant wedge-shaped design, penned
by Pininfarina, made it instantly popular.

And its basic proportions were inherited by later V-8 models.

Thanks to its head-turning looks, the 308 also appeared
in many movies and TV series.

Its compact body made it lightweight and agile, while
the V-8 let out a truly melodic roar.

This 1975 model came equipped with both fuel injectors and
carburetors.

The wonderful engine and the responsive chassis
made this car as fun to drive as it was to look at.
usedCar.zh:
传统的法拉利中置引擎V8车型始于
308系列。

确实，这一车型无疑具有真正的
历史价值。

它的设计正是出自Pininfarina之手。

随后的V8车型继承了其
时尚的比例。

它的紧凑型车身轻盈而敏捷，
性感的引擎音非常悦耳。

这款1975年的车型同时采用燃油喷射和
化油器。

灵敏的油门使得这款车型更趋完美，
让你真正享受引擎的咆哮。;

vehicleCollection.en:
This successor to the Ferrari Dino 246 GT features a V-8 mounted amidships."

Making its debut in 1975 was the successor to the very popular Ferrari Dino 246 GT called the 308 GTB. This svelte sports car represented one of the first of a long line of V-8-powered mid-engine Ferraris that would the exotic-car genre for years to come.

The wedge-shaped exterior was penned by Leonardo Fioravanti of Pininfarina, who was responsible for a number of Ferrari designs from the late 1960s to the early 1990s.

Under the sheet metal, the 308 GTB was equipped with a 3.0-liter DOHC V-8, the same powerplant as the Dino 208 GT4, which produced 255ps. In 1980, new emissions regulations brought output down to 215ps, but two years later Ferrari increased it back up to 240ps after it adopted a 4-valve system for the engine. The new car was called the 308 GTB Quattrovalvole. In 1977, a targa top GTS was added to the mix, setting the stage for the 328 that was introduced in 1985.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款Dino 246 GT的继任者采用中置布局，容纳一台V8引擎。

308GTB是法拉利制造的一款引擎中置跑车，于1975年首次在众人面前亮相。作为Dino 246 GT的继任者，此车被认为是双座中置V8引擎风潮的滥觞，并在之后成为了法拉利阵容的主打。

管式车架之上覆盖的优雅外观是由宾尼法利纳的列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂设计的，他负责了从60年代末到90年代初的一系列法拉利车型设计。

此车使用了与Dino 308 GT4相同的3升V8双顶置凸轮轴引擎，初期型号可产生255ps的动力。然而在1980年，为了满足新的排放法规，引擎改为燃油喷射，该车摇身一变，变成了308 GTBi。1982年，为了解决动力输出不足问题（已降至215ps），引擎的气缸盖换用了4气门设计，创造出了240ps的308 GTB四气门。

从1977年起，法拉利还追加推出了采用Targa顶篷的GTS车型。在1985年接替此车的328车型上，308 GTB的车身外观风格也得到延续。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
I don't care what anyone else says, I think this is the
world's most beautiful race car!

I just can't get enough of that bodywork, especially the
wheelhouses and fenders.

It's not just a nice looking car, though.

It won the 24 Hours of Daytona on its first try in 1967.

In fact, the 330 P4 occupied
all the podium positions.

Seeing three 330 P4s cross the finish line together...
well, that was enough to bring a tear to my eye.

The 330 P4 won the 1000 Kilometers
of Monza that same year as well!

Formula 1 drivers Lorenzo Bandini and Mike Parkes
piloted the Ferrari in that race.

The car was then entered in the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

But defending champion Ford still proved dominant,
and the 330 P4 came in 2nd place.

The Ford GT40 that won at Le Mans hat year is also
a beautiful car.

But for me, nothing comes close to the 330 P4.
Viva Ferrari!
*
dialogues.zh:
我不管其他人怎么看，反正我就觉得
这辆车就是世界上最好看的赛车！

这些曲线我不管看多少遍都看不腻。
瞧瞧这轮拱罩和挡泥板！

而且这辆车不仅是好看！

它在1967年亮相时就赢得了戴通纳24小时耐力赛！

实际上，为了展现硬实力，这款车直接霸占了整座领奖台！

想象一下三辆330 P4一同跨过终点线的景象……
简直要让我感动到哭了！

就在同一年，330 P4还赢得了蒙扎1000km的冠军！

一级方程式车手洛伦佐·班迪尼和迈克·帕克斯
都曾代表法拉利参赛。

330 P4还参加过勒芒耐力赛……

但是福特的数量优势实在太大，所以330 P4只得了第二名。

那辆在勒芒夺冠的福特GT40$是一辆优美的车子……

但对我而言，330 P4才是我心中永远的神。
法拉利万岁！

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
There never was a more stylish and sleek
thoroughbred than the 330 P4.

Not before or since.

It may have been built for racing, but it doesn't feel
like ‘winning’ was the absolute objective.

You could say that it is the ultimate expression of
a style that goes back to the 250 P of the ‘60s.

In terms of design, the fender lines and surfaces
are very expressive...

Giving it its Italian flavour.

After the 330 P4, Ferrari racers went a bit dry,
prioritising performance and function.

Indeed, this masterpiece comes from an era when race cars
were still works of art.
dialogues.zh:
我的观点是，330 P4是最时尚、最具魅力的纯血赛车，

前无古人，后无来者。

尽管这辆车是严格按照竞赛标准设计的，
但如果你只看外观，赢得比赛似乎并不是它的最高设计准则。

可以说330 P4就是Ferrari在1960年代
中置引擎赛车设计的终极体现。

从设计美学的角度分析，它的侧面线条和轮廓
既流畅，又充满力量感……

……呈现出独有的意大利风貌。

在它之后，就连Ferrari的赛车都开始变得
不那么重视美感，而是将优先级放在性能和功能上。

这款杰作代表了那个赛车也可以很美的时代。
