brandCentral.en:
This third generation FIAT 500 is the quintessential
Italian compact car.

Not only did it inherit its design from the hugely popular
second generation model...

But like its predecessor, it too proved to be
a massive worldwide success!

With a 1.2L 70ps engine that feels great on the road...

From handling to acceleration, it's simply a joy to drive!
brandCentral.zh:
第三代FIAT 500是一辆典型的意大利紧凑型汽车。

此车不仅继承了大受欢迎的第二代车型的设计思路……

而且也和前代一样在全世界范围内获得了巨大的成功！

此车配备一台动力为70ps的1.2L引擎，驾驶感受十分出色……

从操控到加速，驾驶这辆车简直是一种享受！

usedCar.en:
The FIAT 500 is the quintessential Italian compact.

The design is based on that of the famed 1950s
second-generation model of the same name.

The car utilizes a front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout
that we refer to as "FF."

The FIAT 500's "FIRE" is one in a long line of inline-4 engines
that have been in use since the first Pandas.

While it may not look like much...

...it handles well for a front-drive compact car, and its engine
note is pleasing to the ear.
usedCar.zh:
FIAT 500是意大利小型车的代表作。

它的设计基于20世纪50年代著名的
同名第二代车型。

这辆车采用了传统的前置
前驱系统……

它搭载的直列四缸FIRE引擎是从第一代
Panda车型上沿用下来的。

确实，这辆车看起来中规中矩……

但是它的操控性不错，
而且引擎声浪非常悦耳。

vehicleCollection.en:
The Italian version of the people's car makes a comeback after a 50-year hiatus.+

With its irresistibly charming design and remarkably low price, the second-generation FIAT 500 sold four million units between 1957 and 1977, playing a pivotal role in Italy’s automotive revolution. With its endearing round "eyes," smooth curves, and unmistakable charm, the spirit of the second-generation FIAT 500 was reborn 50 years later in the third generation.

Unveiled at the 2004 Geneva Motor Show, the concept car immediately captivated the world. When it finally hit the market in 2007, its popularity soared. Its appeal was so overwhelming that backorders continued in most markets worldwide, even two years after its launch.

The available engines under the hood came in the form of a 1.2-liter and 1.4-liter gasoline engine and a 1.3-liter diesel. The 1.2-liter engine produced only 69ps and 10.4kgm of torque, but revved quite smoothly. Weighing just 1010kg, even in the luxury-grade Lounge model, the FIAT 500 boasted a finely tuned chassis that delivered a surprisingly sporty driving experience, belying its cute appearance.

Pronounced “cinquecento” in Italian, the FIAT 500 carries this affectionate nickname worldwide.
vehicleCollection.zh:
阔别50年的第3代500，保留了2代的可爱造型。

由于价格极低、造型可爱，第2代菲亚特500在1957年到1977年期间卖出了400万台，为意大利的汽车普及率做出了极大贡献。在第2代菲亚特500诞生的50年后，它那圆圆的小“眼睛”、圆润的线条和可爱的气质又在第3代菲亚特500身上重现。

它的概念车在2004年日内瓦车展上刚一亮相，就立即吸引到了全世界的目光。2007年上市后，它的人气爆炸式膨胀。由于实在太受欢迎，直到上市2年后，依旧在全世界大部分市场上供不应求。

它娇小的前置前驱车身上搭载1.2升和1.4升的汽油引擎，或1.3升的柴油引擎。1.2升引擎只能输出69ps的动力和10.4kgm扭矩，但加速很快。它身材轻盈，豪华的尊享版车型也仅重1010kg，经过精心调整的底盘让它能发挥出与外表不符的强悍性能。

车名中的500在意大利语中读作“cinque cento”，这也成为了它在世界各地的昵称。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
This rare beauty is an icon of Italian car manufacturing.

The FIAT 500 made its debut in 1957.

It is considered one of legendary FIAT car designer
Dante Giacosa's most enduring masterpieces.

Giacosa contributed to the fabulous engineering legacy
of FIAT for many, many years.

At under 3m in length, it's compact in nature, but can snugly
fit four people thanks to a space-saving rear-engine.

It is celebrated to this day for its undeniable charm.

You can see where the modern FIAT 500
got its good looks from!
dialogues.zh:
这款稀世珍品诠释了意大利汽车制造业的外在之美。

FIAT 500于1957年问世。

被认为是极富传奇色彩的FIAT汽车设计大师但特·吉奥科萨的
代表作之一，这款车型久盛不衰，是永恒的经典。

吉奥科萨为FIAT设计多年，留下许多非凡的作品。

这款车总长不到3m，是紧凑型汽车，但由于
配置了省空间的后置引擎，因此可以容纳4人。

这款车的魅力毋庸置疑，因而久负盛名……

我们一眼就能看出具备现代感的
FIAT 500外观有多吸睛！

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
Along with the German Beetle and the British Mini,
this Italian FIAT 500…

...is one of the most iconic European small cars in history.

It may be the smallest of its rivals...

...but it can seat four passengers, and its feisty little engine
is capable of thrilling speeds.

Its splendid exterior is owing to the handiwork of famed
FIAT engineer Dante Giacosa.

He also penned the underlying design.

Giacosa created many great cars for FIAT, and I'm sure
you'll come across them in time!
dialogues.zh:
与德国的Beetle和英国的MINI一样，
这辆意大利的FIAT 500……

是欧洲历史上最具代表性的紧凑型车之一。

和其竞争对手相比，它可能是体型最小的……

但它可以容纳四名乘客，
而且其强劲的小引擎能够达到惊人的速度。

它华丽的外观由著名的FIAT工程师
但特·吉奥科萨亲手打造，

他还包揽了车辆的内饰设计。

吉奥科萨为FIAT创造了许多台伟大的汽车，
你会逐渐发现这些瑰宝的。

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you.
It showcases a high level of product design.

In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.

No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.

Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...

...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600,
Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.

He then took on the challenge of...

...creating an even better minimally-packaged car.
The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.

Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches,
the car appears to be in constant motion.

The yawning hood lid is also quite appealing,
not to mention functional.
dialogues.zh:
千万不要小看这款娇小的车型。它表现出了极高的
产品设计水平，

甚至堪称永恒经典。

难怪最新款的500也借鉴了它的设计。

菲亚特的传奇工程师但特·吉奥科萨……

在1955年设计出了600，为意大利汽车行业拿出了
战后紧凑型汽车的标准答案，也借此声名鹊起。

然后他勇敢地接受了更大的挑战……

开始打造一款更加优秀的低配置车型。
最终他开发出了这辆后置引擎、空间超紧凑的500。

在他的巧手勾勒下，这款车采用了外扩式轮拱，
让它呈现出一种始终处于运动状态下的观感。

它宽大的引擎盖也拥有一种慵懒闲适的吸引力，而性能
自然也不容小觑。

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic

conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.en:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you.
It showcases a high level of product design.

In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.

No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.

Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...

...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600,
Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.

He then took on the challenge of...

...creating an even better minimally-packaged car.
The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.

Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches,
the car appears to be in constant motion.

The yawning hood lid is also quite appealing,
not to mention functional.
conversation.zh:
千万不要小看这款娇小的车型。它表现出了极高的
产品设计水平，

甚至堪称永恒经典。

难怪最新款的500也借鉴了它的设计。

菲亚特的传奇工程师但特·吉奥科萨……

在1955年设计出了600，为意大利汽车行业拿出了
战后紧凑型汽车的标准答案，也借此声名鹊起。

然后他勇敢地接受了更大的挑战……

开始打造一款更加优秀的低配置车型。
最终他开发出了这辆后置引擎、空间超紧凑的500。

在他的巧手勾勒下，这款车采用了外扩式轮拱，
让它呈现出一种始终处于运动状态下的观感。

它宽大的引擎盖也拥有一种慵懒闲适的吸引力，而性能
自然也不容小觑。

usedCar.en:
The FIAT 500 F is one of the most recognisable Italian cars
in history.

It has a rear-engine, rear-wheel drive layout,
and hauls an air-cooled two-cylinder engine.

In this respect, it resembles no less a car than
the Porsche 911!

This later model features conventional front-hinged doors.

Despite having debuted half a century ago, the legacy of this
iconic car lives on in the modern FIAT 500.]
usedCar.zh:
FIAT 500 F是历史上最著名的
意大利车之一。

它采用了后置后驱布局，
并搭载了一台风冷双气缸引擎。

从这个角度上看，这辆车其实和
Porsche 911差不多！

此款后期的型号安装了便捷地前开式车门。

虽已是年过半百的老车，
这款标志性车型的设计精神在现代的FIAT 500中得以延续。

vehicleCollection.en:
Small, versatile and inexpensive, this minimalist car could also be raced.

Introduced in 1957, the FIAT 500 was a compact car that carried forward the legacy of the pre-war Topolino. But it was more than just a successor, it was a new design that redefined the essence of a functional passenger car.

Certainly, there are many differences between the Topolino and the FIAT 500. Although compact, the FIAT 500 offered seating for four adults—an improvement over the two-seat Topolino. Furthermore, unlike the front-engine/rear-drive layout of the Topolino, the FIAT 500 featured a rear-engine/rear-drive configuration within a full monocoque body.

The FIAT 500's engine was a 479cc air-cooled 2-cylinder OHV that produced 15ps, enabling a top speed of <90km/h>. The standard front-half canvas-top was designed primarily for improved ventilation and noise reduction, rather than just open-air driving appeal.

Even though it was compact, it was highly practical. Of note, the affordable FIAT 500, with its immense popularity in Italy, inspired a variety of tuning models over the years. Among them, the model tuned by Carlo Abarth—hailed as the god of engine tuning—was unmatched in the compact class, making the 500 a formidable force in motorsports.

Naturally, the FIAT 500 itself evolved. In 1959, the sport model was introduced, with engine displacement increased to 499cc and power raised to 18ps. This sports engine came as standard fare in the 500D, introduced in 1961. And, for safety reasons, the original front-opening doors were replaced with rear-hinged ones in the 1965 FIAT 500F.

As a pioneer of the "minimum car" concept—some call it the original mini—this iconic vehicle remains beloved to this day.
vehicleCollection.zh:
功能全面，价格合理，还能用于竞速。一款充满乐趣的极简原创车型。

菲亚特500是一款于1957年面世的紧凑型车，继承了战前车款Topolino的理念。但更重要的是，它是一辆全新乘用车，追求最基础的功能性。

诚然，Topolino和菲亚特500之间有许多不同之处。与双座的Topolino相比，菲亚特500虽然紧凑，但可供4个成年人乘坐。此外，Topolino的引擎为前置后驱，菲亚特500则采用全单体车壳和引擎后置前驱式布局。

菲亚特500的引擎为一款479cc的风冷双缸顶置式气门引擎，马力为15ps，最高速度可达到<90km/h>。标配前半开式、帆布车顶。这样的设计主要考虑噪音控制和通风的需求。

虽然属于一款紧凑型车，但菲亚特500非常实用。这款价格亲民的菲亚特500在意大利尤其受到欢迎，多年来也诞生了许多调校版车型。其中由当时的引擎调校之神卡洛·阿巴斯调校的车型在当时紧凑型车款中无可匹敌，在各种赛车比赛中也非常有竞争力。

当然，菲亚特500自身也在发展。1959年，跑车车型首次亮相，引擎排量增加到499cc，最大马力输出也上升到18ps。跑车引擎在1961年发布的500D上成为了标配。之后，前开门设计由于安全原因被替换，在1965年的500F上被改为后开门。

作为“小型车”或“迷你车”的先驱，这款车在今天仍然享有高人气。

dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
I think the little FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse is the perfect
expression of the "Italian spirit."

Particularly the spirit of the 1950 and 1960s, when the zeal
and passion of Italian people were expressed without restraint.

The tuned-up version by Carlo Abarth...

...is known for its lowered stance
and various mechanical changes.+
dialogues.zh:
我认为这辆小巧的FIAT Abarth 595 Esseesse
是对“意大利精神”的完美诠释。

特别是在50至60年代，意大利人民即使能力受到客观限制，
热情和激情仍然无比高昂的那股劲儿。

这是由卡洛·阿巴斯改装的版本……

特点是降低了车身的高度，并在机械结构方面进行了调整。

dialogues.speaker: Fabio Filippini
dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
The same goes for the red stripes, scorpio badges, and the
light wheels, transforming it into a race car.

But above all, some details are striking, such as the
rubber locks for the hoods.

The rear-hood was raised to improve cooling,
and "Record Monza" chromed double exhausts were added.
dialogues.zh:
再加上红色条幅、天蝎徽标和轻量化车轮，
这些改动令其摇身一变，成为了一辆赛车。

那些令人尤为印象深刻的细节也十分吸引眼球，
比如引擎盖上的橡胶锁……

还有为了改善散热而抬高的后引擎盖，以及
“Record Monza”镀铬双排气管。

usedCar.en:
Many consider the early 1960s as Abarth's golden era.

A big part of the reason is because of the 500 Esseesse.

Although it only produces a mere 32ps, which might
lead you to think it's underpowered...

...but in fact, its small, light construction gave it
a surprising amount of pep.

In fact, its performance is nothing short of incredible.

Esseesse, incidentally, is the Italian pronunciation
of SS, which stands for Super Sport.
usedCar.zh:
许多人认为1960年代是Abarth的
黄金年代。

500 Esseesse就是该时期的标志。

只能输出32ps，这可能会让人觉得
马力不足。

然而，这样小型而轻量的构造却会产生
惊人的速度。

实际上，它的性能非常魔幻。

顺便说一句，Esseesse是意大利语
SS的发音，代表超级跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A hardcore sports version of the FIAT 500.

Introduced in 1963, the FIAT Abarth 595 was a high-performance version of the second-generation FIAT 500 tuned by Abarth.

While the base FIAT 500 featured a 496cc air-cooled 2-cylinder engine, the Abarth version received comprehensive upgrades. Displacement was increased to 594cc, complemented by enhanced intake and exhaust flow. These upgrades delivered a significant performance boost, with peak output rising from 18ps to 27ps and top speed increased from <95km/h> to <120km/h>. The transformation made the Abarth variant a favorite among young enthusiasts who craved more power.

Then, in 1964, Abarth introduced an even more finely tuned version of the 595. This car was called the 595 Esseesse.

The 595 Esseesse utilized the same basic engine as its predecessor, but compression ratio was increased and a larger diameter carburetor was installed, resulting in 32ps and a top speed of <130km/h>.

Thanks to the newfound power, the 595 series enjoyed great success in the under-600cc-class of racing all over Europe.
vehicleCollection.zh:
菲亚特500的硬核运动版。

菲亚特阿巴斯595于1963年推出，是第二代菲亚特500的高性能版本，接受过阿巴斯的调校。

作为调校基础的菲亚特500车型拥有一台496cc的风冷双缸引擎。在阿巴斯版本中，这台引擎得到了全面改进，排量增加到了594cc，同时优化了进气和排气量。这让车辆的性能得到了巨大提升，最大输出功率从18ps增加到27ps，极速从<95km/h>增加到<120km/h>，立即受到众多渴望获得动力的年轻车迷的青睐。

在1964年，阿巴斯紧接着就发布了595的进一步调校版本。这便是595 Esseesse。

虽然引擎的排量没有变化，但提高了压缩比，并安装了一个更大直径的化油器，再加上重新设计的歧管，使得最大输出功率达到了32ps，最高速度更是达到了<130km/h>。

595系列旗下的各种车型在欧洲各地的多项600cc级以下房车比赛中取得了辉煌的胜利。

catch.en: A hardcore sports version of the FIAT 500.
catch.zh: 菲亚特500的硬核运动版。

虽然引擎的排量没有变化，但提高了压缩比，并安装了一个更大直径的化油器，再加上重新设计的歧管，使得最大输出功率达到了32ps，最高速度更是达到了<130km/h>。

595系列旗下的各种车型在欧洲各地的多项600cc级以下房车比赛中取得了辉煌的胜利。

dialogues.en:
Since its debut in 1980, this first-gen Fiat Panda went on to
become a best-seller with a 20-year-plus production run.

The basic car par excellence, it remains beloved by drivers
all over the world.

The original Panda is perhaps the car most associated
with the world-class car designer Giorgetto Giugiaro.

Fiat entrusted him with designing the next generation
of the compact car.

The objective was a car combining intuitive handling
with cost-effective production.

Drawing on his deep knowledge of automotive design, Giugiaro
came up with solutions to all sorts of problems...

...such as the economical use of flat glass
for all of the car's window surfaces.

Indeed, this masterpiece is simply brimming with hallmarks
of his inimitable genius!
dialogues.zh:
自1980年问世以来，这款初代菲亚特Panda
以长达二十余年的生产周期成为常青车型。

作为极致简约却性能卓著的经典代表，
至今仍深受全球车迷喜爱。

初代Panda可谓是与世界级设计大师
乔盖托·乔治亚罗最具渊源的车型。

菲亚特将这款紧凑车型的换代设计全权委托于他。

设计计划书要求打造兼具直观操控体验
与亲民制造成本的车型。

凭借深厚的汽车设计造诣，
乔治亚罗采用创新方案解决了诸多难题……

诸如全车玻璃表面均采用成本更有优势的平板玻璃。

毫无疑问，这件杰作处处闪耀着
大师独一无二的设计智慧！

usedCar.en:
Perfect timing! I just received this little Italian gem—
a first-generation 1985 Fiat Panda.

This car made its debut in 1980, during the global oil crisis,
when small, economical cars were in high demand.

Intended as a replacement for the 126, it was penned by
none other than master designer Giorgetto Giugiaro.

To keep costs low, Giugiaro opted for a simple, boxy shape
that still managed to get across a modern sense of luxury.

The Panda came in a choice of 652cc and 903cc engines.
This one is powered by the former, making it light and zippy.

Giugiaro’s self-proclaimed masterpiece, the Panda is one car
you can’t do without!
usedCar.zh:
你来得正好！我刚收到这台意大利宝藏小车——
1985年的第一代FIAT Panda。

这款车于1980年问世，当时正值全球石油危机时期，
小巧省油的车型备受青睐。

作为126的换代车型，它由设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗
亲自操刀设计。

为控制成本，乔治亚罗采用了简洁的方正造型，
却依然营造出精致的现代感。

Panda提供652cc和903cc两种引擎。
这辆搭载的是前者，因此车身轻巧、动力灵敏。

被乔治亚罗自称为得意之作的Panda，
绝对是一款让人爱不释手的经典车型！

vehicleCollection.en:
This jewel of a compact car is the one designer Giugiaro called his greatest work.

In 1980, as demand for smaller cars rose in the wake of the oil shock, Fiat introduced a bold new compact to replace the aging 126. In a stark departure from its predecessor, the Panda was a front-wheel-drive hatchback with a transverse, front-mounted engine.

Although relatively simple, its design was both modern and practical. The packaging of the Panda was entrusted to design maestro Giorgetto Giugiaro. To reduce costs, the body panels were shaped with flat surfaces and straight lines, while the windows were made of flat glass. The seats followed suit, using a basic hammock layout with fabric stretched over a pipe frame. Yet the overall look of the car was fresh, and the interior proved surprisingly spacious.

At its debut, the Panda was powered by either a 652cc 2-cylinder air-cooled engine or a 903cc 4-cylinder water-cooled engine. At the time, Fiat named its engines according to output, with the former designated the 30 and the latter the 45. In 1983, a part-time 4-wheel-drive 4x4 version appeared. It marked a world first for a vehicle with a transverse-engine/front-wheel-drive layout.

The Panda became an immediate success upon release, quickly emerging as one of the driving forces behind Fiat's resurgence. Giugiaro himself declared at the time that this compact masterpiece was the greatest work of his career.
vehicleCollection.zh:
紧凑型车中的瑰宝，被其设计师乔治亚罗视作个人巅峰之作。

1980年，石油危机后市场对小型车的需求不断增长，菲亚特随即推出一款大胆创新的紧凑型车型，以取代跟不上时代的126车型。与126车型截然不同的是，这款“Panda”采用前轮驱动掀背式设计，以及横置前引擎布局。

尽管结构相对简单，其设计却兼具现代感与实用性。Panda的整车布局由设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗亲自操刀设计。为控制成本，车身板件采用平面与直线元素构成，车窗也使用平面玻璃。座椅同样采用简易的吊床式绷布座椅，以织物覆盖钢管框架，但整车外观造型新颖，且内部空间意外宽敞。

Panda车型首发时提供两种引擎选项：652cc双缸风冷引擎或903cc四缸水冷引擎。当时，菲亚特往往根据引擎功率为车型命名，两台Panda分别被称为“30”型和“45”型。1983年，菲亚特推出了首款分时四轮驱动“4x4”车型。开创了基于横置前引擎前轮驱动平台的四驱系统全球先河。

Panda车型一经推出便大获成功，成为推动菲亚特取得市场成功的主要动力之一。这款紧凑型轿车设计中的瑰宝，还曾被乔治亚罗本人称为自己最杰出的作品。(

brandCentral.en:
Emerson Fittipaldi is one of the true legends of motorsports.
His credentials include...

...two-time Formula 1 champion...

...two-time Indy 500 winner...

...and now, car designer. This Vision Gran Turismo model is
his take on the perfect race car.

Its official name is the Fittipaldi EF7 VGT by Pininfarina.

The concept was to create a car that anyone could drive,
but one that could also be a serious racing contender.

And as anyone taking the wheel will see, that concept
has become reality.=

Emerson Fittipaldi是一位赛车运动领域的传奇人物。

拥有两个一级方程式冠军头衔……

两届印地500冠军得主……

而现在，他又成为了一名汽车设计师。这辆Vision Gran Turismo
让他的赛车梦想成为现实。

这辆车的全称是Fittipaldi EF7 VGT，由Pininfarina负责打造。

其设计理念是打造一辆任何人都能驾驶，但同时又具备
强大的赛事竞争力的车。

握住它方向盘的人想来都会认同，这个理念已经实现了。

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The '32 is the quintessential hot rod!

It was nicknamed "Deuce" because of the 2 in "32."

It was visually simple but complex in its execution.

Look closely and
you'll not find a flat line anywhere!

It possesses a powerfully aggressive package,

that's all about proportion,
balance, stance and form.

The shape tapers in every view.

 The stance is set up
 with just the right amount of rake.

The back tires taller than the fronts.

The '32 also signals the beginning of
the iconic Ford V-8!

In a '32 Hot Rod, the motor becomes
an emotional part of the whole.]
dialogues.zh:
这款'32可以被视作是改装车中的标杆！

玩家们还将“32”中的“2”变成了这辆车的昵称：“二点”。

看似平平无奇的外观下，其实内有乾坤。

仔细观察后，你会发现整个车身上找不到一条平直的线条！

它的整体设计充满了力量和冲劲……

这也是车身比例、平衡、姿态和整体轮廓巧妙结合的成果。

让它在各个角度都显得凌厉利落……

前倾角的角度设置得恰到好处，

后轮比前轮高一些，就形成了现在这攻击型的姿态。

此外，这辆'32还标志着福特首次引入其招牌V8引擎！

对于'32 而言，
这台引擎是其浑然天成的整体中的神来之笔。

collection.en:
If you're looking for a car that will really give you a
taste of traditional American hot rod culture...

Then the 1932 Ford Model B, or "Deuce", as it is
affectionately called, is a great place to start.

The name "Deuce" comes from its two-door
configuration.

Popular as a base for customization...

It is a prime example of a custom hot rod.
collection.zh:
如果您正在寻找一辆能够真正体验美国传统改装车文化
的汽车……

那么又被大家昵称为“Deuce”的1932年Ford Model B
或许会是个不错的开始。

“Deuce”这个名称来源于车型的双门配置。

它是广受欢迎的改装车基础车型，

你可以将之当做美国定制改装车的一个典型范例。!

vehicleCollection.en:
This "High Boy"-style hot rod was displayed at the Henry Ford Museum.

When it comes to custom cars, the U.S. ranks number one in terms of quality, volume and genre. And, by far, the oldest genre—one that is now an iconic part of American culture—is the hot rod. This was a movement that originated in the 1930s, where the Ford Model T, and later the Model A and Model B, were heavily modified by their owners. Extensive exterior modifications were performed on these cars, such as removing fenders and engine hoods, and altering the body to make chop-tops. Later, as newer and more powerful engines were developed elsewhere in the world, they then were mounted into these vehicles.

The most well-known platform for this practice was the Ford Model B. Why? Not just because it was the first car of the era to be powered by a V8, it was also quite rare—the Model B was only produced for a single year, in 1932.

The vehicle with number plate "V-3883" displayed in the Henry Ford Museum is one such car based on the Model B, carrying the nickname of "Deuce." It was built by Richard Smith of Phoenix, Arizona, in 1954, with US $2800 (a considerable sum back then) and a massive amount of time and effort. The V-3883 is a classic "highboy" style hot rod, with removed fenders, but the engine has been swapped for a 180ps Chrysler 331 Hemi. The side panels have been cut and modified to accommodate the wide engine, and the engine covers are now part of the exterior accents. This is a car that has been crafted to the very last detail; it is a simple, yet beautiful example of the "good old days."F
vehicleCollection.zh:
在亨利·福特博物馆展出的“高脚橱”风格的改装车。

在定制汽车的世界里，无论是质量、数量还是类型，美国都是毫无疑问的第一名。其中最古老的一类，现在已经成为了美国文化的一个标志性部分，那就是改装车。

这是一场起源于20世纪30年代的运动，福特T型车和后来的A型车和B型车在他们的主人手中接受了大刀阔斧的改装。他们对这些汽车进行了广泛的外部改装，如拆除轮拱罩、引擎盖和切割车身，以将其改造为敞篷车。随着技术不断进步，越来越强劲的引擎被安装到这些车上。

最受欢迎的基础车是福特Model B。这是因为该车是第一辆装备了那个时代最先进的V8引擎的汽车，也因为它的稀有性——只在1932年生产了一年。

亨利福特博物馆展出的车牌号为“V-3883”的汽车就是这样一辆车，以Model B为基础改装，被昵称为“杜斯”。此车是由亚利桑那州凤凰城的理查德·史密斯在1954年耗资2,800美元改造的——这在当时是一笔巨款，而且耗费了大量的时间和精力。

这是一辆经典的“高脚橱”风格的车辆，去掉了轮拱罩，还换上了来自克莱斯勒331 Hemi，能够产生180ps动力的引擎。此车侧板被切割和修改，以适应更宽大的引擎，而引擎盖本身也成为了外观造型的一部分。这是一辆被加工到了最后一个细节的车，简单而优美地见证了那个已逝的美好年代。

catch.en: This "High Boy"-style hot rod was displayed at the Henry Ford Museum.
catch.zh: 在亨利·福特博物馆展出的“高脚橱”风格的改装车。

long.en:
When it comes to custom cars, the U.S. ranks number one in terms of quality, volume and genre. And, by far, the oldest genre—one that is now an iconic part of American culture—is the hot rod. This was a movement that originated in the 1930s, where the Ford Model T, and later the Model A and Model B, were heavily modified by their owners. Extensive exterior modifications were performed on these cars, such as removing fenders and engine hoods, and altering the body to make chop-tops. Later, as newer and more powerful engines were developed elsewhere in the world, they then were mounted into these vehicles.

The most well-known platform for this practice was the Ford Model B. Why? Not just because it was the first car of the era to be powered by a V8, it was also quite rare—the Model B was only produced for a single year, in 1932.

The vehicle with number plate "V-3883" displayed in the Henry Ford Museum is one such car based on the Model B, carrying the nickname of "Deuce." It was built by Richard Smith of Phoenix, Arizona, in 1954, with US $2800 (a considerable sum back then) and a massive amount of time and effort. The V-3883 is a classic "highboy" style hot rod, with removed fenders, but the engine has been swapped for a 180ps Chrysler 331 Hemi. The side panels have been cut and modified to accommodate the wide engine, and the engine covers are now part of the exterior accents. This is a car that has been crafted to the very last detail; it is a simple, yet beautiful example of the "good old days."F

这是一场起源于20世纪30年代的运动，福特T型车和后来的A型车和B型车在他们的主人手中接受了大刀阔斧的改装。他们对这些汽车进行了广泛的外部改装，如拆除轮拱罩、引擎盖和切割车身，以将其改造为敞篷车。随着技术不断进步，越来越强劲的引擎被安装到这些车上。

usedCar.en:
You seem like a rally car enthusiast. If so, then this
is definitely the car for you!

The Ford Escort RS Cosworth was the successor
to the legendary Sierra Cosworth 4x4.

While the Escort had its heyday in the late 1960s and 1970s,
this car adopted the engine and 4WD layout from the Sierra.

The two-tier rear wing made quite the impression!

Needless to say, this car was fast, claiming five of 13 wins
at the 1993 World Rally Championship.

It certainly played a major role in restoring Ford to its
former rally glory.
usedCar.zh:
看来你是位拉力赛车爱好者。那么这款车
一定会让你心动！

Ford Escort RS Cosworth继承了
传奇车型Sierra Cosworth 4x4的衣钵。

Escort在上世纪60年代末和70年代就曾登上巅峰，
而这款车又继承了Sierra的引擎与四驱系统。

其标志性的双层尾翼更是令人印象深刻！

这款性能出众的车型在1993年世界拉力锦标赛上
创下了13战5胜的骄人战绩。

它无疑为Ford重返拉力赛车之巅立下了汗马功劳。

vehicleCollection.en:
A WRC homologation special with a unique double-decker wing design.

Ford began their 1990s World Rally Championship (WRC) campaign fighting in the Sierra RS Cosworth 4x4. Then, in 1992, came the Escort RS Cosworth, a homologation special developed for even higher performance.

The original Escort was a masterpiece in itself, having been widely used in rally races in the late 1960s and early 1970s. Years later, Ford Europe took the compact body of the fifth-generation Escort, installed a highly tuned version of the 4WD powertrain from the Sierra, and added a large dual level rear wing to create a fearsome race machine.

At the heart of the beast was a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.0-liter twin-cam engine built by Cosworth, as per the car's name. The bore-stroke ratio was tweaked, resulting in 1993cc of displacement and an output of 227ps/30.4kgm in stock form. For the 4WD system, the central differential utilized a combination of a viscous coupling and planetary gears for maximum reliability.

The Escort RS Cosworth began production in 1992 and gained homologation status the following year when it began competing in the WRC's Group A category.

The "Cossie," as fans called it, finished 1-2 in Round 3 of the Portugal Rally before going on to achieve two consecutive victories in Rounds 5 (Tour de Corse) and 6 (Acropolis). It won again in Rounds 11 and 12 (San Remo and Spain), solidifying Ford's reputation as a strong contender on the rally circuit.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一款装有独特双层尾翼的世界拉力锦标赛赛事认证车型。"

福特在20世纪90年代初期以Sierra RS Cosworth 4x4参加世界拉力锦标赛（WRC）。随后在1992年推出了福睿斯RS Cosworth，这是一款为提升竞技性能而开发的特殊赛事认证车型。

其原型福睿斯是20世纪60年代末和70年代拉力赛场上的王者之作。针对福睿斯RS，福特欧洲选用第五代福睿斯的紧凑车身，搭载了经过高度调校的Sierra四轮驱动系统，并加装了大型双层尾翼，实现全面的性能升级。

这头猛兽的核心动力系统是一台由Cosworth打造的纵置2升涡轮增压双顶置凸轮轴引擎，这也是其命名的由来。通过优化缸径行程比，使引擎排量达到1993cc，在原厂调校状态下即可输出227ps/30.4kgm的动力。四轮驱动系统采用粘性耦合器与行星齿轮组合的中央差速器设计，以确保最佳的可靠性。

福睿斯RS Cosworth于1992年投产，并在次年通过认证后开始参加世界拉力锦标赛的A组赛事。

这款被车迷亲切称为“Cossie”的赛车在第3轮葡萄牙拉力赛中取得了一二名的成绩，并在第5轮（科西嘉岛拉力赛）和第6轮（雅典卫城拉力赛）中连续获胜，更是在第11轮和第12轮（圣雷莫拉力赛和西班牙拉力赛）中再度上演这一连冠壮举，重振了福特作为拉力赛强者的声誉。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Ford's F-Series is the most popular line of pickup trucks
in North America.

And the Raptor is by far the highest performance model
of the bunch.

One design objective was to optimize it for off-road racing,
therefore, the truck possesses sports-car-like handling.

The Raptor boasts a wide body, reinforced suspension and a
6.2-liter V-8 capable of producing more than 400ps.

Put this beast in its element, and it'll shatter your notion
of how fast a truck can go.
dialogues.zh:
Ford的“F系列”车型是北美最流行的皮卡。

Raptor是该系列中迄今性能最强大的一款车型。

它的设计理念之一便是强化在越野赛中的性能表现，
这使得它与其他贴地的跑车截然不同。

Raptor不仅有宽车体、强化的悬挂系统，
还有一台能输出400ps以上的6.2升V8引擎。

只要将这头野兽的本领发挥出来，
您对于卡车能跑多快的认识一定会被击碎。

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The Raptor is an aggressive and capable beast.
I love this truck!

It has a solid overall design and possesses plenty of Ford’s
unique DNA.

The wide stance and large tires result in great
handling character and tremendous height.

Its capable 4WD system allows it to excel
on rough off-road terrain.

This first-generation Raptor had a V-8 that matched
its aggressive character.=
dialogues.zh:
Raptor的外形充盈着侵略性和力量感！
这就是我爱这辆卡车的原因！

它不仅拥有Ford血统的优点，还有许多独到之处！
形成了一套性能全面的设计方案。

它拥有宽大的车架和大外径尺寸的轮胎，
因此获得了出色的操控性和充分的离地间隙。

极大的上坡角增大了车架前后部分与地面的空间，
使其能够轻松搞定起伏坎坷的地形。

另外，这辆初代Raptor搭载的可是一台V8引擎，
无论是个性还是侵略性，都更上一层楼！

brandCentral.en:
The Ford F-Series has consistently been one of the most
popular vehicles in the U.S.

This model, the SVT Raptor, was added to the lineup
in 2010.

It was developed for off-road use, with specially designed
dampers and an engine that produced more than 400ps.

Its interior looked like it came from a sports car.

Oh, and the "SVT" in its name stands for
"Special Vehicle Team,"....

…which is the division within Ford that's responsible for
developing the company's high-performance vehicles.
brandCentral.zh:
Ford的F系列是美国车品牌中最畅销的产品之一。

这款SVT Raptor是在2010年加入F系列产品线阵容的。

这是一台专为越野而生的卡车，拥有专门设计的避震器
和超过400ps动力的引擎。

其豪华的内饰也足可以与典型的跑车相媲美。

顺便解释一下，其名称中的“SVT”代表了“特殊车辆团
队”（Special Vehicle Team）。

这是一个负责为Ford开发最高性能车辆的团队！

vehicleCollection.en:
With 417ps on tap, this was one of the most potent pickup trucks ever created, thanks to Ford's Special Vehicle Team.

The F series is a line of full size pickup trucks sold by Ford since 1948. This is a model that has stayed on top of the pickup truck segment for over 40 years, and has also been the best selling car across all car categories for over 30 years in the United States.

The F-150 has always been the core of the series since being introduced in 1975. It is a model that has been the backbone of Ford throughout the years.

The F-150 Raptor is a special off-road model based on the 12th generation F-150, which started sales in the fall of 2008. It was developed by Ford's special vehicle development team "SVT" to be fit for racing in the desert and was added to the lineup in 2010.

The body is 18cm wider with its enlarged fenders that house considerably thicker aluminum suspension arms supported by Fox Racing dampers, which are known to be the first off-road competition dampers to come equipped on a production car. The suspension travel in the front has been extended to 284.5mm and 307.3mm in the rear. The clearance under the car is also large, with an approach angle of 30 degrees and a departure angle of 22.7 degrees.

The engine is a 6.2 litre supercharged V8 producing 417ps and 60.9kgm of torque, and is combined with a 6 speed automatic transmission.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款出自福特的特种车辆团队之手的高性能皮卡有着417ps的超强马力。

F系列是福特自1948年起销售至今的全尺寸皮卡系列车型。该车款已经雄踞皮卡类别销量榜达40余年，同时也是30年来美国所有汽车类别中最畅销的车款。

自1975年推出以来，F-150一直是该系列的核心，这个车款一直是福特的主力车款。

福特F-150猛禽是在第十二代F-150基础上开发的越野特别版车款，于2008年秋季开始销售。这款车是由福特的专用车辆开发团队“SVT”开发，作为一款适应沙漠地形的赛车上市，并加入了2010年的车款阵容中。

车身采用更大的挡泥板并加宽18cm，能够容纳更厚的铝制悬挂臂，悬挂臂由狐狸赛车避震支撑，这是量产车上首次装备越野赛车避震。车辆前悬挂的行程增大到了284.5mm，后悬挂则增大到了307.3mm。车辆离地高度也较高，接近角可达30度，离去角则为22.7度。

引擎采用了6.2升机械增压V8引擎，能够产生417ps的动力和60.9kgm的扭矩，并配备了6速自动变速箱。

catch.en: With 417ps on tap, this was one of the most potent pickup trucks ever created, thanks to Ford's Special Vehicle Team.
catch.zh: 这款出自福特的特种车辆团队之手的高性能皮卡有着417ps的超强马力。

long.en:
The F series is a line of full size pickup trucks sold by Ford since 1948. This is a model that has stayed on top of the pickup truck segment for over 40 years, and has also been the best selling car across all car categories for over 30 years in the United States.

The F-150 has always been the core of the series since being introduced in 1975. It is a model that has been the backbone of Ford throughout the years.

The F-150 Raptor is a special off-road model based on the 12th generation F-150, which started sales in the fall of 2008. It was developed by Ford's special vehicle development team "SVT" to be fit for racing in the desert and was added to the lineup in 2010.

The body is 18cm wider with its enlarged fenders that house considerably thicker aluminum suspension arms supported by Fox Racing dampers, which are known to be the first off-road competition dampers to come equipped on a production car. The suspension travel in the front has been extended to 284.5mm and 307.3mm in the rear. The clearance under the car is also large, with an approach angle of 30 degrees and a departure angle of 22.7 degrees.

The engine is a 6.2 litre supercharged V8 producing 417ps and 60.9kgm of torque, and is combined with a 6 speed automatic transmission.
long.zh:
F系列是福特自1948年起销售至今的全尺寸皮卡系列车型。该车款已经雄踞皮卡类别销量榜达40余年，同时也是30年来美国所有汽车类别中最畅销的车款。

自1975年推出以来，F-150一直是该系列的核心，这个车款一直是福特的主力车款。

福特F-150猛禽是在第十二代F-150基础上开发的越野特别版车款，于2008年秋季开始销售。这款车是由福特的专用车辆开发团队“SVT”开发，作为一款适应沙漠地形的赛车上市，并加入了2010年的车款阵容中。

车身采用更大的挡泥板并加宽18cm，能够容纳更厚的铝制悬挂臂，悬挂臂由狐狸赛车避震支撑，这是量产车上首次装备越野赛车避震。车辆前悬挂的行程增大到了284.5mm，后悬挂则增大到了307.3mm。车辆离地高度也较高，接近角可达30度，离去角则为22.7度。

引擎采用了6.2升机械增压V8引擎，能够产生417ps的动力和60.9kgm的扭矩，并配备了6速自动变速箱。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on the
Ford Focus ST.

The drivetrain has been converted from powering only the
front wheels to 4WD.

Various changes have also been made to alter the weight
distribution, such as moving the radiator to the rear.

The handling is considerably sharper as a result.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于Ford Focus ST开发。

其传动系统从标准的前置前驱改为了四轮驱动。

为了调整配重比，这台车经历了翻天覆地的改装，例如
将散热器挪到了车身后部。

这辆车的操控性也因此得到了大幅强化，容错率更高。

vehicleCollection.en:
The chassis performance of the late third-generation model shines in this rally special.

Ford saw performance potential in its affordable sedan, the Focus, so it created the Focus ST, a souped-up version that made its debut in 1998. The third-generation Focus ST (the ST stands for Sports Technology) debuted at the 2010 Paris Motor Show equipped with a brand new engine.

The previous Focus ST came powered by a Volvo-based turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-5, but the new car featured an “EcoBoost” turbocharged direct-injection 2.0-liter inline-4 that boasted better fuel economy and reduced emissions. Despite being smaller by 500cc, the new engine delivered 25ps more power, up to 250ps. While many models had moved on to 2 pedal transmissions, this stoic model only came with a 6-speed manual.

The car thrilled enthusiasts for years, and in 2014, in addition to a mild facelift, Ford engineers made some drastic changes under the sheet metal. They completely revamped the suspension system, changed the variable ratio of the power steering, updated the stability program, and installed a torque vectoring system. As a result, the new Focus ST’s boasted class-leading handling, impressing even hardened race car drivers with its quick reactions and road-holding ability. And with a price that undercut its rivals in the competitive C segment, the Ford ST is still the talk of performance-car aficionados, even at the tail-end of its model run.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.B regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款最新的第3代拉力特别款车型将底盘性能发挥得淋漓尽致。

FoxST是Fox系列中备受推崇的运动车型，从1998年Fox面世的时候开始它就出现在该系的阵营中。ST是“运动科技”的英文缩写。

第三代FoxST在2010年巴黎车展中首次被宣布推出。该款车型设计的最大改变当属它的引擎从沿袭自沃尔沃的2.5升涡轮增压直列式5缸引擎降格至带有“节动”的2.0升涡轮增压直喷4缸引擎。这个改动当然是为了减少二氧化碳排放并提高燃油效率，但是在减少了500cc排量之后，它的动力却获得了25ps的提升，达到了250ps。尽管很多新款车型已经开始采用双离合变速箱，这款经典车型却依然只提供6档手动变速箱。

该车在2014年进行了一次车型翻新，成为了最新的款式。与此同时，悬挂设置也被完全改造，动力转向的可变比率经过调整，稳定系统被更新，同时还加入了扭矩控制系统。尽管从一开始就获得了不俗的评价，福特还是花时间对底盘进行了整体更新。

正因如此，它的操控性在车手中评价很高，同时还由于其低于竞争对手的亲民价格，使其在C级小型跑车中名列前茅。尽管该车型临近停产，但是依然最后一次吸引了许多欧洲车迷的关注。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别B规则进行过特殊调校。

catch.zh: 这款最新的第3代拉力特别款车型将底盘性能发挥得淋漓尽致。

brandCentral.en:
The RS sits at the top of the Focus line, and is
particularly popular with rally fans.

Previous RS models had been designed with an FF layout...

But this fourth iteration, which debuted in 2018, employed
a 4WD setup for the first time.

The torque distribution can be adjusted for anything between
100% forward and 100% rear.

This makes it perfect for any purpose—even drifting.
brandCentral.zh:
这款RS傲立于整个Focus产品线的巅峰，在拉力赛爱好者中
尤其受欢迎。

之前的RS型号都是前置前驱布局设计……

而这款于2018年亮相的第四代型号却破天荒的采用了四轮
驱动配置，

其扭矩分配可以进行从100%前轮到100%后轮的全面调整。

这项功能使其可以满足任何条件下的驾驶，甚至连漂移
也不例外。

vehicleCollection.en:
The RS model of the third-generation Ford Focus was the first to get 4-wheel drive.

While the Focus is mostly known as a friendly everyday commuter, Ford has traditionally mixed in a high-performance version called the RS that catered directly to enthusiasts.

The fourth-generation model, which made its debut in 2018, was no different, but this time, the Focus RS was offered with AWD. With the new RS, drivers could adjust the torque distribution between the front and rear wheels, from 0:100 to 100:0, meaning it could be driven in pure front-drive or rear-drive form. Thanks to the rear axle's twin-clutch system that functions as an LSD, the driver could choose from several driving modes, including "Track" and "Drift."

Under the hood was the company's EcoBoost 2.3-liter inline-4 tuned to produce an impressive 350ps and 44.8kgm, thanks to new turbocharger and larger intercooler. This allowed the car to run to <100km/h> in 4.7s and reach a top speed of <266km/h>, making this Ford one of the hottest American hatches of all time.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款第三代福克斯的RS车型是首款使用四轮驱动的车型，已获得更高的比赛性能。

福特福克斯的型号种类繁多，但每次都会推出一款运动版本。第四代福克斯也延续了这一传统，在2018年推出了高性能的RS车型。

在此前几代中，RS代表运动型的前轮驱动款式，而2015款的RS则变更为四轮驱动。扭矩分配可在前轮100%和后轮100%之间进行调节，后轴为双离合设计，同时也起到限滑差速器的作用。除了赛道模式之外，福特还在驾驶模式中增加了漂移模式。悬挂系统也得到了重点关照，配备了双模式避震器。

动力单元采用Mustang同款的2.3升直列4缸智能动力引擎，通过引入全新的涡轮增压器和大号中冷器，调校为可输出350ps和44.8kgm。0-<100km/h>加速仅需4.7秒，极速为<266km/h>的福克斯RS可不只是一台“小钢炮”而已。

brandCentral.en:
The third generation Focus ST's engine can push 25ps
more than its predecessor, reaching up to 250ps.

This is a later model, produced after the line underwent
some modifications in 2015.

The suspension setting has been revised, and handling has
been improved to allow for sharper turning.

The design has also received a facelift, giving the Focus
a thinner, more sporty feel.
brandCentral.zh:
相比上一代，第三代Focus ST的引擎将动力又推高了25ps，达
到了250ps。

这台车是2015年改款后的后期车型，

重新调校了悬挂的设置，操控性得到了改善，能够进行
更激烈的转向。

外观设计方面也得到了提升，使这台Focus更轻薄，更具有
运动感。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Now, this is a true icon! A modern take
on the Ford GT40 of Le Mans fame.

It was built to commemorate Ford's 100th anniversary.

In terms of design, it conjured up memories of the beautiful
race cars that played a big role at Le Mans in the 1960s.

Under the sheet metal, however, it was completely revamped,
with an innovative aluminum space frame.

Also, in a brilliant move, it combined a supercharged
mid-mounted V8 engine...

...with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

Honestly, I can't imagine the value of this beauty
ever going down.
dialogues.zh:
现在这款车可以说是真的经典！
因勒芒耐力赛而闻名的现代版Ford GT40……

为庆祝Ford成立100周年而制造。

从设计上来看，令人回忆起那些在20世纪60年代
大放异彩的赛车。

至于内装，则完全改头换面，
采用全新研发的铝制空间车架。

这款车另一项高明的设计是搭载
中置V8机械增压引擎……

并配备六速手动变速箱。

坦白说，我觉得这款尤物的价值
不可能下降。

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
It is really a clever design in that it is larger
than the original but scaled up perfectly!

 If you put an original next to it, you won't
believe the difference in size.

The original car was really quite small.

The shut-lines play a key part and play an important role
in modernizing the GT40.

The larger size allows larger and taller people to fit
comfortably and allows them get in and out easily.

This is truly an iconic "daily driver" super car
with Ford reliability and parts access.

The styling inside and out has proven to be timeless.
A true collector's car for the serious enthusiast.
dialogues.zh:
他们采取了非常巧妙的设计手法：
扩大车身尺寸，然后完美复刻原车比例！

将两辆车停在一起时，你甚至很难发现它们的差别。

而实际上，GT40要小上一号。

在打造现代版GT40时，
精准化镶板的工艺发挥了重要的作用。

“大号”的新Ford GT为身材更高大的驾驶者带来了便利。

这是一款真正能满足日常驾驶的经典超级跑车，
并拥有Ford的可靠品质和零部件供应支持。

vehicleCollection.en:
The final-year model of this potent supercar came right after the company's 100th anniversary.

The Ford GT40 became an instant icon in the GT racing world by dominating the famous 24 Hours of Le Mans endurance race, taking the top three spots on the podium in 1966 and winning the next four in a row. In celebration of Ford's 100th anniversary in 2002, the company elected to recreate the legend by producing the spiritual successor to the classic race car of the sixties, the Ford GT.

The concept model was presented at the 2002 North American International Auto Show, followed by the unveiling of the production car at the same show in 2004. Its beautiful styling closely resembled that of the original GT40, but the new machine came armed with the latest technological features. The car measured 457mm longer and 102mm taller than the original, but its larger size was effectively veiled by the stunning exterior styling.

Placed amidships, immediately behind the cabin, was a longitudinally-mounted supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 that pumped out 558ps/6500rpm with 69.13kgm of torque at 3750rpm. It came with a 6-speed gearbox. The new GT boasted remarkable performance, running from 0 to 60 mph (about 100km/h) in 3.3 seconds, while reaching a top speed of <330km/h>.

A total of 4038 Ford GTs were unleashed onto the streets during its three-year production run, and, by all accounts, this revived version of the GT40 will be just as collectable as the original.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款接受了精心调校的百年纪念版车型于该年度停产。

福特GT40是一款传奇跑车，在1966年勒芒24小时耐力赛上包揽了前三名，并在此后直至1969年的连续四年间蝉联冠军。为庆祝公司成立一百周年，福特开发了新款福特GT，试图重现当年的传奇形象与精神。其概念赛车型公布于2002年北美国际车展，正式发布则是在2004年的同一车展上。

此车优美的造型与六十年代的GT40十分相似，但包裹铝制空间框架的车身完全按照现代标准和规范重新设计。车身长457mm，高102mm，所有部件都运用了表面冲洗技术以提高制造质量。富有艺术气息的内饰兼顾了旧日形象与现代风格，使得两名乘客能够以放松的心情来乘坐。

纵向放置的中置引擎为一款5.4升双顶置式凸轮轴V8机械增压引擎，最大马力为558ps /，最大扭矩为69.13kgm / 3750rpm。变速箱没有采用当时逐渐成为流行的双踏板半自动变速箱，而是采用了传统的三踏板6速手动变速。0-60英里/小时的加速只需3.3秒，最高速度为<330km/h>。

从这些规格参数中可以看出，福特不仅关注造型，同时也努力重现与GT40相当的性能，并使其能够合法上路行驶。

福特GT一直服役到2006年，三年间一共生产了4,038辆。其中大多数有两条从车身前部一直延伸至后部的赛车条纹，但也有少量车辆上没有。

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
The Mini, Beetle and Cinquecento of today...

Are more than just products of their manufacturers.
They have become unique brands unto themselves.

Well, the Ford GT that appeared in 2005 is
a sports car example of this phenomenon.

Nine years later, a slew of hypercars
would appear, stirring fierce rivalry.

This 2017 Ford GT returned to its origins while,
at the same time, adopting innovation.

Viewed from a low angle, it bears traces of
the 1960s car that raced at Le Mans.

And from a higher angle, one can clearly make out
its innovative three-dimensional design.
dialogues.zh:
极具标志性特色的Mini、Beetle和Cinquecento……

……不仅只是一款产品……

……更成为了各自品牌独一无二的名片。

这款2005年亮相的Ford GT
则是Ford的超跑“门面”。

但在那之后的九年间，随着大量超级跑车相继问世，
市场竞争日趋激烈。

这款2017 Ford GT采用了传承经典的设计理念，
同时引入了多项革新。

俯下身来观察，你会发现它甚至保留了
1960年代勒芒赛车时的部分特征。

而通过俯瞰视角，则可以清晰地见证革新性的3D建模设计车壳。<

vehicleCollection.en:
The second-generation Ford GT came complete with reengineered aerodynamics."

The original Ford GT, which was produced from 2005 to 2006, brought back the glory of the renowned GT40, whose exploits in the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the 1960s are now legendary. At the 2015 North American International Auto Show, Ford introduced the second-generation GT that boasted even more performance and technical savagery than its predecessor.

While the first Ford GT's styling strongly resembled that of the GT40, the new 2016 car featured a number of aerodynamic improvements that included an active rear spoiler and a large underbody tunnel that directed air from the side through to the rear. Underneath the sheet metal, there were aluminum front and rear subframes that provided a remarkably rigid body structure, while the body panels themselves were composed of lightweight carbon fiber.

Mounted aft of the cockpit was not the V8 of yore, but a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V6 that produced a whopping 656ps and 76kgm. It came with a 7-speed DCT transmission that sent the power to the rear wheels. This combination enabled the new Ford GT to run from 0 to 60 mph in a scant 3.2 seconds, while reaching a top speed of <348km/h>.
vehicleCollection.zh:
福特GT的回归，空气动力学性能经过了大幅改善。

在2005至2006年间，福特以在1960年代在勒芒24小时耐力赛中大放异彩的车型GT 40为基础，重新打造了一台福特GT。到了2015年的底特律车展上，福特宣布推出经过大幅改进的第二代车型。

在造型方面，第一代福特GT几乎与原版GT 40别无二致，而9年之后的第二代虽然依旧继承了GT 40的风貌，但大量空气动力学方面的提升使得车身设计概念已大相径庭。新车款包括了主动式的后扰流板，从车顶下延到后轮拱的隐藏挡板形成巨大的进气风道，从侧面一直深入到车尾。

车身的主要结构由铝合金材质的前车架和后副车架组合而成，车身板件则考虑到减重因素，使用碳纤维板制成。

动力单元不再是传统的V8引擎，而是换上了一台3.5升双涡轮增压V6引擎，可以输出656ps和76kgm的扭矩，再搭配上7速双离合变速箱，最高时速可达<348km/h>。

catch.en: The second-generation Ford GT came complete with reengineered aerodynamics."
catch.zh: 福特GT的回归，空气动力学性能经过了大幅改善。

long.en:
The original Ford GT, which was produced from 2005 to 2006, brought back the glory of the renowned GT40, whose exploits in the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the 1960s are now legendary. At the 2015 North American International Auto Show, Ford introduced the second-generation GT that boasted even more performance and technical savagery than its predecessor.

While the first Ford GT's styling strongly resembled that of the GT40, the new 2016 car featured a number of aerodynamic improvements that included an active rear spoiler and a large underbody tunnel that directed air from the side through to the rear. Underneath the sheet metal, there were aluminum front and rear subframes that provided a remarkably rigid body structure, while the body panels themselves were composed of lightweight carbon fiber.

Mounted aft of the cockpit was not the V8 of yore, but a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V6 that produced a whopping 656ps and 76kgm. It came with a 7-speed DCT transmission that sent the power to the rear wheels. This combination enabled the new Ford GT to run from 0 to 60 mph in a scant 3.2 seconds, while reaching a top speed of <348km/h>.
long.zh:
在2005至2006年间，福特以在1960年代在勒芒24小时耐力赛中大放异彩的车型GT 40为基础，重新打造了一台福特GT。到了2015年的底特律车展上，福特宣布推出经过大幅改进的第二代车型。

在造型方面，第一代福特GT几乎与原版GT 40别无二致，而9年之后的第二代虽然依旧继承了GT 40的风貌，但大量空气动力学方面的提升使得车身设计概念已大相径庭。新车款包括了主动式的后扰流板，从车顶下延到后轮拱的隐藏挡板形成巨大的进气风道，从侧面一直深入到车尾。

车身的主要结构由铝合金材质的前车架和后副车架组合而成，车身板件则考虑到减重因素，使用碳纤维板制成。

动力单元不再是传统的V8引擎，而是换上了一台3.5升双涡轮增压V6引擎，可以输出656ps和76kgm的扭矩，再搭配上7速双离合变速箱，最高时速可达<348km/h>。

cars.nameZh: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II8

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Beginning in 1966, the first-generation Ford GT
claimed four consecutive wins at Le Mans.

Thirty-six years later, in 2005, a reproduction model
was released to celebrate Ford’s centennial.

About 1,500 units of this reproduction model
were sold as road cars.

But what if this car were to race at Le Mans today?

Developed for Gran Turismo, this Ford GT LM Race Car
Spec II tries to answer that question.

Just wait until you see its speed on the straights!
?
dialogues.zh:
从1966年开始，第一代Ford GT在勒芒连续拿下了四冠。

在36年后的2005年，为了纪念公司的一百周年，
Ford又推出了一款复刻车。

这台复刻车款是一台公路车，总共生产了约1500辆。

如果让这款车去参加当今的勒芒比赛，会有什么样的亮
眼表现呢？

为了回答这个问题，专为跑车浪漫旅开发的
Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II应运而生。

你就等着见识一下它在直道上的速度吧！

brandCentral.sourceName: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
brandCentral.en:
Ford's achievements at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the 1960s
are some of the most impressive in the company's history.

Their newly developed GT40 allowed them to beat the Ferrari
team, and become champions for the first time.

This Gran Turismo original Gr.3 race car is a modern version
of that classic motor.

It is based on the Ford GT that was released in 2004.

Its supercharged midship V8 engine is capable of a
massive 600ps.

What's more, both the suspension and transmission have been
designed specially with racing in mind.
brandCentral.zh:
Ford在1960年代的勒芒24小时耐力赛中取得的辉煌战绩是这
家公司历史上最激动人心的成就之一。

由他们自行研发的新车GT40击败了Ferrari车队，第一次拿下勒
芒赛事的冠军。

这辆跑车浪漫旅原创的Gr.3级别赛车就是那辆经典赛
车的现代版本。

它基于2004年推出的Ford GT开发。

车上搭载的中置机械增压V8引擎可以输出惊人的600ps马力，

包括悬挂系统和变速箱都针对比赛而进行了重新设计。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
vehicleCollection.en:
Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.

As a stunning new take on a legendary racing car, the new Ford GT supercar was launched in the summer of 2004 to commemorate the company's 100th anniversary. As a reinterpretation of the classic 1960s GT40 that won four straight 24 Hours of Le Mans races, this new version featured the latest and greatest automotive technology. With that in mind, Grand Turismo decided to make a good thing even better by creating its own Ford GT to contemporary Le Mans specs, we call it the Ford GT LM Race Car.

The powertrain remains the same as that found in the production Ford GT, a supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 mounted amidships behind the seats. But the 558ps output from the stock version has been boosted to a whopping 600ps in this race car model. A 6-speed manual race-spec gearbox has also been added.

The LM Race Car has the identical proportions as that of the stock Ford GT, measuring 4.61m from bumper to bumper and 1.95m wide. The chassis is an aluminum space frame design incorporating all of the latest automotive technologies, and the body is composed entirely of carbon-fiber. A large rear wing for increased downforce has also been added. The suspension system consists of a double-wishbone configuration fore and aft. Total curb weight: just 1150kg.'
vehicleCollection.zh:
跑车浪漫旅打造的梦幻车型，代表着勒芒传奇的回归！

2004年夏发布的福特GT是为了纪念福特一百周年而打造的超级跑车。此车被认为是采用最新的汽车技术重新诠释了福特六十年代的经典车型GT40。因此我们抱着将福特GT调试到勒芒比赛规格的想法，创造了这款LM赛车，看看会有怎样的成果。

原版GT40是为夺取勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军而开发的，这也是福特长久以来的梦想。在60年代，勒芒耐力赛的鼎盛时期，当法拉利和保时捷这样的顶级欧洲车厂针锋相对，争夺冠军的时候，这款奇迹般的赛车横空出世，自1966起连续四年蝉联冠军，展现了福特的实力。所以，我们认为福特GT作为“重生版”的GT40，自然要在勒芒赛场上一显身手。考虑到这一点，此车是按照现已停止使用的勒芒GTS级别规则设计的，这个级别曾是科尔维特C5-R和Viper GTS-R等车型的舞台。

引擎仍然是福特标志性的5.4升双顶置式凸轮轴机械增压V8引擎，采用中置式安装在座位后方，和普通的福特GT一样只使用后轮驱动，但赛车款将公路车型的558ps提高到了惊人的600ps。前后均采用双叉臂式悬挂，变速箱为赛车规格的6档变速。

At the 1966 Le Mans, the first-generation Ford GT
beat its archnemesis, Ferrari.

This victory made the Ford GT the first American car to win
the 24-hour race.

Fast-forward 50 years to 2016.

The Ford GT returned to beat Ferrari
once again at Le Mans.

It was an amazing feat 50 years in the making.
It’s what makes racing so much fun!

Indeed, the long history of motorsports is filled
with such iconic battles.

我们将时针快拨50年，来到2016年……

Ford GT又回到了勒芒的赛场上，再次将Ferrari斩落马下！

这是一场跨越半个世纪的伟大胜利！也再次展现了赛车
运动的精彩与乐趣！

在赛车运动漫长的历史中，永远不缺乏这样的经典之战。

vehicleCollection.en:
This race car claimed numerous World Endurance Championship titles.

The second-generation Ford GT, introduced in 2015, came equipped with compact twin-turbo V-6 that allowed the car to spring to 60 mph in about 3.0 seconds and reach a top speed of <348km/h>, making it a legitimate super car and a worthy successor to the classic GT40 of yesteryear.

Like the GT40, the GT shined on the race track. Under the Chip Ganassi Racing and Ford factory team banner, it scored several victories in the World Endurance Championship (WEC) that included the 2016 24 Hours of Le Mans, as well as winning in IMSA, taking three race wins in 2016, two in 2017, five in 2018 and three in 2019. In 2018, after winning the 24 Hours of Daytona, the GT's strong performance that season handed Ford the manufacturers title in the GT-LM class.
vehicleCollection.zh:
赢得世界耐力锦标赛的福特车厂车队专属赛车。

新生的福特GT第二代于2015年推出，比前代车型更加强调速度。

新的车身设计在空气动力学效能上有了更长足的进步，并配备了一款紧凑型的V6双涡轮增压引擎，使这一切成为可能。0-60英里/小时的加速时间为3.0秒，最高速度为<348km/h>，性能远胜过欧洲同类车型。

毫无意外，福特也将它投入到了赛车界的拼杀中。著名的美国赛车队纳斯卡甘纳西车队从2016年起作为福特车厂车队参加了多项系列赛事，包括国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛和美国的国际汽车运动协会赛事。

虽然从勒芒24小时耐力赛开始，该车队在世界耐力锦标赛赛事中的胜场寥寥，但在国际汽车运动协会中却奉上了绝佳的表现。2016年赢得了3场比赛，2017年2场，2018年5场，2019年3场。2019年也是车厂赞助车队的最后一年。

此外，在2018年赛季的戴通纳24小时耐力赛中，以赛季首胜作为开端，福特GT又在赛季中多次登上领奖台，最终帮助福特获得了GT-LM级别的车厂冠军。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
This is the road version of the Mark I that raced at Le Mans
in 1966.

The Ford GT40 Mk I was introduced in 1964.

It was developed specifically to beat Ferrari at Le Mans,
where the Italian company had dominated.

Three Mk Is participated in the 1964 Le Mans race, but they all
retired without making it to the finish line.

In 1965, Ford put Carroll Shelby in charge of everything
from development to strategy, with the same result...

Then, Shelby completely overhauled the chassis and engine,
creating the Mk II in 1966.

Eight Mk IIs and five Mk Is waged war at Le Mans
that year.

It was an overwhelming show of strength in numbers!

This determination brought home the Le Mans title for Ford,
finally putting an end to Ferrari's run.
dialogues.zh:
这辆车是参加了1966年勒芒耐力赛的Mark 1的公路版。

福特GT40 Mark 1公布于1964年。

这辆车是专门为了超越当时称霸勒芒的法拉利而开发的。

1964年，有三辆Mark 1参加了勒芒耐力赛，但全部中途退赛了。

1965年，福特任命卡罗尔·谢尔比负责从开发到战略的一切工作，
但比赛结果还是一样……

1966年，对底盘和发动机进行了完全改造的Mark II开发完成。

一共八辆Mark II和五辆Mark I参加了当年的勒芒耐力赛。

那可是压倒性的数量优势！

因此，福特也毫无意外地在那年首次夺得了勒芒耐力赛冠军宝座！

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
I love this car, and it's easily one of my top three all time.

Based on sketches by Ford designers...

...you get the feeling that its appearance was brought together
by British designers...

...who knew how racecars should look and perform.

When compared to the Ferrari 330P4 of the same year...

...the overall shape of the GT40 is emotionally modest,
while characterized by a more modern silhouette.

They're both nice, but I think I prefer the GT40.

The face created by the square headlamps and air intakes,
which are rare in racecars...

...is aggressive and stylish.

But there's a rather elegant, feminine quality within the car's
overall muscular nature...

...expressed by the line that runs from the cabin to
the rear end.

Although it hasn't been mentioned much before, but there's
a quality not unlike that of the Lamborghini Miura her.

The Mark II added air intakes, which gave the car
even more racecar intensity.

It's this part of the car that I find very alluring.
dialogues.zh:
我喜欢这辆车。
如果要排名的话，它能轻松跻身我个人喜好排行榜的前三。

此车是由一支来自英国的团队

基于福特设计师的草图打造的……

看得出来，他们对赛车的外观和性能胸有成竹。

与同年的法拉利330 P4相比……

GT40可能欠缺一些激情，但有着更具现代感的轮廓。

当然了，这两部车都很棒，只是我个人更偏爱GT40。

请注意方形大灯和进气口所构成的前脸，
这在赛车上是很少见的。

我会觉得它既有侵略性，又有时尚感。

尽管总体上“孔武有力”，但还是可以让人感受到
一丝优雅气质，

主要体现在从车厢延伸到尾部的线条中。

虽然之前很少被提及，但其实
兰博基尼Miura与此车师出同门。

在Mark II版'中增加的多个进气口使它看起来更有张力。

事实上，我觉得最有魅力的就是这部分。

collection.en:
When most people think of the Ford GT40, they think of
Carroll Shelby, and they wouldn't be wrong.

But it's worth mentioning that Shelby wasn't actually
involved with the first GT40 Mark I, debuted in 1964.

The Mark I was a car with a fantastic concept.

I think the way it retains the look of a classic GT car
makes it especially beautiful.

The only thing the Mark I was missing was the reliability
required for endurance racing.

That's why Ford decided to hand a large part of its
racing programme over to Carroll Shelby.

The rest of GT40's glorious story is, of course, history.

But the GT40 Mark I is where it all began, and obviously
it's considered a prized collector's item.
collection.zh:
大多数人听到Ford GT40时，都会想到卡罗尔·谢尔比，
他们这样想没有错。

但值得一提的是，谢尔比本人其实与1964年登场的首款GT40 Mark I
并无关系。

GT40 Mark I是一款有着杰出概念设计的跑车。

因为它保留了传统GT赛车的外形，我认为这一点令其
尤为惊艳。

Mark I唯一缺少的是耐力赛所需的可靠性。

所以Ford才将他们的赛车项目中相当大的一部分事务交给
了卡罗尔·谢尔比掌管。

此后GT40的光辉事迹，史册上早有公论。

但GT40 Mark I才是传奇的开端，而其作为稀有的汽车收藏品，
自然也是实至名归。

vehicleCollection.en:
This historic machine achieved a much-desired Le Mans victory with an incredible 1-2-3 finish.

In 1963, Ford attempted to buy Ferrari in order to improve its brand image through racing. The talks did not go well, to say the least. The deal didn't happen, and Henry Ford II went on a mission to beat Ferrari at its own game, expanding a collaboration with British race car constructor Lola Cars (to whom Ford was already providing engines) to develop a brand-new racing car.

In 1964, based on a race chassis designed by Lola, the Mark I was completed and the Ford GT was born. The commonly known name "GT40" was originally a nickname given by a reporter who was surprised by the low 40-inch height of the car.

A lightweight aerodynamic body of fiberglass was mounted on a steel monocoque chassis, powered by an all-aluminum 4.7-liter OHV V8 mounted amidships. The car made its debut at a 1964 Nürburgring race. Later that year, three Mark I's began the assault on Ferrari. The cars showed incredible speed at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, breaking the lap record and achieving the first run in Le Mans history over 186mph, but the Fords failed to win due to reliability issues.

From 1965, Ford commissioned race activities to Carroll Shelby, and though the GTs again set new top speed and lap records at Le Mans, all of the cars were again forced to retire from the race. At the 1966 Le Mans race, 8 out of 13 Ford GTs in the race were advanced Mark IIs, with improved chassis and Shelby-made 7-liter OHV V8s. In addition to many other refinements, the power of the engines skyrocketed from 350ps to 475ps.

Mr. Ford himself came to the circuit to watch this race, and Ford not only achieved a much-sought victory, they dominated the podium with an incredible 1-2-3 finish. From 1966 through 1969, the Ford GT devastated the competition, winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans four years in a row.
vehicleCollection.zh:
众望所归地在勒芒大赛中夺得胜利，包揽全部领奖台，为传奇拉开帷幕，极具历史意义。

1963年，福特曾经希望收购法拉利，并通过赛车活动来提高他们的品牌形象。然而谈判并不顺利，收购未能成功。于是，福特决定与英国赛车车厂罗拉赛车合作，他们曾向这家车厂供应过引擎。两家共同启动了全新赛车开发计划。

1964年，以罗拉设计的比赛用跑车为基础开发的Mark I车型完成，并被命名为福特GT。广为人知的名称“GT40”其实是一位记者起的昵称，后者因为总车身高度仅有40英寸而惊讶万分。

玻璃纤维制成的空气动力学轻量化车身安装在钢制单体底盘上，同时配备了中置式安装、全铝制的4.7升顶置式气门V8引擎。此车在1964年的纽博格林1000 km耐力赛上亮相，同年参加了勒芒24小时耐力赛，共有三辆Mark I车型参加角逐。在勒芒耐力赛上，这款车展现出了惊人的速度，创下了单圈纪录，并在勒芒历史上首次跑出<300km/h>以上的速度，但由于车辆可靠性原因，最终所有车辆颗粒无收。

自1965年起，他们将赛车活动委托给著名的Shelby美国公司，虽然他们再次在勒芒24小时耐力赛上创下了最快单圈纪录和最高速度纪录，但依然没有车辆完赛。

在1966年勒芒耐力赛上，参赛的13辆福特GT中有8辆是经过改进的Mark II车型，拥有改进后的底盘和由Shelby制造的7升顶置式气门V8引擎。在众多改进之外，引擎的马力也由350ps提高到了475ps。

亨利·福特二世本人也亲临赛场观看比赛。最终，福特不仅获得了他们追求已久的胜利，而且还取得了包揽前三名的压倒性胜利。从这一年起直到1969年，福特GT连续4年蝉联勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

亨利·福特二世本人也亲临赛场观看比赛。最终，福特不仅获得了他们追求已久的胜利，而且还取得了包揽前三名的压倒性胜利。从这一年起直到1969年，福特GT连续4年蝉联勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

In terms of design, the Mark IV was a complete departure
from the Ford GTs that came before it.

Its body and side profile alone evidence a prioritization
of pure aerodynamic performance.

From this point on, Ford showed its commitment to
breaking the GT mold...

...its mission to create completely pure race cars.*
dialogues.zh:

而作出的优化。

从此刻开始，Ford展现了突破GT风格桎梏的决心……

目标是创造出完全不同的纯粹赛车。

collection.en:
The Ford Mark IV dominated the 1967 Le Mans 24 hour race,

and it was a momentous achievement for Ford,
which had also won the prior year.

The car was powered by the 7L V8 engine that Carroll Shelby
had chosen for the Mark II,

But its chassis was completely different.

This chassis was based on the J-car that was under development
to meet new regulations…

incorporating cutting edge aerodynamic innovations.

As a result, the Mark IV was incredibly quick.

So quick in fact, that it finished a full four laps ahead of
the second-placed Ferrari 330 P4 at Le Mans in 1967.

It's also worth noting that the drivers Dan Gurney and
A.J. Foyt were both American,

making this the first victory for an all-American team
in the history of the 24 hours of Le Mans.

And it's because of these facts that the Ford Mark IV
has a special place in motorsport history.
collection.zh:
这是福特的一项重大成就——在1967年主宰勒芒24小时耐力
赛的福特Mark IV。

不仅如此，上一年的比赛桂冠也是由Mark IV摘得的。

该车配备了卡罗尔·谢尔比为Mark II挑选的引擎，

但是使用的底盘完全不同。

该底盘来自研发中的J-car，后者的研发旨在满足新发布的
比赛规则……

还整合了当时最先进的空气动力学特性，

使得这台Mark IV的速度快到可怕。

在1967年的勒芒耐力赛正赛中，它以足足领先亚军法拉利330 P4
四圈之多的优势完赛！

由于两位参赛车手丹·格尼和A.J. 福伊特都是美国人，

于是这就成了全美籍车手车队在勒芒24小时耐力赛上的
首胜。

这些独一无二的成就帮助Mark IV在赛车运动史上占据了特
殊的位置。

vehicleCollection.en:
This race car represented Ford's last effort to challenge for the 24 Hours of Le Mans title.

The year was 1966, and Ford was on a roll, especially at the world's most famous endurance race, the 24 Hours of Le Mans. The company realized its goal of winning the historic contest on its third try, dominating the competition with the Ford GT Mark II. With their eyes set on winning future Le Mans races, the engineers from Ford began work developing a new race car in 1965, one that would eclipse the prowess of the GT Mark II. The GT Mark IV was built according to changes in Article J of the FIA vehicle regulation.

The new car possessed an aluminum honeycomb chassis, which replaced the previous car's steel monocoque one. The profile of the car was characterized by its long, low body that curved from the center section to the rear end. The side air intakes utilized NACA ducts for less drag. The car was subjected to intense wind tunnel testing, and as a result, the Mark IV was one of the most aerodynamically-proficient vehicles in the world.

Although the Mark IV's engine was carried over from the Mark II, its power was increased to 530ps. The chassis was also updated. The result was a race car with an improved top speed of <347km/h> and a better overall stability than its predecessor. In 1967, the Mark IV won the 12 Hours of Sebring and claimed the checkered flag at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, beating its rival, Ferrari, by five laps. This victory marked the last time the Ford works team participated at Le Mans. The main reason for its departure was the adoption of a new rule in 1968 that restricted maximum displacement, which seemed directly aimed at the Ford GT because, simply put, the car was too fast for the competition.
vehicleCollection.zh:
福特最后一次参加勒芒锦标赛的车型。

福特的GT Mark II统治了1966年的勒芒24小时耐力赛，在参赛的第三年终于达成了梦寐以求的目标。但这也意味着该车的基础设计已经是3年前的了，他们需要尽快研发出该车的后继者。

这正是福特如此关注国际汽联车辆技术规范J条款，并在1965年开始全力研发的主要原因。在对他们的测试原型车“J款赛车”进行了多处最终调整后，福特GT Mark IV就此诞生。

全钢一体式车身被废弃，取而代之的是铝制蜂窝结构车架。前车身加长并压低高度，中部到尾端设计为弧形，两侧的进气口使用了NACA式设计来降低阻力。这是一款经过大量的风洞测试而设计出的高度符合空气动力学的车辆。

动力单元基本继承自Mark II，但经过精心调校，动力输出提升到了530ps。底盘的基础结构没有变化，但同样接受了精心调整。

这款车的极速提高到了<347.2km/h>，并有着更加出色的稳定性，Mark IV在1967赛季的赛百灵12小时耐力赛上夺魁，在勒芒24小时耐力赛中更是以5圈的优势领先死敌法拉利完赛。不幸的是，这也是福特最后一个以厂队身份夺得的冠军。原因之一便是1968年起增加的对车辆最大排量的限制，可以说是专门针对在当时看来速度太快的福特GT的。

catch.en: This race car represented Ford's last effort to challenge for the 24 Hours of Le Mans title.
catch.zh: 福特最后一次参加勒芒锦标赛的车型。

collection.en:
This is a legendary Mustang packing the Boss 429 Ford
racing engine.

You may have heard of the 427 'side oiler' engine
used by Ford in the 1960s.

It's what powered classic models like the GT40 and the
Shelby 427 Cobra.

Well, the 429 engine is the successor to that 427 unit.

Historically speaking, it was developed as part of Ford's
push into NASCAR racing.

While the street-legal Boss 429 produced a conservative
380ps, its racing version boasted around 560ps.

NASCAR entry regulations required 500 of these engines to
be mass-produced.

After the Mustang Boss 429 fulfilled the homologation
requirement, it ended production in a short two years.
collection.zh:
这是一辆装有Boss 429 Ford赛车引擎的传奇Mustang。

您可能听说过Ford在20世纪60年代使用的427“侧油器”引擎。

它是为GT40和Shelby 427 Cobra等经典车型提供动力的核心。

在历史上，429引擎作为427的后继型号，

是Ford为了进入NASCAR赛车运动而专门开发的。

虽然合法上路版BOSS 429的动力输出相对保守，仅有380ps，
而其赛车版本的动力则高达560ps。

NASCAR参赛条件规定这些引擎必须生产至少500台。

也因此，Mustang BOSS 429在满足认证要求后，
在短短两年内就结束了生产。

vehicleCollection.en:
This special high-performance Mustang was produced for only two years.

The Ford Mustang has always included high-performance versions in its lineup with many examples created especially for racing.

One of the first special Mustang versions to be specifically used in motorsports was the GT350, developed by Shelby American for SCCA races. Then, there was the BOSS series, produced in 1969 and 1970, a high-performance Mustang for the street that also possessed a racing heart because it was primarily created for NASCAR homologation purposes. Among these, the BOSS 429 stands out as perhaps the most impressive Mustang ever.

Under its hood was a 7.0-liter V-8, the largest engine to ever grace a Mustang. While officially rated at 375ps, its true output was said to be closer to 600ps. And the car's signature hood scoop came only on the Boss 429.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这是符合纳斯卡赛车赛事认证的Mustang，仅仅只生产了两年。

每一代的福特Mustang都会推出高性能的跑车款。而在其悠久的历史中，还有专门为了赛车运动而设计的型号。

其中最为人所熟知的一款赛车就出自品牌的第一代，准确说就是GT350。这款车由Shelby美国专门为了美国赛车俱乐部赛事而打造，创下了辉煌的赛车运动生涯记录，并因此举世闻名。

除此之外，仅在1969至1970年间生产的Boss系列也具有相当的历史价值。Boss 429这款车是为了符合纳斯卡赛车赛事认证规则中的引擎生产数量要求而推出的产品，并被许多车迷评价为是Mustang历史上最伟大的车款。

其7升V8 429引擎是Mustang使用过的全部引擎中排量最大的一款。其官方标称功率为375ps，不过有鉴于当时公布的赛车引擎功率通常都会比实际情况要低得多，坊间传闻说这款引擎的实际输出功率基本达到了600ps上下。

其标志性的超大型引擎盖进气口也仅在Boss429上可以得见。

It's a powerful FR, making it a great choice for anyone

这款公路车是一款经过改装，并获得认证的
Ford Mustang Gr.3级别赛车。

它的加速性或者过弯能力都远高于标准。

这是一辆性能强大的前置后驱车，也是所有漂移爱好者

vehicleCollection.en:
The sixth-generation Mustang marked the model’s 50th anniversary and was sold in 120 countries around the world.(

America’s premier pony car celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2014, and Ford celebrated this occasion by introducing the all-new sixth-generation model. Unlike previous versions of the Mustang that were only available in limited markets, Ford decided to share the wealth and marketed the new car to more than 120 countries.

The designers at Dearborn took extreme care in styling the new Mustang, making it appear more aggressive than any model before it, but making sure that it would still be instantly recognizable as a Mustang upon first glance. The engineers took the same tack, giving the car a great balance of efficiency and power. They brought back the inline-4 of Mustangs past, but after bolting on a turbocharger, the base 2.3-liter engine pumped out a hearty 314ps/32.6kgm to the delight of sports car fans worldwide. However, the star of the show was the thundering Mustang GT's 5.0-liter V-8, which people expected from a powerful American muscle car. It didn’t disappoint, delivering a whopping 441ps/40.8kgm, making it among the most powerful Mustangs ever.

The new pony car also featured a fine-tuned fully independent suspension system (previous models came with a rear beam axle). It was clear to see from this rebirth of the modern-day pony car that the Mustang was no longer only an American icon, but an international one.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
诞生于该车型第50周年的第6代Mustang，福特的这款杰作广销至全球120多个国家。

福特Mustang于2014年改款成为了第六代车型，这一年也是它首次面世的50周年纪念。尽管这台车过去仅仅在美国以及其他有限的几个国家中销售，但它现在已在120个国家/地区的市场中销售。

为了准备好这次扩张，该车型的改造也受到了非常大的重视。

车辆外形经过了大幅改造，比此前任何一款都更有冲击力，但是它著名的前格栅和大灯及其强烈的流线型设计均得以沿用，从而让任何看见它的人都能立刻认出这是一台Mustang。

该车的工学设计也经历了重大的变动。老式的刚性车桥终于被彻底抛弃，所有4个轮子都换上了独立的悬挂系统。

在引擎方面，第二及第三代中出现过的直列式四缸引擎则卷土重来。尽管为了保护环境而选择了此款降档的直喷引擎，它依然是能提供314ps功率与32.6kgm扭矩的2.3升涡轮增压引擎，并依然在世界各地大受欢迎。

不过，对于该系列的粉丝来说，人们聚焦的依然是Mustang GT，配备其标志性的V8引擎。这台5升的V8引擎能提供441ps功率与40.8kgm扭矩的动力，无论低速还是高速均能提供稳定的动力来源，但是V8系列车型的顶配车型还数Mustang GT豪华版。该豪华车型配备了丰富的配套产品，包括语音识别车载导航系统、以及Recaro真皮座椅。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。"

车辆外形经过了大幅改造，比此前任何一款都更有冲击力，但是它著名的前格栅和大灯及其强烈的流线型设计均得以沿用，从而让任何看见它的人都能立刻认出这是一台Mustang。

该车的工学设计也经历了重大的变动。老式的刚性车桥终于被彻底抛弃，所有4个轮子都换上了独立的悬挂系统。

在引擎方面，第二及第三代中出现过的直列式四缸引擎则卷土重来。尽管为了保护环境而选择了此款降档的直喷引擎，它依然是能提供314ps功率与32.6kgm扭矩的2.3升涡轮增压引擎，并依然在世界各地大受欢迎。

不过，对于该系列的粉丝来说，人们聚焦的依然是Mustang GT，配备其标志性的V8引擎。这台5升的V8引擎能提供441ps功率与40.8kgm扭矩的动力，无论低速还是高速均能提供稳定的动力来源，但是V8系列车型的顶配车型还数Mustang GT豪华版。该豪华车型配备了丰富的配套产品，包括语音识别车载导航系统、以及Recaro真皮座椅。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。"

That said, its improved handling made it a well-rounded
race car.

这款原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.3级别赛车采用第六代Mustang

令人难以置信的最高时速是其最突出的优势，

vehicleCollection.en:
The sixth-generation Mustang marked the model’s 50th anniversary and was sold in 120 countries around the world.(

America’s premier pony car celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2014, and Ford celebrated this occasion by introducing the all-new sixth-generation model. Unlike previous versions of the Mustang that were only available in limited markets, Ford decided to share the wealth and marketed the new car to more than 120 countries.

The designers at Dearborn took extreme care in styling the new Mustang, making it appear more aggressive than any model before it, but making sure that it would still be instantly recognizable as a Mustang upon first glance. The engineers took the same tack, giving the car a great balance of efficiency and power. They brought back the inline-4 of Mustangs past, but after bolting on a turbocharger, the base 2.3-liter engine pumped out a hearty 314ps/32.6kgm to the delight of sports car fans worldwide. However, the star of the show was the thundering Mustang GT's 5.0-liter V-8, which people expected from a powerful American muscle car. It didn’t disappoint, delivering a whopping 441ps/40.8kgm, making it among the most powerful Mustangs ever.

The new pony car also featured a fine-tuned fully independent suspension system (previous models came with a rear beam axle). It was clear to see from this rebirth of the modern-day pony car that the Mustang was no longer only an American icon, but an international one.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.

this original Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car.

This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on the
sixth-generation Ford Mustang.

The livery is inspired by the Ford GT race car.

The four lights mounted on the hood and wide body give
the car a menacing presence.

Underneath the body, the suspension has been strengthened
to keep ride quality stable.

The original car was rear-wheel drive, but this one has been
converted to 4WD.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于第六代Mustang开发。

它的涂装来源于Ford GT的官方车队配色……

它的宽体车身和在引擎盖上高高竖起的四盏车灯形成了
具有冲击力的造型。

此外，其悬挂系统也进行了特别强化，以确保相对恒定
的离地间隙。

传动系统方面，则是从基础车型的前置后驱布局换成了
拉力赛常用的四轮驱动。

dialogues.en:
The Ford Mustang has been celebrated as a legendary American
sports car ever since it hit the market in 1964.

dialogues.en:
The goal of J Mays and his team...

...was to make this car more of a European sports car
while not losing its American pony-car heritage.

It was truly a tough undertaking!

The resulting car is the quintessential Mustang...

...which looked like it went to finishing school in Europe.

The new side DLO with rear quarter window
was initially controversial...

...because the previous Mustangs had a B-pillar separating
a scoop, window, or a clean panel.

The new DLO made the Mustang visually more sophisticated
and provided better visibility.

The front-end looked aggressive, with its thin, angled eyes
and aggressive grille!

The rear-end took the three-bar iconic taillights
to a new level.

It had a sequential blinker inspired by the '67/'68 Shelby.

And, did it ever look ean, especially with optional big
wheels spaced-out to the edges!
dialogues.zh:
梅斯及其团队的目标……

是使这款车更贴近一辆欧洲跑车，同时不失
其美式小马车的传统。

这确实是一个艰巨的任务！

他们最终的成果是一款典型的Mustang……

但跑去欧洲的商场采购装扮了一番。

新的后侧窗设计起初引发了不少争议……

前款Mustang的B柱非常宽厚，在后侧只隔出了一个进气口、
以及一扇小窗，或者叫它一块平整的玻璃更合适。

相比之下，新侧窗使这款Mustang在视觉上更加精致，
并提供了更好的侧后方视野。

前脸部分的设计更为激进
——细长而倾斜的大灯和狰狞的进气口极具攻击性！

经典的三道杠式尾灯设计被提升到了一个新的高度……

并采用了受到'67/'68 Shely启发的顺序闪灯效果。

在选配了几乎占满全部轮拱的大尺寸轮圈之后，
整车的姿态近乎完美，更显卓尔不凡！

The sixth-generation Mustang represented a big step
in the model's evolutionary process.

For the first time, it utilized a 4-wheel independent

brandCentral.zh:

vehicleCollection.en:
The 50th Anniversary sixth-generation Ford Mustang GT goes international.

America’s premier pony car celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2014, and Ford celebrated this occasion by introducing the all-new sixth-generation model. Unlike previous versions of the Mustang that were only available in limited markets, Ford decided to share the wealth and marketed the new car to more than 120 countries.

The designers at Dearborn took extreme care in styling the new Mustang, making it appear more aggressive than any model before it, but making sure that it would still be instantly recognizable as a Mustang upon first glance. The engineers took the same tack, giving the car a great balance of efficiency and power. They brought back the inline-4 of Mustangs past, but after bolting on a turbocharger, the base 2.3-liter engine pumped out a hearty 314ps/32.6kgm to the delight of sports car fans worldwide. However, the star of the show was the thundering Mustang GT's 5.0-liter V-8, which people expected from a powerful American muscle car. It didn’t disappoint, delivering a whopping 441ps/40.8kgm, making it among the most powerful Mustangs ever.

The new pony car also featured a fine-tuned fully independent suspension system (previous models came with a rear beam axle). It was clear to see from this rebirth of the modern-day pony car that the Mustang was no longer only an American icon, but an international one.
vehicleCollection.zh:
在该车型50周年亮相的第6代Mustang，这款备受期待的产品在全球120个国家销售。

福特Mustang于2014年改款成为了第六代车型，这一年也是它首次面世的50周年纪念。尽管这台车过去仅仅在美国以及其他有限的几个国家中销售，但它现在已在120个国家/地区的市场中销售。

为了准备好这次扩张，该车型的改造也受到了非常大的重视。

车辆外形经过了大幅改造，比此前任何一款都更有冲击力，但是它著名的前格栅和大灯及其强烈的流线型设计均得以沿用，从而让任何看见它的人都能立刻认出这是一台Mustang。

该车的工学设计也经历了重大的变动。老式的刚性车桥终于被彻底抛弃，所有4个轮子都换上了独立的悬挂系统。

在引擎方面，第二及第三代中出现过的直列式四缸引擎则卷土重来。尽管为了保护环境而选择了此款降档的直喷引擎，它依然是能提供314ps功率与32.6kgm扭矩的2.3升涡轮增压引擎，并依然在世界各地大受欢迎。

不过，对于该系列的粉丝来说，人们聚焦的依然是Mustang GT，配备其标志性的V8引擎。这台5升的V8引擎能提供441ps功率与40.8kgm扭矩的动力，无论低速还是高速均能提供稳定的动力来源，但是V8系列的顶配车型还数Mustang GT豪华版。该豪华车型配备了丰富的配套产品，包括语音识别车载导航系统以及Recaro真皮座椅。

usedCar.en:
You can't have a discussion about great American sports cars
without mentioning the Mustang Mach 1.

Its fastback body, where the roof slopes towards the rear
of the car, is one of the Mach 1's signature elements.

Originally introduced in 1968, it featured a front-engine,
rear-wheel-drive layout that we call "FR."

Its performance was awesome, especially in a straight line.

The 1971 model had a 7.0-liter V-8 429 Cobra Jet engine, still
one of the most powerful engines Ford has ever produced!

And the wide tires ensured that the car had plenty of traction
when you stomped on the throttle. &
usedCar.zh:
在讨论最出色的美国跑车时，
你不可能不提到Mustang Mach 1。

有谁能忘记那极度倾斜的斜背式“Fastback”车身呢？

Mach 1被认为是这种设计的
范例车型。

自然，它的性能也
非常出众。

1971年版的Mach 1搭载了一台7升V8 429 Cobra Jet引擎
——这款引擎至今仍是Ford生产过的最强大的引擎之一！

宽大的轮胎进一步强化了这辆车优秀的
加速性能。<

vehicleCollection.en:
With more muscle than others in its class, this pony car set a new standard for aggressiveness.

In the postwar era, American cars were widely seen as large and expensive, but that perception shifted dramatically in the early 1960s with the debut of the Ford Mustang in 1964. With its sporty attitude and impressive performance—offered at an affordable price—the Mustang immediately won over the American public. It became a financial triumph for Ford Motor Co., and its popularity only grew in the years that followed.

In 1969, Ford gave the Mustang a major redesign, but it retained its signature long nose and short rear deck. Otherwise, nearly everything else about the car changed so dramatically that many saw it as a completely new machine. The updated Mustang was larger but kept its core structure and layout.

It was during this refresh that the formidable Mach 1 arrived in 1969. Launched as part of the Mustang’s fastback lineup known as the "SportsRoof," its sweeping roofline didn’t just enhance aerodynamics, it inspired sports-car designers around the world.

Ford offered a wide range of engines under the Mustang’s hood, from high-powered big-block V-8s capable of matching race cars in performance to more accessible options. The most common was the small-block 351-cubic-inch V8. In its 1970–1971 Ram Air configuration. It produced an impressive 304ps, making the 351 Mustang one of the quickest and most thrilling street cars of its time.
vehicleCollection.zh:
全球的跑车都追随着这款车型掀起的激进风格潮流。

战后美国车给人的印象是大而昂贵，但二十世纪六十年代早期，随着1964年福特Mustang的上市，这种潮流发生了剧烈的变化。这款车主打动感的风格和高性能，同时价格又相对低廉，很快受到了美国大众的青睐。原版的Mustang立刻令福特汽车公司赚得盆满钵满，这款车在之后的几年内仍然长盛不衰。

1969年，福特对其小马车进行了重大改款，仅仅保留了标志性的车型特征，即长车头和短车尾。除此之外，其他的一切都进行了改进，事实上，改动如此之大，以至于许多人认为改款后的Mustang是一款全新的汽车。新车款更大，但基本的配置和构成仍然没有变。

这次改款后，“不祥”的Mach 1于1969年登场。这款跑车级汽车属于Mustang名为Sports Roof的溜背车产品线，动感的车顶设计给全世界的跑车制造商带来了启示。

Mustang包含多种引擎版本，包括和许多跑车不相上下的大排量V8引擎，但最常见的是小缸的351-cu.-in.V8引擎。1970至1971年推出的351 Mustang采用冲压空气引擎，马力为304ps，是当时合法上路的轿车中最具运动感和速度最快的类型。

It was during this refresh that the formidable Mach 1 arrived in 1969. Launched as part of the Mustang’s fastback lineup known as the "SportsRoof," its sweeping roofline didn’t just enhance aerodynamics, it inspired sports-car designers around the world.

Ford offered a wide range of engines under the Mustang’s hood, from high-powered big-block V-8s capable of matching race cars in performance to more accessible options. The most common was the small-block 351-cubic-inch V8. In its 1970–1971 Ram Air configuration. It produced an impressive 304ps, making the 351 Mustang one of the quickest and most thrilling street cars of its time.
long.zh:
战后美国车给人的印象是大而昂贵，但二十世纪六十年代早期，随着1964年福特Mustang的上市，这种潮流发生了剧烈的变化。这款车主打动感的风格和高性能，同时价格又相对低廉，很快受到了美国大众的青睐。原版的Mustang立刻令福特汽车公司赚得盆满钵满，这款车在之后的几年内仍然长盛不衰。

1969年，福特对其小马车进行了重大改款，仅仅保留了标志性的车型特征，即长车头和短车尾。除此之外，其他的一切都进行了改进，事实上，改动如此之大，以至于许多人认为改款后的Mustang是一款全新的汽车。新车款更大，但基本的配置和构成仍然没有变。

这次改款后，“不祥”的Mach 1于1969年登场。这款跑车级汽车属于Mustang名为Sports Roof的溜背车产品线，动感的车顶设计给全世界的跑车制造商带来了启示。

Mustang包含多种引擎版本，包括和许多跑车不相上下的大排量V8引擎，但最常见的是小缸的351-cu.-in.V8引擎。1970至1971年推出的351 Mustang采用冲压空气引擎，马力为304ps，是当时合法上路的轿车中最具运动感和速度最快的类型。

brandCentral.en:
This is a modern-day take on the Shelby GT350, a legendary
performance car created by Carroll Shelby.

It's based on the sixth-generation Mustang.

To handle the naturally-aspirated 500ps V-8, the Mustang
chassis was strengthened to handle the extra power.

The power and performance of the car made it a monster on the
track, which of course, would gain Mr. Shelby's approval.
brandCentral.zh:
Shelby GT350是由Carroll Shelby一手打造的高性能跑车，而这一辆
则是它的现代版本。

它的开发基于第六代Mustang，

采用特别强化过的底盘，并搭载一台500ps马力的自然进气
V8引擎……

它专注于赛事的配置与设计足以让Shelby本人都感到无比自豪。|

vehicleCollection.en:
This high-performance model of the seventh-generation Mustang takes its name from a legend.

The roots of the Shelby GT350R date back to 1965, when Ford commissioned Carol Shelby to build a car to compete in the SCCA (Sports Car Club of America). Based on the first-generation Mustang, the GT350R was sold as a road car because the SCCA allowed only minor modifications for its competition cars. Still, the car dominated its class, gaining instant recognition.

Fast forward to 2016, when the Shelby 350R based on the seventh-generation Mustang, made its debut as road car that was race ready, like the original model. Its naturally-aspirated 5.2-liter V-8 was tuned to produce 533ps and 59.3kgm and was mated to a 6-speed manual transmission.

The reinforced chassis featured Ford's MagneRide suspension system, which detected road conditions and adjusted damping strength using magnetorheological fluid. Also, to reduce weight, the 2+2 layout of the stock Mustang was converted into that of a two-seater.

The GT350R enjoyed a loyal following and great success, thanks in part to it exclusivity. It was sold as a special model available through a limited number of dealers.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款7代Mustang的高性能车型被赋予了一位传奇的名字。

Shelby GT350R的起源可以追溯到1965年，当时的福特委托卡罗尔·谢尔比为参加美国赛车俱乐部的赛车活动而打造一辆赛车。GT350R的开发基于初代Mustang，但由于美国赛车俱乐部的赛事规则只允许最低限度的改装，例如对原厂车进行减重，所以它最终作为一款可以直接参加比赛的公路车上市。这款车在比赛中大放异彩，很快便成就了传奇。

2016款的Shelby 350R基于第7代Mustang开发，同样是一款可以直接开上赛道，享受风驰电掣感觉的公路车。

其5.2升自然进气V8引擎经过调校，可以输出533ps和59.3kgm扭矩，并搭配了一部6速手动档变速箱。其底盘为了支持引擎的强大性能，也经过了加固处理。悬挂系统方面应用了福特的磁驾系统，可以主动检测路面状况，并使用磁流变液来调整减震器应力强度。除此之外，这款两座车还下了很大功夫来减轻车身重量。

GT350R的销售基于标准型GT350，不过由于接受了各种特殊调校，仅作为特殊车型在少数几家经销商处限量销售。
