usedCar.en:
The Ford Sierra RS 500 Cosworth is a truly legendary car,
one that all race fans especially like.

It's a special model, built with the globally popular Gr.A
races in mind, which are for cars based on production models.

The original Sierra is a rear-wheel-drive car,
developed by Ford's European operation.

The RS Cosworth was then created to compete in
1985's Gr.A races.

The car was notable for its 2.0-liter front-mounted turbo
engine, created by the esteemed English company Cosworth.

Its suspension and body were specially tuned.

An even more powerful evolution model based on the
RS Cosworth was released in 1987.

That is this car, the Sierra RS 500 Cosworth.
Everything has been upgraded, including the engine.

Its exploits in the Gr.A races of the late 1980s and early
1990s are still talked about to this day!
usedCar.zh:
福特Sierra RS 500 Cosworth是一辆货真价实的传奇汽车，
是许多赛车车迷的心头好。

眼前的这台特殊车型在设计时就考虑参加全球高人气的
组别A比赛——一项基于零售车型的改装赛车参加的比赛。

原版的Sierra是后轮驱动的车型，由福特的欧洲部门开发。

而RS Cosworth的诞生则是专门为了1985年的组别A比赛。

它的亮点包括一台2升的前置涡轮增压引擎，
由备受推崇的英国公司Cosworth设计打造。

悬挂和车身也经过了特别调试。

1987年，一个基于RS Cosworth开发，性能更强的
进化车型发布。

也就是我们现在看到的这辆Sierra RS 500 Cosworth！
它接受了包括引擎在内的全面升级。

在二十世纪八十年代晚期到九十年代早期的组别A比赛中，
它的出色表现至今令人津津乐道！`

vehicleCollection.en:
A Cosworth tuned masterpiece that dominated touring car racing.

The Sierra was a relatively standard family car with an aerodynamic hatchback body produced by Ford Europe from 1982.

But in 1985, the impression of car enthusiasts regarding the Sierra took a big turn. This was because the famed Cosworth added the Sierra RS Cosworth to the selection, known affectionately as the "Cossie" among enthusiasts. The Sierra RS Cosworth was powered by a 2.0-liter inline 4 tuned to 206ps with DOHC and a turbocharger. The chassis was reinforced, and the exterior was upgraded with fender extensions and a large rear spoiler.

A year later, power was further increased to 227ps, and a 500-unit limited Sierra RS 500 Cosworth was added to the lineup, with an engine reinforced for race use and better aerodynamic details.

And, of course, all of these improvements were developed for touring car racing. From 1988 to 1990, the Sierra won a number of series championship titles in the international Group A category in countries such as Germany, UK, Australia, Japan and New Zealand.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆称霸房车赛的考斯沃斯杰作。

Sierra是一款具有空气动力学掀背式车身、相对标准的家庭用车，由福特欧洲公司从1982年开始生产。

1985年，汽车爱好者对Sierra的印象发生了很大转变。这是因为著名的考斯沃斯公司将Sierra RS Cosworth加入了阵容，车迷亲切地将它称作“Cossie”。Sierra RS Cosworth由一台2升的直列4缸发动机驱动，并采用双顶置凸轮轴和涡轮增压器，令马力提升至206ps。底盘得到了加强，而外部也装上了挡泥板和大号后扰流板。

一年后，它的马力被进一步提升至227ps，只生产500台的限量版Sierra RS 500 Cosworth也加入了阵容，这个版本拥有经过强化的赛事专用发动机，以及更好的空气动力学设计。

这所有的改进自然是为了房车赛而开发。从1988年到1990年，Sierra在德国、英国、澳大利亚、日本和新西兰等国家的国际A组别赛事中赢得了许多系列赛冠军头衔。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Why, this is the Garage RCR Civic, the winner of the Gran
Turismo Award at SEMA 2017!

Garage RCR refers to a body shop in Phoenix, Arizona,
and the Civic, which this car is based om, is the 1992 EG.

The custom parts are genuine JDM!

From its widebody kit to its hood, a wealth of
Japanese tuning parts have been expertly used.

Built to excel at time attacks, its chassis, engine and
transmission were tuned to perfection.

You’ll be blown away by its 5-speed sequential gearbox
and 400ps of turbocharged power.

I hear that Phil Robles, the owner of this car...

...built it piece-by-piece with his son Jesse.
dialogues.zh:
哇，这就是那台Garage RCR思域，
2017年美国汽车用品改装车展览会跑车浪漫旅大奖的得主！

“Garage RCR”指的是亚利桑那州凤凰城的一家车身工厂，
“思域”则是指这辆改装车的原型车'92 EG思域。

它所有的定制部件都是纯正的JDM（为日本国内市场生产）！

从宽体套件到前引擎盖，都是从品类丰富的日本改装件中
专业甄选出来的。

为了在计时赛中获得出色的成绩，它的底盘、引擎
及变速箱都经过了精心调校。

五速序列变速箱和高达400马力的涡轮增压引擎
绝对震撼。

据说这辆车是由它的主人飞利浦·罗伯斯与
他的儿子杰西一起……

逐个零件亲手组装起来的！

This Garage RCR Civic is a finely-tuned mod of the EG Civic,
a popular Japanese hot hatch from the 1990s.

Garage RCR is a body shop located in Phoenix, Arizona.

They specialise in fitting PANDEM widebody kits and
other Japanese tuning parts to cars.

This car is, without a doubt, a JDM custom hero.

Powered by a swapped-in 2.4L K-series engine with turbo,

In 2017, it was crowned with the Gran Turismo Award at SEMA,
the world’s largest custom-car show.

这辆Garage RCR Civic就是对该车型精心改装后的产物。

其他日产改装部件。

它搭载了一台带涡轮增压的2.4L K系列引擎，
最大功率可达400马力，驾驶起来更是如梦如幻。

2017年，它在全球最大的改装车展SEMA展会上

vehicleCollection.en:
A time attack Civic customized in the classic JDM style.

The overwhelming popularity of Japanese performance cars on the international circuit led to the creation of the JDM (Japanese Domestic Market) category. Among these machines was a Honda Civic, a JDM-inspired creation that took home the Gran Turismo Award in 2017—an accolade bestowed upon the best custom vehicles at the SEMA Show.

In 2006, Philip Robles acquired a largely unmodified 1992 EG Civic, and together with his son Jesse, transformed it into a formidable track machine. Their goal was to compete in Time Attack and Time Trial events across circuits in the American Southwest. Over the course of a decade, marked by countless weekends at the track, their Civic secured multiple championships in both disciplines. In 2017, Robles was invited to showcase his creation at SEMA, under the banner of Mackin Industries, a leading importer of tuning parts. In preparation for the event, the Civic underwent an extensive aesthetic transformation for the show.

The most striking visual enhancement was the aggressive wide-body kit from Japanese aero specialists PANDEM, complemented by a front splitter and a rear wing. Adding even more pop to the car's appearance was a carbon-fiber hood, inspired by a signature design from J’s Racing of Japan. Inside, the cockpit was stripped to its bare essentials—only a full roll cage and a single racing bucket seat remained.

The original engine was replaced with a Honda K24 inline-4 powerplant. When the car appeared at SEMA in 2017, the engine was still naturally aspirated. However, in pursuit of greater performance, it was later turbocharged, unleashing a significant increase in power. It came mated to a Quaife 5-speed sequential gearbox, purpose-built for Honda's revered K-series engines.

High-capacity brake systems with Brembo calipers were installed at both front an rear. Also, the suspensions system was enhanced to circuit-tuned specs t further sharpen its handling characteristics.
vehicleCollection.zh:
以经典JDM风格改装的计时赛专用思域。

日本高性能跑车在各大国际赛道上一炮走红后，“JDM”（日本国内市场）这一类别也应运而生。这辆JDM风格的改装版本田思域在2017年一举拿下了当年的Gran Turismo大奖，这一奖项专门颁发给美国改装车协会车展上的最佳改装车辆。

在2006年，飞利浦·罗伯斯购买了这辆保持出厂状态，接近全新的1992年“EG”思域，随后便与儿子杰西一起开始改装他们的爱车。父子二人的目标是开着这台座驾在西南地区的赛道上参加地区计时赛和计时挑战赛。连续10年驰骋在周末比赛的赛道上，他们夺得了多个计时赛和计时挑战赛冠军。2017年，飞利浦受邀出席美国汽车用品改装车展览会，在美国改装零部件进口商Mackin Industries的展位上展示这台思域。为了这次车展，他们进一步改装和翻新了这台车。

这台车上最显眼的改装便是来自日本空气动力学品牌“PANDEM”的宽体套件，以及前扰流器和尾翼。另一个引人注目的改动则是大胆换用了碳纤维引擎盖，后者的灵感来源于日本改装车厂“J's Racing”的作品。这辆车的内饰已被拆得一干二净，仅保留了一个桶椅，同时加装了防滚架以提供额外的稳固性。

原厂引擎被换成了一台本田K24直列四缸引擎。这辆车在2017年美国改装车协会车展亮相时，引擎还是自然进气设计，但在之后的大量改装过程中加装了能够极大提升引擎功率的涡轮增压器。该车搭载了一台由Quaife专为K系列引擎而设计的5速序列变速箱。

原本的前后刹车则升级成带布雷博卡钳的高性能制动系统。当然，悬挂系统也被升级为了赛道专用版本。

long.en:
The overwhelming popularity of Japanese performance cars on the international circuit led to the creation of the JDM (Japanese Domestic Market) category. Among these machines was a Honda Civic, a JDM-inspired creation that took home the Gran Turismo Award in 2017—an accolade bestowed upon the best custom vehicles at the SEMA Show.

In 2006, Philip Robles acquired a largely unmodified 1992 EG Civic, and together with his son Jesse, transformed it into a formidable track machine. Their goal was to compete in Time Attack and Time Trial events across circuits in the American Southwest. Over the course of a decade, marked by countless weekends at the track, their Civic secured multiple championships in both disciplines. In 2017, Robles was invited to showcase his creation at SEMA, under the banner of Mackin Industries, a leading importer of tuning parts. In preparation for the event, the Civic underwent an extensive aesthetic transformation for the show.

The most striking visual enhancement was the aggressive wide-body kit from Japanese aero specialists PANDEM, complemented by a front splitter and a rear wing. Adding even more pop to the car's appearance was a carbon-fiber hood, inspired by a signature design from J’s Racing of Japan. Inside, the cockpit was stripped to its bare essentials—only a full roll cage and a single racing bucket seat remained.

The original engine was replaced with a Honda K24 inline-4 powerplant. When the car appeared at SEMA in 2017, the engine was still naturally aspirated. However, in pursuit of greater performance, it was later turbocharged, unleashing a significant increase in power. It came mated to a Quaife 5-speed sequential gearbox, purpose-built for Honda's revered K-series engines.

High-capacity brake systems with Brembo calipers were installed at both front an rear. Also, the suspensions system was enhanced to circuit-tuned specs t further sharpen its handling characteristics.
long.zh:
日本高性能跑车在各大国际赛道上一炮走红后，“JDM”（日本国内市场）这一类别也应运而生。这辆JDM风格的改装版本田思域在2017年一举拿下了当年的Gran Turismo大奖，这一奖项专门颁发给美国改装车协会车展上的最佳改装车辆。

在2006年，飞利浦·罗伯斯购买了这辆保持出厂状态，接近全新的1992年“EG”思域，随后便与儿子杰西一起开始改装他们的爱车。父子二人的目标是开着这台座驾在西南地区的赛道上参加地区计时赛和计时挑战赛。连续10年驰骋在周末比赛的赛道上，他们夺得了多个计时赛和计时挑战赛冠军。2017年，飞利浦受邀出席美国汽车用品改装车展览会，在美国改装零部件进口商Mackin Industries的展位上展示这台思域。为了这次车展，他们进一步改装和翻新了这台车。

这台车上最显眼的改装便是来自日本空气动力学品牌“PANDEM”的宽体套件，以及前扰流器和尾翼。另一个引人注目的改动则是大胆换用了碳纤维引擎盖，后者的灵感来源于日本改装车厂“J's Racing”的作品。这辆车的内饰已被拆得一干二净，仅保留了一个桶椅，同时加装了防滚架以提供额外的稳固性。

原厂引擎被换成了一台本田K24直列四缸引擎。这辆车在2017年美国改装车协会车展亮相时，引擎还是自然进气设计，但在之后的大量改装过程中加装了能够极大提升引擎功率的涡轮增压器。该车搭载了一台由Quaife专为K系列引擎而设计的5速序列变速箱。

原本的前后刹车则升级成带布雷博卡钳的高性能制动系统。当然，悬挂系统也被升级为了赛道专用版本。

brandCentral.en:
In 2015, the South Korean manufacturer Hyundai established
its 'Genesis' premium brand.

The G70 is the third model produced by the brand since its
inception.

It's the entry-level model of the Genesis sedan range.

Since debuting in 2017, the G70 has been widely praised for
its design...

Though that design was overhauled in 2020, adding an extra
layer of refinement to the car's striking appearance.

This 3.3T is the highest grade model in the G70 range.

It has a 3.3L V6 twin turbo engine, capable of a massive
370ps.
brandCentral.zh:
2015年，韩国车厂Hyundai成立了名为“Genesis”的高级旗下品牌。

G70是该品牌诞生后生产的第三个车型。

它也是Genesis轿车系列的入门级车型。

自从G70于2017年公布以来，它的设计大受各方好评……

该车的设计在2020年进行了大幅修改，
使得这辆车本已新颖的外形变得更加精致了。

这辆3.3T是G70车型中的最高端版本。

它搭载了一台3.3升的V6双涡轮增压引擎，能输出
370ps的澎湃动力。

vehicleCollection.en:
An AWD Genesis sports sedan powered by a potent twin-turbo V-6.

The G70 is a sports sedan developed as part of Hyundai's high-performance Genesis brand. A standard D-segment vehicle, it was released in 2017 and intended as an entry-level model.

Despite sharing most of its features, including the platform, with the KIA Stinger (KIA are also part of the Hyundai group), the G70 was designed from the ground up as a luxury sedan.

Three engines were made available for the G70: a twin-turbocharged 3.3-liter V-6, a turbocharged 2.0-liter gasoline turbo, and a 2.2-liter diesel turbo. The twin-turbo V-6 was capable of 370ps. Like the other cars in the Genesis lineup, rear-wheel drive and AWD versions of the G70 were offered.

The G70's styling was an instant hit, widely praised for its elegant outline. In 2020, however, the car underwent a major redesign, intended to make it more similar to the luxurious G90 and G80. As a result, the G70 looked more polished and even more striking.

In 2021, a shooting brake model, based on the sedan was produced for the European market. Its stunning style made it an instant hit.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆捷尼赛思运动型轿车，四轮驱动，均由双涡轮增压V6引擎提供动力。

G70是一款运动型轿车，作为现代的高性能品牌捷尼赛思旗下的车型而开发。这是一款标准的D级车。它于2017年首次发布，定位为入门级的捷尼赛思车型。

尽管与起亚斯汀格（起亚也是现代集团的一部分）共享了包括平台在内的大部分功能，但G70从一开始就是按照豪华轿车的标准设计的。

G70有三种引擎可选：3.3升V6双涡轮增压引擎、2升汽油涡轮增压引擎和2.2升柴油涡轮增压引擎。其中V6双涡轮增压发动机能够输出370ps的动力。与捷尼赛思产品线的其他车型一样，G70会同时生产后轮驱动和全轮驱动版本。

G70的造型一经问世，就因其优雅的车身轮廓而广受赞誉。然而，在2020年，该车又经历了一次重大的改款设计，目的是让造型与同为豪华车型的G90和G80更加相似。改款之后，G70显得愈发耀眼、引人注目了。

2021年，捷尼赛思在轿车的基础上向欧洲市场推出了猎装车型，其令人惊叹的外观风格使之立即成为热门车款。

This Gr.4 racing car is a Gran Turismo original, based on
the G70.

Its shape incorporates all the latest design trends, as well
as a restrained approach to aerodynamics.

It features a 4WD layout, just like its base car, and its
engine has been tuned to produce 420ps./
brandCentral.zh:
这台Gr.4赛车是Gran Turismo的原创赛车，
原型为G70。

它的造型囊括了所有的最新设计，
并采用了较为克制的空气动力学外形。

与原型一样，这辆车也采用了四驱布局，但引擎出力被提高至了420ps。

它的外形设计以标志性的双线为基准，

vehicleCollection.en:
A Gr.3 machine that combines luxury with competition performance.

In April 2021, Hyundai's new premium brand, Genesis, unveiled its Genesis X concept, the brand's interpretation of how GT cars could look in the future.

The front fascia features the shield-shaped crest grille that has become the brand's signature design element. Two lines stretch from the grille to past the front wheel arches and reappear again at the rear of the car to form the taillights. This new-generation example of car styling is part of Genesis calls its "Athletic Elegance" design language.

This car was more than a concept, as Genesis also created a racing edition for Gran Turismo that was inspired by the Genesis X. The Genesis X Gr.3 is a serious Gr.3-spec machine designed to compete in Gran Turismo's fierce championship competition.

The X concept was originally designed as an electric vehicle, but the Genesis X Gr.3 is equipped with a conventional gasoline engine. Thanks in part to forced induction, it produces 550ps. To house the race car's larger tires, the body was widened to 1992mm, while aerodynamic improvements were added to the underside. Also, a larger rear wing helps make this machine look race-ready.

A combination of luxury and performance, the Genesis X Gr.3 is a radical new type of Gr.3 machine, the likes of which have never been seen before.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一台将奢华气质与竞赛级性能结合在一起的组别3赛道机器。

2021年4月，现代的高端品牌捷尼赛思发布了捷尼赛思X concept，作为对近未来GT跑车形态的探索。

前脸采用了已经品牌家族化设计的盾形徽章格栅，两侧伸出的两条线勾勒出头灯，并延伸过前轮拱，然后在车尾再次出现，构成尾灯的轮廓。新一代的外观设计风格是对捷尼赛思的“运动优雅”设计语言的创新诠释。

不过，这款概念赛车型的使命并未就此止步。捷尼赛思还为跑车浪漫旅专门设计了一款赛道版，它采用了捷尼赛思X的相同概念和设计精髓。捷尼赛思X组别3是一款顶级的组别3规格赛道机器，专为在激烈的锦标赛中杀出重围而生。

虽然捷尼赛思X concept最初被设计为电动车，但这台捷尼赛思X组别3依然采用传统的内燃机提供动力。加装增压装置以后，最大输出功率可达550ps。为了适配加宽后的轮胎，车体也相应加宽至1992mm，同时在车底、车尾都安装了空气动力学优化部件。尾部的大型扰流板使得整辆赛车气势非凡。

捷尼赛思X组别3是奢华气质与竞赛级性能的结合，也是组别3组别前所未见的新生代竞争者。

brandCentral.en:
Unveiled at the Gran Turismo World Series 2023 World Finals,
this first-generation Genesis Vision Gran Turismo...

Is distinguished by an iconic two lines’ brand identifier
that links its quad lights and crest grille.

Its cab-back layout positions the driver
further aft of the vehicle.

And, its proportions are representative of the entire
Genesis lineup...

...making this cutting-edge concept car a manifestation of
Genesis’ Athletic Elegance design philosophy.
brandCentral.zh:
第一代Genesis Vision Gran Turismo于
Gran Turismo系列赛2023世界总决赛现场公布。

它最亮眼的设计便是以品牌标志性的双“抛物线”线条
元素将四盏条状大灯和盾徽形格栅进行了有机衔接。

此外它还采用了驾驶舱后移设计，
让驾驶员的位置更远离车头……

这款车型也同样延续了Genesis整个产品线
普遍采用的车身比例。

这些因素让这款VGT车型以充沛的感情
体现了Genesis的“运动优雅”设计理念。

vehicleCollection.en:
A sports coupe that embodies the athletic elegance sought by Genesis.

The Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept embodied Genesis’ “Athletic Elegance” design philosophy. The design combined cab-rearward proportions with the brand’s signature anti-wedge stance, structured around a virtual parabolic tension theory seen across the Genesis lineup.

Its form was both pure and muscular, with volumes centered around the wheels. It introduced a new front fascia that abstracted the crest grille and integrated it with the quad lights, while the brand’s signature two-line lighting motif visually connected the car from front to rear. The fuselage extended rearward into an elliptical concave volume, a theme shared with other Genesis models. It was framed by a rear spoiler and lateral trailing edges to enhance high-speed stability.

The interior followed Genesis’ “Beauty of White Space” philosophy, creating a minimalist, driver-focused environment. Essential functions were prioritized to support track performance. A digital panoramic interface served as the central information hub, linked to a surround digital monitoring system. Steer-by-wire controls enabled precise inputs. The quilted, padded bolsters provided protection for the driver during high-speed driving and facilitated quicker ingress and egress during pitstops.

Aerodynamically, the X Gran Berlinetta Concept achieved notable efficiency. It boasted a drag coefficient of 0.34 through the integration of active aerodynamic elements and carefully managed airflow.

The powertrain featured a front-mid-mounted Lambda II V6 engine, supported by Genesis E-SC hybrid technology. The hybrid race-spec system delivered a total output of 1,071 HP and 986 lb.-ft. of torque. The V-6 produced 870 HP and 790 lb.-ft. of torque, revving to 10000rpm, while the Yasa E-SC motor contributed an additional 201 HP and 96 lb.-ft. of torque.
vehicleCollection.zh:
体现出捷尼赛思所追求的运动优雅理念的运动型双门跑车。

捷尼赛思X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept在其设计中以充沛的热情融入捷尼赛思的“运动优雅”设计哲学。概念车沿袭了整个捷尼赛思产品线中普遍运用的虚拟抛物线理论，打造捷尼赛思代表性的反楔形姿态，配合驾驶舱后移的设计，形成精致的车身比例。

X Gran Berlinetta Concept的设计语言讲求纯粹和力量感，主要车体围绕轮毂构建。这款车还展现了捷尼赛思的全新前脸风格，对盾徽形格栅进行了抽象化设计，顺滑地过渡到两侧的四盏条状大灯，并以品牌标志性的双“抛物线”线条元素将前后体量进行有机衔接，共同构成统一的整体。车身沿椭圆形凹面结构从前向后收拢，这一造型在其他捷尼赛思车型上也非常常见。车尾的后扰流板和多处侧面后缘加入封闭包边，以提升高速下的空气动力学稳定性。

其内饰设计衍生自捷尼赛思的“留白之美”理念，为驾驶者打造出最简练及纯粹的环境。——所有核心功能都得到了优先凸显，以便车手专注于提升赛道表现。其数字全景界面连接到车身四周的数字监控系统，起到了信息集成的作用；而其线控转向控制命令系统也有助于让驾驶者获得更精确的操纵。装有衬垫的支撑座椅可在赛道上以及在快速进出维修站时为车手提供有效保护。

X Gran Berlinetta Concept拥有引人瞩目的空气动力学流畅外形。设计师们整合了多种空气动力学辅助部件，并巧妙地协调了车内气流和外部层流，实现了低至0.34的阻力系数。

X Gran Berlinetta Concept由一部前中置Lambda II V6引擎提供动力，并以捷尼赛思E-SC技术进行电子辅助。其比赛级的混动传动系统可以输o高达1071 HP（1071 BHP）和986 ft-lb（136.3kgm）的扭矩，确M这辆车内外兼修，秀外慧中。这款V6引擎最高转速可达10000rp>，能够输出最大870 HP (870 BHP)U动力和790 ft-lbo109.2kgm）的扭矩，而E-C电机能够额外产f201 HP(201 BHP)的Y力和196 ft-l（27kgm）的扭矩。

brandCentral.sourceName: Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept
brandCentral.en:
This is the racing version of the Genesis X Gran Berlinetta
Vision Gran Turismo Concept.

While retaining its Berlinetta essence...

It's got new aerodynamic features, like a cool wing and a flat
underbody, increasing downforce for superior track performance.
brandCentral.zh:
这是Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept
的赛车版本。

保留Berlinetta的核心设计理念的同时……

在空气动力学方面进行了升级，包括造型激进的大尺寸
尾翼和平滑的底板，额外提升了车辆的下压力。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept
vehicleCollection.en:
The racing version of the Gran Berlinetta adorned with aerodynamic parts.

The Genesis X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept is the most emotional expression of Athletic Elegance in the Genesis portfolio.

It is a racing derivative of the Genesis X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept, with increased downforce achieved by the effective wings, active aerodynamic flaps, flat floor, front and rear diffusors, canards and gurneys. While the drag coefficient increases according to wing configurations, the increased downforce allows better lap times.

The X Gran Racer Concept is powered by a front mid-mounted race-spec Lambda II V-6 engine, electrically assisted by Genesis E-SC technology. The hybrid race-spec drivetrain delivers a combined 1,540 HP and 1,015 ft-lb. of torque. The V-6 redlines at 10000rpm while delivering a maximum output of 870 HP and 790 ft-lb. of torque while the front E motor generates an additional 670 HP and 225 ft-lb. of torque.
vehicleCollection.zh:
加入各种空气动力学部件的Gran Berlinetta赛车版本。

捷尼赛思X Gran Racer Vision Gran Turismo Concept是捷尼赛思产品阵容里对“运动优雅”设计理念最感情充沛的表达。

作为捷尼赛思X Gran Berlinetta Vision Gran Turismo Concept的赛车衍生款，通过增加令人过目不忘的前后翼、主动式空气动力学襟翼、平板底盘、前后扩散器、前翼和格尼襟翼，有效地增加了车辆下压力。还可根据不同的扰流翼配置来提高阻力系数，从而增加其下压力以大幅提升圈速。

X Gran Racer Concept由一部前中置比赛级拉姆达II V6引擎提供动力，并以捷尼赛思E-SC技术进行电子辅助。比赛级的混动传动系统可以输出高达1540马力（1561ps）的动力和1015英尺-磅（140.3kgm）的扭矩。这款V6引擎最高转速可达10000rpm，能够输出最大870马力（882ps）的动力和790英尺-磅（109.2kgm）的扭矩，而前置电机能够额外产生670马力（679ps）的动力和225英尺-磅（31kgm）的扭矩。

brandCentral.en:
There's nothing quite like a 1980s Formula 1 car.

They were stylish, powerful and downright raw, with
gobs of power and incredible sound.

Gran Turismo thought of bringing back the mystique
of that golden era with this car.

Powering this machine is a turbocharged 1.6-liter V-6
that recalls the classic engines of the day.

And it packs some serious Formula 1 heat, too.
How's 1000ps at 11000rpm?

If you want to feel a pure Formula 1 race car,
give this one a try.
brandCentral.zh:
俗话说，英雄所见略同……

如果您对外观设计略有心得，您一定也同意80年代的一
级方程式赛车是最美的！

这辆车就是跑车浪漫旅尝试将那个黄金年代再现的
产物。

它使用一台1.6L V6涡轮增压引擎，能让您再次体验到那个
时代的经典动力。

这款F1赛车能够输出非常强大的动力，在11000rpm的转速时能
够输出1000ps马力。

在我看来，没有一款车比它更值得推荐了。

vehicleCollection.en:
This original formula car adopted the spirit and performance of the mid-1980s Formula 1 race cars.

F1 machines in the mid-80’s were characterized by a compact V6 turbo engine and their stoic, well cut appearance. The Gran Turismo F1500T-A is a machine that brings back the style still considered to be the best form in F1 history, with its own unique interpretation.

While maintaining the basic concepts from 30 years ago with a slightly forward cockpit and a simple aerodynamic package, this car also incorporates the performance of a front line formula racing machine.

The carbon fiber chassis is 4235mm long, 2146mm wide, and has a wheel base of 2718mm. The 1.5 liter turbocharged V6 is symbolic of F1 engines from the 1980’s, and produces approximately 1000ps at 11000rpm.

The aerodynamic design of the wings and other components also follow the trends from the 80's, but as a result of increased cooling performance of the turbocharger and the engine, the opening of the air outlets on the side pontoons were minimized, improving the aerodynamics on the body sides.

Formula cars are a different type of beast compared to touring cars. Get a taste for Formula level performance with this machine.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一款原创方程式汽车，重现了80年代中期一级方程式赛车的性能。

80年代中期的F1赛车给人留下的最突出印象，是紧凑的V6涡轮增压引擎，以及线条简练的造型。跑车浪漫旅F1500T-A正是一款力求还原这种普遍被认为是F1史上最棒造型的车辆，并有着自己对这一风格独特的解读。

这款车保持了30年前方程式赛车的基本概念，即略微前置的驾驶舱和简练的空气动力学造型，同时还具备了前沿的方程式赛车的性能。

由碳纤维打造的车身长4235mm，宽2146mm，轴距为2718mm。1.5升涡轮增压V6引擎是1980年代F1赛车的标志性配置，在11000rpm时可输出约1000ps的动力。

前翼、尾翼和其他部件的空气动力学设计同样遵循了80年代的风潮，不过因为涡轮增压器和引擎如今更优秀的散热性能，侧箱的进气口得到了最大程度的缩减，从而改善了两侧的空气动力学效应。

方程式赛车和旅行房车相比，是完全不同级别的体验，通过这款车型来感受一下方程式级别的性能吧。

brandCentral.en:
F1 machines of the early 1990s were technologically simple
yet remarkably elegant.

Gran Turismo’s very own formula machine, the F3500-A
was born from a deep admiration of this bygone era.

Like actual F1 race cars of the time, the chassis
is made from negative molded carbon fiber.

The car's naturally-aspirated 3.5-liter V-12, with pneumatic
valves, is capable of reaching up to 15,000 revs.

It's got a 6-speed semi-automatic gearbox with paddle shifters
and a pushrod suspension, just like the classic cars of yesteryear.

The body features a distinctive high-nose design, with front wings
from the nose rather than being underslung.

Proving there's no end to the evolution of F1 machines,
the F3500-A serves as a benchmark for what is possible.
brandCentral.zh:
1990年代初的F1赛车虽然技术上相对简单，却是
极具优雅和艺术感的经典之作。

Gran Turismo中的F3500-A
脱胎于团队对这一时代赛车的深切景仰和致敬。

它模仿了当时的F1赛车，采用负压模成型的碳纤维材料
打造车架。

搭载一台使用气动气门的3.5L自然进气V12引擎，
最高转速可达15000转。

与换档拨片结合的是一款6速半自动变速箱，
悬挂方面采用了当时的经典推杆式悬挂系统。

单体车壳采用高鼻设计，前鼻翼并非下悬挂式，
而是直接与鼻锥相连，向两侧展开。

F3500-A可以视作是这一领域发展的模板，
展现了F1赛车不断进化的可能性。

vehicleCollection.en:
An original formula car created in the image of classic F1 cars.

The F3500-A is a Gran Turismo original formula car inspired by a profound admiration for early 1990s F1 machines.

Its chassis was crafted from negative-molded carbon fiber, which was a hallmark of the era. The suspension employed a classic configuration, with horizontally mounted shock absorbers operated through pushrods and bell cranks.

The power unit is a compact naturally-aspirated 3.5-liter V-12. Fitted with pneumatic valves, it can rev to an impressive 15000rpm, while its variable-length intake funnels deliver consistent torque across the entire rev range. The high-pitched wail of its exhaust at peak RPMs—a signature trait of naturally aspirated engines—remains an irreplaceable hallmark, unmatched by turbocharged systems. The drivetrain features a 6-speed semi-automatic transmission with paddle shifters, positioned laterally to preserve the aerodynamically optimized rear diffuser design.

Focusing on aerodynamics, the monocoque adopts a high-nose design. In contrast to modern front wings, which are often suspended by struts, this design features an anhedral configuration, with the wing angling diagonally outward from beneath the nose. A variety of options are available, including multiple front and rear wing designs, along with interchangeable engine cowl shapes, allowing you to tailor the car to suit your personal preferences.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一款以经典F1赛车为灵感打造的原创方程式赛车。

F3500-A是一款跑车浪漫旅原创的方程式赛车，源自团队对上世纪90年代初F1赛车的深切景仰和致敬。

车体方面，底盘采用负模碳纤维，这种材料在当时非常流行。悬挂系统沿用了经典布局，采用横向安装的减震器，通过推杆和摇臂进行调节。

动力单元是一台轻便紧凑的3.5L自然进气V12引擎，配备气动气门，能够达到15000rpm的转速。进气系统上的可变长度喉管则确保了各转速区间的充足扭矩输出。自然进气引擎在高转速下发出的排气声浪有着涡轮增压系统无法复制的独特音质。变速箱为6速半自动变速箱，配有换挡拨片，横向安装设计旨在避免与后扩散器相冲突。

空气动力学方面，单体壳车身采用高鼻设计。与现代F1前鼻翼常用的主翼片下悬挂设计不同，这款车的前翼则采用了反翼布局，翼板从鼻锥底部斜向展开。此外，玩家可以在游戏中根据个人需求，选择不同的前后翼和引擎罩形状，对车辆进行定制。

catch.en: An original formula car created in the image of classic F1 cars.
catch.zh: 一款以经典F1赛车为灵感打造的原创方程式赛车。

long.en:
The F3500-A is a Gran Turismo original formula car inspired by a profound admiration for early 1990s F1 machines.

Its chassis was crafted from negative-molded carbon fiber, which was a hallmark of the era. The suspension employed a classic configuration, with horizontally mounted shock absorbers operated through pushrods and bell cranks.

The power unit is a compact naturally-aspirated 3.5-liter V-12. Fitted with pneumatic valves, it can rev to an impressive 15000rpm, while its variable-length intake funnels deliver consistent torque across the entire rev range. The high-pitched wail of its exhaust at peak RPMs—a signature trait of naturally aspirated engines—remains an irreplaceable hallmark, unmatched by turbocharged systems. The drivetrain features a 6-speed semi-automatic transmission with paddle shifters, positioned laterally to preserve the aerodynamically optimized rear diffuser design.

Focusing on aerodynamics, the monocoque adopts a high-nose design. In contrast to modern front wings, which are often suspended by struts, this design features an anhedral configuration, with the wing angling diagonally outward from beneath the nose. A variety of options are available, including multiple front and rear wing designs, along with interchangeable engine cowl shapes, allowing you to tailor the car to suit your personal preferences.

空气动力学方面，单体壳车身采用高鼻设计。与现代F1前鼻翼常用的主翼片下悬挂设计不同，这款车的前翼则采用了反翼布局，翼板从鼻锥底部斜向展开。此外，玩家可以在游戏中根据个人需求，选择不同的前后翼和引擎罩形状，对车辆进行定制。

brandCentral.en:
Gran Turismo players may already have been familiar with
the special formula machine known as the F3500-A.

The F3500-B was its variant, although both cars were
born of the same admiration for 1990s F1 racing.

The key difference lay in their power units. Where the F3500-A
employed a V-12, the B model carried a V-8.

Although less powerful, the V-8 delivered an output of 710ps.
Light and compact, it carried advantages of its own.

Note the newly added front wing, crafted specifically made for the
car’s high nose and offered in three unique designs.

Beyond showcasing an evolution of the hanging wing concept,
it was a visual delight.

Setting the benchmark for formula machines, the F3500-B
delivered an experience that only a V-8 could provide.
brandCentral.zh:
跑车浪漫旅》的玩家或许早已对
名为F3500-A的特殊方程式赛车耳熟能详。

这款F3500-B是其衍生型号，两款车均
源于对90年代一级方程式赛车的致敬。

二者的主要区别在于动力单元：
F3500-A采用V12引擎，而B型则搭载V8引擎。

V8的动力虽稍逊，但最大输出仍达710ps，
紧凑且轻量化的引擎结构更增独特优势。

注意观察新增的前翼，专为匹配该车的高鼻锥设计，
并提供了三种独特款式。

它不仅展现了悬吊式前翼设计的演进，
更带来视觉上的享受。

作为方程式赛车的标杆之作，F3500-B
带来了独属于V8引擎的驾驭体验。

vehicleCollection.en:
Here's a V-8 version of the GT original formula car.

Gran Turismo introduced the F3500-A, an original formula machine created as a tribute to the golden age of early 1990s Formula 1. It captured the speed and technology of that era, giving players a breathtaking taste of top-level racing.

To continue that lineage, we now present the F3500-B. The most significant change lies in its power unit. Where the F3500-A was powered by a naturally-aspirated V-12, the F3500-B turns to a lighter, more compact V-8.

Although devoid of cutting-edge systems such as variable intakes or pneumatic valves, it retains the same electronic fly-by-wire throttle of its predecessor. This engine revs to 13800rpm, and despite the inherent limitations of the V-8, it produces more than 710ps. A transverse 6-speed gearbox ensures the best possible packaging.

The body remains faithful to the F3500-A, but the front end has been refined. Three different high-nose wings are available, each with its own aerodynamic philosophy.

The sharp responses and direct feel of the F3500-A remain, but with the F3500-B, you will also discover the “lightness” of this V-8-powered machine.
vehicleCollection.zh:
跑车浪漫旅系列原创方程式赛车的V8版本。

在《跑车浪漫旅》系列登场的F3500-A是一款原创方程式赛车，其设计初衷是向90年代初期的一级方程式赛事致敬。这款赛车堪称那个时代速度与技术的结晶，致力于为玩家带来令人心潮澎湃的方程式赛车体验。

为延续这一传承，我们推出了全新的F3500-B。两款车型的核心差异在于动力单元。与F3500-A搭载的自然进气V12引擎不同，F3500-B采用了更轻量化、结构更紧凑的V8引擎。

尽管不再搭载可变进气系统或气动阀门等高科技配置，该引擎仍沿用与F3500-A相同的电子线控油门技术。其转速可达13800rpm，这意味着即使V8结构存在固有的功率短板，该引擎仍能输出超过710ps的强劲动力。变速箱采用6速横向布置设计，以实现最优的空间布局。

车身造型与F3500-A保持一致，但前脸部分进行了若干调整。高鼻锥设计提供三种不同的前翼选择，每种都采用了独特的空气动力学设计思路。

该车沿袭了F3500-A的方程式赛车响应特性与直接路感，但V8引擎所带来的那份“轻盈”驾驶感受，仍需您亲身体验才能领略其精妙之处。

brandCentral.en:
This go-kart-style vehicle is a Gran Turismo original!

Equipped with a sequential six-speed manual transmission
and front brakes...

It feels a lot like a formula car to drive!

In fact, it can even reach speeds of up to <200km/h>,
depending on its gear ratio.

So don't let its appearance fool you—this is one zippy ride!
brandCentral.zh:
这辆卡丁车模样的赛车是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型！

搭载序列式六速手动变速箱和前轮刹车……

事实上，此车的驾驶感觉更像一辆方程式赛车！

在进行齿轮比设置后，其时速甚至可以达到<200km/h>。

因此，不要被这辆车的外表迷惑了——这是一辆活力四
射、灵活迅捷的车！

vehicleCollection.en:
With its tremendous performance and 6-speed gearbox, this kart proves fast enough for full-size tracks.

A steel pipe frame with simple mechanisms. A tiny seat and exposed engine. A racing go-kart is often seen as the most basic form of a race car. However, these karts can be quite complicated, coming in a number of shapes and sizes; some, like the Shifter Kart featured here, are virtually mini versions of formula cars.

The Shifter Kart is basically the same as a standard racing kart, but the major differences are that the former is equipped with a 6-speed transmission and front brakes. The gearbox is combined with a dry clutch, requiring the driver to operate the clutch whenever stopped, including after a spin. Gear-shifting is usually accomplished by pushing or pulling a lever next to the steering wheel. Depending on the gear ratios, top speed can reach up to <200km/h>, so Shifter Karts are often raced on full-size auto circuits.

The front brakes are primarily to control this high-speed range, but they also allow changes in brake balance between front and rear, which in turn changes control characteristics. A Shifter Kart can be set up with much more precision than a standard kart with only rear brakes.

The Shifter Kart is a full-fledged race machine, used to train top drivers. Drive one and feel for yourself the level of performance. It is sure to change your opinion about these tiny machines.
vehicleCollection.zh:
拥有能在全尺寸赛道飞驰的速度：拥有6速变速箱的完整赛道车型。

一个带有简易机械机构的钢管车架，加上一台裸露引擎和一个小座椅。从它们的外观来看，卡丁车经常会被视为赛车运动的入门车型。可是，事实上这个名称包含了各种各样的外形和大小，而且还有一些仅次于方程式的车辆也被包含在内。而此处介绍的变速卡丁车就是其中的一种。

变速卡丁车基本上和标准卡丁车相同，但是它们最主要的区别在于其还配备了一个6档变速箱和前刹车。这个6档变速箱与干式离合器相搭配，需要车手在停车或者打转之后才能操作。换挡则通过推拉方向盘旁边的拉杆实现。根据传动比而定，这种车的最高时速最高可达到<200km/h>，所以它们也经常用来在标准赛道上竞技。

安装前刹车的原因就是要在这样的高速中实现操控性，但是现在也可以将刹车平衡从前部变换到后部。通过这样的调整，可改变车辆的控制特性，相比只带后刹的普通卡丁车，能够设置更多细节。

这是一台被用来训练顶尖车手的成熟赛车。驾驶并亲身感受一下它的性能吧，这会颠覆你对于卡丁车的传统认知。

cars.nameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Junior
cars.nameZh: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Junior

brandCentral.en:
This hypothetical fan car was developed by Gran Turismo
in partnership with Red Bull Racing.

Considered an entry-level model, as opposed to the
higher-performing X2014 Standard...

Its highly aerodynamic body makes it a great choice for
anyone looking to learn how to drive a formula car.

It comes equipped with a 250ps 2L straight-four engine.
brandCentral.zh:
这款架空的爱好者车型是由跑车浪漫旅与红牛车队
联合开发的。

相对于性能更高的X2014 Standard而言，这是一台入门车……

其车身在空气动力学方面进行了高度优化，是任何想学
习驾驶方程式赛车的人的最佳选择。

安装在这台车上的是一台250ps的2L直列四缸引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
A beginner level machine for learning the basics of formula cars.

The fan car project that started with the collaboration between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo continued even after the release of Gran Turismo 5. Adrian Newey, the chief technical officer of Red Bull Racing, and Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi further refined the concept of the "fastest racing car on earth, untouched by any and all regulations," and pursued the optimization of the design even further. What came as the result, was the X2014 series announced at the end of 2013 in Gran Turismo 6.

The entry level model for beginners to the X series is the X2014 Junior. A conventional aerodynamic, compact body is matched to an equally compact naturally aspirated 2000cc inline 4 cylinder engine that produces approximately 250ps. This is an optimal machine for learning the basics of driving a formula car, with high grip and high downforce characteristics.
vehicleCollection.zh:
入门级车型，用于熟悉方程式赛车。

红牛车队和跑车浪漫旅合作开启的车迷向赛车项目在跑车浪漫旅5发售后仍在继续。红牛车队的首席技术官艾德里安·纽维和跑车浪漫旅系列的制作人山内一典对“地球上最快的赛车，不受任何规则束缚”的概念作了进一步细化，持续追求最优设计。最终诞生了X2014系列，并于2013年年末在跑车浪漫旅6内发布。

X2014 Junior这款车是X系列面向初学者的入门级车款。采用传统的空气动力学紧凑型车身和同级别的紧凑型自然吸气2000cc直列式4缸引擎，能够产生约250ps的动力。此车适合用来学习高抓地力和高下压力特征明显的方程式赛车的基本诀窍。

cars.nameEn: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Standard
cars.nameZh: Gran Turismo Red Bull X2014 Standard

brandCentral.en:
This hypothetical fan car was developed by Gran Turismo
in partnership with Red Bull Racing.

But don’t let name 'Standard' fool you—it's actually
the higher-performing sibling of the X2014 Junior.

Under its bonnet is a 2L straight-four turbo engine
that can generate 810ps of power.

Employing a Venturi car design, the Standard boasts
increased downforce...

Which essentially means that air pressure on the car
adapts to changes in its speed.

It’s fascinating! In fact, you might learn a thing or two
about aerodynamics just driving this beauty!
brandCentral.zh:
这款架空的爱好者车型是由跑车浪漫旅与红牛车队
联合开发的。

但不要被名称中的“Standard”字样所迷惑了，它可是红牛
X2014 Junior的兄弟车，而且是高性能版本。

其引擎盖下安装着一台2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎，可以
产生810ps的动力。

这辆Standard还安装了文丘里管扩散器，以提供更大的下压力……

这意味着车身所受的空气下压力会因为速度而发生变化，

是相当惊人的设计！事实上，试着驾驶一下这台美丽的
车，您或许能对空气动力学有所体会！

vehicleCollection.en:
A traditional venturi car with the axial flow fan and skirts removed from the X2014.

The fan car project that started as a collaboration between Red Bull Racing and Gran Turismo continued at full speed after the blockbuster release of Gran Turismo 5. Red Bull Racing’s Chief Technical Officer Adrian Newey and Gran Turismo Producer Kazunori Yamauchi continued to refine their premier concept of creating the fastest race car on earth, no holds barred.

The result was the groundbreaking X2014 series, announced at the end of 2013 in Gran Turismo 6.

The X2014 Standard, the mid-range model of the X2014 series, features conventional suspension and aerodynamics, without the axial flow fan and ground-effect skirt of the X2014 Fan Car that serves as the flagship of the lineup.

V-6, a liter less than the Fan Car but still delivering a massive 810ps. When piloting this version of the X2014, the driver must keep in mind that the downforce available during cornering changes greatly as speed increases and decreases.

代表了赛车设计的巅峰水平。

vehicleCollection.en:
This is an evolution of the X2014 created for the FIA Gran Turismo Championships.

Imagine a race car that can unleash its full unbridled potential, free of any restrictions or regulations. That's exactly what Gran Turismo and Red Bull did when they created the X2010, followed by the X2014 a few years later. This project of creating the ultimate performance machine was updated for the 2019 FIA Gran Turismo Championship, and thus, the X2019 Competition was born.

Based on the X2014 Standard, the X2019 Competition features a front wing and a slightly modified rear end that produces less downforce to minimize aerodynamic changes to the car during close battles. The rear wheel covers have been altered to allow fast tire changes. Under the hood, the turbocharged 2.0-liter engine was swapped for a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter powerplant, equipped with a more conventional throttle system to provide a more attractive exhaust note.

The X2019 Competition will be painted in the national colors of the Nations Cup finalists and will no doubt bring added excitement to this year's championships.
vehicleCollection.zh:
X2014的演化版，专为国际汽联的GT锦标赛而打造。

世界上最快的赛车，不受规则束缚”：红牛车队和跑车浪漫旅联手打造的车迷计划源自山内一典一贯秉承的梦想，迄今为止已经打造出两款终极赛车X2010和X2014。随着国际汽联GT锦标赛的开幕，需求一款能同时取悦车手和观众的终极赛车的呼声又一次涌现出来。X2019 Competition应运而生。

这款跑车以X2014 Standard为基础，通过改进车身的前翼和后段来减少下压力，避免与其他赛车贴身肉搏时产生急剧的空力变化。对前轮盖和后轮盖的改造是为了快速更换轮胎。2.0升的涡轮增压引擎被换成了3.0升自然进气引擎。这款赛车依然应用传统油门系统，以便在比赛中产生更吸引人的音效。

X2019 Competition将根据国家杯决赛车手的国籍上色。这款赛车将以无与伦比的性能让锦标赛更加激动人心。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
A Gran Turismo Championship icon
and the ultimate race car....

...inaugural series champion Igor Fraga and
2019 champion, Mikail Hizal...

...raced this machine at the 2018 GTC finals in Monaco
to a near dead heat.

I’ll never forget the electrifying energy in the venue
when the winner was announced!

The responsiveness of its 3.0-liter NA engine is incredible...

...and its exhaust note is like music!

Because of its sharp handling, it requires
comprehensive driving skill to master.

But if you can tame this beast, you’re well on
your way to becoming Gran Turismo royalty!
dialogues.zh:
它是GT锦标赛的传奇，也是终极的赛车。

首届锦标赛冠军伊戈尔·弗拉加和2019年度冠军
米迦勒·希扎尔……

驾驶着这款比赛机器在摩纳哥举行的2018年总决赛中杀得
难解难分。

我永远不会忘记最后宣布冠军那一刻赛场里迸发的热烈
气氛！

3升自然进气引擎的响应速度十分傲人……

它的排气声响听起来也极其美妙！

灵敏的操控意味着你需要拥有全面的驾驶技术才能够驾
驭它。

如果你能够驯服这头猛兽，相信你的跑车浪漫旅比赛传奇之路
会一路畅通！

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
I think that the Fugu Z is a very appealing car.

The interior is especially cool because it's so carefully
stripped down.

Only the bare minimum parts have been added,
which match the car's power output that has nearly doubled.

The original 240Z was straightforward and had
beautiful proportions...

...and this car is respectful of that with its
minimal customization.

Look at the original fender mirrors, they're in the
original Kilimanjaro White color.

It was as if a young person from California came upon
a Z that was a bit rough around the edges...

...and polished it with the admiration he had of the car
in the past.

And now...

...the raw pureness of the spirit of the
1973 Z shines brightly in the Fugu Z.

Thank you, Sung Kang!
dialogues.zh:
我觉得Fugu Z是一辆充满魅力的车。

内饰经过了非常细致的精简，显得尤其炫酷。

这款车只最低限度地安装了必要的改装件，
与之相对的是几乎翻倍的动力输出。

原始车型240Z的设计本身就很简约，
但有着优美的车身比例……

……这台车很好地延续了这一风格，只进行了极少量的改装。

你瞧瞧这原版的挡泥板上装后视镜，
连油漆都是原版的乞力马扎罗白。

就好像是有个加州的年轻人遇上了一辆老爷车Z，
感怀它的破旧不堪……

……就抱着自己对这辆车的情怀对它进行了打磨。

而现在……

……1973 Z那最纯粹、最原始的精神
在Fugu Z的身上得到了灿烂重现。

姜成镐，谢谢你的付出！)

内饰经过了非常细致的精简，显得尤其炫酷。

这款车只最低限度地安装了必要的改装件，
与之相对的是几乎翻倍的动力输出。

原始车型240Z的设计本身就很简约，
但有着优美的车身比例……

……这台车很好地延续了这一风格，只进行了极少量的改装。

你瞧瞧这原版的挡泥板上装后视镜，
连油漆都是原版的乞力马扎罗白。

就好像是有个加州的年轻人遇上了一辆老爷车Z，
感怀它的破旧不堪……

……就抱着自己对这辆车的情怀对它进行了打磨。

而现在……

……1973 Z那最纯粹、最原始的精神
在Fugu Z的身上得到了灿烂重现。

姜成镐，谢谢你的付出！)

brandCentral.en:
The Fugu Z stemmed from the imagination of actor Sung Kang, who's
best known for his role in the "Fast and Furious" series.

The car is based on a 1973 Datsun 240Z.

The body kit was supplied by popular custom manufacturer
Rocket Bunny.

Under its hood is the RB26DETT from the GT-R sans turbos.

The combination of its stylish exterior and high-tech engine
makes the Fugu worthy of being in the next FF movie.

It certainly impressed us. It won the Gran Turismo's
Best in Show Award at the 2015 SEMA show.
brandCentral.zh:
Fugu Z是《速度与激情》演员姜成镐（Sung Kang）心中的梦幻
车款。

它的改装原型是一台1973年的Datsun 240Z。

车身套件则来自于人气很高的外观定制商Rocket Bunny。

就连它的引擎都是一款独一无二的工程产物。

那是一台Skyline GT-R引以为傲的著名引擎RB26DETT，不过改造成了
自然进气模式。

难怪这辆小宝贝在2015年的美国汽车用品改装协会大展上
赢得了Gran Turismo的最佳巡展奖。>

vehicleCollection.en:
This "poisonous" 240Z, which won the 2015 GT Award, packed a naturally-aspirated RB26 engine.

The big winner of the 2015 Gran Turismo Awards at SEMA was this S30 Datsun Z, nicknamed the “Fugu Z.” The car was built by actor Sung Kang, known for his role in "The Fast and the Furious” movie franchise. When he purchased the car, it was a stock 1973 240Z, but it soon became something quite different and very special.

The "Rocket Bunny" body kit gives the reborn Z aggressive good looks, consisting of wide fender flares and stylish front and rear spoilers. Not just for show, the car comes equipped with a naturally-aspirated version of the RB26DETT engine, pulled from a Skyline GT-R. Thanks to some fine tuning, the inline-6 produces 220ps, but feed it E85 IndyCar fuel, and that total jumps to more than 300ps.

To handle this newfound power, a roll cage was installed to strengthen the body. Weight-saving measures were implemented to the car's dashboard and console, which were custom made by CarbonSignal.

The name of the car, “Fugu,” refers to the Japanese poisonous blow fish. Its organs are so toxic that anyone not taking proper precautions when handling the fish may die... and, we suppose, the same can be said about this car.
vehicleCollection.zh:
2015年GT大奖获胜者，这款“有毒的”240Z使用的是自然进气的RB26引擎。

在2015年美国汽车用品改装车展览会上，跑车浪漫旅大奖的获胜者是一辆S30 Datsun Z，昵称为“Fugu Z”。这辆车是由《速度与激情》系列电影中的知名演员姜成镐一手打造。这辆车的原型是他以原厂状态购入的一辆1973年款240Z，并按照他指定的规格进行了定制改装。

外观方面最引入注目的特征自然是一套包含超宽挡泥板和前后扰流板的“火箭兔”宽体套件。当然了，这款车并不只有外表。它的内在核心是一台久负盛名的Skyline GT-R RB26DETT引擎，改成自然进气后通过机械调校将动力提高到了220ps。当使用E85印地赛车燃油时，这台引擎可以输出约300ps。

为了承受庞大的动力，车身内部不得不焊接上防滚架。而为了减轻车身重量，这辆车的仪表板和控制面板都由CarbonSignal进行了定制。

这辆车的名字“Fugu”在日语里是河豚的意思。这种鱼毒性极强，如果不经过妥善处理就食用的话，可能会致死。对于这台车来说，也是如此。

brandCentral.en:
This 1971 Ford Maverick was built by Greening Auto Company
(GAC), a custom car builder in the U.S.

It made history when it took the GT Award...

...at the 2018 SEMA Show, the world’s largest event for
automotive aftermarket products.

The original Ford Maverick was an affordable and practical
compact coupe.

But for this custom job, the chassis was rebuilt
with genuine racing architecture.

The car's 7.0-liter Windsor V-8, widely considered
to be a Ford masterpiece...

...has been tuned to deliver an unbelievable
1,200 horsepower!

In 2019, this GAC Maverick registered a top speed
of <326km/h>.?
brandCentral.zh:
这辆1971 Ford Maverick是由美国定制汽车制造商
Greening Auto Company（“GAC”）制造的。

这是一台创造了历史的车……

它在2018年的世界顶级定制汽车年度盛会
——SEMA展会上获得了GT大奖。

Ford Maverick原本只是一款经济实用的紧凑型双门轿车。

但这辆改装车就不一样了，它的底盘按照
真正的赛车结构重新打造……

并安装了一台经过调校的7L Windsor V8引擎，
后者是公认的Ford引擎杰作。

我可不是信口雌黄，要知道它可以输出
高达1200马力的动力！

在2019年，这辆GAC Maverick跑出了
令人折服的<326km/h>最高速度记录。

vehicleCollection.en:
A vicious hot rod with 1200HP and a nostalgic body

The SEMA Show takes place every year in November in Las Vegas, Nevada. At the world’s largest automotive aftermarket festival, Gran Turismo handpicked standout vehicles for its prestigious Gran Turismo Awards. In 2018, the "Best of Show" honors went to the 1971 Ford Maverick, created by Greening Auto Company (GAC).

The Maverick was originally an affordable compact coupe built on the Ford Falcon chassis. GAC transformed the Maverick into a monster hot rod that blended extreme performance with street-friendly drivability.

The exterior's lowered ride height and flared fenders immediately turned heads, but the real showstopper was found under the hood. In the engine compartment resided Ford's famous 7.0-liter small-block Windsor V-8. Packing not one, but two turbochargers, GAC claimed the engine unleashed a staggering 1216ps. But it wasn't all about raw, unadulterated power—adjustable engine control logic allowed for the car to cruise comfortably around town.

In the spring of 2019, this Maverick took on a top speed challenge, setting a record of 202.748 mph (approximately <326km/h>). This car was truly a rare masterpiece where nostalgia and cutting-edge technology seamlessly blended together.
vehicleCollection.zh:
在怀旧车身中塞进1200制动马力引擎的改装神车。

美国汽车用品改装车展览会每年11月在美国的拉斯维加斯举办。在这场世界上最大的定制汽车盛会上，《跑车浪漫旅》会评出获得“跑车浪漫旅大奖”的汽车。而2018年的“最佳巡展”得主就是这辆由格林宁汽车公司（GAC）制造的1971年福特翼虎。

这台车的原型是一辆廉价的紧凑型双门跑车，基于福特猎鹰的底盘打造。但格林宁汽车公司却将这辆翼虎改造成了可在城市街道上合法行驶的“怪物级”改装车。

在外观上，最先抓住所有人眼球的是降低后的车身以及外扩的挡泥板。但它最大的亮点藏在引擎盖下——里面安装的是一台福特鼎鼎大名的7升Windsor V8 Small Block引擎。此外，它的涡轮增压器不是一个，而是两个！据介绍，这套动力单元能产生高达1216ps的动力。但它却不是一匹无法驾驭的马力怪兽，通过引擎开闭控制，你甚至可以在城市悠闲地巡航。

在2019年春天，这辆翼虎接受了一次最高速度的挑战，创造了202.748英里/小时的纪录。通过将怀旧审美和尖端技术结合，格林宁汽车公司创造出了这样一台绝无仅有的车型。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
The long and storied history of Japanese kei cars
has seen many sporty versions of the genre.

And the Honda Beat stood out because
it was mid-engine and a convertible!

While the NSX may be Honda’s original
mid-engine sports car...

...the Beat boasts the same front/rear
weight distribution.

No one ever imagined a kei car with a
centrally located engine and an open body...

...that is, until Honda created the Beat!
dialogues.zh:
在日式轻型车漫长而丰富的历史上，
出现过许多这种小型跑车。

这款Honda Beat因为采用敞篷设计而显得独树一帜！

Beat采用了与Honda旗下设计出众的中置跑车NSX

近似的配重平衡，

并且在中置布局上安装了一款开放式单体车壳车身……

这也使它成为了世界上第一款采用这种设计的车型！
<

dialogues.speaker: Fabio Filippini
dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
Here, we have the cute Honda Beat...

...a symbol of the Japanese two-seat
convertible kei-car category, born in the 1990s.

The car was a result from a historic collaboration
between Honda and Pininfarina.

Its clean and simple design perfectly envelops
the super compact mid-engine package.

It features side air inlets, but also a "clamshell" front hood
and aerodynamically side mirrors.

The perforated steel rims and
the motorcycle-like instrument cluster...

...they both contribute to reinforce
the basic and sporty spirit of the car.

A special mention goes to the zebra-striped fabric of the seats.

They were a typical 1990s Japanese fashionable trend.
dialogues.zh:
看，这就是我们可爱的本田Beat……

……日本双座敞篷轻型车类别诞生于20世纪90年代，
而它就相当于这一类别的象征符号之一。

这台车是本田和宾尼法利纳历史性合作的成果。

它的设计简洁而精巧，将一台超紧凑的中置引擎套件
安装在后轴上。

除了侧面进气口，它还配备了“蚌壳形”的前引擎盖
和集成空气动力学效应的侧后视镜。

孔洞式的钢轮毂和类似摩托车的仪表组……

……无不在强调这辆车走的是朴实、运动的路线。

特别值得一提的是座椅套上的斑马纹路，
这可是走在20世纪90年代日本的时尚潮流前列。

usedCar.en:
Those in the market for a reasonable mid-engine sports car
won't be disappointed with this one.

The Honda Beat was built in accordance with Japanese "kei
car" specifications.

It features a naturally-aspirated inline-3 engine, with
individual throttle-bodies on all three cylinders.

There's some motorcycle technology in this unit because
it can rev to 8000rpm.

Because of its sporty nature and mid-engine layout,
it was often referred to as a baby NSX.

Although it was marketed only in Japan, the car
developed a following around the world.
usedCar.zh:
如果想在市场上寻觅价格合理的中置引擎
跑车，那么这款车必定不会让你失望。

Honda Beat按照日本轻型车标准制造。

它采用自然进气三缸引擎，且三个气缸
全部带有独立节流阀。

这款惊艳的车型能够在日常使用中将转速
提高到超过8000rpm。

这样的轻型跑车在20世纪90年的日本
格外受欢迎...

而Beat则因身处这一潮流的最前沿而闻名。

vehicleCollection.en:
This wonderful kei sports car offered style and driving excitement never before seen in Japan.

The Beat defied every kei-car convention and was an instant "classic in the making" for Honda. Not only was it a convertible — a very rare attribute for kei cars — it had a mid-engine layout, making the Beat totally unique.

The little Honda measured 3295mm from bumper to bumper, sat 1395mm wide and 1175mm tall. What's especially notable is the Beat's curb weight of only 760kg. The mass was distributed front and rear just like a large exotic car, with 43 percent of its weight over the front wheels and 53 over rear. The engine, which was situated immediately behind the cabin, was a 656cc naturally-aspirated inline-3 that produced 64ps. Despite being classified as a kei engine, it was quite high-tech, featuring a multi-joint throttle and an engine control system that trickled down from the company’s Formula 1 program. A 5-speed manual gearbox managed the power sent to the rear wheels.

The Beat's handling was in a league of its own. The suspension was tuned for sporty driving, and Honda incorporated different size wheels for the front (13 in.) and rear (14 in.). The brakes were excellent, being fitted with discs at all four corners, the first for a kei car.

Despite the somewhat pricey nature of the Beat, Honda ended up selling 33,672 of this svelte convertible until production was halted in 1996.
vehicleCollection.zh:
可爱的2座轻型车，开起来乐趣十足。

1991年登场的本田Beat与铃木Cappuccino和马自达AZ-1等车款一起，开创了轻量型两座跑车的风潮。

该车的尺寸为3295mm长，1395mm宽，1175mm高，整车重量仅有760公斤。该车为两座配置，没有配备防滚架。尽管车顶蓬需要手动折叠，但因为整车轻量化的特性，即便一个人也可以轻松打开或者关闭。

车身的重量分配也相当理想，43%位于前部，57%位于后部，后部尾翼配备了进气道来冷却发动机。为了追求完美的操控性，前后轮采用了不同尺寸的轮胎，前轮为13英寸，后轮为14英寸。刹车也按照性能级别车进行了配置，首次在轻量型车款上配备了四轮碟刹。

656cc直列三缸自然吸气引擎可输出64ps的动力，并配备了来自F1技术的多段油门和动力控制系统。变速箱为5速手动，档位行程调校得很短。内饰也相当特别，加入了三个摩托车式样的仪表，和玩心浓厚的斑马条纹配饰座椅。

用户对该款车的评价是令人心悦的。不需要去找蜿蜒颠簸的路段，在熟悉的街道上驾驶同样能享受跑车的行驶乐趣。本田Beat的生产持续到了1996年，总销量达到了33672辆。尽管售价不菲，本田Beat仍然是一辆闪耀的优秀跑车，有不少人希望本田能够继续生产它。

One of my all-time favorite cars is an 1980s icon—
the fourth-generation Civic.

With its powerful engine, this Civic Si
was the pride of the hatchback pack.

Civics of this era ranged from smart and chic sedans
to uniquely designed 5-door wagons like the Shuttle.

And each was beautiful
in its own way!

我的毕生挚爱之一诞生于80年代
——那就是第四代Civic。

这台搭载强劲引擎的Civic Si掀背版，堪称
家族的门面担当。

这一时期的Civic车系从优雅时髦的四门轿车，
到造型独特的Shuttle五门瓦罐车，应有尽有。

每款车型都绽放着独特的美！

usedCar.en:
Good timing! I just received a stylish hot hatch—a 4th-gen
EF Civic Si, also known as the Grand Civic.

Civics are often associated with VTEC technology, but this
Si is powered by an older ZC engine.

The ZC was Honda’s first DOHC engine since the S800, which
made its debut fourteen years prior.

Although its 130 horsepower doesn't seem that impressive,
the engine's long-stroke design provides torque at low speeds.

The car's body is light and compact, and its double-wishbone
suspension is sheer perfection.

A major player in touring car races, the Civic was one
of the most iconic hot hatches of the 1980s.
usedCar.zh:
你来的真巧！我刚刚收了一辆风采依旧的高性能掀背车
——第4代EF Civic Si，又被称作“Grand Civic”。

Civic虽以VTEC技术闻名，但这辆Si搭载的却是
老款的ZC引擎。

它是Honda自S800以来的首款DOHC引擎。
而S800，已经是十四年前的车了。

130马力看似平平，但其长行程设计能在低速时
提供充沛的扭矩。

车身轻巧紧凑，双叉臂悬架近乎完美。

作为房车赛场上的主力军，Civic俨然是80年代
最具标志性的性能掀背车。

vehicleCollection.en:
A dominating force on the touring car circuit, this fourth-generation Civic features the famous ZC engine.

In 1987, the Civic underwent a full model change, ushering in its fourth generation. It was known as the Grand Civic or simply by its model code "EF."

While retaining the key design elements of its predecessor, the exterior featured modern refinements on a slightly larger body. One of the most notable updates was the new platform, which introduced a 4-wheel double-wishbone suspension system. The wheelbase was also substantially extended, enhancing stability and delivering a sportier handling experience.

The lineup remained diverse, offering four body styles: a 3-door hatchback, 4-door sedan, 5-door shuttle, and the "Pro" commercial model. The Si sport variants, powered by 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4, were also carried over from the previous generation. A new "Si Extra" grade was introduced, combining the Si's sporty essence with an enhanced suite of equipment.

The ZC engine received extensive tuning, including a higher compression ratio, improved intake and exhaust flow, and reduced piston friction. The result was a maximum net output of 130ps and 14.7kgm of torque. The previous "Wonder Civic" era boasted 135ps and 15.5kgm; however, these were gross figures. However, when adjusted for the 15% difference between gross and net measurements, the new ZC engine proved to be more powerful.

The Si and Si Extra models also made a strong impression in motorsports, such as the Japan Touring Car Championship (JTC). Making its debut in the 1988 season, the Civic claimed its first victory in Round 3 and went on to secure both the drivers and manufacturers titles. The following year, the car repeated its success, capturing the manufacturers title once again.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款称霸房车赛场的第四代思域搭载了久负盛名的ZC发动机。+

1987年，思域进行了全面换代，拉开了第四代车型的序幕。这代车型通常被称为“Grand Civic”，或以其车型代码简称为“EF”。

外观设计保留了前代的主要特征，在略微增大的车身上融入了现代化元素。最显著的改变之一是全新的底盘平台，配备了四轮双叉臂悬挂系统。轴距的显著加长，让驾驶者在享受运动化操控的同时获得更出色的稳定性。

车系阵容延续了此前的组合，推出四大车型，包括三门掀背车、四门轿车、五门旅行车以及“Pro”商用版本。承袭自上一代的还有搭载1.6L DOHC直列四缸引擎的“Si”运动版本。在此之上，这一代还新增了“Si Extra”级别，在Si的基础上增添了丰富的配置。

ZC引擎经过全面调校，包括提高压缩比、改善进排气流通性、降低活塞摩擦等多项改进。最终实现了130ps的最大动力输出和14.7kgm的扭矩净值。虽然上一代“Wonder Civic”就曾宣称达到135ps和15.5kgm的数据，但那是总动力输出值。由于净值通常比总值低15%，这意味着新款ZC引擎实际上更为强劲。

Si和Si Extra车型还在日本房车锦标赛等赛事中大显身手。在首次参赛的1988赛季，该车在第3站首次夺魁，并摘得当年的车手总冠军和制造商总冠军。在1989赛季，这款赛车再次展现硬实力，成功卫冕制造商总冠军。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
I know this Civic very well!

It's the car known as the "Sports Civic" from the 1990s
—the fifth-generation "EG" model to be precise.

The "Sports" moniker alone should tell you that it’s fast,
but its engine design and sound are second to none.

You often see these cars tuned in all manner of ways.

What do I like best about tuning a Sports Civic, you ask?

The engine swaps, of course!

For example, a Honda K-engine with a large displacement
will give you great sound, speed, and power.

But my favorite would have to be the Type R
B-engine.

It might not offer as much power as the K-engine,
but its roar is simply unforgettable!
dialogues.zh:
我对这种类型的思域非常熟悉！

准确来说，这是一辆1990年代生产，被称为“运动思域”
的第五代“EG”思域。

从其昵称中的“运动”二字就能看出它的速度有多快，
此外它的引擎设计和声浪也无出其右。

你经常会看到这款车被调校成各种不同的形态。

你知道关于运动思域的调校，我最爱哪一方面吗？

当然是更换改装引擎啦！

比如说，大排量的本田K-引擎可以给你澎湃的声浪、
风驰电掣的速度和充沛的动力。

不过我的最爱还是Type R B-引擎。

虽然动力不如K-引擎，但它的咆哮声绝对令人
终生难忘！

usedCar.en:
Compact, lightweight and low to the ground, with an
aggressive yet attractive body style...

...the fifth-generation Civic, introduced in 1991, is the
quintessential compact performance car.

Many consider this model to be one of the best handling FF
(front engine/front-wheel drive) cars on the planet.

The top-of-the-line SiR･II came equipped with a naturally
aspirated 1.6-liter DOHC VTEC engine.

It featured a double-wishbone suspension and quick-ratio steering
system that made the car efficient through corners.

It was, and remains, the pride of Japan. The Civic is still popular
today, thanks to predecessors like this 1991 model.
usedCar.zh:
小巧、轻灵、贴地，采用了高转速、自然吸气引擎

——如果你想寻找一辆特别适合运动驾驶的车，
那么这辆思域运动版就是首选！

1991年推出的第5代思域
是一款前置引擎、前轮驱动（或简称前置前驱）运动型轿车。

产品线中的顶配版本SiR･II装备了
一部1.6升双顶置凸轮轴可变气门正时和升程电子控制系统引擎……

并采用了双叉臂设计，在悬挂和转向性能之间取得了精确的平衡。

这辆紧凑型运动车款是日本的骄傲，更得到了广大车迷的青睐。
放到如今这个时代，可谓独步天下。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line fifth-generation Civic balances speed with comfort.

Honda introduced the fifth-generation Civic in 1991. Its VTEC engine made it much faster than the outgoing model. It came as a 3-door hatchback, the "Ferio" 4-door, and the 5-door shuttle.

Thanks to the evolution of the VTEC system, more variants were added to the engine mix. The base models came with a carbureted 1.3-liter and 1.5-liter inline-4, while more upscale cars had a 1.5-liter SOHC VTEC and a fuel efficient 1.5-liter VTEC-E. The top-of-the-line car, SiR, boasted the high-performance 1.6-liter DOHC VTEC.

All Civics featured Honda's new double wishbone suspension. The SiR model, which epitomized the "Sports Civic," produced 10ps more power than the previous car, totaling 170ps.

The SiR's suspension system had a revised spring rate biased towards better performance. As with previous models, the SiR came in at a lower weight because many luxury amenities were deleted. However, the SiR･II catered to those who enjoyed comfort, with such things as air conditioning, power windows, and a genuine leather wrapped steering wheel as part of its equipment.

New for the SiR･II was the addition of a 4-speed automatic transmission. While the 5-speed manual gearbox's close gear ratios were tuned for winding roads, the new 4-speed automatic model was developed to deliver more torque at low to medium speeds. The automatic transmission scored big with fans, attracting a wider range of users.
vehicleCollection.zh:
在速度和舒适性之间取得完美平衡的第5代思域顶配版本。

在1991年9月，思域的接力棒交到了第5代车型手中。它装备了VTEC引擎，速度也更上一层楼。整个产品组合中包含了3门掀背车和全新命名的“Ferio”4门轿车。而前一代中的5门旅行车版本也得到了保留。

由于VTEC系统得到了长足的发展，引擎种类也变得五花八门。基础车型配备了1.3升和1.5升汽化器引擎。而更高一档的车型配备了驾驶感更佳的1.5升顶置单凸轮轴VTEC引擎，以及燃油效率更高的1.5升VTEC-E引擎。车系中的顶配车型被冠以了SiR之名，采用了高性能1.6升双顶置凸轮轴VTEC引擎。

全系车型均采用了本田全新标配的双叉臂悬挂。作为“运动思域”品牌的门面，SiR版本能够输出的动力比前代车型提高了10ps，达到了170ps。

另外在悬挂方面，其弹簧刚度和悬挂行程拉伸量等参数也得到了改进，更加强调运动性。和前代车型相同，SiR也致力于通过简化配置来减轻车重，而SiR･II版本则提供全套的舒适性配置，例如全自动空调、电动车窗和真皮包裹方向盘等。

SiR･II车型的新装备包括了可选的4速自动变速箱。其5速手动变速箱版本使用了针对蜿蜒道路调校的密齿轮比，而全新的4速自动变速箱版本则为了在中低速下提升扭矩进行特别调校，降低了最大功率和扭矩参数。不论定位如何，这款全新自动挡型号的推出取得了巨大的成功，而思域的运动形象也被推广到了更广大的用户群体之中。

dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
This is the first Civic that wore the Type “R” designation.

This model started the tradition that continues to this day.

When compared to the latest Type “R” model,
it was much purer and simpler.

It shows that times have changed during the past 20 years,
like an evolution of a sneaker design.
dialogues.zh:
这是第一款得到“Type R”命名的Civic。

也开启了延续至今的传统。

与最新的Type R车型相比，它更加纯粹和简洁。

它展示了过去20年间的车型变化。就像
运动鞋设计的演变一样。

usedCar.en:
No matter the year or model, the Honda Civic has always
been a popular choice for young driving enthusiasts.

But perhaps among the most appreciated of all the Civics
was the EK Type R.

Its naturally-aspirated VTEC powerplant revved like a race car
engine and delivered excellent torque.

Armed with VTEC, it packed an incredible 185ps punch
for a 1.6 liter inline-4.

The engine was so durable that some aftermarket firms powered
it up even more by adding forced induction.

Combine this engine with the car's lightweight body, and you
had one of the most potent cars on the planet.
usedCar.zh:
很多不同型号的Honda Civic受欢迎程度
经年不衰。

但是说到纯粹的驾驶体验，
这辆EK Type R就少有对手。

它的超高扭矩自然进气VTEC引擎是
Honda最伟大的成就之一。

排气量只有1.6L，
却提供足足185ps的马力！

即使是引擎转动的方式都令人着迷：
锋利又轻盈，几乎像是越野摩托！

轻量级的低高度车身使得它成为一款
操控性优良的车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
This car represented the first Type R model that eventually dominated circuits around the world.

When you talk about hot Honda Civics, surely the 6th iteration of this compact-car icon that first appeared in 1972 would take the forefront of the conversation. The car known in-house as the "EK" and dubbed by Civic loyalists as the "Miracle Civic" arrived in 1995. It boasted excellent fuel economy, high output three-stage VTEC, and a CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission) called the Honda Multimatic.

It came in 3-door hatchback and sedan forms, the latter called the Ferio in Japan. This Civic won Japan's prestigious Car of the Year award, as well as racking up a number of different honors all over the world. In August 1997, Honda introduced a "Type R" variant, which was based on the Civic hatchback. It was the first "Type R" model in Civic's history.

The engine of the Civic Type R was a B16B, a 1.6-liter DOHC 16-valve inline-4, equipped with VTEC. The engine cranked out an amazing 185ps/8200rpm, figures previously unheard of in a naturally aspirated engine. Also, it was lighter than the other Civics, making it that much quicker off the line.

The car was also an excellent handling machine thanks to a lowered body and firmer suspension. Naturally, the Type R made for an exceptional racer, with many victories in Grassroots Motorsports and in Japan's Super Taikyu endurance series. Even after all these years, the car still has a loyal following.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第一款称霸全球赛道的Type R。

本田思域起源于1972年，是一款经久不衰的车型。第6代EK思域的主流车型在1995年面市，又叫做奇迹思域。它采用高燃油效率、高输出的3冲程VTEC引擎，以及名为本田Multimatic的无级变速箱。

2年后的1997年8月，第6代思域的Type R型号首次亮相。它以3门掀背款为基础，是思域产品线首次推出的Type R，因而吸引了不少关注。

Type R思域使用的是B16B 1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸16气门引擎，配合VTEC，这台自然进气引擎在8200rpm时能输出惊人的185ps。它的车身和其他Type R一样经过减重，悬挂系统则更低也更硬，并配置了加大版四轮碟刹和竞速型防抱死刹车系统。

轻盈、紧凑、高性能的思域Type R在赛场上表现十分活跃，甚至催生了思域单一车种赛。它还多次参加日本超级耐久赛等多项赛事，在离最初发售的10年后，这款Type R仍然受到大量业余车手的喜爱。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
This is a first-generation Honda Civic Type R.

What's really special about this car is its specially-tuned
1.6L naturally-aspirated straight-four engine.

Just wait till you hear its thrilling roar and exhaust note—
you'll think you're driving a genuine racing car!

The effect is really amazing, especially when you go
from the 6000rpm to over 8000rpm.

Since it was based on a front-wheel drive car, the Type R
was originally marketed at an affordable price.

But nowadays its value has been reassessed
owing to its exceptional performance.
dialogues.zh:
这是第一代Honda Civic Type R。

这款车的独到之处在于配备专门调校过的
1.6L自然吸气直列四缸引擎。

当你听到这辆车亢奋的引擎声和排气声时，你会以为
自己在开一辆真正的赛车！

具备惊人的性能，特别是从6000rpm
加速到8000rpm以上时，效果更为震撼。

Type R是前轮驱动的车款，因此起初的定价相当实惠。

但如今，由于其优异的性能，所以已经重新定价了。

This EK model was the first 'Type R' Civic.

Despite its light size and weight, it boasts a high-revving
naturally-aspirated engine that can produce 185ps.

Its body was extensively reworked with an eye towards
enhanced rigidity and weight reduction.

The base chassis was of a newer generation than that of
the first Integra Type R model.

Though small in stature, its speed is undeniable.

This particular variant is a late-model release. The bumper
and light detailing differ slightly from earlier designs.
usedCar.zh:
这款EK是最早的CiviC “Type R”。

虽然它尺寸小，重量轻，但仍搭载了一台能产生185ps马力的高转速自然
吸气引擎。

它的底盘也经过了大幅改造，减轻了重量，
增强了刚性。

这辆车的基础底盘比第一款Integra Type R
先进了一代。

虽然体量小，但它的速度是毋容置疑的。

这款车是较晚推出的款型，保险杠和车灯的细节
与先前推出的款型稍有不同。%

Type R思域使用的是B16B 1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸16气门引擎，配合VTEC，这台自然进气引擎在8200rpm时能输出惊人的185ps。它的车身和其他Type R一样经过减重，悬挂系统则更低也更硬，并配置了加大版四轮碟刹和竞速型防抱死刹车系统。

轻盈、紧凑、高性能的思域Type R在赛场上表现十分活跃，甚至催生了思域单一车种赛。它还多次参加日本超级耐久赛等多项赛事，在离最初发售的10年后，这款Type R仍然受到大量业余车手的喜爱。

catch.en: This car represented the first Type R model that eventually dominated circuits around the world.
catch.zh: 第1款称霸全球赛道的Type R。

long.en:
When you talk about hot Honda Civics, surely the 6th iteration of this compact-car icon that first appeared in 1972 would take the forefront of the conversation. The car known in-house as the "EK" and dubbed by Civic loyalists as the "Miracle Civic" arrived in 1995. It boasted excellent fuel economy, high output three-stage VTEC, and a CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission) called the Honda Multimatic.

It came in 3-door hatchback and sedan forms, the latter called the Ferio in Japan. This Civic won Japan's prestigious Car of the Year award, as well as racking up a number of different honors all over the world. In August 1997, Honda introduced a "Type R" variant, which was based on the Civic hatchback. It was the first "Type R" model in Civic's history.

The engine of the Civic Type R was a B16B, a 1.6-liter DOHC 16-valve inline-4, equipped with VTEC. The engine cranked out an amazing 185ps/8200rpm, figures previously unheard of in a naturally aspirated engine. Also, it was lighter than the other Civics, making it that much quicker off the line.

The car was also an excellent handling machine thanks to a lowered body and firmer suspension. Naturally, the Type R made for an exceptional racer, with many victories in grassroots motorsports and in Japan's Super Taikyu endurance series. Even after all these years, the car still has a loyal following.

vehicleCollection.en:
The first Type R model tuned by Gran Turismo.

This is an original tuned model created by Gran Turismo, based on the Honda Civic Type R (EK) '97.

The following is the description of the base model:

The Civic has been a long-standing Honda staple since its debut in 1972. It reached new heights with the sixth-generation EK model in 1995. Often referred to as the “Miracle Civic,” it featured a high-output, fuel-efficient 3-stage VTEC engine and introduced the Honda Multimatic.

It was offered as a sporty 3-door hatchback and a more refined 4-door sedan known as the Ferio. Praised for its innovation and well-rounded performance, this Civic won Japan’s Car of the Year.

Then, in August 1997, Honda unveiled a true game-changer—the very first Civic Type R. Based on the 3-door hatchback, this high-performance variant captured widespread attention.

At the heart of the Civic Type R was the B16B—a 1.6-liter inline-4 DOHC 16-valve engine featuring Honda’s signature VTEC system. Remarkably, despite being naturally aspirated, it delivered an impressive 185ps at a 8200rpm. True to the Type R philosophy, the body was lightened for sharper performance, and the chassis was upgraded with stiffer, lower suspension, enlarged 4-wheel disc brakes, and sport-tuned ABS.

It also came standard with Recaro bucket seats, perfectly contoured for spirited driving, and a compact MOMO steering wheel with an integrated airbag. Finished in the iconic Championship White, it featured distinctive touches like the red Honda emblem and a machined titanium shift knob—styling cues that proudly broadcast its motorsports DNA.

Lightweight, compact, and built for performance, the Civic Type R sparked dedicated one-make race series and actively competed in events like the Super Taikyu endurance championship. Even a decade after its debut, it remained a beloed choice among amateur racers.

跑车浪漫旅特别调校的第一款Type R车型。

这是《跑车浪漫旅》以本田思域Type R (EK) '97为基础，调校制作的原创车型。

以下是针对原始车型的介绍：

本田思域起源于1972年，是一款经久不衰的车型。第6代EK思域的主流车型在1995年面市，又叫做奇迹思域。它采用高燃油效率、高输出的3段VTEC引擎，以及名为本田Multimatic的无级变速箱。

车型有3门掀背款和4门轿车款可选（后者叫做Ferio），收获了众多不错的评价，甚至当选日本年度风云车。

2年后的1997年8月，第6代思域的Type R型号首次亮相。它以3门掀背款为基础，是思域产品线首次推出的Type R，因而吸引了不少关注。

Type R思域使用的是B16B，这是一台1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸16气门引擎，配合VTEC技术，这台自然进气引擎在8200rpm时能输出惊人的185ps。和其他Type R一样，它的车身接受了减重，悬挂系统更硬也降得更低，并配置了加大版四轮碟刹和竞速型防抱死刹车系统。

此外，它还标配竞速向的Recaro赛车桶椅和加装安全气囊的小尺寸MOMO方向盘。它的“冠军白”车身涂装、本田红头标和钛合金换挡杆头大大凸显了它的竞速形象。

轻盈、紧凑、高性能的思域Type R在赛场上表现十分活跃，甚至催生了思域单一车种赛的举办。它还积极参加日本超级耐久赛等多项赛事。在最初发售的10年后，这款Type R仍然受到大量业余车手的喜爱。

vehicleCollection.en:
One of the world's most beloved pocket rockets comes back with a vengeance."

When most people hear the name “Honda Civic,” they tend to envision an efficient compact people hauler known for its great fuel economy, but for people like us, we immediately think of the Type R, one of the best little pocket rockets in the world.

The Civic Type R was first introduced in 1997 and immediately developed a loyal following, thanks to its powerful high-revving engine and remarkable handling character. It went away in 2012, only to return in 2015, with the introduction of the fourth-generation Civic.

The European 5-door model served as the foundation for the car, but the Type R was a completely different animal, as attested by its exterior appearance. It sported a large front spoiler, rear wing, side skirts and rear diffuser, all of which not only spiced up the car’s appearance, but were functional aerodynamic parts. Honda engineers spent months perfecting these pieces in the wind tunnel to minimize the Civic Type R’s air resistance and improve downforce. Also, wider front and rear fenders were adopted to make room for wider tires.

Under the hood was a dedicated direct-injection turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with VTEC. This rev-happy engine delivered a whopping 310ps and 40.8kgm of torque, making it the most powerful Type R ever. It was the quickest and fastest Civic ever too, as it ran from zero to <100km/h> in 5.7 seconds, and reached a top speed of <270km/h>.

The fourth-generation Type R lapped the Nürburgring Nordschleife in 7 minutes, 50.63 sec., setting a record for front-wheel-drive production cars.
vehicleCollection.zh:
人气车型成功回归，在纽博格林北侧赛道创下商业前驱赛车的单圈纪录。

思域Type R是一台源于本田思域家族的跑车，自从在1997年首次亮相以来，它一直都让全球的跑车爱好者兴奋不已。

它的历史在2012年被划上了休止符，但是在2015年重生的第四代思域又卷土重来。

它的原始车型是欧洲的第九代5门款。其外部带有一个大尺寸的前扰流板、尾翼、侧围板、以及尾翼扰流翼。这些设置不仅仅是为了酷炫，这些都是在不断的风洞测试和路试之后进行的改进，它们可以尽量减少车辆的风阻，从而提高下压力。就连前后挡泥板都是为了更好地配合宽轮胎而设置的。

该车的动力系统配备了2.0升直喷涡轮增压直列式VTEC 4缸引擎，它能产出310ps功率与40.8kgm扭矩的动力，为Type R系列带来前所未有的动力输出水平。该车的0-<100km/h>加速时间仅为5.7秒，最高时速可达<270km/h>，是思域历史上性能最高的一款车。

悬挂系统使用了前轮双轴支柱，与标准思域相比，其扭矩转向降低了50%左右，该车还配备可调节的减震系统。

这台第四代Type R在纽博格林北侧赛道上的单圈时间为7分50.63秒，成功刷新了该赛道上市售前驱车的最高纪录。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
This here is the 7th generation
of the Civic Type R.

I hear it set a fabulous time at the notoriously tough
Nürburgring track in Germany.

Speaking of Honda sports cars and the Nürburgring...

...the first-generation NSX was test-driven there
during its development.

Rumor has it, after its first test run, the test driver
came back with a curious complaint.

Apparently, the car had not performed very well
"in the air."

Now, the Nürburgring is known for its elevation changes
and many "jumps."

Still, when the Honda engineers heard the news,
they were shocked.

Honda later built its own test track based on
the Nürburgring in Hokkaido, Japan.

The track is known as Takasu Proving Ground.

This new Type R was developed at the Takasu Proving Ground and the Suzuka Circuit.
dialogues.zh:
这是第七代思域Type R。

我听说它在德国以挑战难度最高而著称的纽博格林赛道上
创下了惊人的圈速记录。

说到本田的跑车和纽博格林赛道……

第一代NSX在研发期间就选择了在那里试驾。

传闻称，在首次试跑之后，试驾员给出了
一个“奇特”的负面评价，

说这辆车在“空中”的表现不佳。

这并不让人意外，因为纽博格林赛道以其起伏的路面
和许多“飞越”而闻名。

然而，当本田的工程师们听到这个消息时，还是感到十分震惊。

之后，本田在日本北海道建造了一条以纽博格林赛道为原型
的测试赛道，

该赛道被命名为“鹰栖试车场”。

这款新的Type R就是通过在鹰栖试车场和铃鹿赛道
不断测试而开发的。

这款新的Type R就是通过在鹰栖试车场和铃鹿赛道
不断测试而开发的。

brandCentral.en:
If you like sports cars at all, you can’t help but get
excited at the unveiling on a new Honda Type R.

I actually got to test-drive the predecessor to this model—
the FK8 Civic Type R.

The track was a high-speed winding road, with sharp
corners that seemed to distort my field of vision.

But in spite of the strong vertical and lateral Gs, I was
able to brake hard into each corner with ease.

I remember thinking to myself, ‘Wow! The Honda Civic Type R
is really next-level stuff!’

But just when I thought the Civic Type R had hit its peak...

Out came this FL5, which far surpassed the FK8, both
technically and in terms of driving experience.
brandCentral.zh:
如果你喜欢跑车，肯定会情不自禁地为
新款Civic Type R的亮相而振奋。

我实际试驾过这款车型的前身——FK8 Civic Type R。

测试赛道是一条蜿蜒的高速路，有不少
视野十分受限的急弯道。

尽管垂直和横向的G力都很大，我还是能够完成大力刹车，
顺畅地转过每个弯道。

我记得自己当时在想：“哇！
这款Honda Civic Type R的性能真是一流！”

结果就在我以为Civic Type R已经站在巅峰时……
这辆FL5闪亮登场。

无论是在技术规格上还是在驾驶体验上，
它都远远超越了FK8。

vehicleCollection.en:
Driving feel comes first. The legendary R badge returns for the 11th generation Civic.

The sixth version of the Civic Type R was introduced one year and three months after the world premiere of the base model, the 11th-generation "FL" Civic, which was introduced as the "Sokai (Exhilarating) Civic."

The Type R is based on the 5-door hatchback configuration. Compared to previous standard models, the FL has done away with flashy tuning car stylings. While it retains the essential elements of a sports model, such front and rear aero parts and widened fenders, it has adopted simpler, refined design.

The power unit is the definitive Type R engine, a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 K20C unit, which after an overhaul of its turbo system and other improvements, now produces 10ps and 2kgm more than the previous model for a maximum output of 330ps and 42.8kgm of torque. The engine ECU map has also been meticulously tuned to improve throttle response and low-end torque.

The suspension uses an evolution of the same 4-wheel independent Adaptive Damper System first introduced in the 2015 FK2 model Civic Type R. On the FL5, the system controls not only pitch and roll, but also introduces considerations for the vertical acceleration of unsprung components. Through this system, Honda aims to offer the same direct handling feeling on the smooth surfaces of the racing circuit as it does on uneven public roads.

Additionally, by linking the car with their smartphone, drivers can review their drive data and share videos of their trips allowing them to enjoy the Type R experience even when they're not behind the wheel.
vehicleCollection.zh:
传奇R标在第11代思域回归，以操作手感为先。

在追求“爽快”设计理念的第11代“FL”思域基础车型全球首发的一年零三个月后，六代目思域Type R也闪亮登场。

Type R版本基于思域的5门掀背车车型开发。与上几代车型相比，“FL5”思域摈弃了华而不实的改装车风格，保留了运动车型的基本元素，如前后空气动力套件和加宽挡泥板，但采用了更加简洁和精炼的设计。

动力单元更不用说，采用了Type R产品线最新的2升直列4缸涡轮增压引擎K20C。经过对涡轮系统的全面改动和引擎其他方面的优化，比早期型号又多了10ps出力，扭矩提高2kgm，使得最大动力输出和扭矩分别来到了330ps和42.8kgm。引擎电子控制单元的脉谱图也得到了专业调校，只为提高油门响应度和低扭。

悬挂方面，用于2015年“FK2”思域Type R的四轮独立自适应避震器再度进化。在“FL5”车款上，这套系统不仅兼顾对前后摇摆和左右晃动的控制，还加入了对无弹动部件的垂直加速的考量。无论是行驶在赛道的平整路面还是坑洼不平的公共道路时，本田希望这套系统都能提供同等标准的、直接的操作手感。

此外，驾驶者可以将智能手机与汽车相连，直观查看驾驶数据并分享行程视频。即便不在车中，也可以畅享Type R世界所带来的乐趣。

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The Type R is an aggressively styled 4-door
hatchback coupe.

This segment was popularized by the original VW Golf GTI.

What sets this one apart is like an action movie with lots
of special effects!

First you notice the big rear wing...

...then the aggressive front flares.

The front is emphasized by huge side nostrils
and a NACA duct on the hood!

The great stance is set up by the tires set out to the
edges and special suspension.

You'll also spot the big red Brembo brake calipers
behind the glossy black wheels.
dialogues.zh:
Type R是一款风格激进的四门掀背轿跑车。

这一细分市场最初由VW Golf GTI炒热。

这款车的特别之处在于它就像一部充满特效的动作电影！

你会首先被巨大的尾翼吸引，

然后是战斗力十足的前轮宽体。

巨大的侧裙和引擎盖上的NACA导管映衬前脸！

外突的轮胎和特殊的悬挂让其拥有出色的车身姿态。

你还会注意到闪亮黑色轮毂后的大红色
Brembo刹车卡钳。它一点也不适合那些想低调的人！

brandCentral.en:
The sixth-generation Civic Type R is also called the FK8.

It is powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 that
produces 320ps and more than 40kgm of torque.

This limited-edition car was released in 2020.

It boasts a custom-tuned suspension and is
20kg lighter than the original car.

Other notable features was its Sunlight Yellow body, which
is an homage to the first-gen Civic Type R labeled the EK9.+
brandCentral.zh:
第六代Civic Type R也被称为FK8。

它采用了一台2L直列四缸涡轮增压引擎，可以提供320ps的
马力和超过40kgm的扭矩。

这款限量版车型在2020年发布，

拥有一套定制化调校的悬挂系统，并减重20kg。

阳光黄色的配色尤其引人注目，令人不禁回想起第一代
Civic Type R EK9刚诞生时的模样。

vehicleCollection.en:
What will no doubt be a collector car someday, the limited-edition Civic Type R sold out in minutes.

In 2017, Honda took its rich history in racing and incorporated it into its popular compact sports coupe, the Civic Type R. Unlike Civic Type Rs before it, this fifth-generation model was not merely an upgraded version of the base Civic, but a car that had been developed from the ground up as a pure Type R performance machine.

The new Civic Type R's turbocharged, direct-injected 2.0-liter inline-4 was carried over from the previous model with power increased by 10ps to 320ps, thanks to the fine tuning of the engine control system. The front suspension was totally redesigned, while the rear multilink setup was significantly stiffened. All of these changes resulted in a car that set the fastest FWD lap time at the Nürburgring with a blistering time of 7 minutes 43.80 seconds.

The 2020 model took things a step further with the addition of special forged wheels and a lighter curb weight by 20lb. With a limited production run of 1000 units, the 2020 Civic Type R sold out in a matter of minutes.
vehicleCollection.zh:
经过特殊调校的限量版思域Type R。

第五代本田思域Type R的首次亮相要追溯到2017年。与前几代Type R最大的差别在于，这次的车型不再是基于标准版本思域进行性能提升后的产物，而是从一开始就专为Type R量身定制的一款车。

这样一来，各项核心技术零部件都得以采用与标准车型迥异的专项设计方案。

引擎虽然沿袭自上一代，但通过对引擎控制系统的微调，额外挤出了10ps，总动力输出提高到了320ps。这些改变有效地提升了Type R的整体速度，帮助它重新夺回了纽博格林北侧赛道量产前驱车的最速纪录：7分43.80秒。

2020年发售的限量版Type R对性能做了进一步优化。通过配备特制的锻造轮毂并拆除隔音材料，限量版又轻了20kg。性能方面则通过专属减震器和电动助力转向系统调校做了进一步完善。毫无意外，这款全球限量1000辆的车型一经面世，立即售罄。
