brandCentral.sourceName: CR-V e HEV EX BLACK EDITION ’21
brandCentral.en:
Everyone appreciates a sport utility vehicle that combines
commanding visibility with dependable off-road capability.

Enter the Honda CR-V, which was introduced in 1995. Featured
here is the fifth-generation model, launched in 2016.

Measuring 4.6m in length and 1.85m wide, it shares its
underpinnings with the tenth-generation Civic.

Notably, this was the first CR-V to offer a hybrid powertrain,
delivering impressive fuel efficiency even at highway speeds.

Spacious and comfortable—particularly in the back—it provides
more than 1,100 liters of cargo space with the rear seats folded.

Equipped with advanced driving assists tailored to modern needs,
the fifth-generation CR-V is a car for town and country.
brandCentral.zh:
有谁会不爱一款既能提供良好视野，又拥有可靠
越野性能的运动型多功能车呢？

1995年首次面世的Honda CR-V就是一辆这样的车。
这里介绍的是2016年推出的第5代车型。

它沿用了第10代Civic的平台，车身长度和宽度
分别为4.6m和1.85m。

这辆车最值得一提的特点是首次在车系中采用了
混动单元，以及在高速下拥有十分优秀的油耗。

这款车空间大，乘坐舒适，特别是后排。如果把
后排座椅放倒，还能够提供超过1100升的货运空间。

为了满足现代驾乘需求，第5代CR-V还配备了先进的
驾驶辅助技术，城市通勤和远程出行都能轻松应对。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: CR-V e HEV EX BLACK EDITION ’21
vehicleCollection.en:
The fifth-generation model of this popular SUV is the first to feature a hybrid system.

In the 1990s, Honda embarked on creating vehicles tailored for leisure, coining the term “Creative Movers” to define this new category. The first of these was the Odyssey, launched in 1994 to widespread commercial acclaim. A year later, the Creative Movers concept expanded with the debut of a crossover SUV. This was the first-generation CR-V.

From that point onward, the CR-V established itself as a perennial favorite, particularly in the North American market. The model featured here is the 2021 iteration, an evolution of the fifth-generation CR-V that first appeared in 2016.

A defining feature of this generation was the introduction of a hybrid powertrain—the first such offering for the series. The system paired a 2.0-liter Atkinson-cycle engine with two electric motors, capable of operating in both series and parallel modes. Its efficiency shone particularly at cruising speeds, where the gasoline engine took over. The availability of 4-wheel drive further broadened its appeal, offering versatility across a wide range of driving conditions.

While the styling retained many cues from the previous generation, the body was slightly enlarged to enhance rear-seat legroom and passenger comfort. Practicality remained a hallmark of the CR-V, with more than 1,100 liters of cargo space available when the rear seats were folded down. A gasoline-powered variant also offered 3-row, 7-seat configuration.

Beyond its practicality and efficiency, the fifth-generation CR-V was equipped with a comprehensive suite of driver assistance features, including collision mitigation braking and adaptive cruise control. All of this made the CR-V an ideal companion for both weekend adventures and everyday life.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款高人气SUV的第五代车型是系列中的首款混动车。

时间来到1990年代，本田开始致力于打造以休闲出行为定位的车型，并将这一类汽车称为“创行者”。该类别的第一款车就是在1994年推出，并立刻获得广泛商业成功的奥德赛。然后本田又在95年推出了一款高离地间隙的SUV车型，这便是第一代CR-V。

自此，CR-V就成为了一款热销的常青产品，特别是在北美市场。至于这里介绍的车型，这辆2021款是基于2016年首次推出的第五代CR-V升级而来。

第五代车型最受人关注的特点就是在系列中首次采用了混动单元。这套动力系统结合了一部2升阿特金森循环引擎和2部电机，能够串联或并联运行。在高速巡航时，这套高效节能的系统还允许仅使用燃油引擎提供动力。厂商还提供了四轮驱动选项与之搭配，进一步抬高了CR-V的人气。

它在外观上继承了许多前代车型的特征，还稍微拓展了车身尺寸，为后排乘客提供了更多的腿部空间，提升了乘坐舒适性。此外，通过折叠后排座椅，这款车还能腾出超过1100L的货物空间，用于运载大量的行李。其油车车型还提供了一套3排7座布局选项。

第五代CR-V不仅仅是一款设计精良的SUV，还配备了多种驾驶辅助系统，例如碰撞缓解制动和自适应巡航控制等等。CR-V综合了各种优点，使其成为休旅出行和日常代步的最优选。

catch.en: The fifth-generation model of this popular SUV is the first to feature a hybrid system.
catch.zh: 这款高人气SUV的第五代车型是系列中的首款混动车。

long.en:
In the 1990s, Honda embarked on creating vehicles tailored for leisure, coining the term “Creative Movers” to define this new category. The first of these was the Odyssey, launched in 1994 to widespread commercial acclaim. A year later, the Creative Movers concept expanded with the debut of a crossover SUV. This was the first-generation CR-V.

From that point onward, the CR-V established itself as a perennial favorite, particularly in the North American market. The model featured here is the 2021 iteration, an evolution of the fifth-generation CR-V that first appeared in 2016.

A defining feature of this generation was the introduction of a hybrid powertrain—the first such offering for the series. The system paired a 2.0-liter Atkinson-cycle engine with two electric motors, capable of operating in both series and parallel modes. Its efficiency shone particularly at cruising speeds, where the gasoline engine took over. The availability of 4-wheel drive further broadened its appeal, offering versatility across a wide range of driving conditions.

While the styling retained many cues from the previous generation, the body was slightly enlarged to enhance rear-seat legroom and passenger comfort. Practicality remained a hallmark of the CR-V, with more than 1,100 liters of cargo space available when the rear seats were folded down. A gasoline-powered variant also offered 3-row, 7-seat configuration.

Beyond its practicality and efficiency, the fifth-generation CR-V was equipped with a comprehensive suite of driver assistance features, including collision mitigation braking and adaptive cruise control. All of this made the CR-V an ideal companion for both weekend adventures and everyday life.

dialogues.en:
The Honda Fit is one of Japan's most popular compact cars.

By the time this third-generation model made its debut in 2013,
2,000,000 units had been sold in Japan alone!

It is a perennial bestseller.

From this model on, the Fit Hybrid began featuring
a more powerful engine.

Which reminds me, have you heard of the Civic?
It's another Honda compact car.

Like the Fit, the Civic is a front-wheel-drive
compact.

And it drives just like a sports car!
dialogues.zh:
Honda Fit是日本最著名的紧凑型汽车之一。

到2013年第三代车型首次亮相时，仅在日本就
卖出了200万台！

它是一款常青畅销的车型！

从这个车型开始，Fit Hybrid开始配备更强大的引擎。

这让我想起了另一台车——你知道 “Civic”吗？
也是Honda的紧凑型车。

与Fit一样，老款Civic是一款前轮驱动的紧凑型车......

但它开起来就像一辆跑车！
\

Although it's considered an eco-friendly car, the Fit Hybrid

This third-generation model came with a 1.5-liter engine and
a 7-speed DCT.

Although it wasn't particularly fast, it wasn't slow either.

The chassis had a lower center of gravity, enabling the car

身为一款环保车型，Fit Hybrid真的很有跑车感。

这款第三代Fit Hybrid配备有一台1.5L引擎和一个7速双离合变
速箱，

拥有广受赞誉的加速反应速度，

特殊的底盘重心较低，使操控更加稳定。

usedCar.en:
When it comes to Japanese compact cars, the Honda Fit
is one of the best of the bunch.

This is the third-generation Fit, a hybrid model that’s
powered by electric motors as well as an engine.

What's more, the motors in this model are twice as powerful
as those in the second-generation version.

The vehicle really gets going as soon as you put your foot down,
thanks to its abundance of low-end torque.
usedCar.zh:
说到日本小型汽车，很难有车能够超越
Honda Fit。

这是第三代Fit，是一款搭载电机和燃气动
力引擎的混合动力汽车。

此外，第三代汽车电机的功率是第二代汽车的两倍。

在你踩下油门的瞬间扭矩就会开始运转，
这使它成为一款动力十足而又易于操作的小车。

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation hybrid Fit utilized i-DCD to maximize energy efficiency.!

It was natural for Honda to offer a hybrid version of its popular compact vehicle, the Fit, for its lightweight nature made it an exceptional candidate to take full advantage of the company's excellent hybrid system. While the first-generation Fit Hybrid was a great hit, the second-generation model was even better, equipped with a completely new hybrid system.

The Honda IMA (Integrated Motor Assist) in the first generation model had a motor connected directly to the engine--using the engine as the main power source as the motor provided assist as necessary--but the second-gen Fit Hybrid separated the power units. Called the new Sport Hybrid i-DCD (Intelligent Dual Clutch Drive), this new system had a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission with a built-in electric motor that connected the motor to the gasoline engine, which prevented energy loss during regenerative power generation. Also, it allowed the vehicle to be driven in engine, Hybrid, or EV modes, depending on the driving conditions.

This i-DCD system combined with a 1.5-liter i-VTEC engine produced a combined output of 139.5ps, offering powerful, sporty driving while also achieving the excellent fuel efficiency of <36.4km/l> in JC08 mode.

Aside from the hybrid system, the rest of the Fit was no different than any other third-generation model, with the choice of four trim levels, but the most sporty S package was the only one available with a paddle shifter.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第3代飞度混合动力车型，使用了i-DCD，节能效果更好。

第二代飞度混动使用的混合驱动系统与第一代截然不同。第一代车型搭载的本田智能电机辅助系统直接连接了电机与引擎。使用引擎作为主要动力来源时，电机会视需要提供动力辅助。第二代飞度混动则采用全新智能双离合驱动系统，以引擎搭配内置电机和新型的七速双离合变速箱。引擎和电机分离的i-DCD系统有很多优势，包括可以回收动力，防止能量流失，并根据驾驶情况在引擎、油电混合及纯电模式间切换。

这套i-DCD系统搭配1.5升i-VTEC引擎，共可输出139.5ps。这样的条件让本车得以发挥强悍跑车性能，同时在JC08模式下也能达到<36.4km/l>的高燃油效率。

除了这套特殊的系统外，本车其他配置都与第三代飞度的标准燃油车款相同。本车共推出四种不同配置等级的车型，但只有跑车款的S配置能配备换档拨片。

dialogues.en:
The Type R has the perfect balance of cosmetic and
mechanical tuning.

Its design is simply iconic.

Equally well-balanced in its proportions, it has a great
stance that speaks to its agility on the track.

The car that set the standard for FWD racers,
it still looks great.

What’s more, it captured the spirit of JDM tuners better
than any other model that came after it.<next id=2102306 type
dialogues.zh:
Honda Type R在外观设计和机械性能调校方面
达到了完美的平衡。

它的设计堪称经典。

其车身比例同样协调，完美的车身姿态充分
展现了它在赛道上的灵活性。

这款车型为前驱性能车树立了标杆，
时至今日依然魅力不减。

更重要的是，它比后续其他车型都更好地
诠释了日本国内改装车（JDM）文化的精髓。

usedCar.en:
The Honda Integra was the second car to get a Type R model,
after the brand was introduced on the NSX.

The Type R moniker is reserved for the company's most
performance-oriented cars.

Sold as an Acura in the U.S., this was front-wheel-drive car.

Its naturally aspirated 1.8-liter B18C engine screamed at
high rpms, providing 200ps at 8000 rpm.

While its suspension was a bit softer than later versions,
many still prefer the more nimble '96 Spec.
usedCar.zh:
这款车型是广大车友爱好者眼中的
Honda Type R。

这款备受喜爱的Type R车型基于
前轮驱动的Integra。

它是一款早期的车型，通常称为'96 Spec。

它的自然进气1.8L B18C引擎可以达到超高
转速，释放出强大的马力。

虽然它的悬挂系统可能比后期版本更加脆弱，
但很多人仍然更喜欢灵活性更高的'96 Spec。

vehicleCollection.en:
The first Type R model of the Integra, this car was built to be the ultimate front-wheel drive sports car.

The Honda Integra was sold as the Acura Integra in the US.

People didn't call the third-generation Acura Integra the "100 meter eye catcher" for no reason. This term meant that it was instantly recognizable from as far away as 100 meters, a testament to the car’s unusual four round headlights. The new-look Integra proved to be a hit in the U.S. when it arrived in May 1993, but it proved too radical for the Japanese public. So in response to its less-than-stellar sales in Japan, the Japan-market version returned to more conventional-looking trapezoidal headlights two years later.

The second most noteworthy thing about the new Integra was the inclusion of a Type R model. By this time, sports car enthusiasts were already familiar with the "Type R" moniker, thanks to the emergence of the NSX Type R in 1992. In the Integra's case, the engine was based on the Si's 1.8-liter VTEC B18. This high-compression motor featured high-pressure piston heads, special control rods and two-fold valve springs. Each component of this inline-4 was meticulously tuned, resulting in 200ps, or 111ps per liter. Honda chassis engineers refortified the Integra's chassis, at the same time making it lighter by removing sound insulation and installing a smaller battery. Switching to lightweight aluminum wheels also shaved off 40kg. The Type R became the poster child for the ultimate front-wheel-drive sports machine, and spurned the 98spec. R in 1998 that came with equal-length exhausts and 16-in. wheels.
vehicleCollection.zh:
形格的首个Type R车型，旨在成为终极的前轮驱动跑车。

形格Type R于1995年面市。就赛车爱好者而言，对“Type R”的认知来自于92年推出的NSX Type R，意味着“开上街头的赛车”。随着形格的发售，Type R的售价不再高不可攀。

它的引擎是在Si.红线的1.8升B18 VTEC引擎基础上改装而来。高压缩活塞头、高强度连杆和双气门弹簧的使用提高了引擎的压缩性能。所有引擎的组装都由手工完成，能够提供200ps，相当于每升排量对应111ps。车身经过加固，并降低了车重。尽管增加了高性能连杆和螺旋限滑差速器等分量较重的零件，但还是通过缩小电池尺寸、去除隔音材料、采用轻型铝制轮毂等方式减掉了40公斤的车重。它的基础悬挂设置在经过调整后彻底消除了转向不足的情况。

形格Type R刚一上市，就俨然成为了高性能前轮驱动车的代表。

catch.zh: 形格的首个Type R车型，旨在成为终极的前轮驱动跑车。

它的引擎是在Si.红线的1.8升B18 VTEC引擎基础上改装而来。高压缩活塞头、高强度连杆和双气门弹簧的使用提高了引擎的压缩性能。所有引擎的组装都由手工完成，能够提供200ps，相当于每升排量对应111ps。车身经过加固，并降低了车重。尽管增加了高性能连杆和螺旋限滑差速器等分量较重的零件，但还是通过缩小电池尺寸、去除隔音材料、采用轻型铝制轮毂等方式减掉了40公斤的车重。它的基础悬挂设置在经过调整后彻底消除了转向不足的情况。

形格Type R刚一上市，就俨然成为了高性能前轮驱动车的代表。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Simply put, the Honda Integra Type R is one of the meanest
compact cars in the world. It is a true race car for the road.

At its release, this first-gen Integra Type R came with a
price tag that was affordable to young enthusiasts.

It served as a tool for young drivers to hone their
skills as only a Type R could.

The Integra Type R's naturally-aspirated engine was a pumped-up
version used in the base model...

...producing 20ps more output.

The car also featured a strengthened chassis and boasted
more than 40kg in weight reduction.

It serves as a true showcase of 1990s Japanese automotive
engineering.
dialogues.zh:
不用多说，本田Type R提供了迅疾而流畅的驾驶体验。
完全是款名副其实的公路赛车。

第一代形格Type R发售时，由于其定价对于年轻车主来说
并非不可接受……

因此吸引许多人将其作为入门车型，
用来体验驾驶Type R的乐趣。

其自然吸气引擎比起基础车型
更加强劲有力。

因此在功率上提升了20ps。

形格Type R还采用了强化底盘，并减轻了40kg以上的整体车重上。

这款车是上世纪90年代日本汽车制造业中当之无愧的代表杰作。

When it comes to front-drive performance cars, Honda is
among the world's elites.

One of its FF jewels was the Integra Type R, the second 'Type R'
to ever appear after the incredible NSX Type R.

Under its hood is a 1.8-liter naturally-aspirated inline-4,
that revs all the way up to an incredible 8500rpm!

Did you know the technology that went into this engine trickled
down from Honda's participation in Formula 1 racing?

It possesses a special undercarriage too, making the car
super stable at high speeds.

Thanks to its power and razor-sharp handling, this 1998 Spec R
is totally at home at the race track.;
usedCar.zh:
Integra Type R是一款相当有名的
前驱跑车。

这是继NSX Type R之后上市的
第二款Type R车型。

它搭载了一台性能优异的1.8升自然吸气
直列四缸引擎。

这台引擎的红线达到了8500rpm，能在高转速区间
产出强大的动力。

得益于其轻量的车体和坚硬的悬挂，
这辆车有能力攻克任何急弯。

这款车型是98年Spec R，该晚期车款的底盘得到了改进，
稳定性更佳。

vehicleCollection.en:
This third-gen Integra Type R received more power and hand-crafted tuning.

The legend of the "Type R," which was designated to the highest-performance Honda vehicles began in 1992 with the NSX Type R; however, Honda decided to bring the brand to the masses by creating a lower-priced version, which came in the form of the Integra Type R in 1995.

The engine was based on the 1.8-liter B18 VTEC equipped in the Si. Redline and engine compression was increased using high-compression piston heads, high-strength connecting rods, and dual-valve springs. Each engine was assembled by hand, and what a piece of work it was. It produced 200ps, which equals 111ps per liter of displacement. The body was reinforced and, despite the use of heavy parts such as performance rods and a helical LSD, the car weighed 40kg less, thanks to a smaller battery, the lack of soundproofing material, and lightweight aluminum wheels. The suspension was retuned for sharper handling, minimizing the car's tendency to understeer.

When it was released to the market, this Integra Type R became the golden standard of high-performance front-wheel drive-cars.

Believe me when I tell you that this N-ONE

liveries is pure joy!

The spirit of Honda’s first kei-car, the 1967 N360,
lives on in the modern N-ONE.

And nowhere was that more evident than in the second-generation
RS model from 2022.

Wearing the legendary RS badge, this version came with
a turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual gearbox.

A close-ratio gearbox and reinforced clutch gave
the RS a rugged, driver-focused character.

With traits like the aggressive black trim and a purposeful stance,
the N-ONE RS was designed to project speed and intensity.

Compact and lightweight, it was a small car that punched well
above its weight—and surpassed expectations in every corner.\
brandCentral.zh:
Honda首款轻型车N360在1967年展现的卓越工程技术，
如今在出色的N-ONE车型中得以传承。

你眼前看到的是N-ONE第二代RS版本，于2022年推出。

秉承Honda运动车型的传奇命名传统，这款RS
凭借涡轮引擎和6速手动变速器脱颖而出。

搭载密齿比变速箱和重载离合器，这是一台
专为带来纯粹运动驾驶体验而生的座驾。

从内到外，N-ONE RS的设计都在诠释速度与激情，
尤其是那些黑色边饰，更为其增添了几分战斗气息。

小巧轻盈的它，是一台能够超越所有预期的动感小车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This performance-focused model is a first kei-car with front-wheel drive, a turbocharged engine and a 6-speed manual transmission.

The N-ONE was introduced as a new basic model, taking design cues from the original N360—Honda’s first kei-car. Launched in 2012, the first-generation N-ONE quickly earned praise for its charming looks and fun-to-drive nature.

By 2020, it had entered its second generation. Although the platform was redesigned, strong fan demand for continuity meant the body panels from the original model were carried over. Instead, Honda refined the shape of the grille and bumper, subtly signaling the model’s evolution.

The second-generation sports variant was named the RS, short for Road Sailing. While the RS badge also appeared on the first-generation model, the new version introduced a key upgrade: a front-mounted turbocharged engine paired with front-wheel drive and a 6-speed manual gearbox—one that made it even more enjoyable to drive.

The RS also featured exclusive styling with black trim pieces, but the standout element remained the 6-speed manual transmission. Geared for enthusiasts, the transmission used close ratios similar to the S660. Second and third gears benefited from heavy-duty synchros, and the clutch system was similarly reinforced.

Despite its performance focus, the RS also included modern driving aids. A peak torque limiter smoothed out clutch engagement, while auto brake hold helped during hill starts—features that made the car more approachable in daily use.

Weighing in at under 1000kg and with compact dimensions, the N-ONE RS delivered sharp, responsive handling not typically expected from a car in this class. The result was a well-balanced package that brought the fun and excitement of sports driving to the masses.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款“性能”车型搭载了轻型车史上首个前驱涡轮增压+6速手动变速箱的动力组合。

N-ONE作为一款全新的基础车型推出，融入了本田首款轻型车规格乘用车N360的经典设计元素。第一代车型于2012年上市，凭借俏皮的外观设计和出色的驾驶性能赢得了业界好评和市场认可。

2020年，N-ONE迎来了第二代车型。虽然车身框架经过了全面革新，但应广大车迷保持外观不变的强烈要求，第一代车型的车身面板得以延续使用。取而代之的是对前格栅和保险杠造型的细微调整，以可爱的都市品味诠释车型的进化升级。

第二代运动版本被命名为“RS”，寓意“公路巡航”。虽然第一代也有RS版本，但第二代车型首次采用前置涡轮增压引擎配前轮驱动，搭配6速手动变速箱的组合，驾驶乐趣更上一层楼。

RS版本采用专属的外观设计搭配黑色边饰件，但最引人注目的特色当属那台6速变速箱。专为驾驶爱好者打造的传动系统采用了与S660相同的密齿比档位，2档和3档配备重载同步器，离合器同样使用强化部件。

另一方面，它也像其他现代手动挡车型一样配备了丰富的辅助功能，包括峰值扭矩限制器（减少急抬离合时的换挡顿挫）和自动驻车功能（让坡道起步等操作更加轻松）。

得益于紧凑的车身尺寸和不足1000kg的轻盈重量，驾驶感受比同类车型更加直接纯粹。总而言之，此车可以说是一个极具吸引力的整合方案，让普通人也能感受运动驾驶的乐趣。

brandCentral.en:
The powertrain of this second generation NSX is a sports
hybrid SH-AWD system.

It utilises a midship 3.5L turbocharged V6 in conjunction
with three additional motors to drive all four wheels.

Two of these motors allow the front wheels to be
independently operated.

The driver can therefore make minute adjustments when
cornering without having to compromise speed.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆第二代NSX的传动系统采用了跑车型混动超级控制全
轮驱动系统。

它通过一台中置3.5L涡轮增压V6引擎搭配三台额外的电机
来驱动全部四个车轮。

其中两台电机负责支持前轮独立运作，

车手可以在过弯时进行微调，而无需牺牲速度。

vehicleCollection.en:
Acura's popular exotic sports car returns after a 10-year hiatus.

The Acura NSX became an icon after only several years on the market, and although it was gone in 2005, it was hardly forgotten. To the delight of performance-car enthusiasts everywhere, Honda introduced a concept of a second-generation car in 2012, and then gave us a production version of it at the 2015 North American International Auto Show.

The new NSX came in the form of a mid-engine supercar that combined aluminum, high tensile steel and other advanced materials in the chassis, covered by a lightweight carbon-fiber body. The engine, mounted behind the cockpit, came in the form of a twin-turbo V-6 with a dry sump, mated to 9-speed dual-clutch transmission with a built-in motor. There were also electric motors powering the front wheels to make the new NSX an all-wheel-drive machine. The AWD system, called the Sports Hybrid SH-AWD, allows torque vectoring that controls deceleration as well as drive force, enhancing the car’s ability to corner.

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
This second-generation NSX-GT race car appeared in 2014.

Does that sound odd to you?

It should, because the second-generation NSX production
car was released two years later in 2016.

There's simple explanation to this.

The race NSX wasn't based on the production NSX, but on
the NSX Concept...

...which was unveiled ahead of the production version
in 2014.

However, it was this concept car that took
the GT name.

In mid-2016, the second-generation NSX production car
was officially released.

Because of this, the competition car was also called
the NSX-GT.

This car came in 3rd place in Round Five of the
Super GT in Japan.
dialogues.zh:
这台第二代NSX-GT于2014年首次亮相。

听起来不觉得有些奇怪吗？

毕竟，它的基本车型，第二代NSX，在2016年才开始销售。

实际上，这辆车既是NSX，也不是NSX。

这是因为，它的原型车是一辆叫做NSX Concept的车……

那辆车是在本田于2014年，在其生产型出现前公布的。

然而，继承GT名号的依然是一辆赛车！

2016年中，第二代NSX正式发布。

因此，这款赛车也被称为NSX-GT。

作为概念时代的最后一款特规车型，
这款车在日本Super GT第五轮比赛中获得了第三名。

vehicleCollection.en:
This race machine claimed the Super GT championship in 2016 equipped with a conventional gasoline engine.

The NSX CONCEPT-GT was Honda’s entry into the GT500 class of the Super GT series, competing from 2014 to 2016. It was based on the NSX concept car unveiled by Honda in 2012, which previewed the forthcoming production model of the new-generation NSX. The concept employed a hybrid powertrain that combined a mid-mounted V-6 engine with electric motors.

Like other GT500 machines, the NSX Concept GT was built under the 2014 regulations that aligned with DTM technical standards. Unlike its rivals, however, it featured a midship-mounted turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection—developed within a unified format across manufacturers. It also incorporated a hybrid system similar to the production car. However, to prevent the system from providing an unfair advantage, a minimum weight was imposed, and strict limits were placed on both the electric assist output and energy usage.

While the car faced numerous challenges during its debut season in 2014, performance improved significantly in 2015. In 2016, however, Honda encountered supply issues from its battery manufacturer, forcing the team to compete without the hybrid system. The Raybrig NSX CONCEPT-GT was one of the standout cars in this program. In 2014, with Takashi Kogure and Hideki Mutoh at the helm, it finished 11th in the team rankings. In 2015, driven by Naoki Yamamoto and Takuya Izawa, it climbed to an impressive 3rd place in the series standings. However, 2016 proved difficult for all Honda teams, with the season ending in a disappointing 12th place.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款未装配混合动力系统的赛车是2016年Super GT锦标赛的参赛车辆。

NSX Concept GT是本田推出的一款赛车，于2014年到2016年参加超级跑车系列赛的GT500级别比赛。这款车的原型NSX是本田于2012年发布的概念车，这款车是作为新一代NSX量产车而开发的。概念车型采用了中置式V6引擎与电机相结合的混合动力系统。

和其他GT500车型一样，NSX Concept GT根据2014年新颁布的规则开发，该规则中加入德国房车大师赛的车辆规则。车辆的不同之处在于采用中置式安装的2升涡轮增压直列式4缸直喷引擎，由不同公司各自按照统一规格专门开发，并配置有和量产公路车相同的混合动力系统。然而，为了避免从这些配置中获得不公平的优势，车身最小重量、电力辅助输出和能量使用都受到了限制。

NSX Concept GT在参赛的第一年发生了各种问题，好在从2015年开始，这款车渐渐跟上了节奏。然而在2016年，车厂遇到了电池供应商方面的问题，因此参赛车辆都没有使用混合动力系统。Raybrig NSX Concept GT是参赛车辆之一。2014年，由小暮卓史和武藤英纪担任车手的车队取得了车队排名第11名的成绩，在2015年，山本直树和伊泽拓为车队取得了系列赛第3名的成绩。然而，2016年对本田车队来说并不是个好年头，他们最终仅位列系列赛的第12名。

驾驶室后方安置的引擎是一台双涡轮V6干式油底盘引擎，还配备了9档双踏板离合器以及内置电机。此系统与左前和右前轮的电机相结合，形成了一套完整的电力四驱系统。此系统名为Sports Hybrid SH-AWD，可进行扭矩矢量分配，从而可以对减速和传动力进行控制，提升了该车在使用各种速度过弯的时候依然紧贴理想线路的能力。

本车还配备了一套整合式动力系统，其包含了4种模式，既有在低速时仅依靠电动机提供动力的模式，也有在赛道上释放其极限动力性能的模式。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

catch.en: This second-generation NSX with SH-AWD was modified for Gr.4 competition.
catch.zh: 一款专为组别4竞赛而改装的SH-AWD四驱系统2代NSX。

long.en:
The Acura NSX became an icon after only several years on the market, and although it was gone in 2005, it was hardly forgotten. To the delight of performance-car enthusiasts everywhere, Honda introduced a concept of a second-generation car in 2012, and then gave us a production version of it at the 2015 North American International Auto Show.

The new NSX came in the form of a mid-engine supercar that combined aluminum, high tensile steel and other advanced materials in the chassis, covered by a lightweight carbon-fiber body. The engine, mounted behind the cockpit, came in the form of a twin-turbo V-6 with a dry sump, mated to 9-speed dual-clutch transmission with a built-in motor. There were also electric motors powering the front wheels to make the new NSX an all-wheel-drive machine. The AWD system, called the Sports Hybrid SH-AWD, allows torque vectoring that controls deceleration as well as drive force, enhancing the car’s ability to corner.

The NSX also featured an Integrated Dynamic System that possessed four modes—the lowest one allowed driving with electric power alone at low speeds, while the highest one combined the gasoline engine and electric motors to provide the highest performance, intended for use on the racetrack.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is an original
based on the Honda NSX.

It has unique custom suspension, ensuring plenty of ground
clearance and an ability to handle the harshest terrain.

Because of its mid-engine/AWD layout, the car's weight
distribution is biased towards the rear.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于Honda NSX开发。

它采用独特的定制悬挂系统，以保持稳定的离地间隙，
其他针对泥地赛道的必要改装也不曾缺席。

尽管采用中置引擎布局和四轮驱动传动系统，但它的车
重配比明显地向车身后部倾斜。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
The NSX is a Japanese GT racer! This was proved at the 2000
All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC).

The NSX made its first appearance in the JGTC’s GT500 class
during the 1996 season.

Despite putting up a good fight...

It was unable to beat such powerful opponents as the Nissan
Skyline GT-R and Toyota Supra.

However, come 2000, the NSX took a great evolutionary
leap forward.

In this year, a team of five NSXs won four of seven races...

With Ryo Michigami, in the No.16 Castrol MUGEN NSX,
winning the driver’s title.

This was the first time an NSX won in JGTC history.
dialogues.zh:
这辆NSX是参加全日本GT锦标赛的赛车啊！它的实力已经在2000年
全日本GT锦标赛中得到了充分证明。

NSX在1996赛季全日本GT锦标赛的GT500组别中首次亮相。

尽管拼尽全力……

仍然无法撼动如日产Skyline GT-R和丰田Supra
这样的强大对手。

不过当时间来到2000年，NSX得到了飞跃般的进化。

在这个赛季，总共五辆NSX组成的参赛阵容拿下了
七场比赛中的四场胜利……

而驾驶16号嘉实多无限NSX赛车的道上龙
更是赢下了车手冠军头衔。

这也是NSX在全日本GT锦标赛的历史上首次夺魁。

collection.en:
The Castrol MUGEN NSX was one of the standouts
in the competitive 2000 JGTC season.

It became the first Honda NSX to win a high-level Japanese
GT championship.

In the top GT500 class of the Japanese GT Car Championship
(JGTC), there was a real dogfight...

...between the factory teams of Honda, Nissan and Toyota,
who were always trying to one-up each other.

Since 1997, Honda had been competing with its NSX GT race car.

But tuning regulations in the JGTC restricted the developint of the NSX GT.

This led to less than satisfactory results on the track, but
Honda's race department refused to give up.

Through tuning of the car's aerodynamics and improvements to weight
balance, the NSX steadily improved year after year.

All of that perseverance came to fruition in the 2000 season when
the Castrol MUGEN NSX took home the series championship.

Today, the original NSX has become a consummate collector
car, an icon of Japanese automobiles

And this car repesents the model's legacy as a
timeless, persistent race machine.
collection.zh:
卡斯特罗无限NSX参加了全日本GT锦标赛2000赛季……

并成为了赢得日本顶级房车赛冠军的第一款
本田NSX车型。

GT500是全日本GT锦标赛中的最高组别，

也是日产、丰田和本田三家原厂车队之间激烈
竞争的战场。

在本田参加的首个完整赛季中，其派出了旗下的
1997 NSX GT车型……

但在参赛伊始，全日本GT锦标赛的调教规则就给了
NSX GT的后续开发当头一棒……

他们的成绩也因此一落千丈。

不过本田对空气动力学性能和配重平衡的持续调校
让赛车的表现在接下来的数年里稳步提升……

而到了2000赛季，卡斯特罗无限NSX赛车终于不负
众望，拿到了冠军。

如今，原版NSX已经成为了日本汽车史上的传奇偶像。

而这款赛车车型更是留下了光辉灿烂的遗产，成为了真
正的丰碑。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new design with a lower center of gravity was the key to victory for this JGTC champion.

During the 2000 All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC), Japan's Big Three automakers—Honda, Toyota and Nissan—engaged in an unprecedented war for the GT500-class title.

he NSX development team made major changes to the 2000 model, going as far as repositioning the transverse mounted engine. Installing the V-type engine in a transverse layout helped to shorten the length of the vehicle, but the layout created problems in routing the exhaust pipes from the two cylinder banks. Previously, the NSX's exhaust pipes ran under the engine, but the development team decided to re-route them to the sides to lower the engine itself.

In this configuration, the gearbox, which was mounted on the side of the engine, was in the way. Therefore, to make space for the exhaust pipes, the team set about redesigning a smaller gearbox. The result was a completely bespoke transmission that employed formula car gears, which are thinner and more compact than normal.

Five NSX cars entered the 2000 season. Among them, the Castrol Mugen NSX, along with Takata Dome NSX, took on the role of advanced-development "works cars" inside the NSX camp.

The Takata Dome NSX delivered an impressive performance, winning two races. However, due to the weight handicap system of the JGTC, it fell short of the series title. The Castrol Mugen NSX emerged in its shadow. Ryo Michigami drove it, and Osamu Nakako drove it until he was replaced by Hidetoshi Mitsusada halfway through the season. Despite the extra weight from its first-place finish, the Castrol Mugen NSX drove away with the championship.
vehicleCollection.zh:
重心更低的全新设计成为了全日本GT锦标赛夺冠路上的基石。+

在2000年的全日本GT锦标赛上，三家巨头制造商本田、丰田和日产为了争夺豪华旅行车500组别的冠军头衔展开了史诗般的拼搏。

NSX开发团队决定对2000型号进行重大改进，甚至大刀阔斧地调整了横置引擎的位置。将V形引擎进行横置安装可以有效缩短车身长度，不过这种布局也增加了从两个气缸组向外布置排气管的难度。之前车型的排气管多从引擎下方通过，不过这一次开发团队决定将排气管挪到侧面，进而降低引擎的高度。

不过若采用这种配置，原本安装在引擎侧面的变速箱就会挡住排气管。为了给排气管腾出空间，团队开始着手设计一款体积更小的变速箱，最后为其打造出了一套定制传动系统，其采用的方程式赛车齿轮相比于普通齿轮更薄、更紧凑。

总共有五支NSX车队参加了2000赛季的比赛。而在整个NSX阵营中，嘉实多无限NSX车队和高田童梦NSX车队的赛车扮演了领衔开发“厂队车”的角色。

高田童梦NSX展现出了压倒性的性能优势，拿下了比赛胜利。然而全日本GT锦标赛赛事规则中独有的车重限制成为了极大的不利因素，导致车队最终未能登上锦标赛冠军宝座。反而是嘉实多无限NSX异军突起，拿出了一场又一场稳定的表现。这辆车由道上龙和中子修驾驶，中子修在赛季半程时被替换成了光贞秀俊。嘉实多无限NSX车队巧妙地化解了因第1名完赛而受到的车重限制，势如破竹地夺得了系列赛的冠军头衔。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Did you know that there is a full-scale paper model
of this EPSON NSX?

It's true. EPSON commissioned Japanese paper artist
Hitoshi Shinozaki to build one.

It’s entirely made of cardboard, including
the tires and all of the other intricate parts.

It looks like the real thing, as if it could
drive off at a moment’s notice.

But I digress.

The real NSX competed under EPSON colors
in Japanese GT races from 2004 to 2009.

At the time, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship
was evolving into the Super GT Series.

The EPSON NSX competed in the latter half of the 2008
season, where it came in 2nd place in Round 8 race.
dialogues.zh:
你知道吗？这款ESPON NSX居然还有一套全尺寸的纸模呢。

这是真的，是Epson委托日本纸模艺术家筱崎仁帮他们打造的。

这个纸模全部由硬纸板做成，甚至连轮胎和其他的圆形
部件也不例外。

这个纸模看上去足以以假乱真，就好像可以随时上路一般！

……咳咳，不好意思跑题了。

Epson涂装的NSX真车参加了2004年到2009年期间的
全日本GT赛事。

当时正是全日本GT锦标赛向国际Super GT系列赛转型的阶段。

这款EPSON NSX参加的是2008年系列赛的后半段赛程，并在第8
轮中跑出了第二名的好成绩。

dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.en:
The prototype and final production model
of the original NSX...

Was designed by my friend and former chief
designer at Honda, Masato Nakano.

The performance target for the NSX was
to surpass the Ferrari 328 and 348...

So you know it had plenty of fighting power.

The GT500 class adopted a stepped-bottom rule in 2007, and
that year this car took the title, winning 5 of 9 races.

Because of its incredible speed, you can almost say
the series imposed a weight-handicap system.

The following year, in 2008, the NSX's highlight was a 2nd-
place finish in the 8th race of the season at Autopolis.
dialogues.zh:
这辆初代NSX的原型和最终量产型……

……都由我的朋友、前本田首席设计师中野正人所设计的。

NSX的性能目标是要超越法拉利328和348，

所以可想而知，它的战斗力极其惊人。

GT500组别的赛事在2007年采用了阶梯式淘汰规则，

在这一年里，这辆NSX不仅赢得了冠军，还拿下了
九场比赛中的五场胜利。

因为它所向无敌的速度，甚至会让人们怀疑这项系列赛
是不是采用了一套非常不利于大重量赛车的制度。

在接下来的2008年，NSX最亮眼的表现则出现在
奥托波里斯赛道，它在赛季的第八场比赛中以第二名完赛。

vehicleCollection.en:
The special race NSX brings to mind the bold driving styles of racers Loic Duval and Katsuyuki Hiranaka.

The Super GT Series has been the most popular touring car racing series in Japan, even when it was operating under its former name, the JGTC (Japanese Grand Touring Championship). In 2007, new regulations for top-tier GT500 cars called for a skidplate measuring 30mm to be added beneath the car in an effort to reduce cornering speeds.

This new rule hardly had an effect on the Honda NSX as it went on to win five of that year's nine races. The following season, while the NSX teams were allowed to use the same successful chassis as the previous year (thanks to a regulation that required the main frame be used two years in a row), the rules committee decided to allow other cars to catch up by imposing a 50kg weight handicap to the NSX (this was reduced to 40kg from Round 3 on). In addition, the committee imposed smaller engine restrictors for the cars, which slowed the NSXs down even more.

In response, Honda revised the specifications of its 3494cc 32B V-6 for added throttle response, improved the car's aerodynamics, and made it even lighter.

There were five NSXs competing that year, and the EPSON NSX of Nakajima Racing was the only one running with DUNLOP tires, making them the odd man out when it came to data sharing with the other NSX teams.

Drivers Loïc Duval and Katsuyuki Hiranaka exceeded everyone's expectations, finishing 2nd in the eighth round at Autopolis, which was their highest placing of the year.
vehicleCollection.zh:
看到这台车，就让人联想起卢里克·杜瓦尔和平中克幸勇敢无畏的驾驶风格。

Super GT是日本最受欢迎的房车赛事。从2007年起，这项赛事的GT500组别中加入了一项阶梯式底盘规则。在此之前，规则要求使用平滑的底盘，而新规则要求在车辆底部加入一个30mm的防滑板，进而降低过弯速度。

本田NSX巧妙地解决了规则问题，并展现出了他们的惊人速度，在总共9轮比赛中赢得了5轮，称霸了这项赛事。在第二年里，他们遵守规定，连续两年使用相同的主车架。但因为前一年的速度太快，从系列赛开始时，赛事方要求使用特殊的性能调节器，在NSX的车上增加一个50kg的障碍配重（从第3轮开始改为40kg），并且要求他们将引擎限制器改得更小。

为了应对要求，本田修改了他们的3494cc排量32B V6引擎的细节规格，提高了驾驶操控性。另外，他们还额外改良了空气动力学外形，减轻了车身重量，以将横摆惯性影响最小化。

2008年的赛事中共有5辆NSX出征，只有中岛赛车派出的EPSON NSX使用了邓禄普轮胎。因此他们在数据共享方面处于不利地位，好在有卢里克·杜瓦尔和平中克幸挺身而出，在奥托波里斯赛道举办的第8轮比赛中取得了第二名的好成绩，这也是他们在当届赛事中取得的最高名次。

在这一年的Super GT中，日产GT-R展现出了超强的性能，而上述两名车手则在年度总排名中位居第10。

brandCentral.en:
This improved Honda NSX Type R, also known as the 02R,
was released in 2002.

Its lightweight body and sport-tuned suspension made it
a monster on the track.

Part of the reason was an excellent aerodynamic shape
that allowed the car to generate gobs of downforce.

You'll be hard-pressed to find a car that feels as good to
drive as this one.
brandCentral.zh:
这款改进后的NSX Type R也被称为02R，于2002年发布。

其轻巧的车身和坚硬的悬挂大大提升了其在赛道上的表现。

此车还拥有出色的空气动力学设计，可产生强大的下压力。

您很难找到像这款车一样易于驾驶的车了！

usedCar.en:
Released in 2002, this baby is an updated version of the
first-generation NSX Type R.

It uses the NA2 model NSX as a base, which means that it
came powered by a 3.2-liter V-6.

One of this car's charms was its refined aerodynamic profile.

Modifications were made to its underside to improve air flow,
and several major aerodynamic components were added.

So you can bet that its handling and stability at high speeds
were impressive, to say the least.

The naturally-aspirated V-6 revs like a dream — and its power
will have you comfortable attacking any circuit.
usedCar.zh:
该车型为初代NSX Type R的改进版，
于2002年上市。

它以NA2型NSX为基础，
搭载了3.2升V6引擎。

它的主要卖点是经过优化的空气动力设计。

经过改造的底盘获得了更优秀的空气流动性，
并装上了数个轻量化组件。

这些改进使此型号的高速操控性和稳定性达到了
优越的水准。

大马力自然吸气V6引擎
有着令人满意的动力，并赋予了这辆车足以攻克任何赛道的性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
Thanks to advancements in aerodynamics, the 2nd-gen NSX had more downforce than the original.

Beginning in November of 1992, the first-generation NSX Type R was available over the course of a limited three-year-period run, and then became an icon. Seven years later, a new NSX-R was shown as a concept car at the 2001 Tokyo Motor Show, reviving the legend. Not long after, the NSX Type R once again became available to the public when it went on sale in May of 2002.

Why such a long period between Type R models? With the base NSX's performance threshold already so high, engineers elected to wait for new cutting-edge automotive technology to incorporate into their creation rather than just carry over pre-existing packages.

Special emphasis was placed not on the engine, which was addressed when the second-generation NSX's power plant had its displacement increased and was fitted with a new 6-speed manual transmission, but in the area of aerodynamics. The work done in this area resulted in a rare feat for a commercially available vehicle: a shape that not only produced negative lift but generated downforce.

In order to achieve this newfound aerodynamic efficiency, a newly-shaped hood and rear wing were created; lightweight carbon-fiber was used unsparingly in these vital components. The final result was a new NSX Type R that became the first street-legal road car to lap the famed Nürburgring course in less than 8 minutes, an unheard of feat for a full-fledged production car at the time.
vehicleCollection.zh:
2代NSX改进了空气动力学设计，增加了车辆的下压力。

第一代NSX Type R发售于1992年11月，只销售了3年便宣告停产，却在坊间成为了一代传说。7年之后，NSX-R的概念赛车在2001年东京车展上发布，2002年5月的发售版本也几乎和车展版别无二致。

早些年的时候，标准版NSX曾提升引擎排量，并换用了6速变速箱。也因此，Type R回归的传闻不胫而走。不过最终在97年亮相的高性能车型却是一台Type S Zero。开发团队之所以没有在97年就将Type R带回大众视线，原因其实很简单，当时的技术尚不足以配置出一台合格的Type R。

第一代Type R所追求的轻量化、高刚性是1992年备受追捧的理念。而要重新复活“R”的金字招牌，不只是继承旧的理念那么简单，需要引入革命性的、更前沿的新技术。

最终，本田找到了能与R的盛名匹配的改进方向—空气动力学。在第二代Type R身上，对空气动力学的调整几乎深入到了每一个细节，也为我们带来一台别具一格的商业车款：可以提供负升力的车体，或者换个更简明的说法，制造下压力。

为了实现效果，前引擎盖和尾翼都毫不吝啬地用上了碳纤维材质。当然，新款Type R并未放弃奠基之作所追求的减重与刚性要求。车内的其他设备也得到了更新，以符合新时代的配置标准。

追随着前代，新一代NSX Type R再次挑战纽博格林赛道，甚至跑进了8分钟。时至今日，仍是公路车纪录中不可逾越的一道高墙。

The final result was a new NSX Type R that became the first street-legal road car to lap the famed Nürburgring course in less than 8 minutes, an unheard of feat for a full-fledged production car at the time.
long.zh:
第一代NSX Type R发售于1992年11月，只销售了3年便宣告停产，却在坊间成为了一代传说。7年之后，NSX-R的概念赛车在2001年东京车展上发布，2002年5月的发售版本也几乎和车展版别无二致。

早些年的时候，标准版NSX曾提升引擎排量，并换用了6速变速箱。也因此，Type R回归的传闻不胫而走。不过最终在97年亮相的高性能车型却是一台Type S Zero。开发团队之所以没有在97年就将Type R带回大众视线，原因其实很简单，当时的技术尚不足以配置出一台合格的Type R。

第一代Type R所追求的轻量化、高刚性是1992年备受追捧的理念。而要重新复活“R”的金字招牌，不只是继承旧的理念那么简单，需要引入革命性的、更前沿的新技术。

最终，本田找到了能与R的盛名匹配的改进方向—空气动力学。在第二代Type R身上，对空气动力学的调整几乎深入到了每一个细节，也为我们带来一台别具一格的商业车款：可以提供负升力的车体，或者换个更简明的说法，制造下压力。

为了实现效果，前引擎盖和尾翼都毫不吝啬地用上了碳纤维材质。当然，新款Type R并未放弃奠基之作所追求的减重与刚性要求。车内的其他设备也得到了更新，以符合新时代的配置标准。

追随着前代，新一代NSX Type R再次挑战纽博格林赛道，甚至跑进了8分钟。时至今日，仍是公路车纪录中不可逾越的一道高墙。

dialogues.speaker: Fabio Filippini
dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
I remember very well the impact of the Honda NSX
at the 1989 Geneva Motor Show.

It was the expression of absolute sportiness
combined with Japanese perfection.

In fact, its clean and streamlined style...

...comes from studies previously
made with Pininfarina.

These were further developed later by
in-house Japanese designers

This design is so pure and balanced that...

...it lasted 15 years without noticeable changes.

While the front and
side are slightly reminiscent of the Ferrari style...

...the tail is particularly original and successful.

Of note are its integrated wing and
the transversal strip of lights

The "Type R" version boasts intense technical improvement work...

...amd is virtually identical in aesthetics*
dialogues.zh:
1989年，本田NSX在日内瓦车展上造成的轰动，
我现在依然记得很清楚。

它是绝对的动感和日本的完美主义的结合。

这种简洁的流线造型……

……其实是本田与宾尼法利纳合作研究的成果。

之后又由日方的内部设计师
进一步完善和发扬光大。

这项成功的设计不仅纯粹，而且平衡……

……以至于沿用了整整15年都未见任何显著改动。

虽然前脸和侧面会让人觉得向法拉利靠拢……

……但其车尾的原创度很高，也相当成功。

一体化的尾翼和横向全尺寸灯带都是可圈可点的创新。

后来的“Type R”版本虽然在技术上做出大幅的改进……

……但在美学方面几乎是全面照搬了原版车。

usedCar.en:
Nowadays, when you see "Type R," it means that you're looking
at a Honda sports car with over-the-top performance.

And, the first to wear this badge was the first-gen NSX,
considered the company's premiere super sports car.

With the Acura NSX Type R, Honda created something that was
virtually race ready, brimming with Formula 1 technology.

One of the more notable aspects of the NSX Type R is its curb
weight, which is 120kg lighter than the base model.

The special Acura exotic also possesses a custom-tuned
suspension system, as well as special sports tires.
usedCar.zh:
这款NSX Type R是Honda Type R车系中的第一款车型，
同时也是最传奇的车型之一。

初代NSX就已经是性能极为
强悍的跑车了。

而这辆Type R更是专门针对赛道性能而
做出优化的衍生车型。

具体来讲，这辆车的重量被尽可能地削减了，
比基础车型还轻了120kg。

其配备的悬挂和轮胎也为
Type R进行了量身定制。[

vehicleCollection.en:
The first of the Honda Type R series, only 500 cars of this rare model were produced.

The NSX proved to be a major hit with both automotive enthusiasts and the media alike, but the limited-edition NSX Type R (NSX-R) that went on sale in Japan in November 1992 took Honda's mid-engine sports car formula to the extreme limits. This ultimate sports car was so well received that the "R" designation eventually made its way into the lineup of Honda's more mainstream cars, namely the Civic and Integra.

Honda's engineering philosophy for its Type R vehicles followed two main principles: "less weight" and "increased rigidity." In the case of the NSX, this meant removing the car's air-conditioning unit and sound system hardware, not to mention all of its sound absorbing insulation. Other changes included installing lightweight seat and wheels. The result was a lean performance machine that tipped the scales at a low 1230kg (the stock NSX weighed 1350kg), improving the Type R's weight-to-power ratio from the base car's <4.82kg/ps> to <4.39kg/ps>.

Complementing its new lean body was improved structural rigidity that came via additional bracing throughout its aluminum monocoque chassis. Stiffer shocks and springs on the suspension system were also key contributors. Overall, the Type R behaved like an entirely different animal when compared to the base NSX, especially on the racetrack where the car belonged. Less than 500 NSX Type Rs were produced during the car's limited three-year run, with all of them now considered collector items by many Honda fans.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款赛车正是本田Type R系列的起源，当时仅生产不足500辆。

对于备受车迷青睐的跑车来说，持续进化是必需项。NSX当然也遵循着这样的原则，通过每年推陈出新的改装来完善其车型。1992年11月发售的NSX Type R是其进化历史当中极其重要的一款车。

NSX本就是一款性能卓越、配置完善的车型，而Type R则向完美又迈进了一大步。虽然大家对Type R的认知大多来自于之后几年里陆续推出的形格和思域，但最初的理念践行者，是这台NSX Type R。

本田在这台NSX身上投注的是轻量化与高刚性的理念。为了尽可能降低重量，空调、车内音响系统，乃至保温层都可以舍弃，只留下驾驶性能相关的部件。随着座椅、方向盘和轮毂都换成轻量化的版本，本田终于将标准版本的1350kg降到了1230kg。重量马力比从标准车款的1ps对应4.82kg，降到了1ps对应4.39kg。

为了与提升后的动力匹配，NSX Type R采用了高刚性的车架。单体车壳的各处加入了铝管作为加固，与刚性结构连接的避震器、弹簧乃至衬套的性能全都用到了极限。

虽然引擎没有变化，但车重的减轻可以视作动力的提升。车速自然也获得了提升。每一台Type R的引擎在出厂前都接受了一对一的调校，使得高转速下的引擎表现让人欲罢不能。截至1996年停产前，NSX Type R仅只生产了不足500台，被送到翘首以盼的车主手中。

brandCentral.en:
This ultra-lightweight pure sports car concept was born from
the collaboration between Honda and Gran Turismo.

The design theme drew inspiration from Honda's first
Formula 1 race cars in the 1960s.

Its power unit incorporates technologies developed
for superbikes.

The engine is normally used in the Honda RC213V-S,
which is a MotoGP class motorcycle.

The car demonstrates the company's ability to compete in
all manner of races, be it on two wheels or four.
brandCentral.zh:
这款超轻量级的纯正跑车的概念设计来自于
Honda和跑车浪漫旅的合作项目。

其设计主题源自Honda 60年代的第一批F1赛车。

动力单元部分采用的是为超级摩托车特别开发的技术。

确切地说，它的车身上安装了一台MotoGP摩托车的专用引擎
——Honda RC213V-S。

它也是Honda纵横两轮及四轮赛事的实战能力的充分体现。

vehicleCollection.en:
A new species with the openness of a motorcycle and the handling of an automobile.

A new driving experience has been created through a collaboration between the Honda design team and Gran Turismo. What makes this possible is the Honda Project 2&4 powered by RC213V.

At the heart of this car that was born from a design competition project involving Honda’s 2-wheel and 4-wheel divisions, is a V-4 motorcycle engine. Thus, the car is a new form of fun mobility that combines the openness and agility of a motorbike with the dynamic performance of a 4-wheeled vehicle.

The working theme of the car's development was "'Exposure," and indeed, drivers of the vehicle can feel the sun and wind all around them, giving them an incredible sense of freedom.

Perhaps the most noteworthy element of the Honda Project 2&4 is the structure, which is a fusion of 2- and 4-wheeled vehicles powered by a motorcycle engine that's mounted amidships on an aluminum carbon composite backbone frame.

The combination of the 999cc V4 engine producing 215ps and the car's low 405kg curb weight results in an incredible weight-to-power ratio of <1.88kg/ps>. The rear wheels are driven through a 6-speed DCT controlled with paddle shifters on the steering wheel. If you remove the assistant side body cowling it is also possible to add a passenger seat that makes it a two-seater.
vehicleCollection.zh:
既有摩托车的开放感，又有4轮车的横向重力加速度，带来全新的驾驶体验。

在本田设计团队与跑车浪漫旅的通力合作下，为我们带来了全新的驾驶体验，这款车型就是“Project 2&4 powered by RC213V”。

通过本田的二轮和四轮部门之间的激烈设计竞争，该车的动力核心最终选用了竞速摩托车的V4引擎。它结合了摩托车的开放性、敏捷性和四轮汽车的动力性能，让你能真正感受到它的横向重力加速度。

它的设计理念“展露”得到了很好的展现，车手在体验驾驶的极致自由时还能享受到太阳和疾风的真实存在。

本田Project 2&4的最重要亮点之一是它的架构，它融合了二轮和四轮车的特性，并由摩托车引擎提供动力，该引擎被安装于铝碳复合材料的车架上。

这台紧凑的999cc V4中置引擎可提供215ps功率的动力，结合了超轻量化的405kg车身，实现了惊人的<1.88kg/ps>重量马力比。它的后轮由6档双离合变速箱驱动，并在方向盘处设置了换挡拨片。如果移除侧面的整流罩，你还可以添加一个乘客座位，使其成为一台双座赛车。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
This is the car that kick-started Honda’s near 60 years
of Formula 1 Grand Prix history.

After a rough start in 1964, Honda was back in 1965,
with this RA272.

It took the checkered flag at the Mexican Grand Prix
in the final round of the season.

That year happened to be the last one in which F1 machines
were powered by 1.5-liter naturally-aspirated engines.

And let me tell you, the engine that powered this RA272
was something special!

It was a V-12 with 1495cc of displacement and capable of
a whopping 230 horsepower!

Surprisingly, the displacement per cylinder was a mere
125cc, something that reflected Honda's motorcycle engines.

What’s more, weighing in at 215kg, this super compact
engine was mounted horizontally amidships!

Have you ever heard of such a thing being done
on a Formula 1 car?

But if you give it some thouht, you’ll see that
it actually made a lot of sense.

By mounting an engine on its side, you can shorten
the wheelbase and put less stress on the gearbox.

Compact and easy to handle, Honda’s early attempt
at an F1 machine was an amazing display of engineering.

The track on which the Mexico Grand Prix takes place
is 2300m above sea level.

The low air pressure typically gives engines some
trouble generating power.

In designing the RA272’s powerplant, former aircraft engineer
and Honda’s F1 team leader Yoshio Nakamura...

...made sure it would function at high altitudes,
giving the RA272 an edge over its rivals.

The driver of the winning car was Richie Ginther,
one of the most skilled drivers of his day.

All these ingredients came together in Honda’s first F1 win.
And with that, a glorious history was in the making!
dialogues.zh:
这款车是本田近60年的F1大奖赛历史的先行者。

在经历了1964年的艰难起步之后，本田在1965年
携这款RA272卷土重来……

它在本赛季的最后一站，即墨西哥大奖赛上取得了冠军。

1965年也是赛会允许F1赛车使用
1.5升自然吸气引擎的最后一个赛季。

事实上，为这台RA272提供动力的引擎有点本事！

这台排量为1495cc的V12引擎能够产生惊人的230马力！

更令人惊讶的是，单个汽缸的排量仅有125cc，
让人不禁联想到本田摩托车引擎的传承。

除此之外，这台超级紧凑的引擎重量仅为215kg，
而且横向安置在车体的中部！

你可曾听说过这样的事情发生在一台F1赛车上？

但是细细思量，你就会发现这样的设计实际上颇为合理。

通过将引擎横向放置T可以缩短轴距，
减轻变速箱所承受的压力。

本田的初次试水获得了立竿见影的成效，
他们的F1赛车因尺寸紧凑而易于操控。

由于墨西哥大奖赛所处的赛道高于海平面，2300m

低气压通常会给引擎的动力输出带来一些影响。

在设计RA272的引擎时，前飞机工程师
兼本田的F1车队负责人中村良夫……

就确保了它能在高海拔地区正常运转，
使RA272在竞9对手前抢占了先机。

而坐在获胜赛车中的车手里奇·金瑟尔，
也是一位真正专业的赛车大师！

所有的致胜因素在本田的第一个F1冠军头衔中
汇集到了一起。就这样，一段光辉的历史诞生了！

conversation.en:
This is the car that kick-started Honda’s near 60 years
of Formula 1 Grand Prix history.

After a rough start in 1964, Honda was back in 1965,
with this RA272.

It took the checkered flag at the Mexican Grand Prix
in the final round of the season.

That year happened to be the last one in which F1 machines
were powered by 1.5-liter naturally-aspirated engines.

And let me tell you, the engine that powered this RA272
was something special!

It was a V-12 with 1495cc of displacement and capable of
a whopping 230 horsepower!

Surprisingly, the displacement per cylinder was a mere
125cc, something that reflected Honda's motorcycle engines.

What’s more, weighing in at 215kg, this super compact
engine was mounted horizontally amidships!

Have you ever heard of such a thing being done
on a Formula 1 car?

But if you give it some thouht, you’ll see that
it actually made a lot of sense.

By mounting an engine on its side, you can shorten
the wheelbase and put less stress on the gearbox.

Compact and easy to handle, Honda’s early attempt
at an F1 machine was an amazing display of engineering.

The track on which the Mexico Grand Prix takes place
is 2300m above sea level.

The low air pressure typically gives engines some
trouble generating power.

In designing the RA272’s powerplant, former aircraft engineer
and Honda’s F1 team leader Yoshio Nakamura...

...made sure it would function at high altitudes,
giving the RA272 an edge over its rivals.

The driver of the winning car was Richie Ginther,
one of the most skilled drivers of his day.

All these ingredients came together in Honda’s first F1 win.
And with that, a glorious history was in the making!

collection.en:
One of the most iconic cars in Honda's history
is this Formula 1 machine, the Honda RA272.

Honda was the first Japanese automaker to
compete in F1 racing.

In 1965, this car earned Honda its first F1 win at the
Mexican Grand Prix in the final round of the season.

With an aluminum monocoque chassis up front
and a space-frame towards the rear...

...it was powered by a horizontal 1.5-liter V-12 mounted amidships.

The RA272 was developed and driven by Richie
Ginther, an American racer of the 1960s.

Honda has since earned many victories as an engine
supplier, and it all began with the RA272.
collection.zh:
Honda是第一家参加F1赛事的日本制造商。

其历史上最具有标志性的车型就是
这款F1赛车——Honda RA272。

这辆赛车在1965年的最后一站比赛——墨西哥大奖赛
上夺魁，为Honda赢得了第一座F1分站赛冠军奖杯。

它的前半部分采用铝制单体车壳底盘，
而后部则采用了空间框架……

并由一部横中置1.5升V12引擎提供动力。

这辆RA272由活跃于1960年代的美国车手
里奇·金瑟尔参与开发以及驾驶。

自那之后，Honda作为一家引擎供应商赢得了无数F1胜利，
但一切辉煌都始于这辆RA272。

vehicleCollection.en:
The F1 machine that scored Honda its first F1 victory.

Honda has always been at the forefront of innovation. This dates back to the company's early days, a precedent established by founder Soichiro Honda. An example of its technical prowess was its Formula 1 race car in 1964. Called the RA271, it featured an aluminum shell over a space frame body and a 1.5-liter V-12 engine mounted transversely in an unusual fashion amidships. Unfortunately, the car did not fare well in its debut season.

The following year, Honda radically changed the RA271, resulting in the RA272. The RA272E engine was a more efficient version of the previous V-12 with lighter components. The construction of the rear suspension was changed from an inboard to an outboard setup, which allowed the weight to be reduced from 525kg to 498kg, signifying a drastic decrease. The drivers for the new, improved Honda race car were Ronnie Bucknum, in his second year, and new arrival Richie Ginther.

At the start of the 1965 season, the extra power from the RA272's engine showed great potential, but the car suffered from poor stability. The team opted to skip Round 7's German Grand Prix to address the issue. The engineers moved the engine 100mm rearward, while also making adjustments to the body, suspension and exhaust.

In the final race of the season—Round 10's Mexican Grand Prix—the RA272 finally showed its true potential. After starting in 3rd place, Ginther grabbed the lead and stayed there until the finish, giving Honda its first F1 victory. Teammate Bucknum finished 5th.

Since then, Honda has won many F1 races and several championships, and it was the RA272 that started it all for the forward-thinking Japanese car manufacturer.
vehicleCollection.zh:
为本田斩获了第一场胜利的F1赛车。

在创新性思维和前瞻性工程技能的加持下，本田实现了大量的技术革新。其中最杰出的例子当属他们在1964年首次参与F1比赛。当时，他们还只是一家名不见经传的不知名车厂。他们开发的赛车就是RA271，这款车采用了铝制车壳和空间车架，并以与众不同的横中置布局安装了一部1.5升V12引擎。遗憾的是，这样的独创设计也成为了它的软肋，这款车未能在参赛首年取得任何成绩。

在1965年，本田对这部赛车进行了激进的全面重新设计，其成果就是RA272。它的RA272E引擎采用了轻量化部件，效率优于前款V12引擎，后悬挂的设计由一体化内构改为了外置，成功将车重从525kg削减到了498kg，这是一项重大的优化。连续第二年出战的罗尼·巴克纳姆与新车手里奇·金瑟尔搭档驾驶这辆新赛车。

在1965赛季伊始，拥有更强动力的RA272新引擎展现出了巨大的潜力，却又受到稳定性较差的问题所掣肘。车队选择不参加第7轮的德国大奖赛，挤出时间来优化他们的赛车。他们将引擎向后方移动了100mm，并对车身、悬挂和排气等部分进行了其他调整。

在该赛季的最后一场比赛、也就是第10站的墨西哥大奖赛中，RA272全面展现出它真正的潜力。金瑟尔从第三位发车，然后很快提升到了领跑位置，并一直保持到了终点线，为本田赢下了他们的第一个F1分站冠军。他的队友巴克纳姆则以第5名完赛，为车队首次实现了双车积分完赛。

自那之后，本田拿到了无数的F1比赛胜利，不过为他们打开通向辉煌之路的RA272永远是拥有重要历史意义的无价之宝。

usedCar.en:
Honda was nice enough to celebrate its 50th birthday
by giving us the S2000 sports car.

It was the company's first front-engine/rear-drive roadster, or
FR as we say in the biz, since the S800 we last saw in 1970.

Born from the company's Formula 1 experience was the car's
amazing 2.0-liter inline-4 engine.

It is naturally aspirated and revved to an incredible 9000rpm,
but some complained that it lacked low-end torque.

That wasn't enough to deter fans from owning this wonderful
convertible, because Honda sold the car for 10 years.

Another cool tidbit about the S2000 is that it was one of the
first production cars to feature an "Engine Start" button.
usedCar.zh:
S2000车型发布于Honda公司50周年庆之际。

它是该公司自S800以来推出的第一台前置后驱双座敞篷跑车，
堪称呕心沥血之作。

该车采用顶级的自然进气直列四缸引擎。

它的专属定制配置使其转速能在眨眼间
达到惊人的9000rpm之高。

在当时，这款早期版本的汽车引擎曾一度
被一些人批评为“太过极端”...

但在其停产后的数年里，S2000标志性的
灵敏反应性让它收获了很多粉丝。

vehicleCollection.en:
The FR open top sports car debuted for the 50th anniversary of Honda.

The Honda S2000 was a revolutionary car that symbolized the company’s future direction in sports cars. It possessed technology that trickled down from its deep association with motorsports, thus, the S2000 was like a Formula 1 car for the road, from its high-revving engine to its engine-start button. The S2000’s true roots came from Honda’s S series from the 1960s. The S500, S600 and S800 were the S2000’s forefathers, all two-seat convertible sports cars with FR (Front engine, Rear drive) configurations.

The S500, released in 1963, embodied Honda’s philosophy of the engine and suspension working together harmoniously for maximum results and pleasure. Honda revived this philosophy for the modern age and instilled it into the S2000. Every component of the car was custom-built, including the super-rigid open monocoque “X-bone frame” chassis. The engine was as race-oriented as they came in a production car. The F20C, a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 featured an amazing 9000-rpm redline, with power rated at 250ps. It also boasted excellent fuel economy. Mated to the engine was a sturdy 6-speed manual gearbox whose throws were short and well-defined. In July 2000, the S2000 Type V was added to the lineup, featuring the VGS system that electrically controlled the steering ratio according to speed and turning angle. Aerodynamics and suspension were reworked in 2007, giving birth to the Type S with enhanced drivability on winding roads.
vehicleCollection.zh:
本田推出的50周年款S2000，这辆前置后驱敞篷跑车很好地融入了公司的设计哲学。

本田的经典车型S习惯在命名中用3位数字来标明其排量，例如S500、S600和S800。在1999年4月，S800推出的28年之后，本田复活了S系列，并带来了一款4位数编号的产品：S2000，作为庆祝其50周年的纪念车型。

为了最大体现运动车型的操控感，S2000的每个零件都是专门研发的。

虽然是一款敞篷车，但它所采用的“高X-骨”单体车壳可以提供与封闭式车身同等乃至更优秀的刚性。高达9000转的转速上限在量产车中也是凤毛麟角。车上搭载的2.0L自然进气直列4缸F20C引擎可以输出250ps最大马力，却拥有相当经济的油耗。在日本的10-15排放测试中，S2000得出的燃油效率比仅为<12.4km/L>。6速手动变速箱同样是定制产品。为了强化换档手感和减轻重量，研发团队倾注了无数心血在二级齿轮减速箱上。

2000年7月，本田在产品线中添加了以VGS系统为卖点的S2000 Type V，该系统支持根据车速和转向角度来调节转向比。2007年面世的Type S为空气动力学和悬挂系统带来全面提升，从而大幅增添了弯道方面的驾驶乐趣。

What a cute little car. It looks like a miniature
supercar.

There are no gimmicky surfaces or details.

It makes me want to get in and attack a twisty road.

真是一辆可爱的小车啊。它看上去就像是一辆微缩版超跑。

没有任何花哨的表面或细节。

它只会让我想要钻进车里，
在崎岖的道路上风驰电掣。

brandCentral.en:
The Honda S660 was a mid-engine sports car that was
classified as a "kei car" in Japan.

Its compact nature and low price made it one of the most
affordable MR sports cars in the world.

Thanks to its mid-engine layout, the S660 boasted a
front/rear weight distribution ratio of 45/55.

Its suspension system was also tuned to
provide a MR sporty feel.

Despite its diminutive size, I would challenge you to find
a more fun to car to drive than this one.
brandCentral.zh:
Honda S660是一辆中置引擎的跑车，其设计完全符合日式“轻
型车”的规范。

这款车的设计思路是打造一辆更易于驾驶的跑车。

其中置引擎布局使得前后重量分布比例达到了优秀的45/55。

其侧倾中心和重心也进行了调优……

让这辆车的驾驶体验非常顺滑、稳定，操控性也数一数二。

vehicleCollection.en:
The spiritual successor to the Beat was this small-yet-unadulterated mid-engine kei sports car.

While kei-cars aren’t necessarily known to be fun to drive, there are a few exceptions, such as the Honda S660, which was introduced to the Japan market in 2015. This super compact convertible was the spiritual successor to the popular Honda Beat that was discontinued back in 1996.

Like the Beat, the new S660 sports a mid-engine layout. The exterior is characterized by an entirely new look, with sharp lines and smooth curves. Ultra-high-tensile steel comprises 60 percent of the car, including the center tunnel, side sills and side frame. The rear subframe is composed of die-cast aluminum. All this helps keep the S660’s curb weight down to a low 800kg, while maintaining the twisting rigidity that surpassed even that of the S2000.

The roof is a variation of a targa top, where only a portion of it can be removed. The soft top can also be rolled and removed, to be stored in a box under the front hood.

Powering the S660 is a turbocharged 660cc DOHC inline-3 that produces 64ps and 10.6kgm of torque. It comes mated to a close-ratio 6-speed manual gearbox or a paddle-shift CVT with sports mode. Stopping the car are disc brakes at both front and rear.

The suspension consists of struts at all four corners. A torque vectoring system reduces understeer by slightly applying the brakes on the inside front wheel. Thanks to the lightweight and the S660’s remarkable chassis, it’s one of the best handling cars, kei or otherwise, in the world.
vehicleCollection.zh:
本田Beat的精神续作，一辆符合日本轻型车标准的纯正中置引擎迷你跑车。

S660是本田于2015年推出的开顶跑车，这款敞篷跑车被归入超轻量级轻型车的范畴，承袭了本田Beat的精神。后者已经在19年前的1996年停产了。

机械布局方面，这款车采用了中后置引擎双座的布局。车体则是从零重新设计的，结构主要由直线和平顺的弧线构成，整车的60%，从中心通道、侧边门槛到侧边框均由超高拉伸度钢材制造，后部副框架则使用压铸铝材。尽管整车重量被很好地控制在800kg较轻范围内，但车体的静态扭转刚度甚至超过了S2000。

车顶的设计近似于保时捷Targa，也就是说只有乘坐者头顶的部分可以移除。软式顶篷可以拆除并卷起，存放在前引擎盖下的盒子里。

该车的动力基于N-BOX等车款所使用的660cc双顶置凸轮轴直列3缸涡轮增压引擎，可输出64ps/10.6kgm的动力。传动系统为6速手动变速箱，1至5档齿轮比较密，提供了排挡杆、无段变速功能，带有运动模式。

四轮的悬挂均使用了支撑杆，且配备了碟式刹车。在转向时，扭矩向量系统将通过对内侧前轮施加轻微制动的方式抑制转向不足。轮胎则是与横滨轮胎合作开发的特别型号，提供了平衡的前后抓地力。这一系列的细节，使得该车可达到一般微型车上所罕见的弯道速度，且可保持较为均衡与有趣的操控体验。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
The Honda S series will always be remembered for the bold
way it tore up the race track!

It was Honda’s first mass-produced car and a true racer
that was active before its official release.

In 1963, a year before its debut, it took part in
a famous European rally called the Marathon de la Route.

A year later, the Honda S600 pulled off a
stunning GT1-class victory at the Japanese Grand Prix.

In the same year, it also competed in world endurance races,
such as the Nürburgring 500 km, where it won best-in-class.

Around this time, Honda was also performing well in Formula 1 and
had established itself as a major player in motorsports.

The year 1966 saw this S800, powered by a 791cc-engine.

This car became the vanguard of Japanese racing
well into the 1970s.

At the time, Honda had plans to establish a motorsports
support department for S seris competition racers.

This initiative would later result in the creation of the
Racing Service Center (RSC).

Today, RSC is known as Honda Racing Corporation (HRC), a
division of Honda overseeing motorsports activities.

Indeed, the S series is an indispensable part of Honda
and Japan’s racing history!
dialogues.zh:
本田S系列将永远被人们铭记，因为它曾经以不羁
的风格征服了赛道！

它是本田的第一辆量产车，也是一款真正的
赛道机器，在其正式发售之前就活跃在赛场上。

1963年，在其正式发布的前一年，它就参加了
鼎鼎大名的欧洲拉力赛——84小时马拉松汽车耐力赛。

一年之后的1964年，在首次亮相后，本田S600
又在日本大奖赛的GT1级别中取得了惊人的胜利。

同年，它还参加了世界耐力赛，
在纽博格林500km赛事上战胜了同级别最强大的对手！

在本田S系列大放异彩期间，本田在F1锦标赛中也屡有出色表现，
从而在赛车运动领域确立了自己的重要地位。

1966年，这款由791cc引擎驱动的S800发布。

并且一直到1970年代都处于日本赛车的先锋地位。

当时7本田就计划为参加S系列比赛的赛车手们
建立一个赛车运动支持部门。

这一提案在后来推动了赛车服务中心的创建……
也就是今天的本田赛车公司——专门统管其赛车活动的部门。

可以这么说，S系列是本田和日本赛车历史中
不可缺少的一部分！

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
My buddy had bought one when it came out.
I was impressed with how beautiful the engine looked.

It possessed all the right components that make a sports car.

But it was scaled proportionally to match the
body size of a kei-car...

...just like the original FIAT 500.

I loved that short stroke 5-speed shifter.
It had a tight mechanical feel to it.

However, it became notchy often.

That’s why I wanted the Miata to have a short stroke shifter...

...without the notchiness, of course.
dialogues.zh:
我正好有位朋友在这部车发售时买过一辆。
我记得当时我就被这台漂亮的引擎给打动了。

它具备一台真正跑车的所有要素，

只是在设计时按照轻型车的尺寸需要被按比例缩小了。

就像原版的FIAT 500一样！

我真的太喜欢它这台短行程的5速手动变速器了。
它可以为你提供扎实、机械的手感……

虽然确实时不时会出一些小毛病。

是它帮助我下定决心为Miata配备了短行程变速箱……

当然，我们的变速箱没有那些小毛病。?

usedCar.en:
Not many people know that Honda has been in the sports car
business for a long time, since the 1960s actually.

Back then, the company produced the S600, which evolved
to become the S800, a compact open-top sports car.

Under its hood is a DOHC 4-cylinder engine that sends power
to the rear wheels, meaning that it has an FR layout.

Beginning with the S600, the size of the engine grew over time,
from the prototype's 360cc to 500cc, then to 600cc.

As you might guess from the S800's name, this one came with
a 791cc engine that produced 70ps.
usedCar.zh:
S系列跑车是Honda跑车的起源。

它是一款后轮驱动的敞篷双座跑车，
配备了直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎。

随着时间的推移，S车系的引擎排量逐渐
增加，从原型车的360cc到500cc再到600cc。

S800的排量还要更大一些，达到了791cc，
使其能够拥有70ps马力。

显然，它是S2000车型的灵感来源，
且在本质上一脉相承。

vehicleCollection.en:
With a larger displacement than its predecessor, this car represented the pinnacle of the "S" line.

Having dominated the world of two-wheeled racing at the Isle of Man TT, World GP, and more, Honda moved into to the world of four-wheeled cars in 1963. The company's first example was an ultra compact, two-seat sports car called the S500. Soichiro Honda, the founder of Honda Motors, shocked the world by building a sports car from scratch.

But this decision made sense because it was easier for a motorcycle manufacturer to to build a sports car than a sedan because it was much simpler in structure. So the company utilized all the know-how they gained in producing motorcycles into building the S500, a car that lined up with the company's already-established sporty image.

After the debut of the S500 in 1963, Honda produced the S600 the following year, equipped with a more powerful engine. That was followed by a special fastback coupe that performed well in racing. Back then, and even today, the world had never seen a car that could rev up to 10000rpm in stock form. Two years later, the S800 with an even larger engine was added, and when the improved S800M made its appearance, the Honda sports car had finally come into its own, now equipped with a true automotive 4-wheel suspension system.

Starting with the S800, the Honda Sport series featured an exceptionally short shifter, only 10cm in length, which allowed effortless shifting from the low seating position. Delivering a true sports car experience and driving feel, these cars would become popular classics the world over."
vehicleCollection.zh:
本田S系列的巅峰之作，更佳的性能，更大的排量。

在赢下马恩岛TT和世界大奖赛等多项世界知名赛事，统治了两轮竞速世界后，1963年，本田在万众期待的目光中完成了在四轮汽车世界的首秀，公布了一款极其紧凑的两座跑车：S500。这辆由日本战后汽车工业的领军人物本田宗一郎亲手打造的车让业界为之侧目。

本田的运动赛车产品线随着这台S500起航。仅仅半年后，排量和动力都有所提升的斜背双门轿车S600被加入到了敞篷车产品线中。它在赛车场上的成绩也相当优异。无论是在当时，还是在现在，都鲜少有原厂量产车能将转速提升至10000rpm。听到女高音般的引擎轰鸣声时，你就知道，本田S开过来了。

两年之后，S800带着更大的引擎加入了S家族的行列。等到提升版的S800M亮相时，本田的跑车已日趋完美。悬挂系统也变成真正的四驱车布局，高速过弯全不在话下。

从S800开始，短换挡杆成为了本田运动车型的特色。只有10cm的拨杆便于低坐姿的车手进行换挡。携着真正的赛车体验和驾驶感受，这几款车很快就在全球市场上成为了热门经典车型。

catch.en: With a larger displacement than its predecessor, this car represented the pinnacle of the "S" line.
catch.zh: 本田S系列的巅峰之作，更佳的性能，更大的排量。

long.en:
Having dominated the world of two-wheeled racing at the Isle of Man TT, World GP, and more, Honda moved into to the world of four-wheeled cars in 1963. The company's first example was an ultra compact, two-seat sports car called the S500. Soichiro Honda, the founder of Honda Motors, shocked the world by building a sports car from scratch.

But this decision made sense because it was easier for a motorcycle manufacturer to to build a sports car than a sedan because it was much simpler in structure. So the company utilized all the know-how they gained in producing motorcycles into building the S500, a car that lined up with the company's already-established sporty image.

After the debut of the S500 in 1963, Honda produced the S600 the following year, equipped with a more powerful engine. That was followed by a special fastback coupe that performed well in racing. Back then, and even today, the world had never seen a car that could rev up to 10000rpm in stock form. Two years later, the S800 with an even larger engine was added, and when the improved S800M made its appearance, the Honda sports car had finally come into its own, now equipped with a true automotive 4-wheel suspension system.

Starting with the S800, the Honda Sport series featured an exceptionally short shifter, only 10cm in length, which allowed effortless shifting from the low seating position. Delivering a true sports car experience and driving feel, these cars would become popular classics the world over."

brandCentral.en:
The Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo is a compact
mid-engined sports car.

Everything about it has been designed with the driver in
mind, an approach for which Honda is well-known.

The design team put this model through real-life tests when
developing its aerodynamic features.

Under its bonnet is a 410ps 2L
straight-four turbo engine...

Accompanied by a 8-speed dual-clutch transmission.

Amazingly, the whole thing only weighs 899kg!
brandCentral.zh:
Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo是一款中置引擎的紧凑型跑车。

在这辆车上，所有的设计都以驾驶者为中心，这也是Honda
赖以成名的设计理念。

设计团队在进行该车的空气动力学特性研发时，直接进
行了实车测试。

其引擎盖下装载了一台410ps的2L直列四缸涡轮增压引擎……

搭配8速双离合器变速箱。

最令人称道的是，整部车的重量仅有899kg！

vehicleCollection.en:
This lightweight mid-engine sports car embodied Honda's "Power of Dreams" philosophy.

The "Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo" midship-engined 2-seater coupe was born from a collaboration between the Honda design team and Gran Turismo.

This is a true sports model that takes to heart the Honda corporate spirit of "doing it because it's fascinating," and pursues the fun of driving as well as authentic realism befitting the "real driving simulator," Gran Turismo.

The "Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo" was the winner of the global design competition. For further design refinements after the competition, designers from both Japan and the US had their input in the process, with each applying their own unique strengths into project. The design progressed globally, with the quarter model built in the US, and the modeling data and hardware decisions made in Japan. Staff from each region were closely connected in the process, and the designers enjoyed participating in the project.

The "Honda Sports Vision Gran Turismo" brings to life the design direction of Honda, "Human Centered Design". This is a human-centric way of thinking that is brought to life in the package design, where the position of the passengers, engine, and tires determines the shape of the car’s structure. The proportions of the car that makes it look as though it is about to propel itself forward, the clean cut body and the powerful front and rear fenders that spreads wide with air intakes, and wheels that combine function and beauty; all these things that are expected of a sports car, are expressed in the strong sense of presence emitted by the car.

Carbon fiber is utilized in many parts of the body, achieving a weight of just 899kg. The 1998cc engine is mounted midship, and combined with an L4 turbo and DOHC-VTEC, it produces 410ps at 7500rpm. This power is then efficiently transferred to the road through an 8-sped dual clutch transmission.

The aerodynamics simulations for the car o course involved wind tunnel testing, as it would be for a real life ca. Throuh this process, the flow and exhaust ofair passing through he body, underfloor, cabin, andengine room have been fuly optmized.

The"Honda Sports Vsion Gran Turismo" is a car that exemplifies Honda's "Power of Dreams," and is a ca that we believe is a true o life machine that can e enoyed by many.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆轻型中置引擎跑车传达着本田“极致马力”的理念。"

本田Vision Gran Turismo运动特别版中置引擎双座双门跑车诞生于本田设计团队和跑车浪漫旅的合作。

这是一台融入了“引人入胜的卓越驾驶感”这一本田企业精神的真正跑车，并借助不断追寻着真实感和驾乘乐趣，它完美契合了跑车浪漫旅所倡导的“真实驾驶模拟”理念。

本田Vision Gran Turismo运动特别版还获得了全球设计大赛的冠军。为了对获胜后的车型进行进一步改良，日本和美国的设计师们都在这个过程中作出了贡献，并将他们各人自身的优势应用到此项目之中。本田在全球的各个分公司都参与了此设计流程，美国负责制造1:4的模型，而数据分析和硬件则由日本决定。各地区成员通力合作，设计师们也很享受参与项目的过程。

本田Vision Gran Turismo运动特别版孕育了本田“以人为本”的设计理念。这是一个在整车研发设计中诞生的以人为本的思维方式，乘员位置、引擎、以及轮胎决定车身结构布置。这台车的独特比例让它即使在静止时依然让人觉得马上就要向前疾驰，干净利落的车身以及宽阔且带有进气口的前后挡泥板，还有融合性能和美学的车轮；一台跑车所应该拥有的品质均在该车上淋漓尽致地展现了出来。

通过在车身多处使用碳纤维，本车实现了仅899kg的自重。中置1998cc引擎，搭配上L4涡轮以及双顶置凸轮轴-VTEC，它可以在7500rpm的转速下产生410ps的动力。动力再通过8档双离合变速箱传导至路面。

这台车的空气动力学模拟当然也包含了风洞测试，因为这将是一款投入实际使用的车型。经过一系列测试之后，通过车身、底盘、以及驾驶室和引擎室的气i和排气都被全方位优化。

这台“本田Vision Gran Turismo@动特别版”是本田“梦想力量”的代表作品，我们相I它将R会被投入实际使用并被大众O喜爱。

brandCentral.en:
The letter 'N' is a special marking for Hyundai cars,
designating the company’s know-how and passion.

The ELANTRA N is one such car—the ultimate high-performance
FF sports sedan.

Encased in its sleek body is a 2L turbo boasting 280ps
of power, and capable of going 0-<100km/h> in 5.3 seconds.

The car is offered in 6-speed MT and 8-speed DCT, the latter
of which is equipped with an N Grin Shift overboost feature.

The suspension uses electronically controlled dampers
and an eLSD that allows for next-level high-speed cornering.

But the cherry on top is an N Sound Equaliser that lets
the driver enjoy their ideal exhaust sound while driving.

A sporty yet practical 4-door sedan, the ELANTRA N makes
everyday life exciting!
brandCentral.zh:
字母“N”是Hyundai为旗下汽车打造的特殊标识，
象征着品牌的技术实力与激情。

ELANTRA N也是如此——这是一台终极高性能前驱运动轿车。

流畅的车身内搭载了一台2升涡轮增压引擎，
输出功率达280ps，0-<100km/h>加速仅需5.3秒。

该车提供6速手动与8速双离合变速箱两项选择，
后者更支持N Grin Shift超增压功能。

悬挂采用电子控制减震器与eLSD电子限滑差速器配合，
能实现前所未有的高速过弯。

而点睛之笔在于N Sound Equalizer，让驾驶者
能按个人喜好定制排气声浪。

这台兼具运动性与实用性的四门轿车ELANTRA N
让日常生活也充满激情！

vehicleCollection.en:
This track-ready Elantra is brought to you by the letter "N.")

Since its debut in 1990, the Elantra had been a cornerstone of Hyundai’s lineup. In 2020, the seventh generation was introduced, earning wide acclaim for the bold “Parametric Dynamics” of its exterior design. At the top of this seventh-generation range stood the Elantra N.

Created to embody the N philosophy of “making cornering fun,” the Elantra N was powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter engine producing 280ps and 40.0kgm of torque. Despite its front-wheel-drive layout, it accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in just 5.3 seconds.

The car was offered with either a 6-speed manual or an 8-speed DCT. The manual came equipped with rev-matching, while the DCT added advanced features such as N Grin Shift for overboost, N Power Shift to enhance shifting characteristics, and N Track Sense Shift, optimized for race-track driving.

The suspension featured electronically controlled dampers, an eLSD, and a large braking system, ensuring sharp handling and confidence at speed. With its reinforced chassis and Michelin Pilot Sport 4S tires, it achieved a fine balance between cornering agility and stability. Inside, the Elantra N offered a custom steering wheel, supportive bucket seats, and the N Sound Equalizer, which allowed drivers to tailor the exhaust note to their liking for a heightened sports-driving experience.

Hyundai even developed a TCR touring car variant of the Elantra, a machine that earned respect on the track and underscored the car’s deep ties to motorsports."
vehicleCollection.zh:
挂上“N”名号的伊兰特，专为赛道而生。

自1990年问世以来，伊兰特始终是现代主力车系中的中坚力量。2020年推出的第7代车款因外观设计中运用的“参数动力学”理念而广受赞誉。伊兰特N则是第7代中的性能最强版本。

为体现N品牌“弯道顽童”的理念，伊兰特N搭载了一台2升涡轮引擎，可输出280ps功率与40.0kgm扭矩。此外，尽管采用了前驱布局，其0-<100km/h>加速时间仍能达到5.3秒。

该车提供6速手动和8速双离合变速箱两种版本。前者支持降档补油，后者配备了N驾趣增强模式（超增压功能）、N动力换挡模式（改变双离合变速箱特性）及N赛道感知换挡（赛道驾驶优化）等多项功能。

悬挂方面，伊兰特N配备了电子控制减震器、电子限滑差速器及大号碟刹。与之搭配的强化底盘与米其林Pilot Sport 4S轮胎帮助其在弯道表现与高度稳定性之间取得完美平衡。车内配备定制方向盘与桶形座椅，并配有N声浪均衡器，让驾驶者可随心调节排气声浪，进一步提升运动驾驶体验。

同期开发的还有一款伊兰特的TCR赛车版本，以其卓越性能而备受赞誉。这也充分体现出伊兰特是现代车系中与赛道有着紧密联系的一款车型。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
In 2022, scarcely a year after its first appearance...

...the ELANTRA N TC rose to the top, claiming the crown
at the very pinnacle of global TCR competition.

Even now, it continues to assert its authority as
a constant force on the world stage.

And who could overlook its astonishing performance
at the Nürburgring 24h in May 2025?

That was the moment the ELANTRA N TC delivered an improbable
1–2 finish in the TCR Class!

Remarkably, it also marked Hyundai’s fifth straight class victory
at this legendary endurance race.
dialogues.zh:
2022年，即此车面世仅一年之后……

ELANTRA N TC就荣获了世界TCR系列赛
最高级别比赛的冠军。

直至今日，此车仍旧在国际舞台上展现着它强大的实力！

谁能忘记它于2025年5月
在纽博格林24小时耐力赛的赛道上驰骋的英姿？

在那场比赛中，ELANTRA N TC
可是包揽了TCR组别的冠亚军，堪称奇迹！

此外，这也是Hyundai在这项传奇赛事中
获得该组别的第五次连胜。
\

brandCentral.en:
Ever heard of the “TCR” racing category? It’s where
2.0-liter FF touring cars battle it out on the track.

Ever since this perennially popular category began, Hyundai
has been actively developing cars to compete in it.

This ELANTRA N TC is the third-generation successor to
the i30 N and Veloster N.

Exploiting the full potential of the ELANTRA N, it becomes
the ultimate lightweight, aerodynamic machine.

Although its power and torque remain within regulation limits,
its advanced chassis settings deliver superior handling.

Already carrying several victories from around the globe, it has
earned a stellar reputation among racing privateers.

Thanks to its unique design, this is one car that truly
stands out on the track!<

vehicleCollection.en:
This track-oriented Elantra was meticulously crafted to achieve victory.

The ELANTRA N is a high-performance sedan from Hyundai’s N brand. There was also a special edition of this car built specifically for motorsports, called the ELANTRA N TC.

The base-model ELANTRA N was already an excellent choice for the circuit, featuring a turbocharged 2.0-liter direct-injection engine producing 280ps and 40.0kgm of torque, and capable of accelerating from 0–<100km/h> in 5.3 seconds in a front-wheel-drive layout. With these strong fundamentals, the TC variant was specially modified to meet international touring-car regulations and was imbued with the capability to win.

The aerodynamic wide body, carbon-fiber splitter, and large rear wing generated substantial downforce, dramatically improving high-speed cornering stability. The drivetrain incorporated a sequential 6-speed gearbox, while the dedicated racing suspension and adjustable dampers allowed it to adapt instantly to varying track conditions. The braking and cooling systems were also upgraded with endurance-spec components.

Efforts to reduce weight and increase rigidity were evident throughout, with the cockpit featuring a regulation roll cage and racing seat. The steering and pedal layout were engineered for immediate response to driver inputs. Carefully crafted into a machine built for victory, the ELANTRA N TC carried the competitive spirit of its road-going counterpart while retaining its agility and reliability.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这台为赛道而生的伊兰特，每一处细节都经过细心雕琢，只为决胜于赛场。

伊兰特N”是现代“N”品牌下的一款高性能轿车。此外，现代还为赛车运动打造了该车型的特别版——伊兰特N TC。

基础款伊兰特N本身已经堪称赛道利器了，它配备一台2.0升的直喷涡轮增压引擎，可产生280ps的动力和40.0kgm的扭矩，基于前驱布局，0-<100km/h>加速仅需5.3秒。伊兰特N TC则在这个坚实的基础上，严格遵循国际房车赛规则进行了深度改装，为其赋予了决胜赛场的实力。

宽体空气动力学车身、碳纤维前分流板和大型尾翼共同作用，产生强大的下压力，使其高速过弯性能得到了显著的提升。传动系统采用6速序列式变速箱，以及特殊定制的赛车悬挂和可调减震器，使其能够即时适应不同路况。刹车和冷却系统也经过了全面升级，采用了耐力赛规格的配件。

整车致力于减重和提升刚度，座舱内配备符合赛事规则的防滚架和赛车座椅。转向系统和踏板布局也进行了优化，确保车手的操作即时得到反馈。伊兰特N TC经过细致改装，成为了一台能够决胜赛场的利器，同时又保留了公路车型的灵巧操控和可靠品质。

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The Genesis Coupé was a true sports car with RWD
and a 343ps 3.8-liter V-6.

The exterior styling was inspired by its RWD proportions.

This resulted in a long dash-to-front axle, a long hood with
a short front-overhang...

...and a cabin set rearward.

The styling lines and graphics were unique, inspired
by an East Asian ink-wash painting process.

This process started with abstract black ink-brush strokes
to find the right facial and styling expressions.

The idea of the artistic process was to create a unique
character and interest.

In a way, this was an extension of the classical theme
of sketching...

...with the added bonus of allowing the brush strokes
to create unexpected graphics.
dialogues.zh:
捷尼赛思Coupe是一款真正的后驱跑车，搭载一台
输出343ps的3.8升V6引擎。

外观设计为了着重凸显后驱车的比例，

带来长轴距的前舱（从仪表盘到车头）、修长的引擎盖
和较短的前悬挂……

以及向后移置的车厢。

其造型的线条和样式均十分独特，是从东亚水墨画的
绘制过程中汲取了灵感。

在水墨绘画中，往往会用毛笔以抽象的墨色笔触
勾勒出准确的面部和造型表达。

其内核是追求独特的个性和审美趣味。

在某种程度上，它是素描这一经典画技的延伸……

并加入了以毛笔笔触带来的、意想不到的视觉效果。

vehicleCollection.en:
Circuit-developed components characterized this high-performance sports car.

The Genesis Coupe is a sporty 2-door that shared a platform with the Genesis luxury coupe.

The Genesis Coupe was shorter than the sedan by 345mm, with a wheelbase that was also shorter, by 115mm. These dimensions, combined with the front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout and four-wheel independent suspension, gave the car excellent agility. The engine choices were a 3.8-liter V-6 or a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline 4. Thanks to the car's excellent power delivery and agile rear-drive handling, the Genesis Coupe quickly gained popularity.

A minor change was implemented in 2012 that gave the coupe sharper looks, but the focus was on increasing engine output across the board. Power for the 3.8-liter V6 was increased to approximately 350ps, making it one of the most powerful cars in its class. Also, in addition to the previous 6-speed manual gearbox, a paddle-shift 8-speed unit was added as an option.

The high-performance model was the 3.8 Track. Springs, dampers and stabilizers were changed to race track-developed, heavy-duty parts, with an adjustable front camber and Torsen LSD. Also, Brembo four-piston calipers were added to the car, emphasizing its pure sport focus. In well-respected tests carried out by unbiased organizations, the Genesis Coupe easily outperformed class rivals.
vehicleCollection.zh:
配备有赛道专用部件的高性能双门跑车。

捷尼赛思Coupe是一款与捷尼赛思豪华双门轿车共享平台开发的跑车。

其车身比轿车款短了345mm，并缩短了115mm的轴距。再搭配上前置引擎、后驱布局以及四轮独立悬挂，赋予了这台车卓越的敏捷性。引擎可使用3.6升V6引擎，或者2.0升直列四缸涡轮引擎。由于世界上后驱双门跑车车型日渐凋零，此车迅速地吸引了公众的目光。

该车于2012年进行中期小改款，为其带来了更酷炫的造型，而内在最主要的改变则是其引擎整体动力得到了相当程度的提升。3.8升V6引擎的动力输出提升到350ps之后，该车终于能够进入超跑的行列。与此同时，除了此前使用的6档手动变速箱之外，此车还提供了拨片式8档自动变速箱的选项。

该车的高性能版本为3.8赛道版。弹簧、避震器、以及平衡杆都变更为专为赛道所开发的高强度零部件，并包含了可调前车外倾角以及托森限滑差速器。该车上还加装了布雷博的4活塞刹车卡钳，使其能更专注于竞速。

在广受认可的汽车材料表征研究所测试中，捷尼赛思Coupe轻松击败了同级别的其他竞争对手。

捷尼赛思Coupe是一款与捷尼赛思豪华双门轿车共享平台开发的跑车。

其车身比轿车款短了345mm，并缩短了115mm的轴距。再搭配上前置引擎、后驱布局以及四轮独立悬挂，赋予了这台车卓越的敏捷性。引擎可使用3.8升V6引擎，或者2.0升直列四缸涡轮引擎。由于世界上后驱双门跑车车型日渐凋零，此车迅速地吸引了公众的目光。

该车于2012年进行中期小改款，为其带来了更酷炫的造型，而内在最主要的改变则是其引擎整体动力得到了相当程度的提升。3.8升V6引擎的动力输出提升到350ps之后，该车终于能够进入超跑的行列。与此同时，除了此前使用的6档手动变速箱之外，此车还提供了拨片式8档自动变速箱的选项。

该车的高性能版本为3.8赛道版。弹簧、避震器、以及平衡杆都变更为专为赛道所开发的高强度零部件，并包含了可调前车外倾角以及托森限滑差速器。该车上还加装了布雷博的4活塞刹车卡钳，使其能更专注于竞速。

在广受认可的汽车材料表征研究所测试中，捷尼赛思Coupe轻松击败了同级别的其他竞争对手。

*此型号经过跑车浪漫旅特殊调校，符合组别3规范。
