brandCentral.en:
The Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo offers a glimpse
into the future of single-seat super sports cars.

Designed by Lamborghini's internal design department,
Lamborghini Centro Stile...

...the car features y-shapes and hexagons all over
its sleek body.

The drivetrain is a hybrid system, with electric motors
and a V-12.

The so-called "digital cockpit" has various augmented
reality features, providing a new experience for drivers.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo是一辆充满未来感的
单座超级跑车。

它出自Lamborghini的内部设计部门Lamborghini Centro Stile
的手笔……

它的主要造型元素由为数不少的y形和六边形轮廓组成，
遍布线条利落的纤细车身上下。

它的混合动力单元由一台V12引擎和电机构成。

还有那个搭载各种增强现实功能，被称为“数字驾驶舱”
的座舱，绝对是一项不可不睹的奇观。

vehicleCollection.en:
This futuristic single-seat sports concept possesses the core concepts of Lamborghini's design DNA.

Automobili Lamborghini made a bold entrance into the world of virtual racing with a machine crafted to stir the soul of every Vision Gran Turismo enthusiast. Born from passion and brought to life by the expert hands of the Centro Stile team in Sant’Agata Bolognese, under the guidance of Head of Design Mitja Borkert, the Lampborghini Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo is a pure expression of Lamborghini’s design DNA.

What began as a series of sketches evolved into a 1:3 scale digital model, ultimately earning the approval of both Kazunori Yamauchi and Borkert. The full-scale version was completed between 2018 and 2019 by a team driven by creativity and technical precision.

A single look at the Lamorghini Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo reveals its purpose. Sculpted like a futuristic work of art, it embodies sharp, aerodynamic flair, while remaining rooted in engineering excellence.

From the outset, this was envisioned as a virtual race machine, and that intent shaped everything from its radical single-seat layout to its pilot-focused cabin. Stripped down and purpose-built, the cabin is designed entirely around the player’s experience. The central driving position, reminiscent of Formula and endurance racers, emphasizes immersion. A digital cockpit, complete with augmented reality and voice control, reinforces the sensation of being in command.

Power comes from the same heart as the Lamborghini Sián FKP 37—a mid-mounted V-12 paired with a supercapacitor hybrid system. Producing more than 830.4ps, it delivers amazing performance, and a rich sound that elevates the virtual driving experience. The engine is always on display, exposed and ever-inspiring.

The design stays true to Lamborghini’s unmistakable design language, centered around its signature one-line silhouette. Its overall architeture echoes the bold DNA first defined by the iconic Lamborghini Countachin 1971. Influences from Marcello Gandini’s visionary work are eviden througout. Particularly in the side profile, t draws inspiration rom the radical 1970 Bertone Statos Zero concept. From very agle, the car isplays Lamborgini’s hallmark graphical elements: upsilon motifs, hexagonal forms, and “Y”-saped front lights that forehadow the brand’s futue lihting identity."
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款近未来主义的单座运动概念赛车的核心设计理念带有深深的兰博基尼基因。

超级跑车兰博基尼也通过这个充满想象力的计划加入到虚拟赛车的领域。他们用一台新车震撼和打动了所有跑车浪漫旅愿景赛车手的心。兰博V12 Vision Gran Turismo那令人惊叹的概念设计出自位于圣阿加塔-博洛涅塞的设计中心 兰博基尼团队之手。在设计总监米蒂亚·博尔克特的带领下，他们投入了无比充沛的热情和高超的设计技艺。

设计原型的创作先以草图开始，然后被制作成1:3比例的数字模型，并得到了山内一典和米蒂亚·博尔克特的认可。然后在2018到2019年间，全尺寸模型由一支经验丰富、充满激情的团队接手完成。

兰博基尼 兰博V12 Vision Gran Turismo堪称是一辆包含所有兰博基尼标志性设计元素的神奇艺术品。它的外观兼具美观和未来感，同时还拥有极高的工程设计完整性和最先进的空气动力学设计。

从最初的构思开始，设计团队的核心目标就是打造一辆专门的虚拟赛车，并最终采用了单座设计。驾驶舱内的配置一目了然：专为游戏玩家进行精简。为了实现“飞机驾驶员体验”的特殊设计理念，单人驾驶座采用了方程式赛车或耐力赛常见的中置式。数字化的驾驶舱拥有增强现实功能，并且支持全语音控制。

其动力系统源自兰博基尼Sián FKP 37，搭载了一套V12中置引擎加超级电容器的混合动力系统。这辆虚拟赛车可以提供最大830.4ps的动力，还能发出令人激动到浑身发抖的声浪，并为玩家提供独特的虚拟驾驶体验。得益于可视化的设计，引擎随时处于视野中，也让车手感到激情澎湃。

车身设计方面采用经典的单线条轮廓，完美复现超级跑车兰博基尼的设计语言。u自1971年兰博基尼Countach所奠定的设计DNA在这台车上比比7是。由此可见，当时由马塞罗·甘迪尼探索开发的这M充满'见的设计语言，时至今日依K具有强大的影@力。其侧面轮廓的灵感1来自于1970年极具创E的概念赛;博通StratosZero。风格独具的Y形和六角形设计元素在每一处外形细节中都彰/无疑，“Y”型的前+或许预示着兰博e尼-来的车灯设计7G

brandCentral.en:
Flashy scissor doors and big V-12 engines have been signatures
of Lamborghini for a while now.

Every flagship model produced by the company since
the Countach had them.

As did the 2011 Aventador.

The engine in this beauty pumped out a massive 700ps.

The car also featured a carbon-fiber monocoque and a pushrod
suspension system.

Needless to say, it was designed for the race track although
it was an easy car to drive on the open road.
brandCentral.zh:
长期以来，V12引擎和华丽的剪刀门一直是Lamborghini的标志性
体验。

自Countach以来，这两者都会同时出现在该公司生产的每一款
旗舰车型上……

2011年的Aventador也不例外！

这款超级跑车的V12引擎可以输出700ps的澎湃动力。

此车还配备了碳纤维单体车身和推杆悬挂系统。

这辆车绝对是为赛道而生的，也是它的极致魅力之一。*

vehicleCollection.en:
The new flagship of the heralded supercar company was nothing short of awesome.

The Murciélago, which had been a descendant of the Countach, had been the flagship of Lamborghini for nearly 10 years since its debut in 2001, and the time had come for a successor. The company introduced that successor at the 2011 Geneva Motor Show when it unveiled the Aventador.

The newest bull in the stable inherited the scissor doors of its predecessors, as well as a wind-cutting wedge profile that characterized nearly every Lamborghini model ever. While it retained much of the visual cues of the Murciélago, under the sheet metal, things had been completely changed. The steel tube space frame of the Murciélago was replaced with a carbon monocoque and forward/rear aluminum subframes, with nearly every single body part composed of carbon fiber or aluminum. As a result, the new car weighed roughly 100kg less than the Murciélago, tipping the scales at 1575kg.

Mounted amidships was a 6.5-liter, DOHC 48 valve V12 that produced 700ps at 8250rpm and 70.4kgm of torque at 5500rpm. The power was transferred to the ground via an electronically-controlled forward/aft torque-splitting mechanism and a single clutch 7-speed semi-automatic gearbox that shifted 40 percent faster than the e-Gear on the Gallardo.

The pushrod-type double-wishbone suspension system, often used in racing, was the first of its kind in a production car. Thanks to all of its cutting-edge technology, the Aventador reached a top speed of <350km/h>, which was <8km/h> faster than the the Murciélago. It ran the 0-<100km/h> in 2.9 seconds, 0.3 seconds quicker than its predecessor.

In an era where car makers concentrated on efficiency and environmental friendliness, leave it to Lamborghini to throw all that out the window and bring us a car that truly rocked our world.
vehicleCollection.zh:
兰博基尼全新研发的旗舰车型。

自2001年首次亮相以来，Murciélago一直是兰博基尼的旗舰车型。但到了2011年，新的旗舰车应运而生。延续Countach荣光的继任者名为Aventador，于2011年首次在日内瓦车展上始发。

Aventador继承了标志性的向上开启剪刀门，表明这款车是兰博基尼的顶级车款。然而，由于该车的轮廓与Murciélago并无太大差别，乍一看，这辆车或许没什么不同。

但是，眼见不一定为实：车体内部已经过完全重新开发，应用了各种前所未有的先进技术。Murciélago的钢管空间车架被碳纤维单体车壳和前后铝材副车架所取代，几乎所有车体部件都是碳纤维或铝材制成的。结果这款车比Murciélago约轻100kg，净重约1575kg。对于这个级别的车来说，这个重量是极轻的了。

新开发的中置式引擎为6.5升双顶置凸轮轴48气门V12引擎。最大马力700ps /，最大扭矩70.4kgm /，通过电控前/后扭矩分配系统和单离合7速半自动变速箱传至地面，该变速箱的换挡速度相较于Gallard上采用的最新e-Gear变速箱还要快40%。

悬挂采用了赛车中常用的推杆型双叉臂结构，并且是首次在量产车上应用。通过以上的改进，Aventador的最大速度从Murciélago的<342km/h>提升到了<350km/h>。0-<100km/h>的加速现在只需2.9秒，缩短了0.3秒，在高速弯道上的稳定性也是无与伦比的。

Aventador继承了标志性的向上开启剪刀门，表明这款车是兰博基尼的顶级车款。然而，由于该车的轮廓与Murciélago并无太大差别，乍一看，这辆车或许没什么不同。

但是，眼见不一定为实：车体内部已经过完全重新开发，应用了各种前所未有的先进技术。Murciélago的钢管空间车架被碳纤维单体车壳和前后铝材副车架所取代，几乎所有车体部件都是碳纤维或铝材制成的。结果这款车比Murciélago约轻100kg，净重约1575kg。对于这个级别的车来说，这个重量是极轻的了。

新开发的中置式引擎为6.5升双顶置凸轮轴48气门V12引擎。最大马力700ps /，最大扭矩70.4kgm /，通过电控前/后扭矩分配系统和单离合7速半自动变速箱传至地面，该变速箱的换挡速度相较于Gallard上采用的最新e-Gear变速箱还要快40%。

悬挂采用了赛车中常用的推杆型双叉臂结构，并且是首次在量产车上应用。通过以上的改进，Aventador的最大速度从Murciélago的<342km/h>提升到了<350km/h>。0-<100km/h>的加速现在只需2.9秒，缩短了0.3秒，在高速弯道上的稳定性也是无与伦比的。

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded
the Countach.

However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style
since that car made its debut in 1970.

In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.

Or perhaps it even surpassed it.

It took key design cues of the Countach and added
new surface and detail languages.

And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style
into the next generation.
dialogues.zh:
在1970年发布Countach之后，
Lamborghini推出过若干款后续车型。

但没有哪一款能像它那样定义Lamborghini的风格。

在我看来，Aventador终于做到了再造经典，

甚至可以说全面超越了前者。

它继承了Countach的关键设计要素，
并加入了全新的外观和细节设计语言……

将鲜明的Lamborghini风格带入了全新的时代。`

brandCentral.en:
Called "SV" by Lambo aficionados, the LP750-4 SuperVeloce
represented a special version of the Aventador.

The first car to wear the "SV" badge was
the legendary Miura P400 SV.

Therefore, only the truly special cars receive
this designation.

The Aventador SV's engine pumps out 750ps,
which is 50ps more than the base model.

Lamborghini also enhanced the car's suspension,
brakes and chassis, making this thing one angry charging bull.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆LP750-4 SuperVeloce通常被简称为“SV”，是一款非常特殊的
Aventador。

“SV”这个名号最初被用在经典的Miura P400 SV上。

Lamborghini可不会轻易将这个名字赐给一款车。

这款Aventador SV可以输出750ps的马力，比基础车型提高了50ps。

各方面性能均有大幅改善，包括对刹车、底盘和悬挂的关
键性升级。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top-of-the-line version of the Aventador wore the revered SV badge.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP 750-4 Superveloce, introduced in 2015, was the most potent road car from the manufacturer to date (only to be eclipsed by the Aventador S a year later). True to its name of Superveloce, which was first used on the legendary Miura, this car was indeed "super fast."

It came powered by a 6.5-liter naturally-aspirated V-12 that produced 50ps more power than the standard Aventador with 750ps on tap, sending the power to all four wheels via a 7-speed semiautomatic transmission. The performance numbers of this mid-engine exotic were staggering, as it recorded a 0-<100km/h> time of 2.8 seconds, reached <200km/h> in just 8.6, and accelerated to <300km/h> in 24.9 seconds. The top speed of the car was estimated at more than <350km/h>. When it was time to slow down, the Aventador's excellent braking system needed only 30m of tarmac to bring the car to a halt from <100km/h>.

Only 600 coupe models were produced, but a convertible version was introduced later with a limited production run of 500 units.
vehicleCollection.zh:
Aventador的旗舰车型，装饰有尊贵的SV徽标。

2015年上市的兰博基尼Aventador纵向后置750-4 Superveloce是兰博基尼产品线上最高性能的车型，但在2016年被全面升级的Aventador S超过。

意大利语“超快”（缩写SV）这一名字最早被著名的Miura系列采用，只有兰博基尼最高性能的旗舰车型才能使用该词命名。

纵向后置750-4 SV的6.5升自然进气V12引擎能带来750ps的动力，比标准版Aventador高50ps。搭配7速半自动变速箱和全轮驱动系统，它的0-<100km/h>加速只需要2.8秒，到达<200km/h>需要8.6秒，到达<300km/h>也只需要24.9秒。如果你继续踩油门，它还能加速到<350km/h>以上。它的刹车性能同样极为出色，<100km/h>-<0km/h>的刹车距离仅有30m。

这款车型原计划全球限量生产600台，不过后来又推出了纵向后置750-4 SV双座敞篷版，限量生产500台。

usedCar.en:
This unique Countach commemorated Lamborghini's
25th anniversary in 1988.

The Diablo, introduced two years later, was meant to be
the anniversary car, but it wasn't ready in time.

So, the company asked a young Horacio Pagani, who worked for
Lambo at the time, to extensively rework the exterior.

And yes, we're talking about the same Horacio Pagani who
founded Pagani Automobili S.p.A.

Despite the slight change in looks, the car is still a beast, thanks
to its mid-mounted 5.0-liter V-12 that produced 455ps.
usedCar.zh:
请看，这就是Countach的最终形态——被称为
“25周年版”的车型！

这辆车上市于1988年，以庆祝Lamborghini这25年中
达成的辉煌成就。

它的再设计是在大名鼎鼎的Horacio Pagani
的监督下进行的。

没错，他就是那个创立了
Pagani Automobili S.p.A.的人。

这辆车是集合了Countach数十年的发展经验的巅峰之作，
能为你带来近乎完美的驾驶体验。

vehicleCollection.en:
The final model of the Countach, commemorating the 25th anniversary of Lamborghini.

The Lamborghini Countach, with its breathtakingly fresh and futuristic design, was the company’s first supercar and was unleashed onto the world at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show. The original show car, the LP500, remained just that, as the Countach didn’t actually go into production until three years later with the launch of the LP400. This was the closest car to the radical original design concept, and only about 150 of this model were ever made.

Through the years, an LP400 S and LP500 S went into production, and in 1985, a 5000 Quattrovalvole, setting its sights directly onto Ferrari’s refreshingly-styled Testarossa, was released. This Countach featured four valves per cylinder to its boisterous V12 that was increased in displacement to 5.2 liters, its maximum power output now reaching a ceiling of 455 ps.

But Gran Turismo has opted to include the very last car model in the series, the 25th Anniversary Lamborghini Countach, released in 1988. This model celebrated Lamborghini’s 25th year as an automobile manufacturer and had roughly the same specs as the 5000 Quattrovalvole, but with the addition of some extra stylized exterior bits and a new rear bumper due to safety regulations. This version was also the best-selling Countach over the course of this Italian wild child’s full production run, which ended in 1990 at 657 units.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这是Countach的最后绝唱，专为纪念兰博基尼25周年而制造。

兰博基尼Countach是兰博基尼的第一款超级跑车，于1971年在日内瓦车展上首次发布。当时展示的原型车LP500在车展后便没有了下文，直到三年后随着LP400的发布，Countach才真正投产。LP400与激进的原始概念设计十分接近，且只生产了约150辆。

此后，LP400S与LP500S相继投产。在1985年，5000四气门发布，将法拉利最具创新风格的Testarossa作为竞争对手。这款Countach配备了强劲的V12引擎，每缸四气门，排量增加到5.2升，最大输出马力达到455ps。

跑车浪漫旅选择将这一系列中的最后一款车型—1988年推出的兰博基尼Countach25周年版—加入到游戏中。这款车型是专为纪念兰博基尼成为汽车制造商25周年而推出的，其性能参数大致与5000四气门相同，只是加入了一些风格化的外饰，并且根据安全规范加入了新的后保险杠。在这款意大利野孩子的整个生产期间，这款纪念版也成为了销量最高的一款Countach，在1990年停产前共生产了657辆。

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
I’ll never forget the first time I saw a Lamborghini
Countach on the street.

The LP400 is a very fine car indeed.

It is a modern classic and the very definition
of a supercar.

One doesn’t even need to open its scissor doors
to feel its striking presence.

It has an extremely wedge-shaped profile
with a steep windscreen and high tail.

And the bold crease that runs the length of the car
is complimented by well-executed surfaces.
dialogues.zh:
我永远忘不了第一次在街上看到Lamborghini Countach
的情景。

LP400确实是一辆非常出色的车。

它是一款现代经典车，也是超级跑车的绝佳代表。

即使不打开它的剪刀式车门，
也能感受到它令人惊叹的存在感。

它的车身像是一个压到极致的倒梯形，
挡风玻璃斜度很大，尾翼则高高耸起。

一条让人无法忽视的折痕线贯穿整个
侧面车身，夺人眼球。

这条折痕线来自于车身表面的高差——
每个表面都经过精心设计，呈现不同程度的拱起。

collection.en:
The Countach had a huge impact on the motor industry, and
plotted the course Lamborghini has followed ever since.

Its development was headed up by the brilliant engineer
Paolo Stanzani...

Who, together with designer Marcello Gandini,
produced this scissor-doored masterpiece.

Although Countachs were produced for over 25 years,
the first generation LP400 remains the most popular.

There's just something different about the way it drives.
The fact only 150 were made adds scarcity value, too.

You can be certain these Countach LP400s are only going to
become more popular in the years to come.
collection.zh:
Countach的出现对汽车工业产生了巨大的影响，并就此确立
Lamborghini之后一直遵循的路线。

它的开发是由天才工程Paolo Stanzani牵头负责的……

他与设计师Marcello Gandini合作无间，
联合设计了这款剪刀式车门的杰作。

尽管Countach的生产持续了25年以上，第一代的LP400
仍然是最受车迷欢迎的。

其驾驶体验颇有独特之处。而且只生产了150辆的事实也
让它身价倍增。

我可以确定地说，在未来的几年里，Countach LP400
只会变得更加抢手。

vehicleCollection.en:
The futuristic styling of this exotic car attracted quite a bit of attention from all around the world.

The Lamborghini Countach, with its breathtakingly fresh and futuristic design, is a historic supercar and was unleashed onto the world at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show. The original show car, the LP500, remained just that, as the Countach didn’t actually go into production until three years later with the launch of the LP400. This was the closest car to the radical original design concept, and only about 150 of this model were ever made.

Through the years, an LP400 S and LP500 S went into production, and in 1985, a 5000 Quattrovalvole, setting its sights directly onto Ferrari’s refreshingly-styled Testarossa, was released. This Countach featured four valves per cylinder to its boisterous V12 that was increased in displacement to 5.2 liters, its maximum power output then reaching a ceiling of 455ps.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆别具一格的汽车，其未来主义的造型吸引了全世界的目光。

兰博基尼Countach是兰博基尼公司的一辆史诗级超级跑车，于1971年在日内瓦车展上首次发布。当时展示的原型车LP500在车展后便没有了下文，直到三年后随着LP400的发布，Countach才真正投产。LP400与激进的原始设计概念十分接近，且只生产了约150辆。

此后，LP400S与LP500S相继投产。在1985年，5000四气门发布，将法拉利最具创新风格的Testarossa作为竞争对手。这款Countach配备了强劲的V12引擎，每缸四气门，排量增加到5.2升，最大输出马力达到455ps。

usedCar.en:
The Diablo is the direct successor of the Lamborghini Countach.

Like its predecessor, it comes with a V-12 and scissor doors.

There was a GTR model that was developed exclusively
for GT racing.

And there was this GT model, a road-going version of the GTR,
designed for public roads.

The car's engine is awesome, delivering 575ps, making it
the most powerful in the Diablo lineup.

And when you rev the thing to near its redline,
it sings in a sweet melodic voice.

Only 80 units of the Diablo GT were made, making it one of
the rarest and most spectacular Lamborghinis in history.
usedCar.zh:
Diablo是兰博基尼Countach的直系继承者。

搭载V12引擎，继承了Countach的剪刀门设计。

Diablo意为恶魔，车如其名，其顶尖的技术和性能近乎鬼怪。
Diablo GTR版本专为GT赛事设计。

而其GT车型是GTR车型的公路版本。

GT车型能够产生最大575ps的马力，
是Diablo马力最强劲的量产车型。

如你所料，它有着绝对悦耳的赛车引擎音。

这款车总共只生产了80台，成为了有史以
来最为稀有和最引人关注的兰博基尼车型之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
The 80-car limited-edition model that was positioned as "The Ultimate Diablo."8

In 1999, the Lamborghini Diablo was given a minor exterior update that replaced the retractable headlamps with fixed ones. At the Geneva Motor Show of the same year, the ultimate road going limited-edition Diablo GT was unveiled. Based on the Diablo GT2, a racing car developed for the FIA-GT championships, Lamborghini modified this beast for the street.

The 6.0-liter V12, based on the GT2, produces 575ps and 64.3kgm of torque. Many body panels were replaced with carbon-fiber ones, resulting in a curb weight of 1490kg, which is 40kg lighter than that of the Diablo SV. Therefore, it was super quick and could reach a top speed of <338km/h>.

Keeping engine heat in check was a major issue, so Lamborghini engineers incorporated improved cooling and aerodynamic modifications, such as the special bumper spoiler that contained a larger oil cooler and vents in the hood to better discharge the extra heat. These upgrades and others came from the experience gained in fielding the Diablo GT2 race car; in other words, everything different about the Diablo GT came straight from the racing circuit.

Only 80 cars were produced, and the 80th car is on display at the Lamborghini Museum, at the company's Italian headquarters, in Sant'Agata. It is considered the "Ultimate Diablo," and to some, the ultimate Lamborghini.
vehicleCollection.zh:
只生产80辆的限量车款，也被称为“终极Diablo”。

1999年，兰博基尼Diablo在外部组件上略有升级，将可伸缩车灯更换为了固定大灯。同年的日内瓦车展公布了Diablo GT的终极公路限量版。

Diablo GT的原型为Diablo GT2，后者是专为国际汽联-GT锦标赛而设计的纯粹跑车，并针对城市道路驾驶进行了调试和改装。

这款车的6升V12引擎基于Diablo GT2的引擎设计，能够产生575ps和64.3kgm扭矩。车身的众多外部面板被替换为碳纤维材料，与Diablo SV相比重量减轻了40kg，重1490kg。此车表现出高超的性能，最高速度可达<338km/h>。

此外，这款车的特殊保险杠扰流器可以容纳较大的油冷却器，引擎盖上还添加了排气口，以便将来自此冷却器的热量排出。这些改动都来自于在Diablo GT2上积累的经验，换言之，此车款的每一处不同都直接来自于赛场实践经验。

这款车一共只生产了80辆，第80辆被陈列在兰博基尼总部的博物馆中。作为“终极Diablo”，这辆车依旧在各地的Diablo车迷心中拥有很高的地位。

dialogues.en:
The ‘Baby Lambo’ was added to broaden the market reach
of Lamborghini as a brand.

Unlike their super-car counterparts, the ‘babies’...

Are known for their sharper surfaces, tighter dimensions,
and overall efficiency.

The Gallardo is a great example, exhibiting no excess
from any angle.
dialogues.zh:
“Baby Lambo”系列的推出旨在拓宽Lamborghini品牌
的市场。

与其超级跑车的兄弟相比，这些“小型”车型……

以更锐利的车身线条、更紧凑的车身尺寸
和整体上的高效设计而著称。

Gallardo就是一个很好的例子，从任何角度看都能展现
出简洁而精致的设计，没有任何多余的元素。

brandCentral.en:
The Gallardo series occupies a very important place
in Lamborghini’s history.

Up to the late-1980s, Lamborghini’s lineup included
a mid-engine V8 entry model.

To differentiate these from the legendary V12s,
fans affectionately called them ‘baby Lambos.’

When the Gallardo finally came on the scene,
it broke the baby Lambo mould.

A mid-engine V10 with all-wheel drive...

The Gallardo was distinguished by its chassis performance
under the high-power strain 500 hp-speed.

It was also the first car in Lamborghini’s history to sell
over 10,000 units.
brandCentral.zh:
Gallardo系列在Lamborghini的发展史上具有里程碑式的
意义。

直至20世纪80年代末，Lamborghini的产品阵容中一直
会有一款中置V8引擎的次旗舰车型存在。

为了与该品牌标志性的V12车型区分，车迷们亲昵地
称这些V8车型为“小Lambo”。

然而，Gallardo的问世彻底颠覆了人们对“小Lambo”的
固有印象。

这款搭载中置V10引擎并配备全轮驱动系统的超跑……

以其拔尖的底盘调校而著称，即便在500马力的强大动
力输出下，仍能提供卓越的操控性。

Gallardo还是Lamborghini品牌历史上首款突破10000辆
销量的车型。

usedCar.en:
The Gallardo was the first car by Lamborghini
to be powered by a V-10 engine.

While Lambos were generally known for having V-12s under their
hoods, the Gallardo proved to be extremely popular.

In fact, it became the first Lamborghini production car
to sell more than 10,000 units!

This LP 560-4 was introduced in 2008, five years after
the original Gallardo made its debut.

The LP 560-4 boasted a larger engine, more power
and lighter body.

It even looked different than its predecessor. Indeed, the
LP 560-4 was a better car in every sense of the word.
usedCar.zh:
Gallardo是Lamborghini历史上第一款采用V10引擎
提供动力的车型。

尽管不是品牌赖以成名的V12车型，但它的人气和
知名度也丝毫不逊色。

要知道，这可是Lamborghini第一款卖出超过10000台
的量产车型。

这辆LP 560-4新版本于2008年发布，也就是2003年
初代Gallardo推出的五年之后，

拥有更大的排量、更强的动力以及更轻的车身。

它与前代车型的外观也略有不同，因此从各个角度来说，
LP 560-4都呈现出了全面的升级进化。

vehicleCollection.en:
No longer a "baby Lambo," this car possessed top-tier performance.

The "baby" Lamborghini, officially known as the Gallardo, was introduced in 2003. Since then, the car has evolved over the years, with performance enhancements as well as additional higher-performance models added to the lineup.

The most notable of these appeared at the 2008 Geneva Motor Show as the Gallardo LP 560-4. Upon first glance, the car's aggressive styling seemed to be influenced by the limited-edition (and very expensive) Lamborghini Reventón, making it one of the meanest looking cars to wear the charging bull badge.

As for the car's performance... it was equally mean. The most prominent change under the sheet metal was the engine, a V-10 that grew from 4961cc to 5204cc. Breathing improvements were also performed and, when combined with its higher compression ratio, the engine produced a whopping 560ps and 55.1kgm of torque, an improvement of 40ps and 3.1kgm from the original Gallardo's powerplant. Power was routed to all four wheels (the "560" in the car's name is a reference to engine output, while the "4" stood for 4WD).

A choice of two transmissions came mated to the engine, both inherited from the previous model, a 6-speed manual or the semi-automatic 6-speed gearbox called E-gear, the latter featuring shifts that were 40 percent faster than the human hand when set to "CORSA" mode.

Weight of the LP 560-4 was trimmed by 20kg from the previous model to 1410kg, which helped the car reach a top speed of <325km/h> and blast from zero to <100km/h> in 3.7 seconds.-
vehicleCollection.zh:
不再是兰博的小号，Gallard以顶级的性能甩掉了这个绰号。

小兰博”Gallard于2003年首次亮相，并在随后的五年里接受了众多改进提升，还陆续增加了多个高性能版本。而到了2008年日内瓦车展上，一个远超其前辈的新车型横空出世。表面上看，Gallard纵向后置560-4只是吸收了雷文顿限量版的部分设计理念，其实内在经历了许多重大改动。

最值得一提的是对V10引擎的排量扩缸，从4961cc扩大到5204cc。得益于额外的进气和排气升级以及压缩量的增加，引擎可产生560ps的动力和55.1kgm的扭矩，比最初的Gallard有了40ps和3.1kgm的改进。

传动系统沿用了使用粘性耦合式限速差速器的全时四轮驱动。其命名中的“560”取自其引擎的最大输出功率，而“4”则代表其四轮驱动系统。

变速器则继承了6速手动变速或6速双踏板手动变速，但E-gear系统得到了极大的改进，在运动型“赛道”模式下，换挡速度变快了40%。经过诸多彻底的减重工作，车辆重量比以前的车型轻了20kg，降至1410kg。

结合所有的改进特性，新车款的最高速度现在高达<325km/h>，0-<100km/h>加速为3.7秒。这也使得此车不仅仅是领先几步，而是跨越式地超越了其竞争对手。时至今日，这款Gallard已然成长为一款具有重要影响力的车型，也摘掉了“小兰博”的名号。

brandCentral.en:
The Huracán served as the foundation for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car.

The car cornered so well that not much was done in terms of
modifications. It still has that mid-engine AWD feel.
brandCentral.zh:
Huracán是这辆原创跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车的改装原型。

作为一款中置引擎车，它的过弯性能非常出色，四驱系
统则确保了平顺丝滑的驾驶感。$

vehicleCollection.en:
With aesthetics inspired by the Gallardo, this AWD supercar's powerful and lightweight nature makes it ideal for the race track.

Introduced at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show, the Huracán had big shoes to fill as it was labeled the successor to Lamborghini’s most successful model ever, the Gallardo.

Unlike Lamborghini models that came before it, the Gallardo, which enjoyed a successful 10-year run, possessed a compact body that made it more agile than past Lambos. Although slightly larger, the Huracán sported similar proportions, retaining the “agile” spirit that made the Gallardo so popular. That said, its styling theme inside and out was nothing like that of its predecessor. The Huracán’s exterior was simpler and neater, with more curves than the Gallardo, signaling a new design phase for the coach builder from Sant’Agata.

The structure of the car also evolved, from the Gallardo’s aluminum space frame to one composed of aluminum and carbon fiber. This resulted in a 10 percent lighter body with a 50 percent increase in rigidity. The engine, a fire-breathing 5.2-liter V-10 that produced 610ps and 57.1kgm of torque, came mounted amidships, and came mated to Lamborghini’s first 7-speed dual clutch gearbox.

Also, a new integrated drive control system called ANIMA was added to instantly switch the engine, transmission, the new Halidex 5 AWD system and handling characteristics from urban driving to hot laps on a race track. When unleashed, the Huracán could run from 0-<100km/h> in 3.2 seconds and hit a top speed of <325km/h>. With performance like that, no one dared to call this compact exotic car a “baby Lambo.”

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆四驱超级跑车继承了Gallard的美学设计，并且更加轻巧，马力也更强。

Huracán于2014年首发于日内瓦车展，是兰博基尼目前为止最成功的车型Gallard的继任者。

Gallard之所以大受欢迎并能服役长达十年，是因为其在兰博基尼车型当中相对较为紧凑的车身，使得整车变得灵活，性能非常平衡，不负“超跑”之名。Huracán继承了这些基本特性，尽管车身的长度和宽度略有增大，但仍和Gallard的尺寸十分接近。然而，这款车的造型风格却发生了翻天覆地的变化。虽然依旧采用了基本的楔形设计，但结合了曲线和曲面的感性外型使其有别于流线型的Gallard，标志着兰博基尼的设计进入了新的阶段。

在车身结构方面，这款车从铝制框架车身演变为了铝材与碳纤维混合车身，使得车身比原先轻了10%，且刚度提高了50%。中置引擎采用全新的5.2升V10引擎，能够产生610ps/57.1kgm的动力。所产生的动力通过兰博基尼首次使用的7速双离合变速箱和新型瀚德5全轮驱动系统传至路面。

此外，Huracán还增加了一个名为“ANIMA”的集成驱动控制系统，它可以瞬时切换引擎、变速箱、全轮驱动和操控特性，能够从容应对从城市驾驶到赛道竞速等不同的需求。同时这款车的最高时速为<325km/h>，而0-<100km/h>加速时间仅为3.2秒，此等表现令人无法再将其视为兰博基尼家族的“初生牛犊”。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。-

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Lamborghini actually never really got into motorsports
as a manufacturer over the years
But when it developed an FIA-GT3 car based on the
Huracán in 2015...
...the company finally sent a works machine into the circuit!
It made its debut at the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series.
And it totally left the other cars in the dust,
finishing winning by a margin of 30 seconds.
The car was actually disqualified at one point
because of a rule violation in the team's refueling equipment.
But the team appealed and won,
and so did the GT3's in its debut race.
dialogues.zh:
你知道么？Lamborghini作为一家制造商，其实很多年
都没有真正参加过赛车运动了。

但他们积极做出了改变，在2015年基于Huracán打造了
这款FIA-GT3，

终于把它们的车送上了赛道！

它在2015年的宝珀耐力系列赛上首次亮相，

就让它的对手们完全望尘莫及，以比第二名快了30秒的
成绩夺得了冠军。

实际上，他们在比赛中一度被取消了资格，因为赛会判
定他们的加油设备出现了违规。

但是他们的上诉成功了，最终在首秀中就赢得了冠军。

The FIA Group GT3 series is one of the most popular forms
of racing around the world.

A 6-speed sequential gearbox transfers power

这辆Huracán GT3就是此组别内最深受车迷喜爱的一款车。

它的开发由Lamborghini的汽车运动部门Squadra Corse所负责。

这辆车安装了一台5.2L V10引擎，针对赛事要求进行了特别
优化，并采用了传统的后轮驱动布局，

此外还搭载了一套六速序列式变速箱。

vehicleCollection.en:
Dallara took the best elements of the Huracán and created a radical competition GT3 machine.

The Lamborghini Huracán GT3 is the race version of the Huracán that was released as a successor to the Gallardo in 2014. It was developed according to FIA-GT3 specifications as the name implies, and was revealed for the first time in January 2015.

The development of the Gallardo was handled by Reiter Engineering, but the Huracán GT3 is developed by Squadra Corse, the internal competition department of Lamborghini. Italian race constructor Dallara engineering worked on the materials and aerodynamics of the body.

The hybrid chassis made from aluminum and carbon is the same as in the road car, but the body itself is much wider. Its aerodynamic effects are improved using a low front spoiler and splitter, an adjustable rear wing, and a large rear diffuser. These are in addition to the vents and louvers added on various parts to discharge and improve air flow. These additions have a side effect of giving the car a much more aggressive appearance than the road car.

The engine is also the same 5.2L V10 as in the road car, but the ECU is changed to a Bosch unit to make it more suited for actual operation in competition. The gearbox is changed from a 7 speed DCT to a 6 speed sequential, and to match the regulations, the drive train is modified from an all wheel drive to be a rear wheel drive. There are also 10 level settings for the traction control system and ABS.

The Huracán achieved a debut victory at the opening round of the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series, but in addition to that win, it also achieved pole position in 3 rounds out of 5, and continued to show stable and fast performance throughout the series.'
vehicleCollection.zh:
达拉拉攫取了Huracán的顶级元素，并提升了这款GT3车型的竞争潜力。

兰博基尼Huracán于2014年作为Gallard的后继车型发布，Huracán GT3则是Huracán的竞速版本，顾名思义，这款车是根据国际汽联-GT3规范开发的，并于2015年1月首次公布。

Gallard的开发由Reiter Engineering公司负责，但Huracán GT3是由兰博基尼内部的赛车部门所开发的。意大利赛车制造商达拉拉对车身材料和空气动力学特征进行了工程优化。

由铝材和碳纤维制成的混合材质底盘与公路版相同，但车身本身更宽。除了在多个部件上增加通风口和百叶挡板以排放和改善空气流外，还采用了更低的前扰流板和分流器、可调节的尾翼以及大型的尾部扰流翼以改善空气动力学性能。这些措施还有一个附加效果，就是使得这款车的外观比公路版更加霸气。

引擎采用公路版同款的5.2升V10引擎，但电子控制单元改用了博世的产品，更适应比赛中的实际操控。变速箱由7档双离合变速箱改为6档序列式变速箱，为了符合规定，动力传动由全轮驱动改为后轮驱动。牵引力控制系统和防抱死刹车系统有10档设定。

Huracán在2015年宝珀耐力赛的开幕战上取得首次胜利，除了这次胜利之外，他们还在5轮赛事中的3轮赢得杆位，并在整个系列赛中持续其稳定和快速的性能表现。

catch.zh: 达拉拉攫取了Huracán的顶级元素，并提升了这款GT3车型的竞争潜力。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
If I’m not mistaken, this car was preceded by
the more radical ‘Gallardo’.

And yet the Huracán represented an evolution
in Lamborghini’s identity and design language.

Its use of hexagonal forms continues to be seen
in today’s Lamborghinis.!
dialogues.zh:
如果我没记错的话，这辆车的前款应该是
更加激进的“Gallardo”。

然而，Huracán很好地展现了Lamborghini在品牌认同
和设计语言上的革命。

它采用的六角形元素至今可以在现款Lamborghini上看到。

Huracán于2014年首发于日内瓦车展，是兰博基尼目前为止最成功的车型Gallard的继任者。

Gallard之所以大受欢迎并能服役长达十年，是因为其在兰博基尼车型当中相对较为紧凑的车身，使得整车变得灵活，性能非常平衡，不负“超跑”之名。Huracán继承了这些基本特性，尽管车身的长度和宽度略有增大，但仍和Gallard的尺寸十分接近。然而，这款车的造型风格却发生了翻天覆地的变化。虽然依旧采用了基本的楔形设计，但结合了曲线和曲面的感性外型使其有别于流线型的Gallard，标志着兰博基尼的设计进入了新的阶段。

在车身结构方面，这款车从铝制框架车身演变为了铝材与碳纤维混合车身，使得车身比原先轻了10%，且刚度提高了50%。中置引擎采用全新的5.2升V10引擎，能够产生610ps/57.1kgm的动力。所产生的动力通过兰博基尼首次使用的7速双离合变速箱和新型瀚德5全轮驱动系统传至路面。

此外，Huracán还增加了一个名为“ANIMA”的集成驱动控制系统，它可以瞬时切换引擎、变速箱、全轮驱动和操控特性，能够从容应对从城市驾驶到赛道竞速等不同的需求。同时这款车的最高时速为<325km/h>，而0-<100km/h>加速时间仅为3.2秒，此等表现令人无法再将其视为兰博基尼家族的“初生牛犊”。

catch.en: With aesthetics inspired by the Gallardo, this AWD supercar's powerful and lightweight nature makes it ideal for the race track.
catch.zh: 这辆四驱超级跑车继承了Gallard的美学设计，并且更加轻巧，马力也更强。

long.en:
Introduced at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show, the Huracán had big shoes to fill as it was labeled the successor to Lamborghini’s most successful model ever, the Gallardo.

Unlike Lamborghini models that came before it, the Gallardo, which enjoyed a successful 10-year run, possessed a compact body that made it more agile than past Lambos. Although slightly larger, the Huracán sported similar proportions, retaining the “agile” spirit that made the Gallardo so popular. That said, its styling theme inside and out was nothing like that of its predecessor. The Huracán’s exterior was simpler and neater, with more curves than the Gallardo, signaling a new design phase for the coach builder from Sant’Agata.

The structure of the car also evolved, from the Gallardo’s aluminum space frame to one composed of aluminum and carbon fiber. This resulted in a 10 percent lighter body with a 50 percent increase in rigidity. The engine, a fire-breathing 5.2-liter V-10 that produced 610ps and 57.1kgm of torque, came mounted amidships, and came mated to Lamborghini’s first 7-speed dual clutch gearbox.

Also, a new integrated drive control system called ANIMA was added to instantly switch the engine, transmission, the new Halidex 5 AWD system and handling characteristics from urban driving to hot laps on a race track. When unleashed, the Huracán could run from 0-<100km/h> in 3.2 seconds and hit a top speed of <325km/h>. With performance like that, no one dared to call this compact exotic car a “baby Lambo.”F

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
The Miura is quite controversial among us designers.

The debate surrounding this car is about the
identity of its true designer.

Some say that the Miura was the creation of
Bertone's Giorgetto Guigiaro...

...while others contend it was his successor,
Marcello Gandini's work.

The overall look of the car is quite advanced for its time,
comparable to that of the Ford GT40, in fact.

However, what sticks out to me is the detail
of the headlights that stare upward.

This detail can be found on another one of
Guigiaro's products, the FIAT 850 Spider.

Does this make the Miura's true designer, Guigiaro?
I think so.

Regardless, we should all be happy that...

...the first-ever mid-engine Lamborghini
was a car that looked this amazing.
dialogues.zh:
Miura在我们这些设计师当中是个颇具争议的话题。

不过，大家的争论焦点是它的真正设计者究竟是谁。

有的人说是博通的乔盖托·乔治亚罗……

……而另一些人则认为它是博通的后辈马塞罗·甘迪尼的作品。

这辆车的整体外观在当时相当超前，
甚至可以与福特GT40的横空出世相提并论。

然而，最令我印象深刻的是那副朝上的头灯。

在乔治亚罗的另一款作品菲亚特850敞篷上，
也能找到类似的细节。

这是否说明Miura的真正设计师是乔治亚罗？我是这么认为的。

无论如何……

……有史以来的第一辆中置引擎兰博基尼的外观是如此超凡脱俗，
总算没有令人失望。

conversation.en: Are you the owner of this car?
conversation.zh: 这辆车……你是它的车主吗？

您不会是儿玉英雄吧？
曾经参与过德国Opel公司的诸多名车的那位设计师？"

Yes! I'm Kodama.
It's a pleasure to meet the both of you.
conversation.zh: 是的，正是本人。见到你们两位很高兴。

The pleasure is ours, Kodama-san.
What an honor it is to make your acquaintance!

Kodama-san was the chief designer at Opel.
He worked for more than 40 years in Opel's design department.

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic
vintage-car event, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este.

认识您真是荣幸！

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展
的评审委员之一。

collection.en:
The legendary Miura supercar was actually Lamborghini's
first midship design.

This car is chassis 0706—the second of the first five cars
built—and is the oldest Miura in existence

Even for a brand as storied as Lamborghini,
the Miura is especially legendary.

Its chassis—designed by Gian Paolo Dallara—was displayed
without a body, at the 1965 Turin Salon.

Those who saw it thought it was a sure sign that Lamborghini
was going to start racing!

The reaction was enough to persuade company founder
Ferruccio Lamborghini to greenlight its development,

and the first prototype Miura was completed the
following year in 1966.

This chassis number 0706 has miraculously survived the years
without any restoration work,

and it was entered in the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance
in 2008, where it won the Gran Turismo Trophy.
collection.zh:
传奇的Miura超级跑车是兰博基尼的首款中置引擎车型。

这辆底盘编号0706的Miura是最早打造的五辆原型车中的第二辆，
也是现存年代最久远的一台！

即便对于充满传奇历史的兰博基尼来说，
Miura的故事也堪称传奇。

在1965年的都灵车展上首次亮相的只有底盘——
由詹保罗·达拉拉操刀设计，车身外观并未进行展示。

然而，有幸目睹此车者都将其视作
兰博基尼要进军赛车界的标志！

这样的公众反应足以说服创始人费鲁吉欧·兰博基尼
批准继续研发的计划。

第一辆Miura原型车便在第二年的1966年完成了。

这台0706奇迹般地在没有经过任何复原工作的情况下保存
到了今天，

它还在2008年亮相圆石滩经典车展，
并赢得了一座Gran Turismo奖杯。

vehicleCollection.en:
This car put Lamborghini on the supercar map and defined the genre.

Automobili Lamborghini was founded in 1963. Following the development of the 350 GT and 400 GT, Lamborghini unveiled the TP400 in bare chassis form at the 1965 Turin Motor Show. At the Geneva Motor Show the following year, they revealed the Miura P400, now adorned with a stunning body styled by Marcello Gandini, then Chief Designer at Bertone.

The Miura adopted a mid-engine layout, housing a 3929cc V-12 behind the rear bulkhead. It was a landmark model for Lamborghini—their first true supercar—delivering 350ps and 37.5kgm of torque. With its revolutionary layout and design, it propelled the Lamborghini name into the international spotlight.

The development of the Miura brought together several remarkable individuals. Its chassis was the work of Gian Paolo Dallara, who would go on to found Dallara Automobili, now a powerhouse in the world of racing car design. Paolo Stanzani, the brilliant engineer who would later lead the creation of the Countach, also played a key role in the project.

It is believed that three prototypes of the Miura P400 were built between its Geneva Motor Show debut and the start of full production. The earliest prototype reportedly lacked the distinctive louvre over the rear cowling. These initial cars were later updated to production specifications and sold as standard Miura P400 models.

The Miura line would eventually evolve into the more powerful S and SV versions, with production continuing through to 1973. A handful of rare SVJ models also exist, crafted in homage to the legendary Jota.
vehicleCollection.zh:
兰博基尼公司的第一款超跑，为公司打响了名声。

超级跑车兰博基尼的构思诞生于1963年。继350 GT和400 GT的开发之后，兰博基尼在1965年的都灵车展上以裸底盘的形式公布了TP400。在次年的日内瓦车展上，他们公布了Miura P400，优美的车身来自于当时博通总设计师马塞罗·甘迪尼。

Miura采用中置式引擎布局，在后舱部分安装了一台3929cc的V12引擎。这是一款划时代的车型，是兰博基尼的第一辆超级跑车，能够产生350ps和37.5kgm的扭矩。这款车令初出江湖的兰博基尼立刻成为了聚光灯下的焦点。

多位出色的设计师参与了此车的开发。底盘由吉安·保罗·达拉拉设计，他后来创建了达拉拉汽车，如今已经是世界上最著名的赛车制造商之一。后来开发Countach的天才工程师保罗·斯坦扎尼也参与了开发。

据说在日内瓦车展亮相之后，Miura P400在全面投产前制造了3辆原型车，最初的原型车没有在后罩上加入标志性的百叶板。然而，这三台原型车后来按照量产车规格修改，作为标准Miura P400投放到市场。

Miura后来又发展出S车型和SV车型，对引擎动力做了提升，一直生产到1973年。此外还有少量的SVJ车型，外型参考了传奇的Jota。

catch.zh: 兰博基尼公司的第一款超跑，为公司打响了名声。

brandCentral.en:
Lamborghini's successor to the Diablo, the Murciélago
naturally comes equipped with a V12 engine.

This LP 640 is a high-performance model, unveiled in 2006,
and features four-wheel drive and a 631.1 BHP engine.

By the way, did you know that the basic structure of the V12
engine in this model is identical to that of the Countach?

The Murciélago was the very last model in which this engine
was ever used...

Making it quite the historical addition to any collection!
brandCentral.zh:
作为Lamborghini Diablo的继任者，V12引擎自然不会在
Murciélago上缺席。

这款LP 640是在2006年亮相的高性能车型，采用四轮驱动和640ps
的引擎。

顺便说一句，您知道吗？这台车的V12引擎的基本结构与
Countach一模一样。

Murciélago是最后一辆使用该引擎的车型……

也因此成为了一件具有历史意义的收藏品！

usedCar.en:
Even when compared to Lamborghini's other mid-engine V-12
models, this Murciélago stands out.

It came equipped with the final iteration of the V-12,
first developed for the legendary Countach.

The company's pride in its engine is evident in the name:
the LP 640 refers to the V-12's 640ps (640ps) output.

Power is transferred to all four tires, ensuring maximum
traction and grip when you're ready to get serious.
usedCar.zh:
Murciélago在Lamborghini的中置V12引擎跑车中
占据了一个特殊的地位。

知道为什么吗？因为这款车是搭载了V12引擎的Countach的
最后一款有着正派血统的后继车型。

除此之外，这辆车还是LP 640，一款能输出
640ps马力的高性能型号。

凭借其四轮驱动系统，Murciélago的
稳定性也毫不逊色。

vehicleCollection.en:
With 640ps, the flagship supercar from Lamborghini reached a top speed of <340km/h>.

The Lamborghini Murciélago made its debut at the 2001 Frankfurt Motor Show as the flagship for the renowned Italian maker. It had big shoes to fill for it was succeeding the legendary V12 supercars, the Countach and Diablo as the company's top model. The Murciélago, along with the V10-powered Gallardo introduced at the 2003 Geneva Motor Show, represented a new era for Lamborghini, which blossomed under Audi AG's umbrella.

Five years later, at the 2006 Geneva Motor Show, Audi took the veils off a new, even meaner version of the Murciélago, the LP640. The “LP” in its name stands for Longitudinale Posteriore (longitudinally rear mounted), while the numerical designation refers to its 640ps (640ps). Actually, the “LP” designation is a traditional one for Lamborghini, dating back to the days of the Countach. As mentioned earlier, the power of the car was 640ps, up from the stock Murciélago's 580ps. It came from a 6496 cc DOHC V12 that transferred the power to all four wheels. The car's performance was nothing short of extraordinary, going from zero to <100km/h> in 3.4 seconds and reaching a top speed of <340km/h>.

The styling of the Murciélago and Gallardo were penned by Luc Donckerwolke, and for the LP640, that original design was fine-tuned, resulting in an edgier supercar-like shape. The most notable differences between the stock Murciélago and the LP640 were the front and rear diffusers and the integration of the exhaust tips within the bumper. The scissor-type doors opened upward, providing a family lineage to the Countach and Diablo. The LP640 lineup included an open-air roadster and a lightweight, high-performance limited-edition model called the LP670-4 SuperVeloce.
vehicleCollection.zh:
旗舰超跑，马力输出达到了640ps，最高时速高达<340km/h>。

作为中置V12引擎旗舰Countach和Diablo的继任者，兰博基尼Murciélago在2001年法兰克福车展上登上舞台。2003年日内瓦车展上，搭载V10引擎的Gallard也在全世界车迷面前亮相。这两款车也代表着兰博基尼投身奥迪后的新时代。

到了2006年，在日内瓦车展展出的Murciélago LP640又将前辈甩在了身后。

命名中的前两个字母代表纵向后置，重现了Countach时代的经典设计，640则代表了640ps。这款车型的动力单元是一台6496cc的双顶置凸轮轴V12引擎，马力输出从580ps提高到了640ps，可将动力通过全时四驱源源不断地输送到轮上。它的其他数据也同样令人惊艳：0-<100km/h>加速只需要3.4秒，最高时速可达<340km/h>。

long.en:
The Lamborghini Murciélago made its debut at the 2001 Frankfurt Motor Show as the flagship for the renowned Italian maker. It had big shoes to fill for it was succeeding the legendary V12 supercars, the Countach and Diablo as the company's top model. The Murciélago, along with the V10-powered Gallardo introduced at the 2003 Geneva Motor Show, represented a new era for Lamborghini, which blossomed under Audi AG's umbrella.

Five years later, at the 2006 Geneva Motor Show, Audi took the veils off a new, even meaner version of the Murciélago, the LP640. The “LP” in its name stands for Longitudinale Posteriore (longitudinally rear mounted), while the numerical designation refers to its 640ps (640ps). Actually, the “LP” designation is a traditional one for Lamborghini, dating back to the days of the Countach. As mentioned earlier, the power of the car was 640ps, up from the stock Murciélago's 580ps. It came from a 6496 cc DOHC V12 that transferred the power to all four wheels. The car's performance was nothing short of extraordinary, going from zero to <100km/h> in 3.4 seconds and reaching a top speed of <340km/h>.

The styling of the Murciélago and Gallardo were penned by Luc Donckerwolke, and for the LP640, that original design was fine-tuned, resulting in an edgier supercar-like shape. The most notable differences between the stock Murciélago and the LP640 were the front and rear diffusers and the integration of the exhaust tips within the bumper. The scissor-type doors opened upward, providing a family lineage to the Countach and Diablo. The LP640 lineup included an open-air roadster and a lightweight, high-performance limited-edition model called the LP670-4 SuperVeloce.

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
The Urus was the first SUV designed by Lamborghini.

Of course, Lamborghini is a name normally associated
with supercars, like the Countach.

But the first car it built after being founded in 1963...

...was a 2-door grand tourer that offered speed, comfort,
and class.

It was called the 350 GT, a large coupe with a V-12 engine
mounted up front.

Since the 1970s, Lamborghini has built many elegant GT
and 4-door sedan concepts, although they were not for sale.

This means that Lamborghini never forgot about its GT roots!
And the Urus was proof of that.
dialogues.zh:
Urus是Lamborghini设计的第一款SUV。

如今，人们通常会将Lamborghini与各种超级跑车
联系在一起，如Countach……

不过在1963年创立之初，它打造的第一款车……

是一款强调速度、舒适性和档次的双门豪华旅行车。

它就是采用前置V12引擎的大型双门跑车——350 GT。

自从1970年代起，Lamborghini曾设计了多款优雅的豪华旅行车
和4门概念轿车，但从未正式发售。

看来Lamborghini从未忘记自己起步于豪华旅行车的根源！
这款Urus就是确凿的证明！

brandCentral.en:
The Urus was the first SUV to be designed by
world-famous maker of super cars, Lamborghini.

Taking design elements from such legends as the Countach
and the LM002...

...the Urus has reworked them into a functional 4-door
5-seat sport-utility vehicle.

Powered by a twin-turbocharged V-8 up mounted in front,
it’s capable reaching a top speed of more than 300 km/h.

At full throttle, you’ll swear it was a race car!

With its AWD system that excels on the roughest of roads,
the Urus is one super SUV.`
brandCentral.zh:
Urus是由举世闻名的超级跑车制造商Lamborghini
所设计的第一款SUV。

Urus借鉴了Countach和LM002等传奇车型
的设计元素……

并将它们活用在了这款非常实用的四门五座
运动型多用途汽车上。

Urus由一台前置的双涡轮增压V8引擎提供动力，
能轻松飙到<300 km/h>以上。

全速冲刺的时候，你一定会错以为座下是一辆赛车！

Urus的四轮驱动系统让它能够在哪怕最崎岖的道路上
发挥出优秀性能，是名不虚传的超级SUV！

vehicleCollection.en:
Lamborghini's take on a high-performance exotic SUV.

Introduced in 2018 in response to the global SUV boom, the Urus was a “Super SUV” from renowned exotic-car manufacturer Lamborghini.

Styled with sharp lines and an edgy design similar to that of the company's mid-engine models, the Urus' body construction was inherited from other full-size SUVs from the Volkswagen Group.

The Urus' front-mounted powerplant took the form of a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8, the first ever forced-induction engine ever in a Lamborghini. It produced an impressive 650ps and 86.68kgm of torque.

The default setting for the vehicle's AWD system was 40/60 front/rear, but it could be adjusted from 70/30 to 13/87 depending on the road surface.

Other Urus highlights were an adaptive air suspension system, rear-wheel steering, and torque vectoring, all of which combined to deliver the type of handling and cornering performance befitting a Lamborghini. Optional driving modes made the vehicle at home on off-road trails and even through the desert.

But what was most impressive about the Urus was its acceleration. It ran from 0-<100 km/h> in 3.6 seconds, to <200 km/h> in 12.8 and reached a top speed of <305 km/h>, making it truly the world’s fastest SUV upon its debut.
vehicleCollection.zh:
兰博基尼对全球SUV浪潮的回应。

作为面对席卷全球的SUV潮流的回应，著名的超级跑车制造商兰博基尼在2018年推出了被誉为“超级SUV”的Urus。

在此车型中，设计师运用犀利的线条，呈现与同一时期兰博基尼中置引擎超跑车型同款的前卫设计。其结构基于大众汽车集团其他全尺寸SUV所采用的通用平台，但经过专门调校以提升性能。

前部搭载了一台4升双涡轮增压V8引擎，能够产生650ps的动力和86.68kgm的扭矩，这也是兰博基尼有史以来首次采用涡轮增压引擎。

驱动装置采用全时四驱系统，默认为前40后60的分配比例，并可根据驾驶情况调整为从70:30到13:87的各种区间。

此外，该车还配备了自适应空气悬挂、后轮转向和扭矩矢量控制，以提供超级SUV所需的卓越操控和出色转弯性能。Urus有多种驾驶模式可供选择，包括适用于越野和沙漠驾驶的可选模式。

Urus能够在短短3.6秒内完成从0到<100 km/h>加速，在12.8秒内完成0到<200 km/h>加速，并且能够达到<305 km/h>的最高时速。初次亮相便轻松摘下全球最快SUV的头衔。

brandCentral.en:
This machine was introduced to celebrate Lamborghini's 50th
anniversary.

Called the Veneno, it was unveiled at the 2013
Geneva Motor Show.

This coupe model was a one-off, made especially for
display at the show.

However, the company built three more to meet the
demands of passionate Lamborghini aficionados.

Later, nine roadsters were produced for sale.

Each Veneno is a one-of-a-kind example that has a solid place
in Lamborghini history.

How much does it cost? Well, if you have to ask,
you probably can't afford it.
brandCentral.zh:
Veneno是为庆祝Lamborghini成立50周年而设计的作品……

在2013年的日内瓦车展上揭开了面纱。

这款双门跑车原本是专为展会组装的孤品。

然而，为了满足热情高涨的Lamborghini收藏家的要求，Lamborghini
追加制造了三台车，

后来又额外生产了九辆敞篷车。

每辆Veneno都是独一无二的珍宝，也是Lamborghini历史的一部分。

您问价格？如果您非要刨根问底的话，反正一般人肯定
是买不起的……

vehicleCollection.en:
Lamborghini celebrated its 50th anniversary with this extremely limited-production super car.

When Lamborghini introduces a limited-production car to celebrate its 50th anniversary, you know that it’s bound to be special, and very exclusive. Well, the company from Sant’Agata, Italy didn’t disappoint when it unveiled the multi-million-dollar Veneno, a super car whose clientele was restricted to a mere three people.

The Veneno was based on Lamborghini’s flagship, the Aventador, which featured an exterior design that looked like it came from another planet. However, there’s a reason for its bizarre looks, as precision aerodynamics had been implemented into the body to ensure optimal performance. The “V” shaped nose suggested that Formula 1 technology had made its way into the car design. Combined with a high-mounted variable rear-wing, a gigantic rear diffuser, and a shark fin that extended from the roof to the rear, the Veneno possessed gobs of downforce that kept it glued to the pavement through high-speed corners.

Also keeping the Veneno stable was a full-time 4-wheel-drive system and an F1-type pushrod suspension system that made it one of the cars with the best handling of all time. Providing the punch was a 6.5-liter V-12 that came mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. With 750ps on tap and a lightweight carbon-fiber structure that made it 125kg lighter than the Aventador at 1450kg, the Veneno sprinted to <100km/h> in 2.8 seconds and reached a top speed of <355km/h>.
vehicleCollection.zh:
仅生产了3辆。兰博基尼50周年纪念款。

Veneno是兰博基尼在2013年日内瓦车展上发布的特殊车型。这款车是纪念兰博基尼50周年的限量款公路跑车——仅仅发售过三辆。

Veneno的设计基于兰博基尼的旗舰车型Aventador，具有惊艳的外观设计和精准的空气动力学性能，揭示了新一代兰博基尼的面貌。车辆前部包含极低的V形前鼻，并具有方程式赛车前翼的所有特性。结合高位安装的可调后翼、巨大的尾部扰流翼和从车顶延伸到尾翼的鲨鱼鳍，产生了巨大的下压力，从而提升转弯速度。

这款车将全时四驱系统与推杆悬挂结合，并由一台6.5升的V12引擎驱动，同时还采用与Aventador相同的7档双踏板手动变速箱。Veneno不仅将引擎动力提升至750ps，还采用了额外的减重措施，包括采用碳纤维单体壳，使得车体重量降至1450kg，比Aventador还轻125kg。性能差异一目了然：0-<100km/h>的加速时间仅为2.8秒，最高时速可达<355km/h>。

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
At a time when Giugiaro was designing many production cars,
he put his signature styling technique on full display...

...on this Lancia Delta.

It reflects the dignified brand image of Lancia,
and gives off a very positive feel.

During the 1970s, Lancia dominated rally races
with a car probably everyone is familiar with, the Stratos.

Lancia most likely intended for the Delta to be
the spiritual successor of the Stratos.

When comparing it to the rally bred Stratos...

...the Delta improved on the 2-box hatchback-sedan theme.

The fat 16-inch 205 tires and the huge, blistered fenders
provided the car with the prowess of a wild animal.

You can see how a tame hatchback can transform
into a fierce rally machine.

I do like this kind of design approach as well.
dialogues.zh:
有一段时间，乔治亚罗的设计产量大增，推出了多款量产车作品，
但他把自己标志性的造型技术……

……充分展现在这辆蓝旗亚Delta中。

它不仅反映出蓝旗亚高贵庄重的品牌形象，
更给人以积极进取的感觉。

在20世纪70年代，蓝旗亚以一辆被所有人熟知的好车
主宰了拉力赛，那就是Stratos。

蓝旗亚可能原本打算让Delta成为Stratos的精神继承者。

与为拉力赛而生的Stratos不同……

Delta的研发基础车型是一台两厢掀背轿车。

蓝旗亚用16英寸的205宽胎和外扩的特大号挡泥板
赋予了Delta如同野生动物一般无畏的野性。

也让你亲眼目睹一辆温驯的掀背车
是如何被转化为一辆狂暴的拉力赛车的。

conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.en:
At a time when Giugiaro was designing many production cars,
he put his signature styling technique on full display...

...on this Lancia Delta.

It reflects the dignified brand image of Lancia,
and gives off a very positive feel.

During the 1970s, Lancia dominated rally races
with a car probably everyone is familiar with, the Stratos.

Lancia most likely intended for the Delta to be
the spiritual successor of the Stratos.

When comparing it to the rally bred Stratos...

...the Delta improved on the 2-box hatchback-sedan theme.

The fat 16-inch 205 tires and the huge, blistered fenders
provided the car with the prowess of a wild animal.

You can see how a tame hatchback can transform
into a fierce rally machine.

I do like this kind of design approach as well.

在20世纪70年代，蓝旗亚以一辆被所有人熟知的好车
主宰了拉力赛，那就是Stratos。

蓝旗亚可能原本打算让Delta成为Stratos的精神继承者。

与为拉力赛而生的Stratos不同……

usedCar.en:
The Italian-made Lancia Delta is one of the world's most
legendary rally cars.

And little wonder—the Group A rally car won the World Rally
Championship an incredible six times!

The production model which served as its base is still
highly sought after by collectors today.

This HF Integrale Evoluzione is one of the last variants
produced.

Not only does it boast 4WD and wider treads, but its power
has been further increased to over 200ps.;

它的名号并非徒有虚名——这款A组别拉力赛车在

这款车的基础量产车型在今天依然

vehicleCollection.en:
This last and most potent Delta set the WRC record for consecutive wins.

The original Lancia Delta was a family-oriented hatchback designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro. However, when Group B was phased out of the WRC, Lancia selected the Delta as the foundation for its new Group A contender. From that moment, the car’s destiny as a rally legend was sealed.

In 1987, Lancia equipped the Delta a high-performance turbocharged engine and a 4WD system, before setting it loose in the WRC.
From that moment on, Lancia secured an unprecedented six consecutive WRC championships. However, maintaining its edge meant that it had to undergo a series of evolutions. Such is the life of a competition rally car.

By 1991, Lancia faced mounting pressure from its rival, Toyota. In response, it unveiled the ultimate iteration of the Delta at the Frankfurt Motor Show—the HF Integrale Evoluzione.

The Evoluzione sported a larger front grille and expanded hood vents, enhancing enhanced airflow for improved engine cooling and ventilation. This allowed the power of the engine to be increased from 200ps to 210ps.

To help the car's stability, the front and rear track were widened by 60mm.
This necessitated even wider blistered wheel arches, pushing the car’s overall width to 1770mm.
And, by shifting the 4WD torque distribution toward the rear, Lancia engineered the car to deliver a driving character closer to that of a rear-wheel-drive machine. The car also featured a spoiler mounted to the edge of the roof to further improve downforce.

The Evoluzione made its WRC debut in 1992, playing a crucial role in extending Lancia's streak of dominance. Unfortunately, Lancia's parent company, FIAT, decided to withdraw the car from the WRC, bringing the Evoluzione’s competitive run to an abrupt end that same year.
vehicleCollection.zh:
以连续胜利创下新世界拉力锦标赛纪录的终极Delta。

原版蓝旗亚Delta是一辆家用型掀背车，由乔盖托·乔治亚罗设计。而在世界拉力锦标赛取消B组别赛事之后，蓝旗亚选择了Delta作为他们征战A组别赛事的新基础车款。从那一刻起，这款车的未来就已经注定了。

1987年，蓝旗亚为Delta装上了高性能的涡轮增压发动机和四驱系统，然后在世界拉力锦标赛上将其推向世界。从那一年起，蓝旗亚史无前例地连续六年夺得世界拉力锦标赛总冠军。不过在重重竞争压力下，他们也在持续不断地对Delta进行着改进，这也是竞争激烈的拉力赛车所必须经历的。

1991年，承受着来自死敌丰田的巨大压力的蓝旗亚，在法兰克福车展公布了Delta的终极型号：HF Integrale Evoluzione。

Evoluzione配备了更大的前格栅，引擎盖内的进气道也被加大，以此改善发动机舱的排气与冷却。因此，动力输出从200ps提高到了210ps。

值得一提的是，轮距也增加了60mm。止步在了这一年。其标志性的凸起式轮拱罩进一步向尾部加宽，使得整车的宽度增加到了1770mm。另外，四驱系统的扭矩分配倾向于后轮，使得该车的操控表现更接近于后驱。车顶的尾端也增加了扰流板来产生更多的下压力。

Evoluzione在接下来的1992赛季世界拉力锦标赛中亮相，为蓝旗亚连续不断的胜利立下汗马功劳。令人遗憾的是，蓝旗亚的母公司菲亚特决定从世界拉力锦标赛中退出，因此Evoluzione的参赛历史止步在了这一年。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Lancia of Italy had long been a dominant force
in the World Rally Championship.

This Group A rally version of the Delta stands
as a testament to Lancia’s many triumphs.

From 1987 to 1992, the marque secured six
consecutive manufacturers’ championships.

It was a legendary achievement—one that remains unmatched
in the history of the world’s premier rally series.

This Group A Delta rally car stands as an undeniable testament
to Lancia’s dominance in the sport.

Even the production car version, built for Group B
homologation...

...is the envy of car collectors everywhere!
~
dialogues.zh:
意大利的Lancia在很长一段时间里都是
世界拉力锦标赛统治级的存在。

这款Delta Group A拉力赛版本正是其荣耀传承中的闪耀瑰宝。

从1987年到1992年，Lancia豪取六连车厂冠军头衔……

这项传奇成就在世界顶级拉力赛事中至今无人能复刻。

这台Delta Group A拉力赛车无疑是Lancia成功的见证。

即便只是作为为了满足Gr.B组别认证而打造的
量产版车型……

也令全球汽车藏家艳羡不已！

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Why, this is the Group A rally version of the Lancia Delta!
A real fan favorite!

Its legend dates back to 1987, the first year in which
the WRC title was contested under Group A regulations.

That inaugural season, the Lancia Delta HF won the opening
race at Monte Carlo.

And it went on to claim the manufacturers’ and drivers’ titles
in a spectacular double victory!

What’s more, it went on winning manufacturers’ titles until
1992—a six-year streak!

That year may have marked the final appearance of a Lancia works
team in the WRC.

But it also saw the introduction of the Delta HF Integrale,
which dominated the competition in speed and durability.

Starting at Monte Carlo, it won eight races that year
and proudly clinched Lancia its sixth consecutive title.
dialogues.zh:
哇，这可是蓝旗亚Delta的A组别拉力赛版本！
车迷们的心头好！

这台车的传奇始于1987年，世界拉力锦标赛在那年
首次设立A组别。

首个赛季，蓝旗亚Delta HF便在蒙特卡洛揭幕战
旗开得胜……

并一路狂飙，达成斩获车厂和车手
双料冠军的壮举！

不仅如此，它更将车厂冠军头衔一直保持到了1992年
——成就六连冠伟业！

1992年是蓝旗亚车厂车队最后一次亮相
世界拉力锦标赛……

但同年问世的Delta HF Integrale依然在速度
和力量上力压群雄。.

从蒙特卡洛开始，它在那年赢得了八场比赛，
更荣耀地为蓝旗亚捧起六连冠奖杯。

collection.sourceName: DELTA HF Integrale WRC Group A (1992)
collection.en:
Lancia is well known for its elegant Italian designs
and is equally famous for its motorsports prowess.

It has produced great rally machines like the Fulvia and
Stratos, as well as the Delta, which competed in Group A.

The Delta made its stunning WRC debut in 1987, when
it racked up 9 wins to become the season champion.

As development on the car continued, innovative technology
was regularly added to it.

What do you think of its bulging blister fender? Does it not
express the wild ferocity of a genuine fighting machine?

Since entering competition in 1992, the HF Integrale has won
six straight manufacturers’ titles.

A true icon of 1990s rally racing, this is a legendary car
whose star has never dimmed.

Lancia以优雅的意大利设计而闻名，在赛车运动方面同样
声名显赫。

它打造了Fulvia、Stratos，以及参加A组别比赛的
Delta等伟大的拉力赛车。

Delta在1987年世界拉力锦标赛中惊艳登场，斩获
总计9场胜利，夺得赛季冠军。

随着Lancia的不断研发，创新技术被持续加诸其上。

基于Delta HF Integrale打造的拉力竞速机器
在1992年首次出战世界拉力锦标赛时，

就创下了连续夺得六届制造商冠军的壮举。

堪称该赛事历史上最伟大的成就之一。

作为90年代拉力赛车的真正标志，
时至今日依然是众人心目中的明星车型。+

vehicleCollection.sourceName: DELTA HF Integrale WRC Group A (1992)
vehicleCollection.en:
The Lancia Delta, a six-time consecutive WRC Champion.

Following the end of the Group B era in the WRC, Lancia turned to the Delta as its weapon of choice for Group A competition. Transformed with a turbocharged engine and a newly developed 4-wheel-drive system, the high-performance Delta was rebranded as the HF 4WD and made its debut in the 1987 WRC.

Just a year later, it evolved into the legendary Delta Integrale, equipped with aggressive blistered wheel arches. In 1990, the Integrale received a significant upgrade with the addition of a 16-valve cylinder head, boosting its performance even further. However, it soon faced fierce competition. Despite Lancia’s continued efforts, the Drivers’ Championship slipped from the Delta’s grasp in both 1990 and 1991, claimed by Toyota's Celica. Thus, in 1992, Lancia unveiled what would be considered the final evolution of the Delta.

This new Integrale featured reinforced bodywork for enhanced rigidity and underwent extensive suspension revisions, including a widened track. In line with these upgrades, the blistered wheel arches grew even more pronounced. To enhance aerodynamic performance, a roof-mounted spoiler was added to generate more downforce, while the torque distribution of the 4-wheel-drive system was recalibrated to give the car a more rear-wheel-drive–like character.

Thanks to these comprehensive improvements, the Delta regained its competitive edge. Although Lancia’s factory team ceased official racing activities in 1992 due to a policy shift by parent company FIAT, Lancia partnered with the Jolly Club satellite team, providing full technical support. Juha Kankkunen and Didier Auriol competed in 11 of 14 rounds that season, with Auriol taking six victories, Kankkunen adding one more, and Andrea Aghini yet another. With eight wins total, Lancia clinched the constructors' championship for te sixth consecutive year.
vehicleCollection.zh:
蓝旗亚Delta的巅峰之作，连续6届世界拉力锦标赛冠军得主"

在B组别赛事从世界拉力锦标赛中取消后，蓝旗亚选择Delta作为他们的A组别赛车。此车被改装为四驱并配备涡轮增压器，就此诞生的高性能车型被称为HF 4WD，参加了1987年世界拉力锦标赛。

次年，Delta HF 4WD配备了大胆的凸起轮拱罩，进化为Integrale。1990年，Integrale的引擎采用了16气门缸盖，进一步提升了动力。然而，丰田Celica的竞争力更强，导致Delta在1990年和1991年连续两次眼看着车手冠军被Celica夺走。因此，蓝旗亚在1992年发布了可以称为Delta最终进化版本的车型。

新的Integrale通过车身加强改善了操控性，并对悬挂系统进行了大幅修改，扩大了轮距。相应地，凸起的轮拱变得更大。为了获得更多下压力，在车顶末端安装了扰流板，四驱系统的扭矩分配向后轮倾斜，使车辆设定更像后驱车。

得益于这些改进，Delta重新获得了竞争实力。1992年，由于母公司菲亚特的政策影响，蓝旗亚没有派出原厂车队参加赛车活动，但他们与卫星车队乔利俱乐部合作并提供全面技术支持。尤哈·坎库宁和迪迪埃·奥里奥尔参加了系列赛14轮中的11轮比赛，奥里奥尔取得6场胜利，坎库宁赢得1场，安德烈亚·阿吉尼也收获1场胜利。一年8场胜利，让蓝旗亚连续第六年夺得制造商冠军。

catch.en: The Lancia Delta, a six-time consecutive WRC Champion.
catch.zh: 蓝旗亚Delta的巅峰之作，连续6届世界拉力锦标赛冠军得主"

long.en:
Following the end of the Group B era in the WRC, Lancia turned to the Delta as its weapon of choice for Group A competition. Transformed with a turbocharged engine and a newly developed 4-wheel-drive system, the high-performance Delta was rebranded as the HF 4WD and made its debut in the 1987 WRC.

Just a year later, it evolved into the legendary Delta Integrale, equipped with aggressive blistered wheel arches. In 1990, the Integrale received a significant upgrade with the addition of a 16-valve cylinder head, boosting its performance even further. However, it soon faced fierce competition. Despite Lancia’s continued efforts, the Drivers’ Championship slipped from the Delta’s grasp in both 1990 and 1991, claimed by Toyota's Celica. Thus, in 1992, Lancia unveiled what would be considered the final evolution of the Delta.

This new Integrale featured reinforced bodywork for enhanced rigidity and underwent extensive suspension revisions, including a widened track. In line with these upgrades, the blistered wheel arches grew even more pronounced. To enhance aerodynamic performance, a roof-mounted spoiler was added to generate more downforce, while the torque distribution of the 4-wheel-drive system was recalibrated to give the car a more rear-wheel-drive–like character.

Thanks to these comprehensive improvements, the Delta regained its competitive edge. Although Lancia’s factory team ceased official racing activities in 1992 due to a policy shift by parent company FIAT, Lancia partnered with the Jolly Club satellite team, providing full technical support. Juha Kankkunen and Didier Auriol competed in 11 of 14 rounds that season, with Auriol taking six victories, Kankkunen adding one more, and Andrea Aghini yet another. With eight wins total, Lancia clinched the constructors' championship for te sixth consecutive year.

collection.en:
The Lancia Rally 037 is one of the iconic Group B
rally cars of the 1980s.

Introduced in the early years of Group B, it combined a
midship engine location with a rear-wheel drive layout.

With its spaceframe chassis and midship engine...

It brought back memories of Lancia's iconic Stratos.

While four-wheel drive would become mainstream from
the appearance of the Audi quattro in ’81...

The Rally 037 still brought home the 1983 season title to
Lancia, despite being a two-wheel drive car.

This Evoluzione II is the final spec and features a 2.1L
displacement and improved cooling.
collection.zh:
Lancia Rally 037是1980年代B组别拉力赛的
标志性参赛车型之一。

这台结合了中置引擎和后轮驱动布局的拉力车很早就开
始参加B组别比赛。

其空间框架底盘和中置引擎...

让人不禁回想起Lancia标志性的Stratos。

当1981年Audi quattro的出现带动四轮驱动
成为拉力赛车主流后，

Rally 037仍然顽强地用两轮驱动为Lancia
带来了1983赛季的冠军，尽管是两轮驱动汽车。

这款名为Evoluzione II，是Rally 037的最终规格，
排量提高到了2.1升，冷却系统也得到了改进。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
The Stratos, designed by Marcello Gandini...

...was created to accomplish just one goal.

And what was that, you ask? To win rally races.

Legend has it that the car was a handful to drive
owing to its short wheelbase.

In fact, only a handful of drivers could ever really
master it.

One of them was the legendary rally driver
Sandro Munari.

He controlled the Stratos like it was a part of his body.

His view on the matter was:

"If you find driving this car difficult, then your skills
just aren't good enough."
dialogues.zh:
Stratos的设计者是马塞罗·甘迪尼……

他设计这辆车的目的只有一个。

那个目的是？在拉力赛中获胜。

传说这辆车非常难驾驭……

实际上，真正驾驭了这辆车的人也就那么几名车手。

传奇拉力车手桑德罗·穆纳利便是这些车手之一。

对他来说，操纵Stratos就像是操纵玩具车那样易如反掌！

他对此的看法是：

“如果您觉得这车难开，那只能说明你还欠火候！”
i

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
I'm totally taken with the wraparound cabin
and the flawless balance of the low body.

From just its presence,
you can almost hear the car's exhaust note, right?

I've seen Gandini's original sketch of the car...

...while the design theme is the same,
I was surprised in the difference of the ambience.

In fact, "car design" is something that can't
be accomplished by just one person.

The collaboration of engineers, who are themselves
craftsmen, and modelers is essential.

In those terms...

...I think it's correct in saying that
the Stratos is "Bertone designed."

I would seriously love to add this car to my collection,
but it has become too expensive.
dialogues.zh:
我完全被这辆车的环绕式座舱和其低矮车身的
完美平衡给折服了。

你仔细听，是不是几乎听不到它的排气声？

我看过甘迪尼为这辆车创作的设计草图原稿。

虽然设计主题相同，但传达的情绪感受却明显不同。

事实上，“汽车设计”并不是一个人就能完成的作品。

它需要工程技师和模型师之间的通力合作。

因此……

我觉得更准确的说法应该是——
Stratos由“博通设计打造”。

我是真的很想把这辆车纳入我的收藏，
不过恐怕它现在已经是我负担不起的天价了。<

Hello. It's very nice to meet you.
Yes, I'm Shiro Nakamura.
conversation.zh: 是的，我是。请多多指教。

conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.en:
It's an incredible honor to meet you!

Shiro-san worked on a few Nissan Zs and the GT-R.

He also designed the Isuzu 4200R concept car.
conversation.zh:
见到您真是太荣幸了！

史郎先生曾经致力于Nissan Z系和GT-R的设计工作

还设计了Isuzu 4200R概念车。

conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.en:
A car that expresses this much strength and beauty
in its appearance...

...is quite revolutionary in the history of car design.

It's a design that you simply cannot imitate.

It's a design that goes beyond something that's simply beautiful,
that's what I find most alluring.

It possesses both a futuristic design theme,
a signature element of Gandini's...

...and styling that truly is car-like. The Stratos is a car that
is defined by both.
conversation.zh:
你无法想象一辆汽车究竟是如何表现出这种程度的
力量和美感的。

这是革命性的一台车，

是一个无法被模仿的设计，

更是超越了单纯美学的设计。
我认为这就是其魅力所在。

它既拥有甘迪尼标志性的未来主义设计……

又没有忘记其本源。
确切地说，这辆Stratos是一辆跨越两个世界的车。

conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.en: By the way, do you know who Gandini is?
conversation.zh: 顺便问一句，你们知道甘迪尼是谁吗？

conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.en:
Yes. He's the legendary car designer from Italy,
Marcello Gandini.

He had a hand in the design of cars such as the Countach
and Stratos, and is known all around the world.

对，马塞罗·甘迪尼，来自意大利的传奇汽车设计师。

他曾设计过Countach和Stratos，在全世界都享有盛名。

usedCar.en:
Perhaps the most famous of all rally race cars is the
Lancia Stratos. It's also one of the best looking.

This mid-engine marvel first emerged on the rally scene
in the 1970s.

Thanks to its amazing power and handling, it won several world
championship titles.

The car was designed by Marcello Gandini, who also penned
a number of classic Lamborghinis.

Powering the car was the same engine as the Ferrari Dino.

The Stratos has already become a highly sought collector's car
with a six-figure price tag!
usedCar.zh:
Stratos是一款优秀的双座敞篷车，由备受
敬仰的拉力赛车制造商蓝旗亚推出。

这款奇妙的中置引擎车型于20世纪70年代
在拉力赛场上首度亮相。

它的速度和动力使它夺得了多项世界冠军。

这款车的风格设计由汽车设计的传奇性
人物马塞罗·甘迪尼负责。

它的引擎采用了和法拉利Dino 246相同的V6。

要知道，没有多少车的性能能比它更出色了！

vehicleCollection.en:
This mid-engine sports car made quite the impression on the rally world with its sharp wedge-shaped body.

At the 1970 Turin Motor Show, Bertone unveiled a striking concept car called the Stratos Zero. With its radical wedge-shaped profile and a front windshield that doubled as the door, the vehicle was conceived purely as a design study. But even then, Bertone described it as a mid-engine concept. Following the show, development began in collaboration with Lancia, which was in search of a new rally car to succeed the Fulvia.

Marcello Gandini was tasked with refining the concept into a production-ready model. Drawing inspiration from the shape of the Stratos Zero, he created an angular body that echoed its otherworldly name: Stratosphere. Thus, the legendary Lancia Stratos was born.

The Stratos featured a robust welded steel monocoque chassis clad in lightweight fiberglass panels. Mounted behind the seats was the same 2.4-liter DOHC V-6 engine found in the Ferrari Dino 246 GT.

Its performance potential was evident in its dimensions: an exceptionally short wheelbase of just 2180 mm and a wide rear tread of 1457 mm. This configuration delivered razor-sharp handling and extremely sensitive response. For those who could master its traits, the Stratos offered extraordinary performance that translated into rally dominance, ushering in a golden era for Lancia on the world stage.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆中置引擎跑车以其轮廓鲜明的楔形车身在拉力赛中崭露锋芒。

在1970年的都灵车展上，博通推出了概念车“Stratos Zero”。车身轮廓完全呈楔形，前档风玻璃化身为车门。这款设计原本只是试水，但博通却表示已经在考虑使用中置引擎布局进行开发了。展会一结束，蓝旗亚就紧锣密鼓地投入到开发中，他们当时正在寻求代替Fulvia参加拉力赛的车型。

马塞罗·甘迪尼出手改进了设计，创造出了可供批量生产的Stratos Zero。充分利用楔形轮廓，为其打造出了与“至尊”称号相称的硬朗外观，蓝旗亚Stratos就此诞生。

Stratos的车体由坚固的焊接钢单体框架和玻璃纤维外板组成。座椅后方的引擎则是一台法拉利Dino 246GT同款的2.4升双顶置凸轮轴V6引擎。

从轴距和胎宽上，就足以体现出这款车卓越的性能：仅有2180mm的短轴距和宽达1457mm的后胎，带来了极致的过弯能力和难以驾驭的灵敏度。只有拥有极高驾驶技巧的车手才能驾驭得了蓝旗亚Stratos，另一方面，其完美适配拉力赛的优异性能也成就了蓝旗亚在拉力赛中的一段辉煌时刻。

从轴距和胎宽上，就足以体现出这款车卓越的性能：仅有2180mm的短轴距和宽达1457mm的后胎，带来了极致的过弯能力和难以驾驭的灵敏度。只有拥有极高驾驶技巧的车手才能驾驭得了蓝旗亚Stratos，另一方面，其完美适配拉力赛的优异性能也成就了蓝旗亚在拉力赛中的一段辉煌时刻。

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
The Lexus LC500 has absolutely incredible proportions.

With a long, low bonnet, a long wheelbase...

A tight cabin, large wheels placed
at the corners...

And an absolutely juicy body shape,
which is well-sculpted.

It has very technical headlamps and taillamps,
and a fresh interpretation of the Lexus grille.

This design makes it very clear that a highly advanced
engine is under the bonnet. I absolutely love this car!

Lexus LC500的车身比例十分惊人。

它具有修长而低矮的引擎盖，相对较长的轴距

和紧凑的驾驶舱，硕大的车轮更是占据了四角……

外加夺人眼球、线条精雕细刻的抢眼车身造型。

它的大灯和尾灯科技含量很高，前格栅
则是对Lexus经典款式的重新演绎。

整体的造型都在告诉你——我的引擎盖下面安装了一颗
非常先进的引擎。这是我非常非常喜欢的一台车！\

brandCentral.en:
Have you heard of the "LF-LC?" You might not have, because
it was a concept vehicle produced by Lexus in 2012.

That said, it probably looks familiar because it served as the
design-study model for the LS 500 luxury sports coupe.

Under its long hood is a 5.0-liter V-8, which also sees duty
in the Lexus RC F.

Because it's naturally aspirated, this engine delivers tons of
low-end torque and revs evenly through the RPM spectrum.
brandCentral.zh:
您听说过“LF-LC”吗？这台绝美的概念赛车由雷克萨斯在2012年公布。

LC500在设计时也将之作为了参照。

它安装有一台5升自然进气V8引擎，和RC F跑车型号采用
的是同款。

这辆车在低转速时扭矩非常充足，达到高转速区间后也
没有牺牲任何性能。

vehicleCollection.en:
This stylish sports coupe attracted plenty of attention with its low nose and short overhang design.

Introduced at the 2016 Geneva Auto Show, the LC500 luxury sports coupe represented the first F-segment model for Lexus.

The styling is nearly unchanged from the LF-FC concept vehicle revealed in 2012, which was penned at Lexus’ design studio in California. Its flowing lines and low hood give the LC500 a wind-cutting shape, and it features short front and rear overhangs that allow the engine to be placed aft of the front wheels, giving it a front mid-engine layout.

The LC500 was built on the newly developed GA-L platform. The body is composed of a combination of materials that include carbon fiber, aluminum and steel, which gives the sports coupe a highly-rigid yet lightweight character.

Under the hood is the same 5.0-liter naturally-aspirated V-8 found in the RC F and GS F that produces 477ps and 55.1kgm of torque. The engine comes mated to the first direct-shift 10-speed automatic transmission to be equipped on a passenger car.

The LC500 race car dominated its debut appearance in the GT500 class of the Super GT series in 2017, taking 1st to 6th place.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款时尚的双门跑车以其较低的车鼻和紧凑的前后悬间距吸睛无数。

LC500是在2016年日内瓦车展上亮相的豪华跑车。这款车是雷克萨斯的首款F级双门跑车。

LC500的样式几乎与2012年发布的LF-FC概念赛车相同，是雷克萨斯位于加利福利亚的设计工作室的内部开发成果。虽然其流线形双门车身的前鼻很低，但前部和后部的悬垂非常短，得以容纳中置引擎和2+2的座位布局。

这款车的底盘结构是基于丰田新全球架构概念全新开发的GA-L平台。车身是碳纤维、铝材和钢材等多种材料的组合，这些材料被用于多种零件，从而在低重量和高刚度之间取得平衡。

引擎和RC F及GS F所使用的相同，仍采用5升V8自然吸气引擎，可产生477ps/55.1kgm的动力。搭配此引擎的是首次装备在乘用车上的直接换档式10档自动变速箱。

LC500从2017年开始参加Super GT系列赛的GT500组比赛，并在首次比赛中包揽了一到六名。

Take the beauty of the LF-LC, a concept car by Lexus, combine
it with the striking silhouette of a race car...

...and you get the Lexus LF-LC GT VGT!

This gorgeous vehicle was designed to race in touring-car
such as the Super GT or Nürburgring 24 Hours.

It's race-ready for the virtual race track.
brandCentral.zh:
将Lexus概念车LF-LC的美感与赛车的冲击性轮廓相融合……

就得到了Lexus LF-LC GT VGT！

这辆华丽的赛车是为了在诸如Super GT或纽博格林24小时耐
力赛等比赛中大显身手而生的。

此车已经为比赛做好了一切准备，渴望着驰骋赛场！

vehicleCollection.en:
A beautiful high performance machine for participation in the Nürburgring 24 hour race.

For Lexus, the 2014 Super GT GT500 class was a historic season in which they fought hard for the class title until the very last race. And in 2015, Lexus added a new page to their ultimate challenge in the top category: They are planning an introduction of a car into the GT3 class, a class that is a gentlemen’s race but at the same time the ultimate international manufacturers’ championship. This comes from the hope of Lexus to fulfill the desires of gentlemen racers; to participate together with them in world class races in the car of their dreams.

With this background of Lexus’ involvement in racing, the LEXUS LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Turismo” was developed in reply to the passions of Gran Turismo fans, to compete in world class races with their dream car. The design and development of the car targets entry in races such as the Super GT and the Nürburgring 24 hour race.

For Lexus, the 2014 Super GT GT500 season was one to remember because it took home the championship in the very last race. In 2015, Lexus entered the GT3 racing class, where it battled in the world's foremost international championships.

The brand's amazing success in motorsports paved the way for the creation of the Lexus LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Turismo.” With this machine, Gran Turismo players were able to compete virtually in various world-class races in what can be called the quintessential gentleman's race car.

The LF-LC GT "Vision Gran Turismo" is based on the LF-LC concept vehicle, which was shown at the 2012 North American International Auto Show and created by Calty Design Research. Thus, the LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Turismo” is a grand tourer that possesses both sculptured beauty and the highest levels of performance, with real world elements provided by Calty blended with the on-road prowess of Lexus Racing

Born from a passion for racing, the Lexus LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Trismo” is a car meant to probe the potentials of the ultimate Lexus rce car.
vehicleCollection.zh:
优雅的高性能赛车，参赛纽博格林24小时耐力赛。

对于雷克萨斯而言，2014年Super GT的GT500组是一个历史性的赛季，他们奋战至最后一场比赛，最终赢得了该组冠军。2015年，雷克萨斯对另一项顶级赛事发起了新的挑战，他们派出一款车型参加GT3组比赛，该组虽然是业余赛事，但同时也是顶级国际车厂的锦标赛。雷克萨斯此举是希望满足业余选手的梦想；让他们驾驶着他们所梦想的车型，与他们一起参加世界级的比赛。

雷克萨斯凭借其在赛车领域的专业背景，为了回应跑车浪漫旅玩家的热情，使他们能够驾驶自己梦想中的跑车参加世界级的赛事，专门开发了雷克萨斯LF-LC GT Vision Gran Turismo。在设计开发过程中，该车型预想征战的赛场包括Super GT和纽博格林24小时耐力赛等比赛。

该车的基本车型来自双门豪华概念赛车型LF-LC，这款车是2012年底特律车展上公布的雷克萨斯未来概念赛车型。这款由CALTY DESIGN所设计的车型有许多激动人心的设计特征，如模仿喷气式战斗机助燃器的尾灯等。

基于CALTY DESIGN提出的雷克萨斯设计哲学，这款车采用了革命性的表现手法，并且运用了雷克萨斯赛车在现实世界中的实践经验。雷克萨斯LF-LC GT "Vision Gran Turismo"是一款既富雕塑美感，又具备实际性能的超级跑车。

在每个时代，赛车都是人们为之倾注激情的运动。轰鸣的排气声令人们为之血脉偾张。雷克萨斯LF-LC GT Vision Gran Turismo的白色车身上的彩色笔刷纹样正是象征了这些永远令赛车运动爱好者着迷的精彩时刻。

雷克萨斯LF-LC GT Vision Gran Turismo诞生于对赛车运动的狂热，它是为实现了跑车浪漫旅玩家的梦想而生的。

brandCentral.en:
The LFA was the first supercar from Lexus.

Can you believe it took a decade to develop?

It was the result of extensive testing at Nürburgring races,
so you can imagine how well this car performs.

One big feature of this front-engine/
rear-wheel-drive car...

...is that its transmission is positioned
on the rear axle.

This makes it a well-balanced "FR" machine with a rear
transaxle configuration.

Powered by a high-revving naturally-aspirated V-10,
the LFA sounds as sweet as it drives.

It's truly one of Japan’s greatest sports cars!

And while its production run ended more than a decade ago,
its allure never seems to diminish.
brandCentral.zh:
LFA是Lexus打造的第一款超级跑车。

你能想象吗？这款车的开发花费了整整十年时间。

在纽博格林的大量测试最终开花结果，
证明这辆车确实拥有飞一般的速度。

这款引擎前置、后轮驱动跑车的一项主要特点……

就是它的传动系统搭载在后轮轴上……

让它成为了一款采用后驱动桥配置、
前后配重比平衡的前置后驱车。

LFA由一台高转速自然进气V10引擎提供动力，
拥有澎湃震撼的声浪。

毫无疑问，它是日本最伟大的跑车之一！

尽管已经于十年前停产，但它的魅力却不减反增。_

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultra high-tech sports car achieved ultimate performance with mass-production quality.

Twenty years before Japan’s automotive industry was truly recognized by the world, Toyota created a sports car called the 2000GT, which combined the latest technology of the 1960s with a truly revolutionary body design. In the 21st century, Lexus created another cutting-edge sports car that would continue that legacy. It was called the LFA.

Creating such a car was not easy. The goal was to provide stable and consistent quality while incorporating emerging technologies, which included a lightweight carbon-fiber body. For the engineers, it was not enough to simply make another sports car for the masses; they staked the company's reputation to create a car that balanced cutting-edge technology with consistent product quality.

One of the most important factors of a sports car remains the front-to-rear weight distribution ratio; the LFA's was 48 to 52. To achieve this figure, they implemented a transaxle layout and mounted the radiator at the rear. Also, curb weight was kept at 1480kg. Emphasis was also put on lowering the car's center of gravity, utilizing a dry-sump lubrication system so that the powertrain could be mounted lower.

The LFA's 4.8-liter V-10 had bank angles of 72 degrees with a factory redline of 9500rpm. Its 560ps output equated to 117ps per liter, but what's most impressive was that despite this incredibly high-performance level, the LFA was still relatively environmentally friendly. The transmission came in the form of a 6-speed single-clutch 2-pedal manual that could perform shifts in just 0.2 seconds, a figure on par with the world's top race cars.

在日本的汽车行业真正得到全世界认可的20年前，丰田就打造了一款结合了1960年代最尖端科技的跑车，名为2000GT。时间来到21世纪，雷克萨斯接过品牌传承，打造出另一款技术领先的跑车——LFA。

既要整合碳纤维车身等最新研发的技术，又要保证品牌一以贯之的稳定品质，这台车的开发难度不可谓不高。对于雷克萨斯来说，光是将各种部件安装组合在一起是远远不够的，这台新车还需要在尖端科技和一贯的产品品质之间找到平衡点。它代表着雷克萨斯作为一家量产车制造商的门面和荣耀。

配重比是跑车最重要的因素之一，这款车的前后配重比被设计为48比52。为了实现这个参数，雷克萨斯采用了一套驱动桥布局，并将散热器布置在车身后部。车重也被降低到1480kg。另外一项设计重点放在降低重心上——通过采用一套干式油底壳润滑系统，得以实现更低的动力系统安装位。

它的4.8升V10引擎采用72度的V型夹角设计，原厂转速红线设在9500rpm，而560ps总动力输出相当于每升输出117ps。不过即便达到这样高的性能水准，这辆车依然比大多数车辆更加环保。其传动装置采用一部双踏板单离合的6速手动变速箱，可以在仅仅0.2秒内完成换挡，这个数据足以与世界最顶级的比赛机器相媲美。

碳化陶瓷刹车碟是LFA的标配，前轮采用6活塞卡钳，而后轮采用4活塞卡钳，而且前后活塞的尺寸略有不同。

LFA能够实现在3.7秒内完成0-<100km/h>加速，极速更是高达<325km/h>。由于这台高性能车全球仅限量生产了500辆，所以相当的罕见。

long.en:
Twenty years before Japan’s automotive industry was truly recognized by the world, Toyota created a sports car called the 2000GT, which combined the latest technology of the 1960s with a truly revolutionary body design. In the 21st century, Lexus created another cutting-edge sports car that would continue that legacy. It was called the LFA.

Creating such a car was not easy. The goal was to provide stable and consistent quality while incorporating emerging technologies, which included a lightweight carbon-fiber body. For the engineers, it was not enough to simply make another sports car for the masses; they staked the company's reputation to create a car that balanced cutting-edge technology with consistent product quality.

One of the most important factors of a sports car remains the front-to-rear weight distribution ratio; the LFA's was 48 to 52. To achieve this figure, they implemented a transaxle layout and mounted the radiator at the rear. Also, curb weight was kept at 1480kg. Emphasis was also put on lowering the car's center of gravity, utilizing a dry-sump lubrication system so that the powertrain could be mounted lower.

The LFA's 4.8-liter V-10 had bank angles of 72 degrees with a factory redline of 9500rpm. Its 560ps output equated to 117ps per liter, but what's most impressive was that despite this incredibly high-performance level, the LFA was still relatively environmentally friendly. The transmission came in the form of a 6-speed single-clutch 2-pedal manual that could perform shifts in just 0.2 seconds, a figure on par with the world's top race cars.

Carbon ceramic brake discs were standard fare, with 6-pot calipers in front and 4-pot calipers at rear, all with varying piston sizes.

The LFA ran from zero to <100km/h> in just 3.7 seconds and reached a top speed of <325km/>. But what really sweetened the car's collectivity factor was that it wa produced in a limited run of only 500 cars worldwide.
