brandCentral.en:
The Lexus RC F is well-known for its GT3 racing variant.

Did you know that the 'F' in the model name stands for the
Fuji Speedway, the home course for Lexus Gazoo Racing?

The naturally aspirated 5.0 L V8 engine allows for smooth
transition to higher RPMs and a pleasant exhaust note.

And the enhanced oil cooler also allows you to get the most

brandCentral.zh:
Lexus RC F因其参加GT3组别的赛车而广为人知。

你知道吗，车型名称中的“F”代表富士赛道，后者正
是Lexus Gazoo车队的主场。

自然进气的5.0 升 V8引擎可以平顺过渡到更高的转速，发
出的排气声更是令人心旷神怡，

更有经过强化的油冷却器助您在赛道上取得佳绩。

vehicleCollection.en:
Even beginners can experience dynamic driving performance with a range of electronic aids.

While German luxury carmakers have traditionally defined the luxury sports coupe market, Lexus decided to join the fray with a svelte version all its own called the RC F. Introduced at the 2014 North American International Auto Show, the RC F is the sportiest entry of the RC line—the letter “F,” which references Fuji Speedway, is added to all of the brand’s high-performance models.

Under the hood is a 5.0-liter V-8, the same powerplant found in the IS F, with new titanium valves, forged connecting rods, newly designed cylinder heads and custom exhaust system. They combine to help the engine produce 456ps/53.0kgm, which is 33ps and 1.5kgm more than the IS F. It comes mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission that performs lightning-quick shifts via paddles near the steering wheel.

The Sports Mode of the VDIM, which centrally controls vehicle dynamics, has been refined for the racetrack, and most of the electronic devices have been updated. The RC F features the first torque-vectoring system in the world to be incorporated into a front-engine/rear-wheel drive car. This system allows drivers of all levels to enjoy the RC F’s excellent handling balance and overall performance.

With the exception of the limited-edition LFA supercar, the RC F is the sportiest model to ever come from Lexus.
vehicleCollection.zh:
即便是新手也可以在多种电子辅助设备的帮助下体验到动态的驾驶表现。

RC F是雷克萨斯品牌的高性能双门跑车，发布于2014年的底特律车展。雷克萨斯在他们的高性能车型名称中使用字母“F”进行标识，代表富士赛道。RC F是对2013年东京车展上发布的RC系列双门跑车大幅度升级后的版本。

引擎基于IS F所采用的5升V8引擎，采用新的钛合金气门、锻造连杆和新设计的气缸盖和排气系统。这款车的输出动力可达到456ps/53.0kgm，相比原款引擎，马力提高了33ps，扭矩提高了1.5kgm。同时还配备了带换档拨片的8档自动变速箱。

针对赛道驾驶，该车对控制车辆动力的车辆动态综合管理系统的跑车模式进行了进一步优化。这款车的电子设备得到再次更新，配备了世界首个用于前置引擎、后轮驱动车型的扭矩矢量分配系统。这是因为RC F的一个核心设计理念——让车手和新车手都能享受澎湃的跑车驾驶性能所带来的乐趣。

除了LFA之外，RC F是雷克萨斯史上最动感的车型。

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

This is the Lexus RC F GT3, a car developed with FIA GT3

It has competed in events like the Japanese Super GT, the US

And not only has it competed, it has won everywhere it has

vehicleCollection.en:
Emil Frey Racing was one of the first teams to compete with a GT3 version of the Lexus RC F.

While Lexus ran an RC F-based race car for the VLN and Super GT Series in 2015, it was allowed to compete with this particular car without

having to adhere to homologation requirements. The RC F GT3 Prototype made its debut in Round 9 of the VLN series and won the SPX class, which allowed specially permitted entries.

This prototype race car was developed with the intent of eventually providing a GT3 machine to race teams around the world. Starting out as an RC F, the entire car was altered dramatically to ensure competitiveness and reliability in GT3 races. Weight was significantly reduced and the body drastically stiffened; the front and rear fenders were swapped to improve aerodynamics; and power from the 5.0-liter V-8 engine was increased to 540ps. Ultimately, the car was homologated and introduced as the Lexus RC F GT3 in 2017.

The following year, the new race car was delivered to Emil Frey Racing in Switzerland, which took part in the development of the RC F GT3. Participating in the GT Open Championship of Europe, the team won four of 14 races and placed 3rd for the season.
vehicleCollection.zh:
埃米尔弗雷车队使用的GT3车型。埃米尔弗雷车队是最早使用雷克萨斯RC F的车队之一。

自2015年起，雷克萨斯使用一台基于RC F改装的赛车参加了VLN系列赛和超级跑车系列赛，但这辆车是没有经过认证的特许车辆。凭借这些经验，雷克萨斯继续研发了RC F GT3原型车，并将其用于2016年秋季VLN系列赛的第9轮比赛。在这场比赛中，他们成功赢得了特许车辆的SPX类别冠军。

原型车的最终开发目标是为GT3车队提供一款超级跑车，并以此参加世界各地的比赛。因此，这款车需要让业余车手也能驾驭，并能通过强化部件来提供可靠的性能。在对每一个组件的耐久性进行彻底的计算后，车辆设计进行了全面改动，在保证刚度的前提下减轻了重量，包括前后挡泥板等设计修改则进一步提升了车辆的空气动力学性能。量产版的5升双顶置凸轮轴V8引擎经过调试后，马力超过了540ps。这款车最终在2017年通过认证并以雷克萨斯RC F GT3的名称登场。

同年晚些时候，同属于RC F GT3开发团队的瑞士埃米尔弗雷车队也使用此车参加了欧洲GT公开锦标赛，在14场比赛中夺得4场冠军，在赛季车队排行榜上位列第三名。

catch.en: Emil Frey Racing was one of the first teams to compete with a GT3 version of the Lexus RC F.
catch.zh: 埃米尔弗雷车队使用的GT3车型。埃米尔弗雷车队是最早使用雷克萨斯RC F的车队之一。

long.en:
While Lexus ran an RC F-based race car for the VLN and Super GT Series in 2015, it was allowed to compete with this particular car without

having to adhere to homologation requirements. The RC F GT3 Prototype made its debut in Round 9 of the VLN series and won the SPX class, which allowed specially permitted entries.

This prototype race car was developed with the intent of eventually providing a GT3 machine to race teams around the world. Starting out as an RC F, the entire car was altered dramatically to ensure competitiveness and reliability in GT3 races. Weight was significantly reduced and the body drastically stiffened; the front and rear fenders were swapped to improve aerodynamics; and power from the 5.0-liter V-8 engine was increased to 540ps. Ultimately, the car was homologated and introduced as the Lexus RC F GT3 in 2017.

The following year, the new race car was delivered to Emil Frey Racing in Switzerland, which took part in the development of the RC F GT3. Participating in the GT Open Championship of Europe, the team won four of 14 races and placed 3rd for the season.

brandCentral.en:
The Lexus RC F GT3 is a race car specifically developed
to wage war in the popular FIA GT3 series.

While the car was expected to be competitive, it was still behind
the others in development...or so people thought.

This race car made a name for itself in Race 9 of the 2016
Nürburgring Endurance Series, surprising everyone.

Despite competing as a prototype, it finished first
in its class.

The victory was also the first of its kind for a Japanese
automobile in the series.

Needless to say, this model has become a major piece
in the history of Toyota racing.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Lexus RC F GT3是一辆专为满足FIA GT3规则所开发的原型车。

它因为在某场比赛中的优异表现而一夜成名。

具体是哪场比赛呢？那当然就是2016年纽博格林24小时耐
力赛的第九场！

尽管是作为一款原型车参赛，却在所属组别中登上了冠
军的宝座。

这也是日本同类型车辆在纽博格林耐力赛中摘得的第一
个冠军。

无需我多言，它早已在历史上留下了光辉灿烂的一笔。

vehicleCollection.en:
This highly refined Lexus RC F coupe competed in the 2016 VLN as a GT3 race car.+

When Lexus introduced the RC luxury sports coupe in 2014, it also included a high-performance version in the lineup called the RC F, which served as the foundation for the RC F GT3 race car.

Created to compete in GT3 races around the world, the RC F GT3 was developed at the same time as the production RC F. The original V-8 engine was converted to have a dry sump lubrication system, and displacement was increased to 5.4 liters. Mated to a 6-speed sequential gearbox, the race engine produced 500ps. Although it looks larger than the production car because of its wider fenders, the RC F GT3 tipped the scales at a lean 1300kg.

Starting in the 2017 season, the RC F GT3 waged battle in the American IMSA series (GTD category), the European International GT Open series, and the Japanese Super GT series (GT300 class), where it performed admirably.

In the International GT race at Silverstone, the RC F GT3 grabbed its first victory. Then in Japan, it won for the first time in the Super GT series, taking the checkered flag in the second-round race at the Fuji Speedway.

The RC F GT3 prototype represented here is a car that was built for performance evaluation before the RC F GT3 acquired homologation. This car won the ninth race of the VLN (Nürburgring Endurance Series) on October 8, 2016, running without a paint job and its carbon-fiber body fully exposed. The car here, though, wears the livery of Emil Frey Racing, a top Swiss team that competes in the International GT Open.
vehicleCollection.zh:
参与过2016 VLN赛事的雷克萨斯RC F GT3。

RC F是雷克萨斯2014年发布的RC豪华双门跑车产品线中的高性能车型。雷克萨斯根据这一车型开发了竞赛车型RC F GT3，用于参加在世界各地所举行的GT3类别的知名赛事。

RC F GT3的立项在这款公路量产车型的开发阶段就已经开始，并与这款公路跑车同步进行开发。竞赛车型将标准款RC F的V8引擎驱动改为了干式油底壳润滑系统，排量也增加到了5.4升，同时采用了6档序列变速箱，最大输出功率达到500ps。由于使用了大直径的光面轮胎，所以这辆车还配备了挡泥板，并且尽可能地减轻重量，将整车重量降至1300kg。

从2017赛季开始，RC F GT3参加了美国国际汽车运动协会系列赛（GTD类别）、欧洲国际GT公开系列赛以及日本超级跑车（GT300组）赛事，并取得了不俗的成绩。

在国际GT公开系列赛中，这辆车参加的第二场比赛就在银石赛道斩获首胜；在日本，这辆车首次在超级跑车于富士赛道举行的第二轮比赛中获胜。

这里展示的RC F GT3原型车是RC F GT3在获得认证之前，为了评估性能而制造的车型。这辆车于2016年10月8日赢得了纽博格林耐力系列赛的第九轮比赛。当时参赛时，这辆车尚未涂装完毕，碳纤维的表面完全暴露在外。但在这里，车身使用了埃米尔弗雷车队的涂装，埃米尔弗雷车队是一支在国际GT公开赛中参赛的顶尖瑞士车队。

catch.zh: 参与过2016 VLN赛事的雷克萨斯RC F GT3。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
This Lexus RC F competes in Japan's top racing category,
Super GT.

It made it debut in...2014, I think.

This one is the 2016 spec. I have fond memories of seeing
it in action!

It lost the first four races to the Nissan GT-R, but then
made a stunning comeback after changing the engine!

By the end of the season, it had managed to claw its way up
to fifth place in the rankings.

As it happens, that season's championship was won by another
RC F, number 39!
dialogues.zh:
这辆Lexus RC F参加了日本的顶级赛事Super GT。

这款车应该是在……2014年首次亮相的。

这辆车是2016年的型号。它在赛场上驰骋的样子仍能令我心潮澎湃！

这辆车在前四场比赛中输给了Nissan GT-R，
但在更换引擎之后，它上演了一场惊人的反击战！

在赛季结束时，它已经成功地爬到了第五的位置。

碰巧的是，该赛季的冠军是由另一辆车号为39的RC F赢得的！

brandCentral.zh:
这辆Lexus au TOM'S RC F是2016年日本Super GT系列赛的

vehicleCollection.en:
This Toyota/Lexus race car competed under joint regulations between the Super GT Series and DTM.

Toyota's weapon of choice for the GT500 class of the Super GT Series from 2014 to 2016 was the race version of the Lexus RC F production car, which was released in October 2014.

Because of new regulations from 2014, the car underwent a several changes to conform to the new rules. The weight and rigidity of the monocoque and center of gravity were altered, while new dampers, brakes and a rear wing were added, making it look like a true DTM machine. Powering the car was a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection (called the RI4AG), which also saw use in Super Formula cars. Because of of a new regulation that limited fuel flow from <100kg/h> to <95kg/h>, improvements were made elsewhere so the car could produce more power with less fuel.

The 2016 model was the final version of this RC F race car, with the au TOM’S RC F wearing the ace car number 36. It placed 3rd in the third race of the season and 2nd in Round 6, ultimately finishing 5th overall out of 15 cars.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款丰田/雷克萨斯超级跑车同样参加了德国房车大师赛。

代表丰田/雷克萨斯在2014至2016赛季的Super GT系列赛中赢得GT500级别冠军的是雷克萨斯RC F，原型来自2014年上市的量产车。

由于2014年颁布新规定，车辆的单体车壳重量、刚度及重心都接受了调整，以符合德国房车大师赛的规定。避震器、刹车和尾翼也改为符合德国房车大师赛规定的版本。受到新规定的限制，RC F外廓的车身上半部分无法改动，因此只能对下半部分进行重新设计以提高下压力。动力单元是一款2升涡轮增压直列式4缸直喷引擎：RI4AG引擎。这款与Super方程式完全共享的引擎已针对Super GT赛事的使用进行了专项调校。

2016的车型是这款车的最终版本。由于规则限制日益增多，燃油限制器的流量由<100kg/h>降低到了<95kg/h>，车辆接受了进一步改装，以便利用更少的燃料来产生更大的马力。同时还进行了多项其他改进。

雷克萨斯TOM’S车队的36号au TOM’S RC F在第6轮中取得了第2名，在第3轮中则取得了第3名，总成绩位列15辆参赛车辆中的第5位。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Toyota introduced this Lexus SC430 as the successor to...

The 80 Supra for the Super GT racing series.

The 2008 series in which it debuted was a heated contest
right down to the last race!

But when the Petronas Tom’s car crossed the finish line
and took the team title...

It established itself as a champion car
for the history books.

By the way, did you know that the base SC430
wwas a vario-roof convertible?

To get it battle-ready, Toyota built a reinforced roof
that combined a roll cage and carbon panels...

and fit it over the original.

In other words, the SC430 GT500 is in fact
built upon a coupe body!
dialogues.zh:
这辆雷克萨斯SC430是丰田为……

参加Super GT赛事的80 Supra推出的继任者。

在这辆车出道的2008年，系列赛的每一场厮杀都十分激烈，
悬念一直留到了决赛！

最终，这辆Petronas Tom’s赛车越过终点线，
为车队夺得了冠军……

自己也作为冠军之车被载入了史册。

顺带一提，你知道SC430的基础车其实是一辆折叠硬顶敞篷车吗？

为了让它能够参赛，丰田专为它打造了以防滚车架
和碳纤维面板制造的强化车顶……

安在原先的车辆上。

换句话说，这辆SC430 GT500其实是基于双门轿跑的车身而打造的！

dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.en:
The Lexus SC is a grand tourer series.

The second-generation model, the SC430, was a hardtop convertible
powered by a mighty V-8 engine.

You see them quite often in the U.S.

The first-generation model was designed at Calty, a Toyota design
studio located in California.

However, this SC430 was mainly conceived
at design studios in Europe.

A competitor at Japanese GT races, it received aerodynamic
upgrades for the 2008 season...

...during which it tore up the high-speed tracks.
dialogues.zh:
Lexus SC属于品牌的豪华旅行车系列车型。

其二代车型SC430是由一台强力的V8引擎所驱动的硬顶敞篷车。

在美国，这辆车相对比较常见。

该系列的第一代车型由位于加利福尼亚的
Toyota设计工作室Calty所设计。

However, this SC430 was mainly conceived

A competitor at Japanese GT races, it received aerodynamic

Toyota introduced this Lexus SC430 as the successor to...

The 80 Supra for the Super GT racing series.

The 2008 series in which it debuted was a heated contest
right down to the last race!

But when the Petronas Tom’s car crossed the finish line
and took the team title...

It established itself as a champion car
for the history books.

By the way, did you know that the base SC430
wwas a vario-roof convertible?

To get it battle-ready, Toyota built a reinforced roof
that combined a roll cage and carbon panels...

and fit it over the original.

In other words, the SC430 GT500 is in fact
built upon a coupe body!

参加Super GT赛事的80 Supra推出的继任者。

在这辆车出道的2008年，系列赛的每一场厮杀都十分激烈，
悬念一直留到了决赛！

最终，这辆Petronas Tom’s赛车越过终点线，
为车队夺得了冠军……

自己也作为冠军之车被载入了史册。

顺带一提，你知道SC430的基础车其实是一辆折叠硬顶敞篷车吗？

为了让它能够参赛，丰田专为它打造了以防滚车架
和碳纤维面板制造的强化车顶……

安在原先的车辆上。

换句话说，这辆SC430 GT500其实是基于双门轿跑的车身而打造的！

vehicleCollection.en:
Won the Super GT team title with its stable performance on high-speed circuits.

In 2008, the Nissan GT-R made its heralded return to the Super GT Series in Japan. As the GT-R made the headlines, Lexus was quietly making significant improvements to its entry in Japan's most popular racing series, the SC430.

The SC430 did not fare well in the Super GT series the previous year, as it was aerodynamically inferior to the competition, the result of a compact body with front and rear overhangs that were too short to provide acceptable levels of downforce. However for 2008, Lexus lengthened the overhangs, giving the car much improved aerodynamics than the previous year. The result was a sleek, fast race car that flourished on high-speed race tracks.

Despite winning only one race during the entire season (at the Fuji International Speedway) by the ZENT CERUMO team, the Lexus SC430 GT machine took home the overall championship, thanks to the consistency of the Petronas TOM's team. The combination of a good long-term strategy and a reliable, fast car proved to be the right formula in winning the series title that year.!
vehicleCollection.zh:
在高速赛道上的稳定发挥帮助车队赢下了Super GT组别的桂冠。+

2008年是日本Super GT赛事的一场盛会，日产赶在公开赛事首轮前，帮助日产GT-R全面回归，重返赛场。赛事期间，雷克萨斯仍在继续钻研如何提升SC430。

相比其他参赛车辆，最初的SC430存在一项巨大的缺陷。在超级跑车车辆中，安装于车身底板前后轴的空气动力学套件需要有效产生足够的下压力，而原版SC430相对较短的前后悬间距不足以提供足够的空力效果。

在前几个赛季，SC430的速度表现都不尽如人意。到了2008赛季，在加大了前后悬间距，获得了与对手相当的下压力后，紧凑车身的更小风阻成为了他们的优势。整个赛季当中，他们在多条高速赛道上展现出非凡的速度。

尽管只由森特塞鲁莫车队在富士赛道上取得一胜，但同样使用SC430的马石油汤姆车队最终赢得了当年的车队冠军，并将这台车的高水准研发和稳定的速度留在了赛车历史的史册中。

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
Very Italian in improvisation,
I'm quite taken by...

....the high degree of precision displayed here.

One of the things the Maserati brothers, who sold Maserati
and started OSCA, left behind was...

...the sohc 6-cylinder engine.

The car that used this engine was their grand prix machine.
With that at the foundation, the A6GCS was born.

The car's four driven wheels and various other mechanical parts
are covered by a body that seems to be made of soft cloth.

The volume here is minimal.

This body was the work of the famous
Modena craftsman Fantuzzi.

You can feel the presence of the design language
of the Type 61 Birdcage in this car.

It really excites the soul, this design.
dialogues.zh:
这是非常有意大利风格的即兴演绎，
尤其令我着迷的是……

整台车体现出的高精细度。

当玛莎拉蒂兄弟最终离开公司，创建奥斯卡时，

他们为玛莎拉蒂留下了一件宝藏，
就是这台直列六缸单顶置凸轮轴引擎。

使用这台引擎的是他们的一款大奖赛赛车。
在此基础上，他们开发了A6GCS。

宛若薄绸般轻盈的车身用顺滑的曲线
包覆车轮和其他机械部件……

同时也将车身体积控制在了最低限度。

这正是莫德纳的著名车身制造商凡图奇的手笔。

你可以明显看到它的设计语言和Type 61鸟笼一脉相承。

看到这样的设计，让人从内心深处受到震撼！

collection.en:
This Maserati A6GCS Spider was
bodied by the small Italian Carrozzeria, of Medardo Fantuzzi.

A Modest production run of the beautiful Fantuzzi spiders were
built on the A6GCS chassis.

Like most of the competition bodies from the Bolognese
coachbuilder, the Maserati displayed a functional beauty.

That same beauty was true of the stunning Maserati 250F
and sharknose Ferrari 156 Formula 1 cars,

 and dozens of other Maserati and Ferrari sports racing cars.

The A6GCS featured a twin cam straight-six mounted up front that
was designed by the famed Italian engineer, Gioacchino Colombo.

Fitted with three twin throat Weber Carburetors, the
1985cc engine had a maximum output of 170ps.

This car, chassis 2078 has a fantastic history.

Built as a works racing car, it was assigned to the
great Luigi Musso for the 1954 season.

Musso contested ten races in 1954, and came away with three
overall wins and five class victories,

becoming the Italian 2000cc champion.p/>
A6GCS 2078 was sold to Argentina, where it was raced with mixed
results in 1955. It returned to Italy in 1986.

This car won the Gran Turismo Trophy at the
2014 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
collection.zh:
玛莎拉蒂A6GCS Spider的车身是意大利
小型车身制造商梅达多·凡图奇的杰作。

这款出自凡图奇之手的Spider车型精美绝伦，
基于A6GCS底盘打造，只进行了小批量生产。

和这家博洛尼亚车身制造商所推出的大部分赛车车身一样，
这辆玛莎拉蒂也兼顾了功能性和美观性。

你可以在摄人心魄的玛莎拉蒂250F、
鲨鱼鼻造型的法拉利156方程式1赛车……

以及数十款玛莎拉蒂和法拉利跑车身上
找到这份绝无仅有的审美语言。

这辆A6GCS在车前部安装了由知名意大利工程师乔亚基诺·科伦坡
所设计的双凸轮轴直列六缸引擎。

这款引擎配备了三部双腔沃柏化油器，
排量高达1985cc，可以输出最高170ps的动力。

这辆底盘号为2078的车有着辉煌的战史。

它是一台玛莎拉蒂厂队赛车，
并由杰出车手路易吉·穆索驾驶，出战1954赛季。

穆索驾驶着这辆赛车^车在1954年参加了十场比赛，就带回了
三个总冠军和五个组别冠军，

成为了意大利2000cc级别毫无争议的冠军。

1955年，A6GCS 2078被卖到了阿根廷。但比赛成绩起伏不定。
直到1986年，它才又重返意大利的怀抱。

此外，这辆车还在2014年的圆石滩经典车展上
赢得了GT奖杯。

vehicleCollection.en:
A beautiful streamlined 2-seat sports car that won the Gran Turismo Trophy

Every August in the U.S., the world’s most stunning automobiles from across automotive history gather for the prestigious Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance. In 2014, the Gran Turismo Trophy—just one of the many coveted awards—was claimed by this Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder, chassis No. 2078.

The A6 nameplate referred to a series of 6-cylinder race cars Maserati developed between 1947 and 1956. The GCS variant was built for sports car championship competition and initially took the form of a two-seat version of the classic cigar-shaped Grand Prix racers. But in 1953, following a shift in regulations, coachbuilders began to craft their own bodies for the car’s tubular frame.

Chassis No. 2078 was one such creation, graced with an elegant Spyder body penned by Carrozzeria Fantuzzi. Its 170ps engine came from none other than Gioachino Colombo. During the 1954 season, this car competed as part of the Maserati works team, racking up five class wins and three overall victories.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆绝美的流线型双座跑车，曾赢得过GT奖杯W

每年八月，世界汽车史上最优美的车辆都会齐聚美国，参加举世闻名的圆石滩经典车展。车展中会颁出诸多奖项，超级跑车奖杯就是其中之一。2014年的获奖者就是这辆玛莎拉蒂A6GCS/53 Spyder，底盘号2078。

A6是玛莎拉蒂在1947到1956年期间开发的6缸赛车系列的代号。这款GCS原本是用于参加运动赛车赛事的，所以最初的外形设计类似于大奖赛赛车的经典雪茄型，但改成了双座版本。不过由于1953年的赛事规则变化，各家车厂纷纷开始改用管式框架打造赛车。

这辆底盘号2078的玛莎拉蒂采用了由凡图奇车身制造公司打造的优雅敞篷车身。其170ps的引擎则由乔亚基诺·科伦坡打造。这辆车代表玛莎拉蒂厂队出战了1954赛季，总共拿下了6个组别冠军和3次总成绩第一。

The GCS variant was built for sports car championship competition and initially took the form of a two-seat version of the classic cigar-shaped Grand Prix racers. But in 1953, following a shift in regulations, coachbuilders began to craft their own bodies for the car’s tubular frame.

Chassis No. 2078 was one such creation, graced with an elegant Spyder body penned by Carrozzeria Fantuzzi. Its 170ps engine came from none other than Gioachino Colombo. During the 1954 season, this car competed as part of the Maserati works team, racking up five class wins and three overall victories.
long.zh:
每年八月，世界汽车史上最优美的车辆都会齐聚美国，参加举世闻名的圆石滩经典车展。车展中会颁出诸多奖项，超级跑车奖杯就是其中之一。2014年的获奖者就是这辆玛莎拉蒂A6GCS/53 Spyder，底盘号2078。

A6是玛莎拉蒂在1947到1956年期间开发的6缸赛车系列的代号。这款GCS原本是用于参加运动赛车赛事的，所以最初的外形设计类似于大奖赛赛车的经典雪茄型，但改成了双座版本。不过由于1953年的赛事规则变化，各家车厂纷纷开始改用管式框架打造赛车。

这辆底盘号2078的玛莎拉蒂采用了由凡图奇车身制造公司打造的优雅敞篷车身。其170ps的引擎则由乔亚基诺·科伦坡打造。这辆车代表玛莎拉蒂厂队出战了1954赛季，总共拿下了6个组别冠军和3次总成绩第一。

The Maserati Gran Turismo...

...was a classic interpretation of Italian style and sportiness
by Pininfarina.

The long hood, set-back cabin...

...and compact tail were immediately recognizable.

These extremely distinctive proportions were a synthesis
of the typical dynamic balance of the GT category.

That said, there were elements that renewed the
historic identity of Maserati’s design.

Among them were the three little vents behind the front wheel.

比如前轮后方的三个小小的通风口。

这辆车的操控性无与伦比——延续Maserati的

vehicleCollection.en:
True to its Italian heritage, this grand tourer was defined by class, performance and elegance.

Maserati's GranTurismo S, not to be confused with this driving simulator of the same name, was unveiled at the 2008 Geneva Motor Show as the high-performance version of Maserati's handsome GranTurismo Coupe.

Although there wasn't much that visually separated the two cars, there were significant differences under the sheet metal; the most noteworthy of which being the drivetrain. For starters, the displacement of the DOHC V8 in the GranTurismo S was increased to 4691cc, 500cc more than in the base car. Combined with this revitalized engine was a state-of-the-art semi-automatic gearbox dubbed "MC Shift." MC Shift allowed drivers the choice between a smooth-shifting automatic transmission befitting a pure luxury car and a quick-shifting sequential manual where shifting is performed via paddles on the steering wheel.

And because it was a transaxle (with the gearbox mounted on the rear differential), the front/rear weight distribution was drastically improved, making the GranTurismo S a better handling machine.

Despite the two cars looking virtually identical, the GranTurismo S possessed a more athletic nature than the base car, while still delivering the luxury and elegance that has made the marque famous for nearly 100 years.
vehicleCollection.zh:
传统杰作，强大的赛车性能隐藏在并不明显的外观之下。"

在2008年日内瓦车展官宣的跑车浪漫旅S是玛莎拉蒂伟大旅行的高性能版本。与标准版本相比，最大的两处差异在于专属引擎的引入和传动系统的改变。

跑车浪漫旅S的双顶置凸轮轴V8引擎排量高达4691cc，比标准车款高出500cc之多。双踏板半自动变速箱“MC Shift”也是首次用于该系列。相较而言，最让人动容的当属传动系统的改变，驱动桥的布局改头换面，变速箱后移与后限滑差速器整合在了一起。除此之外，这款车型以赛车为标准打造，因此前后车身配重也与标准版本截然不同。

外观方面，跑车浪漫旅S的唯二不同落在大一寸的轮毂和熏黑头灯上，内饰方面则延续了玛莎拉蒂品牌一贯的优良传统。当超高品质的GT车型遇上极致赛车性能，跑车浪漫旅S让全世界的爱车人士都对它心驰神往。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
The Maserati MC20 is a mid-engine sports car from 2020.

The letters in its name stand for "Maserati" and "Corse,"
meaning "race," along with its introduction year.

You can think of it as a successor to the MC12, that legend
built to compete at the 2004 FIA GT Championship.

Since its founding in the early-20th century, Maserati has
been known for its race cars.

From F1 machines like the 250F to sports cars like the
A6GCS, there is no limits to the company's achievements.

Now, while Maserati hasn’t been racing much
these days...

...this MC20-based machine marked its glorious return
to the track!
dialogues.zh:
Maserati MC20是一台2020年的中置跑车。

它的名字将“Maserati”和意为“竞速”的“Corse”
与发布年份相结合。

此前，Maserati曾为2004 FIA GT锦标赛打造了传奇车型MC12，
此车可以视作其继任者。

自从二十世纪早期成立以来，Maserati一直以赛车享誉世界。

从250F这样的F1赛车到A6GCS这样的跑车，
可以说是取得了数不胜数的成就。

近年来，虽然Maserati较少涉足赛车竞速领域……

但这台基于MC20开发的赛车无疑标志着它荣归赛场！

vehicleCollection.en:
A special super car that embodies the tradition and passion of Maserati.

The MC20 is a mid-engine supercar introduced by Maserati in 2020. The Italian company is widely known for its elegant and masterfully constructed high-performance GT cars. The MC20 is the first mid-engine model in the company's road car lineup since the discontinuation of the MC12 in 2005.

With its scissor-type doors, the body is elegant and clean. It's seemingly devoid of aggressive aerodynamic add-ons, such as a large rear wing or a radical front splitter, but that is because this car doesn't need them. Developed by race-car constructor Dallara, this Maserati body underwent rigorous wind-tunnel testing from the beginning, so the use of overt downforce-induing parts was not necessary.

At its foundation is a carbon monocoque that apparently weighs as little as 100kg. Keeping the car lightweight was a priority for Maserati, and the engineers were able to keep curb weight down to less than 1500kg.

The newly developed twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine features the first F1-style pre-chamber combustion system used in a production car. It produces 630ps and 730 Nm (74.5kgm) torque. Combined with an 8-speed DCT transmission, the MC20 can accelerate from 0 to <100km/h> in under 2.9 seconds and reach a top speed of more than <325km/h>.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一台承载了玛莎拉蒂决心与激情的极致超级跑车。

MC20是玛莎拉蒂在2020年宣布推出的一款中置引擎超级跑车。提起玛莎拉蒂，首先让人想起的便是其在前置及后置引擎高性能GT跑车上炉火纯青且不失优雅的工艺。而MC20则是该厂自2005年MC12停产后15年来推出的第一辆中置引擎公路跑车。

乍一看，这辆有着蝶翼门的跑车似乎并没有任何明显的空气动力学套件，这是因为它那由跑车制造商达拉拉借助严谨的风洞测试设计制造出的外壳，巧妙的造型已经能够在不借助任何诸如扰流板的空气动力学组件的情况下，就产生足够的下压力。

该车采用了碳纤维单体车壳结构，外壳自重仅100kg。另外，在整车的各个区域都应用了轻量化措施，将整车总重降到了1500kg以下。

玛莎拉蒂最新研发的3升、V6双涡轮增压引擎使得MC20成为了第一台应用了F1式预燃室技术的量产车型。这台引擎可以提供最高630ps的动力与730 牛·米（74.5kgm）的扭矩。结合其8速双离合变速箱，MC20可以在短短2.9秒内完成0-<100km/h>加速，且据称最高速度可达超过<325km/h>。

Many consider the Maserati Merak as one of the most beautiful
mid-engine supercars of the 1970s.

Introduced in 1975, the Merak SS was the high-performance
grade in the lineup.

This 1980 version of the SS came with a 220ps V-6 engine.

And, it was true 2+2, meaning although it was a 2-door,
it came with rear seats.

The elegant lines of the car still look fresh today, a testament
to the genius of Giorgetto Giugiaro, who designed the car.

Maserati Merak是1970年代最漂亮最独特的
中置引擎超跑之一。

Merak SS问世于1975年，
是高性能版车款。

这款1980年发售的车型搭载
马力为220ps的V6引擎。

像所有2+2车型一样，它配备
两个小型后座以备不时之需。

强大的马力与完美的样式，
Merak完美诠释了内外兼备。

collection.en:
The Maserati Merak is a fine example of a
beautiful mid-engine supercar from the 1970s.

It was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro, who
began at FIAT in 1955, then worked at...

...Bertone for six years, and later at Ghia until 1968.

He subsequently established "Italdesign," a design firm
that would create many masterpieces.

The Maserati Merak was created during
Giugiaro’s early Italdesign days.

This stunning new Maserati was introduced at
the 1972 Paris Motor Show.

The Merak SS is the lighter and more
powerful model that made its debut in 1975.

This 1980 model is powered by a 220ps version
of the V-6 shared with the Citroën-Maserati SM.

Although the striking Merak has a mid-mounted
engine, it is actually a 2+2 with small rear seats...

...which is very rare for an exotic high-performance car.
collection.zh:
玛莎拉蒂Merak堪称二十世纪七十年代最优美
的中置引擎超级跑车的样板之一。

它的设计出自乔盖托·乔治亚罗之手。
1955年，乔治亚罗在菲亚特开始职业生涯，

随后又在博通工作了六年，
然后重回吉亚，继续工作到了1968年。

此后，他自己创办了“Italdesign”，一间在未来
奉献出无数杰作的设计公司。

玛莎拉蒂Merak就是乔治亚罗在“Italdesign”的
早期设计作品之一……

这辆光采夺目的全新玛莎拉蒂在1972年的巴黎车展上
完成了首秀。

在1975年，更加轻量化、性能更强的Merak SS闪亮登场。

我们眼前的这辆1980车型装备了一台输出220ps的V6引擎，
这台引擎也被用在了雪铁龙-玛莎拉蒂SM上。

这辆令人惊叹的Merak采用了中置引擎，却实现了“2+2”座位布局，
只是后排座位偏小……

对于一辆面向专业玩家的高性能跑车而言，实属罕见。

vehicleCollection.en:
This high-output model of the Merak has been tuned for even sharper performance.+

The Maserati Merak, a mid-engine sports car introduced in 1972, was developed as a sister model to the Bora that came out the previous year. Both vehicles shared the same basic exterior styling, penned by renown designer Giugiaro; however, the rear ends were noticeably different, as the Bora was a fastback, while the Merak was a notchback with a fastback-style pillar.

The engines of the two cars were also different. Where the Bora had a rumbling V-8 in its engine bay, the Merak featured a 190ps 3.0-liter V-6 borrowed from the Citroën SM, thus allowing the Merak to adopt a 2+2 layout and boast more luggage space.

In 1975, a high-performance version of the Merak was offered, called the Merak SS, which came equipped with a 220ps engine that increased the car's top speed from <225km/h> to <250km/h>.
vehicleCollection.zh:
Merak的这款高动力车型经过调校后，性能更加犀利。

玛莎拉蒂Merak是1972年推出的一款中置引擎跑车。此车是作为一年前亮相的博拉的姐妹车型而开发的。

该车的车身也是由乔治亚罗设计的。所以外观风格与博拉一脉相承。不过，博拉是一款溜背车，而Merak却是一款带有溜背车后柱的掀背车款。这也使得此车能够在保留相同外轮廓的同时，给人以更轻盈的感受。引擎冷却有所改善。

博拉采用的是一台V8引擎，而为Merak配备的是来自雪铁龙SM的3升V6引擎，可以带来190ps。搭载了这台更紧凑的引擎，座位布局也相应变为2+2，从而为行李厢腾出了空间。

在1975年，高性能版本的Merak SS面世了。压缩比优化及其他调整将引擎的动力输出提高到了220ps，而极速也从<225km/h>提高到<250km/h>。

catch.zh: Merak的这款高动力车型经过调校后，性能更加犀利。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
“Rotary engines are notorious for their poor fuel economy,
making them ill-suited for endurance races.”

At least, this is what people in the racing world had believed.

But the engineers at Mazda took a different view.

So, they got together and created the R26B engine,
which emphasized horsepower over torque.

This decision effectively made it a durable
and fuel-efficient engine.

The 4-rotor engine found a home in the now-legendary 787B.

It was the first Japanese car to claim the overall title
at Le Mans in 1991.

Jonny Herbert, the driver who drove
the final three stints...

...was so dehydrated after the race that he was unable
to make the podium.

As for the engine, when Mazda's engineers took it apart, they
apparently saw that it could have gone another 500 km!
dialogues.zh:
转子引擎的油耗高得吓人，所以不适合耐力赛。”

赛车界曾是这样看待转子引擎的。

但是马自达的工程师们却不这么认为！

他们努力的结晶便是将重点放在马力上，
而不是扭矩上的R26B引擎。

这项明智的决定使这台引擎不仅可靠，而且省油。

这台传奇的发动机就装在了这台787B上。

于1991年，它成为了第一台在勒芒夺冠的日本车。

不幸的是，约翰尼·赫伯特在开完最后三段后……

由于严重脱水，无法站上领奖台。

赛后，当马自达的工程师将引擎拆开时，
他们发现这台引擎还能再跑500km！

dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.en:
The number of cars participating in the 1991 Le Mans race
was only 38, but among those was the new Peugeot 905.

There were also perennial powerhouses like Mercedes-Benz,
Jaguar and Porsche sharing that starting grid.

To take them all on, Mazda entered two 787B race cars.

Of those two, the No. 55 car, which started the race in 19th
position, gradually worked its way up the running order...

Until it found its way to the front and finished on top!
A dramatic first victory for Japanese manufacturers.

To this day, I haven't forgotten the famous green
and red livery of that race machine.<next id=1900306 type=
dialogues.zh:
在1991年参加勒芒耐力赛的赛车仅有寥寥38辆，
但全新的标致905也在其列。

此外，在发车格上还有各品牌常年出战的高性能赛车，
如梅赛德斯-奔驰、捷豹和保时捷等等。

马自达派出了两辆787B赛车来挑战这些强大的对手。

在这两辆车中，从第19位发车的55号赛车
步步为营，不断提升自己的排位……

……最后终于攀升到领跑位置，并以头名完赛！
这是日本车厂的第一次获胜，过程充满了戏剧性。

时至今日，我依然无法忘怀那部比赛机器
的橙绿色涂装。

collection.en:
Do you know about the 1991 Le Mans 24 Hours?

In the final year that rotary engines were allowed to compete,
Mazda defied the odds and won in miraculous fashion.

The winning race car was the 787B, powered by 4-rotor engine,
which outlasted powerhouse rivals like Jaguar and Porsche.

The victory was made even sweeter by the fact that Mazda
became the only Japanese company to win the historic race.

After a bad showing the previous year, no one expected the
787B to do well in 1991, quarting in 19th position.

However, the Mazda team was undeterred and ran a strategic
and consistent race, taking the checkered flag.

The drivers who accomplished the impossible were Volker Weidler,
Johnny Herbert and Bertrand Gachot.

After the race, the now-historic No. 55 car was safely stowed
away to be preserved forever.

Then, in 2011, the car was restored and returned to Le Mans for a
demo run celebrating the 20th anniversary of its victory.
collection.zh:
您对1991年的勒芒24小时耐力赛了解吗？

那是允许转子引擎赛车参赛的最后一年，
马自达也抓住了机会一举夺魁！

在那场令人震惊的赛事中，这辆编号为55的787B成为了全
场的天皇巨星。

因为马自达此前几年在勒芒屡次出师不利，这场来之不易的
胜利就显得更加的甘美——

1990年，787在比赛中大败而归，而1991年更是因为糟糕的排
位赛表现而只能从19位发车。

但Mazda车队并未气馁，克服了一切困难，取得了传奇般的
伟大胜利。

这实际上也是勒芒比赛史上第一次由日本赛车夺冠。

获得冠军的55号赛车在赛后被妥善保存。

在2011年它还接受了全面复原，在勒芒故地重游庆祝获胜
20周年的辉煌时刻！]

vehicleCollection.en:
The legendary Mazda 787B was the first Japanese-manufactured race car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

Mazda's rotary-engine race cars were a familiar sight at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the mid-seventies and throughout the eighties, but it would be 18 years after its first race at the Sarthe Circuit when the car company from Hiroshima would make history.

It all began with the development of the 787, which was powered by the R26B, a 4-rotor Wankel engine that produced 700ps. To match this power, the car's frame was changed from a conventional aluminum honeycomb composite to a carbon-fiber, which resulted in a light, rigid body structure. The 787 made its debut at the 1990 24 Hours of Le Mans, but mechanical problems forced it to retire from the race early. Mazda came back the following year with an improved version of the race car called the 787B.

The 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans fielded one of the most competitive grids in the history of the event with an all-out effort by Peugeot, as well as strong entries from Mercedes-Benz, Jaguar and Porsche. Two Mazda 787Bs were entered, with the No. 55 car, driven by Bertrand Gachot, Johnny Herbert and Volker Weidler, starting in the 19th position. Once the contest started, the Mazda race car gradually worked its way up the leader board, taking the overall lead just three hours before the end of the race. It managed to hang on to claim the checker, completing 362 laps, which beat the previous year's record. The win marked the first and still the only Japanese race team to win the overall title at Le Mans.
vehicleCollection.zh:
帮助马自达成为首家赢得勒芒大赛的日本生产商，成就一代传奇。

马自达自1974年起开始参加勒芒24小时耐力赛，并凭借他们的转子发动机获得了相当出色的战绩。但由于禁止使用转子发动机的技术规范即将到来，留给马自达的时间便不多了。这便是787投入研发的时代背景。

787配备了一台型号为R26B的四转子发动机，最大动力输出为700ps。为了承受如此强大的动力，车身框架从传统的铝制蜂窝结构变为了碳纤维复合材质，在降低重量的同时提高了刚性。车身的宽度被缩减以降低空气阻力，前鼻处安装了一个尺寸较大的散热装置。

787于1990年的勒芒24小时耐力赛首次登场，但由于遇到多个技术问题，而遭到了出人意料的失败。马自达很快从这令人失望的结果中走出，全面改进了787，将新款787B带到了下一年的勒芒。

这一年，标致携倾尽全力开发的905加入赛事，老牌劲旅梅赛德斯·奔驰、捷豹与保时捷的存在也意味着这将是一场艰苦的比赛。在参赛的两辆787中，由伯特兰·加丘、乔尼·赫伯特和沃克尔·魏德勒驾驶的55号车从19位出发，不断超越，在距离比赛结束仅有三小时的时候攀至第一。

这辆787B最终顺利完赛，在飞驰了362圈之后成功冲线，并且打破了上一年的纪录。马自达在参赛的第18个年头终于赢得了这场伟大的胜利，这是日本车厂在勒芒史上首次获胜。

马自达自1974年起开始参加勒芒24小时耐力赛，并凭借他们的转子发动机获得了相当出色的战绩。但由于禁止使用转子发动机的技术规范即将到来，留给马自达的时间便不多了。这便是787投入研发的时代背景。

787配备了一台型号为R26B的四转子发动机，最大动力输出为700ps。为了承受如此强大的动力，车身框架从传统的铝制蜂窝结构变为了碳纤维复合材质，在降低重量的同时提高了刚性。车身的宽度被缩减以降低空气阻力，前鼻处安装了一个尺寸较大的散热装置。

787于1990年的勒芒24小时耐力赛首次登场，但由于遇到多个技术问题，而遭到了出人意料的失败。马自达很快从这令人失望的结果中走出，全面改进了787，将新款787B带到了下一年的勒芒。

这一年，标致携倾尽全力开发的905加入赛事，老牌劲旅梅赛德斯·奔驰、捷豹与保时捷的存在也意味着这将是一场艰苦的比赛。在参赛的两辆787中，由伯特兰·加丘、乔尼·赫伯特和沃克尔·魏德勒驾驶的55号车从19位出发，不断超越，在距离比赛结束仅有三小时的时候攀至第一。

这辆787B最终顺利完赛，在飞驰了362圈之后成功冲线，并且打破了上一年的纪录。马自达在参赛的第18个年头终于赢得了这场伟大的胜利，这是日本车厂在勒芒史上首次获胜。

brandCentral.en:
This road car was designed as a homologated
Mazda Atenza Gr.3.

Its key features are Gr.3-worthy handling and a powerful
400ps engine.

A true expression of Mazda's "KODO" design philosophy...

Every detail has been considered, right down to how its body
reflects light.
brandCentral.zh:
这款公路车是Mazda Atenza Gr.3级别赛车的认证车型，

拥有Gr.3级别的操控性和一台性能强大的400ps引擎。

此车充分彰显了Mazda的“魂动”设计哲学……

充分考虑每一处细节，连车身对光线的折射这样的细微

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation Mazda6 featured a curvaceous body style and SkyActiv technology.

Called the Atenza in various markets, the Mazda 6 sports sedan offered European-like style and performance in a less expensive package. In 2012, the third-generation model was unveiled, sporting an exterior body that resembled the dashing Takeri concept car shown at the 2011 Tokyo Motor Show. However, the biggest surprise came under the sheet metal as the new Mazda 6 came equipped with an optional diesel engine called the SKYACTIV-D for select markets.

This diesel was in fact an improved version of the turbocharged direct-injection 2.2-liter inline-4 of the CX-5. It produced 175ps and 42.8kgm of torque, supplying the driver with gobs of low-end power that enabled the Mazda 6 to jump off the line like a lightweight sports car. Power was transferred via a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual to either the front wheels or all four. In select markets, the “i-stop” idle-stop feature and a capacitor-based regenerative braking system called “i-ELOOP” were incorporated, helping the SKYACTIV-D-equipped Mazda 6s boast a high JC08 mode fuel economy of <22.4km/L>.

The diesel-engine powered cars were labeled “XD,” with Standard, Proactive, and L trim levels. The highest version, the L, came with luxury features including leather seats and accounted for an astounding 76 percent of all Mazda 6 sales in the first month of availability.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款第3代阿特兹赛车因其优美的车身线条和创驰蓝天技术脱颖而出。

作为马自达的旗舰，阿特兹（马自达6）于2012年演化为第三代车型。这款车型受到了广泛的关注，因其外观酷似一年前在东京车展上所发布的“雄”概念车，其优美的轿跑车身流线极受青睐。但还有其他的因素令这款车型在发售时受到更多关注。第三代车型已全部采用马自达的次世代创驰蓝天技术（在CX-5车型中首次应用），配置了柴油驱动的创驰蓝天D型引擎。

相比CX-5使用的缸内直喷2.2升直列式4缸涡轮增压引擎，阿特兹采用的柴油引擎是该引擎的升级版。升级后的引擎能够产生175ps/42.8kgm的动力，仅需达到略高于怠速状态下的转速就能产生强劲的动力，足以使车手精神一振。该引擎不仅可以匹配6档自动变速箱，同时也能匹配6档手动变速箱，并且有前轮驱动和全轮驱动两种模式。在环保方面，除了“i-stop”怠速自动启停功能外，所有车型都配备了被称为“i-ELOOP”的基于电容的制动动能回收系统；配备了创驰蓝天D系引擎的车型能够实现油耗仅为<22.4km/L>的JC08高燃油经济性模式。

配备柴油引擎的车型被命名为XD，包括标准款、主动款和L包款三个等级。L包款为豪华车型，配备有真皮座椅等豪华配饰。这款柴油版的阿特兹极受欢迎，在发售首月便占到了销售总数的76%。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

秀的牵引力。

有多种不同的空气动力学部件。

相比CX-5使用的缸内直喷2.2升直列式4缸涡轮增压引擎，阿特兹采用的柴油引擎是该引擎的升级版。升级后的引擎能够产生175ps/42.8kgm的动力，仅需达到略高于怠速状态下的转速就能产生强劲的动力，足以使车手精神一振。该引擎不仅可以匹配6档自动变速箱，同时也能匹配6档手动变速箱，并且有前轮驱动和全轮驱动两种模式。在环保方面，除了“i-stop”怠速自动启停功能外，所有车型都配备了被称为“i-ELOOP”的基于电容的制动动能回收系统；配备了创驰蓝天D系引擎的车型能够实现油耗仅为<22.4km/L>的JC08高燃油经济性模式。

配备柴油引擎的车型被命名为XD，包括标准款、主动款和L包款三个等级。L包款为豪华车型，配备有真皮座椅等豪华配饰。这款柴油版的阿特兹极受欢迎，在发售首月便占到了销售总数的76%。

*这款车已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

dialogues.speaker: Fabio Filippini
dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
The Atenza has a dynamic and elegant design.

It reinterprets the classic sensuality of Italian sportscars
from the 1960s...

With a typically Japanese sensitivity to surfaces
and details.

A 4-door sedan-coupe layout...

Combined with a style inspired by Mazda Design's
'Kodo' philosophy.

Its soft, fluid shapes and evolving surfaces...

Are enhanced by specially developed metallic colours.

It's not by chance that Mazda cars are often
shown in red.

This is done to evoke a sort of fiery temperament
defined by emotion and movement.@
dialogues.zh:
Atenza兼具动感和优雅的设计。

它重新诠释了20世纪60年代意大利跑车的经典性感……

又同时具备日本车典型的对于表面和细节的敏感。

这款车采用四门轿跑车的布局，

并融入了Mazda设计部提出的“魂动”设计理念。

柔和的流畅线条与不断演变的表面
被专门开发的金属色车漆进一步增强。

在Mazda的不同广告宣传中，经常以红车示人。
>
这并非偶然，红色唤起了某种充满情绪和动感的极致激情意象。

dialogues.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
dialogues.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
dialogues.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
dialogues.en:
In a way this Atenza is my debut work. There were a lot of
obstacles, and it brings back a lot of memories.

I was appointed the general manager of the design division
in 2009, to be the leader of Mazda design,

but I was told about my new position just 2 weeks before, so
I became general manager without any time to be ready.

And the first production car that I worked on,
was this Atenza.

Givender major role and responsibility,
this was a state of emergency for me,

but it was just as much a chance as it was a crisis.

It was a time in which the design theme for the next generation of
Mazda's were being considered from almost scratch,

and I thought to make design the major
pillar of Mazda from here and now.

And actually, the development of this car had already progressed
quite a bit under the previous design manager already,

but after thnking that we need to create the philosophy of Mazda
for the next age, and make design itself one of the pillars,

I made the decision to completely change the design
that was already in motion.

To do this it was necessary to redesign things that normally
should not be touched in terms of the development schedules.

As a result, the final design schedule for the production car
was delayed about 10 months...

And I was really scolded badly by the managing drector
of development at the time. A LOT.

At the time I was working on the "SHINARI" concept car
that would be the vision model for the next era,

and I translated the design theme of SHINARI to the production car
because it was a car made alongside the SHINARI.

It's a car that I personally care for a lot, I was
even still driving it until very recently.

Its been over 10 years now, but I think
its a design that doesn't feel old.

The more you work onwstandard cars, the more you understand
the power of design.

And saloons are difficult to design, because
they are the base for all cars.

I think timeless cars of an orthodox category is where
the ability of designers are truly tested.
dialogues.zh:
阿特兹可以说是我的设计生涯的开端，说起来，这个项
目真是苦乐自知，回忆满满啊。

2009年，我突然被任命为马自达设计部门的部长。

事情非常突然，我只有两周时间来适应这个新职位。

我接手后参与的第一款量产车就是阿特兹。

说实话，那会儿真是责任重大，差点儿没把我压垮。
不过，我硬是把这个危机扭转成了成功的机遇。

当时，马自达正在为下一代车型寻找新的设计主题。

我的想法是把“设计哲学”作为马自达未来发展的支柱。

老实说，前任部长在阿特兹上已经下了不少功夫。

但为了实现我的新一代设计理念……

我决定把这个已经在顺畅推进的项目推倒重来。

也就是说，一些通常在生产后期不会再改动的部分，我
们也^重新设计。

结果就是这款量产车设计进度整整推迟了10个月左右。

这下可把上司们气得不轻——他们当时大发雷霆。

与此同时，我还在筹备一款叫“靱”的概念赛车，它将成为
马自达下一代的前瞻性参考车型。

有意思的是，因为“靱”和阿特兹的开发是同期进行，
它们俩最后用上了同一个设计主题。

说真的，阿特兹U我来说意义非凡。事实上，直到前不
久我还在开这车呢。

虽然这款车已经面世十多年了，但它的设计仍然经得住
时间的考验。

你知道吗？你在标准车型上花的功夫越多，就越能体会
到设计的魔力。

尤其是轿车，看起来再普通不过，设计起来反而最难。

所以，要评估一位设计师的水平，关键在于他能否为正
统车型设计出经久不衰的作品。

brandCentral.en:
The third-gen Atenza's handling is in line with Mazda’s
‘Jinba Ittai’ credo: unity between car and driver.

This model is equipped with a 2.2L turbocharged
straight-four diesel engine.

With plenty of torque, the engine has a mighty roar, and
is partnered by a six-speed manual transmission.

By the way, have you heard of Mazda’s Skyactiv Technology?

This line of fundamental engineering is found throughout
the vehicle, from body to engine to chassis.

Indeed, one might say that the entire third-gen Atenza
is the product of this advanced engineering approach.
brandCentral.zh:
第三代Atenza的操控体验非常符合Mazda的“人马一体”理念：
即车辆和驾驶者之间的和谐统一。

这款车型配备了一台2.2升涡轮增压直列四缸柴油引擎

和六速手动变速箱，充足的扭矩让这台引擎的轰鸣声响
彻云霄。

话说，您听说过Mazda的Skyactiv技术吗？

Mazda的这套汽车工程技术贯穿了整辆车的每个部件，从车
身到引擎，再到底盘，无处不在。

可以毫不夸张的说，
第三代Atenza就是集先进的Skyactiv技术于大成的作品。

vehicleCollection.en:
The third-generation Mazda 6 features a flowing body style and SKYACTIV technology.

Called the Atenza in various markets, the Mazda 6 sports sedan offered European-like style and performance in a less expensive package. In 2012, the third-generation model was unveiled, sporting an exterior body that resembled the dashing Takeri concept car shown at the 2011 Tokyo Motor Show. However, the biggest surprise came under the sheet metal as the new Mazda 6 came equipped with an optional diesel engine called the SKYACTIV-D for select markets.

This diesel was in fact an improved version of the turbocharged direct-injection 2.2-liter inline-4 of the CX-5. It produced 175ps and 42.8kgm of torque, supplying the driver with gobs of low-end power that enabled the Mazda 6 to jump off the line like a lightweight sports car. Power was transferred via a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual to either the front wheels or all four. In select markets, the “i-stop” idle-stop feature and a capacitor-based regenerative braking system called “i-ELOOP” were incorporated, helping the SKYACTIV-D-equipped Mazda 6s boast a high JC08 mode fuel economy of <22.4km/L>.

The diesel-engine powered cars were labeled “XD,” with Standard, Proactive, and L trim levels. The highest version, the L, came with luxury features including leather seats and accounted for an astounding 76 percent of all Mazda 6 sales in the first month of availability.

long.en:
Called the Atenza in various markets, the Mazda 6 sports sedan offered European-like style and performance in a less expensive package. In 2012, the third-generation model was unveiled, sporting an exterior body that resembled the dashing Takeri concept car shown at the 2011 Tokyo Motor Show. However, the biggest surprise came under the sheet metal as the new Mazda 6 came equipped with an optional diesel engine called the SKYACTIV-D for select markets.

This diesel was in fact an improved version of the turbocharged direct-injection 2.2-liter inline-4 of the CX-5. It produced 175ps and 42.8kgm of torque, supplying the driver with gobs of low-end power that enabled the Mazda 6 to jump off the line like a lightweight sports car. Power was transferred via a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual to either the front wheels or all four. In select markets, the “i-stop” idle-stop feature and a capacitor-based regenerative braking system called “i-ELOOP” were incorporated, helping the SKYACTIV-D-equipped Mazda 6s boast a high JC08 mode fuel economy of <22.4km/L>.

The diesel-engine powered cars were labeled “XD,” with Standard, Proactive, and L trim levels. The highest version, the L, came with luxury features including leather seats and accounted for an astounding 76 percent of all Mazda 6 sales in the first month of availability.
long.zh:
作为马自达的旗舰，阿特兹（马自达6）于2012年演化为第三代车型。这款车型受到了广泛的关注，因其外观酷似一年前在东京车展上所发布的“雄”概念车，其优美的轿跑车身流线极受青睐。但还有其他的因素令这款车型在发售时受到更多关注。第三代车型已全部采用马自达的次世代创驰蓝天技术（在CX-5车型中首次应用），配置了柴油驱动的创驰蓝天D型引擎。

相比CX-5使用的缸内直喷2.2升直列式4缸涡轮增压引擎，阿特兹采用的柴油引擎是该引擎的升级版。升级后的引擎能够产生175ps/42.8kgm的动力，仅需达到略高于怠速状态下的转速就能产生强劲的动力，足以使车手精神一振。该引擎不仅可以匹配6档自动变速箱，同时也能匹配6档手动变速箱，并且有前轮驱动和全轮驱动两种模式。在环保方面，除了“i-stop”怠速自动启停功能外，所有车型都配备了被称为“i-ELOOP”的基于电容的制动动能回收系统；配备了创驰蓝天D系引擎的车型能够实现油耗仅为<22.4km/L>的JC08高燃油经济性模式。

配备柴油引擎的车型被命名为XD，包括标准款、主动款和L包款三个等级。L包款为豪华车型，配备有真皮座椅等豪华配饰。这款柴油版的阿特兹极受欢迎，在发售首月便占到了销售总数的76%。

brandCentral.en:
Modern Mazdas are known for their elegant designs,
and this CX-30 is no exception.

Take a moment to admire its profile—the way the light dances
across its sculpted lines. Stunning, isn’t it?

But the CX-30 is far more than just a pretty face. Beneath that
sleek exterior lies Mazda’s innovative SKYACTIV-X engine.

Capable of burning a very lean air-fuel mixture at high pressure,
it stands as a next-generation engine—clean and efficient.

The X Smart Edition enhances the SKYACTIV-X base package
with a variety of driver-assist features.

Balancing control and comfort, the CX-30 possesses the heart
of a sports car wrapped in a crossover SUV body.
brandCentral.zh:
现代Mazda以优雅的设计著称，这款CX-30更是集大成者。

细致观察它的侧面轮廓和车身光影，是不是令人
叹为观止？

但CX-30的过人之处不仅在于外表。它搭载的SKYACTIV-X引擎
可谓技术卓越。

这款引擎能在高压环境下燃烧极度稀薄的空燃混合物，
堪称高效环保的“新世代动力”。

而X Smart Edition在这一基础上还增添了多项智能
驾驶辅助功能。

在操控性与舒适性之间达到完美平衡，CX-30
为驾驶者带来超乎想象的愉悦体验。

vehicleCollection.en:
This crossover SUV from Mazda featured a revolutionary engine design.

During the global sport utility vehicle (SUV) boom of the 2010s, Mazda introduced the CX-3 and CX-5, although a notable gap in size existed between the two. The C30 was conceived to bridge that divide, offering a well-balanced compact crossover SUV.

Measuring 4395mm from front to rear, 1795mm in width, and standing 1540mm high, the CX-30's exterior was relatively compact while showcasing Mazda’s signature "KODO Design" philosophy. The signature wing on the front fascia seamlessly linked the grille to the headlights, while the undulations along the body's side panels artfully reflected shifting light.

Under the hood was a choice of three powertrains: the 2.0-liter gasoline direct-injection SKYACTIV-G, the 1.8-liter direct-injection diesel SKYACTIV-D, or the 2.0-liter SKYACTIV-X, which employed a groundbreaking Spark-Controlled Compression Ignition (SPCCI) system.

The CX-30 X Smart Edition, shown here, was introduced in 2021, based on the SKYACTIV-X model. This model grade emphasized comprehensive driver assistance features as standard, including the Active Driving Display, which projects key information onto the windshield, and the Smart Brake Support automatic emergency braking system. Also, the introduction of this model coincided with refinements to the SKYACTIV-X system, with automatic transmission models receiving enhanced throttle pedal resistance that improved driving response.

Combining versatile dimensions with a dynamic driving character, the CX-30 stands out as an appealing option in Mazda's lineup.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这是一款搭载革命性引擎设计的马自达跨界SUV。

在2010年代全球SUV热潮中，马自达推出了CX-3和CX-5车型。不过，这两款车型之间存在明显的尺寸差距。CX-30作为一款跨界SUV，正是为了填补CX-3和CX-5之间的产品线空缺。

在相对紧凑的尺寸下（长4395mm、宽1795mm、高1540mm），CX-30的外观依然展现出了马自达推崇的“魂动”设计理念——动态且流畅。在前脸设计上，标志性的展翼造型向两侧延伸连接左右大灯，而车身侧面的腰线则巧妙地反映出动态的光影效果。

该车提供三种动力总成选项：2升汽油直喷引擎“创驰蓝天-G”、1.8升柴油直喷引擎“创驰蓝天-D”，以及采用革命性火花控制压缩点火（SPCCI）系统的2升汽油直喷引擎“创驰蓝天-X”。

这里展示的“CX-30 X Smart Edition”版本于2021年推出，在“创驰蓝天-X”车款上更进一步。该车型的主要卖点之一是标配丰富的驾驶辅助设备，包括将信息投影到挡风玻璃上的Active Driving Display抬头显示系统，还有Smart Brake Support智能行车制动系统。这个版本的车型同时也对创驰蓝天-X系统进行了优化，自动挡车型增强了油门踏板反馈力度，提升驾驶质感。

CX-30凭借实用的车身尺寸和充满活力的驾驶体验，成为一款极具吸引力的车型。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
This Demio is Mazda’s entry in the compact
car marketplace.

It was sold outside of Japan as the "Mazda2"
and it proved to be a big hit.

So the car was reintroduced to the Japanese market in 2019
with that very name.

Mazda is famous for its beautiful rear-wheel sports cars...

...and its legendary race cars that have won titles
the world over.

I'm sure that you'll run into one eventually!
dialogues.zh:
这款Demio是Mazda对紧凑型汽车市场的贡献。

实际上它在日本以外被称为“Mazda2”......

以至于它在2019年重新进入日本市场时，也叫回了这个名字！

Mazda旗下的名车既有优雅的后轮驱动跑车......

也有在全世界范围包揽冠军头衔的传奇赛车。

我相信你以后会遇到一辆这样的车！

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
This car reminds me of a happy little rabbit in the way
it sits slightly inclined towards the front.

It looks more like a fun runabout than a typical
commuter econobox.

Unlike retro-modern cars, such as the current Mini
and FIAT 500...

...this car is a modern interpretation of the original
FIAT 500 with Topolino character.
dialogues.zh:
这辆车的车头弧度略微下滑，看上去
就像是一只快乐的小兔子。

与其说它是一款典型的经济型通勤车，
不如说更像一辆提供愉悦驾乘体验的轻便汽车。

和其他的复古现代风格汽车，
例如当前版本的MINI和FIAT 500不同……

这辆车就好比是以“米老鼠”角色特点对
初代FIAT 500的现代化演绎。

dialogues.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
dialogues.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
dialogues.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
dialogues.en:
So I was the Chief Designer for the Demio before this model,
and have a lot of memories about the car.

This model was not designed as a single car but as a series.

The three models, the Atenza, Axela, and the Demio
were designed simultaneously.

And actually I love small cars like the Demio.

I especially love Italian compact cars like the Autobianchi
and the Alfa Romeo Alfasud,

and I personally owned an old British Mini in the past.

So when I first found out that I would be designing
the Demio I was really happy about it!
dialogues.zh:
哦，没错，说到这个车型，我可是前一代DEMIO的
首席设计师呢。

不过，这次我们可不是单独设计一款车，而是一口气
设计了一整个系列。

ATENZA、AXELA和DEMIO这三款车，我们是同期设计，
同时进行，一气呵成！

说实话，我其实特别喜欢DEMIO这种小巧玲珑的车。

尤其是意大利的那些紧凑小车，比如Autobianchi和
Alfa Romeo Alfasud。

我还真有过一辆老款的英国Mini呢。

所以你能想象到，当我听说要我来设计DEMIO的时候，
我有多高兴！

brandCentral.en:
The Demio is Mazda's entry-level model.

This fourth-generation version was introduced in 2014.

Power is supplied by a turbocharged 1.5-liter diesel engine
that produces 25kgm of torque.

Because of its predictable handling character, this car is
ideal for novices learning how to race.<
brandCentral.zh:
Demio是Mazda的入门级车型。

这一款2014年推出的车型已经是第四代产品了。

它的动力系统是一台1.5L涡轮增压柴油引擎，可以产生25kgm
的扭矩。

凭借绝对可靠的操控性，它成为了赛道新人的不二之选。

usedCar.en:
The fourth-generation Demio, which made its debut in 2014,
is perhaps best known for its diesel engine.

It's a turbocharged 1.5-liter inline-4 developed especially for
compact cars.

It delivers 20kgm of torque in the low-RPM range that results
in a gratifying sensation when you take off from a standstill.

The car’s stable handling was also a major selling point, thanks
to the wheelbase that’s longer than the previous model.
usedCar.zh:
第四代Demio于2014年首次亮相，
最出名的可能就是它的汽油引擎。

这个1.5L直列四缸涡轮引擎，
专为紧凑型的车款而研制。

在低转速范围内能够超过20kgm，
真正运转起来时感觉很棒。

与上一型号相比轴距明显加长，
使其操控更加稳定。

vehicleCollection.en:
This compact diesel model from Mazda offered more luxury than you would expect from a car in its class.

The fourth-generation Mazda2, known as the Demio in its home market, was introduced in 2014.

It featured the company's "KODO" design philosophy, which implemented many traditional Japanese styling cues along with a sleek overall profile. The car came powered by the usual gasoline-engine options, but for this model, a 1.5-liter turbodiesel that Mazda dubbed "SKYACTIV-D" was added. This engine boasted the performance equivalent to a 2.5-liter gasoline engine, with 25.5kgm of torque on tap for the 6-speed automatic model and 22.4kgm for the 6-speed manual. The latter returned an impressive <30.0km/L> on the Japanese JC08 mode fuel economy test. Customers were so enthralled with the new diesel that more than 60 percent of the initial orders were for the SKYACTIV-D models.

There were three grades available for the diesel-powered cars. This included the base XD model, the XD Touring that included practical options such as LED lights and cruise control, and the XD Touring L Package, which included luxury options such as white leather seats and a leather bound steering wheel.
vehicleCollection.zh:
马自达的紧凑车型，使用柴油引擎，带来远胜于同级别车型的豪华体验。

马自达2（Demio）在2014年进行了大改款，升级到了第4代。

它的外观延续了马自达在高端车型上推行的“魂动”设计理念，为它赋予了与理智知性的欧系车比肩的设计风格。另一个值得一提的特点是它不仅提供汽油引擎，还提供由马自达全新开发的1.5升“创驰蓝天-D”涡轮增压柴油引擎。这款引擎的性能可以和2.5升汽油引擎媲美。在经过调校后，6速自动档车型可以输出25.5kgm的扭矩，而6速手动档车型也可以输出22.4kgm的扭矩，并且在日本的JC08模式燃油经济性测试中取得了<30.0km/L>的惊人成果。事实证明，马自达2的柴油款车型非常受欢迎，初期收到的订单中有60%都是订购柴油版本。

柴油车共有三种型号配置，包括基础款的XD，提供LED大灯和定速巡航等实用功能的XD Touring，以及提供白色真皮座椅和真皮方向盘等奢华选项的XD Touring L Package。但每个车型都能为您提供超越其级别的品质。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Now this is a true icon—it can truly be said to
have changed the history of the racing car.

In addition to its really familiar styling, it's got a top
that can be folded down easily and a snug cockpit.

What's more, at the time of release, it was very
reasonably priced.

The market for convertible lightweight sports cars— those
ones that make you feel at one with your vehicle—

Well, it was virtually at the point of extinction.

This was the saviour which revived an entire genre of cars.
dialogues.zh:
这辆车是一面真正的旗帜，你甚至可以说它改变了赛车
的历史。

还是那家喻户晓的造型，加上方便折叠的顶篷和舒适无
比的座舱，

还有在发售之初非常实惠的价格。

能让你感到人车融为一体、操控自如的敞篷轻量级跑车
的市场

在当时已几近消亡。

这款车可以说是以一己之力挽救了所有同类车型的救星。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
This is a famous car—I know this one!

I always think it’s so cute when I see one.

And I love how it looks when the headlights pop open!

There are lots of Mazda Roadster fans all around the world, right?

That’s another great thing about this car.
-
dialogues.zh:
这是一款很有名的汽车，我认识的！
我一直觉得这辆车非常的可爱

……而且我还喜欢它的大灯翻起来的样子！

Mazda Roadster在全世界有很多粉丝对不对？

这是这款车另一个很酷的地方。

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
You know, from the start, I wanted to give this Roadster
a timeless design.

It’s full of that sentiment which compels an owner
to wish their car a goodnight.

I've even heard of fans who chose to sleep in it
the very first day they had it in their garage.

Truly, it’s the car you’ll name, throw birthday parties for
and one day lovingly restore...
dialogues.zh:
你知道吗，从一开始我就想让这款Roadster成为永不褪
色的设计。

我希望它能完整传递一种情绪，让车主们会在睡前对自
己的爱车道“晚安”……

而且我确实听说过有车迷在买完车的第一天，睡在了车
里。

我希望这是一辆你会特地为它取名、为它庆生的车，并
在某一天将它恢复到最佳状态……

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
There was this one time I received a wedding invitation
from a total stranger living in Texas.

And I thought to myself, 'Maybe its an owner of a Roadster?'
So I contacted the Roadster Club of Texas...

And found out that the happy couple had met at the club,
and that one had a red car while the other a white one.

Unfortunately I wasn't able to attend the wedding,

But a year later I received word that they had given birth
to a baby!

So I painted a miniature model of a Roadster in Pink
and sent it to them.

Being able to connect with owners like this
is really gratifying for me as a designer.

dialogues.zh:
有一次，我收到一封喜帖，是住在德克萨斯的陌生人寄
来的。

我心想，“也许这是一位敞篷跑车车主”？然后我联系了
德克萨斯的敞篷跑车俱乐部。

我发现这对夫妇就是通过俱乐部认识的，他们一个人开
红车，一个人开白车

很遗憾我无法抽身参加那场婚礼，

然后过了一年，我又收到了一条消息，他们有了一个宝
宝！

于是我涂了一个粉色的敞篷跑车模型送给他们。

可以像这样和车主们产生交流和联系，令身为设计师的
我感到万分满足。

如果没有开发这台车的同事们投注的热情，也不可能促
成这样的美事。

This little beauty is the perfect first choice for
an aspiring sports-car driver.

The car is nice and light, with a decent amount of power,
and most importantly...

...it's rear-wheel drive! Just the thing if you're still
learning your way around sports cars.

The MX-5 Miata, as we now call it, has a long history, but the NA
is the original model, and some say the very best one!
usedCar.zh:
这辆小美人儿非常
适合入门跑车爱好者。

它外观简洁，车身轻盈，马力适中……
而且还是后驱！

因此，它非常适合还在学习基础的车手。

这款Roadster拥有悠久的历史，但自然进气引擎
才是它最原本的引擎配备。有些人觉得自然进气才是最棒的！

vehicleCollection.en:
Mazda's Eunos Roadster is credited with reviving the small fun-to-drive rear-drive convertible sports car.

The Eunos Roadster was sold as the Mazda MX-5 in Europe and as the Mazda MX-5 Miata in the U.S.

The Eunos Roadster captured the imagination of the world as soon as it made its appearance in September 1989. We know it better as the Miata, and it revived the category of the lightweight convertible sports car, bringing the classic genre back into the limelight. With a compact body, rear-wheel-drive and a simple, and yet straightforward 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4, the Eunos Roadster was as fun to drive as it was good-looking.

It came powered by the 1.6-liter Type B6-ZE that produced 120 ps and 14.0 kgm of torque. The suspension system consisted of double wishbones at all four corners, while the brakes were discs at both the front and rear.

Mazda wanted to make sure that its new creation acted like part of the driver's body, going wherever the driver wanted in an effortless way. Thus, the phrase "rider, horse, one body" was adopted as its guiding principle.

In August 1993, a new engine, the 1.8-liter DOHC Type BP-ZE, was placed under the hood, with the output increased to 130 ps and 16.0 kgm of torque. The next round of changes came in August 1995 when the final gear ratio and flywheel were modified, thus creating the 1800 Series 2. Mazda produced 531,890 units through the end of 1997, setting a world record for production of a 2-passenger open vehicle, an achievement recorded by the Guinness Book of World Records.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款广受欢迎的畅销车型在全球带起了一阵紧凑型跑车的风潮。

Eunos Roadster在欧洲和美国分别以马自达MX-5和马自达MX-5 Miata的名字发售。

在20世纪末，Eunos Roadster以一己之力复兴了轻量级跑车品类。这是一台传统的两座轻型敞篷跑车，拥有紧凑而轻巧的车身，1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎和后驱布局。

1989年9月在日本地区上市时，采用的还是1.6升的B6-ZE引擎，可以输出120ps和14.0kgm扭矩。铝制的动力框架连接传动系统和后差速器，带给驾驶者直接、硬派的换挡感受。该车型还应用了全新设计的双叉臂悬挂和四轮碟刹。据说，只要是与驾驶相关的零件，马自达在设计时都不计代价。这也是为什么人们常将驾驶Eunos Roadster与骑马的美妙体验相提并论了。更何况，这还是一台敞篷跑车。最原始的驾驶乐趣和上佳的操控体验成功抓住了全世界车迷的心，无论是新手，还是资深玩家都对它心驰神往。

1993年8月，新一代的Eunos带来了小改款和一台全新的1.8升BP-ZE引擎，动力输出提高到了130ps和16.0kgm扭矩。

1995年的第二次改款中，最终齿比和飞轮也接受了改装，进化为Eunos Roadster 1800系列2。

马自达共为这款车型推出过无数个限量版本，截至1997年年底，总共生产出531890台，创下了两座敞篷车的生产世界纪录，甚至被收录进了吉尼斯世界纪录。

With a compact body, rear-wheel-drive and a simple, and yet straightforward 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4, the Eunos Roadster was as fun to drive as it was good-looking.

It came powered by the 1.6-liter Type B6-ZE that produced 120 ps and 14.0 kgm of torque. The suspension system consisted of double wishbones at all four corners, while the brakes were discs at both the front and rear.

Mazda wanted to make sure that its new creation acted like part of the driver's body, going wherever the driver wanted in an effortless way. Thus, the phrase "rider, horse, one body" was adopted as its guiding principle.

In August 1993, a new engine, the 1.8-liter DOHC Type BP-ZE, was placed under the hood, with the output increased to 130 ps and 16.0 kgm of torque. The next round of changes came in August 1995 when the final gear ratio and flywheel were modified, thus creating the 1800 Series 2. Mazda produced 531,890 units through the end of 1997, setting a world record for production of a 2-passenger open vehicle, an achievement recorded by the Guinness Book of World Records.
long.zh:
Eunos Roadster在欧洲和美国分别以马自达MX-5和马自达MX-5 Miata的名字发售。

在20世纪末，Eunos Roadster以一己之力复兴了轻量级跑车品类。这是一台传统的两座轻型敞篷跑车，拥有紧凑而轻巧的车身，1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎和后驱布局。

1989年9月在日本地区上市时，采用的还是1.6升的B6-ZE引擎，可以输出120ps和14.0kgm扭矩。铝制的动力框架连接传动系统和后差速器，带给驾驶者直接、硬派的换挡感受。该车型还应用了全新设计的双叉臂悬挂和四轮碟刹。据说，只要是与驾驶相关的零件，马自达在设计时都不计代价。这也是为什么人们常将驾驶Eunos Roadster与骑马的美妙体验相提并论了。更何况，这还是一台敞篷跑车。最原始的驾驶乐趣和上佳的操控体验成功抓住了全世界车迷的心，无论是新手，还是资深玩家都对它心驰神往。

1993年8月，新一代的Eunos带来了小改款和一台全新的1.8升BP-ZE引擎，动力输出提高到了130ps和16.0kgm扭矩。

1995年的第二次改款中，最终齿比和飞轮也接受了改装，进化为Eunos Roadster 1800系列2。

马自达共为这款车型推出过无数个限量版本，截至1997年年底，总共生产出531890台，创下了两座敞篷车的生产世界纪录，甚至被收录进了吉尼斯世界纪录。

brandCentral.en:
The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo is a real beauty!

It's the perfect iteration of Mazda's "KODO: Soul of Motion"
design philosophy.

One of the inspirations for its styling was the legendary
787B race car that made history at Le Mans.

The designers attempted to capture the past and future of Mazda
in a single design, and I'd say they succeeded.

Its powertrain is capable of incredible power, efficiency,
and durability.

And who knows? Perhaps a victory at Le Mans is on the cards
for this mean machine too.
brandCentral.zh:
Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo实在是美得不可方物！

此车是Mazda“魂动：Soul of motion”设计理念的
完美示范。

其设计背后的灵感之一是在勒芒赛道上创造历史的
Mazda 787B。

可以说，这个车型成功地在一套设计中捕捉到Mazda的过去
和未来！

其动力系统能够提供令人难以置信的动力、功效和
耐久性。

谁知道呢，也许这个小美人将来也能在勒芒24小时耐力
赛中取得胜利！!

vehicleCollection.en:
A fusion of speed and elegance, born from the spirit of an unrelenting challenger.

The Vision Gran Turismo project is the setting for the world's best automakers to develop concept cars for motorsports fanatics. The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo pushes the boundaries at the intersection of technology and design. This is not your traditional Mazda but a vision of the future with a healthy dose of respect for the past. It’s the result of an unwavering pursuit of glory at the world’s most grueling endurance event, the legendary 24 Hours of Le Mans.

In crafting the Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo, the Mazda Design team masterfully fused agility with elegance. Its dynamic silhouette is drawn with sensual forms inspired by Mazda’s KODO design philosophy. Even the shape of the grille is an interpretation of the Mazda signature front end developed for its production vehicles. The stance of the Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo, reminiscent of the famed 787B that took overall victory at the 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans, is powerful yet graceful.

The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo is engineered to be lightweight, featuring extensive use of carbon fiber, including a monocoque chassis, all wrapped in atmospheric white paint. Pair this with advanced drivetrain technology that delivers the pinnacle of power, efficiency, and durability, and the result is a remarkable power-to-weight ratio that surpasses most vehicles in its class.

The Mazda LM55 Vision Gran Turismo embodies Mazda’s vision for the future and its unwavering spirit to embrace challenges.
vehicleCollection.zh:
速度和优雅的融合，源自挑战者百折不挠的精神。

跑车浪漫旅愿景项目是世界上最好的车厂为赛车狂热分子打造概念车的平台。马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo推动了技术与设计之间的交汇。这不是一台传统的马自达，而是对未来的愿景，同时又适当兼顾传统。这款车是能在世界上要求最苛刻的耐力赛——著名的“勒芒24小时耐力赛”中取得卓越胜利，吸引万千瞩目的产品。

在马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo的设计中，马自达的设计团队将敏捷与优雅合二为一。感性的造型风格构造了这款车动感的轮廓，其灵感则来自于马自达的“魂动”设计理念。甚至前格栅的形状也源自马自达量产车的标志性前脸设计。马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo的风格让人想起在1991年勒芒24小时耐力赛中大获全胜的名车787B，强劲而不失优雅。

马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo车体极为轻盈，采用了轻巧的碳纤维组件，醒目亮白色涂装之下是轻盈的单体底盘。这款车采用了集大马力、高效率和耐久性于一体的高级动力传动技术，因而获得了极高的马力重量比，超过其同级别的大多数车型。

马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo是马自达对未来的设想，是他们不屈不挠的挑战者精神的产物。

dialogues.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
dialogues.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
dialogues.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
dialogues.en:
This was a car that was produced with the concept:

"if Mazda was to compete in the top category of the Le Mans,
what would be a great design."

The LM55 name stands for "Car Number 55 of Le Mans,"
and is taken from the legendary racing car of Mazda.

I remember that we did a full aerodynamic simulation, and really
went through a thorough development process for this car.

We had engineers knowledgeable about racing cars
also become involved in the development.

There is a full scale model as well, and its on display
in the Mazda Museum.

And actually, my name is on the car as the driver.

It is from the wish that if this car appears, and it runs
on the Le Mans, that I want to be the driver.

The Le Mans hyper car class regulations allow
a fair amount of design freedom...

and if we make a car like this and compete,
that would be a huge opportnity!
dialogues.zh:
这辆车回答了这样一个问题：“马自达要怎样设计，
才能在勒芒顶级组别的赛事中一争高下？”

LM55这个名字中，“LM”是“勒芒”的缩写，
“55”则是“55号赛车”，是向马自达的一位传奇赛车手致敬。

设计这辆车的时候，我记得我们进行了多项测试，
还包括全面的空气动力学模拟。

而且还特意请来了对赛车有深入了解的工程师支援……

我们甚至还做了个1:1的实物模型，现在就摆在
马自达博物馆里呢。

哦对了，你可能会发现车手名单里有我的名字。为什么？

因为要是有朝一日它真的能征战勒芒，我想亲自开上它！

勒芒超级跑车组别的规则给了设计师很大的发挥空间……

所以，要是我们真能造出这样一辆车去参赛，嘿，说不
定真能捧回^军奖杯呢！

前田先生还是Mazda“魂动设计”理念的缔造者，可以说是
日本最有名的汽车设计师之一。

马自达LM55 Vision Gran Turismo是马自达对未来的设想，是他们不屈不挠的挑战者精神的产物。

*这款车已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别1规则进行过特殊调校。

dialogues.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
dialogues.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
dialogues.en:
In many respects this ND Roadster is a product
that I put alot of effort into.

The car I started competing in races with when I was into
motorsports as a student, was the NB Roadster.

Later I would buy an NR-A version of the ND Roadster
and compete in one-make races,

but what I focused on most as the designer of the ND roadster,
was how it looks on the move.

It had to look good racing on a track, and in order
to create the base structure that would achieves this,

I kept imagining its form exiting a corner with
the load on its rear tires,while working on its design.

Today I'm competing in Japan’s Super Endurance series
as both the team manager and driver of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING.

I actually race in a Roadster with this very livery, and we're
lucky to have many other roadsters participating in this class.
Whether it be real or virtual, I hope we can all enjoy
racing on the track, as challengers with the same goals!

And I hope you'll keep up with the latest activities
of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING, too.
dialogues.zh:
我曾经为设计这辆ND Roadster
付出了极大的精力和时间。

我从学生时代起就是狂热的赛车迷，
还驾驶着NB Roadster参加过正式比赛。

再后来，我买过一辆NR-A版本的ND Roadster
去参加马自达举办的单一车种比赛。

在设计这款ND Roadster时，我最重视的一点
就是它在运动中所表现出来的模样。

也就是说，要让它在赛道上显得特别炫酷。
为了实现这个目的……

我在设计它的外观时，始终在脑海中想象
一辆重心后置的赛车出弯的模样。

目前我正在以马自达SPIRIT RACING车手以及车队经理
的身份参加日本的超级耐久系列赛。

我驾驶的其实是一辆采用同样涂装的敞篷跑车，
能与这么多同组别的其他敞篷跑车汽车竞技真是太幸运了。
不论赛道是真实还是虚拟的，
我希望大家都可以作为志同道合的挑战者，共同享受比赛的乐趣！

我也希望你可以多多关注马自达SPIRIT RACING的最新动态。

brandCentral.en:
The NR-A is a sports car with a very special place
in Mazda’s Roadster series.

It was developed to be driven on both city streets
and the racing track.

The standard model was equipped with an enhanced drivetrain,
large brake rotors...

And an upgraded suspension system.

It even included a NR-A-branded roll cage and bucket seats,
items required for competition racing.

A Roadster with a long and storied history, the NR-A debuted
in 2002, during the era of the second-gen NB Roadster.

That same year, Mazda launched a one-make party race series
for numbered NR-A grade Roadsters.

The Roadster Party Race continues to be one of Japan’s
most popular race events.
brandCentral.zh:
在Mazda的Roaster系列中，NR-A拥有特殊的地位。

它的设计既考虑了城市街道使用，
也考虑到了赛道比赛。

标准版本就配置了改进后的传动系统、大型碟刹……

以及经过升级的悬挂系统。

甚至还加入了带有NR-A标志的防滚架和桶型座椅
——两者都是正式比赛必备的装备。

NR-A作为一款历史悠久、经历丰富的车型，首发于2002年，
当时在售的MX-5还是第二代型号NB。

同年，Mazda还专门举办了单一车种派对系列赛，
仅限有编号的NR-A Roadster参加。

这一赛事从此延续了下来，并成为了日本最有人气的赛事之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
This motorsports-based model epitomizes the core concepts of the Roadster.

Released in 2015, the fourth-generation ND MX-5 received worldwide praise for its return to the original concept of "Jinba Ittai," which translates to "rider and horse, one body." This essence was especially apparent in the NR-A trim level, which was intended for track use.

The NR-A first made its appearance on the second-generation NB MX-5, catering to those who enjoyed driving their sports cars on the track. The concept proved popular enough for Mazda to include an NR-A in the ND lineup.

The section of the frame that connects the transmission to the rear differential was upgraded for the ND NR-A, along with the driveshaft, LSD and differential case. The size of the radiator and brake rotors were increased, and the suspension adopted height-adjustable dampers made by Bilstein. Another useful feature was the Multi-Information Display that allowed the driver to get vital stats through switches on the steering wheel.

This 2022 model has further improvements, including a new Kinematic Posture Control system that stabilizes the rear end of the car. The options list also features racing equipment such as roll bars and bucket seats, which come especially useful for hot-lapping sessions.

The NR-A is the ideal track car for weekend warriors because of its excellent and predictable handling, with power delivery that's just enough to make things fun and exciting.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款赛车向的基础车型成为了展现敞篷跑车核心理念的典范。

这台2015年发售的第四代“ND” Roadster回归最初的“人马一体”理念，受到了全世界的赞誉。ND的精髓在NR-A这款比赛专用的基础车型上得到了纯粹而淋漓尽致的表达。

NR-A最初是在第二代“NB”车型时加入了系列，它推出时的理念是为所有人提供一个轻松体验赛道乐趣的机会。这些理念在ND版本的NR-A中得到了继承，并特别针对竞速驾驶作出了对应改动。

将传动系统与后轮差速器连接的动力装置得到了升级，同期强化的还有传动轴、限滑差速器和差速器箱等相关配件。散热器和刹车盘都变大了一码，悬挂采用了由倍适登制造的高度可调减震器。另外新增的一项实用功能是驾驶者现在可以通过方向盘上的声控开关来命令多功能显示器显示油耗等统计数据了。

这台2022年的车款还拥有进一步的改进，全新的运动姿态控制系统大幅提高了车尾的稳定度。选配清单中还包括了防倾杆和桶型座椅等赛车装备，可以轻松将此车变为一辆彻头彻尾的赛车。

NR-A可能是许多人梦寐以求的车型，在城市街道和赛道上都能提供同样的驾驶乐趣。

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
I got a call one day from my protégé at Mazda Design asking
for my thoughts on the design of the fourth-gen Miata.

I told him that I wrote a scenario for the first three
generations at the beginning of the NA project.

I normally look forward 20-25 years ahead
from the start of a project.

Therefore, I had no ideas for the fourth-gen car,
except the following:

 If it was to be mechanically similar,
then the design should...

...differ more from the NA to NB, and NB to NC.

If the car was to be mechanically new...

...with an innovative layout or different type of
powertrain, then it should be evolutionary.

 I never got to see the design of the
fourth-gen development at any stage.

When I asked the designers how things were going?
Their answer was always...

“Don’t worry, you guided us
to do the right thing.”

 They actually didn't want to show me the car...

...even on the night before
the world premiere event.

Enough was enough, so I made my stand.

 I told them that
“You know that I can't keep a poker face.”

"Whatever I see or feel shows on my face.
I can't help it."

"Can you risk that happening tomorrow?”

They thought about that for a moment,
and they came to the correct conclusion.

They finally showed me the car, and do you know
what I thught?

The fourth-generation car was designed in the right
direction, indeed.
dialogues.zh:
有一天，我接到来自在马自达设计工作的一位弟子的电话。

他询问我是否为第四代Miata Roadster做过类似的设计规划。

我有个习惯，每当我开启一个项目时，
我都会尝试想象它在之后20年里的演变。

所以我是这样告诉他的。

我说，我在NA项目启动的时候，就已经
为前三代都写好了方案……

但对于第四代而言……

我暂时没有什么具体的想法。

不过我又补充了一句，
如果机械结构上没有太大变化的话，那么设计方面……

相较于从NA到NB以及从NB到NC的演化，
应该体现出更大的变化。

此外……

如果这辆车在机械结构上是全新的，
应用了创新的布局或不同的传动系统……

那么在外观方面也应该体现出充分的演化。

在此之后，我直没机会参与到第四代Roadster的开发当中。

每当我询问设计师们事情进展如何时，他们都会叫我放心。

“不用担心，”他们总是这样说。

“您给我们指出了一条正确的道路。”

事实上，直到新车全球首发的前一天晚上，
他们都还在想方设法对我保密。

我后来忍不住了。

我对他们说：“我是个藏不住事的人。
万一明天我一不小心当众露7失望表情，你们打算怎么办？”

他们这才让我看到了新车，你猜怎么着？

第四代的设计方向走得很踏实。

brandCentral.en:
If you're in the market for a fun rear-wheel-drive sports car,
you can't go wrong with this Mazda MX-5.

This fourth-generation model is known as the ND.

More than 100kg lighter than its predecessor, it embraced
all the virtues that made the original so popular.

The S-segment ND is good looking, lightweight and
an absolute joy to drive.
brandCentral.zh:
如果您正在寻找一辆后轮驱动的跑车，那么选这款Mazda MX-5
准没错。

这款第四代车型被称为ND。

这台全球热门车型比上一代要轻100kg，被视为回归经典的
纯粹之作。

MX-5 ND属于轻量级的S级车，整重只稍微超过一吨，但驾驶乐
趣无穷。\

vehicleCollection.en:
The MX-5 Miata returns to its roots with a lightweight 990kg body and dashing looks.

One look and almost anyone in the world can recognize Mazda’s sporty convertible sports car that's proved so popular that it made its way into the Guinness Book of World Records. While it goes by different names throughout the world, the Roadster in Japan, the MX-5 in Europe and the MX-5 Miata in the US, we’ll refer to it simply as the MX-5 here.

The fourth-generation MX-5, codenamed “ND,” was introduced at the New York Auto Show in April 2014. It was obvious from this “display only” model that the car possessed all the attributes to make it great, returning to the formula that made the first-generation model so successful. It was going to be lighter than the outgoing model, with most of the heavy components, including the driver, focused at the center of the chassis.

When the final exterior and interior design of the MX-5 was revealed simultaneously in the US, Japan and Europe in September of the same year, driving fans were excited. The new MX-5 looked sleek and sexy, sitting low to the ground with a wide stance. The car, slightly smaller than the previous model, was more in line with the first generation car. It measured 3915mm long, 1735mm wide and 1235mm high, and rode on a 2310mm-wheelbase. It tipped the scales from 990kg to 1060kg, depending on the grade model.

Powering the compact roadster was a 1496cc DOHC inline-4 that delivered 131ps and 15.3kgm of torque. It came mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox or an automatic transmission with a torque converter. The combination of the lightweight package, peppy engine and manual gearbox made the “ND” one of the most rewarding cars to drive on the planet, and it reminded everyone of how enjoyable top-down motoring can truly be.

*The Mazda Roadster was sold as the Mazda MX-5 in Europe and the Mazda MX-5 Miata in the S.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第四代Roadster，车体加宽，车重更是低至990kg。

代号“ND”的第四代马自达敞蓬跑车于2014年4月在纽约车展上首次以实物形态亮相。虽然当时仅仅展示了底盘、引擎、传动系统和悬挂系统，但可以看到较重的元件被安置在较低、靠近底盘中心的位置，设计者为了减轻重量付出了大量的努力，车手坐在车辆中部略微靠后的位置。这次亮相成功地引起了全世界车迷的期望。

在同年9月的另一次重大更新中，车辆的造型于日本、美国和欧洲同步亮相，并宣布将于2015年开始发售。

这款车的前鼻和肩线较低，车身整体偏宽偏低。其优雅的线条十分迷人，但车身的尺寸比前辈型号NC要小。这款车在尺寸和设计方面受到了全世界的好评。

2015年，关于这款车的更多信息被透露出来。车的尺寸为3915mm×1735mm×1235mm，轴距为2310mm。车身重量在990kg与1060kg之间，根据车型等级而有所不同。引擎使用的是1496cc双顶置凸轮轴直4引擎，马力为131ps/15.3kgm。变速箱可提供6档手动变速箱和带有变矩器的自动变速箱。

预订开始于2015年3月，共有几个级别可选：基本S款、驾驶性能提升的S特别款和豪华版S真皮款。S款的配置十分简单，并未配备限滑差速器和后稳定杆。然而，此级别车型的重量低于1吨，只有990kg，适合驾驶者体验新款“ND”双座敞蓬跑车的本色。

*此款马自达双座敞蓬跑车在欧洲销售的型号为MX-5，在美国销售的型号为马自达MX-5 Miata。

brandCentral.en:
This tuned Mazda MX-5 was based on the
first-generation model.

Nearly every aspect of the car was improved, from its engine
to its upgraded suspension system.

It was also lightened and made more durable.

The changes to its chassis resulted in a more neutral handling
balance, which makes it a blast to drive on the race track.
brandCentral.zh:
这款改装车型基于第一代Mazda MX-5研发而来，

并接受了全方位的优化改造——引擎微调、悬挂升级……

而且还变得更轻、更结实！

与众不同的是，在这样的改造后，它还能够保留中性的
转向特质，因此极为适合在赛道上狂飙突进！

vehicleCollection.en:
A first-generation Mazda Roadster, tuned to perfection by Gran Turismo.

The Eunos Roadster was sold as the Mazda MX-5 in Europe and as the Mazda MX-5 Miata in the U.S.

This original car created by "Gran Turismo" is based on the 1989 Mazda Eunos Roadster (NA Special Package). The following is the description of the base model:

The Eunos Roadster captured the imagination of the world as soon as it made its appearance in September 1989. We know it better as the Miata, and it revived the category of the lightweight convertible sports car, bringing the classic genre back into the limelight. With a light and compact body, rear-wheel-drive and a simple-yet-straightforward 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4, the Roadster was as fun to drive as it was good-looking.

It came powered by the 1.6-liter Type B6-ZE that produced 120ps and 14.0kgm of torque. The suspension system consisted of double wishbones at all four corners, while the brakes were discs at both the front and rear.

Mazda produced 531,890 units through the end of 1997, setting a world record for production of a 2-passenger open vehicle, a fact recorded by the Guinness Book of World Records.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第一代Roadster，由跑车浪漫旅完成调校。

Eunos Roadster在欧洲和美国分别以马自达MX-5和马自达MX-5 Miata的名字发售。

这是跑车浪漫旅以马自达Eunos Roadster'89（自然进气特别版）为基础，调校制作的原创车型。以下是针对原始车型的介绍：

在20世纪末，Eunos Roadster以一己之力复兴了轻量级跑车品类。这是一台传统的两座轻型敞篷跑车，拥有紧凑而轻巧的车身，1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎和后驱布局。

1989年9月在日本地区上市时，采用的还是1.6升的B6-ZE引擎，可以输出120ps和14.0kgm扭矩。铝制的动力框架连接传动系统和后差速器，带给驾驶者直接、硬派的换挡感受。该车型还应用了全新设计的双叉臂悬挂和四轮碟刹。据说，只要是与驾驶相关的零件，马自达在设计时都不计代价。

马自达共为这款车型推出过无数个限量版本，截至1997年年底，总共生产出531890台，创下了两座敞篷车的生产世界纪录，甚至被收录进了吉尼斯世界纪录。

usedCar.en:
If you're looking for a car that handles like it's on rails,
then you can't go wrong with any of the RX-7s.

This second-generation "FC" has a lower center of gravity than
many of its competitors, and it's lighter, too.

Even today, people rave about its amazing on-road prowess,
which comes via its unique rotary engine.

Properly tuned, it'll run circles around some of the
newer models out there today.
usedCar.zh:
想找一辆操控性出色的车子吗？
那么RX-7系列车型肯定适合你。

在第二代“FC”上市时，它的重量更轻，
重心也比当时的竞争者要低。

即使放在今天，这辆车优良的过弯性能
也并不常见。

在经过适当调校后，这辆车完全可以与
最新款的车型一较高下。

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of the second-generation RX-7 offered better driver feedback and agility.

By the time the second-generation RX-7, the FC3S, arrived in October 1985, Mazda had firmly established the model as a competent rotary-powered sports machine. Although the new model was shorter than the previous car, it was wider and slightly taller, resulting in a 200-kg weight increase. The newly designed 13B Wankel did more than compensate for the extra mass, as the turbocharged 654-cc powerplant produced 185ps and 25.0kgm of torque. To keep the rear end more secure, Mazda incorporated semi-trailing arms and lateral rods for the rear suspension that featured a toe control hub.

An even purer sports version of the car was introduced in August 1986, called the Infini. This limited-edition model was a two-seater, and featured, among other things, BBS alloy wheels, firmer shocks and an aluminum hood. The Infini name would make an appearance seven times, each time representing the sportiest version of the model, before production of the FC3S ceased in 1991.

Mazda made significant tweaks to the RX-7 in 1989, when it matched a new independent twin-scroll turbocharger to the 13B as well as raising the engine's compression ratio. The result was a power increase to 205 ps and 27.5kgm. The final Infini model saw the power of the 13B raised to 215 ps and 28.0kgm. A convertible model was added to the lineup in 1987, which proved popular in the U.S., especially with women.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第2代RX-7的完整形态，性能与操控回馈都有提升。

RX-7于1985年10月进化为第二代“FC3S”。

未来主义风格的第二代相比第一代RX-7，长度更短，但更宽也更高，车身重量增加了大约200公斤。不过全新设计的13B引擎抵消了增加的重量。每个转子的排量扩展到了654cc，配合涡轮增压器后性能提升到了185ps和25.0kgm扭矩。

后部悬挂改为多连杆布局，同时采用了半拖曳臂和侧边杆。这个后悬挂的特点是采用了特殊的前束控制轮轴，能够提升车辆在转弯时后轮的稳定性。

FC3S系列同样推出了偏向于持久驾驶风格的限量版车型——英菲妮版本。英菲妮是一款高性能2座车型，省略了后排座位，装备了BBS合金轮毂、特殊减震器以及铝制引擎罩。第一款英菲妮亮相于1986年8月，但在1991年FC3S停产前，这款车一共限量发售了七批，是RX-7的标志性版本。

1989年，RX-7进行了几处小的改动。13B引擎应用了新型双涡流涡轮增压器，随着压缩比的提高，马力提高到205ps，扭矩则提高到27.5kgm。英菲妮的最后一款马力达到215ps，扭矩为28.0kgm。在外部配件方面，在小幅调整之后，三个圆形的尾灯成为了这几款车型的显著特征。

1987年，RX-7系列中新增了一款敞篷车型，与以往的耐久型赛车的印象不同。此车在美国获得成功，尤其在女性驾驶者中受到欢迎。
