cars.nameEn: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02
cars.nameZh: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02

dialogues.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
dialogues.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
dialogues.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
dialogues.en:
In my mid 20's I was assigned to a position in the US,
and the FD was a car from that time.

It was when Matano-san was in the US studio, and the clay model
for this car was being made in the design studio.

It isn't a car that I worked on myself, but I remember
thinking that the shape of this car is really great.

The greatness of this car is in the relationship
between the tires and the body.

The body is thin vertically, and the tires have a sense of presence,
and it is a honed 3 dimensional shape with no excess anywhere.

That's why this car still doesn't look old.
Its beautiful.

The original idea came from a designer named Wu-Huang Chin.

He draws surfaces like this just with a marker. He's
a design genius who is really good at drawing.

I think you could say that the FD and NA Roadster of this era
are at the pinnacle of the Mazda design in Mazda history.

Their ability to work 3 dimensional shapes at the time
was truly world class

and this is a product from the time when the foundations of
Mazda design was formed.
dialogues.zh:
说起这款FD，那可得追溯到我20多岁的时候了，那会儿
我还在美国工作呢。

那时俣野努先生也在美国工作室任职，这辆车的黏土模
型就是在那儿做的。

虽然不是我个人参与设计的，但我记得当时就觉得这辆
车的造型很独到。

这车最棒的地方就是轮胎和车身的比例关系。

车身压低变薄，让轮胎显得特别醒目，整体看上去给人
一种精雕细琢的感觉，一点儿多余的东西都没有。

正是这种设计，让它成为了经典。美，真的太美了。

这车最初的创意图来自一位叫秦无荒的设计师。

这位老兄可是个设计天才，画功了得。你敢信吗？

conversation.en:
In my mid 20's I was assigned to a position in the US,
and the FD was a car from that time.

It was when Matano-san was in the US studio, and the clay model
for this car was being made in the design studio.

It isn't a car that I worked on myself, but I remember
thinking that the shape of this car is really great.

The greatness of this car is in the relationship
between the tires and the body.

The body is thin vertically, and the tires have a sense of presence,
and it is a honed 3 dimensional shape with no excess anywhere.

That's why this car still doesn't look old.
Its beautiful.

The original idea came from a designer named Wu-Huang Chin.

He draws surfaces like this just with a marker. He's
a design genius who is really good at drawing.

I think you could say that the FD and NA Roadster of this era
are at the pinnacle of the Mazda design in Mazda history.

Their ability to work 3 dimensional shapes at the time
was truly world class

and this is a product from the time when the foundations of
Mazda design was formed.

vehicleCollection.en:
This final version of the Mazda RX-7 marked the end of an excellent 25-year run for the model.

Arguably, one of the purest sports cars to come from Japan is the third-generation RX-7 (FD3S) that was introduced in 1991. Gone was the name "Savanna" that graced previous models, replaced by the moniker, ɛ̃fini RX-7. The FD3S was wider than the FC, and significantly lighter at 1200kg, thanks to the aluminum used for the hood, double wishbone suspension, and spare-tire jack.

New life was breathed into the 13B Wankel via new twin sequential turbochargers. The rotary engine produced 255ps and 30.0kgm of torque. With each passing year, the FD improved, with dramatic improvements in body rigidity and ABS. The weight-to-power ratio of the lighter Type S was <4.90kg/ps>, making it the fastest RX-7 to date.

The FD3S continued to evolve. Body rigidity, the computer, and ABS were upgraded. The Type I, created in 1991, led to the Type II, Type III, and the Type VI in 2000. Available only in the Japan market was the limited-edition Type RZ, the first Japanese car equipped with 40/45 low-profile tires. This was followed by the Type R Bathurst R in 2001 that came equipped with self-leveling shocks.

The 13B got an upgrade in 1996 and produced 265ps. In 1998, after Mazda refined the engine's cooling system, the two-rotor Wankel was able to produce the maximum 280ps allowed for JDM cars at the time. This allowed the Type R to boast a weight-to-power ratio of <4.50kg/ps>, which put it in the same league as the exotics. In August 2002, the RX-7 Spirit R was introduced as an anniversary model and became the last one in the series. After 25 years of delighting sports car fans around the world, the RX-7 was discontinued.
vehicleCollection.zh:
RX-7的最后一款纪念车型，25年的历史告一段落。

FD3S作为第三代的RX-7，发布于1991年12月。先前版本的名称“Savanna”被弃用，更名为ɛ̃fini RX-7。

为了适应更宽的轮胎，FD3S被明显加宽，但其引擎盖、备胎、千斤顶和前后双叉臂悬挂均采用铝制，使车身重量在车身加大的同时奇迹般地降到了1200公斤。

和FC3S一样，FD3S采用了13B涡轮增压引擎。但借助全新的序列式双涡轮系统，让输出提高到了255ps和30.0kgm的扭矩。重量更轻的Type S的动力重量比达到<4.90kg/ps>，此车在所有已发布的RX-7车款中速度最快，并且仍有极大的升级潜力。

FD3S在随后不断进化。车身刚度、车载电脑和防抱死刹车系统的规格也逐年升级。1991年制造的Type I车型进化为Type II和III，并在2000年最终成为Type VI。

在升级过程中的亮点之一是限量版的Type RZ，这是第一辆采用40/45小尺寸轮胎的日本车。在此后的2001年，Type R Bathurst R发布，采用高度可调式悬挂，这在标准量产车中也十分罕见。

当然，引擎也在不断更新。1996年，对电子控制单元的进气和排气系统进行了改进，将马力提高到了265ps。1998年，对冷却系统和引擎的优化使马力最终达到了280ps。Type R的重量马力比已达到了<4.50kg/ps>，性能上已经和超级跑车不相上下。

然而，RX-7无法满足21世纪的环保标准。2002年8月，RX-7 Spirit R作为周年纪念版推出，同时也是该系列的最后一款，结束了其为期25年的生产。

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
I was also involved with the design of the “FD."

I thought that this FR layout sports car at $30K range above
the MX-5 would be the last model as the RX-7 as we knew it.

If Mazda were to develop a next-generation
RX model...

...I expected that it would have to have a mid-engine layout
at a much higher price point.

Then, when the FD replacement project started.

 I was torn because we were going to replace the
timeless design of the FD...

...with a completely new one.

Luckily, it became 4-seater and a totally different concept.
dialogues.zh:
我确实参与了“FD”的一部分工作。

当时，我们都以为它会是我们挚爱的RX-7系车型
的最后一款……

而且，如果要开发下一代的话……

应该会采用中置引擎布局，还要调高售价。

再后来，FD的替换项目启动了。

一开始我有点纠结，因为我们不得不把我心目中
永不过时的设计……

替换成一个全新的设计。

幸好，最终的4座车车型
成功展现出了完全不同的概念。'

dialogues.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
dialogues.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
dialogues.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
dialogues.en:
This is a car for which I was the Chief designer.
I also owned this RX-8 for quite a while.

Actually my children were born in the year
that the RX-8 was announced.

They were twin boys, but in our house it was already decided
from the very beginning that our family car would be an RX-8.

The RX-8 was perfect for raising twins.

One reason is that the RX-8 is a 4 door, but you can't
open the rear
doors without opening the front doors.

So even when they were at a rambunctious age, I could drive
without worrying about them accidentally opening the doors

To make a silhouette that looks like a sports car with 4 doors
and with proper space for 4 people,

is actually very difficult.

There's not many cars in the world that have accomplished this.

It would be great to design something again
with this package and engine one day.

There was a Mazda Fan Festa event the other day,
at a circuit in Okayama.

There were a lot of RX-8 owners there. I really appreciate the
fact that they are taking great care of these cars even today.
dialogues.zh:
说起这款RX-8，我可是它的首席设计师。不仅如此，
我自己也有一辆RX-8，开了相当长一段时间。

实际上，我家的双胞胎恰好就出生在RX-8发布的那一年。

我生的是一对男孩，但在他们出生之前，我就打定主意
要把RX-8作为家里的家用车。

RX-8简直就是为带双胞胎量身定做的。

虽然它是一辆四门车的，但有个特别之处：前门得先打
开，后门才能开。

这可就省心了，我再也不用担心那两个调皮蛋在我开车
时不小心把门拉开了。

说实话，要设计一辆既有跑车范儿，还能舒舒服服坐四
个人的四门车……

不是件容易事。

能做到这一点的车真不多。

有朝一日要是我能再设计一款这种配置和引擎的车型
就好了。

前几天，我'冈山参加了个马自达车迷聚会……

我看到好多人都是开着RX-8来的。这么多年过去了，这
款车还是很有人气，真令人开心。

vehicleCollection.en:
The final version of the RX-8, Mazda's rotary engine sports car with a unique 4-door layout.

Introduced in 2011, the Mazda RX-8 Spirit R was the final special edition model of the RX-8 that was first released in 2003.

The RX-8 had two distinct personalities, depending on the gearbox you chose. Cars equipped with the 6-speed manual drove like a pure sport car, with brisk acceleration and more driver control, while those with the 6-speed automatic essentially behaved like luxury grand tourers. The Spirit R equipped with the 6-speed manual was based on the sporty Type RS, and featured extra aero parts and a sporty suspension setup, complete with Bilstein dampers. The automatic Spirit R was based on the Type E and included luxury accoutrements, such as leather seats. The car's Renesis rotary engine produced 235HP and 159 ft.-lb. of torque.

The lifespan of the Spirit R was short-lived, as Mazda discontinued the RX-8 in June 2012. Because of that, initial orders for the Spirit R exceeded the intended batch of 1000 units, so Mazda produced another 1000 to meet demand.[
vehicleCollection.zh:
马自达的转子引擎跑车RX-8的最后限量版车型，具有独特的4门设计。

马自达RX-8 Spirit R在2011年首次推出，是2003年亮相的RX-8的最终特别版。

RX-8共可提供两种略有差异的体验。6速手动档款偏向跑车，而6速自动档的感觉更像是豪华旅行车。这款Spirit R车型也同样提供了手动档和自动档选项，都代表了符合其定位的最高档配置。

其手动型号基于跑车型的Type RS，包含额外的空气动力学套件和采用倍适登避震器的强化悬挂。自动档型号基于豪华旅行车风格的Type E，拥有高档内饰和皮革座椅。和旧型号相比，差异仅仅在于外观和内饰的诸多细节变化，引擎规格和机械系统完全没有改变。尽管如此，随着官方公布将于2012年6月停产RX-8，订单量飞快地超过了原计划的1000台。为了满足需求，最后又额外生产了1000台RX-8。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
Did you know that in Europe, they have an annual contest
for the world’s most beautiful car?

Well, the Mazda RX-Vision took home the "Most Beautiful
Concept Car" award at this contest in 2016.

The event draws crowds of car enthusiasts from all over
the world to pick the most beautiful cars of the year.

The RX-Vision was the first car by an Asian manufacturer
to win this award.

Penned by Ikuo Maeda, it was a car that left its mark on not
only Mazda but Japanese sports-car design in general.
dialogues.zh:
你知道吗？在欧洲，每年都会举办一场评选
全球最美汽车的比赛。

2016年，Mazda RX-Vision凭借其卓越设计夺得了
“最美概念车”的殊荣。

这项赛事汇聚了来自世界各地的汽车专家，他们负责
从众多参赛车辆中评选出年度最具魅力的汽车。

RX-Vision是赢得该奖项的汽车中，首款由亚洲制造商制造的汽车。

设计师前田育男倾注心血的成果不仅在Mazda的历史上
留下了深刻印记，同时也对日本跑车设计产生了深远影响。

dialogues.speaker: Fabio Filippini
dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
Unveiled at the Tokyo Motor Show in 2015...

...the MAZDA RX-VISION immediately thrilled design specialists
with the masterful beauty of its sinuous and complex forms.

The "Kodo" design philosophy of applying emotional shapes
to evoke fluid and natural movement…

...is perfectly expressed in this spectacular concept car.

Consider its low and wide body, large bonnet,
and set-back cockpit.

The side profile is particularly stunning.

This is owing to a controlled use of soft textures
and light reflection.

Almost evoking a kind of Japanese lacquer,
the flaming red livery...

...helps to amplify the liquid appearance of the RX-VISION’s
beautiful sheet metal surfaces.
dialogues.zh:
2015年东京车展上首次亮相的……

马自达RX-VISION概念赛车，凭借其复杂而流畅的整体
造型美学立即引起了设计专家们的热烈反响。

马自达“魂动”设计理念旨在通过饱含情感的动态造型呈现
流畅自然的动感……

这款令人惊叹的概念赛车完美诠释了该设计哲学。

它拥有低矮而宽阔的车身、
修长的引擎舱盖和靠后的驾驶舱位置。

车身侧面轮廓尤为出众。

这得益于对柔和曲面和光线反射的巧妙运用。

其火焰般的红色车身涂装让人瞬间联想到
日本传统漆器的质感……

进一步强化了RX-VISION车身金属表面的流动美感。

dialogues.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
dialogues.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
dialogues.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
dialogues.en:
The RX-VISION is a car in which I placed
my car designer life on the line.

I worked on it from the standpoint of really making
the dream sports car I have in my mind.

And one of the most important things for a sports car
is its fundamental structure.

Historic cars that are still popular and beautiful to look at
today all have exceptionally great proportions.

So the first thing we worked on for the RX-VISION
was also the structure.

A textbook FR (Front Engine Rear Drive) with a long nose,
and the ability to place proper load on the rear wheels.

In the final stages, we extended the front nose about 150mm
from the structure we had originally designed,

the part from the front doors up to the front wheel center.

In the very end we made it a slightly unbalanced proportion...

But at that moment we got a lot of traction on the rear wheels,
I thought "This will work!"

That slight unbalance is the hook. It's the secret
to making someone go "Hmm".

The other secret is the reflection of light.

If you look at the RX-VISION as you circle it, I think you'll
notice that the light's reflection moves around like a creature.

Cars are like family or friends to those who are into them.

And it's a very rare industrial product
that runs around on its own.

That makes cars have the same type of existence as animals running
around in the wild, or an athlete running on a field.

And when you think of it that way, I also want cars to be
something that looks beautiful and truly alive in nature.

And for that you need a "sense of life."

So when thinking about what is the sense of life,
that will put cars at one with nature,

we tried to express life in the car with the light's reflections
6nd their beauty on the car's body.

And those are the type of shapes
that are instilled in the RX-VISION.<next id=2600206 type=9݇
dialogues.zh:
说到RX-VISION，那可是我赌上专业设计师的身份，
倾注全部心血的作品。

我想通过它，把我脑海中理想跑车的样子变成现实。

设计跑车，最关键的就是定好基本结构。

你看那些经典车型，哪个不是比例优美？

所以我设计RX-VISION时，第一步就是确定它的结构。

我先是采用了教科书般经典的前置引擎后轮驱动
设计——就是那种前脸很长，重心偏后的布局。

然后，在定稿前的最后一刻，我又把前鼻加长了150mm。

具体来说，就是加在了从前门到前轮中心那一段。

这么一改，车身比例看起来有点不太协调……但是这样
做能让后轮抓地力更强。

当时我就想：“嘿，没准这主意不错！”

就这样，一个小小的设计巧思成了这辆车的独特之处。

RX-VISION还有另一个让人惊喜的地方——光影效果。

只要绕着车子转一圈，你就会觉得它像个有生命的东西。

对于车迷来说，汽车就跟家人朋友一样亲密。

跟一般的工业产品不同，汽车是为了奔跑而生的。

它们有点像在野外奔驰的动物，或是在赛场上飞奔的运
动员。

当我生出这个念头时，我就W道我不仅要让RX-VISION
美，还要让它“活”起来。

为了达到这个效果，我得给它注入“生命感”。

在思考怎么才能让它看起来更自然时……

我开始实验光线在车身上的反射效果。

就这样，RX-VISION活灵活现地呈现在了大家面前！

不仅如此，他还是领导Mazda所有设计项目的总设计师，
在业界享有盛名。

前田先生还是Mazda“魂动设计”理念的缔造者，可以说是
日本最有名的汽车设计师之一。

conversation.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
conversation.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
conversation.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
conversation.en:
The RX-VISION is a car in which I placed
my car designer life on the line.

I worked on it from the standpoint of really making
the dream sports car I have in my mind.

And one of the most important things for a sports car
is its fundamental structure.

Historic cars that are still popular and beautiful to look at
today all have exceptionally great proportions.

So the first thing we worked on for the RX-VISION
was also the structure.

A textbook FR (Front Engine Rear Drive) with a long nose,
and the ability to place proper load on the rear wheels.

In the final stages, we extended the front nose about 150mm
from the structure we had originally designed,

the part from the front doors up to the front wheel center.

In the very end we made it a slightly unbalanced proportion...

But at that moment we got a lot of traction on the rear wheels,
I thought "This will work!"

That slight unbalance is the hook. It's the secret
to making someone go "Hmm".

The other secret is the reflection of light.

If you look at the RX-VISION as you circle it, I think you'll
notice that the light's reflection moves around like a creature.

Cars are like family or friends to those who are into them.

And it's a very rare industrial product
that runs around on its own.

That makes cars have the same type of existence as animals running
around in the wild, or an athlete running on a field.

And when you think of it that way, I also want cars to be
something that looks beautiful and truly alive in nature.

And for that you need a "sense of life."

So when thinking about what is the sense of life,
that will put cars at one with nature,

we tried to express life in the car with the light's reflections
6nd their beauty on the car's body.

And those are the type of shapes
that are instilled in the RX-VISION.<next id=2600206 type=9݇
conversation.zh:
说到RX-VISION，那可是我赌上专业设计师的身份，
倾注全部心血的作品。

我想通过它，把我脑海中理想跑车的样子变成现实。

设计跑车，最关键的就是定好基本结构。

你看那些经典车型，哪个不是比例优美？

所以我设计RX-VISION时，第一步就是确定它的结构。

我先是采用了教科书般经典的前置引擎后轮驱动
设计——就是那种前脸很长，重心偏后的布局。

然后，在定稿前的最后一刻，我又把前鼻加长了150mm。

具体来说，就是加在了从前门到前轮中心那一段。

这么一改，车身比例看起来有点不太协调……但是这样
做能让后轮抓地力更强。

当时我就想：“嘿，没准这主意不错！”

就这样，一个小小的设计巧思成了这辆车的独特之处。

RX-VISION还有另一个让人惊喜的地方——光影效果。

只要绕着车子转一圈，你就会觉得它像个有生命的东西。

对于车迷来说，汽车就跟家人朋友一样亲密。

跟一般的工业产品不同，汽车是为了奔跑而生的。

它们有点像在野外奔驰的动物，或是在赛场上飞奔的运
动员。

当我生出这个念头时，我就W道我不仅要让RX-VISION
美，还要让它“活”起来。

为了达到这个效果，我得给它注入“生命感”。

在思考怎么才能让它看起来更自然时……

我开始实验光线在车身上的反射效果。

就这样，RX-VISION活灵活现地呈现在了大家面前！

brandCentral.en:
The RX-Vision concept car was first presented at the 2015
Tokyo Motor Show.

Mazda's stated aim when designing it was to create the
world's most beautiful rear-wheel drive sports car.

Its distinctive styling is bursting with life, and is based
on Mazda's 'KODO: Soul of Motion' design theory.

Powered by a naturally aspirated four-rotor engine...

It follows in the footsteps of the Mazda's legendary
787B racing car.|
brandCentral.zh:
这款RX-Vision概念车的首次露面是在2015年
的东京车展。

Mazda表示，此车的设计目的就是打造出全世界最漂亮
的后驱跑车。

以Mazda的“魂动：Soul of motion”设计理念为原点，
它那独特的造型充满了生命力。

追随Mazda传奇赛车787B的脚步，

它也搭载了一台自然进气的四转子引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
This stunning concept provided a glimpse of a next-generation rotary-engine-powered car.

The Mazda RX-VISION was first shown at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Billed then as the company's Rotary Sports Concept.

Based on Mazda's KODO design philosophy, the car was a visual tour de force, with smooth flowing lines and proportions befitting a spiritual successor of the RX-7 and Eunos Cosmo. A bit of mystery surrounded what was under its hood.

All that was disclosed was that it was Mazda's next-generation Skyactiv-R rotary engine.

The catchphrase included the words, "a dream to hopefully achieve one day." That the company still had plans for a future rotary engine was made clear with this machine.

Gran Turismo Sport players had an exclusive chance to sample its prowess in the virtual world in the form of the RX-VISION GT3 Concept.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆采用了次时代转子引擎的优雅概念车。

2015年的东京车展上，马自达在他们的展位上展出了一辆跑车，并赢得了观众极高的关注度。这款车称为RX-VISION，副标题则是“转子运动概念车”。

这款车基于马自达的“魂动”设计理念开发，采用流畅的长车头、短驾驶舱外形，摒弃了一切不必要的线条或平面，追求前置后驱跑车的终极美感。它的外形也清楚地昭示了其双座前中置引擎的布局。

尽管规格详情没有公开，但据描述，这款车采用了下一代的转子引擎“创驰蓝天-R”。

其宣传口号中包含这样一句话，“希望有朝一日可以实现的梦想”。这款车也是全世界广泛转子引擎迷们翘首以盼、希望能够亲眼目睹的梦想。

而在这款车的公路型号公布之前，你已经可以在《跑车浪漫旅 竞速》中驾驶到RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT了。

vehicleCollection.en:
Mazda's dream rotary race car.

The MAZDA RX-VISION is a concept car introduced at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Based on Mazda’s "KODO - Soul of Motion" design theme, the car represented Mazda's attempt to create the most beautiful FR sports car in the company's history. It came powered by the next-generation rotary engine called "SKYACTIV-R."

Back in 1967, Mazda overcame numerous obstacles to produce the first commercial rotary engine in history. It powered the Cosmo Sport and then was fitted to a number of other Mazda cars, including the RX-7, and even those that raced. In 1991, the four-rotor Mazda 787B became the first Japanese car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The MAZDA RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT expresses the design beauty of form following function in a race machine. To meet the performance requirements of the Gr.3 category, the design was inspired by the 787B, specifically the 4-rotor powerplant, now equipped with SKYACTIV technology. This new rotary engine was mounted in a lightweight body to achieve unprecedented performance.
vehicleCollection.zh:
马自达的梦幻转子引擎赛车。

马自达RX-VISION在2015东京车展上以概念车的身份亮相。这台基于马自达的“魂动”设计主题打造的新车旨在挑战自我，创造出最美前置后驱跑车。它还搭载了下一代的转子引擎“创驰蓝天-R”——代表马自达对未来的憧憬。

时间回到1967年，马自达克服了重重技术难关，推出搭载了商用转子引擎的Cosmo Sport。在那之后，作为唯一能够批量生产转子引擎的制造商，他们持之以恒地改进引擎的动力、燃油消耗和耐久性，甚至凭借787B引擎拿下了1991年勒芒24小时耐力赛的最终胜利。

马自达RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT在维持原型车设计美学的基础上，展现了更加凶悍的赛车外观。为了配合组别3级别赛事的性能标准，该车借鉴了787B引擎的设计理念，并采用了经创驰蓝天技术改良的四转子引擎。这款全新的转子引擎搭配轻量化车身，带来空前的性能体验。"

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
This car is based on the RX-VISION that was introduced at the
2015 Tokyo Motor Show.

It's powered by a 4-rotor engine, and you can immediately tell
from its shape that it's a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive car.

This was the future vision of the rotary sports car.

And now, this RX-VISION was made into a race car.

The engine is a naturally-aspirated 4-rotor
rotary called the SKYACTIV-R.

The weight of the car is 1250kg, and it
produces 570ps.

It truly feels like the return of the legendary 787B
as a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive model!
$
dialogues.zh:
这辆车是基于2015年在东京车展上推出的一款名为
“RX-VISION”的汽车。

它由一部四转子引擎提供动力，而且你可以从车的外形
上看出来，这是一款前置引擎后轮驱动的汽车。

在当时，这是对转子发动机跑车的未来展望。

而如今，这款RX-VISION终于被改成了一辆赛车。

引擎是被命名为SKYACTIV-R的四转子自然进气引擎。

整车重量为1250kg，引擎功率为570ps。

看到它，就让人觉得传奇的787B跑车以前置引擎、后轮
驱动的形式王者归来了！

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
This car looks so beautiful no matter which angle
you look at it from.

I see, so it’s a special concept car of Mazda.

I mean, you can tell right away it’s a sportscar,
but its so elegant and attractive.

But the engine sound is a big surprise!

I didn't know engines could sound so crisp and clear!
dialogues.zh:
无论从哪个角度看，这辆车都是那么的漂亮迷人。

我知道了！所以这是一辆Mazda的特别概念赛车！

我是说，你一眼就能看出这是一辆跑车，但它的外形是那么优雅，
那么让人目眩神迷。

可是发动机的声音真的是让人大吃一惊！

我从来不知道发动机也可以发出如此清脆的声音！

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
This is such an exciting car!

From an angle, it seems to begin with a tire and end with a
tire, and the cabin takes up about half the body.

The height of its shoulder is determined by the suspension,
and the rear half of the cabin sits on the driven wheels.

This produces a lot of traction, and that raw power is
reflected in the clean lines of the car's sides.

And, it's channeled to propel the long nose forward!

The clean design features classically Japanese inspirations
such as flowing rivers and split bamboo.

You could even go far as to say it combines an angelic boldness
with a devilish level of detail.

It really is the epitome of "Kodo" design!

Incidentally, the fact that a race version was produced,
seemingly out of the blue...

...is probably related to the fact that the design boss
in Hiroshima is a race driver himsef.

I really can't wait to hear that rotary engine roar!
dialogues.zh:
这是一辆让人热血沸腾的车！

当你从某个特定角度看它的时候，它的线条以一颗轮胎
为始，以另一颗轮胎为终。它的座舱占据了大约车身的1/2。

车辆肩线的高度完全由悬挂的行程决定……座舱后半部
分的重量正落在驱动轮上，

产生大量的牵引力……这股动力沿着展现车辆亮点的侧
面弧线流动……

带着庞大的推力径直冲向长长的车头！

它有破竹的清澈，更有清溪的纯净，简洁的设计带有经
典的日本风韵。

仿佛结合了天使的大胆以及魔鬼的邪恶细节。

“魂动”设计的巅峰，就在此刻，此处！

像这样横空出世般的赛车版本……

可能与广岛工厂的设计总监本身就是一名赛车手有关。

噢，我已经迫不及待想听听它的转子引(轰鸣的声音了！

dialogues.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
dialogues.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
dialogues.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
dialogues.en:
When producing the RX-VISION, I had a long running desire to
make the RX-VISION a GT3 car and compete in the Le Mans.

I'm a car designer, but I have a soft spot for motorsports.

The first movie that I spent my own allowance on to go see in a theater,
during elementary school, was about the 24 hours of Le Mans.

I still remember being really excited to see the fantastic
battles between cars like the Porsche 917 and Ferrari 512S.

It made me want to race at the Le Mans in the future,
and it also was what got me to strive for a job involving cars.

Mazda won the Le Mans,

and that event naturally connected to that scene
of the Le Mans that I dreamed of as a child.

But I want to have everyone take interest in todays motorsports scene,
not just events of the past like the 787B.

I strongly hope to add a new page to Mazda's motorsports.

In that espect the GT3 version of the RX-VISION
was a car that I really wanted to make happen,

and I was able to do that first in Gran Turismo virtually.

This is something I created with the strong conviction,
"that this will be a real car in the future."

And I personally want to drive the Sarthe circuit in this car.
dialogues.zh:
不瞒你说，当RX-VISION还只是张图纸的时候，我就已经
在盘算着有朝一日要让它征战勒芒了。

要知道，我不光是个汽车设计师，还是个赛车迷呢。

还记得我人生第一次自掏腰包买电影票，看的就是讲
勒芒24小时耐力赛的片子。

那会儿看到保时捷917和法拉利512S在赛道上激烈
厮杀，那个兴奋劲儿，到现在我都忘不了。

就是那时候，我萌生了自己也要去勒芒的念头，也是从
那时起，我下定决心要投身汽车行业。

1991年马自达在勒芒的那次胜利……

毫无疑问又一次点燃了我年轻时的梦想。

不过，我觉得我们不能老是躺在787B的功劳簿上。

是时候该为马自达的赛车史开启一页新的篇章。

这就是为什么我铆足了劲要打造RX-VISION的GT3版本……

虽然现在这辆车只在《跑车浪漫旅》（在此感谢游戏）里
作为一辆虚拟车首次亮相。

但我坚信，总有一天，我会亲自驾驶着它……在那条

传说中的萨森赛道上驰骋！

conversation.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
conversation.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
conversation.en:
This is such an exciting car!

From an angle, it seems to begin with a tire and end with a
tire, and the cabin takes up about half the body.

The height of its shoulder is determined by the suspension,
and the rear half of the cabin sits on the driven wheels.

This produces a lot of traction, and that raw power is
reflected in the clean lines of the car's sides.

And, it's channeled to propel the long nose forward!

The clean design features classically Japanese inspirations
such as flowing rivers and split bamboo.

You could even go far as to say it combines an angelic boldness
with a devilish level of detail.

It really is the epitome of "Kodo" design!

Incidentally, the fact that a race version was produced,
seemingly out of the blue...

...is probably related to the fact that the design boss
in Hiroshima is a race driver himsef.

I really can't wait to hear that rotary engine roar!

conversation.en:
When producing the RX-VISION, I had a long running desire to
make the RX-VISION a GT3 car and compete in the Le Mans.

I'm a car designer, but I have a soft spot for motorsports.

The first movie that I spent my own allowance on to go see in a theater,
during elementary school, was about the 24 hours of Le Mans.

I still remember being really excited to see the fantastic
battles between cars like the Porsche 917 and Ferrari 512S.

It made me want to race at the Le Mans in the future,
and it also was what got me to strive for a job involving cars.

Mazda won the Le Mans,

and that event naturally connected to that scene
of the Le Mans that I dreamed of as a child.

But I want to have everyone take interest in todays motorsports scene,
not just events of the past like the 787B.

I strongly hope to add a new page to Mazda's motorsports.

In that espect the GT3 version of the RX-VISION
was a car that I really wanted to make happen,

and I was able to do that first in Gran Turismo virtually.

This is something I created with the strong conviction,
"that this will be a real car in the future."

And I personally want to drive the Sarthe circuit in this car.

vehicleCollection.en:
Mazda's dream rotary race car.

The MAZDA RX-VISION is a concept car introduced at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Based on Mazda’s "KODO - Soul of Motion" design theme, the car represented Mazda's attempt to create the most beautiful FR sports car in the company's history. It came powered by the next-generation rotary engine called "SKYACTIV-R."

Back in 1967, Mazda overcame numerous obstacles to produce the first commercial rotary engine in history. It powered the Cosmo Sport and then was fitted to a number of other Mazda cars, including the RX-7, and even those that raced. In 1991, the four-rotor Mazda 787B became the first Japanese car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The MAZDA RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT expresses the design beauty of form following function in a race machine. To meet the performance requirements of the Gr.3 category, the design was inspired by the 787B, specifically the 4-rotor powerplant, now equipped with SKYACTIV technology. This new rotary engine was mounted in a lightweight body to achieve unprecedented performance.
vehicleCollection.zh:
马自达的梦幻转子引擎赛车。

马自达RX-VISION在2015东京车展上以概念车的身份亮相。这台基于马自达的“魂动”设计主题打造的新车旨在挑战自我，创造出最美前置后驱跑车。它还搭载了下一代的转子引擎“创驰蓝天-R”——代表马自达对未来的憧憬。

时间回到1967年，马自达克服了重重技术难关，推出搭载了商用转子引擎的Cosmo Sport。在那之后，作为唯一能够批量生产转子引擎的制造商，他们持之以恒地改进引擎的动力、燃油消耗和耐久性，甚至凭借787B引擎拿下了1991年勒芒24小时耐力赛的最终胜利。

马自达RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT在维持原型车设计美学的基础上，展现了更加凶悍的赛车外观。为了配合组别3级别赛事的性能标准，该车借鉴了787B引擎的设计理念，并采用了经创驰蓝天技术改良的四转子引擎。这款全新的转子引擎搭配轻量化车身，带来空前的性能体验。"

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
If you ask me, this car is less of a design study than it is
a study in aerodynamics.

The roofline runs straight across the body to the rear,
where it abruptly cuts off in a coda tronca.

This tells me that it may have been developed as a prototype
for engineering purposes.
dialogues.zh:
依我看，这辆车更像是一项“空气动力学研究”
而非“设计研究”。

车顶线条贯穿整车一直延伸到后部，
突然以coda tronca的形式戛然而止。

我有个大胆推测，它可能是以工程研究为目的
而开发的原型车。

dialogues.speaker: Sarah
dialogues.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
dialogues.en:
That’s right, it refers to a truncated tail, or rear.
What we call a "Kamm Tail" in English.

The Kamm Tail is named after the German aerodynamicist
Wunibald Kamm, who theorized the design in the 1930s.
dialogues.zh:
没错，它指的是尾部被截短。
在英语中通常被称为“Kamm tail”（断尾）。

这一术语源自于德国空气动力学家温纳尔德·卡姆
（Wunibald Kamm），他在上世纪30年代提出了这种设计理念。

collection.en:
The Mazda RX500 is a supercar that is nothing short of mythical.

It was built in 1970 for the 50th anniversary of Toyo Kogyo,
known as Mazda today, and displayed at the Tokyo Motor Show.

This RX500 was conceived as a successor
to the famed 'Cosmo Sport' of the 1960s.

Unlike the Cosmo Sport however, its rotary engine was not
 mounted in front but positioned rear-midship.

And this rotary engine was a high rpm type that would
rev up to 14000rpm.

With 247 HP and weighing only 850kg,
the RX500 was an extremely fast car.

Only one RX500 was ever built as a concept model, and in
2008 it was restored by Mazda to its original glory.
collection.zh:
Mazda RX500是一款神奇的超级跑车。

它于1970年为了纪念Toyo Kogyo（即现在的Mazda）
创立50周年而制造，并在东京车展上展出。

RX500是60年代广负盛名的Cosmo Sport的继任者。

与Cosmo Sport不同的是，它的转子引擎没有安装在前面，而是
采用了中后置布局。

这款转子引擎专为高转速而调校，最高转速高达14000rpm。

高达250ps的马力配上仅有850kg重的车身，RX500的速度快得惊人。

RX500仅有一台概念车存世。在2008年，经Mazda修缮后，它恢复
了往日的神采。

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultra-exotic concept featured a rotary engine and cutting-edge technology.

Created to commemorate the 50th anniversary of Toyo Kogyo (Mazda), the RX500 concept car was introduced to the world in 1970. It featured the company's revolutionary rotary engine, which made its debut in the Cosmo Sport three years prior, and an unforgettable bullet-shaped body that focused on aerodynamics.

The designers of the car experimented with several different versions of the RX500, including a coupe with a beautiful rear section and a race car with a rear wing, but opted to go for the car you see here because of its superior Cd (drag coefficient) value of 0.31. In terms of styling, the car was truly before its time; for example, its upswing doors were introduced before those of the Lamborghini Countach.

The powerplant, mounted amidships in a steel-tube space frame, was a 10A rotary engine built for the company's Spa 24 Hours race car and produced more than 250ps. It came mated to a 4-speed manual gearbox from the RX87 Luce Rotary Coupe. Top speed was expected to exceed <250km/h>, and the brake system featured 4-piston calipers and 4-wheel ventilated discs, which represented cutting-edge technology for that time, as only a very few racing cars boasted a similar set-up.
vehicleCollection.zh:
搭载了转子引擎和尖端科技的超跑概念车。

马自达RX500是为了纪念马自达的前身，东洋工业株式会社成立50周年而打造的概念跑车，也是对马自达转子引擎的绝佳展示。全球首台商用的转子引擎就装在马自达1967年款的Cosmo Sport身上。

RX500令人印象深刻的子弹造型是在综合考虑空气动力学效果后做出的决定。在车身制模阶段，公司内的设计师们曾制作过一款双门版本，拥有美妙的车尾，另外还有加装了尾翼的竞赛版本。但最后，马自达选择了这个在风洞测试中获得优秀成绩（风阻值0.31）的造型。不仅如此，在兰博基尼Countach问世之前，RX500就已经用了上开式剪刀门。

装在空间钢管车架上的中置引擎是一台为斯帕24小时耐力赛打造的10A转子引擎，可以输出超过250ps。传动系统则是一款RX87 Luce Rotary Coupe上使用的4速手动变速箱。这台车的预期最高时速是<250km/h>。刹车系统则包括了四活塞卡钳和四轮通风碟刹，以应对极速下的制动需求。这是一台集当时先进科技于大成的车型，恐怕只有少数赛车的配置能与之媲美。

brandCentral.en:
Have you heard of MAZDA SPIRIT RACING? It’s a new brand born
of Mazda’s exceptional achievements in motorsports.

One car that embodied the full extent of Mazda’s racing
expertise was the MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R.

As its name suggested, it was based on the ND Mazda Roadster,
although beneath the surface it was something totally different.

The 2.0-liter engine is a rarity in Japanese soft-tops—featuring
hand-assembled heads and pistons.

In terms of power, it pushed the boundaries of what a
production car could achieve, with 200ps.

Its chassis was reinforced, the suspension used height-adjustable
Bilstein dampers, and the brakes supplied by Brembo.

Alas, production was limited to just 200 units. A true works-tuned
roadster, it was a rare and shining gem.
brandCentral.zh:
你听说过MAZDA SPIRIT RACING吗？
这个全新品牌源自Mazda在赛车领域的非凡成就。

MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R正是一款
凝聚了Mazda所有赛车技术的集大成之作。

顾名思义，它基于ND Mazda Roadster打造，
但其内部构造却焕然一新。

这台2升引擎在日本敞篷跑车中极为罕见，
配备特制气缸盖和活塞，全部由手工组装。

在动力性能方面，它将量产车规格推向极致，
可爆发出200ps的强劲动力。

底盘刚性十足，悬挂采用高度可调的Bilstein减震器，
刹车系统则来自Brembo制造。

遗憾的是产量仅限200台！
相信我，这款经过厂队调校的敞篷跑车堪称稀世珍品！

vehicleCollection.en:
With only 200 units ever produced, this is the ultimate works-tuned roadster.!

“MAZDA SPIRIT RACING” was an initiative launched by Mazda to cement the company’s place in motorsports and to cultivate new talent through racing. Competing in events such as the Super Endurance Series with a large crew made up of Mazda employees, it grew into a formidable presence in the sport.

From this foundation, the team created a car that embodied the skills and knowledge it had gained through years of competition. That car was unveiled as the “MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R” in early 2025 at the Tokyo Auto Salon.

As its name suggested, it was based on the ND Mazda Roadster. But beneath the familiar silhouette, it was packed with works-grade components.

The centerpiece was its engine, built on a 2.0-liter block not normally offered in the domestic soft-top model, enhanced with a specially tuned head, pistons, and exhaust manifold among other components, each unit painstakingly assembled by hand. The power had been pushed close to the very limit of what was achievable in a production car that also demanded durability, ultimately delivering 200ps.

Its chassis reflected the lessons learned from the Super Endurance Series. Among them was the suspension that used height-adjustable Bilstein dampers, while the brakes were equipped with 4-piston calipers from Brembo. It featured forged Rays wheels, identical to those used on race cars.

Other special parts included Recaro seats and a Fujitsubo exhaust system. With production capped at just 200 units, the ROADSTER 12R stood as perhaps the ultimate works-tuned roadster.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这是一台经过官方调校的终极敞篷跑车，全球限量仅200台。

马自达灵魂车队”是马自达为确立品牌在赛车领域的地位，并通过赛车培养新兴人才的一个项目。通过组织公司员工组成庞大的团队参加如超级耐力锦标赛等赛事，马自达灵魂车队逐渐成长为赛车界不容忽视的存在。

团队将把在赛车中积累的所有技能与知识，融入到一款全新车型的设计之中。这款“马自达灵魂车队ROADSTER 12R”于2025年初在东京汽车沙龙迎来首秀。

顾名思义，这台车基于ND Mazda Roadster打造而成。可以说，这辆车满载了官方车队使用的各类部件的精华。

其核心亮点在于引擎：采用了日本国内市场敞篷版车型鲜少配备的2升缸体，并增配了专门调校的气缸盖、活塞及排气歧管等部件，且每台引擎均采用手工组装。在确保部件耐受性的前提下，这款量产车的功率输出已逼近理论极限，最终达到200ps。

底盘设计充分参考了车队在超级耐力锦标赛中汲取的丰富经验。例如，悬挂采用了倍适登特别调校的可调高度减震器，刹车则是一套布雷博四活塞卡钳。莱耶斯锻造轮毂与赛车同款。

其他特殊零部件更是不胜枚举，如瑞卡罗桶椅和藤壶排气。该车限量生产200台，堪称是一台经过官方调校的终极敞篷跑车。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
The Mazda RX-7 is synonymous with rotary-engine sports cars.

This is the 3rd-gen model from 1991, also known
as the 'FD.'

It notably bears the name and emblem of
Mazda’s former luxury vehicle division, 'ɛ̃fini.'

The FD RX-7 is a light and powerful car.

Pressing down on the accelerator, you immediately
feel the limitless motive power of its rotary engine.

And its low, wide stance becomes apparent as soon
as you get behind the wheel.

Seen from the outside, it’s a thing of beauty,
and a legend in the annals of Mazda history.
dialogues.zh:
Mazda RX-7是转子引擎跑车的代名词。

眼前这款是1991年推出的第三代车型，代号是“FD”。

其车名与徽标源自Mazda旗下的前豪华车部门——
“ɛ̃fini”，可谓声名显赫。

尽管FD RX-7身轻如燕，动力却相当澎湃。

当你深踩油门，转子引擎那源源不绝的强劲动力
便会瞬间涌现。

而一旦坐进驾驶舱，其低趴、宽体的战斗姿态更是展露无遗。

从旁观赏，它堪称一件工业艺术品，
更是Mazda品牌史上的一段不朽传奇。

usedCar.en:
The 1990s marked a golden era for Japanese sports cars,
and perhaps none was more iconic than the RX-7.

This is the third-generation ɛ̃fini RX-7, introduced in 1991. It
is often referred to as the “FD,” a nod to its chassis code.

With its wide body and tires, the globally positioned FD was
never constrained by Japan’s strict size regulations.

Like the model before it, it runs on a 13B rotary engine, this time
paired with a sequential twin-turbo producing 255ps.

Equing a fine-tuned double-wishbone suspension system,
the FD weighs 1260kg and boasts a 5kg/hp ratio.

At launch, the most focused variant, the Type R, featured shorter
gearing and suspension tuned for sharper acceleration.

A breathtaking machine that seems untouched by time, the FD
stands as a rotary sports car legend for the history books.*
usedCar.zh:
20世纪90年代是日本跑车的黄金时代，
而其中最具传奇色彩的，或许当属RX-7。

眼前这台便是1991年首发的第三代ɛ̃fini RX-7。
车迷们常以其底盘代号“FD”来亲切称呼它。

FD拥有宽体设计与大尺寸轮胎，
其全球化的定位让它得以摆脱日本严苛的尺寸法规束缚。

它继承了前代的13B转子引擎，
但辅以一套可输出255ps的串列式双涡轮增压系统。

得益于高性能双叉臂悬架，FD的车重被控制在1260kg，
重量推力比达到5kg/马力。

作为最初也最极端的版本，Type R车型
配备了专为迅猛加速而调校的终传比与悬架。

FD之美，历久弥新，惊艳如初。
它无疑是转子跑车史上一位值得大书特书的杰出代表。<

vehicleCollection.en:
The debut model of the third-generation RX-7, a car developed to be the ultimate sports car.

The FD3S, the third-generation RX-7, made its debut in December 1991. The “Savanna” name used on earlier versions was retired, and the model was rebadged as the ɛ̃fini RX-7.

To accommodate wider tires, the FD3S was significantly widened. Even so, extensive use of aluminum for the hood, spare wheel, jack, and front and rear double-wishbone suspension kept curb weight to a remarkable 1260kg, despite the increase in size.

Power came from the 13B Turbo carried over from the FC3S. But the addition of a new sequential twin-turbo system raised output to 255ps and 30.0kgm of torque. In its lighter Type S form, the power-to-weight ratio reached <4.90kg/ps>, making it the fastest RX-7 ever released and a platform with enormous potential.

The FD3S continued to evolve throughout its lifecycle. Body rigidity, engine management, and ABS specifications were refined year after year. The original Type I introduced in 1991 progressed through Type II and Type III, culminating in the Type VI released in 2000.

Ultimately, the RX-7 could not meet the tightening environmental standards of the 21st century. In August 2002, the RX-7 Spirit R was released as a final commemorative model, closing the book on 25 years of RX-7 production.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第三代RX-7车型首发，旨在成为一款终极跑车。)

FD3S，即第三代RX-7，于1991年12月首次亮相。先前版本的名称“Savanna”不再沿用，而是重新命名为ɛ̃fini RX-7。

为了适应更宽的轮胎，FD3S的车身被大幅加宽，但其引擎盖、备胎、千斤顶以及前后双叉臂悬挂均为铝制，所以尽管尺寸增加，但车身重量却奇迹般地降至1260kg。

和FC3S一样，FD3S采用了13B涡轮引擎。但得益于新引入的串列式双涡轮增压器，让输出提高到了255ps和30.0kgm的扭矩。而车身更轻的Type S的马力重量比更是达到了<4.90kg/ps>，是有史以来最快的RX-7，而且升级潜力巨大。

FD3S持续进化车身刚性、车载电脑和ABS的规格年复一年地获得升级。从1991年诞生的Type I，发展到Type II和Type III，最后演化为2000年的Type VI。

long.en:
The FD3S, the third-generation RX-7, made its debut in December 1991. The “Savanna” name used on earlier versions was retired, and the model was rebadged as the ɛ̃fini RX-7.

To accommodate wider tires, the FD3S was significantly widened. Even so, extensive use of aluminum for the hood, spare wheel, jack, and front and rear double-wishbone suspension kept curb weight to a remarkable 1260kg, despite the increase in size.

Power came from the 13B Turbo carried over from the FC3S. But the addition of a new sequential twin-turbo system raised output to 255ps and 30.0kgm of torque. In its lighter Type S form, the power-to-weight ratio reached <4.90kg/ps>, making it the fastest RX-7 ever released and a platform with enormous potential.

The FD3S continued to evolve throughout its lifecycle. Body rigidity, engine management, and ABS specifications were refined year after year. The original Type I introduced in 1991 progressed through Type II and Type III, culminating in the Type VI released in 2000.

Ultimately, the RX-7 could not meet the tightening environmental standards of the 21st century. In August 2002, the RX-7 Spirit R was released as a final commemorative model, closing the book on 25 years of RX-7 production.

为了适应更宽的轮胎，FD3S的车身被大幅加宽，但其引擎盖、备胎、千斤顶以及前后双叉臂悬挂均为铝制，所以尽管尺寸增加，但车身重量却奇迹般地降至1260kg。

FD3S持续进化车身刚性、车载电脑和ABS的规格年复一年地获得升级。从1991年诞生的Type I，发展到Type II和Type III，最后演化为2000年的Type VI。

dialogues.speaker: Ikuo Maeda

dialogues.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
dialogues.en:
In the Japanese Super Endurance Series,
I myself race in the MAZDA3 race car.

Lots of effort went into the MAZDA3 as a production model
of course, but it was also drawn with the racing scene in mind.

In this racing modified version as well, I tried to maintain
the original shape of the MAZDA3 as much as possible.

The modification including the livery is something that doesn't
disrupt the beauty and silhouette of the car.

Another point of focus was how good it looks when running.

Like how the rear tread sticks out like
a proper Super Endurance race car.

When you're overtaken by this car, I think you'll really notice
how good it looks from the back...

...so on the track, I'd appreciate if you would let me pass!
dialogues.zh:
我跟你讲，我在日本超级耐力系列赛中可是真开过这辆
马自达3赛车哦！

马自达3本身是款普通的量产车型，不过我们设计的时候
就已经考虑到了它未来可能会上赛道。

所以在打造赛车版本的时候，我们尽量保留了原版的帅
气造型。

不光是车身轮廓线条，连车身涂装我们都精心设计，
就是想让它保持原车的美感。

当然啦，我们也得让它在赛道上看起来够劲儿。

怎么做到的？我们给它装上了更宽的后轮轴，也是超级
耐力赛车的标配。

效果太棒了，尤其是超车的时候，那叫一个帅气！

所以呢，要是哪天你在赛道上碰到我，可得乖乖让道。
然后你就知道它的超车有多帅气了！

brandCentral.en:
This Gr.4 racing car is based on the MAZDA3...

Which was built to compete in the Super Taikyu series, one
of Japan’s most storied events for production touring cars.

Small but stylish, its swan-neck rear spoiler is among
its many design highlights.

vehicleCollection.en:
Exploring the potential of internal combustion, a next-generation bio-diesel-powered race car.

This MAZDA3 Gr. 4, featured here, is a Gran Turismo original model, aesthetically based on the Super Taikyu spec. MAZDA3 Bio concept.

The MAZDA3 Bio concept car is a next-generation, bio-diesel-powered race car, created for real-world testing in the 2023 Super Taikyu endurance race series.

It is the spiritual successor to Mazda’s Bio concept Demio, also known as the MAZDA2 Bio concept, which was created in 2021 with the dual pursuit of achieving carbon neutrality and preserving the joy of driving. Both vehicles participated in the ST-Q class, a category almost exclusively reserved for manufacturer development prototypes.

The car ran on 100-percent next-generation bio-diesel fuel refined from used cooking oil. Under the hood was a 2.2-liter SkyActiv-D diesel engine.

The car itself went through extensive modifications. To reduce weight, components such as the engine hood and roof were crafted from hybrid materials that combine carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP) with natural fibers. Aerodynamic efficiency was enhanced through wider front and rear fenders, while new aero components, including a front spoiler, rear wing, and side skirts, were added to further optimize performance.
vehicleCollection.zh:
下一代生物燃料赛车，继续发掘内燃机的潜力。

这款马自达3组别4赛车，如图所示，是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，其外观借鉴了日本超级耐力赛规格的马自达3 Bio赛车。

其原型车马自达3 Bio concept是新一代采用生物柴油供能的赛车，该项目的立项与开发是为了实际参与2023年的日本超级耐力赛。

它也是马自达Bio concept Demio/马自达2 Bio concept概念车的后继者。两台生物柴油概念车自2021年起便开始参加超级耐力赛ST-Q组别（专为各家厂商的技术开发中车型设置）的比赛，意图在“碳中和”以及“提升娱乐性”中寻找到恰到好处的平衡点。

该车使用的生物柴油完全由废弃食用油制备。车型搭载的是一台2.2L 创驰蓝天-D引擎。

作为赛车，改装自然必不可少。为了减重，引擎盖和车顶等部位均应用了由碳纤维复合材料和天然纤维打造的复合型材料。而为了提高空气动力学性能，车身的前后轮挡泥板都相应加宽，并装上了前扰流板、尾翼和侧裙。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
If you’re looking for a stylish hatchback, you can’t
go wrong with the MAZDA3.

The MAZDA3 comes in two body types: a 5-door hatchback
and a 4-door sedan.

That said, the fact that they have so few shared parts
is proof of their purposeful design.

Take the smooth roof line of the hatchback—it’s so beautiful
that Mazda went and marketed it as a fastback.

What’s more, this MAZDA3 fastback comes in a
"burgundy selection" grade!

From the seats to the interior panels, everything in this
package is expressed in a most distinctive shade of red.
dialogues.zh:
如果你想要找一辆外观时尚的掀背车，选MAZDA3准没错！

MAZDA3提供两种车身版本选择：5门掀背版和4门轿车版。

尽管同属一个车型，但二者之间的通用配件却不多，
这也证明了它们的设计目标性非常明确。

以掀背版本为例，它那流畅的车顶线条非常优雅，而Mazda
也特意将其宣传为“斜背车”。

另外，这款MAZDA3掀背版还供应“勃艮第红”版！

从座椅到内饰板材，一切配置
都采用了最特别的红色调处理。

dialogues.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
dialogues.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
dialogues.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计
dialogues.en:
I think the MAZDA3 is one of the top 5 cars
in my career as a car designer.

The design of the MAZDA3 also trails back to the RX-VISION.

In the RX-VISION, I created a form that expresses
a sense of life in the beauty of its reflections.

And the design of the MAZDA3 is an achievement of that form
created in the RX-VISION, in the C segment.

It's one of my personal favorites, and I think its a car
that will mark its name in history.
dialogues.zh:
MAZDA3可以说是我的职业生涯中最有代表性的五款车之一。

它的设计其实和RX-VISION挺有渊源的。

我在设计RX-VISION的时候，创造了一种通过漂亮的光
影折射效果让车身“活”过来的造型。

而MAZDA3呢，就是把这种设计应用到了C级车上。

我个人很喜欢MAZDA3。我敢打包票，这款车绝对会成为
汽车设计史上的一个亮点！

brandCentral.en:
This MAZDA3 fastback is especially prized
for its beautiful design.

In Japan, it has long been referred to as the Axela.

But ever since the debut of this fourth-gen model in 2018,
it has been known around the world as the MAZDA3.

Distinguished by its phenomenal styling, which adopts Mazda’s
"KODO" design language...

...this hatchback, with its beautiful roof line,
is referred to as a fastback in some markets.

In 2020, it won the World Car Design of the Year title,
an award celebrating the best international car design.
brandCentral.zh:
斜背版MAZDA3因其靓丽的设计造型而深受消费者喜爱。

在日本，这辆车被称为“Axela”（昂克赛拉）。

不过随着第4代型号于2018年亮相，它在全世界
打响了“MAZDA3”这个名号。

它那现象级的外观设计充分体现了Mazda的“魂动”
设计语言，优雅而独树一帜……

这款掀背车拥有美妙的车顶线条，并以“斜背车”的身份
在部分市场展开宣传。

在2020年，这款车赢得了国际性的汽车设计奖项——
世界汽车年度最佳设计大奖。

vehicleCollection.en:
An elegant fastback with a revolutionary combustion system.

This MAZDA3 represents the fourth-generation model of Mazda's C-segment passenger car first released in November 2018. Back then, it was called the Axela in Japan, but with this model, it went by the moniker "MAZDA3" all around the world.

Like its predecessor, this MAZDA3 came in both fastback and sedan versions, but thanks to the company's "KODO" design language, the character of the car became more refined. The shape of the fastback was especially impressive, with the delicate form of the body panels beautifully expressing the subtle transition of light.

Powering the car was a new SKYACTIV engine. The base MAZDA3 models came with a 1.5-liter and 2.0-liter direct injection gasoline engines. There was a 1.8-liter turbo diesel powerplant and a 2.0-liter "Mild-Hybrid" (M-Hybrid) version that came a little later. The M-Hybrid was powered by the SKYACTIV-X engine that introduced proprietary spark-controlled compression ignition, a revolutionary technology that suppressed carbon emissions without relying on expensive solutions like the Urea-SCR.

The X Burgundy Selection was a special model with a burgundy interior on the Grade X model. Equipped with wine-colored leather seats and dashboard, this special model exuded a classy, uniquely mature aura.
vehicleCollection.zh:
采用了革命性的新引擎、外观优雅的斜背车。

马自达3于2018年11月上市，是马自达推出的第四代C级乘用车，其前代型号在日本也被称为昂克赛拉。这辆第四代型号是马自达全新一代产品中的第一款车，因此在全球范围内统一使用了“马自达3”的名字。

如之前型号一样，它也提供斜背和轿车两种车型，不过在马自达“魂动”设计语言的加持下，每种车型的特征都更加鲜明。它的斜背车型尤为引人注目，车身板件的精妙轮廓反映出了美轮美奂的光线变幻。

为这辆车提供动力的引擎源自马自达的新一代创驰蓝天引擎。主力型号包括1.5升和2升直喷汽油引擎款和1.8升柴油涡轮增压引擎款，之后又推出了一款2升“轻度混合动力”（M-Hybrid）型号，由一台创驰蓝天-X引擎供能。这款引擎引入了独家专利的火花控制压缩点火技术，而且这款革命性的引擎无需采用像Urea-SCR那样昂贵的解决方案便能够抑制氮氧化合物（NOx）输出。

这辆X Burgundy Selection是一款基于Grade X型号、采用了勃艮第红配色内饰的特殊型号。它的酒红色真皮座椅和仪表板彰显出了优雅的格调和成熟的韵味。

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
The McLaren 650S has classic mid-engine proportions,
executed in a very fresh way.

It has a very bold and distinct face,
as well as a strong rear.

All of the shapes, curves, plan views, and overall profile
work together...

Highlighted by the side scoop and side glass shape.
dialogues.zh:
McLaren 650S拥有经典的中置引擎比例，
但以一种非常新颖的方式呈现。

它的前脸大胆而独特，车尾设计也风格鲜明。

从车身造型、曲线、表面效果到整体轮廓，无不协调融洽……

侧进气口和侧窗玻璃形状更是将这一特点重点凸显出来。

brandCentral.en:
The 650S Coupe was the successor to the McLaren MP4-12C.

Mounted amidships in the lightweight carbon-fiber chassis
was a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter V-8...

...that cranked out a massive 650ps, which is
reflected in the car's name.

McLaren's patented active suspension was refined even
further to provide neck-wrenching handling.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆650S Coupe是McLaren MP4-12C的后继车型。

3.8L V8双涡轮增压引擎安装在一套轻量化碳纤维底盘的
中部……

可以输出最大650ps的动力，因此被命名为650。

McLaren还针对这一型号专门调校了其专利的主动式悬挂系统
的设置。.

vehicleCollection.en:
The 650S supercar came loaded with F1 technology.

McLaren introduced the 650S at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show as the successor to its amazing MP4-12C, which signaled the company’s willingness to duke it out with Ferrari in the exotic production-car market, as wells at in Formula 1.

The 650S was designed to be the high performance version of the MP4-12C, as it shared the basic structure with its predecessor. It sported an extremely light-yet-rigid carbon-fiber monocoque body that helped keep its curb weight down to 1360kg. The styling was updated from the MP4-12C, with a freshened face and improved aerodynamics.

The Proactive Chassis Control suspension was also based on the one in the MP4-12C, but revised to provide sharper responses and a smoother ride quality. Also making its way from the MP4-12C into the 650S was the torque vectoring brake steering and variable rear wing.

The car’s name came from the power derived from its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8 that produced 650ps and 69.1kgm of torque. The fire-breathing engine came mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox that exhibited smoother shifts than that of its predecessor, and allowed the driver to choose three different shift maps: normal, sports, and tracks.

The 650S’s performance was certainly world-class with a zero-to-<100km/h> time of 3.0 seconds, a zero-to-400m time of 10.5 and a top speed of <333km/h>.
vehicleCollection.zh:
当MP4-12C进化成了豪华超跑。

迈凯伦的超级跑车650S发布于2014年的日内瓦车展，接力迈凯伦首次全力进军超跑领域的车型MP4-12C。

该车型在策划之初是MP4-12C的高性能版，沿用相同的基本结构——至轻至坚固的碳纤维“单体车壳”，重量也与前者基本相当，为1360kg。

在造型方面，这款车的正面给人的印象与旗舰车型P1相似，但这其实是为了改善空气动力学性能而作的改进。从后面看，这款车几乎和MP4-12C一模一样，将其看作是改进车款也不无道理。

正如车名所示，650S使用的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎被调整为650ps/69.1kgm的动力输出。所配备的7档双离合变速箱在改进后换挡更加顺滑。搭载的驾驶模式选择器可以在普通、跑车和赛道三个模式之间切换。

主动式底盘控制悬挂在机械结构方面保持不变，但经过调整，使响应更加灵敏的同时保持迈凯伦超跑知名的舒适度。

当然，这款车也保留了扭矩矢量分配制动转向和提供空气制动的可变式尾翼。

0-<100km/h>的加速时间为3.0秒；0-400米所需时间为10.5秒，最高时速可达到<333km/h>。

该车型在策划之初是MP4-12C的高性能版，沿用相同的基本结构——至轻至坚固的碳纤维“单体车壳”，重量也与前者基本相当，为1360kg。

在造型方面，这款车的正面给人的印象与旗舰车型P1相似，但这其实是为了改善空气动力学性能而作的改进。从后面看，这款车几乎和MP4-12C一模一样，将其看作是改进车款也不无道理。

正如车名所示，650S使用的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎被调整为650ps/69.1kgm的动力输出。所配备的7档双离合变速箱在改进后换挡更加顺滑。搭载的驾驶模式选择器可以在普通、跑车和赛道三个模式之间切换。

主动式底盘控制悬挂在机械结构方面保持不变，但经过调整，使响应更加灵敏的同时保持迈凯伦超跑知名的舒适度。

当然，这款车也保留了扭矩矢量分配制动转向和提供空气制动的可变式尾翼。

0-<100km/h>的加速时间为3.0秒；0-400米所需时间为10.5秒，最高时速可达到<333km/h>。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

brandCentral.en:
Based on the 650S, this racing variant was developed in
accordance with FIA GT3 specifications.

It received acclaim after claiming victory at the 2016
Bathurst 12 Hour in Australia.

Numerous improvements have been made since the days of the
MP4-12C, such as the expansion of the front treads.

The front canards and large rear wing are a few of the more
notable additions made to enhance the car's aerodynamics.
brandCentral.zh:
这个赛车版本基于650S开发，符合国际汽联GT3的规范。

在2016年赢得了澳大利亚巴瑟斯特12小时耐力赛后，这辆
车收获了业界的广泛赞誉。

相较于MP4-12C时代，这辆车有了大幅的改进，例如扩宽了前
轮轮距。

此外，车身的空气动力学性能也有所提升，增加了前翼
和大尺寸尾翼等套件。

vehicleCollection.en:
The GT3 successor to the remarkable MP4-12C race car.

McLaren introduced the 650S at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show as the successor to its amazing MP4-12C, which signaled the company’s willingness to duke it out with Ferrari in the exotic production-car market, as wells at in Formula 1.

The car’s name came from the power derived from its twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8 that produced 650ps and 69.1kgm of torque. The fire-breathing engine came mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox that exhibited smoother shifts than that of its predecessor, and allowed the driver to choose three different shift maps: normal, sports, and tracks.

The 650S’s performance was certainly world-class with a zero-to-<100km/h> time of 3.0 seconds, a zero-to-400m time of 10.5 and a top speed of <333km/h>.

The race spec version of the 650S, introduced three months after the road car, was called the 650S GT3. As its name implied, it was developed in line with FIA-GT3 regulations. The 650S GT3 was the successor to the the MP4-12C GT3, the race car McLaren introduced in 2011. The MP4-12C GT3 contested in GT races all over the world, including the Blancpain endurance series and SCCA World Challenge.

Like the MP4-12C, the basic structure of the 650S GT3 consisted of a carbon mono cell taken from the road car; however, the suspension system was completely revised. The car came equipped with exterior carbon parts that further improved upon the MP4-12C GT3's excellent aerodynamics, thanks to a larger splitter and redesigned door mirrors.

The twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-8's power was restricted down to 500ps in line with GT3 regulations, but McLaren announced that there were additional improvements made to increase durability of various parts.

The 2015 650S GT3 won the 2015 GT Asia and the Bathurst 12-hour race in the beginning of 2016.
vehicleCollection.zh:
在凶猛而性感的野兽的排气共鸣声中沉迷。

迈凯伦的超级跑车650S发布于2014年的日内瓦车展，接力迈凯伦首次全力进军超跑领域的车型MP4-12C。

其基本结构沿袭自MP4-12C，正面外观与旗舰车型P1相似。和P1一样，这款车也采用了轻质高强度的碳纤维单体车壳作为车体骨架，同时配备了动力调高至650ps/69.1kgm的3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎。重量和MP4-12C相当，为1360公斤，但性能更高，0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需3秒，最高时速可达<333km/h>。

650S的竞速版车型为650S GT3。顾名思义，这款车是根据国际汽联-GT3规则设计的，并在650S公路版跑车发布3个月后发布。650S GT3将取代2011年亮相的迈凯伦GT跑车：MP4-12C GT3。MP4-12C GT3活跃在世界各地的GT赛场上，包括宝珀耐力系列赛和美国赛车俱乐部世界挑战赛等。

和MP4-12C一样，650S GT3的基本结构也采用了和公路版相同的碳纤维单体车壳，但悬挂却被完全修改，胎面也比MP4-12C宽52mm。650S GT3还配备了MP4-12C同款碳纤维空气动气学组件，并且安装了更大的分流器，对后视镜也进行了重新设计，空气动力学性能得到进一步提高。

引擎仍为3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎，和MP4-12C的GT版本一样，为了符合GT3规则，这款车的马力被限制为500ps。据称，迈凯伦对各种零件的耐久性进行了额外的改善。

2015款650S GT3在2015年亚洲GT系列赛和2016年初的巴瑟斯特12小时耐力赛屡获殊荣。)

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
These days, it's rare to see one person's vision result in a
product that reflects his intent to the smallest details.

Setting out to create a fresh car, the genius Gordon Murray
came up with the concept.

He then handed the reins to designer Peter Stevens.
The result is the F1 you see here.

The concept, which became the base for the F1, was for it to
be "a super sports car that could be driven every day."

Some say that the first-generation
Honda NSX served as the benchmark.

The center-forward driving position in a three-seat
configuration helped to balance the car.

...and also keeping the car's height to a low 1140mm.

But the design is well-executed,
without any strangeness to it at all. I do like it.
dialogues.zh:
近几十年来，我们鲜少能看到将设计师的意图
贯彻到每一处细节的作品。

天才设计师戈登·穆雷曾提出过一辆新车的概念构想，

然后将接力棒交到了彼得·史蒂文斯手中。
两人的合作成果就是你眼前的这台F1。

F1的设计初衷，就是创造一辆
“可以日常驾驶的超级跑车”。

还有人说它的设计对标参照物是第一代本田NSX。

这辆车有许多独到之处。例如在三座布局中，
将驾驶员座椅放在前排居中位置，以使重量分配达到最优，

……亦或是将车身高度降到只有1140mm。

迈凯伦在实现设计时做的非常到位，没有一丝不协调感。
我很欣赏这一点。

conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

conversation.zh: 这辆车……你是它的车主吗？

Are you by chance Mr. Hideo Kodama? The designer who had a

conversation.zh:
您不会是儿玉英雄吧？
曾经参与过德国Opel公司的诸多名车的那位设计师？"

Yes! I'm Kodama.
It's a pleasure to meet the both of you.

The pleasure is ours, Kodama-san.
What an honor it is to make your acquaintance!

Kodama-san was the chief designer at Opel.
He worked for more than 40 years in Opel's design department.

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic
vintage-car event, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este.

应该高兴的是我们，儿玉先生。
认识您真是荣幸！

他在Opel的设计部门工作了超过40年。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展
的评审委员之一。

collection.en:
Is the McLaren F1 the greatest supercar of them all?
Quite possibly.

McLaren's founder, Bruce McLaren, had always wanted
to enter the road car business...

But died in 1970 before a true production car
could be developed.

The company would not start working on road cars again
until the late 1980s.

This three-seater McLaren F1 was finally born in 1992.

Conceived and engineered by Gordon Murray, the exterior
and interior were designed by Peter Stevens.

Many aspects of this car, including the weight balance
and distribution, are close to perfection.

Needless to say, with only 106 built,
they're not easy to get.

It’s little wonder that the McLaren F1 is one
of the most desirable supercars ever.
collection.zh:
这辆McLaren F1是最伟大的超级跑车吗？我觉得算。

实际上，McLaren的创始人Bruce McLaren一直想要进入公路车市场。

可惜他在真正的量产车开发完成前就于1970年去世了。

直到1980年代后期，公司才开始重新考虑公路车的开发计划。

这款3座的“McLaren F1”终于在1992年姗姗来迟。

此车由戈登·穆雷构思和设计，
外观和内饰则交由彼得·史蒂文斯操刀。

这辆车在各方面的性能，包括配重平衡和动力平衡，都
堪称完美。

它的稀有程度自不用说：总共只生产了106辆，要想入手
十分不易。

这样一想，McLaren F1成为史上最受追捧的超级跑车之一，就
一点也不稀奇了！]

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultra-exotic McLaren F1 exemplified the genius of its designer, Gordon Murray.

The McLaren F1 production car first made its appearance in 1991 as the king of all super sports exotics. The car was built by Formula 1 constructor McLaren and styled by lead designer Gordon Murray, who was assigned the arduous task of bringing to life company founder Bruce McLaren's dream of building a road-going automobile with the McLaren name.

The F1 sports car had scissor-type doors not unlike those of a Lamborghini Diablo. Its monocoque structure was extremely light, contributing to the car's weight of 1140kg. The car was laden with so many special features that they are too many to list here, but one trait worth noting is the car's passenger seating arrangement. By positioning the driver's seat at the center of the interior and the two passengers on opposing sides behind the driver, an ideal lateral and vertical weight balance was realized. Even the trunk was positioned within the wheelbase to ensure optimal weight distribution. Mounted amidships was BMW's 6.1-liter V12 that pumped out 627ps. Although other exotics of the day used forced induction, McLaren opted to keep its powerplant naturally aspirated for better overall response and driving ease.

Upon its release to the public, the McLaren F1 was hailed as the fastest road-going sports car in the world, one that was also quite practical as an everyday driver. Needless to say, many McLaren F1 owners wanted to race the car because of its incredibly high level of performance, prompting the company to produce the F1 GTR, a race version of the road car. The F1 GTR went on to enjoy a successful racing career that included wins in races such as the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
vehicleCollection.zh:
跑车的终极，汲取了天才戈登·穆雷的理念。

迈凯伦F1是由一级方程式车厂迈凯伦研发的超级跑车，发布于1991年。

此车由一级方程式设计师戈登·穆雷设计，是为了实现已故公司创始人布鲁斯·迈凯伦未完成的梦想——制造一款在公路上行驶的迈凯伦。

这款车采用鸥翼式车门和单体车壳结构，极度轻盈的车身仅重1140kg，并拥有数不清的特殊特性，成就革命性的车款。其中最值得注意一点的是，为了提高驾驶性能，设计者对重量配比的优化极其重视。

驾驶座被安置在车辆中部，两个乘客座位分别布置在后方左右两侧，形成了独特的三角形3座布局。甚至连行李箱也设置在前后轴之间，以使重心位于中央。中置安装的6.1升宝马V12引擎能够产生627ps。虽然当时超跑的主流是涡轮增压，设计者还是采用了自然吸气引擎，以便在整体上获得更好的反应能力和驾驶灵活性。

通过上述努力，迈凯伦F1得以享誉全球，被誉为全世界最快的公路超跑，且仍兼具日常实用性。由于其惊人的速度和驾驶性能，许多客户想将这款车用于赛车比赛，有鉴于此，迈凯伦又生产了此车的赛车规格版F1 GTR。迈凯伦F1在勒芒24小时耐力赛等比赛中大获成功，开创了自己的时代。

catch.en: The ultra-exotic McLaren F1 exemplified the genius of its designer, Gordon Murray.
catch.zh: 跑车的终极，汲取了天才戈登·穆雷的理念。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
This is a McLaren F1 that has seen some track action.
Many consider this car to be the perfect sport car.

This race spec version first made an appearance in 1994.

And in 1995, it made its Le Mans debut,
going on to grab the overall title!

Incidentally, the victorious McLaren F1 GTR was once driven
by former Formula 1 driver JJ Lehto...

...and Japanese driver Masanori Sekiya.

It was the first time that a Japanese driver had won at
Le Mans.

He was also the fastest driver on the team, even when rain
fell during the night at the Circuit de la Sarthe.
dialogues.zh:
一辆久经战阵的McLaren F1！这可能是
有史以来最接近“完美”的车子了……

这辆车的赛车版本在1994年首次出现……

并于1995年首次在勒芒参赛，然后赢得了比赛！

顺便一说，那辆获胜的McLaren F1 GTR是由前F1车手JJ尼赫托和……

日本车手关谷正德驾驶的。

那是日本车手首次在勒芒夺冠！

而且，在那个萨森赛车场的雨夜里，他是车队里最快的车手！

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.en:
...Th-This car!
Is it yours!?
conversation.zh:
这这这……这辆车！！
这车是你的？！!

conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.en:
Wow, Jeremy, nothing gets past you, does it?

Jeremy loves nothing more than geeking out about racing.
conversation.zh:
是杰里米啊！真是什么好车都逃不出你的法眼啊！

杰里米就是喜欢赛车，他是名副其实的赛车死忠粉！

conversation.speaker: Jeremy
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
conversation.en:
Oh man, I mean, I can't help myself when there's
a car like this sitting right in front of me!
conversation.zh:
哎呀，兄弟，我是说，我一见到这样不得了的车，就控
制不住自己！

collection.en:
This McLaren F1 GTR is the overall winner
of the 1995 Le Mans 24 Hour race.

The drivers in the race were Masanori Sekiya, J.J. Lehto,
and Yannick Dalmas,

and Sekiya was the first Japanese driver to win the famed race,

and Lehto was also the first Finn to claim this honor.

Although design engineer Gordon Murray was not
keen on entering it in races,

he agreed to make some aerodynamic alterations,
and the result was a win at its first race,

which happened to be at Le Mans!

 Following the Le Mans victory, McLaren resolved to
continue developing the GTR as a race car,

making this a crucial icon in both the history
of McLaren and in the history of Le Mans.
collection.zh:
这辆McLaren F1 GTR是1995勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军车。

参加比赛的车手是关谷正德、J.J. Lehto和Yannick Dalmas，

关谷还是第一位赢得这项著名比赛的日本车手，

而Lehto也是第一位获得这一荣誉的芬兰人。

尽管设计工程师戈登·穆雷对于让它参加比赛并不感冒，

但还是同意作出一些空气动力学方面的改动。结果就在
处女秀上取得胜利，

更重要的是，那场比赛就是勒芒大赛！

在勒芒胜利之后，McLaren决定继续将GTR作为赛车来开发，

这也使它同时成为了McLaren历史和勒芒历史上的一个重要标志。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate automobile by McLaren would go on to win both the BPR series and the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

In 1991, McLaren unveiled its first true road car. It was conceived by Gordon Murray, who designed the company’s Formula 1 machines at the time, and the exterior of the car styling was penned by Peter Stevens, who designed the new shape of the Lotus Esprit. The collaboration resulted in a true masterpiece called the “F1.”

The monocoque body was formed from carbon composites, so it was extremely light, weighing just 180kg, thus enabling the F1 to tip the scales at a lean 1140kg. A 6.1-liter V12, made by BMW motorsports (the famous “M” division) produces 636ps and 66.4kgm torque. It helped power the car to an official record top speed of <391.0km/h> in 1998.

With the high demands of the racing world, McLaren developed a model with even more refined aerodynamics: the McLaren F1 GTR. Delivery started in 1994. From 1995, the McLaren F1 GTR entered the BPR Global GT Endurance series and won the championship, but they also had another significant victory that year taking the checker at the 24 Hours of Le Mans. In wet conditions that lasted nearly the entire day, the McLaren staved off the open prototype racers that were then said to have the advantage. In the end, car No. 59 (which was practically a McLaren works car) driven by Yannick Dalmas, JJ Lehto and Masanori Sekiya took the overall win.
vehicleCollection.zh:
终极机器，BRP GT系列赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军。

1991年，迈凯伦官宣将推出其首台公路车型。这台名为“F1”的车型出自当时为迈凯伦车队设计一级方程式赛车的设计师戈登·穆雷的设想，外观设计则来自为莲花跑车Esprit设计了新外形的彼得·史蒂文斯。

全部由碳纤维复合材料打造的单体车身极致轻盈，仅重180kg，整车重量也仅有1140kg。6.1L的V12引擎来自宝马的运动赛车部门，可以输出636ps和66.4kgm的扭矩。这台车在1998年创下了官方速度纪录：<391.0km/h>。

为了满足赛事规则更严苛的标准，迈凯伦又研发出了一款空气动力学更优秀的车型：迈凯伦F1 GTR。这款车型1994年驶下生产线，1995年初次参加BRP GT系列赛事就勇夺当年的赛季冠军。另一项值得迈凯伦大书特书的胜利，则是赢下了当年的勒芒24小时耐力赛：在连天阴雨的赛场上，迈凯伦F1 GTR与其他公认更具有优势的原型车展开了争夺，由雅尼克-达尔马斯、J.J.莱赫托和关谷正德驾驶的59号赛车（相当于迈凯伦卫星车队赛车）在开赛后不断超越，夺取了最终的胜利。

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
I’ve always liked the design of the McLaren MP4.

It’s bold, aggressive, but not over-the-top.

Much like the McLaren 650S, all of the design elements
work in harmony, making for a very consistent design.

I love the side intakes and the graphics on the rear,
including the cool exhaust shape and location.
dialogues.zh:
我一直非常中意McLaren MP4的设计。

它大胆不羁、具有侵略性，但又不过分张扬。

就像McLaren 650S一样，所有的设计元素协调统一，
形成了和谐的风格。

我喜欢它侧进气口和车尾的效果，包括酷炫的排气管造型和布局。

conversation.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president

conversation.en:
Would you happen to be the championship winner
from the other day?

That was some fantastic driving!

By the way…
conversation.zh:
你不会刚好就是那天锦标赛的冠军吧？

你的驾驶技术真是漂亮！

顺便问一句……

brandCentral.en:
This here is a McLaren masterpiece!

The MP4-12C was McLaren's first road car since the legendary
F1, and has all the goods you'd expect of the maker.

Its single-piece carbon monocoque was the first of its kind
in a commercially available car...

And its active suspension system is also a stroke
of McLaren genius.

But let's not forget its ultra-powerful 3.8L V8 twin-turbo
midship engine, which is capable of 600ps!

We had to wait a long time for the successor to the F1,
but there's no doubt it was worth it!
brandCentral.zh:
这一台就是McLaren的杰作啦！

MP4-12C是McLaren自推出传奇的Mclaren F1以来的第一辆公路车，
不负众望地凝聚了制造商的所有优点。

其一体式碳纤维单体结构是首次下放到公开发售的商业
车型……

主动悬挂系统则是McLaren的研发天才们的巧思。

同时也别忘了这辆车超强的3.8L V8双涡轮增压中置引擎，
它能达到600ps的动力！

我们为F1的继任者等待了很长时间，但毫无疑问，这场
等待是值得的！

usedCar.en:
When you think of McLaren road cars, the 3-seat F1 might come
to mind, but the MP4-12C is also pretty impressive.

Standing for "McLaren Project 4" from a merger with Project 4
headed by McLaren's former race director Ron Dennis...

...the MP4-12C comes equipped with a twin-turbo V-8
mounted amidships in a carbon-fiber chassis.

It also features the company's high-tech "ProActive Chassis
Control" suspension, making this car one amazing handler.

In fact, the arrival of the MP4-12C saw market share moving
from Ferrari to McLaren, kickstarting a nice little rivalry.

It was a good thing for customers because whether you went
with a British or Italian supercar, you couldn't go wrong.
usedCar.zh:
MP4-12C车型有着McLaren汽车中最具辨识度的中置引擎...

它是继传奇F1跑车之后McLaren设计制造的首款公路跑车。

搭载V8双涡轮增压引擎，搭配兼具高强
度和轻量化的碳纤维复合底盘。

此外，它还搭载了McLaren引以为傲的
“主动式底盘控制系统”悬挂。

在握住方向盘的那一刻，你就会发现它具
有非凡的抓地性能...

驾驶这款车的幸福感可谓如梦似幻。

vehicleCollection.en:
The MP4-12C was the first McLaren production car since the McLaren F1 road car.

Following in the footsteps of the McLaren F1 with its ultimate performance, and the SLR McLaren with Mercedes Benz, the third McLaren supercar was given the name MP4, as if to remind one of its relationship with F1 machines. As with the revolutionary MP4 F1 car that introduced carbon composite bodies to F1 racing back in 1981, the major point of note in this car is the one-piece carbon composite "mono-cell" tub utilized in its structure. The weight of the mono-cell alone is just 80kg and contributes greatly to weight reduction. In the front and rear of the mono-cell is an aluminum frame to which the engine and suspension are assembled.

The midship-mounted engine is a 3.8-liter V8 twin turbo, with a maximum output of 600ps. The displacement and power specifications may perhaps appear to be surprisingly modest for a McLaren road car. However its performance is nothing short of incredible, as its boasts a top speed of over <320km/h>, 0-400m (400m) acceleration of approximately 11 seconds, and a 0-<200km/h> acceleration of less than 10 seconds, giving it a performance level equal to or greater than the Ferrari 458 Italia.

The 7-speed dual clutch system is given the name "Seamless Shift Gearbox," much like F1 machines, and incorporates six preset driving modes. The electronically controlled suspension is set up as a 4-wheel double wishbone configuration, and it is also notable that the front-rear-left-right dampers are connected hydraulically for ride comfort.
vehicleCollection.zh:
迈凯伦的第三代超跑，拥有新的轻盈车身。

在推出性能卓越的迈凯伦F1，以及与梅赛德斯-奔驰合作打造SLR迈凯伦后，迈凯轮发布了第三辆超级跑车，并将其命名为MP4，仿佛在提示这款车与F1赛车之间的关联。正如1981年革命性的MP4 F1赛车将碳纤维复合车壳引入了一级方程式比赛，这辆车的主要亮点也是其车身结构中使用的一体式碳纤维复合“单体车壳”。该“单体车壳”的重量仅为80kg，对减轻车身重量极有帮助。车壳前后均为铝材车架，用于安装引擎和悬挂。

中置引擎为一款3.8升V8双涡轮增压引擎，最大输出功率为600ps。作为一款迈凯轮的公路跑车，这样的排量和马力规格乍看似乎有点太过平庸，然而其性能实际上却是令人难以置信地出色。其最高时速超过<320km/h>，0-#400m的加速仅需11秒，0-<200km/h>加速的时间小于10秒，性能水平与法拉利458 Italia相比可以说是有过之而无不及。

变速箱采用了名为“无缝式换档变速箱”的7档双离合器系统，与一级方程式车型十分相似，并带有六种预设的驾驶模式。电子控制悬挂系统采用4轮双叉股式配置，同时值得注意的是，前后左右的减震器均采用液压连接，以提高驾乘的舒适度。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
In 1983, after a 15-year break, Honda returned to Formula 1 racing.

For the next 10 years, until it retired again in 1992,
it dominated the competition like no other.

In 1984, a year after its comeback, a Honda-Williams machine
claimed a victory at the American Grand Prix.

The driver of that car was none other than Keke Rosberg,
winner of the 1982 F1 Drivers’ Championship.

Man, did he look super cool when it came time for him
to ascend the podium.

In any event, the successor of Honda-Williams’ impressive machine
was this McLaren MP4/4.

McLaren began powering its machines with Honda engines
in 1988.

And with drivers Ayrton Senna and Alain Prost, it claimed
the championship that year.

The man responsible for designing the MP4/4 was genius
race-car designer Gordon Murray.

In addition to having a low center of gravity, the McLaren
MP4/4 was equipped with Honda's 1.5-lier RA168E engine.

This turbocharged engine normally produced at 685 horsepower,
but it could be boosted to a maximum 1500 horsepower!

Apparently, the car had trouble with fuel economy,
but Honda’s brilliant engineers found a way to deal with that.

Indeed, they managed to produce the best F1 engine
of the day.

McLaren’s F1 results for the 1988 season were nothing short
of astounding.

To start, they won 15 of 16 races that year!

They alo claimed 15 pole positions, ten 1-2 finishes,
and ten fastest laps.

And with 199 Constructors’ points, they finished
139 points ahead of the second-place team.

When it came to Drivers’ points, Prost had 87 and Senna
had 90, handing him his first Drivers’ title.

This historic win for Senna took place at the Suzuka Circuit
in the Japanese Grand Prix.

It was such a glorious win Soichiro Honda supposedly
said, “If only every day could be this greatv”
3
dialogues.zh:
1983年，阔别赛场15年之后，本田回到了F1的赛场。

在接下来的十年里，本田彻底主宰了赛道，
直到1992年再次退出。

1984年，在本田归来一年后，本田-威廉姆斯车队的赛车
在美国大奖赛上取得了胜利。

夺冠车手正是1982年F1世界锦标赛总冠军得主——科克·罗斯伯格。

天啊，那位老兄登上领奖台的样子酷得不行。

紧随其后，延续本田-威廉姆斯优雅胜利
的是这辆迈凯伦MP4/4。

迈凯伦在1988年开始选用本田引擎作为他们赛车
的动力单元……

并与两位车手埃尔顿·塞纳和阿兰·普罗斯特一起，
一鼓作气夺得了制造商冠军。

负责设计这台MP4/4的人是F1天才工程师戈登·穆雷。

除了低重心设计外，迈凯伦MP4/4
还搭载了1.5升本田RA168E引擎。

这台涡轮增压引擎的标准功率就]685马力，
但还可以通过增压提升到最大1500马力！

显然，这辆车的油耗会是个难题——
但本田出色的工程师们迎难而上，成功克服了这项艰巨的任务。

事实上，他们制造出了当时最出色的F1引擎。

迈凯伦在1988年赛季取得的成绩惊天动地。

这么说吧，他们赢下了那年16场比赛中的15场！

他们还拿下了15个杆位，在10场比赛中完成一二带回，
以及创造了十次最快圈速。

最终，他们获得了199分的制造商积分，
足足领先第二名139分！

在车手积分方面，普罗斯特拿下87分，而塞纳拿下90分，
获得了他的第一个世界冠军。

塞纳的这次历史性胜利就发生在日本大奖赛的铃鹿赛道上。

这场胜利是如此的辉煌，以至于我仿佛还能听到
本田宗一郎说：“如果每天都能如此精彩就好了！”
P

collection.en:
The McLaren MP4/4 Honda was a legendary F1 machine that
proved virtually unbeatable in the 1988 Formula 1 season.

The chassis was developed by Gordon Murray,
the renowned race-car designer.

It came powered with the RA168E turbocharged Honda V-6 engine.

In 1988, Formula 1 regulations changed significantly...

...with strict limits placed on turbo boost pressure
and fuel usage during races.

Honda’s turbocharged engine utilized advanced electronic control
technology, delivering both power and efficiency.

The driver lineup featured two of the sport’s finest:
Alain Prost and Ayrton Senna.

With two legends behind the wheel, the MP4/4 won
an extraordinary 15 of 16 races that season.

Car No. 12 was driven by Ayrton Senna.

In 1988, Senna secured the drivers’ championship,
recording 13 pole positions and eight victories.
collection.zh:
这辆迈凯伦MP4/4 Honda是一部具有传奇地位的一级方程式赛车，
在1988赛季的一级方程式大奖赛上几乎所向无敌。

它的底盘由知名一级方程式设计师戈登·穆雷所开发……

并由一台本田出品的RA168E涡轮增压V6引擎提供动力。

1988年，一级方程式对引擎规则进行了大幅修改……

严格限制了涡轮增压提高的压力
和比赛中赛车搭载的燃油量。

本田的涡轮增压引擎运用了先进的电子控制技术，
同时兼顾了性能和燃油效率。

不仅如此，当时驾驶这台赛车出战的车手也是高手中的高手：
阿兰·普洛斯特和埃尔顿·塞纳。

在两名一级方程式历史中的传奇车手的驾驭下，
这辆MP4/4在1988年惊人地拿下了16场大奖赛中的15场胜利。

其中车号为12号的MP4/4就是由埃尔顿·塞纳所驾驶。

在1988赛季，塞纳拿下了13次杆位和8个分站冠军，
并最终摘下了车手总=军的桂冠。

vehicleCollection.en:
This legendary machine marked the end of the turbocharged era in Formula 1."

Many motorsports historians consider the McLaren MP4/4 as the most successful race cars ever built. This machine, designed by Gordon Murray and Steve Nichols and powered by the Honda RA168E engine, dominated the 1988 Formula 1 World Championship season, winning all but one race (15 out of 16 races) and taking all but one pole position.

Much of the credit was attributed to the Honda engine that effectively balanced fuel consumption and raw power, but the chassis was also superior to the rest of the field. Another big factor was the driving team of Ayrton Senna and Alain Prost, who helped score McLaren-Honda a then-record 199 points in the Constructors Championship. Senna took the drivers' title that year although Prost scored more points. The reason was that only the eleven best results counted, and Senna had more first-place finishes than Prost (eight to seven).
vehicleCollection.zh:
标志着涡轮增压时代终结的传奇F1赛车。

1988年，迈凯伦派出MP4/4征战F1世界锦标赛新赛季。这是一台由戈登·穆雷和史蒂夫·尼克斯联手设计的低高度、低阻力的机器，由本田RA168E引擎驱动。

这一年也是方程式赛事中允许使用涡轮增压机的最后一年。根据规则要求，涡轮的最大增压压力从4巴降到了2.5巴，车载燃料容量也遭到了削减，总计只能携带150升，比原来减少了45升。对于采用涡轮增压的赛车来说，这本应该是一个非常艰难的赛季。

但最终结果却是迈凯伦本田MP4/4彻底占据了主导地位，在16场比赛中豪取15胜。诚然，车辆底盘的研发非常优秀，但大家普遍认为在油耗和有效动力之间取得极致平衡的本田引擎才是他们获胜的主要因素。

车身涂装有12号的MP4/4是由阿伊尔顿·塞纳驾驶的赛车。在那一年里，塞纳以令人咋舌的13个杆位和8个冠军领奖台的优异成绩拿下了车手总冠军。

catch.en: This legendary machine marked the end of the turbocharged era in Formula 1."
catch.zh: 标志着涡轮增压时代终结的传奇F1赛车。

dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.en:
The McLaren P1 is a special edition plug-in hybrid
from British automaker McLaren Automotive.

It features a carbon-fiber monocoque with a roof
structure called "MonoCage."

It’s the successor to McLaren’s legendary F1.

But the P1 carves out its own identity with a fresh,
organic design language.

And, to enhance aerodynamics
on the track...

...This GTR features a large front splitter, aggressive
side skirts, and an imposing rear wing.
dialogues.zh:
McLaren P1是英国汽车制造商McLaren Automotive推出的
一款特别版插电式混合动力车。

其车身采用了碳纤维单体车壳和
名为“MonoCage”的车顶结构。

尽管设计灵感来源于McLaren的传奇F1赛车……

但P1的设计语言更新颖，更具有活力。

此外，为了提高赛道上的空气动力学性能……

这款GTR配备了大型前分流器、侧裙
以及一个引人注目的尾翼。
