brandCentral.en:
The McLaren GTR needs little introduction.

The F1 GTR burst onto the scene when it took Le Mans
by storm in 1995.

The P1 GTR was developed to celebrate the 20th anniversary
of that legendary victory.

As you might expect, it's based on the P1, a hybrid supercar.

This track-only model had plenty of power, with total output
rated somewhere around 1000ps.
brandCentral.zh:
这款McLaren GTR想来不需要我多做介绍了。

F1 GTR的狂潮在1995年席卷了勒芒，也俘获了汽车爱好者的心……

而P1 GTR正是为了庆祝这次伟大胜利20周年而开发的。

如您所预料，这辆车基于混动超跑P1开发，

是一辆血统纯正的赛道用比赛机器，足以称霸整个1000ps马
力级别。

vehicleCollection.en:
This track-only model further defines the potential of the P1 hybrid supercar.

The P1 GTR, introduced in 2014 to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the McLaren F1 GTR that dominated sports-car racing in the 1990s, was based on the "P1" hybrid super car that went on sale the year before. The main difference between the two was that the "GTR" version was created exclusively for the racetrack.

Although it may look like the road-going car at first glance, the aerodynamic efficiency of the P1 GTR is on an entirely different level, thanks to a larger front splitter, aggressive side skirts, and a massive rear wing.

Mounted amidships for both the P1 road car and the P1 GTR is a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter V-8 that produces 737ps. Also powering the vehicle are 179ps electric motors, which enable the P1 road car to boast an output of 916ps and the P1 GTR to pump out 1000ps.

In order to purchase a P1 GTR, you must first have a P1 road car in your garage. Production for the race car was reported to be 30 to 35 units. Those lucky few who got their hands on the P1 GTR were invited to participate in a circuit driving program hosted by McLaren. Well, it's a nice offer, considering you need to shell out a staggering 1.9 million GBP (about US $2.4 million) to buy the car.
vehicleCollection.zh:
专为赛道而设计的车型，进一步提升了P1混合动力超级跑车的潜力。

P1 GTR是基于2013年公布的混合动力超跑P1打造的赛道版本车型，不能上路驾驶。这款庆祝F1 GTR问世20周年的车型在2014年正式亮相。它的前辈F1 GTR曾在20世纪末的赛事当中屡次斩获冠军。

基础车架方面，P1 GTR沿用了P1的碳纤维单体车壳和设计造型，但在空气动力学部分带来了极大的提升：宽大的前定风翼和侧边包围，以及夸张的大尾翼。对底盘的设定也是专门针对赛道配置的。

P1车架中部搭载的3.8升双涡轮增压V8引擎和电机组合可以共同输出916ps，或分别输出737ps+179ps的动力。而在GTR版本中，总动力输出被再次提升到了1000ps。

在Mclaren对外的公告中，购买P1 GTR的前置条件是拥有一台公路版本P1，且这款车型的总产量将限定在30到35台之间。所有P1 GTR的车主都将受邀参加一项由迈凯伦举办的赛道驾驶计划，该计划的运输和维护成本也包含在了190万英镑的售价里。

catch.en: This track-only model further defines the potential of the P1 hybrid supercar.
catch.zh: 专为赛道而设计的车型，进一步提升了P1混合动力超级跑车的潜力。

long.en:
The P1 GTR, introduced in 2014 to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the McLaren F1 GTR that dominated sports-car racing in the 1990s, was based on the "P1" hybrid super car that went on sale the year before. The main difference between the two was that the "GTR" version was created exclusively for the racetrack.

Although it may look like the road-going car at first glance, the aerodynamic efficiency of the P1 GTR is on an entirely different level, thanks to a larger front splitter, aggressive side skirts, and a massive rear wing.

Mounted amidships for both the P1 road car and the P1 GTR is a twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter V-8 that produces 737ps. Also powering the vehicle are 179ps electric motors, which enable the P1 road car to boast an output of 916ps and the P1 GTR to pump out 1000ps.

In order to purchase a P1 GTR, you must first have a P1 road car in your garage. Production for the race car was reported to be 30 to 35 units. Those lucky few who got their hands on the P1 GTR were invited to participate in a circuit driving program hosted by McLaren. Well, it's a nice offer, considering you need to shell out a staggering 1.9 million GBP (about US $2.4 million) to buy the car.
long.zh:
P1 GTR是基于2013年公布的混合动力超跑P1打造的赛道版本车型，不能上路驾驶。这款庆祝F1 GTR问世20周年的车型在2014年正式亮相。它的前辈F1 GTR曾在20世纪末的赛事当中屡次斩获冠军。

基础车架方面，P1 GTR沿用了P1的碳纤维单体车壳和设计造型，但在空气动力学部分带来了极大的提升：宽大的前定风翼和侧边包围，以及夸张的大尾翼。对底盘的设定也是专门针对赛道配置的。

P1车架中部搭载的3.8升双涡轮增压V8引擎和电机组合可以共同输出916ps，或分别输出737ps+179ps的动力。而在GTR版本中，总动力输出被再次提升到了1000ps。

在Mclaren对外的公告中，购买P1 GTR的前置条件是拥有一台公路版本P1，且这款车型的总产量将限定在30到35台之间。所有P1 GTR的车主都将受邀参加一项由迈凯伦举办的赛道驾驶计划，该计划的运输和维护成本也包含在了190万英镑的售价里。

brandCentral.en:
This Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo is McLaren's idea of what
racing might look like in 2030 and beyond.

When you get behind its wheel, be ready to be
thoroughly impressed.

But first, you'll need to get accustomed to the
prone driving position.

By assuming this posture, your field of vision is enhanced,
and there are also benefits in terms of interior layout.

Every aspect of this car was intended to put the needs of the
driver above everything else.

McLaren's total dedication to creating the perfect race car
is reflected in this amazing design study.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo是McLaren对于2030年之后的
赛车做出的畅想。

它包含了一系列精妙设计，为驾驶者带来无穷的惊喜。

设计概念的重中之重必然是俯卧的驾驶姿势。

这样的姿势不仅可以扩大驾驶员的视野范围，对内饰布
局也有所助益。

这些设计的背后凝聚着以驾驶员为中心的设计理念。

这部终极机器充分体现了McLaren对完美驾驶体验的不懈追求。

vehicleCollection.en:
Putting the driver before all else, this car is the ultimate realization of the McLaren philosophy.

McLaren established their road car department “McLaren Automotive” in 2010, continuing to release high performance cars into the world ever since. The McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo is a car developed by McLaren Automotive with an eye for 2030 and beyond.

Gran Turismo series producer Kazunori Yamauchi was also involved in development of this car. It brings to life the future of McLaren, while staying true to the design pillars and principles that were established, by being committed to putting the driver first. Within the main structure of the cabin, the driver resides in a motorcycle-like driving position. This enables an extreme cabin-forward design, by giving the driver an ability to clearly identify the apex of the corners as they turn. The teardrop shaped canopy covering the driver carries on the tradition of McLaren roadcars, helping to provide this excellent field of vision.

Mounted behind the cabin is McLaren's 4-Liter V8 Twin Turbo engine. This drives the rear wheels, while the “pods” housing the front wheels contain high output electric motors which drive the front wheels. The overall combined output of the car reaches 1150ps.

The aerodynamics of the car is also very innovative. The body of the McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo is optimized so that the body itself generates peak aerodynamic performance, by minimizing individual components that would adversely affect aerodynamics. Rather than actuating surface panels in its active aerodynamics system, tiny aperture covers around the air inlets on key surfaces will open, producing drag and downforce. As a result, the number of moving parts in the system was reduced to help keep weight to a minimum. With McLaren being the pioneer who first implemented carbon fiber into F1 racing, this machine also utilizes carbon fiber compoents throughout the car, which achieves a curb weight of just 1000kg.

The McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo will be available in three lieries: erformance, Ulterior, and Noir. We hopeyou will take the oportunity to experience this senory overload, combining ncredile sound withawe-inspiring aceleration.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆跑车实现了迈凯伦以车手为中心的终极设计哲学。

迈凯伦在2010年设立了他们的公路车部门“迈凯伦汽车”，并持续推出高性能车型。而迈凯伦Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo就是一款迈凯伦汽车着眼于2030年乃至更久以后未来而开发的汽车。

跑车浪漫旅系列游戏的制作人山内一典也参与到这辆车的开发之中。该车型着眼未来，同时恪守迈凯伦树立的设计理念和原则，坚持以车手为本。在座舱的主框架下，车手的坐姿类似于驾驶摩托车。这种设计可以将驾驶舱极度前置，使得车手在过弯时可以清楚地辨识弯心。车手上方的水滴形车顶沿袭了迈凯伦公路车的传统，也提供了极佳的视野。

座舱后安装了迈凯伦4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，用于驱动后轮；而在包裹前轮的座舱处安装有一台大功率电机，用于驱动前轮。两台引擎相结合，可使这款车的整体功率达到1150ps。

这款车在空气动力学方面同样充满了创新。通过将每一个可能会对空气动力学造成负面影响的部件进行小型化设计，迈凯伦Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo的车身得到了大量优化，从而可以发挥出最佳的空气动力学性能。该车并没有利用主动式空气动力系统来控制表面挡板，而是开启主要表面上进气口周围的小孔，进而产生流气拉力和下压力。因此，整辆车的可活动部件数量得到了大幅削减，将整车重量控制在最低水平。迈凯伦是在F1比赛中率先使用碳纤维的先行者，这辆车同样大量使用了碳纤维零件，使得车辆自重仅仅只有1000kg。

迈凯伦Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo一共推出了三种涂装：Performance、Ulterior和Noir。这辆车有着难以置信的引擎声浪和令人惊叹的加速度，我们希望你可以借L机会体验一下它带给你的感官冲击。

This Gr.1 racing car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on
the McLaren Ultimate Vision Gran Turismo.

Power is restricted to 950ps as per group regulations,

McLaren's driver-focused technology makes this a formidable
weapon in any racing arsenal.

这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.1级别赛车是基于

秉承以驾驶者为中心的技术理念，McLaren将这辆车打造成了

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
I love compact sports models from Germany.

They all have wide tires, twice as wide as
Japanese compact cars.

Those wide tires are among the most significant
components of this car.

They give the car its personality.

And the resulting wide stance makes the car look stable,
as well as possessing performance.

They distinguish the base C coupe from the AMG version
for those who have keen eyes.
dialogues.zh:
我非常喜爱德国产的紧凑型跑车。

这些车型都采用了宽胎，
其宽度足有日本紧凑型车的两倍。

宽胎正是这辆车最重要的组成部分之一。

赋予了这辆车鲜明的个性。

而这种设计让车身显得又宽又低，看上去非常稳定，
性能也同样卓越。

在懂行的人眼里，这些特点让AMG版本与
基础的C级双门跑车有了明显的区分。

俣野努先生因参与设计Mazda MX-5 Miata Roadster

他在欧洲和美国等地也工作过相当长一段时间，
而他的绰号“俣野汤姆”也因此闻名于世。

I love compact sports models from Germany.

They all have wide tires, twice as wide as
Japanese compact cars.

Those wide tires are among the most significant
components of this car.

They give the car its personality.

And the resulting wide stance makes the car look stable,
as well as possessing performance.

They distinguish the base C coupe from the AMG version
for those who have keen eyes.
conversation.zh:
我非常喜爱德国产的紧凑型跑车。

这些车型都采用了宽胎，
其宽度足有日本紧凑型车的两倍。

宽胎正是这辆车最重要的组成部分之一。

赋予了这辆车鲜明的个性。

而这种设计让车身显得又宽又低，看上去非常稳定，
性能也同样卓越。

在懂行的人眼里，这些特点让AMG版本与
基础的C级双门跑车有了明显的区分。

brandCentral.en:
Mercedes-Benz has produced some memorable high-spec rear-wheel
drive sedans in its long history.

The C Class are the most compact of these.

But don't let their size deceive you, because they
deliver good power and world-class handling.

This particular iteration is the 2015 AMG C63 S, which is
the top-of-the-line model that packs more than 500ps.

AMG, a subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz, focuses on tuning the
company's cars, making them world-class sports machines.

In particular, AMG is famous for hand-assembling all of its
engines.

The company follows the philosophy of "one man, one engine"—
every engine is the responsibility of a single engineer.
brandCentral.zh:
Mercedes-Benz制造过许多高规格、高性能的后轮驱动汽车。

“C Class”是其中最紧凑的型号。

但千万不要因为体型的缘故而小看了这些性能优异，操
控稳定、可靠的好车。

这台迭代车型是一款2015年的AMG C63 S，是产品线中的顶配
车型，马力高达500ps。

AMG是Mercedes-Benz的子公司，专注于开发跑车和高性能车辆，

因其坚持手工组装引擎而声名远扬。

公司严格履行“一人一引擎”的原则，让每一名工程师
都全权负责打造一部引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
The most powerful model of the fourth-generation C-Class boasts a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8.

Mercedes-Benz introduced an AMG version of the fourth-generation C-Class a year after the base model was introduced in 2014. And although it wore the same C63 badge as its predecessor, the 2015 AMG C63 featured an all-new powerplant. Gone was the naturally aspirated 6.2-liter V-8, replaced by a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 known as the M177, which used the same basic configuration as the M178 in the AMG GT.

The new C63 delivered 476ps and 66.3kgm in base form, and the C63 S provided a whopping 510ps and 71.4kgm. While horsepower was the same as the AMG GT models, the C63 engine featured better torque delivery that came lower in the rpm spectrum. Because of this, the C63 behaved in a smooth, civil manner on public roads. Only after the sedan and station wagon body styles were introduced did Mercedes-Benz offer the C63 and C63 S as a coupe in 2016.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第四代C级阵容中的最强音，采用4升双涡轮增压V8引擎。

第四代梅赛德斯-奔驰C级是在2014年推出的。和之前一样，梅赛德斯在2015年又追加推出了一款AMG车型。

虽然同样采用C63车标，但内里换上了一颗新的心脏。6.2升V8自然进气引擎换成了4升V8双涡轮增压M177引擎，采用与AMG GT上的M178引擎相同的基本配置。

在最大动力输出和扭矩方面，基础版C63可提供476ps和650牛·米（66.3kgm），而高性能C63 S则可输出510ps和700牛·米（71.4kgm）。这两款车型在马力上可与同级别的AMG GT相媲美，并且能够输出更大的扭矩。除此之外，经过调校后的动力带起点降低，拓宽了有效转速的发力范围。这些改进也让AMG版本的C63车重较一般跑车要更重些，可以作为日常用车使用。

C63和C63 S车型原本只供应轿车或旅行车，但在2016年时又引入了两门轿跑车型。

brandCentral.sourceName: Mercedes-AMG F1 W08 EQ Power+ (Color Variation) 2017
brandCentral.en:
AMG's W08 EQ Power+ was an unstoppable force in the 2017
Formula 1 season.

This particular version features an all-new color scheme
that gives the dominant race car some flash.

Like the previous year, the AMG F1 team dominated in 2017 taking
its fourth straight Constructors Championship.

Ace driver Lewis Hamilton also had a stellar year,
winning his fourth Drivers Championship.
brandCentral.zh:
AMG的W08 EQ Power+在F1的2017赛季中势不可挡。

这个版本采用了全新的配色，显得卓尔不群。

2017年是难忘的一年，AMG F1车队正是凭借此车连续第四年
拿下车队总冠军，

而无法超越的Lewis Hamilton也用他的第四个车手总冠军实现了双
喜临门。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Mercedes-Benz Formula 1 car dominated the 2017 season with Lewis Hamilton winning the championship.

The W08 EQ Power+ was developed by Mercedes AMG Petronas Motorsport to compete in the 2017 Formula 1 season.

Mercedes-Benz made a full return to F1 in 2010 after a 55-year hiatus. It splashed onto the scene as among the top four contenders in that first year, and then showed marked improvement in the ensuing years. By 2014, Team Mercedes-Benz had conquered F1, winning both the Drivers and Constructor's titles from 2014 to 2016. But because of new regulations in 2017, there were some initial minor problems. Drivers were struggling to establish their preferred setup, and although the car was fast in mid- to high-speed corners, it didn't fare as well on tracks with lots of low-speed corners. Still, the M-B overcame these issues in time for the start of the season.

The power unit reportedly produced approximately 950ps, making it tops in the field, which explained the car's excellent speed throughout the 2017 season. Drivers Lewis Hamilton and Valtteri Bottas achieved a fantastic 15 pole positions and 12 victories out of 20 races, giving Mercedes-Benz its fourth straight double titles.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款强调动力的梅赛德斯F1以其无与伦比的速度主导了2017赛季。

W08 EQ动力+是梅赛德斯奔驰为参加2017年世界一级方程式锦标赛制造的车款。

在缺席长达55年之后，梅赛德斯奔驰于2010年重返F1赛事。在回归的第一年，梅赛德斯奔驰便成为了名列前四的车队，并在接下来的几年里不断增强实力，于2014到2016年间完成了车手与车队总冠军三连霸的壮举。因此，除了针对2017赛季新技术规则进行的改动之外，这款赛车似乎没有显著的设计思路变化。

但是相比去年，车手们多次出现对这款赛车的设定的不适应。它在中高速弯道中的表现很出色，却在有着大量低速弯道的赛道上表现挣扎。

它的动力单元可输出约950ps的动力，也是2017赛季所有赛车中最为强大的、也是最快的赛车。由刘易斯·汉密尔顿和瓦尔特利·博塔斯组成的车手阵容在20站比赛中拿下了惊人的15个杆位与12个分站冠军。梅赛德斯也在当年再一次完成了车手车队双料冠军的伟业。

brandCentral.en:
The AMG F1 W08 EQ Power+ was the standout performer in the
2017 Formula 1 season.

The engine is a 1.6L V6 turbo with a unique integrated
hybrid energy recovery unit.

In 2017 it was driven by Lewis Hamilton and Valtteri Bottas.

Between the two of them, they notched up an impressive 12
victories in 20 races.

This performance earned Hamilton his fourth World Drivers'
Championship win.

Thanks to this effort, Mercedes AMG also bagged its
fourth consecutive Constructors' Championship.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆AMG F1 W08 EQ Power+是2017年F1赛季中最亮眼的表演者。

它的1.6L V6涡轮增压引擎上安装了独有的混动能量回收单元。

在2017年，Lewis Hamilton和Valtteri Bottas驾驶这款车参赛，

二人在20场比赛中总共拿下了惊人的12胜。

统治级的表现帮助Hamilton赢得了他的第四个车手世界冠军，

也帮助Mercedes AMG将他们的第四个车队冠军奖杯收入囊中。

brandCentral.en:
The "Black Series" is a name given to the meanest road cars
that Mercedes AMG produces.

This AMG GT is one of just five Black Series models
ever developed.

This means it's not just supremely powerful, it's also
supremely rare.

Mercedes AMG has experienced success in a variety of
motorsports genres, including Formula 1 and touring cars.

And the cutting-edge technology developed on the track has
trickled down to the Black Series.

The car's aerodynamics and chassis development incorporate
technology from the GT3 race machine.

The engine is one of AMG's jewels in the crown, boasting
703ps of power.

On the Nürburgring's Nordschleife in 2020, the AMG GT recorded
a time of 6:43:616, a record for production cars at the timeǾ
brandCentral.zh:
“Black Series”是我的Mercedes AMG生产的
终极公路车才能得到的头衔。

这辆AMG GT是有史以来开发的五款Black Series车型之一。

这意味着，这辆车不仅极度强劲——还极度稀有。

Mercedes AMG已经在许多赛事，包括F1和房车赛中取得了成功……

为上述赛事开发的顶尖技术也被运用到了Black Series上。

这辆车的空气动力学和底盘设计都采用了GT3赛车上的技术。

它搭载了一台AMG的顶级市售发动机，
能输出高达703ps的动力。

2020年，这辆车在纽博格林赛道的北环
跑出了6:43:616的成绩——当时市面车型的最快记录。

vehicleCollection.en:
This ultimate version of the AMG GT is laden with Formula 1 technology.

Since its debut in 2014, the Mercedes-AMG GT came in various forms, including a roadster and a 4-door coupe. There were high-performance versions offered, including the potent AMG GT Black Series that was introduced in 2020.

The Black Series represented the pinnacle of the AMG performance brand, thus, the AMG GT Black Series possessed true race car technology. Under its hood was a specially tuned twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 that produced 730ps and 800 Nm (81.57kgm) of torque. It came mated to a strengthen 7-speed DCT transmission whose gear ratios were revised. The end result was a car that ran from zero to <100km/h> in 3.2 seconds, to <200km/h> within 9 seconds and reach a top speed of <325km/h>.

Not all about going fast in the straight line, AMG tuned the chassis to capably handle the extra power, while the body was reshaped in various places to provide adequate downforce. In short, the AMG GT Black Series is a race car for the street, tuned to the nth degree by the most prominent luxury and motorsports brand in the world.
vehicleCollection.zh:
注入了无数赛车运动的经验和知识，这就是AMG GT的终极版本。

自从2014年首次亮相以来，梅赛德斯AMG GT已经推出了若干不同的版本，包括敞篷双座跑车、双开门跑车和高性能版本等。在2020年，梅赛德斯又推出了AMG GT的终极车型。这就是AMG GT Black Series。

Black Series的名号仅限用于限量款车型，在设计时力求尽可能多地将梅赛德斯AMG在赛车运动事业上开发出的科技运用于量产车平台上。

AMG GT Black Series是Black Series中的第六弹，采用了一部特殊调校过的4升V8 双涡轮引擎，将功率和扭矩分别提升到了730ps和800 牛·米（81.57kgm）。为了有效地传输这种超强动力，这款车配备的7速双离合变速箱也接受了强化，并重新设计了齿轮比。其结果就是这辆车可以在3.2秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速，9秒内完成0-<200km/h>的加速，并且可以达到<325km/h>的极速。

车辆的悬挂系统也得到了相应的调整。此外，全车各个部件都获得了材料和工艺上的改进，提高了操控性和过弯能力。

车身方面也毫不例外，加入了各种赛车风格的改动调整，但没有一处改动是多余的。

Under its hood was a specially tuned twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 that produced 730ps and 800 Nm (81.57kgm) of torque. It came mated to a strengthen 7-speed DCT transmission whose gear ratios were revised. The end result was a car that ran from zero to <100km/h> in 3.2 seconds, to <200km/h> within 9 seconds and reach a top speed of <325km/h>.

Not all about going fast in the straight line, AMG tuned the chassis to capably handle the extra power, while the body was reshaped in various places to provide adequate downforce. In short, the AMG GT Black Series is a race car for the street, tuned to the nth degree by the most prominent luxury and motorsports brand in the world.
long.zh:
自从2014年首次亮相以来，梅赛德斯AMG GT已经推出了若干不同的版本，包括敞篷双座跑车、双开门跑车和高性能版本等。在2020年，梅赛德斯又推出了AMG GT的终极车型。这就是AMG GT Black Series。

Black Series的名号仅限用于限量款车型，在设计时力求尽可能多地将梅赛德斯AMG在赛车运动事业上开发出的科技运用于量产车平台上。

AMG GT Black Series是Black Series中的第六弹，采用了一部特殊调校过的4升V8 双涡轮引擎，将功率和扭矩分别提升到了730ps和800 牛·米（81.57kgm）。为了有效地传输这种超强动力，这款车配备的7速双离合变速箱也接受了强化，并重新设计了齿轮比。其结果就是这辆车可以在3.2秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速，9秒内完成0-<200km/h>的加速，并且可以达到<325km/h>的极速。

车辆的悬挂系统也得到了相应的调整。此外，全车各个部件都获得了材料和工艺上的改进，提高了操控性和过弯能力。

车身方面也毫不例外，加入了各种赛车风格的改动调整，但没有一处改动是多余的。

And the suspension has been updated to incorporate
the technology used in today's GT3 race cars.

Thanks to the addition of a rear-wheel-steering system,

So, if you want to enjoy neck-wrenching cornering with amazing
straight-line performance, this is the car for you.

vehicleCollection.en:
This 'road-legal race car' evokes the image of the much-celebrated 300SL sports car.

The Mercedes AMG GT R made its debut in 2016 as a high performance version of the AMG GT introduced in 2014. While it was officially designated as a road car, it was in fact a race car in street-car clothing.

The first thing to catch the eye on the AMG GT R were the vertical accents on the grille, reminiscent of those of the 300SL that won the 1952 Carrera Panamericana Mexico. Other notable features of the exterior included the adjustable rear wing and the flared fenders.

Under the sheet metal, many of the car's components were swapped for carbon-fiber pieces, including the roof, front fenders and torque tube. This car was also the first Mercedes AMG model with 4-wheel steering. Under the hood, the car's twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter
V-8 was retuned to produce 585ps and 71.3kgm, allowing the AMG GT R to run from 0-<100km/h> in a lightning quick 3.6 seconds and reach a top speed of <318km/h>.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款“能合法上路的赛车”唤起了对曾备受瞩目的300SL跑车形象的追思。

梅赛德斯AMG GT R于2016年首次亮相，是2014年亮相的AMG GT的高性能版本。虽然以公路车的身份进行销售，但从性能角度来说，这辆车更接近于一款能够合规上路的赛车。

首先抓住你视线的便是前格栅上那凶猛的垂直板条，让你回想起1952年赢得墨西哥泛美越野大赛的那辆300SL赛车。其他夺人眼球的外观特色还包括可调整的尾翼以及宽体上的外扩挡泥板。

不过和原本车型相比，最大的改变还是它的内在。车顶、前挡泥板和扭矩管等多处换上了碳纤维部件以减轻重量，4升V8双涡轮引擎也经过调校，可以输出585ps的动力和71.3kgm的扭矩。这也是首款采用四轮转向的梅赛德斯AMG车型，车身前部还加入了主动式空气动力系统。

它可以在3.6秒内完成从0-<100km/h>的加速，并拥有<318km/h>的最大速度。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
Do you know the history of AMG?

It started out as a company that built racing engines.

At the helm were two engineers.

They were Hans Werner Aufrecht and Erhard Melcher.

These two worked in the race-engine forge
of Daimler-Benz.

When Benz took a hiatus from motorsport...

...Aufrecht and Melcher decided to go into
business together.

They founded their engineering company out of
Aufrecht’s house in Großaspach, Germany.

Taking the initials of Aufrecht, Melcher, and Großaspach,
they christened their company "AMG."

That was in back in 1967!
dialogues.zh:
你了解AMG的历史吗？

它起初只是一家专门打造赛车引擎的公司……

由两名工程师汉斯·维尔纳·奥夫莱西特……

和埃尔哈特·梅尔赫执掌。

二人曾经在戴姆勒-奔驰的赛车引擎铸造厂工作。

当奔驰暂时远离赛车运动后……

奥夫莱西特和梅尔赫决定共同创业。

于是他们在奥夫莱西特位于德国格罗萨斯帕赫
的家里创办了他们的工程公司。

他们从奥弗莱希特、梅尔赫和
格罗萨斯帕赫三个名字中

各取一个首字母，为公司起名为“AMG”。

那是在1967年！

vehicleCollection.en:
With a <310km/h> top speed, this Mercedes-Benz is a race car in street-car clothes.

After the exotic Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG was discontinued in 2013, the AMG GT was created to fill the void. But calling the AMG GT the direct successor of the SLS AMG wouldn’t entirely be accurate as the GT was slotted slightly lower than the SLS, and it didn’t feature the car’s trademark gull wing doors.

However that isn’t to say that the cars were not alike. The new AMG GT featured a long nose and stout rear deck like its predecessor, and its body was constructed over a rigid aluminum space frame. The engine was mounted just aft of the front axle, and a 7-speed semi-automatic transaxle was placed at the rear, helping the AMG GT achieve an ideal 47:53 front/rear weight distribution.

Under that long hood resided the compact M178, a twin turbocharged 3982cc V-8 developed specifically for this car. Customers had the choice of going with the standard engine tune that provided 460ps and 61.2kgm of torque, while those with insatiable performance appetites could opt for the upgraded version that delivered 510ps and 66.3kgm of torque. The high output engine came in the AMG GT S, and it allowed the super sports car to run to <100km/h> in a scant 3.8 seconds and reach a top speed of <310km/h>. The standard AMG GT was by no means a slouch, as it reached <100km/h> in 4.0 seconds and hit <304 km/h> in full stride.

The rear-wheel-drive sports car came equipped with an LSD, along with electronically controlled variable dampers and a drive select system that featured a race mode, which was appropriate because the AMG GT was pretty much a race car in street-car clothes.
vehicleCollection.zh:
最高时速<310km/h>。尽显梅赛德斯精神的超跑。

AMG GT是梅赛德斯-奔驰于2014年开始售卖的超级跑车。

这款车是于2013年停产的SLS AMG的后继型号，不过这辆新车比SLS低一个等级，车身更加紧凑。而且缺少了SLS标志性的鸥翼式车门。

不过，这款车的制造工艺依然精密准确。采用硬质铝制框架的车身具备标志性的长车鼻和极短的车尾风格。引擎放置在前轴后方，采用标准的前中置引擎布局，而后轮处则安装有变速驱动桥式传动系统。前后配重比为47:53，是针对公路驾驶的最佳平衡比例。

这款车的引擎是一具专门开发的紧凑型M178V8双涡轮增压引擎，变速箱则继承了SLS的7档双离合设计。所有车型都配有限滑差速器，以及带有电子控制的可变式减震器，并连接到包括赛车模式的驾驶模式选择系统。这套系统和其他系统整合后，可以提供激进的驾驶性能。

这款车提供两种引擎调校，标准型号可以提供460ps/61.2kgm的动力输出，而高性能版则可以提供510ps/66.3kgm的动力。

配备有高性能版引擎的型号被命名为AMG GT S。这是一款纯粹的跑车，悬挂更加坚韧，而且为了配合更高的引擎功率使用了宽胎。标准款GT的0-<100km/h>加速和最高速度分别是4.0秒和<304km/h>，而GT S当然会更快，分别是3.8秒和<310km/h>。

long.en:
After the exotic Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG was discontinued in 2013, the AMG GT was created to fill the void. But calling the AMG GT the direct successor of the SLS AMG wouldn’t entirely be accurate as the GT was slotted slightly lower than the SLS, and it didn’t feature the car’s trademark gull wing doors.

But that isn’t to say that the cars were not alike. The new AMG GT featured a long nose and stout rear deck like its predecessor, and its body was constructed over a rigid aluminum space frame. The engine was mounted just aft of the front axle, and a 7-speed semi-automatic transaxle was placed at the rear, helping the AMG GT achieve an ideal 47:53 front/rear weight distribution.

Under that long hood resided the compact M178, a twin turbocharged 3982cc V-8 developed specifically for this car. Customers had the choice of going with the standard engine tune that provided 460ps and 61.2kgm of torque, while those with insatiable performance appetites could opt for the upgraded version that delivered 510ps and 66.3kgm of torque. The high output engine came in the AMG GT S, and it allowed the super sports car to run to <100km/h> in a scant 3.8 seconds and reach a top speed of <310km/h>. The standard AMG GT was by no means a slouch, as it reached <100km/h> in 4.0 seconds and hit <304 km/h> in full stride.

The rear-wheel-drive sports car came equipped with an LSD, along with electronically controlled variable dampers and a drive select system that featured a race mode, which was appropriate because the AMG GT was pretty much a race car in street-car clothes.
long.zh:

这款车是于2013年停产的SLS AMG的后继型号，不过这辆新车比SLS低一个等级，车身更加紧凑。而且缺少了SLS标志性的鸥翼式车门。

不过，这款车的制造工艺依然精密准确。采用硬质铝制框架的车身具备标志性的长车鼻和极短的车尾风格。引擎放置在前轴后方，采用标准的前中置引擎布局，而后轮处则安装有变速驱动桥式传动系统。前后配重比为47:53，是针对公路驾驶的最佳平衡比例。

这款车的引擎是一具专门开发的紧凑型M178V8双涡轮增压引擎，变速箱则继承了SLS的7档双离合设计。所有车型都配有限滑差速器，以及带有电子控制的可变式减震器，并连接到包括赛车模式的驾驶模式选择系统。这套系统和其他系统整合后，可以提供激进的驾驶性能。

这款车提供两种引擎调校，标准型号可以提供460ps/61.2kgm的动力输出，而高性能版则可以提供510ps/66.3kgm的动力。

配备有高性能版引擎的型号被命名为AMG GT S。这是一款纯粹的跑车，悬挂更加坚韧，而且为了配合更高的引擎功率使用了宽胎。标准款GT的0-<100km/h>加速和最高速度分别是4.0秒和<304km/h>，而GT S当然会更快，分别是3.8秒和<310km/h>。

The AMG GT3 is renowned for its reliable strength

vehicleCollection.en:
This race car dominated the 24 Hours of Nürburgring in its very first outing.

The AMG-GT3, which made its debut at the 2015 Geneva Motor Show, was based on the AMG GT road car. It served as the replacement to the SLS AMG GT3 that had competed in races all over the world since 2011.

The AMG-GT3, built to FIA-GT3 specifications, looked meaner than its road-going counterpart, thanks to a special vertical-latticed grille, wide front and rear fenders, a low front splitter, large canard wings, and a rear wing carried over from the SLS AMG GT3. Also, the rear diffuser was much larger than that of the previous GT3.

The engine was swapped from the twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8 of the road car to a naturally-aspirated 6.3-liter V-8 that powered the SLS AMG GT3. This powerplant was mounted low on the car's aluminum space frame, which was a tad smaller than that of the SLS AMG GT3. This meant that the new race car was lighter, with a curb weight under 1300kg, and more nimble, thanks in part to a shorter wheel base.

The car took to the track in 2016 in various GT3 races around the world. At the 24 Hours of Nürburgring, it took the top four spots in its very first year of competition.

HTP motorsports of Germany, one of the top teams running the AMG GT3, found itself consistently in the championship hunt with the Mercedes race car in the Blancpain GT series. It won the Budapest and Silverstone rounds in 2016, as well as having finished 2nd place overall in the Nürburgring endurance race.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第一年参赛就称霸纽博格林赛道24小时耐力赛的领奖台。

AMG-GT3是梅赛德斯-奔驰在2015年日内瓦车展上公布的一款竞赛车型。这辆车的设计基于公路版AMG GT，用以接替自2011年起就活跃在全世界各大赛场上的SLS AMG-GT3。

这款车严格依照国际汽联-GT3规范进行开发，包括加宽前后挡泥板和许多引人瞩目的空气动力学套件。车身前部的低处装有分流器，保险杆左右两侧各有一片大前翼，并且继承了SLS AMG GT3那与车顶高度相同的尾翼，以及比前款GT3大得多的尾部扰流翼。特殊的纵向进气格栅似乎也在展示这款车与普通公路款的截然不同。

鉴于SLS AMG GT3极其优异的比赛成绩，我们自然也将公路款的4升V8双涡轮增压引擎众望所归地换成了6.3升的V8引擎，并安装在铝制框架车身当中。这款车的车身比SLS AMG GT3小了一个尺寸，而重量则控制在1300kg以下。较短的轴距也使其在敏捷性方面更具优势。

这款车于2016年开始在全世界多项GT3赛事中亮相。在纽博格林24小时耐力赛中，这款车在参赛的第一年里就霸占了第一到第四顺位。

德国HTP汽车运动车队就是使用AMG GT3的顶级车队之一，并且始终占据宝珀GT系列赛的领先地位。他们在2016年赢下了布达佩斯站和银石站的冠军，也在纽博格林24小时耐力赛中获得总排名第二。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Ever since it was introduced, the Mercedes AMG GT3
has been hailed as one of the fastest and fiercest GT3 race cars.

The original AMG GT3 made its debut in 2016.

At its first Nürburgring 24 Hours race, it did the
unthinkable, achieving an amazing 1-2-3 finish!

This machine is the updated AMG GT3,
which was introduced in 2019.

It featured aerodynamic improvements that generated
greater downforce than before.

Also, an all-new braking system placed less stress
on the tires.

While these performance upgrades resulted in
faster lap times...

...a more durable engine gave the AMG GT3 increased reliability.
And, a vastly improved parts management system...

...as well as several other tweaks made setting up and servicing the car easier for race mechanics.
dialogues.zh:
自初代型号发布以来，梅赛德斯AMG GT3一直被誉为
最强最速GT3赛车。

初代AMG GT3在2016年首次登上赛车舞台。

在参加的第一场纽博格林24小时耐力赛里，
它令人震惊地包揽了前三名，创下了永垂史册的壮举！

我们面前的这款赛车是升级后的AMG GT3，
于2019年首次亮相。

经过全面强化的空气动力性能
确保可以提供超强的下压力！

而全新的刹车技术则有效降低了轮胎磨损的压力。

除了这些性能升级带来的更出色的单圈时间外……

这辆AMG GT3还配备了更耐用的引擎、
一套大幅升级的零部件管理系统……

以及多项精细调整，从而帮助车队在赛道上更加风驰电掣。

vehicleCollection.en:
An improved and more cost effective GT3 machinej

The Mercedes-AMG GT3 was based on the Mercedes-AMG GT sports car that was unveiled to the public at the Paris Motor Show in 2014. This FIA (Federation Internationale de l'Automobile) homologated GT3 race car appeared on the international motorsports scene in 2016.

This updated 2020 model was introduced in 2019 with a focus on further reducing running costs as a customer race car. Improvements like a more durable engine and better protection for the radiator through a redesigned front end helped keep the costs of running a GT3 car more affordable for privateers.

The car's aerodynamics were improved through the addition of a front splitter and winglets, as well as a large wing and diffuser at the rear. The engineers also reduced the car's weight by using carbon fiber anywhere and everywhere possible.

The lower portion of the front grille was significantly widened, and the front and rear lights were updated. Although it retained the distinctive design of the previous model, many details on the car were updated to match the refreshed production model.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆性能更强、更经济的GT3赛车。

梅赛德斯AMG GT3基于梅赛德斯AMG GT跑车所打造，后者首次亮相于2014年的巴黎车展，而这款国际汽联赛事认证的GT3赛车则于2016年首次登上国际赛车舞台。

这辆2020升级款发布于2019年，作为一款面向客户车队出售的赛车，其开发重心是进一步降低维护费用。其改进包括延长了引擎的使用寿命，并通过重新设计车头部分为散热器提供更好的保护，进而降低维护一辆GT3赛车的高昂成本，减轻私人车队的经济压力。

此外，这款车的车身添加了前定风翼和侧翼片，以及在车尾加上了大尺寸尾翼和扩散器，以强化空气动力学效果。设计师还在许多部件上采用了碳纤维材料，尝试进一步减轻车重。

这款车的前格栅下半部分得到了大幅拓宽，前后车灯也进行了更新换代。尽管依然保留了前代型号的独特设计，但诸多细节之处已经根据量产型号的改款而进行了全面更新。

梅赛德斯AMG GT3基于梅赛德斯AMG GT跑车所打造，后者首次亮相于2014年的巴黎车展，而这款国际汽联赛事认证的GT3赛车则于2016年首次登上国际赛车舞台。

这辆2020升级款发布于2019年，作为一款面向客户车队出售的赛车，其开发重心是进一步降低维护费用。其改进包括延长了引擎的使用寿命，并通过重新设计车头部分为散热器提供更好的保护，进而降低维护一辆GT3赛车的高昂成本，减轻私人车队的经济压力。

此外，这款车的车身添加了前定风翼和侧翼片，以及在车尾加上了大尺寸尾翼和扩散器，以强化空气动力学效果。设计师还在许多部件上采用了碳纤维材料，尝试进一步减轻车重。

这款车的前格栅下半部分得到了大幅拓宽，前后车灯也进行了更新换代。尽管依然保留了前代型号的独特设计，但诸多细节之处已经根据量产型号的改款而进行了全面更新。

collection.en:
If you're looking for a legend of sports sedan,

then look no further than
the Mercedes-Benz 190 E 2.5-16 Evo II.

This car was made with a single goal:
to win races.

It was developed to compete in the DTM, a German race series
that gained a worldwide following through the 1980s and 1990s.

The DTM is contested by touring cars,
which are based on road-going production models.

For its entry, Mercedes-Benz turned the compact 190-series sedan
into a mighty homologation model.

The final evolution model of this is this Evolution II.

Although technically a production road car,
visually, it's a bona fide touring race car.

The race version of the 190 E Evo II
dominated the DTM and the European racing scene.

The AMG Mercedes-Benz works team won the manufacturers title
for two consecutive seasons in 1991 and 1992.

Only 502 road legal versions
of the homologation model were ever produced.

This is one car that any serious collector must have.
collection.zh:
如果你在寻找一款拥有传奇地位的运动型轿车，

只看梅赛德斯-奔驰190 E 2.5-16 Evo II就够了。

这辆车的设计目的只有一个——那就是赢得比赛。

梅赛德斯打造它的目的完全是为了参加一项在二十世纪八九十年代
举世瞩目的赛事——德国房车大师赛。

这项赛事的参赛车辆都是基于常规的量产房车所打造的。

为了符合参赛条件，梅赛德斯将190系列紧凑型轿车
改造成了性能强大的赛事认证型号。

而这个系列的最终进化——就是这辆Evo II。

尽管从技术角度上讲，它仍然是一款量产公路车，
但从外观来看，它已经是一台不折不扣的竞赛用车了。

190 E Evo II的赛车版本不仅在德国房车大师赛，
更在整个欧洲的赛车领域取得了统治性的地位。

AMG梅赛德斯-奔驰厂队在1991年和1992年
连续两个赛季拿到了车厂冠军头衔。

作为赛事认证车型，90 E Evo II的合法上路版本
仅生产了502辆。

不用我多说，这是一辆所有真正的收藏家
都必须拥有的车。

vehicleCollection.en:
Born from touring racing, the ultimate evolution of the 190E.)

In the early 1980s, Mercedes-Benz decided to return to motorsports after a long absence. The car it developed then was the 190E 2.3-16, based on the compact 190 sedan series, which was unveiled in 1983.

The biggest highlight of the 190E 2.3-16 was its engine, a tuned version of the 2.3-liter SOHC inline-4 that Mercedes-Benz already had in production. A 16-valve DOHC head was added, and the rest of the powerplant was tuned by Cosworth, a company famous for F1 engines. The result was 185ps maximum output and 23.1kgm of peak torque.

The 190E 2.3-16 began racing in the Deutsche Tourenwagen Meisterschaft (DTM) in 1986, but in only a matter of a few years, the personality of the car changed dramatically. By 1988, it had evolved into the 190E 2.5-16, equipped with a larger engine to keep pace with its arch-rival, the BMW M3. With displacement increased to 2.5 liters, the engine produced up to 200ps. The DTM homologation model, known as the 190E 2.5-16 Evolution, began its limited production in 1989.

Then, in 1990, Mercedes-Benz released the 190E 2.5-16 Evolution II, the king of all 190E race machines. Thanks to its menacing appearance, the Evolution II impressed all who laid eyes on it. Large wheel arch extensions were added at the front and rear to accommodate the wide 245/40ZR17 tires, and the trunk sported a spoiler so big that it hung over the rear end.

The engine was further tuned, boosting output up to 235ps (power was said to exceed 330ps in the DTM racing version.) A mere 500 of these Evolution IIs were produced during its limited production run. It took the DTM by storm in 1992 where it defeated many of its rivals, proving to all that it was the ultimate 190E, created in the competitive world of touring car racing.
vehicleCollection.zh:
自房车赛而生的190 E终极进化型号。

在二十世纪八十年代早期，梅赛德斯-奔驰决定在长期缺席之后重返赛车运动领域。为此，他们基于紧凑型190系列开发了一款跑车型号，也就是190 E 2.3-16，并于1983年正式向外界公布。
2.3-16最大的亮点就是专为它配备的引擎。这款全新引擎基于梅赛德斯已经量产的2.3升顶置单凸轮轴直列四缸引擎所开发，添加了16阀门双凸轮轴，并交由以调校F1引擎而闻名的考斯沃斯公司调校，其动力总成可以达到185ps的最大输出和23.1kgm的最大扭矩。
搭载着这部引擎，190 E 2.3-16从1986年起开始参加德国房车大师赛，但很快也被动陷入了无限升级迭代的命运中。到了1988年，这款车已经升级到了190 E 2.5-16，并且为了击败宿敌宝马M3而换上了更大排量的引擎。在排量提升到2.5升之后，新款引擎现在可以输出200ps的动力。另外一款德国房车大师赛赛事认证型号190 E 2.5-16 Evolution于1989年开始限量生产。
到了1990年，梅赛德斯又推出了2.5-16的终极车型：190 E 2.5-16 Evolution II。仅凭外观，Evolution II就惊艳了所有人。为了容纳宽大的245/40 ZR17轮胎，前后轮的轮拱都进行了大量外扩，架在后备箱上的巨大尾翼甚至探出了车身。
这款引擎经过了进一步调校，将动力输出拉高到了235ps（其德国房车大师赛赛车版本的动力据说超过了330ps）。限量生产的Evolution II总共只制造了500辆，却在1992年如暴风骤雨一般席卷了德国房车大师赛的赛场。在与强大对手的对决中，它以优异的表现证明自己不愧终极之名，是在房车赛中千锤百炼铸造出的传奇。

catch.en: Born from touring racing, the ultimate evolution of the 190E.)

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
This is a race car version of Mercedes-Benz's luxury sedan,
the 300 SEL.

The 300 SEL caught the eye of Mercedes-Benz tuner, AMG...

Who tweaked it to racing spec by increasing the engine
displacement to 6.8L.

It made its race debut in July 1971...

...in a European Touring Car Championship race at Spa-
Francorchamps in Belgium.

It won its class there, and finished in a very impressive
2nd place overall.

Pretty amazing for a large, 4-door sedan!

This result put AMG on the map, and gave it worldwide
prominence.

AMG would go on to play a key role in Mercedes-Benz's
race teams at the DTM and elsewhere.
dialogues.zh:
这是梅赛德斯-奔驰的豪华轿车300 SEL的赛车版本。

梅赛德斯-奔驰的改装商AMG慧眼发掘了300 SEL。

AMG将其调整为赛车规格，引擎排量增加到了6.8升。

它于1971年7月首次在比赛中亮相……

在比利时斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道举行的欧洲房车锦标赛中，

它不仅赢得了本级别的比赛，并获得了总成绩第二名，
令人印象深刻。

对于一辆大型四门轿车来说，这是很了不起的成就。

这一成就也使AMG声名鹊起，并在全世界范围内为人所知。

在那之后，他们在梅赛德斯-奔驰旗下的各支赛车队伍中、
在包括德国房车大师赛的各项赛事中发挥了关键作用。

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
This 300 SEL may have been big for a sedan, but
I consider it a sports sedan all the same.

The best image of this car that I can recall is a head-on
shot of it coming out of a corner at speed.

It must have been intimidating for other drivers
to see this machine in their rear-view mirrors.

This car is a great example of good visual weight balance.

It also showcases great dynamic weight distribution
in full racing trim.
dialogues.zh:
作为一辆轿车，这辆300 SEL也许有点尺寸过大，
不过我依然认为它是一辆很棒的运动型轿车。

我印象中这辆车最美的姿态就是
站在正前方看着它以高速驶出弯道。

其他车手从后视镜里看着这辆猛兽步步逼近时
心里一定非常紧张。

它拥有恰到好处的车身比例。

全套赛车饰条与配件加身后，更显动态十足。:

collection.en:
This 300 SEL 6.8 AMG is an important car
in AMG's success story.

AMG started as a company that built competition vehicles
based on Mercedes-Benz cars.

It was established by former Daimler-Benz engineer
Hans Werner Aufrecht...

And Erhard Melcher.

The name of the brand comes from the combination
of 'A' for Aufrecht, 'M' for Melcher...

And 'G' for Grossaspach, the hometown of Aufrecht.

This model was entered in the 1971 24 Hours of Spa,
where it won its class and finished second overall.

The great result really put AMG on the map...

And Mercedes-Benz owners flocked to AMG
so they could work their tuning magic.

AMG’s fame only increased thereafter, and became a
wholly-owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz in 2005.
collection.zh:
300 SEL 6.8 AMG是AMG的
成功发展史上一辆重要的赛车。

AMG公司起初生产用由
Mercedes-Benz汽车改装的赛车。

公司由Daimler-Benz前工程师
Hans Werner Aufrecht……

和Erhard Melcher创办。

品牌名称中的A代表Aufrecht，M代表Melcher……

G代表Grossaspach，也就是Aufrecht的故乡。

这款车型参加了1971年斯帕24小时耐力赛，
赢得了所在级别的头名和全场亚军。

这一胜举让AMG吸引了所有人的注意……

Mercedes-Benz的车主们涌向AMG公司，
希望他们能对自己的车也施展一番调校魔法。

AMG在随后的比赛中继续积累声誉，
最终于2005年成为Mercedes-Benz的全资子公司。

vehicleCollection.en:
This legendary race car put AMG on the map after its class victory at the 1971 24 Hours of Spa.

AMG began as a company that designed and tested race engines, founded by two engineers from Daimler-Benz’s development department. The company created this Mercedes-Benz 300 SEL 6.8 AMG for touring car races.

The stock 300 SEL 6.3 was powered by a 6.3-liter V-8. The car was plenty fast, but AMG decided to push the envelope even further by increasing the engine's displacement to 6.8 liters, adding special cams and other dedicated parts developed in-house to raise output from 250ps to 428ps. In 1971, the car won its class in the 1971 Spa Francorchamps 24 Hour race, and came in 2nd place overall.

It is said that only a total of three race cars and two test cars were ever produced.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆传奇赛车在1971年斯帕24小时耐力赛中赢得了所在组别的冠军，打响了AMG的名声。

梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SEL 6.8 AMG是AMG早年生产的一款竞速房车。

这是一家由两名来自戴姆勒-奔驰研发部的工程师在1967年创立的机械工程公司。这款车采用一台W100 Type 600的6.3升V8引擎，被装进了W109 Type 300 SEL原本搭载3升直列6缸引擎的引擎舱。它在1971年的斯帕弗朗科尔尚24小时耐力赛赢得分组冠军，总成绩排名第2。它优异的表现抓住了梅赛德斯车迷的心，也让这家公司走上正轨，日后更是成为梅赛德斯的厂队和竞速赛事官方合作伙伴。

它的基础车型梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SEL 6.3本身就以速度见长，而AMG把排量又进一步提高到了6.8升，还增加了特制的凸轮和其他自制零件，马力从250ps提升至了428ps。

据说，这款车总共只生产了3台赛车和2台测试车。

long.en:
AMG began as a company that designed and tested race engines, founded by two engineers from Daimler-Benz’s development department. The company created this Mercedes-Benz 300 SEL 6.8 AMG for touring car races.

The stock 300 SEL 6.3 was powered by a 6.3-liter V-8. The car was plenty fast, but AMG decided to push the envelope even further by increasing the engine's displacement to 6.8 liters, adding special cams and other dedicated parts developed in-house to raise output from 250ps to 428ps. In 1971, the car won its class in the 1971 Spa Francorchamps 24 Hour race, and came in 2nd place overall.

It is said that only a total of three race cars and two test cars were ever produced.

dialogues.en:
There seems to be a reason behind every detail of this design,
a design with the spirit of rationality.

Yet it possesses irresistible charm.
This is the W194, also known as the 300SL.

It won the Mille Miglia, Grand Prix of Bern,
and the Carrera Panamericana in 1952.

On top of that, it placed 1-2 at Le Mans.

The doors of this car swing upward in
what is known as "gullwing" types.

That term also serves as the nickname for this car.

This design is the result of avoiding the bottom portion
 of the structure of the space frame./
dialogues.zh:
这款车的每一处设计细节似乎皆有所本，既具有理性精神，
又有令人无法抵挡的魅力。

它就是W194，也被称为300SL。

它不仅于1952年的意大利一千英里耐力赛、伯尔尼大奖赛和
Carrera泛美公路拉力赛上豪迈地拿下了冠军头衔，

还在勒芒24小时耐力赛中包揽了前二。

此车的上翻式车门被称作“鸥翼”车门，

由此，“鸥翼”也成为了本车的绰号。

其实，如此设计是为了避免车门与空间车架结构的底部发生冲突。

collection.en:
The Type W194 300SL is one of the more notable Mercedes-Benz
machines from the Golden Age of racing of the 1950s.

A champion at Le Mans and the Carrera Panamericana, the car
is also known for inspiring the iconic 300SL Coupe.

Designed by Rudolf Uhlenhaut, a legendary engineer with a
vast amount of experience in race car design...

...the Mercedes-Benz W194 300SL boasted the latest
in the race technology of its day.

It featured a spaceframe chassis, an independent suspension
and a single-overhead camshaft inline-6.

Only ten were believed to have been built.

Thanks to its excellent performance and reliability, the car
shone in endurance races.

This car, chassis number 007/52, is the car
that won Le Mans.

If a W194 were to hit the market now, the price
would surely be astronomical.
collection.zh:
诞生于20世纪50年代的W194 300SL
是Mercedes旗下的传奇赛车。

在勒芒和卡雷拉泛美拉力赛取胜以后，
它又因为启发了经典的300SL Coupe而名声大噪。

W194 300SL由Mercedes工程师
Rudolf Uhlenhaut设计……

他是一位具有丰富赛车设计经验的传奇工程师。

其空间框架底盘上装配了独立悬挂
以及顶置单凸轮轴直列六缸引擎。

据称该车总计只生产了10辆。

归功于其良好的抓地力性能和可靠性，它曾与许多
顶尖赛车一决高下，留下多场令人难忘的比赛。

底盘编号为007/52的这辆赛车是勒芒冠军之车。

如果传出W194待售的消息，只怕会
堆出一个个天文数字的报价来。

vehicleCollection.en:
The car that brought Mercedes-Benz its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.+

To many, the 300 SL name represents Mercedes-Benz's classic sports coupe that first appeared in 1954, but the 300 SL moniker actually originated with a prototype race car built by the company for its factory team.

Codenamed W194, the 300 SL race car featured an aluminum tube frame and improved versions of the engine and suspension from the W186 300. It weighed just 870kg, and the inline-6 was tuned to produce 172.4ps.

This very car, chassis number 194007/52, went out and won the 1952 24 Hours of Le Mans on its debut race, then two months later, after having its roof removed to cut 100kg from its racing weight, took the checkered flag at the 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

Naturally, its success on the race track convinced the execs at Mercedes-Benz to create a production version, which we now know as the "Gullwing 300 SL."
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款车为梅赛德斯-奔驰带来了勒芒24小时耐力赛有史以来的首胜。

虽然对许多人来说，300SL令人想起的是梅赛德斯在1954年首次亮相的历史悠久、优雅的量产跑车形象，但这个名字最初属于为车厂车队制造的原型赛车。

300SL赛车的开发代号为W194，它采用了铝管框架和铝制车身板件，搭配来自W186 300的改进版引擎和悬挂。这台车的重量仅有870kg，直列6缸引擎经过调校后可产生172.4ps，用于参加勒芒24小时耐力赛。

这辆底盘编号为194007/52的汽车在1952年勒芒24小时耐力赛上首次亮相便为梅赛德斯-奔驰取得了惊人的胜利。2个月后，这辆车在纽博格林赛道上再获成功。在参赛前，该车的车身再次修改，切掉了车顶，形成了蜘蛛状的车身，将重量又减轻了100kg。

赛场上的成功因为促成了对量产车型的大量需求，公路版车款的开发就此启动。

dialogues.en:
The Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé is one of the most
recognisable sports cars in the history of automobiles.

Overall, it has a look of ‘refined speed,’ and deserves
all of the acclaim it receives.

The 300 SL has some great shapes...

Take, for instance, its bonnet, fender eyebrows, sloping
tail, and beautifully executed roof and windows.

One of its most distinct design elements are its gullwing
doors, which I think look even better when closed.{
dialogues.zh:
Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé是汽车史上
最具辨识度的跑车车型之一。

总体上看，它便是“精致速度”的代表，
完全配得上它所获得的一切赞誉。

300 SL的轮廓中融合了一些美轮美奂的形状……

比如它的引擎盖、挡泥板上缘、下倾的车尾
以及设计精巧的车顶和车窗。

它最特别的一处设计元素就是它的
鸥翼车门，而且我觉得门关上之后甚至更好看了。

collection.en:
The Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé is a classic car
with a real racing pedigree.

It was based on the legendary W194 racing coupé,
which won races all over the world...

Including the 24 Hours of Le Mans
and the Carrera Panamericana.

Its victory at the latter really turned heads
in North America.

When east coast importer Max Hoffman asked the German
manufacturer to produce a road version of the W194...

Mercedes-Benz boldly stepped up to the task.

The 300 SL 'Gullwing' Coupe was the result
of this undertaking.

It's undoubtedly one of the most important models
in the company's history!
collection.zh:
有着真正的赛车血统的Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupé
是一辆无可争议的经典跑车。

它是基于传奇赛车W194设计制造的。

W194在全世界赢下了包括勒芒24小时耐力赛在内的无数赛事。

它甚至在卡雷拉泛美拉力赛中取胜，让北美车迷也为之
侧目！

东海岸的进口商马克斯·霍夫曼请求德国制造商生产W194
的量产公路版本。

Mercedes-Benz毫不犹豫就接下了订单！

而“鸥翼车门”300 SL Coupe就是这次豪赌交易的产物。

它无疑是这家公司史上最重要的车款之一！

vehicleCollection.en:
With its gullwing doors and other advanced technologies, the 1954 Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupe was a car way ahead of its time.

At the 1955 New York International Auto Show, Daimler-Benz unveiled an innovative new sports car—the Mercedes-Benz 300 SL. Its engine was mounted longitudinally within a lightweight multi-tubular space frame crafted from slender steel pipes, and tilted at a 50-degree angle to allow for the lowest possible hood line. Equipped with a 4-speed transmission, this high-performance machine was capable of reaching speeds of up to <260km/h>.

The car’s most distinctive features were its unique side doors. They opened upward and were hinged at the center of the roof. When both doors were raised, the car’s silhouette resembled a seagull in flight—earning the 300 SL’s doors the famous moniker, "gullwing."

Power came from a 2996cc SOHC inline-6 engine, the first production engine to employ the same mechanical fuel injection system used in the W196 Formula 1 racer. This setup produced an impressive 215ps at 5800rpm. Although its 4-wheel drum brakes and 1295kg curb weight were considerable for the time, the car’s exceptional engine performance made it one of the preeminent sports cars of its era. The production 300 SL proved its worth on the track as well, securing numerous victories in sports-car racing.

Between 1955 and 1957, 1,400 300 SL gullwing coupes were built. In 1957, production of the coupe ended, passing the torch to the 300 SL Roadster, an open-top successor that continued the legacy of one of Mercedes-Benz’s most iconic creations.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一台领先时代的鸥翼双门轿车，许多现代跑车的鼻祖。

在1954年的纽约国际车展上，戴姆勒-奔驰公布了一款创新跑车梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SL。它的引擎纵向安装在细钢管制成的多管式空间车架中，为了尽可能降低引擎盖高度，安装角度被调整为了斜向50度。它采用4速变速箱，是一款极速能够达到<260km/h>的高性能车型。

这款车最标志性的特色是向上开启到车顶的侧门。两侧门打开后，从正面看像极了一只海鸥，因此300 SL的车门又被叫做鸥翼门。

这辆车采用2996cc顶置单凸轮轴直列6缸引擎，并且首次把W 196赛车的机械式燃油喷射系统下放到量产车型上。得益于这些技术，它的最大输出达到了5800rpm时的215ps马力。它的刹车系统采用了四轮鼓式刹车。整车重量为1295kg，与同时代车型相比并不算轻，但由于搭载了最高级别的引擎，它依然是那个年代最顶级的跑车之一。量产版的300 SL在汽车赛事中的表现同样可圈可点，多次为梅赛德斯赢得胜利。

从1955年到1957年，300 SL鸥翼双门跑车一共生产了1400台。1957年起，这款双门跑车停止生产，交棒300 SL Roadster。后者是一款中规中矩的敞篷车。

catch.en: With its gullwing doors and other advanced technologies, the 1954 Mercedes-Benz 300 SL Coupe was a car way ahead of its time.
catch.zh: 一台领先时代的鸥翼双门轿车，许多现代跑车的鼻祖。

Its engine was mounted longitudinally within a lightweight multi-tubular space frame crafted from slender steel pipes, and tilted at a 50-degree angle to allow for the lowest possible hood line. Equipped with a 4-speed transmission, this high-performance machine was capable of reaching speeds of up to <260km/h>.

The car’s most distinctive features were its unique side doors. They opened upward and were hinged at the center of the roof. When both doors were raised, the car’s silhouette resembled a seagull in flight—earning the 300 SL’s doors the famous moniker, "gullwing."

Power came from a 2996cc SOHC inline-6 engine, the first production engine to employ the same mechanical fuel injection system used in the W196 Formula 1 racer. This setup produced an impressive 215ps at 5800rpm. Although its 4-wheel drum brakes and 1295kg curb weight were considerable for the time, the car’s exceptional engine performance made it one of the preeminent sports cars of its era. The production 300 SL proved its worth on the track as well, securing numerous victories in sports-car racing.

Between 1955 and 1957, 1,400 300 SL gullwing coupes were built. In 1957, production of the coupe ended, passing the torch to the 300 SL Roadster, an open-top successor that continued the legacy of one of Mercedes-Benz’s most iconic creations.
long.zh:
在1954年的纽约国际车展上，戴姆勒-奔驰公布了一款创新跑车梅赛德斯-奔驰300 SL。它的引擎纵向安装在细钢管制成的多管式空间车架中，为了尽可能降低引擎盖高度，安装角度被调整为了斜向50度。它采用4速变速箱，是一款极速能够达到<260km/h>的高性能车型。

这款车最标志性的特色是向上开启到车顶的侧门。两侧门打开后，从正面看像极了一只海鸥，因此300 SL的车门又被叫做鸥翼门。

这辆车采用2996cc顶置单凸轮轴直列6缸引擎，并且首次把W 196赛车的机械式燃油喷射系统下放到量产车型上。得益于这些技术，它的最大输出达到了5800rpm时的215ps马力。它的刹车系统采用了四轮鼓式刹车。整车重量为1295kg，与同时代车型相比并不算轻，但由于搭载了最高级别的引擎，它依然是那个年代最顶级的跑车之一。量产版的300 SL在汽车赛事中的表现同样可圈可点，多次为梅赛德斯赢得胜利。

从1955年到1957年，300 SL鸥翼双门跑车一共生产了1400台。1957年起，这款双门跑车停止生产，交棒300 SL Roadster。后者是一款中规中矩的敞篷车。

dialogues.en:
One really cool thing about the design of this car...

Is how it does not rely on gimmicks, but is rather
a pure expression of functional beauty.

The surfaces are well-sculpted into tasteful shapes.
And the body is muscular, with great proportions.

Though the wheels are the largest of their kind,
the car seems to almost hug the ground.

Indeed, the Mercedes A45 AMG has been carefully designed
To express a tough and cool attitude.

I want one in my garage!
dialogues.zh:
这辆Mercedes A45 AMG的设计十分成熟，
性能强悍而且外形帅气。

其车身轮廓充满肌肉感，而且保持了合理的比例。

车身表面经过精心塑形，弧形线条丰富而流畅。

设计师甚至考虑到了轮胎的问题，
最宽尺寸的车胎可以让这辆Mercedes牢牢扒住地面。

这辆车的优势在于不忘初心，
绝无任何花哨的设计，只用实力说话。

这样的车，连我也想买一辆！/

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate hot hatch based on the third-generation A Class.)

Completely rebuilt and redesigned from the ground up, the third-generation Mercedes-Benz A Class bowed at the 2012 Geneva Motor Show, possessing a low, wide stance that made it look much sportier than the somewhat tame previous-generation model.

To go along with its dashing exterior, Mercedes-Benz upgraded the new A Class’ on-road performance. It came powered by a peppy turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-4 that delivered 122ps/20.4kgm, but the choice for driving enthusiasts was the upgrade turbocharged 2.0-liter engine that pumped out an impressive 210ps/35.7kgm. The new A Class also boasted an enhanced chassis, featuring a much more rigid body structure and stiffer suspension system.

A year after the introduction of the new A Class, Mercedes-Benz unveiled the A45 AMG, a creation that brought out the true sporty potential of the small passenger vehicle. AMG went straight to work on the upgrade 2.0-liter inline-4, and without increasing displacement, was able to squeeze an amazing 360ps/45.9kgm out of it. They also mated it to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. This allowed the new A45 AMG to run to <100km/h> in a scant 4.6 seconds and reach a top speed of <250km/h> (restricted by a speed limiter).

AMG also did their magic on the vehicle’s suspension and brakes, giving it sports car-like handling, while also installing the newest version of the “4Matic” Mercedes 4WD system, which can distribute power from 50:0 front/rear (full front-wheel-drive) to 50/50.

It was clear that the A Class, especially the AMG version, was no longer a daily people hauler, it was now essentially a 5-door sports car.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第三代A级中的终极高性能小钢炮。

梅赛德斯-奔驰A级在2012年日内瓦车展上进行了全面更新，升级到第三代车型。新款车没有沿袭其前代的家用式高掀背设计，而是改成了更宽、更低、具有跑车外形的5门掀背式设计，以符合年轻人的品味。

让这款车具有跑车感的不仅仅是其外观：结实的车身可以和更高一级别的车款相媲美，同时还配备有1.6升或2升的直4涡轮增压引擎。其基本款车型可以提供122ps/20.4kgm的动力，而高级别车型可以输出更高的210ps/35.7kgm动力。所有车型的悬挂都进行了加硬，使其更适合运动驾驶的体验。

在日内瓦车展首次亮相的一年之后，第三代A级迎来了一款更能够彰显运动风范的车型，那就是A45 AMG。这款车的引擎同样采用高级别的2升涡轮增压引擎，并由AMG进行调校。在排量不变的情况下，引擎可以输出高达360ps/45.9kgm的强悍动力。0-<100km/h>的加速时间仅需4.6秒，而最高时速可达<250km/h>（超过后，限速器将介入），显示出远超其级别的性能。

当然，这款车的悬挂和刹车也得到了进一步的加强，不过更可圈可点的是其在驱动系统上的升级。这辆车采用最新版本的“4Matic”梅赛德斯四轮驱动系统，与7档双离合变速箱配合，并安装在后轴上，可将前轮驱动系统的驱动力进行线性调整，最多可分配为前后比50：50。

在这款终极的高性能小钢炮身上，没有任何缺陷。

The 2013 Mercedes-Benz AMG VGT was the first car created for
the Vision Gran Turismo project.

Its design was inspired by the legendary Mercedes-Benz
300 SL, which was released in 1952.

The car's designers also drew inspiration from the dynamic
movement of big cats on the prowl.

It featured a lightweight carbon-fiber body, aluminum
space frame and a twin-turbocharged 5.5-liter V-8...

...which produced 585ps, enough to outrun a GT3 race car!

2013 Mercedes-Benz AMG VGT是Vision Gran Turismo项目创作的

其设计灵感取自1952年发布的传奇车型Mercedes-Benz 300 SL。

该车的设计师还从大型猫科动物潜行捕猎时的动态中获
得了灵感。

除了轻量级的碳纤维车身和铝制空间车架外，此车还配

可以产生585ps的动力——甚至超越了GT3类别的赛车！

vehicleCollection.en:
The start of something very special: The very first "Vision Gran Turismo."

Vision Gran Turismo is a project in which the world's auto makers and global brands develop a concept car for the fans of "Gran Turismo". The car that crowns the opening of this innovative collaboration is the Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo.

The design team of Mercedes-Benz incorporated the image of a large cat on the hunt, incorporating both agility and graceful elegance in the design. The characteristic body with its sensual contours is reminiscent of traditional Mercedes-Benz sports car proportions. Even the shape of the front grille is a reinterpretation of the wide Mercedes-Benz sports car grille with central star. Its shape is reminiscent of the legendary 300 SL racing car which won the third Panamericana race, known for being one of the toughest long distance races in the world.

With an aluminum spaceframe body and components in carbon fiber, the material of choice in motor racing, the Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo tips the scales at only 1385kg. The AMG V8 biturbo engine delivers an exceptionally agile response to even the smallest movements of the accelerator. It develops 430 kW (585ps) and a maximum torque of 800 Nm (590.4 ft-lb). With its ultra lightweight body, the weight-to-power ratio calculates to an amazing <2.4kg/ps>. In addition, anyone can experience its breathtaking performance thanks to its AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT 7-speed sports transmission, which is systematically configured for outstandingly dynamic performance.

The sound of the car is another point to be noted. The powerful howl emitted by this engine was composed by sound specialists at AMG. The sonorous exhaust note and engine sounds are tuned perfectly to awaken the excitement of a racetrack wherever you are.

The double wishbone suspension on the front and rear axles reflects a long-standing racing experiece at Mercedes-Benz. The electronic differential lock ensures the ideal taction for the powered rear wheels. The AMG ceramic high-performance copound bake system guarantees excellent decelertion.

Experience or yourself the exquisite concet sports car presented b Mercees-Benz.
vehicleCollection.zh:
体验精致的概念跑车。Vision Gran Turismo的头号车型。

跑车浪漫旅愿景是一个联合全世界汽车制造商和品牌为跑车浪漫旅的玩家群体共同打造一款概念赛车的计划。为这次创举般的合作打响第一炮的就是梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo。

梅赛德斯-奔驰的设计团队在这辆车的形象中注入了狩猎中的猫科动物所表现出的敏捷性和优雅姿态。极富性格的车身和流畅的轮廓会让人回想起梅赛德斯-奔驰经典的跑车比例。中央嵌入三角星车标的前进气格栅同样是对梅赛德斯-奔驰跑车宽大进气格栅风格的重新演绎。这款车的外形让人回忆起一代传奇赛车300 SL。在1952年，这辆车曾经在世界上最困难的长距离比赛之一的第三届Carrera泛美公路拉力赛上夺冠。

梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo使用了赛车专属的铝制框架车身和大量碳纤维部件，因此重量仅为1385kg。其使用的AMG V8双涡轮增压引擎输出430千瓦（585ps）的功率，拥有82公斤力米的最大扭矩，可以对油门任何轻微的动作做出极其灵敏的反应。超轻量车身使得重量马力比达到了惊人的<2.4kg/ps>。此外，AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT 7档运动变速箱可以让每一个人都能轻松体验它的超强性能，这套变速箱经过了系统化的配置，可以提供非常优秀的动力性能。

这款车的声音是它的另一大特色。引擎发出的强有力的咆哮声由AMG的声音专家专门打造。排气声和发动机的轰鸣声也同样经过精心调校，不论身在何处，都可以带给你身处赛道的兴奋感。

前后轴处安装的双横臂悬挂系统反映出梅赛德斯-奔驰对极致赛车体验的不懈追求。电子差速锁确保提供动力驱动的后轮可以获得理想的牵引力。AMG的高性能陶瓷L合刹车系统可以保证完美的减速。

说了这么多，你H是亲身体验一下梅赛德斯-奔驰推出的这款精美概念跑U吧。

梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo使用了赛车专属的铝制框架车身和大量碳纤维部件，因此重量仅为1385kg。其使用的AMG V8双涡轮增压引擎输出430千瓦（585ps）的功率，拥有82公斤力米的最大扭矩，可以对油门任何轻微的动作做出极其灵敏的反应。超轻量车身使得重量马力比达到了惊人的<2.4kg/ps>。此外，AMG SPEEDSHIFT DCT 7档运动变速箱可以让每一个人都能轻松体验它的超强性能，这套变速箱经过了系统化的配置，可以提供非常优秀的动力性能。

这款车的声音是它的另一大特色。引擎发出的强有力的咆哮声由AMG的声音专家专门打造。排气声和发动机的轰鸣声也同样经过精心调校，不论身在何处，都可以带给你身处赛道的兴奋感。

前后轴处安装的双横臂悬挂系统反映出梅赛德斯-奔驰对极致赛车体验的不懈追求。电子差速锁确保提供动力驱动的后轮可以获得理想的牵引力。AMG的高性能陶瓷L合刹车系统可以保证完美的减速。

说了这么多，你H是亲身体验一下梅赛德斯-奔驰推出的这款精美概念跑U吧。

This special edition of the Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran
Turismo is named for racing legend Lewis Hamilton.

Key differences from the base model include the rich
Bordeaux bodywork and the large fixed rear wing,

Also, the power of the engine has been increased to 600ps.

这台Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo的特殊版本
以传奇F1车手Lewis Hamilton命名。

它和原版车型的主要区别在于波尔多红色的车身涂装和大尺

vehicleCollection.en:
This race-focused Vision Gran Turismo machine was developed by Mercedes-Benz.!

”Vision Gran Turismo” is a special project where leading international brands develop concept cars for Gran Turismo and its fans. And the car which kicked everything off with was the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo," that first made its appearance in November 2013.

The Mercedes-Benz design team created a sensual gull-winged sports car designed in the image of a hunting feline. The car is elegance personified, infusing elements that reflect the 130-year legacy of Mercedes-Benz with futuristic sports design cues such as the LED front grille, an ultra lightweight body and an exhaust system that is integrated with the taillights.

There is also a separate version that is optimized for the competitive racing in Gran Turismo called the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo LH Edition," which is distinguished by a fixed rear wing that provides gobs of downforce on fast straights. The CCD camera side mirrors were returned to conventional mirrors, while the brake lights are adorned with the “Gran Turismo” logo.

For the race car, output for AMG's twin-turbocharged 5.5-liter V-8 was raised to 600ps, and the 7-speed dual-clutch transmission was optimized for fast gear changes, featuring sequential shifting with dog links. And while the road car tips the scales at a lean 1385kg, the race car comes in at a fighting 1300kg, thanks to the removal of all creature comforts. Also, thanks to a lower seating position, the car's center of gravity was improved for superior circuit performance.

Whichever version you happen to choose, one thing for certain is that the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo" represents a balance of ultimate elegance and competitive performance.
vehicleCollection.zh:
专注于竞速的Vision Gran Turismo，由梅赛德斯研发。

跑车浪漫旅愿景是各家国际顶级汽车品牌为跑车浪漫旅及其粉丝开发概念赛车型的梦幻计划。这项计划以2013年11月闪亮登场的梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo拉开序幕。

这款奔驰团队的杰作是一台充满感官刺激的鸥翼跑车，灵感来自狩猎的猫科动物。它是优雅的化身，完美融合了各种元素，既体现出了梅赛德斯奔驰百年历史的厚重，又有LED前格栅、超轻型车身以及与尾灯集成一体的排气系统等未来风超跑设计。

该型号还有一个优化版本，单独针对跑车浪漫旅的竞赛场景进行了优化，这就是梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo LH版。

后视镜是该版本与原始版本的外观区别之一。原始版本采用了CCD摄像机，而优化版本则使用了常规的后视镜。在刹车灯设计当中还俏皮地加入了跑车浪漫旅的徽标。

优化版本的特性包括极限的比例、性感的轮廓和更精确的图形，共同形成了激动人心的车身造型。AMG出品的5.5升双涡轮V8电机的动力输出被提高至600ps，针对传动性能优化，放弃了部分驾驶舒适性的7速双离合器变速箱被换成了使用止转杆的序列式变速箱。虽然原版的车重已经降到了1385kg，但优化版本在舍弃了实用性和舒适性配置后，将重量进一步减轻至1300kg。离地间隙和重心再一次降低，以提高赛道表现。

在呈现极致优雅与竞技性能的完美平衡的同时，这款梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo时刻准备着扑向猎物。

cars.nameEn: Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo Racing Series
cars.nameZh: Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo Racing Series

brandCentral.sourceName: Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo Racing Series
brandCentral.en:
The track version of the Mercedes-Benz AMG
Vision Gran Turismo is one monster of a car.

The base model's tuned engine is equipped with
a powerful racing transmission!

Weighing 85kg less than its predecessor, it goes and handles
better than you could ever imagine.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆车是Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo的赛道版。

基础车型的引擎经过调校后，配备了强大的赛车变速箱！

其重量比前代车型轻85kg，优秀的操控性超出您的想象。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo Racing Series
vehicleCollection.en:
Another "Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo" ready for competitive racing.!

”Vision Gran Turismo” is a dream project in which leading international brands develop concept cars for Gran Turismo and its fans. And the car which kicked off the project with its stunning debut in November 2013, was the “Mercedes Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo”.

The creation by the Mercedes-Benz design team is a sensual gull-winged sports car designed in the image of a hunting feline. The car is elegance personified, infusing elements that show the 130-year legacy of Mercedes Benz perfectly with futuristic sports designs such as the LED front grille, an ultra lightweight body and an exhaust system that is integrated with the tail lights.

And for the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo”, there is also a separate version that is optimized for the competitive racing scene of Gran Turismo. This is the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo Racing Series”.

The immediately noticeable difference with the original version is the fixed rear wing. Despite the increase in drag this creates, the aerodynamic device was utilized in favor of more downforce on high speed circuits. The side mirrors using CCD cameras were returned to conventional mirrors, and the rear brake light is decorated with the “Gran Turismo” logo for a touch of racing flavor.

And of course the non-visible elements have also been stepped up. The AMG 5.5 liter V8 Twin Turbo has been raised to 600ps, and the 7 speed dual clutch transmission has been optimized for transmission performance rather than ride comfort; now changed to a sequential transmission with dog links. Though the original is already extremely light at 1385kg, equipment for utility and comfort have been omitted to reduce the weight down to 1300kg. Lowering the ride height even further, the center of gravity has also been lowered for better circuit prformance.

The balance of ultimate elegance and competitive performanc. This is another breed of the “Mercedes-Benz AMG Vision Gran Turismo
, waiing to pounce on its prey.
vehicleCollection.zh:
又一款可以立即投入比赛的梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo车型。

跑车浪漫旅愿景“是一项由全球顶级汽车制造商为跑车浪漫旅和其粉丝开发概念赛车的梦幻计划。在2013年11月惊艳亮相，为这个计划揭开大幕的便是梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo。

这件来自梅赛德斯-奔驰设计团队的杰出作品是一辆充满感官刺激的、带有鸥翼式车门的跑车，其外形仿佛是一只正在捕猎的猫科动物。这辆车就是优雅的代名词，将梅赛德斯-奔驰百年历史的元素和未来跑车设计完美融合在一起，包括LED前进气格栅、超轻量车身，以及与尾灯一体的排气系统。

除了此型号之外，这辆车还有另外一个专为跑车浪漫旅的赛车竞技目的而优化的版本。那就是“梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Turismo赛车系列”。

其与原始版本最为显著的区别在于固定尾翼。虽然这个设计会增加风阻，但是该空气动力学装置却可以用来在高速赛道上获得更大的下压力。外后视镜也有别于传统后视镜，使用了CCD摄像机，而后刹车灯也加上了跑车浪漫旅标志装饰，平添了一份赛车风味。

对这辆车的强化并不止于此，还有极限设计的比例、充满感官冲击的外廓以及精致的图案，这一切结合起来，形成了一套独特的车身，让人一眼就能看出这辆车的卓越性能。这辆车的AMG 5.5升V8双涡轮增压引擎的输出功率被提升到了600ps，之前针对传动性能优化的7档双离合变速箱忽略了驾驶舒适度，因此这次也被替换成了带有止转杆的序列变速箱。虽然原始版本已经非常轻了，仅有1385kg，但该款车在移除众多功能性和舒适性设备后，将重量进一步缩减至了1300kg。另外，由于驾驶座的高度得到进一步降U，重心也相应降低以实现更卓越的赛道性能。

这辆v简直就是极致优雅和竞技性能的完美平衡。它是另一e类型U梅赛德斯-奔驰AMG Vision Gran Tursmo，此刻正虎U眈眈，准备猛扑向它的X物。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Who didn’t pay attention to the FIA GT Championship
when it launched in the mid-1990s?

Especially with all those incredibly cool Group GT1 machines!

This Mercedes-Benz CLK-LM from 1998 is a legend
of that GT1 category.

It was the successor to the CLK-GTR, which was built
in only 128 days...

...to compete in the 1997 championship.

Despite its short production time, the CLK-GTR really
tore up the track!

At the championship in 1997, it won six of 11 races, earning it
the coveted series title.

Appearing in the middle of the 1998 series was the CLK-GTR’s
evolution model—the CLK-LM.

With these two cars, Mercedes-Benz went on to win every race
of the GT Championship that year!
dialogues.zh:
在上世纪90年代中期，国际汽联GT锦标赛的诞生引起了
无数人的关注。

特别是那些令人叹为观止的GT1级赛车，
让人简直挪不开眼！

1998年推出的这辆梅赛德斯-奔驰CLK-LM就
堪称GT1级赛车中的传奇。

CLK-LM是CLK-GTR的继任者。1997年，为了赶上当年的锦标赛……

梅赛德斯在短短的128天内就造出了CLK-GTR。

尽尽管时间紧迫，CLK-GTR在赛道上的表现却令人刮目相看！

在1997年的锦标赛中，它在11场比赛中6次告捷，
成功夺得人们梦寐以求的系列赛冠军。

而在1998年的系列赛中，CLK-GTR的演化版本
——CLK-LM也随之亮相。

凭借这两款赛车，梅赛德斯-奔驰在当年的GT锦标赛中一路称霸，
豪夺每一场比赛的胜利！

dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.en:
To qualify the CLK-GTR, the predecessor of this CLK-LM,
for racing...

Mercedes-Benz was required to build 25 road-going cars for a few
lucky multi-millionaires.

Like its predecessor, the CLK-LM evolution had leather
upholstery and an air-conditioning system.

The dashboard, grille, headlights, and taillights
are similarly pleasing.

At the same time, it clearly maintains the design integrity
of its mass-produced CLK brethren.
dialogues.zh:
为了使Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR，这款CLK-LM的
前代车型获得参赛资格……

Mercedes-Benz不得不生产了25辆公路车，
出售给少数几位幸运的超级富豪。

因此，和前代车型一样，这款称作CLK-LM的改款车型
也配备了真皮内饰和空调系统。

其仪表盘、前格栅、前大灯和尾灯的设计同样精致。

与此同时，它也明显保留了与其量产CLK系列车型

conversation.en:
Who didn’t pay attention to the FIA GT Championship
when it launched in the mid-1990s?

Especially with all those incredibly cool Group GT1 machines!

This Mercedes-Benz CLK-LM from 1998 is a legend
of that GT1 category.

It was the successor to the CLK-GTR, which was built
in only 128 days...

...to compete in the 1997 championship.

Despite its short production time, the CLK-GTR really
tore up the track!

At the championship in 1997, it won six of 11 races, earning it
the coveted series title.

Appearing in the middle of the 1998 series was the CLK-GTR’s
evolution model—the CLK-LM.

With these two cars, Mercedes-Benz went on to win every race
of the GT Championship that year!
conversation.zh:
在上世纪90年代中期，国际汽联GT锦标赛的诞生引起了
无数人的关注。

特别是那些令人叹为观止的GT1级赛车，
让人简直挪不开眼！

1998年推出的这辆梅赛德斯-奔驰CLK-LM就
堪称GT1级赛车中的传奇。

CLK-LM是CLK-GTR的继任者。1997年，为了赶上当年的锦标赛……

梅赛德斯在短短的128天内就造出了CLK-GTR。

尽尽管时间紧迫，CLK-GTR在赛道上的表现却令人刮目相看！

在1997年的锦标赛中，它在11场比赛中6次告捷，
成功夺得人们梦寐以求的系列赛冠军。

而在1998年的系列赛中，CLK-GTR的演化版本
——CLK-LM也随之亮相。

凭借这两款赛车，梅赛德斯-奔驰在当年的GT锦标赛中一路称霸，
豪夺每一场比赛的胜利！

collection.en:
This CLK-LM is one of the most attractive race cars
produced by Mercedes-Benz.

It only competed for a few years in the late 1990s, racing in
GT1, which was then the pinnacle of Touring Car competition.

GT1-class regulations required an automaker to build only
one street car to be approved for competition.

Despite their appearance, these street cars
were in fact full-on race machines.

The CLK-LM's predecessor, the CLK-GTR, was produced
in accordance to these regulations in 1997.

When the FIA GT World Championships began that same year,
the CLK-GTR took home the title.

This CLK-LM was a further evolution of the CLK-GTR.

The replacement of the V-12 engine with a V-8 improved the
race car's overall balance.

As soon as it took to the track in the '98 FIA-GT Championships,
it absolutely dominated the competition.

That year, it took home both Drivers' and Manufacturers'
championships.
collection.zh:
这辆CLK-LM是梅赛德斯-奔驰生产过的
最诱人的赛车之一。

它只在90年代后半期参加了几年的GT1比赛，
随后就是房车比赛的巅峰时期。

GT1级别的规则只要求汽车制造商制造一辆公路车
就能获准参加比赛。

尽管外观如此，为此生产的公路车
核心却是一辆成熟的赛车。

CLK-LM的前身CLK-GTR也是出于同一目的
而于1997年生产的。

当国际汽联GT世界锦标赛于同年开始举办时，
CLK-GTR在出战便获得了冠军头衔。

CLK-LM可以视为CLK-GTR的进化版本，

用V8引擎取代V12引擎带来了
车辆的整体平衡性的改善。

使CLK-LM在1998年国际汽联-GT锦标赛中
一亮相就掀起了夺冠狂潮……

并且赢得了当年GT1赛事的
车手和制造商双料冠军。

vehicleCollection.en:
Making the switch from a heavy V12 engine to a lighter V8 helped this Mercedes-Benz dominate the FIA GT championship.

The Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR was created to compete in the ITC (International Touring Car Championship) after it replaced the FIA GT Championships in 1997. Developed in just 128 days by the company's motorsports and tuning division, AMG, the CLK-GTR got off to a somewhat rocky start in its race career, but rebounded quickly, winning six out of its first 11 races, claiming both the drivers' title and the constructor's championship in its first season.

The following year saw a new, evolved version of the car called the CLK-LM. The most noticeable change was the engine. Replacing the V-12 was a new V-8 that made the car lighter and enhanced its longitudinal balance. The radiator was moved from the front of the car to the sides so a lower hood could be implemented, thus improving the car's aerodynamics, while a new pushrod-type suspension gave it superior handling performance.

The CLK-LM made its debut at the 1998 Le Mans 24-hour race. While it failed to win that race, it did dominate every race of the FIA GT series, claiming the series championships with Klaus Ludwig and Ricardo Zonta at the wheel.
vehicleCollection.zh:
用V8引擎取代了沉重的V12引擎，这是一辆在国际汽联超跑比赛中获得压倒性优势的赛车。

为了参加1997年创立的国际汽联-GT锦标赛，戴姆勒克莱斯勒和AMG联手在短短128天里就打造出了一台比赛机器。这便是梅赛德斯-奔驰CLK GTR。除了前格栅取自CLK外，其他部分都变成了纯粹的比赛机器。车架由碳纤维复合单体车壳和钢制防滚架组成，车身顶部加入了巨大的进气口。

居中放置在驾驶座后部的是一台5000ccV12引擎，马力输出达到600ps。尽管缺乏足够的测试，CLK GTR依然在参赛的首个赛季里拿下了11场比赛中的6次胜利，帮助贝恩德·施奈德摘得赛事冠军。

但保时捷很快就在1998赛季推出了911 GT1，两款车型的龙争虎斗就此展开。为了应对强大的对手，除了派出两台厂队赛车之外，梅赛德斯还为私人车队提供了两辆CLK GTR，以此提高赛道竞争力。

在勒芒24小时耐力赛中，他们则派出CLK GTR的后继车型CLK LM参赛。LM和GTR的最大区别在于引擎：后者的V12引擎被重量更轻的V8引擎所取代。此外，散热器被移动到了侧面，车身经过重新设计，悬挂也改为了连杆式，使其操控特性更接近方程式赛车。

虽然CLK LM最终未能在勒芒完赛，却摇身一变成为了国际汽联GT锦标赛的厂队用车。GTR和LM联手在98赛季取得了10战10胜的完美表现。其中克劳斯·路德维希和里卡多·宗塔的组合拿下5胜。

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
This rare S model was built by British coachbuilder Barker,
best known for its work with Rolls-Royce cars.

In fact, you’ll notice that its body greatly resembles
that of a Rolls-Royce.

Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche during his stint as
chief engineer at Daimler-Benz...

...the S-type showed its potential when it won the opening race
at the Nürburgring in 1927.

Powered by an inline-6 mounted mid-wheelbase,
it is distinguished by its massive hood.

This feature gives the car very sporty proportions.

In addition to a factory body by Mercedes-Benz, the "S" also had bodies
by French and Italian coachbuilders.
dialogues.zh:
这款极其罕见的S系列是由因为与劳斯莱斯合作而闻名的
英国车身制造厂巴克所打造的。

其实你可以看出，它的车身与劳斯莱斯非常相似。

这辆S型的设计者是当时仍在戴姆勒-奔驰担任
首席工程师的斐迪南·保时捷博士……

并在1927年纽博格林赛道的开幕赛事上获胜，
向世人展现出了巨大的潜力。

它由一部中置直列六缸引擎提供动力，
其巨大的引擎盖尤为吸睛，

也赋予了这辆车极具运动感的比例。

除了由梅赛德斯-奔驰打造的原厂车身外，这辆S型还可以采用
法国和意大利车身制造厂推出的车身。

collection.en:
If classic cars are your thing, then you're bound to
recognize this S-Type Mercedes right away.

It won "Best of Show" at the 2017
Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.

And it's known as Mercedes-Benz's first sports car. Called
the S-Type, it was designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche.

The body was constructed by Barker & Co., a coachbuilder
best known for its work on Rolls-Royce cars.

The car's distinctive rear end is commonly referred to as
a "boat tail."

No one quite made them like Barker & Co.

This S-Type was commissioned by Earl Howe, a co-founder
of the British Racing Driver's Club.

Not only is this car a priceless gem, it takes
a certain amount of grace drive it!
collection.zh:
如果经典老爷车是您的菜，那您一定认得
这台看起来动力十足的S-Type Mercedes。

毕竟，她在2017年圆石滩经典车展中
可是赢得了“最佳巡展”奖。

被誉为Mercedes-Benz的第一款运动车型的“S”系列
由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计……

并由因与Rolls-Royce合作而名声大噪
的Barker & Co.提供的车身。

这辆车独树一帜的车尾造型被称为“船尾”

正是由Barker一手打造的。

此车是由英国赛车手俱乐部的联合创始人
Earl Howe委托制造的。

这样一台特立独行，举世无双的珍品，
惟有风度和气度俱佳的驾驶者才配得上它！$

vehicleCollection.en:
This very unqiue sports car was the first from Mercedes-Benz and is known for its characteristic boat tail styling.

Produced from 1927 to 1933, the Model S is considered the first sports car produced by Mercedes Benz. Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche, the Model S chassis boasted much improved performance than that of its predecessor, the Model K. Powering the car was a supercharged 7.0-liter inline-6 that produced 180ps, which was quite high in its day.

This Model S shown here won the Best of Show and the Gran Turismo Trophy at the 2017 Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance. Nicknamed the "Barker Tourer," this car was a one-off and remains very valuable. It was first owned by Earl Howe, a decorated racing driver who won both the Mille Miglia and the 24 Hours of Le Mans and was a co-founder of the British Racing Driver’s Club. He commissioned Barker, a British coachbuilder founded in 1710, to build him a lightweight tourer body with a boat-tail design, and the company delivered him the beauty you see here.
vehicleCollection.zh:
最古早的梅赛德斯跑车，拥有优美的收敛式车尾。

在1927年到1933年期间投产的Type S可以说是梅赛德斯奔驰的第一款跑车。

由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计的底盘表现出卓越的驾驶性能。与可以算是前辈的Modell K相比，它在重心和重量平衡方面都有着更优异的表现。Type S搭载的是一台7升直列6缸机械增压引擎，可输出180ps的动力，就当时而言性能相当强劲。

在2017年的加州卵石湾汽车巡展上，一台拥有标志性车身的梅赛德斯奔驰 Type S不仅荣获了最佳巡展奖，还赢得了GT奖杯。这辆车便是“Barker Tourer”。

Barker Tourer的第一任车主是豪威伯爵，一位功勋卓著的赛车手，曾获得一千英里拉力赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军，他也是英国赛车手俱乐部的创始人之一。他委托成立于1710年的英国车身制造商“Barker”为他的Type S打造了一款采用收敛式车尾设计的轻型旅行车车身。

这是一台极其珍贵的车型，全球仅此一辆。

catch.en: This very unqiue sports car was the first from Mercedes-Benz and is known for its characteristic boat tail styling.

long.en:
Produced from 1927 to 1933, the Model S is considered the first sports car produced by Mercedes Benz. Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche, the Model S chassis boasted much improved performance than that of its predecessor, the Model K. Powering the car was a supercharged 7.0-liter inline-6 that produced 180ps, which was quite high in its day.

This Model S shown here won the Best of Show and the Gran Turismo Trophy at the 2017 Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance. Nicknamed the "Barker Tourer," this car was a one-off and remains very valuable. It was first owned by Earl Howe, a decorated racing driver who won both the Mille Miglia and the 24 Hours of Le Mans and was a co-founder of the British Racing Driver’s Club. He commissioned Barker, a British coachbuilder founded in 1710, to build him a lightweight tourer body with a boat-tail design, and the company delivered him the beauty you see here.
long.zh:
在1927年到1933年期间投产的Type S可以说是梅赛德斯奔驰的第一款跑车。

由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计的底盘表现出卓越的驾驶性能。与可以算是前辈的Modell K相比，它在重心和重量平衡方面都有着更优异的表现。Type S搭载的是一台7升直列6缸机械增压引擎，可输出180ps的动力，就当时而言性能相当强劲。

在2017年的加州卵石湾汽车巡展上，一台拥有标志性车身的梅赛德斯奔驰 Type S不仅荣获了最佳巡展奖，还赢得了GT奖杯。这辆车便是“Barker Tourer”。

Barker Tourer的第一任车主是豪威伯爵，一位功勋卓著的赛车手，曾获得一千英里拉力赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛的冠军，他也是英国赛车手俱乐部的创始人之一。他委托成立于1710年的英国车身制造商“Barker”为他的Type S打造了一款采用收敛式车尾设计的轻型旅行车车身。

这是一台极其珍贵的车型，全球仅此一辆。

vehicleCollection.en:
The already aggressive-looking SLR McLaren looked even more ominous with optional 19-inch wheels.

The concept version of the Mercedes-Benz Vision SLR was unveiled at the North American International Auto Show in Detroit in 1999. It was the talk of the town, and everyone wondered if Mercedes-Benz was indeed going to build this supercar. The answer came at the 2003 Frankfurt Motor Show when a production version of the car was displayed. As the name suggests, the Mercedes-Benz SLR McLaren was built alongside McLaren Automotive of Formula 1 fame.

The SLR McLaren was a supercar of the highest order. It featured a carbon-fiber unitized body, ensuring low weight, which, by the way, was a lean 1768kg, more than 200kg lighter than the SL 55 AMG. Under its hood sat a supercharged 5.5-liter V8 with dry-sump lubrication that produced a whopping 625ps at 6500 rpm and 79.6kgm of torque from 3250 rpm to 5000 rpm. The SLR had the same 5-speed automatic that the SL used, but added sport, comfort and manual settings.

The brakes featured SBC (Sensotronic Brake Control), a brake-by-wire system, with carbon-ceramic discs at all four corners. The front calipers were 8-pot Brembos while the rears, also Brembo, had 4 pots. The suspension system consisted of double wishbones at all four corners.

The SLR boasted an amazing weight-to-power ratio of <2.8kg/ps>, which allowed the car to accelerate from zero to <100km/h> in 3.8 seconds. Top speed: a cool <334 km/h>.
vehicleCollection.zh:
造型更具攻击性的SLR车型，可选19寸轮毂。

梅赛德斯-奔驰愿景SLR的首次亮相是在1999年的北美国际车展上，立即攫取了所有人的目光。但直到2003年的法兰克福车展，它的量产版本才姗姗来迟。

这款车的官方名称是梅赛德斯-奔驰SLR迈凯伦，由著名的英国F1车厂迈凯伦负责打造。SLR最令人瞩目的特色是一套全碳材质的单体车壳，其他部位也都尽可能地用上了碳纤维，只有引擎舱室用了铝材质，最终将车重降到了1768kg，比SL55AMG足足轻了200kg。

SLR的动力单元是一台接受过AMG部门调校的5.5升顶置单凸轮轴双涡轮增压V8引擎，最大动力输出为6500rpm下的625ps，最大扭矩为3250rpm到5000rpm之间的79.6kgm。传动系统方面，SLR配置了SL同款5速自动变速箱，但拥有运动、舒适和手动模式。在手动模式下还能够自定换挡速度。

刹车系统毫无疑问是来自戴姆勒的电子感应制动控制系统，刹车盘全部是纤维增强陶瓷材质。前后刹车分别为布雷博的8活塞卡钳和4活塞卡钳，前后悬挂则采用了传统的双叉臂机械悬挂。

SLR的重量马力比达到了令人难以想象的<2.8kg/ps>。据官方数据宣称，这台车从0加速到<100km/h>仅需要3.8秒，最高时速可达<334km/h>。另一方面，这台SLR迈凯伦的价格也同样令人咋舌。德国本土售价高达43.5万欧元，在英国的售价则为33万英镑。

dialogues.en:
The 300 SL, which was introduced in the 1950s, is considered
a masterpiece of Mercedes-Benz engineering to this day.

This SLS AMG brings that legendary vehicle to
the 21st century.

And, it revives the most iconic feature of the 300 SL, which
are those gullwing doors!

Under the sheet metal, the chassis is all modern, highlighted
by a highly-rigid and lightweight aluminum space frame.

Under the hood is a naturally-aspirated V-8 that
produces 571ps.

It possesses an FR layout, complete with a transaxle,
meaning that the gearbox is located at the rear.

This allows for an ideal front/rear weight distribution that
makes this car extremely balanced through corners.

As the successor to the 300 SL, one can only imagine that
its value will continue to rise.
dialogues.zh:
300 SL在上世纪五十年代亮相时
被认为是梅赛德斯-奔驰的工程杰作。

这辆SLS AMG将那辆口碑载道的传奇带回到了21世纪。

它甚至让300 SL最具标志性特色——鸥翼门复活了！

这辆车的底盘采用了现代的设计，
由高硬度和轻质的铝制空间框架构成。

它搭载了一台发动机自然吸气V8发动机，
能够输出571ps的强大动力。

尽管这辆车采用了前置后驱布局，但其变速箱
位于后部；这意味着它有跨轴传动。

这种设计让理想的重量分布成为了可能，
从而改善了这辆车在直线和弯道上性能！

作为300 SL的后继者，这辆车的价值
肯定会水涨船高吧。

vehicleCollection.en:
With the SLS AMG, Mercedes-Benz recreates the 300 SL for the modern era.

The SLS AMG, with gull wing doors that paid homage to the classic 300 SL, bowed at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show. This exotic sports car, built from the ground up by AMG, made its debut in Japan in September of the same year, but not at an auto show or a Mercedes-Benz dealership; rather, it was featured in the "Gran Turismo" booth at the Tokyo Game Show.

Many considered the SLS AMG to be the successor of the SLR McLaren, but the body structure of the two cars were quite different. The SLS AMG did away with the costly carbon monocoque body of the SLR McLaren and instead came with an all-aluminum platform. The sacrifice in weight savings was nominal as the aluminum monocoque frame weighed only 241kg, allowing the SLS AMG to tip the scales at a lean 1600kg. This is quite impressive for a car that stretches more than 4600mm from front to rear.

Mounted just aft of the front axle was a new 6.3-liter V8 with dry-sump lubrication, dubbed internally as the M159. It produced 571ps/6800rpm with a peak torque of 66.3kgm/4750rpm, and came mated to a newly developed 7-speed DCT (dual clutch transmission) in a trans-axle layout. Of note, the driveshaft and torque tube were composed of carbon fiber.

The car featured five driving modes: "Comfort," "Sports," "Sports Plus," "Manual," and "Launch Start." Mercedes-Benz claimed that the SLS AMG could sprint from zero to <100km/h> in 3.8 seconds, and reach a top speed of <317km/h>. dialogues.en:
What, you don’t think that I know this car?
It’s the SLS AMG GT3!

The first customer race car in Mercedes-Benz’s
long and storied history.

It was produced in an era when Mercedes race cars were out
of reach for most privateers.

But the SLS AMG GT3 changed all that.

And its speed and reliability made it a formidable
weapon for privateers the world over.

The SLS AMG GT 3 has really competed in
many, many GT races over the years.
dialogues.zh:
什么？你以为我不认识这辆车？
开什么玩笑，这可是SLS AMG GT3啊！

这是Mercedes-Benz那漫长而传奇的历史当中的首款客制赛车！

在那之前，大部分的私人车队都没机会入手
这样一辆Mercedes赛车。

不过，SLS AMG GT3的出现改变了历史。

凭借可靠且强劲的速度，它成为了全球各地私人车手手
中最强力的武器。

这款SLS AMG GT 3参加过的GT比赛数不胜数！
