vehicleCollection.en:
This race car version of Mercedes-Benz's supercar was tailored to FIA GT3 regulations.

In 2009, the Mercedes-Benz SLS AMG was introduced at the Frankfurt Motor Show.

This supercar was developed independently by AMG, the high-performance development arm of Mercedes-Benz also responsible for the company's motorsports activities. The car sparked a worldwide sensation, thanks to its incredible high performance and gull winged doors that were reminiscent of the historic 300SL.

Mounted front amidships within the all-aluminum space frame was the M159, a tuned 6.2-liter V8 based on the AMG 63 series engine. Producing 571ps/66.3kgm of torque, and combined with a Getrag 7-speed DCT, it went 0-<100km/h> in 3.8 seconds and hit a top speed of <317km/h>.

The SLS AMG GT3 was a racing car based on this SLS AMG, modified to comply with FIA-GT3 regulations. The front and rear bumpers and side sills have been modified and an adjustable wing was added in the rear. The front/rear fenders were widened, and a cooling duct was incorporated to the hood. Aside from being fully functional, the styling is notably more aggressive. Its engine is shared with the production SLS, but although there are no official figures, it is said to have been massaged to exceed 600ps.

The transmission was swapped for a racing-style 6-speed sequential gearbox with paddle shifters. Composite brakes were fitted with a competition-level ABS, the steering was made direct ratio, and the car was given a special adjustable suspension.

This machine competed from the beginning of 2011, and out of the 101 races it contested, it won 25 times.
vehicleCollection.zh:
梅赛德斯专为国际汽联GT3规则打造的超跑。

在2009年法兰克福车展上首次亮相的梅赛德斯-奔驰SLS AMG是一款由梅赛德斯-奔驰的高性能车及赛车运动部门AMG独立开发的超级跑车。

这款车一经亮相，立刻受到了全球瞩目。它的鸥翼式车门让人立即回忆起声名显赫的300 SL。此外，其性能也能媲美其意大利竞争对手。

这款车采用中前置引擎布局，将一具基于AMG 63系列引擎全新开发的6.2升V8引擎M159置于全铝车架上。这具引擎可以输出571ps和66.3kgm的扭矩，搭配格特拉克 7档双离合变速箱，可以在3.8秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速，最高时速可达<317km/h>。

SLS AMG GT3是基于这款SLS AMG开发的竞速版，并根据国际汽联GT3规范进行了调整。

其前后保险杆和侧梁被修改为更符合空气动力学的设计，并在后部加上了一副可调尾翼。前后翼也都进行了加宽，并在引擎盖上增加了一条冷却道。除了功能上的优化之外，这款车的造型看上去也明显更加凌厉。这辆车和量产车款采用相同的引擎，虽然官方并未发布任何参数，但据传此引擎经过调校，输出功率超过了600ps。

而变速箱则改用带换挡拨片的竞技级6档序列式变速箱。其复合式刹车系统也搭配了竞技级的防抱死刹车系统，而转向则采用1:1转向比，另外还配备了经过特别调校的悬挂系统。

这辆车从2011年开始参加比赛，在当年参加的总共101场比赛中赢得了25场胜利。

这款车采用中前置引擎布局，将一具基于AMG 63系列引擎全新开发的6.2升V8引擎M159置于全铝车架上。这具引擎可以输出571ps和66.3kgm的扭矩，搭配格特拉克 7档双离合变速箱，可以在3.8秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速，最高时速可达<317km/h>。

SLS AMG GT3是基于这款SLS AMG开发的竞速版，并根据国际汽联GT3规范进行了调整。

其前后保险杆和侧梁被修改为更符合空气动力学的设计，并在后部加上了一副可调尾翼。前后翼也都进行了加宽，并在引擎盖上增加了一条冷却道。除了功能上的优化之外，这款车的造型看上去也明显更加凌厉。这辆车和量产车款采用相同的引擎，虽然官方并未发布任何参数，但据传此引擎经过调校，输出功率超过了600ps。

而变速箱则改用带换挡拨片的竞技级6档序列式变速箱。其复合式刹车系统也搭配了竞技级的防抱死刹车系统，而转向则采用1:1转向比，另外还配备了经过特别调校的悬挂系统。

这辆车从2011年开始参加比赛，在当年参加的总共101场比赛中赢得了25场胜利。

dialogues.en:
The Unimog—a versatile, multi-purpose truck with a storied legacy
has been a legend among enthusiasts for decades.

Its remarkable history traces all the way back to 1945.

It was originally designed as an agricultural workhorse.

And, it first entered production in 1948.

The 411 you see here belongs to the second-generation
series from 1956.

In addition to boasting a more powerful engine than the 401, it
was equipped with a wide array of specialized attachments.

It was the most well-rounded of the early Unimogs. Its endearing
design has captured the hearts of countless tractor enthusiasts.

作为多功能卡车界的“活化石”，Unimog
数十年来一直是车迷心中的机械传奇。

事实上，它的传奇历史甚至可以追溯到1945年！

最初被设计为农用机械的它……

于1948年正式量产。

眼前这台411属于1956年诞生的第二代车型。

相较401型，不仅引擎功率大幅提升，更配有
整套专业级拓展套件。

作为早期Unimog家族最全能的成员，其独特设计
征服了无数拖拉机爱好者。

collection.en:
Mercedes-Benz, renowned for its passenger vehicles,
has also made significant contributions to the commercial sector.

One such example is the Unimog.

An acronym for Universal-Motor-Gerät, its name translates to
"Universal Motorized Working Machine."

Designed in 1945, the Unimog was engineered as an all-wheel-drive
farming vehicle capable of navigating rugged terrain.

Its versatility stemmed from a range of attachments,
enabling it to perform virtually any task required.

1953 sarked the debut of the 401/402, the first iteration
to bear Mercedes-Benz's iconic three-pointed star.

It was followed by the Type 411.

It featured a cabin and flatbed mounted on a ladder frame
derived from the 401.

Often hailed as "the last original Unimog,"
the 411 holds a special place in automotive history.

Having evolved beyond its agricultural roots, it is now
celebrated as a premier vintage vehicle.~
collection.zh:
在乘用车之外，Mercedes-Benz还生产了多款
商用车类型的经典之作。

Unimog便是其中之一。

Unimog是“Universal-Motor-Gerät”的缩写，
意为“通用机动工作机器”。

Unimog于1945年设计，最初是一款四轮驱动的
农用载具，专为应对不平整的地形而打造。

通过配置各种用途的附件，几乎可以完成任何任务。

1953年，401/402型号问世，这是第一款采用
Mercedes三叉星标识的车型。

Type 411紧随其后推出，

采用继承自401的边梁式车架，并配有驾驶室和平板车厢……

411被誉为“最后一款原汁原味的Unimog”，因此
成为了极具收藏价值的珍贵车型。

如今，它已经超越了“农用机械”的定义，
被视为一款一流的经典车。]

vehicleCollection.en:
The benchmark for versatile, high-mobility vehicles.

The Unimog was a commercial truck produced and sold by Daimler Truck. With its ladder frame construction and rugged all-wheel-drive system, the Unimog has become a preferred vehicle in a wide array of industries, such as agriculture, slow ploughing, cleaning, high altitude work, disaster response, logistics, railways, airports, mining, construction and many others. Its long-standing performance record has solidified its status as the ultimate multi-purpose truck.

The Unimog’s story began in 1945, when Albert Friedrich, a former head of Daimler-Benz’s aircraft engine production, conceived the idea for a "universally applicable motorized machine for agriculture." Even from its earliest design stages, the Unimog was envisioned as a vehicle that could perform a wide range of tasks by simply swapping attachments. This versatile, practical approach has led to more than 70 years of loyalty from customers across various fields.

Full-scale production began in 1948. It was originally built by machine tool manufacturer Boehringer, but all production moved over to Daimler-Benz in 1950 where it was modified for mass-production. In 1953, the new 401/402 series core models arrived.

The 411 series, the model that followed the 401/402, was introduced in 1956. It was a developmental upgrade featuring a more powerful engine and reinforced chassis. The lineup offered three distinct wheelbases and multiple body styles, resulting in a total of 12 different models. These could be further customized for specific purposes with various attachments.

This model was available with two cab options: a cabriolet-style cap, designed for added convenience in work environments, or a closed cab crafted by Westfalia. The closed cab was available in two variations: the Type B, which shared design elements with the cabriolet versio, and the DvF, which was inspired by Mercedes-Benz truck designs of the 150s and 1960s. The DvF model could also be equipped with a heater upon equest.

Today, the 411 is considered by enthsiasts as the last o the "classic" Unimog models. I continues to enjoy a cut follwing for its owerful performnce, distinctive design, and enduring legacy.
vehicleCollection.zh:
多用途高机动性作业车辆的代名词。

Unimog是由戴姆勒卡车生产和销售的商用卡车。凭借其边梁式车架和强劲、可靠的全时四驱系统，Unimog在农业、慢速犁耕、清洁、高空作业、灾难响应、物流、铁路、航空、矿业、建筑等广泛领域中深受喜爱。其悠久的历史和性能表现巩固了其作为多用途卡车首选的声誉。

Unimog的历史始于1945年，当时戴姆勒-奔驰航空引擎生产部门的前负责人阿尔伯特·弗雷德里希开始构思一款“适用于农业的通用动力机械”。在设计最初阶段，它就已经被设想成一款多用途车辆，可以通过简单更换附件来完成不同的任务。这种理性和经济的创新理念，为其赢得了长达70多年的用户青睐和支持。

这款车的全面生产始于1948年，最初由机床制造商勃林格制造。但在1950年，所有生产转移到戴姆勒-奔驰，并为适应大规模生产进行了持续改进。1953年，401/402新系列的核心车型问世。

经过开发升级的下一代411系列发布于1956年，搭载更强劲的引擎，底盘得到了加强。该系列包含3种不同的轴距和多种车身类型，能组合出共计12种不同的车型，还可通过各种附件进一步定制以适应特定工作需求。

该车型可选择敞篷式驾驶室，方便不同工作环境下使用，也可选择由韦斯伐利亚制造的封闭式驾驶室。封闭式驾驶室也有两种版本：一种是与敞篷式设计相似的Type B，另一种是仿照50年代和60年代梅赛德斯-奔驰卡车设计的DvF型，后者还可以按需装配加热器。

411被车迷奉为“经典”Unimog的绝响，至今仍因其强大的性能和独特的外观而受到追捧。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
The W 196 R was an F1 powerhouse that took the international
racing scene by storm!

It made its debut in 1954, during the French Grand Prix,
or Race 4 of the World Championship of Drivers.

It was piloted by none other than Juan Manuel Fangio,
who had raced for Maserati up to Race 3…

...before he decided to join the newly arrived Mercedes-Benz
works team.

An Argentinian, Fangio claimed his first Grand Prix
title in 1951.

At the time, he was already one of the fastest drivers
in the sport.

Behind the wheel of the Mercedes-Benz W 196 R, Fangio proved
to be near-unstoppable.

He claimed two consecutive World Drivers’ Champion titles
in 1954 and 1955!
dialogues.zh:
W 196 R是一辆席卷了国际赛车界的F1赛车！

它于1954年在法国大奖赛，也就是世界赛车锦标赛的
第4站中首次亮相。

驾驶它的是胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥，他在第3场比赛为止
还在为玛莎拉蒂车队效力……

随后决定加入新成立的梅赛德斯-奔驰车队。

方吉奥是阿根廷人，他在1951年赢得了自己的
第一个大奖赛冠军。

在当时，他已经是这项运动中最快的车手之一。

在梅赛德斯-奔驰W 196 R的加持下，
方吉奥几乎无人能挡……

在1954年和1955年连续赢得两届世界车手冠军！
]

collection.en:
The name "W 196" evokes a special reverence among
Mercedes-Benz enthusiasts.

The reason is this legendary model didn’t just compete;
it dominated the racing world of the 1950s.

When the 2.5-liter engine limit was set for F1 in 1954,
Mercedes-Benz engineered a car tailored to the new regulation.

This machine, christened the "W 196 R," was equipped with an inline
8-cylinder angled, which on the track, became a finely tuned weapon.

Upon its debut in 1954, the car claimed four out of six victories in
the skilled hands of racing legend Juan Manuel Fangio.

The following year, in 1955, it solidified its reputation,
claiming five wins out of six races.

The "W 196 R" before you hails from that illustrious,
unforgettable 1955 season.

In this iteration, it appears without the original cowl, showcasing
the sleek single-seater with "monoposto" body.

It features a distinctive hood bulge designed for air intake.

By the way, did you know that the "W 196 R" had a sibling
developed for sports-car racing?

Named the "W 196 S," this model became a legend in its own right,
becoming a titan of the sports-car world.

Officially known as the "300 SLR", it left an indelible mark on
automotive history with its unmatched design and performance.
collection.zh:
对梅赛德斯-奔驰车迷而言，“W 196”是一个
意义非凡的型号。

这个传奇名字在20世纪50年代主宰了赛车界。

1954年，F1引擎规格限制改为2.5升后，
梅赛德斯-奔驰随即着手开发符合新规则的赛车。

这台被命名为“W 196 R”的赛车配备了一台倾斜放置的
直列八缸引擎，在赛道上所向披靡。

1954年首次参赛时，在赛车传奇胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥的
驾驭下，六站比赛斩获四冠。

到了1955年，它更是展现出无与伦比的实力，
在六站比赛中夺得五场胜利。

你眼前的这台W 196 R正是来自那个辉煌的赛季。

这款去除了首发时整流罩的单座赛车……

引擎盖上突起的鼓包进气口格外醒目。

对了，你知道吗？W 196 R还有一个为跑车比赛
开发的姊妹车型。

名为“W 196 S”的它同样名声显赫，是运动跑车领域
的翘楚。

它的正式名称是“300 SLR”，^样在汽车发展史上
留下了不可磨灭的印记。

vehicleCollection.en:
A legendary F1 car that made motorsports history.

The W 196, produced by Mercedes-Benz following its return to motorsports in 1951, was developed in response to the new 2.5-liter engine regulations introduced by Formula 1 in 1954. This groundbreaking car was crafted alongside a sports-car racer that shared many of the same core components. Both cars went on to achieve significant success in their respective fields, with the W 196 R dominating Formula 1 and the W 196 S excelling in sports-car racing.

The W 196 featured a tubular steel space frame chassis and made its debut at the 1954 French Grand Prix, equipped with a streamlined body that enclosed both the front and rear wheels in an aerodynamic shell. While the design provided successful on fast circuits, it became evident after the British Grand Prix that it obstructed the driver’s visibility and required frequent maintenance. As a result, from the German Grand Prix onwards, the car ran with an open-wheel body style, reserving the streamlined version for high-speed tracks.

In total, the W 196 was available in seven distinct configurations, featuring three different wheelbase lengths, two types of brakes, and two engine positions.

Powering the W 196 was an inline-8, constructed as two banks of four cylinders aligned longitudinally. This powerplant produced an impressive 290ps from its 2496cc displacement, enabling the car to reach a top speed of <290km/h>.

The W 196 cemented its place in racing history by dominating the 1954 and 1955 Formula 1 World Championships, securing back-to-back Drivers' Championships for the legendary Juan Manuel Fangio.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一款在赛车运动上名留青史的传奇F1赛车。

梅赛德斯-奔驰在1951年重返赛车界后，基于世界一级方程式在1954年规定的2.5升引擎开发出W 196。它与另一款竞速跑车车型同步开发，二者使用相同的基本组件： W 196 R参加世界一级方程式，而W 196 S则负责参加跑车比赛，两款车在各自领域都取得了成功。

这款赛车拥有基于钢制管状空间架构的底盘以及覆盖前后轮的空气动力学流线型车身，并于1954年在法国大奖赛首次亮相。然而，在之后的英国大奖赛中，人们发现这种车身设计会阻碍车手的视线，且需要频繁进行维护。因此自德国大奖赛起，这款车主要以开轮式车身参赛，只有在高速赛道上才会使用流线型车身。

两款车身还不是W 196的全部，它还包括3种不同轴距的底盘配置、2种刹车类型和2种引擎布局，总共有7种变体。

其引擎为直列8缸设计，类似于将两个4缸引擎纵向排列在一起。这款2496cc排量的引擎最大输出功率可达290ps，能将最高时速推至<290km/h>。

W 196统治了1954年和1955年的世界一级方程式锦标赛，助胡安·曼努埃尔·方吉奥赢得了两次车手总冠军。

catch.en: A legendary F1 car that made motorsports history.
catch.zh: 一款在赛车运动上名留青史的传奇F1赛车。

long.en:
The W 196, produced by Mercedes-Benz following its return to motorsports in 1951, was developed in response to the new 2.5-liter engine regulations introduced by Formula 1 in 1954. This groundbreaking car was crafted alongside a sports-car racer that shared many of the same core components. Both cars went on to achieve significant success in their respective fields, with the W 196 R dominating Formula 1 and the W 196 S excelling in sports-car racing.

The W 196 featured a tubular steel space frame chassis and made its debut at the 1954 French Grand Prix, equipped with a streamlined body that enclosed both the front and rear wheels in an aerodynamic shell. While the design provided successful on fast circuits, it became evident after the British Grand Prix that it obstructed the driver’s visibility and required frequent maintenance. As a result, from the German Grand Prix onwards, the car ran with an open-wheel body style, reserving the streamlined version for high-speed tracks.

In total, the W 196 was available in seven distinct configurations, featuring three different wheelbase lengths, two types of brakes, and two engine positions.

Powering the W 196 was an inline-8, constructed as two banks of four cylinders aligned longitudinally. This powerplant produced an impressive 290ps from its 2496cc displacement, enabling the car to reach a top speed of <290km/h>.

The W 196 cemented its place in racing history by dominating the 1954 and 1955 Formula 1 World Championships, securing back-to-back Drivers' Championships for the legendary Juan Manuel Fangio.

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
This may look like an ordinary R34 GT-R, but I can
recognize its true identity at a glance.

This is the BNR34 N1 base, built by the legendary
Japanese tuning house, Mine’s!

Mine’s is one of the oldest and most respected tuners
of the Skyline GT-R lineage.

Its creations embody the perfect balance of power, handling,
and speed, whether on the street or the circuit!

This is a machine every collector dreams of owning.

Among Mine’s many GT-R masterpieces, the BNR34 N1
base stands out as truly exceptional!
dialogues.zh:
这看似是一台普通的R34 GT-R，
但我当即就辨认出了它的不凡来历。

它竟然是著名日本改装厂Mine’s出品的
BNR34 GT-R N1 base！

Mine’s是历史最悠久、最受推崇的
Skyline GT-R改装厂商之一。

无论是街道驰骋还是赛道竞速，
他们的作品都展现出极致的动力、操控与速度！

这无疑是每位收藏家心驰神往的梦想座驾。

而在Mine’s众多GT-R改装杰作中，
BNR34 GT-R N1 base堪称真正的非凡之作！

brandCentral.en:
If you've heard of Mine’s, then you are a true “Car Guy.”

Mine’s is a Japanese tuning firm renowned for its GT-Rs.

Its most celebrated creation was the BNR34 GT-R N1 base,
a fully loaded, high-performance street car.

Capped at 600ps, its RB26DETT engine was tuned for
seamless acceleration across the entire rpm range.

Its ability to lap the Tsukuba Circuit in less than a minute was
the ultimate testament to Mine’s engineering prowess.

In 2021, this example underwent a full restoration, driven
by a strong desire to preserve it for future generations.

Only its GT-R badge bore battle scars—a subtle yet striking
detail added by Mine’s president, Michizo Niikura.

Once the subject of a 300,000,000 yen offer, time would tell
how it might one day be appraised on the global stage.
brandCentral.zh:
若你知晓迈恩斯大名，那你一定是位真正的“玩车佬”。
迈恩斯是一家日本专业改装厂，专精于改造GT-R车型。

其最负盛名的作品基于BNR34 GT-R N1 base打造，
是一款性能卓越、配置齐全的高性能街车。

其所搭载的双顶置凸轮轴电子汽油喷射双涡轮引擎峰值功率被设定在600ps，
专为在常规转速区间内提供线性加速而打造。

这台车在筑波赛道跑进了一分钟大关——
充分印证了Mine's的顶尖工程造诣。

2021年，此车进行了全面修复，
因为人们强烈希望将其完好保存，以传后世。

唯有车头的GT-R徽标留有往日激战的痕迹——
这一匠心细节正是迈恩斯总裁新仓通藏先生提出的。

这台曾获3亿日元报价的座驾，
其国际舞台的价值，且待时间评说。

vehicleCollection.en:
This legendary, fully tuned GT-R gained a new following after an ambitious restoration.

Mine’s is renowned as one of the stalwart tuners in the Nissan world, and its most iconic creation was without question the fully tuned BNR34 GT-R N1 base.

Born in 1999, this machine was a deep exploration into the beauty of the R34 GT-R, while remaining faithful to the spirit of a street car. From the meticulous tuning of the RB26DETT, to the low, balanced suspension, to the restrained yet purposeful exterior, every element was shaped by the vision of Mine’s CEO Michizo Niikura, whose goal was nothing less than a first-class street car.

Yet this car was equally at home on the race track. It breezed past the one-minute barrier at Tsukuba Circuit, proving its remarkable ability.

Thus, this particular car—revered among enthusiasts as the Hon-Demo—achieved the astonishing feat of recording more than 10000km on its odometer through circuit driving alone.

But its story did not end there. In 2021, the car received a full restoration by Garage Yoshida, breathing new life into the legend. At Niikura’s request, the original front GT-R emblem remained unrestored, a nod to its history. Its value was underscored in Gran Turismo 7, where it was priced at 3 million Cr.—a figure echoed in the real world, as the owner declined a cash-equivalent offer of the same amount.

Thanks to the dedication of Japanese restomod specialists Built By Legends, the worth of the BNR34 GT-R N1 base was once again being reexamined across the globe. If fortune ever grants you the chance to witness one in person, consider yourself truly lucky.
vehicleCollection.zh:
经过全面翻新修复后，这款传奇的全面改装版GT-R重新赢得了车迷青睐。

迈恩斯作为改装界享有盛誉的老牌日产改装厂商，其最具代表性的作品当属基于“BNR34 GT-R N1”打造的全方位改装车。

该车诞生于1999年，在恪守街车风格理念的同时，对R34 GT-R的美学设计进行了深度探索。从双顶置凸轮轴电子汽油喷射双涡轮引擎的精心调校，到低趴式悬挂系统，再到简约的外观设计，所有细节均遵循迈恩斯首席执行官新仓通藏的理念，旨在打造“一流街车”。

然而，该车在封闭赛道上同样表现卓越。该车在筑波赛道轻松跑出1分钟以内的圈速纪录，彰显其卓越实力。

因此，这台被车迷昵称为“Hon-Demo”的改装车还创下了其他令人惊叹的纪录：仅赛道行驶里程便突破了10000km。

然而，它的传奇并未就此终结。2021年，吉田车库对该车进行了全面修复，为这头性能猛兽赋予了新生。应新仓通藏要求，车前部的GT-R徽章保留了原始未修复状态。《跑车浪漫旅 7》中为该车设置300万货币的定价，正是对车主极致热诚的致敬——他曾拒绝同等金额的收购要约。

得益于日本经典车修复改装厂“传奇制造”的匠心打造，该车原型车BNR34 GT-R N1的价值正在全球范围内获得重新审视。若是你有幸得见实车，不妨将之当做人生一大幸事。

brandCentral.en:
If I had to describe the Mini Clubman Vision Gran Turismo
in simple terms, it would be "battle-ready."

The car sits much wider and lower to the ground than the
classic model, looking ready to attack the race track.

Indeed, that's what it was created to do. Maximum performance
is ensured with lots of aerodynamic features.

And it's lightweight. It tips the scales at 1050kg and comes
powered by an impressive engine that produces 400ps.

Also, its full-time 4WD drivetrain provides plenty
of stability.
brandCentral.zh:
如果要用一个词来形容Mini Clubman Vision Gran Turismo，我会用
“蓄势待发”来形容！

此车带有MINI的标志性设计，但比经典车型更宽，离地间
隙更低。

这是因为此车是为赛道设计的，具备扁平化底板等空气
动力学特性。

其1050kg的轻盈车身由一台可提供约400ps动力的强劲引擎驱动……

而全时四驱系统则负责提供充足的稳定性。

vehicleCollection.en:
A race spec Clubman able to reach 0-<100km/h> in just 3.5 seconds, with a top speed of <290km/h>.

The MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo, created from the inspiration of the MINI's success in motorsports, was designed strictly for the track. It's powered by a 395ps engine that sends this 1050kg vehicle from zero to <100km/h> in a mere 3.5 seconds. Top speed is rated at <290km/h>, with the right gear ratios. Power is transferred to all four wheels via a 6-speed sequential race gearbox. The suspension system consists of McPherson struts in the front and HA3 dampers at the rear, all of which are fully adjustable and ensure excellent cornering ability.

The MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo sits low to the ground, with the wheels positioned outside the body, resulting in go-kart-like agility. Adjustable carbon diffusers are placed in the front and rear, while large vents behind the wheel arches regulate air flow to cool the engine and brakes. The split rear spoiler and fully enclosed underbody enhance the sophisticated aerodynamics.

The car MINI design has familiar touches, such as the hexagonal front grille, elliptical headlights with implied racing-design stickers, and rally stripes on the hood and roof. Quick release hinges on the hood and tank and the small sliding window on the side reveal that this is not your oridinary performance car.
vehicleCollection.zh:
竞赛配置的俱乐部人，从0到<100km/h>加速仅需3.5秒，最高时速可达<290km/h>。

在MINI的传奇赛车运动历史的启发下，MINI的设计团队打造了全新的MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo：一款为竞赛而生的MINI精品。MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo的轻量级车身仅重1050kg，高达395ps的动力可以在3.5秒内完成0到<100km/h>加速。全时四驱和竞赛级6档序列式变速箱确保该车的最佳动力传动。前轮的麦弗逊减震器和后轮的HA3减震器有多档可调，能完美适应任何路况。根据齿轮传动比（根据每条赛道特别调校）而定，Clubman最高可以达到<290km/h>的时速。

MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo那充满个性的轮廓在路面上驰骋，四个车轮置于车身外远端，让车辆的操控像卡丁车一般。车身前部和后部的可调式碳纤维扰流翼和轮拱后方的大型通风口可以控制气流，为引擎和制动器提供冷却。而其后扰流板和全封闭的底部也加强了车身的空气动力学性能。

这款MINI的设计特点，例如扁平六边形的前进气格栅，装饰有含蓄赛车风格贴纸的椭圆形大灯，以及引擎盖上的拉力条纹都清晰地表现了MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo的赛车运动设计思路。引擎盖、油箱和侧窗上的快开铰链更是为MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo的经典外形加上了画龙点睛的一笔。

这款MINI的设计特点，例如扁平六边形的前进气格栅，装饰有含蓄赛车风格贴纸的椭圆形大灯，以及引擎盖上的拉力条纹都清晰地表现了MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo的赛车运动设计思路。引擎盖、油箱和侧窗上的快开铰链更是为MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo的经典外形加上了画龙点睛的一笔。

dialogues.en:
Without a doubt, the Mini is one of the world's
most popular compact cars.

It was introduced in Britain in 1959.

Its outward appearance was left largely unchanged
over the course of its 40-year production history.

In 2001, it was reborn in the form of the next-generation Mini
we see here.

Although double the size of its classic predecessor,
its handling and styling were pure Mini.

Although the original Mini was British, these modern iterations
were actually developed by BMW.

The German manufacturer did a commendable job
maintaining the spirit of the original car.
dialogues.zh:
Mini毋庸置疑是全世界最畅销的车型之一。

1959年在英国问世……

经过长达40年的生产历史，
外观大体未变。

直到2001年才推出新一代Mini，
也就是我们目前见到的这一款。

尽管尺寸上比历史悠久的前代车型大了两倍，
其操控性和风格仍维持地道的Mini水准。

Mini本是英国车，但其新一代车型出自BMW之手。

制造商的变动，在其响应迅速的转向及
卓越的刚性上得到淋漓尽致的体现。

dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The 2005 MINI Cooper S is still stylistically and
proportionately the best one！

I loved these when they came out, and I still love them!

Minimal overhangs and simple bodysides.
Low beltline and great all-round visibility.

 All the horizontal lines were drawn in parallel
to each other.

This is when it seemed the MINI designers
had a bigger voice with great vision!

They looked amazing in a variety of colors,
liveries with optional roof colors and graphics.

The interior continued the theme with the
big round central screen.

The MINI screamed fun!
dialogues.zh:
从风格和比例上比较，2005 MINI Cooper S都应当是
MINI产品线中的佼佼者！

这款车刚刚投产时我就爱上了它。
直到今天。我觉得它依然魅力不减！

你可以重点关注极限的短前悬、简约的廓形，以及
低腰线和全方位的视野，

还有车身的每一根水平线条都保持平行。

全都来自那个MINI的设计师们还抱有远见的时代！

无论搭配什么样的涂装、车顶颜色或是贴花，
它都能让你惊艳不已。

另外我还要夸一句圆形的中控屏幕。

没错，MINI就是这样，从里到外都充满乐趣！

brandCentral.en:
BMW obtained the rights and resurrected the popular
British car known as the Mini in 2001.

The folks at BMW were careful to keep the car's signature
compact boxy design intact.

This particular model is the high-performance Cooper S.

It boasts a peppy supercharged 1.6-liter inline-4 engine.

Thanks to its rigid chassis and solid structure, this car
has the feel of a go-kart when you push it to it limits.
brandCentral.zh:
BMW的第一代Mini早在2001年就进入了市场……

并立即因经久不衰的标志性设计而表现得卓尔不群。

这款特殊的车型是Cooper S，主打高性能……

此车拥有一台轻巧的1.6L直列四缸机械增压发动机。

除了悬挂相当硬外，它的驾驶感受几乎和卡丁车一样，
颇有乐趣！

usedCar.en:
BMW poured their heart and soul into the development of
this R50 Mini.

This version has an FF layout, which in our world stands
for front-engine/front-wheel drive.

Like its predecessor, this car is light and agile, able to
tackle the sharpest of corners like a rail car.

The engine in this Cooper S comes with a supercharger...

...meaning it delivers excellent power at 170ps with
plenty of pop in both low- and mid-rpm ranges.
usedCar.zh:
R50 Mini是BMW生产的新世代Mini Hatch的
首款车型。

这辆车采用了前置前驱布局。

它继承了前代车型轻便、灵活的特性，
能轻松应对急弯。

这一Cooper S款还额外安装了机械增压装置，
进一步提升了性能。

它中低转速区间的出力
定能让你大吃一惊！

vehicleCollection.en:
This hopped-up MINI Cooper S featured a supercharged engine.

In the latter half of the 1990s, famed sports car manufacturer BMW purchased the branding and manufacturing rights to the MINI brand and resurrected the MINI Cooper in 2001.

This new MINI was a bit larger than the classic model of yesteryear, measuring 3655mm, 1690mm and 1455mm, overall length, width and height, respectively. But BMW kept the car's spirit intact, thanks to quirky styling cues that were reminiscent of the original 1959 model. These included a "cute" face, highlighted by large round headlights and a square front grille and boxy silhouette.

The performance-oriented version in the new MINI lineup was the Cooper S. The power plant in the standard MINI was the "Pentagon," a 1.6-liter SOHC inline-4 developed in cooperation between BMW and Chrysler, while the Cooper S got an intercooled supercharger bolted on to its power plant—the large air intake on the model's hood being a dead giveaway of forced induction.

The supercharger accounted for an additional 54ps and 7.26kgm of torque over the stock engine, for a grand total of 170ps and 22.45kgm. It came mated to a slick-shifting 6-speed manual gearbox. This made the Cooper S one of the most fun to drive FF (Front drive, Front engine) compact cars in the marketplace.

It was a testament to the German company that effectively instilled the car's British heritage into the new MINI Cooper.
vehicleCollection.zh:
MINI的热门车型，配备了机械增压引擎。

在90年代后半段，宝马收购了MINI的品牌使用权和制造权。待到2001年，一款全新的MINI诞生了。

归入宝马旗下的新MINI长3655mm、宽1690mm、高1495mm，车身比原来的MINI足足大了两倍。无论是更大尺寸的头灯、特色鲜明的前格栅，还是拱起的车轮罩等元素，无不体现出对1959年原型车款的致敬和传承，一眼便能认出是MINI的正统继承者。

新MINI系列最热销的车型当属Cooper S。MINI的动力核心是一台1.6升顶置单凸轮轴Pentagon直列4缸引擎，由宝马和克莱斯勒共同研发。而Cooper S车型还加装了中冷机械增压，看到它引擎盖上巨大的进气口便不难猜到。机械增压为Cooper S额外带来了54ps和7.26kgm扭矩，总计可输出170ps和22.45kgm扭矩，再搭配上特制的6速手动变速箱，这台小车满载着驾驶的乐趣。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
When it comes to speedy little road rockets,
the first thing that comes to mind is this Mini.

Although the original Mini was built as a compact car for the
masses, it possessed a high level of performance.

The first to notice the Mini’s potential was the car
constructor Cooper, of Formula 1 fame.

That was the company that created this sporty Mini Cooper S.

The car shined in in races and rallies of the day,
leaving behind a lasting legacy.

This model, with an improved engine displacement of 970cc,
is especially prized within the series.
dialogues.zh:
说到小而快的车型，首先想到的就是这款Mini。

尽管最初的英国Mini可能是定位于紧凑型民用车，
但其性能仍然不可小觑。

首先注意到Mini潜力的是天才汽车工程师Cooper，
对，就是以F1闻名的传奇人物。

他的团队是这款运动型Mini Cooper S的
幕后推手。

这款车在竞赛和拉力赛中取得的光辉战绩，
成就了一代传奇。

这款车型引擎排量提升高达970cc，
是该系列中弥足珍惜的一款。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
When the Mini was born in 1959, it revolutionized the world
of compact front-wheel-drive cars.

Designed by the English engineer Alec Issigonis...

...it sported a uniquely positioned engine and gearbox.

This maximized the space-saving potential of its
front-wheel-drive layout.

The result was a small and fast car with a roomy interior.

The Mini's historic front-wheel drive layout is now
widely referred to as an "Issigonis" layout.

And why shouldn't it be? It was designed by the
brilliant engineer after all.
dialogues.zh:
当Mini于1959年诞生时，它彻底改变了小型前轮驱动汽车的世界。

此车由英国工程师亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯设计……

它的引擎和变速箱安装的位置非常独特，

最大限度地发挥了前轮驱动布局节省空间的潜力。

因此造就了一辆小而快的汽车，具有宽敞的内部空间。

Mini的历史性前轮驱动布局现在被广泛称为“伊斯戈尼斯”布局。

这并不奇怪。毕竟它就是由这位杰出的工程师设计的！

dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.en:
This is the original Mini. I can't think of any
other car design that is so efficient.

It's the ultimate expression of a 4-seat passenger vehicle.
It truly has a 'timeless design'.

The original Mini was, for its time, an unusual
front-wheel-drive compact.

It was developed for minimal power and
maximum interior space.

This packaging was revolutionary for the 20th century.

The car was created in 1955 by the BMC development
team, led by Sir Alec Issigonis.

After that, John Cooper tuned the car with
twin carburettors and disc brakes.

Thus the Mini Cooper S you see here was born.<next id=1900106 type=9׾
dialogues.zh:
这是一辆初代MINI。
我觉得没有比它更高效的汽车设计了。

它就是4座乘用车的终极体现。
这真是一款“不过时的设计”。

这款初代MINI在当时是一辆非常罕见的前驱紧凑型车。

它的开发思路就是追求最小的动力和
最大的可用内部空间。

这样的产品规划在20世纪是非常具有革新性的。

在1955年，由亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯爵士领导的英国汽车集团开发团队
打造了这台MINI。

之后，约翰·库珀对车型进行了调校，
加入了双化油器和碟式制动器……

于是，你眼前的这一辆MINI Cooper S就诞生了。*

它的引擎和变速箱安装的位置非常独特，

最大限度地发挥了前轮驱动布局节省空间的潜力。

因此造就了一辆小而快的汽车，具有宽敞的内部空间。

Mini的历史性前轮驱动布局现在被广泛称为“伊斯戈尼斯”布局。

这并不奇怪。毕竟它就是由这位杰出的工程师设计的！

conversation.en:
This is the original Mini. I can't think of any
other car design that is so efficient.

It's the ultimate expression of a 4-seat passenger vehicle.
It truly has a 'timeless design'.

The original Mini was, for its time, an unusual
front-wheel-drive compact.

It was developed for minimal power and
maximum interior space.

This packaging was revolutionary for the 20th century.

The car was created in 1955 by the BMC development
team, led by Sir Alec Issigonis.

After that, John Cooper tuned the car with
twin carburettors and disc brakes.

Thus the Mini Cooper S you see here was born.<next id=1900106 type=9׾
conversation.zh:
这是一辆初代MINI。
我觉得没有比它更高效的汽车设计了。

它就是4座乘用车的终极体现。
这真是一款“不过时的设计”。

这款初代MINI在当时是一辆非常罕见的前驱紧凑型车。

它的开发思路就是追求最小的动力和
最大的可用内部空间。

这样的产品规划在20世纪是非常具有革新性的。

在1955年，由亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯爵士领导的英国汽车集团开发团队
打造了这台MINI。

之后，约翰·库珀对车型进行了调校，
加入了双化油器和碟式制动器……

于是，你眼前的这一辆MINI Cooper S就诞生了。*

usedCar.en:
Cooper Car Co. is a British firm that revolutionized Formula
1 vehicle construction.

The sportier Mini variants that the company designed
have become true classics.

The cars with the "S" designation came with a more
powerful engine.

This model, the 970 S, was extra special.

Its name referred to the size of the engine, which was 970cc.
It was an inline design that delivered 66ps.

Its limited production run means that this is one of
the most sought-after Cooper S models out there!
usedCar.zh:
Cooper是一家彻底革新F1车辆构造的
英国公司。

他们设计的MINI衍生跑车是真正的经典。

这些带有“S”名称的车型搭载
具备更高动力的引擎。

这款车型中尤其昂贵的是970 S。

前置970cc直列四缸引擎可以产生
高达66ps的动力。

由于其限量生产，这就意味着它会是这里
最受欢迎的Cooper S车型之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
Devised by Formula 1 legend John Cooper, this very special Mini was intended to excel on the race track.

The first high-performance model for the iconic Mini Cooper was the "S". The Mini, which was manufactured as a compact car for the everyman by BMC (British Motor Corporation), wasn't only extremely civil - able to accommodate four passengers - it was extremely fun to drive, thanks in part to its sports-car-like handling.

Together with the Cooper Car Company, which won the 1960 F1 Constructor’s Championship, BMC created the new Mini Cooper and the sporty Mini Cooper S. These models were equipped with twin carbs and disc brakes, features seldom seen in compact cars at the time.

What made the 970 "S" special was its larger engine, whose displacement was increased to 970cc resulting in a hearty 66ps. This change was made so the Mini Cooper could race in certain classifications. (The standard 848cc engine produced 34ps.) Although the 970 "S" found success on the racetrack, only 963 examples were built since it made its debut in 1964, making it the least produced Mini Cooper model ever.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆MINI由一级方程式赛车领域的传奇人物约翰·库珀设计，专为胜利而生。

MINI Cooper'S'是MINI的首款跑车车型，后者是由英国汽车集团推出的紧凑型平民车款。

尽管MINI原本设计为一款经济适用的平民车款，既可以在很小的车身内搭载4个成人，同时具备相当出色的操控性。英国汽车集团与1960年F1车队总冠军库珀汽车公司以及约翰·库珀合作，推出了全新的MINI Cooper和性能更高的MINI Cooper'S'。这些车型配备了双化油器与碟式刹车，均是在当时的紧凑车型上罕见的配置。

970 'S'是一款引擎排量调整为970cc以满足指定比赛级别的车型，动力输出为66ps。（标准款的848cc引擎可输出马力为34ps）。这款车在房车赛事中颇为成功，但也是MINI车系中产量最少的，自1964年推出以来只生产了963辆。

brandCentral.sourceName: Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.en:
This model served as the inspiration for
the Mitsubishi Concept XR-PHEV....

...which was unveiled at the Tokyo Motor Show
in 2013.

Known as the Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION VGT, it is powered
by an innovative plug-in hybrid system.

It also had an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission that
managed the impressive power of the drivetrain.

What’s more, it handled exceptionally well, thanks to
Mitsubishi's S-AWC 4-wheel-drive technology.
brandCentral.zh:
Mitsubishi Concept XR-PHEV于2013年的东京车展上亮相……

这款车型正是其灵感来源。

这款车的真实名称是Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION VGT，
采用了创新的插入式混合动力系统……

并配备了一款八速双离合器变速箱，能输出相当劲爆的
动力……

在Mitsubishi的S-AWC四轮驱动技术的加持下，
它的操控性也相当出众。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION Vision Gran Turismo
vehicleCollection.en:
A hybrid concept packed with know-how and spirit gained through motorsports.

Mitsubishi Motors, a company with a spectacular history in races like the Dakar Rally and World Rally Championships (WRC), has developed a special concept model for Vision Gran Turismo: This is the “Mitsubishi Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION Vision Gran Turismo”.

In the development of this special concept model, Mitsubishi Motors introduced their design team, Advanced Vehicle Research and Development Group, and Aerodynamic Engineering Development Group into this project in the same process they would normally follow to plan and develop real motorsports vehicles.

The styling of the car follows the basic concepts of the “MITSUBISHI Concept XR-PHEV” shown at the 2013 Tokyo Motor Show, while pouring in know-how gained from years of motorsports experience into its every detail. As a result, the concept was evolved into a stoic racing machine.

The “Athlete Form” design concept was advanced further, emphasizing the driving features aggressively. The iconic front grille is a study of next generation Mitsubishi SUV identity, and the shape that forms a wedge starting from the triple diamond mark is designed in the image of an athlete at crouching position on a starting line, evoking an intense image of tension and potential.

Applying advanced development technology from the Plug-in Hybrid EV System, the spontaneous power of the motor and powerful torque of the engine is transmitted through an 8 speed dual clutch transmission (DCT) to drive the 4 wheels. Its overwhelming drive performance is controlled precisely with the S-AWC vehicle dynamics control system that distributes the drive force optimally to the 4 wheels, producing a handling characteristic that moves the car exactly as the driver desires. In addition, the carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP) body reduces weight and greatly contributes toits agility, and the downforce produced by the aerodynamic form of the frnt and rear diffusers produces excellent cornering performance. The lare diameer 20 inch aluminum wheels gives an impession of a tough supension system, and the powerfu appearance of the frontand rer fenders is n the image of oned muscles of a powerful athlete.

We hope you enjoy this special concept model packed with the sports spiit of Mitsubishi Motors.
vehicleCollection.zh:
将赛车经验和精神注入其中的混动概念车。

三菱汽车在达喀尔拉力赛和世界拉力锦标赛（WRC）等赛事中取得过辉煌的成就，他们也为跑车浪漫旅愿景开发了一款特殊的概念赛车型，那就是“Concept XR-PHEV EVOLUTION Vision Gran Turismo”。

为了开发这款特殊的概念赛车，三菱汽车让他们的设计团队——高级汽车研发组和空气动力学工程研发组按照规划及开发真实的赛车运动车辆的流程参与到此项目中。

这辆车的风格设计沿袭了在2013年东京车展上亮相的“三菱 Concept XR-PHEV”的基本概念，还在车身细节中加入了从多年赛车运动经验中提炼出的许多心得。最终，这辆概念赛车被升华成了一部冷峻的赛车。

其“运动员形态”的设计概念得到了进一步发扬，激进地强调了车子的驾驶特点。标志性的前进气格栅借鉴了新一代三菱SUV的特点，从三钻石标志开始构成的楔形形状则表现出一个运动员在起跑线前蹲踞式起跑的画面，给人一种紧张感和希望感。

该车应用了插电式混合动力电动车系统的开发技术，搭载的电机动能和引擎的强大扭矩通过一套8档双离合变速箱进行传动，驱动4个车轮。其压倒性的驾驶性能通过S-AWC车辆动态控制系统得到了精确的控制，将动力以最佳方式分配到4个车轮，带来了优异的操控性，使得车手能够随心所欲操控车辆。

此外，碳纤维强化塑料车身减轻了重量，有效地提高了车辆的敏捷性，而前后扰流翼的空气动力学外形产生的下压力也提供了极佳的弯道性能。20英寸的大尺寸铝制轮毂使得硬朗的悬挂系统非常夺人眼球，而其前后挡泥板的有力外观也展现出了如同运动员般的强壮肌肉感。

我们希望j能够喜欢这辆特殊的、充满了三菱汽车赛车精神的概念8车。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
The Mitsubishi FTO is a sports coupe that took the racing
world by storm.

It famously competed in the All Japan GT Championship
in 1998 and 1999.

Although it retained the front-wheel-drive layout
of its road-going sibling...

...it replaced the latter’s naturally-aspirated engine with a
turbocharged version of the venerable 4G63 inline-4.

On the track, cars with rear-wheel drive areyin contenders for power and traction.

Although the Mitsubishi FTO never captured a victory
in the All Japan GT Championship...

...it did earn a 2nd-place podium finish at the series opener
in 1999!
dialogues.zh:
Mitsubishi FTO是一款曾在赛坛掀起波澜的
运动型双门轿跑。

其最广为人知的战绩当属1998至1999年间
征战全日本GT锦标赛的经历。

尽管其公路版姊妹车型的
前轮驱动布局被保留下来……

但原厂自然进气引擎被替换为了
经涡轮增压强化的经典4G63直列四缸引擎。

要知道，在赛场上比拼动力优势的
往往是那些后轮驱动车型。

虽然此车型未能在全日本GT锦标赛摘得桂冠……

但在1999赛季揭幕战中还是成功斩获了亚军佳绩！

...Th-This car!
Is it yours!?
conversation.zh:
这这这……这辆车！！
这车是你的？！!

conversation.en:
The Mitsubishi FTO is a sports coupe that took the racing
world by storm.

It famously competed in the All Japan GT Championship
in 1998 and 1999.

Although it retained the front-wheel-drive layout
of its road-going sibling...

...it replaced the latter’s naturally-aspirated engine with a
turbocharged version of the venerable 4G63 inline-4.

On the track, cars with rear-wheel drive areyin contenders for power and traction.

Although the Mitsubishi FTO never captured a victory
in the All Japan GT Championship...

...it did earn a 2nd-place podium finish at the series opener
in 1999!
conversation.zh:
Mitsubishi FTO是一款曾在赛坛掀起波澜的
运动型双门轿跑。

其最广为人知的战绩当属1998至1999年间
征战全日本GT锦标赛的经历。

尽管其公路版姊妹车型的
前轮驱动布局被保留下来……

但原厂自然进气引擎被替换为了
经涡轮增压强化的经典4G63直列四缸引擎。

要知道，在赛场上比拼动力优势的
往往是那些后轮驱动车型。

虽然此车型未能在全日本GT锦标赛摘得桂冠……

但在1999赛季揭幕战中还是成功斩获了亚军佳绩！

usedCar.en:
Hi there! Looking for a fine Japanese car from the 1990s?
If so, then have I got the car for you!

Check out this FTO, a compact coupe from Mitsubishi.
A speedy FF, it shares its basic parts with the Mirage.

Its biggest selling point is its 2.0-liter V-6. It is fitted with
a variable valve mechanism and can produce 200ps.

Measuring 4365mm long and 1735mm wide, this car
looks ferocious, particularly with its bulging hood.

And ferocious it was—hailed as the fastest FF machine of its era.
The sheer speed at which it takes corners is unbelievable.

Believe me, there aren’t many cars out there that have had
such a hold on young drivers as the Mitsubishi FTO!
usedCar.zh:
嘿！在找90年代的精品日本车吗？
那我这儿可有一款好车要推荐给你！

来看看这款Mitsubishi FTO，一款紧凑型轿跑。
作为一款速度傲人的前驱车，它与Mirage共享基础部件。

此车最大亮点是搭载可变气门机构的2升V6引擎，
可输出200ps的强劲动力。

车身长4365mm、宽1735mm，
外观极具攻击性，尤其是那隆起的引擎盖线条。

它的表现也相当凶猛——曾被誉为当时最快的前驱车！
过弯时的凌厉姿态令人难以置信。

相信我，很少有车型能像Mitsubishi FTO这样，
让年轻的车手们一见倾心！

vehicleCollection.en:
This high-powered front-wheel-drive sports car featured a number of new systems.+

The FTO, which made its debut in October 1994, marked the return of the nameplate 23 years after the original model first appeared. The first Galant-based FTO coupe had been the little brother to the Galant GTO, and the reborn version was once again positioned as a 2-door coupe following in the GTO’s footsteps.

While the first generation was an FR, the new car adopted an FF layout, sharing its platform with the Lancer and Mirage. Classified as a larger size Class 3 vehicle (Japanese regulations), it was unusual for its category, its wide body becoming a defining feature.

Its design, with sweeping curves and flowing lines, was in harmony with the GTO and Eclipse of the same era. The front fenders blended seamlessly into the hood, creating a bold form that carried its motion through to the rear fenders.

Power came from a 1.8-liter SOHC inline-4, the 4G93, producing 125ps and 16.5kgm of torque; a 2.0-liter DOHC V-6, the 6A12, producing 170ps and 19.0kgm (180ps and 19.5kgm in later models); or a highly tuned 6A12 delivering 200ps and 20.4kgm. The 200ps output of the high-spec engine was achieved with Mitsubishi’s MIVEC variable valve timing system.

Its transmission was also ahead of its time. In addition to the standard 5-speed manual, Mitsubishi offered the INVECS-II 4-speed automatic with a sports mode—the first of its kind in a Japanese car—paving the way for future sport automatics.

With its distinctive styling and engaging performance, the FTO earned Japan Car of the Year honors in 1994. By 1997, the INVECS-II had evolved into a 5-speed automatic. Sadly, as the market shifted away from coupes toward MPVs and SUVs, production of the FTO came to an end in 2000.
vehicleCollection.zh:
搭载多项创新系统的高性能前驱运动跑车。

1994年10月问世的FTO车型，是在初代车型发布23年后重归市场的经典之作。初代Galant coupé FTO是定位稍低于Galant GTO的同系车型，而新款车型同样被定位为同系GTO的后续双门轿跑。

初代车型采用前置后驱布局，而新款车型因与Lancer/Mirage共享平台，转而采用前置前驱布局。按照日本法规标准，车身属于较大的3级规格，在当时实属罕见。宽体造型也顺理成章地成为该车型的鲜明特征。

该车型采用充满力量感的流线型设计，与同时期的GTO及Eclipse保持统一的设计语言。前翼子板与引擎盖浑然一体，以大胆的流线造型从前部流畅延伸至后翼子板。

搭载的引擎可选：1.8升顶置单凸轮轴直列四缸4G93引擎，输出功率125ps，扭矩16.5kgm；或2.0升双顶置凸轮轴V6 6A12引擎，输出功率170ps，扭矩19.0kgm（后期型号提升至180ps，扭矩19.5kgm）；或经重度调校的6A12引擎，可爆发200ps与20.4kgm扭矩。调校引擎输出的200ps，得益于三菱创新阀门定时电子控制系统可变气门正时系统的应用。

其传动系统同样具有革命意义。除标准5速手动变速箱外，该系列首次在日本汽车中引入了配备运动模式的智能革新车辆电子控制系统-II 4速自动变速箱，为后续其他自动变速款运动车型的发展开辟了道路。

其独特的造型设计与出色的驾驶性能备受赞誉，最终荣膺1994年日本年度风云车大奖。1997年，智能革新车辆电子控制系统-II变速箱由4速升级为5速。遗憾的是，随着市场潮流逐渐从轿跑车转向多用途汽车和运动型多用途汽车，FTO于2000年停产。

usedCar.en:
For many, this car represents the quintessential Japanese
high-performance car of the 1990s.

Mitsubishi's GTO Twin Turbo was marketed as a "super
4WD sports vehicle."

And it is. It has both all-wheel drive and 4-wheel steering,
not to mention active aerodynamics.

It came powered by a twin-turbocharged V-6.

The high-tech nature of the GTO, called the 3000GT in
the U.S., truly made it a car before its time.+
usedCar.zh:
对于许多人来说，三菱GTO Twin Turbo是
20世纪90年代最典型的日产高性能车。

它在营销时被称为“超级四驱跑车”。

这款车结合了四轮驱动和四轮转向系统，
同时运用了主动式空气动力学系统……

它可以说是满载了各类先进技术。

而其采用的前置V6双涡轮增压引擎让人尤为惊喜。

vehicleCollection.en:
This pure-bred sports car by Mitsubishi featured advanced AWD technology.

The Mitsubishi GTO was sold as the 3000GT outside Japan.

Introduced in October 1990, the GTO represented a bold statement from Mitsubishi, which hadn’t produced a flagship sports car in years. The name GTO, of course, paid homage to the legendary Galant GTO. Simply giving this new sports car that name signaled just how high expectations were within the company.

The styling was classic Mitsubishi of the era—bold, muscular, and clearly tailored to appeal to the U.S. market’s tastes. When viewed from above, the car’s distinctive bottle shape—narrowing noticeably at the doors—was striking. It was a design that turned plenty of heads back in the day.

But this car wasn’t just about looks. Beneath its exterior was a host of technical features that showcased the company's engineering prowess. The chassis was built around Mitsubishi’s cutting-edge All-Wheel Control philosophy—a key focus for the brand at the time. It boasted an impressive suite of advanced features, including full-time 4WD, 4-wheel steering (4WS), electronically controlled suspension, and ABS. It was also equipped with an active aerodynamics system in which the front and rear spoilers self-adjusted according to speed, and it possessed an active exhaust system that controlled exhaust sound. The GTO’s array of high-tech systems—combining electronic controls with variable, adaptive mechanisms—further added to its uniqueness.

The platform was based on the Diamante. Transversely mounted in front was the 6G72, a 3.0-liter DOHC V-6 offered in two grades: a potent twin-turbo or a naturally-aspirated variant. The turbocharged version unleashed 280ps and 42.5kgm of torque, while the naturally-aspirated one produced 225ps and 28.0kgm.
vehicleCollection.zh:
由三菱全力打造的纯正跑车，采用了其久负盛名的四驱技术。

在日本以外地区，三菱GTO改以3000GT的名字发售。

于1990年10月面世的三菱GTO是一辆纯粹的跑车，距离三菱上次推出同类车型已经有相当久的时间了。车型的命名，毫无疑问，来自如雷贯耳的一代名车Galant GTO。由此也可以看出三菱对这款车的期待值有多高了。

外观设计方面，GTO尽显三菱的特色——审美趋向美国市场。从顶部俯瞰这台车时，饮料瓶造型的车身在车门处向内略略收窄，令车身曲线显得愈发动人，在当时引来众人的青睐。

当然了，这辆车绝非虚有其表，其内部的机械配置同样出类拔萃。底盘以三菱在90年代专注开发的全轮驱动为基础，进行了专项再开发。全车囊括了当时行业内最先进的各种特性，例如全时四驱、4WS、电控悬挂和ABS等等。它甚至搭载了一套主动空气动力学系统，可根据时速来调节前后扰流板，另外还有一套主动排气系统，可供随时改变排气的音量。这些电控高科技特性和各色机械配置都让GTO在当时显得独树一帜。

GTO的开发平台是同级别的Diamante，搭载有一台3.0L双顶置凸轮轴V6引擎，引擎代号6G72，共分双涡轮版本和自然进气版本两种，被横向前置在底盘车架上。其涡轮增压版本可以提供280ps和42.5kgm扭矩，自然进气版本也可以产生225ps和28.0kgm扭矩。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is an iconic turbocharged
4-wheel-drive Japanese sports car.

It's affectionately known as the "Evo."

The early Evos have won the hearts of countless fans thanks to
their stellar performance at world rally championships.

Although Mitsubishi has not competed in a
world rally competition since 2005...

...the Evo's popularity only continues to grow.

Historically speaking, this Evo X "Final Edition" was
the last production car to be produced of the series.

It featured a tuned-up engine capable of outputting
an astounding 313ps.

You can bet that its value on the international market
will only continue to appreciate with time.
dialogues.zh:
三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神是标志性的日本
四轮驱动涡轮增压跑车。

车迷都称这辆车为“翼豪陆神”……

由于这一系列车型在世界拉力赛中表现出众，
赢得了无数粉丝的喜爱。

虽然自2005年以来，三菱和翼豪陆神
一直没有参加世界拉力赛……

但这款翼豪陆神的热度却不减反增。

回顾其发展史，翼豪陆神X的“终极版”车型是这系列的
最后一款量产车型。

这个版本的车型搭载更强大的引擎，
输出功率高达令人震惊的313ps。

可以保证，这款车型将来
在国际市场上的价值只会越来越高。

Perfect!

If this is the final Evo Edition,
they saved the best for last.

Mitsubishi got it right with the 2015 Evolution
Final Edition.

Their designers created a well-executed body shape,
with very well-developed surfaces and line work.

In addition, all of the aero devices, air intakes, and air
exits are in harmony with the car’s overall design.

As are the tyre and wheel sizes!
conversation.zh:
多么完美！

如果这就是Evo的最后一款车型，那么他们无疑是
将最好的留到了最后。

Mitsubishi在2015 Evolution Final Edition的设计中
做到了出色的极致。

他们的设计师创造出了工艺精湛的车身外型，
各个表面、各处线条都做工精细，流畅延伸。

此外，所有空气动力学组件、进气口和出气口
都与该车的总体设计和谐相融，

就连轮胎和轮毂的尺寸也是如此！

brandCentral.en:
The prized qualities of Mitsubishi's famed AWD sports sedan
are on display in the Lancer Evolution's Final Edition.

At the heart of every Evo is the engine.

The one in this car produces 313ps and 43.7kgm of torque,
making it the most powerful Evo engine ever.

Not only are the suspension and brakes also impressive...

...the technically-advanced AWD system makes this a monster
on all types of terrain.
brandCentral.zh:
这款Lancer Evolution Final Edition完全彰显了
Mitsubishi赫赫有名的四驱轿跑车那屡获殊荣的冠军车品质。

它拥有一台无与伦比的引擎，

可以输出313ps的动力和43.7kgm的扭矩，是目前性能最强的Evo引擎。

它的悬挂系统和刹车也同样进行了增强。

毫无疑问，这就是Evo长达二十三年历史中的巅峰之作。

vehicleCollection.en:
An icon bodes farewell with a special Final Edition model.

April 10, 2015 marked the end of a legend when the final Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution was announced. All 1000 cars were sold out by August 20 of the same year.

The Final Edition Lancer Evo was based on the GSR with plenty of changes made throughout the vehicle to make it special. The power of the Evo's high-strung turbocharged 4-cylinder was raised to make an additional 13ps and 0.7kgm of torque to bring the total to 313ps and 43.7kgm. The High Performance Package included Bilstein dampers, Eibach springs and high-performance tires that came wrapped around 18-inch BBS dark aluminum wheels. The interior was highlighted by full bucket Recaro seats.

The Final Edition is basically another performance version of the Lancer Evolution X, but you won’t see the Roman numeral anywhere on its body. That’s because there will not be any more Evos after this model (no XI). Since its debut as a homologation model for a WRC race car in 1992, the Evo has been an icon for rally and performance enthusiasts all over the world, and it’s indeed sad to see this wonderful car go.
vehicleCollection.zh:
真正的最终车型，为其漫长的世界拉力锦标赛征战历史画上句号。

在2015年4月10日，三菱限量推出1000辆“最终版”三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神。这批车型在2015年8月20日就告售罄。

这款“最终版”基于配置5档手动GSR变速箱的车型开发。使用钠冷排气阀来加强引擎的冷却，使得引擎的功率提高13ps/0.7kgm，达到了313ps/43.7kgm。这辆车自带“高性能套装”，包括倍适登减震器、艾巴赫弹簧和高性能轮胎，此外还配备了18英寸的BBS铝制轮毂、Recaro全凹背桶椅和大量第三方选配套件。

最终版的开发基础车型为蓝瑟翼豪陆神X，但是“X”并没有出现在其名称中。这也意味着“最终版”将是蓝瑟翼豪陆神的最终形态。自从它作为一款世界拉力锦标赛赛车认证车型在1992年首次亮相以来，“蓝瑟翼豪陆神”就一直深受全世界车手和拉力赛爱好者的喜爱。随着此款车型的推出，其悠久的历史也真正地告一段落。

For this original Gran Turismo Gr.3 vehicle, the Lancer

后驱布局。

在2015年4月10日，三菱限量推出1000辆“最终版”三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神。这批车型在2015年8月20日就告售罄。

这款“最终版”基于配置5档手动GSR变速箱的车型开发。使用钠冷排气阀来加强引擎的冷却，使得引擎的功率提高13ps/0.7kgm，达到了313ps/43.7kgm。这辆车自带“高性能套装”，包括倍适登减震器、艾巴赫弹簧和高性能轮胎，此外还配备了18英寸的BBS铝制轮毂、Recaro全凹背桶椅和大量第三方选配套件。

最终版的开发基础车型为蓝瑟翼豪陆神X，但是“X”并没有出现在其名称中。这也意味着“最终版”将是蓝瑟翼豪陆神的最终形态。自从它作为一款世界拉力锦标赛赛车认证车型在1992年首次亮相以来，“蓝瑟翼豪陆神”就一直深受全世界车手和拉力赛爱好者的喜爱。随着此款车型的推出，其悠久的历史也真正地告一段落。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别B规则进行过特殊调校。

catch.en: An icon bodes farewell with a special Final Edition model.
catch.zh: 真正的最终车型，为其漫长的世界拉力锦标赛征战历史画上句号。

long.en:
April 10, 2015 marked the end of a legend when the final Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution was announced. All 1000 cars were sold out by August 20 of the same year.

The Final Edition Lancer Evo was based on the GSR with plenty of changes made throughout the vehicle to make it special. The power of the Evo's high-strung turbocharged 4-cylinder was raised to make an additional 13ps and 0.7kgm of torque to bring the total to 313ps and 43.7kgm. The High Performance Package included Bilstein dampers, Eibach springs and high-performance tires that came wrapped around 18-inch BBS dark aluminum wheels. The interior was highlighted by full bucket Recaro seats.

The Final Edition is basically another performance version of the Lancer Evolution X, but you won’t see the Roman numeral anywhere on its body. That’s because there will not be any more Evos after this model (no XI). Since its debut as a homologation model for a WRC race car in 1992, the Evo has been an icon for rally and performance enthusiasts all over the world, and it’s indeed sad to see this wonderful car go.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.B regulations by Gran Turismo.

This N-class road car was designed as a homologated
version of the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution Gr.B.

The weight is evenly distributed between front and rear, and
its 4WD system provides plenty of grip through corners.

This one truly breaks the rallying mold, making for
a hugely enjoyable on-road experience.

这辆车完全打破了拉力赛车的桎梏，为您提供极其享受
的公路驾驶体验。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Most every rally-racing enthusiast knows about the "Evo."
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution is really that historic.

This is the Evo III, the third-generation model.
It's a car with a storied history.

It helped Mitsubishi ace driver Tommi Mäkinen win
his first WRC drivers title in 1996.

Mäkinen then went on to win four consecutive
drivers titles piloting different iterations of the "Evo."

He was truly a legendary rally driver.

And, the car that put him on his path to history was a rally
car based on this Mitsubishi Lancer Evo III.
@
dialogues.zh:
每一个拉力赛的车迷都对“Evo”了如指掌！
Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution就是有这么出名。

这台是Evo III，第三代车型，有着一段传奇的历史……

当Mitsubishi的王牌车手，托米·马基宁在96 WRC上
赢得首个车手冠军时，驾驶的便是这辆车。

此后，马基宁驾驶着不同迭代版本的“Evo”
拿下了车手冠军四连胜！

他是拉力赛史上的传奇车手！

而助他走上荣耀之路的正是基于这台
Mitsubishi Lancer Evo III开发的拉力赛车。

usedCar.en:
The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution, more commonly known as
the "Evo," is an iconic Japanese car from the 1990s.

It was developed for competing in the World Rally Championship,
the pinnacle of rally racing.

This is the third-generation model from 1995,
called the "Evo III."

It's a truly historic machine because it handed Mitsubishi ace Tommi
Mäkinen his first world rally drivers title.

From its wide front bumper to the flamboyant rear spoiler,
everything on the Evo III was rally-spec.

And, it represented an evolutionary leap from the previous models,
thanks mainly to its incredible performance.

What’s more, the production Evo III came with an anti-lag
system, which was usually reserved just for race cars.
usedCar.zh:
Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution（简称“Evo”）是
二十世纪九十年代最具标志性的日式车之一。

它是为了参加世界拉力锦标赛
所开发的一款基础车型。

这辆车是1995年推出的第三代型号，俗称“Evo III”。

这款车型因帮助Mitsubishi的王牌车手托米·马基宁
拿下了他的第一个世界拉力车手冠军而名声斐然。

从宽大的开口式前保险杠到帅气的后扰流板，
它车身上的每一个配件都完全符合拉力赛规格。

这个型号与一代和二代型号Evo相比堪称是革命性的飞跃，
比前两代速度更快、性能更强。

此外，Evo III还从量产阶段就设计了一套偏时点火系统。

vehicleCollection.en:
Improved aerodynamics and cooling make for the ultimate first-gen "Evo."

The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution, launched in September 1992, took the compact body of the production Lancer sedan and implemented components used in the Galant VR-4 WRC race car. Thus, the Lancer Evolution was a rally machine in the guise of a passenger sedan.

At the heart of the "Evo" was the 4G63, a turbocharged 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 that pumped out 250ps and 31.5kgm of torque at the time of its debut. With the incredible power delivered to all four wheels, the car had amazing traction and was already much faster than any other model in its class.

One year after its creation, in December 1993, an improved Lancer Evolution II was introduced with power increased to 260ps. The tires were also changed to 205/60R15, while modifications to the wheelbase were also implemented. At about this time, Japanese fans began referring to it by a new nickname, "Lan-Evo."

Then came another "evolution" in January 1995, when the Lancer Evolution III was introduced. It featured a drastically modified body style that resulted in better aerodynamic performance. With a larger grille and an enhanced rear spoiler, it now had the powerful look of a vehicle focused on competition.

The compression ratio of the 4G63 power unit was raised to 9.0, improving output to 270ps. Enhancements were also made to the suspension, and these changes greatly improved the car's already excellent handling character. At the time, the base Lancer model was about to receive a full model change, and it was rumored then that the Evo III could be the last Evo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
改进的空气动力学和冷却系统催生出首批巅峰“进化版”跑车。

蓝瑟翼豪陆神于1992年9月推出。它的设计从商用蓝瑟轿车的紧凑车身出发，加上三菱仅用于世界拉力锦标赛级格兰特 VR-4的机械装置，打造了一款面向拉力赛的汽车。

这款车的核心是4G63，一台涡轮增压的2.0升双凸轮轴直列4缸引擎，在其首次亮相时已经能够输出250ps的动力和31.5kgm的扭矩。凭借输送到全部四个车轮的压倒性牵引力和动力，它的速度远超同级别的任何其他车型。

在其诞生一年后，即1993年12月，改进后的蓝瑟翼豪陆神II亮相，其最大动力输出增加到260ps。轮胎也改为205/60 R15，并对轴距和胎面尺寸进行了拓展改进。也是在同一时期，日本车迷给它起了一个后来响彻全球的绰号“蓝翼”。

它的下一次进化发生在1995年1月。第三代车型被命名为蓝瑟翼豪陆神III，为了提高空气动力学性能，其外观进行了大幅度的修改。前保险杠的开口更大，后扰流板也更宽大，让人一眼就能看出它是一辆专注于比赛的高性能赛车。

4G63动力单元的压缩比提高到了9.0，将最大动力输出提升到了270ps。悬挂系统也进行了复杂的修改和加强，这些改动大大改善了引擎的性能和车辆的机动性。当时，蓝瑟的基础车型即将迎来全面换代，所以有传言说，翼豪陆神III实际上可能是最后一款翼豪陆神。

usedCar.en:
The Lancer Evolution is one of the most popular
Japanese 4WD sports cars ever produced.

The fourth-generation model—the Evolution IV—was developed
during Mitsubishi's golden age of rallying.

Its 4G3 engine, a turbo 2.0-liter inline-4, pumps out 280ps—
a voluntary limit adopted by Japanese manufacturers.

The car features the company's first Active Yaw Control system,
or AYC, which electronically controls rear-wheel torque.

This innovation significantly improved the Lancer Evo's
handling and made it favorite among rally fans.
usedCar.zh:
Lancer Evolution是有史以来最具辨识度的
日产四驱跑车。

这款车的第四代——Evolution IV
是在Mitsubishi的拉力赛黄金年代诞生的。

因日本车厂之间一条不成文的君子协定，
其2升直列四缸涡轮增压4G3引擎的最大马力被限制在280ps。

这款车上还首次配备了主动式舵角控制器
（Active Yaw Control，即AYC），能通过电子装置控制后轮扭矩……

这使得Lancer Evo具备优良的过弯性能。!

vehicleCollection.en:
The 4th-gen Evo's handling got a boost from electronic Active Yaw Control and power now up to 280ps.

The Lancer Evolution took a major leap forward in August 1996, with the Evo IV. It completely redefined the model, starting with the 4G63 powerplant, which was flipped around 180 degrees in the engine bay and output was raised to 280ps and 36.0kgm of torque. But perhaps the noteworthy change was the introduction of the electronically-controlled AYC (Active Yaw Control) that replaced the mechanical LSD of previous models.

Building on the success of the Evo IV, the Evo V appeared in January 1998 with a slightly enlarged body to meet WRC specifications. The Evo V had more torque than its predecessor, rated to 38.0kgm, and came with a new helical LSD for the front differential.

In January 1999, Mitsubishi introduced the Evo VI. While the car looked basically the same as the Evo V, there were significant differences under the sheet metal, including a refined engine and re-tuned suspension system. In January 2000, the first anniversary model was offered, as well as another special model that commemorated Tommi Makinen's four consecutive WRC championships. This special-edition model, limited to only 2500 units, featured a large front spoiler, a revised suspension stroke and quicker steering, among other things. It proved to be the final and ultimate example of the truly ground-breaking second-generation Lancer Evolution.
vehicleCollection.zh:
采用电子主动偏航控制，马力达到280ps的第四代蓝瑟翼豪陆神。

历经翼豪陆神I、II和III三代车款的蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列在1996年8月进行了重大更新。得益于蓝瑟轿车进行的全面更新，在此基础上开发的蓝瑟翼豪陆神IV成为了翼豪陆神系列真正意义上的第二代车款。

4G63引擎的位置翻转了180度，能够产生280ps，最大扭矩也提高到36.0kgm。最显著的变化是电控主动偏航控制的引进，替代了前几款车中后轮差速器采用的机械式限滑差速器。

此后，蓝瑟翼豪陆神V于1998年1月发布。这款蓝瑟翼豪陆神V的车身比以往车款更大，以满足世界拉力锦标赛的技术规格。

考虑到竞争对手都充分利用了1997年推出的WR车辆规则，坚持奋战在A组的蓝瑟翼豪陆神有必要采用较宽的车身。在性能方面，引擎的最大扭矩提高到了38.0kgm，前轮差速器采用螺旋限滑差速器。悬挂改用反式避震，还进行了许多微调和优化。

1999年1月，更进一步的蓝瑟翼豪陆神VI推出。此车与翼豪陆神V的外观差异很小，但内部已经完全变成一辆成熟的公路跑车，引擎和悬挂都得到了进一步的优化。

蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列的第一款周年纪念车型发布于2000年1月，就是基于这款蓝瑟翼豪陆神VI开发的。为了纪念托米·马基宁在世界拉力锦标赛锦标赛中的4连胜，发布了限量生产2500辆的托米·马基宁版。该车型采用了大块前扰流板以及其他特殊配件，悬挂冲程也经过修正，转向也更快，以适应公路上的驾驶。这是蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列第二代的最后一款，也是最顶级的一款车型。

cars.nameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR GSR '06
cars.nameZh: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR GSR '06

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
The Evo’s history is marked by constant improvements
and functional expansions.

This MR version was the final model of the third-gen Evo IX,
and is said to be one of the best Evos ever.
The third-generation car was based on the Lancer Cedia,
which, in turn, was a serious and practical family sedan.

Compared to the second-generation model, it was larger overall.
The nose took on a rounded shape, while blister fenders were adopted.

Not quite the battle machine it used to be...

...the large iconic fog lights, reminiscent of rally cars,
were done away with.

It was a sign that the Evo was expanding its sphere of competition
to include endurance races and the like.

At the same time, the car's upscale nature grew.

Multi-purpose cars like the Evo tend to adapt
to their surroundings.

In this sense, they evolve like living things.

And that is just one of the many reasons that
fans continue to love the Evo.
dialogues.zh:
在翼豪陆神的发展史上，充斥着持续不断的改进和功能拓展。

这款MR版本是第三代翼豪陆神IX的终极车型，
也被公认为最卓越的翼豪陆神之一。

第三代翼豪陆神的开发基于蓝瑟西迪亚，
一款普通而实用的家庭轿车。

相较于第二代，它的车身整体更大，车头被重新设计得
更加圆润，同时加入了引人注目的凸起轮拱。

它不再保持曾经的战斗机器风格……

标志性的硕大雾灯，以及那些让人联想到
拉力赛车的元素，也不复存在……

这暗示着翼豪陆神正在将其竞争领域从耐力赛扩大到
更多不同领域。

与此同时，车辆的高端进阶属性也更为凸显。

像翼豪陆神这样的多功能车型往往能够灵活
适应不同的环境。

从这个意义上说，它们就像生物一样在不断演变进化。

这正是车迷们一直对翼豪陆神怀有深厚感情的众多原因之一。

brandCentral.en:
There are two ways of sorting Lancer Evolution generations:
by number or by base model.

According to the base model system, the Lancer Evo VII,
VIII, and IX all belong to the third generation.

Of these, the Lancer Evolution IX MR was the last model.

It was also the last Lancer Evolution to be equipped with
Mitsubishi's 4G63 4-cylinder turbo engine.

With a strong turbocharger and continuous variable valve
timing, it offered better engine response than ever before.

And its sporty look helped distinguish it as the
definitive IX version.

The "MR" in its name stands for "Mitsubishi Racing," an exclusive
label reserved for Mitsubishi’s top-tier sports cars.
brandCentral.zh:
Lancer Evolution的代际排序通常有两种算法：
按照编号排，或是按照基础车型划分。

以后者划分的话，Lancer Evo VII、VIII和IX
均属于第三代。

这样算来，Lancer Evolution IX MR就是第三代的
最后一款。

同时也是最后一款搭载Mitsubishi
4G63 4缸涡轮引擎的Lancer Evolution。

凭借强大的涡轮增压器和连续可变气门正时技术，
它提供了远超常规的引擎响应。

运动外观更是Evo IX的集大成者。

名称中的“MR”则代表“Mitsubishi Racing”
——Mitsubishi顶尖跑车的专属标签。

usedCar.en:
You might say that the Evo IX MR represented a new milestone
for the Lancer Evolution series.

After all, it was the last of its kind to come equipped with
the Mitsubishi 4G63 4-cylinder turbo engine.

Although the 4G63 would prove to be no match for its
successor, the 4B11, in terms of power and torque...

...it offered more power and better engine response in the
low rev range.

A gem of an engine, it's sure to stand the test of time!
usedCar.zh:
这台Evo IX MR可以说标志着Lancer Evolution系列的
一道里程碑。

毕竟，它是最后一款搭载Mitsubishi
4G63 4缸涡轮引擎的车型。

尽管4G63确实无法在功率和扭矩方面与其后继
产品4B11匹敌……

但在低转速区间，它的动力更大，响应也更优秀。

像这样的宝藏引擎，定能经受住时间的考验！

vehicleCollection.en:
The "9.5," the final 4G63-powered Lancer Evolution.

The Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR GSR was the updated version of the Lancer Evolution IX GSR that appeared a year prior. Although the two cars look nearly identical, numerous refinements were made to the 2006 model. Although the car's engine specs remained largely unchanged, the MIVEC variable valve timing system was retuned, the standard specification turbine wheel was changed to a titanium-aluminum alloy, and the compressor inlet diameter was downsized. Along with other minor improvements, this resulted in sharper engine response and faster acceleration.

The suspension system was also enhanced, with high spring rate Eibach coils combined with Bilstein dampers. The electronically controlled Super AYC 4WD system was reprogrammed to focus on cornering ability. There were also refinements to the aerodynamics with the shape of the front bumper being changed to reduce lift.

The" MR" of its name stood for Mitsubishi Racing. Throughout the company's history, this designation was given to its highest performing models. For the Lancer Evolution, the MR name first appeared in the VIII lineup, making this IX the second MR model in the car's history.

This model represented the culmination of development on the third-generation Lancer Evolution, and it was the last to be equipped with the legendary 4G63 engine.
vehicleCollection.zh:
9.5代蓝翼，是采用4G63引擎的最后一款蓝瑟翼豪陆神。

三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神IX MR GSR是2005年首次亮相的蓝瑟翼豪陆神IX GSR的2006年升级改款。

乍看之下，这款车似乎和旧款一模一样。事实上整车内部都进行了大量的改良。比方说，虽然4G63引擎的最大功率和扭矩保持不变，但三菱创新阀门定时电子控制系统系统得到了调校，涡轮叶轮的材质升级成了钛铝合金，而且压缩机进气口尺寸也做了相应缩小。再加上一些小的改进，结果使得引擎反应更灵敏，加速度更快。

悬挂系统也进行了升级，使用倍适登避震器搭配高性能艾巴赫螺旋弹簧。“主动偏航控制”电控四轮驱动系统也进行了重新编制，更专注于转弯能力。同样接受优化的还有空气动力学外形，对前保险杠的形状进行了修改以降低抬升力。

车型名称中的“MR”代表“三菱赛车”。在该公司历史上，这个代号一向是用来指代最高性能的运动型车型。对于蓝瑟翼豪陆神来说，MR车型首次出现是在蓝瑟翼豪陆神VIII上，因此这款IX是系列车型历史上的第二款MR。

这款车型是2001年面世的第三代蓝瑟翼豪陆神开发历程的顶点，也是最后一款装备4G63传奇引擎的蓝瑟翼豪陆神。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
With the arrival of the Evo V generation, the Lancer Evo
series' turning performance improved dramatically.

The body was made wider to accommodate the increased
tread width.

The tyres have 17 inch rims and Brembo
brake calipers come fitted as standard.

All in all, it's one of the greatest cars
to drive in the world.
dialogues.zh:
Lancer Evo系列是从Evo V这一代开始大幅改善它的转弯
性能的。

车身变得更宽，以便扩大胎距，

而且换上了17英寸轮毂，全系标配了Brembo刹车卡钳。

我概括一下，它是全世界开起来最棒的车之一。
-

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
This car...it's named after a mounted knight with a lance.

And this is the fifth-generation version?

I can tell by its appearance that
it's not slow or modest.

It gained fame in the World Rally Championship
and enjoyed popularity across the globe? Impressive!

This is a really nice car, I hope you take good care of it!
dialogues.zh:
所以说这款车是以一位手持长枪的骑士命名的……

而且这是第五代车款了？

一看外表就知道，它肯定不是一辆慢吞吞的老爷车。

哇哦，所以它在世界拉力锦标赛上一举成名，接着在
全世界都很受欢迎。

这真是一辆好车呀。希望你能好好照顾它哦。

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
Historically, many road cars that served as the basis
for rally machines have been especially appealing.

Cars like the Mini Cooper S, Audi quattro
and Lancia Delta...

...all began as practical, utility-focused family cars.

Yet beneath that everyday form, they carried
serious performance potential.

There have been many Lancer Evolution models over the years,
and among the most popular of all was the Evo V.

In fact, today, its a highly sought after collectible, with people
all over the world clamoring to get their hands on one.

The sport-tuned suspension really shines when you
whip the car around a race track.

Its turbocharged engine has power to spare, and the aerodynamic
body makes the car look race-ready as ever, don't you think?

这些专为A组别赛事认证规定而设计的空气动力车身部件

vehicleCollection.en:
The 5th-gen Evo impressed with its bolder-looking flared fenders and an engine that produced more torque.

The Lancer Evolution took a major leap forward in August 1996, with the Evo IV. It completely redefined the model, starting with the 4G63 powerplant, which was flipped around 180 degrees in the engine bay, and output was raised to 280ps and 36.0kgm of torque. But perhaps the most noteworthy change was the introduction of the electronically-controlled AYC (Active Yaw Control) that replaced the mechanical LSD of previous models.

Building on the success of the Evo IV, the Evo V appeared in January 1998 with a slightly enlarged body to meet WRC specifications. The Evo V had more torque than its predecessor, rated to 38.0kgm, and came with a new helical LSD for the front differential.

In January 1999, Mitsubishi introduced the Evo VI. While the car looked basically the same as the Evo V, there were significant differences under the sheet metal, including a refined engine and re-tuned suspension system. In January 2000, the first anniversary model was offered, as well as another special model that commemorated Tommi Makinen's four consecutive WRC championships. This special-edition model, limited to only 2500 units, featured a large front spoiler, a revised suspension stroke and quicker steering, among other things. It proved to be the final and ultimate example of the truly ground-breaking second-generation Lancer Evolution.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第五代的蓝瑟翼豪陆神，加上了挡泥板，更增添了扭矩。"

蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列在经历了翼豪陆神I、II和III代之后，终于在1996年8月实现了一次大飞跃。随着原版蓝瑟轿车的大改款，第二代翼豪陆神系列的第一款车型蓝瑟翼豪陆神IV诞生了。

代号4G63的引擎的摆放位置调转了180度，为车辆带来280ps，最大扭矩也提升到了36.0kgm。翼豪陆神4最显著的变化来自于电子控制的主动偏航控制的引入，用于替代上代采用的机械LSD后差速器。

紧接着，蓝瑟翼豪陆神V在1998年1月面世。这一次，为了符合世界拉力锦标赛的比赛规格要求，三菱对车身尺寸进行了放大。

当翼豪陆神的对手得以充分利用1997年颁布的新赛事规则时，蓝瑟翼豪陆神不得不屈身于A组别比赛中。也因此，宽体的引入变得势在必行。而在性能方面，翼豪陆神V的引擎最大扭矩再次提升，达到了38.0kgm，前差速器加装了螺旋限滑差速器，其他改进还包括为悬挂系统添加倒插式避震器和更多细微的精校设定。

到了1999年1月，进化得愈发完善的蓝瑟翼豪陆神VI到来。与翼豪陆神V的外观差异不大，但内部的调校愈加成熟。引擎和悬挂也得到了进一步的优化。

时间来到2000年1月，蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列的第一款纪念车型发布。这台基于翼豪陆神VI打造的汤米·马基宁版本是专为纪念汤米·马基宁连续4年摘得世界拉力锦标赛桂冠而推出的，限量发售2500台。这款纪念车型配有更大的前扰流板和各种专属配件，并附以更适合公路驾驶的调校：例如更短的悬挂行程和快速转向技术。它代表了第二代蓝瑟翼豪陆神最终极的形态。

dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
The Lancer Evo is one of the most boring Japanese family
sedans to have been transformed into a racing beast.

It’s a mild-mannered nobody turned superhero...

The kind typically found in comic books and action flicks.

So what might the ‘super powers’ of this car be
from a design perspective?

Why, they are expressed by its sharp spoilers, bumpers
and grilles!

All of this brings to mind the imposing image
of a samurai’s suit of armour.
dialogues.zh:
Lancer Evo是由日本最平淡的轿车产品
族系之一改造而来的比赛野兽。

它就像是漫画或者动作电影中常见的那种……

不显山露水的平凡人变成的超级英雄。

那么从设计角度来说，这款车的“超能力”是什么呢？

还用问吗，它那犀利的扰流板、保险杠和
前格栅就能充分回答这个问题了！

所有这一切都让人不由得联想到日本武士的盔甲。\

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Lancer Evolution VI GSR T.M. EDITION Special Color Package '00
vehicleCollection.en:
Optional body graphics stood out on this rare Tommi Mäkinen Edition Evo.

In commemoration of Tommi Makinen's achievement of Drivers' Champion 4 years running from 1996 to 1999, The Lancer Evolution T.M. EDITION was sold in a limited run of 2500 cars. The model code was GFCP9A, and is sometimes nicknamed the Lancer Evo 6.5.

Compared to the Evo V, the Evo VI introduced in the beginning of the same year had a softer ride, due to the unpopularity of the previous suspension that was considered too hard for driving in the city. In addition, the front bumper shape had been revised for aerodynamic and cooling performance. The T.M. EDITION on the other hand was created in the image of a tarmac rally setup, and was equipped with a front bumper that omits fog lights for even better aerodynamics, and the harder suspension from the EVO V further lowered by another 10mm. The steering gear ratio is also slightly quicker in this model.

By utilizing a titanium-aluminum alloy turbine and smaller compressors, its maximum torque of 38.0kgm is produced earlier at 2750rpm, rather than the usual 3000rpm. It is also given red Recaro seats with a stitched TOMMI MAKINEN logo, special red meters, the same Enkei spoke wheels as the rally car, and a large exhaust muffler with a circular exit, rather than the original elliptical one.

The promotional image color of the body was red, and it was possible to select a special color package which had a black stripe running from the front fenders to the body sides.

This Evo was popular as a model that was further perfected, worthy to be crowned with the name of the undefeated WRC champion.
vehicleCollection.zh:
可选的车体条纹让这款汤米·马基宁版显得尤为亮眼。

为了纪念汤米·马基宁在1996到1999年间连续四年蝉联世界拉力锦标赛车手冠军宝座的壮举，三菱限量生产了2500台蓝瑟翼豪陆神T.M.版投入市场。这款车型的代号是GFCP9A，但车迷间更喜欢称呼它蓝瑟翼豪陆神6.5，以便将其与在同年早些时候推出的翼豪陆神6进行区分。

翼豪陆神6相比翼豪陆神5调整了乘坐的舒适性，原因是后者在城市行驶时偏硬的悬挂设定备受用户诟病，销量不佳。除了根据空气动力学和冷却效率的需要对前保险杠的形状进行了改动外，T.M.版还打造出了独一无二的柏油公路拉力车的设定。前保险杠上的雾灯被取消，以获得更好的空气动力效果。比翼豪陆神5更硬的悬挂往下降了10mm，转向齿比也更快。

钛铝合金涡轮搭配更小型的压缩机，使它的最大扭矩高达38.0kgm，而且在转速2750rpm时即可达到，而非常规版本时的3000rpm。作为专属版本的特色，本车配置了红色的Recaro桶椅，椅背上绣有梅基宁的标志、特别设计的红色仪表、拉力车同款的恩肯定制轮毂，还有大号圆型排气消音器（原版拉力车为椭圆形）。

虽然宣传文案中的主推颜色是红色，但购买者还可以追加一套特殊涂装：一条纯黑色的拉力条纹从前挡泥板上方沿着车身侧面往后延伸。

这款尽善尽美的翼豪陆神车型配上无可匹敌的世界拉力锦标赛冠军之名，广受大众的追捧，毫无意外地成为了同类型当中的王者。

catch.en: Optional body graphics stood out on this rare Tommi Mäkinen Edition Evo.
catch.zh: 可选的车体条纹让这款汤米·马基宁版显得尤为亮眼。

long.en:
In commemoration of Tommi Makinen's achievement of Drivers' Champion 4 years running from 1996 to 1999, The Lancer Evolution T.M. EDITION was sold in a limited run of 2500 cars. The model code was GFCP9A, and is sometimes nicknamed the Lancer Evo 6.5.

Compared to the Evo V, the Evo VI introduced in the beginning of the same year had a softer ride, due to the unpopularity of the previous suspension that was considered too hard for driving in the city. In addition, the front bumper shape had been revised for aerodynamic and cooling performance. The T.M. EDITION on the other hand was created in the image of a tarmac rally setup, and was equipped with a front bumper that omits fog lights for even better aerodynamics, and the harder suspension from the EVO V further lowered by another 10mm. The steering gear ratio is also slightly quicker in this model.

By utilizing a titanium-aluminum alloy turbine and smaller compressors, its maximum torque of 38.0kgm is produced earlier at 2750rpm, rather than the usual 3000rpm. It is also given red Recaro seats with a stitched TOMMI MAKINEN logo, special red meters, the same Enkei spoke wheels as the rally car, and a large exhaust muffler with a circular exit, rather than the original elliptical one.

The promotional image color of the body was red, and it was possible to select a special color package which had a black stripe running from the front fenders to the body sides.

This Evo was popular as a model that was further perfected, worthy to be crowned with the name of the undefeated WRC champion.

cars.nameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
cars.nameZh: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The long-named Evo VIII MR GSR is a really special machine.
A true sports sedan with rallying pedigree.

The Evo's styling is sober and restrained, but set off
by its large functional rear wing.

The sober theme is continued on the inside.

The main difference is a thick steering wheel
and high-bolstered Recaro seats.

Did you know that the name "Recaro" is short for
"Reutter Carosserie?"

This is where Porsche handmade many of its car bodies
in the 1960s.

The body manufacturing division was sold to Porsche
and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!

A small bit of trivia!!.
dialogues.zh:
拥有长串名字的翼豪陆神VIII MR GSR车型是一款非常特别
的座驾。它是一辆具有拉力赛血统的运动型轿车。

翼豪陆神的外观设计简洁而内敛，但实用的大型尾翼
为其增添了亮点。

这种简洁风格在内饰中得以延续。

主要的区别在于厚实的方向盘和
高包裹性的Recaro赛车座椅。

你知道吗？“Recaro”这个名字其实是
“Reutter Carosserie”的缩写。

在20世纪60年代，保时捷的许多车身就是
在这里手工打造的。

后来，车身制造部门被出售给了保时捷，
而“瑞特”则以“Recaro”的名义专门生产座椅！

这是个有趣的小知识！

brandCentral.sourceName: Lancer GSR Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
brandCentral.en:
Mitsubishi cars adorned with the "MR" badge (Mitsubishi Racing)
 placed a high priority on high performance.

The first Lancer Evolution to include an MR car to its model
lineup was the Evo VIII MR.

The Lancer Evolution VIII MR boasted world-class performance,
bred from the company's winning rally race car.

With its sporty-tuned suspension, improved aerodynamics,
more responsive engine, and lightweight aluminum roof...

...the car was truly a world-class sports car,
albeit with four doors.

To this day, not many sports cars can outperform
the Lancer Evolution VIII MR on the race track.
brandCentral.zh:
带有“MR”（Mitsubishi Racing）标志的Mitsubishi车型
以其高性能而著称。

第一款获得这一殊荣的Lancer Evolution
便是Evo VIII MR……

其标准车型本就是四驱运动型轿车中的世界级之作。

MR版本通过强化悬挂系统、改进空气动力学设计、
提高引擎响应速度和采用铝合金车顶……

打造出一款经过精细调校的轻量化高性能车型。

即使放到今天，在速度和驾驶乐趣方面能与之媲美的
车型也不多见。

usedCar.sourceName: Lancer GSR Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
usedCar.en:
This car was the first Lancer Evolution to receive
Mitsubishi’s high-performance MR badge.

Thanks to its 4G63 turbocharged inline-4, this rally-inspired
machine accelerated like a sports car.

The Lancer Evolution VIII marked a major leap from the
previous model, thanks to its Super AYC torque control system.

Over any driving surface, the sedan was fast and easy to control.

The MR version did away with many luxury comforts, instead
placing a high priority on speed.

Not only did it boast a sportier suspension and lightweight
aluminum roof, the engine had more punch in the low-to-mid range.

With the company's excellent all-wheel-drive system and Super AYC,
the Lancer Evolution VIII was indeed a rally car for the street.
usedCar.zh:
这款车型是第一辆获得Mitsubishi运动级“MR”命名的
Lancer Evolution。

它不仅能在各种路面上达到惊人的速度，还拥有梦幻般出色
的转弯性能。

Lancer Evolution VIII相较于Evo VII实现了重大突破，
配备了Super AYC（主动偏航控制）扭矩控制系统……

以及强劲的4G63涡轮增压引擎。

这款MR版本的设计更加简洁，与其高性能的定位相符。

除了改进的悬挂系统和更换为铝合金车顶外，MR版本
在低中转速范围内响应更为灵敏……

其四轮驱动系统和AYC系统也经过了精心调校，
达到了近乎完美的状态。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Lancer GSR Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
vehicleCollection.en:
The final evolution of the Lancer Evo VIII with updated suspension and low center of gravity.

As far as rally-inspired performance sedans go, Mitsubishi's Lancer Evolution VII, introduced in 2001, was in a class of its own, one-upping its main rival, the Subaru WRX STI. The new Evo featured cutting-edge all-wheel-drive technologies that included the ACD (Active Center Differential) and the AYC yaw-control system. In 2002, Mitsubishi offered an INVECS-II electronically controlled automatic transmission with manual shift mode, mating it with a detuned 272ps version of the 4G63 engine.

In 2003, Mitsubishi introduced the Lancer Evolution VIII whose engine produced 40kgm more torque than its predecessor, along with enhancements to the drivetrain and handling components. This set the stage for the Lancer Evolution VIII MR, which made its debut in 2004. As the final Evo VIII model, the MR came with various refinements across the board, including the addition of an aluminum roof panel and the implementation of Bilstein dampers for the very first time.
vehicleCollection.zh:
蓝瑟翼豪陆神VIII的最终进化，更新了悬架系统，具有更低的重心。

第三代蓝瑟的第一款Evo车型是2001年推出的翼豪陆神VII。这台车上最吸睛的当属那套主动式中央差速器。在与主动偏航控制系统同步控制的帮助下，主动式中央差速器将翼豪陆神VII本来就很高的牵引力性能提升到了一个新的水平。2002年，第一款使用自动变速箱的蓝瑟翼豪陆神车型问世。这款车整合了功率下调至272ps的4G63引擎和INVECS-II电控自动变速箱，并且支持切换手动模式。

2年之后，第八代蓝瑟翼豪陆神VIII于2003年1月发布。通过这款车型，4G63引擎的扭矩进一步提升至40kgm。传动系统的其他方面也获得了长足的进步与提升，这其中当然也包括主动式中央差速器和主动偏航控制系统的改进。

在2004年2月，蓝瑟翼豪陆神VIII MR作为翼豪陆神VIII系列的最终版本推出。再次对整车进行了多项优化改进，包括换用铝制车顶板，并首次采用了倍适登减震器。

catch.en: The final evolution of the Lancer Evo VIII with updated suspension and low center of gravity.
catch.zh: 蓝瑟翼豪陆神VIII的最终进化，更新了悬架系统，具有更低的重心。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
This 400R is the complete car, not the GT-R that was based
on the R33.

It’s a car for connoisseurs.

With new bumpers, air outlets,
and overfenders...

...it’s practically a different car, and yet it’s
incredibly sleek all the same.
dialogues.zh:
这辆400R是一辆“完全体”的车，而不仅仅是脱胎于R33的GT-R。

这是一辆为鉴赏家们设计的车。

它采用了新的保险杠、出气口和轮眉……

实际上可以算成一辆完全不同的车了。
尽管如此，它的外观依然是那么的流畅和优美。
