collection.en:
The Nismo 400R was long considered the ultimate GT-R.

 The car is based on the Skyline GT-R, but you won't find
the name "Skyline" or "GT-R" anywhere on the body.

From the engine to the body to the chassis, this limited-edition model
was extensively tuned by Nismo, Nissan's motorsports division.

And they named it simply the "400R."

Perhaps that's why this car isn't talked about
as much as other legendary Skyline GT-R models.

This is a culmination of the Nissan works team's knowhow gained at Le Mans,
coming in the form of increased displacement engine,

a reinforced suspension and clutch,
as well as the extensive use of carbon fiber, notably in the prop shafts.

At the time the 400R was being planned, Japanese automakers had a
self-imposed limit of 280 horsepower for their road cars.

As its name suggests, the 400R had a bit more, with 400.

It also had a price tag to match, costing three times as much
as a new R33 model Skyline GT-R.

One of the most expensive Japanese-made cars at the time, Nissan
claims to have built only 44 of them.

Because of its rarity, it has become one of the most
difficult Skyline GT-R models to find.
collection.zh:
NISMO 400R是GT-R产品谱系的终极形态。

虽然同样基于Skyline GT-R打造，
但车型中并未带有“Skyline”或“GT-R”的字样。

从引擎到空气动力学设计、再到底盘，这款限量型号的每一处
都由日产的赛车部门NISMO进行了精心调校……

并给予了它“400R”这个朴实无华的型号名。

这或许就是它不如其他Skyline GT-R
传奇型号那般口口相传的原因。

但有一说一，从定制的加大排量引擎
到强化后的悬挂和离合器……

再到碳纤维材料的大量使用，特别是传动轴，这台限量款
可谓是日产从勒芒取得的赛车经验和知识的集大成之作。

在400R的设计规划阶段，日本的汽车制造行业
规定公路车的动力不能高于280马力。

不过顾名思义，400R拥有400马力的性能。

当然，它的价格也充分说明了什么叫一分钱一分货，
贵到可以买下3台全新的Skyline GT-R R33。

400R#当时最昂贵的日本汽车之一，
而且日产宣称总共只生产了44辆400R。

由于产量稀少，现如今，它已经是最难找到的Skyline GT-R了。/

vehicleCollection.en:
Boasting 400ps and an extremely limited production run, this is the ultimate R33 GT-R from Nismo.

The 400R, introduced in 1996, broke the mold when it came to Japanese performance cars. With a maximum output of 400ps, it was the most powerful in its day when JDM cars were limited to 280ps, and its eye-popping 12 million-yen price tag was roughly three times that of the base R33 Skyline GT-R. Utilizing all of NISMO's expertise, the 400R was developed with the goal of producing the fastest possible GT-R variant that could still be driven on the road.

The 400R came equipped with a power unit based on a special version of the RB26DETT engine, known as the RB-X GT2. This was paired with N1-spec turbochargers to deliver increased boost. To meet the requirements of a road-approved vehicle, maximum output was kept at a relatively restrained level, especially when considering the full potential of the engine. Even so, specially developed pistons and a reinforced crankshaft allowed displacement to be increased to 2.8 liters, delivering strong low-end torque and making the engine far more manageable than its standard counterpart.

At the same time, the engine maintained formidable power at high revs, necessitating the use of twin-plate clutch units to handle the output. A lightweight carbon fiber propeller shaft was added, along with a fully original suspension setup featuring Bilstein dampers, front and rear stabilizers, and reinforced bushings.

As a showcase of NISMO's engineering expertise and decades of motorsports know-how, the 400R stood as the complete package.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款NISMO打造的终极R33 GT-R拥有400ps的动力，只生产了极其有限的数量。

1996年推出的400R拥有最大400ps的动力，以及令人侧目的1200万日元售价，是一款经过充分调校的车型。在当时日本乘用车的性能普遍限制在280ps，而全新的R33天际线GT-R仅售400万日元的时代，这两个数字震撼了所有的车迷。400R以R33 GT-R为原型，大量运用了NISMO积累的所有知识和心得，旨在打造一台能够合法上路的最速GT-R。

这款400R配备了基于RB26DETT引擎开发的动力单元，被称为RB-X GT2，并加装了N1-spec涡轮增压器来提供额外推进力。为了符合公路车型的准入标准，其最大动力输出被限制在了相对适中的水平，远远没有发掘出这台引擎的潜力。另一方面，这款引擎采用了特别开发的活塞和更坚固的曲轴，排量也扩到了2.8升，让它可以在低转速范围下达到更高的扭矩，进而使这个型号比采用常规引擎的车更易操控。

这款引擎还能够在高转速范围下输出强大无比的动力，因此需要双踏板离合单元作为辅助。此外，这款车还采用了轻量化碳纤维传动轴、倍适登减震器的原装悬挂套件，前后平衡杆，以及强化衬套。

作为NISMO技术实力和赛车知识的巅峰之作，400R是一台尽善尽美的公路赛车。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Nismo is the name of Nissan’s in-house works team.

They are famous for building production cars packed
with racing know-how.

In 2004, to mark its 20th anniversary, Nismo introduced
this R34 GT-R Z-tune.

Of all the Nismo products, this one takes the crown.

At the time of its release, the R34 Skyline GT-R was
already retired.

This meant that the Z-tune had to be based on used cars.
Naturally, only those deemed excellent by Nismo were used.

The engines and bodies were disassembled and reengineered
with racing technology.

Today, R34 GT-Rs are celebrated as prized collector’s cars
across the globe.

But none more than the legendary Z-tune!
dialogues.zh:
Nismo是Nissan自家厂队的名称，

以打造出结合诸多赛车技术的量产车而闻名。

2004年，为纪念成立20周年，Nismo推出了
这款R34 GT-R Z-tune。

在所有Nismo作品中，这款车堪称巅峰之作。

在它发布之时，R34 Skyline GT-R已经停产退役……

这意味着Z-tune必须以旧款车型为基础来进行打造。
自然，只有那些被Nismo评定为极品的车辆才会被选用。

引擎和车身随后被拆解，并运用赛车技术
进行重新改造。

如今，R34 GT-R被全世界奉为收藏珍品。

而其中最珍贵的莫过于Z-tune！
]

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Remember the R34 Skyline GT-R? I was a big fan
of that car.

Sadly, it made its exit from the All Japan GT Championship in 2003.

But then, in 2004, it came back…

When Nissan’s in-house works team, Nismo, poured all
of its racing know-how into a street-legal GT-R version.

That’s right, I’m talking about the Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune!

Apparently, development started on this project
back in 1999.

In other words, when the R34 Skyline GT-R was at the height
of its racing prowess!

To be able to see such a special GT-R up-close like this
is really a great honour!
dialogues.zh:
还记得R34天际线GT-R吗？我是它的忠实粉丝。

遗憾的是，这台车在2003年退出了全日本GT锦标赛的舞台。

不过在随后的2004年，

日产自家厂队NISMO倾注其所有赛车技术打造出了
一款可以合法上路的GT-R，让它便重回大众视野……

没错，我说的就是NISMO R34 GT-R Z-tune！

不难猜出，这一项目的开发工作早在1999年就开始了。

换句话说，开发在R34天际线GT-R还在
实力巅峰的时候就开始了！

能够如此近距离地观赏这样一台特别的GT-R，
真是莫大的荣幸！
*

brandCentral.en:
Surely you’ve heard of Nismo, right? Nissan’s legendary
motorsports division?

In 2004, Nismo released the R34 GT-R Z-tune, the ultimate
complete tuner car to mark its 20th anniversary.

Since the Z-tune was based on the discontinued R34 Skyline GT-R,
it needed to be crafted from chosen pre-owned examples.

But that didn’t make it any less of a Nismo. Take the engine, for
example—a 2.8-liter RB26DETT, purpose-built for Super GT.

There was also the precision spot welding, CFRP parts, re-tuned
suspension and brakes, and newly developed aero parts.

Fewer than 20 were ever built, yet the Z-tune became a defining
milestone in the second generation of the GT-R legacy.
brandCentral.zh:
你一定听说过Nismo吧？就是Nissan那个传奇的
赛车运动部门。

2004年，Nismo推出了R34 GT-R Z-tune，这款终极完全体
车型是为了纪念该部门在汽车创新领域深耕20年的成果。

由于Z-tune是基于已经停产的R34 Skyline GT-R打造的，
只能从精心挑选的二手车中寻找合适的车型作为基础。

但这丝毫不影响它的“Nismo”血统。就拿引擎来说——
这台2.8L RB26DETT与GT500比赛中使用的引擎相同。

更不用提车身采用了点焊工艺、CFRP碳纤维部件、重新
调校的悬挂和制动系统，以及全新的空气动力学套件。

虽然产量不足20台，但Z-tune无疑成为了
GT-R第二代车型中的里程碑式作品。

vehicleCollection.en:
This GT-R bows out with the ultimate complete tuned model.

In 2004, Nismo—now known as Nissan Motorsports & Customizing—celebrated its 20th anniversary. To mark the milestone, the team set out to build the ultimate road car, a showcase of two decades of motorsports know-how. The result was the Nismo R34 GT-R Z-tune.

By then, however, production of the R34 Skyline GT-R had already ended. To overcome this, Nismo sourced 20 carefully selected used cars that met strict criteria, then stripped them down to bare shells for a complete, hand-built reconstruction.

Every component added was engineered to meet the high standards of the Z name. At the heart of it all was the RB26DETT Kai-Z2 engine. The engine was based on the same 2.8-liter setup used in the GT500 GT-R of that era. It featured strengthened internals, from the pistons and rods to the block, for maximum reliability under extreme use. The IHI turbochargers were proven in the 2004 Nürburgring 24-Hour race. And the titanium exhaust system helped improve catalytic performance and flow.

To enhance chassis rigidity, additional spot welds were applied in key areas like the door frames, while sections vulnerable to heat-related distortion were reinforced with molded CFRP parts. For suspension, Nismo worked with SACHS to develop specially tuned bolt-on dampers, drawing on SACHS's GT500 expertise. Bespoke brake components were co-developed with Brembo to achieve 1.6G of braking force on semi-slick tires. The exterior was also reworked with a focus on reducing weight, improving cooling, and enhancing aerodynamics. In particular, the front bumper, fenders, and hood were replaced with CFRP parts.

In the end, only 19 units were produced—including the original prototype—but the R34 GT-R Z-tune remains, without question, Nismo’s crowning achievement among the second wave of GT-R models.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第二代GT-R车系以这款终极完全调校版本作为完美收官。

2004年，NISMO（现日产汽车与定制）迎来了成立20周年纪念。为了纪念这一重要时刻，他们决定打造一款终极公路跑车，作为20年技术积淀的集大成之作。这个充满激情的项目最终诞生了NISMO R34 GT-R Z-tune。

然而，作为该项目研发基础的R34天际线GT-R此时已经停产。为了解决这一问题，NISMO精选了20台符合严格标准的二手车，将车身完全拆解后进行手工重建。

自然而然，每一个加装的部件都达到了配得上“Z”字代号的最高水准。其心脏是一颗RB26DETT Kai-Z2引擎。以与同期的GT500组别GT-R赛车相同的2.8升规格为基准，从活塞、缸体到连杆的每个部件都经过精挑细选，确保强度和可靠性。涡轮增压器采用石川岛播磨重工业制造的单元，这也是曾在2004年纽博格林24小时耐力赛中取得佳绩的经典单元。同时，排气系统采用钛合金材质打造，提升了催化器性能和排气流量。

为提升底盘的刚性，在门框等关键部位增加了额外的点焊，而容易因焊接高温变形的区域则采用模压碳纤维增强基复合材料部件进行强化。悬挂系统采用萨克斯公司生产的特调螺栓式减震器，这家公司的产品已在GT500赛事得到了检验。为了在半光面轮胎上达到1.6G制动力的目标，NISMO与布雷博合作，为其量身定制了一批刹车部件。外观方面也进行了多项优化，专注于车身轻量化、散热性能和空气动力学效应。特别是前端部分，保险杠、挡泥板和引擎盖都更换为碳纤维增强基复合材料部件。

最终有19台车完工（包含原型车在内），但R34 GT-R Z-tune无疑是NISMO在第二代GT-R车系中推出的巅峰之作。

catch.en: This GT-R bows out with the ultimate complete tuned model.
catch.zh: 第二代GT-R车系以这款终极完全调校版本作为完美收官。

The exterior was also reworked with a focus on reducing weight, improving cooling, and enhancing aerodynamics. In particular, the front bumper, fenders, and hood were replaced with CFRP parts.

In the end, only 19 units were produced—including the original prototype—but the R34 GT-R Z-tune remains, without question, Nismo’s crowning achievement among the second wave of GT-R models.
long.zh:
2004年，NISMO（现日产汽车与定制）迎来了成立20周年纪念。为了纪念这一重要时刻，他们决定打造一款终极公路跑车，作为20年技术积淀的集大成之作。这个充满激情的项目最终诞生了NISMO R34 GT-R Z-tune。

然而，作为该项目研发基础的R34天际线GT-R此时已经停产。为了解决这一问题，NISMO精选了20台符合严格标准的二手车，将车身完全拆解后进行手工重建。

自然而然，每一个加装的部件都达到了配得上“Z”字代号的最高水准。其心脏是一颗RB26DETT Kai-Z2引擎。以与同期的GT500组别GT-R赛车相同的2.8升规格为基准，从活塞、缸体到连杆的每个部件都经过精挑细选，确保强度和可靠性。涡轮增压器采用石川岛播磨重工业制造的单元，这也是曾在2004年纽博格林24小时耐力赛中取得佳绩的经典单元。同时，排气系统采用钛合金材质打造，提升了催化器性能和排气流量。

为提升底盘的刚性，在门框等关键部位增加了额外的点焊，而容易因焊接高温变形的区域则采用模压碳纤维增强基复合材料部件进行强化。悬挂系统采用萨克斯公司生产的特调螺栓式减震器，这家公司的产品已在GT500赛事得到了检验。为了在半光面轮胎上达到1.6G制动力的目标，NISMO与布雷博合作，为其量身定制了一批刹车部件。外观方面也进行了多项优化，专注于车身轻量化、散热性能和空气动力学效应。特别是前端部分，保险杠、挡泥板和引擎盖都更换为碳纤维增强基复合材料部件。

最终有19台车完工（包含原型车在内），但R34 GT-R Z-tune无疑是NISMO在第二代GT-R车系中推出的巅峰之作。

This car really shows off its proportional balance.

Aside from the retrofitted detail parts,

Design elements such as the retractable headlamps...

这辆车的车身细节部件进行了全面的翻新升级，
给人以优雅的印象。

其他的一些设计元素，例如上翻式车头灯……

……玻璃后背和B柱的衔接……

现在看来，这种设计欠缺些魄力，
不过的确传达出积极求变的信息。

Unlike the notchback Silvia, this car features an

不同于凹背的Silvia，这款双门跑车

vehicleCollection.en:
This front-engine/rear-wheel-drive specialty car was given a different character to its sister car, the Silvia.

The Nissan 180SX — sold as the Nissan 240SX in the U.S. and the 200SX in the EU — was created as the Silvia's sister hatchback model in March 1989. This car, sporting retractable headlights and a glass hatchback, was overshadowed by the coupe at first—despite sharing the same powerplant, a 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4 that came available only with a turbocharger. But as time went on, people recognized the true value of this stylish sports coupe and sales began to climb.

The engine received an upgrade in 1991 to the SR20DET, the same 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 in the normal Silvia with output rated at 205ps and 28.0kgm. This prolonged the 180SX's life span because its production run was initially slated to end alongside the S13 Silvia; however, thanks to the popularity of the 2.4-liter 240SX in the U.S. (that possessed the same body shape of 180SX), Nissan elected to keep the compact rear-drive coupe around.

In 1996, the first normally-aspirated 180SX, the Type S, was added to the lineup. Without forced induction, the Type S lacked the acceleration of the hotter version. This made the car a favorite among tuners, who took things into their own hands, giving the car their own dose of power and beefing the chassis up accordingly. This paved the way for a new 180SX, one that featured the Silvia's front end, making the two cars virtual clones of each other; it was dubbed the "Sil-Eighty."
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款前置后驱特殊车型被赋予了与其姐妹车Silvia完全不同的特征。

日产180SX在美国和欧洲地区分别以日产240SX和200SX发售。

180SX是在1989年3月作为Silvia的姐妹车型推出的一款掀背车，主打上翻式头灯和一体式玻璃的后箱盖。在大热的Silvia的掩盖之下，这款车型在上市后并未激起太多水花。尽管也采用了同款1.8升引擎，但180SX只提供涡轮增压车型。

1991年，在更换了2.0L的SR20DET引擎后，车辆的动力输出变成了205ps和28.0kgm扭矩。按照原计划，180SX将被大改款后的Silvia直接取代。幸运的是，采用2.4升引擎的240SX在北美地区持续热销，日产最终决定在Silvia之外保留180SX产品线。

在停产之前，180SX与旧款Silvia S13都是使用同样的基础组件，但时不时的改款使其依然能跟上时代的节奏。因为车重偏重，而且掀背设计导致后部的刚性不足，所以最初大部分人都认为180SX的性能不如Silvia。好在丰富的副厂改装件帮助S180SX轻松克服了这一弱点。到后来，众多爱好者纷纷推出原创特殊改装，创造出各种各样的原创车型，让180SX成为了一款丰富多彩的特别车型。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
The Nissan Concept 2020 VGT gave us the great opportunity...

...to freely express the design vision of the Nissan brand.

This styling theme here was created by our London studio
in a short time. It's overflowing with energy, don't you think?

This car wasn't particularly based on a specific model, but we
gave our young designers complete freedom to shape this car.

And yes, it seems that they all had the future GT-R in mind.

Most anyone can tell that the design was inspired by the GT-R
by simply looking at the greenhouse and taillights, right?

The balance of the proportions suggests
not a mid-engine car or a long-nose FR machine,

but that of a front mid-engine 4WD car.

While this car is purely a design study...

...the front bumper and details of the rear end
are related to that of the 2017 GT-R.
dialogues.zh:
日产Concept 2020 Vision Gran Turismo给了我们一个前所未有的机会……

……让我们可以无拘无束地展现我们对于日产品牌的愿景。

这款车的风格定调是由我们的伦敦工作室在很短的时间内
完成的。你是不是也能感觉到其中充满了流动的能量？

这款车并不是基于某款GT-R车型设计的命题作文，我们
给了年轻设计师们绝对的自由，可以随心所欲地打造这辆车。

而从结果看，他们心中都有各自对于GT-R未来的畅想。

如果单看车身侧面和车尾灯，
很容易就能辨认出其中的GT-R元素，对吧？

还有从车身比例就能看出，它不是什么中置引擎
，也不是长车鼻的前置后驱车，

而是一款前中置引擎四驱车款。

尽管这款车只是一项设计课题……

……但前保险杠^后部的部分细节
与2017款GT-R有着密切的联系。

brandCentral.en:
The Nissan Concept 2020 VGT was the culmination of
Nissan's storied involvement with motorsports.

Nissan Design Europe, based in London, England,
did most of the design work here...

...while all the technical stuff was undertaken by the
company's engineers based in Japan.

What made this car unique was its "performance hybrid FR-4WD"
layout that consisted of a twin-turbocharged V-6...

...combined with three electric motors, where the front
left and right motors worked independently.

Therefore, this car was, as its name suggested, an AWD vehicle.

With torque being distributed independently to each wheel, the
Nissan Concept 2020 VGT possessed remarkable handling.
brandCentral.zh:
Nissan在制造GT和赛车方面拥有历史悠久的传统，而这款
Nissan Concept 2020 VGT就是他们的集大成之作。

总部设立于伦敦的Nissan Design Europe团队负责开发整车的外观
设计和风格……

而日本的Nissan工程团队则负责所有的技术细节。

这款车采用了独特的“性能混动前置后驱-四驱”布局……

并安装了一台V6双涡轮增压引擎，与三部电机搭配工作，

而且位于前部左右的两台电机可以独立工作。

这些革新让这辆车拥有了出神入化的操控性，即便在极
高速的情况下也体验非凡。\

vehicleCollection.en:
A look into the future of performance-minded touring cars.

In its 80 year history, Nissan has participated, and succeeded, in nearly every form of motorsports imaginable. Its specialty has been in the grand-touring category where the company has continually produced championships after championships, with cars such as the 510 and 300Z. What's more, because these cars were based on production versions, anyone could drive the road-going versions of them on public roads with remarkable comfort and safety. Nissan is now looking to the future and has imagined a new type of performance machine, one that we're calling the "NISSAN CONCEPT 2020 Vision Gran Turismo".

Through the magic of digitization, the design and development processes of automobiles have been undergoing a revolutionary change in recent years. Designers now work in a world where they can share their expressions and insights instantaneously. Their visions and ideas can also be realized virtually, and on this occasion, the designers at Nissan decided to turn to Gran Turismo to visualize their concept. The car you see here was penned by young designers from Nissan Design Europe, based in the UK, and when the final product was shown to the young engineers on the engineering side in Japan, they excitedly inputted their technical evaluations and simulations.

The car is characterized by a unique 2+2 profile based on Nissan's touring cars that have competed all over Europe. It features prominently shaped fenders that act like wings, providing gobs of downforce at high speed. The air enters the front side inlet and travels through the inner side of the wheels, before it is drawn out in an accelerated manner. This allows the body to cut through the air like a hot knife through butter. The air flows over the roof and off the rear deck without creating excessive turbulence behind the car. If you examine the airflo over the car, you will realize that despite its boxy shape, it's configued much like a prototype race car.

The rear wing automatically risesand lowrs, depending on the speed of the car. t a speed of <300km/>, it generates more than 400k of downforce. The undebody aso takes cuesfrom a race carto ensure excellent aerodynamics.

Powering the car is a high-performance hybrid R-4WD system with a turbochrged V-6 engine and thre eletric motors. vehicleCollection.zh:

在其80年的历史中，日产始终坚持不懈，追求赛车驾驶的一切可能性。特别是在针对GT赛事的GT车型上，日产在无与伦比的性能和日常功能性以及舒适性之间找到了平衡点，成功地创立了独特的品牌形象。而现在，他们带来了对于不久的将来的展望，以及下一代的GT Concept“日产CONCEPT 2020 Vision Gran Turismo”。

catch.en: A look into the future of performance-minded touring cars.
catch.zh: 采用跑车空气动力学技术的下一代GT Concept。

long.en:
In its 80 year history, Nissan has participated, and succeeded, in nearly every form of motorsports imaginable. Its specialty has been in the grand-touring category where the company has continually produced championships after championships, with cars such as the 510 and 300Z. What's more, because these cars were based on production versions, anyone could drive the road-going versions of them on public roads with remarkable comfort and safety. Nissan is now looking to the future and has imagined a new type of performance machine, one that we're calling the "NISSAN CONCEPT 2020 Vision Gran Turismo".

Through the magic of digitization, the design and development processes of automobiles have been undergoing a revolutionary change in recent years. Designers now work in a world where they can share their expressions and insights instantaneously. Their visions and ideas can also be realized virtually, and on this occasion, the designers at Nissan decided to turn to Gran Turismo to visualize their concept. The car you see here was penned by young designers from Nissan Design Europe, based in the UK, and when the final product was shown to the young engineers on the engineering side in Japan, they excitedly inputted their technical evaluations and simulations.

The car is characterized by a unique 2+2 profile based on Nissan's touring cars that have competed all over Europe. It features prominently shaped fenders that act like wings, providing gobs of downforce at high speed. The air enters the front side inlet and travels through the inner side of the wheels, before it is drawn out in an accelerated manner. This allows the body to cut through the air like a hot knife through butter. The air flows over the roof and off the rear deck without creating excessive turbulence behind the car. If you examine the airflo over the car, you will realize that despite its boxy shape, it's configued much like a prototype race car.

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
What happened in June 1972 was pretty unusual by anyone's
standards.

It was the second race of the popular Fuji Grand Champion
Series, which took place on the Fuji International Speedway.

And, despite being up against Gr.6 and Gr.7 race cars...

...a lower-level machine based on a production model managed
to emerge victorious!

The car was a Fairlady 240ZG, and its driver
was Japan's Haruhito Yanagida.

The race took place in heavy rain, and the 240ZG performed
exceptionally against its higher-ranked rivals.

And yes indeed, it beat all of the other entries.

The event became known in Japan as the "Z in the Rain" race, and
remains one of the most legendary moments in motorsports.
dialogues.zh:
在任何人看来，1972年6月发生的事情都是非比寻常的
奇迹。

当时，人气十足的富士大冠军赛的第二场比赛正在富士
高速赛道上如火如荼地举行。

面对组别6和组别7类别的对手……

一辆基于零售车型改装的低级别汽车却杀出重围、斩获
了胜利！

这辆车是一辆Fairlady 240ZG，车手是日本的柳田春人。

在大雨滂沱的赛场上，240ZG在与高等级对手的较量中
表现得异常出色……

最终以第一名的成绩冲过终点线！

这场比赛在日本被称为“雨中的Z”，是赛车运动中最具
传奇色彩的时刻之一。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
No doubt about it, the S30 has a sports car design
that is quintessentially Japanese.

I might even go so far as to say that its proportions and
lines are just about perfect.

The over-fenders and long nose which were added
to the ZG variant...

They actually balance the car quite nicely, giving it
a more ‘aggressive’ charm, so to speak.

Just remember to give it some wide-rim wheels!
dialogues.zh:
毫无疑问，Nissan S30的跑车设计带有典型的日本风格。

我甚至可以毫不夸张地说，它的比例和线条都堪称完美。

它在ZG车型的基础上增加了宽挡泥板和长车头……

在外形上实现了平衡的观感，更为它赋予了
一种更具“攻击性”的魅力，

同时也没有忘记为它配上一套更宽的车轮！

usedCar.en:
Many Japanese sports-car enthusiasts refer to the original
Datsun 240Z by its in-house codename, the S30.

Powering the car is a 2.4-liter inline-6, mounted up front
and powering the rear wheels.

One of the more intriguing examples is the 240ZG, which has
a slightly different front-end from the base car.

Called the G-nose, the extended hood lengthened the car by
about 190mm and gives it a more exotic presence.

The car's revised profile isn't only for looks. It improves its
aerodynamics, raising its top speed by about <5km/h>.
usedCar.zh:
Nissan S30是有史以来最优秀、
最受欢迎的日产跑车之一。

这款高性能的240Z衍生型——240ZG，搭载了一台
2.4升直列六缸引擎。

这辆车的加长车头是最明显的变化之一，
许多人亲切地称之为“G-nose”。

相比240Z，这一改动使车辆的
总长度延伸了190mm。

它的“大鼻子”不单是为了好看——这一改动还优化了
车身的空气动力特性，使240ZG的最高时速提升了大约<5km/h>。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its 'G-nose' and fender flares, this car epitomized Japanese sports car cool in the 1970s.

The Nissan Fairlady Z was sold as the Nissan Z in markets outside of Japan.

Near the end of the 1960s, Japanese cars made a name for themselves on the international stage. One of these examples was the Datsun 240Z that was introduced in 1969. Yutaka Katayama, the president of Nissan North America at the time, convinced the Japanese brass that "now was the time for real sports cars," to challenge those from Europe. Thus, the Z was born.

Among the more notable Zs was the 432. While other Zs were equipped with the Type L engine, the 432 came equipped with the S20, a DOHC inline-6 lifted from the Prince R380. The "4" stood for 4 valves per cylinder, the "3" for 3 twin-choke carburetors, and "2" represented the engine's 2 camshafts. Output of the engine was rated at 160ps and 18.0kgm of torque.

This 432 also had a 432R racing spec model that sported a carbon-fiber hood for weight reduction. Only 30 of these cars were made.

A considerable amount of work went into making the 432. The S20 was known to be a delicate powerplant that only the Nissan mechanics at Oppama could get the most out of.

On the other hand, the 2.4-liter Type L engine in the U.S.-spec 240Z was easy to work with, and its ability to provide plenty of torque throughout the rpm spectrum made it popular for racers. The 240Z performed well in safari races and notable off-road events such as the Monte Carlo Rally, as well as those on tarmac racing circuits.

Thanks to its high level of performance, the 240Z made it to Japan in 1971, marketed there as the Fairlady Z. A special version of the car called the 240ZG, referred to as the "G nose," added to the car's popularity, solidifying its place in the history books as one of the most popular and longest-tenured sports cars ever.
vehicleCollection.zh:
挡泥板外包围和“G字鼻”，70年代最具代表性的日系跑车。

在日本以外的地区，日产Fairlady Z改以日产240ZG的名字投放市场。

60年代末，日本车逐渐在国际市场上获得了认可。Fairlady Z在1969年的亮相也为这场风潮起到了推波助澜的效果。时任日产北美总裁的片山丰成功说服日本总部“现在是开发真正跑车的最佳时机”，并最终推出一款与能欧洲车叫板的车型。Z系列的历史就此拉开帷幕。

Z系列的标志性车型当属432。在其他Z系列车型还在使用L型引擎时，432却得到了一台王子R380上使用的双顶置凸轮轴直列6缸引擎。命名中的4代表每个气缸有4个阀门，3代表3个双腔式化油器，而2则代表一对凸轮轴。这款车型能够输出160ps，最大扭矩可达18.0kgm。

432还有一款赛车版本，名为432R。为了降低车重，采用了纤维强化塑胶引擎盖，仅仅生产了30台。

为了达到如此高的性能，颇费了一番苦心。因为S20是一台相当敏感的引擎，据说只有日产追浜工厂的工程师才能让其发挥出真正的威力。也因此，日产逐步将赛车开发的重心放到了240Z身上。

美版的240Z搭载的是一台2.4升L型引擎，优点是腔体更结实，调校更便利，加速时的转速区间也更宽松。这款车型在各种国际越野赛事和拉力赛事中均表现出色。

优异的表现帮助240Z得以在日本市场销售。1971年推出的240ZG以其长长的前鼻和宽轮眉成为大热车型，一时间让Z系列成为了跑车的同义词。

catch.en: With its 'G-nose' and fender flares, this car epitomized Japanese sports car cool in the 1970s.
catch.zh: 挡泥板外包围和“G字鼻”，70年代最具代表性的日系跑车。

long.en:
The Nissan Fairlady Z was sold as the Nissan Z in markets outside of Japan.

Near the end of the 1960s, Japanese cars made a name for themselves on the international stage. One of these examples was the Datsun 240Z that was introduced in 1969. Yutaka Katayama, the president of Nissan North America at the time, convinced the Japanese brass that "now was the time for real sports cars," to challenge those from Europe. Thus, the Z was born.

Among the more notable Zs was the 432. While other Zs were equipped with the Type L engine, the 432 came equipped with the S20, a DOHC inline-6 lifted from the Prince R380. The "4" stood for 4 valves per cylinder, the "3" for 3 twin-choke carburetors, and "2" represented the engine's 2 camshafts. Output of the engine was rated at 160ps and 18.0kgm of torque.

This 432 also had a 432R racing spec model that sported a carbon-fiber hood for weight reduction. Only 30 of these cars were made.

A considerable amount of work went into making the 432. The S20 was known to be a delicate powerplant that only the Nissan mechanics at Oppama could get the most out of.

On the other hand, the 2.4-liter Type L engine in the U.S.-spec 240Z was easy to work with, and its ability to provide plenty of torque throughout the rpm spectrum made it popular for racers. The 240Z performed well in safari races and notable off-road events such as the Monte Carlo Rally, as well as those on tarmac racing circuits.

Thanks to its high level of performance, the 240Z made it to Japan in 1971, marketed there as the Fairlady Z. A special version of the car called the 240ZG, referred to as the "G nose," added to the car's popularity, solidifying its place in the history books as one of the most popular and longest-tenured sports cars ever.
long.zh:
在日本以外的地区，日产Fairlady Z改以日产240ZG的名字投放市场。

60年代末，日本车逐渐在国际市场上获得了认可。Fairlady Z在1969年的亮相也为这场风潮起到了推波助澜的效果。时任日产北美总裁的片山丰成功说服日本总部“现在是开发真正跑车的最佳时机”，并最终推出一款与能欧洲车叫板的车型。Z系列的历史就此拉开帷幕。

Z系列的标志性车型当属432。在其他Z系列车型还在使用L型引擎时，432却得到了一台王子R380上使用的双顶置凸轮轴直列6缸引擎。命名中的4代表每个气缸有4个阀门，3代表3个双腔式化油器，而2则代表一对凸轮轴。这款车型能够输出160ps，最大扭矩可达18.0kgm。

432还有一款赛车版本，名为432R。为了降低车重，采用了纤维强化塑胶引擎盖，仅仅生产了30台。

为了达到如此高的性能，颇费了一番苦心。因为S20是一台相当敏感的引擎，据说只有日产追浜工厂的工程师才能让其发挥出真正的威力。也因此，日产逐步将赛车开发的重心放到了240Z身上。

美版的240Z搭载的是一台2.4升L型引擎，优点是腔体更结实，调校更便利，加速时的转速区间也更宽松。这款车型在各种国际越野赛事和拉力赛事中均表现出色。

优异的表现帮助240Z得以在日本市场销售。1971年推出的240ZG以其长长的前鼻和宽轮眉成为大热车型，一时间让Z系列成为了跑车的同义词。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
In some ways, the Z34 is more classic in overall styling
than the Z33.

The wheelbase has been shortened by 100mm...

...giving it long-nose proportions.

The shape of the roof,
and the window graphics with the peak at the very front...

...also adopt the S30's design basic theme.

In contrast, the massive rear fender that squeezes the shape
of the body from front to rear...

...aims to ithis car a level of aggressiveness never
before seen on a Z.

There were challenges on how to evolve the Z33's styling.

If the Z33 represented a modern and more
elegant design theme...

...then the Z34's look is one that's a more authentic of an
FR sports car with added aggressiveness.
dialogues.zh:
从设计上看，Z34比Z33的外观更回归经典。

首先，轴距缩短了100mm……

显得车头相对更长。

其车顶的形状以及最前面的车窗贴花……

则特意延续了S30的设计风格。

相比之下，巨大的后挡泥板让车身的重心从前向后挪……

令它看上去更具有攻击性。
这是之前的Z系列中所罕见的。

当然了，对Z33的外型进行迭代并非易事。

简而言之，如果Z33给人以现代的优雅感……

Z34则更像是一款地道的前置后驱跑车，
而且更具攻击性。

brandCentral.en:
This sixth-generation 2009 370Z was known in-house as the Z34.

It came with a redesigned naturally-aspirated 3.7-liter V-6.

This engine produced 336ps, which represented a significant
bump from the 3.5-liter unit of its predecessor.

It came mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox
with a new rev-matching technology.

Called SynchroRev, it automatically matched engine speed
to wheel speed during downshifts.

This allowed the driver to perform perfect downshifts without
having to employ a technique called heel-and-toe.
brandCentral.zh:
这款第六代2008 Fairlady Z也被称为Z34。

其全新设计的3.7L V6自然进气引擎……

可提供336ps的最大输出功率，远远超过其前作Z33……

还有六速手动变速箱采用的技术也是前所未有的。

这项技术能够在每次车手换档时自动调整引擎的旋转……

不需要车手的跟趾动作，就能实现顺滑的降档补油！

usedCar.en:
The 370Z, called the Fairlady Z in Japan, is shorter than
its predecessor, the 350Z, but just as good looking.

Its shortened wheelbase helps it to be more agile, making it
easy to control on the race track.

But don't worry if you think that its small body results
in less stability, because that isn't the case at all.

In fact, the car actually feels more solid through corners
and remains composed in a straight line at high speeds.

And don't forget about the powerful 3.7-liter naturally-aspirated
V-6 under its hood, which pumps out more than 330ps.
usedCar.zh:
370Z——在日本本土被为“Fairlady Z Z34”的车型。
相较350Z，它的轴距和车长更短。

这不仅使得该车的外观显得更加圆润、灵巧，
还令这辆车的过弯性能变得更迅敏。

别担心，这辆车的稳定性并没有
因此减退分毫。

它搭载的3.7升自然吸气V6引擎动力澎湃，
能产生超过330ps的马力。

如果这是你的第一辆后驱车，
那你大可放心开着它驰骋！

vehicleCollection.en:
A shortened wheelbase plus larger engine equals driving fun in this sixth-gen Z car.

When the sixth-generation Fairlady Z, the Z34, was introduced in December 2008, most people assumed that the car would be just a mildly updated version of the Z33 that revived the Z car in January 2002. The 370Z, as we knew it, appeared relatively the same; however, upon closer inspection, it became evident that this was an all-new car.

Built atop the E platform that also serves as the foundation of the Infiniti "Skyline" G37, the new Z featured an aluminum hood, door and rear hatch that kept the car's curb weight about the same as the previous vehicle (around 1500kg). The new Z was nimble, thanks to a wheelbase that was 100mm shorter and retuned suspension system that consisted of a double-wishbone setup in front and multilink at rear.

Under the hood was a more powerful engine, the VQ37VHR with VVEL. VVEL was a mechanism that varies the operating angle and lift of the valves for improved power and lower emissions. With 200cc more displacement, the new V6 pumped out 336ps/7000rpm and 37.2kgm of torque that peaked at 5200rpm. The engine came mated to either a quick-shifting 6-speed automatic transmission, or a revolutionary 6-speed manual gearbox equipped with the world's first synchro rev control mechanism. This system automatically adjusted engine rpm when downshifting, eliminating the need to heel and toe.

Thus, the Z34 became a true enthusiast sports car that even novices could drive effectively.
vehicleCollection.zh:
排量提高，缩短轴距，第6代Fairlady Z更专注驾驶体验。

属于第6代的Fairlady Z，Z34登场于2008年12月。它是于2002年1月成功回归的5代车型Z33的继任者。

因为外观设计方面全面沿袭大获成功的Z33，所以人们会误以为这是Z33的小改款，其实不然。Z34的改动是全方位的。这款车型与V36 Skyline轿跑共享E平台，高度关注车辆的安全性能。引擎盖、车门和后箱盖的材质更换成了铝，以确保车重与前代的1480kg-1530kg相当。轴距相比Z33缩短了100mm，但操控性能得到了优化。

动力单元来自配备VVEL技术的VQ37VHR引擎，前者能够在引擎工作时调节气阀的工作角度和工作高度。这台引擎的最大输出是7000rpm下的336ps，最大扭矩则是5200rpm时的37.2kgm。

传动系统分别提供了一款6速自动变速箱，在切换至手动模式时的换挡速度也名列前茅，另一款6速手动变速箱则应用了全球首款同步转速控制技术，在换挡时无需车手跟趾降档补油，而是能自动将引擎转数调节至最优转速范围。

双叉臂前悬挂和多连杆后悬挂，以及前四后二的铝合金对置活塞卡钳在调校后可提供最大限度的操控性能。

纵观Fairlady Z的全部历史，这是在研发过程中对驾驶体验投入最多关注的一款车型。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
For a car that came two generations
after the S30, this one has rediscovered its "Z-ness."

Three-dimensional undulations of the body are restrained,

and the design theme is simple yet bold.

The flush surface of the side glass and body around
the door section was an American design trend at the time.

You coud say that the Z32
is more of a coupe in design than a sport car,

The super wide-and-low body proportion
makes the overall look amazingly sporty.

If you look at the design flow it does deviate
from the "Z story",

but the level of refinement of its design
is truly outstanding.

That's why the car is still so popular.

And here's an interesting fact:
The area around the opening line of the rear hatch,

 was carried over to the Z33.
dialogues.zh:
自S30推出又过了两代之后，
这款新车终于重新找回了“Z”系列的特色。

车身的起伏曲线十分克制，

用于展现简洁而又大胆的设计主旨。

侧面车窗底部与车门周围的车身齐平于同一平面……

体现了当时美国汽车设计领域的主流趋势。

与其说Z32是跑车，它更像是一台双门轿跑……

但那宽体低趴的姿态像是匍匐在地，
使整体外观充满了动感。

如果从设计流线上看，确实有些偏离Z系列的传统要素，

但其设计的精致程度无疑令人赞许。

这也解释了它为何至今仍然受到车迷们的追捧。

另外，后备箱盖开合线附近区域的设计在
后续车型Z33中也得到了沿用。

usedCar.en:
Not many sports cars in the world can boast a history
spanning 50 years, especially from Japan.

But one of them is the Nissan Z, called the Fairlady Z
in its home market.

In 1989, Nissan introduced the fourth-generation model,
the 300ZX, which came powered by...

...a twin-turbocharged V-6, making it the first Z to
be offered with forced induction.

This resulted in the engine becoming the first to reach the
280ps limit adopted by Japanese manufacturers.
usedCar.zh:
世界上很少有跑车的历史
能超过50年。

Nissan Z型车，或者说 “Fairlady Z”——
就是罕见的例外之一。

这辆第四代300ZX于1989
年上市。

它搭载的双涡轮增压V6引擎
不可小觑。

这也是在日本厂商达成不成文的280ps君子协定
后上市的第一款引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its tidy exterior design, this 4th-gen Z car was a handsome sports car for the global market.(

The Nissan Fairlady Z was sold as the Nissan 300ZX outside Japan.

The Z32, appearing in 1989, was the first complete transformation for the Fairlady Z. It came in a wide, flat body, turning 180 degrees from the narrow, long body designs that lasted 3 generations. It was sized as a global sports car, not restricted by the size classes of the Japanese market.

Its steering characteristics were changed drastically. As soon as the steering wheel is turned, the nose slices into the corner, and the wide tread gave it a high level of potential. This Z opened new doors as a cornering machine, while maintaining its performance as a GT. Again, the Z dropped European thoroughbreds into a hole of despair.

At the heart of this car was a compact V6 with a low center of gravity. Even though it is an FR, it was given a front midship layout with the engine located as far back as possible, to make the front/rear weight distribution close to 50:50. Aiming for the global market, the engine size was fixed at 3 liters, and producing 230ps in the NA, and 280ps in the twin turbo, its performance decorated the end of the 20th century. Its suspension used advanced designs as well, and even features like an ABS that does not transfer shock to the brake pedal, were things that went beyond the usual standards of the time.

In 1992, a convertible model was added to the lineup, and was greatly welcomed in its main market of California.
vehicleCollection.zh:
改用宽体车身之后，第四代Z成为了面向全球市场的跑车。

在日本以外的地区，日产Fairlady Z改以日产300ZX的名字投放市场。

1989年亮相的Z32标志着Fairlady Z的彻底转身，车身设计从延续3代的纤细颀长转为低平的宽体设计。不再受制于日本市场对于车型尺寸的限制，紧跟国际市场的跑车标准。

相应的，车辆的驾驶特性也发生了翻天覆地的变化。当转动方向盘时，车鼻可以灵巧地切入弯道，再加上更宽的车胎带来高抓地力。这款Z32为Z系列打开了一扇新大门——在保持超级跑车性能的同时，打造出一台强大的过弯机器，也让欧洲的竞争对手们如坠冰窟。

这辆车的心脏是一台紧凑的V6引擎，车身重心相当得低。这是一辆前置后驱车，却采用了类似中置引擎前移的车身布局，将引擎位置尽量后挪，以达到车身前后配重为50:50的均衡配比。因为面向国际市场，引擎排量被定在了3.0。自然进气230ps和双涡轮280ps的动力参数在20世纪末期可谓鹤立鸡群。悬挂方面也应用了当时的先进设计，甚至超前引入了防抱死刹车系统，以避免将刹车时震动传回到制动踏板。

在1992年，产品线中又添加了一款敞篷车型，在Z系列的主要市场加利福尼亚州尤为受到欢迎。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
This is a masterpiece of Japanese car design.

To be honest, the S30 was developed as a hatchback coupe,
rather than a sports car.

There's plenty of cabin space.

Overall headroom is generous for a pure sports car.

Still, it looks very sporty,
meaning it is a very special design.

Take the proportion, line, and surface...

...in many ways, the design of this car says
"it can only be done this way."

But what is most impressive is...

...is its purity.
It exudes a high sense of Japanese beauty.

The look of the nose is modern.

It's a design that's distinctly Japanese,
unlike any other car from the U.S. or Europe.

The S30 is unmistakably a design that represents Japan.

From the latter half of the 1960s and on,
more than a few amazing sports-car designs were created in Japan.

In that day, there were man motivated
and talented young designers inside Japanese car companies.

They borrowed the best parts of Western design elements,
while keeping their own unique character.

I pay respect to the achievements of all of them, especially
Yoshihiko Matsuo-san, who recently passed away.
dialogues.zh:
这辆车可是日本汽车设计的杰作之一！

严格来讲，S30是作为一款掀背式双门轿跑车开发的，
而不是一款跑车。

如你所见，这辆车的车厢空间很大……

而且与纯粹的跑车相比，头顶空间更富裕。

不过，得益于其卓越的设计，它看起来还是动力十足。

此车的一切——车身比例、线条和外观表面……

无不彰显着“纯正”二字。

但最为出众的……

还是其体现着日式设计美学的优雅和精致。

以其现代化的车头设计为例。

与美式或欧洲的设计都不相同，极具日本车特色。

S30就是一台纯粹的日系车。

从六十年代晚期开始，日本设计出了无数台跑车杰作。

当时的日本汽车公司汇聚了许多位
热忱且有才华的年轻设计3。

他们从西方设计中汲取精华，
但又保留了自己独特的感受力。

这些设计师都值得我们尊敬。
尤其值得一提的一位，便是最近去世的松尾良彦。

collection.en:
The first model of the Nissan Z series was known
as the type S30.

Of all the S30s, this Z432 is particularly special.

With a classic Z-series design...

It is powered by the same S20 2L inline six-cylinder
engine seen in the Skyline GT-Rs of its day.

The four valves per cylinder...

Three carburettors...

And two cams don’t just prove its high performance.

These numbers are also the origin of the 'Z432'
model name.

The fact that it had a GT-R engine was reflected in its
price, more than double that of standard S30s.

Furthermore, only 419 of the Z432s were produced,
making it the most valuable of the first-gen Zs.

There was also a higher performance competition model
of the Z432, the Z432R.

An extremely rare variant, it tends to fetch a very
handsome price at auctions.
collection.zh:
Nissan Z系列的第一款车型被称为type S30。

在所有S30车型中，Z432显得格外耀眼。

在保留了Z系列经典设计的同时……

它搭载了当时同样用于Skyline GT-R的
S20 2升直列六缸引擎。

这款引擎每个气缸有4个阀门……

3个化油器……

和2个凸轮，足以保证它的高性能。

这些数字也是“Z432”车型名称的来源。

配备GT-R同款高性能引擎的代价反映在其售价上，
它的定价是标准S30的两倍以上。

此外，Z432只生产了419辆，
使其成为所有第一代Z系列中最有价值的车型。

Z432还推出过一款性能更出色的竞赛版，
即Z432R。

其存世量极少，当它出现在拍卖会上时
往往能拍出相当可观的价格。

vehicleCollection.en:
This special Datsun Z was equipped with the same engine as the Skyline GT-R.

In 1969, Nissan completely transformed the Fairlady brand from that of a classic open-top roadster into a classy fixed-roof sports car that went by the name 240Z in many parts of the world. A performance-oriented version of this car was created, called the Z 432.

The car's name referred to its engine, namely its 4 valves, 3 carburettors and 2 camshafts. While the base car came with the L20, a SOHC inline-6, the Z 432 was powered by the L20, which was in fact a detuned version of the 220ps GR8 engine used in the R380 prototype race car. In the Z 432, it produced 160ps, which was the same as the previously released Skyline GT-R version.

This made the special Z car quick — a 0-400m time of 15.8s and top speed of <210km/h> — making for an ideal race car, but only a limited number of a pure race versions of the car, called the Z 432R, were made. It featured fibrerlass and acrylic components that decreased its weight by 100kg. Today, the car is a prized collector's item with an example rumored to have fetched $800,000 at auction. .
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆Fairlady Z配备了与Skyline GT-R相同的S20引擎，只为比赛而生。

1969年，日产Fairlady从传统的双座敞篷车变为了激进的斜背车造型。新的Fairlady “Z”系列的顶级型号为高性能的Z 432。

这款车最大的特色是它的引擎。基础款Z使用L20顶置单凸轮轴直列6缸引擎，只有Z 432配备了双顶置凸轮轴的S20引擎——日产R380原型赛车上使用的220psGR8引擎的量产性能调低版本，它的动力输出和此前发售的Skyline GT-R一样，达到了160ps。车名中的“432”则代表了引擎配置：4个气阀、3个化油器和双凸轮轴。

这款车的0-400m成绩为15.8秒，极速可达到<210km/h>，在当时算是相当快的车型了。凭借如此优异的性能，它在面世一年后便登上了赛车舞台，并一举收获多个冠军头衔。

日产后来还推出了赛车版本Z 432 R，但销量寥寥。日产在赛车版本上应用了玻璃纤维和亚克力部件，让车重减轻了100kg。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
The main role of the Z33, introduced in 2001, was to resurrect
the Z, and serve as a symbol of the revival of Nissan itself.

Therefore, it was a car that had to succeed.

Because the Z has been a defining symbol for Nissan through the
years, it naturally embraced the design heritage of the company.

That said, we couldn't give it a retro look.

We needed to retain the essence and spirit
of notable Nissans of the past...

...while giving it a thoroughly modern character.

The inspiration for the car's design language was
the S30 and the CSP first-generation Silvia.

And, it may be difficult to notice, but there are hints
of the SP Fairlady in the body section.

All of this made the Z33 more modern
and possess different proportions than the S30...

...but I feel it's still instantly
recognizable as a Z from any angle.<nextid=1800306 type=9ԙ
dialogues.zh:
Z33于2001年首次亮相，
它的使命是复活Z系列，并成为日产复兴的象征。

因此，这是一款不许失败的汽车。

作为日产的代表车型，Z33必须体现出公司的设计传统……

但又不能太“复古”。

因此，我们必须保留过去成就的精髓和精神……

再以完善的现代特征进行展现。

它的设计语言可以追溯到S30和第一代Silvia CSP。

而且，容易被人忽略的一个点是
——其车身部分还有些Fairlady SP的影子。

这些设计元素都使得Z33在比例和主题方面较S30更加现代。

但你还是一眼就能看出，这是一辆Z系车。

selling points.

which boasts a higher redline than the standard model.

naturally-aspirated engines is truly astounding.

These cars are reasonably priced when bought used.
In any case, it’s a really great car.

大排量自然吸气引擎？

这款2007年晚期的车型搭载VQ35HR引擎，
转速红线比标准型号更高。

以独特的方法大幅提升自然吸气引擎的
整体操纵感，令人震叹。

这款车的二手车售价很合理。
无论如何，这是一款很棒的车。

史郎先生曾经致力于Nissan Z系和GT-R的设计工作

还设计了Isuzu 4200R概念车。

conversation.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
conversation.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
conversation.en:
The main role of the Z33, introduced in 2001, was to resurrect
the Z, and serve as a symbol of the revival of Nissan itself.

Therefore, it was a car that had to succeed.

Because the Z has been a defining symbol for Nissan through the
years, it naturally embraced the design heritage of the company.

That said, we couldn't give it a retro look.

We needed to retain the essence and spirit
of notable Nissans of the past...

...while giving it a thoroughly modern character.

The inspiration for the car's design language was
the S30 and the CSP first-generation Silvia.

And, it may be difficult to notice, but there are hints
of the SP Fairlady in the body section.

All of this made the Z33 more modern
and possess different proportions than the S30...

...but I feel it's still instantly
recognizable as a Z from any angle.<nextid=1800306 type=9ԙ
conversation.zh:
Z33于2001年首次亮相，
它的使命是复活Z系列，并成为日产复兴的象征。

因此，这是一款不许失败的汽车。

作为日产的代表车型，Z33必须体现出公司的设计传统……

但又不能太“复古”。

因此，我们必须保留过去成就的精髓和精神……

再以完善的现代特征进行展现。

它的设计语言可以追溯到S30和第一代Silvia CSP。

而且，容易被人忽略的一个点是
——其车身部分还有些Fairlady SP的影子。

这些设计元素都使得Z33在比例和主题方面较S30更加现代。

但你还是一眼就能看出，这是一辆Z系车。

conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师

See you around sometime.

那么，回头见。

brandCentral.en:
This fifth-generation Nissan Fairlady Z was codenamed Z33.
We know it better as the 350Z.

The Z was temporarily discontinued in 2000 with the 300ZX,
codenamed Z32.

It was revived in 2002 with the 350Z.

This specific model is from 2007, and it features massive
improvements to its naturally-aspirated V-6 powerplant.

In fact, this little beauty is capable of more than 300ps
with added torque to make it quick off the line.
brandCentral.zh:
这款第五代Nissan Fairlady Z在日本被称为Z33，
而在日本以外地区则被称为350Z。

在90年代末和21世纪初之间，
Fairlady或 "Z-car"系列逐渐退出了市场……

而现在，Z系列将因为新350Z的出现得以复苏！

这一车款是2007年推出的，
特点是对自然进气的V6引擎进行了大规模改进。

事实上，由于扭矩的增加，
这辆娇小尤物的动力已经超过了300ps！

usedCar.en:
The Nissan 350Z—known as the Fairlady Z (Z33) in Japan—
is impressive on both road and track.

With a naturally-aspirated engine that sends power to the
rear wheels, balance is the name of its game.

The 3.5-liter V-6 was retuned for this 2007 model.

So it possesses better top-end performance, partly because
the redline was raised.

The end result was the company's first naturally-aspirated
V-6 capable of producing more than 300ps.
usedCar.zh:
Nissan 350Z——这款在日本本土被称为“Fairlady Z (Z33)”
的车子，几乎就是为赛道而生的。

这要归功于它搭载的大排量自然吸气引擎和
后驱系统。

2007年版的350Z搭载了重新设计的V6引擎。

改进版引擎的动力更强，转速区间更高。

这也是Nissan生产的第一款马力达到300ps
以上的自然吸气V6引擎。

vehicleCollection.en:
This refined Z33 model came powered by the next-generation VQ35HR engine.

Nissan's legendary sports car, the "Fairlady Z," disappeared from the catalog lineup in the summer of 2000, but Nissan President Carlos Ghosn knew full well the importance of this car and had secretly given the go-ahead for the new generation model. In July of 2002, the new Z33 Z-car made its debut.

It shared its base frame and the V6 3.5-liter VQ35DE engine with the V35 Skyline, but it produced 280ps and 37.0kgm of torque. It also came with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

The new Z continued to evolve in the following years. One major advancement was made in January 2007, when the engine was changed to the new generation VQ35HR, improving power output to 313ps. The intake manifold was completely redesigned, and the friction within the engine was reduced. By further improving the crankshaft section, the engine revved more freely. Also, the exhaust note was tuned to give off a deep and low sound, reminiscent of a V-8 engine. The designers added a power bulge to the car's hood to show the Z's extra power.

The engineers heavily modified the car's suspension, improving absorption of the road surface and delivering a flatter cornering character. These changes translated to better overall handling feel and enhanced race-track performance.
vehicleCollection.zh:
经过调校的Z33配备了新一代的VQ35HR引擎。

在2000年夏天，传奇的日产Fairlady Z突然在日产的产品名录中消失了。但日产充分意识到这台车的历史渊源和重要性，因此私下里批准了新一代车型的开发。在2002年7月，全新的Fairlady Z33正式亮相，

配备6速手动变速箱，并与V35 Skyline共享基础车架和3.5升的V6引擎VQ35DE，而且这台引擎的出力首次被调校到了280ps和37.0kgm扭矩。

随后的几年里，日产开发部门将“不断演进”的口号落到了实处，持续对Z系列进行改进提升。在2007年的重大改进中，新一代的VQ35HR引擎被用到了Z33上，将马力输出提高到了313ps。进气歧管得到了重新设计，以降低引擎内的摩擦。而对曲轴的改进大大提高了引擎的转速体验，给人以动力强劲又细致入微的跑车感受。排气声沉稳有力，仿佛出自大排量V8引擎一般。此外，引擎盖中央的隆起仿佛也在强调着变化。

悬挂设定经过重大改动后提升了对路面反馈的吸收，并能保持车身行驶时的平面稳定性，帮助营造出自然的操控感。

vehicleCollection.en:
Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.

This new Nissan GT-R was announced at the New York International Auto Show in April 2016, amid a fury of anticipation and hype. As the most significantly changed model since its introduction in 2007, the new R35 GT-R didn’t disappoint.

Changes to the car’s design was not only intended to make the car look better, but also designed to enhance its aerodynamic performance. The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.

The GT-R remained a monster when it came to performance. The engine, which was still built by hand by master craftsmen, had more power than before, with 573ps at 6800rpm and a maximum torque of 64.6kgm on tap. Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges.

With pavement-sticking all-wheel-drive handling, the new GT-R now wreaked havoc in a custom-tailored suit.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
2017年的车型做出了更深入的改进。

日产GT-R于2016年4月在纽约国际车展上公布。这是自2007年推出以来对R35 GT-R最大幅度的更新。

外部特征的改变并不仅仅是为了外观，也在很高水平上平衡了空气阻力、下压力和冷却性能。车头前方依然保留了日产的标志性Vmotion前脸。引擎盖刚度进一步提升，以抵消超高车速情况下的变形。全新的前扰流板也可以产生强大的下压力。

这辆车的3.8升V6双涡轮增压引擎全部由手工打造，最大输出功率已提升到了573ps/6800rpm，最大扭矩为64.6kgm。在改良型6档双离合变速箱的辅佐下，这部引擎可以提供从中到高速度范围的平顺加速。当然，为了争夺世界最佳操控性车的名号，其弯道性能也同样得到了提高。

就如其“深度进化”表现那样，这是一辆代表日本跑车风范的车。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
At the risk of sounding crass by compliment our own designs...

...I always felt that the GT-R in the Super GT Series was
"oh so cool" when watching it in races.

The racecar is modified by NISMO every year...

...and the original image of the GT-R is carefully retained in
the grille and the shape of the lights.

When watching a race, it's important to be able to
recognize a car when seeing it from a distance.

For that to happen, the front and rear of
the base production car must be distinctive.

Also, while race cars may be modified for aerodynamics,
GT regulations prohibit changes to the cabin.

In fact, when I was watching a GT race at Suzuka...

...I said to myself, "The racecars painted in their
sponsor colors all look the same."　

That's when I decided that the shape of
the R35 GT-R's cabin must abolutely remain distinctive!
dialogues.zh:
虽然这样说感觉像是在自卖自夸……

……不过我坚信当你在Super GT系列赛中
看到这辆GT-R时，你一定会觉得“哇，太酷了”。

每年，我们都会将赛车交由NISMO进行改装……

……而GT-R原本的外观，如格栅和车灯形状等
都精心地保留了下来。

我认为在观看比赛时，能让观众远远地
就把赛车辨认出来很有必要。

要达到这个目标，
基础量产车的前后外观必须要有独到之处。

为了增强空气动力学性能，赛车的车身通常会接受
大量的改装，但GT系列赛又规定

驾驶舱必须与原版量产车保持一致。

我过去在铃鹿赛道观看超跑比赛的时候……

……就觉得“除了赞助商的涂装，这些赛车
看上去都一个样。”

所以，我才会在S计R35 GT-R的时候赋予驾驶舱独特的风格！

recognize a car when seeing it from a distance.

For that to happen, the front and rear of
the base production car must be distinctive.

Also, while race cars may be modified for aerodynamics,
GT regulations prohibit changes to the cabin.

In fact, when I was watching a GT race at Suzuka...

...I said to myself, "The racecars painted in their
sponsor colors all look the same."　

That's when I decided that the shape of
the R35 GT-R's cabin must abolutely remain distinctive!

vehicleCollection.en:
This very fast GT-R scored wins at Suzuki, Okayama, and Autopolis in the 2008 Super GT.

When the all-new R35 GT-R made its debut in the Fall of 2007, it was obvious that Nissan intended its supercar to go racing. The company didn't waste much time making its official announcement. Only a month after the GT-R went on sale, Nissan told the Japanese press that the new GT-R would compete in the Super GT Series, the most popular race series in Japan, perhaps all of Asia.

Specifically developed with 2009 vehicle regulations in mind, this race-ready Nissan GT-R featured an innovative construction design that centered on the cabin. While its overall appearance was similar to that of the production GT-R, the race car was a completely different animal.

The engine was a 4.5-liter V8 based on the VK45DE, the power plant in the Fairlady Z GT race car from the previous year. It was reported to produce more than 500ps.

In competition, the number 23 Xanavi Nismo GT-R piloted by Satoshi Motoyama and Benoît Tréluyer, showed incredible performance from the opening round of the car's maiden season, winning the first two races. In the end it won a total of three races, good enough to bring the team the drivers' title in 2008.

In all, five GT-Rs competed in the Super GT series that year. The GT-R finished 1-2 in the opening round at Suzuka, and won a total of seven out of that year's nine races, meeting, and perhaps exceeding, the expectations of Nissan and GT-R fans all over Asia.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第一款符合新规则的GT-R，以压倒性的速度回应了车迷的期待。

R35 日产GT-R于2007年秋季发布后，紧接着就在12月开始销售。2008年1月，这款刚上市不久的新GT-R就宣布会自本赛季起参加日本最受欢迎的超跑比赛“Super GT”系列赛。

这款车型提前根据将于2009年颁布的汽车法规进行研发，将原型车的车顶和立柱直接与由管式车架和部分座舱室组成的主底盘相连。也因此，虽然前饰板和车顶曲线依然有着GT-R的影子，但外观和感受都与普通的GT-R大不相同。

引擎是一款源自Super GT参赛车型Fairlady Z的VK45DE 4.5升V8引擎，最大动力输出超过500ps。R34 Skyline在参加全日本GT锦标赛时，将传动系统从四驱更改为前置后驱。

由本山哲和伯努瓦·特雷吕耶驾驶的23号Xanavi Nismo GT-R赛车代表NISMO车队参赛，在首轮比赛中就有惊人表现，夺下冠军，随后又趁势赢下了第二轮比赛。

两位车手在赛季中总共夺得3场比赛冠军，最终获得了2008年的车手总冠军。在这个赛季的Super GT中共有5辆GT-R参赛，他们在铃鹿举办的首轮比赛中包揽冠亚军，并在当年的9场比赛中赢下了7场，向广大车迷交出了一张满意的答卷。其中有接近半数的胜利是由Xanavi Nismo GT-R取得的。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
This is a truly historic car, and an extremely valuable one.

Érik Comas became Driver Champion behind the wheel of
a GT-R at the 1999 All Japan GT Championships.

In fact, the Pennzoil car finished in the points
in every race that season...

...and claimed four podium finishes out of seven races that year.

It was also the last GT-R powered by the RB26DETT engine
to claim the title in the GT Championships.
dialogues.zh:
这可是一台历史悠久的车了……而且极其珍贵。

埃里克·科马斯就是坐在这辆GT-R赛车里夺得1999年
全日本GT锦标赛车手总冠军的。

这辆Pennzoil赛车在那个赛季的每站比赛中都获得了积分，

并在当年的7场比赛中4次登上领奖台。

这也是最后一辆搭载RB26DETT引擎获得该项赛事冠军的GT-R。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Ah, Car No. 1, this one brings back memories.

It’s the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R that competed
in the 1999 All Japan GT Championship.

Érik Comas drove the No. 23 Pennzoil GT-R to victory...

...earning the No. 1 designation for the following season.

Oh, and here’s a bit of trivia,
if you’re interested.

Many Nissan GT race cars carry the number 23, right?

That number comes from the Japanese pronunciation of 2-3 (ni-san).

It’s a long-standing tradition for Nissan race cars to wear
this number, seen well before 1999.
dialogues.zh:
哎，这不是冠军车吗？我知道这辆车！

这是参加过1999年全日本GT锦标赛的Pennzoil Nismo GT-R！

驾驶23号Pennzoil的埃里克·科马斯拿到了最后比赛的胜利，

艰辛地为这辆车守住了宝贵的冠军。

对了，关于这辆车还有一件轶闻，
有兴趣听听吗？

有很多Nissan的超级跑车都是23号对不对？
但第一辆使用23作为号码的……

没错，就是1998年的这辆Pennzoil！

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
This is a great-looking car. It remains one of the
more popular models in Gran Turismo.

The R34 Skyline.

It was developed with a clear intent—to create a sports
sedan that could serve as the foundation for the GT-R.

In the late 1990s, building a 4-door sedan with limited rear
cabin space was far from conventional.

Yet that very approach helped define the R34’s character, and it
went on to become one of the most iconic GT-R-based models.

It was fast and strikingly designed.

Even in race-prepared form, it still exudes that unmistakable
R34 presence.
dialogues.zh:
这辆车的外形很不错。
我认为它是Gran Turismo当中比较受欢迎的一款R34 Skyline……

我认为这是一款由开发者创造的、开发意图十分明确的汽车，
目的是制造出一款能作为GT-R基础的运动型轿车。

在20世纪90年代末，
考虑制造一辆后座空间有限的四门轿车显然不是正常的思路。

但最终，R34成为了即使在GT-R历史上也最为耀眼的明星。

这也是它甚至到了现在也备受众人欢迎的原因。

即使变成了如今的赛车模样，
它仍然非常有R34的感觉。

collection.en:
The Nissan Skyline GT-R has a storied racing history.

It established a tradition that was carried on by the
second-generation GT-R.

The 1999 Pennzoil Nismo GT-R was powered by
the RB26DETT, an inline-6 engine.

It won the All Japan Grand Touring Championship.

It remains one of the most consistent race cars to
ever wage war in the competitive series.

While the R34 GT-R took the title again
in 2003, which was its final year...

...the battle-tested engine under its hood had
already
been swapped in favor of a V-6 powerplant.

This means that this 1999 Pennzoil was the last GT-R
to win the series title with the iconic inline-6.

There's just something special about this inline-6-powered model.
For me, its achievements are nothing short of legendary.
collection.zh:
日产Skyline GT-R曾拥有过一段传奇般的赛车历史。

它确立了这一传统，且在第二代GT-R上
得以延续。

1999年的Pennzoil Nismo GT-R由一台直列6缸RB26DETT引擎
提供动力，

一举夺得了全日本GT锦标赛冠军。

在这一年中，它表现出了坚如磐石的性能，
证明了自己是天生赢家。

当它在2003年再次夺冠时，
这一代GT-R也步入了末年，

连引擎都已经换成了新的V6引擎。

这意味着这台1999年的Pennzoil是最后一台搭载Nissan标志性
直列6缸引擎赢得系列赛冠军的GT-R。

这款直列6缸车型非常特殊。在我看来，
它的成就本身已是个传奇。

vehicleCollection.en:
This JGTC machine gained its edge by lowering the center of gravity and shortening the wheelbase.

Nissan originally conceived the Skyline GT-R R32 as a Group A race car, but when Group A racing went defunct, Nissan found a new series for its prized car, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC). The GT-R later underwent a full redesign as the R33, and performance of this new car on the track was impressive to say the least. However, as Nissan's main rival, Toyota, started contesting with a faster version of the Supra, and Honda added more heat when it joined the series in 1997, the GT-R was losing its grasp on JGTC dominance.

Although Nissan took both the Drivers' and Constructors' championship titles in 1998, the company switched to the new R34 in 1999 as the foundation for its race car. The new GT-R rode on a 55mm shorter wheelbase than the R33, making it more agile than its predecessor. Also a shallower oil pan and the fuel tank relocated inside the cabin accounted for better weight distribution.

The new revived GT-R found itself in far fiercer competition than anticipated, and didn't score its first win until the fourth race of the season.

The GT-R was unable to log a second win that year, but collected enough points on the strength of its reliability to give Érik Comas, driving the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R, the Drivers' championship title for the second year in a row before the final race was even run.
vehicleCollection.zh:
通过降低重心和缩短轴距来提高速度的全日本房车锦标赛赛车。

参照A组别赛车规则设计的R32 GT-R在A组别赛事停办后，转而投入到全日本GT锦标赛的竞争行列当中。为此，GT-R推出了全新设计的R33，在赛道的表现依旧强劲。但随着丰田的Supra一骑绝尘，本田的NSX也在1997年加入赛事，GT-R略显臃肿的车身成为了负担。

尽管在1998年的全日本GT锦标赛中，日产依旧收获了车队和车手冠军，但还是决定在1999年将基础车型更新至R34，轴距比R33缩短了55mm，带来了更强的竞争力。伴随着新的车身设计，日产为引擎换上了更浅的油底壳，通过压缩引擎高度来降低车身重心。为了应对新规，他们巧妙地将油箱挪到车厢内来优化配重比。

从1999年第一场比赛开始，GT-R便发现赛道上的竞争远超以往，胜利不再唾手可得。R34直到第四站美弥才迎来了首胜，埃里克·科马斯和本山哲驾驶的Pennzoil NISMO GT-R带着无法使用的4档艰难前行，在完赛前的5圈前超越了领先的Supra，拔得头筹。

但在那一年的后续比赛中，GT-R再未获胜，好在凭借稳定性能带来的积分足以帮助科马斯提前一轮蝉联车手冠军头衔。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
I was pretty surprised when I heard about the car Nissan
were entering into Le Mans in 2015!

This GT-R LM NISMO.

The designer, Ben Bowlby, opted for an FF layout, and worked
hard on the aerodynamics.

Unfortunately, however, these innovations didn't pay off.

In qualifying, the car was 20 seconds slower than its
fastest rival.

Worse still, in the race itself, two of three cars had to
retire, so only one was able to reach the finish line.

However, even this finisher didn't complete enough laps,
and was officially judged not to have finished!
dialogues.zh:
听说Nissan要在2015年参加勒芒比赛时，我非常惊讶！

在这辆GT-R LM NISMO上，

设计师本·鲍尔比选择了前置前驱布局，并在空气动力学
方面下了很大功夫。

不幸的是，这些创新并没有得到回报。

在排位赛中，该车比第一名慢了足有20秒。

雪上加霜的是，参加正赛的三辆车中有两辆不得不退赛，
这意味着只有一辆车最终到达了终点。

而且，就连这位通过终点线的车手也因为没有完成足够
的圈数而被判定为未完成比赛！

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
Do you remember the DeltaWing that raced in the
2014 24 Hours of Le Mans?

This car inherits the spirit of that machine.

It was developed with a truly original idea,
one that sort of went over the heads of normal folks.

This front-engine/front-drive car gave designer and engineer Ben
Bowlby the freedom to realize his vision without compromise.

And it ended up taking this honest shape. I like it.

The proportions are uniqiue and the overall design is well-executed,
espeically the rear-quarter.

This wasn't exactly a race version of the GT-R, but
after talking things over with Ben...

...he gave it a Vmotion grille and four round taillights,
details that gave the DeltaWing some Nissan GT-R flavor.

Unfortunately, the car failed to produce any results at Le Mans,
and it was discontinued after a year.
dialogues.zh:
你们记得三角翼吗？
参加过2014年勒芒24小时耐力赛的三角翼？

这辆车就是它的精神继承者。

它运用了完全原创的设计思路，
而且可能有些超出普通人的理解范畴。

我的意思是，这是一辆前置前驱车。设计师兼工程师
本·鲍尔比在打造它的过程中获得了充分的自由。

其结果就是这种朴实无华的外形。
我个人觉得很喜欢。

它的比例非常特殊。但效果非常棒，你不觉得呢？
它从侧后方的观赏角度看上去特别震撼。

严格意义上说，它不能算是GT-R的赛车版本，
不过在本和我的通力合作下，

为这款车安装了V动感前格栅，而在其后部，
我们也安装了四盏圆形尾灯。这些细节为它增加了日产GT-R的风味。

遗憾的是，这辆车在勒芒未能有所斩，在一年后便停产了。

brandCentral.en:
The Nissan GT-R LM Nismo made its debut at the 24 Hours of
Le Mans in 2015...

Where it competed in the Le Mans Prototype 1 Hybrid class.

To the surprise of many, it utilised a front-engine
front-wheel drive layout.

It was an unusual design for an LMP1 vehicle, and a number
of problems had to be resolved before it was ready.

While the Nismo failed to meet expectations in the race, it
nevertheless left a lasting impression on all who saw it.
brandCentral.zh:
Nissan GT-R LM Nismo在2015年的勒芒24小时耐力赛上首次亮相，

参加了勒芒原型车1级（LMP1）混合动力组的比赛。

令许多人感到惊讶的是，该车居然采用了前置引擎前轮
驱动的布局。

对于LMP1车辆来说，这是一个非常规的设计，需要解决为
数不少的问题，才能达到良好的竞技状态。

虽然它最终未能在比赛中取得预期的成绩，但还是给所
有看到它的人留下了深刻印象。

vehicleCollection.en:
A front-wheel-drive prototype hybrid racer designed by Ben Bowlby.

In the spring of 2014, Nissan Motor Company announced that it would enter the LPM1 hybrid class of the 24 Hours of Le Mans the following year with a race car wearing a GT-R badge. It would mark the return of "the Nissan prototype race car" after a 16-year hiatus—since the R391 in 1999. As if that wasn't newsworthy enough, Nissan revealed at the car's introduction in February 2015 that its new race machine, called the GT-R LM NISMO, possessed a front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout, a concept previously unheard of in prototype race cars.

The mastermind behind the GT-R LM NISMO is none other than Ben Bowlby, the man who created the DeltaWing and ZEOD RC race cars. By mounting the engine in the front, Bowlby claims that it opened up new design possibilities to maximize aerodynamics, thus making the car more efficient at higher speeds.

The body consists of a monocoque chassis and outer panels made of carbon fiber, allowing the car to tip the scales at a light 880kg. Under the long front nose is a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter direct injection V-6 mated to an energy-recovery system.

The drivers of the car include homegrown talents, Michael Krumm and Tsugio Matsuda; GT Academy graduates Lucas Ordóñez and Jann Mardenborough; former F1 drivers Marc Gené and Max Chilton; and sports car drivers Alex Buncombe, Harry Tincknell and Olivier Pla.

Nissan will run two cars starting from the first round of the FIA World Endurance Championships, and enter three cars in the 24 Hours of Le Mans, with the sole purpose of grabbing the overall title.
vehicleCollection.zh:
前轮驱动混动车原型，由本·鲍尔比设计。

在2014年春季，日产汽车公司宣布将于次年参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的勒芒原型车1级混合动力组别比赛，而参赛车辆则是一款GT-R车型。他们在2015年2月公布了他们的新车，并将其命名为“GT-R LM NISMO”。这辆车的革新性结构超出了每个人的想象。这也是自1999年的原型车R391以来，日产在时隔16年之后再次推出的一款原型赛车。这辆车出人意料地将引擎移至车身前方，不仅如此，它还是辆前轮驱动的车。

引擎前置解放了车辆的整体设计，从而在空气动力学方面获得更大的优势。毫无意外，这个特别的想法是由本·鲍尔比提出的，他负责设计了底盘和车身。也是同一个人，设计出了像三角翼和佐德RC这样的赛车。

车身包含一体式底盘和碳纤维制成的外部面板，重量最低只有880kg。在长长的前车鼻下安装有一具3升直喷V6双涡轮增压引擎，辅以一套能量回收系统。

这辆车的车手包括日产内部培养的车手迈克尔·克鲁姆和松田次生、跑车浪漫旅学院毕业生卢卡斯·奥多涅斯和扬·马登堡以及他们的导师亚历克斯·邦科姆、前F1车手马克·吉恩和马克斯·奇尔顿，另外还有在赛车界久负盛名的哈里·廷克内尔和奥利维耶·普拉。

日产将在国际汽联举办的世界汽车耐力锦标赛首轮派出两辆车参赛，并会在勒芒24小时耐力赛中派出三辆车参赛，剑指冠军。

catch.en: A front-wheel-drive prototype hybrid racer designed by Ben Bowlby.
catch.zh: 前轮驱动混动车原型，由本·鲍尔比设计。

这辆车的车手包括日产内部培养的车手迈克尔·克鲁姆和松田次生、跑车浪漫旅学院毕业生卢卡斯·奥多涅斯和扬·马登堡以及他们的导师亚历克斯·邦科姆、前F1车手马克·吉恩和马克斯·奇尔顿，另外还有在赛车界久负盛名的哈里·廷克内尔和奥利维耶·普拉。

日产将在国际汽联举办的世界汽车耐力锦标赛首轮派出两辆车参赛，并会在勒芒24小时耐力赛中派出三辆车参赛，剑指冠军。

brandCentral.en:
This particular GT-R was fine-tuned by Nissan's motorsports
division, NISMO to shine on the race track.

For starters, it uses the same turbochargers as
the GT-R GT3 race car.

This allows the V-6 engine to produce an incredible 600ps
and 66kgm of torque.

The 2017 model featured enhanced rigidity
and a competition-tuned suspension.

It set an amazing lap time of 7 minutes and 8.679 seconds
at the Nürburgring.

This actually set a record for a production vehicle
at the time!
brandCentral.zh:
这辆GT-R由Nissan的传奇团队NISMO针对比赛用途进行了精细调校。

它甚至用上了GT3组别赛车的同款涡轮增压器，

将引擎的每一滴动力都榨取了出来，用于输出600ps的动力
和66kgm的扭矩。

这辆2017款车型的刚性接受了强化，悬挂系统也按照比赛
标准进行了调校。

它在纽博格林赛道上跑出了7:8.679的最佳时间，
这个成绩为团队的实力提供了最佳佐证，

也创下了当时的量产车圈速纪录！`

vehicleCollection.en:
The 2017 GT-R was a smoother, more refined version of the previous model.

The GT-R NISMO was introduced in 2014 as the high-performance version of the R35 GT-R. It delighted Japanese sports-car enthusiasts as soon as it appeared and remained unchanged until the summer of 2016 when an updated model finally arrived.

The 2017 GT-R NISMO featured structural adhesives that improved body rigidity. Under the hood, new GT3 turbines were added and the engine was slightly tuned, but output was kept at 600ps/66.5kgm. While still a menacing handling machine, the new GT-R felt more civil on public roads, thanks to the Damp Tronic ECU incorporated into the car's suspension.

At first glance, the new GT-R looked similar to the outgoing model, but in fact, major improvements were made to the car's aerodynamics. The addition of rear spoiler and a front under spoiler and bumper with canard shaped fins on both sides resulted in 100kg more downforce than the standard GT-R at <300km/h>.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款2017年的车型将GT-R的性能提升到了新的高度。

GT-R NISMO于2014年推出，是R35 GT-R系列中性能最高的车款。自此之后，它始终是一款热门车型，但一直没有进行显著的改进，直到2016年夏季推出的2017款GT-R NISMO为它带来了多项改进。

GT-R NISMO标志性的一体化车身使用结构胶粘剂进一步提高了车身刚性、GT3涡轮的使用以及经过精心调校，可输出600ps/66.5kgm的引擎基本没有改动。但2017款车型的前车窗框架进行了强化，同时也是对车身刚性的改善。悬挂系统由湿电电控减振器的控制单元进行设定，改善了极限过弯时的舒适性。

另一项重要的改变是空气动力学外观。前下扰流板与保险杆的两侧均安装了鸭翼样式的鳍片，而后扰流板和保险杆则由参与了Super GT公路版的空气动力学设计师打造。这使得时速达到<300km/h>时的下压力相比标准GT-R车型提高了100kg。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
The R32 Skyline GT-R is popular the world over, but this NISMO
version is really something else.

NISMO, or "Nissan Motorsport International," is the company's
motorsports division.

It was established in 1984.

Back then, Japan was totally into international touring car races
starring the Super Silhouette and other Nissan greats.

Actually, ever since the 1960s, Nissan’s works team has won
many of Japan’s top grand prix races.

This wealth of experience is what made NISMO possible.

And, with all the work that NISMO put into this GT-R,
you know it was destined to be a legend!
dialogues.zh:
R32 Skyline GT-R在全世界都非常有人气，但这台NISMO
却有其独特之处。

NISMO即“Nissan国际赛车”的简写，负责管理Nissan的赛车部门。

它成立于1984年。

当时，以“超级剪影”和其他Nissan大赛为代表的
国际房车赛令整个日本都为之痴狂。

事实上，自1960年代以来，Nissan官方车队就登顶了
许多场日本顶级的大奖赛。

这些在比赛中积累的宝贵经验成为了NISMO设计的基石。

只要了解NISMO在这台GT-R中倾注的努力，你就知道
它是一台不折不扣的传奇！

usedCar.en:
This NISMO is the elusive Skyline GT-R R32,
a car of near-mythic status.

It is the evolution of a production car designed
to win Group A touring car races.

Only 500 units were sold for its limited release in 1990.
But how did it differ from the standard model?

For starters, it featured a front-bumper air duct to improve
engine cooling...

...and a metal turbine to overcome high boost
pressure.

The addition of aerodynamic parts and the cutting of frills
ensured it was faster and more lightweight.

No doubt about it, this special edition was designed
to win races.

Built by NISMO, Nissan’s very own motorsports division,
this venomous beauty is a true fan favorite.
usedCar.zh:
这辆NISMO是一辆极为难得的Skyline GT-R R32，
堪称一代神车。

它是基于为赢得A组别房车比赛而设计的量产车改装而成的
衍生车型，

在1990年限量销售，仅售500辆。但它与标准车型
有什么不同呢？

它在前保险杠处增加了风道，以改善引擎冷却……

选用金属材质的涡轮内壁来承载高增压带来的压力。

空气动力学部件的添置和外观装饰物的削减
有效实现车身减重并提升速度。

毋庸置疑，这台特别版的设计初衷就是冲着赢得比赛去的。

这辆漂亮的双排气管跑车由Nissan自己的赛车部门NISMO打造，
是真爱车迷的心头好。

vehicleCollection.en:
A homologation model with 500 cars produced for Group A racing

Nissan's BNR32 Skyline GT-R was created to win touring car races. Armed with the RB26DETT engine with displacement meeting Group A specifications, this all-wheel-drive grand tourer had all the ingredients that went into a high-performance sports machine, including a 4-wheel steering system.

As was expected, a GT-R NISMO version appeared in its second year of production in the form of a Group A homologation model with a limited production of 500 cars.

Compared to the standard GT-R, the GT-R NISMO was equipped with fins above the front grille that increased airflow into the engine room for cooling, as well as air inlet openings in the front bumper. To improve aerodynamic characteristics, the rear end of the side sills had protectors that directed airflow around the rear tires. A small rear spoiler was also added to improve downforce, while the turbos were changed from ceramic to metal. The exhaust manifold was specially redesigned for this car, and to reduce weight the A/C, audio system, and rear wipers were deleted, making the car 30kg lighter than the base model.

The GT-R NISMO won the top touring car class in Japan, as well as many other famous endurance races throughout Asia, Europe and in Australia. Its mere presence was enough to cause havoc at Group A races all over the world.
vehicleCollection.zh:
仅量产500辆的A组别赛事认证车型。

BNR32 Skyline GT-R配备了排量符合A组别规格的RB26DETT引擎，四轮驱动系统不浪费任何一点传输到路面的动力，四轮转向系统则进一步扩展了底盘能力，是一台专为赢得房车比赛而诞生的车型。

在R32推出第二年诞生的GT-R NISMO就是最好的明证——这是一款A组别赛事认证车型，限量生产500台。

与标准版GT-R相比，GT-R NISMO在前格栅上方配备了鳍状翼片，通过增加导入引擎室的气流以强化冷却效果，还在前保险杠上新增了进气风道；为了改善空气动力学特性，侧梁的后端加装了保护罩，以引导后轮周围的气流，车尾也增加了小型后扰流板；涡轮增压器从陶瓷改为金属；排气歧管也是专门设计的；为了减轻重量，空调、音响系统和后雨刷都被省略了，比基础车型减重了足足30kg。

GT-R NISMO不仅在日本本土的最高级别客用车比赛中连续登顶，还在欧洲和澳大利亚的多项著名耐力赛中称雄。它在全世界范围的A组别比赛中横扫千军，惊艳了所有人。

brandCentral.en:
The GT-R NISMO GT3 was designed for GT3-class racing
by Nissan's motorsports arm, NISMO.

The car you see here was prepared by a privateer, who
entered it in the Nürburgring 24 Hours in 2013.

And, here's an interesting tidbit, it was driven by
Kazunori Yamauchi, producer of Gran Turismo!

Which is why it comes loaded with simulation data from
Gran Turismo.

You might say it's more than just a car. We consider it
an integral part of Gran Turismo history!
brandCentral.zh:
GT-R NISMO GT3是一辆由Nissan和NISMO共同设计的GT3类别赛车。

此车由一家私人车队开发，并在2013年参加了纽博格林24
小时耐力赛。

跑车浪漫旅系列游戏的制作人山内一典曾驾驶过此车，

上面甚至还装载了来自跑车浪漫旅的模拟数据。

可以说这不仅仅是一辆车——而是跑车浪漫旅历史
上不可或缺的一部分。

vehicleCollection.en:
Kazunori Yamauchi and this GT-R NISMO GT3 fought hard in the Nürburgring race in 2013.

In 2012, Nissan introduced the GT-R NISMO GT3 into GT3 racing, a category that has now become the mainstay of GT races. Schulze Motorsport is a private team that fielded this car in the German ADAC GT Masters series.

In 2013, Gran Turismo game producer Kazunori Yamauchi collaborated with Schulze Motorsport for a fourth attempt at the 24 Hours of Nürburgring. The GT-R NISMO GT3 was updated to 2013 specs, and Polyphony Digital set up the car specifically for the Nürburgring using the simulation technology of Gran Turismo. In addition to Yamauchi, drivers taking the wheel included the two Schulze brothers, Tobias and Michael, as well as professional racer Michael Krumm.

Appearing like the production GT-R at first glance, the race car was converted from AWD to rear drive to meet FIA GT3 regulations. Fenders were widened to fit larger tires, and weight was reduced to 1300kg. Engine output, brake performance, and aerodynamics were also upgraded. In qualifying for the 2013 race, car number 123 recorded the top time, a first for a Japanese car at the Nürburgring, but on race day, the team was plagued by a combination of red flags and mechanical problems. In the end, the 123 GT-R did not have a chance to show its full potential. There was a silver lining; however, the driving data gained from this racing effort significantly advanced the simulation engine of Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
在2013年里与山内一典共同征战纽博格林赛道的GT3。

在2012年，日产推出了GT-R NISMO GT3参加当今超级跑车界的主流赛事——GT3组别。私人车队舒尔茨赛车就使用这辆车参加了全德汽车协会超跑大师赛。

在接下来的2013年，跑车浪漫旅系列制作人山内一典与舒尔茨赛车携手合作，第四次参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛。GT-R NISMO GT3也升级到了2013版规格，Polyphony Digital还使用跑车浪漫旅的模拟技术专门针对纽博格林为赛车进行了调校。除了山内一典外，另两位车手是来自舒尔茨赛车的两兄弟，托拜厄斯和迈克尔，以及专业赛车手迈克尔·克鲁姆。

粗略一看，这款GT3赛车和其量产版非常相似，但是为了符合国际汽联GT3规范改成了后轮驱动。挡泥板被设计得更宽，以便使用更宽的比赛用胎，而且重量也减低到了1300kg。这次升级还包括引擎输出功率和刹车性能的提升，以及对空气动力学的强化。

在2013年的24小时耐力赛上，123号车曾一度升至排位赛的首位，这可是日本车在纽博格林上首次创此佳绩。只可惜在决赛时，车子遇到红旗和机械故障等影响，没能发挥出其完全的潜力。不过，从这部赛车上收集到的驾驶数据却为跑车浪漫旅模拟引擎的提高提供了很大的帮助。

在接下来的2013年，跑车浪漫旅系列制作人山内一典与舒尔茨赛车携手合作，第四次参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛。GT-R NISMO GT3也升级到了2013版规格，Polyphony Digital还使用跑车浪漫旅的模拟技术专门针对纽博格林为赛车进行了调校。除了山内一典外，另两位车手是来自舒尔茨赛车的两兄弟，托拜厄斯和迈克尔，以及专业赛车手迈克尔·克鲁姆。

粗略一看，这款GT3赛车和其量产版非常相似，但是为了符合国际汽联GT3规范改成了后轮驱动。挡泥板被设计得更宽，以便使用更宽的比赛用胎，而且重量也减低到了1300kg。这次升级还包括引擎输出功率和刹车性能的提升，以及对空气动力学的强化。

在2013年的24小时耐力赛上，123号车曾一度升至排位赛的首位，这可是日本车在纽博格林上首次创此佳绩。只可惜在决赛时，车子遇到红旗和机械故障等影响，没能发挥出其完全的潜力。不过，从这部赛车上收集到的驾驶数据却为跑车浪漫旅模拟引擎的提高提供了很大的帮助。

brandCentral.en:
A joint effort between Nissan and NISMO, the GT-R NISMO GT3 was
engineered to comply with FIA GT3 regulations as a race machine.

This particular example is the 2018 model.

You’ll notice that the power unit was repositioned lower and closer
to the center of the chassis to enhance handling dynamics.

The driver’s seat was also lowered, further sharpening steering
response and overall vehicle control.

这里这辆是2018年的版本。

可以注意到动力单元被安装在较低、靠中间的位置，
以改善操控性。

驾驶员的座位也被放低，使得转向响应更加灵敏。

vehicleCollection.en:
This racing spec version of the GT-R was created for GT3 category competition.

The Nissan GT-R GT3, based on the road-going R35 GT-R, was a familiar presence in the FIA's GT3 class. When the race car was introduced in 2012, it came powered by the same twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-6 as in the production model, with the output of the engine rated well above 500ps.

A new version of the race car appeared in 2015 with a stiffer body structure and going by a new name: the Nismo GT3. In 2018, a dry sump oil system was incorporated to allow the powerplant to sit lower in the engine bay by 150mm, giving the car a better overall center of gravity. It was also moved aft by 150mm to optimize front and rear weight distribution.

The radiators and intercoolers were repositioned to provide enhanced airflow and better engine cooling. By redirecting how the air flowed over the body, the Nismo GT3 possessed improved body stability, while a stiffer front body rigidity and retuned suspension system improved handling.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这是GT-R的赛车规格版本，用于参加GT3组别的比赛。

日产GT-R NISMO GT3是由NISMO基于日产R35车型GT-R开发的国际汽联GT3合规量产赛车。

自2012年起，GT3版本的GT-R就已经开始面向消费者发售，但在2015年后，基础车型换成了GT-R Nismo，其特点是提高了车身刚性。2018款的GT-R GT3换上了干式油底壳，使引擎在引擎室中的位置降低约150mm，以降低车身的重心；而且引擎还后移了150mm，以优化重量分配。

前部车身刚性得到了提升，前后悬挂和构件都进行了重新设计，以提供精准的车身反馈。

引擎室布局也得到了改进，散热器和中间冷却器的位置经过了重新调整，可以提供带来更多气流，获得更好的冷却效果。通过优化气流，高速段的车身稳定性有了长足的进步。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
When it comes to R35 GT-R race cars, the Nissan MOTUL
AUTECH GT-R is perhaps the best of them all!

It won two consecutive Super GT championships in the GT500
class, starting in 2014.

It also began the 2016 season in unbelievable
form.

It took the first two races, at Okayama and the
Fuji International Speedway, respectively.

These victories made it the odds-on favorite to win ithird series champion in a row.

The car was atop the rankings going into the final race...

However, because of the ballast it was required to carry,
it could only manage a 7th-place finish in the race.

This meant that it ended the season in
3rd place for the series.

The MOTUL Autech team did give it all it had,
but just came up a little short.

The drivers were Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie uintarelli.

They showed amazing speed all season long, and today,
they're still at it and still winning races!
dialogues.zh:
说起R35 GT-R赛车的话，
日产MOTUL AUTECH GT-R绝对是其中的王者。

从2014年开始，这辆车已经在GT500级别的
Super GT锦标赛中连续获胜了两次。

它在2016赛季中的开局也是势不可挡……

在冈山的第一场和富士赛道的第二场中接连获胜！

在当时看来，这辆车拿下第三个锦标赛冠军已经是板上钉钉的事了。

在赛事进行到最后一场时，它在排名中依然名列前茅……

但是沉重的压舱物使它在这场比赛中惜败，只获得了第七名。

这意味着，这辆车在这个季度中仅以第三名完赛。

他们没能上演帽子戏法，真是太可惜了！

不过，松田次生和罗尼·昆塔雷利的老司机团队无疑是非常快的！

他们俩现在8已步入四十，但却依然没有一丝慢下来的迹象！
,

brandCentral.en:
The Nissan MOTUL AUTECH GT-R was a familiar sight in the
2016 Super GT Series.

Its red paint scheme made it stand out among the other GT-Rs.

While it looks the same as the road-going car, underneath
the sheet metal things were very different.

It was adapted to conform to the requirements of the DTM,
the German Touring Car Masters series.

Therefore, it was rear-wheel drive, not AWD like the road car.
brandCentral.zh:
Nissan MOTUL AUTECH GT-R参加了日本最高级别的GT系列赛，
Super GT。

我们的这一款车亮相于2016年。

虽然在外观上保留了经典的GT-R元素，但内在截然不同，
应用了单体车壳设计。

这项改动是为了符合DTM，也就是德国房车大师赛的规范
要求。

另外，这辆车采用的是前置引擎和后轮驱动布局。

vehicleCollection.en:
This 2016 Super GT race car was driven by the team of Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie Quintarelli.

Since 2008, Nissan's entry in the GT500 class of the Super GT Series was the R35 GT-R. The car initially came with a 4.5-liter V-8 (VK45DE), then switched to a 3.4-liter V-8 (VRH34A/VRH34B) in 2010. In 2014, it sported yet another new powerplant: a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection (NR20A), independently developed in the same manner as Toyota and Honda.

Because of new regulations in the Super GT Series for the 2014 season, where the weight and center of gravity of the monocoque had to mimic those of DTM machines, the GT500 GT-R underwent major changes under its skin. These changes continued all the way to the 2016 season.

In 2014, four teams competed with the new GT-R, and the Motul Autech team of Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie Quintarelli brought home the series championship that year. The following year saw them repeat the feat bringing home the Driver Championship and the Constructor Championship to Nissan for the second straight year. The streak came to an end in 2016 when, despite winning the first two races of the season, they ended up in 3rd place in both the Driver and Constructor championships.
vehicleCollection.zh:
在2016年Super GT赛事中由松田次生和罗尼·昆塔雷利驾驶。

自2008年起，日产就派出R35 GT-R参加Super GT系列赛的GT500类别比赛，最初的车辆采用4.5升的V8 VK45DE引擎，从2010年起换成了3.4升的V8 VRH34/VRH34B引擎。2014年又改成了2升涡轮增压直列4缸直喷式引擎NR20A，这款引擎的规格与丰田和本田使用的相同，但是独立开发的。

根据2014年新颁布的车辆规范，单体车壳的重量和重心均经过调整以符合德国房车大师赛的车辆要求，避震和后尾翼则需采用通用部件。虽然外观方面没有重大的变化，但统一规范化对GT500规格GT-R的车身内部造成了重大的影响。在对细节进行持续修改和优化后，这款车进一步升级为2016款。

有四支日产车队采用这款GT-R参赛，2014年，松田次生和罗尼·昆达列尼驾驶摩特奥泰克GT-R取得了系列赛冠军。在接下来的2015年，他们以同一支队伍再次夺冠，连续两年赢得车手冠军和车厂冠军。2016赛季他们再次以同一支队伍参赛，在第一、二轮获胜后，三连冠的呼声高涨，但赛季结束时，他们在车手和车厂排位上都只获得了第三名。

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
Ah, this is the 2017 model, after the second minor change.

This front design was actually...

...a reproduction of the GT-R Proto that we displayed
at the 2005 Tokyo Motor Show.

We felt that the graphic theme of the GT-R Proto might be a bit
too aggressive for a car making its first ever appearance...

This design was born from us saying, "Let's try one
more time to express the design in a different way."

The 2017 car has a very complete look to it, and
I do like it myself.

Also, regarding the interior,
it has a modern design with depth and good textures.
dialogues.zh:
哦，这是2017年的车型，经历了第二次“小”改款。

前部车身的设计其实取自……

我们在2005年东京车展上展出的GT-R Proto概念车。

当时，我们觉得作为一款首次亮相的车型，
设计有些过于激进……

于是搁置了这个设计方案，等待时机成熟。
正如你现在所看到的，时机到了。

2017年车型的外观设计完成度很高，我自己也很满意。

我也非常喜欢现代感十足的新内饰，
我们对材质的应用很到位。

brandCentral.en:
The 2017 Nissan GT-R boasted numerous improvements,
including a refined engine setup.

Ignition control was optimized, resulting in a 20ps
power increase over the previous model.

Maximum power output was now rated at 570ps.

The car also featured significant styling changes to
the already-menacing exterior.

This included a new front end inspired by the
GT-R Concept R35.
brandCentral.zh:
2017款GT-R的主要特性包括一套优化调校的引擎配置以及其
他方面的关键设计改良。

点火控制的优化让它的动力比前一代提升了20ps，

最大功率输出达到了惊人的570ps。

另外，车身上还应用了大量外观改进。

其全新的车头设计灵感来源于GT-R Concept R35。

vehicleCollection.en:
Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.

This new Nissan GT-R was announced at the New York International Auto Show in April 2016, amid a fury of anticipation and hype. As the most significantly changed model since its introduction in 2007, the new R35 GT-R didn’t disappoint.

Changes to the car’s design was not only intended to make the car look better, but also designed to enhance its aerodynamic performance. The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.

The GT-R remained a monster when it came to performance. The engine, which was still built by hand by master craftsmen, had more power than before, with 565 HP at 6800rpm and a maximum torque of 467 ft-lb on tap. Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges. Of course, to be considered the world’s best handling car, the cornering performance has also been improved.

With pavement-sticking all-wheel-drive handling, the new GT-R now wreaked havoc in a custom-tailored suit.
vehicleCollection.zh:

就如其“深度进化”表现那样，这是一辆代表日本跑车风范的车。
