long.en:
This new Nissan GT-R was announced at the New York International Auto Show in April 2016, amid a fury of anticipation and hype. As the most significantly changed model since its introduction in 2007, the new R35 GT-R didn’t disappoint.

Changes to the car’s design was not only intended to make the car look better, but also designed to enhance its aerodynamic performance. The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.

The GT-R remained a monster when it came to performance. The engine, which was still built by hand by master craftsmen, had more power than before, with 565 HP at 6800rpm and a maximum torque of 467 ft-lb on tap. Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges. Of course, to be considered the world’s best handling car, the cornering performance has also been improved.

With pavement-sticking all-wheel-drive handling, the new GT-R now wreaked havoc in a custom-tailored suit.

brandCentral.en:
Since its debut in 2007, Nissan has consistently introduced
upgrades to the GT-R on an almost annual basis.

When the 15th-anniversary model was revealed in 2022,
many believed it would mark the end of an era.

Defying these expectations, Nissan continued to refine the
GT-R, leading to the release of the 2024 model.

Featuring a new aerodynamic body, the car benefits from
enhanced cooling and improved downforce.

The electronic suspension has also been further refined.

And the T-spec model incorporates carbon-ceramic brakes
and a specially calibrated suspension.

These advancements elevate the GT-R to new heights in the
evolution of the touring car.

自2007年首次推出GT-R以来，Nissan几乎每年都会推出
升级版本。

当15周年纪念版在2022年推出时，人们普遍认为这将
是系列的最后一款。

然而，似乎是为了打破这种预期，Nissan继续对这款车
进行改进，随后推出了这款2024年车型。

其全新的空气动力学设计提供了更好的冷却效果和
更强的下压力。

电子悬挂系统也得到了优化。

这款T-spec车型应用了碳陶瓷碟刹和特别调校的悬挂系统……

将GT-R在高性能房车领域的进化推向了新的高度。

vehicleCollection.en:
News of the Nissan GT-R R35's demise was evidently greatly exaggerated.

Rumors had circulated that production of the GT-R would conclude with the 2022 model, but in reality, Nissan was still diligently working on further developments. This became evident with the unveiling of the 2024 model at the 2023 Tokyo Auto Salon.

Two significant changes distinguished the 2024 model from its 2022 predecessor. The first was the development of a new muffler system designed to meet the stricter noise regulations that had fueled speculation about the GT-R's discontinuation. This new system successfully reduced unwanted noise and vibrations without compromising engine performance.

The second update was a comprehensive exterior redesign, the first since the 2017 overhaul. The front end now features a horizontal line across the bumper, reminiscent of the iconic R34 GT-R. At the rear, a redesigned bumper and the first modification to the rear wing geometry since the R35's debut subtly push the attachment points further back. These enhancements increased downforce without adding drag.

Beneath the surface, several improvements were also made. For instance, the accelerometers in the electronically controlled suspension was upgraded to more sensitive units, resulting in better traction control and a noticeably smoother ride compared to previous models.
vehicleCollection.zh:
R35 GT-R系列的巅峰之作粉碎了停产的传言。

此前曾有传言称GT-R的2022年车款将成为系列的绝唱，但实际上日产一直在暗中努力进。在2023年东京汽车沙龙上亮相的2024年款车型粉碎了之前的传言。

与2022年款相比，新车型有两项重大改进。首先是开发了一套全新的排气消音管，可以满足更为严格的噪音限制规定——后者正是此前传闻导致GT-R停产的一大主因。新排气系统成功地降低了不必要的噪音和振动，同时保障了引擎的性能。

其次是对外观进行了重大改动。这是GT-R自2017年重新设计以来的首次大幅更新。前脸采用了横贯保险杠的水平线条设计，令人联想起R34 GT-R的经典造型。车尾则采用了全新设计的保险杠，并且自R35亮相以来首次调整了后扰流板的几何形状，将连接点略微后移。这些改进使得车辆能够在不增加空气阻力的情况下产生更大的下压力。

除了外观上的变化，新款GT-R在技术层面也有诸多升级。例如，电子控制悬挂系统中的加速度传感器被更为灵敏的新设备所替代。这一改进使得车辆的牵引力控制更加精准，路感之前的车型更加平顺，从而大幅提升了乘坐舒适性。

brandCentral.en:
Nissan has made a significant mark on the SUV landscape, with
standout models like the Qashqai leading the way in Europe.

Introduced in 2006, the Qashqai quickly became a household name,
and now, it's in its third generation since 2021.

The third-generation Qashqai marked a milestone by bringing
Nissan’s innovative e-Power technology to Europe in 2022.

As a series hybrid, its remarkable fuel efficiency and smooth
driving experience set itself apart from other SUVs.

Visually, its signature Vmotion grille and coupe-like roofline
provided a fine beauty rarely seen in compact crossovers.

The Qashqai remains in the center of Nissan’s global strategy,
with more than four million units built in the UK to date.?
brandCentral.zh:
Nissan曾为SUV市场贡献过多款热销车型，比如在
欧洲广受欢迎的Qashqai。

Qashqai于2006年首次亮相，目前已进入2021年问世
的第三代。

作为将e-Power技术引进到欧洲的车型，第三代Qashqai
在2022年引入了串联混合动力系统。

凭借出色的燃油经济性和驾驶性能，它在
众多SUV竞争对手中脱颖而出。

在美学设计上，独特的Vmotion进气格栅和轿跑式车顶
展现了紧凑型车独有的美感。

作为Nissan全球战略的重要角色，Qashqai迄今
已在英国生产超过400万辆。

vehicleCollection.en:
Nissan's compact SUV is even better with e-Power.

The Qashqai is Nissan’s C-segment compact SUV, positioned as a cornerstone of the brand’s global lineup. It was launched in 2006 and followed by a second-generation model in 2013. The version featured here represents the third-generation Qashqai, which made its debut in 2021.

With this latest incarnation, the Qashqai continued to evolve. It arrived with a striking redesign, complementing its larger body with a bold, angular aesthetic. Sharp character lines converged toward Nissan’s signature Vmotion grille, giving the front end a confident and modern presence. Underpinning the vehicle is the advanced CMF-C/D3 platform, which enhances both ride comfort and handling.

When it comes to the powertrain, the Qashqai offers more than just conventional gasoline options—it also features Nissan’s innovative "e-Power" series-hybrid system. This setup uses a gasoline engine solely to generate electricity, which then powers an electric motor that drives the wheels. What’s more, the engine at the heart of Nissan’s e-Power system is the world’s first mass-producible variable compression ratio engine. It delivers significantly improved thermal efficiency, resulting in reduced CO₂ emissions.

Tekna denotes one of the higher model grades in the lineup. This trim comes generously equipped, with larger alloy wheels, ambient lighting, and a head-up display—all included as standard.
vehicleCollection.zh:
日产紧凑型SUV搭载电驱动力系统后更加出色

逍客是日产产品线中占据C级车细分市场的紧凑型SUV。第一代车型于2006年发布，第二代车型于2013年发布。这里介绍的车型是2021年首次亮相的第三代。

第三代逍客配合更宽大的新车身，进行了造型改革。大胆外观设计的锐利线条汇聚在日产标志性的Vmotion前脸进气格栅上。该车使用最新的第3代紧凑型/中型车通用模块化平台，提供提升的乘坐舒适性和操控性。

在动力系统方面，除了更传统的汽油引擎外，逍客还提供日产专有的“e-Power”串联混合动力系统。该系统使用引擎驱动发电机，再将产生的电力传输到驱动车轮的电机。更重要的是，日产的发电引擎是世界上首台可量产的可变压缩比引擎。其出色的热效率也大大改善了二氧化碳排放。

“Tekna”指的是旗舰版车型等级。旗舰版提供丰富的配置，标配更大的轮毂、氛围灯和抬头显示器。[

dialogues.en:
The Nissan R92CP has an exquisite body design that speaks
to its enormous capacity for downforce.

And its blue paint job is dazzling to behold.

Back in 1992, Nissan pitted the R92CP against Toyota’s
TS010 in a battle for supremacy.

After winning the opening round at Suzuka, the R92CP
went on to win at Fuji and at Sugo...

...contributing to an incredible class victory for Nissan.
dialogues.zh:
Nissan R92CP以精致的车身设计彰显其强大的下压力性能。

此外，其炫目的蓝色涂装更是令人眼前一亮。

在1992年，Nissan R92CP与Toyota的TS010展开激烈对决，
争夺行业的巅峰地位。

在铃鹿赛道夺得开幕战胜利后，R92CP继续在富士和
SUGO运动乐园赛道再下两城……

Nissan最终震撼赢得该级别的冠军，此车功不可没。

conversation.en:
The Nissan R92CP has an exquisite body design that speaks
to its enormous capacity for downforce.

And its blue paint job is dazzling to behold.

Back in 1992, Nissan pitted the R92CP against Toyota’s
TS010 in a battle for supremacy.

After winning the opening round at Suzuka, the R92CP
went on to win at Fuji and at Sugo...

...contributing to an incredible class victory for Nissan.
conversation.zh:
Nissan R92CP以精致的车身设计彰显其强大的下压力性能。

此外，其炫目的蓝色涂装更是令人眼前一亮。

在1992年，Nissan R92CP与Toyota的TS010展开激烈对决，
争夺行业的巅峰地位。

在铃鹿赛道夺得开幕战胜利后，R92CP继续在富士和
SUGO运动乐园赛道再下两城……

Nissan最终震撼赢得该级别的冠军，此车功不可没。

collection.en:
This Nissan R92CP is the fastest Group C racing car of them all.

It really is an absolute beast, reaching over <400km/h>
on Fuji Speedway's long straight.

Group C races used to be extremely popular in Japan in their day,

The year after the FIA World Endurance Championship was created,
Japan had already set up its own endurance racing series.

This series was initially dominated by Porsche,

but Nissan and Toyota quickly grew stronger to become
its top contenders.

The R92CP - designed by Nissan's Kazutoshi Mizuno and built
entirely in-house, was developed for the former C1 class,

and its level of maturity as well as its speed
were way ahead of its competition.

Even legendary drivers of Japan such as Kazuyoshi Hoshino and
Masahiro Hasemi spoke of R92CP's acceleration with dread.
collection.zh:
这辆Nissan R92CP在所有C组别赛车中速度名列榜首！

这辆车绝对是一匹真正的猛兽，曾在富士赛道的长直道
上跑出超过<400km/h>的速度。

C组别的比赛在日本曾经非常流行。

事实上，在FIA创立世界耐力锦标赛的第二年，日本就建
立了自己的耐力系列赛。

这个系列赛最初由Porsche主宰，

但Nissan和Toyota迅速崛起，成为其主要竞争者。

R92CP由水野和敏设计，所有零件均由Nissan自行制造组装，
原本是为了参加曾经的C1组别而开发的。

它的完善度和速度都要远远领先于其竞争对手。

就连日本传奇车手星野一义和长谷见昌弘也对R92CP无可比
拟的加速能力而生T

vehicleCollection.en:
Appearing towards the end of Group C's turbo era, this car won every round of the final All-Japan Sports Prototype Championship.

In the 1980s, Group C represented the most competitive arena for GT racing, prompting Nissan engineers to develop a strong engine for this class: a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V-8. This powerplant found a home inside the engine bay of a new, sleek race car called the R89C, which

was co-developed with the British company, Lola.

The R89C waged war in the European World Championships, the American IMSA and the All-Japan GT Championships, as well as the 24 Hours of Le Mans. As Nissan began development on its own chassis to house the powerful engine, those plans were scrapped when the FIA revised the regulations for the Group C class, prohibiting turbocharged engines. So while Nissan began development of a new Group C car for race series abroad, it refined its racer for Japan, where the regulations remained unchanged. The R89C eventually made way for the R92CP. With 900ps on tap, the car's revised VRH35 engine allowed it to reach <400km/h> on the front straight at Fuji Speedway, generating 3.5 tons of downforce. An even more powerful version was tuned for Le Mans, which pumped out 1200ps.

The new race car was most successful in Japan, winning all six All-Japan Championship races it entered.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款优秀的汽车一直坚持到了C组别涡轮引擎时代的终结，曾在全日本跑车原型锦标赛总决赛中赢下了每一轮的冠军。

在二十世纪八十年代，日产在C组的赛事中投入了大量的精力，并开发了全新的3.5升双涡轮增压V8引擎，同时对该级别的车辆规则做了仔细分析。

他们的这台引擎安装在与英国的罗拉公司合作开发的底盘上。这辆车被命名为R89C，参加了欧洲世界锦标赛、美国国际汽车运动协会赛、全日本锦标赛和勒芒24小时耐力赛。此外，他们还基于R89C开发了自己的底盘，并持续提高车辆性能。

然而，随着国际汽联于1990年修订了C组的车辆规则，决定从1991年开始禁止采用涡轮增压发动机。日产针对新规则开展了新的C组赛车的开发，但同时也注意到全日本锦标赛在1992年年底之前将仍然采用旧的C组规则进行比赛。因此，采用现有涡轮增压发动机的C组赛车得到了延续，R92CP是开发的最后一款车型。

R92CP在1992年的全日本锦标赛上所向无敌。此车以6场比赛全胜的成绩，为涡轮增压C组赛车的时代划上了句号。VRH35引擎官方公布的输出马力为900ps以上，并在勒芒赛上证实特殊情况下可以输出1200ps。这款R92CP在富士赛道的主要直道上曾达到超过<400km/h>的最大速度，据说此车在第一个弯道减速前仍在继续加速。车身的下压力更是高达3.5吨。

此外，R92CP是一款设计理念前卫的车型，关注改善座舱环境，以减缓驾驶者的疲劳。其压倒性的胜利得益于对耐力赛分析过程中细致的思考和考量。

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
Usually, when using the elements of
an existing car to create a variant...

...you usually hit it with a completely design to differentiate
it from the original, so they don't occupy the same market.

This is done to avoid cannibalism.

That's why, from the designer's point of view, although in
theory it may be possible, you dare not just carry over a design.

It's like you're not doing your job.

But considering the playful spirit and freedom of will of
car guys, this act can't be ignored.

Nope. These days, just about anything goes!

In North America, when the merging of auto makers and their
brands happened early on, this sort of thing was very common.

Things like customization and the diversification
and maturity of the autotmotive culture...

...it all comes down to the passion of the customers.
dialogues.zh:
通常情况下，在设计一款当前车款的衍生车型时……

你会想应用一些新的设计，使其与基础车型作出区分。

换句话说，你会希望避免与原车型发生直接竞争。

所以对于设计师而言，借鉴设计元素通常是业界大忌，

会让人觉得设计师根本没有尽职尽责地去设计。

但是对于追求玩趣、想象力丰富的怪咖设计师来说，
这种手法却是不可或缺的。

事实上，现在的汽车设计已经是百无禁忌！

在北美，随着汽车厂商及其品牌的并购，
这种做法已经变得司空见惯。

这种风潮代表了定制和汽车文化的多样性和成熟化……

它是以消费者的热情为第一驱动力的。

usedCar.en:
How familiar are you with the SilEighty?

This unique Japanese entity emerged from the 1990s' street-racing
scene, courtesy of Japanese aftermarket specialists.

The reason this car existed at all was because the Nissan Silvia S13
and the 180SX shared the same front end.

Therefore, it was easy to stick the Silvia's face onto the
body of an 180SX, thus combining the "Sil" and "Eighty."

While not an official Nissan offering, the car did manage to
gain a certain amount of popularity back in the day.
usedCar.zh:
你熟悉Sileighty吗？

这款独特的日本车诞生于20世纪90年代
的街头赛车现场。

因为S13 Silvia和180SX有相同的底盘，
和相同的前部结构，所以这才造就了这款车型的诞生。

“用180SX的车身搭配Silvia的车头。”
这样简单的改装非常容易实现。

Sileighty这款独特的改装车就这样在
人们追求趣味创新的过程中诞生。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Nissan blended the 180SX with the appealing front end of the Silvia.

The Nissan 180SX — sold as the Nissan 240SX in the U.S. and the 200SX in the EU — was created as the Silvia's sister hatchback model in March 1989. This car, sporting retractable headlights and a glass hatchback, was overshadowed by the coupe at first—despite sharing the same powerplant, a 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4 that came available only with a turbocharger. But as time went on, people recognized the true value of the stylish fastback and sales began to climb.

The engine received an upgrade in 1991 to the SR20DET, the same 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 in the normal Silvia with output rated at 205ps and 28.0kgm. This prolonged the 180SX's life span because its production run was initially slated to end alongside the S13 Silvia; however, thanks to the popularity of the 2.4-liter 240SX in the U.S. (that possessed the same body shape of 180SX), Nissan elected to keep the compact rear-drive coupe around.

In 1996, the first normally-aspirated 180SX, the Type S, was added to the lineup. Without forced induction, the Type S lacked the acceleration of the hotter version. This made the car a favorite among tuners, who took things into their own hands, giving the car their own dose of power and beefing the chassis up accordingly. This paved the way for a new 180SX, one that featured the Silvia's front end, making the two cars virtual clones of each other; it was dubbed the "Sil-Eighty."
vehicleCollection.zh:
将180SX和Silvia糅合在一起，车迷的狂热喜爱让它得以诞生。!

日产180SX在美国和欧洲地区分别以日产240SX和200SX发售。

180SX是在1989年3月作为Silvia的姐妹车型推出的一款掀背车，主打上翻式头灯和一体式玻璃的后箱盖。在大热的Silvia的掩盖之下，这款车型在上市后并未激起太多水花。尽管也采用了同款1.8升引擎，但180SX只提供涡轮增压车型。

1991年，在更换了2.0L的SR20DET引擎后，车辆的动力输出变成了205ps和28.0kgm扭矩。按照原计划，180SX将被大改款后的Silvia直接取代。幸运的是，采用2.4升引擎的240SX在北美地区持续热销，让日产决定在Silvia之外保留180SX产品线。

直到停产前，180SX都与旧的Silvia S13共享基础组件，但时不时的改款使其依然能跟上时代的节奏。因为车重偏重，而且掀背设计导致后部的刚性不足，所以最初大部分人都认为180SX的性能不如Silvia。好在丰富的副厂改装件帮助S180SX轻松克服了这一弱点。到后来，众多爱好者纷纷推出原创特殊改装。这些努力最终也为一台原创车型铺平了道路：当Silvia S13的前段车身被嫁接到S180SX身上后，独一无二的Sileighty就此诞生。

catch.en: This Nissan blended the 180SX with the appealing front end of the Silvia.
catch.zh: 将180SX和Silvia糅合在一起，车迷的狂热喜爱让它得以诞生。!

But as time went on, people recognized the true value of the stylish fastback and sales began to climb.

The engine received an upgrade in 1991 to the SR20DET, the same 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 in the normal Silvia with output rated at 205ps and 28.0kgm. usedCar.en:
The Silvia is an iconic sports coupe,
produced by Nissan.

This example is the 6th-generation model, which first
appeared in the 1990s and is known as the S14.

This specific car is actually the very last of the S14s
that came out in 1996.

Its design is notably different from earlier models,
with a distinctively sharp look.

The power and torque remained the same as those of its
predecessor, but this K's grade car features a turbo.

And what about the Silvia's drivetrain, you ask?
Well, it's real-wheel-drive, giving it an FR layout.

The turbo engine's max output of 220ps and the FR layout
makes it suitable for both track racing and drifting.
usedCar.zh:
Silvia是一款标志性的、优雅的双门跑车，由Nissan生产。

该车型来自于二十世纪九十年代初次推出的第六代，
被命名为S14。

我们看到的这一台事实上是S14的最后一作，于1996年推出。

其设计与早期车型有着明显的不同，更加棱角分明。

动力和扭矩数据都和老款相同，但这辆S-14 K's
拥有一台涡轮增压引擎。

那么Silvia的传动系统又如何呢？你可能会问。
好吧，它是一台后驱车，确切地说，是前置后驱。

搭载涡轮增压器的引擎的最大输出马力是220ps，
这使它在赛道竞速和漂移中都能游刃有余。

vehicleCollection.en:
The top grade of the S14 adds a rear spoiler and leather wrapped steering wheel.+

The S14 Silvia made its debut in October 1993 as the successor to the hugely successful S13 model. Armed with a new larger body Nissan hoped to continue on its previous successes.

The S14 is 1730mm wide compared to the S13's 1690 ,and track width was increased. The new model is also 30mm longer at 4500mm and 5mm taller at 1295mm for an overall larger body. The softer lines of the body design make the wider stance stand out the most. The K's grade model also featured 16-inch wheels as standard.

The engine is a retuned version of the S13's SR20 series. The highest grade K's model features an intercooled turbocharger and produces 15ps more than the previous generation at 220ps/28.0kgm with the naturally aspirated Q's and J's models producing 160ps/19.2kgm. The basic suspension structure was carried over from the S13, utilizing front struts and a multilink setup at the rear. The car was also available with the Super HICAS electronic rear-wheel steering system.

In 1996, Nissan released a facelift model with an extensive redesign. The exterior's soft image was tightened up with scowling headlights and a large real spoiler was added for a more sharp and striking appearance.

The "Aero" model featured here was added to the Q's and K's lineup in the spring of 1995 as the top-of-the-line model. The exterior features unique bumpers along with front and rear spoilers. The interior received a leather wrapped steering wheel, a new shift knob and white gauge faces. These changes proved to be popular with drivers, and the grade was continued on the facelift model.

As the number of affordable rear-wheel-drive coupes dwindled through the 1990s, the S14 Silvia can be considered a very important car for carrying that design DNA into the next generation. It was also popular overseas where it wa sold in North America as the 240SX and in Europe as the 200SX.
vehicleCollection.zh:
装有后扰流板和皮革包裹方向盘的最顶级S14。

S14 Silvia在1993年10月首次推出，是大获成功的S13的后继车型。日产希望它能延续这个系列的成功，为其配备了更大尺寸的新车身。

S14的车身宽度为1730mm，较之S13的1690略有增加，轮距也进行了相应的增加。另外，新一代车款的车身长度增加了30mm，为4500mm，车身高度也加高了5mm，增加到1295mm。可以说，整台车都大了一圈。而且，它车身设计中的柔和线条也更进一步凸显了车身的宽度。此外，其K's型号还标配了16英寸轮毂。

S14 Silvia采用的引擎是基于S13的SR20系列重新调校的版本。最高配置的K's型号还加装了中冷式涡轮增压器，输出功率为220ps/28.0kgm，比上一代多了15ps，而自然进气的Q's和J's型号则可以输出160ps/19.2kgm的动力。其基础悬挂结构也是直接继承自S13，前轮使用了支撑臂，而后轮使用了多连杆系统。这辆车还配置了一套“超级高性能主动控制转向”电子后轮转向系统。

日产在1996年又推出了经过大量重新设计的改款车型。改掉了原本柔和的外观，改为使用更具压迫性的大灯和大尺寸尾翼，让车身整体更加犀利、更引人注目。

这里登场的“飞空”车型是在1995年春天作为最高级别的配置版本加入到Q's和K's车型中的。其外饰装有独特的保险杠和前后扰流板。内饰采用了皮革包裹的方向盘和换挡杆柄，以及白色的仪表面。这些变化在车手中大受欢迎，所以该级别在后来的改款车型上得到了延续。

由于在90年代市面上价格实惠的后驱双门车型数量大幅减少，S14 Silvia可以说将这种设计理念延续到了下一个世纪，起到了承前启后的作用，是一款非常重要的车v。S14 Silvia在海外也备受欢迎：它在北美地区以240SX的型5名上市，而在欧洲地区的型号名则是200SX。

dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favourite Japanese cars of the early ‘90s.

One thing that has always impressed me about it
is the quality of its shape.

Specifically, the slight 'S' curve in the side profile,
above the wheel of the front fender.

This gives a very delicate and sensitive finish
to the surface modelling and reflections.
dialogues.zh:
第五代Nissan Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。

它最让我印象深刻的一点就是外观风格。

具体来说就是它车身侧面轮廓中，前挡泥板轮圈上方
略微呈现出的“S”弧线。

这一细节为车身的立体造型和光线反射添加了
精妙而感性的一笔，起到了画龙点睛的作用。

usedCar.en:
The Nissan Silvia went by the name 240SX in the U.S.

Among the more popular variants of this beloved Japanese
sports car was the S13, introduced in the 1980s.

In Japan, the sleek 2-door car gained many fans,
especially from the younger crowd.

The 1990 "K's" model came equipped with a turbocharged
1.8-liter inline-4 that sent power to the rear wheels.

And because all Silvias came with a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive
layout, or what we refer to as FR...

...they handled like true sports cars and felt at home on
both winding roads and the race track.
usedCar.zh:
Nissan的Silvia拥有一段悠久而著名的历史。

20世纪80年代上市的S13
是Silvia中最受欢迎的车型之一。

这款双门轿跑一经亮相便在日本流行了起来，
尤其受年轻人的追捧。

1990年的“K's”型搭载了前置1.8升
直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。

凭借其可靠的后驱性能，它将是
车手的理想之选。

此外，其紧凑的车身使得它在蜿蜒的道路和传统的赛道上
都非常具有竞争力。

vehicleCollection.en:
This special S13 had many previously optional items now included as standard equipment.

The Nissan Silvia, called the 240SX in the States, had a loyal following since it was first introduced in 1988 because of its extremely sporty nature and head-turning good looks.

The most popular version was the 5th-generation model, which many felt was the best looking in the car's lineage. Produced from 1988 through 1993 and dubbed the S13, the stylish coupe was also heralded by the media, garnering Japan Car of the Year honors for 1988. It would eventually go on to become the best-selling Silvia ever. The top-of-the-line version was the K model, powered by Nissan's CA18DET, a turbocharged DOHC inline-4 that produced 175ps/6400rpm and 23.0kgm of torque at 4000rpm.

From the driver's seat, the engine felt much more powerful, thanks mainly to the car's lean curb weight of 1140kg. Its straight-line prowess and finely-tuned suspension that included a compliant multilink setup at the rear made the FR (Front drive/Rear engine) sports coupe a true driver's car that was capable on both winding roads and the open highway.

In February 1990, a Diamond Select Edition was added to the lineup. This special model offered an array of optional features that included automatic climate control, aluminum wheels and a rear spoiler, allowing prospective owners to tailor their car toward either a grand tourer or pure sports car.
vehicleCollection.zh:
采用特殊规格的S13 Silvia，加入了众多倍受欢迎的选配配置。

Silvia是日产旗下的双门轿车产品线。其中的S13是于1988-1993年间生产的第5代车型。

日产对S13的最初定位是一款用于约会兜风的时尚双门轿跑，结果在推出后却受到了街头车手们的热烈追捧：在当时已堪称稀有的中级别前置后驱车款，强劲的引擎动力和操控性能卓越的底盘，都完美契合竞速车的标准。

正是S13的出现，把大众心目中的Silvia定义成了一款运动车型。在随后推出高性能版本S13s（之前的Silvia高性能版本都被称为Ks）上，搭载有CA18DET双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压直列4缸引擎，可在6400rpm时输出175ps，以及4000rpm时的23.0kgm扭矩，对于一台仅重1140kg的车来说绰绰有余，再加上日产全力研发，精心打造的多连杆后悬挂，让它成为了一款在任何设定下都能畅快驾驶的车。

在1990年2月，日产针对Silvia的Ks、Qs和其他级别车型推出了钻石选配包，包含自动空调、铝制轮毂和后扰流板等多种多样的选配件可供选择。

usedCar.en:
Among Japanese 2-door sports coupes, the Nissan Silvia
is one with particularly deep roots.

Bowing in 1965, the legendary first-gen model is remembered
as an indispensable part of Japanese automotive history.

This model here, affectionately known as the S14,
dates back to 1993.

The direct successor to the S13, it marked the arrival
of the sixth-generation car.

Compared to its predecessor, it was a bit wider, with a
longer body and wheelbase.

In line with its pedigree, it featured a front-engine/
rear-wheel-drive, or FR, layout.

And its sleek and simple proportions gave it a
look that makes it instantly recognizable as a Silvia.

Contributing to its excellent performance was
an evolved undercarriage.

This came with reinforced brakes and a stiffer suspension
resulted in improved handling.

This K’s Type S Grade was the top-of-the-line model. It came with
a turbocharged 4-cylinder engine and rear spoiler.%
usedCar.zh:
在日本的双门运动型轿跑车中，日产Silvia是一个
历史渊源尤为深厚的系列。

这个传奇车型在1965年首次亮相的第一款车
已成为了日本汽车史上不可缺少的一部分。

眼前的这款车型被亲切地称为“S14”，
它的历史可以追溯到1993年。

作为S13的继任者，它标志着Silvia第六代车型的到来。

与它的前辈相比，它的车身略宽，车身和轴距更长。

其他方面则与之前的车型一致，
采用了前置引擎、后轮驱动，亦即“前置后驱”的布局……

其圆润的造型和简单的比例被称作“Silvia外观风格”
并受到全世界车迷的推崇。

改进后的底盘为其卓越的性能贡献不少……

强化的刹车和提升后的悬架刚性则改善了操控性。

这款K’s中的Type S配置是顶配，
配备了涡轮增压4缸引擎和后扰流板。

vehicleCollection.en:
The sixth-generation Silvia emphasized heightened luxury in a wide body format.

The S14 Silvia made its debut in October 1993 as the successor to the hugely successful S13 model, and with a new larger body, Nissan hoped to continue on the car's previous success.

The S14 sat 1730mm wide compared to the S13's 1690 and the track was also enlarged. The new car stretched 30mm longer at 4500mm and 5mm taller at 1295mm than the outgoing model. The softer lines of the body really enhanced the wider nature of the car's body. The K trim level came with 16-inch wheels as standard, further adding to it visual flair.

Under the hood was a retuned version of the S13's SR20 engine. The K model came with an intercooled turbocharger that helped pump out 15ps more than the previous generation at 220ps/28.0kgm. The naturally-aspirated Q and J trim levels produced 160ps/19.2kgm. The basic suspension geometry was carried over from the S13, featuring front struts and a multilink system at rear. The car was also available with Super HICAS electronic rear wheel steering.

The S14 placed an extra focus on luxury to increase its appeal as an FR coupe, but when Japan's financial bubble burst in 1991, the coupe market shrank, and the car lost its appeal. To revitalize the model, Nissan released a facelift model in 1996 with an extensive redesign. The exterior's soft image was tightened up with scowling headlights and a large real spoiler for a sharper and more striking appearance.

The S14 Silvia was sold in North America as the 240SX and in Europe as the 200SX.

S14的车身宽度为1730mm，较之S13的1690mm略有增加，轮距也进行了相应的增加。另外，新一代车款的车身长度增加了30mm，为4500mm，车身高度也加高了5mm，增加到1295mm。可以说，整台车都大了一圈。而且，它车身设计中的柔和线条也更进一步凸显了车身的宽度。此外，其K型号还标配了16英寸轮毂。

另外，作为一款前置后驱双门轿跑，S14还额外强调了奢华的驾乘体验。但随着1991年日本经济泡沫破裂，日本的双门轿跑市场严重缩水，导致这款车销量不佳。为了振兴这一系列，日产在1996年又推出了经过大量重新设计的改款车型。改掉了原本柔和的外观，改为使用更具压迫性的大灯和大尺寸尾翼，让车身整体更加犀利、更引人注目。由于在90年代市面上价格实惠的后驱双门车型数量大幅减少，S14可以说将这种设计理念延续到了下一个世纪，起到了承前启后的作用，是一款非常重要的车型。

S14 Silvia在北美地区以240SX的型号名上市，而在欧洲地区的型号名则是200SX。

catch.en: The sixth-generation Silvia emphasized heightened luxury in a wide body format.
catch.zh: 第六代Silvia采用宽体车身设计，呈现出更强的奢华感。

long.en:
The S14 Silvia made its debut in October 1993 as the successor to the hugely successful S13 model, and with a new larger body, Nissan hoped to continue on the car's previous success.

The S14 sat 1730mm wide compared to the S13's 1690 and the track was also enlarged. The new car stretched 30mm longer at 4500mm and 5mm taller at 1295mm than the outgoing model. The softer lines of the body really enhanced the wider nature of the car's body. The K trim level came with 16-inch wheels as standard, further adding to it visual flair.

Under the hood was a retuned version of the S13's SR20 engine. The K model came with an intercooled turbocharger that helped pump out 15ps more than the previous generation at 220ps/28.0kgm. The naturally-aspirated Q and J trim levels produced 160ps/19.2kgm. The basic suspension geometry was carried over from the S13, featuring front struts and a multilink system at rear. The car was also available with Super HICAS electronic rear wheel steering.

The S14 placed an extra focus on luxury to increase its appeal as an FR coupe, but when Japan's financial bubble burst in 1991, the coupe market shrank, and the car lost its appeal. To revitalize the model, Nissan released a facelift model in 1996 with an extensive redesign. The exterior's soft image was tightened up with scowling headlights and a large real spoiler for a sharper and more striking appearance.

The S14 Silvia was sold in North America as the 240SX and in Europe as the 200SX.

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Combining a light, compact body with a responsive
rear-wheel drive chassis...

And a peppy 1.8L straight-four engine—this S13 Silvia
is one well-balanced FR sports car.

Not only does it strike an elegant pose when parked, but it
looks great tearing around a corner, too!

Nowadays, these cars are really something special.
In fact, the S13's best qualities are priceless!
dialogues.zh:
这轻巧紧凑的车身与响应迅速的后轮驱动底盘相结合……

加上强劲的1.8升直列四缸引擎，这台S13 Silvia
简直是面面俱到的前置后驱跑车。

不仅停放时姿态优雅，转弯时同样美得让人窒息。

现如今，这款车确实非同寻常。
老实说，S13本身就是无价之宝！

dialogues.speaker: Fabio Filippini
dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
The fifth-generation Nissan Silvia was one of
my favorite Japanese cars of the early '90s.

A coupe of classic beauty—its lines were
remarkably clean and elegant!

It almost looked Italian in design.

That low front, transverse light strip,
bright cabin and slender tail...

Everything in this car comes together
in a perfect harmony of proportions.
dialogues.zh:
第五代Nissan Silvia是我最爱的
九十年代初期日式车之一。

这辆呈现出经典美感的双门跑车
拥有令人眼前一亮的简洁优雅线条！

看上去非常像是意大利的设计风格。

低矮的车头、横断式条状车灯、
亮色的驾驶舱和纤细的车尾……

一切都完美地融合在一起，呈现出非常和谐的比例。

vehicleCollection.en:
A low price, excellent handling and naturally aspirated engine made this S13 quite attractive.

In May 1988, the fifth-generation S13 Silvia stole market share away from the Honda Prelude and gained immediate popularity. This is because of its front-engine/rear-drive layout and fun-to-drive nature, but the main reason was the car's elegant styling.

Under the hood was the CA18, a 1.8-liter inline-4, but it was later replaced by the SR20, a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4. The premium K's model came turbocharged, producing 205ps and 28.0kgm of torque, while the Q's and J's remained naturally aspirated, rated at 140ps and 18.2kgm. The front suspension consisted of MacPherson struts up front and a multi-link setup at rear. Nissan's 4-wheel steering system, Super HICAS, was available as an option.

Thanks in part to the car's light weight — it tipped the scales at a lean 1170kg — the turbocharged K's was quick off the line and made for an ideal drift machine. It was also a huge favorite among tuners, especially because the CA18DET could easily deliver 300ps after a few tweaks. In fact, the S15 proved more popular to drifters and tuners than Nissan's signature FR sports car, the Z.
vehicleCollection.zh:
S13由自然进气引擎提供动力，平易近人的价格和优越的操作性是其备受欢迎的原因之一。

1988年5月推出的第五代S13 Silvia从本田前奏手中抢过了大量市场份额，获得了令人难以置信的高人气。除开“约会车”的定位，它还是一款带来驾驶乐趣的紧凑型前置后驱车。

不用说，外观是其获得极高人气的最首要，也是最重要的原因：精心打造的双门车身造型在当时领先于潮流，其张扬的华丽感正是扬帆起航的世界经济的缩影。当然了，驾驶性能也是不可或缺的重要因素。灵活、充满运动感，而且价格非常亲民。完全匹配当时年轻一代的所有需求。

S13最初采用的是一款1.8升CA18引擎，在后期的小改款中换上了SR20系列的2.0L双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸引擎。顶级Silvia的K型加入了涡轮增压器，可以输出205ps和28.0kgm扭矩，而Q和J型则仍为自然进气引擎，可以输出140ps和18.2kgm扭矩。前悬挂采用麦弗逊悬架，而后悬挂则采用了多连杆悬架。除此之外，消费者可以选购名为超级高性能主动控制转向的四轮转向系统。

涡轮增压的K型号全重仅为1170kg，205ps带来的加速性能令人振奋不已，得益于底盘的绝佳平衡性，驾驶员可以更直观地感受到来自地面的反馈。这台车还是众多日本车手的漂移启蒙。另一方面，Silvia还是一款特色突出的调校基础车，开发潜力强大。这款无比坚强的CA18DET引擎在调校之后甚至可以输出超过300ps。曾经有一段时间，日本的改装车店门口停的清一色全是S13 Silvia。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
With a body as compact as the S13 two generations before it,

This car has a design that combines superb styling
with impeccable balance.

And being turbocharged, it produces a respectable 250ps.

It actually competed in Japan's GT Championships too.

It's also a great base car for drifting customisations,
meaning you get a lot of fun for your dollar.
dialogues.zh:
随着Silvia重新回归两代之前，S13时期的紧凑车身设计，

整体造型变得集造型优美和完美匀称于一身。

涡轮增压则使这款车能够输出令人惊叹的250ps。

这辆车不仅作为赛车参加了全日本房车锦标赛，

同时也是漂移改装车的绝佳基础车型。可以这么说，
你付出的每一分价格都能带来无上的乐趣。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
You know when you look at this car from an angle
it looks like an Italian car, it's so beautiful.

Huh, what's with this gauge that’s mounted in
this weird position?

Ohh, so they've already got a place for the boost gauge
for the turbo.

With the boost gauge in your face like that
It probably makes you wanna drive faster!
dialogues.zh:
你从某个角度看这辆车的时候，它就像一台意大利车那
样美丽。

嗯？安装在这个奇怪位置的仪表是怎么回事？

哦哦，所以他们为涡轮增压表特意找了一个位置。

像这样把仪表装在你面前，大概会让你想要开得更快吧！

dialogues.speaker: Ed Welburn
dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
The Nissan Silvia Spec-R is a small coupe with great proportions.

But it is a great opportunity
for you to express your own creativity.

It would make a great custom project car,
with large wheels and flaired fenders as a starting point.

Then paint it black, with a splash of color for graphics, or...
...just use your own creative magic!
dialogues.zh:
Nissan Silvia Spec-R是一款车身比例非常好的小型双门跑车，

也是你表达自己的创造力的绝好机会。

它非常适合改装。如果是我的话，会先从大车轮和拓宽
挡泥板入手。

然后把它涂成黑色底色，再添加更多色彩……

不过，可能还是你自己发挥创造力比较好！

vehicleCollection.en:
This popular S15 model included side skirts and a rear spoiler.

Tapped as the savior of the brand, the seventh-generation Silvia made its debut in January 1999 amid the S14's struggle in the marketplace. Returning to basics, the S15 came with a more compact body, one more like the popular S13. This was Nissan's way of saying that the new Silvia wasn't intended to be luxurious, but very sports minded.

Under the hood was the same SR20 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 that powered both the S13 and S14, only it was more refined than ever. The naturally aspirated variants produced 165ps and 19.6kgm of torque, while the turbocharged version pumped out 250ps and 28.0kgm of torque. The S15 was offered in two main trim levels: the naturally aspirated Spec S and the turbocharged Spec R that boasted a weight-to-power ratio of <4.96kg/ps>.

Retaining key components of the S13 and S14 chassis, Nissan drastically increased body rigidity, which improved handling. The S15s also received a helical LSD.

To broaden the car's appeal even more, a convertible version of the Spec S, called the Varietta, was introduced in 2000. However this year also marked the beginning of the end for the Silvia because it wasn't able to meet Japan's exhaust emission standards for 2000. Production of the S15 stopped in August 2002, marking the end of the 38-year Silvia dynasty that started in 1965.
vehicleCollection.zh:
S15最受欢迎的车型，侧面和尾部扰流板成为标配。

尽管S14未能取得商业上的成功，第7代Silvia（S15）还是在1999年1月如期而至。它的最大卖点在于车身尺寸的调整，恢复到了与S13同级别的尺寸。显然，这是为了摆脱之前追求奢华的趋势，将定位纠回灵活尺寸的前置后驱运动车上。

S15沿用了S13和S14使用的SR20引擎，但在调校方面做出了长足的进步，自然进气版本可以输出165ps和19.6kgm扭矩，涡轮增压版本的动力则为250ps和28.0kgm扭矩。这一次，S15为客户准备了两款车型：自然吸气（S）和涡轮增压（R）。其中手动版本R配置有一款6速手动变速箱。

S15的底盘也继承了前两作的底盘，但做出了大幅改进，以增加Silvia作为前置后驱运动车型的吸引力—在提升了车身刚性、制动力和悬挂系统，加入了螺旋限滑差速器后，这款底盘的性能表现与S14天差地别。

能够输出250ps，搭载6速手动变速箱的S15 R更是拥有令人艳羡的<4.96kg/ps>重量马力比。完美的操控与优异的性能表现让驾驶者体会到随心所欲的操纵感。2000年，日产又加入了自然进气版本的敞篷版本Varietta。

作为紧凑型前置后驱车在日本硕果仅存的独苗，S15最终因为不符合2000年后实施的尾气排放标准，不得不在2002年8月宣告停产。这也标志着长达38年的Silvia王朝的终结。

brandCentral.en:
This original Gran Turismo Gr.4 race car uses the
S15 Silvia Spec-R as its base.

Its most distinctive feature is its strikingly wide body.

Around 170mm wider than the base car, it came equipped
with extra-wide race tires.

As the "Touring Car" name implies, this model was
designed for the race track.

But that's not to say you can't drift this car because
after all, Silvias love to be thrown sideways.

In fact, the handbrake has been left intact to allow the
driver to break the rear tires loose.

Whether you're looking for grip on the track or just want to
slide through corners, you can't go wrong with this machine.

比一般
车宽了约170mm，所以可以容纳下宽大的赛车轮胎。

顾名思义，这款“Touring Car”是专为赛道设计的……

尽管如此，Silvia也受到了漂移爱好者群体的热捧。

事实上，为了兼顾漂移性能，这辆车甚至完整地保留了
手刹的配置。

不论是想要足够的赛道抓地力，还是追求漂移过弯时的
爽快感，这辆车一定都能够让您称心如意！\

vehicleCollection.en:
This popular S15 model included side skirts and a rear spoiler.

Alongside the Z and the GT-R, the Silvia (240SX) represented one of Nissan's most prominent sports cars. The seventh-generation Silvia (S15) was introduced in January 1999 with a smaller body than its predecessor and a focused sport-car-minded disposition.

Under the S15's hood was the SR20 engine, which also powered the S13 and S14, but tuned for enhanced performance. The naturally aspirated version produced 165ps and 19.6kgm of torque, while the turbocharged inline-4 pumped out 250ps and 28.0kgm. The S15 came in two trim levels: the Spec S and the Spec R, which also came with a manual 6-speed gearbox.

While sharing the same basic chassis of the S13 and S14, the new Silvia boasted a stiffer body structure, better braking performance and upgraded suspension system. It also featured a helical LSD that made it a much better handler then the S14.

The Spec R was the choice for enthusiasts, thanks partly to a weight-to-power ratio of <4.96kg/ps>. In 2000, a convertible model, the Varietta, was introduced with a naturally aspirated engine, but the entire line was discontinued just two years later, marking the end to this legendary model after 38 years.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
This is the successor to the legendary original Skyline GT-R,
or "Hakosuka," as it was affectionately known in Japan.

This car earned its nickname from an ad campaign featuring a
charming young couple known as “Ken” and “Mary.”

Among Skyline fans, it has forever been remembered by that name
—the “Kenmeri GT-R.”

The Hakosuka rose to prominence in Japanese touring car racing,
earning a fearsome reputation for being unstoppable.

Naturally, the Kenmeri was expected to carry the torch passed
down by its proud predecessor. But fate had other plans.

The 1970s ushered in a new era of strict emissions regulations,
cutting short the Kenmeri’s racing legacy before it began.

Because of these regulations, building cars with high-performance
engines like the GT-R became impossible.

And so, just four months after the Kenmeri went on sale,
production ended, leaving behind only 197 units ever built.

Although it never had a chance to compete in any races...

...its tragic fate and small production run have made
it—in the eyes of enthusiasts—a legend all its own.
,
dialogues.zh:
此车是传奇初代天际线GT-R的继承者，
后者在日本被亲切地称为“箱型”……

而本车的昵称则源自一则流行广告，在广告中出现了
一对名为“肯”与“玛丽”的可爱年轻情侣。

因此，在天际线车迷圈中，如今人们都称这款车为
“肯·玛丽GT-R”。

前辈“箱型”在日本房车赛事中声名鹊起，
赢得了不可战胜的美誉。

按理说，“肯·玛丽”本应延续其前辈铸就的辉煌……

然而时运不济，1970年代恰逢严格的排放法规
开始实施的时代。

这些法规导致GT-R这类搭载高性能引擎的车型
无法继续生产。

因此，“肯·玛丽”在上市仅四个月后便宣告停产，
最终产量定格在197台。

虽然它从未有机会踏上赛场……

但悲情的命运与稀有的产量，反而成就了
其独特的传奇地位。

conversation.speaker: Chris
conversation.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
conversation.en:
This is the successor to the legendary original Skyline GT-R,
or "Hakosuka," as it was affectionately known in Japan.

This car earned its nickname from an ad campaign featuring a
charming young couple known as “Ken” and “Mary.”

Among Skyline fans, it has forever been remembered by that name
—the “Kenmeri GT-R.”

The Hakosuka rose to prominence in Japanese touring car racing,
earning a fearsome reputation for being unstoppable.

Naturally, the Kenmeri was expected to carry the torch passed
down by its proud predecessor. But fate had other plans.

The 1970s ushered in a new era of strict emissions regulations,
cutting short the Kenmeri’s racing legacy before it began.

Because of these regulations, building cars with high-performance
engines like the GT-R became impossible.

And so, just four months after the Kenmeri went on sale,
production ended, leaving behind only 197 units ever built.

Although it never had a chance to compete in any races...

...its tragic fate and small production run have made
it—in the eyes of enthusiasts—a legend all its own.
,
conversation.zh:
此车是传奇初代天际线GT-R的继承者，
后者在日本被亲切地称为“箱型”……

而本车的昵称则源自一则流行广告，在广告中出现了
一对名为“肯”与“玛丽”的可爱年轻情侣。

因此，在天际线车迷圈中，如今人们都称这款车为
“肯·玛丽GT-R”。

前辈“箱型”在日本房车赛事中声名鹊起，
赢得了不可战胜的美誉。

按理说，“肯·玛丽”本应延续其前辈铸就的辉煌……

然而时运不济，1970年代恰逢严格的排放法规
开始实施的时代。

这些法规导致GT-R这类搭载高性能引擎的车型
无法继续生产。

因此，“肯·玛丽”在上市仅四个月后便宣告停产，
最终产量定格在197台。

虽然它从未有机会踏上赛场……

但悲情的命运与稀有的产量，反而成就了
其独特的传奇地位。

collection.en:
The 1973 Skyline GT-R is often considered almost mythical
because of its extremely low production numbers.

It is nicknamed the "Kenmeri GT-R" in reference to the 'Ken
& Mary' commercials used to promote the C110 Skyline.

The base model is the C110 Skyline that debuted in 1972,
the direct successor to the legendary "Hakosuka" GT-R.

The exact model code of Kenmeri GT-R was "KPGC110,"
and sales began in January 1973.

However, the Kenmeri GT-R was only sold
for three months after its debut.

The emissions regulations introduced at the time stopped
the production of high-performance cars like the GT-R.

It is said that only around 200 cars were produced
in the three months it was available.

In order to focus on environmental issues like exhaust
emissions, Nissan also stopped its motorsports activities...

And because of this, not only did this GT-R
have a short lifespan...

It never had a chance to prove itself in racing,
which was an important part of the Skylne mystique.

As a result, this model is considered the unicorn of GT-Rs
and is highly prized by collectors around the world.
collection.zh:
1973年发售的Skyline GT-R由于产量极少，
因此在世人眼前蒙上了一片神秘的面纱。

它的昵称是“Kenmeri GT-R”，源自C110 Skyline
的“Ken&Mary”系列促销广告。

它的基础车型是发布于1972年的C110 Skyline，
传奇车型“Hakosuka” GT-R的直接继承者。

Kenmeri GT-R准确的车型代码是“KPGC110”，
于1973年1月正式面市。

然而，Kenmeri GT-R的销售仅仅持续了
短短三个月就被叫停。

由于当时出台了更加严格的排放法案
限制了GT-R这类高性能车的存在。

据说在三个月的销售时间内，日产只生产了不到200辆新车。

而且为了解决废气排放等环境问题，
日产还停止了赛车方面的活动……

因此，这辆GT-R不只经历了短暂的量产生涯……

也从未有机会在赛车比赛中证明自己的实力，
这也正是这台Skyline的神秘感来源。

因此，这个车型被视作GT-R中的独角兽，
并
获了全世界的收藏家们的高度评价。

vehicleCollection.en:
Only 197 examples of this GT-R were made before it was discontinued because of stricter emissions standards.

The C10 Skyline, more commonly known as the Hakosuka, was succeeded by an all-new model in September 1972. The new car, designated C110 , came to be known as "Kenmeri" because its commercials featured a couple of models named Ken and Mary. The car was an instant hit, thanks to its attractive styling and excellent performance. The Kenmeri also included the four round headlights that defined previous Skylines.

The top-of-the-line GT-R was added to the Kenmeri lineup in January 1973. This car was designated inhouse as KPGC110, and it came equipped with the same legendary engine as its predecessor, the S20 inline-6. Output remained at 160ps and 18.0kgm of torque, as did the front strut and rear semi-trailing arm suspension, but the new 4-wheel disc brakes were an improvement over the previous model.

The car's dimensions were 4460mm in overall length, with a width of 1695mm and height of 1380mm, not much different than the Hakosuka.

The Kenmeri GT-R should have won many races, but it wasn't able to compete because of stringent emissions regulations. You see, the S20 inline-6 was virtually a pure race engine, which meant it could not adhere to the new emissions laws. So, Nissan made the difficult decision of shelving the Kenmeri after only three months and 197 units produced, without it ever having raced. The GT-R name would lay dormant for another 16 years, until it returned in the form of the R32.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款GT-R只生产了197辆，就因更严格的排放标准而不得不停产。

被车迷们昵称为“Hakosuka”（意为box skyline）的C10 Skyline于1972年9月交棒给了新车型。新的C110得到了取自其宣传广告的昵称“Kenmeri”，在发布后立刻产生了巨大的反响。流体般顺畅的车身省去了所有不必要的线条，只保留了Skyline标志性的侧面轮廓线和4盏圆形车头灯。

GT-R的标识也于次年，即1973年1月回到了这辆Kenmeri上。这台GT-R的车型代码为KPGC110，并采用了同款传奇引擎——S20直列6缸引擎。最大功率160ps、最大扭矩18.0kgm，原汁原味，未作改动。前支撑杆和半拖曳臂后悬挂也和上一款GT-R一样，刹车则与时俱进地换成了新式碟刹。

整车尺寸为长4460mm、宽1695mm、高1380mm，看起来比“Hakosuka”大一号。

如果一切顺利的话，这辆Kenmeri GT-R原本也应该赢下许多系列赛事。但这辆车却不得不先与逐渐严格的排放法规抗争。

作为一台纯粹的跑车引擎，S20无法达到相应的减排要求。所以日产不得不作出了一个艰难的抉择。在仅仅生产了三个月，197辆车后，这辆Kenmeri GT-R就彻底消失了，从未在赛场上亮过相。此后，日产将GT-R的标识雪藏了16年，直到以R32再次宣告回归。

catch.en: Only 197 examples of this GT-R were made before it was discontinued because of stricter emissions standards.
catch.zh: 这款GT-R只生产了197辆，就因更严格的排放标准而不得不停产。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
'The Romance of Minus 21 Seconds'.

That was the advertising slogan for the R33 Skyline GT-R.

In a time trial on the Nürburgring Nordschleife...

It shaved a full 21 seconds off the lap time of its
predecessor, the R32 GT-R.

It was a slogan that reflected all the effort that
had gone into the development of the R33 GT-R.

I think stories like that really add to this car's value.
dialogues.zh:
缩短了21秒的浪漫”。

这是R33 Skyline GT-R广告口号。

在纽博格林北侧赛道的一次计时赛中，

R33 Skyline GT-R将前辈车型R32 GT-R的单圈成绩消掉了
整整21秒。

这条口号也反映出了Nissan为研发R33 GT-R所做的所有
投入。

我认为正是这样的故事让R33 GT-R这款车更有价值。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
You know, the R33 GT-R always reminds me of Le Mans in 1995.

At the time, regulations prevented cars from entering if
a four-door version existed in the lineup.

So, Nissan developed a special 2-door “NISMO GT-R LM."

It was registered in the U.K. to meet homologation requirements.

And Nissan succeeded in entering the car at Le Mans.

It showed just how determined team manager, Kozo Watanabe was...

...to see the GT-R compete in the race.
dialogues.zh:
说起R33 GT-R，总是让我想起
1995年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。

因为当时的勒芒规则明确规定：
若某车系拥有四门版本，则其赛车不得参赛。

为此，Nissan特别打造了一辆双门版的Nissan NISMO GT-R LM，

在英国注册并通过了赛事认证，

这才成功将这辆车送上了勒芒的起跑线。

由此可见，这辆GT-R的研发主管渡边衡三

让其参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的意愿是何等强烈！

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
The Skyline GT-R is an icon of the
Japanese automotive industry.

But there may be no other car in Japan
where its history and tradition...

...weighs so heavily on a designer.

In that respect, designing a GT-R today is not so different
than designing a Porsche or a Ferrari.

Back when this R33 was built, a normal mid-size sporty sedan
was the base.

So there was probably a lot of difficulties in its design.

Based on a three-box shape, the 4-seat production car...

...strictly adhered to its underlying philosophy
as a "Wolf in Sheep's Clothing."

Also, because the beginning of the R33 development overlapped
with the tail end of the economic bubble in Japan...

...the body of the R33 was large, heavy, and its style
was stocky, but it was elegant in overall style.
dialogues.zh:
Skyline GT-R品牌是日本汽车工业的一个标志。

但也没有哪辆日本汽车的历史和传统会像这辆车一般……

对设计师产生如此大的压力。

有鉴于此，设计一辆GT-R的压力其实无异于设计一辆
保时捷或法拉利。

这辆R33在设计时以普通的中型运动型轿车为基础……

遇到很多设计上的难题也就无可避免。

在对这台四座三厢量产车进行改造时，

基本的理念是打造出了一匹“披着羊皮的狼”。

而且，由于R33的开发初期正好撞上了日本经济泡沫的
尾声，

因此，R33的车身既大且重，但气度优雅，与当时的时代
背景相吻合。

handling machine than the R32.

Credit here goes to the R33's longer body.

I mean, just look at the wheelbase. It's more than 100mm
longer than that of the R32.

on a race track.

as the R32 V-Spec.

system to make it behave as neutrally as possible.

除此之外，这辆V-spec版不像R32那样容易遇到
转向不足的情况。

毕竟，这辆车还搭载了先进的ATTESA E-TS
四轮驱动系统。

vehicleCollection.en:
This top-of-the-line GT-R R33 included the ATTESA ET-S Pro high-performance all-wheel drive system.

When the new ninth-generation SKYLINE sedan, the R33, was introduced in August 1993, one model was conspicuously missing from the lineup: the GT-R. The R32 GT-R was still being sold at dealerships (all the way through November 1994), and Nissan engineers were working overtime to create a car that surpassed the R32. The car was finally unveiled at the 1993 Tokyo Motor Show, but fans still had to wait until January 1995 for it to hit dealerships.

Many had their doubts whether the R33 could surpass the awesome performance standards set by the R32, but it not only met everyone’s expectations, it surpassed them, proving this in a television commercial called “Minus 21-second Dream.” It showed the R33 running the famed Nürburgring race course 21 seconds faster than the R32.

Under the R33’s hood, which was now made of aluminum along with the front fenders, sat the RB26DETT, but this one was more refined. It pumped out a whopping 280 ps at 6800 rpm and 38.2 kgm of torque at 4400 rpm. Gear selection was performed through a 5-speed manual gearbox that sent power to all four wheels via Nissan’s ATTESA E-TS all-wheel-drive system. Also included in the handling mix was an active LSD, strut-tower bar and powerful ABS-equipped Brembo brakes.

To commemorate its entrance in the famed 24 Hours of Le Mans race, the LM Limited was introduced in 1996.
vehicleCollection.zh:
R33 GT-R的顶级车型，搭载ATTESA E-TS Pro系统。

1993年8月，SKYLINE系列进化为第九代R33。然而，R32 GT-R一直持续到1994年11月才停产。R33 GT-R作为原型车在1993年秋季东京车展上展出，但直到1995年1月才正式亮相。

R32 GT-R是一款历史上赫赫有名的传奇车型，每个人都在怀疑R33 GT-R是否能够超过R32。日产在他们著名的电视广告《减掉21秒的梦》中用实际、客观的数据打消了所有的疑问。R33在德国纽博格林赛道上的单圈成绩比R32缩短了整整21秒。

R33 GT-R的理念是“终极的驾驶乐趣”。引擎再次采用了RB26DETT，这台引擎早在其第一代时就已经成为传奇。通过对控制CPU进行改进，提升增压压力，在极端操控范围内的扭矩和响应能力得到提升，使得高速状态下的性能也得到相应改善。

革命性的Attesa E-TS四轮驱动系统在进化后使得从前到后的扭矩分配更接近前置后驱，提高了转弯时的可控性。系列中加入了代表车款V·spec，采用了性能更强大的Attesa E-TS Pro系统。为了提高车身的刚度，车头和车尾都加装了支撑杆。引擎盖和前翼均更换为铝材，从而减轻了车身重量。

为了纪念勒芒耐力赛参赛，1996年，GT-R还发行了LM限量版。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Of all the Nissan Skyline GT-Rs, this R32 stands out
as truly special.

From the late 1960s to the early 1970s, the Skyline seemed
unstoppable on the Japanese race circuit.

However, Nissan halted production of the Skyline GT-R
in response to the 1973 oil crisis.

In 1989, the GT-R name was revived with this
R32 Skyline GT-R.

Nissan poured all of its technical know-how into
its development.

The hard work paid off, as the R32 dominated the competition
from the get-go, winning the hearts of motorsport fans.

I can only imagine that its value will continue to increase
over time.
dialogues.zh:
在日产Skyline GT-R系列车型中，这款R32
脱颖而出，成为一代变革之作！

从20世纪60年代末到70年代初，Skyline在日本赛道上
大杀四方，几乎势不可挡。

然而，为应对1973年的石油危机，日产中断了
该车型的生产。

1989年，GT-R这个代号因这款R32 Skyline GT-R车型
而再次响亮于赛场之上。

日产在研发这款车型时倾注了其
所有的技术积累。

辛勤努力最终有了回报，R32一出现就称霸了
整个赛场，赢得了众多赛车铁杆粉的青睐。

我推测，随着时间的累积
这款车将持续升值。

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
You know, I used to drive my friend's
PGC10 GT-R a lot.

That’s what got me into sports sedans, which I consider to be
a "wolf in sheep’s clothing".

Now, this here is the model that set the basic formula
for the modern GT-R.

At first glance, it evokes a clear sense of volume.

And by weighing down the rear fender, the designers
made the car look like it was in motion even when standing still.

This allowed the GT-R to strike a more aggressive stance
than the base GT model.

Also...

...it marked the beginning of the era of sensor-controlled
vehicle dynamics and other high-performance technologies.

All of this makes the current GT-R the rightful heir
to this R32 GTR.
dialogues.zh:
我过去常常开我朋友的PGC10 GT-R，所以对它非常熟悉。

运动型轿车给人一种“披着羊皮的狼”的感觉，
这正是这种车型最吸引我的地方。

我现在要介绍的这款车为现代GT-R确立了基本范式。

首先，它表现出一种清晰的体积感。

然后，设计师通过压低后挡板的重心，
让此车有一种蹲伏起跑、跃跃欲试的感觉。

从而赋予了GT-R超越GT的定位。

此外……

从这个型号开始，由传感器来控制车辆动力
和其他高性能附加套件的时代揭开了序幕。

这一切都足以证明这台R32 GT-R正是当代GT-R系列的鼻祖。

This third-generation GT-R Skyline played a lead role

vehicleCollection.en:
This unique R32 GT-R came fitted with 17-inch BBS wheels, Brembo brakes and 45-series tires.

On August 21, 1989, after a 16-year hiatus following the legendary "Kenmeri" GT-R, the iconic GT-R badge made its triumphant return as part of the eighth-generation Skyline series.

Powering the car was the freshly developed RB26DETT, a twin-turbocharged 2.6-liter DOHC inline-6. Equipped with ceramic turbochargers, the engine delivered 280ps and 36.0kgm of torque, while being packed with motorsports-bred technology, including six individual throttle bodies, sodium-filled exhaust valves, and a reinforced cylinder block. The drivetrain featured the groundbreaking ATTESA E-TS system—an electronically controlled, torque-split 4WD system engineered with a clear focus on one goal: enhancing cornering performance.

The suspension employed Nissan’s unique multilink setup at both the front and rear, working in harmony with the brand’s Super HICAS 4-wheel steering system. Aluminum calipers were introduced to the braking system, with 4-pot opposing pistons in front and 2-pot opposing pistons at the rear.

Nissan resurrected the GT-R name with one clear mission: to dominate Group A racing. After pouring its cutting-edge technology into this machine, it became an unstoppable force on the circuit, going on to win race after race.

The company introduced several special variants that pushed the GT-R’s performance even further. This included the limited-edition Nismo model, followed later by the V·Spec and V·Spec II.
vehicleCollection.zh:
配备了布雷博刹车和45小尺寸轮胎的特殊R32 GT-R。

1989年8月21日，在“肯·玛丽”GT-R停产16年后，GT-R这个令人期待已久的名字再次出现在第八代天际线系列中。

这款车使用新开发的2.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列6缸双涡轮增压引擎RB26DETT。这款采用陶瓷双涡轮的引擎能够产生280ps的动力和36.0kgm的扭矩，并且大量应用赛车技术，包括6个互联的节流阀体、钠填充排气阀和强化缸体。传动系统包括了革命性的ATTESA E-TS系统——电控扭矩分配4轮驱动系统，着重满足“让车辆实现轻松转向”的需求。

前后悬挂均采用日产独特的多连杆布局，并与该公司的Super HICAS 4轮转向技术相辅相成。刹车采用铝制卡钳，前轮采用对置4活塞卡钳，后轮则采用对置2活塞卡钳。

相隔16年，GT-R重新归来，志在取得A组别冠军，日产将当时拥有的所有技术都倾注在GT-R上。而这款车也不负众望，因连续赢得众多比赛而扬名天下，成为赛车场上不败的传奇。

除了后来上市的限量版NISMO外，GT-R又推出了V·spec和V·spec II车款，在性能上更进一步。

前后悬挂均采用日产独特的多连杆布局，并与该公司的Super HICAS 4轮转向技术相辅相成。刹车采用铝制卡钳，前轮采用对置4活塞卡钳，后轮则采用对置2活塞卡钳。

相隔16年，GT-R重新归来，志在取得A组别冠军，日产将当时拥有的所有技术都倾注在GT-R上。而这款车也不负众望，因连续赢得众多比赛而扬名天下，成为赛车场上不败的传奇。

除了后来上市的限量版NISMO外，GT-R又推出了V·spec和V·spec II车款，在性能上更进一步。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
The Nissan Skyline GT-R is the quintessential
Japanese sports car.

Among its many iterations, this R34
is particularly popular.

Not only does it sport the famed RB26DETT engine,
but it was also the final version of the model.

This limited-edition final production model...

...called the V-Spec II Nür features an extremely
balanced engine.

It remains one of the crown jewel of all Skyline GT-Rs.
dialogues.zh:
Nissan Skyline GT-R是日本跑车的代表作。

在这个车系众多的车型中，R34型尤其受欢迎。

这辆车不仅搭载了一台备受赞誉的RB26DETT引擎，
它还是这款车的终极形态……

一辆限量版最终生产型……

这辆V·Spec II Nür不仅引擎更加平衡……

它更是被视作Skyline GT-R皇冠上的明珠。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
The fifth-generation Skyline GT-R went by the codename R34.

The man responsible for its development was
Kozo Watanabe.

A graduate of Tokyo University, Watanabe earned
a degree in automotive engineering.

The R34 was his follow-up to the R33.

A longtime admirer of race car development...

Watanabe wanted to go to Britain to develop Formula 1 cars.

But fate ialised and he began working for Nissan,
which was then racing the R380 and the R381.

When Watanabe was tasked with developing the R33
Skyline GT-R...

...he swore he'd build a car that would exceed the speed
of the R32.

It turned out, he kept his word. On a test run, the R33
set a lap time of 7:59 at the Nürburgring!

This time was 21 seconds faster than the fastest lap
set by the R32.

The R33 then led to the R34, śhich carried on the
spirit of its predecessor.
dialogues.zh:
这辆R34是第五代的Skyline GT-R。

这辆车的设计者是渡边衡三。

他毕业于东大汽车工程系。

R34是R33的后继车型。

渡边早对赛车开发早就心痒不已……

他本想前往英国去设计F1赛车。

由于这个目标未能实现，他进入了
当时正在使用R380和R381竞赛的日产工作。

当渡边接到了设计Skyline GT-R R33的任务时……

他曾发誓要造一辆比R32更快的车。

您猜怎么着？在试跑时，R33在纽博格林赛道上
跑出了7:59的单圈时间！

比R32的记录快了21秒。

当然了，它的后继者R34身上也继承了这种精神。

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
This car brings back the spirit of the original Skyline GT-R.

When you compare this car to the R33, the overall design has
become compact and solid.

Looking at the abruptly cut-off front end, you get a sense of
a modernized version of the C10 "Hakosuka."

The side glass graphics at the C-pillar
are also reminiscent of the C10.

You can say that the different front and rear overfenders
are take from the Hakosuka, too.

And while the enlarged round taillights are an homage to the
C110, dubbed the "Ken-Meri..."

...this car is characterized by an uncommon Japanese design
that's simple and powerful.

It's undeniable that the Nissan designers wanted to express
the story of the Skyline GT-R through this car.

After all, the growth of a brand stems from love.*
dialogues.zh:
这辆车再现了原版Skyline GT-R的风采。

与R33相比，它显得紧凑而又结实。

修整过的车头仿佛是C10 “Hakosuka”的
现代版诠释……

C柱处的侧窗玻璃贴花是如此，

甚至连前后不同尺寸的挡泥板也与C10有着深厚的渊源。

那对又大又圆的尾灯
则是对绰号“Ken-Meri”的C110的致敬……

其简约而有力的设计是在日本车中十分罕见的。

毫无疑问，日产的设计师希望通过这款车
展现出Skyline GT-R的背景故事。

我只能说，这绝对是真爱了。@

The V-Spec II Nür was the last version of the
Skyline GT-R (R34) that Nissan produced.

It featured an improved L6 twin-turbo RB26DETT engine
that delivered better responsiveness and torque.

This ultra-rare model had an extremely limited

This means that it's already a collector's item,

V-Spec II Nür是Nissan所生产的Skyline GT-R的最后一款车型。

此车采用了改进版本的L6双涡轮增压RB26DETT引擎，提高了动
力响应和扭矩。

这款超稀有的车型产量极其有限……

因此对于任何汽车爱好者而言，此车都很有收藏价值！

This final and limited edition R34 GT-R was dubbed the

The name derives from the Nürburgring track where the GT-R

For this model, the engine's components were upgraded
to achieve higher performance than its predecessors.

Only 1000 of these priceless variant R34 GT-Rs were
constructed in the line's final production year.

R34 GT-R的最终限量版，
型号名为“V-Spec II Nür”。

这个名字的由来是用于开发GT-R的
纽博格林赛道。

为了达到比前代更加优异的性能，
该款车型的引擎部件得到了专门升级。

在该款车型生产线运作的最后一年里，
这款珍贵的R34只有1000辆被生产出来。

vehicleCollection.en:
A limited-edition model signifying the end of production, the "Nür" stands for Nürburgring, where the car was developed.

The much anticipated R34 was unveiled in January 1999, armed with a total new approach to styling and technology. The new GT-R was a bit smaller than its predecessor, with a slightly shortened overall length and wheelbase. The new chassis, whose structural rigidity was increased dramatically, made for a car more adept through tight corners. The R34’s exterior styling was based on form over function with all the elements designed to help the car’s aerodynamics, including providing massive amounts of downforce at high speed.

For the engine, the RB26DETT saw significant improvements, including the refinement of the ceramic turbocharger that generated less friction. The 2.6-liter inline-6 was more efficient than before and produced more torque, rated at 40.0 kgm. Horsepower remained level at 280 ps, the maximum allowed for JDM cars at the time. The ATTESA-E-TS all-wheel-drive system efficiently managed torque between the four wheels. The R34’s steering system was also tweaked to exhibit more sharpness.

The high-performance V-spec model featured an active LSD (Limited-Slip Differential). The V-spec II, introduced in October 2002, got a carbon-fiber hood with NACA ducts. A better riding version of the GT-R arrived in May 2001 in the form of the M-spec.

As a final hurrah for the R34, in January 2002, Nissan unveiled the most potent GT-R ever, the Nür, whose name was derived from the famous Nürburgring race course in Germany.
vehicleCollection.zh:
以研发地为名；限量版V Spec II，为纪念停产推出。

R34 GT-R车款于1999年1月首次亮相。相比于更大一些的R33，R34的车身作了调整，长度缩短了75mm，轴距也缩短了55mm。车体刚度得到了最大程度的加强，先进的空气动力学设计同时保证了冷却和下压力的表现。

引擎仍然是R32原先所采用的RB26DETT，但作出了进一步的优化，增大了扭矩，提升了响应速度，并减轻了重量。陶瓷涡轮的降低摩擦的效果显著，最大扭矩终于达到了#40kgm大关。

底盘性能也得到大幅提升，从而对车辆实现更精确的操控。由ATTESA E-TS Pro控制的驱动分配系统便于车辆进行迅速转向。转向时甚至不再有4轮驱动的感受。哪怕与传奇的R32相比，这样的操控表现都能给人以领先一个时代的感觉。

高性能的V-spec版本是首款采用碳纤维后扰流翼以产生下压力的量产车，并且标配主动式限滑差速器。这款V-spce版本在2000年10月得到了进一步强化，升级为V-spec II，配备了带NACA进气口的碳纤维引擎盖。2001年5月，高舒适度的M-spec版本上市，主要参考了勒芒赛车的悬挂配置。

2002年1月，限量版的Nür版（以德国纽博格林赛道命名）亮相。这款车是配备N1规格RB26DETT引擎的特别版车款。由于新的排放规定发布，曾改变跑车世界的第二代GT-R系列的历史在此款车型之后宣告终结。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
This is one of my favourite Skylines—the R31, and a Group A
homologation GTS-R no less!

Who could forget its performance at the Japanese Touring Car
Championship, Japan’s top touring car event of the 1980s?

It's no doubt best known for its performance
in the 1989 JTC series.

It was this year that saw three Skyline GTS-Rs competing...

of which Masahiro Hasemi and Anders Olofsson’s
No. 50 car won three of six races!

What a way to win the series title!

And the way it stood up to those mighty European cars—
how cool is that!
dialogues.zh:
这是我最爱的一辆Skyline——R31，而且这辆GTS-R
还获得了A组别认证！

它在1980年代日本顶级房车赛事——日本房车锦标赛上
的优异表现实在让人过目难忘！

它最亮眼的一次表现无疑是在1989年日本房车锦标赛系列赛上。

就在这一年，三辆Skyline GTS-R在比赛中同台竞技……

其中长谷见昌弘和安德斯·奥洛夫松驾驶的50号赛车
赢下了六场比赛中的半数！

这是多么震撼人心的夺冠过程啊！

更不必说它勇敢挑战那些强大欧洲赛车的英姿——
真是太酷了！

它最亮眼的一次表现无疑是在1989年日本房车锦标赛系列赛上。

就在这一年，三辆Skyline GTS-R在比赛中同台竞技……

其中长谷见昌弘和安德斯·奥洛夫松驾驶的50号赛车
赢下了六场比赛中的半数！

这是多么震撼人心的夺冠过程啊！

更不必说它勇敢挑战那些强大欧洲赛车的英姿——
真是太酷了！

usedCar.en:
The R31, introduced in 1985, represented the seventh-generation of the
Nissan Skyline Brand.

The most superior version was the GTS-R that was introduced in 1987.

Built to win the Japanese Touring Car Championship (JTC),
Japan’s top touring car event at the time...

...It was a homologation model developed in accordance
with international Group A regulations.

Under the hood, Nissan added a new turbocharger to the GTS base
models' 2.0-liter inline-6.

Exterior tweaks included a large rear spoiler, along with other
aerodynamic equipment.

This R31 Skyline GTS-R had a limited production run
of about 800 units.

So, it should come as no surprise that this model has
become a true collector's item of the famous Skyline serie
usedCar.zh:
1985年亮相的“R31”标志着Nissan的Skyline品牌迈入
第7代……

而产品阵容中的终极版本就是1987年推出的GTS-R。

这辆车是专门为了当时日本最顶级的房车赛事——
日本房车锦标赛（JTC）……

按照国际A组别规则所打造的认证车型。

在引擎盖下，它在基础车型GTS原本的2升直列六缸引擎上
又添加了一部涡轮增压器……

而在外观上，它的车尾添加了一部大尺寸尾翼，
车身上也多了不少空气动力学部件。

这辆R31 Skyline GTS-R仅限量生产了800余辆。

如此鲜少得见的车型，自然成了历史悠久的Skyline车系
中真正受到收藏家觊觎的车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
An unlikely monster machine born from the elegant lines of the seventh-generation Skyline.

Despite retaining the sporty appeal of the previous generation R30, the seventh-generation R31, when it was released in August 1985, marked a change of direction for the Skyline brand line. The Japanese car scene at the time saw a growing trend in luxurious "high-society cars." In response to this cultural boom, Nissan repositioned the Skyline as a luxury sedan.

When the car was introduced, the only variants available were a sedan and an estate. Not until May 1986 was the coupe model offered.

But the real star of the seventh-generation Skyline arrived in August 1987, when Nissan unveiled the GTS-R. Only 800 cars were made available, and the car's true raison d'etre was to reclaim the Group A racing title for Nissan.

The powerplant was based on the turbocharged RB20DET DOHC inline-6 featured in the GTS, which generated 180ps and 23.0kgm of torque. The GTS-R version added a stainless-steel exhaust manifold and a T04E turbocharger, resulting in 210ps and 25.0kgm of torque. This was a very special engine, earning itself the designation RB20DET-R.

The suspension and exterior of the car were also modified. While the normal GTS-X possessed an automatic front spoiler that deployed according to vehicle speed, the GTS-R instead had a fixed spoiler, with the rear spoiler also being upgraded to a larger version. And the car was offered in an exclusive Blue Black exterior.

Group A machines based on this GTS-R shined on the race track. The Reebok Skyline won three races in the Japan Touring Car Championship in 1989, taking home the series title. However, the GTS-R name sparked a fervent debate among fans, who wondered why it was not called a GT-R. The answer would be revealed in the form of the R32 Skyline GT-R, which was introduced two years after the release of the GTS-R.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆不可思议的怪物赛车脱胎于拥有优雅外形的第7代Skyline。+

尽管保留了前代R30那极富运动感的外观，1985年8月推出的第7代R31 Skyline却标志着该产品线开发方向的转变。在当时的日本汽车界，4门或2门豪华配置“高级轿车”的销量和大众流行度都呈上升的趋势。为了迎合这个文化热潮，Skyline的定位也调整为了豪华轿车。

在首发时，Skyline仅推出了几个较为保守的版本，包括一款4门硬顶、一款轿车和一款旅行车。车迷们一直等到1986年5月才迎来了万众期待的2门轿跑版本。

第7代Skyline真正的重磅车型更是姗姗来迟——那就是1987年8月推出、全球限量生产800辆的GTS-R。GTS-R的开发目标是为了夺回A组别比赛的桂冠，因此是一款极致运动的车型。

其动力核心基于GTS所采用的涡轮增压RB20DET双顶置凸轮轴直列6缸引擎，这款基础版本引擎可以产生180ps的动力和23.0kgm的扭矩，而GTS-R版本引擎换上了不锈钢排气管和一部T04E涡轮增压器，可以产生210ps的动力和25.0kgm的扭矩。这部特殊的引擎最终被命名为RB20DET-R。

其悬挂系统和车身外形也得到了改进。基本款的GTS-X车型采用自动前扰流翼，可以根据车速自动部署，在GTS-R车型中则改为固定版本，另外尾翼的尺寸也得到升级，变得更大。此外，这款车还采用了专属的“蓝黑”车身配色。

基于这款GTS-R打造的A组别赛车在比赛中拿出了异常优秀的战绩。在1989年，Reebok Skyline赛车在全日本房车锦标赛中拿下了3场比赛胜利，并最终赢得了系列赛冠军。不过这款GTS-R也在车迷群体中引发了热议，大家都不明白为何不将其纳入GT-R产品线中。这个问题的答案在GTS-R推出的两年后才得到揭晓——R32 Skyline GT-R闪R登场。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
When I hear the name Skyline GT-R, I immediately think of
racing champions!

So, it probably goes without saying that I’m also a big fan
of the Prince-era Skyline GT, the forefather of the GT-R.

This Nissan Skyline GT-R, affectionately known as the "Hakosuka,"
carried the torch passed down from the formidable Skyline GT.

It made its debut at the 1969 JAF Grand Prix,
held at the legendary Fuji Speedway...

...where it didn’t just win,
it made a statement.

From that first race, it racked up 49 consecutive victories
through to December 1971!
dialogues.zh:
当我听到“Skyline GT-R”这个名字，我条件反射般地
想到了这四个字：赛车冠军！

理所当然，我也是GT-R的前身，Prince时代
的Skyline GT的狂热车迷。

这辆“Nissan Skyline GT-R”，也被称作“Hakosuka”，
继承了所向披靡的Skyline GT的衣钵。

它于1969年在传奇的富士赛道上举办的
JAF大奖赛上首次亮相。

它不只在这条赛道上初战告捷，此后还连战连胜……

最终到1971年12月为止，取得了
举世闻名的49连胜的战绩！

dialogues.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
dialogues.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官
dialogues.en:
This is the original GT-R, a sports coupe
Japan proudly offered to the world in the 1960s.

It has the famous "Surfin' Line" as the disctinct design feature,
but the other parts are also well executed.

Despite being passenger car-based, its proportions are rather
sporty, and the main design theme is powerful yet simple.

It's an excellent design with a bit of American-car flavor, from
the solid door sections to the overall sense of volume.

But it does lack the four round taillights.

When we were designing the R35 GT-R, we were, of course,
inspired by the Hakosuka's overall ambience and details.

In truth, a key thing about traditional GT-Rs is that they
aren’t fastbacks, but are shaped by the C Pillar.

At first glance, the R35 may look like a fastback...

...but you'll notice that when compared to the KPGC,
the window line of the Pillar is set at the same angle.
dialogues.zh:
这辆初代GT-R是日本在1960年代
呈现给全世界的骄傲——一台双门跑车。

久负盛名的“冲浪线条”是它的专属特色。
当然，其他部位的设计也同样可圈可点。

首先，原车型的定位是轿车，但GT-R将车身比例改得更偏向运动。
其主要的设计主旨就是“简单但性能强大”。

从方正、结实的车门到整车的廓形，
这款杰出的设计里
多少带着一些美国车的影子。

唯一缺少的，是后续车型中加入的四盏标志性圆形车尾灯。

我们在设计R35 GT-R的时候，从Hakosuka的
整体氛围和细节上汲取了不少灵感。

事实上，有个重要设计点值得一提——GT-R并没有采用溜背设计，
溜背的视觉效果来自于直接与下部车身相接的C柱。

粗看之下，R35很像是一台溜背车……

…但与KPGC进行比较之后你就会发现
两者C柱窗户的线条呈现的角度其实是一模一样的。

collection.en:
The "Hakosuka" Skyline has become a cult classic for
Japanese car enthusiasts.

Of the various models, this 2-door hardtop GT-R,
known by its model number, KPGC10, stands out.

This car remains on the most-wanted list for many collectors.

Among the car's many charms was its engine.

It was the direct descendent of the high-performance engine
in Japan’s first prototype race car, the Prince R380.

Fewer than 1200 KPGC10s coupes were produced. Including
the 4-door models, the total is still only around 2000 cars.

This car made a name for itself by winning 49 consecutive races
in the Japanese Touring Car Championship.

Owning it means owning a piece of that
incredible history.
collection.zh:
轮廓分明的“Hakosuka” Skyline在全世界都
有着无数拥趸。

其中，这辆双门硬顶GT-R，
因其型号KPGC10而闻名于世……

至今令全世界的收藏家们趋之若鹜。

引擎是它众多的魅力之一……

该引擎是日本首辆赛车原型车，
Prince R380上的高性能赛车引擎的直接继承者。

KPGC10总共只生产了不到1200辆，算上四门版也只有2000辆左右。

这还是一台在日本房车锦标赛中连续取得
49胜的历史传奇赛车。

拥有了它，就如同拥有了那段不可思议的历史。

vehicleCollection.en:
This car, dubbed the "Hako-Suka," became a legend after winning 50 races in a row.

This GT-R, added to the Skyline (C10) line on February 1969, kick-started the glorious history of the brand, a few years after Nissan had taken over Prince Motors.

The car has since become a classic, going by the nickname "Hako-suka," which in Japanese means "box" and a shortened form of Skyline (suka-i-ra-in)," an obvious reference to its boxy overall body style.

Equipped with the S20 engine, a twin-cam inline-6 that was lifted from the famed R380 race car, the sporty GT-R model was made primarily for competition.

In fact, it was said that only the most skilled technician could perfectly adjust the high-tech valves and three carburetors to maximize the engine's potential. When it was tuned just right, the S20 had few equals, allowing the C10 Skyline GT-R to leave most of its rivals in the dust. The car also possessed excellent handling, thanks to its stable suspension system, with struts up front and a semi-trailing arm setup at rear.

The race version of the car was as dominant as there ever was. With famous drivers such as Moto Kitano and Kunimitsu Takahashi behind the wheel, the competition GT-R racked up 50 consecutive wins, making it one of the most successful race cars in history.
vehicleCollection.zh:
Skyline传奇的开启者。连续赢得50场比赛的传奇Hakosuka（Box Skyline）。

1969年2月，GT-R被加入到了Skyline C10的产品线中，奠定了Skyline通往辉煌的第一步。

GT-R获得的是一台双凸轮6缸引擎，每缸拥有4气门。这款S20引擎取自著名的R380，后者是一台在世界速度记录和日本大奖赛里都留下了浓墨重彩的车型。虽然制造这款引擎的王子汽车公司已经被日产兼并，但引擎本身依旧闪耀，光彩夺目。

四门轿车版本的GT-R和硬顶敞篷版的GT-R都延续了Ska-G传统的长车头，但后档泥板上令人耳目一新的柔和线条并没得到GT-R的青睐。为了容纳更大号的轮胎，车身的优雅线条直接被轮拱罩切断。

原因很简单，GT-R从不以花哨闻名，而是凭借创造赛事纪录来打响名声。代表追浜厂队的GT-R在北野基和高桥国光等著名车手的驾驭下，在富士和铃鹿赛道上风驰电掣，连续赢得50场比赛，一举铸就传奇。

另一方面，GT-R那台拥有每缸4个气门、3个化油器、双凸轮结构的高科技引擎总是很难调试到完美状态。据传闻，一般用户几乎没有可能在公路上享受到这台引擎带来的全部卓越性能。

尽管如此，只要GT-R咆哮出金属般的轰鸣声，就能轻而易举地让所有对手从后视镜里消失，一骑绝尘而去。它那久经考验的前支撑杆和半拖曳臂后悬挂也与引擎动力达成了极佳的平衡。

catch.en: This car, dubbed the "Hako-Suka," became a legend after winning 50 races in a row.
catch.zh: Skyline传奇的开启者。连续赢得50场比赛的传奇Hakosuka（Box Skyline）。

long.en:
This GT-R, added to the Skyline (C10) line on February 1969, kick-started the glorious history of the brand, a few years after Nissan had taken over Prince Motors.

The car has since become a classic, going by the nickname "Hako-suka," which in Japanese means "box" and a shortened form of Skyline (suka-i-ra-in)," an obvious reference to its boxy overall body style.

Equipped with the S20 engine, a twin-cam inline-6 that was lifted from the famed R380 race car, the sporty GT-R model was made primarily for competition.

In fact, it was said that only the most skilled technician could perfectly adjust the high-tech valves and three carburetors to maximize the engine's potential. When it was tuned just right, the S20 had few equals, allowing the C10 Skyline GT-R to leave most of its rivals in the dust. The car also possessed excellent handling, thanks to its stable suspension system, with struts up front and a semi-trailing arm setup at rear.

The race version of the car was as dominant as there ever was. With famous drivers such as Moto Kitano and Kunimitsu Takahashi behind the wheel, the competition GT-R racked up 50 consecutive wins, making it one of the most successful race cars in history.

collection.en:
Have you ever heard of the 'Fuji Grand Champion Race'?
It was really popular in Japan during the 1980s.

If you've heard of the race before...

You probably know about the 'Super Silhouette' race cars
that competed in the opening races for those events.

The Super Silhouette races were hosted under the
Group 5 regulations of the time.

While the exteriors of the cars maintained the look of
a production model...

On the inside they were purebred racing cars
developed for competition.

This Nissan Skyline Super Silhouette proved to be
the most popular car in the series.

Famous for its flaming side-exit exhaust, it is an iconic
car that is still fondly remembered by many fans.
collection.zh:
您听说过“富士大冠军赛”吗？
如果您听说过，

这是20世纪80年代风靡日本的赛事

你可能也听说过参加开幕式比赛的“Super Silhouette”赛车的故事。

“Super Silhouette”比赛采用的是第5组别规则，

参赛车辆虽然保持了量产车的外观，

但内部已经变成了专为比赛开发的纯粹赛车。

我们的这一台叫做日产“Skyline Super Silhouette”，
是系列赛中最受欢迎的车。

因其侧面的排气管会喷出波浪形火焰而闻名全国，
至今仍有许多车迷对这台标志性的名车记忆犹新。

vehicleCollection.en:
An extraordinary Skyline that stood out in races of the 1980s)

The Hakosuka GT-R, which gets its nickname from "Hako" (square) and "Suka" (Skyline), took Japanese motorsports by storm and ended its illustrious career in 1972. But the legend of the Skyline refused to die, and fans continued to hope for its return many years after.

Their hopes became reality in 1982 when Nissan created a Silhouette Formula car based on the sixth-generation Skyline 2000RS, powered by a 4-valve DOHC engine that had not been in the lineup since the "Kenmeri" GT-R. (Ken Meri was a nickname that came from the car's commercials.) This was the Skyline Super Silhouette.

The Super Silhouette racecars were pure race cars that maintained the silhouette of production models. These cars were active in the Fuji Super Silhouette Series, which began as the supporting race for the Fuji Grand Champion Races in 1979, but the Silhouette Series soon became more popular than the main Grand Champion event.

The Skyline Super Silhouette is one of the most iconic cars from this series, with a look that is far from ordinary, to say the least. Sporting a chin spoiler that extends far forward of the car that nearly scrapes the tarmac, it also had fenders expanded to extreme levels at both the front and rear and a large rear wing. It came powered by a turbocharged 2.1-liter 4-cylinder race engine called the LZ20B. It often spit flames out of its exhaust, which was located just below the left door, making it an awesome presence on the track, completely mesmerizing car enthusiasts and race fans.

In the hands of legendary driver Masahiro Hasemi, it competed in the 1982 to 1984 seasons with eight wins to its credit. Because of regulation changes, it was active for three seasons, accounting for 19 races. People still refer to this car as the "extraordinary" Skyline, and it is still fondly remembered to this day.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一辆超凡卓绝的Skyline，在1980年代的赛事中脱颖而出

这辆“Hakosuka”（square-Skyline的简称）GT-R曾经席卷了整个日本赛车运动领域，直到1972年才结束它光辉灿烂的生涯。但在那之后的许多年里，Skyline的传奇依旧在延续，而粉丝们也一直期盼着这款车能够回归赛道。

日产在1982年基于第6代Skyline “2000RS”打造了一辆Silhouette Formula赛车，让大家终于梦想成真。这辆车由一部4阀门双顶置凸轮轴引擎提供动力，这也是这款引擎自从“Kenmeri”（绰号来源于Ken&Mary广告）GT-R后再次得到使用。它被命名为Skyline Super Silhouette。

作为一款保留了量产型号外形的纯种赛车，这款“super silhouette”赛车首先在1979年参加了富士冠军系列赛的垫赛“富士Super Silhouette系列赛”。没过多久，垫赛的人气反而超过了主赛事。

这辆Skyline Super Silhouette也因为其别具一格的外观而成为了系列赛事中最具标志性的赛车之一：努力前探的宽大扰流板前唇低的几乎要铲到路面，前后轮的挡泥板也拓宽到了极限，外加一部巨大的尾翼。在安装了型号为LZ20B的2.1升4缸涡轮增压赛车引擎后，左侧车门下方的排气管中常常能喷出火焰，在赛道上显得尤其抢眼，也让当时的赛车迷和汽车爱好者们都为之疯狂。

在传奇车手长谷见昌弘的驾驭下，这辆车参加了1982到1984赛季的角逐，并将8场胜利收入囊中。由于规则更改，它只活跃了3个赛季，参加了19轮的比赛。不过，这辆“超凡卓绝”的Skyline还是在人们心中留下了无数美好的回忆。

catch.en: An extraordinary Skyline that stood out in races of the 1980s)
catch.zh: 一辆超凡卓绝的Skyline，在1980年代的赛事中脱颖而出

brandCentral.en:
This is the latest entry in Nissan's world-famous
Z-car range.

There have been seven generations of Z-cars over the years.

The first ones went on sale in 1969, meaning the range has
over half a century of history.

They're now some of the world's best-known sports cars!

The latest model includes many features from the first
generation, such as the long nose and the short deck.

What's more, it retains the classic Z-car FR layout.

The engine is Nissan's very latest turbo unit—the 3L V6 twin
turbo VR30DTT.

It's also benefitted from some specialist tuning, improving
its power and also its throttle response..
brandCentral.zh:
Nissan的Z系列中最新的车型。

自问世以来，Z系列已经有了七代车型。

初代Z型车于1969年上市，意味着
这个系列的历史已经跨越了半个多世纪。

它们现在已经成为了世界上最出名的车型之一！

这款最新车型采用了许多来自初代的特点，例如长车头和短车尾。

此外，它还沿用了经典的Z型车前置后驱布局。

这辆车搭载了Nissan最新的涡轮增压引擎
——3升的V6双涡轮增压引擎VR30DTT。

在经过专家调校之后，它的动力和油门反应时间都得到了改善。

vehicleCollection.en:
The seventh-generation Z is a 21st century reinterpretation of the classic S30.

In September 2020, Nissan unveiled a new prototype Z car. Its design was reminiscent of the original 240Z (S30) that appeared in 1969. A few months later, Nissan announced that it would be building a production model scheduled to hit the market in North America in 2022. While the new Z would utilize the same platform of the previous model, sharing much of the same basic construction, everything else would be completely new.

The new Z features a complex mix of tradition and cutting-edge technology. The exterior follows on from the S30's iconic long nose, while dynamic touches like its undulating character lines and LED headlights make it look fresh. It also utilizes the latest developments in cooling and aerodynamic performance.

The previous generation's naturally aspirated engine was replaced by the powerful VR30DDTT, a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 found in the Skyline 400R that produced 405ps/6500rpm and 475 Nm (48.4kgm)/1600rpm-5600rpm of torque.

This powerplant was mated to a 9-speed automatic with manual mode or a traditional 6-speed manual. To keep the car's curb weight in check for the automatic-gearbox model, the engineers opted to use a magnesium alloy transmission case. Also, the front and rear dampers featured monotube construction that improved response and an advanced launch control system that ensured the car left the line with aplomb. This is the first time Nissan offered such a system on its rear-wheel-drive models.

Can this classic sports car survive in an industry increasingly moving towards automated driving and electrification? Time will tell, but we think it will not only survive but flourish.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第七代Z系列跑车是经典S30在21世纪的最新演绎。

2020年9月，日产出人意料地揭晓了新款Fairlady Z的原型车。它的设计是对1969年第一代S30的致敬。全世界的跑车爱好者们屏息以待，终于等到了日产公布其将于2021年夏在北美（在日本则是2022年初）发售量产版本的消息。从规格数据来看，新款车型将于上一代车型共享底盘与大部分车身构造，但归根结底，它将继承第七代Fairlady Z的名号。

新款Z是跑车传统与尖端科技的精妙结合。其外观继承了S30经典的长车头设计，但在此基础上添加了更具动感的装饰，如起伏的边线和LED头灯。它还引入了冷却系统和空气动力学表现方面的最新技术。

引擎方面，新一代Z抛弃了旧款的自然进气引擎，取而代之的是动力毫不逊色的VR30DDTT 3升V6双涡轮增压引擎，这一动力单元同样被用于Skyline 400R。在不借助任何电子辅助的情况下，引擎最大功率可达405ps/6500rpm，最高扭矩则为475 牛·米（48.4kgm）/1600rpm-5600rpm。

变速箱方面，新一代Z不仅可装配提供手动模式的九速自动变速箱，还为拒绝拥抱当下潮流的驾驶者提供了六速手动变速箱。设计师想尽一切办法对这辆车进行了轻量化处理，其中自动挡车型使用了镁合金变速箱箱体来减轻重量。除此之外，前后避震采用了单管结构以提高响应速度，并安装了先进的起步控制系统，确保在发车线上不落人后。这是日产首次在其后轮驱动车型上提供该系统。

魅力十足的经典后轮驱动跑车能否在日益走向自动驾驶和全面电气化的汽车行业中生存下去？新款Fairlady Z可能就是日产对这个问题的答案。

cars.nameEn: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo
cars.nameZh: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo

brandCentral.sourceName: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.en:
After more than 160 years of success, Opel remains
an ambitious trailblazer of the automotive industry.

Carrying the spirit of the classic Corsa into the
future is the Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo.

The GSE label stands as Opel’s pledge to create high-performance,
emission-free cars for a new electric era.

This is an exceptionally fast machine, powered by dual motors at
the front and rear that together produce an astonishing 800ps.

It can sprint from 0-<100km/h> in just two seconds and reach a top
speed of <320km/h>, truly living up to the Opel “blitz” emblem.

Its imposing exterior was defined by the Opel Compass, formed
by the front grille and the central crease of the hood.

With its emphasis on sustainability, the GSE Vision Gran Turismo
promises to carry sports-car driving boldly into the 21st century.
brandCentral.zh:
历经160多年辉煌历程，Opel依旧是
汽车行业雄心勃勃的开拓者。

承载经典Corsa迈向未来的正是这款
Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo。

GSE标识象征着Opel致力于为电动新时代
打造高性能零排放汽车的承诺。

毫无疑问，这是一台极其迅捷的座驾，
前后双电机驱动，综合输出功率高达800ps。

The brand with the Blitz logo was the first European manufacturer to unveil a concept car in 1965—the Experimental GT. Now, 60 years later, Opel once again broke new ground with a “phygital” concept—a physical show car that could also be driven in Gran Turismo 7.
