brandCentral.en:
While Pagani is a relative newcomer to the
exclusive supercar world...

...its creations have certainly made a splash in the
short time they've been around.

The Huayra, successor to the Zonda, is one such car.

Featuring a carbon-fiber and titanium monocoque frame...

...it had a Mercedes-Benz AMG twin-turbo 6.0-liter V-12...

...which pumped out 700ps and 102kgm of torque.
That's definite super-car territory.

Indeed, company founder, Horacio Pagani, is quite proud
of his magnificent work of rolling art!<
brandCentral.zh:
虽然对于超级跑车世界来说，Pagani是一位相对较新的成员……

但不可否认，它们的作品在极短的时间内就引起了巨大
的轰动！

Huayra，Zonda的继任者，就是一个完美的例子。

此车使用了碳纤维和钛合金混合单体车架……

以及一台Mercedes-AMG 6L双涡轮增压V12引擎

为车辆提供世界一流的性能—700ps的动力和102kgm的扭矩！

我敢打赌，就连霍拉西奥·帕加尼都会这样的伟大艺术
作品感到自豪的！

vehicleCollection.en:
A car with bold styling, a lavish interior and a 6.0-liter twin-turbo Mercedes-AMG V12.

Argentine businessman Horacio Pagani's background as a designer worked in his favor when he established Pagani Automobili in Modena, Italy, and then, in 1999, announced the company's first supercar. After all, this is a man who worked on the Lamborghini Countach 25th Anniversary.

His first model, the Zonda, was developed with another famous Argentine, legendary race car driver Juan Manuel Fangio, who served as an adviser. The car focused purely on driving performance. It was an extremely expensive and limited-production model, but it certainly proved its mettle on the track, even recording the fastest lap time at the world-famous Nürburgring in Germany up to that point. Highly regarded by many, it sold out immediately.

The Zonda's successor, the Huayra, made its debut in 2011. It was produced with a newly developed monocoque frame, combining carbon and titanium, and incorporated the gullwing doors that were carried over from the Zonda. However, in contrast to the sharp, edgy styling of the Zonda, the Huayra instead adopted beautiful, flowing lines. It was a vehicle that married high quality craftsmanship with top tier supercar performance; the mostly carbon-fiber body encased a luxurious interior, which combined leather, aluminum and carbon. In terms of aerodynamics, the four variable flaps in the front and rear of the car automatically adjusted downforce, while also serving as air brakes.

Under its hood was the same 6.0-liter, hand-built AMG V12 of the Zonda, but twin-turbochargers were added for more power. The Huayra produced 700ps and 102kgm torque, and was combined with a 7-speed sequential transmission. With a 0 to <100km/h> acceleration of 3.2 seconds and a top speed of <378km/h>, it was one of the fastest cars ever built.
vehicleCollection.zh:
奢华的内饰，杰出的性能。这款高档超级跑车是高品质杰作的代表。

在成为商人之前，阿根廷人奥拉西欧·帕加尼曾是知名设计师，参与过兰博基尼Countach25周年版的设计。后来，他在意大利摩德纳创办了帕加尼汽车。

1999年，他的公司公布了首款自行设计的超级跑车，名为Zonda，作为顾问参与联合研发的是另一位阿根廷人，鼎鼎大名的传奇赛车手胡安·曼纽·方吉奥。这是一款完全专注于驾驶性能的车。

这款限量生产的昂贵车型在赛道上证明了自己，它甚至在著名的纽博格林赛道上创下了单圈最快纪录。Zonda不但收获了高度评价，而且刚一开订就被抢购一空。

2011年，Zonda的继承者Huayra面市。

它采用了全新研发的碳钛单体框架，并且安装了Zonda同款鸥翼车门。但不同于Zonda线条分明的外形，Huayra选用了柔美顺畅的流线设计。这款车是最高品质和运动性能的结晶，车体主要用碳纤维制成，奢华的内饰由皮革、铝和碳纤维组成。在空气动力学方面，前方和后方的4片可变襟翼能自动调节下压力，也可起到空气制动作用。

这款车采用与Zonda相同的6升AMG V12引擎，但增加了两套涡轮来提高功率。它能输出700ps和102kgm扭矩，并配有7速序列式变速箱。它的0-<100km/h>加速仅需3.2秒，最高时速可以达到<378km/h>。超高的性能令各家老牌超级跑车厂商都为之侧目。

dialogues.en:
About Pagani's design...

...its approach is quite different
from other traditional car makers from Modena.

Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati...

...most of their designs are born from
historic cars that were on sale in the 1960s and 1970s...

...with body styles that were designed by a carrozzeria in Turin.

When the Zonda was introduced, at the end of the 1990s, the era
of designs that shined 30 years before in Turin had concluded...

...thus, Pagani adopted its own unique design language.

It wasn't as if it was leaving all of its rivals in the
past at once...

...but it sought to wrap sophisticated mechanisms
with an attractive body, without being too flamboyant.

That kind of balance is what defines Pagani, I feel.
dialogues.zh:
帕加尼的设计方法……

和来自摩德纳的其他传统汽车制造商大相径庭。

以法拉利、兰博基尼、玛莎拉蒂等为例，

他们的大部分设计都来自于在20世纪60年代和70年代
亮相的历史名车……

这些车的车身大多是交给都灵的车身制造商设计的。

当Zonda于20世纪90年代末期发布时，
持续30余年的都灵设计时代已经告一段落……

所以帕加尼首次采用了自己的设计语言。

倒不是说它将过去的对手彻底甩在了身后，

但它确实做出了创新尝试，将复杂的机械构造
装入具有吸引力、同时又不会过于喧宾夺主的车身当中。

这也造就了帕加尼设计特有的平衡感。

That's Pagani Zonda, right?

brandCentral.en:
Pagani is known for having the most expensive and exclusive
cars, but the Zonda R is in a class of its own.

Specially designed to be driven on a track, a fact made
evident by its outstanding performance...

Its fully carbon body astonishingly weighs only 1250kg.

Sporting a V12 engine based on the one used in the
Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR, a Le Mans darling...

It recorded an impressive 6:47.50 lap time on
the Nürburgring Nordschleife in 2010.

Impressed? It was a new world record at the time!
brandCentral.zh:
Pagani素来以推出最昂贵和最独特的汽车而闻名，而在其推
出的车款中，Zonda R又自成一系。

此车是专为在赛道上驾驶而设计的，其出色的性能充分
证明了这一点……

全碳纤维制造的车身仅重1250kg，令人赞叹不已。

另外，此车还采用了来自于勒芒耐力赛常胜车型
Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR的V12引擎……

2010年，这辆车在纽博格林北侧赛道上做出了令人印象深
刻的6:47.50的单圈时间。

厉害吧？这在当时可是一个新的世界纪录！

vehicleCollection.en:
The Zonda R featured an adjustable rear wing and a sequential-shift 6-speed transmission.

Italian car manufacturer Pagani Automobili came to fame in 1999 when it introduced the Zonda, a very limited-edition super car for the extremely wealthy, at the Geneva Motor Show that year.

The company founder and president, Horacio Pagani, who once worked for Lamborghini and assisted in the design of the Countach anniversary model, set out to create a hand-made machine that would surpass all others in performance and styling. Many would agree that he did just that with the Zonda.

Looking like a Group C race car for the road, the Zonda C12's body was completely made of carbon fiber, helping the car to weigh in at an incredibly lean 1250kg. Providing the power was a mid-mounted AMG V-12 engine that produced 394ps.

There were a few variations of the Zonda after its initial release. This car, the Zonda R, was one meant strictly for the racetrack, like the Ferrari FXX. In this version, the AMG V12 was tuned to produce 750ps and 72.4kgm of torque, all managed by a 6-speed sequential gearbox. In order to raise stability on the racetrack, the car's wheelbase was lengthened and its tread width was extended. Also, a large front spoiler and a rear variable wing were added to improve downforce. According to Pagani, the Zonda R could accelerate from 0-<100km/h> in just 2.7 seconds and reach a top speed of <350km/h>.
vehicleCollection.zh:
赛道专用Zonda，搭载序列室变速箱和可变尾翼。

帕加尼汽车是意大利的超跑制造商，由曾任兰博基尼设计师的奥拉西欧·帕加尼先生创立，他曾设计过Countach纪念版等车型。

帕加尼致力于生产限量版梦幻跑车，完全摒弃批量制造模式，仅限手工打造。Zonda是帕加尼于1999年在日内瓦车展上推出的车型。

其独特的华丽车身更近似于C组别赛车或勒芒原型车。Zonda完全由碳纤维制成，因此首款Zonda C12的重量只有令人难以置信的1250kg。这款超轻量级超跑由一台394ps的AMG V12引擎驱动，不难想见，其性能是何其惊人。

在Zonda上市之后，该系列又陆续推出了改款产品，例如这款Zonda R就是专为赛道打造，和法拉利FXX的理念颇为相似。这款中置AMG V12引擎可产生750ps和72.4kgm的扭矩，配备6速序列式变速箱。为了提高赛道上的稳定性，设计师延长了轴距，增加了胎面宽度，并在车前部和后部安装了大扰流板和可变尾翼以提高空气动力学性能。车辆的总长度延长了近400mm，以使顶部气流更为流畅。根据官方规格介绍，Zonda R的最大速度可以达到惊人的<350km/h>，从起步加速到<100km/h>仅需2.7秒。

usedCar.en:
Are you interested in a car built to handle twisty roads?
Then, have I got the car for you—the Peugeot 205 GTI.

The 205 made its debut more than 40 years ago in 1983,
yet its design remains timeless and modern to this day.

Initially, Peugeot designated the 205 as a WRC rally car, but it
became clear that a sportier car was needed. Enter the GTI.

The true allure of the 205 GTI lies in its 1.6-liter inline-4,
paired with a chassis tipping the scales at just around 900kg!

In 1986, the engine was enlarged to 1.9L, producing 130ps,
while the chassis remained about the same weight.

On mountain roads, this car was a beast. It put the "hot" in hot
hatches and remains loyal to the spirit of sporty French cars.?
usedCar.zh:
想要寻找一款擅于征服蜿蜒道路的好车？我已经帮你挑
选好了——Peugeot 205 GTI！

在看来也毫不过时。

Peugeot首先基于205打造了一款世界拉力锦标赛参赛
赛车，但他们也需要一款运动车型，于是GTI应运而生。

GTI的魅力毫无疑问来自于它动力充沛的1.6升引擎，
安装在整体重量仅有900kg的车身中。

在1986年，这款引擎升级为1.9升，可以输出130ps动力，
但我要强调，车重依然只有900kg！

在山路上，这辆车始终立于不败之地！它是高性能掀背车
中实力最强劲的选手之一，也是法系车精神的最佳证明。

vehicleCollection.en:
A masterpiece hot hatch from France that became a rally legend.

In 1983, after more than 15 years of production, the Peugeot 104 passed the torch as the brand's compact hatchback to the all-new 205.

Designed by Peugeot's in-house team, the 205 featured a transverse engine layout and quickly became a bestseller, thanks to its modern styling and comfortable interior.

But the story of the 205 doesn’t end there. Alongside its debut, Peugeot unveiled the 205 Turbo 16, a high-performance model developed specifically for competition in the World Rally Championship’s Group B category. Peugeot recognized the need for a road-going sports model that captured the spirit and capability of the 205 Turbo 16. This resulted in the creation of the iconic hot hatch, the 205 GTI.

Its greatest appeal lay in its high-performance engine. Although it only measured a mere 3.7m long and weighed 900kg, this compact car came powered by a high-revving 1.6-liter SOHC engine mated to a 5-speed manual gearbox.

In 1986, engine displacement was increased from 1.6 liters to 1.9, which resulted in a output of 130ps. The car also featured an excellent suspension setup with struts on the front wheels and trailing arms at the rear. Through turns, the 205 GTI showcased exceptional performance, rivaling the reigning "king" of hot hatches at the time, the Golf GTI.

In Europe alone, sales of the Peugeot 205 GTI surpassed 300,000 units. This masterpiece of French engineering is one of the most important cars of 1980s-1990s automotive history.
vehicleCollection.zh:
一款来自法国的高性能掀背车杰作，也是拉力赛领域的传奇。

1983年，投产超过15年的标致104将紧凑型掀背车主打车型的接力棒交到了新近出炉的205车型手上。

205的车身由标致的内部设计团队执笔，采用了横置引擎布局，很快就因其现代的外观和舒适的内饰成为了畅销车款。

不过205的精彩故事并不止于此。在205亮相的同时，标致还公布了一款“205 Turbo 16”，出征当时如火如荼的世界拉力锦标赛B组别。而为了让更多人体验205 Turbo 16的实力，标致还决定推出一款相应的运动版车型。这一理念最终催生了高性能掀背车205 GTI。

205 GTI最大的吸引力来自于它强劲的高出力引擎。尽管这款紧凑型车仅有3.7m长，车重仅为900kg，却拥有一台高转速1.6升顶置单凸轮轴引擎，辅以一套5速手动传动系统。

1986年，车型的引擎得到了进一步升级，排量从1.6升扩大到1.9升，能够输出130ps。它还采用了一套表现出色的悬挂系统：前轮使用支柱式悬挂，后轮则使用拖曳臂式结构。面对蜿蜒曲折的山路，它展现出了极高的性能素质，甚至能与“高性能掀背车之王”——高尔夫GTI相媲美。

仅在欧洲，标致205 GTI的销量就突破了30万辆大关。这件法国汽车工程杰作是上世纪80到90年代世界汽车史上最重要的车型之一。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
The Peugeot 205 T16 made its WRC debut in Race 5 of the 1984
season, at the Tour de Corse.

Although it managed only a 4th-place finish, it dominated the
latter half of the season, winning Rounds 9, 10, and 12.

From the very beginning, the car showed amazing potential!

The secret to the 205 T16’s exceptional speed lies

collection.en:
The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 is sometimes referred to as the
'ultimate rally car'.

It was originally designed to compete in the World Rally
Championship's legendary Group B category.

Group B regulations were officially implemented in 1983,

and at the time, only 200 of a model were required for
Group B homologation within 12 months.

No commitment to mass production of road versions meant that
manufacturers could make bold decisions on development.

And the choice made by Peugeot,

was to mount a powerful turbocharged engine midship,
combined with 4WD.

At that point, the other teams in Group B hadn’t yet adopted
the configuration, which initially gave Peugeot an advantage.

The Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 made its debut in
the middle of the 1984 season,

and it immediately proved itself to be effective, winning the
World Rally Championship title in 1985 and 1986.
collection.zh:
标致205 Turbo 16常常被人称为“终极拉力车”。

它最初是为了参加世界拉力锦标赛充满传奇色彩的B组
别比赛而设计的。

B组别的规则于1983年正式实施时，

只需要在12个月内生产出200台车就可以获得赛事认证。

没有了大规模量产公路车型的限制，意味着制造商可以
在研发上做出更大胆的决定。

而标致做出的决定

是将一台强大的涡轮增压引擎安装在车体中部，并与四
轮驱动结合。

由于其他B组别车队并未采用这种配置，这在锦标赛的
头几年给标致带来了不小的优势。

标致205 Turbo 16在1984年赛季中期首次亮相，

立即证明了自己的高效，在1985年和1986年连续赢得世界拉
力锦标赛的冠军。

vehicleCollection.en:
This 4-wheel-drive pocket rocket took the Group B racing world by storm.

The 205 Turbo 16, a Group B car developed by Peugeot for the World Rally Championship, was similar to the production 205 in both looks and name, but it was an entirely different animal on the inside.

Built on a pipe frame chassis, the 205 Turbo was a converted mid-engine car, with its turbocharged 1.8-liter inline-4 that produced more than 350ps placed where the rear seats once were. The engine sent power to all four wheels, while its double wishbone suspensions system at all four corners provided incredibly agile handling. To better access to the engine and rear suspension for maintenance, the rear half of the body shell from the B-pillar back was a single fiberglass piece that could be lifted out of the way.

The car made its racing debut at the 1984 Tour de Corse. That year it won three races and followed it up in 1985 with three more. But because Peugeot wasn't satisfied with those results, it manufactured an extra limited run of 20 specially modified cars. Called the 205 Turbo Evolution 2, they possessed a lighter frame, an improved engine, and a large rear-wing and became known as one of the monsters of Group B.

The 205 Turbo Evolution won seven out of the 12 Group B races in 1985 and six out of 13 in 1986, taking home both the manufacturers' and drivers' championship titles both years. However, its amazing run lasted until the end of 1986 when the FIA decided to discontinue the Group B category. Still, the car had made its mark and definitely carved out a place in the annals of automotive history.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆四驱中置引擎怪兽横扫了B组别的各项赛事。

205 Turbo 16是一款标致为世界拉力锦标赛开发的B组别赛车。虽然它的外观和名字都与量产型的205非常相似，但事实上，在它的车身内却隐藏着一头截然不同的性能怪兽。

这款车采用了钢管车架底盘，原本应该放置后排座位的空间换成了一具1.8升直列4缸双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压引擎，可以输出超过350ps。其传动系统自然还是采用了全时四驱配置，并且四个轮毂都使用了双横臂推杆悬挂。为了改善引擎和后悬挂的易维护性，从B柱往后的车壳后半部分采用了一整块玻璃纤维结构，可以直接抬起并移除。

在1984年的科西嘉岛拉力赛首次亮相后，这款205 Turbo 16很快就获得了3场赛事的胜利，并在接下来的85年又赢下了3场胜利。不过标致对于这样的成绩并不满意，又生产了一批限量20台的改装车。205 Turbo Evolution 2采用了更轻的车身框架、改良版的引擎、更大型的尾翼，最终化身为B组别里令人畏惧的怪兽。

在经过了这些改良之后，很少再有对手能够追赶上标致车队的脚步。他们在1985年B组别中的12场赛事中赢下了7场，并在1986年的13场比赛中再夺6冠，连续两年赢得了车厂冠军和车手冠军的殊荣。

可惜国际汽联在1986年底决定不再举办B组别赛事。但标致205 Turbo 16也被作为那个时代最具标志性的赛车之一而得到永远铭记。

dialogues.en:
While the standard 208 GTi was undeniably small
and light, it did offer loads of fun to the driver.

This Peugeot Sport-engineered version takes the driving
experience to a whole other level.

Its exquisite chassis is stable and responsive.

On even extremely twisty mountain roads,
the car was an absolute pleasure to drive.

In fact, its amazing chassis is reason enough to add this car
in your collection.

驾驶起来却趣味无穷……

带到了一个全新的高度。

精细的底盘设置给人以无与伦比的稳重感……

即便是行驶在最蜿蜒的山间道路上，
都能让人尽享驾驶妙趣。

老实说，仅凭其优秀的底盘，
就值得你去收藏这辆车了。

Peugeot Sport's 208 GTi picked up the hot hatch mantle where
the legendary 205 GTI left off.

The FF layout, with a powerful engine placed up front,
makes for an exhilarating driving experience.

With a more compact body than its predecessor, the 207,
it's also over 100kg lighter.

The engine is a turbocharged custom 1.6L straight-four,
providing 200ps of power and 28kgm of torque.
brandCentral.zh:
Peugeot Sport推出的208 GTi从传奇车型205 GTI
手中接过了顶级高性能掀背车的衣钵。

以前置前驱布局搭配性能强劲的引擎，提供令人激动的
驾驶体验。

这台专属定制的涡轮增压1.6L直列四缸动力单元可以输出

100kg的重量。

vehicleCollection.en:
An exciting hot hatch with a distinctive French character.

The 208 GTi is the high-performance variant of the 208, Peugeot’s mainstream compact car. It made its official debut at the Paris Motor Show in the fall of 2012, following the launch of the new 208 series earlier that spring.

A key development goal for the 208 series was to redefine Peugeot’s B-segment offering, addressing the issue of the 207 becoming too large and heavy. While the 208 retained the 207’s platform, its overall length was reduced to less than 4m by trimming the front and rear overhangs. Also, the use of lighter materials resulted in a 100kg weight reduction compared to its predecessor.

This weight-saving effort particularly benefited the GTi model. It allowed Peugeot to rekindle the spirit of the legendary 205 GTI—a globally acclaimed sports model known for its compact size, agility, and thrilling performance.

Visually, the 208 GTi featured subtle yet distinctive enhancements, including a large roof spoiler, 18-inch wheels, and unique trim elements. Beneath the surface, however, significant engineering refinements were made. The front and rear track widths were widened by 10mm and 20mm, respectively, while the suspension, subframe, and control arms were specifically tuned for this model.

Power came from a turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-4 direct-injection engine, producing 200ps/28.0kgm, paired with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

With a top speed of <230km/h> and a 0-<100 km/h> acceleration time of 6.8 seconds, it was among the hottest hatches in its class.-
vehicleCollection.zh:
轻盈、小巧、有趣、快速。时髦而现实的紧凑型跑车。

208 GTi是标致的主打紧凑车型208的运动款。2012年春季，标致公布了全新的208系列，而208 GTi也在同年秋季的巴黎车展上首次亮相。

208系列的一项开发目标就是要吸取过大过重的207的教训，重新定义他们的B级车。这辆车沿用了207的平台，不过削减了前后突出的部分，成功地将整车长度削减到了4m以内。部件材料的更换也让这辆车比之前的型号轻了100kg。

这对于主打运动的GTi来说可是大功一件。让208 GTi获得像205 GTI一样风靡全世界的机会。后者是一款轻量级、小尺寸、有趣而且快速的运动小钢炮，既时髦又舒适。

从外表来看，除了顶部的大扰流板和18英寸轮毂，以及装饰件的差别之外，这款新车所做出的改动微乎其微。不过在皮囊之下，这部车得到了全面提升，前后轮的胎面宽度分别拓宽了10mm和20mm，而且悬挂、副车框和摆臂也专为此型号进行了特别定制。

经典的1.6升直喷式直4引擎可以提供最大200ps/28.0kgm的动力，并配合一套6档手动变速箱。

<230km/h>的最高时速和6.8秒的0-<100km/h>加速时间让这辆车位列同级别高性能掀背车的前列。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
This Peugeot 908 HDi FAP really shot past the competition
at the 2010 Le Mans 24 Hours!

After taking down reigning champ Audi
at the 2009 race...

Peugeot approached the 2010 race eager for another win,
and set to improving their 908.

And of the four 908s that competed, all four placed
in the top qualifying positions!

What’s more, the fourth-place Peugeot beat
the fifth-place Audi by over two seconds.

But you know, it’s no easy feat to win a 24-hour
endurance race.

All of the Peugeot’s 908s experienced trouble on the track,
and were forced to retire.

Which goes to show that endurance races are really not
just about speed but also the strength to carry on.
'
dialogues.zh:
在2010年度的勒芒24小时耐力赛上，
标致908 HDi FAP宛如一支离弦之箭，速度快到惊人！

在2009年的勒芒比赛中击败卫冕冠军奥迪后……

标致继续精益求精，改良他们的908。
他们已经迫不及待地想要在2010年的赛场再度蝉联冠军。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Peugeot LMP took the top four spots in qualifying for the 2010 24 Hours of Le Mans, but not one finished the race.

The diesel-powered 908 HDi FAP is a car that Peugeot developed for many years, aimed to dominate the world of prototype racing. In 2007 and 2008, the company continued to perfect the machine using LMS races as a test bed, and finally in 2009, the car attained supremacy when it defeated its main rival, the Audi R10, also diesel-powered, at the 24 Hours of Le Mans with a 1-2 finish.

Peugeot went for two in a row at Le Mans the following year, with a new version of the car with reduced weight, revised aerodynamics and a completely reinforced drive system. Four cars were entered, three from Peugeot Sport and one from Team Oreca.

The driving teams assigned to these cars were first rate, with Anthony Davidson, Marc Gené, and Alexander Wurz piloting the No. 1 car; Nicolas Minassian, Frank Montagny, and Stéphane Sarrazin in the No. 2 car, and Pedro Lamy, Sébastien Bourdais, and Simon Pegenaud driving the No. 3 car.

The drivers were set on making their mark in qualifying as all three cars raced to the front of the grid, led by the amazing lap time set by Bourdais in the No. 3 car of 3 minutes 19.711 seconds.

But the fruits of victory don't always go to the quickest in racing, especially in a race that lasts 24 hours. All four Peugeot cars experienced mechanical trouble, and all four retired from the race. There was no doubt in anyone's mind that the Peugeots were the fastest cars on the track, so not finishing one car was especially disappointing for the company. You could hear the resolve of the team in a company spokesperson's statement after the race: “We'll learn from our defeat today to return stronger.”'
vehicleCollection.zh:
在2010年勒芒24小时耐力赛资格赛中包揽前几名的标致勒芒原型车赛车。

908 HDi FAP是标致花费大量时间持续开发的一款赛车，意在将这辆车打造成原型赛车的巅峰之作。

在2007和2008年，他们通过勒芒系列赛之类的比赛进行了持续的研究和开发，以求进一步完善这款车型。2009年，他们在勒芒24小时耐力赛中击败了他们的宿敌——奥迪的柴油车R10。

到了次年的2010年勒芒24小时耐力赛上，希望取得连胜的标致对整车重量进行大幅削减，空气动力学布局也进行了重新设计，而且驱动系统（从离合器开始）都进行了强化。一共有四辆车参加了比赛，三辆属于标致车队，另一辆属于奥雷卡车队。

标致车队拥有一支车手的梦之队，一号车由安东尼·戴维森、马克·赫内和亚历山大·武尔茨驾驶，二号车由尼古拉·米纳西安、弗兰克·蒙塔尼和斯特凡·萨拉赞驾驶，而三号车则由佩德罗·拉米、塞巴斯蒂安·布尔戴和西蒙·帕基诺驾驶。

他们决心要在与奥迪的狭路相逢中成为赢家，并在自由练习中跑出了最快单圈时间，在驾驶三号车的布尔戴（跑出了令人难以置信的3分19.711秒）的出色发挥下，他们还横扫了预选赛阶段的所有对手，霸占了从杆位到四号位的所有起跑位。

可惜命运之神并未向他们展露微笑，全部四辆908 HDi FAP都在决赛中遇到了机械故障，遗憾退出比赛。

毫无疑问，每个人的心里都相信他们的车是最快的，而且你也能从标致留下的言论中听出他们暗含的决心：“我们会从今天的失败中吸取教训，然后以更强的实力强势回归”。

dialogues.en:
Of all the race cars born from the Le Mans Hypercar regulations...

...the Peugeot 9X8 may be the most
distinctive of them all.

Its wingless concept made headlines
when it made its debut in 2021.

And that bold approach may have helped it briefly take the lead
during an especially wet and grueling Le Mans in 2023.

In 2024, the car underwent a major evolution, gaining an all-new
rear wing and a more conventional aerodynamic package.

A top-tier contender in the WEC, this is a machine
that never fails to make an impression.
dialogues.zh:
在众多遵循勒芒终极跑车组别规则打造的赛车中……

Peugeot 9X8的设计最为独树一帜。

其“无尾翼”的设计理念在2021年首次亮相时便引发热议……

甚至在2023年雨水肆虐、赛程艰苦的勒芒赛场上，
一度助它领跑全场。

2024年这款赛车迎来重大升级，正式加装全新尾翼。

作为WEC赛场上的顶尖强者，这台车总能惊艳全场。

Peugeot once dominated endurance racing with the 905 and 908,
and the 9X8 marked its first entry in the Hypercar class.

Developed by Peugeot Sport, the all-wheel-drive 9X8 combines
a twin-turbo 2.6-liter V-6 with a front electric motor.

Check out the lion-claw light signatures, a design cue
it shares with Peugeot road cars.

The early 9X8’s wingless design drew plenty of attention,
but a large rear wing was eventually added in 2024.

The tires also were changed to a staggered setup,

helping improve aerodynamics and weight distribution.

It showed its refined speed in the 2025 season, finishing
a close second in the seventh race at Fuji.

With its bold approach, the 9X8 aims to redefine what a hypercar

这款车由标致运动开发，搭载一台2.6升V6双涡轮
增压引擎，并配备电动机。

灯组上的狮爪图案值得留意——这也是标致公路车
的标志性特征。

早期的9X8采用无尾翼设计，一度备受瞩目，

大幅优化了空气动力学性能与重量分布。

在2025赛季中，9X8展现了精准调校后的速度，
并在富士站的第七场比赛中以微弱劣势屈居亚军。

9X8大胆的理念旨在重新定义终极跑车的边界——
这头猛兽独具个性，实力不容小觑。]

vehicleCollection.en:
An electric hypercar that represents the racing spirit of Peugeot.

The Peugeot 9X8 was a Le Mans Hypercar (LMH) developed by Peugeot Sport with the goal of returning the French manufacturer to Le Mans glory. After stepping away from top-class endurance competition in 2011, Peugeot returned in 2022 under LMH regulations with the arrival of the 9X8. The "9" referenced its lineage to prototypes such as the 905 and 908. The "X" denoted its status as an all-wheel-drive hybrid built for the electrified era. Finally, the "8" reflected its connection to Peugeot’s modern production car lineup.

Upon its debut, the 9X8 attracted widespread attention for its radical aerodynamic concept, which initially eliminated the need for a rear wing. Its bodywork was shaped through extensive calculations balancing downforce and drag, challenging conventional ideas surrounding prototype race car design.

However, regulation revisions introduced during the 2022 season required adjustments to aerodynamic freedom and tire dimensions. To comply with the updated rules, the 2024 version adopted staggered tire sizes along with major revisions to weight distribution and aerodynamic balance. This dramatic evolution resulted in a redesign of roughly 90 percent of the bodywork, including the addition of a large rear wing.

The 2025 specification further refined these developments, creating the most complete version of the 9X8. Built around a hybrid powertrain combining a twin-turbocharged 2.6-liter V-6 engine with a front-mounted MGU, the car was engineered for reliability and consistent performance. It demonstrated its potential during the fiercely contested 2025 FIA World Endurance Championship season, where Peugeot secured a podium finish with 2nd place at Fuji. Developed through relentless innovation and refinement, the 9X8 became a striking expression of Peugeot’s engineering ambition and racin identity.
vehicleCollection.zh:
淋漓尽致诠释标致赛车精神的电动终极跑车。

标致9X8是法国的骄傲——标致运动部门为征服勒芒而开发的勒芒终极跑车。在2011年退出耐力赛的顶级舞台后，标致于2022年以勒芒终极跑车组别回归，并带来了全新的9X8赛车。数字“9”代表着它继承了905和908等车型的血脉。字母“X”则代表它是电气化时代的全轮驱动混合动力赛车。最后，数字“8”则表明了它与现有车型的传承关系。

9X8一经亮相，便因其革命性的空气动力学设计而备受瞩目，这一设计使其得以省去尾翼。车身造型基于下压力与风阻的精密计算打造，彻底颠覆了原型车的设计常规。

然而，2022年夏季出台的新规要求对空气动力学设计自由度及轮胎尺寸进行调整。为符合新规，2024款车型为前后轮配备了不同尺寸的轮胎，并对重量分配与空气动力学平衡进行了全面调整。这一颠覆性变革促使约90%的车身部件需要重新设计，并加装了一个大型尾翼。

2025款车型在这些改进的基础上更进一步，最终打磨出了这一完美的终极形态。这款车围绕混合动力系统打造，将一台2.6升V6双涡轮增压引擎和一台前置电机发电单元合而为一。整车调校以可靠性和性能稳定性为首要目标。在竞争激烈的2025赛季国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛中，此车初现潜力。标致车队在富士站中夺得第二名，成功登上领奖台。9X8经由不断的创新与迭代精雕细琢而成，堪称标致赛车卓越实力的绝佳体现。

2025款车型在这些改进的基础上更进一步，最终打磨出了这一完美的终极形态。这款车围绕混合动力系统打造，将一台2.6升V6双涡轮增压引擎和一台前置电机发电单元合而为一。整车调校以可靠性和性能稳定性为首要目标。在竞争激烈的2025赛季国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛中，此车初现潜力。标致车队在富士站中夺得第二名，成功登上领奖台。9X8经由不断的创新与迭代精雕细琢而成，堪称标致赛车卓越实力的绝佳体现。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
vehicleCollection.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo pays homage to the legendary L45 race machine.

On May 30, 1916, Peugeot won the legendary “Indianapolis 500 Mile Race” with its L45 race car. One hundred years later, we pay homage to that achievement by bringing you the Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo. 

Filled with the latest technology, the L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo features sharp styling cues and an incredibly low profile. With even the bulge that covers the cockpit kept to a minimum, the car stands a mere 1m tall. The tail section was inspired by the old L45 race car, ending in a streamlined shape with three distinctive rear lamp claws similar to that of the 3008, which is a Peugeot design cue today.

The cockpit utilizes a near-future user interface, with two holograms displaying a variety of information to the driver. Unlike the L45, the L500R is a single seater—the navigator has been replaced with a virtual navigator in this concept.

The L500R is powered by a 1.6-liter 4-cylinder turbocharged engine and two electric motors. Total output is 500ps and maximum torque is 74.43kgm. Utilizing the latest lightweight materials, the car weighs only 1000kg. All this allows the Peugeot race car to run from 0-<100km/h> in 2.5 seconds and to the 1000m-mark in just 19 seconds.

Peugeot has participated in many forms of motorsports all over the world, including the 24 Hours of Le Mans, WRC and Rally Raids. This innovative machine represents the company’s spirit and passion for competition.
vehicleCollection.zh:
专为致敬传奇的L45赛车而打造的Vision Gran Turismo。

在1916年5月30日，标致依靠他们彗星般的赛车L45赢下了传奇赛事——印地500英里比赛。在这场胜利的一个世纪以后，标致又用一辆L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo向这位过去的冠军表达敬意。20世纪初标致赛车的性能和激情被带到了现代，与精雕细琢的优雅和最先进的技术发生了碰撞。

其最出色的外形设计便是那难以置信的极低车身。即便是容纳车手的驾驶舱，其突出高度也被控制在最低程度，而整车高度仅为1m。渐渐收窄的尾部和一个世纪前的老款L45颇为类似，流线型的尾端外形突出三只独具特色的爪型尾灯，和3008的尾灯非常相似。这样的尾灯也成了如今标致车身设计的一大标志。

包裹车手的座舱采用未来风格的用户界面，两块全息图为车手展示了各种信息。虽然L500R是一部单座车，但是L45时代必不可少的领航员在这部概念赛车中被换成了一名虚拟领航员。

动力方面，这辆车使用一具1.6升4缸涡轮增压引擎和两部电机。总输出功率达到500ps，可以产出74.43kgm的最大扭矩。使用最新材料的这款车车重仅有1000kg，可以在2.5秒内完成0-<100km/h>的加速，仅用19秒就可以跑完1000m的距离。

在赛车运动的世界里，标致不仅在印地500中延续出色的发挥，还参加了全世界的各种比赛，包括勒芒、世界赛车拉力锦标赛和越野拉力赛等。这部革命性的赛车将他们的精神和激情带向了未来。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Peugeot L750R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
vehicleCollection.en:
This Vision Gran Turismo pays homage to the legendary L45 race machine.

On May 30, 1916, Peugeot won the legendary “Indianapolis 500 Mile Race” with its L45 race car. One hundred years later, we pay homage to that achievement by bringing you the Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo. To celebrate the release of Gran Turismo Sport, Peugeot decided to develop the L500R even more, creating the L750R HYbrid, a competition model with even more performance. 

What mainly separates the L750R from the L500R is its power unit. By raising the rev limit of the turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-4 to 10000rpm, output has been increased to 580 brake horsepower. And when you combine that with the 170 brake horsepower coming from the electric motors, you get a total output of 750 brake horsepower. 

The L750R basically wears the same body as the L500R, but with improved aerodynamics. A large splitter has been added to the front, and the airflow of the underfloor has been further optimized. A rear wing has also been added to increase downforce. The L750R weighs 175kg less than its stablemate, tipping the scales at 825kg. This has improved the car’s 0-<100km/h> acceleration by 0.1 second, to 2.4 seconds.

Peugeot took the incredible L500R race car and refined it even further to create a truly remarkable machine that conveys the company’s passion and spirit for competition.
vehicleCollection.zh:
专为致敬传奇的L45赛车而打造的Vision Gran Turismo。

在1916年5月30日，标致依靠他们彗星般的赛车L45赢下了传奇赛事——印地500英里比赛。在这场胜利的一个世纪以后，他们又开发出了L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo向L45的百年诞辰表达了敬意。

而现在，为了庆祝跑车浪漫旅竞速的推出，标致决定对L500R进行更深入的开发。在保留L500R原本的未来概念设计的前提下，这部新车将会是一款竞技车型，为了比赛而实现更强的性能——这款超级明星就是L750R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo。

L750R最大的革新在于其动力系统。L500R的1.6升直4涡轮增压引擎的转速上限被提高到了10000rpm，其输出功率也提升到了580有效马力。再加上可以输出170有效马力的电机，整套系统的输出功率达到了750有效马力。

尽管L500R的车身已经非常低了，标致决定进一步改良这辆车的空气动力学设计。车身前部加装了一部大型分流器，进一步优化了车底的气流。在加上大号尾翼后，这辆车成功获得了强大的下压力。车身重量也继续得到削减，仅为825kg，比L500R还轻了175kg。这些努力将0-<100km/h> 的加速时间再次缩短了0.1秒，变成2.4秒。

标致的赛车精神在L500R中得到了充分体现，而这款车则让其赛车理念更加纯粹和炽热。

brandCentral.en:
This road car was designed as a homologated
Peugeot RCZ Gr.3.

The mid-engine layout allows for the glamorous proportions that
give it its unique look.

The design brings to mind Peugeot's 2002 "RC" concept.

And it may have been the original inspiration here.
The RC also had a mid-mounted engine, after all!
brandCentral.zh:
这款公路车是一款经过改装，并获得认证的
Peugeot RCZ Gr.3级别赛车。

通过中置引擎布局，它实现了令人着迷的车身比例
和独特的外观。

其外观设计带有Peugeot的2002款“RC”概念车的影子，

也许它的灵感就来源于此，毕竟RC也是一台
中置引擎车型！

vehicleCollection.en:
This is a Gr.3 production version of the stylish Peugeot RCZ compact coupe."

At the Peugeot booth of the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show, there was a concept car displayed with flowing lines: the “308 RCZ”. This sports car was notable for its wide and low silhouette, with a cabin offset forward due to its midship layout. From the center of the roof to the rear glass, a double-bubble design was utilized, giving it a unique style.

This was a design study based on the 308, but it gathered a lot of attention, with many fans wanting to see the car actually produced. To answer their call, the car was finally released in 2010 with a style that was virtually unchanged from the prototype. It was named with no 308 designation but simply as the “RCZ”.

The engine is a 1.6-liter inline 4-cylinder turbo, with two models producing 156ps and 200ps respectively. The 200ps version is given an engine that becomes more lively as the engine RPM becomes higher, and a suspension system carried over from the original 308 series is made stiffer for sports driving. The combination gave the car a level of performance that provided a fulfilling sports driving experience.

Then in 2012, the RCZ underwent a minor change. This was mostly a stylistic change with the opening of the grille made smaller, the addition of a black light unit and LED position lights, and the overall facelift of the front end, giving it a chic style and appearance.

The GT Line is a grade model added from 2015, with a special front grille, double exhaust pipes, 19-inch wheels, and red stitched black leather interior for a sportier look.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
标致RCZ紧凑型双门轿车的组别3公路车版。

在2007年的法兰克福车展上，标致展示了一部概念赛车，优雅流畅的车身线条拥有极高的辨识度。这是一辆308 RCZ。这辆跑车宽而低的轮廓非常鲜明，而由于其采用了中置引擎布局，座舱被前移。这款车从车顶中央到后窗采用了双气泡设计，独具风格。

这种设计思路来源于308，不过还加入了许多新亮点，许多粉丝也表达了他们对这辆车的期待。为了响应粉丝的呼声，这辆车在2010年最终推出，其外形风格和原型几乎没有任何改变。命名也脱离了308的称呼，而是简单地称为RCZ。

这辆车采用一具1.6升直4涡轮增压引擎，两种型号分别可输出156ps和200ps动力。200ps版本的引擎更加强力，转速更高，而继承自原版308的悬挂系统也进行了加固，更加运动。这样的搭配让这款车的性能非常优秀，这款车的运动驾驶体验令人心满意足。

然后在2012年，RCZ又进行了少量改款。这次的改变主要在外观上，进气格栅的开口更小了，加入了背光单元和LED示廓灯，而前端的整体改款让其风格和外观更加时髦。

GT产品线是在2015年加入的高端型号，带有特殊的前进气格栅、双排气管、19英寸轮毂、和更具运动风的红色缝线黑色皮革内饰。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

Serving as the foundation for the Gran Turismo Gr.3 race car
was the Peugeot RCZ.

While the original came with an FF layout, we changed it to an
MR layout to suit Gr.3 specifications.

This was easily done, thanks to the base RCZ's long wheelbase,
which provides exceptional lateral stability.

We must say that the car's overall balance has been greatly

brandCentral.zh:

原车是前置前驱布局，赛车版本却改为使用中置后驱布
局，以满足Gr.3的规范。

基础的RCZ轴距较长，拥有较高的稳定性，

vehicleCollection.en:
This is a Gr.3 race version of the stylish Peugeot RCZ compact coupe.

At the Peugeot booth of the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show, there was a concept car displayed with flowing lines: the “308 RCZ”. This sports car was notable for its wide and low silhouette, with a cabin offset forward due to its midship layout. From the center of the roof to the rear glass, a double-bubble design was utilized, giving it a unique style.

This was a design study based on the 308, but it gathered a lot of attention, with many fans wanting to see the car actually produced. To answer their call, the car was finally released in 2010 with a style that was virtually unchanged from the prototype. It was named with no 308 designation but simply as the “RCZ”.

The engine is a 1.6-liter inline 4-cylinder turbo, with two models producing 156ps and 200ps respectively. The 200ps version is given an engine that becomes more lively as the engine RPM becomes higher, and a suspension system carried over from the original 308 series is made stiffer for sports driving. The combination gave the car a level of performance that provided a fulfilling sports driving experience.

Then in 2012, the RCZ underwent a minor change. This was mostly a stylistic change with the opening of the grille made smaller, the addition of a black light unit and LED position lights, and the overall facelift of the front end, giving it a chic style and appearance.

The GT Line is a grade model added from 2015, with a special front grille, double exhaust pipes, 19-inch wheels, and red stitched black leather interior for a sportier look.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
标致RCZ紧凑型双门轿车的组别3公路车版。

在2007年的法兰克福车展上，标致展示了一部概念赛车，优雅流畅的车身线条拥有极高的辨识度。这是一辆308 RCZ。这辆跑车宽而低的轮廓非常鲜明，而由于其采用了中置引擎布局，座舱被前移。这款车从车顶中央到后窗采用了双气泡设计，独具风格。

这种设计思路来源于308，不过还加入了许多新亮点，许多粉丝也表达了他们对这辆车的期待。为了响应粉丝的呼声，这辆车在2010年最终推出，其外形风格和原型几乎没有任何改变。命名也脱离了308的称呼，而是简单地称为RCZ。

这辆车采用一具1.6升直4涡轮增压引擎，两种型号分别可输出156ps和200ps动力。200ps版本的引擎更加强力，转速更高，而继承自原版308的悬挂系统也进行了加固，更加运动。这样的搭配让这款车的性能非常优秀，这款车的运动驾驶体验令人心满意足。

然后在2012年，RCZ又进行了少量改款。这次的改变主要在外观上，进气格栅的开口更小了，加入了背光单元和LED示廓灯，而前端的整体改款让其风格和外观更加时髦。

GT产品线是在2015年加入的高端型号，带有特殊的前进气格栅、双排气管、19英寸轮毂、和更具运动风的红色缝线黑色皮革内饰。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

The Peugeot RCZ was the foundation for this
Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.4 race car.

The front fenders are one of a number of custom parts that
were intended to improve aerodynamics.

Despite being front-wheel drive, it handled surprisingly well.

这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车采用

这辆前置前驱车拥有引以为傲的顺滑操控。

This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.B rally car is based on the
Peugeot RCZ.

There's a popular event in Colorado called the Pikes Peak
International Hill Climb.

And, as you can see from the huge front and rear wings,
this car was designed specifically to win that race.

The engine is mounted amidships, providing power to
all four wheels.

这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于Peugeot RCZ开发。

您有没有听说过派克峰？那是位于美国境内的一条传奇
爬山赛道。

您也许可以通过大得离谱的前后翼判断出来，这台机器
就是专为在派克峰这样的赛道上取胜而设计的。

它采用了中置引擎布局，向四轮同时输出动力。/

dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
The Peugeot RCZ GT is a very creative design,
with styling much like a show car.

It’s sporty, youthful, and elegant in its execution.

The silver arched roofline-rails and double bubble-roof
panel look very much like a concept vehicle.

Also, the design of the front and rear gives you
a feeling of security.
dialogues.zh:
Peugeot RCZ GT采用了创意十足的设计方案，
造型形似展示车。

它既富有运动性、年轻气息，又展现了优雅的格调。

银色的车顶立柱弧线和双泡形车顶玻璃面板
更像是概念车的专属。

此外，车头和车尾两处的设计也给人一种安全感。

vehicleCollection.en:
A unique car with a double-bubble rear roof.[

At the Peugeot booth of the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show, there was a concept car displayed with flowing lines: the “308 RCZ”. This sports car was notable for its wide and low silhouette, with a cabin offset forward due to its midship layout. From the center of the roof to the rear glass, a double-bubble design was utilized, giving it a unique style.

This was a design study based on the 308, but it gathered a lot of attention, with many fans wanting to see the car actually produced. To answer their call, the car was finally released in 2010 with a style that was virtually unchanged from the prototype. It was named with no 308 designation but simply as the “RCZ”.

The engine is a 1.6-liter inline 4-cylinder turbo, with two models producing 156ps and 200ps respectively. The 200ps version is given an engine that becomes more lively as the engine RPM becomes higher, and a suspension system carried over from the original 308 series is made stiffer for sports driving. The combination gave the car a level of performance that provided a fulfilling sports driving experience.

Then in 2012, the RCZ underwent a minor change. This was mostly a stylistic change with the opening of the grille made smaller, the addition of a black light unit and LED position lights, and the overall facelift of the front end, giving it a chic style and appearance.

The GT Line is a grade model added from 2015, with a special front grille, double exhaust pipes, 19-inch wheels, and red stitched black leather interior for a sportier look.
vehicleCollection.zh:
具有双气泡后车顶的独特车型。

在2007年的法兰克福车展上，标致展示了一部概念赛车，优雅流畅的车身线条拥有极高的辨识度。这是一辆308 RCZ。这辆跑车宽而低的轮廓非常鲜明，而由于其采用了中置引擎布局，座舱被前移。这款车从车顶中央到后窗采用了双气泡设计，独具风格。

这种设计思路来源于308，不过还加入了许多新亮点，许多粉丝也表达了他们对这辆车的期待。为了响应粉丝的呼声，这辆车在2010年最终推出，其外形风格和原型几乎没有任何改变。命名也脱离了308的称呼，而是简单地称为RCZ。

这辆车采用一具1.6升直4涡轮增压引擎，两种型号分别可输出156ps和200ps动力。200ps版本的引擎更加强力，转速更高，而继承自原版308的悬挂系统也进行了加固，更加运动。这样的搭配让这款车的性能非常优秀，这款车的运动驾驶体验令人心满意足。

然后在2012年，RCZ又进行了少量改款。这次的改变主要在外观上，进气格栅的开口更小了，加入了背光单元和LED示廓灯，而前端的整体改款让其风格和外观更加时髦。

GT产品线是在2015年加入的高端型号，带有特殊的前进气格栅、双排气管、19英寸轮毂、和更具运动风的红色缝线黑色皮革内饰。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
Peugeot cars are distinguished by their numerical names.

Like the 205 or the 306, they all seem to follow
a three-digit pattern.

The history behind this convention actually dates back
to 1921 with the 201.

Today, it’s not uncommon to see four-digit names,
but did you know that those are reserved for SUVs?

This "2008" is a compact SUV.

As is to be expected of a Peugeot, it's perky and nimble,
just as it should be!
dialogues.zh:
Peugeot的车可以从它们名字中的数字区分开来。

例如“205”或“306”，似乎所有车名都遵循着三位数命名格式。

这一传统其实可追溯到1929年的“201”！

如今，它旗下以四位数命名的车型并不少见，
但你或许不知道这些是专门留给SUV的。

这台“2008”就是一款紧凑型SUV。

与其它Peugeot车型相似，这台车活力十足，灵活敏捷，
一切都恰到好处！

With more than 140 years of heritage, Peugeot has carved out

Here is the second-generation update, launched in 2019.

What do you make of its commanding presence? Although it measures

Stepping inside, you were greeted by a unique cockpit, defined by

你觉得它的气势如何？尽管长度不足4.3m，但这辆车
却拥有SUV的全部能力。

注意看那狮爪般的大灯和獠牙式日行灯——无不在
咆哮着提醒你，这款车属于那个以狮子为标志的品牌。

这辆车提供独特的驾驶舱，配备小巧的方向盘
和别具一格的数字仪表盘。

凭借极其优雅、如猫科动物般的悬挂系统，它是一辆
完美适配运动驾驶的活力座驾。

vehicleCollection.en:
This compact SUV showcases Peugeot design cues throughout.

Peugeot has long been known for crafting spirited compact cars. This legacy continues to shine in today’s SUV-dominated market. The brand found success in 2013 with the debut of the original 2008 compact SUV, and in 2019, Peugeot elevated the concept further with the launch of the next-generation 2008.

Peugeot’s traditional naming convention—three digits with a zero in the center—evolved with the rise of SUVs, expanding to four digits. The 2008 follows this format, sharing the same CMP platform as its hatchback sibling, the 208.

Measuring just 4.3m in length, the 2008 may be compact in size, but it projects all the presence and stature expected of a true SUV. Its sharp, angular motifs evoke the image of a lion’s claws and fangs, a design language that has become a hallmark of Peugeot’s identity.

Step inside, and you’re greeted by Peugeot’s distinctive 3D i-Cockpit, a driver-focused layout that sets the cabin apart. At its heart is a compact, flat-topped and -bottomed steering wheel. Just above it sits a head-up digital instrument cluster, cleverly elevated to fall within the driver’s natural line of sight.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款紧凑型SUV处处展现标致的设计风格

标致多年来生产了众多活力十足的紧凑型车。这种热情在SUV主导市场的今天仍然没有退减。他们在2013年凭借“2008”紧凑型SUV获得成功，2019年再接再厉，在此基础上推出了真正的SUV 2008。

标致车型的命名传统是中间带0的3位数字，而在SUV车型上，将其扩展为4位数字。使用与“208”掀背车相同的通用模块化平台的SUV 2008也遵循这一规则。

虽然4.3m的车身尺寸在现实中相对较短，但外观上展现了SUV应有的十足气势。灯具的造型让人联想到狮子的爪牙，这已成为标致近年来设计特色的一部分。

看到内饰时，你会注意到独特的驾驶员布局，被称为“3D直观驾驶舱”。它由上下扁平的小直径方向盘和位于其上方中央的抬头数字仪表盘组成，提供运动感受和无与伦比的驾驶员视野。

vehicleCollection.en:
Experience pure steering response in a car that generates powerful downforces directly from its body panels.

When PEUGEOT designers and PEUGEOT SPORT engineers teamed up to create an exceptional super car the result was PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo.

This racing car, specifically designed for the Anniversary Edition of Gran Turismo 6, brings together the major elements of a hyper-efficient endurance car. Boasting a radical style, the PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo stands out with its almost absent aerodynamic elements and its air-rending monolithic figure. Its design allows an aerodynamic support directly generated by the car bodywork, which reaches a mere 1.04 m (1.04m). 

The PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo focuses on the driver. Behind them, in a rear central position, the 3.2L V6 turbo engine delivers its 875 ch (887ps) to the four permanent driving wheels, sized 22-inch at the front and 23-inch at the rear, via a mechanical 6-speed transmission.

Combined with the car's lightness 875kg, and its ideal mass distribution (48% at the front and 52% at the rear), the ultra-direct steering makes it the perfect ride to face up to the challenges of Gran Turismo. Its acceleration is exceptional thanks to its 1 kg/ch (1 kg/HP) weight/power ratio and its deceleration is just as formidable thanks to its 4 ventilated carbon discs with a diameter of 380 mm (15-inch) on the front, and 337 mm (13-inch) on the rear. 

Are you ready to add your name to PEUGEOT SPORT’s great list of victories on every track of the world?

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
在直接通过车身板件产生下压力的跑车中体验纯粹的转向反应。

标致的设计师们和标致车队的工程师们合作打造了一部优质超级跑车标致Vision Gran Turismo。

这辆赛车是专门为跑车浪漫旅6的周年纪念版所设计的，融合了一辆超高性能耐力车的所有重要元素。标致Vision Gran Turismo的外形非常独特，它几乎不带有任何的空气动力学组件，只有一个单体式的流线型车身。这样的设计让高度仅有1.04米的车身直接赢得空气动力学的优势。

标致Vision Gran Turismo专注于车手的需求。在车身中后部放置一具3.2升V6涡轮增压引擎，将高达887ps的动力通过机械6档变速箱、以全时四驱模式源源不断的输出给四个车轮，其中前轮为22英寸，后轮23英寸。

这辆车的重量仅为875kg，而且前后配重比非常理想（前48%，后52%），再搭配上超直接的转向系统，使其成为挑战跑车浪漫旅的最完美座驾。它的加速性能非常优秀，这要归功于其1公斤/马力的重量动力比，而它的减速性能也无可比拟，共配置有4个风冷碳纤维刹车片，直径分别为前380毫米（15英寸）、后337毫米（13英寸）。

你准备好征服全世界的每一条赛道，将你的名字写进标致车队的名人堂里了吗？

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

Are you ready to add your name to PEUGEOT SPORT’s great list of victories on every track of the world?

long.zh:
标致的设计师们和标致车队的工程师们合作打造了一部优质超级跑车标致Vision Gran Turismo。

这辆赛车是专门为跑车浪漫旅6的周年纪念版所设计的，融合了一辆超高性能耐力车的所有重要元素。标致Vision Gran Turismo的外形非常独特，它几乎不带有任何的空气动力学组件，只有一个单体式的流线型车身。这样的设计让高度仅有1.04米的车身直接赢得空气动力学的优势。

标致Vision Gran Turismo专注于车手的需求。在车身中后部放置一具3.2升V6涡轮增压引擎，将高达887ps的动力通过机械6档变速箱、以全时四驱模式源源不断的输出给四个车轮，其中前轮为22英寸，后轮23英寸。

这辆车的重量仅为875kg，而且前后配重比非常理想（前48%，后52%），再搭配上超直接的转向系统，使其成为挑战跑车浪漫旅的最完美座驾。它的加速性能非常优秀，这要归功于其1公斤/马力的重量动力比，而它的减速性能也无可比拟，共配置有4个风冷碳纤维刹车片，直径分别为前380毫米（15英寸）、后337毫米（13英寸）。

你准备好征服全世界的每一条赛道，将你的名字写进标致车队的名人堂里了吗？

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

brandCentral.en:
The Peugeot Vision Gran Turismo is all about performance.

This remarkable car was developed by Peugeot's design team
and the engineers responsible for the Peugeot Sport.

Its turbocharged 3.2-liter V-6 engine, mounted amidships,
pumped out a hearty 887ps.

Particular attention was paid to endurance race cars during
the development of this efficiently-designed model.

You can see this in its aerodynamic parts, which are kept
to an absolute minimum without affecting performance.
brandCentral.zh:
Peugeot Vision Gran Turismo是纯粹为驾驶而生的。

这款非凡的车辆是由Peugeot的设计团队和Peugeot Sport背后的
工程师们共同开发的。

此车采用了中置引擎布局，配备了3.2L V6涡轮增压引擎，
能够提供887ps的动力。

为了实现性能的飞跃，在车型的开发过程中，设计师们特别参
考了耐力赛车型。

您可以从空气动力学部件中看出这一点，这些部件在不
影响性能的前提下，都采取极简化的处理。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
This here’s a legend of American stock car racing.

In stock car racing, production-model cars are raced
pretty much as-is.

The Superbird’s large rear wing and long front nose
were essential tools...

...for winning NASCAR races, the top tier of stock
car racing in the United States.

Basically, they were special racing parts
for a production car.

In its effort to meet NASCAR homologation,
the Superbird was sold for but one year...

...and few were ever produced.

Afterwards, stock car races began to feature more
and more pure race cars.

Indeed, this car is from an age when street cars
and race cars greatly resembled each other.
*
dialogues.zh:
这一辆是美国改装赛车比赛中的传奇。

在改装赛车比赛中，量产型的车辆通常是以原始的出厂配置的状态直接参与竞速。

这辆Superbird的大号后翼和长车鼻都是竞速利器……

能够帮助它赢得美国的顶级改装赛车赛事——纳斯卡赛车。

事实上，这些车身部件都是专门服务于量产型车辆的特殊竞速部件。

为了满足纳斯卡赛车的赛事资格认证条件，
Superbird仅对外销售一年……

总产量也不多。

在那之后，改装赛车比赛开始涌入越来越多种类的赛车。

的确，这款车来自于那个公路车和赛车
相似度极高的时代。

collection.en:
If you call yourself a racing fan, then you're no doubt
familiar with NASCAR.

Its race machines are loosely based on production cars,
and the series is extremely popular in the U.S.

Established in 1948, NASCAR is a motorsport series
with a lot of history behind it.

Among the more legendary race cars in the history of
NASCAR is the Plymouth Superbird.

Towards the end of the 1960s, NASCAR race cars were starting
to regularly exceed speeds of more than <300km/h>.

The Superbird was based on the Plymouth Road Runner.

Its long nose and large rear wing helped increase stability
at high speeds.

These aerodynamic advantages translated to incredibly
fast lap times that left the competition in the dust.

The brass at NASCAR weren't thrilled in seeing the
lopsided results of the races...

...nor did they want to see race car production costs
skyrocket, making it inaccessible to the masses.

As a result, the Superbird was discontinued after two years.

Regardles, it's remembered as a legendary muscle car.
collection.zh:
只要是对赛车感兴趣的人，肯定
都听说过美国的纳斯卡赛车系列赛。

这是一项超高速系列赛，使用车辆
均为与量产车型有深厚联系的赛车。

始于1948年，这项汽车赛事的
系列赛背后有着无数精彩的历史。

普利茅斯Superbird是一款
专门为纳斯卡赛车开发的传奇肌肉车。

在20世纪60年代末，纳斯卡赛车的
比赛时速屡屡突破<300km/h>大关。

Superbird的开发是基于普利茅斯路跑的。

它配备了一个长车头与尾部的大尾翼
有助于增加高速时的稳定性。

这些空气动力学优势使它在比赛中创下了
多个出色的单圈时间纪录。

然而，纳斯卡赛车的赛会却对这种
专为比赛而设计的汽车全无好感。

他们担心这会提高赛车成本
而让赛事更加难以接近。

因此，Superbird的生产只持续了两年。

它真的是一款大胆而罕见的美国肌肉车。

vehicleCollection.en:
This stock car for the street had a wedge-shaped front end and one of the tallest rear wings ever to grace a production car.

From the middle of the 1969 season, the Charger 500 Daytona made its appearance in stock car racing. It took full advantage of its aerodynamics, and was performing very well. This in turn raised demand from teams racing Plymouth race cars which are in the same Chrysler group, for a model that has the same aerodynamics as the Daytona.

The answer to those demands was the Superbird.

Because Plymouth did not produce a vehicle that could be considered the sibling of the Charger, the Road Runner — with the same intermediate-class chassis — was selected to be its base.

Because of the familiar extended nose and rear wing, it looks very similar to the Daytona, but there are slight differences to details such as the shape of the roof.

Because the number of cars required for homologation was doubled in 1970 from 500 cars to 1000, and with the Daytona’s performing so well on the circuit, many Superbirds made it to the streets, not just the circuit.

The base engine for the Superbird was the 375ps 440 Super Commando, with a 426 Hemi producing over 425ps, and a 390ps 440 six barrel as options. This was more in line with the GTX, which was ranked above the Road Runner.

The Superbird was produced, like the Daytona, during the homologation certification period of only one year.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这是一辆拥有令人难以置信的巨大尾翼和延展车头的原厂赛车。

从1969年赛季中期开始，Charger 500 Daytona在原厂车比赛中亮相。它充分发挥了其在空气动力学方面的优势，取得了极其优异的表现。这反过来促使使用普利茅斯赛车（与克莱斯勒同属一个集团）的车队提出需求，要求获得一款具备与戴通纳相同的空气动力学特性的车型。对这些需求的回应就是Superbird。

普利茅斯没有选择直接生产一台Charger血统的车型，而是选择了具有相同中级底盘的路跑作为其赛车的基础。

Superbird看起来与Daytona非常相似，同样拥有眼熟的加长车头和尾翼等特征，只在细节上有细微差别，如车顶的形状等。

1970年，通过赛事认证所需的量产车数量翻了一番，从500辆增加到1000辆。随着Daytona在赛道上的表现愈发出色，也让更多的Superbird有机会出现在了街头和赛道上。

Superbird使用的基础引擎是375ps的440超级突击队。另有两个备选版本：可产生超过425ps动力的426 Hemi引擎，以及产生390ps的440六缸引擎。这样的配置基本上照搬了规格与性能还在路跑之上的普利茅斯 GTX的产品线。

和Daytona一样，Superbird只在赛事认证期内生产了一年。

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
Virgil Exner is a designer that I'm quite fond of.

After working with Raymond Loewy, he served as the first
design director for Chrysler from 1953 to 1961.

With designs overflowing with personality, he was the
leading figure in the golden age of Chrysler design.

From all of those creations, the one that stands out to me
is the XNR.

This concept car can be regarded as an answer to sports cars
like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.

It features a unique asymmetrical design, with an air scoop,
interior panel and tailfin serving as accents.

One might call the styling of this car outrageous,
but it was very fresh.
dialogues.zh:
维尔基尔·艾克斯勒是我非常欣赏的设计师。

在与雷蒙德·洛威展开合作后，他在1953到1961年之间
担任Chrysler的首位设计总监。

他的设计洋溢着个人风格，
也是Chrysler设计黄金时代的领导人物。

在他所有的创作中，我觉得最杰出的就是这辆XNR。

这款概念车可以称得上是Chrysler对Chevrolet Corvette和
Ford Thunderbird等跑车的回应。

它采用了独特的非对称设计，并通过进气口、
内衬板和尾翼等元素加以强调。

也许有人会认为这样的风格十分离经叛道，
但确实做到了让所有人耳目一新。*

conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.en:
Virgil Exner is a designer that I'm quite fond of.

After working with Raymond Loewy, he served as the first
design director for Chrysler from 1953 to 1961.

With designs overflowing with personality, he was the
leading figure in the golden age of Chrysler design.

From all of those creations, the one that stands out to me
is the XNR.

This concept car can be regarded as an answer to sports cars
like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.

It features a unique asymmetrical design, with an air scoop,
interior panel and tailfin serving as accents.

One might call the styling of this car outrageous,
but it was very fresh.
conversation.zh:
维尔基尔·艾克斯勒是我非常欣赏的设计师。

在与雷蒙德·洛威展开合作后，他在1953到1961年之间
担任Chrysler的首位设计总监。

他的设计洋溢着个人风格，
也是Chrysler设计黄金时代的领导人物。

在他所有的创作中，我觉得最杰出的就是这辆XNR。

这款概念车可以称得上是Chrysler对Chevrolet Corvette和
Ford Thunderbird等跑车的回应。

它采用了独特的非对称设计，并通过进气口、
内衬板和尾翼等元素加以强调。

也许有人会认为这样的风格十分离经叛道，
但确实做到了让所有人耳目一新。*

collection.en:
This unique Plymouth roadster is best known for having been
designed by Carrozzeria Ghia.

But do you know where the "XNR" name comes from?

If you try to read “XNR” out loud, it sounds just like
"Exner," doesn't it?

It's the name of the legendary American designer
Virgil Max Exner...

...who led Chrysler's design for much of the 1950s and 1960s.

He developed various designs in conjunction with
Luigi Segre of Carrozzeria Ghia.

Many innovative and interesting designs
resulted from this collaboration.

And this XNR Ghia Roadster was one of them.

The XNR also made waves in 2011 when it claimed the Gran Turismo
Trophy at the Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
collection.zh:
这款独特的Plymouth敞篷跑车的出名之处在于
它是由Carrozzeria Ghia设计的。

但您知道“XNR”这个名字是怎么来的吗？

您读一下就会发现“XNR”听起来很像“Exner”，对吧？

这款车的名字正是取自美国传奇设计师Virgil Max Exner，

他于上世纪50至60年代主要领导Chrysler的设计。

他与Carrozzeria Ghia的Luigi Segre 合作完成了许多设计，

二人的合作带来了大量创新而有趣的作品。

这辆XNR Ghia Roadster就是其中之一。

这辆XNR还于2011年在圆石滩经典车展夺得了Gran Turismo奖杯，
再次吸引了所有人的目光。

vehicleCollection.en:
The Gran Turismo Trophy winner, with unique asymmetric styling.

The car that won the Gran Turismo Trophy at the 61st Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in 2011 was this 1960 Plymouth XNR Ghia Roadster.

The designer was Virgil Exner, the legend who led the golden years of Chrysler in the 1950s and 1960s. The XNR Ghia Roadster, which inherited his name in abbreviated form, was actually built by Carrozzeria Ghia, a company that Exner had close ties with.

Plymouth represented the entry-level brand for Chrysler, but that didn't stop Exner from incorporating technology into his creation that had trickled down from Chrysler's involvement in NASCAR. This concept car was made as the future of sports cars that would rival cars like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.

By far, the most striking feature was its asymmetric styling. From the air intake in the car's nose to the flow from the headrest to the rear, it's Exner's interpretation of aerodynamic styling that characterized 1950s racing. The cockpit's right side is covered with a tonneau cover which makes the car appear to be a single-seater at first glance, but there actually is a seat hiding under the cover, making it a fully-fledged 2-seat sports car.

The prominent fins on the sides of the body were actually a shared design feature from the Valiant, the car on which the concept car was based. Although its overly avant-garde styling ultimately proved too much for the market, thus prohibiting the car from making it to mass production, the XNR did manage to make major shockwaves in the car design realm at the time and gave a glimpse into the depth of American Automotive History.
vehicleCollection.zh:
GT奖杯获得者，独树一帜的不对称设计风格让人眼前一亮。!

在2011年举办的第61届圆石滩优雅竞赛中，这台来自1960年的普利茅斯 XNR Ghia Roadste荣获了GT奖杯。

负责设计这款车型的传奇设计师便是维吉尔·埃克斯纳，他在1950到1960年代将克莱斯勒带入了黄金时代。XNR便是以他的名字命名的。这款车的车身来自于Ghia，后者与埃克斯纳的合作堪称亲密无间。

普利茅斯原本是克莱斯勒的入门级品牌，然而埃克斯纳却借助克莱斯勒在纳斯卡赛车中的表现，将高性能的印象植入到这辆车中。制造这辆概念赛车的目的是在未来成为与雪佛兰科尔维特和福特雷鸟比肩的跑车。

最令人眼前一亮的当属其非对称的设计风格。从前鼻的进气口、引擎盖的隆起，再到座椅头枕到后部的线条，无不体现出埃克斯纳对50年代赛车的空气动力学造型的解读和诠释。座舱右侧被车厢盖布全部覆盖，让人在初见时错以为这辆车仅限单人驾驶。揭开盖布露出副驾驶座椅后，才让人明白这是一辆不折不扣的双座车型。

车身两侧突出的侧鳍则来源于其设计原型，另一款车型勇猛者。虽然过于前卫的造型设计使得这款车无法投入量产，但却在当时的车辆设计行业引发了一场地震。通过这款车型，我们也能对美国汽车工业的历史纵深有所了解。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
Polestar is an electric vehicle brand from Sweden.

Among its lineup is the hybrid Polestar 5...

...a four-door GT that produces more than 800 horsepower!

You know, Polestar has a bit more history behind it
than meets the eye.

It originally served as Volvo’s racing division in the mid-1990s.

The team even collaborated with Volvo to develop several
road-going sports cars.

In 2017, Polestar branched out on its own as a high-performance
electric vehicle brand.

So now you know a little more about Polestar,
a Swedish company with deep racing roots!
dialogues.zh:
Polestar是源自瑞典的电动汽车品牌。

其产品阵容中包含这款混动版Polestar 5……

这是一款动力超过800匹马力的四门GT车型！

事实上，“Polestar”的品牌底蕴远比表面所见更为深厚。

九十年代中期，它曾担任Volvo的赛车研发部门。

甚至协助Volvo打造了多款公路版运动车型。

2017年，品牌正式独立，转型为高性能电动汽车制造商。

总之，现在你应该对Polestar有点初步概念了——
这是一家植根赛车传统的瑞典企业！
?

brandCentral.en:
Polestar is a premium EV brand from Sweden with a
unique focus on speed and sustainability.

Its flagship car is the Polestar 5, a grand AWD saloon
measuring 5m in length.

Its panoramic glass roof doesn't compromise visibility
thanks to a camera-supported virtual rear-view mirror.

Powered by dual motors at the car’s front and back,
the performance model can output 650 kW...

And employs BWI MagneRide dampers that can read the road up
to 1,000 times per second, increasing comfort and speed.

Its 800V battery supports charging rates up to 350 kW, and
its rear motor can be detached to boost efficiency.

Sustainable inside and out, the Polestar 5 may very well be
a guiding light for automotive design in the years to come.
brandCentral.zh:
Polestar是来自瑞典的高端电动品牌，
对于速度与可持续性有独到专注。

其旗舰车型Polestar 5是一款大型四驱轿车，
车长达到5m。

全景玻璃车顶丝毫不影响后方视野，
这得益于通过摄像头实现的虚拟后视镜。

前后双电机加持的Performance版可输出650千瓦……

还配备了BWI MagneRide减震器，每秒可扫描路面信息
高达1.000次，从而提升行驶时的舒适感与疾速。

800V高压电池支持最高350千瓦充电功率，
后电机可分离，以提升能效。

由内到外贯彻可持续理念的Polestar 5，
很有希望成为未来汽车设计的指路明灯。

vehicleCollection.en:
Polestar's flagship model combines sustainability with high-performance.

The Polestar 5 is the flagship model of the Scandinavian high-performance electric brand, Polestar. It represents the realization of ideas introduced by the Precept concept car in 2020, embodying pure Scandinavian design, advanced technology, and sustainability.

Its stretched form, measuring 5m in length, draws inspiration from aircraft, while the panel structure and expansive glass roof, extending toward the rear, contribute to its aerodynamic efficiency. With a drag coefficient of just 0.24, the bonded aluminum body delivers a lightweight yet rigid structure, offering greater torsional rigidity than many sports cars.

The powertrain employs a dual-motor system built around an in-house developed electric rear motor. The Performance Edition is capable of a total system output of 650 kW (884ps) and runs from zero to <100km/h> in just 3.2 seconds. Its 800 V electric architecture enables 350 kW fast charging, replenishing the battery from 10 percent to 80 in only 22 minutes. Maximum range under WLTP testing reached 670km for the Dual Motor edition.

The suspension consists of a specially designed double-wishbone layout. The Performance Edition features magnetorheological dampers that read the road surface up to 1,000 times per second, balancing agility with comfort. Driver assistance systems extend further, with automatic lane and speed control operating up to <150km/h>.

With futuristic design, remarkable electric performance, and a deep commitment to sustainability, the Polestar 5 stands as the ultimate grand tourer package.
vehicleCollection.zh:
将环保理念与高性能完美融合的极星旗舰车型。

极星5是源自斯堪的纳维亚地区高性能电动汽车品牌极星的旗舰车型。该车型完美践行了2020年发布的“Precept”概念车所倡导的理念，通过纯正的斯堪的纳维亚设计、前沿科技与可持续性理念得以具象化呈现。

修长的5m车身造型从飞机设计汲取灵感，延伸至车尾的面板结构与玻璃车顶共同实现了卓越的空气动力学表现。该车型车身风阻系数仅为0.24，采用铝材胶接技术打造出轻量化且高刚性的车身架构，其抗扭刚度甚至优于众多跑车。

动力总成采用双电机系统，其核心为自主研发的后置电机。Performance性能版可实现650千瓦（884ps）的总输出功率，0-<100km/h>加速时间仅需3.2秒。800伏电气架构支持350千瓦快速充电，仅需22分钟即可将电池电量从10%提升至80%。全球统一轻型汽车测试程序测试标准下的最大续航里程为670km（双电机版）。

悬架系统采用特殊设计的双叉臂结构。Performance性能版搭载磁流变液减震器，可每秒1000次实时扫描路面状况，完美兼顾舒适驾乘与敏捷操控。该车还配备全面的驾驶员辅助系统，支持最高<150km/h>的自主车道保持与速度控制功能。

极星5集前瞻设计、卓越电动性能与可持续性于一身，以终极豪华旅行车的姿态完美呈现了所有这些特质。

usedCar.en:
The Pontiac Firebird was built to compete with the Mustang.

The high-performance version, called the Trans Am, gained
widespread fame in the movie "Smokey and the Bandit."

Despite the oil crisis of the 1970s, Pontiac elected to
retain the large V-8 engine in subsequent designs.

This particular model is the second-generation Firebird
Trans Am that came equipped with a 6.6-liter V-8.

You can call it the Chevrolet Camaro's brother because both
were built by General Motors.

The two cars were historically called the F-body pony cars.~
usedCar.zh:
Pontiac Firebird是Ford Mustang的最著名的竞争对手之一。

它的高性能版本Trans Am永远地改写了
美国跑车历史的进程。

尽管选择了在后续设计中保留大排量的V8引擎。

这个特殊的车型就是第二代
Firebird Trans Am。

它发布于1978年，搭载前置6.6L V8引擎。

对于许多人来说，
Pontiac仍然经典的“肌肉车”。

vehicleCollection.en:
Made famous by Burt Reynolds in "Smokey and the Bandit," this was one of the leading '70s muscle cars.

Pontiac was the sporty upscale brand of General Motors, and the model which helped define the division in its heyday was an American muscle car called the Firebird. It was created to take on Ford's ultra-popular pony car, the Mustang.

Many variations of the Firebird were produced in order to compete against its famous rival, with Pontiac making the cars faster and more luxurious. The top model "Trans Am" was a car enthusiast's dream: the name of this top-of-the-line model, which ended up becoming more famous than the original "Firebird" name, was taken from the popular sports car racing series. The Pontiac Trans Am, with its giant Firebird sticker garnishing the hood, became a revered muscle car, and a classic American automotive symbol of the 1970s.

The final 1978 model of the second-generation series was available with both a 400 or 403 cubic inch V8. The big, high-compression 6.6-liter mill was an engine exclusive to Pontiac, and was not available in its pony car brother, the Chevrolet Camaro. The brass at Pontiac figured that instead of aligning the Trans Am with the Camaro, they were better off developing a special engine unique to the Firebird. Also, the car possessed a four-headlamp design, instead of the customary two, which differentiated it from the Camaro and other GM products.

The car was a great hit, and the Firebird Trans Am lives on in infinite lore as the car driven by Burt Reynolds in the movie "Smokey and the Bandit."
vehicleCollection.zh:
来自1970年的头号肌肉车，核心是一颗自行研发的特殊引擎。

庞蒂亚克是通用汽车旗下的高端运动品牌，在曾经的峥嵘岁月里，撑起这一品牌的是一款美国市场独有的车型：火鸟。

在当时，它的竞争对手是畅销全美的小马车——福特旗下的Mustang。为了与这位著名的竞争对手一较高下，火鸟陆续推出过多款车型，有些专注速度，有些则兼顾奢华感。

其中的顶级车型“Trans Am”是爱好者心目中的梦想车款。这个车型的命名来自1978年全美热门的跑车系列赛事，最终变得比火鸟的本名更为人熟知。庞蒂亚克Trans Am及其引擎盖上的硕大火鸟贴纸，代表着1970年代最最热门的肌肉车。

第二代火鸟的最后一个1978年车款上分别搭载了400立方英寸和403立方英寸的两款引擎。这台高压缩比的6.6升V8引擎是由庞蒂亚克自研开发的，甚至未开放给其兄弟车型雪佛兰科迈罗使用。对他们来说，使用科迈罗同款引擎还不够好，所以希望制造一台有别于其他任何车款的特殊引擎来宣告Trans Am的独一无二。

可以这么说，火鸟Trans Am代表的是庞蒂亚克的骄傲和原则。

dialogues.en:
The Pontiac GTO was a king among American muscle cars,
and the GTO 'The Judge' was the ultimate GTO.

My favourite aspect of the 1969 GTO 'The Judge' was the
beautifully sculpted body side and soft fender peaks.

It’s unfortunate that the rear bumper didn’t get the
same colour treatment as that of the front bumper.

Other than that, all this car needs are much larger wheels.

They would make the design look more balanced
and athletic.\
dialogues.zh:
Pontiac GTO就是美国肌肉车之王，
而这辆GTO 'The Judge'则是终极的GTO。

我对这辆1969款GTO 'The Judge'最喜爱的一点就是
它那雕塑般硬朗的车身侧线条与柔和的挡泥板上部的交融。

这里有个小小的遗憾，它的后保险杠并没有采用
与前保险杠相同的喷漆颜色。

除此之外，这辆车唯一欠缺之处就是需要更大的轮毂。

大尺寸的轮毂可以让它整体看上去更平衡、更具运动感。

collection.en:
Introduced in 1964, the Pontiac GTO is considered
one of the first American muscle cars.

In a series of one-upmanship by various manufacturers, the GTO's
performance was soon eclipsed by the competition.

In response, Pontiac created a new high-performance
model called "The Judge."

It came equipped with a powerful 6.6-liter V-8.

It also boasted wide tires, a rear spoiler and distinctive livery
that gave the car an extremely powerful presence.

Because of The Judge, the Pontiac GTO retained its rightful
place at the top of the muscle-car heap.
collection.zh:
被视为美式肌肉车的先驱之一的
Pontiac GTO于1964年推出。

但没过多久，强大竞争对手就将它的表现掩盖。

作为回应，Pontiac将希望寄托在一款
新的高性能版本，“The Judge”。

除了性能卓越的6.6升V8引擎外……

 其外观也在独特的贴花，宽轮胎、后扰流板与
其他装饰的加持下显得霸气。

多亏了“The Judge”的存在，Pontiac GTO才能维持
其在肌肉车领域其应有的领导地位。

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate sports spec car that appeared towards the end of the GTO era, when muscle cars flourished.

The first-generation Pontiac GTO, which was introduced in 1964, was a big hit and is credited for the boom in street-legal muscle cars. The second-generation model followed in 1968 with a more stylish fastback style and decent performance. It wasn't enough to prevent the GTO from losing its king-of-the-hill status to its increasingly impressive rivals, however.

Keen to rectify this situation, in 1969, General Motors released a new GTO known as "The Judge." The standard sports package wore an exclusive logo and stripe decals, and powered by a 6.6-liter V-8 "Ram Air 3" engine that was said to be capable of more than the advertised 366ps. It was mated to a Hurst shifter. The car had a heavy-duty suspension system, wide tires, and a rear spoiler. Despite all this, it only cost $332 more than the standard GTO. In terms of both performance and sheer presence, it outdid its rivals and attracted plenty of attention.

Muscle cars such as the GTO started to disappear when strict emissions regulations were introduced a couple of years later.
vehicleCollection.zh:
在肌肉车首次领跑的GTO时代末期出现的终极运动规格车辆。

第一代庞蒂亚克GTO于1964年首次亮相并获得了很大的成功，据说这是第一辆能够合法上路的肌肉车。然而，1968年推出的第二代车型转而采用了风格更鲜明的溜背设计，虽然动力表现依旧不俗，但随着动力更强劲的竞争对手登上舞台，渐渐显露不支之态。

为了扭转这一局面，1969年通用汽车发布了“The Judge”。该运动套件售价仅为332美元，却包含了相当丰富的“标准配件”。其中包含了独家标志和条纹贴花、一个赫斯特变速箱、重型悬挂车架、宽胎以及后扰流板。引擎升级为一台6.6升“冲压空气III”V8引擎，官方标明的动力输出为366ps，但据说其实力不止于此。最终“The Judge”无论是性能还是车身外观，都超越了竞争对手，引来了广泛的关注。

不过只过了一年，随着更严格的排放法规在美国推出，GTO这样的肌肉车逐渐退出了历史舞台。

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The 1956 GS Carrera Coupe was the most powerful
and most luxurious Porsche available in its day.

This year marked the first time we saw the improved "A" model.

It was visually similar to the "pre-A,"
except it had the 15-inch wheels...

...with larger rear-wheel openings and non-rolled rocker sills.

The GS had the same sill and bumper trim as the lower
line models, but there really wasn't a visual difference...

...except for the fact that the rear sat a bit lower due to
the heavier 4-cam Carrera engine.

The interior was the same as well, except there were two
push-pull switches above the instrumentation.

This was to control the dual coils specific
to the Carrera engine.

When you opened up the rear lid, you saw the real difference between the A and pre-A.

The 4-cam Carrera engine was an artistic masterpiece!
The fan shroud and assembly were gorgeous too!=
dialogues.zh:
‘56 ‘GS’ Carrera Coupe是保时捷史上最强劲、最豪华的一款。

名称中的56代表经过大刀阔斧改进的365A新款
问世的首个年份。

在外观上，它与之前的“pre-A”车型非常相似，
唯一不同之处在于采用了新款15英寸车轮……

后轮轮拱更大，侧裙没有滚边。

由于GS车型与低端车型都采用同款侧裙和保险杠装饰，
所所以外观上并无差异……

只是因为搭载了更重的四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎，
车尾被压得更低。

内饰也几乎一模一样，只在
仪表板上方多了两个推拉按钮，

那是用来控制“Carrera”引擎独有的两个点火线圈的。

只有当你打开后引擎盖时，才能发现真正的差别所在！

你会发现，四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎简直是一件美妙的艺术品！
连风扇罩和总成打造得异常精美！

collection.en:
On the outside, the Porsche GS Carrera looks no different
from other 356 coupes of its day,

 but what makes this GS Carrera so special
and raises its value,

is the four-cam 1.5L engine that produces 100ps.

This engine was the most powerful version
available for the 356 series at the time.

It was also possible to order lighter speedster seats,
and even without heaters to reduce weight.

That's why the GS was not just a fast street car,
but was also seen in many races.

I think you'll find that it's directly linked to
Porsche's illustrious past!
collection.zh:
从外观上看，Porsche GS Carrera和当时的其他356 coupe
并无二致，

但令GS Carrera如此独特而价值不菲的，

是那台能够输出100ps的四凸轮1.5L引擎。

这款引擎代表了当时356车系的最强动力版本。

同时这款车接受定制轻量化的speedster座椅，甚至为了减重拆
除了加热系统。

也因此，GS不仅是一辆够快的街车，更是许多赛事的常客。

看着它的光辉履历您就会发现，这辆车与Porsche辉煌的过去
密不可分！

vehicleCollection.en:
A semi-race equipped model of the 356A, one of the cars that contributed to the Porsche mystique.

The 356, Porsche's first mass-produced car, made its debut in 1949 and immediately revolutionized the compact sports-car genre. An updated version of the original model called the 356A appeared in 1955 and again in 1959.

The 356A featured a rounded windshield, soft padding above the interior panels, and a horn at the center of the steering wheel. Performance of the car increased every year, ultimately leading to the 1500 GS Carrera and the 1500 GS GT Carrera, which were limited-production models billed as the GT3 of their day.

Powering the 356A was a slightly detuned version of the 4-cam engine found in the 550 Spyder race car. The road-going 1500 GS Carrera produced 100ps, while the track-ready 1500 GS GT Carrera pumped out 110ps. Both cars were offered as a coupe, cabriolet, and speedster.

Of particular note is that the 1500 GS Carrera was the first to go by the "Carrera" name, which has now become synonymous with Porsche.
vehicleCollection.zh:
356A的半赛事车型，该车使保时捷闻名于世。

保时捷356是保时捷的第一款量产车型，于1949年首次亮相，并在1955年和1959年经历了两次大改款。在这一时期诞生的型号被统称为356A。

356A的各个方面都在向现代设计靠拢，包括更自然的前车窗弧线、内饰面板上包裹的软垫，以及在方向盘中央加装喇叭等。自诞生之日起，356A的性能越来越强大，最终生产出的几款限量车型：1500 GS Carrera和1500 GS GT Carrera，成为了一直延续至今的GT3系列的前身。

1500 GS采用的4凸轮引擎来自550 Spyder赛车，但性能略微调低。1500 GS Carrera的定位是公路车，输出动力为100ps，1500 GS GT Carrera则是半赛车，输出动力为110ps。保时捷为这款车型提供了双门、敞篷和双座敞篷等多种款式选择。

多年来，Carrera这个名字已成为保时捷的代表，而第一款冠以Carrera之名的车就是356A 1500 GS/GS GT。

cars.nameZh: Porsche 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster '56

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster takes the most
spartan model in the Porsche lineup...

...and pushes it into the level of "unobtanium."

The Speedster shape and form are an extension
of the other 356A models, but more extreme.

With its low wrap-around windshield, tall shoulder...

...and longer rear deck...

...the Speedster has attitude.

Both James Dean and Steve McQueen had Speedsters.

Unique to the Carrera GT are the deletion of
the side spears and sill deco.

The bumpers do away with the bumper horns and the deco
is replaced with aluminum trim.

You can also see the front leather tie-down straps
and GT roll bar.

The GT eventually received aluminum opening panels.

And even the normal-looking wheels are specially
constructed of steel and aluminum.

As with all Porches, you really need to take a close look at
each model to know all the variations.
dialogues.zh:
356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster是基于保时捷产品线中
最简约的车型开发的……

又将其推向了“无法企及”的境界！

Speedster的外形沿袭了其他356A车型的设计，
但更加的极致……

低矮的环绕式挡风玻璃、高耸的轮眉……

还有更长的后部，
无不彰显其自成一派的风范！

詹姆斯·迪恩和史蒂夫·麦奎因都曾
将Speedster作为他们的座驾。

这个Carrera GT版本的独特之处在于
取消了侧面装饰条和侧裙装饰。

前保险杠取消了撞角，用铝制饰条取代了装饰件。

你还可以看到前盖的皮革固定带和后座的GT防护杆。

GT车型最终采用了铝制板材……

甚至看起来平平无奇的轮圈也是
钢铝混合材质的特殊结构。

保]捷的车总是需要你仔细观察才能分辨出它与
普通“推杆”车型的各种差异！这一台也不例外。

collection.en:
It's a well-known fact that Porsche’s first production car
started with the rear-engine Porsche 356.

Full production of the 356 series began in 1950...

...and the coupe model was soon followed by
open-top versions.

All of these models shared a boxed sheet metal
chassis with independent suspension.

And the flat-4 engine was available in five
different displacements and output.

A slightly modified 356A appeared in 1955.

In 1956, a high performance 1.5-liter engine developed for
the 550 Spyder was offered as an option.

Models equipped with the powerful 1.5-liter engine
were called the GS Carrera.

They are known to have been cars that could immediately
be raced as is.

This model is a GS Carrera GT, characterized by
a lighter body and powerful engine.

These cars are collectibles that rarely change hands,
so don't miss your chance to drive it!
collection.zh:
众所周知，保时捷的第一辆量产车
是引擎后置的保时捷356。

356系列的全面生产始于1950年……

继双门硬顶版本之后很快推出了敞篷版。

所有车型都适配了搭载独立悬挂的箱形金属底盘，

水平对置四缸引擎则有五种不同的排量和动力输出可选。

小改款356A于1955年推出，

到了1956年，专为550 Spyder设计开发的
高性能1.5升引擎正式登场。

配备了强大的1.5升引擎的车型被称为GS Carrera。

它们的特点在于可以随时下场参加比赛。

这台车型为GS GT Carrera，配备了
更轻的车身和更强大的引擎。

是相当罕见的Speedster款，几乎未曾易手，
您绝不会想错过亲手驾驭这款车的机会！

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Ah, the 1973 Porsche 911 Carrera RS...
What a legend! What a treasure!

This precious gem was designed to compete
in touring car races.

Touring car races are specifically for modified
production cars.

The extent to which a car can be modified
is heavily restricted by FIA guidelines.

But transforming high-performance road cars into
pure race cars...

...is serious business for many automakers, and it has
led to the some really special machines.

These cars are known as homologation models, which
means they meet FIA requirements for competition.

When the FIA revised its world championship regulations
in 1973...

...Porsche was approved to compete in Group 4 (Gr.4)
of the Grand Touring competition.

The 911 Carrera RS was the homologation model designed
to conquer this Gr.4 class.

The road-going car was made lighter and more powerful
than the standard 911...

...and served as the base for the competition-tuned
911 Carrera RSR!

When the 911 Carrera RSR made its debut in March 1973
at the 12 Hours of Sebring in Florida...

...it turned heads with a dazzling 1-2 finish!

After that, it continued to perform well at
the world championship series!

It even came out on top against more powerful rivals at
major races like the Daytona 24 Hours and Targa Florio.

That season was simply magificent, as it scored a well-deserved
world championship title!
dialogues.zh:
啊，1973款保时捷911 Carrera RS……
好一个传奇！好一颗瑰宝！

这款保时捷的掌上明珠是专为参加房车赛而设计的，

后者是专为公路车改装赛车设立的比赛。

尽管其改装程度受到了国际汽联准则的严格限制……

但打造一台可以轻易改装为符合
赛事规格赛车的高性能公路车……

依然有许多汽车制造商将其视为工作的重点。
也因此，许多出类拔萃的高性能车应运而生。

这类汽车被称为“赛事认证车型”，
代表它们符合国际汽联的比赛规格要求。

当国际汽联在1973年修订其世界锦标赛规则时……

保时捷被批准参加房车赛组别4（Gr.4）级别的比赛。

这台911 Carrera RS正是为征服组别4级别赛事而设计的赛事认证车型。
这款改装后的公路跑车比标准版911更轻、动力也更强劲

并成为了竞赛规格的911 Carrera RSR的原型！

911 Carrera RSR于1973年3月在佛罗里达州的
赛百灵12小时耐力赛上首次亮相……

就以包揽前两名的惊人战绩让所有人眼前一亮！

此后，它继续在世界锦标赛的各项系列赛中发挥出色！

它甚至在戴通纳24小时耐力赛和塔格·佛罗热等重大比赛中
力压性能更强大的对手并脱颖而出。
对于保时捷来说，这是一个辉煌的赛季，
也是属于当之无愧的世界冠军的胜利！

代表它们符合国际汽联的比赛规格要求。

当国际汽联在1973年修订其世界锦标赛规则时……

保时捷被批准参加房车赛组别4（Gr.4）级别的比赛。

这台911 Carrera RS正是为征服组别4级别赛事而设计的赛事认证车型。
这款改装后的公路跑车比标准版911更轻、动力也更强劲

并成为了竞赛规格的911 Carrera RSR的原型！

911 Carrera RSR于1973年3月在佛罗里达州的
赛百灵12小时耐力赛上首次亮相……

就以包揽前两名的惊人战绩让所有人眼前一亮！

此后，它继续在世界锦标赛的各项系列赛中发挥出色！

它甚至在戴通纳24小时耐力赛和塔格·佛罗热等重大比赛中
力压性能更强大的对手并脱颖而出。
对于保时捷来说，这是一个辉煌的赛季，
也是属于当之无愧的世界冠军的胜利！

collection.en:
There have been many great Porsche 911s over the years,
but the Carrera RS stands out as a shining masterpiece.

The 1973 Carrera RS was the first production
911 to wear the "Carrera RS" name.

And it was built specifically to win races.

It was a homologation model designed to meet FIA Group 4
regulations.

Its engine displacement was increased to 2.7 liters
from 2.4 liters of the standard 911.

The car was lighter than the stock version because
all luxury and convenience amenities were removed.

Summer tires were chosen for enhanced grip, aided by
special front and rear spoilers.

The "ducktail" rear spoiler served as a
particularly iconic design feature.

The 911 Carrera RS was sold in limited numbers
from late 1972 to 1973.

And while race iterations of other 911s followed,
a trend that continues to this day...

...the 911 Carrera RS was the first of the series,
thus, it now enjoys legendary status among Porsche fans. &
collection.zh:
多年以来，保时捷911推出过许多款伟大的车型，
不过Carrera RS才是其中最闪亮的杰作。

1973款Carrera RS是第一辆被冠以
“Carrera RS”之名的911……

也是专为胜利所打造的比赛机器。

这辆针对国际汽联组别4规则所开发的认证赛车……

将引擎排量从标准911车型的2.4升增加到了2.7升。

此外，它还拆除了一切非必要的部件，
让车重得到了大幅减轻。

为了增强抓地力，这款车采用了夏用轮胎，
并由特制的前后扰流板来辅助增加下压力。

车尾的“鸭尾”扰流板是其极具标志性的特征。

这款911 Carrera RS仅在1972到1973年之间限量销售。

尽管在此之后，多款后续赛车型号继承了前辈的衣钵，
直至演化到最新款的911……

但作为系列的开山之作，这款911 Carrera RS永远
享有最传奇的知名度。

vehicleCollection.en:
A first in Porsche 911 history, the elusive Rennsport.

Introduced in 1973, the 911 Carrera RS 2.7 was the first model in the long history of the Porsche 911 to feature the RS badge. The "RS" stands for "Rennsport," which is translated as "racing sport" in English. As its name suggests, this sports car was developed as a homologation model for the FIA's Group 4 category.

Mounted at the rear is a 2.4-liter engine from the base model 1973 911 S, but displacement was increased to 2.7 liters, which in turn upped power to 210ps. The front end was modified to house an air dam that fed into an oil cooler. The tail section of the car featured the iconic duck-tail spoiler as standard fare, and the fenders were stretched to make room for wider rear tires.

The Carrera RS 2.7 came in three grades: Touring, Sport and Racing. Of note, even the luxury-oriented Touring model weighed less than 1100kg.

The car was originally produced in a limited homologation run of 500 units; however, because it sold out almost immediately, Porsche increased production to 1,580 units.
vehicleCollection.zh:
保时捷911历史上首款冠以稀有的比赛运动型之名的型号。"

于1973年亮相的911 Carrera RS 2.7是保时捷911那漫长历史上第一款采用了RS徽标的型号。RS代表了“Rennsport”，也就是“比赛运动型”的意思。顾名思义，这款车是作为国际汽联组别4组别赛事认证型号而开发的。

它将1973款911 S中的2.4升引擎扩容到了2.7升，可以输出210ps的动力。车头底部的前保险杠加宽，以便多容纳一部油冷器。而车尾则标配了标志性的鸭尾型扰流板；为了容纳宽胎，还延长了后挡泥板。

Carrera RS 2.7共推出了三个等级的配置：旅行、运动和赛车。即便是其中配置最豪华的旅行款，重量也不超过1100kg。

这辆车起初只计划按照认证规则限量生成500辆，但因为几乎瞬间售罄，导致保时捷不得不追加生产。这款车型最终总共生产了1580辆。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
The only notable difference with the standard 964 Carrera
is the 40mm lower ride height.

You may not notice that because it's very discreet.
At a glance you would think it was a standard 964.

But that's another element that woos the fans
of the 964 911 Carrera RS.

It's extremely pure to say the least. There are no comfort
items here at all.

As a result, it's 120kg lighter, and its handling
is razor sharp.

I'm certain it will continue to rise in value over time.
It's definitely one of the best of the best.
?
dialogues.zh:
这款车与标准的964 Carrera唯一明显的视觉差异是
离地间隙又降低了40mm。

如果没注意到这个差异，
你可能会错以为这是台标准版本的964。

但是，令964型911 Carrera RS的铁粉们
疯狂的要点在于

它的极致简化配置，完全摒弃了
装饰件和舒适性功能。

其结果便是高达120kg的减重，以及如同手术刀般
犀利的操控。

这款车的价值无疑会持续攀高，
因为它绝对是一辆好车中的好车。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
Even I know this one—the Porsche 911 is famous.

I thought this would be a really expensive model.

But this RS doesn’t have much in the way of equipment.

I don’t even see a door handle.

Oh, you pull this red strap?

So it’s all to make the car lighter?

That’s pretty wild. They really went that far
to save weight.
dialogues.zh:
就连我都知道这款车，Porsche 911太有名了。

我还以为这款车会非常非常贵，可是……这款RS上面
缺了好多的设备呀。

我甚至连门把手都没见着。
哦，你要拉这根红绳……
所以这都是为了让车更轻？
这也太疯狂了，他们居然会为了减重做这么极端的事。
?

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.

Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape
and air-cooled flat-6!

I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have
any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.

Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.

A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.

You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by
just looking at the stance and the wheels.

The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.

On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider
and made from lighter magnesium.

Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!
dialogues.zh:
这款964 RS版本是我最喜欢的车型之一。

为什么？因为它保留了911原汁原味的“Ur-911”型外形和风
冷水平对置六缸发动机！

它带来的纯粹感令我兴奋不已，比如说，它就没有添加
固定尾翼之类的部件。

而且，它是保时捷的第一辆“奖杯赛车”。

我认为它是73版RS和74版RS 3.0真正的继承者。

只需看一下车辆的姿态和车轮，你就能立即分辨出
964 RS和普通964的差异。

964使用的17寸车轮杯型1是铝制的，

而964 RS虽然使用了同尺寸的车轮，但显得更宽，而
且使用更轻的镁合金材料制造。

镁现在已经被归为“超导矿石”类目，价格不菲！

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
It could be ordered in standard colors, along with
Rubystone, Signal Green or Maritime Blue.

The sparse interiors came in black as standard.

Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros,
with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.

There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002"
RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.

This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!
dialogues.zh:
这辆车的标准车身配色包括了红宝石色，信号绿，海洋
蓝。

内饰倒是标准且朴素的黑色，

外加中间包边的Recaro运动桶椅，可选双色皮革，

还分成了“M001” Carrera Cup版本、“M002” RS Touring版
和“M003” N/GT1 Carrera RS。

对于追求纯粹的风冷引擎911爱好者来说，这是一台必须
拥有的车！
