brandCentral.en:
This is the second-generation BRZ, which appeared in 2021.

Much like the first-generation model, it is a well-sized,
lightweight car with a rear-wheel-drive layout.

That said, it is a great leap forward in terms of
speed and handling.

Trust me, you’ll especially love how responsive
it is on corners.

Also, the increased body rigidity and aluminum roof help to
reduce weight and lower the car’s center of gravity.

But that’s not all. In addition to the chassis, consider
the improvements to its engine.

Its enlarged 2.4-liter displacement has contributed
to greater power and torque.

And tweaks to the inertia and friction of its moving parts
have made for better driving in the high RPM range.
brandCentral.zh:
这是在2021年亮相的第二代BRZ。

与第一代类似，它同样是一款尺寸适中的后轮驱动轻量
化跑车。

另一方面，它在速度和操控上实现了巨大的飞跃。

相信我，你绝对会爱上它在弯道中的优异响应！

此外，车身刚度的增加和铝制车顶都有助于减轻车重，
以及降低汽车的重心。

但这还不是新款车型全部优化！
除了底盘之外，引擎的改进也可圈可点。

引擎在扩容到2.4L后带来了更大的功率和更强的扭矩。

对活塞部件的惯性和摩擦力的调校，有效改善了高转速
时的驾驶表现。

vehicleCollection.en:
The second-gen FR sports car features a larger 2.4-liter engine.

A collaborative effort between Subaru and Toyota resulted in the front engine/rear-wheel-drive Subaru BRZ and Toyota 86. In 2020, the second-generation versions (ZD8) of these identical twins were released.

A new platform was adopted, featuring a number of improvements from the previous models. The entire chassis adopted Subaru's inner frame construction, which provided more rigidity and reduced weight. The combination of Subaru's flat-4, also called a boxer engine, with Toyota's direct-injection technology was carried over from the previous car. One big change to the new car was that the engine's cylinder bore was enlarged, increasing displacement from 2.0 liters to 2.4 liters. As a result, output was raised to 173 kW (235ps)/250 Nm (25.5kgm), making the car faster and more pleasant to drive. The transmission was either a 6-speed manual or 6-speed automatic, with the automatic-equipped model coming with the EyeSight driver assistance system as standard equipment.

The car featured here is the "S," the high-end model with improved interior and exterior, including 18-inch wheels, ultra suede and leather combination seats and an 8-speaker car stereo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
采用排量更大的2.4升引擎的第二代紧凑型前置后驱跑车。"

斯巴鲁BRZ和丰田86跑车是斯巴鲁和丰田联合开发的水平对置、前置后驱跑车。在2020年，这对姊妹车款更新到了第二代（ZD8）。

新平台继承了上一代后期车型的改进，将斯巴鲁的内部框架结构应用于整个底盘。在增加刚性的同时减轻了车重。斯巴鲁的4缸水平对置引擎与丰田开发的直喷技术组合在新车型上得到了延续，最大的变化是扩大了汽缸孔径，使引擎排量从2升增加到2.4升。将动力输出提升到173千瓦（235ps）/250牛米（25.5kgm），改善了各种场景下的驾驶性能。排挡有6速手动或6速自动变速箱可供选择，自动档车型还标配眼镜驾驶辅助系统。

这里展示的BRZ S是一款高端豪华型号，内外部组件都有升级，如18英寸车轮、豪华麂皮和皮革座椅，以及配备8个扬声器的汽车音响。

catch.zh: 采用排量更大的2.4升引擎的第二代紧凑型前置后驱跑车。"

This fully-customized car built by STI, Subaru's motorsports
division, was based on the standard BRZ.

It features specially engineered dampers, high-grip tires,
and original STI-built body parts.

You'll certainly notice how much better this upgraded
version corners.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆由Subaru的汽车运动部门STI全方位定制打造的赛车以一
辆标准版BRZ作为改装原型，

使用了特殊设计的避震，高抓地力的轮胎和STI原厂制造
的车身部件。

行驶当中，您一定会感觉到这辆升级版本的过弯性能提
升有多大。<

vehicleCollection.en:
Numerous chassis performance and visual enhancements by STI gave the BRZ sports car unprecedented flair.

The top-of-the-line version of Subaru's popular BRZ sports car was the BRZ STI Sport, introduced in 2017. The STI in its name referred to the company's motorsports division, Subaru Tecnica International, which gave the BRZ plenty of special touches that distinguished it from the base model.

The exterior featured a unique front bumper and fender garnishes, providing more muscle to the compact rear-drive machine. In the cabin, more luxury and exclusivity was added, including a Bordeaux red color scheme, available only on STI Sports models, and leather and alcantara seats.

STI made no major engine tweaks, but it did add flexible V bars and draw stiffeners to enhance rigidity. Also, the suspension system was tuned with Sachs shocks and springs, which helped provide the car with razor sharp steering responses and excellent handling.
vehicleCollection.zh:
STI为BRZ开发的最高级别车型，进行了大量的底盘性能和外观改进。

BRZ STI Sport于2017年面市，是BRZ系列中的最高端车型。如名称所示，它是与斯巴鲁国际技术部，也就是斯巴鲁的赛车研发团队合作开发完成的。

内饰和外观都进行了改动，以符合其顶级型号的形象。外观方面，STI Sport配备了独有的前保险杠和侧裙饰条，内饰则革新为版本独享的波尔多红。座椅使用了皮革和阿尔卡塔纳材料混搭，拥有更成熟和时尚的质感。

虽然动力单元和基础版并无不同，但STI Sport的最大卖点其实在于STI出品的性能科技套件。弹性V型稳定杆和防倾杆均用于强化车身刚性，提高响应速度和车身稳定性。萨克斯为其量身定制的避震和弹簧也有助于提高整车的操控性。

usedCar.en:
Any fan of WRC racing in the 1990s has the Impreza 22B on
their list of must-buy cars.

This replica model is based on the Impreza that enjoyed such
great success during the golden age of rally.

Its price upon release was roughly twice that of the
Impreza WRX...

But the 400 units produced still sold out in an instant!

This variant sports more than just updated looks—
the engine is a custom 2.2L.

Capable of generating more torque than the 2L turbo, it
promises solid acceleration and satisfying speed.
usedCar.zh:
20世纪90年代世界拉力锦标赛的所有粉丝
都会把Impreza 22B列入他们的必买汽车清单。

翼豹在拉力赛的黄金时代取得了巨大的成
功，而这款车型正是它的复刻版。

它在发售时的价格几乎是Impreza WRX的两倍...

但当时生产的400台还是瞬间就被抢购一空！

这个版本的特别之处不仅在于外观上的
升级，还有专属定制的2.2L引擎。

它能够产生比2L涡轮增压引擎更大的
扭矩，保证了扎实的加速性能和令人满意的速度。

vehicleCollection.en:
Essentially a road-going version of Subaru's WRC car, this car’s production was limited to only 400 units (and sold out immediately).

In March 1998, Subaru introduced the Version 22B-STi, based on the Impreza WRX STi Version IV. The “22” in its name signified the size of the engine, which came in the form of a turbocharged 2.2-liter flat-4. With a larger turbo, this boxer pumped out 280 ps and 37.0 kgm of torque, making it as fast as many European sports cars costing twice as much. The car’s biggest draw was its styling that featured wide-body fenders, making it look very similar to the WRC race car. The 22B’s production was limited to 400 units, but all of them were snatched up in a matter of months, despite a price tag of 5 million yen or about $50,000.

Not long after the 22B, Subaru took the covers off the STi Version V in September 1998. In addition to new aerodynamic parts on the exterior, the new STi received a new sport ABS to help stopping power.

In September 1999, the STi Version VI appeared featuring only modest changes that included a new front under spoiler, a reshaped rear spoiler and redesigned 16-in. alloy wheels. The competition model, the RA, came complete with mirror shells on the doors and sheeted rear quarter panels, designed to save weight. The STi Version VI marked the end of the GC-platform. What made this car especially noteworthy was that in its eight-year span, the WRX’s body style stayed generally constant, staying true to the original.
vehicleCollection.zh:
拥有与WR赛车完全相同外观的翼豹，限量400台。刚一上市就被抢购一空。

1998年3月，一款基于翼豹WRX STi Version IV开发的特殊车款正式发售，这就是翼豹22B-STi，顾名思义，它搭载了一台2.2升涡轮增压水平对置四缸引擎，最大马力输出为280ps，最大扭矩可达到37.0kgm。

最吸睛的自然是它的外观。添加宽轮拱罩后，与WR拉力赛车型几乎一模一样。这款车型仅按照订单限量生产400台，尽管售价高达500万日元，却在几天内销售一空，随即成为车迷心中的梦想车款。

除22B-STi之外，同系列的翼豹WRX常规版本也获得了不少提升。到了1998年9月，STi Version V带着安装有新空气动力学外部套件的外观粉墨登场，应用新的运动型防抱死刹车系统以及部分细微的提升和改装，保持原样的惟有马力输出（280ps）和稍稍降低的扭矩（36.0kgm）。隐藏在其后的现状便是对这部底盘的开发已经走到了尽头。

待到1999年9月，基于GC平台开发的最后一个STi版本，STi Version VI发布。在外观方面，增加了前下侧扰流板，尾翼的截面也有所改动，并且重新设计了16寸的铝合金轮毂。作为竞赛版本的WRX STI Type RA还换用了尖锥形的后视镜。而在减重方面，针对两门版本的后窗厚度进行了削减。STi Version VI之后，翼豹的接力棒被交到了新一代GD平台的手中。八年间，翼豹不断演化改进，唯一不变的是经典的车身造型。

The Subaru Impreza?
It was really famous in motorsports too right?
And so this is the final version of the special models?
'The most refined and rare…'
You really like this car huh.

Subaru Impreza在赛车圈里相当有名对不对？

usedCar.sourceName: Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99
usedCar.en:
This first-generation Impreza Type R STi Version Vi is known
among Subaru fans as the "ultimate GC8."

GC8 was the in-house name of the first-gen Impreza, with
the "C" representing the chassis code.

The Type R STi is special because it possesses way more rigidity
than the base model, thanks partly to its coupe design.

The accessories are also simple and effective, making
the car look rally-race ready.

Because of its compact nature, its all-wheel-drive system and
remarkable agility, this machine shines on tight circuits!
usedCar.zh:
初代Impreza也被称作GC8。
C是底盘代号。

有许多人将Type R STi Version VI
称为“终极GC8”。

这个称号的由来之一便是双门车体
所带来的刚性提升。

该车的内饰相当简洁，非常符合
赛车的定位。

Impreza特别适合狭窄的赛道——没有其他车比它更适合用来
感受曲折道路的刺激魅力！

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Impreza Coupe WRX Type R STi Version VI '99
vehicleCollection.en:
After six years of evolution, this car represented the final form of the GC8 Impreza coupe.

The Impreza WRX STi was first introduced in 1994 with the goal of winning the World Rally Chanpionships. Known as "GC8," which referred to its in-house chassis designation, the car met with success both on and off the track. In September 1999, the very last GC8, the WRX STi Version VI, made its debut.

Thanks to numerous improvements in the six years since the the GC8's debut, the engine's (EJ20) horsepower rating went from 250ps to 280ps, while the transmission, which was always considered a weak point of the car, was enhanced for quicker, more precise shifts and better durability. Aerodynamics, brakes and suspension were significantly upgraded, all maximizing the incredible potential of the GC8 chassis.

Of the three body types available for the Version VI, which included a sedan and station wagon, the most notable was the "Type R" coupe. Along with a rally-car styled exterior, it featured a driver-controlled central differential, an intercooler water sprayer, specially-tuned suspension system and an upgraded rear axle as standard equipment. The car was a virtual road rocket, weighing only 1260kg, making it a fan favorite on the WRC circuit as well as a popular performance choice for enthusiasts.
vehicleCollection.zh:
经过6年的发展，这款基于GC8平台的翼豹双门轿车终于问世。

1994年，第一辆翼豹WRX STi问世，剑指世界拉力锦标赛拉力赛冠军。它另一个更广为人知的名字则来自它的底盘代号——“GC8”。1999年9月，最后一款GC8，也就是WRX STi Version VI推出市场。

自1994年Version I发布以来，六年间的持续改进从这台EJ20引擎中额外压榨出30ps，总输出达到了可观的280ps。被大家认为是弱项的变速箱也有长足的改进。空气动力学、刹车和悬挂系统的改进都非常大。全部结合到一起后成就了这款GC8的终极版本。
在Version VI可选的三类车型，双门、四门以及旅行车当中，最受关注的当属“Type R”两门车型：拉力车风格的造型、原厂标配的车手可控中央差速器、中冷水喷冷却系统、接受过特别调校的硬悬挂系统和超耐压后车轴。正如车迷所期待的，这款车型在赛道和泥地中都展现出了极高的潜力。而得益于其轻盈、紧凑的车身（重量仅1260kg，车宽1690mm），运动车型的纯粹特性也并未缺席，完美响应车手的每个动作。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Subaru won the World Rally Championship's Manufacturers' Title
three years in a row.

It was from 1995 to 1997, and I still remember the thrill
of witnessing that incredible achievement.

Equally exciting was when the company introduced the Impreza WRC
in 1997!

The "WRC" in its name stood for "World Rally Car,"
and it was a new version...

...that allowed a wider range of modifications
permitted by Group A regulations.

Previously a 4-door sedan, the Impreza
was reborn as a sporty 2-door coupe.

But it wasn't all about style. It performed like a sports car!

In the 1997 season, the Subaru rally team...

...Won eight of 14 races, including the opening rounds
in Monte Carlo, Sweden and Kenya.

This incredible performance led to the team taking home
its third consecutive WRC title.

The Impreza WRC continued to evlve
until the year 2000.

It was a car that defined its era and hailed as an
important part of WRC history.
dialogues.zh:
斯巴鲁——世界拉力锦标赛三冠王！

我永远不会忘记1995年到1997年那段激动人心的时光。

同样令我振奋不已的还有1997年翼豹世界拉力赛车的到来！

世界拉力赛车是“世界拉力赛车”的缩写，也是当年引入的新规格……

相比A组规则，世界拉力赛车组可以进行更广泛的改装。

翼豹原本是一款四门轿车，经过回炉重造，成为
一款漂亮的双门车型。

但它不仅长得好看——它真的能跑得很快！

在1997赛季，斯巴鲁拉力车队

在全年的14场比赛中赢得了8场，包括
在蒙特卡洛的开幕战、以及瑞典和肯尼亚站。

惊人的表现也让斯巴鲁连续第三次赢得
世界拉力锦标赛冠军。

翼豹世界拉力赛车持续改装进化，直至2000年。

这款车定义了它所处的时代，至今仍被视为
世界拉力锦标赛历史的重要组成部分。

翼豹世界拉力赛车持续改装进化，直至2000年。

这款车定义了它所处的时代，至今仍被视为
世界拉力锦标赛历史的重要组成部分。

collection.en:
The World Rally Championship represents the pinnacle
of rally racing.

It was on this international stage where Subaru became the
first Japanese automaker...

...to accomplish the great feat of winning three successive
manufacturers' titles, from 1995 to 1997.

The car that was responsible for the "three-peat"
was the Subaru Impreza WRC.

The Impreza WRC came bathed in the blue livery of
the Subaru works team.

It combined a turbocharged boxer engine with an advanced
all-wheel drive system.

This machine won many rally competitions, including the
Rallye Monte Carlo.

After the announcement of new world rally-car regulations
in 1997...

...the Impreza WRC went to battle as a 2-door coupe with
unique blister fenders both at front and rear.

Its refreshed appearance strongly resembled the original
Impreza 22B STi.

From behind the wheel of the new-look Impreza WRC...

...driver Colin McRae claimed three victories for
the Subaru rally team in 1998.
collection.zh:
拉力赛有着100多年的悠久历史。

其中最高规格的比赛，就是世界拉力锦标赛。

在这项赛事中，斯巴鲁曾经从1995年到1997年连续三届
蝉联车厂冠军头衔……

成为首个达成这项丰功伟业的日本汽车制造商。

帮助他们实现三连冠梦想的就是这台拉力赛版本的
斯巴鲁翼豹。

这辆翼豹身披斯巴鲁厂队的蓝色涂装……

搭载标志性的涡轮增压水平对置引擎和一套四轮驱动系
统……

翼豹的辉煌之路从赢得历史悠久的蒙特卡洛拉力赛
开始……

之后就是一路凯歌高奏。

在引入全新的世界拉力赛规则之后，斯巴鲁于1997年推
出了翼豹世界拉力锦标赛。

这款车的双门跑车身和独特的鼓起式前后挡泥板十分有
辨识度。

有意思的是，它还是后来大名鼎鼎的
翼豹22B STi Version的原型。

眼前这辆车是1998年的版本。

正是这辆车，在科林·克雷的驾驶下，为斯巴鲁拉力
车队摘下了第三个冠军头衔。

vehicleCollection.en:
Subaru's triple race winning Impreza World Rally car from the 1998 season.

Subaru's Impreza has been a formidable contender in the World Rally Championship since 1993, securing the Manufacturers' Championship title in 1995 and 1996 under Group A regulations. In 1997, under the new WRC regulations, Subaru clinched the Manufacturers' Championship title yet again, achieving an impressive three-year consecutive streak.

The 1997 World Rally Car-specification Impreza, known as the WRC97, was based on the 2-door coupe model. The existing engine was tuned to deliver 300ps and 48kgm of torque. The suspension geometry was redesigned, and the body was widened to the regulatory maximum of 1770mm to enhance handling performance.

The WRC98, introduced in 1998, featured further modifications, including computer-controlled active differentials in the front, rear, and center couplings.

Although Subaru missed out on the championship title in the 1998 season, the car demonstrated its prowess as a serious contender. Colin McRae drove it to victory in Round 4 (Portugal), Round 6 (Tour de Corse), and Round 8 (Acropolis), highlighting the vehicle's pure off-road tenacity.
vehicleCollection.zh:
在1998赛季中为斯巴鲁三夺分站冠军的翼豹世界拉力赛车

斯巴鲁的翼豹自1993年起参加世界拉力锦标赛的争夺，并在A组别规则下于1995年和1996年连续赢得车队冠军头衔。此后在1997年，在转入“世界拉力赛车”规则后，他们再次勇夺冠军，创造了惊人的三连冠。

采用1997年“世界拉力赛车”规格的翼豹也被称为世界拉力锦标赛97，以原版双门轿跑车型为基础，通过调校现有引擎，使其得以输出300ps的动力和48kgm扭矩。悬挂几何结构也进行了重新设计，车身宽度在合规前提下尽可能扩展，达到了1770mm，为车辆提供最大限度的操控。

1998年推出的世界拉力锦标赛98在前一款车型基础上作了进一步的改进，增加了一块用于控制前、后和中央联轴器的主动差速器的微型电脑。

在1998赛季，斯巴鲁遗憾地与冠军头衔失之交臂，没能延续他们的连胜纪录。然而，这款车依然证明了其作为世界拉力赛车的真正价值——科林·麦克雷在第4轮葡萄牙站、第6轮法国环科西嘉岛站和第8轮雅典卫城站的比赛中驾驶着它登上了最高领奖台。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
This is a second-generation Subaru Impreza STi.

In Japan, the Impreza STi and the Mitsubishi Lancer Evo
were known to have an intense rivalry.

The second-generation STi featured numerous upgrades, none more
evident than in this 2004 model.

Notice how the rear wheel arch appears to be slightly
widened?

This was done to give the car wide tires and wheels.
The suspension and engine were also improved.

This car certainly turned heads after its time trial run
at the Nürburgring in Germany.

It was the first Impreza to complete a lap
in less than eight minutes!
dialogues.zh:
这是一台二代Subaru Impreza STi。

在日本，Impreza STi和Mitsubishi Lancer Evo是
一对有名的宿敌。

第二代STi引入了多项升级，在这台2004版的车型上
体现得淋漓尽致。

注意到后轮拱看起来更宽了一些吗？

这是通过加宽轮毂和使用宽胎来实现的，悬挂和引擎
也得到了相应升级。

此车在德国的纽博格林赛道上试测，拿到了令人侧目的结果。

毕竟，这是首台在八分钟内跑完这条赛道的Impreza！

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
Today, the WRX STI has grown into a model
with its own distinct identity...

...representing Subaru’s engineering capability, technical
efficiency and focus on high performance.

But the second-generation WRX STI remained closely
tied to the Impreza.

And that connection gave its character a unique appeal.

It effectively reflected the idea of an everyday sedan
transformed into a serious performance machine.

With the newer WRX, however, the base model already carried a more
aggressive character, making the contrast less pronounced.

If you’re drawn to that sense of transformation—like
Peter Parker becoming Spider-Man...

...then this second-generation model, with its clean, understated
cabin and simpler window design, may be just right for you.~
dialogues.zh:
时至今日，WRX STi已经……

拥有了自己独立的品牌价值和存在意义，它代表着
斯巴鲁的技术实力与热情。

有鉴于第二代WRX STi是翼豹的改款版本之一……

使得它的设计完美体现了我们常用来打趣的那句俗语……

“文能出门买菜，武可拉力比赛。”

相比之下，新一代WRX的出厂版本就已经颇具进攻性，
所以新型号上的文武之分就没有那么鲜明了。

因此，如果你想看到的是彼得·帕克
变身成为蜘蛛侠那种迥然相异的反差……

那么内饰朴实简洁，且没有配备三角形后车窗的
第二代WRX将是你的不二选择。

brandCentral.en:
This is the 2nd-gen model of the Subaru Impreza WRX series.

Like its predecessor, it was a World Rally Championship star.

Specifically, it was the last Impreza to win a world title
at the WRC—a legacy that's talked about to this day.

The production model received extensive upgrades,
including a major facelift.

The 2004 model was faster and stronger by leaps and bounds.

Engine-wise, not only was max. torque give a 2kgm upgrade,
but the mid-range response was significantly improved.

Paired with rigid and ground-hugging chassis, this car is
incredibly fun to drive on any course.
brandCentral.zh:
这是Subaru Impreza WRX车族中的第二代型号。

和其前代车型一样，它也是世界拉力锦标赛上的明星。

尤其值得一提的是，它是最后一款在世界拉力锦标赛上赢得
世界冠军的Impreza。这个荣誉直到今天依然被人们津津乐道。

其量产车型经过了大量的升级，包括外观方面的大量修改。

这辆2004款车型在速度和性能方面有了突飞猛进的发展。

在引擎方面，它的最大扭矩不仅提升了2kgm，
中转速下的响应速度也得到了大幅优化。

再搭配上坚固且贴合地面的底盘，让它能在任何赛道上
都能提供无与伦比的驾驶体验。

usedCar.en:
The Subaru Impreza is a legendary Japanese car that made its name
at the World Rally Championship, the pinnacle of rally racing.

Defined by its compact body, a mighty turbo engine and4WD system,
it never failed to impress on every kind of terrain.

The road-going Impreza WRX STi is admired by sports-car
enthusiasts from all over the world.

This model is the second-generation WRX STi that came equipped
with a powerful 2.0-liter powerplant.

This 2004 model saw its engine receive further upgrades, along
with a new suspension and wider tires.

It was the first Impreza to run the Nürburgring’s old track in
less than eight minutes!
usedCar.zh:
Subaru Impreza是一辆在拉力赛领域巅峰赛事——
世界拉力锦标赛上闯出名号的传奇日本赛车。

这款车型采用紧凑型车身设计，装备有强大的涡轮增压引擎，
并配备四轮驱动系统，在速度方面的表现从不会令人失望！

而其公路车型Impreza WRX STi受到了
来自全世界跑车爱好者的倾慕。

这里的这一辆车是第二代WRX STi，2升排量级别，
拥有当时最强大的引擎之一。

而到了2004款车型上，引擎获得了进一步的升级，
此外还采用了全新的悬挂和宽胎。

它是第一款在纽博格林赛道旧布局上跑进八分钟的Impreza！

vehicleCollection.en:
The second-generation Impreza was developed alongside the rally spec model."

One year after the potent Spec C was introduced, Subaru wasted no time finessing the look of the new Impreza by taking a scalpel to the car's front end after only two years on the market. The round headlights were a bust as it alienated many loyal buyers, so the company replaced them with more conventional-looking tear-drop shaped ones.

The car's overall aerodynamics were also improved, thanks to developmental work performed by SWRT (Subaru World Rally Team). The team also improved the response of the boxer powerplant, raising peak torque to 40.2kgm. The new exhaust system, which was originally developed for the 2003 Legacy, was more efficient, too. Of particular note was a new center differential that featured an automatic mode. This system managed the distribution of torque between the front and rear wheels through the center differential, allowing for maximum traction through all variety of corners.

The car's new handling prowess demanded more grip, so wider tires were used in 2004. This year also saw the torque figure of the flat-4 climb yet again, to 42.0kgm. By this time, the Impreza WRX had caught the attention of performance enthusiasts everywhere, and in 2003, the car finally made its way to U.S. shores. Soon thereafter, Mitsubishi brought the Lancer Evolution to the U.S., and the two Japanese rally icons waged war on a new battleground, America.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第二代翼豹，与拉力赛规格车型同时开发。

在令人震惊的Spec C推出一年后，翼豹系列在2002年11月进行了全面改款。

尽管受到不少人的喜爱，但现实中市场反响不佳的圆形车头灯被替换成了水滴型。这一次，与斯巴鲁拉力车队的通力合作为车型带来了更出色的空气动力学特性。

在性能方面，为了提升线轴效率，这款车采用了全新的双涡流涡轮增压系统，并对应地调整了排气系统。它的曲轴、活塞和连杆也进行了强化，让引擎可以输出40.2kgm的扭矩——这在当时2升排量级别车型中是最高的扭矩规格。

在部分手动档版本上还配备了驾驶者可控并具备自动模式的中央差速器，前后扭矩可根据过弯情况自动分配，让这款车在赛道和曲折道路上都展现了出色的效率。

2004年6月，应日本超级耐力赛等赛事的比赛规则要求，斯巴鲁追加推出了大尺寸轮胎版本。并将最大扭矩再次提升到了42.0kgm。

至此，翼豹已成为了代表日本的高性能车款，并得到了全世界车手们的一致认可。2003年起，STi开始出口到美国，而随着三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神也开始出口，两位老对手在日本之外又一次展开了竞争。

By this time, the Impreza WRX had caught the attention of performance enthusiasts everywhere, and in 2003, the car finally made its way to U.S. shores. Soon thereafter, Mitsubishi brought the Lancer Evolution to the U.S., and the two Japanese rally icons waged war on a new battleground, America.
long.zh:
在令人震惊的Spec C推出一年后，翼豹系列在2002年11月进行了全面改款。

尽管受到不少人的喜爱，但现实中市场反响不佳的圆形车头灯被替换成了水滴型。这一次，与斯巴鲁拉力车队的通力合作为车型带来了更出色的空气动力学特性。

在性能方面，为了提升线轴效率，这款车采用了全新的双涡流涡轮增压系统，并对应地调整了排气系统。它的曲轴、活塞和连杆也进行了强化，让引擎可以输出40.2kgm的扭矩——这在当时2升排量级别车型中是最高的扭矩规格。

在部分手动档版本上还配备了驾驶者可控并具备自动模式的中央差速器，前后扭矩可根据过弯情况自动分配，让这款车在赛道和曲折道路上都展现了出色的效率。

2004年6月，应日本超级耐力赛等赛事的比赛规则要求，斯巴鲁追加推出了大尺寸轮胎版本。并将最大扭矩再次提升到了42.0kgm。

至此，翼豹已成为了代表日本的高性能车款，并得到了全世界车手们的一致认可。2003年起，STi开始出口到美国，而随着三菱蓝瑟翼豪陆神也开始出口，两位老对手在日本之外又一次展开了竞争。

brandCentral.sourceName: SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo
brandCentral.en:
The VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo was all about Subaru's
pursuit of delivering a great driving experience.

Armed with a powerful hybrid power unit...

...this machine is powered by turbocharged 2.0-liter
flat-4 engine and three powerful electrical motors.

The power is distributed to all four wheels via Subaru's
all-wheel-drive system.

And the car's appearance is striking, is it not?

By the way, a fun fact about this design...

...it was inspired by the world's hardest food: "katsuobushi,"
a Japanese delicacy made of dried and fermented tuna!
brandCentral.zh:
VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo体现了Subaru对终极驾驶体验的
全部追求。

此车搭载有强大的混合动力单元：

包括一台2L的水平对置涡轮增压四缸引擎和三台动力出
众的电机……

并输送至Subaru传统的全时四轮驱动系统上。

这样的设计令人眼前一亮！

顺便分享一个关于这辆车的设计小趣闻：

其灵感来自于世界上最难入口的食物：“鲣节”，一种
由干燥并发酵过的金枪鱼制成的日本美食！

vehicleCollection.sourceName: SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo
vehicleCollection.en:
Subaru's most aggressive sports car ever is potent yet civilized.

Vision Gran Turismo is a revolutionary project established for car enthusiasts all over the world. The car provided by Subaru for this dream project, where the world's car manufacturers and brands develop concept cars in the game world, is an ultimate sports car carrying Subaru's concept car motto "VIZIV"; Vision for Innovation. The car is called the "SUBARU VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo".

Inheriting the design language of Subaru's "SUBARU VIZIV 2 Concept" revealed at the March 2014 Geneva show, the Subaru design team have added dynamic and solid shapes to the model. Its shoulder line extends from the front hexagonal grill all the way to the rear. Its tough-looking body seems as though it was carved from hard, solid metal. And with blister fenders extending its shape three dimensionally outward, it visually expresses Subaru's pursuit of a safe and enjoyable driving experience. Its large diffuser, the roof integrated rear spoiler, and its shooting brake silhouette, which accounts for aerodynamic performance, will surely stand out among others in the game.

Thorough weight reduction was a focus in the design of the body structure, and carbon materials have been utilized everywhere. As a result, the vehicle weight was held down to 1380kg despite being equipped with heavy batteries and motors. And propelling the lightweight body is Subaru's legendary 2 liter horizontally opposed engine that has been fully tuned with years of motorsports experience. The direct injection turbocharged engine that has been powered up with revised restrictor diameters is combined with one high-power motor in the front and two in the rear, which achieves a total system power output of 600ps and 800 Nm (82kgm) of maximum torque. By independently controlling each of the motor outputs, turning ability while cornering is drasticaly improved, while the torque vectoring lamps built into the fenders visulize its movement. Thus, as with any other Subaru, the car is made contollablefor anyone driving it, regardless of it extremely high perfrmance levels.

Experience th "SUBARU VIZIV GT VisionGran Trismo," a carthat delivers Sbaru's ideals of confidence and driving pleasure through an unprecedented aggressiv design and extreme levels f performance.
vehicleCollection.zh:
斯巴鲁历史上最激进的跑车，但依然易于操纵，驾驶充满乐趣。

跑车浪漫旅愿景是一项专为全世界赛车爱好者设立的革命性项目。全世界的汽车制造商和品牌会联合起来共同打造游戏内的概念赛车，而斯巴鲁为这项梦幻项目所提供的是一辆终极跑车。车名延续了斯巴鲁概念赛车座右铭 “VIZIV”：意为创新的愿景，因此这辆车被命名为“斯巴鲁VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo”。

这辆车沿袭了2014年3月日内瓦车展上公布的“斯巴鲁VIZIV 2 Concept”的设计语言，除此之外，斯巴鲁的设计团队还为这款车加入动感硬朗的造型。其肩部线条从车头六角形进气格栅一直延伸到车尾，硬朗风格的车身看起来就像是刚从一块坚硬、结实的金属上切削下来的一样。鼓起的挡泥板将车身横向扩展，完美展现了斯巴鲁对于安全和舒适驾驶体验的追求。这辆车有着大号的扰流翼、与车顶一体的后扰流板、以及考虑到空气动力学性能的猎装车外形，绝对可以在游戏里脱颖而出。

彻底的减重是车体结构设计的重点，因此碳纤维材料得到了广泛使用。因此，尽管装备了许多沉重的电池和电机，车重还是被控制在了1380kg。推动这套轻量化车身的是斯巴鲁传奇般的2升水平对置引擎，并使用多年的赛车运动经验进行了精心调校。直喷涡轮增压引擎的限制器直径得到了改良，再搭配上前部的一台和后部的两台大功率电机，总输出功率可达600ps，最大扭矩可达800 牛·米（82kgm）。通过对两部电机的输出功率进行独立控制，这辆车的弯道转向能力得到了大幅增强，而内置在挡泥板上的扭矩矢量控制灯让它的运动变得清晰可见。因此，和斯巴鲁的其他车款一样，虽然这辆车有着超高性能，其设计却能让每一个人都可以轻松驾驭。

“F巴鲁VIZIV GT Vision Gran Turismo” 通过前所未有的冲击性V计和y强的性能展现了斯巴鲁的自n和对驾驶乐趣W执行追求，快去体验下k辆车吧。

brandCentral.en:
This is a Gr.3 racing car based on the WRX STI, and has been
created exclusively for Gran Turismo.

The chassis has been cut down to reduce frontal profile,
making it incredibly low to the ground for a sedan.

Also, the underbody has been aerodynamically optimised,
providing even more downforce than a coupé body.

The drivetrain has been converted to FR.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一辆基于WRX STI改装而来的Gr.3赛车，专为跑车浪漫
旅所打造。

其车身高度进行了削减，进而缩小了前剖面面积，成为
了一款底盘极低的轿车。

车身底板方面的空气动力学优化则带来比双门车身更
强的下压力。

传动系统也被更换为前置后驱。

vehicleCollection.en:
The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.

While traditionally known as the Subaru Impreza WRX, the rally-inspired compact sports sedan became simply the Subaru WRX in the fall of 2013, but everything that made this model one of the most exciting machines in the world remained intact.

The WRX was built on the platform of the Levorg, a Japan-market-only station wagon. After seriously reinforcing the body structure, Subaru engineers went to work on the engine and chassis, putting much of their focus on the high-performance STI. They wanted to make sure that the WRX STI and the WRX S4 were completely different models, the former meant for the performance enthusiast, while the latter catered to grand touring fans. While the STI and S4 looked similar, everything from the engine to the steering mechanism was different.

For the STI, the engineers dropped the EJ20, a turbocharged 2.0-liter flat-4, into the engine bay. This powerplant produced 308ps and 43.0kgm of torque, routing the power to all four wheels via a 6-speed manual gearbox and Subaru’s excellent 4-wheel-drive system that featured a driver-controlled center differential. It was this 4WD system that made all WRX STIs so special. It included both an electronically-controlled and mechanical LSD—a Helical LSD controlled the front wheels, while a Torsen LSD was installed for the rear.

The WRX STI defined the “point and shoot” nature of compact sports cars of its day, thanks in part to its quick and precise hydraulic power steering system and custom-tuned suspension. On either road or dirt, the WRX STI had very few equals.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
源自翼豹，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

2013年秋季发布的斯巴鲁WRX是从翼豹系列独立出来的中档轿车。WRX这个车型等级过去曾被用来命名翼豹的高性能版本，现在则成为了一款新的车型，并且顺理成章地成为了翼豹 WRX的后继者，被发展为高性能的轿跑车。

这款车使用与斯巴鲁力狮运动相同的平台，但考虑到旅行车和轿车之间存在差别，两车预期的行驶条件也不相同，因此对WRX的车体进行了大幅强化。该车型包括跑车车型的STI和豪华旅行车版的S4。两个版本均为四轮驱动，动力单元为该厂标志性的水平对置4缸引擎。然而，STI与S4除了中央差速器不同外，动力转向结构也不相同，就算使用的都是2升水平对置4缸引擎，也并非是同一款。斯巴鲁坚持奉行差异化策略。

高性能的STI版本配有EJ20引擎，该引擎经过了彻底的改进，能够输出308ps和43.0kgm的动力。传动方面采用强化版的6档手动变速箱和车手可控中央差速器，同时配备了电子限滑差速器和机械限滑差速器，前轮装备了螺旋齿轮限滑差速器，而后轮则采用托森限滑差速器。方向盘也采用了提高驾驶手感的液向式动力转向系统。毫无疑问，悬挂也是专为这款车而独立开发的。总之，WRX在成为独立车型后，给予了设计师追求全面性能的自由度。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别3规则进行过特殊调校。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo Gr.4 original was based on the WRX STI.

The car's AWD system enables the car to corner with the best
of them and keep it connected to the road in all conditions.

The custom front splitter and rear wing provide extra downforce
to enhance stability at higher speeds.
brandCentral.zh:
这台原创跑车浪漫旅组别4级别赛车基于WRX STI打造。

四轮驱动系统可以提供强大的牵引力，在过弯时实现稳
定的操控。

定制的前定风翼和尾翼进一步增加了车辆的下压力。

高性能的STI版本配有EJ20引擎，该引擎经过了彻底的改进，能够输出308ps和43.0kgm的动力。传动方面采用强化版的6档手动变速箱和车手可控中央差速器，同时配备了电子限滑差速器和机械限滑差速器，前轮装备了螺旋齿轮限滑差速器，而后轮则采用托森限滑差速器。方向盘也采用了提高驾驶手感的液向式动力转向系统。毫无疑问，悬挂也是专为这款车而独立开发的。总之，WRX在成为独立车型后，给予了设计师追求全面性能的自由度。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。

long.en:
While traditionally known as the Subaru Impreza WRX, the rally-inspired compact sports sedan became simply the Subaru WRX in the fall of 2013, but everything that made this model one of the most exciting machines in the world remained intact.

The WRX was built on the platform of the Levorg, a Japan-market-only station wagon. After seriously reinforcing the body structure, Subaru engineers went to work on the engine and chassis, putting much of their focus on the high-performance STI. They wanted to make sure that the WRX STI and the WRX S4 were completely different models, the former meant for the performance enthusiast, while the latter catered to grand touring fans. While the STI and S4 looked similar, everything from the engine to the steering mechanism was different.

For the STI, the engineers dropped the EJ20, a turbocharged 2.0-liter flat-4, into the engine bay. This powerplant produced 308ps and 43.0kgm of torque, routing the power to all four wheels via a 6-speed manual gearbox and Subaru’s excellent 4-wheel-drive system that featured a driver-controlled center differential. It was this 4WD system that made all WRX STIs so special. It included both an electronically-controlled and mechanical LSD—a Helical LSD controlled the front wheels, while a Torsen LSD was installed for the rear.

The WRX STI defined the “point and shoot” nature of compact sports cars of its day, thanks in part to its quick and precise hydraulic power steering system and custom-tuned suspension. On either road or dirt, the WRX STI had very few equals.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.

This Gr.B rally car is a Gran Turismo exclusive based on
the WRX STI.

Thanks to its exploitation of all the latest trends in
rally racing, the downforce is second to none.

It's been adapted for super wide wheel treads, and has
a suspension specifically tuned for dirt driving.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅专属的Gr.B拉力赛车基于WRX STI开发。

它应用了拉力赛领域的诸多最新科技趋势，拥有首屈一
指的下压力。

为了应对拉力赛，它改用超宽轮距，并安装了一套专为
泥地驾驶调校过的悬挂系统。

cars.nameEn: Subaru WRX STI Isle of Man Time Attack Car '16
cars.nameZh: Subaru WRX STI Isle of Man Time Attack Car '16

brandCentral.en:
The 60.8km Isle of Man TT course is renowned for being
an unforgiving and often downright dangerous challenge.

But did you know there's a car-based time trial that takes
place on the very same track?

Subaru America's time attackers have been trying to break
records in cars like the one you see here since 2011.

This WRX's 2L flat-four turbocharged engine has been
expertly tuned to provide 600ps of pure power.

STI provided the technical support to enable this, with pro
drivers designing and building the cars themselves.

This is the same winning combination that ushered in the
golden era of Subaru WRC dominance.
brandCentral.zh:
全长60.8km的马恩岛TT赛道以高难度而著称，甚至可以称得
上是生死挑战。

但是您知道这条赛道上还一直举行着一项四轮汽车的计
时赛吗？

自2011年起，Subaru America的计时赛挑战者们就一直想要用你眼前
的这台车打破纪录。

这辆WRX体内的2L水平对置四缸涡轮增压引擎经过专业人
士调校，可以输出600ps的纯粹马力。

如此强大的动力全靠STI的技术支持才得以实现，甚至有
多位专业车手也参与到了这款赛车的设计和制造中。

正是这样的技术合作阵容帮助Subaru开启了在世界拉力锦标
赛上的霸主时代。/

vehicleCollection.en:
This celebrated WRX set the lap record on the holy ground of motorcycle racing, the Isle of Man.

In June 2016, a Subaru WRX STI set a new record for 4-wheeled vehicles in the Time Trials at the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy race.

The competition, which has been a part of the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy since 1907, gained notoriety for the daring motorcycle racers who ripped through the island's roads at reckless speeds. One lap of the course measures 60.7km, with more than 200 corners and no escape zones. There are sections where vehicles reach speeds in excess of <200km/h>. With an elevation change of roughly 400m and a slick tarmac, this is arguably one of the most dangerous courses in the world.

The record-setting WRX STI was prepared by Subaru of America, which had been participating in the event since 2011. In that first year, the company set the fastest speed record of 19 minutes 56 seconds in an Impreza WRX STI, and in 2014, it broke that record with run of 19 minutes 15 seconds using a VAB series WRX STI, a model that became separate from the Impreza.

For 2016, Subaru returned with VAB WRX STI, but this time, the car featured engineering from STI, Subaru’s motorsport division, and styling/manufacturing support from Prodrive of the UK; the very group who had dominated the World Rally Championships (WRC) with Subaru. The car's turbocharged 2.0-liter flat-4 turbo was tuned to produce more than 600ps, with further refinements such as a DRS built into the rear wing.

As a result, with former rally driver Mark Higgins behind the wheel, Subaru cut two minutes off of its previous record, with a time of 17 minutes 35.139 seconds and an average speed of <207km/h>.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆著名的WRX曾在摩托车赛事的圣地马恩岛上创下单圈纪录。

2016年6月，斯巴鲁WRX STI在每年举办的马恩岛旅行者大奖赛的计时赛中，刷新了4轮汽车的纪录。

这项赛事自1907年开始举办并延续至今，是马恩岛旅行者大奖赛的一个重要环节，并作为世界上最具挑战性的摩托车比赛之一而广为人知。在将部分公路关闭后，创造出单圈长度60.7km的赛道，该赛道有超过200个弯道，不设避险区，有数个路段的最大速度可超过<200km/h>，起伏高度变化接近400m，再加上远远低于专用赛道的道路摩擦力，使其成为了世界上最困难的公路比赛之一。

创下该纪录的WRX STI来自斯巴鲁美国。该车厂自2011年以来一直在向这个奖项发起挑战。2011年，他们通过翼豹WRX STI创下了19分56秒的最快速度纪录，2014年，他们使用一辆VAB series WRX STI创下了19分15秒的纪录，后来该车型从翼豹中独立出来，成为了一个车款。

2016年挑战赛沿用了去年使用的VAB WRX STI。这一年，他们得到了来自斯巴鲁赛车部门STI的工程支持，车辆则交给英国的普罗迪夫设计和制造。这家车厂正是与斯巴鲁合作，称霸世界拉力锦标赛多年的车厂。经过调校的2升水平对置4涡轮引擎能够产生超过600ps，此外还有其他改进，如在尾翼中加入空气阻力降低系统。

因此，在前拉力赛车手马克·希金斯的驾驶下，他们得以将现有的纪录缩减了将近两分钟之多，以<207km/h>的平均速度创下了17分35.139秒的新纪录。

catch.en: This celebrated WRX set the lap record on the holy ground of motorcycle racing, the Isle of Man.
catch.zh: 这辆著名的WRX曾在摩托车赛事的圣地马恩岛上创下单圈纪录。

long.en:
In June 2016, a Subaru WRX STI set a new record for 4-wheeled vehicles in the Time Trials at the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy race.

The competition, which has been a part of the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy since 1907, gained notoriety for the daring motorcycle racers who ripped through the island's roads at reckless speeds. One lap of the course measures 60.7km, with more than 200 corners and no escape zones. There are sections where vehicles reach speeds in excess of <200km/h>. With an elevation change of roughly 400m and a slick tarmac, this is arguably one of the most dangerous courses in the world.

The record-setting WRX STI was prepared by Subaru of America, which had been participating in the event since 2011. In that first year, the company set the fastest speed record of 19 minutes 56 seconds in an Impreza WRX STI, and in 2014, it broke that record with run of 19 minutes 15 seconds using a VAB series WRX STI, a model that became separate from the Impreza.

For 2016, Subaru returned with VAB WRX STI, but this time, the car featured engineering from STI, Subaru’s motorsport division, and styling/manufacturing support from Prodrive of the UK; the very group who had dominated the World Rally Championships (WRC) with Subaru. The car's turbocharged 2.0-liter flat-4 turbo was tuned to produce more than 600ps, with further refinements such as a DRS built into the rear wing.

As a result, with former rally driver Mark Higgins behind the wheel, Subaru cut two minutes off of its previous record, with a time of 17 minutes 35.139 seconds and an average speed of <207km/h>.

The WRX STI is the pinnacle of the highly popular
Impreza WRX line.

Introduced in 2014, it is equipped with a turbocharged
variant of Subaru's legendary EJ20 boxer engine.

It's mated to an improved 6-speed manual gearbox
with short throws.

Like previous models, this one features all-wheel drive.

brandCentral.zh:
WRX STI是经久不衰的Impreza WRX系列的最新作。

这款车型于2014年推出，采用Subaru传奇的EJ20跑车引擎的涡轮
增压版本，

还配备了改进后的六速手动变速箱。

强大的引擎与富有韧性的车架搭配，构成了一个美妙的

vehicleCollection.en:
The WRX STI continues its tradition of delivering potent 4WD performance.

While traditionally known as the Subaru Impreza WRX, the rally-inspired compact sports sedan became simply the Subaru WRX in the fall of 2013, but everything that made this model one of the most exciting machines in the world remained intact.

The WRX was built on the platform of the Levorg, a Japan-market-only station wagon. After seriously reinforcing the body structure, Subaru engineers went to work on the engine and chassis, putting much of their focus on the high-performance STI. They wanted to make sure that the WRX STI and the WRX S4 were completely different models, the former meant for the performance enthusiast, while the latter catered to grand touring fans. While the STI and S4 looked similar, everything from the engine to the steering mechanism was different.

For the STI, the engineers dropped the EJ20, a turbocharged 2.0-liter flat-4, into the engine bay. This powerplant produced 308ps and 43.0kgm of torque, routing the power to all four wheels via a 6-speed manual gearbox and Subaru’s excellent 4-wheel-drive system that featured a driver-controlled center differential. It was this 4WD system that made all WRX STIs so special. It included both an electronically-controlled and mechanical LSD—a Helical LSD controlled the front wheels, while a Torsen LSD was installed for the rear.

The WRX STI defined the “point and shoot” nature of compact sports cars of its day, thanks in part to its quick and precise hydraulic power steering system and custom-tuned suspension. On either road or dirt, the WRX STI had very few equals.
vehicleCollection.zh:
源自翼豹，追求速度和驾驶的乐趣。

2013年秋季发布的斯巴鲁WRX是从翼豹系列独立出来的中档轿车。WRX这个车型等级过去曾被用来命名翼豹的高性能版本，现在则成为了一款新的车型，并且顺理成章地成为了翼豹WRX的后继者，被发展为高性能的轿跑车。

这款车使用与斯巴鲁力狮运动相同的平台，但考虑到旅行车和轿车之间存在差别，两车预期的行驶条件也不相同，因此对WRX的车体进行了大幅强化。该车型包括跑车车型的STI和豪华旅行车版的S4。两个版本均为四轮驱动，动力单元为该厂标志性的水平对置4缸引擎。然而，STI与S4除了中央差速器不同外，动力转向结构也不相同，就算使用的都是2升水平对置4缸引擎，也并非是同一款。斯巴鲁坚持奉行差异化策略。

高性能的STI版本配有EJ20引擎，该引擎经过了彻底的改进，能够输出308ps和43.0kgm的动力。传动方面采用强化版的6档手动变速箱和车手可控中央差速器，同时配备了电子限滑差速器和机械限滑差速器，前轮装备了螺旋齿轮限滑差速器，而后轮则采用托森限滑差速器。方向盘也采用了提高驾驶手感的液压式动力转向系统。毫无疑问，悬挂也是专为这款车而独立开发的。总之，WRX在成为独立车型后，给予了设计师追求全面性能的自由度。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
When it comes to genuine kei sportscars…

This Suzuki Cappuccino is truly a legend.

It has a front-engine, rear-wheel-drive layout,
making it an ‘FR’ car.

Lift up its bonnet and you’ll find that its engine
is mounted near the centre of the car.

That alone should convince you that
it’s a real sportscar!

Released in 1991, the Cappuccino...

Is often grouped with its competitors,
the Mazda AZ-1 and Honda Beat.

Combing their initials, the three may be referred to
as the ‘A-B-C’ of kei sportscars.
dialogues.zh:
如果要讨论最正宗的轻型跑车……

这款Suzuki Cappuccino就是真正的传奇。

它采用前置引擎、后轮驱动布局，也就是所谓的“前置
后驱”车。

抬起它的引擎盖，你会发现它的引擎位置更贴近车身的
正中。

这就是它作为真正跑车的明证！

这款Cappuccino在1991年上市……

常被拿来和它的竞争者Mazda AZ-1和Honda Beat相提并论。

如果把这三款车的型号名称首字母连在一起，就形成了
轻型跑车的“A-B-C”，代表了最基础的车型。

usedCar.en:
Despite belonging to Japan's kei-car class, the Suzuki
Cappuccino is a genuine sports car.

It's a lightweight vehicle with a compact body and an
FR layout.

The engine is a highly efficient and reliable turbocharged
inline-3 with 657cc of displacement.

Although it only produces 64ps, the Cappuccino's weight
of 700kg means it possesses decent acceleration.

The chassis was also specially developed, so the front/rear
weight distribution is ideally balanced.

The car's 'tossable' nature makes it a delight to drive,
even for hardcore enthusiasts!
usedCar.zh:
虽然是日本轻型车中的一款，Suzuki Cappuccino
仍是一辆货真价实的跑车。

这是一辆采用前置后驱布局的轻型车辆。

它搭载了一台排量为657cc的直列三缸涡轮增压引擎，
秉承了Suzuki一贯的可靠性。

尽管它只能输出64ps，但它700kg的重量
意味着这辆车拥有不错的加速性能。

此车的底盘也是专门开发的，
所以前后的重量分配绝对均衡。

这辆车的操控性无与伦比，非常好开！

vehicleCollection.en:
The rear-drive Cappuccino roadster kickstarted the two-seat kei-car trend.

The Cappuccino was an instant hit when it was introduced by Suzuki in November 1991. Along with the other sporty kei-cars such as the Honda Beat and Mazda Autozam AZ-1, the Cappuccino provided unprecedented flair to the mainly economy-oriented kei-car category.

Like a traditional sport car, the Cappuccino adopted a 2-seat front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout in a convertible body. In contrast, the Beat and the gull-winged AZ-1 featured mid-engine layouts. And although kei-cars often shared parts, the Cappuccino had an all-original body. Suzuki ensured that it was a capable handling machine, giving it a 51:49 front-to-rear weight distribution and a sport-tuned suspension system consisting of double wishbones at front and rear.

Another innovative element of the Cappuccino was its three-piece detachable roof. With all the pieces in place, the car was essentially a hard-top coupe, but depending on how you configured them, the car could be converted to a T-top, a targa-top or a full-on convertible, offering the owner four different body styles.

Under the hood was a 657cc turbocharged DOHC 12-valve inline-3 based on the 64ps powerplant of the Alto Works, the most powerful engine used in a kei model. Providing stopping power were disc brakes at all four corners with ventilated front discs.

In 1995, the car received a number of minor improvements including an a newly designed all-aluminum engine block. The engine control unit was also updated. An electronically controlled 3-speed automatic joined the 5-speed manual gearbox in the lineup, with the automatic transmission models equipped with power steering.

At the end of 1998, the production run for the Cappuccino ended at 26,500 units, but the car remains popular today with collectors and driving enthusiasts, and is still considered one of the gretest kei-cars of all time.
vehicleCollection.zh:
前置引擎、后轮驱动的敞篷小车，在日本掀起了双座轻型车的潮流。

Cappuccino是铃木在1991年11月发布的轻型跑车。这是一款在当时收获海量人气的双座轻型车，与本田Beat和马自达Autozam AZ-1等车齐名。

Cappuccino的主要特点在于它是一款双座前置后驱敞篷车，具有和引擎中置的敞篷本田Beat和引擎中置、采用鸥翼车门的AZ-1截然不同的独特设计概念。有趣的是，虽然轻型汽车经常使用共享零件，但这台车的车身是专门为该车型设计的全原创车身。这样的做法自然是为了使其具有出色的操控特性，同时也说明铃木在开发Cappuccino时的认真程度。

Cappuccino的设计具有明显的前置后驱车特色，有一个长长的车头部分，并呈现出圆润的形态。另一项创新是车顶的结构，可以分三部分拆除。从硬顶开始，它可以转换为T型栏杆顶、TARGA顶，并且随着后窗的降低，可成为完全开放的车顶，使车主能够享受4种样式的变化。

其动力单元是一台657cc、双顶置凸轮轴 12气门直列3缸涡轮增压引擎。此引擎的规格与奥拓Works的64ps引擎相同，同时也是日本轻型汽车的最高规格。

从1995年起，引擎采用了全铝打造，使前后重量分配更接近理想的51:49。悬挂系统在前后都使用了新设计的双叉臂式，前部采用配备通风盘的四轮碟刹。变速箱最初只提供5档手动，但后来又增加了电子控制的3档自动。自动档车型还配备了动力转向系统。

截止1998年底，Cappuccino在停产时总共生产了26,500辆车。这是一款诞生于日本的经济泡沫时代、真真正正的梦幻轻型跑车。

Cappuccino的主要特点在于它是一款双座前置后驱敞篷车，具有和引擎中置的敞篷本田Beat和引擎中置、采用鸥翼车门的AZ-1截然不同的独特设计概念。有趣的是，虽然轻型汽车经常使用共享零件，但这台车的车身是专门为该车型设计的全原创车身。这样的做法自然是为了使其具有出色的操控特性，同时也说明铃木在开发Cappuccino时的认真程度。

Cappuccino的设计具有明显的前置后驱车特色，有一个长长的车头部分，并呈现出圆润的形态。另一项创新是车顶的结构，可以分三部分拆除。从硬顶开始，它可以转换为T型栏杆顶、TARGA顶，并且随着后窗的降低，可成为完全开放的车顶，使车主能够享受4种样式的变化。

其动力单元是一台657cc、双顶置凸轮轴 12气门直列3缸涡轮增压引擎。此引擎的规格与奥拓Works的64ps引擎相同，同时也是日本轻型汽车的最高规格。

从1995年起，引擎采用了全铝打造，使前后重量分配更接近理想的51:49。悬挂系统在前后都使用了新设计的双叉臂式，前部采用配备通风盘的四轮碟刹。变速箱最初只提供5档手动，但后来又增加了电子控制的3档自动。自动档车型还配备了动力转向系统。

截止1998年底，Cappuccino在停产时总共生产了26,500辆车。这是一款诞生于日本的经济泡沫时代、真真正正的梦幻轻型跑车。

brandCentral.en:
Japan’s kei-cars are a unique category of ultra-compact vehicles
that deliver surprising capability with a modest footprint.

This class spans everything from SUVs to nimble sports cars,
even including “kei-trucks” like the Suzuki Carry.

Although the series dates back more than six decades, the model
here is from 2012, from the tenth generation introduced in 1999.

Measuring just 3.4m meters in length, it’s surprisingly capable,
and its 658cc engine delivers ample torque, even under load.

Today, used Carrys are finding homes far beyond Japan’s borders,
a sign of growing global appreciation of the kei-car’s appeal.
brandCentral.zh:
日本的“轻型车”指的是将充沛的动力塞进小车身
的一种微型汽车特殊类型。

这个类别下不仅囊括了SUV和跑车车型，甚至还
包含了“轻型卡车”，正如这辆Suzuki Carry。

这个系列已经拥有超过60年的历史，而这一辆是最新的
2012款，属于1999年推出的第十代车型。

尽管车身长度仅有3.4m，但它的运输能力毫不逊色，它的
大扭矩658cc引擎在满载情况下依旧性能卓越。

如今，二手Carry已经在海外市场流行开，标志着
全世界都开始领会到日式轻型车的魅力。

vehicleCollection.en:
A quintessential example of the micro-truck trend that has become a hit all over the world.

Japan’s micro-car segment, known domestically as kei-cars, has become an essential part of daily life across the country. While the category includes everything from passenger vehicles and mini-SUVs to sports cars, it also plays a critical role in supporting infrastructure through a wide range of commercial vans and trucks. The Suzuki Carry stands as a quintessential example of the commercial kei truck.

First introduced in 1961, the Carry boasts a long and storied history. The tenth generation was introduced in 1999 following a full model change to comply with revised kei-car regulations introduced the previous year. The model shown here is from 2012, marking the final iteration of the tenth-generation model.

Compared to its predecessor, the new Carry featured a slightly larger footprint, measuring 3395mm in length and 1475mm in width. Its semi-cabover design placed the engine beneath the occupants' feet. Displacement remained within the kei-class limit at 658cc, with early variants even offering turbocharged options.

To accommodate a variety of needs, the Carry was offered in several trim levels. The KC—its most well-equipped—came standard with power steering and air conditioning. While rear-wheel drive was standard, a 4-wheel-drive variant ensured that it was at home on snowy roads and rugged terrain as it was on the highway.

Beyond its utilitarian function, the Carry’s charming design and remarkable practicality garnered international attention. In the United States, pre-owned Carrys—eligible for road use 25 years after their original release—have become increasingly popular among farmers and hobbyists alike. Compact yet capable, the Carry is a testament to the ingenuity of Japanese design and its ability to resonate around the world.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款车是席卷整个世界的“微型卡车”风潮中的典范。

时至今日，被称为“轻型车”的日系微型车已经发展成为了人们不可或缺的日常生活工具。日式轻型车类别中涵盖了多种客运车型，以及SUV和跑车，但此外还包含大量用于支持城市基础运行的商用小货车和卡车车型。铃木Carry就是一款这样的微型卡车，忠实地反映出了整个日式轻型车领域的特点。

Carry拥有悠久的历史，最远可追溯到其诞生的1961年。为了符合1998年引入的新版日式轻型车认证标准，系列在1999年进行了全面升级，推出了第10代车型。在那之后，第10代车型又进行了多次改款，而这里介绍的这辆2012款便是目前最新的车型。

与前代相比，它的车身得到了加大，长度和宽度分别达到了3395mm和1475mm。得益于半平头的车头设计，其引擎被置于乘客坐席的正下方，排量仅有658cc。在最初上市时，铃木也提供了涡轮增压版本作为选择。

为了满足不同的用途和价位，Carry提供了若干不同档次，其中配置最高的是标配动力辅助转向和空调的KC版本。除了后轮驱动版本之外，该车型还提供了四轮驱动选项，即便在雪地或崎岖不平的山路上也能发挥出全部性能。

这款日式轻型卡车拥有可爱的外表和优异的功能性，也帮助它在国外收获了广泛的关注。二手Carry在美国的农牧业领域拥有相当高的人气。在发布超过25年后，其右座驾驶版本已经自动获得了上路认证。Carry小小的身躯中蕴含着无限的潜力，是日系汽车设计在全世界赢得认可的又一个独特例证。

brandCentral.en:
The Suzuki Jimny is best known as Japan’s kei-car
off-roader par excellence.

The Jimny that broke the kei-car mold was the Sierra,
designed for the global market.

This Jimny Sierra is the third-gen model, known as the JB74.
Its rugged-yet-boxy stance is quite attractive, wouldn’t you say?

While the original Jimny had a mere 660cc displacement,
the Sierra possessed a 1.5-liter engine capable of 102ps.

Thanks to its part-time 4WD system and rigid suspension
in the front and rear, the Sierra offers sublime handling.

The JC grade refers to a Japanese trim that includes LED
headlamps and alloy wheels as standard fare."
brandCentral.zh:
Suzuki Jimny作为日本轻型车中的越野典范而闻名。

在产品线中，突破轻型车界限的是为全球市场
打造的“Sierra”车型。

这款第三代Jimny Sierra型号为“JB74”。
它那棱角分明的硬朗外形极具吸引力，你说是吗？

相比原版Jimny仅有660cc的排量，Sierra搭载了
一台可输出102ps的1.5升引擎。

凭借分时四轮驱动系统和前后刚性悬挂的配置，
Sierra展现出卓越的操控性。

“JC”等级是其日本市场版本，标准配置包括LED前大灯
和铝合金轮圈。

vehicleCollection.en:
A stouter Jimny with an eye on global success.

While the Suzuki Jimny's diminutive stature allowed it to fit into Japan's kei-car regulations, under its skin was a tenaciously rugged off-road vehicle with a ladder-frame construction. The Jimny Sierra was a global-market variant that retained the Jimny’s off-road prowess while breaking free from its kei-car limitations.

Introduced in 2018, the JB74 chassis represented the third generation of the Sierra lineage, following the original that appeared in 1993. Compared to the previous chassis, called the JB43, the new one measured 50mm shorter and 45mm wider. The vehicle's revised dimensions were further emphasized by a bolder, more squared-off body, giving it a commanding presence.

Under the hood resided the K15B engine, a 1460mm DOHC inline-4 that produced 102ps and 13.3kgm of torque. At first glance, these figures might not have appeared like much, but the sustained low-end torque made the Jimny Sierra ideal for off-road crawling.

Equipped with a mechanical transfer case, the Jimny Sierra's part-time 4WD system provided off-road capability when needed.
With rigid axles at both the front and rear, the fine-tuned suspension system helped the vehicle feel at home crawling over rocks or trudging through mud as it did cruising on paved roads.

The top-of-the-line version in Japan was the JC.
It came generously equipped with LED headlamps and 15-inch alloy wheels as standard fare, while also offering the option of a black roof panel for added style and contrast.
vehicleCollection.zh:
面向全球市场的“更强壮”的吉姆尼。

铃木吉姆尼小巧的车身使其符合日本“轻型汽车”的法规要求，但其内在是一款坚固耐用的越野车，拥有真正的边梁式车架结构。吉姆尼Sierra是面向全球市场发售的车型，不仅继承了原车强大的越野能力，同时摆脱了轻型车法规的限制。

JB74底盘于2018年推出，是该车型自1993年首次亮相以来的第三代产品。与之前的JB43底盘相比，新款车型的车身短了50mm但宽了45mm，让车身更加方正，线条更为大胆。

该车搭载了1460cc排量的“K15B”直列4缸双凸轮轴引擎，输出功率为102ps/13.3kgm。从数据上来看，这辆车的动力可能并不突出，但源源不断的低转速扭矩使其在越野攀爬中表现尤为出色。

这套分时四驱系统搭配机械分动箱。悬挂上采用前后刚性轴，让车辆无论是在岩石上爬行、泥泞中跋涉，还是在铺装道路上行驶，都得心应手。

JC车型是日本本土提供的最高配版本，标配LED大灯和15英寸合金轮毂，并可选配黑色车顶。

catch.en: A stouter Jimny with an eye on global success.
catch.zh: 面向全球市场的“更强壮”的吉姆尼。

brandCentral.en:
While the Suzuki Jimny may belong to the kei-car class,
it's still a rugged and capable 4x4 vehicle.

Small yet strong, it combines urban agility
with world-class off-road performance.

Don’t let its compact size fool you—this car
can hit serious speeds.

Equipped with physicality and functionality,
it excels on rocks, sand and even snow.

Introduced in 1970, it was the first kei-car to
boast a genuine 4-wheel-drive system.

And, for more than 50 years, it has built its success
on tradition and change.
brandCentral.zh:
尽管Suzuki Jimny属于日式轻型车类型，
但同样也是一款粗犷的4x4越野车。

它同时具备轻量和坚固的特点，综合了
都市通勤车的便利性和世界级的越野性能。

不要被它的紧凑型规格蒙蔽了，
它可以达到非常惊人的极速。

它兼顾韧性和功能性，即便在最崎岖的
地形上也能表现出色。

这款车于1970年首次亮相，是第一款真正采用
四轮驱动系统的日式轻型车……

而在50年多的发展历史里，它也在坚守传统
和不断求变中书写了无数的成功故事。

vehicleCollection.en:
Japan's mighty micro off-roader boasts amazing all-terrain ability beyond its size.

The Jimny is a cross-country style 4WD model that has been produced by Suzuki since 1970. While there have been variants in each generation that crossed over into the compact-car class, the mainstay of the series is the kei model.

The Jimny has continued to evolve over the years with a second-generation model introduced in 1981, a third-generation variant introduced in 1998 and a fourth-generation model in 2018. What remained constant throughout the entire series was its construction formula: a kei-size body on a ladder frame chassis with rigid axle suspension and oversized tires. The vehicle always came with part-time 4-wheel drive, but rear-wheel-drive-only models were offered as well.

This specialized off-road setup has gained widespread acclaim, not just in Japan but worldwide. It continues to serve as a versatile commercial vehicle in many regions with mountainous terrain, while appealing to outdoor enthusiasts seeking adventure, and even to race drivers as a foundational vehicle for rally competition.

The main features of the fourth-generation Jimny, introduced in 2018, were its overtly square body and its round headlamps that's reminiscent of the first-gen model. Also, driving stability and ride comfort at high speeds—a common weakness of off-road vehicles— were greatly improved.

The new Jimny's 660cc turbocharged engine was specially tuned, and its classic part-time 4-wheel drive system once again featured a mechanical transfer case. To reduce wheel spin, the car came with electronically controlled brake LSD traction control as standard fare.

The most popular model in the line-up is the luxury "XC," which included a wide variety of extra features such as cruise control and steering wheel-mounted audio controls.
vehicleCollection.zh:
超越其规格的惊人全地形能力。日本最强大的微型越野车。

吉姆尼是一款铃木自1970年起便一直生产的越野四驱车型。尽管每一代都推出过各种改款，甚至跨界到紧凑型车类别中，但其主力产品依然是日式轻型车车型。

自诞生以来，这个系列便一直推陈出新，其第二代产品在1981年推出，第三代在1998年推出，而第四代也在2018年姗姗来迟。整个系列中一以贯之的便是其不变的架构，即将“轻型车”规格的车身外壳安装在梯形框架底盘上，并采用刚性车桥悬挂和超大尺寸轮胎。其传动系统始终采用分时四驱布局，不过也曾推出过后驱款。

不仅是在日本国内，这套纯正越野配置所提供的全地形能力为它在全球范围内也赢得了无数的赞誉。作为一款量产车，它在降雪量较大和山地环境较多的地区颇受欢迎，也成为了户外休闲驾驶爱好者的热门选择，甚至成为了越野赛车运动的基础车型。

2018年推出的第四代吉姆尼最主要的特点是它那鲜明的方形车身和圆形大灯等追根溯源的设计。此外，针对越野车的普遍弱项，它在高速下的稳定性和驾乘舒适性获得了极大的提升。

这一代吉姆尼还采用了特殊调校的660cc涡轮增压引擎，而其经典的分时四轮驱动系统也再次用回了机械式传动箱。为了减少车辆打滑的情况，这款车还标配电子控制限滑差速器牵引力控制系统。

这个产品族系中最受欢迎的车型便是主打豪华的“XC”级吉姆尼，额外配备了诸多进阶功能，如巡航控制系统和安装在方向盘上的音响控制器。

吉姆尼是一款铃木自1970年起便一直生产的越野四驱车型。尽管每一代都推出过各种改款，甚至跨界到紧凑型车类别中，但其主力产品依然是日式轻型车车型。

自诞生以来，这个系列便一直推陈出新，其第二代产品在1981年推出，第三代在1998年推出，而第四代也在2018年姗姗来迟。整个系列中一以贯之的便是其不变的架构，即将“轻型车”规格的车身外壳安装在梯形框架底盘上，并采用刚性车桥悬挂和超大尺寸轮胎。其传动系统始终采用分时四驱布局，不过也曾推出过后驱款。

不仅是在日本国内，这套纯正越野配置所提供的全地形能力为它在全球范围内也赢得了无数的赞誉。作为一款量产车，它在降雪量较大和山地环境较多的地区颇受欢迎，也成为了户外休闲驾驶爱好者的热门选择，甚至成为了越野赛车运动的基础车型。

2018年推出的第四代吉姆尼最主要的特点是它那鲜明的方形车身和圆形大灯等追根溯源的设计。此外，针对越野车的普遍弱项，它在高速下的稳定性和驾乘舒适性获得了极大的提升。

这一代吉姆尼还采用了特殊调校的660cc涡轮增压引擎，而其经典的分时四轮驱动系统也再次用回了机械式传动箱。为了减少车辆打滑的情况，这款车还标配电子控制限滑差速器牵引力控制系统。

这个产品族系中最受欢迎的车型便是主打豪华的“XC”级吉姆尼，额外配备了诸多进阶功能，如巡航控制系统和安装在方向盘上的音响控制器。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
A second-generation Swift Sport!

Thanks to its high base specs, this car can compete
without much modification.

In fact, it was even entered as a junior rally car
at the World Rally Championship!

Having taken the title twice, Suzuki has proved...

The great potential of this machine.

Manufacturing credit goes to Monster Sport, a Japanese
company headed by Nobuhiro Tajima.

Speaking of Tajima-san...

His impressive career includes six consecutive wins
at the Pikes Peak International Hillclimb.

Monster Sport has also built legendary hill climbers
based on the Suzuki Cultus and Escudo.
dialogues.zh:
这是第二代的Swift Sport啊！

因为基础规格够高，所以无需过多改装，
就能直接参加比赛。

事实上，它甚至作为青年拉力赛赛车参加了
世界拉力锦标赛！

Suzuki用两个冠军头衔证明了……

这辆车的巨大潜能。

这辆车的制造者是Monster Sport，一家田嶋伸博创办的日本公司。

说起田嶋先生……

他拥有傲人的职业生涯战绩，曾在派克峰国际爬坡赛中获得六连胜。

在他的带领下，Monster Sport也基于Suzuki Cultus和Escudo
生产传奇的山地爬坡赛车。

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
A company that’s known to pivot hard, Suzuki sometimes
offers products that really take you by surprise.

The Wagon R was one such example. And so
 was this Swift Sport.

The four corners of its chunky body are fit with relatively
large wheels that speak to its excellent maneuverability.

A small car, it’s equipped with everything it needs
and nothing else.

If you were to see it driving down an Italian street, you’d
think the car was designed by Italians.
dialogues.zh:
Suzuki是一家出了名的“推陈出新”的公司，有时会拿出一些
出人意料的产品。

比如Wagon R轻型车，又比如这款Swift Sport。

这款车的外形方正，在四个轮位安装了大一号的轮毂，
体现出它优异的操控性。

这是一辆麻雀虽小，五脏俱全的小型车，
不少一分，也不多一分。

如果在狭窄的意大利街道看到它驶过，你可能
会觉得它和当地的环境浑然一体。

brandCentral.en:
This is Suzuki's Swift Sport, an iconic Japanese FF hot hatch.

It served as a great foundation for a rally race car. Just look
at its performances at the Junior World Rally Championship.

Okay, so maybe the 1.6-liter naturally-aspirated engine sounds
unimpressive at first...

...but this thing featured variable valve-timing technology,
and forged pistons!

It came mated to a close-ratio 5-speed manual, making the car
a hoot to drive on the race track.
brandCentral.zh:
这就是Swift Sport，一款标志性的日本前置前驱高性能掀背车……

它在世界拉力锦标赛青年组上的表现为自己赢得了拉力
赛场上的众多崇拜者。

知道引擎盖下有什么吗？一台1.6L自然进气发动机！

此车采用可变气门正时技术、锻造活塞……

以及密齿轮比的5速手动变速箱，典型的赛事配置表明
此车随时做好了驶上赛道的准备！

usedCar.en:
If you're shopping around for a FF hot hatch, you'd be smart
to take a close look at the Swift Sport.

Its 1.6-liter naturally-aspirated engine transitions well to
high speeds, and its handling is as sharp as a katana.

This particular model marks a real evolution in chassis
construction, with more rigidity than ever before.

The year 2007 was a special one for the Swift because it made
a name for itself by winning the Junior World Rally Cup.
usedCar.zh:
如果你在找一辆前置前驱的高性能掀背车，
Swift Sport是个不错的选择。

它搭载的1.6L自然吸气引擎完全能应对高速行驶，
而它的操控性能更是无与伦比。

凭借其大幅提升的底盘刚性，这款车型标志了
Swift底盘制作工艺的进化。

这辆车也因在2007年世界青年拉力锦标赛中夺冠
而声名大噪。

vehicleCollection.en:
Suzuki's fun-to-drive Swift Sport was made even more lively with a high-revving engine and close-ratio gears.

The Suzuki Swift Sport is a model that is based on the second-generation Swift, their model aimed for the global market. The European model is a 3-door body, but in Japan it is also offered in a 5-door body.

Its development was performed mainly in Europe, and was based on the production model rather than a prototype. Though this delayed the release timing to be later than the model change, this European development was imperative to perfect the level of tuning on the car. For the same reason, it was subjected to numerous tests, under a large variety of road conditions.

One merit for developing in Europe was that they gained the partnership and support of Teneco. Their knowhow gained from their Monroe brand helped to perfect the driving performance of the Swift Sport.

The engine is a 1.6-liter normally aspirated engine, combined with forged pistons and VVT, and tuned for driving in the high rpm range.

In a minor change in 2007, the maximum power did not change but the rev limit was increased from 7000rpm to 7500rpm. And by introducing cross ratio gears for the 5-speed MT, its power can now be more effectively applied and appreciated. It is also equipped with an ESP, a feature which is becoming more common among European cars, and the overall performance of the car has been improved. The interior also used to have many red accents, but this has been reduced for a more mature, chic atmosphere.
vehicleCollection.zh:
改良版速翼特运动版，拥有密齿轮比和高转速引擎。

铃木速翼特运动版基于第二代速翼特开发，是针对全球市场推出的车款。面向欧洲的车型为3门版，但在日本也供应5门版。

这款车的开发主要在欧洲进行，且开发直接基于量产车，而非原型车。虽然这使得该车的发布晚于改款更新，但为了使得车辆调校更加完善，欧洲的开发工作相当关键。出于同样的原因，这款车在各种各样的道路条件下经受了无数次试验。

在欧洲开发的优势之一是能与天纳克合作并获得其支持。他们通过其蒙诺品牌积累的技术经验有助于完善速翼特运动版的驾驶性能。

引擎采用1.6升自然吸气引擎，同时配备锻造活塞和可变气门正时技术，专门针对高转速条件下的驾驶性能进行了调校。

在2007年的小升级中，最大马力没有变化，但转速上限从7000rpm提高到了7500rpm。5速手动变速箱中使用了双速比齿轮，从而更有效地利用和发挥了引擎的马力。与此同时，车辆上还配备电子稳定程序系统，该系统的应用在欧洲车中越来越普遍，同时提高的还有车辆的整体质量水平。在内饰方面，曾经占据主导的红色装饰件被删减，改为更加成熟和别致的配色。

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
In the Japanese automobile world, performing a model change
without dramatically altering the car's design is rare.

But it is carried out quite well here.

The way the windscreen blends into the side glass
gives the impression of a full-face helmet.

This car possesses the same basic design theme
as its predecessor.

What has noticeably changed is...

A more powerful looking one-frame front end
and air intakes on either side.

However, these aren't exaggerated changes,
just effective.
dialogues.zh:
在日本汽车界，在车辆改款时不对原设计进行大幅更新
是非常少见的情况。

不过这款新车的整体感觉非常不错。

它的挡风玻璃与侧面车窗融为一体，
给人一种全罩式头盔的感觉。

新车采用了与前代车型相同的基础设计主题。

最明显的改变在于……

更凸显力量感的单条前格栅
以及车头两侧的进气口。

这些改动不追求夸张的造型变化，只追求效率。.

brandCentral.en:
If you're looking for a small hatchback that's fun to drive,
then this fourth-generation Swift Sport is the car for you!

This model probably marked the biggest evolution in the
history of the line.

It weighs only 970kg, but the turbo engine
is capable of delivering 20kgm of torque.

The newly developed body is exceptionally stiff,
and its under-body aerodynamics are advanced.

The simple, responsive handling and the excellent power
delivery make this a great car to throw around corners.
brandCentral.zh:
如果你想要寻找一台充满驾驶乐趣的小型掀背车，这款
第四代Swift Sport就非常适合您！

这个型号见证了整个产品系列历史上最大的革新。

这台重量仅为970kg的小车却装备了一台涡轮增压引擎，可
以输出超过20kgm的扭矩。

全新设计的车身拥有极其出色的刚性，车身底盘的空气

简单而灵敏的操控性带来愉悦的驾驶体验，加速性能更
是不容小觑！

vehicleCollection.en:
Superb handling was just one of the fortes of this high-performance Japanese hatchback.

The Swift has traditionally been one of Suzuki's most popular models, especially the Swift Sport, which has been touted as one of the most fun-to-drive compact sports coupes in Japan. When the fourth-generation Swift was introduced in 2016, the Swift Sport wasn't far behind, coming out a year later.

With a lower front end that enhanced the car's aerodynamics, the new Swift Sport wasn't simply better looking, but a better performer in every way. Under the hood was a turbocharged 1.4-liter engine that replaced the previous model's naturally aspirated 1.6-liter, putting out a respectable 140ps and 230 Nm (23.45 kgm).

Also, because Suzuki engineers retuned the car's suspension system, while also widening the front and rear track by 30mm, the car handled better than ever. The car was 70kg lighter than before, so it possessed a pronounced low- and mid-range punch.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款纯粹的日系性能小钢炮展现出远超以往的操控性。

2017年发布的速翼特运动版是2016年上市的第四代铃木 速翼特的高性能版本。

车身针对空气动力学性能进行了重新设计，尤其是车头比标准的速翼特略低。引擎也由之前车型上搭载的1.6升自然进气引擎缩减为1.4升涡轮增压配置。这款引擎此前曾应用在铃木的其他车型上，但针对运动性能接受了重新调校，得以在使用高辛烷值汽油的情况下产生140ps和230牛·米（23.45）的扭矩。

与以往速翼特运动版车型的另一个不同之处在于悬挂系统的设置，铃木不仅专门为该车型进行了特殊调校，而且还将前后轮距增加了30mm，以提高操控性。此外，车身比同款基础版本的速翼特既轻又硬，同时也比之前的速翼特运动版车型轻了70kg。

brandCentral.en:
This is a Gran Turismo original Gr.4 race car is based on
the fourth-generation Suzuki Swift Sport.

As you probably know, Suzuki is famous for producing motorcycles
as well as cars.

So it should come as no surprise that the look of the Swift Sport
KATANA Edition Gr.4 was inspired by the Katana sports bike.

The car was inspired by the Swift Sport KATANA Edition prototype,
which was shown at the Tokyo Auto Salon in 2020.

Its key features are the logo it shares with the Katana
motorcycle, and its bold and imposing wide fender.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车基于
第四代Suzuki Swift Sport开发。

我想不需要我多介绍您也知道，
Suzuki是闻名遐迩的摩托车和汽车制造商。

这款Swift Sport Gr.4的外观设计灵感也确实来自于
同公司的传奇摩托车“Katana”。

它的改装原型是在2020年东京汽车沙龙上亮相的
Swift Sport Katana Edition，

拥有与Katana摩托车一模一样的标志，
以及粗犷霸气的挡泥板。

vehicleCollection.en:
A tuned up Gr. 4 version of the Swift Sport based on the 'KATANA Edition'.

Since its release in 2018, the ZC33 Swift Sport has been praised by automobile enthusiasts as an extremely sporty and fun-to-drive hatchback. The credit here went to the car's lightweight highly rigid body structure, a responsive turbocharged 1.4-liter engine and excellent handling character.

Unveiled at the 2020 Tokyo Auto Salon, the "KATANA Edition" concept offered a peek into what future Swift Sports may look like. The car borrowed the spirit of Suzuki's high-performance sports bike, the Katana. Because Suzuki specializes in building both cars and motorcycles, this is a vehicle that could be created by only a few manufacturers in the world.

The designers used the Suzuki Swift as a base, but added the front and rear bumpers that had design elements from the Katana. The exaggerated fender flares widened the car further. The interior featured burnt titanium-colored panels that simulated a hot exhaust to create the look and feel of a sports bike. Additionally, both the interior and exterior came with red accents and Katana logos throughout.

In addition to the two-tone silver-and-matte black design on the show car, five other color variations were added. "Candy Daring Red" was the same color as the limited-edition Katana bike that was sold in January 2021. Only 100 examples of that bike were made.

This special version featured in Gran Turismo has been slightly modified in design and specification to compete in Gr.4 racing. Among the changes were an enlarged front spoiler, a new unique GT wing designed to reflect the shape of the Katana's seat cowling and the addition of a roll cage.
vehicleCollection.zh:
基于速翼特运动版KATANA版调校的组别4级别赛车。

自从ZC33 速翼特运动版在2018年首次亮相以来，这款紧凑的高性能掀背车就得到了所有汽车爱好者的广泛好评，大家都称赞它的轻量化高强度车身，响应速度灵敏的高扭矩1.4升涡轮增压引擎，和由欧洲工程师精心调校过的操控性。
这款“KATANA版”在2020年东京汽车沙龙上首次亮相，是对这个车型未来进化方向的完美示范。通过速翼特运动版的车身来充分体现高性能Katana摩托车的动力和美学。铃木是世界上为数不多同时生产摩托车和汽车的厂商，因此也只有充满运动理念的他们才能够拿出这样的创意。

这款车的设计采用铃木 速翼特作为基础车型，并如之前所说加入了包含Katana外观元素的前后保险杠。其夸张的外扩挡泥板进一步扩宽了车身，并着重强调了速翼特运动版那迷人的轮廓。其内饰采用烧灼钛合金配色的饰板，模拟出类似运动型摩托车的烧灼排气管以及其他元素，丰富主题体验。此外，其内饰和外观还采用了红色的次要配色和随处可见的Katana标志。
除了在东京汽车沙龙上看到的这种Katana银和磨砂黑的双色设计之外，这款车还提供另外5种配色版本。其中“糖果炽烈红”版本采用了2021年1月推出的100台限量版Katana摩托车的同款车身配色方案。

跑车浪漫旅中包含的这个特殊版本在设计和规格上进行了轻微的改动，以符合组别4级别的规范。其前置底部扰流器进行了扩大，并添加了一部独特的GT尾翼，与Katana的座椅整流罩形状遥相呼应。这款车还更改了轮胎的尺寸，减轻内饰重量，加入了防滚架，并换用了一部调校过的引擎，已经彻底进化为了一台跑车浪漫旅专属组别4O格比赛机器。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Can you name for me the world’s highest hill climb,
held annually in the state of Colorado?

That’s right! The Pikes Peak International Hill Climb,
a race with more than a century of history.

Built to dominate the competition at Pikes Peak was
the Suzuki V6 Escudo, a 900kg beast.

It was a machine that required a monster talent to tame.

So, it was fitting that piloting the Escudo was a driver named
Nobuhiro "Monster" Tajima.

A veritable dirt veteran, Tajima-san claimed seven
straight wins at the All-Japan Dirt Trial Championship.

In 1995, he became the first Japanese driver to win
the overall championship at Pikes Peak.
<
dialogues.zh:
你知道在美国科罗拉多州每年举办的
世界海拔最高的登山赛吗？

正是拥有百年历史的派克峰国际爬坡赛！

Suzuki V6 Escudo这台仅有900公斤重的机械猛兽，
正是为赢得派克峰爬坡赛而生。

想要驯服这头狂暴怪兽，就需要一名怪兽级车手……

他便是有着“怪兽Tajima”名号的田岛伸博。

这位砂石路面的绝对统治者，曾七度蝉联
全日本砂道锦标赛冠军。

1995年，他更是成为首位在派克峰赛事中
斩获全场总冠军的日本车手。

collection.sourceName: V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special spec.98
collection.en:
The V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special immediately boosted
Suzuki’s profile around the world.

It was built specifically to compete in the classic Pikes
Peak Hill Climb in the U.S. state of Colorado.

The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race in which cars ascend a
mountain road to an elevation of over 1400m.

With a history of over 100 years, it is among world's oldest
motor sport events.

The Escudo which challenged this hill climb packs a 1000ps
2.5L V6 engine in a body that only weighs 800kg.

It has been specially tuned so minimise loss of
performance at altitudes exceeding 4000m.
collection.zh:
凭借V6 ESCUDO Pikes Peak Special在
“云端比赛”中的出色表现，

这是一台专为参加科罗拉多州经典比赛派克峰
国际爬坡赛而制造的车。

参赛车辆要沿着海拔高度差为1400m的
山路上不断向上。

拥有100多年的历史，是世界上最古老的
赛车运动。

挑战这次赛事的V6 ESCUDO在仅重800kg的
车身中装入了一台1000ps的2.5升V6引擎，

并且经过特别调校，使其在海拔超过4000m的情况下，
性能损失降至最小。

vehicleCollection.sourceName: V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special spec.98
vehicleCollection.en:
A monster made for the Pikes Peak Hillclimb.[

The world's largest hill climb race, the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb, is held every summer on Pikes Peak Highway near Colorado Springs in the United States.

The 20km course covers an elevation difference of 1440m, from 2862m to 4302m above sea level. It consists of 156 corners ranging from tight <60km/h> hairpins to <200km/h> sweeping high speed curves. Also, the temperature difference between the starting point and the finish line can be as much as 20 degrees. All these make for extremely harsh conditions for any race car.

The Suzuki V6 Escudo Pikes Peak Special was a machine developed specifically to compete in this environment. It was built around a newly designed aluminum space frame, with the engine relocated aft of the front axle line to improve the car's front/rear weight distribution. The engine itself was tuned dramatically; the 2.5-liter V-6 came fitted with twin turbochargers, enabling it to pump out 995ps and 95kgm of torque.

Plenty of mass was taken out of the car. It tipped the scales at a lean 800kg. Helping to keep this lightweight vehicle planted to the road surface was a massive front spoiler and rear wing, both developed through extensive wind-tunnel testing. These modifications changed the production Escudo into a fearsome beast.

The car was driven by Nobuhiro "Monster" Tajima, who boasted seven consecutive wins in the All-Japan Dirt Trial Championships. He began competing at Pikes Peak in 1988, and in 1995, he became the first Japanese driver to take the overall title at Pikes Peak. His race car then was the Suzuki Twin-Engine Escudo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
为传奇爬坡赛而生的怪兽车。

全球最大的爬坡赛，派克峰国际爬坡赛每年夏天在美国科罗拉多泉附近的派克峰高速公路举行。

这条20km长的赛道海拔从2862m直冲4302m，高差变化达1440m。它拥有156个弯道，从<60km/h>的急发夹弯到时速<200km/h>的高速大弯道，不一而足。此外，起点和终点线的温差可达20度。在这样的条件下，每一台参赛车辆都要面临极端严峻的考验。

这辆铃木V6 Escudo派克峰特别版就是为了在这些条件下比赛而开发的怪兽——车架采用全新设计的铝合金空间车架。为了达到最大性能，动力系统接受了大幅改装，引擎布局从基础车型的前置改为中置。经过全面调校的2.5升V6引擎加装了两个涡轮增压器，使其能够产生高达995ps的最大动力和95kgm的扭矩。

车身仅重800千克，相对较轻。为了在湿滑路面上牢牢抓住地面，车身上安装了大型前扰流板和尾翼，且经过专门的风洞测试。这些改装将一台量产的Escudo变为了一辆动力凶兽。

这辆野兽由同样有“怪兽”之称的田岛伸博驾驶。他曾经在全日本越野锦标赛中获得7连胜，主宰了泥地比赛。他于1988年开始参加派克峰比赛。1995年，他驾驶一辆铃木双擎Escudo在派克峰获得了日本车手有史以来的首次全面胜利。

这辆铃木V6 Escudo派克峰特别版就是为了在这些条件下比赛而开发的怪兽——车架采用全新设计的铝合金空间车架。为了达到最大性能，动力系统接受了大幅改装，引擎布局从基础车型的前置改为中置。经过全面调校的2.5升V6引擎加装了两个涡轮增压器，使其能够产生高达995ps的最大动力和95kgm的扭矩。

车身仅重800千克，相对较轻。为了在湿滑路面上牢牢抓住地面，车身上安装了大型前扰流板和尾翼，且经过专门的风洞测试。这些改装将一台量产的Escudo变为了一辆动力凶兽。

这辆野兽由同样有“怪兽”之称的田岛伸博驾驶。他曾经在全日本越野锦标赛中获得7连胜，主宰了泥地比赛。他于1988年开始参加派克峰比赛。1995年，他驾驶一辆铃木双擎Escudo在派克峰获得了日本车手有史以来的首次全面胜利。

brandCentral.en:
Suzuki is one of the few manufacturers
that builds both 2- and 4-wheel vehicles.

This machine you see here broke new ground for the company.
It's called the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo.

It's a compact 2-seater convertible evoking
memories of the Swift Sport and Cappuccino.

Under the hood, located just aft of the front axle line is...

...the 1340cc engine from the Suzuki Hayabusa,
one of the most popular motorbikes in the world.

In addition to sporting two motors up front,
the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo also has one at the rear.

This gives the hybrid-powered vehicle all-wheel-drive
and plenty of power on demand.
brandCentral.zh:
铃木是为数不多同时制造两轮摩托车和四轮汽车
的制造商之一。

我们这里的这辆尤物是他们的一个“突破”——
Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo。

从车身来看，这是一辆紧凑型的双座敞篷车，
令人想起Swift Sport和Cappuccino。

但是最值得注意的是它的前中置引擎！

别惊讶，这可是一台1340cc的Suzuki Hayabusa引擎——
世界上最顶级的摩托车引擎。

除了前面的两个电机，后面也安装了一个……

它是四轮驱动车型中最令人印象深刻的混合动力车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
A super sports car combining the heart of the Hayabusa with electric motors.

Suzuki is one of a small number of manufacturers to produce both cars and motorbikes. First introduced 20 years ago, the GSX-R/4 sports concept was developed as the amalgamation of its 2- and 4-wheeled sports vehicles. It featured the high-performance engine from the company's "Hayabusa" flagship sports bike mounted amidships on a lightweight aluminum-framed car body. The GSX-R/4 has also appeared in previous Gran Turismo titles.

And now, the latest rendition of the Hayabusa engine returns with Suzuki's latest developments in electrification and lightweight construction methods in the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo.

The car sports a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout with the new Hayabusa 1340cc engine mounted just aft of the front axle. The gasoline engine is combined with two electric motors that drive the front wheels and one that powers the rear. Total output is rated at 318kW (432ps) and 610 Nm (62kgm) of torque peaking at 3000 rpm. And thanks to Suzuki's lightweight construction methods, the 2-seat convertible tips the scales at a lean 970kg.

The exterior design combines the DNA of Suzuki's sporting heritage seen on the Swift Sport. The GSX-R/4's long nose is reminiscent of the company's Cappuccino "kei car." The interior design possesses the aesthetics of a motorcycle and expresses the joy of driving in a modern pure sports fashion.
vehicleCollection.zh:
用一颗隼的心脏加上多台电机综合打造的超级跑车。

铃木是少数几家同时生产汽车和摩托车的制造商之一。在20年前首次推出时，GSX-R/4的开发理念是针对2轮与4轮运动车型混合开发。它将一颗来自铃木旗舰摩托车“隼”的高性能引擎安装在轻量化铝制框架车身的中部。这款GSX-R/4在之前的跑车浪漫旅作品中就亮过相了。

如今，隼引擎的进化版随着铃木在电动化和轻量化工程方案方面的最新进展一同回归，铃木Vision Gran Turismo应运而生。

这款车采用了前置引擎、后轮驱动布局，一台新款隼 1340cm³（即1340cc）引擎依然置于车身中部，附带前2后1的电机配置，形成全轮驱动系统。引擎和电机的混合动力输出让总功率达到了318kw（432ps）和3000转下610牛·米（62kgm）的最大扭矩。再配合铃木通过轻量化工程方案实现的970kg双座无顶紧凑车身，打造出一款超级跑车。

此车的外观设计继承了以速翼特运动版为代表的铃木运动基因，修长的前车头轮廓让人想起了经典的Cappuccino。内饰部分与GSX-R/4相近，拥有摩托车框架的美学表达，以现代、纯粹的运动风格展现驾驶的乐趣。

brandCentral.en:
This Gran Turismo original Gr.3 racecar was based on
the Suzuki VGT.

To comply with Gr.3 specifications, it adopted
a simple FR layout.

Powering the vehicle was a twin-turbocharged V-8.

This powerplant was actually two Hayabusa engines from
the company’s flagship sports bike stuck together.

It redlined at a very high 10000rpm
and churned out 586ps of power.

Thanks to enlarged front and rear spoilers and added air ducts,
the body generated gobs of downforce.

Also, the use of carbon-fiber throughout the body
kept the entire vehicle extremely lightweight.

Sporting the colors of Suzuki’s motorcycle race team,
this particular Suzuki car is sure to turn heads on the track.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆原版Gr.3级别赛车
是基于Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo改装而来。

根据Gr.3的规格要求，它采用了普通的
前置后驱传动系统，

搭载一台狂野的双涡轮增压V8引擎。

事实上，这款引擎是由两台Suzuki旗舰级运动摩托车
Hayabusa的引擎组合而成。

它能达到10000rpm的转速，输出586ps马力。

除了全面提升的下压力、加大尺寸的前后扰流板
和新增的导气口……

这台猛兽还在全车身应用了轻量化碳纤维材料，
大幅减轻了自重。

此外，它还装备了Suzuki摩托车车队的官方配色，
在赛道上一定能夺人目光。

vehicleCollection.en:
This Gr.3 Vision Gran Turismo possesses Suzuki's racing spirit.

This car is the Gr.3 version of the Suzuki Vision Gran Turismo, a lightweight sports car combining the sporting philosophies of Suzuki's 2- and 4-wheel machines. This model highlights the company's racing prowess and has been extensively tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations.

The base Suzuki VGT features a hybrid powerplant, combining the 1340cc Hayabusa engine with three high-powered electric motors. While the base car was all-wheel drive, the Gr.3 machine takes the form of a front-engine/rear-wheel driver with two 4-cyclinder Hayabusa engines bolted together, making it a 2680cc V-8. With twin turbochargers providing extra muscle, this amazing engine produces 586ps at an astoundingly high 10000rpm.

Compared to the base model, the design aesthetics have been altered to provide increased downforce that comes via an enlarged front spoiler, rear wing, air ducting on the hood, and front and rear diffusers. Also, plenty of carbon fiber has been used to keep the car's weight minimal.

The livery represents a vivid representation of Suzuki's passion for motorsports, featuring graphics using Metallic Triton Blue and Metallic Mystic Silver, Suzuki's motorcycle race team colors.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆组别3 Vision Gran Turismo充满了铃木的不屈斗争精神。

这辆车是铃木Vision Gran Turismo的组别3版本，这款轻量级跑车结合了铃木在二轮和四轮车型上的运动理念，体现出了铃木在赛车运动上强大的实力，并经过大幅改装，以满足组别3规则的要求。

作为基础车型的铃木Vision Gran Turismo采用了1340 cm³（1340cc）的隼引擎，并在全轮驱动系统中与3台高功率电机相连。然而，这个组别3版本却采用了简化的前置引擎、后轮驱动布局，由两个隼引擎模块组成V8双涡轮增压动力组，总排量达2680 cm³（2680cc）。在此形态下，这台怪兽般的引擎能够在令人惊叹的10000rpm下产生最大586ps的强劲动力。

与基础车型相比，外观设计被稍作调整以增大下压力，加大了前扰流板，并增加了前后扩散器，GT尾翼和引擎盖上的风道。此外，车身通过换装多处碳纤维部件，极大地减轻了车重。

此车的涂装采用了铃木摩托车车队的官方配色：海神金属蓝和神秘金属银，旗帜鲜明地展现了铃木对赛车运动的激情。

brandCentral.en:
Tesla's compact EV sedan, the Model 3, is the company's
entry-level model.

Much like the Model S, it has a sporty design
that's almost coupe-like in appearance.

Powered by two motors at the front and rear,
this car can satisfy the most ardent performance enthusiast.

This AWD sedan can accelerate like a super sports car,
running from zero to <100km/h> in just 3.3 seconds!

Like the exterior, the interior of the Model 3
is also uniquely Tesla.

Nearly every control inside has been laid out on a 15-inch
touchscreen.
brandCentral.zh:
Model 3是Tesla的入门车款，也是一辆紧凑型电动轿车。

和Model S类似，它采用了运动型外观设计，形似双门轿车。

Model 3的前后轮各由一部电机驱动，
在性能方面丝毫没有妥协。

这款四驱版本的加速性能可以媲美超级跑车，
能够在3.3秒内完成0-100 km/h的加速！

这款车将大量的控制模块集中布置在一块15英寸触摸屏上……

而内饰方面也和外观一样，拥有鲜明的特斯拉风格。>

vehicleCollection.en:
A best-seller from the company that changed the EV market forever.

The Tesla Model 3, an EV sedan introduced in 2016, was one of Tesla's smaller models, measuring 4695mm long, 1850mm wide and 1445mm tall. Rumor has it that it was designed with considerations for Japanese mechanical parking garages.

Inside the sporty 5-door hatchback style body was a surprisingly simple cabin. You couldn't find any switches on the dashboard or on the center console because nearly every car function, from the climate control to the "autopilot" system, was operated through a 15-inch touch screen. What's more, many of these functions could also be managed on your smartphone.

The most powerful model in the lineup was the Performance Dual Motor AWD grade, which was available until 2023. This all-wheel-drive system placed an electric motor on each of the front and rear axles and, while the total system output was never officially published, the car was able to run to <100km/h> in 3.3 seconds and reach a top speed of <261km/h>. Based on these figures and its retail price tag, the Model 3 had very few rivals in cost-to-performance ratio.

The claimed battery range was 547km as calculated by the WLPT cycle, an international test standard for energy consumption.

In September 2023, the Model 3 received its first major change since its debut. The car grew slightly, to 4720mm in overall length, and wore a sharper looking front fascia. Inside, the dashboard and controls looked more similar to other Tesla models.
vehicleCollection.zh:
彻底改变了电动汽车行业的企业所推出的销冠产品。

特斯拉Model 3是一款于2016年首次发布的电动轿车。它的车身长4695mm、宽1850mm、高1445mm，是特斯拉尺寸最紧凑的车型，明显考虑到了日本的机械式立体车库的需求。它的5门掀背车身充满运动感，但车辆内部却出奇地朴实无华。仪表板和中控台上几乎没有任何开关，从空调到“自动驾驶”系统，几乎所有功能都通过一块15英寸触摸屏进行控制。许多功能也可以通过智能手机上的特斯拉应用程序进行控制。产品线中性能最强的型号是从首发起至今一直在售的Performance Dual Motor AWD版本。这套全轮驱动系统在前后轴各安装了一部电机，尽管官方并未公布总输出，不过这辆车可以在3.3秒内完成0-<100km/h>加速，极速可达<261km/h>。以这样的性能数据和市场售价，Model 3可以说在性价比方面全无敌手。根据全球统一轻型汽车测试规程的续航标准计算，其电池续航能力据称可达547km。在2023年9月，Model 3迎来了自首发后的第一次重大更新。新款车型的长度略有增加，达到了4720mm，并换上了更犀利的前脸设计，以及与其他特斯拉车型更为类似的仪表板和控制台。

dialogues.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
dialogues.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
dialogues.en:
Tesla Model S Signature Performance has
 an absolutely wonderful stance.

 The wheels are placed well outside of the basic body shape,
with generous flairs reaching out to those tires.

The body shape is sleek, slippery, and very cool.

 It doesn’t need any tacked-on chrome or aero devices.

 I really like the front-end graphics of the Signature Performance
model much better than the base Model S.
dialogues.zh:
Tesla Model S Signature Performance的外形绝对令人惊艳。

车轮恰到好处地超出车身外廓，
宽大的轮眉向外延展，盖住车轮。

车身线条顺滑流畅，
无需任何附加的铬合金或空气动力学部件，

就已经显得未来感十足，帅气非凡。

我很喜欢Signature Performance的前脸造型，
比基础款Model S的平面耐看多了。

conversation.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
conversation.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁
conversation.en:
Hi there, I think it’s my first time seeing you here.
