dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
The GR Yaris was developed by Toyota as a rare
example of a fully in-house sports car.

It featured a carbon-fiber roof and a highly rigid body
structure designed specifically for this model.

Its engine and all-wheel-drive system were also purpose-built.

The car was engineered from the ground up to compete in
the World Rally Championship (WRC).

It delivered an exceptionally engaging driving experience, with
performance that rivaled far more expensive cars.

It stands as a model likely to leave a lasting mark
in automotive history.
dialogues.zh:
经过了很长一段时间的沉寂后，GR Yaris是Toyota 100%
自主研发的第一辆新跑车。

碳纤维车顶和坚固的车身都是专门为这款车设计的，

引擎和四驱系统也是如此。

这辆从头打造的赛车就是冲着世界拉力锦标赛去的。

驾驶它的感觉非常美妙，不是吗？我认为在比它贵上一
倍的车也不一定具备如此高的性能水准。

我相信这是一款会在车史上留下印记的车型。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
The Yaris WRC is a car that totally dominated
the World Rally Championships.

It claimed the Manufacturers' title in 2018...

and in 2019 it took the Drivers' title as well,
with a record six wins.

Sure enough, the GR Yaris was developed specifically
with the goal of total domination of the WRC in mind.

Initially, a competition car was developed for the WRC,
with a commercial car planned for homologation.

In any case, for a real motorsports fan, there aren't
many cars on the road that are quite this exciting!
dialogues.zh:
Yaris WRC是一款彻底统治了世界拉力锦标赛的赛车。

它在2018年获得了制造商冠军，

在2019年则取得创纪录的6场胜利，摘下车手冠军的桂冠。

我们可以确定的是，这辆GR Yaris是专为统治世界拉力
锦标赛而研发的！

他们先是制造了一台能在锦标赛上夺冠的比赛机器，
然后再规划量产车型，接受赛事认证。

不管怎么说，对于一个真正的赛车迷来说，这是少数几
辆能令人兴奋到不能自己的公路车！

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
It's not big, but you just can ignore it.

Ah, I see. This GR Yaris was made for motorsports.

I guess it does look like a sports car,
and it's no slouch out on the track.

It's nice that it's also good for everyday use—I mean,
you can even sit in the back!
dialogues.zh:
这辆车虽然小巧玲珑，但实力却不可小觑。

噢，原来是这样。这辆GR Yaris是专为赛车运动而生的。

它看上去确实就是一辆跑车，在赛道上表现得也不弱。

而且日常使用也非常好开，我说真的，后排也能坐人！

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
Notice how the tires are positioned far out at the corners,
while the cabin tapers gracefully toward the rear.

It’s a winning combination, wouldn’t you agree?

The design conveys a remarkable sense of genuine agility,
no matter the vehicle’s height.

It's a type of beauty that is common with cars like
the Honda CR-Z.

Front-end designs of recent Toyotas are fairly aggressive
looking even unmodified.

In this case, they've taken that and run with it, for the
kind of car a real gearhead would appreciate.

The expression of the fascia isn't bad, but it's disappointing
that it reminds you of an older Peugeot from afar.

The car is packed with good things so it would be nice if the
model sticks and is loved on the streets for a long time.

It makes you want to see a different model like the Renault R5
Turbo where an adult could dress up and drive it in style.<next id=2000406 type=9ԙ
dialogues.zh:
你看，轮胎被远远地放在四角，座舱自然向后收窄，

这就叫强强联合，你说对不对？

即便车身高度很高，依然给人以灵活的感觉。

这种美感在诸如本田CR-Z等车型中相当常见。

最近几年的丰田在车身前部设计方面相当具有侵略性。

在这一台上也是如此，而且绝对能让真正的爱车人
满心欢喜。

前饰板的设计不算太坏，但还是有点令人失望。
从远处看，它会让你想起标致的老爷车。

丰田在这款车里塞进了很多不错的特性，
希望普罗大众会喜欢它吧，让它证明自己……

我很高兴能看到一台跟雷诺R5涡轮增压版同类型的其他车型
出现在市场上，成为成熟车手的心头好。

brandCentral.en:
This is a true 4WD sports car, developed by Toyota with the
goal of competing in the World Rally Championship.

Its power ranks among the top of the turbo 1.6-liter class at
272ps, and its 4WD system was tuned for sports driving.

The body is surprisingly sturdy, resulting in excellent
handling on all types of terrain.

The specially designed 3-door body gives the car
a distinctly competition-focused feel.
brandCentral.zh:
这是一辆Toyota专为参加世界拉力锦标赛而设计的四轮驱动
跑车。

它的1.6L涡轮增压引擎拥有同级别中的最强动力，马力高
达272ps，而且四轮驱动系统也针对跑车驾驶进行了特别调校。

它的车身出奇的坚固，而且拥有让人赞不绝口的出色操
控性和稳定性，

特殊设计的三门车身也说明了这台车独特的竞赛属性。

vehicleCollection.en:
This new WRC race car was created to carry the torch for Toyota's strong rallying tradition.

Toyota has long been a dominant presence in the World Rally Championships, consistently fighting for the series championship year after year. After building a number of classic rally race cars, the company will be introducing its newest off-road competition machine in 2021: the GR Yaris.

At first, it may not look that different from the production hatchback, aside from the super wide rear fenders, but under the skin beats the heart of a serious racer. Built on a combination of the TNGA GA-B and GA-C platforms, the extremely lightweight body possesses increased rigidity. Its flowing profile, characterized by the low carbon-fiber roof, optimizes airflow.

Under the hood of the RZ model is the G16E-GTS, a turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-3. Boasting the smallest size and lightest weight in its class, this unit produces 200 kW (272ps)/370 Nm (37.7kgm) and comes mated to a 6-speed manual transmission that sends power to all four wheels via a newly developed electronically controlled coupling type center differential. The RZ High Performance model is equipped with Torsen LSDs for both the front and rear differentials, for maximum traction.

This "First Edition" model, introduced alongside the GR Yaris in January 2020, was offered to those who pre-ordered the car. Among other things, it featured special forged aluminum wheels and was autographed by Toyota "master driver" Morizo, who is in fact Toyota CEO Akio Toyoda.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款全新的世界拉力锦标赛赛车将延续丰田一贯强大的拉力赛夺冠传统。

多年来，丰田为了继续完善赛车，持续征战世界拉力锦标赛。他们为2021年推出的新款拉力赛车而开发的原型车就是这款GR雅力士。

它给人的第一印象可能是一款可爱的紧凑车，但事实上这是一款为了在世界拉力锦标赛中夺冠而专门打造的战斗机器。三门车身里包含了两个丰田新全球架构 GA-B和GA-C模块，用于加固车身所需的刚性，同时也能减轻车重，降低重心。加宽的后挡泥板彰显着这台车的潜力，而以顺滑线条延伸至车后部的碳纤维顶棚及后扰流翼则是优化气流设计的成果。

为这款四轮驱动RZ车型提供动力的是一台G16E-GTS 1.6升涡轮增压3缸引擎。这是丰田最新开发的动力单元，在同级别中具有最小的尺寸和最轻的重量，可以输出200kW功率（272ps）马力和370牛·米（37.7kgm）扭矩。与这套动力系统搭配的是一台6速手动变速箱。其传动系统也非常有创意，采用了一款全新开发的电控联轴中央差速器，用以调整前后轮的扭矩配比。此外，其“RZ高性能”版本还为前后差速器增加了托森限滑差速器，确保为车辆提供稳定的牵引力。

在2020年1月随GR雅力士一同发布的还有一款特殊“首发版本”。这款限量版本需要预订，车身上带有传奇赛车手“Morizo”的签名，并配备了一些限量版的配件，如铸造铝轮毂。

brandCentral.en:
This GR010 HYBRID was Toyota’s all-new entry for
the 2021 World Endurance Championship (WEC).

The 2021 season saw the introduction of
a ‘Hypercar’ category.

This top-tier class is the successor to the LMP1.

In any event, the GR010 HYBRID was built
specifically for the Hypercar Class.

This Car No. 7 claimed a victory in the fourth round
of the 2021 WEC event at Le Mans.

It was driven by Mike Conway, Kamui Kobayashi
and José María López.

To top things off, Car No. 8 followed right
on its heels, placing in second.

Therefore, in its first Le Mans attempt, the GR010 HYBRID
claimed an impressive one-two finish.

With this, Toyota was able to extend its winning streak to
four straight Le Mans victories since 201
brandCentral.zh:
这辆GR010 HYBRID是Toyota为
2021年世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）准备的全新参赛车辆。

2021赛季，锦标赛引进了“超级跑车”组别。

这个顶级类别可以视作是LMP1的继承者。

总而言之，GR010 HYBRID是特别为“超级跑车”
级别而设计的。

这辆幸运的7号赛车由迈克·康威、小林可梦伟
和何塞·马里亚·洛佩斯驾驶。

在勒芒的2021 WEC第四轮比赛中取得了冠军。

锦上添花的是，8号赛车也紧随其后冲线，名列第二亚军。

也就是说，GR010 HYBRID在勒芒的第一次亮相，
就令人惊叹地包揽了冠亚军。

算下来，Toyota自2018年以来已经在勒芒取得四连冠了。

vehicleCollection.en:
Four consecutive wins at Le Mans for Toyota with this prototype race carQ

With the LMP1-class TS050 Hybrid, TOYOTA GAZOO Racing captured two consecutive titles in the 2018–2019 and 2019–2020 World Endurance Championship seasons, along with three straight victories at Le Mans. But from 2021 onward, new regulations shifted the top level of competition to the LMH class. To meet these new conditions, Toyota developed the GR010 HYBRID.

As a completely new design, the GR010 differed from the TS050 in many ways, most notably in its powertrain. The engine went from a 500ps twin-turbocharged 2.4-liter V-6 to a 680ps twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V-6. Meanwhile, the 500ps electric motors powering both front and rear wheels were replaced by a 272ps system driving only the front wheels. The result was a 4-wheel-drive configuration that relied on electric power at the front and engine power at the rear.

For the 2021 season, Car No. 7 was driven by Mike Conway, Kamui Kobayashi, and José María López, while Car No. 8 was piloted by Sébastien Buemi, Kazuki Nakajima, and Brendon Hartley. That year, Toyota secured its fourth consecutive Le Mans victory—and sixth overall—marking a triumphant start to the new Hypercar era.
vehicleCollection.zh:
丰田的这款原型赛车在勒芒比赛中获得4连胜，从而在超跑时代伊始登上了舞台的正中央。

凭借勒芒原型车1组别的TS050 Hybrid赛车，丰田图像赛车在2018-2019及2019-2020赛季的世界耐力锦标赛连续拿下2个冠军，更在勒芒24小时耐力赛蝉联3届冠军。然而随着2021年新规定的颁布，最高级别赛事组别已调整为LMH级别。GR010 HYBRID的研发旨在应对这些新规下的竞赛环境。

这款赛车采用全新设计，在多方面都与TS050存在不同，其中最核心的差异体现在动力总成上。引擎由原来的500ps2.4升V6双涡轮增压升级为680ps3.5升V6双涡轮增压。与此同时，共计可产生500ps的前后轮双电机配置已调整为仅前轮提供272ps的系统。由此形成了一套前轮纯电机驱动、后轮引擎驱动的四轮驱动系统。

2021赛季，7号赛车由迈克·康威、小林可梦伟与何塞·马里亚·洛佩斯组成的车组执驾，而8号赛车则由塞巴斯蒂安·布埃米、中岛一贵及布兰登·哈特利执驾。本赛季，丰田在勒芒24小时耐力赛中连续第四年折桂，这也是其在该赛事中的第六个总冠军，让丰田图像赛车在混合动力终极赛车时代伊始便占据主导地位。

brandCentral.en:
This GR 86 represents an evolved version of the Toyota 86
rear-wheel-drive sports car.

Continuing the tradition established by the original AE86, this
latest “hachi-roku” is compact and has an FR layout.

What’s new is the 2.4-liter flat-four engine.

With an extra 400cc of displacement, it delivers more
power and torque than ever before.

And, let me remind you that the new 86’s body structure
has been significantly stiffened...

...so when you’re tackling a winding road, you’ll really feel
as if you’re one with the car!
brandCentral.zh:
这辆GR 86是经典的后轮驱动跑车Toyota 86的进化版。

它继承由AE86开创的传统：适中的车身尺寸，以及必不可
少的后轮驱动。

它的2.4升水平对置四缸引擎是一款全新开发的引擎，

比前代多了400cc的排量，以输出更加充沛的动力和扭矩。

另外值得一提的是，它的车身刚性也得到了大幅的强化。

当您握住这辆车的方向盘，您会感觉自己仿佛能够掌控
一切！

vehicleCollection.en:
This version of Japan's signature lightweight sports car boasts a bigger engine, but it remains true to its heritage.

Since its introduction in 2012, more than 200,000 units of the Toyota 86 were sold around the world, solidifying its place in the history books as one of the most popular front-engine/rear-wheel-drive compact sports cars of all time.

Nine years after the 86's debut, Toyota introduced the GR86, a high-performance version of the car that wore the Gazoo Racing badge (GR). While maintaining the virtues of the original car, namely a lightweight body and superb handling, Toyota engineers equipped the GR86 with a larger engine. Under the bonnet was a 2.4-litre flat-4 that replaced the 2.0-litre variant. Power came in at an impressive 235ps/7000rpm with maximum torque peaking at 25.5kgm/3700rpm. This translated to a 0-<100km/h> acceleration time of 6.3 seconds, which was a stark improvement over the 7.4 seconds of the first-generation model.

To enhance the 86's handling, the company's chassis engineers stiffened the body and adopted aluminium in the roof panel to lower the center of gravity, as well as reduce overall weight. With the GR86, Toyota offered sports-car enthusiasts exactly what they were hoping for with the 86: a meaner, faster version of the car that was designed for the race track.
vehicleCollection.zh:
排量与动力更大的引擎，不变的理念。日本最具代表性的轻量级前置后驱跑车。

自从2012年推出以来，丰田86在全世界已经售出了超过20万台，巩固了它作为史上最受欢迎的前置后驱紧凑型跑车的地位。

在86亮相的九年后，丰田又推出了GR86，这是一款顶着Gazoo Racing头衔的高性能版本。丰田的工程师们保留了原始款的优点，也就是轻量化车身和出众的操控性，还为GR86配置了更强大的引擎。这辆车的引擎盖下藏着一部2.4升水平对置4缸引擎，替代了原本的2.0升版本。其功率输出高达235ps/7000rpm，最大扭矩峰值可达25.5kgm/3700rpm。这样的性能可以在6.3秒内实现0-<100km/h>的加速，相比于第一代7.4秒的成绩可谓是长足的进步。

为了增强86的操控性，底盘工程师们加固了车身，并采用了铝制车顶，进而降低了车辆的重心，并且整体降低了整车重量。GR86是丰田为所有的跑车迷们提供的梦寐以求的86升级款，它专门为赛道打造，速度更快，更具侵略性。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Do you remember when the Toyota GT-One competed
at Le Mans in 1998 and 1999?

Well, I remember those spectacular races like it was yesterday!

And while Toyota may not have taken the overall victory
it was hoping for...

...it was doubtless the team that everybody expected to see
on the podium in 1999.

That year, Toyota entered three GT-Ones at Le Mans,
and they thoroughly impressed during qualifying!

Two of its cars took the 1st and 2nd positions, while the 3rd
started in P8.

The performance of the cars were simply awesome.

However, at the start of the race, the top two GT-Ones had
to retire—a reminder that anything can happen on the track.

This left Toyota with only the No. 3 car...

...driven by Toshio Suzuki, Ukyo Katayama,
and Keiichi Tsuchiya.

Having lost its top two cars, Toyota bet the farm
on this last hope of winning.

Initially racing on the defensive, Car No. 3
quickly changed its tactics, going on the offensive.

Picking up its pace, it miraculously set a course record
in the final part of the race.

Before long, it climbed to 2nd place, with the race-leader, BMW,
in its crosshairs.

But then—it burst a rear tire while traveling
at more than 300 km/h!

An attempt was made to continue, but an emergency pitstop
dashed Toyota’s dream of an overall victory.

After tire change, Car No. 3 raced to a 2nd-place
finish that had all the world holding its breath.

This is why the GT-One has a special place in my heart,
even if Toyota has now become a Le Mans champion.
dialogues.zh:
你还记得丰田GT-1在1998年和1999年
参加勒芒24小时耐力赛时的飒爽身姿吗？

嗯，那几场精彩的比赛让我记忆犹新！

尽管丰田没能获得期待中的总冠军……

但毫无疑问，每个人都相信这支车队
是99年的夺冠热门。

在那一年，丰田将三辆GT-1赛车带到了勒芒，
并以风驰电掣的速度一路碾压排位赛阶段！

三辆车中的两辆分别夺得了第一和第二名，
而第三辆车排在第8名。

每辆车跑出的时间都不容轻视。

然而决赛甫一开始，两辆领先的GT-1赛车就被迫退赛，
也证明了赛道上一切意外皆可能发生。

于是丰田车队只剩下了一辆赛车……

由片山右京、铃木利男和土屋圭市驾驶的3号GT-1。

在损失了两辆前排赛车之后，丰田将赌注全部下
在了这台唯的希望上。

3号赛车最初采取了守势，但很快便转守为攻……

并且不断加速，在比赛最后阶段奇迹般地
创下了赛道纪录。

很快它就攀升到了第二名，并将目标锁定在了
领先的宝马赛车上……

但接下来发生的事情让所有人惊掉了下巴
——在超过<300 km/h>的时速下，它的一个后轮发生了爆胎！

他们选择顽强坚持，但被迫紧急进站也剥夺了
他赢得总冠军的梦想！

在更换轮胎后，3号赛车奋力追赶，让全世界
都屏住了呼吸，最终仍旧以第二名完赛。

这就是为什么即便现在丰田已经成为了勒芒冠军，
GT-1依然在我心中占据了非常特殊的地位。

collection.en:
Overall victory in the 24 Hours of Le Mans
is one of the greatest achievements for a manufacturer.

This Toyota GT-One is one of many cars
that sought to secure its place in the history books.

It competed in Le Mans in the late 1990s under GT1 regulations,
the highest category for production-based race cars.

Having developed this Le Mans spec car specifically to
compete in GT1, Toyota named it simply the "GT-One."

Development of the GT-One, and the race team,
was led by genius race car designer André de Cortanze.

Already an accomplished engineer, Cortanze had
developed cars for F1, WRC and Le Mans.

What he created for Toyota was
a beautifully advanced racing machine.

His GT-One combined formula car technology
with the styling of a GT car.

The Toyota GT-One competed in Le Mans twice,
in 1998 and 1999.

In its first outing in 1998, it finished 9th overall.

Toyota returned in 1999 with the team of Ukyo Katayama,
Toshio Suzuki and Keiichi Tsuchiya taking 2nd in car No.3.

Although the team wasn't quite able to reach its goal,
fans will never forget the feats of the GT-One.
collection.zh:
能够在勒芒24小时耐力赛上赢得总冠军对于
每一家汽车制造商来说都是莫大的成就。

这辆丰田GT-1就是为了勇攀这项赛事的
巅峰所打造的车型之一。

它在上世纪90年代参加了勒芒的GT1组别比赛，即为基于
量产车型打造的赛车所设置的最高组别。

丰田专门为参加GT1的竞速而开发了这款勒芒规格的赛车，
甚至将其直截了当地命名为“GT-1”。

GT-1的开发以及车队管理均由天才赛车设计师
安德烈·德·科尔但泽所领衔。

作为一名功成名就的工程师，科尔但泽曾经为F1、
世界拉力锦标赛和勒芒都开发过赛车。

而他为丰田贡献的作品则是一款外形美观、
性能优异的比赛机器。

他的GT-1结合了方程式赛车的科技和
GT车型风格的车身设计。

这款丰田GT-1在1998年和1999年两度征战勒芒。

在首次亮相的1998年，它以第9名的总成绩完赛。

在1999，丰田又派出由片山右京、铃木利男
和土屋圭市组成的车手阵容

重回勒芒，并依靠他们的3号赛车拿到了第二名的好成绩。

尽管车队并未实现他们的终极目标，但车迷们
将会永远铭记GT-1的伟大功勋。_

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's endurance race machine that achieved a class win at Le Mans in 1999.!

In the early 1990s, Toyota set out to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans with its Group C TS010 race car. A number of unsuccessful years followed, but the company would return for the 1998 season with the Toyota GT-One (TS020). During its Group C racing days, Toyota developed its race cars almost exclusively within Japan. However, it revamped its plans and entrusted this project to the group in charge of their World Rally Championship activities, German-based TTE (Toyota Team Europe), in an attempt to once again claim overall victory in the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The new Le Mans car, the GT-One, was designed by André De Cortanze, a race-car design genius with a brilliant track record in top motorsports genres, including Formula 1, Le Mans and the WRC. De Cortanze designed the Peugeot 905B, the first Group C Peugeot car to claim victory at Le Mans in 1992 and 1993.

For the GT-One, Cortanze incorporated the latest in F1 technology into its design. Its carbon-composite monocoque body was developed for aerodynamic performance. Providing the power was the same twin-turbocharged 3.6-liter V-8 developed during the Toyota's Group C days. The suspension had very long arms in both the front and rear, allowing for ideal suspension geometry.

In its first time out at Le Mans in 1998, Toyota entered three GT-Ones in the LM GT1 class in a serious attempt for overall victory. While one of its cars led the race, a combination of mechanical trouble and bad luck kept it from taking the checkered flag.

The following year, a change in the race's technical regulations saw the GT-One entered in the LM GTP prototype class. Three GT-Ones were entered in the race, but two of them, including the favorite and its supporting car, were forced to withdraw due to a host of problems.

However, the third car, driven by Ukyo Katayama Toshio Suzuki and Keiichi Tsuchiya managed to stay in the race and claim2nd place overall. This was the highest ever finish for a Japanese car riven b an all-Japanese team.
vehicleCollection.zh:
丰田耐力赛赛车于1999年在勒芒赢得组别冠军

在1990年代初期，丰田派出旗下的TS010赛车争夺勒芒24小时耐力赛C组别的冠军。虽然接连数年受挫，但丰田并未气馁。在1998赛季，公司决定再度参赛，这次他们派出的是丰田GT-1（TS020）。在C组别时代，丰田的赛车几乎全部由日本工厂开发。然而，这次他们改变了做法，将这个项目交给了负责其世界拉力锦标赛活动的德国TTE（丰田车队欧洲）团队。他们的目标是再次在勒芒24小时耐力赛中摘下总冠军。

这台新的勒芒战车GT-1由赛车设计天才安德烈·德·科尔但泽设计，他的辉煌战绩遍布F1、勒芒和世界拉力锦标赛等顶级赛事。德·科尔但泽曾帮标致设计出了首辆在1992和1993年的勒芒摘桂的C组别赛车——标致905B。这一次，他将最新的F1技术融入了GT-1的设计中。

其碳纤维复合单体车身旨在提高空气动力学性能，搭载了丰田在C组别时代开发的双涡轮增压3.6升V8引擎。悬挂系统的前后悬臂都拥有较长的臂长，实现了理想的悬挂几何构造。

1998年，丰田首次将三辆GT-1赛车带到LM GT1组别，剑指勒芒赛总冠军。尽管曾一度领先，但由于机械故障加上时运不济，再次无奈折戟。

在此车问世的第二年，1999年，为适应技术规则变化，GT-1被改装成LM GTP原型级别的赛车。在出战的三辆GT-1赛车当中，备受期待的领头羊赛车和其支援车由于一系列问题双双退赛。

然而，由片山右京、铃木利男和土屋圭市驾驶的第三台车成功坚持到了终点，并一举拿下总排名亚军。这成为由全日本团队驾驶的日本赛车在勒芒耐力赛中取得的最高名次。

catch.zh: 丰田耐力赛赛车于1999年在勒芒赢得组别冠军

brandCentral.en:
Storability, operability, durability—commercial vehicles
certainly have a lot of boxes to tick.

And one that’s been ticking them for near 60 years is
Toyota’s forward control Hiace.

This Hiace is a 5th-generation model from 2004.

'DX' refers to the base grade or regular size developed according
to Japan’s five-number vehicle size regulations.

With room for a maximum of nine passengers, its seats can
be folded for additional storage.

Such efficient interior design has naturally made the Hiace
exceedingly popular as a base car for caravans.
brandCentral.zh:
储存能力、操控性、耐久性——商用车确实需要满足
诸多要求。

而近60年来持续满足这些要求的正是这一台Toyota的
前控式车型Hiace。

这款Hiace是2004年推出的第5代车型。

“DX”指的是车辆基础级别，即根据日本五号车辆尺寸
规定开发的标准尺寸车型。

它最多可容纳9名乘客，座椅可折叠以增加储物空间。

如此高效的内部设计使Hiace自然而然地成为了极受
欢迎的房车改装基础车型。

vehicleCollection.en:
The cab-over commercial van was equally capable of moving people and cargo."

Since its introduction in 1967, Toyota's Hiace cab-over commercial van has enjoyed international acclaim for its utility and reliability. The fifth-generation H200 model was introduced in 2004 and, thanks to regular updates, remains in production to this day.

The H200 Hiace lineup featured a number of different configurations and trim levels to meet various uses and specifications, but these can largely be categorized by the body's overall length, width and height. The H200 was equipped with a choice of engines: a 2.0-liter or 2.7-liter gasoline inline-4, or a 2.8-liter diesel inline-4.

This Van DX was the base model that measured 4695mm long, 1695mm wide and 1980mm high. It was powered by the 2.0-liter gasoline engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission that sent power to the two rear wheels. This 4-door configuration did not include a right-hand sliding door, and accommodated nine people. When needing to haul large cargo, the second- and third-row seats folded down to provide 2435mm of storage.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款前置驾驶室的商用厢型车在载人和载货方面同样出色。

自1967年问世以来，丰田的海狮系列前置驾驶室商用厢式车凭借其卓越的实用性和可靠性赢得了全球市场的赞誉。第五代H200车型于2004年推出，得益于持续的技术更新，该车型至今在上线生产。

H200 海狮系列提供多种不同的配置和装饰级别，以满足各种用途和规格，但这些大致可以按车身长度/宽度和车顶高度分类。H200搭载2L或2.7L汽油、或2.8L柴油直列4缸引擎。

这款“Van DX”车型是一款基础配置车型，采用标准4695mm长、1695mm宽车身和标准1980mm车顶高度设计。其动力系统采用2.0L汽油引擎，搭配6速自动变速箱，采用后轮驱动方式。这款四门版本省略了右侧滑动门，可容纳9名乘客。要运载大型货物时，第二排和第三排座椅可以折叠收起，从而形成一个有2435mm空间的载货区。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
The Toyota Land Cruiser is the vehicle that effectively wrote
the first chapter of Japanese off-road history.

Released in 1960, the “40” marked the third-generation model.

In Japan, fans affectionately call it the “Yonmaru,” a nickname
drawn from the Japanese pronunciation of its model number.

A commercial vehicle built to haul goods in agriculture and
farming, it also served first-responders in times of emergency.

Above all else, it was created with one purpose in mind—
to be a true “working vehicle."

From its ladder-frame chassis to its suspension, every component
was engineered with durability in mind.

Well-built and dependable, it embodied all the qualities
that made the Land Cruiser a legend.

With an impressive production run that has lasted 24 years...

...this best-selling SUV has made the Land Cruiser a household name
all over the world.
dialogues.zh:
丰田Land Cruiser是真正开创
日本越野历史的车型。

这款1960年发布的“40系”是第三代车型。

它被日本车迷亲切地称为“四丸”，
这个昵称源自其车型编号的日语发音。

作为旨在运输农业物资和进行紧急救援的商用车辆……

它的首要且最重要的设计目的是成为一款“工具车”。

从梯形车架底盘到悬挂系统，
每个部件都可谓为经久耐用而打造。

制造精良且可靠耐用，它完美体现了
Land Cruiser的所有优秀特质。

凭借长达24年的辉煌生产周期……

这款畅销车型让Land Cruiser之名
享誉全球，家喻户晓。

collection.en:
The Toyota Land Cruiser is one of the longest-running
and most respected vehicles in the world.

Its story began more than 70 years ago, in 1951.

The FJ40 series arrived in 1960, marking
the model’s third generation.

It was offered in a variety of body styles,
each designed for a specific purpose.

The 2-door hardtop, seen here, was built to conquer
the harshest off-road conditions.

Although compact at just 3.9m in length, it was
powered by a stout 3.9-liter gasoline engine.

Its rugged 4WD system with a 2-speed transfer case
made it indispensable on mountain trails.

With its distinctive charm, the FJ40 became an enduring favorite
and stayed in production for 24 years, until 1984.

In 2021, TOYOTA GAZOO Racing began producing
reproduction parts for the model.

Why? Because a legendary off-roader like this
was simply too good to let fade away.
collection.zh:
Toyota Land Cruiser是品牌最常青
且最受景仰的车型之一。

它的故事始于70多年前的1951年。

1960年推出的FJ40系列标志着该车系进入第三代，

且提供多种车款以满足不同用户的需求。

这里展示的双门硬顶版本专为应对极端越野条件而打造。

车身虽然小巧（车长约3.9m），却搭载了实力派的3.9升汽油引擎。

再加上带有两速分动箱的四驱系统，
让这台车成为山路驾驶的绝对利器。

FJ40凭借迷人外观大受欢迎，持续生产24年，
直至1984年才停产。

TOYOTA GAZOO Racing于2021年开始
为其生产复刻零件。

原因很简单，因为如此杰出的越野车型值得被永续传承！

vehicleCollection.en:
A best-selling Land Cruiser with a 24-year production run.

The Toyota Land Cruiser was first conceived as a vehicle for Japan’s National Police Reserve, but it evolved into a world-class off-roader renowned for its all-terrain ability and legendary reliability. More than 70 years later, the model that continued to hold a special place in the hearts of enthusiasts was the third-generation “40,” introduced in 1960.

Exports had begun earlier with the “20” series in 1955, establishing the Land Cruiser as a serious contender on the world stage. The “40” was designed to better meet the expectations of international customers. Beyond its refreshed exterior, it elevated the model’s already renowned off-road prowess with greater comfort on the highway, broadening its appeal.

The 40 series was available in short, medium, and long-wheelbase versions, each tailored to different needs. The 2-door hardtop variant, seen here, found extensive use in mountainous regions, where its short 2285mm wheelbase proved invaluable.

Compact in size, it measured 3870mm in length, 1690mm in width, and 1930mm in height. Originally equipped with a 3.9-liter “F” gasoline engine, the lineup gained even more popularity in 1974 with the addition of the 3.0-liter “B” diesel engine. Its part-time 4-wheel-drive system with a 2-speed transfer case only reinforced its reputation for toughness. This was the model that embodied the Land Cruiser philosophy of “go anywhere and come back alive.”

Alongside the 2-door hardtop, the 40 series as a whole became one of the Land Cruiser’s greatest successes, remaining in production for 24 years, until 1984. Its enduring popularity inspired the launch of the FJ Cruiser in 2006, a modern homage that revived many of the classic 40’s design cues.

And in 2021, Toyota announced the reproduction of 40-series parts throuh Gazoo Racing, proving that this iconic Land Cruiser was, and always wil be, worth keeping alive on the road.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款经典畅销的Land Cruiser生产周期长达24年。

丰田Land Cruiser最初是为日本国家警察预备队设计的车辆，后来凭借其卓越的全地形能力和可靠性，演变成了世界级的越野车。70多年后，有一款车型已深深植根于Land Cruiser车迷的心中，那便是1960年推出的第三代车型“40”。

自1955年的“20”车型起，Land Cruiser便开始出口全球，并迅速成为全球越野舞台的有力竞争者。“40”车型的设计旨在更好地满足全球消费者的期望。除了外观方面的升级，这款车还在原本就有口皆碑的越野能力基础上，提升了高速公路上行驶时的舒适性。

40车型提供了短、中、长轴距三种版本，可满足不同的用车环境。此处的双门硬顶版本广泛应用于山地环境，2285mm短轴距得以一展所长。

车身尺寸也相对紧凑，长3870mm、宽1690mm、高1930mm。最初的动力单元是一台3.9升“F”汽油引擎，而1974年推出的3升“B”柴油引擎更让这款车的人气飙升。传动系统为分时四驱，并配备两速分动箱。这款车型完美诠释了Land Cruiser“无惧前路，安全归来”的理念。

与这款双门硬顶版本一样，“40”也成为Land Cruiser最畅销的车型之一，持续生产近24年，直至1984年才停产。其人气之高使得丰田于2006年推出FJ Cruiser，复刻经典40车型的多项设计元素。

在此之后，2021年丰田又通过图像赛车宣布复产40车型零件，从侧面证明了40 Land Cruiser是一款永不过时、值得永远驾驶下去的经典。

long.en:
The Toyota Land Cruiser was first conceived as a vehicle for Japan’s National Police Reserve, but it evolved into a world-class off-roader renowned for its all-terrain ability and legendary reliability. More than 70 years later, the model that continued to hold a special place in the hearts of enthusiasts was the third-generation “40,” introduced in 1960.

Exports had begun earlier with the “20” series in 1955, establishing the Land Cruiser as a serious contender on the world stage. The “40” was designed to better meet the expectations of international customers. Beyond its refreshed exterior, it elevated the model’s already renowned off-road prowess with greater comfort on the highway, broadening its appeal.

The 40 series was available in short, medium, and long-wheelbase versions, each tailored to different needs. The 2-door hardtop variant, seen here, found extensive use in mountainous regions, where its short 2285mm wheelbase proved invaluable.

Compact in size, it measured 3870mm in length, 1690mm in width, and 1930mm in height. Originally equipped with a 3.9-liter “F” gasoline engine, the lineup gained even more popularity in 1974 with the addition of the 3.0-liter “B” diesel engine. Its part-time 4-wheel-drive system with a 2-speed transfer case only reinforced its reputation for toughness. This was the model that embodied the Land Cruiser philosophy of “go anywhere and come back alive.”

Alongside the 2-door hardtop, the 40 series as a whole became one of the Land Cruiser’s greatest successes, remaining in production for 24 years, until 1984. Its enduring popularity inspired the launch of the FJ Cruiser in 2006, a modern homage that revived many of the classic 40’s design cues.

And in 2021, Toyota announced the reproduction of 40-series parts throuh Gazoo Racing, proving that this iconic Land Cruiser was, and always wil be, worth keeping alive on the road.

自1955年的“20”车型起，Land Cruiser便开始出口全球，并迅速成为全球越野舞台的有力竞争者。“40”车型的设计旨在更好地满足全球消费者的期望。除了外观方面的升级，这款车还在原本就有口皆碑的越野能力基础上，提升了高速公路上行驶时的舒适性。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
The Toyota Mark II is widely regarded as one of Japan’s
most iconic luxury sedans.

Produced from 1968 to 2004, it enjoyed a remarkable
36-year run spanning nine generations.

The original 1968 model was known
as the Corona Mark II.

The name suggested a larger, more luxurious
version of Toyota’s popular Corona sedan.

When the fifth-generation model arrived in 1984, the Corona
name was dropped in favor of Toyota Mark II.

This particular car is an eighth-generation Mark II.

More specifically, it is the highly sought-after Tourer V.

Under the hood is Toyota’s legendary turbocharged
1JZ-GTE inline-6.

What sets the Tourer V apart is it combines the refinement
of a luxury sedan with high performance.
dialogues.zh:
丰田Mark II作为日本最经典的豪华轿车之一，可谓久负盛名。

从1968年到2004年，这款车的生产持续了足足36年，
期间一共迭代了九代。

1968年生产的初版车型
被命名为“Corona Mark II”。

“Mark II”代表它是丰田的
日常代步轿车车型Corona的豪华版。

在该系列于1984年发布第5代车型时，
其名称不再包含“Corona”标识，而是直接命名为“丰田Mark II”。

这里的这台是第8代的Mark II。

也就是车迷圈子中炙手可热、一车难求的Tourer V。

它所搭载的，正是丰田大名鼎鼎的
1JZ-GTE直列6缸涡轮增压引擎。

这款车的独特之处，便是将精致的豪华车设计
与生猛的动力进行了无缝的融合。

usedCar.en:
Ever heard of the Toyota Mark II? It was an iconic FR car
that led Japan’s midsize sedan market for decades.

The performance version of the Mark II was the Tourer V, and
I happen to have an excellent one in stock right now.

This is an X100-series car from the model’s eighth generation.
What do you think? Looks like a regular sedan, right?

Well, wait until you see the serious hardware under the hood:
a 1JZ-GTE 2.5-liter inline-6 inherited from the A70 Supra.

The rush of its 280ps acceleration is pure madness,
and its 5-speed manual captivated enthusiasts everywhere.

With double wishbones at all four corners, the setup is supple
yet grippy, giving the car a remarkable degree of depth.

Older sedans are seeing a major resurgence right now,
so adding this one to your collection is an easy call.
usedCar.zh:
听说过Toyota Mark II吗？这款标志性的前置后驱车型
曾主导日本中型轿车市场数十年。

Mark II的运动版名为Tourer V，
我店里现在正好就有一台成色极好的。

是第八代的X100系列。
怎么样？看着像普通轿车，对吧？

不过等你见识过它那台凶悍的引擎再说：一台源自
A70 Supra的1JZ-GTE 2.5升直列六缸涡轮增压引擎！

它280ps的加速动力简直狂野，
5速手动变速箱更是让全球车迷为之着迷。

前后双叉臂悬挂调校偏软，
却抓地力十足，极高的可操控性令人惊叹。

如今把玩老式轿车的风潮再起，
所以把这台车收入车库，根本无需犹豫！

vehicleCollection.en:
This sports sedan's refined looks hide sharp teeth.

Originally released in 1968, the Toyota Mark II was Japan’s answer to the midsize sedan. The Tourer V was a performance trim grade that became available from the seventh-generation Mark II onward. The version shown here was the Tourer V from the eighth-generation Mark II, also known as the X100 series. The clean-cut, long-nose sedan body and wild driving character resulted in a very attractive car.

Its most notable feature was the power unit. The 2.5-liter inline-6 1JZ-GTE engine was a further-evolved, second-generation model with variable valve timing and a single turbocharger, producing 280ps/38.5kgm. Also available with a 5-speed manual transmission, a push of the throttle pedal delivered a surge of boost and the sensuous growl of the inline-6.

While it boasted excellent performance, the interior focused instead on luxury and comfort, gently enveloping the driver and passengers.

This dichotomy was what made the Tourer V so attractive. It hid its teeth, presenting the image of a refined gentleman. Its discerning drivability sent many car enthusiasts wild.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款运动轿车精致的外表下暗藏锋芒。

丰田Mark II于1968年首次推出，是日本应对中型轿车市场的代表作。Tourer V是该车型的一款运动版配置，从第七代Mark II开始提供。这里展示的是第八代Mark II的Tourer V，即X100系列。利落的长车头轿车车身与狂野的驾驶特性，共同打造出一款极具魅力的车型。

它最为人称道的地方在于其动力单元。这台2.5L直列六缸1JZ-GTE引擎是经过进一步优化的第二代机型，具备可变气门正时技术，并搭载单涡轮增压器，可输出280ps/38.5kgm的动力和扭矩。搭配5速手动变速箱，踩下油门，涡轮增压瞬间爆发，伴随直列六缸引擎悦耳的咆哮。

在卓越性能之上，内饰也是意料之外的豪华与舒适，将驾乘者温柔环抱其中。

正是这种矛盾统一，让Tourer V独具魅力。它藏起锋芒，塑造出一副温文尔雅的绅士形象。但又凭借其突出的操控性能，让无数车迷为之狂热。

dialogues.en:
It's fast, affordable, and manageable in size...

Truly this is one of the great commercial sportscars.

The 2nd generation MR2 that debuted in 1989 was
continually improved over the years.

This represents its pinnacle, with its power
ramped up to an impressive 245ps.

In spite of this, its handling remains remarkably
straightforward.

Truly this is a car where the price tag
doesn't reflect its true value.
dialogues.zh:
价格在可承受的范围之内，尺寸可控且速度很快，

它确确实实是最好的量产跑车之一。

第二代MR2于1989年首次亮相，之后多年来一直在不断
改进。

这一台是系列的巅峰之作，功率提高到了令人心驰神往
的245ps，

操控方面也是相当直截了当。

就这辆车而言，其价值远大于售价，太划算了。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
It looks like a really compact supercar.
It's smooth and looks really cool.

So the engine is in the back? It’s a two seater
and pretty tight inside.

Wow but its got a pretty decent sized boot,
not bad!
dialogues.zh:
这款车一眼看上去就是辆紧凑版超跑。
流线型的车身非常的酷。

所以发动机放在后面？这是部两座车，里面很紧凑。

哇喔，但是后备箱还是挺大的，不错！

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
Look at this MR2, and you're likely to notice its modest, understated design.

In Italy, you'll find fierce beasts like the Urraco,
named after a fighting bull, and the Merak.

These are flashy cars that really stand out, but they're
not for the faint-hearted.

Let's just say that even when you handle them the
right way, they can still bite back.

This MR2 is pretty domesticated in that respect,
and does exactly what you tell it to do.

But that doesn't mean it's tame by any means. Put the pedal
to the metal and you won't know what hit you!

Still, for a carefree driving experience,
you can't go too wrong with this car.

It's one you'll want to make a place for
in your heart and in your home.

You can recognize some elements inspired by Ferrari here
and there, but all in all, it retains a certain modesty.

Perhaps this reflects Řhe belief of the Japanese designers
that they weren't quite ready for the world stage...

...just yet.*
dialogues.zh:
看看这辆MR2，它是如此地谦逊、低调。

在意大利，有着像Urraco这样的猛兽，以公牛的名字命
名，或是同样出名的Merak。

这些姿色出众的好车需要你拥有强大的气场才能驾驭。

这样说吧，就算你知道如何伺候好它们，还是会冷不防
地被它们回咬上一口。

这辆MR2相比之下就服帖多了。你说什么，它就做什么。

当然了，服帖不代表盲从，踩下油门的那一刻，你会瞬
间飞入云端！

拥有如此体贴入微的驾驶体验，怎么的驾驶方法都不会
出错。

这样的它，会让你想将之迎入家中，也迎入你的心里。

你可以在这里或那里瞥见一些与法拉利类似的元素
……但骨子里仍是日本人的谦逊有礼。

也许这反映出了当时的日本设计师的理解，认_自己的
设计还没有达到世界级的水平

……但是只是暂时没有而已。,

These are flashy cars that really stand out, but they're
not for the faint-hearted.

Let's just say that even when you handle them the
right way, they can still bite back.

This MR2 is pretty domesticated in that respect,
and does exactly what you tell it to do.

But that doesn't mean it's tame by any means. Put the pedal
to the metal and you won't know what hit you!

Still, for a carefree driving experience,
you can't go too wrong with this car.

It's one you'll want to make a place for
in your heart and in your home.

You can recognize some elements inspired by Ferrari here
and there, but all in all, it retains a certain modesty.

Perhaps this reflects Řhe belief of the Japanese designers
that they weren't quite ready for the world stage...

...just yet.*

看看这辆MR2，它是如此地谦逊、低调。

在意大利，有着像Urraco这样的猛兽，以公牛的名字命
名，或是同样出名的Merak。

这些姿色出众的好车需要你拥有强大的气场才能驾驭。

这样说吧，就算你知道如何伺候好它们，还是会冷不防
地被它们回咬上一口。

这辆MR2相比之下就服帖多了。你说什么，它就做什么。

当然了，服帖不代表盲从，踩下油门的那一刻，你会瞬
间飞入云端！

拥有如此体贴入微的驾驶体验，怎么的驾驶方法都不会
出错。

这样的它，会让你想将之迎入家中，也迎入你的心里。

你可以在这里或那里瞥见一些与法拉利类似的元素
……但骨子里仍是日本人的谦逊有礼。

也许这反映出了当时的日本设计师的理解，认_自己的
设计还没有达到世界级的水平

……但是只是暂时没有而已。,

没有的事！我自己也很享受这样的交谈！
相信我们会再见的。

usedCar.en:
You don't see many affordable mid-engine sports cars, but
Toyota threw caution to the wind and produced the MR2.

While the first-gen model had quirky styling, this final revision,
called in-house as the SW20, looks like a mini exotic.

It handles like an exotic too, thanks to a sport-tuned
suspension system and quick steering responses.

The engine, mounted behind the GT-S' cockpit, is a turbo
2.0-liter inline-4 that pumps out an impressive 245ps.
usedCar.zh:
Toyota MR2是一款中置引擎跑车。

SW20 是对此的第二次也是最后一次修订
模型，以其先进的处理而闻名。

此 GT-S 等级配备 2升直列四缸涡轮增压
引擎能够达到 245ps。

更重要的是，这辆车的后备箱超大！
非常适合用来装一大堆行李。>

vehicleCollection.en:
The turbocharged model of Toyota's mid-engine sports car featured a rigid chassis that matched its extra power.

The second-generation MR2, which arrived in 1989, represented the all-new version of the AW11, Japan's first mass produced mid-engine sports car. Toyota wanted to broaden the appeal of its two-seater to the general public, so it made the car larger. To compensate for the added mass, Toyota increased power. The 4A-G, a 1.6-liter inline-4, was swapped in favor of the 3S-G, a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4, which produced 165 ps in naturally-aspirated form and 225 ps when turbocharged. Unfortunately, with the new engines, the handling characteristics of the AW11 worsened, as the car exhibited a tendency to oversteer. As a result, in December 1991, the chassis was completely revised in the updated SW20 II model.

Things dramatically improved, even more so in 1994 with version III that featured more power via a stronger turbocharger; 245 ps and 31.0 kgm of torque. The naturally-aspirated model also saw an increase in performance going to 180 ps and 19.5 kgm of torque. In June 1996, the IV added a helical LSD, as well as standard fare ABS. In December 1997, the V introduced the VVT-i (Variable Valve Timing-intelligent) to the naturally-aspirated engine that was now pumping out 200 ps and 21.0 kgm of torque. With all these improvements, the SW20 became one of the most popular sports cars of its day, outshining the AW11, the model that started it all.
vehicleCollection.zh:
最终的涡轮增压机车型，具有可以承受引擎动力的底盘稳定性。

第二代MR2发行于1989年，也被称为SW20，是日本第一部中置式量产车AW11的继任者。虽然外表酷似跑车，但AW11从未被丰田归类为跑车。不过，他们宣称这款第二代的MR2是一款真正的高性能跑车。

SW20的车身延长后达到日本第5级尺寸的极限，平滑的造型也与第一代MR2截然不同，但仍然采用了中置式布局。布局在车手身后的引擎从1.6升4A-G升级为2.0升3S-G，自然吸气版的马力为165ps，涡轮增压版的马力则为225ps。然而，最初的版本未能解决马力增大带来的困扰，使得这款车比AW11更加难以操控，因而在1991年12月对底盘进行了修正，发布了第II型。

1994年，第III型亮相，采用了更强的涡轮增压引擎，能够产生245ps和31kgm扭矩。自然吸气版则提升到180ps和19.5kgm扭矩。底盘悬挂、弹簧、避震和刹车也进行了对应改进。

此后，1996年6月，发布了第IV型。G级的手动版本使用了螺旋式限滑差速器，跑车款制动防抱死系统也成为所有车型的标配。1997年12月，第V型诞生，加入更多改进。这次自然吸气引擎上采用了连续可变气门定时，将输出提升至200ps和21.0kgm扭矩。

在不断进化的过程中，底盘设计逐渐成熟，操控不再像早期那样过于敏感。在SW20系列中，最终型号为第V型的自然吸气版可能是最佳车型，在马力和底盘之间做到了极好的平衡。

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
The Prius caused a great sensation by being
the world’s first mass-produced hybrid car.

But did you know its first-gen design was considered
to be somewhat lacking?

The second-generation model featured a one-motion profile
from its front to its coda tronca rear...

Which became standard for the Prius line, as you can see in
this well-formed third-generation model.
dialogues.zh:
作为全球首款混动汽车，Prius曾引发轰动性的风潮。

不过你知道吗？它的第一代设计被普遍认为有所欠缺，
不够完美。

从第二代车型开始，Prius采用了从车头到
“断尾”（coda tronca）车尾的一体成形轮廓……

这随后就成为了Prius产品系列的标准设计，
你在这款外形美观的第三代车型中也能看到。

conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

brandCentral.en:
The Prius was the world's first mass-produced hybrid car.
This is the third generation model, released in 2009.

The hybrid system in the third-gen model, introduced in 2009,
was 90% revamped, highlighted by a 1.8-liter inline-4.

The chassis was also significantly improved, making it a
smooth performer on the highway.

Oh, its fuel economy was enhanced as well, which meant that it
remained one of the most fuel-efficient cars in the world.
brandCentral.zh:
Prius是全球首款量产的混合动力汽车。这是它的第三代车
型，于2009年发布。

此车配备了经过90%改造的混合动力系统和1.8L直列四缸发
动机，

甚至底盘也得到了升级，以改善路感！

对了，此车的优秀燃油效率也不可忽视。即使以今天的
标准来看，它的指标也是十分优秀的。/

usedCar.en:
This third-generation Prius is arguably the world's
best known hybrid car.

Its 1.8-liter engine and electric motor work together to deliver
better fuel economy and fewer harmful emissions.

This particular model features the third iteration of
Toyota's Hybrid Synergy Drive.

Thanks to the torque from the electric motor, this Prius
is surprisingly quick off the line.

Never thought you could have fun driving the Prius, did you?
usedCar.zh:
这是一辆第三代Prius——它可能是世界上最知名的
混合动力车。

它的动力来源于一个由1.8L发动机、电动马达和
电池组构成的动力系统。

此型号还搭载了第三代Toyota
混合动力系统（Hybrid Synergy Drive）。

这辆车的引擎-马达控制得到了强化，其加速
性能也得到了提升。

这真是一辆潜力无穷的Prius！%

vehicleCollection.en:
This Prius variant focused on both increased performance and delivering better overall driving pleasure.

The third-generation Prius, introduced at the 2009 North American International Auto Show, did not simply improve the environmental characteristics of its predecessor, it significantly raised the bar in terms of sportiness and the all-important fun-to-drive factor.

While the overall body style of the new Prius was defined by sharp lines and angles, making the vehicle more aerodynamic and better looking than the outgoing model, it also had a vastly improved drive system. A larger 1.8-liter engine was installed and more than 90 percent of the hybrid system was redesigned. And yes, it was more fun to drive than any Prius before it.

With an increase in the popularity of "green" vehicles in the global marketplace, the new Prius shattered its sales target goal of 10,000 units per month by selling 18,000 soon after its release. It continued to top the new-car sales chart for the next six months, all the way up to November 2009. Naturally, it was awarded Japan's Car of the Year for 2009.

The new Prius came in three trim levels of L, S, and G, with the G being the most luxurious, fitted with leather-wrapped steering and smart entry system.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这台普锐斯的目标不仅仅是性能提升，还有驾驶乐趣。

2009年的北美国际车展上，第三代普锐斯首次进入大众视野。

丰田对第三代车型的改进不仅限于环保，还加入了对驾驶乐趣的探求。

技术方面，新车型的车身线条更直接，也更符合空气动力学规则。超过90%的混合动力系统被重新设计，引擎排量也相应扩大到了1.8升。这些改进不仅带来了全球最佳的燃油经济性数据：<38km/l>，也证明了在讲究环保的同时，驾驶乐趣并不会缺席。

数据证明，喜爱环保驾驶的新用户数量明显增长，在普锐斯原本月销10000台的基础上，新普锐斯发售第一个月就创下了18000台的销售纪录。而且高燃油经济性和驾驶乐趣成为了持续吸引用户加入的亮点，在2009年5月到2009年11月的6个月间，普锐斯一直稳居新车销售榜的榜首。因其对混动车市场的巨大带动作用，普锐斯还在2009年当选日本年度风云车。

在普锐斯推出的三款车型“L”，“S”和“G”当中，并无太多技术差异，只是在轮胎和部分配置细节上做出了区分。普锐斯的拥簇们倒是对猜测这些差异给能耗带来的细微影响乐此不疲。虽然代表普锐斯产品线最高等级的“G”系列配有真皮包裹方向盘和智能进入系统，以彰显品质，但从燃油经济性方面考虑，它却并非首选。

brandCentral.en:
An SUV built for both weekdays and weekends, the Toyota RAV4
was a car that defied simple categorization.

This fifth-generation model, introduced in 2018,
broke new ground in design and functionality.

The Adventure grade carried rugged styling and had an efficient
2.0-liter engine paired with a CVT and all-wheel drive.

Of particular note was its Dynamic Torque Vectoring AWD system,
which directed torque to the rear wheels for sharper cornering.

For everyday driving, the system could disengage
all-wheel drive to enhance fuel efficiency.

Its Panoramic View Monitor gave drivers a bird’s-eye view around
the vehicle, making parking or navigating rough terrain easier.

Equally at home in the city or in the wild, the Toyota RAV4
promised to take you anywhere, and do so in style.
brandCentral.zh:
兼顾日常通勤与周末出游的Toyota RAV4
是款难以简单定义的SUV。

这台在2018年推出的第五代车型
在设计与功能性方面均不同以往。

作为Adventure版本，它的车身造型十分硬朗，
还搭载了高效的2升引擎、CVT变速箱与全轮驱动系统。

它的动态扭矩矢量分配全轮驱动系统尤其值得关注，
可将扭矩分配至后轮以提升过弯性能。

公路性能方面，该车可以切换关闭全轮驱动
来提高燃油效率。

Panoramic View Monitor全景监控系统让驾驶员能从俯视角度
观察车辆周围，在泊车或行驶在崎岖路面上时尤为实用。

Toyota RAV4能够轻松应对城市与野外出行，
助你随心所欲，自由驰t

vehicleCollection.en:
An adventurous SUV for active lifestyles.

When it was introduced in 1994, the Toyota RAV4 pioneered an entirely new market segment, called the “crossover SUV.” Combining smooth off-road handling with a compact body, the first-generation model was widely praised for its ability to transcend the boundaries of on-road and off-road vehicles, and it continued to evolve with each successive generation. In 2018, the fifth-generation RAV4 was introduced on an all-new platform. Built on Toyota’s New Global Architecture (TNGA), it set new benchmarks for driving dynamics, safety, and comfort.

The Adventure grade, in particular, embodied the core spirit of an SUV. With its distinctive front grille, skid-plate bumper, and 19-inch tires, it projected rugged styling and a readiness to embrace the great outdoors. Its powertrain paired a 2.0-liter 4-cylinder Dynamic Force Engine with a Direct Shift-CVT, delivering smooth acceleration and impressive fuel efficiency.

Of special note was the newly developed Dynamic Torque Vectoring AWD system, which precisely controlled torque distribution between the left and right rear wheels, enhancing both traction and stability. A disconnect mechanism allowed the driver to disengage the rear-drive system entirely, improving fuel economy during everyday use.

On the safety front, Toyota Safety Sense came standard across the lineup, offering advanced features such as a pre-collision safety system, Lane Tracing Assist, and adaptive Radar Cruise Control. Additional amenities included a modern multimedia system with smartphone integration and a Panoramic View Monitor that provided a bird’s-eye view around the vehicle.

An ideal expression of the modern SUV, it excelled on city streets and natural terrain, infusing a sense of adventure into daily driving.
vehicleCollection.zh:
专为挑战与活力打造的运动型多用途汽车。

1994年问世的丰田RAV4荣放开创了“跨界运动型多用途汽车”这一全新的细分市场。首代车型的紧凑车身能提供顺畅的越野操控，因其突破公路与越野车型的界限而广受好评，并持续在此基础上不断进化。2018年，采用新平台的第五代车型发布。基于丰田新全球架构，这款车型在操控、安全性和舒适性方面树立了新标杆。

Adventure版本充分体现了运动型多用途汽车的核心特质。配备专属前格栅、防护板保险杠及19英寸轮胎，外观硬朗，彰显征服户外的决心。动力系统上搭载的是2.0升四缸动力引擎与直接换挡无级变速箱，可同时实现平顺加速与出色的油耗。

特别值得一提的是一套全新开发的动态扭矩矢量分配全轮驱动系统，可通过控制左右后轮扭矩分配来兼顾牵引力与稳定性。此外，它还配备了断开机构，可让驾驶者切断后轮驱动系统从而提升燃油经济性。

安全性方面，车型全系标配丰田智行安全套件，涵盖预碰撞安全系统、车道保持辅助及自适应雷达巡航控制等功能。车辆还配备了多项实用功能，如支持智能手机互联的多媒体系统，以及能提供俯视视角的全景模式影像监测系统。

作为理想的现代运动型多用途汽车，RAV4荣放能自由穿梭于城市与野外场景，为日常驾驶增添冒险乐趣。

brandCentral.en:
The S-FR was a concept vehicle unveiled at the 2015
Tokyo Motor Show.

While this lightweight RWD sports car was designed for everyday
use, it certainly turned heads at the show.

With a compact body on par with the AE86, its weight is
evenly distributed over the front and rear axles.

The design was inspired by the famous Toyota Sports 800.
brandCentral.zh:
S-FR是在2015年东京车展上发布的一款概念车。

这是一款针对日常驾驶设计的轻量级后轮驱动跑车，生
来就拥有一种引人注目的特质！

与AE86相当的紧凑车身将重量均匀地分配在前后轴上。

它的设计灵感来自于鼎鼎大名的早期跑车Toyota Sports 800。

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's exciting concept vehicle that carries on the lightweight sports-car torch established by the Sport 800.

The S-FR was a concept car that the company claimed to “provide perfect control in an entry model, allowing the driver to enjoy interacting with the car in its everyday use.”

One look at the body, and the connection to the Sport 800 was obvious by its long nose and rounded body, but the lines and general design of the car had been updated to incorporate modern styling cues.

The only specifications Toyota released for the car were its measurements. It rode on a 2480mm-wheelbase, while its overall dimensions were 3990mm, 1695mm, and 1320mm, length, width and height, respectively. The four-passenger vehicle possessed a front/rear weight distribution of 50/50 with two passengers on board. The gearbox was designated as a 6-speed manual.

At the 2016 Tokyo Auto Salon, Toyota displayed the S-FR Racing Concept. Based on the S-FR, it featured a number of carbon fiber aerodynamic parts, including fender flares, front spoilers, canards and a large rear wing. Toyota showed that its exciting new concept was sporty enough to become a track-only model if customers so desired.
vehicleCollection.zh:
沿袭了丰田轻量跑车传统的概念赛车。

丰田S-FR是丰田推出的一款轻量级跑车。这款概念赛车定位于入门车型也能提供完美的操控感受，让驾驶者在日常使用中也能感受到与车辆互动的乐趣。

其车体设计包含了著名的丰田Sports 800的元素，有着较长的前鼻和可爱的圆润车身。同时加入时尚元素，使其设计适应现代市场的品味。

在2015年全球首次亮相时，其引擎与其他信息并未披露，只提供了车身大小等尺寸信息：2480mm的轴距、长度3990mm x 宽度1695mm、车高1320mm，以及这将是一款四座车型。前后配重比在两名乘客时达到50:50，变速箱将采用6档手动变速箱。

在2016年1月的东京汽车沙龙上，丰田还展出了一款S-FR Racing Concept。基于S-FR灵动和简约的风格，这一车型被赋予了碳纤维空力组件，包括挡泥板、前下部扰流板、前翼和大尺寸的尾翼。通过不断探索发挥最佳赛道表现的设计，他们展示了S-FR的全新可能。

brandCentral.en:
This race-oriented S-FR made its first official appearance
at the 2016 Tokyo Auto Salon.

While the details of its powertrain remained undisclosed,
its creators suggested that...

...under its hood was a supercharged engine.

With even more power, combined with an excellent chassis,
this car was indeed ready for the track.
brandCentral.zh:
这辆专为比赛而重新设计的S-FR最初在2016年东京汽车沙龙
上亮相。

它的传动系统细节从未公开，不过其设计师表示……

这就是一辆机械增压版本的S-FR。

拥有如此强力的引擎和轻量化的车身，确实有资格被称
为快速、灵巧的比赛机器。

vehicleCollection.en:
The racing version of the attention-getting S-FR concept car.)

The Toyota made a splash at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show when it unveiled the S-FR. The sporty car was compact, measuring only 3990mm in overall length and sitting 1695mm wide. It weighed a mere 980kg, which meant that this stylish car with the long nose and short rear deck was quick and fun to drive. Despite the fact that Toyota said it had no plans to produce the car, it nonetheless generated quite a bit of interest from the show goers.

The race version of this car, called the S-FR Racing Concept, was introduced at the 2016 Tokyo Auto Salon. This concept vehicle sported flared fenders, increasing the S-FR's width by 20mm on each side. Other visual enhancements included a large air outlet on the hood, carbon-fiber front spoiler, rear wing, side skirts and rear diffuser. The end result was a car that appeared to be a serious GT racing machine.

While the road-going S-FR's overall height was 1320mm, the race car sat 50mm lower, at 1270mm. Underneath sheet metal, the suspension was lowered and most likely stiffened, while the front brakes utilize drilled disks and horizontally opposed 4-pot calipers.

No details regarding the engine were offered, and there was no mention of it actually going on sale.
vehicleCollection.zh:
备受期待的GT概念赛车。

丰田S-FR的概念赛车于2015年的东京车展上公开。这款跑车尺寸小巧，长度仅有3990mm，宽度则是1695mm，重量仅有980kg。加上较长的前鼻和短车身的设计风格，以及前中置引擎、后轮驱动的布局，给人以易于驾驶的第一印象。尽管没有制定商用计划，但它还是在车展上吸引了相当多的注意力。

这款车的赛车版便是S-FR Racing Concept，于2016年东京汽车沙龙上展出。顾名思义，此车也是一款概念赛车。

其配备了两侧各外扩20mm的挡泥板、引擎盖上设有大型出风口，还装备了碳纤维空气动力套件，如前部的大型扰流板、尾翼、侧包围和后扩散器，这些额外配件使其从原版的可爱风格摇身一变，展现出一台超级跑车的形象。

尽管S-FR的公路版本高度也只有1320mm，但赛车版本的车高进一步降低50mm，达到了1270mm，由于底盘与路面之间几乎没有空隙，悬挂设定估计也会偏硬。前刹车使用了钻孔刹车碟和水平对向的4活塞卡钳。

目前该车引擎的信息尚未公布，也并没有未来进入量产的消息。不过，在所有参展该年汽车沙龙的车型中，此车依然获得了相当高的关注度。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Here's a legendary car from the early days of Japanese
motorsports.

I've heard all about how it used to race around the newly
built Suzuka Circuit.

If you were to ask me which race by this car nicknamed
"Yota-Hachi" was the finest...

...I would have to say that it was the one at Funabashi
Circuit in July 1965.

The event was the All-Japan Club Championship, and the
driver was Tojiro Ukiya.

Ukiya broke his fender in a collision early in the race,
dropping him to 16th place.

After that incident, however, he staged a stunning comeback,
moving up through the field to win the race!

There was something almost divine about the performance he
displayed that day.
dialogues.zh:
这是一辆来自日本赛车运动早期的传奇汽车。

我听说过它是如何在新建成的铃鹿赛道上飞驰的！

如果你要问我“丰田八”有史以来最精彩的比赛是哪一场……

那一定是1965年7月在船桥赛道举行的那场比赛。

这是全日本俱乐部锦标赛的一站，车手是浮谷东次郎。

在比赛前期的一次碰撞中，浮谷撞坏了他的挡泥板。车
辆修复后，他的位置跌到了第16位。

然而，在那之后他上演了一场惊人的反击战，在一路高
歌猛进，最终取得了第一名的好成绩

他在那天表现出的速度简直如有神助！

dialogues.speaker: Hideo Kodama
dialogues.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
dialogues.en:
This car has the reputation of having a cute design.

But its creators didn't mean for it to be cute. Rather, they
strived to make the design extremely functional.

The end result is effective and quite pleasant.

Based on national automotive standards at the time, Toyota
introduced the 800cc 4-passenger Publica in 1962.

Using that car as a base, the company produced
this sporty model called the Toyota Sports 800.

It's also known as the "Yota Hachi."

Despite having a small engine, the car's look suggests
it drives in a spritely manner...

...with emphasis placed on aerodynamics and lightness.

Shozo Saito, a designer who worked at Kanto Jidosha,
a Toyota subsidiary company...

...played a central role in this design.
dialogues.zh:
这辆车因其可爱的设计而举世闻名……

不过这并非设计师的本意，
在设计时，他们致力于最大化突出功能性。
好在结果非常成功、非常令人满意。

基于当时的国家汽车标准，丰田在1962年
推出了排量800cc的4座汽车帕布利卡。

该公司随后又基于该车型推出了
跑车型号丰田Sports 800，

也就是大家口中的“丰田8”。

尽管排量较小，但得益于设计师将外观设计的重点放在了
空气动力学和轻量化，

让人觉得它拥有活力和动感的操控感。

为丰田子公司“关东自动车工业株式会社”工作的设计师佐藤章蔵

在这辆车的设计工作中担任了举足轻重的角色。

conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.en: This car... Are you the owner?
conversation.zh: 这辆车……你是它的车主吗？

conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.en:
Are you by chance Mr. Hideo Kodama, the designer who had a
hand in many famous cars from the German company Opel?
conversation.zh:
您不会是儿玉英雄吧，
曾经参与过德国Opel公司的诸多名车的那位设计师？"

conversation.speaker: Hideo Kodama
conversation.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师
conversation.en:
Yes! I'm Kodama. It's a pleasure to meet
the both of you.
conversation.zh: 是的，正是本人。见到你们两位很高兴。

conversation.speaker: Sarah
conversation.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师
conversation.en:
The pleasure is ours, Kodama-san. What an honor
it is to make your acquaintance!

Kodama-san was the chief designer at Opel. He worked
for more than 40 years in Opel's design department.

He's also a judge at the prestigious and historic
vintage car event, the Concorso d'Eleganza Villa d'Este.
conversation.zh:
应该高兴的是我们，儿玉先生。认识您真是荣幸！

儿玉先生是Opel的首席设计师。
他在Opel的设计部门工作了超过40年。

他还是权威而且历史悠久的埃斯特别墅古董车展
的评审委员之一。

在设计时，他们致力于最大化突出功能性。
好在结果非常成功、非常令人满意。

基于当时的国家汽车标准，丰田在1962年
推出了排量800cc的4座汽车帕布利卡。

该公司随后又基于该车型推出了
跑车型号丰田Sports 800，

也就是大家口中的“丰田8”。

尽管排量较小，但得益于设计师将外观设计的重点放在了
空气动力学和轻量化，

让人觉得它拥有活力和动感的操控感。

为丰田子公司“关东自动车工业株式会社”工作的设计师佐藤章蔵

在这辆车的设计工作中担任了举足轻重的角色。

conversation.en:
Here's a legendary car from the early days of Japanese
motorsports.

I've heard all about how it used to race around the newly
built Suzuka Circuit.

If you were to ask me which race by this car nicknamed
"Yota-Hachi" was the finest...

...I would have to say that it was the one at Funabashi
Circuit in July 1965.

The event was the All-Japan Club Championship, and the
driver was Tojiro Ukiya.

Ukiya broke his fender in a collision early in the race,
dropping him to 16th place.

After that incident, however, he staged a stunning comeback,
moving up through the field to win the race!

There was something almost divine about the performance he
displayed that day.
conversation.zh:
这是一辆来自日本赛车运动早期的传奇汽车。

我听说过它是如何在新建成的铃鹿赛道上飞驰的！

如果你要问我“丰田八”有史以来最精彩的比赛是哪一场……

那一定是1965年7月在船桥赛道举行的那场比赛。

这是全日本俱乐部锦标赛的一站，车手是浮谷东次郎。

在比赛前期的一次碰撞中，浮谷撞坏了他的挡泥板。车
辆修复后，他的位置跌到了第16位。

然而，在那之后他上演了一场惊人的反击战，在一路高
歌猛进，最终取得了第一名的好成绩

他在那天表现出的速度简直如有神助！

usedCar.en:
Toyota has produced some very cool sports cars over the years,
but one of the most memorable could be the Sports 800.

Introduced in 1965, it was called the "Yota-Hachi."

It was the first Japanese production model to feature aluminum
bodywork, so the car is extremely lightweight.

Weighing only 580kg, it's half the size of today's cars.

While its air-cooled flat-2 produces only 45ps, you can be
sure that it's a true sports car, thanks to its FR layout.
usedCar.zh:
Sports 800是Toyota跑车设计制造史上
一大杰作，诞生于20世纪60年代。

在日本，它以“Yota 8”的昵称
为人们所熟知...

Sports 800是首款采用铝制面板的
日产车型。

因此它的车身极为轻巧。

尽管它的风冷水平对置双缸引擎只能产生45ps的马力，
但它开起来就像是一辆真正的跑车。

vehicleCollection.en:
With its wide tread and low center of gravity, the "Yota-Hachi" was a capable sports car.

With its compact and lightweight body, the Toyota Sports 800 was one of the most admired sports cars of its day. It made its debut in 1965, and represented Toyota's first production sports car. Known in Japan as the "Yota-Hachi" a vernacular phrase for "Toyota Eight," it also was the first Japanese car to feature a targa top and removable roof panel.

As a sports car, it was cleverly designed. It aimed for simplicity rather than complicated mechanics, so many parts came from its popular boxy passenger-car, the Publica. The Yota-Hachi was smaller than the Publica, with an overall length of 3580mm.

The engine was a 790cc flat-2 with two carburetors helping it to produce 45ps. Although it wasn't as powerful as other sports cars, its lean 580kg curb weight allowed it to behave like a true performance machine on the road. The FR (Front engine, Rear drive) exhibited adequate punch off the line and was able to reach <155km/h>, performance comparable to cars with 1500cc engines.

Thanks in part to the Publica's wide tread and low center of gravity, the Sports 800 demonstrated exceptional agility on the twisty stuff, with sharp turn-in response and near neutral handling balance. Its main rival was the Honda S800, and oftentimes, the Sports 800 battled the little Honda on both road and track.
vehicleCollection.zh:
被车迷爱称为“丰田8”的车型。宽胎搭配上较低的重心，在过弯时优势明显。

丰田Sports 800，别名“约塔八”亮相于1965年，证明了轻量化和紧凑的尺寸才是跑车的关键要素。它还是全球最早一批采用车顶收起后仍然保留B柱的车型，这套敞篷系统在后来被统称为Targa顶棚。

这台跑车内藏着非常精妙的构思——遵循简洁的原则，避免使用任何复杂组件。其深层原因在于这台车的大部分零件都取自当时的经济型汽车帕布利卡。当你踩下油门时，就可以听到那台横置双缸风冷引擎发出耳熟能详的嗡嗡声和突突声，仿佛与它那圆润可爱的造型一唱一和。

撇开外观不谈，Sports 800最擅长的就是扮猪吃老虎。简单到极致的车壳设计，加上全车大量使用的铝制和亚克力零件，让全车车重仅有580kg——对于跑车来说实属不可多得的优势。790cc的引擎虽然在双化油器的帮助下也只能输出45ps的动力，却依然能跑出<155km/h>的最高时速，可以与现今的1500cc级别车辆相媲美。

21世纪的我们虽然都将“生态环境友好”和“环保”挂在嘴边。但其实远在1965年的先行者丰田Sports 800才是领先于时代的表率，并为我们留下了这台永不过时的设计。

usedCar.en:
There were two versions of the Toyota AE86 that were released
at the same time: the Trueno and the Levin.

Do you know which was the more popular one? If you guessed
the Levin, you're absolutely right.

But this means that there are fewer used Truenos around today,
making them more of a collector's car than the Levin.

You can tell the difference between the cars by the headlights.
The Trueno has retractable ones, while the Levin's are fixed.

Under the hood is the 4A-G, a reliable 1.6-liter inline-4.

The front-engine/rear-drive sports car, or FR, weighs only
900kg, making it a fun car to toss around corners.
usedCar.zh:
哪一款AE86车型在发售时更受欢迎，
Trueno还是Levin？

不管你是否相信，Levin更受欢迎。
但不用为Trueno感到遗憾！

由于在发售之初缺乏人气，二手Trueno数量现在非常稀少，
如今已经成为了人们梦寐以求的收藏品。

Trueno的4A-G引擎是一款久经考验的1.6L直列四缸引擎...

它在过渡到更高转速范围时非常强劲
有力，也因此而闻名。

对于想要提高车技的车手来说，
Trueno作为一款车重约900kg的前置后驱跑车，正是他们的绝佳之选。

vehicleCollection.en:
The tossable nature of this original hatchback 86 more than compensated for its lack of structural rigidity.

Already considered a classic among enthusiasts today, this compact car has become a favorite for drifters and has been featured in movies and comic books. The car has its roots from the Corolla/Sprinter, but when this model changed its layout to FF (front engine/front drive), the sporty version in the lineup, the AE86 or Corolla Levin/Sprinter Trueno, remained as a rear-wheel driver.

The "86" (or Hachi-Roku, as it was called in Japan) developed an immediate following because of its rear-drive layout, lightweight, excellent handling and affordable price tag. It came in two shapes: a 3-door hatchback and a 2-door notchback. The main difference between the Corolla Levin and Sprinter Trueno was the front end, where the former featured a horizontal grille and fixed headlights and the latter no grille and retractable headlights.

Providing power was the newly developed 4A-GEU, a 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4. This engine featured some of the day's most advanced technology, including EFI-D (Electronic Fuel Injection-Druck), which calculated fuel amount through a pressure sensor, and the T-VIS (Toyota Variable Injection System). This helped the 4-cylinder to produce 130ps and 15.2kgm of torque.

It revved freely and quick, and demonstrated excellent throttle response, making the car wonderfully controllable through tricky corners. The suspension, body and engine worked harmoniously together to provide real sports car attributes. It was this performance and personality that made the "86" loved by so many.
vehicleCollection.zh:
原版86掀背车，车身刚性欠缺的问题在怀旧面前就不再是问题了。

1983年5月，丰田的主流热销车型卡罗拉/Sprinter进行了一次全系大改款，全面改为前置前驱车型。惟有运动车型保留了前置后驱的布局，它就是后来脍炙人口的“86”—AE86卡罗拉Levin/Sprinter Trueno。

作为最后一款轻型前置后驱车型，86立即变得炙手可热起来。在这其中，又可分为三门版掀背和两门版斜背。卡罗拉Levin和Sprinter Trueno的主要差异集中在车身的前半段，前者采用横向格栅和方形固定头灯，而后者没有进气格栅，但拥有上翻式头灯。

两者均采用新开发的1.6升双顶置凸轮轴直列4缸发动机4A-GEU，而且为了尽可能体现双顶置凸轮轴的效用，空气流量计被电子燃油喷射系统取而代之，后者可以根据压力探测器反馈的数据来计算喷油量。除此之外，进气口处还安装了丰田可变进气系统，帮助引擎输出130ps的最大马力和15.2kgm的最大扭矩。

轻盈小巧的引擎加上精准响应的转向为驾驶者带来难以言语的驾驶体验，尽管引擎动力不那么充沛，操控也不够稳定，但驾驶者能获得到随心所欲、车随心动的感觉。所以说，这是一台能让人“人车合一”的纯正前置后驱车。

在当时，虽然有同级别配置的对手虎视眈眈，86却赢得了大多数享受驾驶乐趣，欣喜于其操控体验的车迷的热烈追捧。在它之后，也涌现出了许多主打高性能的车型，但再难找到一款像86这般备受大众喜爱的车。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Now, there's a beauty! This isn’t just any Supra, you know.

It's known as a "homologation model," meaning
it was developed primarily as a race car.

Toyota's reason for creating it was to win the Group A
title in the Japanese Touring Car Championship.

To ensure it was battle-ready, the engineers performed
various mechanical upgrades.

These included a turbine and intercooler, as well as parts for naturally-aspirated and turbocharged engines.

As a result, the Turbo A produced 30ps more
than the base model.

With production capped at 500 units, this homologation model
sold out in the blink of an eye.

Aside from the wheel color and bumper shape, it doesn’t
look too different from its forebear.

However, those in the know will instantly
recognize its worth.
dialogues.zh:
天啊！这可不是一辆普通的Supra……

这是一辆为竞赛而生的“赛事认证”型。

丰田当时想用这辆车夺得日本房车锦标赛的A组别桂冠。

为了准备这项赛事，这辆车得到了多处机械升级。

这些升级包括一台涡轮机和中冷器，以及
自然吸气和涡轮增压发动机的部件。

这些升级使这辆车的马力比基础车型提高了30ps。

由于生产上限是500辆，“赛事认证”型转眼间就卖光了。

除了轮毂颜色和保险杠形状之外，
它的外形与基本型完全一样。

然而，有眼光的人
肯定一眼就能看出它的价值！

dialogues.speaker: Tom Matano
dialogues.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者
dialogues.en:
This was a very unique car in the sense that Toyota’s
designers had to create an original design style for it.

It feels expertly sculpted.

In order to fit a 6-cylinder engine, the Supra’s nose
had to be extended, both physically and visually.

As a result, it looks like a powerful grand tourer.
dialogues.zh:
这是一款非常独特的车型，Toyota的设计师们
注入了完全原创的设计风格。

它的车身给人以精雕细琢的感觉。

为了塞入一台6缸引擎，这辆Supra的车头不得不
横向加宽，也呈现出更豪迈的视觉风格。

最终的造型也更接近一辆性能强大的豪华旅行车。

为了准备这项赛事，这辆车得到了多处机械升级。

这些升级包括一台涡轮机和中冷器，以及
自然吸气和涡轮增压发动机的部件。

这些升级使这辆车的马力比基础车型提高了30ps。

由于生产上限是500辆，“赛事认证”型转眼间就卖光了。

除了轮毂颜色和保险杠形状之外，
它的外形与基本型完全一样。

然而，有眼光的人
肯定一眼就能看出它的价值！

usedCar.en:
The Toyota Supra has always been popular with racers, whether
it's grassroots racing, GT competition or rally events.

Take for example this 3.0GT Turbo A of the A70 model that was
homologated for Group A competition.

Its inline-6 M-variant engine was originally developed
for the 2000GT.

And thanks to its exclusive turbochargers, it produces
more than 270ps of power.

Only 500 units were manufactured, making this rare and unique
car one of the most collectable Supras ever.

A70 Supra在房车赛和拉力赛
中都亮相过。

这辆3.0 GT Turbo A甚至获得了参加A组别
竞赛的许可！

它搭载了一台原本为2000GT开发的
直列六缸M系引擎。

Turbo A的独有涡轮使其能输出超过
270ps的马力。

这款车型最终只有500辆出厂上市。
可以说，每一辆都是Supra历史中的无价之宝。`

vehicleCollection.en:
This variant of the Supra was a homologation model with special equipment for Group A racing.

Using the popular Celica XX, which made its debut in 1981, as the foundation, Toyota decided to embark on making a true sports car that would challenge the best examples from Europe. And after much research and development work, the company introduced the Supra in 1986.

Intended mainly for the North American market, the Supra featured a double-wishbone suspension at all four corners, a first for the company since the 2000GT. The rear differential utilized a subframe to deliver sporty handling and a comfortable ride.

The new Toyota sports car was large for a coupe, measuring 4620mm long, 1690mm wide and 1310mm high. It initially came powered by the 7M engine, a 3.0-liter turbocharged unit that produced 230ps, with a twin-turbocharged 185ps 2.0-liter inline-4 and normally-aspirated versions added later (105ps and 140ps). But the most noteworthy Supra was the 3.0 GT Turbo A, which appeared in 1988. This model became the foundation for a race car that competed in the Japan National Touring Car Series. It used a 3.0-liter turbo engine that produced 270ps., and it wore the same 1745mm-wide body as the North American-spec model, with low-profile tires and improved suspension.

In 1990, this power plant was replaced by the 1JZ-GTE in the 2.5GT Twin Turbo R. The new engine cranked out 280ps, which was the maximum allowed for JDM cars at that time.

Supra是丰田的高性能GT，于1986年2月首次亮相。这款车脱胎自赛利卡系列，是1981年亮相的赛利卡XX（美国版Supra）衍生出来的车款。这原本是一款针对北美市场推出的长车头、掀背双门轿车，但随着日本跑车热的升温，这款车进一步进化成了高性能跑车。

Supra与Soarer共享平台，车身长4620mm，宽1690mm，高1310mm。4轮悬挂均为独立双叉臂式。这是自2000GT以来，丰田旗下车型首次采用这种悬挂布局。后差速器利用副车架来平衡驾驶性能与舒适性。

在最初推出的引擎阵容中，领衔的是7M型3升涡轮增压引擎，动力为230ps。此外还有185ps的2升双涡轮增压引擎、140ps的2升双顶置凸轮轴增压引擎，和105ps的2升双顶置凸轮轴增压引擎。此后，又有多款引擎加入了该系列。

这些车型中最受热议的是1988年发布的3.0 GT Turbo A。这款经过认证的车型用于参加全日本巡回赛车比赛的组别A比赛，采用动力高达270ps的7M-GTEU引擎。和北美规格的车型一样，这款车的车身宽1745mm，车身降低，使用宽度50mm的轮胎和经过改进的悬挂。

在1990年进行的一次重要小改款中，3升引擎从产品线中退出，顶级车型变为2.5GT双涡轮增压R，采用新的1JZ-GTE引擎。该车型的动力为280ps，达到当时日本汽车制造行业自己设定的最大马力限制。这使得Supra进入了超高性能跑车的行列之中，在服役的7年内，一直是丰田跑车车型中的王者。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
This is the 1997 winner of the All Japan GT Championships.
It's a truly valuable race car indeed.

It's also famed for being the first car to take the title from the
Nissan teams, which were dominating the GT Championships.

The Tom's Supra first appeared in 1994, which means
it took four years for them to reach this point.

With a glorious race history and historical value,
this is a treasure for sure.
dialogues.zh:
这款赛车是1997年全日本房车锦标赛的冠军车，是一辆
真正有价值的赛车。

它也是第一辆从一直统治该项锦标赛的
日产手中夺走冠军头衔的赛车。

这款TOM's Supra于1994年亮相，花费了整整四年时间
才取得了如此殊荣。

兼具辉煌的赛史和极高的历史价值，这辆车必定是一笔
珍贵财富。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Japan's GT Championship in the late 1990s was a three-way battle
between the Nissan Skyline, Honda NSX and the Toyota Supra.

The battles amongst Japan's three major car manufacturers
was one for the ages!

By the final round, which was run in the pouring rain,
all three teams were still in contention for the title.

Even after the checkered flag was waved, it wasn't
certain who had won the series.

That's because two teams were tied for the top spot, and
their 2nd-place finishes were also even.

This meant the tiebreaker came down to the number of 3rd-place
finishes they had recorded over the season...

In the end, the Tom's Supra Number 36 came out
on top in the historic 1997 season.
dialogues.zh:
二十世纪九十年代末，日本房车锦标赛呈现的是三足鼎立
的态势：日产天际线、本田NSX和丰田Supra。

这辆Tom's Supra在1997年夺冠的那一役，
堪称一场真正的悬念大戏！

战至大雨滂沱的最后一轮比赛中，
竟仍有4支车队保有夺冠可能！

甚至在方格旗落下之后，冠军归属仍然扑朔迷离。

因为有两支车队积分持平、并列第一，就连他们在赛季中获得亚军
的次数也完全相同。

最后为了决定胜负，竟要追溯这两支车队
在整个赛季中获得季军的次数！

而这辆36号Tom's Supra正是从那场扣人心弦的
1997年冠军决战中脱颖而出的最终王者！

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
The A80 Supra...

...is a coupe with very traditional sports-car proportions
that's kind of rare in Japanese cars.

With a windshield that wraps all around the cabin,
it has a proper greenhouse.

And this car takes the classic, beautiful coupe and drops the
ride height further and widens the track...

...turning it into a race car that looks like it could really
deliver on the track!

The car's shape is simple, so the Castrol livery suits it well.

The lights, which look too close together in the original model,
are camouflaged and don't get in the way of the design.

The A80 Supra had lots of tuning parts available for it, so
it's no wonder it was so popular with the younger crowd.
dialogues.zh:
该怎么描述A80 Supra呢……

这是一款采用传统跑车比例的双门跑车，在日本车当中
相当罕见。

环绕式的挡风玻璃仿若一个倒置的温室。

这辆经典、优美的双门跑车进一步降低了离地间隙，加
宽了胎面，

变成了一辆仿佛随时可以一飞冲天的赛车。

简洁的车型与Castrol的涂装相得益彰。

原版车中看起来相距太近的头灯经过涂装的遮掩后也不
那么碍眼了。

再加上80 Supra有很多可供选择的调校件，难怪它在年
轻人中有如此大的魅力了！<next id=2000306 type=

这辆Tom's Supra在1997年夺冠的那一役，
堪称一场真正的悬念大戏！

战至大雨滂沱的最后一轮比赛中，
竟仍有4支车队保有夺冠可能！

甚至在方格旗落下之后，冠军归属仍然扑朔迷离。

因为有两支车队积分持平、并列第一，就连他们在赛季中获得亚军
的次数也完全相同。

最后为了决定胜负，竟要追溯这两支车队
在整个赛季中获得季军的次数！

而这辆36号Tom's Supra正是从那场扣人心弦的
1997年冠军决战中脱颖而出的最终王者！

collection.en:
The 1997 Castrol TOM'S Supra is one of the most famous
race cars in the history of Japanese motorsport.

The All Japan Grand Touring Championship was a very
popular event in Japan from the late 90s to the early 2000s,

Featuring cars like the Nissan Skyline GT-R, the Honda NSX,
and of course, the Toyota Supra.

Nissan's GT-R had always dominated the series title
from the start of the championships...

And the first Japanese car that challenged and overthrew
the GT-R was this 1997 Castrol TOM'S Supra.

The Supra would go on to win the All Japan Grand Touring
Championship four times in total.

But it's this iconic TOM's Supra that I remember most fondly.
collection.zh:
1997 Castrol TOM's Supra是日本汽车运动史上最著名的赛车之一。

全日本GT锦标赛（JGTC）曾是90年代末期到2000年代初日
本非常热门的汽车赛事。

参赛车型包括了Nissan Skyline GT-R、Honda NSX，
当然也少不了Toyota Supra。

Nissan GT-R在赛事早期是最具有统治力的赛车……

且这辆1997 Castrol TOM's Supra是最先向它们发起挑战
并夺走其统治地位的日本挑战者。

Supra在日后总计赢得了四次全日本GT锦标赛，

但给我留下最深刻印象的还是这辆标志性的TOM'S Supra。

vehicleCollection.en:
This car brought an end to the GT-R's domination by taking the title in 1997.!

As the most popular form of motorsports in Japan, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC) featured the country's top car makers doing battle on the country's most famous racetracks. The series was renamed the Super GT Series in 2005, with races held in Malaysia and China, expanding its appeal throughout Asia. So it was understandable that Japanese automobile manufacturers poured plenty of energy and resources into producing results in this racing series.

Toyota was among the early pioneers, whose Supra, running in the GT500 class, was the main challenger to the Nissan GT-R that had dominated the series for three straight years beginning with the first year of the championship in 1993. In 1997, the Supra finally dethroned the GT-R and became series champion with the number 36 Castrol Tom's Supra.

The winning car was piloted by Michael Krumm and Pedro de la Rosa, who began racing the Tom's Supra starting with the second round of that year. In their next five races, they won two races and placed 2nd and 3rd in two others to secure the championship. This was accomplished despite the fact that the car had not changed greatly from the previous year; the only differences were a switch from an "H"-pattern gearbox to a Hewland 6-speed sequential transmission, and lowering engine displacement to 2.0 liters to decrease weight. Still, the 3S-GT engine produced nearly 500ps.

When all this was combined with better structural rigidity, an improved suspension system and better aerodynamics, the GT500 race Supra had no equals.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这台机器正是终结GT-R王朝的勇士。

2005年，日本的GT系列赛事成为一项国际赛事并因此更名为“Super GT”。而在2004年之前，这项赛事被称为“全日本GT锦标赛（JGTC）”。从举办伊始，它就拥有全日本赛车运动最大的观众人数。也因此，日本的汽车制造商们都为这项锦标赛投注了大量的精力。

丰田Supra从1994年开始参加这项锦标赛，对从1993年首届锦标赛起便连续三年统治这项赛事的日产GT-R发起直接挑战。3年之后的1997年，Supra终于击败了GT-R，夺得了锦标赛的冠军。实现这一壮举的历史性比赛机器是36号赛车，嘉实多Tom’s Supra。

车手是迈克尔·克鲁姆和佩德罗·德拉罗萨，他们在当年比赛的第二轮才加入汤姆车队，担任二号车的车手。在随后的5轮比赛中，这台Supra的表现异常出色，两次摘得冠军，取得亚军和季军各一次，并最终赢得了系列赛的冠军。

这台车和前一年相比并没有太多变化。唯一的重大变化就是从H布局变速箱改为使用Hewland 6速序列式变速箱。除此之外，为了符合赛事规定，降低最小重量，引擎排量缩水到了2升。但这台3S-GT引擎依然可以输出接近500ps，而诸如对车身刚性的强化、悬挂系统结构的改动、空气动力学套件的改良，都只是一部赛车的标准进化过程。

catch.zh: 这台机器正是终结GT-R王朝的勇士。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
I've seen this car in the movie 'The Fast and the Furious'!
It's the Toyota Supra right?
The 'Supra' letters look like it was written
with a Japanese brush.

I am right? I thought so!
So they really wrote it like in Japanese calligraphy.
dialogues.zh:
我在《速度与激情》里见过这款车！
这是Toyota Supra，对不对？
字母Supra就像是用日本的毛笔写的。

我说对了？我就说嘛。他们写的真的是日本书法。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
Oh, I’ve seen this car before in a "Fast & Furious" film.
It’s the Toyota Supra.

As the ancestor of the GR Supra, it has a special
place in Toyota’s sports-car history.

And there’s something really neat about
its emblem, too.

It was actually inspired by the art of
Japanese calligraphy.
|
dialogues.zh:
啊，我以前见过这款车，是在《速度与激情》电影里。
这是一辆Toyota Supra啊。

它是GR Supra的始祖，在Toyota的跑车历史上
拥有非常特殊的地位。

而且它的车标设计也非常简洁。

这个设计的灵感好像是来源于日本的书法！
-

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became
the biggest auto producer in the world.

Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot
of thought about what kind of products should be offered.

It was a time of ambition and decision.

There were lots of discussion of what made
Japanese automotive design distinctive.

Japanese cars from around this time were
embraced by people around the world.

When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or
the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,

it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first
saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.
dialogues.zh:
日本在20世纪80年代经济蓬勃发展时期，曾短暂地为了世
界上最大的汽车生产国。

在汽车行业的领导地位使其自然而然地产生了许多想法，
希望决定汽车发展的方向……

你可以把它视作一种野心或反思。

在那一时期产生了大量的讨论，探讨日本汽车设计独树
一帜的缘由。

撇开理念不谈，这一时期的日本车确实受到了全球车迷
的喜爱。

当我真正遇到白色流线造型的赛利卡，或是在欧洲古城的
鹅卵石街道邂逅A80 Supra时，

那种心灵的震撼和耳目一新的感觉就和我小时候在东京
麻布区看到一辆有巨大尾鳍的克莱斯勒时几乎一模一样。

usedCar.en:
One of the most popular "retro" sports cars today is the
4th-generation Toyota Supra, also called the "80 Supra".

At a recent auction, one went for sale for a half-million dollars.
That's more than ten times the car's original price tag!

This car is all about performance, armed with the 2JZ-GTE
engine that's easy to tune for more power.
usedCar.zh:
Toyota Supra RZ，又称“80 Supra”，
是日本前置后驱跑车工程技术上的杰作。

只要调校得当，它的涡轮增压直列六缸
2JZ-GTE引擎能够发挥出不凡的性能。

无论是比赛、直线加速还是漂移，
它都不会让你失望。/

vehicleCollection.en:
This Supra was all business, equipped with a 6-speed gearbox and Bilstein suspension.

Toyota took its flagship sports car, the Supra, in an entirely new direction when it introduced the second-generation variant in May 1993. This was evident from the car's unique exterior styling that featured a long nose, large fixed rectangular headlights and slim taillights on a round rear. It looked nothing at all like the previous model, or anything else on the road for that matter. It sat 120mm wider and 100mm shorter. Inside the cockpit was a snug 2+2 layout with the dashboard wrapping around the front-seat occupants.

There were two engines offered, a naturally aspirated and turbocharged version of the 2JZ. The base 3.0-liter DOHC inline-6 produced 225ps while the turbocharged one cranked out 280ps. A race version of this engine is said to produce 400ps to 500ps, so it was far from reaching its potential in the Supra, though many aftermarket tuners managed to reach that figure and beyond. The engines came mated to a 5-speed manual, 4-speed automatic or a new Getrag 6-speed manual gearbox.

The Supra's suspension consisted of double wishbones at all four corners, tuned to provide maximum cornering prowess. Thus, ride quality was on the stiff side, but this FR (Front engine, Rear drive) car possessed the best handling in its class.
vehicleCollection.zh:
6速变速箱和倍适登悬挂，让Supra更上层楼。

1993年5月，丰田的GT跑车Supra在经过改款后，重生为全新的车款。

与原本强劲的美式肌肉车理念不同，丰田希望用新一代车款创造一种坚忍、有耐力的印象。长车头的设计被迷人的、阳刚的车身取而代之，宽度增加了120mm，总长度减少了100mm，使得该车拥有了更加理想的跑车比例。

内饰采用了简约的黑色，有五个独立的仪表盘，包括一个模拟时钟。

引擎仍使用一款简单实用的2JZ型3升双顶置凸轮轴直列6缸引擎，有双涡轮增压和自然进气两个版本。双涡轮增压版的马力为280ps，自然吸气版则为225ps。2JZ-GTE双涡轮增压引擎常常用作调试的参照，500ps规格的引擎十分常见。

变速箱有5速手动变速、4速自动变速和6速手动变速多种可选。传动系统则是与德国格特拉克公司共同研发的，与倍适登的悬挂一起搭配使用在SZ-R、RZ和RZ-S等耐力跑车款上。

悬挂采用和前一车款相同的4轮双叉臂悬挂，但尺寸和其他规格都经过了重新设计。多个部位的刚度都经过加强，避震和衬套经过调校后可控性得到显著提高。

I'm sure you know the Japanese manga called "Initial D."
If not, you might want to check out the anime series.

The automotive star of the show was the Toyota AE86, and
this exposure increased the car's popularity tenfold.

Initial D creator, Shuichi Shigeno, was a big fan of the car and
wanted the main character, Takumi Fujiwara, to own one.

The manga was first published in 1995 and an anime series
soon followed, reaching a huge global audience.
usedCar.zh:
AE86的人气经久不衰，众多原因之一
就是它在《头文字D》系列漫画中有着重要的地位。

头文字D的作者重野秀一是这款车的
死忠粉。

它采用自然进气引擎，是能够体现
高超调校技术的典型代表。

驾驶这款车就仿佛是在驾驶藤原拓海的
AE86，给人一种穿越到漫画中的感觉！

vehicleCollection.sourceName: Sprinter Trueno 3door 1600GT APEX (AE86 Shuichi Shigeno Version) '00
vehicleCollection.en:
This modified 86 was built to order for the author of the "Initial D" comic books.

Known in Japan as the "Hachi-Roku" (Eight-Six), the popularity of the AE86 Levin/Trueno platform has not diminished in the more than 25 years since it first appeared. The Trueno here is of special interest—it is owned by Shuichi Shigeno, the author of "Initial D," a very popular comic book series in Japan in which the AE86 plays a pivotal role.

While chassis rigidity was improved by beefing up some body panels in key areas, the car's overall stock curb weight was reduced by about 100 kg, thanks to installing a carbon composite hood in place of the much heavier stock unit.

The AE86 enjoyed a long and varied tuning history, from carburetor conversions to superchargers to turbo kits. The method chosen for our car is perhaps the most common of AE86 upgrades: conversion to a 4-barrel throttle body. Further upgrades like high-compression pistons and a high-lift camshaft helped bring out the famous engine's character even more, imparting it with an exciting power curve where engine response felt sharp and the torque delivered generously with increasing revs.

A powerful MoTeC engine control unit was utilized for superior control, enabling the engine to attain a 210ps maximum output, which is very close to the physical limits under normally aspirated tune. The exhaust system made use of an HKS manifold and Trust muffler to extract the most performance from the engine... plus it sounded really nice.
vehicleCollection.zh:
调校版86，专为《头文字D》作者量身定制。

AE86 Levin/Trueno，即日语中的“86”诞生至今已超过25年，热度依然未见消退。这台车是《头文字D》的作者重野秀一拥有的Trueno。《头文字D》是一部以AE86为主角的畅销漫画作品。

AE86平台有着丰富的引擎调校历史，多年来积累下了无数升级选择，从化油器转换套件，到机械增压套件，再到涡轮套件，不一而足。这台车可以说汇集了最普罗大众的AE86升级方案：更换4孔节流阀体。其他进阶升级则包括更换高压缩比活塞和高升程凸轮轴，帮助这台名声在外的4A-G引擎更好地发挥其特点：输出更加令人雀跃的动力曲线，引擎响应更加犀利，扭矩随着转速提升而大幅增加。

在引擎控制单元方面，莫泰克电脑模块带来的是更卓越的操控，并让引擎的最大输出攀升至210ps，这也几近自然吸气调校下4A-G的物理性能极限了。排气方面选择的是爱驰凯思的中前段和特拉斯特的尾段，不仅提升了引擎性能，还能传递出更运动的声音。

关键位置的车身板件都进行了强化，以加强车身刚性，而在替换碳纤维引擎盖后，原厂净重足足被消去了100千克，减重效果明显。

悬挂方面应用了经典的AE86升级件，并额外添加了丰田赛车开发中心的悬挂套件，配合上轻盈的车身与加固的底盘，新的悬挂系统可带来更优异的倾角控制和更高的入弯速度。

brandCentral.en:
The TS030 Hybrid was Toyota's first ever hybrid race car,
designed for endurance events.

Developed to compete in the 2012 24 Hours of Le Mans
and World Endurance Championship...

...Toyota spent years refining its THS-R hybrid system.

The final product was realized through a collaboration between
Higashi-Fuji Technical Center and Toyota Motorsport.

Although its debut at Le Mans fell short of
the company's expectations...

It went on to claim an impressive 2nd place in the WEC!
brandCentral.zh:
TS030 Hybrid是Toyota有史以来制造的第一款混合动力赛车原型车，

是专门为参加2012年勒芒24小时耐力赛和世界耐力锦标赛
而开发的……

Toyota花费了数年时间完善其THS-R混合动力系统。

最终产品在东富士技术中心和Toyota Motorsport的通力合作下
诞生。

虽然未能在勒芒耐力赛的首次亮相中取得期望的成绩……

但随后在世界耐力锦标赛上技惊四座，夺得了亚军！

vehicleCollection.en:
The revolutionary hybrid-powered racing prototype that waged war at Le Mans and the WEC.

The TS030 hybrid prototype race car waged battle in the 2012 24 Hours of Le Mans and the WEC (World Endurance Championships) as one of the first hybrid-powered machines to step onto the international motorsports stage.

As its name suggests, the TS030 succeeds the TS010 and TS020, Toyota's awesome race cars that competed at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the 1990s. What sets the TS030 apart from its predecessors is its hybrid powertrain.

The THS-R system (Toyota Hybrid System-Racing) was developed by Toyota's production hybrid development team and the East Fuji Research Lab's motorsports department. The car utilizes a newly designed naturally-aspirated 3.4-liter V8 and a Denso motor unit built into the rear gearbox. Power is stored in an electric double-layer capacitor.

The drivers of the TS030 were Alexander Wurz, Nicolas Lapierre and Kazuki Nakajima. For the 24-hour race, a second car, driven by the formidable lineup of Anthony Davidson, Stéphane Sarrazin and Sébastien Buemi, was added.

At its first Le Mans race, the TS030 ran at the top of its class, but was forced to retire due to accidents and problems. However, the car made up for its shortcomings in the WEC. Of the six races the TS030 ran, it won three times, took three pole positions, and set four fastest laps. And although the car didn't partake in every race of the series, it still managed to take 2nd overall at the end of the WEC season.
vehicleCollection.zh:
参加勒芒24小时耐力赛和世界耐力锦标赛的原型赛车，采用混动系统。

TS030 Hybrid是由丰田研发的原型赛车，参加了2012年的勒芒24小时耐力赛和世界耐力锦标赛。

从其名称可以看出，这款车来自1990年代参加了勒芒24小时耐力赛的一系列车型，例如TS010和TS020，主要的区别就在于其使用了混合动力系统。

THS-R（丰田混合系统赛车）的动力系统由丰田量产版混合动力系统的研发团队与东富士实验室的赛车运动部门联手开发，使用了全新设计的3.4升V8自然吸气引擎。电量储存单元并非电池，而是一个双电层电容器。电装电机单元内置在后变速箱内。

驾驶这台赛车的车手是亚历山大·武尔茨、尼古拉斯·拿派尔与中岛一贵。在参加勒芒24小时耐力赛时，第二辆车的车组成员是实力强大的安东尼·戴维森、斯特凡·萨拉赞与塞巴斯蒂安·布耶米。

在其勒芒24小时耐力赛的首秀中，这款车排名一度靠前，但因事故和故障被迫退赛。但随后他们证明了这台赛车在勒芒表现出的速度并非昙花一现，从世界耐力锦标赛的第4轮开始不断创造佳绩。在参加的6站赛事中赢得了3站冠军，取得了3个杆位和4次最快圈速成绩。尽管并未参加全部的赛事，但依然在世界耐力锦标赛的总排行中位列第2。
