dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
Toyota has been entering hybrid racing cars into Le Mans
since 2012...

...with its first victory coming in 2018.

While its cars displayed impressive performance year after year,
they couldn't quite translate those speeds into victories.

There were some close calls, though. In 2016, one of its cars stopped
at the front of the pack, with just one lap to go!

The victorious Porsche team couldn't believe its luck.

In any case, this just made Toyota’s 2018 victory sweeter.
I remember it clearly—I was so happy!

What's more, Toyota would go on to win five in a row,
its most recent win being in 2022!
dialogues.zh:
自2012年以来，丰田一直致力于将混合动力赛车投入
到勒芒的比赛当中……

他们的首个胜利直到2018年才姗姗来迟。

在此之前，这些赛车每每都展现出令人惊叹的速度，
但却始终无法将这种速度转化为胜利。

不过，期间也有过几次胜利触手可及的时刻——2016年，
领跑车阵的丰田却在离终点只剩下一圈时抛锚了！

就连捡漏的保时捷车队都不敢相信自己的好运气。

不过，这些挫败只是让2018年的胜利变得更加甘美。
我清楚记得当时的感受——我当时高兴坏了！

更激动人心的是，丰田在之后的五年里连战连捷，
其中也包括2022年新鲜出炉的一胜！

dialogues.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
dialogues.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师
dialogues.en:
The TS050 Hybrid is the pride of Japan, and one car that
I’d really like to take to the track!

2016 was the year that Toyota introduced the bright white,
red, and black colour scheme for its GAZOO Racing cars.

It was also the year that two TS050s faced off against
the Porsche 919 at Le Mans.

Tragically, a mere 6 minutes from the finish line, the lead
Toyota car suffered engine trouble and lost the race.

However, in 2018, 33 years after its first Le Mans appearance,
Toyota took home an incredible overall victory.

It was the first Japanese car to do so since the Mazda
787B’s win in 1991.<next id=1901006 type
dialogues.zh:
TS050 Hybrid是日本的骄傲，同时也是我
非常渴望在赛道上驾驶的一款车！

2016年，Toyota为旗下所属的GAZOO Racing车队引入了
鲜艳的白色、红色和黑色配色方案。

这一年也是两辆TS050与Porsche 919在勒芒
展开激烈对决的一年。

不幸的是，距离终点仅有6分钟时，领先的Toyota赛车却遭遇
引擎故障，输掉了比赛。

不过，在2018年，在距离首次亮相勒芒已经
过去33年之际，Toyota却取得了令人难以置信的全面胜利。

这是继1991年Mazda787B赢得比赛后，日本车队首次在勒芒夺冠。

不过，这些挫败只是让2018年的胜利变得更加甘美。
我清楚记得当时的感受——我当时高兴坏了！

更激动人心的是，丰田在之后的五年里连战连捷，
其中也包括2022年新鲜出炉的一胜！

brandCentral.en:
This prototype, introduced at Le Mans in 2016, was yet another
effort from Toyota to grab that elusive title.

The naturally-aspirated V-8 of its predecessor, the TS040,
was replaced with a twin-turbocharged V-6.

In fact, almost everything, from the battery system to its
aerodynamics, was totally redesigned.

Although its 1000ps power output was similar to the TS040,
the way it behaved on the track was totally different.
brandCentral.zh:
作为Toyota追逐胜利的最新尝试，这辆原型车在2016年勒芒耐
力赛上粉墨登场。

其前任车型TS040采用的自然进气V8引擎在这款车上被换成
了V6双涡轮增压引擎。

而事实上，从电池系统到空气动力学方案，车辆的每一
个方面都进行了重新设计。

它的输出功率虽然和TS040类似，都是1000ps，但驾驶体验却有
天壤之别。

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's hybrid LMP1 car was developed to dominate the World Endurance Championship.

The TS050 Hybrid was Toyota’s prototype race car, developed in 2016 to compete in the LMP1 class of the FIA World Endurance Championship, which included the legendary 24 Hours of Le Mans. Two years earlier, in 2014, Toyota had claimed the series championship with the TS040 Hybrid. By 2015, however, the team finished the season in 3rd place, prompting Toyota to design the TS050 from scratch to reclaim the top.

Like its predecessor, the TS050 was an all-wheel-drive hybrid, employing MGUs at both the front and rear wheels. But the powertrain switched from the naturally-aspirated 3.7-liter V-8 to a twin-turbocharged, direct-injection 2.4-liter V-6. Its supercapacitor system was replaced with a high-power lithium-ion battery, specially developed for racing and capable of rapid energy storage and deployment. The total system output stood at 1000ps, equal to the TS040’s, but torque was significantly boosted thanks to turbocharging.

Further refinements included a more compact front MGU, which enabled aerodynamic redesigns to channel airflow more efficiently under the car, further sharpening its performance.

Toyota Gazoo Racing fielded two TS050 Hybrids in the World Endurance Championships. One car was piloted by Kazuki Nakajima, Sébastien Buemi, and Anthony Davidson, while the other was shared by Kamui Kobayashi, Stéphane Sarrazin, and Mike Conway. In 2016, the Kobayashi entry demonstrated blistering pace and remained in contention for the Drivers’ Championship, but in the end, the team concluded the season ranked 3rd in the Manufacturers’ standings.
vehicleCollection.zh:
丰田的混合动力勒芒原型车1级车型，专为在世界耐力锦标赛中夺冠而设计。

TS050 Hybrid是一款原型赛车，由丰田于2016年研发，专为征战国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛勒芒原型车1组别而打造，著名的勒芒24小时耐力赛即为该组别赛事之一。在此之前的2014年，即两年前，丰田曾凭借TS040 Hybrid在该赛事中夺魁。2015赛季，丰田以年度季军收官。而TS050赛车就是为此全新研发，志在重夺冠军宝座。

与前代车型相同，这款赛车仍采用全轮驱动混合动力架构，前后轮均配备电机单元，但动力总成实现了重大革新：从原有的3.7升自然进气V8引擎升级为2.4升双涡轮增压直喷V6引擎。储能装置由具备快速充放电特性的超级电容器，更换为专为赛事研发的高功率锂离子电池，其能量存储密度显著提升。包括引擎与前后电机在内的系统总输出功率达到1000ps，虽然在参数上与TS040持平，但得益于涡轮增压技术的应用，扭矩输出获得了显著提升。

此外，前轮电机单元的布局更为紧凑，这一设计优化使得气流能够更有效地被导流至车底，从而进一步提升空气动力学性能。

丰田图像赛车车队派出两辆TS050 Hybrid赛车出战世界耐力锦标赛。其中一辆由中岛一贵/塞巴斯蒂安·布埃米/安东尼·戴维森执驾，另一辆则由小林可梦伟/斯特凡·萨拉赞/迈克·康威执驾。2016年，小林可梦伟所属车队展现出强劲的竞速实力，一度是车手总冠军的有力争夺者，但最终只以赛季总排名第三名收官，同时在制造商排行榜上同样收获季军。-

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
This is no ordinary pickup truck. It's a super truck,
capable of dominating on dirt tracks and oval circuits.

Any mention of a Tundra makes me think of the Baja 1000
desert race.

It's an all-night race that takes place on a 1,600 km
course in the Mexican desert.

It's a challenging race, with more than half the cars entered
never seeing the finish line.

Toyota took on the Baja with this Tundra tuned by TRD,
and the truck won in its class.

And, did you known that the Tundra TRD also
raced on oval race tracks?

In 2019, it entered a survival event in Daytona, winning a
race in which only nine out of 32 cars finished.
dialogues.zh:
这不是一辆普通的皮卡车。这是一辆真正的超级卡车，
在泥地赛道和椭圆赛道上都占据着统治性的地位！

一提到坦途，我就会想到巴哈1000沙漠越野赛。

这场在墨西哥沙漠举办，赛程长达1600km的比赛
全部在夜晚举行。

这是一项艰苦卓绝的赛事，每次都有半数以上的参赛车
辆会因为各种原因退赛。

Toyota公司带着这辆由丰田赛车开发中心改装过的坦途参加了比赛，
并在本级别中揽获冠军。

此外，你知道坦途丰田赛车开发中心也曾在椭圆赛道上比试过吗？

2019年，它参加了在戴通纳举行的生存赛，在一场32辆
汽车中只有9辆完赛的比赛中取得最终的胜利。

...Th-This car!

杰里米就是喜欢赛车，他是名副其实的赛车死忠粉！

brandCentral.en:
The Tundra is Toyota's entry into the full-size
pickup truck segment.

The TRD Pro is the so-called "sports version" of this
versatile vehicle.

As its name suggests, it was produced by TRD, Toyota's
in-house motorsports division.

Thanks to specially produced dampers and wheels, this truck
was able to reach high speeds over the roughest of terrains.

Power was supplied by a 5.7-liter V-8 engine.

Combine that with 4WD capability, this massive beast
could also tow almost anything anywhere.
brandCentral.zh:
Tundra是Toyota在全尺寸皮卡领域最引以为豪的成就。

这款TRD Pro版本相当于这台多功能车型的“运动版”。

它由Toyota的内部汽车运动专业团队TRD负责开发……

它的特制避震和车轮能够在哪怕最崎岖的地形上达到令
人乍舌的高速。

依靠性能强大的5.7L V8引擎

和四轮驱动传动系统，您可以轻松地驱动这台超过2.5吨
的怪物。

vehicleCollection.en:
Toyota's large pickup was equipped with a unique suspension system to maximize its sporting performance.

Toyota decided to go after Ford and Chevy in the heartland of America by offering a large pickup truck called the Tundra to the North American market.

The Tundra struggled at first, as it was smaller than its competition, and unable to sway die-hard Ford and Chevy fans from ditching their F-150s and Silverados. So for the second-generation model which was introduced in 2007, Toyota made its truck even bigger and dropped a larger engine into it. While it wasn't enough to dethrone the American brands, it was a great success in the marketplace.

In 2014, the bodywork was made more aggressive, and in 2015 the “TRD Pro” version was introduced. Tuned by TRD, Toyota’s motorsport arm, the new truck performed significantly better on rough roads, thanks to TRD coils and Bilstein dampers that improved the stroke characteristics of the suspension.

The TRD Pro disappeared from the Tundra lineup afterward, but returned again in 2019. Based on the Crewmax 4x4 with a 5.7-liter V8, the suspension was further tuned with Fox dampers, and its sporting character was enhanced with equipment such as a new hood scoop and BBS wheels.
vehicleCollection.zh:
丰田的全尺寸皮卡使用了独特的悬挂系统和配件，可最大程度发挥运动性能。

坦途是丰田专为北美市场开发的全尺寸皮卡。

第一款车型的尺寸不够大，因此销售情况很不理想。于是丰田在2007年推出二代车型时扩大了车身和发动机排量，销量直线上升，坦途也成为爆款车型。

从2014年开始，小改款的坦途外观更有力量。丰田随后在2015年推出了由赛车部门调校的“丰田赛车开发中心高级”车型。该车型利用丰田赛车开发中心线圈和倍适登阻尼器来改善悬挂的冲程特性，以提高糟糕路况时的行驶性能。

丰田赛车开发中心高级之后曾从产品线里消失过一段时间，但在2019年重返销售目录。新款基于搭载5.7升V8引擎的克鲁麦4x4改装，悬挂进一步强化并配备了狐狸减震器，再加上新的引擎盖进气口和BBS轮毂等配件，让这款皮卡的运动性能更加卓越。

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
Now, this is what I call a British sports car!

The hardcore radical quality here is expressed throughout,
from the interior to its exterior appearance.

The car's spirit is hardly diplomatic.

It's as if this vehicle is saying,
"I have no desire to be a star to the public."

And, at the same time, it exemplifies the pure and naive love
that we feel for sports cars.

On the sexy body, which sits extremely low for a front-engine
car, there's a cold round detail that totally lacks emotion.

The hood, sculpted and low other than around the engine,
and the corresponding trunk lid...

...express a powerful driving force.

In this regard, the styling goes well beyond what
many would accept, for love sees no fault.

This design generates indifferent feelings,
captivating only those who understand it.
dialogues.zh:
看啊，这才是我眼中真正的英国跑车！

从内饰到外观，这辆车浑身都散发着不羁和激进。

摒弃圆滑和世故，展现永不妥协的精神。

实际上，它似乎完全无意迎合大众口味。

与此同时，它也向我们表达了对一款纯血、直击本质的
跑车的热爱。

对于一辆前置引擎车来说，它的车身异常低矮流畅，
圆弧的车身细节也显得极度冷漠，不带一丝感情。

引擎盖深深下凹，只有引擎位置高高隆起，
行李箱盖处也采用了同样的设计……

……露出一副动力充盈、跃跃欲试的模样。

其外观设计已经远超大众能够接受的审美范围，
唯有真正的爱好者方能欣赏。

这是一款必然引发争议的设计，只对那些懂它的人
散发无穷魅力。

对于一辆前置引擎车来说，它的车身异常低矮流畅，
圆弧的车身细节也显得极度冷漠，不带一丝感情。

引擎盖深深下凹，只有引擎位置高高隆起，
行李箱盖处也采用了同样的设计……

……露出一副动力充盈、跃跃欲试的模样。

其外观设计已经远超大众能够接受的审美范围，
唯有真正的爱好者方能欣赏。

这是一款必然引发争议的设计，只对那些懂它的人
散发无穷魅力。

usedCar.en:
The TVR Tuscan Speed Six is a racing car that exudes
the thrill of the track.

It features a 'Speed Six' 4L straight-six engine developed
by TVR themselves.

With its mighty roar and exceptional torque, it's no
wonder the engine features in the name of the car!

Despite boasting a maximum power of 360ps,
it weighs in at a mere 1100kg.
usedCar.zh:
TVR Tuscan Speed Six这款赛车能把赛道本身的刺激
体现得淋漓尽致。

它搭载了由TVR自主开发的
“Speed Six”4升直列六缸引擎。

该款引擎能发出巨大的轰鸣声，拥有非凡的扭矩，
难怪这款车型冠名了它的名字！

尽管拥有高达360ps的最大马力，
这辆车却只重1100kg。

vehicleCollection.en:
This unique machine offers a classic sports car feel to enthusiast drivers of today.

TVR, a name derived from the first name of founder Trevor Wilkinson, is noted for making high-performance specialty cars, British coachworks style.

The company's first production car, the Grantura, made its debut in 1958, and featured the skillful combination of components from existing production cars such as Volkswagens and Austin Healeys, wrapped in sporty, head-turning body styles.

Another model was the Tuscan, that, despite its racing struggles in the 1960s, was resurrected in 2000, armed with a bevy of new features. The 2-seat, 2-door car didn't share the styling of its predecessor. It came equipped with a detachable roof, making it look as good as a convertible as it did as a coupe.

Its eye-catching exterior, highlighted by a wild face, made the car look big, but in fact, the car possessed modest dimensions. Its overall length, width and height measured 4235mm, 1810mm and 1200mm, respectively, while the wheelbase was stretched to 2361mm. The Speed 6 got its name from the number of cylinders in the engine.

Two inline-6s were available; a 3.6-liter model and a 4.0-liter model. The latter featured the day's latest racing technologies, including dry-sump lubrication. Output was rated at 365ps and 42.86kgm of torque, and when this power was coupled with the car's lean 1100kg body, the Speed 6's acceleration was impressive, to say the least. It sprinted to <100km/h> in less than 4.0 seconds, making it one of the quickest cars of its day.
vehicleCollection.zh:
独特的双门跑车，在今天又重现了经典跑车的观感。

特维尔公司以创始人特雷沃·威尔金森的名字而命名，这是一家研发专业车辆的英国汽车制造商。他们的首款量产车是1958年上市的Grantura。从那时起，他们就树立起自己独特的风格，以玻璃纤维强化塑胶车身搭配来自大众和奥斯汀-海利等公司量产车的部件，制造拥有高驾驶性能的车辆。

2000年上市的Tuscan是继承了一款同名跑车精髓的新车，后者曾是1960年代在各大赛道上闻名遐迩的著名车款。

这款双门双座轿跑风格独特，在车身多处使用了圆润的曲线设计，和其初代型号几乎没有相似之处。如今它依然是全球最风格独特的造型之一。

由于这诱人的造型，车体的尺寸看起来相当大，但实际上整车还是比较紧凑的，尺寸仅为4235mm长，1810mm宽，1200mm高。轴距也相当短，只有2361mm。

动力单元是一台自主研发的4升双顶置凸轮轴6缸引擎。名称中的“Speed 6”也正是来自这台6缸引擎。它配备了干式润滑系统和油式冷却，6缸直列节流阀体则负责控制进气，制造工艺堪比赛车发动机。

动力输出为365ps，最大扭矩是42.86kgm，可让只有1100kg重的车身迅猛加速。

从各个角度来看，这都不是一款非常现代的车款，但却是一辆可以享受纯粹的，不经雕琢的跑车体验的车款。

catch.en: This unique machine offers a classic sports car feel to enthusiast drivers of today.
catch.zh: 独特的双门跑车，在今天又重现了经典跑车的观感。

dialogues.speaker: Chris
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
The Volkswagen Type 1 is one little car that made
a big splash in automotive history.

Designed as a functional civilian car by none other than
Ferdinand Porsche…

...its distinctive rounded shape resulted in the nickname,
"Beetle."

Its production run spanned more than 60 years, producing
21,529,464 units from the 1940s to the early 2000s.

Thus, the Type 1 is considered one of the most historically
significant cars ever.
dialogues.zh:
这是一款在汽车史上掀起巨大波澜的小型车。
这款车正是由费迪南德·保时捷所设计的
实用型民用车……

由于其独特的造型，获得了“甲壳虫”的昵称。

Type 1是久盛不衰的经典车型，
在汽车产业热销超过60年……

从20世纪40年代到21世纪初，
总共卖出了21,529,464辆……

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
Did you know that the Volkswagen Beetle and the Porsche 911
have some common linkages?

The Beetle was designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche,
the founder of Porsche Automobiles.

It sports a horizontally-opposed engine at the back of the
car that drives the rear wheels...

Yes, precisely! It's a rear-engine, rear-wheel-drive car!

Dr. Porsche carried design elements from the Beetle over to
the first Porsche sports car, the Porsche 356...

...and later the Porsche 911.

What started out as a small people's car
ended up as a genuine sports car.

While there may be a world of difference
between the two...

...the fact that they share a horizontally-opposed engine,
RR-layout and the same creator is truly fascinating!
dialogues.zh:
你知道大众甲壳虫和保时捷911之间有一些
共同的联系吗？

甲壳虫是由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计的，他同时也是
保时捷汽车的创始人。

甲壳虫的车身后部配置了一台水平对置引擎，用于驱动后轮……

这使它成为了名副其实的后置引擎、后轮驱动车型！

保时捷博士后来将甲壳虫的设计元素应用到了第一辆保时捷跑车，
保时捷356……

以及后来的保时捷911上。

可以这么说，最初的小型民用汽车设计最终却变成了真正的跑车。

虽然现在两者之间可能有天壤之别……

但它们都采用水平对置引擎、后置后驱布局，并且
发明者都是同一个人的事实确实耐人寻味！

dialogues.speaker: Freeman Thomas
dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The lovable Bug continues with the 1966 VW 1200 Beetle.

This version has enlarged front and rear windows.

The first-generation Pretzel's split rear window
changed in 1953 to a larger oval rear window.

In 1958, the rear window changed again
and became even larger.

With this model...

...the demand for better visibility, lighting, power, and
safety caused the three-arch silhouette to evolve again.

But the original character and charm remained.

The last production air-cooled Beetle came in 2003.

Just think, 21,529,464 units built since 1945! That’s quite
a run, and it’s still popular!<
dialogues.zh:
1966大众1200甲壳虫延续了甲壳虫的可爱风格！

这个车型加大了前后车窗。

第一代“椒盐卷饼”的分块式后窗于1953款更换为了
更大片的椭圆形后窗。

在1958款中，后窗又经历了改进，尺寸进一步增大。

而到了这个车型中……

出于更好的可视性、轻盈感、动力和安全的需求，
引擎盖3个拱的形状轮廓又一次发生了进化，

但原先的特色和魅力得到了保留。

最后一款风冷引擎的甲壳虫一直生产到2003年。

你想象一下，从1945年起到现在，这款车一共造了21529464辆！

这是多么漫长的生命周期啊。而且直到现在，
甲壳虫都还很有人气！%

vehicleCollection.en:
Its cute silhouette and rear-engine layout made this car an icon in automobiledom.

The Volkswagen Type 1, better known as "The Beetle" and "The Bug," can arguably be called the most universally loved automobile in history. "The People's Car," as it was known in Germany when it was introduced in the late 1930s, was designed by none other than Dr. Ferdinand Porsche.

The Type 1's most distinctive design features were its cute-looking round silhouette and air-cooled 4-cylinder rear-mounted engine (rear engine/rear-wheel drive layout). This engine would be the predecessor found in a long line of Porsche cars, featuring a flat or Boxer layout. Perhaps most remarkable of all was its production volume and longevity: 21 million cars were produced from 1938 all the way up to 2003.

dialogues.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
Now, this is one aggressive Beetle!

It's a car that proves the motorsports potential
of the good ol’ bug.

Take note of its extremely low stance, wide
motorsport fenders...

...and the exhaust pipe jutting out from its front
arch!

Its large five-spoke wheels are typical of Volkswagen’s
expert design team.

And, its body is simply brimming with confidence.

Indeed, it exudes the luxury that only a top-tier
design studio can deliver.

And the bright graphics contribute nicely to the overall
look of the car.
dialogues.zh:
哇，这可真是一辆外观凶悍的Beetle啊！

它的存在证明了平日的小可爱
也具有赛场竞速的巨大潜力！

请注意它极低的车身姿态，宽大的
赛车级挡泥板……

以及顺着前轮拱突出的排气管！

它采用了大号五轮辐轮毂，这也是
Volkswagen专业设计团队的专属。

它的车身也从头到尾彰显着一股自信。

这份自信源自它所呈现出的奢华品质
——只有顶级的设计工作室能够实现。

车身上各种鲜艳显眼的几何图案更是为
整体外观锦上添花！

This Gran Turismo-exclusive Gr.3 race car is based on

With its wide fenders and missing roof, there's not
much of the original car left in this machine.

vehicleCollection.en:
This Gr.3 race version of the Volkswagen Beetle is on an entirely different level to the road-going model.

The Beetle is an important part of Volkswagen’s history and heritage. But beneath its charming exterior lies a rich motorsport pedigree. It enjoyed its moment in the racing spotlight as far back as the 1950s. Early in its storied history, the Beetle won the East African Safari Rally three times and held its own in the Acropolis Rally in Greece. The reborn Beetle, which debuted in 1998, even inspired its own one-make racing series. In more recent years, it achieved notable success in the Global Rallycross in the U.S.

This Beetle Gr.3 is a model that traces this racing legacy of the Beetle. Its extensively reworked exterior and internals embody the spirit of racing success that Volkswagen has achieved over decades of competition.

The body has been widened to accommodate larger-diameter wheels, while the roofline has been lowered to reduce frontal area, resulting in a silhouette reminiscent of a classic chop-top Beetle. The aggressive front spoiler, functional air outlets channeling flow from the front tires to the door panels, and the towering rear wing all speak volumes about this car’s performance pedigree.

At its heart lies a DOHC 2.0-liter inline-4 paired with a high-pressure turbocharger, mated to VW's proven 7-speed DSG transmission. While output is adjusted according to Balance of Performance (BoP) regulations for each race, rest assured, it packs more than enough punch to compete fiercely in the Gr.3 category.

This racing Beetle exists in an entirely different realm from the charming, street-going Beetles you might be familiar with.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆组别3竞赛级别甲壳虫与可爱的公路版本甲壳虫完全是两个层次。

甲壳虫是大众汽车历史传承的重要组成部分。与那可爱外观截然相反的是，这款车型在赛车运动中的光辉历史可以追溯到1950年代。在早期，甲壳虫曾三次赢得东非萨法里拉力赛，并在希腊雅典卫城拉力赛中也曾名列前茅。1998年曾有一款专为单一赛事准备的甲壳虫推出。而近年来，这款车型在美国的环球跨界拉力赛中也屡有上佳表现。

这辆甲壳虫组别3是追随甲壳虫往昔竞速传奇的车型。从内到外的大幅改装中蕴含着大众多年来孕育的赛车运动胜利精神。

车身加宽以容纳尺寸更大的轮毂，车顶压低来减小正面横截面，使其造型更接近经典的平顶式甲壳虫。前扰流板、前轮到车门的出气道，加上后部的大型尾翼充分代表了这辆车的性能水平。

动力系统由一套2升双顶置凸轮轴直4高压涡轮增压引擎和大众久经考验的7档直接换档变速箱组成。它的动力由不同赛事的性能平衡设置决定，自然也足以应对组别3的竞争。

这辆赛车版的甲壳虫与你在街上看到的可爱甲壳虫不可同日而语。

usedCar.en:
The first-generation Golf GTI has become a true classic because
it ushered in a new generation of European hot hatches.

Like many hatchbacks of its day, it employs an FF layout,
or front-engine/front-wheel drive.

The car's 1.6-liter inline-4 produces 110ps.

Its rock-solid stability on straights, combined with its balanced
handling, make it a fun car on winding roads.

The Golf's styling was penned by acclaimed designer
Giorgetto Giugiaro.

Thanks to his amazing talents, the Golf has become one of
the most recognized cars on the road.
usedCar.zh:
第一代Golf GTI是真正的经典，它是
现代传统高性能掀背车的先驱。

它采用前置前驱布局：
前置引擎前轮驱动系统。

1.6L的直列四缸引擎可产生
高达110ps的马力。

它在直道上坚如磐石的稳定性，结合稳固
的操作性，使它成为车手最可靠的选择。

Golf的造型出自备受赞誉的设计师
Giorgetto Giugiaro。

他的设计使得这款车成为
最具辨识度的公路车之一。

vehicleCollection.en:
This grandfather of hot hatches balanced everyday usability with a fun-to-drive nature.

When the time came for Volkswagen to create a successor to the legendary people's car, the Beetle, it came in the form of the Golf in 1974. Unlike the Beetle, however, the Golf had its engine up front powering the front wheels (FF), and this format would define the company's compact cars to this day.

The revolutionary packaging was a hit with the public, spurring VW to produce a number of variations on the Golf theme. Included among them was the GTI, which made its debut at the 1975 Frankfurt Motor Show.

Based on the 2-door Golf LSI, the GTI came powered by a 1.6-liter SOHC inline-4 whose compression ratio was boosted to 9.5:1 and featured Bosch fuel-injection. The end result was an engine that produced 110 ps at 6100 rpm and 14.0 kgm of torque at 5000 rpm. The car's handling saw dramatic improvements as well. The suspension was strengthened and counterbalanced, with custom shocks and springs that stiffened ride quality but improved the car's cornering nature. Also assisting in this department were 175/70R13 tires.

The Golf GTI enjoyed great popularity, and improved gradually over the years. In 1979, it received a 5-speed manual transmission, then in 1981 a 4-door model was added, and at the end of 1982, a 1.8-liter inline-4 was introduced. The Golf GTI set the standard for VW's compact cars to this day.
vehicleCollection.zh:
小钢炮车型的鼻祖，在日常用途的同时提供更多驾驶乐趣。

1974年5月，大众宣布推出olf，一款仍将持续定义紧凑级别车型的汽车。高尔夫的爆红促使大众开发出了更多的高尔夫车型。其中的运动车型被命名为GTI，并在1975年的法兰克福车展上首次亮相。

GTI的开发基于高尔夫的2门LSE车型，将一台1.6升的顶置单凸轮轴直列4缸引擎的压缩比直接提升到了9.5，再辅以博世出品的燃油喷射系统，可带来6100rpm时的110ps最大马力输出和5000rpm时的14.0kgm最大扭矩。除此之外，GTI的悬挂系统也较原版做了相应强化，安装了专用型号的弹簧和避震。加宽后的轮拱罩容纳下了更宽的175/70R13轮胎。围绕前格栅一圈的亮红色线条奠定了GTI系列代代沿袭的标志性装饰。

兼顾日常使用的理念帮助高尔夫GTI在市场上大获成功，而且彻底扭转了运动驾驶意味着难以忍受的不适感这一刻板形象。由此，GTI长达30年的演进历史正式开启。

dialogues.en:
This is the seventh-generation Golf GTI.

The first GTI established the high-performance
three-box hatchback theme...

That is still very popular around the world.

Since then, the GTI has undergone several evolutions.

While there were a few duds over the years,
this GTI was definitely a ‘hit’.

The size of the car has been gradually
growing with each evolution.

This seventh-generation model got everything right,
from the way it sits to the way it moves.

Not only were these elements balanced, but together
they contributed to creating something better.
dialogues.zh:
这是一辆七代Golf GTI。

它采用三厢掀背设计，并搭载动力强劲的性能套件。
这也是从初代起就确定的设计思路。

每一代Golf GTI的推出，都会经历一些演化和改变。

多年以来，有些改变成功了，而另一些则不尽如人意。
这一台，是成功的幸运儿之一。

历代的车身尺寸在演化中逐步扩大，

这一代的Golf GTI就做到了将所有的要素搭配地恰到好处。

它们的结合形成了运动的姿态，强大的气势和灵活性，
同时还散发出一种和谐感与力量感。

vehicleCollection.en:
The GTI version of the 7th-generation Golf ups its handling performance.

When the 7th-generation Golf made its debut in 2012, the car seemed more or less a carryover from the previous model; however, once Volkswagen revealed the changes made under the sheet metal, it was clear that the new Golf was a different breed altogether from its predecessor.

The platform was thoroughly refreshed, highlighted by a newly developed modular MQB system that significantly heightened driving performance, improved ride quality and increased safety. The Golf has long been considered the benchmark of the C-segment class, but the new version raised the bar even higher, leaving engineers from America, Japan and Korea scratching their collective heads.

In fact, the bar was raised so high that the sport-tuned Golf models were making sports car makers nervous. Both 3-door and 5-door GTIs possessed a high level of performance that could satisfy the most critical enthusiast. Under the hood was an intercooled-turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4, with the output improved from 210ps of the previous GTI to 220ps. This improved the 0-<100km/h> acceleration time of the car from 6.9 seconds to 6.5, and increased its top speed to <246km/h> from <240km/h>.

The new GTI shined in the handling department as well. Advancements in the “XDS” electronic control differential lock, which acts as a limited-slip differential, was improved to give the GTI super crisp turn-in response. The adaptive chassis control called “DCC,” along with the utilization of progressive steering, improved the Golf’s overall stability and cornering speed.

Also of note, the new GTI featured BlueMotion technology, a first for this model. Adding a brake energy recovery system and a start-and-stop mechanism, the new car was greener than before. Safety was also enhanced, thanks to a pre-crash brake system and lane assist.

The Glf GTI has always been known as a giant killer, and the new 7th-gen iteraion embraced that role as never before.
vehicleCollection.zh:
7代高尔夫的GTI版本，操作性能达到巅峰。

于2012年在其祖国面世的第七代高尔夫表面上看起来只是一辆传统的高尔夫，并没有显著的改变，但其内在已经有了惊人的进化。

在这款历久弥新的平台上，使用了一套全新设计的横向模块化平台，以将驾驶性能、乘坐体验和安全性提升到全新的层次。即便是基础车型也具备了超越其档次的豪华驾驶舒适感。作为C级轿车长久以来的代表型号，高尔夫再一次提升了该等级车辆的性能标杆。

这一点在其3门和5门的GTI跑车型号上也不例外。引擎采用2升直列4中冷式涡轮增压TSI，动力输出从之前款式GTI的210ps提高到了220ps。这也将其0-<100km/h>加速时间从6.9秒降低到了6.5秒，最高时速从<240km/h>提高到了<246km/h>。

值得注意的另一点是进一步改善的操控性。“XDS”电子差速器锁定系统（效能等同于限滑差速器）、适应性底盘控制“DCC”与渐进式转向的使用大幅度改善了高尔夫的稳定性与弯道速度。

这一车型也在GTI系列史上首次使用了蓝驱技术。而刹车动能回收系统和自动启停机制的引入，大幅度改善了其环保效能。此外，该车型还增加了诸多安全功能，例如撞击自动刹车系统与车道保持辅助系统。

高尔夫 GTI自面世起就以跑车杀手的形象示人，而这款第7代型号毫不含糊地继承了这一特性。

cars.nameEn: Volkswagen GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo
cars.nameZh: Volkswagen GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo

brandCentral.en:
The spirit of the GTI was glorified with the GTI Roadster
Vision Gran Turismo!

This sporty, open-top 2-seater is a stunner!

You'll notice that its body makes use of various design
motifs from previous GTI models.

But perhaps the most striking aspect of its design
is the incredibly low-cut windscreen.

Appearances aside, it comes powered by a potent 510ps
twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6.

Power is transferred to all four wheels, making this thing
an amazing handling machine.
brandCentral.zh:
GTI的精神在GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo车型上得到了
完美延续！

这款动感十足的敞篷双座车是一件真正的尤物！

您或许已经注意到其车身设计上对前几代GTI的诸多借鉴。

不过，最引人注目的设计可能还是那低平到令人难以置
信的挡风玻璃！

撇开外观不谈，此车配备了一台高功率的510ps的3L V6双涡
轮增压引擎，

与四驱系统形成良好的组合，可在赛道上提供巨大动力！

vehicleCollection.en:
This supercar with the GTI's DNA possesses race car-like acceleration.

The alluring "GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo," created by Volkswagen Design, embraces the successful history of the GTI in its flowing lines. The style-defining design elements from various GTI generations illustrate the rich history of the model, and you can tell by just looking at it, notably the low-cut windshield, that this roadster promises great fun and excitement behind the wheel.

Powered by a 3.0 twin-turbo VR6 TSI engine, the GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo delivers 503 HP with a hearty helping of 665 Nm (67.8kgm) of torque. The 7-speed dual-clutch transmission with sports programming ensures phenomenal acceleration and fast gearshifts on the racetrack.

An aerodynamically optimized front and rear spoiler, together with an integrated diffuser element at the rear, combine to generate gobs of downforce. Fitted with 20-inch wheels that are shod with 235/35 front and 275/30 rear tires, the all-wheel-drive sports car stays glued to the driving surface in all types of conditions. Stopping power is provided by ventilated ceramic brakes, 380 mm in diameter at the front and 356 mm at the rear.

The "GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo" is presented in a bright, intense Gran Turismo Red, a modern interpretation of the classic GTI red.

The result is a fascinating and exceptionally dynamic extreme sports car with a sophisticated design for the racetrack that appropriately conveys what it's like to drive in the GTI world.
vehicleCollection.zh:
体验极限加速性能。具有“GTI”血统的超跑。

基于成功GTI的基因，大众设计研发了一款特征鲜明的超级跑车：“GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo”。

其设计源自 GTI 的成功历史：将史上多款GTI车型的经典设计元素融入该车不断进化的外观。这款双座敞篷车在创新设计的外观之外，还将展示响应快速的驾驶体验——迅猛的加速通过极低的前风挡就能看出来。

“GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo”的动力由一具3.0双涡轮增压VR6 TSI引擎提供，带来503有效马力和665 牛·米（67.8kgm）的惊人扭矩。7档双离合变速箱和运动模式程序的引入确保了极佳的加速性能和在赛道上的快速换挡能力。

前后扰流板均经过空气动力学优化，尾部加入了扰流翼，带来了优秀抓地力所需的下压力。轮胎尺寸为20英寸，前轮为235/35，后轮为275/30，强大的扭矩可通过四个驱动轮直接传递到路面上。这款超级跑车配置了具备通风能力的陶瓷刹车系统，前轮直径为380mm，后轮直径为356mm。

“GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo”的外观使用明亮的跑车浪漫旅大红色，是经典GTI红的现代演绎。

最终展现给大家的是一辆卓越不凡的终极跑车，专为赛道准备的精良设计，让玩家可以切身体验到在GTI的世界中尽情驰骋的独特感受。

Powered by a 3.0 twin-turbo VR6 TSI engine, the GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo delivers 503 HP with a hearty helping of 665 Nm (67.8kgm) of torque. The 7-speed dual-clutch transmission with sports programming ensures phenomenal acceleration and fast gearshifts on the racetrack.

An aerodynamically optimized front and rear spoiler, together with an integrated diffuser element at the rear, combine to generate gobs of downforce. Fitted with 20-inch wheels that are shod with 235/35 front and 275/30 rear tires, the all-wheel-drive sports car stays glued to the driving surface in all types of conditions. Stopping power is provided by ventilated ceramic brakes, 380 mm in diameter at the front and 356 mm at the rear.

The "GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo" is presented in a bright, intense Gran Turismo Red, a modern interpretation of the classic GTI red.

The result is a fascinating and exceptionally dynamic extreme sports car with a sophisticated design for the racetrack that appropriately conveys what it's like to drive in the GTI world.
long.zh:
基于成功GTI的基因，大众设计研发了一款特征鲜明的超级跑车：“GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo”。

其设计源自 GTI 的成功历史：将史上多款GTI车型的经典设计元素融入该车不断进化的外观。这款双座敞篷车在创新设计的外观之外，还将展示响应快速的驾驶体验——迅猛的加速通过极低的前风挡就能看出来。

“GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo”的动力由一具3.0双涡轮增压VR6 TSI引擎提供，带来503有效马力和665 牛·米（67.8kgm）的惊人扭矩。7档双离合变速箱和运动模式程序的引入确保了极佳的加速性能和在赛道上的快速换挡能力。

前后扰流板均经过空气动力学优化，尾部加入了扰流翼，带来了优秀抓地力所需的下压力。轮胎尺寸为20英寸，前轮为235/35，后轮为275/30，强大的扭矩可通过四个驱动轮直接传递到路面上。这款超级跑车配置了具备通风能力的陶瓷刹车系统，前轮直径为380mm，后轮直径为356mm。

“GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo”的外观使用明亮的跑车浪漫旅大红色，是经典GTI红的现代演绎。

最终展现给大家的是一辆卓越不凡的终极跑车，专为赛道准备的精良设计，让玩家可以切身体验到在GTI的世界中尽情驰骋的独特感受。

brandCentral.en:
The GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo is a hint of what
the future may hold for the Golf GTI.

This hatchback-styled vehicle is, in fact, a powerful
two-seater sports car!

The classic Golf's chassis has been upgraded for racing,
with a lower centre of gravity and much lighter weight.

It's also equipped with four-wheel drive and an engine
capable of more than 500ps.

Pretty impressive for a Golf, eh?
brandCentral.zh:
GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo为
Golf GTI的未来埋下了伏笔。

这款掀背车在骨子里是一款强大的双座跑车！

经典的Golf底盘针对赛事进行了升级，重心更低，重量更轻，

而且还配备了四轮驱动系统和能够输出超过500ps动力的引擎。

对于一辆Golf来说，相当诱人吧？

vehicleCollection.en:
The ultimate GTI; there's a reason this car's name includes "Supersport."

Volkswagen developed a new sports car for the digital world when it unveiled the 2-seat “GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo." The designers and engineers injected the DNA from the legendary GTI into this car, before further refining the car's design and performance. The car came equipped a 503-hp VR6 TSI engine that was mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. Power was transferred to all four wheels via VW's 4MOTION four-wheel-drive system. Thanks to a whopping 665 Nm (67.8kgm) of torque, this car provides amazing acceleration, while its handling was tuned specifically for the “Gran Turismo” race tracks.

The body of the “Supersport” was aerodynamically optimized through numerous features. The front-end, for instance, was fine-tuned, with the designers placing the vertical light modules further outboard. They are now connected by a spoiler element to underscore the width of the GTI and enhance its visual presence. The air flow through the body was enhanced with a large air inlet that boosts aerodynamic performance at the front. The airstream flows past the front wheels and is practically sucked out of the wheel arches in order to cool down the brake discs. The hallmark GTI honeycomb structure adorns all the air inlet and outlet openings.

Aerodynamics and cooling are just as important in the strengthened rear section: downstream of the roof spoiler, a rear wing creates the necessary downforce to keep the rear end stable. An aerodynamic feature on the roof ensures that the airflow to the rear wing is ideal. Furthermore, air flows through the rear wheel arches in order to optimally dissipate the thermal energy produced during braking. The flat rear lights have been visually adapted to the extraordinary flat and dynamic proportions of the rear end.

Like the “Roadster,” the “Supersport”was also fitted with 20-inch GTI alloy wheels. The multipiece GTI wheels ere refined further to a five-spokes design finished in ultralight carbn fiber Between the wheels, the two classic GT stripes can be foun above the side sill, an homageto the Golf GTI I. The sme appies to the halmark black fil around the edges of the rear window, which is finished in a carbon-fiber look. A hlmet compartment and a racig tank have also been bult ito the car. The “G Supersport iioh Gran Surismo” coes in io four colors eflex Silver, Gran Turismo Red, apiz Blue and Oryx White.
On digital acetracks around the world, the unmistakably charismatic looks o the new eTI Superport ision Gran Turismo” is sure to catch more than a few tares ab make the competitioh nevu.

大众为数字世界设计了一款新的跑车，这便是双座的“GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo”。设计者与工程师们从传奇的GTI系列的基因中获取视觉与技术上的要点。在进一步的研发中，标志性的紧凑型跑车风格再一次被重新演绎，并被503有效马力的VR6 TSI引擎驱动。7档双离合变速箱将动力通过4动四轮驱动系统传递到赛道上。最高可达665 牛·米（67.8kgm）的扭矩带来强劲的推力。这款车的操控特性针对跑车浪漫旅的赛道做了特别调校。

尽管其造型是对GTI概念的进一步演绎，高尔夫的经典设计元素还是一眼即可认出。从概念的角度来说，整个虚拟GTI的概念便是为赛道的物理法则服务：通过对外观比例与车体表面的优化，设计师们达成了卓越的性能——较低的重心、空气动力学优化的前部和极高的下压力。车身表面特定部位和其他细节部分使用的碳纤维材料进一步降低了重量。

vehicleCollection.en:
This supercar with the GTI's DNA possesses race car-like acceleration.

Based on successful GTI DNA, Volkswagen Design has developed a highly distinctive supercar: the “GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo”.

The design owes much to the successful history of the GTI: style-defining design elements from the various GTI generations illustrate the extraordinary evolution of this vehicle. Boasting a visionary design, the Roadster promises an immediate driving experience – the extreme acceleration can be experienced directly through the low-cut windscreen.

Powered by a 3.0 twin-turbo VR6 TSI engine, the "GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo" delivers 510ps with an enormous torque of 665 Nm (67.8kgm). The 7-speed dual-clutch transmission with sports programming ensures phenomenal acceleration and fast gear-shifts on the racetrack. 

An aerodynamically optimized front and rear spoiler, together with an integrated diffuser element at the rear, achieve the required downforce for excellent road-holding. Fitted with 20-inch wheels in size 235/35 (front) and 275/30 (rear), the massive torque can be transferred reliably to the track via 4 driven wheels. The supercar features ventilated ceramic brakes, 380mm in diameter at the front and 356mm at the rear.

The "GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo" is presented in a bright, intense Gran Turismo Red, a modern interpretation of the classic GTI red.

The result is a fascinating and exceptionally dynamic extreme sports car with a sophisticated design for the racetrack in which players can gain a unique impression of what it’s like to drive in the GTI world.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.

Volkswagen introduced the first production version of its ID.
series of battery electric cars in 2020.

This ID.R played a symbolic role in the launching
of the new brand.

An all-electric racer, it was fitted with two electric motors
in the front and back that produced 680ps.

And, an AWD system efficiently transferred the power
down to the ground.

A competitor in global time trial events since 2018,
the ID.R set several world records during its heyday.

It was the first car to break the so-called "eight-minute
barrier" at the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb.

Pikes Peak is the world’s premier hill climbing event,
held annually in Colorado, USA.

At the Nürburgring Norschleife in Germany, it beat the
previous record set by an electric car by 60 seconds.

And, it was the first car to finish under 40 seconds at the
legendary Goodwood Festival of Speed in England!
brandCentral.zh:
大众的ID.系列纯电动车在2020年推出了
它的第一个量产车型。

这款ID.R在新品牌投放和推广时起到了标志性的作用。

作为一辆全电动赛车，它的前部和后部各安装了两个电机，
能够输出680ps的功率。

由四轮驱动系统有效地将庞大的动力通过车轮传送到路面上。

自2018年以来，ID.R就开始参加全球范围内的计时赛事，
并已经创造了多项世界纪录。

它是第一辆在派克峰国际爬坡赛上打破“八分钟大关”的汽车。

该比赛是世界上首屈一指的爬坡赛事，每年在
美国科罗拉多州举行。

在德国的纽博格林北侧赛道，它以缩短整整1分钟的成绩
打破了之前由电动汽车创造的记录。

同时，它也是第一辆在传奇的古德伍德赛车节上
以低于40秒的成绩完赛的汽车！

vehicleCollection.en:
The prototype EV that rewrote speed records around the world.)

As the threat of global climate change looms ever closer, automotive manufacturers are pushing forward with electrification to reduce carbon dioxide emissions. Volkswagen was one of the first companies to take up the challenge. The company introduced its ID brand in 2020, which included a radical performance machine that showed the awesome performance potential of electric vehicles. This car was the ID.R prototype race car.

The ID.R's body was constructed of carbon-fiber, with oversized wings placed on the front and rear to produce maximum downforce. At 5.2m long, the car was relatively large, but weighed less than 1100kg. The dual-motor 4WD system produced 500 kW (680ps) / 650 Nm (66.3kgm), allowing for a 0-100km/h acceleration time of just 2.25s. These performance statistics rivaled those of race cars with internal combustion engines.

In the real world, the ID.R competed in numerous motorsports events around the world and produced amazing results. At the 2018 Pikes Peak Hill Climb, driver Romain Dumas set a record of 7 minutes 57 seconds, the first ever run to break the 8-minute barrier. At the Nürburgring Nordschliefe, the ID.R set the record for fastest lap by an EV at 6 minutes 5 seconds. At the Goodwood Festival of Speed, the car became the first to ever finish the legendary hill in less than 40 seconds with a record of 39.9s.

Since the birth of the automobile, people have been enamored with the pursuit of speed. The ID.R is proof that even in the age of electrification, this fascination lives on.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款原型电动车在世界各地“刷圈速”。

在全球气候变化的危机渐渐逼近的当下，各大车厂为了降低碳排放，纷纷推进动力系统的电气化。大众就是率先对这一挑战作出回应的公司之一。他们在2020年推出了全电动品牌“ID.”，计划打造出一辆可以代表电动车无限可能性的模板车型。这项计划的成果就是这款ID.R原型赛车。

ID.R的车身采用碳纤维材料，为了产生最大下压力，车身前后都安装了超大尺寸的扰流翼。整车长5.2m，属于大型车的尺寸，但车身重量仅为1100kg。它的双电机四轮驱动系统可以输出最大500千瓦（680ps）/650 牛·米（66.3kgm）的动力，可以在2.25秒内实现0-100km的加速。凭借出色的性能参数，它完全可以与使用内燃机引擎的赛车扳扳手腕。

在现实里，这辆ID.R也参加了全世界范围内的多项汽车运动赛事，取得了多项破纪录的成绩。在2018年的派克峰国际爬坡赛中，车手罗曼·杜马创下了7分57秒的佳绩，也是赛事历史上首次突破8分钟大关。之后在纽博格林北侧赛道上，ID.R又创下了6分5秒的电动车最快单圈记录。在古德伍德赛车节上，这辆车首次在40秒内完成了这项传奇爬坡赛，创下了39.9秒的世界记录。

自从汽车诞生以来，人类便痴迷于追求更快的速度。这辆ID.R就证明了即便在电动时代，速度的魅力依旧如初。

catch.en: The prototype EV that rewrote speed records around the world.)
catch.zh: 这款原型电动车在世界各地“刷圈速”。

brandCentral.en:
This fifth generation Polo GTI is a petite hot hatch
that's a size smaller than the Golf...

Which stands to reason, as the original Polo debuted
in 1975 as the Golf’s 'little brother'.

This generation Polo GTI came with two different engines
depending on whether it is an early model or late model,

But this is the late model that debuted in 2014,
which came with a turbocharged 1.8L inline-4 cylinder engine.

It's capable of producing 192ps and 25.5kgm of torque
from just 1250rpm!

Small but speedy, this model also features an upgraded
chassis and improved handling.
brandCentral.zh:
这台第五代Polo GTI是一款身材娇小的高性能掀背车，它的
尺寸比Golf还要小……

有鉴于原版Polo在1975年就是作为Golf的“小弟”首次亮相，
这也是理所当然的。

这一代Polo GTI的早期车型和晚期车型使用了不同的引擎，

您眼前的这款是2014年亮相的晚期车型，它有一台涡轮增
压的1.8L直列四缸引擎，

能在仅仅1250rpm的转速下，产生192ps的动力和25.5kgm的扭矩！

小而轻快就是它的代名词。此外，这款第五代产品的底
盘和操控也经过了改进！

vehicleCollection.en:
The 'hot' version of the 5th generation Polo uses an advanced engine setup."

The Polo, one of the core models in Volkswagen's lineup, has been considered a benchmark for B-segment cars around the world, and the fifth-generation model, introduced at the 2009 Geneva Motor Show was no exception.

The new Polo featured bold styling cues that differentiated it from other B-segment entries. It was also greener than its predecessor, thanks to a smaller engine and a super efficient 7-speed DSG transmission. The sporty GTI model made its debut in 2010, equipped with a new 1.4-liter direct injection inline-4 that came with both a turbo and supercharger. It produced 179ps/25.5kgm that allowed the GTI to run from zero to <100km/h> in 6.9 seconds and reach a top speed of <225km/h>. What's more, fuel economy was rated at <16.6 km/L>, the best ever for a Polo.

With ground holding improvements including sports suspension and electronic devices that perform the same function as a limited-slip differential, the Polo GTI was one of the best handling machines in its segment, with some even claiming that it was right up there with its bigger brother, the vaunted Golf GTI.

In 2014, the GTI model received a facelift. One of the most notable changes is the new engine. Now featuring a 400cc larger 1.8L inline-4 turbo engine, the maximum power output had increased to 192ps. Extra power isn't the only difference, as the fuel efficiency had also been greatly improved, consuming much less fuel than the 1.4L GTI.
vehicleCollection.zh:
第五代Polo的“高性能”版本使用了先进的引擎配置。

Polo是大众产品线的主力车型之一，比高尔夫的级别更加紧凑。不过这款车囊括了更高级别的高尔夫拥有的一切优质特性，由此成为了全世界B级紧凑车型的参照物。

在2009年的日内瓦车展上，Polo正式更新到第五代。其外观风格设计和同期推出的六代高尔夫非常相似，更简洁、大胆的线条与市面上的其他B级车区分开来。考虑到环保规范要求，引擎排量被进一步降低，并换上了更高效的7速双离合变速箱。

2010年公布的高性能GTI型号的特征如下，1.4升直喷涡轮增压+机械增压配置，尽管排量比以前的模式小，性能方面比上一代提高了29ps/3.1kgm，达到了179ps/25.5kgm。7 速双离合变速箱可实现的最高速度，且0到<100km/h>的加速仅需6.9秒。底盘也进行了升级，配备运动悬架和电子设备，具有与限滑差速器相同的功能。该模型还以其出色的操控响应而著称。

2014年，GTI车型进行了改款。最显著的变化之一是新引擎。现在配备更大的 1.8升直列4涡轮增压发动机，最大功率输出增加到 192ps。额外的动力并不是唯一的区别，因为燃油效率也得到了极大的提高，比1.4升GTI 消耗的燃油少得多。

dialogues.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪
dialogues.en:
The VW Sambabus is truly a design icon, with a design
language that’s whimsical and endearing.

It literally makes you smile.

It’s basically a functional box with rounded
corners full of character.

This "23" Window Sambabus has a fully-opening
pull-back cloth sunroof...

...windows that go round to the back corners,
and "panorama" windows on top.

Its color palette greatly adds to its visual charm.
dialogues.zh:
VW的“Sambabus”是一款真正的设计代表作，它的设计语言
充满奇思妙想，同时又惹人喜爱！

不夸张地说，看到它你就会不由自主地露出微笑！

它的车身可以用长方体盒子来概括，再加上特征鲜明
的圆润边角。

这款“23”窗的Sambabus拥有可完全打开的
后拉式布制天窗……

以及从前一直环绕延伸到后方边角的大量侧窗，
顶上还有“全景式”的一圈边窗。

而丰富的车漆色系也为它的视觉魅力增色不少！

usedCar.en:
Volkswagen has a number of famous models aside from
the Beetle, such as the "Camper."

Officially known as the Type 2, it's based on the Type 1,
which we all know better as the Beetle.

Like the Type 1, it has a rear-engine/rear-drive layout,
which we refer to as RR.

Because the designers kept the air-cooled flat-4 engine low,
there's a surprising amount of interior space.

Like the Beetle, plenty of tuning parts are available, allowing
owners to customize the car to their heart's content.
usedCar.zh:
这又是一款闻名世界的Volkswagen车——人们
亲切地称它为“露营者”。

它的官方代号为Type 2，是
基于Type 1——“甲壳虫”而开发的车型。

这辆车采用了后置后驱布局，搭载了一台风冷平置
四缸发动机。

较小的引擎尺寸为搭载货物让出了空间。

由于它的调校件非常好找，这辆车
开起来非常有意思。

vehicleCollection.en:
With maximum interior space in a small body, this cute bus was highly efficient.+

The Volkswagen created by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche had a plethora of ideas packed in the small bodies, as well as infinite possibilities. The cars were developed into a variety of variants, from off-road cars for battlefields, to sports cars like the Porsche 911.

This Sambabus is an example of its transformation into a van with a large luggage space. Because the engine is mounted in the rear in the same manner as the old Volkswagen Beetle, the nose is extremely short. And because of the flat horizontally opposed engine, the floor of the luggage room is not very high. This is an example of the Volkswagen mechanism proving its superiority, in attaining the maximum space in a minimum body size.

The actual height of the car is relatively low at less than 1600mm, and it is said this is because they did not want to raise the air resistance with a high height. Still, because the floor of the car was very low to the ground, it had more space than its rivals, and it was also very high in cost performance. Its small turning radius thanks to its short wheelbase, and the versatility of its compact size also gave it a lot of advantages as a commercial van.

The round headlights and the rounded front end design was practical but humorous, and is often used as a motif of other custom cars. Volkswagen is well aware of the important image of the Sambabus, and has already introduced this in taller wagon concept cars.
vehicleCollection.zh:
具有露营车风格，以最小的体量实现了最大的内部空间。"

费迪南德·保时捷博士所创立的大众汽车将大量的创意和无限的可能性都集中在小小的底盘上。各种各样的车款由此被开发出来，从战场越野车到保时捷 911这样的跑车，不胜枚举。

桑巴面包车就是这样的一个例子，通过增大行李空间成为了一款多功能旅行车。由于引擎和老式的大众甲壳虫一样被安装在后部，因此车头非常短。由于使用扁平的水平对置引擎，让行李舱的地板高度得以降低，这是大众在最小的车身尺寸中获得最大空间的典型手法。

这款车的实际高度相对较低，不足1600mm，据说这是因为车身较高会增大风阻。不过，由于这款车的地板距离地面非常近，因此拥有比竞争对手更大的空间，性价比也更高。由于轴距较短，这辆车的转弯半径较小，紧凑的车身带来的通用性也使其作为一款多功能旅行车具有许多优势。

圆形的头灯和车头设计原本是出于实用考虑，但从外观上看来十分可爱，而且经常被其他定制车型所参考。大众深知桑巴面包车形象的重要性，已经在车身更高的该类别概念车中引入了这一元素。

catch.en: With maximum interior space in a small body, this cute bus was highly efficient.+
catch.zh: 具有露营车风格，以最小的体量实现了最大的内部空间。"

long.en:
The Volkswagen created by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche had a plethora of ideas packed in the small bodies, as well as infinite possibilities. The cars were developed into a variety of variants, from off-road cars for battlefields, to sports cars like the Porsche 911.

This Sambabus is an example of its transformation into a van with a large luggage space. Because the engine is mounted in the rear in the same manner as the old Volkswagen Beetle, the nose is extremely short. And because of the flat horizontally opposed engine, the floor of the luggage room is not very high. This is an example of the Volkswagen mechanism proving its superiority, in attaining the maximum space in a minimum body size.

The actual height of the car is relatively low at less than 1600mm, and it is said this is because they did not want to raise the air resistance with a high height. Still, because the floor of the car was very low to the ground, it had more space than its rivals, and it was also very high in cost performance. Its small turning radius thanks to its short wheelbase, and the versatility of its compact size also gave it a lot of advantages as a commercial van.

The round headlights and the rounded front end design was practical but humorous, and is often used as a motif of other custom cars. Volkswagen is well aware of the important image of the Sambabus, and has already introduced this in taller wagon concept cars.

The foundation for this Gran Turismo Gr.4 original race car
was the Volkswagen Scirocco.

The small front splitter and rear wing, although modest,
make a huge positive impact on the car's aerodynamics.

Its compact size makes it extremely nimble, and despite being
a front-wheel-drive car, it can handle with the best of them.
brandCentral.zh:
打造这辆原创跑车浪漫旅Gr.4级别赛车时使用的基础
车型是一台Volkswagen Scirocco。

小尺寸的前定风翼和尾翼表明这款车在外形改装方面采
用了较为温和的做法。

无论是前置前驱布局的优秀稳定性，还是Scirocco那指向明确
的过弯性能都在这台车上得到了保留。

vehicleCollection.en:
This attractive coupe possessed the sharp cornering ability of a full-fledged sports car.

Thanks to its sporty and stylish nature, the Volkswagen Scirocco became a popular 3-door model in the 1970s and 80s; however, it ultimately faded into automotive oblivion by the early 1990s. Just when we thought we heard the last of the Scirocco, it made a triumphant return in 2008 as a hot new hatchback based on the popular VW Golf platform.

The new Scirocco continues where the last one left off, offering plenty of sport for the economy-minded enthusiast. Its turbo-/supercharged 1.4-liter TSI engine gained high praise for its performance when it debuted in 2008, but the following year, an even better powerplant was introduced under the hood of the hot Scirocco R. This car was so impressive that it won its class in the Nürburgring 24-hour race two years in a row.

The Scirocco R's lowered ride height and wide body hinted at its high-performance nature: it wore special side skirts and a roof spoiler reminiscent of the successful Nürburgring race car. Its suspension and brakes were greatly improved, and the 2.0-liter TSI direct-injection turbocharged engine produced an impressive 256ps at 6000rpm—the same as the Golf R. But while the Golf R utilized 4-Motion all-wheel drive, the Scirocco remained front-wheel drive to keep its weight low. As a result, it is 120kg lighter than the Golf R at 1410kg.

With its dynamic engine sound, sharp cornering capability and convenient utility, the Volkswagen Scirocco is the rare car that fulfills every boy racer's heart for spirited driving while also serving the role as everyday commuter.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
vehicleCollection.zh:
堪称完成体的运动双门跑车，过弯干净利落。

于2008年强势回归的大众尚酷是一款双门跑车，使用高尔夫的基础组件研发。

具备涡轮与机械增压的1.4 TSI引擎在其面世时就因性能卓越而备受赞誉，但2009年就有性能更加出色的型号出现了。这便是尚酷 R，一款灌注了尚酷经验和技术的新车型，后者连续两年在其组别中赢得纽博格林24小时耐力赛。

该车的低车身和宽体造型预示着优秀的抓地力。其还配备了特别的前/后保险杆，侧边包围和车顶扰流板，与纽博格林参赛车型相似。当然，悬挂与刹车系统也大幅改进，2.0 TSI直喷涡轮增压引擎，加上双离合变速箱带来了256ps/6000rpm的强劲动力。这款引擎也使用在几乎同期面世的高尔夫 R上。不过，高尔夫R使用的是4动四轮驱动系统，尚酷依然采用了前轮驱动设计来保持较轻的重量。

因此，其1410kg的车重足足比高尔夫 R轻了120kg，也是大众产品阵容中速度最快的高配置跑车型号。

具备了动态的引擎声音、犀利的转向性能和日常功能，这是一款可以同时满足日常使用与跑车驾驶感受的车型。

*这款车型已按照跑车浪漫旅的组别4规则进行过特殊调校。'

If you're searching for a powerful FF sports car,
I would recommend the Scirocco R.

It comes with upgraded suspension and brakes, and turbocharged
2.0-liter inline-4 that produced 250ps.

While its specs are similar to the Golf R, it is about 120kg
lighter, thanks to the absence of the 4WD system.

You can really feel the weight difference when
taking sharp corners.
brandCentral.zh:
如果您想寻找一辆动力出众的前置前驱跑车，我推荐Scirocco R！

此车配备了升级的悬挂和刹车系统，以及一台2L直列四
缸涡轮增压引擎，可以产生250ps动力。

虽然规格上与Golf R相似，但由于去掉了四驱系统，所以
重量要比后者轻120kg。

在过急弯时，您就可以切实感受到这种差异了。{

usedCar.en:
There aren't many front-engine/front-wheel-drive cars out there
that you can call sporty, but the Scirocco R is one of them.

With its low height and wide body, you can tell that the
2-door coupe is all business just by looking at it.

Hidden under the sheet metal is a custom sport-tuned suspension
that gives the Scirocco R real sports-car handling.

And the car's turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 packs a mean
250ps punch, making it a monster on the race track.
usedCar.zh:
想要一款前置前驱跑车来帮助你从人群中脱颖而出？
大众尚酷R就能够满足你的需求。

尚酷R具有低高度、宽车架的特点，其设计
自豪宣称专为赛车运动而生。

专属定制的悬挂和刹车设计使得它能够在
弯道拥有卓越表现...

它的2L直列四缸涡轮增压引擎能够产生最高250ps马力，
使它远比一般车辆的动力更为强大。

2008年回归的大众尚酷是一款使用高尔夫的基本组件而开发的双门运动车。

那台涡轮机械双增压1.4TSI引擎初次亮相就博得了满堂彩。在2009年，大众再次引入性能更高的版本：尚酷R，融入了大量从连续两年蝉联纽博格林24小时耐力赛同级别冠军的尚酷身上获取的技术。

它的离地间隙和宽体造型无不昭示着其强大的抓地性能。特制的前后保险杠，侧边包围和车顶扰流板都让人联想起那台纽博格林参赛车辆。悬挂和刹车系统也得到了大幅强化，搭配双离合变速箱的2.0TSI涡轮增压缸内直喷引擎在6000rpm时能够给出256ps。采用同款引擎的高尔夫R也在差不多时间粉墨登场。与使用4motion四驱系统的高尔夫R不同，尚酷因为车重考虑，保留了前轮驱动的布局。

也因此，它比1410kg的高尔夫R轻了120kg，从而成为了大众产品线中速度最快的高配运动车型。

振奋人心的引擎声，干净利落的过弯性能搭配上日常所需的功能配饰，绝无仅有的混搭让尚酷填补了兼顾日常使用和竞速的车型定位空白。

dialogues.speaker: Jeremy
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史
dialogues.en:
More than anything, I associate the Volvo 240 series
with racing.

The 2-door sedan turbo model made a big splash at European
and German touring car championships.

So much so that its hallmark boxy shape earned it
the nickname ‘the Flying Brick.’

Racing performance aside, this Estate model
is a legend among legends.

Between 1974 and 1993, the Volvo 240 series sold
some 2.7 million units...

Of which, 950,000 were the Estate model. Now, more than
thirty years after its retirement...

It remains the classic estate car that people
all over the world still love to this day!
dialogues.zh:
在我心目中，Volvo 240系列都堪称非常优秀的赛车。

其中的2门轿车涡轮增压版本曾在欧洲和德国的房车
赛事中引起了巨大轰动。

由于影响力巨大，乃至于其方块状外形
为它赢得了“飞砖”的昵称。

除了比赛表现之外，这款Estate车型在市场上也堪称
传奇中的传奇。

在1974到1993之间，Volvo 240系列总共售出了
大约270万台……

其中95万台都是Estate型号。即便在停产超过三十年的
现在……

它依然是全世界车迷所深爱的一款经典旅行车！

usedCar.en:
Say the word "estate" to European car enthusiasts, and they're
bound to think of the Volvo 240 Estate.

This station wagon made its debut in 1974 and enjoyed a long
life, with a production run that stretched for two decades.

Although it was discontinued more than thirty years ago,
the model remains popular to this day.

Built with the philosophy of form following function,
the 240 provides excellent outward vision and superb handling.

Some users have logged several hundred-thousand kilometers on
their vehicles, so you can bet it's a reliable machine.

Sure, it may not be fast, but it's stylish and has plenty of luggage
space, making it the ideal companion for extended road trips.
usedCar.zh:
当你听到“旅行车”这个词时，第一个浮现在脑海里的
一定是Volvo 240 Estate。

在1974年首次亮相后，这一车型持续生产了近二十年。

尽管停产已超过三十年，但时至今日它的人气依然很高。

它不仅有充足、高效的宽敞储物空间，还能够提供优秀
的视野和一流的操控性。

像这样一辆设计虽然简单、但永不过时的可靠车型，安全行
驶数十万公里也不在话下！

虽然速度并不是它的优势，但无论何时、不论去哪，
你都会想与它同行。

vehicleCollection.en:
A historic model that epitomized the station wagon.

Back in the day, when someone uttered the name Volvo, many people tended to envision a station wagon. Until SUVs became popular in the late 1980s, station wagons were considered the ultimate family utility vehicle, and the one model that epitomized this genre was the Volvo 240 Estate.

When the 240 was introduced in 1974, it featured a number of different body styles, including the "244" sedan, the "242" coupe and the "245" 5-door wagon. The last digit in these numerical designations denoted the number of doors of the model.

It wasn't until 1983 that these variants were consolidated into a single 240 model. The model was introduced with round headlights, but were replaced with the company's iconic square lamps in 1979. The exterior appearance of the 240 was timeless, remaining largely unchanged until production of the vehicle ended in 1993. But in terms of safety, it was always on the cutting-edge, with airbags and ABS offered as standard equipment. The Estate was extremely popular, making up one-third of the 240 sales mix in an era when sedans were the "in" thing.

One of the most notable features of the 240 Estate was its styling. Its boxy exterior became its most distinguishable feature. It emphasized "safety" with its long overhangs, front and rear that incorporated ample crumble zones. This resulted in the car's characteristically long thin silhouette.

Like the exterior, the car's cabin was characterized by a simple yet functional design that defined cars made in Scandinavia at the time.

Although not particularly powerful, the engine was robust and capable. Ride quality was excellent, thanks to a well-tuned suspension system. Everything about the 240 Estate made drivers want to pack their bags and head out on an extended road trip to enjoy the countryside.

It took quite some time unti the 240 was recognized for its historical significance. It's rare for a ar to retain such a following well after its production run had ended.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款拥有特殊历史意义的车型让全世界对旅行车爱不释手。

当人们提及沃尔沃时，想到的往往是旅行车。而每每提及旅行车时，第一联想到的也是沃尔沃。这样的“固定搭配”在汽车领域持续了许多年，直到1980年代末，全球SUV大行其道时才有所改观。为沃尔沃巩固了这种地位的经典车型便是240伊斯代。

240系列最初在1974年首次亮相，产品组合里包括“244”4门轿车、“242”2门版本以及“245”5门旅行车。其车型名称中的第三位数字代表车门的数量。

在近10年后的1983年，三大车款被合并为统一的“240”型号。首次亮相时，系列车型采用了圆形车头灯，而其标志性的方形大灯直到1979年才千呼万唤始出来。240的生产一直持续到1993年，在此期间，它保留了大部分的原版外形设计，但安全功能却始终紧跟最新技术，加入了例如安全气囊和防抱死刹车系统等标配功能。即便在豪华轿车销量如日中天的时代中，沃尔沃总产量的三分之一以上依然由旅行车车型所占有，这也证明了伊斯代在整个240产品线中人气有多么高。

240伊斯代最引人瞩目的特色便是它的车身外观，不论从哪个角度看都呈现出棱角分明的方形轮廓。较长的前悬车头结构提供充足的碰撞缓冲体积，而车尾后悬结构也同样够长，能同时提供碰撞缓冲和更大的行李空间。整体凸显出特点鲜明的瘦长轮廓。

其内饰同样也体现了典型的北欧设计哲学，简单但重视功能性。这种务实风再搭配上柔软舒适、与沙发相差无几的座椅，成为了这款车的诸多亮点之一。

尽管性能不算特别强大，但它的引擎非常可靠，而悬挂系统也采用简单却高效的机械设计，可以提供稳定流畅的驾驶体验h这种搭配让你只想放慢车速，不疾不徐地体验驾车旅行7乐趣。

尽管在停产之后，240才逐渐得到全世界车_的认@，晋升为汽车历史上最伟大K车型之一。但\这样一辆日常实用车型W够得到如此广泛}热爱*实属不@。

dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏
dialogues.en:
Yes, I can recall when this Volvo V40 debuted like it was yesterday.
It was in 2012, if I’m not mistaken.

It was a 5-door compact hatchback that exemplified
the company's dedication to practicality and safety.

What’s more, it had beautiful coupe-like styling.

I’ll have you know, this styling borrowed many design cues
from the great Volvos of the 1960s.

We're talking P1800 and 1800ES, for instance.
dialogues.zh:
没错，我还依稀记得这辆Volvo V40首发时的情景。
如果我没记错的话，那是在2012年。

这是一款5门紧凑型掀背车，从头到尾贯彻了Volvo
那久经考验的实用性哲学。

此外，它还采用了雅致的双门轿跑外形风格。

我必须要告诉你，这种设计风格从来自1960年代的
伟大Volvo车型身上吸取了不少的灵感。

例如P1800和1800ES之类的经典Volvo车型！

dialogues.speaker: Fabio Filippini
dialogues.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监
dialogues.en:
The Volvo V40 is a pleasant 5-door hatchback
with a sporty demeanor...

...most notably the T5 R-Design version.

Its exterior design conveys an excellent balance
of Latin fluidity and Scandinavian rigor.

In fact, it borrows styling cues from
the historic Shooting Brake P1800 E...

...a car that possessed an Italian flavor, thanks to the
contribution of Sergio Coggiola and Pietro Frua.

What a source of inspiration!

Note the small hollow on the side shoulder
and the rounded glass rear window.

These elements recall one of the most iconic cars
of the Swedish brand.
dialogues.zh:
Volvo V40是一款舒适惬意、带有跑车元素的5门掀背车……

尤其是产品阵容中的T5 R-Design版本。

它的车身外形在拉丁风格的流畅唯美和北欧风格
的严谨坚毅之间取得了傲人的平衡。

它的外形设计借鉴了独具历史意义的Shooting Brake P1800 E……

而科焦拉和弗鲁阿贡献的设计为这款经典车型
赋予了浓厚的意大利风格底蕴。

真是非常了不起的灵感来源。

注意它车身侧面车肩部分的小凹陷和后车窗的
圆弧形玻璃。

这些设计元素带领我们重新领略了这家瑞典品牌
历史上标志性车型的风采。

vehicleCollection.en:
The globally successful Volvo that served as a sedan, estate and coupe.

The V40 was revealed at the 2012 Geneva Motor Show as a C-segment 5-door hatchback. Although positioned as Volvo’s entry-level model, it played a significant role in the lineup, effectively replacing three models: the S40 sedan, V50 wagon and C30 three-door hatchback.

Developed from the ground up, the car was designed to combine the comfort of a sedan, the practicality of a wagon and the sporty appeal of a coupe.

While the underlying structure shared elements with a Ford-derived platform, the styling marked a clear departure from Volvo’s traditionally conservative image. Drawing inspiration from the classic P1800 of the 1960s and the later 1800ES, it featured flowing lines and a distinctive silhouette that blended coupe and estate influences. The model was well received at launch, earning attention for both its design and versatility, with seating for four adults and usable cargo space.

The T5 R-Design stood as the sportiest variant in the range. Its 213ps turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-5 delivered strong acceleration, while a sport-tuned suspension and 18-inch wheels provided a balance of handling and ride comfort. Unique exterior elements, including a revised front bumper and rear diffuser, enhanced both aerodynamics and visual presence.
vehicleCollection.zh:
身兼轿车、旅行车和双门轿车三种身份，在全球范围内取得巨大成功的沃尔沃车型。

2012年日内瓦车展上发布的V40是一款C级5门掀背车。尽管定位是入门级车型，但V40在沃尔沃的产品谱系中扮演了非常重要的角色。它整合了三款不同车型：标准的S40轿车、V50家用旅行车以及运动型的C30 3门掀背车，成为综合性的平替。

为了让这辆车拥有轿车的舒适性、旅行车的实用性以及双门轿跑的年轻运动外形，沃尔沃选择从零开始开发这个项目。

其基础架构采用与福特车型通用的平台，但外观设计更加不受拘束，完全脱离了沃尔沃传统、保守的一贯形象。这辆车的设计中结合了60年代经典车型P1800和其后续改款1800ES的特色灵感，拥有流畅的线条和情绪饱满的轮廓，在视觉上模糊了双门轿车和旅行车之间的界线。这款车能够提供充足的空间和舒适度，能够轻易容纳4位成年人乘客和他们的行李。它一经推出便引爆市场，以其扎实的美学质感和强大功能吸引了全世界消费者的目光。

其T5 R-Design版本是系列中最具运动感的型号。它采用了213ps 2升直列五缸涡轮增压引擎，能够提供推背感十足的加速性能，而其运动型悬挂系统和18英寸轮毂则兼顾了灵敏的操作性和平稳流畅的驾乘体验。其特殊定制的前保险杠和后扩散器有效地提升了车身的空气动力学性能，更为这辆车塑造了一张更加硬朗、粗犷的面容。

Drawing inspiration from the classic P1800 of the 1960s and the later 1800ES, it featured flowing lines and a distinctive silhouette that blended coupe and estate influences. The model was well received at launch, earning attention for both its design and versatility, with seating for four adults and usable cargo space.

The T5 R-Design stood as the sportiest variant in the range. Its 213ps turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-5 delivered strong acceleration, while a sport-tuned suspension and 18-inch wheels provided a balance of handling and ride comfort. Unique exterior elements, including a revised front bumper and rear diffuser, enhanced both aerodynamics and visual presence.
long.zh:
2012年日内瓦车展上发布的V40是一款C级5门掀背车。尽管定位是入门级车型，但V40在沃尔沃的产品谱系中扮演了非常重要的角色。它整合了三款不同车型：标准的S40轿车、V50家用旅行车以及运动型的C30 3门掀背车，成为综合性的平替。

为了让这辆车拥有轿车的舒适性、旅行车的实用性以及双门轿跑的年轻运动外形，沃尔沃选择从零开始开发这个项目。

其基础架构采用与福特车型通用的平台，但外观设计更加不受拘束，完全脱离了沃尔沃传统、保守的一贯形象。这辆车的设计中结合了60年代经典车型P1800和其后续改款1800ES的特色灵感，拥有流畅的线条和情绪饱满的轮廓，在视觉上模糊了双门轿车和旅行车之间的界线。这款车能够提供充足的空间和舒适度，能够轻易容纳4位成年人乘客和他们的行李。它一经推出便引爆市场，以其扎实的美学质感和强大功能吸引了全世界消费者的目光。

其T5 R-Design版本是系列中最具运动感的型号。它采用了213ps 2升直列五缸涡轮增压引擎，能够提供推背感十足的加速性能，而其运动型悬挂系统和18英寸轮毂则兼顾了灵敏的操作性和平稳流畅的驾乘体验。其特殊定制的前保险杠和后扩散器有效地提升了车身的空气动力学性能，更为这辆车塑造了一张更加硬朗、粗犷的面容。

dialogues.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
dialogues.roleZh: 高性能车设计师
dialogues.en:
There are a variety of ways to express your passion for cars.

This machine is a 1951 Ford.

Not only has it been lowered, the roof has been left intact,
and the body itself has been made thinner.

The engine is from a Lincoln of the same era.

The car creators pulled off in real life what designers
today would only attempt on a computer screen.

Cars from this era were simple to tune, having the potential
for customization unlike those of today.

Find a basic design that you fancy, and then inject your
own sense of beauty and experience into it...

...and you have your own one-of-a-kind masterpiece.

Every detail of this car is a 100-percent reflection of the
tastes and experiences of the car owner and creator.

Compare it with today’s exotic cars that await customers in the
showrooms, which one do you think stands ou more?
dialogues.zh:
表达对爱车的热情的方式可谓五花八门。

这是一辆1951年的福特。

它的全车车身经过了降低，没有锯掉车顶，
但整车外壳接受了打薄处理。

它的引擎来自于一辆同时期的林肯。

这辆车的创造者赤手空拳就做到了如今的汽车设计师们
只敢借助电脑才能完成的事。

与今天的车不同，来自那个时代的车辆易于调校，
也有很大的改装潜力。

找一辆你中意的基础车型，然后将你的美学与经验
倾注其中……

就能拥有一辆独一无二的杰作。

这辆车上的每个细节都100%体现了它的所有者
与创造者的品味与经验。

与如今静静地在展厅中等待着买家的豪车相比，
你更喜欢哪一辆呢？"

brandCentral.en:
Held in Las Vegas, Nevada, the SEMA Show is the world's
largest automotive aftermarket event.

The car you see here, the Wicked Fabrication GT 51...

...won the "Best in Show Gran Turismo Award" at the
2016 SEMA Show.

It was designed by former racing driver Bruce Leven...

...and built at the Wicked Fabrication factory in Alabama.

To realize a modern-day classical racing Ford...

...Leven based his creation on a 1951 Ford Custom Club Coupe.

He installed a race-tuned V-8 under the hood and reinforced
the chassis for serious track sessions.

According to Wicked Fabrication, more than 10,000 hours
were spent in building this special car.
brandCentral.zh:
每年在美国举行的美国汽车用品改装车展览会（SEMA）
是世界上最大的改装汽车盛会。

Wicked Fabrication GT51曾在2016年参加车展

并赢得了Gran Turismo“最佳巡展”大奖！

这款车是由前赛车手布鲁斯·列文设计的，

并在阿拉巴马州的Wicked Fabrication工厂制造。

它的设计理念是打造一台“经典Ford赛车”，

因此基于1951年的Ford Custom Club Coupe进行改装……

并安装了一个经过竞速调校的V8引擎。底盘也依照竞速
需求进行了加固。

你能从这台小美人身上明显看到改装师为其倾注的超过
10000个小时的心血！/

vehicleCollection.en:
More than 10,000 labor hours went into this 2016 Gran Turismo Award winner."

In 2016, the 1951 Ford Custom Club Coupe drove away with the coveted Gran Turismo Award, a prize presented every year at the SEMA show in Las Vegas to the best customized car at the convention.

This particular example was built by a team of specialists working for former racing driver Bruce Leven, who incorporated Leven's vision of a classic racing Ford with elements of European style; thus, the Custom Club Coupe features major bodywork that includes a slimmer waistline and lower roof.

Under the hood of this mean machine is a 1956 Lincoln 368 cu.-in. V-8 tuned to produce 380ps. Chassis enhancements included the front and rear suspension constructed to provide competition spec handling. Nearly every piece of this car was customized, with the team saying it took an estimated 10,000 hours of work to complete the entire vehicle.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这辆2016年GT大奖得主车款总共耗费了10000小时的设计与制造工时。

在每年的美国汽车用品改装车展览会上，都会向最优秀的改装车授予GT大奖。2016年，第14个这样的奖项颁发给了这辆由定制专家团队为前赛车手布鲁斯-莱文以1951福特定制俱乐部轿跑为基础打造的汽车。

莱文的梦想是打造一辆融入欧洲风格元素的经典福特赛车。为了实现这一愿景，该车经历了重大的车身改造，削细了腰线，同时降低了车顶线。

它的动力单元是一台1956林肯368 立方英寸的V8引擎，由一位赛车引擎专家调校为380ps。此外，前后悬挂都经过精心构造，以提供比赛级的操控性。

这台机器的几乎每一个零件都是定制的，估计消耗了10,000小时的工时才完成。

brandCentral.en:
Perhaps best known as a smartphone maker, Xiaomi arrived
on the EV scene in spring 2024 with its record-setting SU7.

The SU7 Ultra is a high-performance model that ran the
Nürburgring Nordschleife with a time of 7:04:957.

Its body employs innovative Gigacasting technology
that seamlessly integrates the battery and chassis.

Powered by three electric motors (one in front and two at rear),
it delivers a maximum output of 1548ps!

A host of aerodynamic components and lightweight carbon-fiber
panels help it achieve a maximum downforce of 285kg.

The suspension combines air springs and adaptive dampers with
torque-vectoring control for greatly enhanced handling.

With automobiles now part of Xiaomi’s expanding ecosystem,
the SU7 Ultra is poised to stand as its flagship model.
brandCentral.zh:
以智能手机制造商闻名的小米，在2024年春季凭借
创纪录的SU7强势进军电动车领域。

SU7 Ultra高性能版本以7分04.957秒的成绩
征服纽博格林北环赛道。

车身采用创新的CTB一体化电池技术，
实现电池与底盘的无缝融合。

搭载三电机系统（一前两后），最大功率达1548ps！

众多空气动力学组件与轻量化碳纤维板材
共同创造高达285kg的极致下压力。

悬挂系统集成空气弹簧与自适应减震器，
配合扭矩矢量分配系统显著提升操控表现。

随着汽车业务加入小米生态，
SU7 Ultra必将担当品牌旗舰重任。

vehicleCollection.en:
It's the smartphone giant’s expression of automotive innovation.

Xiaomi has achieved global success in the world of smart devices. Utilizing the same technologies and innovative spirit, Xiaomi has turned its attention to the electric mobility market. Its debut model, the SU7 sports sedan, quickly found success, but development of the car did not end there. It was followed by a monster variant designed to challenge the preconceptions of BEVs. That car was the SU7 Ultra.

The SU7 Ultra used a three-motor all-wheel-drive system, placing one motor on the front axle and two on the rear. This configuration delivered a total system output of up to 1548ps, with the “V-8-type” electric motors capable of spinning up to 27200rpm—an unprecedented feat for a production model. This translated into extraordinary performance, with a
0-<100km/h> acceleration time of just 1.98 seconds and a top speed of <350km/h>.

Xiaomi has also left no stone unturned when it came to body innovation. High rigidity and low weight were realized through extensive use of carbon-fiber body panels and cell-to-body construction, seamlessly integrating the battery and chassis. This introduced an entirely new era of passenger-car construction.

The exterior was engineered for maximum aerodynamic efficiency, with the carbon-fiber body kit generating up to 285kg of downforce. Special attention has also been given to braking performance—its brakes enable the car to decelerate from <100km/h> to a complete stop in just 30.8m.

With its luxurious interior, electronically controlled active suspension, and the latest in ADAS technology, the SU7 also delivered outstanding cost performance. This ultimate mobility solution marked a turning point in the history of BEVs.
vehicleCollection.zh:
智能手机巨头推出的极致出行解决方案。

小米已在全球智能设备领域取得卓越成就。基于既有技术积淀与创新精神，小米将战略目光投向了电动出行市场。小米首款车型SU7运动轿车一经推出便大获成功，但该品牌并未就此满足。品牌随后推出的高性能版本彻底颠覆了人们对纯电动车的传统认知。这辆车便是SU7 Ultra。

SU7 Ultra采用三电机全轮驱动系统，前轴配备双电机，后轴搭载单电机。系统综合功率最高可达1548ps，后轴V8电机转速更可高达27200rpm，创下量产车型前所未有的技术突破。这为车辆赋予了卓越性能，仅需1.98秒即可完成0-<100km/h>加速，最高时速能达到<350km/h>。

小米在车身设计上同样不忘把握机遇，实现创新。该车大量采用碳纤维车身板材，结合“电池车身一体化”技术，实现电池与底盘无缝融合，达成高刚性轻量化的卓越表现。该车型还应用最新的一体化压铸技术，标志着量产车制造工艺迈入全新纪元。

外观经过极致空气动力学优化，碳纤维车身套件可创造高达285kg的强劲下压力。制动性能同样备受重视，车辆从<100km/h>减速至完全静止，仅需30.8m的制动距离。

豪华内饰、电控主动悬挂与先进自动驾驶辅助系统的加持，令SU7 Ultra同样展现出无与伦比的性价比优势。这款划时代的出行解决方案，在纯电动车发展史上具有里程碑意义。

dialogues.speaker: Stella
dialogues.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车
dialogues.en:
So this is the Yangwang U9, the luxury EV from BYD Auto.

The first supercar from the Chinese maker,
it packs an impressive 1,300 BHP as standard.

Would you look at that rear wing? It looks like it came
straight off a race car!

With four independent motors powering each wheel,
it’s a cornering machine.

And its unique active suspension is absolutely packed
with advanced tech.

The supercar of the future, the U9 makes me giddy
just talking about it!
dialogues.zh:
眼前这台车，就是来自比亚迪的豪华电动汽车
——仰望U9。

作为这家中国车企推出的首款超跑，
它标配高达1300hp的澎湃动力。

瞧瞧那个尾翼，简直就是赛车上原装移植过来的！

四台独立电机各自驱动一个车轮，
赋予了它极为出色的过弯能力。

而那套独特的主动式悬挂系统，
更是塞满了各种前沿技术。

这辆展现未来趋势的超级跑车仰望U9，
光是谈论参数规格，就足以令人心潮澎湃！

conversation.en:
So this is the Yangwang U9, the luxury EV from BYD Auto.

The first supercar from the Chinese maker,
it packs an impressive 1,300 BHP as standard.

Would you look at that rear wing? It looks like it came
straight off a race car!

With four independent motors powering each wheel,
it’s a cornering machine.

And its unique active suspension is absolutely packed
with advanced tech.

The supercar of the future, the U9 makes me giddy
just talking about it!
conversation.zh:
眼前这台车，就是来自比亚迪的豪华电动汽车
——仰望U9。

作为这家中国车企推出的首款超跑，
它标配高达1300hp的澎湃动力。

瞧瞧那个尾翼，简直就是赛车上原装移植过来的！

四台独立电机各自驱动一个车轮，
赋予了它极为出色的过弯能力。

而那套独特的主动式悬挂系统，
更是塞满了各种前沿技术。

这辆展现未来趋势的超级跑车仰望U9，
光是谈论参数规格，就足以令人心潮澎湃！

brandCentral.en:
The rapid rise of Chinese automotive design has been evident
across everything from road cars to supercars.

And the Yangwang U9 by BYD stands as a shining example—
an electric supercar that captured the art of speed.

Its bold yet graceful form was penned by Wolfgang Egger,
a renowned automotive designer behind several European icons.

Built on BYD’s e⁴ platform, the U9 featured quad motors
capable of delivering a combined output of 1305ps.

It also employed the DiSus-X system, which integrating hydraulic and
pneumatic controls to enhance stability and precision.

A limited-edition variant, the U9 Xtreme, reached a top speed of
<496.22km/h>, making it one of the fastest EVs in the world.

In 2025, it posted a lap time of 6:59.157
at the Nürburgring Nordschleife.

Representing a pinnacle of China’s advanced EV technology,
the U9 stands as a rare gem in the automotive world.
brandCentral.zh:
中国汽车设计的显著进步已
遍及从家用车到超级跑车的各个领域。

比亚迪仰望U9便是其中一颗璀璨的明珠——这是一款
真正诠释了何为“速度艺术”的电动超跑。

其造型大胆而优雅，由曾打造多款欧洲传奇车型的
知名设计师沃尔夫冈·艾格设计。

U9基于比亚迪“易四方”平台打造，搭载4电机，
综合输出功率高达1305ps。

其云辇-X系统融合了液压与气动技术，
精准掌控速度与姿态。

限量款的U9 Xtreme的最高时速更可达到<496.22km/h>，
使其问鼎全球最快电动车。

2025年，它在传奇的纽博格林北侧赛道
创下了6:59:157的圈速纪录。

作为中国先进电动汽车技术的巅峰代表，
U9无疑是汽车界罕见的瑰宝。

vehicleCollection.en:
This rare electric super car broke world speed records.

One electric motor on each of the four wheels. The Yangwang U9 is a revolutionary model that challenged conventional ideas of the electric supercar.

Released by Yangwang, BYD’s luxury brand, it used the proprietary e⁴ platform, featuring four electric motors and delivering a total system output of 960 kW, or roughly 1305ps. It accelerated from 0-<100km/h> in 2.36 seconds. It boasted a level of performance that could easily mask its status as a heavyweight EV.

But the U9’s appeal extended beyond raw power. The “DiSus-X” suspension system integrated hydraulic and pneumatic controls to manage body balance, at times lifting the tires off the ground and, at others, enabling dynamic movement. This system was not merely theatrical—it formed the technical core of the U9, with four-wheel independent control delivering exceptional stability and precision.

Designed by Wolfgang Egger, the scissor-door coupe presented a futuristic form while retaining the presence expected of a supercar.

In 2025, the high-performance U9 Xtreme variant attempted a world speed record, reaching <496.22km/h>. The Yangwang U9 stands as a clear expression of power and technology and a defining symbol of speed in the electrified era.
vehicleCollection.zh:
这款稀有的电动超级跑车刷新了世界速度纪录。

四个车轮各配备了一台电机。仰望U9是一款革命性的车型，旨在挑战人们对电动超跑的认知。

作为比亚迪旗下豪华品牌仰望发布的车型，此车基于品牌专属的e⁴平台打造，采用四电机布局，系统综合动力输出高达960kW，即1305ps。全力加速下，此车仅用2.36秒即可完成0-<100km/h>加速。这令人瞠目的加速能力，足以让人忘记它是一台身量沉重的电动车。

当然，这款车型的价值远不止于其动力。“云辇-X”悬挂系统融合了液压与气动系统，实现对车身姿态平衡的全面控制，有时甚至能将车轮抬离地面，有时又能让整车呈现出近乎舞动般的动感。然而，这套系统并不仅是用来表演“车身跳舞”的。这套四轮独立悬挂控制系统是重要技术核心，赋予了车辆前所未有的行驶稳定性和操控性。

此车的造型由沃尔夫冈·艾格操刀设计，剪刀门轿跑造型极具未来感，同时保留了超级跑车的动人魅力和视觉冲击。

2025年，U9的高性能版本U9 Xtreme对世纪纪录发起挑战，并跑出了惊人的<496.22km/h>。仰望U9是力量与科技的结晶，更是电动化时代的速度标杆。

brandCentral.en:
Founded in 1895, Škoda is an established automaker
with almost 130 years of history behind it.

Active in motorsport since its early days, the company
has competed in countless races and rallies.

Škoda’s first Vision Gran Turismo was a single-seater EV
inspired by its racing history.

Design-wise, it pays homage to the 1100 OHC, which
competed at the Le Mans 24 Hours in 1957.

An all-wheel-drive car, its four motors, one for each wheel,
boast a combined output of 800 kW (1087ps).

The two liveries that adorn its carbon monocoque chassis
each have a story to tell.

While one uses the 1970s rally-bred 130 RS as its motif...

The other takes inspiration from the Vision 7S, a concept
car unveiled in 2022.
brandCentral.zh:
创建于1895年的斯柯达是一家拥有超过130年历史的
知名汽车制造商。

这家公司自从创立初期就积极投身赛车运动，参加过
无数场比赛和拉力赛。

斯柯达的首款Vision Gran Turismo就是一辆从他们的赛车历史中
汲取灵感而打造的单座电动车。

从设计上看，这辆车是向在1957年参加了勒芒24小时耐力赛的
经典赛车1100 OHC致敬。

作为一款全驱车，它为每个车轮都配备了一部电机，
总共可以输出800千瓦（1087ps）的动力。

官方为它的碳纤维单体车壳车身推出了两款涂装，
每一款都有特别的来历。

其中一款采用了1970年代的拉力赛车130 RS作为
其设计主题。

而另外一款的灵感则来源于2022年亮相的
概念车Vision 7S。]

vehicleCollection.en:
A single-seat all-wheel-drive EV from the distinguished Czech manufacturer."

Leveraging the illustrious legacy of Škoda Motorsport, the Škoda Design Team crafted a visionary rendition of a single-seat, all-electric conceptual race car. Dubbed the Škoda Vision Gran Turismo, this creation was created exclusively for the Gran Turismo gaming series, marking the company's debut in this realm. Drawing inspiration from the iconic Škoda 1100 OHC Spyder race car of 1957, originally conceived for the esteemed 24 Hours of Le Mans, the Vision Gran Turismo paid homage to this legendary vehicle in a contemporary guise. It pledged an immersive and dynamic driving encounter, echoing the spirit of its revered predecessor.

The Škoda Vision Gran Turismo project began in 2019 when the design team revisited the iconic Škoda 1100 OHC. Initially, the team was debating whether to restore the 1100 OHC or create a futuristic iteration for the digital age. After consulting with Chief Designer Oliver Stefani, the Škoda Design team opted for a fresh innovative approach, creating a fusion of past and future.

This race concept pays homage to its legendary predecessor as well as incorporating the defining features of Škoda’s Modern Solid design language, as seen in its T-shaped headlights. What’s more, the Vision Gran Turismo showcased two distinct liveries: one reflecting the heritage of the famous Škoda 130 RS race car from the 1970s, and the other inspired by the Vision 7S concept car, which embodies Škoda´s Modern Solid Design philosophy.

The Škoda Vision Gran Turismo boasts a sleek exterior with crisp, clear lines and pronounced edges, mirroring the aesthetics of current Formula E racers. Its design is optimized for superior handling through active aerodynamics. Features like the aerodynamically sculpted body, and the striking, adaptive two-piece rear wing, all work together to dynamicaly adjust to driving conditions and boost performance. The vehicle incorprated independent wishbone push-rod type suspension systems, mounted toa carbo monocoque similar to those found in Fomula E cars, improvig high-speed stability, reducin body roll, and loweringthe veicle’s centr of gravity.

Efficiency and excellent driving dynamics are at the heart of the Škoda Vision Grn Turismo design. 由知名捷克制造商推出的单座全驱电动车。

斯柯达设计团队从斯柯达汽车运动丰富的遗产中汲取了大量经验，最终打造出了一辆天马行空的技术验证单座全电概念赛车：斯柯达Vision Gran Turismo。这辆概念赛车专为《跑车浪漫旅》打造，也象征着斯柯达品牌首次在《跑车浪漫旅》系列中登场。这款跑车浪漫旅愿景的灵感来源于专为地位崇高的24小时勒芒耐力赛打造的1957年款斯柯达 1100 OHC敞篷赛车，是对这辆传奇赛车的现代化致敬，并且不遗余力地提供极富沉浸感和高度响应的驾驶体验。

斯柯达Vision Gran Turismo项目发起于2019年，设计团队立刻决定复刻充满传奇色彩的斯柯达 1100 OHC。起初，团队还纠结于是否要原汁原味地复原1100 OHC，还是为数字时代打造一款富有未来感的全新版本。在参考了首席设计师奥利弗·史蒂芬尼的意见后，斯柯达设计团队选择了更具革新性的思路——打造一款融合了过去与未来的作品。

这辆概念赛车继承了前辈的衣钵，也囊括了斯柯达当前的“现代固态”设计语言中的典型特征，正如其T字型车头灯所体现。另外，这款Vision Gran Turismo还展示了两款特点鲜明的涂装：一款反映了1970年代著名的斯柯达 130 RS赛车的经典配色，而另一款的设计灵感则来源于Vision 7S概念车，而后者正好是斯柯达的“现代固态”设计语言的代表性作品。

斯柯达Vision Gran Turismo整体呈现出流畅利落的颀长外形设计，运用了大量明显的线条和清晰的边缘，也反映出现代方程式E赛车的美学理念。这种设计通过主动的空气动力学特性，强化本就优越的操控性。这些特点中包括了符合空气动力学的车身塑形，以及造型亮眼的自适

斯柯达设计团队从斯柯达汽车运动丰富的遗产中汲取了大量经验，最终打造出了一辆天马行空的技术验证单座全电概念赛车：斯柯达Vision Gran Turismo。这辆概念赛车专为《跑车浪漫旅》打造，也象征着斯柯达品牌首次在《跑车浪漫旅》系列中登场。这款跑车浪漫旅愿景的灵感来源于专为地位崇高的24小时勒芒耐力赛打造的1957年款斯柯达 1100 OHC敞篷赛车，是对这辆传奇赛车的现代化致敬，并且不遗余力地提供极富沉浸感和高度响应的驾驶体验。

斯柯达Vision Gran Turismo项目发起于2019年，设计团队立刻决定复刻充满传奇色彩的斯柯达 1100 OHC。起初，团队还纠结于是否要原汁原味地复原1100 OHC，还是为数字时代打造一款富有未来感的全新版本。在参考了首席设计师奥利弗·史蒂芬尼的意见后，斯柯达设计团队选择了更具革新性的思路——打造一款融合了过去与未来的作品。

这辆概念赛车继承了前辈的衣钵，也囊括了斯柯达当前的“现代固态”设计语言中的典型特征，正如其T字型车头灯所体现。另外，这款Vision Gran Turismo还展示了两款特点鲜明的涂装：一款反映了1970年代著名的斯柯达 130 RS赛车的经典配色，而另一款的设计灵感则来源于Vision 7S概念车，而后者正好是斯柯达的“现代固态”设计语言的代表性作品。

unmatched.en:
Oh, it refers to a truncated tail, or rear.
What we call a "Kamm Tail" in English.
The Kamm Tail is named after the German aerodynamicist
Wunibald Kamm, who theorized the design in the 1930s.
unmatched.zh:
哦，那我解释下，它指的是尾部被截短。
在英语中通常被称为“断尾”。
这一术语源自于德国空气动力学家乌尼巴尔·卡姆，
他在上世纪30年代提出了这种设计理念。!
unmatched.speaker: Sarah
unmatched.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师

That’s right, it refers to a truncated tail, or rear.
What we call a "Kamm Tail" in English.

没错，它指的是尾部被截短。
