unmatched.en:
Hans Mezger was Porsche's legendary engineer.
He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.
Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...
...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
unmatched.zh:
汉斯·梅茨格是保时捷的传奇工程师！
他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，
以及F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。
尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……
但梅茨格的设计理念依然根植于GT2，GT3以及911 Turbo之中。
unmatched.speaker: Sarah
unmatched.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师

unmatched.en:
That's correct! It's an engine created by Porsche's
legendary engineer Hans Mezger!
He's responsible for the 911's traditional air-cooled
engines, as well as race engines for F1 and Le Mans.
Although 911 engines became water-cooled starting with
the 996...
...the engines for the GT2, GT3 and Turbo
were still rooted in designs by Mezger.
unmatched.zh:
没错！这款引擎由保时捷的传奇工程师汉斯·梅茨格打造！
他负责设计了911的风冷引擎，
以及F1和勒芒赛事用的赛车引擎。
尽管自996之后，911的引擎都换成了水冷……
但梅茨格的设计理念依然根植于GT2，GT3以及911 Turbo之中。
unmatched.speaker: Sarah
unmatched.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师

unmatched.en:
Did you know that the Kangoo was originally designed
as a commercial vehicle?
With its generous cargo space, this is a machine that, for many,
became a trusted co-worker.
But not all Kangoos were built for hard labor.
Some serve as passenger cars, offering a welcome blend of style
and comfort, and they’re every bit as popular.
Renault, after all, has a long tradition of crafting
iconic utility vehicles.
Among them was a commercial version of the Renault 4
from the 1960s.
Another was the Express, derived from
the second-generation Renault 5.
unmatched.zh:
你知道吗？Kangoo最初其实是
按商用车来设计的。
凭借宽敞的载物空间，对很多人来说，
它简直堪称得力的工作伙伴！
不过，并非所有Kangoo都是为了干活而生的。
也有一部分乘用车版本具备时尚外观
和舒适性能，人气也非常高。
多年来，雷诺推出了不少大名鼎鼎
的“工作用车”车型。
其中就包括1960年代雷诺4的商用版本。
还有一款是Express，它是基于第二代雷诺5打造的！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
Renault boasts a rich and storied legacy that
stretches back to the 19th century.
Introduced in 1961, this Renault 4—referred to as “the Quatrelle”
by the French—holds a cherished place in that heritage.
After all, it was the first Renault to
feature front-wheel drive.
For a company that had built its reputation on
front-engine, rear-wheel-drive machines...
...this marked a significant eparture with a sizable interior
and greater ease of operation.
Thankfully, the Quatrelle was a big success!
This bestseller remained in production for more than 30 years
and amassed gobal sales of more than 8 million units!
unmatched.zh:
雷诺拥有悠久且丰富的历史，
可以追溯到上上个世纪。
这款于1961年推出的雷诺4，被法国人亲切地称之为
“四翼”，在这段历史中占据着举足轻重的地位。
要知道，它是第一款采用前轮驱动技术的雷诺汽车。
对于雷诺这样一家以
前置发动机、后轮驱动布局车型而闻名的公司而言……
这确实是一个重:转变，但这种变更带来了更大的空间
和更出色的操控性能。
值得庆幸的是，四翼取得了巨大的成功！
作为一款畅销车型，它的生产周期超过了30年，
全球销量突破了800万辆！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
It's where the rear of the body appears to abruptly cut off.
Much like streamline designs, they're known to have
excellent aerodynamics.
Dr. Wunibald Kamm, the person who came up with this, was a
professor at the University of Stuttgart in the 1930s.
Therein lies the reason why this particular design is called
the "Kamm Tail."
We also refer to it as "Coda Tronca" in Italian.
unmatched.zh:
采用这种设计的汽车后部就像被整齐地切掉一块。
卡姆式与流线型车身设计很接近，而且都以
优秀的空气动力学效应闻名。
这一设计是由斯图加特大学的乌尼巴尔·卡姆博士
于上世纪30年代提出的，
随即以设计者的名字冠名。
在意大利语中，我们也把它叫作“断尾”。$
unmatched.speaker: Sarah
unmatched.roleZh: 主向导 / 赛事工程师

unmatched.en:
Yes! It's a design where the rear of the body appears to
abruptly cut off.
Much like streamline designs, they're known to have
excellent aerodynamics.
Dr. Wunibald Kamm, the person who came up with this, was a
professor at the University of Stuttgart in the 1930s.

unmatched.en:
It looks like a really compact supercar.
It’s sleek and looks really cool.
So, the engine is in the back? It’s a two-seater and
pretty tight inside.
Wow, but it has a decent-sized trunk—not bad!
unmatched.zh:
这款车一眼看上去就是辆紧凑版超跑。
流线型的车身非常的酷。
所以发动机放在后面？这是部两座车，里面很紧凑。
哇喔，但是后备箱还是挺大的，不错！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
A GT3 is basically like a race car, right?
Or at least just as fast? That's what I heard.
It looks like any other Porsche at first glance, but people
who know can tell the difference, right?
It’s not flashy, but it drives like a true race car.
That’s seriously cool.
unmatched.zh:
GT3其实是一辆赛车，是不是？还是说和赛车一样快？
我好像听说过它的。
在我看来这就像别的保时捷一样……
懂车的人才能分辨出来，是不是？
没有那么拉风，但开起来像真的赛车一样，非常酷！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
The 296 GTB is one of Ferrari’s most iconic GT3 racers.
Its name is derived directly from the numbers associated
with its engine.
Specifically, it features a 2.9-liter displacement
and 6 cylinders.
Combine the two and you get “296."
I’ve heard that Ferrari used a similar naming convention
for several models between 1970 and 1990.
I can’t say exactly how many, but I certainly plan to find out!
unmatched.zh:
296 GTB是法拉利最具标志性的GT3赛车。
其命名取自引擎的核心参数。
具体而言，该车搭载2.9升排量的6缸引擎。
两者结合便构成了“296”的命名！
我听说，在1970至1990年间，法拉利
还以类似的方式命名了其他车型。
具体数量我一时说不上来，但我一定会查个明白！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
When I hear the name Citroën, the first thing that comes
to mind is this BX.
Who could forget those straight lines, that boxy shape?
Such a unique-looking car could only come from the Italian
design house Bertone!
From the Break station wagon to the sports-car version,
it was also a car rich in variation.
Launched in 1982, it proved to be a lasting success,
staying in production for over a decade.
All told, around 2.3 million units were produced
across the entire lineup!
unmatched.zh:
一听到雪铁龙，我首先想到的就是这款BX。
有谁会不记得它那笔直的线条和方方正正的造型呢？
而拥有如此独特外观的汽车，毫无疑问
只会出自意大利设计公司博通之手！
从Break旅行车到跑车，这款车的衍生车型十分丰富。
1982年问世的BX堪称车坛常青树，生产周期
横跨十余载……
全系产量约达230万台！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
A viper is a type of poisonous snake, right?
It suits the image of the car.
Although I think the front end looks a bit cute in its own way.
But when you sit in the driver’s seat, it’s hard to judge
where the front of the car ends.
I suppose that’s because the engine is so large.-
unmatched.zh:
知道吗，Viper这个词其实是一种毒蛇的名字？用来
形容这款车倒是很贴切。
尽管我觉得这款车的前脸看上去还挺可爱的。
可是当你坐进驾驶室里的时候绝对会大吃一惊，因为你
很难看到这辆车的车头究竟在哪里……
我猜这是因为它的引擎实在太大了！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
Audi made its Le Mans debut in 1999.
Up to 2016, it competed in the LMP1 class,
where it performed exceedingly well.
In fact, it had podium finishes for eighteen
consecutive years!
But in its final race, Audi's R18 was stuck in 4th place
for most of the race.
People feared that Audi would finish out of the top three,
breaking its long streak of poium finishes
But with ten minutes to go, the race leader, Toyota,
experienced a mechanical problem.
This allowed the R18 to move into 3rd place and establish
its record of 18 consecutive podium finishes!
Ultimately, the streak came to an end when Audi announced
its withdrawal from Le Mans the following year.
unmatched.zh:
奥迪在1999年首次亮相勒芒。
一直到2016年，奥迪在勒芒原型车1级级别的比赛中表现得非常出色。
事实上，奥迪已经连续18年登上领奖台了！
但就在去年，R18在比赛终段时仍然是第四名。
大家都觉得奥迪今年登台无望了。
然而，距离比赛结束还有10分钟时，领头的.田出现了机械故障！
这让R18挤进了第三位，站上了领奖台，
并达成了连续18年登上领奖台的记录。
最终，由于奥迪宣布从那年的勒芒赛事中退出，
他们的连胜纪录v就此终结。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
I know this Civic very well!
It's the car known as the "Sports Civic" from the 1990s
—the fifth-generation "EG" model to be precise.
The "Sports" moniker alone should tell you that it’s fast,
but its engine design and sound are second to none.
You often see these cars tuned in all manner of ways.
What do I like best about tuning a Sports Civic, you ask?
The engine swaps, of course!
Fo example, a Honda K-engine with a large displacement
will give you great sound, speed, and power.
But my favorite would have to be the Type R
B-engine.
It might not offer as much power as the K-engine,
but its ror is simply unforgettable!
unmatched.zh:
我对这种类型的思域非常熟悉！
准确来说，这是一辆1990年代生产，被称为“运动思域”
的第五代“EG”思域。
从其昵称中的“运动”二字就能看出它的速度有多快，
此外它的引擎设计和声浪也无出其右。
你经常会看到这款车被调校成各种不同的形态。
你知道关于运动思域的调校，我最爱哪一方面吗
当然是更换改装引擎啦！
比如说，大排量的本田K-引擎可以给你澎湃的声浪、
风驰电掣的速度和充沛的动力。
不过我的最爱还是Type R B-引擎。
虽然动力不如K-引擎，但它的咆哮声绝对令人
终生难忘！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
The Honda S series will always be remembered for the bold
way it tore up the race track!
It was Honda’s first mass-produced car and a true racer
that was active before its official release.
In 1963, a year before its debut, it took part in
a famous European rally called the Marathon de la Route.
A year later, the Honda S600 pulled off a
stunning GT1-class victory at the Japanese Grand Prix.
In the same year, it also competed in world endurance races,
such as the Nürburgring 500 km, where it won best-in-class.
Around this time, Honda was also performing well in Formula 1 and
had established itself as a major player in motorsports.
The year 1966 saw this S800, powered by a -engine.
This car became the vanguard of Japanese racing
well into the 1970s.
At the time, Honda had plans to establish a motorsports
support department for S seris competition racers.
This initiative would later result in the creation of the
Racing Service Center (RSC).
Today, RSC is known as Honda Racing Corporation (HRC), a
division of Honda overseeing motorsports activities.
Indeed, the S series is an indispensable part of Honda
and Japan’s racing history!
unmatched.zh:
本田S系列将永远被人们铭记，因为它曾经以不羁
的风格征服了赛道！
它是本田的第一辆量产车，也是一款真正的
赛道机器，在其正式发售之前就活跃在赛场上。
1963年，在其正式发布的前一年，它就参加了
鼎鼎大名的欧洲拉力赛——84小时马拉松汽车耐力赛。
一年之后的1964年，在首次亮相后，本田S600
又在日本大奖+的GT1级别中取得了惊人的胜利。
同年，它还参加了世界耐力赛，
在纽博格林赛事上战胜了同级别最强大的对手！
在本田S系列大放异彩期间，本田在F1锦标赛中也屡有出色表现，
从而在赛车运动领域确立了自己的重要地位。
1966年，这款由引擎驱动的S800发布。
并且一直到1970年代都处于日本赛车的先锋地位。
当时7本田就计划为参加S系列比赛的赛车手们
建立一个赛车运动支持部门。
这一提案在后来推动了赛车服务中心的创建……
也就是今天的本田赛车公司——专门统管其赛车活动的部门。
可以这么说，S系列是本田和日本赛车历史中
不可缺少的一部分！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Porsche has contributed greatly to motorsport over the
years, as a manufacturer and seller to privateers.
Even in the world's fastest racing category, which is
the sports prototype class...
It entered races as a factory team while also
selling its race cars to privateers.
Indeed, Porsche's widespread support of race
culture is an integral part of its legacy.
This is evidenced by the history o the 956 and 962,
two Group C models from the early 1980s.
Although the 962’s factory team withdrew from competition
in 1988...
...the cars continued racing for private teams.
It's said that Porsche manufactured 150 examples
of the 956 and 962 for competition.*
unmatched.zh:
多年来，保时捷作为制造商和私人销售商，
对汽车运动做出了巨大贡献。
即使在参与世界上最快的赛事，运动原型赛事的同时……
他们在把赛车卖给私人的同时，还在运营着一支工厂队伍。
事实上，保时捷对赛车文化的广泛支持已经成了其遗产的一部。
这一点可以从956和962这两款
80年代初的C组别#型的历史中看出来。
虽然962的工厂队伍在1988年退出了竞技舞台……
私人车队却仍然在使用那些车竞赛。
据说，在保时捷的赛车生涯期间，
他们一共生产了150辆956和962。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
“Rotary engines are notorious for their poor fuel economy,
making them ill-suited for endurance races.”
At least, this is what people in the racing world had believed.
But the engineers at Mazda took a different view.
So, they got together and created the R26B engine,
which emphasized horsepower over torque.
This decision effectively made it a durable
and fuel-efficient engine.
The 4-otor engine found a home in the now-legendary 787B.
It was the first Japanese car to claim the overall title
at Le Mans in 1991.
Jonny Herbert, the driver who drove
the final three stints...
...was so dehydrated after the race that he was unable
to make the podium.
As for the engine, when Mazda's engineers took it apart, they
apparently saw that it could have gone another 500 km!
unmatched.zh:
转子引擎的油耗高得吓人，所以不适合耐力赛。”
赛车界曾是这样看待转子引擎的。
但是马自达的工程师们却不这么认为！
他们努力的结晶便是将重点放在马力上，
而不是扭矩上的R26B引擎。
这项明智的决定使这台引擎不仅可靠，而且省油。
这台传奇的发动机就装在了这台787B上。
于1991年q它成为了第一台在勒芒夺冠的日本车。
不幸的是，约翰尼·赫伯特在开完最后三段后……
由于严重脱水，无法站上领奖台。
赛后，当马自达的工程师将引擎拆开时，
他们发现这台引擎还能再跑！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
It's fast, affordable, and manageable in size.
This is truly one of the great production sports cars ever.
The second-generation MR2 that made its debut in 1989
kept being improved over the years.
This is the final version, with its power boosted
to a mighty .
And thanks to the mid-engine layout, its handling is remarkably
straightforward.
This is a car that has more value than its price indicates.
unmatched.zh:
价格在可承受的范围之内，尺寸可控且速度很快，
它确确实实是最好的量产跑车之一。
第二代MR2于1989年首次亮相，之后多年来一直在不断
改进。
这一台是系列的巅峰之作，功率提高到了令人心驰神往
的，
操控方面也是相当直截了当。
就这辆车而言，其价值远大于售价，太划算了。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The 300 SL, which was introduced in the 1950s, is considered
a masterpiece of Mercedes-Benz engineering to this day.
This SLS AMG brings that legendary vehicle to
the 21st century.
And, it revives the most iconic feature of the 300 SL, which
are those gullwing doors!
Under the sheet metal, the chassis is all modern, highlighted
by a highly-rigid and lightweight aluminum space frame..
It possesses an FR layout, complete with a transaxle,
meaning that the gearbox is located at the rear.
This allows for an ideal front/rear weight distribution that
makes this car extremely balanced through corners.
As the successor to the 300 SL, one can only imagine that
its value will continue to rise.
unmatched.zh:
300 SL在上世纪五十年代亮相时
被认为是梅赛德斯-奔驰的工程杰作。
这辆SLS AMG将那辆口碑载道的传奇带回到了21世纪。
它甚至让300 SL最具标志性特色——鸥翼门复活了！
这辆车的底盘采用了现代的设计，
由高硬度和轻质的铝制空间框架构成。
它搭载了一台发动机自然吸气V8发动机，
能够输{的强大动力。
尽管这辆车采用了前置后驱布局，但其变速箱
位于后部；这意味着它有跨轴传动。
这种设计让理想的重量分布成为了可能，
从而改善了这辆车在直线和弯道上性能！
作为300 SL的后继者，这辆车的价值
肯定会水涨船高吧。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
Peugeot cars are distinguished by their numerical names.
Like the 205 or the 306, they all seem to follow
a three-digit pattern.
The history behind this convention actually dates back
to 1921 with the 201.
Today, it’s not uncommon to see four-digit names,
but did you know that those are reserved for SUVs?
This "2008" is a compact SUV.
As is to be expected of a Peugeot, it's perky and nimble,
just as it should be!
unmatched.zh:
标致的车可以从它们名字中的数字区分开来。
例如“205”或“306”，似乎所有车名都遵循着三位数命名格式。
这一传统其实可追溯到1929年的“201”！
如今，它旗下以四位数命名的车型并不少见，
但你或许不知道这些是专门留给SUV的。
这台“2008”就是一款紧凑型SUV。
与其他标致车型相似，这台车活力十足，灵活敏捷，
一切都恰到好处！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
The one thing race enthusiasts love about BMW...
...is their long-standing commitment to developing
customer race cars like this one here.
When a new production car is released, you can
expect a race-ready version to offered pretty quickly.
This Z4 GT3 made its biggest impression...
...at endurance races like the Nürburgring 24 Hours.
There, it was driven by BMW works drivers
Bruno Spengler and Timo Glock.
Part of what makes BMW so cool is that it can be
assertive without coming off as arrogant.
The company exudes confidence because it lets
its results speak for themselves.
unmatched.zh:
赛车迷对宝马最津津乐道的就是……
他们长期以来致力于开发客制赛车，就比如我们眼前的
这台。
每当宝马有新款量产车发布时，你可以期待赛事规格的
车型很快会接踵而至。
这辆Z4 GT3在纽博格林24小时耐力赛等多项耐力赛事中……
给人留下了深刻的印象……
在纽博格林，宝马派出的是冠军车手布鲁诺·斯宾格勒和
蒂姆·格洛克。
在比赛方面，宝马从来只用事实说话，
那自然流露的自信而不自负的气质显得尤为卓尔不群。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This is the car that kick-started Honda’s near 60 years
of Formula 1 Grand Prix history.
After a rough start in 1964, Honda was back in 1965,
with this RA272.
It took the checkered flag at the Mexican Grand Prix
in the final round of the season.
That year happened to be the last one in which F1 machines
were powered by 1.5-liter naturally-aspirated engines.
And let me tell you, the engine that powered this RA272
wa something special!
It was a V-12 with of displacement and capable of
a whopping 230 horsepower!
Surprisingly, the displacement per cylinder was a mere
, something that reflected Honda's motorcycle engines.
What’s more, weighing in at , this super compact
engine was mounted horizontally amidships!
Have you ever heard of such a thing being done
on a Formula 1 car?
But if you give it some thouht, you’ll see that
it actually made a lot of sense.
By mounting an engine on its side, you can shorten
the wheelbase and put less stress on the gearbox.
Compact and easy to handle, Honda’s early attempt
at an F1 machine was an amazing display of engineering.
The track on which the Mexico Grand Prix takes place
is above sea level.
The low air pressure typically gives engines some
trouble generating power.
In designing the RA272’s powerplant,former aircraft engineer
and Honda’s F1 team leader Yoshio Nakamura...
...made sure it would function at high altitudes,
giving the RA272 an edge over its rivals.
The driver of the winning car was Richie Ginther,
one of the most skilled drivers of his day.
All these ingredients came together in Honda’s first F1 win.
And with that, a glorious history was in the making!
unmatched.zh:
这款车是本田近60年的F1大奖赛历史的先行者。
在经历了1964年的艰难起步之后，本田在1965年
携这款RA272卷土重来……
它在本赛季的最后一站，即墨西哥大奖赛上取得了冠军。
1965年也是赛会允许F1赛车使用
1.5升自然吸气引擎的最后一个赛季。
事实上，为这台RA272提供动力的引擎有点本事！
台排量为的V12引擎能够产生惊人的230马力！
更令人惊讶的是，单个汽缸的排量仅有，
让人不禁联想到本田摩托车引擎的传承。
除此之外，这台超级紧凑的引擎重量仅为，
而且横向安置在车体的中部！
你可曾听说过这样的事情发生在一台F1赛车上？
但是细细思量，你就会发现这样的设计实际上颇为合理。
通过将引擎横向放置T可以缩短轴距，
减轻变速箱所承受的压力。
本田的初次试水获得了立竿见影的成效，
他们的F1赛车因尺寸紧凑而易于操控。
由于墨西哥大奖赛所处的赛道高于海平面，
低气压通常会给引擎的动力输出带来一些影响。
在设计RA272的引擎时，前飞机工程师
兼本田的F1车队负责人中村良夫……
就确保了它能在高海拔地区正常运转，
使RA272在竞9对手前抢占了先机。
而坐在获胜赛车中的车手里奇·金瑟尔，
也是一位真正专业的赛车大师！
所有的致胜因素在本田的第一个F1冠军头衔中
汇集到了一起。就这样，一段光辉的历史诞生了！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This E92 M3 is the fourth instalment in the BMW
M3 series that began with the E30.
Its pride is in its engine.
It's the only M3 to come equipped with a menacing V-8 engine.
At the time of its development, BMW was powering its other
cars with V-10s built for F1 racing...
But the speed and torque achieved by this high-precision V-8
was nothing to dismiss.
What’s more, you'll be surprised at how light it is
compared to its inline-6 predecessor.
Indeed, this incredible car is worth having for
the powerplant alone.
unmatched.zh:
这款E92 M3是宝马M3车系
继E30后的第四款车。
这款车最引以为傲的是其引擎……
是M3系列中唯一搭载高亢V8引擎的一代车型。
在研发这款车型时，宝马仍采用V10引擎
打造其他F1比赛的车型……
但是，这台高精度V8引擎所实现的速度和扭矩
不容小觑。
更令人惊讶的是，相比于其前代搭载的直列六缸引擎，
这具引擎是如此轻巧。
确实，单纯就冲那引擎，
这款突破想象的车型就值得拥有！
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
Now, this is one of the true icons of the industry, one that
changed the history of sports cars in the world.It has attractive styling, a top that can
be folded down easily...
...and the cockpit space is just snug. Oh, and its price
at the time of release was very affordable.
But above all, the market for convertible lightweight
sports cars...
...was quickly decreasing at the time. It was a dark time
for enthusiasts.
This was the savior that revived this entire genre of cars.
unmatched.zh:
这辆车是一面真正的旗帜，你甚至可以说它改变了赛车
的历史。
还是那家喻户晓的造型，加上方便折叠的顶篷和舒适无
比的座舱，
还有在发售之初非常实惠的价格。
能让你感到人车融为一体、操控自如的敞篷轻量级跑车
的市场
在当时已几近消亡。
这款车可以说是以一己之力挽救了所有同类车型的救星。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
This is a sports car that made no compromises.
It embodied the Porsche spirit.
The 997 GT3, after 2008, produced twice the downforce
than the previous car.
Also, the engines and brakes were even more powerful.
Not only that, it utlilized an engine crankcase that was
developed for racing since their air-cooled models.
It's definitely a precious car today.
unmatched.zh:
这是一辆不折不扣，毫不妥协、绝对纯粹的保时捷跑车。
2008年之后的997 GT3的下压力提高了一倍，
引擎功率和刹车也更加强大。
不仅如此，它所使用的发动机曲轴箱是从风冷技术时代
就不断积累研发的赛车用版本。
毫无疑问，这既是一颗璀璨的宝石。:
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
I have a soft spot for the M3.
I was involved on the first E30 M3...
...while I was working on the beginning of the E36.
Today, the 3 Series coupe is known as the 4 Series,
and the M3 became M4.
I still prefer the old M3 naming, however.
This car here is the most purposefully designed BMW...
...that possesses the true spirit of the M-performance package.
It has the right amount of details like front air intakes
that cool the brakes...
...to side air-outlets with the M accent.
It has an extremely athletic look
that exemplifies sporty and elegant design.
unmatched.zh:
我对M3情有独钟。
当我们开始开发E36系列的时候……
我还同时承担了E30 M3的开发工作。
现在，3系的双门轿跑车已经被宝马改称为“4系”，
M3也跟着变成了“M4”。
但我仍然喜欢M3。
它是目的性最明确的宝马……
其设计主旨与M性能套件的运动精神完全契合。
细节&的配置也相当到位，例如冷却刹车的前进气口……
以及带有“M”系凌厉风格的侧面进气风道。
仿佛一位穿上设计师品牌运动外套的运动员，
集运动和时尚优雅于一身。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
This Audi takes me back to the 2011 Le Mans 24-hour race.
Incredibly, it crossed the finish line and won
the competition...
A nail-biting 13.845 seconds before
the second-place Peugeot.
Rarely has Le Mans had such a close race!
Although Audi bested Peugeot in terms of speed,
the same couldn't be said about fuel efficiency.
Peugeot tried to use this to their advantage
by taking as few pitstops as possible.
So while Audi was making excellent time,
it couldn’t quite shake Peugeot.
But in the end, Audi’s speed won out, eking out
a victory against its competitor.
unmatched.zh:
看着这辆奥迪，我仿佛回到了2011年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。
它以非同凡俗的姿态越过终点线并赢得了冠军……
只领先了第二名的标致13.845秒，令人捏了一把汗。
在勒芒，很少能见到这样针尖对麦芒的比赛！
虽然奥迪在速度上胜过了标致一筹，但是在
燃油效率方面就一言难尽了。
标致充分利用这一优势，尽量减少了进站加油的次数。
所以，单圈时间极其优秀的奥迪始终没能将标致甩开。
但最终，还是奥迪的速度胜出，惊险击败了对手。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
The Stratos, designed by Marcello Gandini...
...was created to accomplish just one goal.
And what was that, you ask? To win rally races.
Legend has it that the car was a handful to drive
owing to its short wheelbase.
In fact, only a handful of drivers could ever really
master it.
One of them was the legendary rally driver
Sandro Munari.
He controlled the Stratos like it was a part of his body.
His view on the matter was:
"If you find driving this car difficult, then your skills
just aren't good enough."
unmatched.zh:
Stratos的设计者是马塞罗·甘迪尼……
他设计这辆车的目的只有一个。
那个目的是？在拉力赛中获胜。
传说这辆车非常难驾驭……
实际上，真正驾驭了这辆车的人也就那么几名车手。
传奇拉力车手桑德罗·穆纳利便是这些车手之一。
对他来说，操纵Stratos就像是操纵玩具车那样易如反掌！
他对此的看法是：
“如果您觉得这车难开，那只能说明你还欠火候！”i
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
The sixth-generation Camaro was a well-built machine,
especially the SS version.
It came equipped with the same 6.2-liter LT1 engine that was
introduced in the Corvette.
The handling was nothing short of exceptional, making it
feel at home on winding roads.
Honestly, for all it offers, it's really quite reasonably
priced.
unmatched.zh:
第六代科迈罗工艺精湛，
特别是这款具备SS等级的制作。
这款车搭载了6.2升LT1引擎，
这款引擎曾首次亮相于科尔维特车型上。
其操控性堪称卓越，在蜿蜒起伏之间，
驾驶体验更加刺激。
坦白说，这款车提供的这一切，
确实对得起这个价。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The first-generation Viper was initially offered as
an open-top model.
That was the RT/10.
This GTS was introduced later as the coupe version.
The coupe’s structure improved rigidity,
which in turn enhanced handling.
Lamborghini was also involved in the development
of the V10 engine.
Viewed in that context, it was a remarkably cost-effective
performance car.
unmatched.zh:
上市的第一代Viper首先推出的是敞篷车。
型号是“RT/10”吧。
这个GTS版本是改良后的双座跑车版本。
车身更加坚固，操纵感也更强。
兰博基尼也参与了它的V10发动机的研发。
如果从这个角度去想，这可是一辆性价比非常高的车。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The "Romance of Minus 21 Seconds."
That was the slogan for the R33 Skyline GT-R.
In a time trial on the Nürburgring Nordschleife...
...it improved on the lap time of the previous GT-R,
the R32, by a full 21 seconds.
It was a phrase that reflected the development effort
that went into the R33 GT-R.
I think stories like that are part of the
magical nature of the R33 GT-R.
unmatched.zh:
缩短了21秒的浪漫”。
这是R33 Skyline GT-R广告口号。
在纽博格林北侧赛道的一次计时赛中，
R33 Skyline GT-R将前辈车型R32 GT-R的单圈成绩消掉了
整整21秒。
这条口号也反映出了日产为研发R33 GT-R所做的所有
投入。
我认为正是这样的故事让R33 GT-R这款车更有价值。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
One of my all-time favorite cars is an 1980s icon—
the fourth-generation Civic.
With its powerful engine, this Civic Si
was the pride of the hatchback pack.
Civics of this era ranged from smart and chic sedans
to uniquely designed 5-door wagons like the Shuttle.
And each was beautiful
in its own way!
unmatched.zh:
我的毕生挚爱之一诞生于80年代
——那就是第四代思域。
这台搭载强劲引擎的思域Si掀背版，堪称
家族的门面担当。
这一时期的思域车系从优雅时髦的四门轿车，
到造型独特的穿梭机五门瓦罐车，应有尽有。
每款车型都绽放着独特的美！%
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
It's not big, but you just can ignore it.
Ah, I see. This GR Yaris was made for motorsports.
I guess it does look like a sports car,
and it's no slouch out on the track.
It's nice that it's also good for everyday use—I mean,
you can even sit in the back!
unmatched.zh:
这辆车虽然小巧玲珑，但实力却不可小觑。
噢，原来是这样。这辆GR雅力士是专为赛车运动而生的。
它看上去确实就是一辆跑车，在赛道上表现得也不弱。
而且日常使用也非常好开，我说真的，后排也能坐人！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
Porsche is a mainstay of the WEC, which is short for the
World Endurance Championship.
Currently, Porsche's entry in this series is the 911 RSR.
The car competes in both the LMP1 and LM-GTE classes.
As you can imagine, the 911 is a force to be reckoned with
because of its speed and reliability.
While contesting for overall victories in the LMP1 class,
it also looked to grab the top spot in the GT class.
This particular 911 RSR competed in the WEC and IMSA
in 2017.
It received a bit of backlash from Porsche
enthusiasts, however.
That’s because its engine is mounted amidships,
and not at the rear.
Therefore, many hardcore enthusiasts cried foul,
saying that it wasn't a real 911.
Still, the new engine location did improve
the car’s stability at high speed.
And the resulting change in weight distribution is said to
have dramatically reducd tire friction.
Seen in this light, the alterations make sense.
Porsche is there to win, after all.]
unmatched.zh:
一贯以来，保时捷都是世界耐力锦标赛，即“世界耐力锦标赛”的冠军有
力争夺者之一。
其发布的911 RSR同时参加了
勒芒原型车1级和LM-GTE两个级别的比赛。
如您预想得到的，作为保时捷毋庸置疑的旗舰，
911在追求勒芒原型车1级级别的全面胜利的同时，也向GT级别的头名
发起了挑战。
这辆911 RSR2017年参加了世界耐力锦标赛和国际汽车运动协会的一系列比赛，
但也受到了保时捷车迷群体的一些质疑。
这是因为它的引擎被安装在车体中部，而不是后部。
很多硬核车迷们会说，“真正的”911必须是后置引擎。
但不得不说，中置布局确实改善了赛车的高速稳定性……
而且，据说这样的重量分配调整极大地减少了轮胎摩损。
从这个角度来看，这些改变是可以理解的。毕竟，
保时捷就是为了赢得比赛而生的。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Renault is a company that loves to compete.
It has been involved in many forms of motorsport,
including Formula 1.
It was also formidable in the rallying world, alongside
cars such as the Gordini and the Alpine from the 70s.
The 1980s, though, the company was all about this R5 Turbo.
One of its early drivers, Jean Ragnotti, mentioned that the
car suffered from terrible handling.
He also confessed that misjudgments on narrow roads would
always cause the rear of the car to hit objects.
This is because the rear of the R5 Turbo was wider than the
front.
It's amusing to hear seasoned pros complain about aspects
of a car they don't like.
unmatched.zh:
雷诺是一家热爱竞技的公司。
他们会参与各项赛车运动，F1自然也在其列。
他们的拉力赛血统包括Gordini，以及1970年代的阿尔派。
而到了20世纪80年代，主角就成了R5 Turbo。
作为早期驾驶者之一的让·拉格诺蒂提到过，车辆原本的
操控性非常糟糕。
他还坦言，在狭窄的道路上，车尾常常会因为车手的错
误判断而导致碰撞。
这是因为R5 Turbo的车尾比车头宽。
听到经验丰富的专业人员也会遇到这类问题，真是很有
意思！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
The year 1967 marked a milestone in Japanese motorsports history.
The country hosted its very first 24-hour endurance race
at the newly opened Fuji Speedway.
Long-distance endurance races like Le Mans had been
a European tradition since the 1920s.
But with their arrival in Japan, a new chapter
in motorsport history began.
And the winner of that historic inaugural
Fuji 24 Hours?
It was none other than the Toyota works team,
racing this 2000GT!
It was driven by the legendary duo of Shihomi Hosoya
and co-driver Yoshio Otsubo.|
unmatched.zh:
这是于1967年举办的盛会……
日本在新开放的富士赛道上举办了该国
有史以来第一场24小时耐力赛。
该比赛的性质与欧洲自20世纪20年代以来举办的勒芒等
长距离耐力赛相似。
也是此类比赛首次踏上日本的国土，
标志着赛车运动史上的新篇章。
至于这场历史性、开创性的富士24小时耐力赛的冠军……
还用说吗？自然是驾驶着这辆2000GT的丰田厂队！
驾驶这辆车的车手是传奇的双人组，
细谷四方洋和领航员大坪善男。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Believe me when I tell you that this N-ONE
is a genuine racer!
It has participated in one-make series across Japan.
Honda launched these events in 2014.
That means the N-ONE boasts over a decade of
racing heritage.
Cars competing in these no-holds-barred races had to be outfitted
with roll cages and a host of specialized racing components.
Just watching them take to the track in their colorful
liveries is pure joy!
unmatched.zh:
相信我，这辆N-ONE是天生的极品赛车！
这款车曾经征战日本各地的单一车种比赛。
本田从2014年开始举办这些赛事，这就意味着……
N-ONE参与赛车运动的历史已有十年之久！
参加此类无护栏赛事的赛车
必须配备防滚架和其他指定赛车配件。
光是看着这些身披五颜六色涂装的赛车进入赛场
就足够让人心潮澎湃！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This car is the same. It has a powerful engine and is
extremely lightweight. It's also quick and agile.
It can go toe-to-toe with sports cars with twice
the price tag.
It's a true heir to the Abarth tradition.
unmatched.zh:
这款车轻盈而敏捷，引擎动力充沛，
甚至能够和价格是自己两倍的跑车比拼速度。
它是阿巴斯传统的真正继承者。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The Unimog—a versatile, multi-purpose truck with a storied legacy
has been a legend among enthusiasts for decades.
Its remarkable history traces all the way back to 1945.
It was originally designed as an agricultural workhorse.
And, it first entered production in 1948.
The 411 you see here belongs to the second-generation
series from 1956.
In addition to boasting a more powerful engine than the 401, it
was equipped with a wide array of specialized attachments.
It was the most well-rounded of the early Unimogs. Its endearing
design has captured the hearts of countless tractor enthusiasts.
unmatched.zh:
作为多功能卡车界的“活化石”，Unimog
数十年来一直是车迷心中的机械传奇。
事实上，它的传奇历史甚至可以追溯到1945年！
最初被设计为农用机械的它……
于1948年正式量产。
眼前这台411属于1956年诞生的第二代车型。
相较401型，不仅引擎功率大幅提升，更配有
整套专业级拓展套件。
作为早期Unimog家族最全能的成员，其独特设计
征服了无数拖拉机爱好者。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
This car taught the world the true meaning of "Turbo".
Even today it is often referred to as simply "Turbo."
Porsche poured all of its the engineering expertise into the
turbocharger that powered this Type 930 911.
Compared to the 1978 model, the flat-6 engine had more
displacement, at 3.3 liters, and an output of .
Because the 911 is a rear-engine car, more load is placed on
the rear tires giving it superior traction.
Add to this a turbocharger, and you've got a machine that
can really get up and go!
This 930 holds its own among Porsche's many masterpieces
and belongs in every enthusiast's collection.
unmatched.zh:
这辆车让世界领教到了“涡轮”的真正含义。
即使在今天，这辆车也会经常被提起。
保时捷汇集了他们所有的涡轮设计经验，
然后将其倾注到了这台930型911的涡轮上。
相比79年版，这款车的排气量提升到了3.3升，动力也增加至了。
由于911是一辆后置引擎的跑车，其后轮承受的重量更多，
产生的抓地力也更大。
在这些基础上，涡轮增压器更是大幅增加了这辆车的进气量！
这辆930在保时捷众多杰作中占有一席之地，非常有收藏价值。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
This car...it's named after a mounted knight with a lance.
And this is the fifth-generation version?
I can tell by its appearance that
it's not slow or modest.
It gained fame in the World Rally Championship
and enjoyed popularity across the globe? Impressive!
This is a really nice car, I hope you take good care of it!
unmatched.zh:
所以说这款车是以一位手持长枪的骑士命名的……
而且这是第五代车款了？
一看外表就知道，它肯定不是一辆慢吞吞的老爷车。
哇哦，所以它在世界拉力锦标赛上一举成名，接着在
全世界都很受欢迎。
这真是一辆好车呀。希望你能好好照顾它哦。
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
If you ask me, this car is less of a design study than it is
a study in aerodynamics.
The roofline runs straight across the body to the rear,
where it abruptly cuts off in a coda tronca.
This tells me that it may have been developed as a prototype
for engineering purposes.
unmatched.zh:
依我看，这辆车更像是一项“空气动力学研究”
而非“设计研究”。
车顶线条贯穿整车一直延伸到后部，
突然以“断尾”的形式戛然而止。
我有个大胆推测，它可能是以工程研究为目的
而开发的原型车。/
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
The Lexus LC 500 has absolutely incredible proportions.
With a long, low hood, a long wheelbase...
...a tight cabin, large wheels placed
at the corners...
...and an absolutely juicy body shape,
which is well-sculpted.
It has very technical headlamps and taillamps,
and a fresh interpretation of the Lexus grille.
This design makes it very clear that a highly advanced
engine is under the hood. I absolutely love this car!
unmatched.zh:
雷克萨斯LC500的车身比例十分惊人。
它具有修长而低矮的引擎盖，相对较长的轴距
和紧凑的驾驶舱，硕大的车轮更是占据了四角……
外加夺人眼球、线条精雕细刻的抢眼车身造型。
它的大灯和尾灯科技含量很高，前格栅
则是对雷克萨斯经典款式的重新演绎。
整体的造型都在告诉你——我的引擎盖下面安装了一颗
非常先进的引擎。这是我非常非常喜欢的一台车！"
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
My buddy had bought one when it came out.
I was impressed with how beautiful the engine looked.
It possessed all the right components that make a sports car.
But it was scaled proportionally to match the
body size of a kei-car...
...just like the original FIAT 500.
I loved that short stroke 5-speed shifter.
It had a tight mechanical feel to it.
However, it became notchy often.
That’s why I wanted the Miata to have a short stroke shifter...
...without the notchiness, of course.
unmatched.zh:
我正好有位朋友在这部车发售时买过一辆。
我记得当时我就被这台漂亮的引擎给打动了。
它具备一台真正跑车的所有要素，
只是在设计时按照轻型车的尺寸需要被按比例缩小了。
就像原版的菲亚特500一样！
我真的太喜欢它这台短行程的5速手动变速器了。
它可以为你提供扎实、机械的手感……
虽然确实时不时会出一些小毛病。
是它帮助我下定决心为Miata配备了短行程变速箱……
当然，我们的变速箱没有那些小毛病。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
What a cute little car. It looks like a miniature
supercar.
There are no gimmicky surfaces or details.
It makes me want to get in and attack a twisty road.
unmatched.zh:
真是一辆可爱的小车啊。它看上去就像是一辆微缩版超跑。
没有任何花哨的表面或细节。
它只会让我想要钻进车里，
在崎岖的道路上风驰电掣。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
The 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans was one for the history books.
Jaguar fans from the UK were showed up in force, with Union Jack
flags waving all around the track.
It was a sight I'll never forget.
This is the car that brought Jaguar the victory that day.
It finally got the better of the Porsches that had
dominated Le Mans for so long.
It certainly put a smile on the legions of Britsh fans.
But they first had to endure a stressful race.
It wasn't until the end that Jaguar was able to put away
the Porsche that was applying pressure all race.
Just thinking of it now sends chill down my spine.
unmatched.zh:
1988年的勒芒24小时耐力赛相当不平凡。
那年，大批来自英国的捷豹车迷涌入赛场，
赛道上的米字旗四处可见。
我永远也忘不了那番景象！
而那天为捷豹赢得胜利的，正是这辆车……
他们在那天终于打败了称霸勒芒已久的保时捷。
这也让英国车迷充满了自豪和喜悦。
萨森赛车场那时热闹非凡！
那场比赛非常激烈，获胜的捷豹到最后
都一直面临着身后保时捷的压力！
光是想想那场景就让我背脊发凉！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
You know, the R33 GT-R always reminds me of Le Mans in 1995.
At the time, regulations prevented cars from entering if
a four-door version existed in the lineup.
So, Nissan developed a special 2-door “NISMO GT-R LM."
It was registered in the U.K. to meet homologation requirements.
And Nissan succeeded in entering the car at Le Mans.
It showed just how determined team manager, Kozo Watanabe was...
...to see the GT-R compete in the race.
unmatched.zh:
说起R33 GT-R，总是让我想起
1995年的勒芒24小时耐力赛。
因为当时的勒芒规则明确规定：
若某车系拥有四门版本，则其赛车不得参赛。
为此，日产特别打造了一辆双门版的日产赛车国际GT-R LM，
在英国注册并通过了赛事认证，
这才成功将这辆车送上了勒芒的起跑线。
由此可见，这辆GT-R的研发主管渡边衡三
让其参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的意愿是何等强烈！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Did you know that there is a full-scale paper model
of this EPSON NSX?
It's true. EPSON commissioned Japanese paper artist
Hitoshi Shinozaki to build one.
It’s entirely made of cardboard, including
the tires and all of the other intricate parts.
It looks like the real thing, as if it could
drive off at a moment’s notice.
But I digress.
The real NSX competed under EPSON colors
in Japnese GT races from 2004 to 2009.
At the time, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship
was evolving into the Super GT Series.
The EPSON NSX competed in the latter half of the 2008
season, where it came in 2nd place in ound 8 race.
unmatched.zh:
你知道吗？这款ESPON NSX居然还有一套全尺寸的纸模呢。
这是真的，是Epson委托日本纸模艺术家筱崎仁帮他们打造的。
这个纸模全部由硬纸板做成，甚至连轮胎和其他的圆形
部件也不例外。
这个纸模看上去足以以假乱真，就好像可以随时上路一般！
……咳咳，不好意思跑题了。
Epson涂装的NSX真车加了2004年到2009年期间的
全日本GT赛事。
当时正是全日本GT锦标赛向国际Super GT系列赛转型的阶段。
这款EPSON NSX参加的是2008年系列赛的后半段赛程，并在第8
轮中跑出了第二名的好成绩。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Here we have a seventh-generation Corvette,
or "C7" for short.
If I'm not mistaken, the C7 made its debut in 2013,
at the North American International Auto Show.
And seeing as how the original Corvette was born in 1953…
...the timing of its release lined up nicely with the Corvette's
60th anniversary.
Even in its basic package, the C7 boasted a powerful
race car engine.
You won't find any European sports car that delivers
so much "bang" for the buck.
If you ask me, I'd say it's a real deal for a sports car!
unmatched.zh:
这是一台第七代科尔维特——
简称“C7”。
如果我没记错的话，C7的首次露面是在2013年的底特律车展上。
1953年是初代科尔维特诞生的年份……
这辆车亮相的日子正好是那款车的60周年纪念日。
C7连基本版都搭载了一台强劲的赛车引擎。
用同样的价钱，你绝对找不到能出这么大力的欧洲产跑车。
要我说，对于一款跑车而言，这辆车绝对物超所值！
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
This is a truly historic car, and an extremely valuable one.
Érik Comas became Driver Champion behind the wheel of
a GT-R at the 1999 All Japan GT Championships.
In fact, the Pennzoil car finished in the points
in every race that season...
...and claimed four podium finishes out of seven races that year.
It was also the last GT-R powered by the RB26DETT engine
to claim the title in the GT Championships.
unmatched.zh:
这可是一台历史悠久的车了……而且极其珍贵。
埃里克·科马斯就是坐在这辆GT-R赛车里夺得1999年
全日本GT锦标赛车手总冠军的。
这辆Pennzoil赛车在那个赛季的每站比赛中都获得了积分，
并在当年的7场比赛中4次登上领奖台。
这也是最后一辆搭载RB26DETT引擎获得该项赛事冠军的GT-R。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
While the standard 208 GTi was undeniably small
and light, it did offer loads of fun to the driver.
This Peugeot Sport-engineered version takes the driving
experience to a whole other level.
Its exquisite chassis is stable and responsive.
On even extremely twisty mountain roads,
the car was an absolute pleasure to drive.
In fact, its amazing chassis is reason enough to add this car
in your collection.
unmatched.zh:
虽然标准规格的208 GTi无疑是一款小而轻巧的车型，
驾驶起来却趣味无穷……
这款标致运动精心设计的款式，更将驾驶体验
带到了一个全新的高度。
精细的底盘设置给人以无与伦比的稳重感……
即便是行驶在最蜿蜒的山间道路上，
都能让人尽享驾驶妙趣。
老实说，仅凭其优秀的底盘，
就值得你去收藏这辆车了。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
This Demio is Mazda’s entry in the compact
car marketplace.
It was sold outside of Japan as the "Mazda2"
and it proved to be a big hit.
So the car was reintroduced to the Japanese market in 2019
with that very name.
Mazda is famous for its beautiful rear-wheel sports cars...
...and its legendary race cars that have won titles
the world over.
I'm sure that you'll run into one eventually!
unmatched.zh:
这款Demio是马自达对紧凑型汽车市场的贡献。
实际上它在日本以外被称为“马自达2”......
以至于它在2019年重新进入日本市场时，也叫回了这个名字！
马自达旗下的名车既有优雅的后轮驱动跑车......
也有在全世界范围包揽冠军头衔的传奇赛车。
我相信你以后会遇到一辆这样的车！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
The number of cars participating in the 1991 Le Mans race
was only 38, but among those was the new Peugeot 905.
There were also perennial powerhouses like Mercedes-Benz,
Jaguar and Porsche sharing that starting grid.
To take them all on, Mazda entered two 787B race cars.
Of those two, the No. 55 car, which started the race in 19th
position, gradually worked its way up the running order...
...until it found its way to the front and finished on top!
It was a dramatic first victory for Japanese manufacturers.
To this day, I haven't forgotten the green and red
Renown livery of that race machine.
unmatched.zh:
在1991年参加勒芒耐力赛的赛车仅有寥寥38辆，
但全新的标致905也在其列。
此外，在发车格上还有各品牌常年出战的高性能赛车，
如梅赛德斯-奔驰、捷豹和保时捷等等。
马自达派出了两辆787B赛车来挑战这些强大的对手。
在这两辆车中，从第19位发车的55号赛车
步步为营，不断提升自己的排位……
……最后终于攀升到领跑位置，并以头名完赛！
这是日本车厂的第一次获胜，过程充满了戏剧性。
时至今日，我依然无法忘怀那部比赛机器
的橙绿色涂装。
unmatched.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
unmatched.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师

unmatched.en:
BMW's EV brand began with the "i."
The company offered two products, an urban commuter,
the i3, and the super high-performance i8.
Both models utilized different power sources, and
each expressed itself with its own form language.
They're quite alluring, no?
Particularly the i3, in addition to the proportions
defined by packaging necessities...
The car is eye-catching, even whenit's driving
around town.
The interior also uses sustainable environmental materials.
Everything about the car is thorough.
This kind of approach serves the role of making the user
highly conscious of the environment.
That's why this design is so important. A gold star!
unmatched.zh:
宝马的电动车都以“i”字母起头。
其电动车品牌主打两款产品：作为都市通勤车的i3，
和拥有超强性能的i8。
这两个型号采用了不同的动力源，
而且都以独特的外形设计语言表达出自己的定位。
两辆车是不是都非常诱人？
尤其是这辆i3，在内饰布局和配置上下了不少功夫，
留足了空间……
即便是在城市里驾驶，它也能非常吸睛。
它的内饰采用了可持续环保材料。
此车的一切都透露着缜密、周全。
这样的做法有助于令用户对环保产生深刻的认识。
正因如此，这份独到的设计才显得至关重要。
值得给它颁发一颗金星勋章！
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
If there is a car that perfectly
represents Ferrari’s spirit...
...it is the F40.
The progenitor of all Hypercars,
an absolute myth for enthusiasts.
It follows typical Pininfarina design continuity.
It incorporates the cabin volume of the usual 308
with a body inspired by competition.
Low, profiled, with retractable headlights...
... and indicators that sit behind
smoked Plexigls.
With the two NACAs
on the hood...
...as well as the four lateral "gills" in GTO-style
behind the rear wheel...
..it integrates many functional air intakes.
Other characterstic elements are...
...the horizontal black groove...
...as well as the three round central exhausts and...
...the huge rear wing with the initials F40
in bas-relief on the right side.
unmatched.zh:
如果说有哪辆车能完美代表法拉利的精神……
……那么非F40莫属。
它是所有终极跑车的始祖，是车迷心目中的绝对神话。
它在设计方面延续了宾尼法利纳的经典风格，
并继承了普通版本308的驾驶舱，
但车身造型设计明显是为竞速而生的：
无论是低矮的轮廓，翻转式大灯……
……及雾面有机y璃后的转向指示灯；
还是引擎盖上的两个NACA进气口……
……或是后轮之后的四道GTO风格竖向“鳃”状风口……
……功能性进气口的数量多得让人瞠目结舌。
当然，它的个性还不止于此：
……纯黑色水平蜂窝格栅、
三联装的中置圆形排气管以及……
……大到夸张的尾翼。
在尾翼的右侧面还有一个大大的“F40”]雕标志。
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
Three days after its introduction at the 2019 Paris Motor Show...
...this car competed in the eighth round of the
Nürburgring Endurance Series.
It qualified 2nd and finished 5th overall in the race—
an impressive result right out of the box.
As it had not yet been commercially released,
it entered the SPX class for test cars.
The R8 LMS Evo demonstrated its potential from
the very beginning.
It went on to compete successfully in GT racing series
around the world.'
unmatched.zh:
在2019年巴黎车展上公布后仅3天，这辆车就出现在
纽博格林耐力系列赛的第8轮比赛中！
它在排位赛中获得总成绩第二名，在决赛中获得总成绩
第五名。作为初出茅庐的新车，这个成绩还不错吧？
因为这款车还没正式上市销售，所以它作为测试车参加
SPX级的比赛。
总而言之，R8 LMS Evo从一开始就完全展示了它的肌肉。
之后也继续在世界各地的超级跑车比赛中再创佳绩。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Here's a legendary car from the early days of Japanese
motorsports.
I've heard all about how it used to race around the newly
built Suzuka Circuit.
If you were to ask me which race by this car nicknamed
"Yota-Hachi" was the finest...
...I would have to say that it was the one at Funabashi
Circuit in July 1965.
The event was the All-Japan Club Championship, and the
driver was Tojiro Ukiya.
After that incident, however, he staged a stunning comeback,
moving up through the field to win the race!
There was something almos divine about the performance he
displayed that day.
unmatched.zh:
这是一辆来自日本赛车运动早期的传奇汽车。
我听说过它是如何在新建成的铃鹿赛道上飞驰的！
如果你要问我“丰田八”有史以来最精彩的比赛是哪一场……
那一定是1965年7月在船桥赛道举行的那场比赛。
这是全日本俱乐部锦标赛的一站，车手是浮谷东次郎。
在比赛前期的一次碰撞中，浮谷撞坏z他的挡泥板。车
辆修复后，他的位置跌到了第16位。
然而，在那之后他上演了一场惊人的反击战，在一路高
歌猛进，最终取得了第一名的好成绩
他在那天表现出的速度简直如有神助！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
The C4 Corvette ZR-1 is a famously speedy Corvette.
It set seven international and world records in the 1990s.
In fact, its speed record went unmatched for more than
two decades.
The V-8 engine developed in conjunction with Lotus
was truly impressive and high powered...
...producing over more than the standard model.
All in all, it's a car that's even more valuable than
its price would suggest.
unmatched.zh:
这辆C4科尔维特ZR-1快如闪电的名气谁人不知，谁人不晓。
它在二十世纪九十年代总计创下了7项世界纪录。
事实上，这个无人能及的速度纪录保持了超过20年。
这款车上装载了与莲花跑车公司一同研制的V8发动机，动力强
劲、令人惊艳，
比标准版的动力提高了不止。
我要说的是，它的售价远远不能代表其真正的价值。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
There's nothing like an M car from BMW. The first-generation M3
is mostly associated with racing.
The final model was this "Sport Evolution," which was quite
popular.
It is distinguished by its upgraded 2.5-liter engine
and rear spoilers.
At first glance, the mods may seem slight, but
those in the know will tell you otherwise.
Oh yeah, these cars were impressive indeed.
Not too many of the original M3s were produced, so you can
expect their prices will increase with time.
unmatched.zh:
哦，一辆宝马M系列的车……
第一代M3最适合拿来竞赛了。
这款“运动进化”是最终型号，备受欢迎。
这款车的特点是升级过的2.5升引擎以及尾部扰流板。
乍一看，好像只是些细微改动，但实则不然。
呵呵！实际上这车型深藏不露……
这款车的产量不多，所以价格
只会不断往上涨。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
This may look like an ordinary R34 GT-R, but I can
recognize its true identity at a glance.
This is the BNR34 N1 base, built by the legendary
Japanese tuning house, Mine’s!
Mine’s is one of the oldest and most respected tuners
of the Skyline GT-R lineage.
Its creations embody the perfect balance of power, handling,
and speed, whether on the street or the circuit!
This is a machine every collector dreams of owning.
Among Mine’s many GT-R masterpieces, the BNR34 N1
base stands out as truly exceptional!
unmatched.zh:
这看似是一台普通的R34 GT-R，
但我当即就辨认出了它的不凡来历。
它竟然是著名日本改装厂迈恩斯出品的
BNR34 GT-R N1 base！
迈恩斯是历史最悠久、最受推崇的
天际线GT-R改装厂商之一。
无论是街道驰骋还是赛道竞速，
他们的作品都展现出极致的动力、操控与速度！
这无疑是每位收藏家心驰神往的梦想座驾。
而在迈恩斯众多GT-R改装杰作中，
BNR34 GT-R N1 base堪称真正的非凡之作！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
Do you know the history of AMG?
It started out as a company that built racing engines.
At the helm were two engineers.
They were Hans Werner Aufrecht and Erhard Melcher.
These two worked in the race-engine forge
of Daimler-Benz.
When Benz took a hiatus from motorsport...
...Aufrecht and Melcher decided to go into
business together.
They founded their engineering company out of
Aufrecht’s house in Großaspach, Germany.
Taking the initials of Aufrecht, Melcher, and Großaspach,
they christened their company "AMG."
That was in back in 1967!
unmatched.zh:
你了解AMG的历史吗？
它起初只是一家专门打造赛车引擎的公司……
由两名工程师汉斯·维尔纳·奥夫莱西特……
和埃尔哈特·梅尔赫执掌。
二人曾经在戴姆勒-奔驰的赛车引擎铸造厂工作。
当奔驰暂时远离赛车运动后……
奥夫莱西特和梅尔赫决定共同创业。
于是他们在奥夫莱西特位于德国>罗萨斯帕赫
的家里创办了他们的工程公司。
他们从奥弗莱希特、梅尔赫和
格罗萨斯帕赫三个名字中
各取一个首字母，为公司起名为“AMG”。
那是在1967年！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
If you’re looking for a stylish hatchback, you can’t
go wrong with the MAZDA3.
The MAZDA3 comes in two body types: a 5-door hatchback
and a 4-door sedan.
That said, the fact that they have so few shared parts
is proof of their purposeful design.
Take the smooth roof line of the hatchback—it’s so beautiful
that Mazda went and marketed it as a fastback.
What’s more, this MAZDA3 fastback comes in a
"burgundy selection" grade!
From the seats to the interior panels, everything in this
package is expressed in a most distinctive shade of red.
unmatched.zh:
如果你想要找一辆外观时尚的掀背车，选马自达3准没错！
马自达3提供两种车身版本选择：5门掀背版和4门轿车版。
尽管同属一个车型，但二者之间的通用配件却不多，
这也证明了它们的设计目标性非常明确。
以掀背版本为例，它那流畅的车顶线条非常优雅，而马自达
也特意将其宣传为“斜背车”。
另外，这款马自达3掀背版还供应“勃艮第红”版！
从座椅到内饰板材，一切配置
都采用了最特别的红色调处理。
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
This is the car that made Henrik Fisker famous!
It’s truly a modern 507!
There's a lot I like about it.
First, I like how it pushes BMW's emotional envelope.
It almost has a handmade look...
It reflects a more human approach to design.
It’s really quite wonderful!
It’s a more emotional, artistic approach that
embraces imperfections as character!
And, if anything, the Z8 is full of character.
unmatched.zh:
这辆车让亨里克·菲斯克声名鹊起！
你可以说，它就是现代版的507了！
我喜欢它的地方有很多。
首先，我喜欢它把宝马感性的一面发挥到了极致。
它的外观给人一种手工打造的质感……
反映出一种更有人情味的设计方法。
它有着极强的表现力！
这是一种更感性、更艺术的设计方法，
接纳不完美，并把它转化为车的个性！
倒不如说，这台Z8全身上下都散发着强烈的个性！
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
Ah, Car No. 1, this one brings back memories.
It’s the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R that competed
in the 1999 All Japan GT Championship.
Érik Comas drove the No. 23 Pennzoil GT-R to victory...
...earning the No. 1 designation for the following season.
Oh, and here’s a bit of trivia,
if you’re interested.
Many Nissan GT race cars carry the number 23, right?
That number comes from the Japanese pronunciation of 2-3 (ni-san).
It’s a long-standing tradition for Nissan race cars to wear
this number, seen well before 1999.
unmatched.zh:
哎，这不是冠军车吗？我知道这辆车！
这是参加过1999年全日本房车锦标赛的Pennzoil Nismo GT-R！
驾驶Pennzoil23号车的埃里克·科马斯拿到了最后比赛的胜利，
艰辛地为这辆车守住了宝贵的冠军。
对了，关于这辆车还有一件轶闻，
有兴趣听听吗？
有很多日产的超级跑车都是23号对不对？但第一辆使用
23作为号码的……
没错，就是1998年的这辆Pennzoil！.
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
What, you don’t think that I know this car?
It’s the SLS AMG GT3!
The first customer race car in Mercedes-Benz’s
long and storied history.
It was produced in an era when Mercedes race cars were out
of reach for most privateers.
But the SLS AMG GT3 changed all that.
And its speed and reliability made it a formidable
weapon for privateers the world over.
The SLS AMG GT 3 has really competed in
many, many GT races over the years.
unmatched.zh:
什么？你以为我不认识这辆车？
开什么玩笑，这可是SLS AMG GT3啊！
这是梅赛德斯-奔驰那漫长而传奇的历史当中的首款客制赛车！
在那之前，大部分的私人车队都没机会入手
这样一辆梅赛德斯赛车。
不过，SLS AMG GT3的出现改变了历史。
凭借可靠且强劲的速度，它成为了全球各地私人车手手
中最强力的武器。
这款SLS AMG GT3参加过的超跑比赛数不胜数！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Lamborghini actually never really got into motorsports
as a manufacturer over the yearsBut when it developed an FIA-GT3 car based on the
Huracán in 2015... ...the company finally sent a works machine into the circuit! It made its debut at the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series.And it totally left the other cars in the dust,
finishing winning by a margin of 30 seconds.The car was actually disqualified at one point
because of a rule violation in the team's refueling equipment.But the team appealed and won,
and so did the GT3's in its debut race.
unmatched.zh:
你知道么？兰博基尼作为一家制造商，其实很多年
都没有真正参加过赛车运动了。
但他们积极做出了改变，在2015年基于Huracán打造了
这款国际汽联-GT3，
终于把它们的车送上了赛道！
它在2015年的宝珀耐力系列赛上首次亮相，
就让它的对手们完全望尘莫及，以比第二名快了30秒的
成绩夺 了冠军。
实际上，他们在比赛中一度被取消了资格，因为赛会判
定他们的加油设备出现了违规。
但是他们的上诉成功了，最终在首秀中就赢得了冠军。@
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Subaru won the World Rally Championship's Manufacturers' Title
three years in a row.
It was from 1995 to 1997, and I still remember the thrill
of witnessing that incredible achievement.
Equally exciting was when the company introduced the Impreza WRC
in 1997!
The "WRC" in its name stood for "World Rally Car,"
and it was a new version...
...that allowed a wider range of modifications
permitted by Group A regulatios.
Previously a 4-door sedan, the Impreza
was reborn as a sporty 2-door coupe.
But it wasn't all about style. It performed like a sports car!
In the 1997 season, the Subaru rally team...
...Won eight of 14 races, including the opening rounds
in Monte Carlo, Sweden and Kenya.
This incredible performance led to the team taking home
its third consecutive WRC title.
The Impreza WRC continued to evlve
until the year 2000.
It was a car that defined its era and hailed as an
important part of WRC history.
unmatched.zh:
斯巴鲁——世界拉力锦标赛三冠王！
我永远不会忘记1995年到1997年那段激动人心的时光。
同样令我振奋不已的还有1997年翼豹世界拉力赛车的到来！
世界拉力赛车是“世界拉力赛车”的缩写，也是当年引入的新规格……
相比A组规则，世界拉力赛车组可以进行更广泛的改装。
翼豹原本是一款门轿车，经过回炉重造，成为
一款漂亮的双门车型。
但它不仅长得好看——它真的能跑得很快！
在1997赛季，斯巴鲁拉力车队
在全年的14场比赛中赢得了8场，包括
在蒙特卡洛的开幕战、以及瑞典和肯尼亚站。
惊人的表现也让斯巴鲁连续第三次赢得
世界拉力锦标赛冠军。
翼豹世界拉力赛车持续改装进化，直至2000年。
这款车定义了它所处的时代，至今仍被视为
世界拉力锦标赛历史的重要组成部分。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Without a doubt, the Mini is one of the world's
most popular compact cars.
It was introduced in Britain in 1959.
Its outward appearance was left largely unchanged
over the course of its 40-year production history.
In 2001, it was reborn in the form of the next-generation Mini
we see here.
Although double the size of its classic predecessor,
its handling and styling were pure Mini.
Although the original Mini was British, these modern iterations
were actually developed by BMW.
The German manufacturer did a commendable job
maintaining the spirit of the original car.
unmatched.zh:
迷你毋庸置疑是全世界最畅销的车型之一。
1959年在英国问世……
经过长达40年的生产历史，
外观大体未变。
直到2001年才推出新一代迷你，
也就是我们目前见到的这一款。
尽管尺寸上比历史悠久的前代车型大了两倍，
其操控性和风格仍维持地道的迷你水准。
迷你本是英国车，但其新一代车型出自宝马之手。
制造商的变动，在其响应迅速的转向及
卓越的刚性上得到淋漓尽致的体现。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The most appealing aspect of the AE86 is the experience it
offered to spirited-driving enthusiasts.
It was a rear-wheel-drive coupe that offered excellent control
and a highly engaging drive.
In the well-known Japanese comic series “Initial D,”
the sister model, the Trueno, took center stage.
However, many enthusiasts favored the Levin.
One reason was weight.
The Levin, with its fixed headlights, was approximately
 lighter than the Trueno.
In a car this light, an extra over the front axle could make
a noticeable difference in handling.
unmatched.zh:
AE86最吸引人的要素朴实无华，就在于它的驾驶感。
这是一款操纵感极强的后驱双门轿车，给驾驶者带来非
常多的乐趣。
著名的日本漫画《头文字D》就将雷凌的姐妹车Trueno
作为了主角车。
但在现实里，大部分人会更青睐雷凌。
原因在于车重的差异。
配有固定头灯的雷凌要比Trueno轻。
在这么轻的车头上多出的，会带来天差地别的影响。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
Combining a light, compact body with a responsive
rear-wheel-drive chassis...
...and a peppy 1.8-liter inline-4 engine is the S13 Silvia,
one of the most popular FR Japanese sports cars ever.
Not only was it elegantly styled, it was one of the best
handling machines around.
Today, the popularity of these cars has not waned.
In fact, some consider the S13 to be priceless!
unmatched.zh:
这轻巧紧凑的车身与响应迅速的后轮驱动底盘相结合……
加上强劲的1.8升直列四缸引擎，这台S13 Silvia
简直是面面俱到的前置后驱跑车。
不仅停放时姿态优雅，转弯时同样美得让人窒息。
现如今，这款车确实非同寻常。
老实说，S13本身就是无价之宝！
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The Super Formula? Of course I know it. It’s a world famous
Japanese formula race series.
The beginning of genuine motorsports in Japan is said
to date back to the 1960s.
The first Japanese Grand Prix was held in 1963.
Back then, the track was dominated by modified road cars,
or "touring cars" to be precise.
Since then, Japan has also slowly crafted its own
formula race scene.
For this to happen, Japanese Grand Prix drivers
had to study abroad...
...at famous race schools in England, where they learned
the ins and outs of formula racing.
After that, they teamed up with Japanese automotive
engineers to develop Japan’s first formula cars.
unmatched.zh:
超级方程式？我当然知道啦。这是一项
全球知名的日本方程式系列赛。
据说日本真正的赛车运动始于二十世纪六十年代。
第一届日本大奖赛在1963年就举办了。
在当时，统治赛道的多是些经过改装的公路车，
或者更准确说是“房车”。
自那时起，日本就一直在逐步地搭建
属于自己的方程式车领域。
为了实现这一目的，日本大奖赛的车手们纷纷走出国门……
在英格兰的著名赛车学校学习，并在那里
了解到了方程式赛车的方方面面。
学成归来后，他们便与日本汽车工程师们合作，
打造出了日本的第一款方程式赛车。
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
After Jaguar took a break from racing in 1956, it continued
to work on a successor to the D-Type.
This was during the transition from a front-engine
layout to a mid-engine one.
While Ford gave us Eric Broadley’s Lola GT,
the base model for the GT40...
...and Ferrari gave us the LM...
...Jaguar was committed to building a car with the same
design language as the D-Type.
The result? A rfined and aerodynamic prototype
with a V-12 mounted amidships.
The XJ13.
Designed by the famous Malcolm Sayer...
...the XJ13 never raced, but it surely served as
inspiration for the nw legendary E-Type.
unmatched.zh:
在1956年短暂退出赛车运动后，捷豹继续投入D-Type
后续型号的研发。
这款车诞生于从前置引擎向中置引擎布局过渡的过程中。
在福特推出GT40的基础车型，
即埃里克·布拉德利设计的罗拉 GT……
以及法拉利推出了LM的同时……
捷豹依然致力于沿袭D-Type的设计语言。
其最终成果是一款精致纯粹、拥优秀
空气动力学性能、采用中置V12引擎的原型车——
XJ13。
XJ13由著名的马尔科姆·塞尔所设计……
尽管从未参加过任何比赛，但它无疑
SE-Type的开发提供了大量的思路。
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
The DB3S is a smaller, lighter and more competitive version
of the DB3, which lacked a fighting spirit.
Although it retired after 222 laps at Le Mans in 1953...
...it performed well at Silverstone and many other races.
See how the large front fenders stretch from the headlights
to the cockpit and on to the voluminous rear?
This is similar to the MGA and AC Ace, as well as the
Frazer Nash and Sebring.
That is, it was designed in the classic British style.
unmatched.zh:
相比于略微欠缺战斗精神的DB3，这辆DB3S可以视作是一个较小较轻、
更偏重竞技的版本。
虽然它在1953年的勒芒只跑了222圈便遗憾退赛……
但在银石和其他赛事上却有上佳的表现。
你看到了吗？它的大号前挡泥板从车头灯一直连接到驾驶舱，
又延伸到宽大的车后部。
这种设计与MGA和AC艾斯，以及弗雷泽·纳什
和赛百灵非常类似。
换句话说，就是经典的英式车身风格。/
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
The R.S. 01 was a true mid-engine competition car
belonging to the GT category.
Designed for the track, it sat low, wide, and it was functional.
Thanks to its dynamic and muscular form, it was also
extremely aggressive.
The huge carbon rear wing always impressed, along with
the front spoiler and the rear diffuser.
That said, Renault desired to maintain a "family feeling"
in the front and rear...
...so it adopted the style of the lights and grille
of the production Mégane.
unmatched.zh:
R.S. 01是一款真正的中置引擎赛车，隶属于GT类别。
它专为赛道设计——底盘低、车身宽且功能强大。
充满动感和肌肉感的外形也令它显得攻击性十足。
硕大的碳纤维尾翼给人留下深刻的印象，前扰流器
和后扩散器也同样引人注目。
尽管如此，雷诺还是希望在车头和车尾的设计上
保持“家族传承”……
因此借鉴了量产版梅甘娜的车灯和进气格栅的设计风格。
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
This is the first Civic that wore the Type “R” designation.
This model started the tradition that continues to this day.
When compared to the latest Type “R” model,
it was much purer and simpler.
It shows that times have changed during the past 20 years,
like an evolution of a sneaker design.
unmatched.zh:
这是第一款得到“Type R”命名的思域。
也开启了延续至今的传统。
与最新的Type R车型相比，它更加纯粹和简洁。
它展示了过去20年间的车型变化。就像
运动鞋设计的演变一样。!
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
Toyota has been entering hybrid racing cars into Le Mans
since 2012...
...with its first victory coming in 2018.
While its cars displayed impressive performance year after year,
they couldn't quite translate those speeds into victories.
There were some close calls, though. In 2016, one of its cars stopped
at the front of the pack, with just one lap to go!
The victorious Porsche teamcouldn't believe its luck.
In any case, this just made Toyota’s 2018 victory sweeter.
I remember it clearly—I was so happy!
What's more, Toyota would go on to win five in a row,
its most recent win being in 2022!
unmatched.zh:
自2012年以来，丰田一直致力于将混合动力赛车投入
到勒芒的比赛当中……
他们的首个胜利直到2018年才姗姗来迟。
在此之前，这些赛车每每都展现出令人惊叹的速度，
但却始终无法将这种速度转化为胜利。
不过，期间也有过几次胜利触手可及的时刻——2016年，
领跑车阵的丰田却在离终点只剩z一圈时抛锚了！
就连捡漏的保时捷车队都不敢相信自己的好运气。
不过，这些挫败只是让2018年的胜利变得更加甘美。
我清楚记得当时的感受——我当时高兴坏了！
更激动人心的是，丰田在之后的五年里连战连捷，
其中也包括2022年新鲜出炉的一胜！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
A second-generation Swift Sport!
Thanks to its high base specs, this car can compete
without much modification.
In fact, it was even entered as a junior rally car
at the World Rally Championship!
Having taken the title twice, Suzuki has proved...
The great potential of this machine.
Manufacturing credit goes to Monster Sport, a Japanese
company headed by Nobuhiro Tajima.
Speking of Tajima-san...
His impressive career includes six consecutive wins
at the Pikes Peak International Hillclimb.
Monster Sport has also built legendary hill climbers
based on the Suzuki Cultus and Escudo.
unmatched.zh:
这是第二代的速翼特运动版啊！
因为基础规格够高，所以无需过多改装，
就能直接参加比赛。
事实上，它甚至作为青年拉力赛赛车参加了
世界拉力锦标赛！
铃木用两个冠军头衔证明了……
这辆车的巨大潜能。
这辆车的制造者是Monster Sport，一家田岛伸博创办的日本公司。
说起田岛先生……
他拥有傲人的职业生涯战绩，曾在派克峰国际爬坡赛中获得六连胜。
在他的带领下，Monster Sport也基于铃木Cultus和Escudo
生产传奇的山地爬坡赛车。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
The GR Yaris was developed by Toyota as a rare
example of a fully in-house sports car.
It featured a carbon-fiber roof and a highly rigid body
structure designed specifically for this model.
Its engine and all-wheel-drive system were also purpose-built.
The car was engineered from the ground up to compete in
the World Rally Championship (WRC).
It delivered an exceptionally engaging driving experience, with
performance that rivaled far more expensive cars.
It stands as a model likely to leave a lasting mark
in automotive history.
unmatched.zh:
经过了很长一段时间的沉寂后，GR雅力士是丰田100%
自主研发的第一辆新跑车。
碳纤维车顶和坚固的车身都是专门为这款车设计的，
引擎和四驱系统也是如此。
这辆从头打造的赛车就是冲着世界拉力锦标赛去的。
驾驶它的感觉非常美妙，不是吗？我认为在比它贵上一
倍的车也不一定具备如此高的性能水准。
我相信这是一款会在车史上留下印记的车型。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
Are you familiar with the term "muscle car?"
They were large American machines from the 1960s known for
their large displacement and enormous power.
The first-generation Camaro Z28 was one of the more notable
models from that era.
Its V-8 engine was developed especially for the Trans Am racing
series, meaning it was highly potent.
Instead having tons of torque like other large-displacement
engines, it offered plenty of top-end power.
With awesome straight-line speed, the race version of the
Z28 took home several victories in Trans-Am races.
Known as the last of the Z28s, this 1969 model has been
covetedfor generations.
unmatched.zh:
你熟悉“肌肉车”吗？
这类车以其大排量和强劲动力而闻名，
是60年代美国跑车文化的典型特征。
第一代科迈罗Z28就是在该文化浪潮中诞生的传奇车型之一……
但其专为泛美系列赛研发的
V8引擎，也同样令人惊叹。
不像大部分的大排量引擎那样强调扭矩，
而是主打高转速。
不但能在日常行驶中派上用场，还是让科迈罗Z28
在特兰斯·艾姆竞赛获胜的幕后功臣。
这款1969年车型是Z28最后的改款，
其每代车款都令人着迷不已。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
This sixth-generation ZL1 may be the most valuable Camaro
of all time.
Taking its engine from the Corvette Z06,
the ZL1 produced more than .
This "1LE Package" was designed and tuned
to shine on the race track.
And did it ever. It completed a lap of the Nürburgring
Nordschleife in 7:16:04!
That's a worthy time for a supercar, mind you.
And yet it's about a third of the price of your average super
car, so you'll be getting a lot for your money!
unmatched.zh:
这款第六代ZL1可能有史以来最有价值的科迈罗车型了。
ZL1搭载的引擎来自科尔维特Z06，能产生超过的功率。
配备了专为赛道性能需求打造的
“1LE套件”。
令人难以置信的是，它以7:16:04的成绩跑完了
纽博格林北侧单圈赛道！
要知道，这可是超跑级别的成绩！
然而，其价格仅是寻常超跑的1/3，
绝对带给你极高的性价比！
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The door section without a character line, and the
simple side proportions are very classic.
The covered headlights that were implemented from the DB5
were a popular trend at the time.
The tailfin design of the rear end
is a bit American in taste...
...but it was an era where Italian design was also
being influenced by American designs.
This lassic aura and modern details form the character
of the DB5.
It's one of the most unique cars out of the DB series.
You probably know that it's the car of choice for James Bond,
appearing in numerous movies featuring the super spy.
unmatched.zh:
车门的部分没有特征明显的分界线，简洁的侧面也十分
经典。
从DB5开始引入的包覆式头灯在当时蔚然成风，体现了当
时的潮流。
尾部的立鳍设计很有美式腔调……
那个时代的意大利也正受到美国车型设计的影响。
经典氛围和现代化细节造就了DB5的个性。
它是DB系列中最为独特的一款车，
虽说成为“邦德”车令它名声大噪，但它本身也不失为一
款经典车型。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
Ah, this is the 2017 model, after the second minor change.
This front design was actually...
...a reproduction of the GT-R Proto that we displayed
at the 2005 Tokyo Motor Show.
We felt that the graphic theme of the GT-R Proto might be a bit
too aggressive for a car making its first ever appearance...
This design was born from us saying, "Let's try one
more time to express the design in a different way."
The 2017 car has a very complete look to it, and
I do like it myself.
Also, regarding the interior,
it has a modern design with depth and good textures.
unmatched.zh:
哦，这是2017年的车型，经历了第二次“小”改款。
前部车身的设计其实取自……
我们在2005年东京车展上展出的GT-R 原型概念赛车。
当时，我们觉得作为一款首次亮相的车型，
设计有些过于激进……
于是搁置了这个设计方案，等待时机成熟。
正如你现在所看到的，时机到了。
2017年车型的外观设计完成度很高，我自己也很满意。
我也非常喜欢现代感十足的新内饰，
我们对材质的应用很到位。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
When you mention the 917, I'm reminded by a particular episode.
Allow me to talk about something that happened in 1968.
At the Eiffel wind tunnel, which opened in Paris in the
19th century, we were in the midst of a project...
...while in the adjacent room,
another car was being tested. That was the 917.
A state-of-the-art advanced racing machine tested at a
turn-of-the-century lab! It was amusingly ironic.
The 917 made its debut at the 1969 Geneva Show.
It was the successor to the 908, and instead of an 8-cylinder
engine, this monster had an air-cooled flat-12.
Depending on the race, the 917 came in different forms.
On high-speed circuits, it wore a long-tail body,
and on tricky courses like the Targa Florio, it had a short tail.
unmatched.zh:
提到917，我正好想起了一个故事。
请容我讲讲1968年发生的一件轶事。
当时我们在十九世纪就设立的巴黎埃菲尔风洞实验室里
，我们的新项目正进行到一半……
这时正好有另一辆车在隔壁接受测试，就是这款917。
一辆采用当时最顶尖科技打造
的比赛机器停放在一座修建于前一个世纪的实验室里！
有一种恍若隔世的反{感。
后来，这款917在1969年的日内瓦车展上首次亮相。
虽然这台动力猛兽是908的继任者，但却没有采用水平对置
八缸引擎，而是换上了一台水平对置十二缸风冷引擎。
此外，这台917还可以根据不同类型的赛事调校为不同形式……
例如在高速赛道上采用长车尾，
在塔格·佛罗热耐力赛这样的蜿蜒赛道上则换上短车尾。
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
For many fans who still adore its essential and compact
shape designed by Pininfarina...
...the 512 BB has achieved near-mythical status.
Its design was inspired by...
...the 1968 P6 Berlinetta Speciale prototype.
This is particularly evident in the front and cabin.
Although few people are aware of this...
...you may also notice details derived from the Modulo,
the 1970s Ferrari concept cr.
The extruding wheel arches are one such detail.
But what everyone certainly remembers
about the 512 BB are...
...the large acrylic indicator covers in the front, the louvered
hood grille, the small NACA side air vents...
...and the lower bodywork painted matte black.
unmatched.zh:
由宾尼法利纳所设计的精简和紧凑的外形
为512 BB赢得了大量的忠实粉丝……
他们也将这款车几乎捧上了神坛。
这辆车的设计灵感来源于……
1968年推出的P6双座特别版原型车。
这一点在其车头和座舱的设计上一览无余。
另外，你还可以从中看到
1970年代推出的法拉利概念赛车摩多罗的部分细节：
例如其向外凸出的车轮拱罩就是其中之一。
不过，发现这些关联的人并不多。
不过，512 BB最让人印象深刻的记忆还是来源于……
车头几何形状的大尺寸亚克力转向灯罩、百叶窗式引擎罩格栅、
小型NACA侧面进气口……
以及哑光黑色的下部车身。
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
The 2016 Camaro was inspired by the original Camaro
of the 1960s.
But in a very fresh, contemporary way.
This iteration of the Camaro placed a greater emphasis on its
wheels, with a wide stance and muscular fender forms.
Many of its shapes, in particular the hood, front end,
and rear were inspired by Corvette design.
unmatched.zh:
这辆2016款科迈罗设计灵感来源于1960年代的初代科迈罗……
但进行了大刀阔斧的现代化改动，令人耳目一新。
这个版本的科迈罗设计重点强调轮毂和
肌肉感十足的挡泥板，展现类似宽体低趴的形态。
车身部位的许多形状，尤其是引擎盖、车头和车尾，
灵感其实都来源于科尔维特。
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
The 997 restores some of what was lost in the transition from
the 993 to the 996, while adding some subtle upgrades.
A few of these elements have become something that is
unique to Porsche.
A good example of this is where the turn signals are integrated
with the bumper's air intake opening.
Such refined details may be small by themselves, however they
increase the overall quality and uniformity of the design.
unmatched.zh:
997这款车带回了保时捷从993过渡到996时失去的
一些东西，并对细节做了部分改进。
其中的一些升级最终成为了保时捷的标准元素。
这里有一个很好的例子，就是将转向灯与保险杠的进风
口融为一体。
这些改进本身可能很微小，但提高了设计的品质，还有助
于提升车辆的整体性。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
There was this one time when I received a wedding invitation
from a total stranger living in Texas.
I thought, "Maybe it's an owner of a Roadster?"
So, I contacted the Roadster Club of Texas.
I found out that the happy couple owned a red car and a
white car, and met each other at that very club!
Unfortunately, I wasn't able to attend the wedding...
...but a year later, I received a note that they had a
baby togther!
So I painted a miniature model of a Roadster in pink
and sent it to them.
Being able to connect with owners like this is really
gratifying as a designer.
It's the result of everyone who became involved with this car
being able to share their passion.
unmatched.zh:
有一次，我收到一封喜帖，是住在德克萨斯的陌生人寄
来的。
我心想，“也许这是一位敞篷跑车车主”？然后我联系了
德克萨斯的敞篷跑车俱乐部。
我发现这对夫妇就是通过俱乐部认识的，他们一个人开
红车，一个人开白车
很遗憾我无法抽身参加那场婚礼，
然后过了一年，我又收到了一条消息，他们有了一个
宝！
于是我涂了一个粉色的敞篷跑车模型送给他们。
可以像这样和车主们产生交流和联系，令身为设计师的
我感到万分满足。
如果没有开发这台车的同事们投注的热情，也不可能促
成这样的美事。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
You know, from the start, I wanted to give this Roadster
a timeless design.
It’s full of that sentiment that compels owners
to wish their car a goodnight.
I've even heard of fans who chose to sleep in it
the very first day they had it in their garage.
Truly, it’s a car you’ll christen, throw birthday parties for
and one day lovingly restore.
unmatched.zh:
你知道吗，从一开始我就想让这款敞篷跑车成为永不褪
色的设计。
我希望它能完整传递一种情绪，让车主们会在睡前对自
己的爱车道“晚安”……
而且我确实听说过有车迷在买完车的第一天，睡在了车
里。
我希望这是一辆你会特地为它取名、为它庆生的车，并
在某一天将它恢复到最佳状态……
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
This is the seventh-generation Golf GTI.
The 3-box hatchback theme with a great performance package
was firmly established with the first GTI.
It has seen evolutional changes through the generations.
Yet, there were a few hits and misses over the years.
This one was one of the successes.
The size of the car has been gradually
growing with each evolutionary model.
This one got all the components, and they
were treated correctly.
They combine to establish a great stance, presence
and agility, exuding not only harmony, but also strength.+
unmatched.zh:
这是一辆七代高尔夫GTI。
它采用三厢掀背设计，并搭载动力强劲的性能套件。
这也是从初代起就确定的设计思路。
每一代高尔夫GTI的推出，都会经历一些演化和改变。
多年以来，有些改变成功了，而另一些则不尽如人意。
这一台，是成功的幸运儿之一。
历代的车身尺寸在演化中逐步扩大，
这一代的高尔夫GTI就做到了将所有的要素搭配地恰到好处。
它们的结合形成了运动的姿态，强大的气势和灵活性，
同时还散发出一种和谐感与力量感。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
The R32 Skyline GT-R is popular the world over, but this NISMO
version is really something else.
NISMO, or "Nissan Motorsport International," is the company's
motorsports division.
It was established in 1984.
Back then, Japan was totally into international touring car races
starring the Super Silhouette and other Nissan greats.
Actually, ever since the 1960s, Nissan’s works team has won
many of Japan’s top grand prix races.
This wealth of experience is what made NISMO possible.
And, with all the work that NISMO put into this GT-R,
you know it was destined to be a legend!
unmatched.zh:
R32 Skyline GT-R在全世界都非常有人气，但这台NISMO
却有其独特之处。
NISMO即“Nissan Motorsport International”的简写，负责管理日产的赛车部门。
它成立于1984年。
当时，以“Super Silhouette”和其他日产大赛为代表的
国际房车赛令整个日本都为之痴狂。
事实上，自1960年代以来，日产官方车队就登顶了
许多场日本顶级的大奖赛。
这些在比赛中积累的宝贵经验成为了NISMO设计的基石。
只要了解NISMO在这台GT-R中倾注的努力，你就知道
它是一台不折不扣的传奇！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
In touring car races and rallies...
Renault has long been represented by the compact R5
and its successor, the Clio.
Ah, the WRC Gr.B R5 Turbo and the F2-class Clio Williams!
Those were some great cars!
But what about the somewhat larger Mégane?
Well...
They certainly pulled out all the stops for
this Mégane Trophy!
Despite the outward resemblance to its road-going
variant...
It is in fact a one-make racer, powered by
a midship 3.8L V6 courtesy of Nissan!
It was originally built to compete in the popular Renault
Sport Series, which takes place in Europe.
unmatched.zh:
在房车赛和拉力赛方面……
一直以来代表雷诺出战的都是紧凑型的R5及其继任者Clio。
像是世界拉力锦标赛组别B R5 Turbo和F2级别的Clio Williams！
都是数一数二的好车！
再往上一个级别，就轮到梅甘娜了？
好吧……雷诺为了推动自家举办的梅甘娜杯，
确实是使出了浑身解数！
虽然外表与其公路版本极其相似……
但实际上这是一辆单一车种专用赛车，
搭载与日产联合开发的中置3.8升V6引擎！
另外，这台车原本打算参加的是在欧洲举办的高人气比赛
——雷诺运AS|赛。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
In 2022, scarcely a year after its first appearance...
...the ELANTRA N TC rose to the top, claiming the crown
at the very pinnacle of global TCR competition.
Even now, it continues to assert its authority as
a constant force on the world stage.
And who could overlook its astonishing performance
at the Nürburgring 24h in May 2025?
That was the moment the ELANTRA N TC delivered an improbable
1–2 finish in the TCR Class!
Remarkably, it also marked Hyundai’s fifth straight class victory
at this legendary endurance race.
unmatched.zh:
2022年，即此车面世仅一年之后……
伊兰特N TC就荣获了世界TCR系列赛
最高级别比赛的冠军。
直至今日，此车仍旧在国际舞台上展现着它强大的实力！
谁能忘记它于2025年5月
在纽博格林24小时耐力赛的赛道上驰骋的英姿？
在那场比赛中，伊兰特N TC
可是包揽了TCR组别的冠亚军，堪称奇迹！
此外，这也是现代在这项传奇赛事中
获得该组别的第五次连胜。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
I was pretty surprised when I heard about Nissan's entry
in the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2015.
It was this GT-R LM NISMO.
The designer, Ben Bowlby, insisted on an FF layout and
focused on the car's aerodynamics.
Unfortunately, these innovations didn't pay off.
In qualifying, the car was 20 seconds slower than its
fastest rival.
Then, in the race itself, two of three cars retired, meaning
only one was able to make it to the finish line.
But this car didn't complete enough laps, so in the end
it was DNFed (Did Not Finish)!$
unmatched.zh:
听说日产要在2015年参加勒芒比赛时，我非常惊讶！
在这辆GT-R LM NISMO上，
设计师本·鲍尔比选择了前置前驱布局，并在空气动力学
方面下了很大功夫。
不幸的是，这些创新并没有得到回报。
在排位赛中，该车比第一名慢了足有20秒。
雪上加霜的是，参加正赛的三辆车中有两辆不得不退赛，
这意味着只有一辆车最终到达了终点。
而且，就连这位通过终点线的车手也因为没有完成足够
的圈数而被判定为未完成比赛！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Ford's F-Series is the most popular line of pickup trucks
in North America.
And the Raptor is by far the highest performance model
of the bunch.
One design objective was to optimize it for off-road racing,
therefore, the truck possesses sports-car-like handling.
The Raptor boasts a wide body, reinforced suspension and a
6.2-liter V-8 capable of producing more than .
Put this beast in its element, and it'll shatter your notion
of how fast a truck can go.
unmatched.zh:
福特的“F系列”车型是北美最流行的皮卡。
猛禽是该系列中迄今性能最强大的一款车型。
它的设计理念之一便是强化在越野赛中的性能表现，
这使得它与其他贴地的跑车截然不同。
猛禽不仅有宽车体、强化的悬挂系统，
还有一台能输出以上的6.2升V8引擎。
只要将这头野兽的本领发挥出来，
您对于卡车能跑多快的认识一定会被击碎。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
Nismo is the name of Nissan’s in-house works team.
They are famous for building production cars packed
with racing know-how.
In 2004, to mark its 20th anniversary, Nismo introduced
this R34 GT-R Z-tune.
Of all the Nismo products, this one takes the crown.
At the time of its release, the R34 Skyline GT-R was
already retired.
This meant that the Z-tune had to be based on used cars.
Natually, only those deemed excellent by Nismo were used.
The engines and bodies were disassembled and reengineered
with racing technology.
Today, R34 GT-Rs are celebrated as prized collector’s cars
across the globe.
But none more than the legendary Z-tune!
unmatched.zh:
NISMO是日产自家厂队的名称，
以打造出结合诸多
赛车技术的量产车而闻名。
2004年，为纪念成立20周年，NISMO推出了
这款R34 GT-R Z-tune。
在所有NISMO作品中，这款车堪称巅峰之作。
在它发布之时，R34天际线GT-R
已经停产退役……
这意味着Z-tune必须以旧款车型为基础来进行打造。
自然，只有那些被NSMO评定为极品的车辆才会被选用。
引擎和车身随后被拆解，
并运用赛车技术进行重新改造。
如今，R34 GT-R被全世界奉为
收藏珍品。
而其中最珍贵的莫过于Z-tuneh
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The Lancer Evo series really improved its handling performance
from this Evo V generation.
The body was made wider to incorporate the wider track.
The tires were wider wrapped around 17-inch wheels,
and Brembo brake calipers were standard.
It was one of the greatest 4WD sports cars of the world.
unmatched.zh:
蓝瑟翼豪陆神系列是从翼豪陆神V这一代开始大幅改善它的转弯
性能的。
车身变得更宽，以便扩大胎距，
而且换上了17英寸轮毂，全系标配了布雷博刹车卡钳。
我概括一下，它是全世界开起来最棒的车之一。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The Volkswagen Type 1 is one little car that made
a big splash in automotive history.
Designed as a functional civilian car by none other than
Ferdinand Porsche…
...its distinctive rounded shape resulted in the nickname,
"Beetle."
Its production run spanned more than 60 years, producing
21,529,464 units from the 1940s to the early 2000s.
Thus, the Type 1 is considered one of the most historically
significant cars ever.
unmatched.zh:
这是一款在汽车史上掀起巨大波澜的小型车。这款车正是由费迪南德·保时捷所设计的
实用型民用车……
由于其独特的造型，获得了“甲壳虫”的昵称。
Type 1是久盛不衰的经典车型，
在汽车产业热销超过60年……
从20世纪40年代到21世纪初，
总共卖出了21,529,464辆……
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The only notable difference with the standard 964 Carrera
is the lower ride height.
You may not notice that because it's very discreet.
At a glance you would think it was a standard 964.
But that's another element that woos the fans
of the 964 911 Carrera RS.
It's extremely pure to say the least. There are no comfort
items here at all.
As a result, it's lighter, and its handling
is razor sharp.
I'm certain it will continue to rise in value over time.
It's definitely one of the best of the best.?
unmatched.zh:
这款车与标准的964 Carrera唯一明显的视觉差异是
离地间隙又降低了。
如果没注意到这个差异，
你可能会错以为这是台标准版本的964。
但是，令964 911 Carrera RS的铁粉们
疯狂的要点在于
它的极致简化配置，完全摒弃了
装饰件和舒适性功能。
其结果便是高达的减重，以及如同手术刀般
犀利的操控。
这款车的价值无疑会持续攀高，
因为它绝对是一辆好车中的好车。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The prototype and final production model
of the original NSX...
...was designed by my friend and former chief
designer at Honda, Masato Nakano.
The performance target for the NSX was
to surpass the Ferrari 328 and 348...
...so you know it had plenty of fighting power.
The GT500 class adopted a stepped-bottom rule in 2007, and that
year, this car took the title, winning five of nine races
Because of its incredible speed, you can almost say
that the series imposed a weight-handicap system.
The next year, in 2008, the NSX's main highlight was a 2nd-place
finish in the eighth race of the season at Autoplis.
unmatched.zh:
这辆初代NSX的原型和最终量产型……
……都由我的朋友、前本田首席设计师中野正人所设计的。
NSX的性能目标是要超越法拉利328和348，
所以可想而知，它的战斗力极其惊人。
GT500组别的赛事在2007年采用了阶梯式淘汰规则，
在这一年里，这辆NSX不仅赢得了冠军，还拿下了
九场比赛中的五场胜7。
因为它所向无敌的速度，甚至会让人们怀疑这项系列赛
是不是采用了一套非常不利于大重量赛车的制度。
在接下来的2008年，NSX最亮眼的表现则出现在
奥托波里斯赛道，它在赛季的第八场比赛中以第二名完赛。
unmatched.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
unmatched.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师

unmatched.en:
This is one of Toyota’s best designs in recent years.
It's been over a decade since this car
hit the streets.
Yet to see it today, you’d think it were novel.
The low height and its double-bubble roof result in a drag
coefficient of 0.28, allowing for a smooth ride.
From the significantly canted windscreen...
...to the drastically sloping rear, this car expresses
a bold, clear vision.!
unmatched.zh:
这辆车是丰田近些年来最好的设计之一。
其实它也已经出现在街头十多年了……
但今天看到它，
还是有种新鲜感。
丰田通过压低车身高度和采用双气泡型车顶
成功将阻力系数降低至0.28。这样的车开起来肯定很舒服。
无论是明显下探的挡风玻璃……
还是向后延、并在车尾收束下坠的利落侧面轮廓线，
都让人有耳目一新的良好感受。
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
Don’t let this cheerful little package fool you.
It showcases a high level of product design.
In fact, it's so good it’s timeless.
No wonder the current Cinquecento borrows from it.
Dante Giacosa, FIAT's legendary engineer...
...rose to prominence in 1955 when he created the 600,
Italy’s answer to the post-war compact car.
He then took on the challenge of...
...creating an even better minimally-packagedcar.
The result was a rear-engine, super-compact Cinquecento.
Thanks to the intentionally flared wheel arches,
the car appears to be in constant motion.
The yawning hood lid is also qite appealing,
not to mention functional.
unmatched.zh:
千万不要小看这款娇小的车型。它表现出了极高的
产品设计水平，
甚至堪称永恒经典。
难怪最新款的500也借鉴了它的设计。
菲亚特的传奇工程师但特·吉奥科萨……
在1955年设计出了600，为意大利汽车行业拿出了
战后紧凑型汽车的标准答案，也借此声名鹊起。
然后他勇敢地接受了更大的挑战……
开始打造一款x加优秀的低配置车型。
最终他开发出了这辆后置引擎、空间超紧凑的500。
在他的巧手勾勒下，这款车采用了外扩式轮拱，
让它呈现出一种始终处于运动状态下的观感。
它宽大的引擎盖也拥有一种慵懒闲适的吸引力，而性能
自然也不容小觑。
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
The F430 is strongly derived from the 360 Modena,
albeit with important technical changes...
...starting with the new V-8 engine.
It is also an evolution from a "style" perspective.
While taking the body panels and glass parts from the 360,
it has a more aggressive and technical expression.
The large double-oval front air intakes...
...are inspired by the "shark nose" front
of the 1961 Ferrari 156 F1.
And the four Enzo-inspired circular taillights
add to its aggressive look.
unmatched.zh:
这辆F430在设计上受到了360 Modena的强烈影响，
但也引入了一些重要的技术革新……
首先是一台全新的V8引擎。
从“风格”的角度上来看，你可以将F430视作是一种进化。
虽然采用了与360相同的车身板件和玻璃部件，
却给人以更具进攻性、更有科技感的印象。
它的大型双椭圆形前进气口……
灵感来源于1961年的法拉利156 F1上的“鲨鱼鼻”。
四个Enzo风格的环形尾灯则进一步地强化了它的进攻性。$
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
The Mercedes A45 AMG is so well thought out,
so tough and so cool.
