The body shape is muscular and has great proportions.
The surfaces are well sculpted
and are rich in shape.
Even the wheels are designed to maximize their size,
 and help to plant this Mercedes firmly to the ground.
What makes this car so very cool is that it is authentic
and does not depend on gimmicks.
I want one of these in my garage!
unmatched.zh:
这辆梅赛德斯A45 AMG的设计十分成熟，
性能强悍而且外形帅气。
其车身轮廓充满肌肉感，而且保持了合理的比例。
车身表面经过精心塑形，弧形线条丰富而流畅。
设计师甚至考虑到了轮胎的问题，
最宽尺寸的车胎可以让这辆梅赛德斯牢牢扒住地面。
这辆车的优势在于不忘初心，
绝无任何花哨的设计，只用实力说话。
这样的车，连我也想买一辆！
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
One of the roles design plays in industrial products is...
...to instantly convey information and the underlying message
in a visual way that may not be noticed at first glance.
It is to project the functional excellence of the product, its
philosophy, tradition and the creator's intent, instantly.
It's also supposed to draw the customer in
by eliciting a "love at first sight" appeal.
Therefore, the look of products at time tries to appeal to
many people at once, making many of them looking similar.
Bluntly put, design is usually dictated by the market.
But in the case of the Radical, this is not the case.
Whether it's a mountain road or the race track,
all it needs to do is to go fast.
The headlight, for example, is simply required
to shine a light forward.
Although seemingly unapproachable, this car knos its role.
It’s a one-of-a-kind sidekick that requires a special love.
These types of cars make life entertaining, don't you think?
unmatched.zh:
设计在工业产品制造中扮演的一个重要角色就是……
……要通过视觉手段即时地传递
第一眼可能看不出来的信息和潜台词。
要立刻呈现产品的功能优点、理念、传统和
创造者的想法。
还要通过营造出“一见钟情”的感受
来吸引到消费者。
因此，产品的外观设计有时会试图同时吸引和取悦不同类型的受众，
导致产品外观趋同性。
说白了，设计大部分时候都受到市场的主导。
不过Radical却是个例外。
不论是山路还是赛道，它唯一的目的就是跑得更快。
比如说它的车头灯就只需要直直地照亮前方。
尽管这台车的声浪不够大、操控性不够友好，
但它很清楚自己的定位。
那就是成为独一无二、让你爱不释手的一_老朋友。
这类车可以让你的人生充满乐趣，你觉得呢？
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
The large air intakes placed on the side of the body are
reminiscent of elegant French styling of the 1930s.
However, I sense it is slightly mismatched with the
wild example of the coda tronca body style.
In the Veyron, the intakes are placed there
to improve aerodynamics.
They make the sides look a bit like a French carrosserie
or the Delage D6 of Henri Labourdette.
This is a beautifulflamboyant French design, one where
the function-defining form to travel at ...
Makes modern-day Bugattis so alluring, don't you think?
It's my fondest hope that they always remain
sublime and pure.
unmatched.zh:
位于车身两侧的大号进气口令人回忆起1930年代
的那些优雅法国车造型。
不过我总感觉这种风格和断尾
的设计有些不搭。
在布加迪Veryron上，在这里设计进气口是为了提升空气动力学性能。
这样的设计让侧面的外观向法式车身靠拢，
又有点类似亨利·拉布戴特的德拉奇D6。
美观到有些浮夸的法系0计，
外加能够达到极速的超跑定位……
让现代版本的布加迪充满了魅力，对吧？
在此致以我最美好的愿望，希望他们可以
永远保持卓越和纯粹。
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
This is the original model where the Jeep culture started.
It was purely a functional design to meet military needs.
The form-follows-function process doesn’t always
guarantee esthetic success.
Only on very rare occasions does it work like
magic and, in this case, it did, and the vehicle became an icon.
 Engineers who worked on this program...
...must have had a good sense of proportion
and high design qality standards.
They knew where the right amounts of radii needed to be applied.
In some cases, that extra depth of the flanges helped add
rigidity to the panel so they could use a thinner piece
My hats off to the original creators.
unmatched.zh:
这辆原版车款就是整个Jeep文化的起点。
作为服役车辆，它的设计完全强调功能性。
这种外形为功能服务的设计出发点
显然无法保证美学上的成功。
或者我应该说，成功的几率绝无仅有。
而这样的成功就落在了Jeep身上，缔造出了汽车史上的经典符号。
参与这项开发计划的工程师们……
……很好地掌握了比例的x念，
并且对设计品质有极高的标准。
他们将外观的弧度与半径计算得分毫不差。
例如，他们会通过采用凹陷度更深的轮缘来强化板件的刚度，
以削减板材厚度，达到减重的效果。
光凭这一点，就值得我们向那些早期设计者们脱帽致敬。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
The Type R has the perfect balance of cosmetic and
mechanical tuning.
Its design is simply iconic.
Equally well-balanced in its proportions, it has a great
stance that speaks to its agility on the track.
The car that set the standard for FWD racers,
it still looks great.
What’s more, it captured the spirit of JDM tuners better
than any other model that came after it.-
unmatched.zh:
本田Type R在外观设计和机械性能调校方面
达到了完美的平衡。
它的设计堪称经典。
其车身比例同样协调，完美的车身姿态充分
展现了它在赛道上的灵活性。
这款车型为前驱性能车树立了标杆，
时至今日依然魅力不减。
更重要的是，它比后续其他车型都更好地
诠释了日本国内改装车（JDM）文化的精髓。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
Both Ferrari and Pininfarina have a certain philosophy.
And that philosophy is that a Ferrari "must
be beautiful and distinctive."
The La Ferrari was introduced as the pinnacle of
technology, aerodynamics and styling.
Like its predecessors, it stood as an expression of
pure functional beauty.
There are no gimmicky surfaces or details in its design.
It stood apart from the more aggressive-looking supercars of its time.
unmatched.zh:
法拉利和宾尼法利纳都秉承了同一设计理念：
每一辆法拉利都必须“美观而独特”。
这台LaFerrari就代表了技术、空气动力学和美学风格上的极致。
和其前辈们一样，它同样遵循“性能高于造型”的设计思路，
摒弃一切花哨的装饰曲面或细节，
在众多外观更加“唬人”的超级跑车中显得鹤立鸡群。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
This is no ordinary pickup truck. It's a super truck,
capable of dominating on dirt tracks and oval circuits.
Any mention of a Tundra makes me think of the Baja 1000
desert race.
It's an all-night race that takes place on a 1,600 km
course in the Mexican desert.
It's a challenging race, with more than half the cars entered
never seeing the finish line.
Toyota took on the Baja with this Tundratuned by TRD,
and the truck won in its class.
And, did you known that the Tundra TRD also
raced on oval race tracks?
In 2019, it entered a survival event in Daytona, winning a
race in which only nine out of 32 cars fiished.
unmatched.zh:
这不是一辆普通的皮卡车。这是一辆真正的超级卡车，
在泥地赛道和椭圆赛道上都占据着统治性的地位！
一提到坦途，我就会想到巴哈1000沙漠越野赛。
这场在墨西哥沙漠举办，赛程长达的比赛
全部在夜晚举行。
这是一项艰苦卓绝的赛事，每次都有半数以上的参赛车
辆会因为各种原因退赛。
丰田公司带着这辆由丰田赛车开发中心改装过的坦途参加了比赛，
并在本级别中揽获冠军。
此外，你知道坦途丰田赛车开发中心也曾在椭圆赛道上比试过吗？
2019年，它参加了在戴通纳举行的生存赛，在一场32辆
汽车中只有9辆完赛的比赛中取得最终的胜利。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
The fifth-generation Skyline GT-R went by the codename R34.
The man responsible for its development was
Kozo Watanabe.
A graduate of Tokyo University, Watanabe earned
a degree in automotive engineering.
The R34 was his follow-up to the R33.
A longtime admirer of race car development...
Watanabe wanted to go to Britain to develop Formula 1 cars.
But fate itervened and he began working for Nissan,
which was then racing the R380 and the R381.
When Watanabe was tasked with developing the R33
Skyline GT-R...
...he swore he'd build a car that would exceed the speed
of the R32.
It turned out, he kept his word. On a test run, the R33
set a lap time of 7:59 at the Nürburgring!
This time was 21 seconds faster than the fastest lap
set by the R32.
The R33 then led to the R34, hich carried on the
spirit of its predecessor.
unmatched.zh:
这辆R34是第五代的Skyline GT-R。
这辆车的设计者是渡边衡三。
他毕业于东大汽车工程系。
R34是R33的后继车型。
渡边早对赛车开发早就心痒不已……
他本想前往英国去设计F1赛车。
由于这个目标未能实现，他进入了
当时正在使用R380和R381竞赛的日产工作。
当渡边接到了设计Skyline GT-R R33的任务时……
他曾发誓要造一辆比R32更快的车。
您猜怎么着？在试跑时，R33在纽博格林赛道上
跑出了7:59的单圈时间！
比R32的记录快了21秒。
当然了，它的后继者R34身上也继承了这种精神。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
When designing a race car, the natural impulse
is to build something small and light.
But this M6 GT3 breaks the mold, with a total length that is
 longer than that of the production model.
The wheelbase has also been extended.
Many wondered if the extra length of the car would
diminish its handling ability.
That concern was wiped clean when racers first
drove the car.
They praised it for its precise balance and
smoth turning feel.
And their findings were soon backed up by results.
The M6 GT3 drove to a magnificent win on
the narrow Macao GP circuit in 2018.
At the wheel then was Japanese touring-car
ace Seiji Ara.
It was a truly incredible race to behold.
unmatched.zh:
说到赛车设计，人们很自然地会想到小而轻的竞速机器。
但是这辆M6 GT3却反其道而行之——
它的车身长度比量产车型还要长出！
它的轴距嘛，当然也很长！
这样的设计让人不由地担心起它的过弯能力来。
然而，开过它的车手却不是这么说的……
他们对车辆的精确操控和平顺过弯能力赞不绝口。
你还是不相信？
那我告诉你一个事实，日本房车赛传奇车手荒圣治驾驶着它
于2018年在狭窄的澳门大奖赛赛道上
取得了一场辉煌的胜利……
这是一场令人难以置信的比赛，精彩程度令人叹为观止！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
What happened in June 1972 was pretty unusual by anyone's
standards.
It was the second race of the popular Fuji Grand Champion
Series, which took place on the Fuji International Speedway.
And, despite being up against Gr.6 and Gr.7 race cars...
...a lower-level machine based on a production model managed
to emerge victorious!
The car was a Fairlady 240ZG, and its driver
was Japan's Hauhito Yanagida.
The race took place in heavy rain, and the 240ZG performed
exceptionally against its higher-ranked rivals.
And yes indeed, it beat all of the other entries.
The event became known in Japan as the "Z in the Rain" race, and
remains one of the most legendary moments in motorsports.
unmatched.zh:
在任何人看来，1972年6月发生的事情都是非比寻常的
奇迹。
当时，人气十足的富士大冠军赛的第二场比赛正在富士
高速赛道上如火如荼地举行。
面对组别6和组别7类别的对手……
一辆基于零售车型改装的低级别汽车却杀出重围、斩获
了胜利！
这辆车是一辆Fairlady 240ZG，车手是日本的柳田春人}
在大雨滂沱的赛场上，240ZG在与高等级对手的较量中
表现得异常出色……
最终以第一名的成绩冲过终点线！
这场比赛在日本被称为“雨中的Z”，是赛车运动中最具
传奇色彩的时刻之一。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
The Yaris WRC totally dominated the World Rally Championships.
It won the Manufacturers Championship in 2018...
...and in 2019 it took the Drivers' title as well, with a
record six wins. The most for the series.
This GR Yaris was developed specifically to dominate
in the rally championship, which it did!
After developing this competition car to win at the WRC,
a production version was planned for homologation.
Whether you're a fan of racing or not, you'll find
that this car is one amazing machine!
unmatched.zh:
雅力士世界拉力是一款彻底统治了世界拉力锦标赛的赛车。
它在2018年获得了制造商冠军，
在2019年则取得创纪录的6场胜利，摘下车手冠军的桂冠。
我们可以确定的是，这辆GR雅力士是专为统治世界拉力
锦标赛而研发的！
他们先是制造了一台能在锦标赛上夺冠的比赛机器，
然后再规划量产车型，接受赛事认证。
不管怎么说，对于一个真正的赛车迷来说，这是少数几
辆能令人兴奋到不能自己的公路车！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This car looks beautiful from every angle.
It's a real work of art.
I see, it’s a special Mazda concept car.
You can tell right away it’s a sports car,
but it’s so elegant and refined.
The engine sound is a real surprise!
I didn’t know an engine could sound so crisp and clear.
unmatched.zh:
无论从哪个角度看，这辆车都是那么的漂亮迷人。
我知道了！所以这是一辆马自达的特别概念赛车！
我是说，你一眼就能看出这是一辆跑车，但它的外形是那么优雅，
那么让人目眩神迷。
可是发动机的声音真的是让人大吃一惊！
我从来不知道发动机也可以发出如此清脆的声音！%
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
You know when you look at this car from an angle
it looks like an Italian car, it's so beautiful.
Huh, what's with this gauge that’s mounted in
this weird position?
Ohh, so they've already got a place for the boost gauge
for the turbo.
With the boost gauge in your face like that
It probably makes you wanna drive faster!
unmatched.zh:
你从某个角度看这辆车的时候，它就像一台意大利车那
样美丽。
嗯？安装在这个奇怪位置的仪表是怎么回事？
哦哦，所以他们为涡轮增压表特意找了一个位置。
像这样把仪表装在你面前，大概会让你想要开得更快吧！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
The Prius caused a great sensation by being
the world’s first mass-produced hybrid car.
But did you know its first-gen design was considered
to be somewhat lacking?
The second-generation model featured a one-motion profile
from its front to its coda tronca rear.
This became standard for the Prius line, as you can see in
this well-formed third-generation model.
unmatched.zh:
作为全球首款混动汽车，普锐斯曾引发轰动性的风潮。
不过你知道吗？它的第一代设计被普遍认为有所欠缺，
不够完美。
从第二代车型开始，普锐斯采用了从车头到
“断尾”车尾的一体成形轮廓……
这随后就成为了普锐斯产品系列的标准设计，
你在这款外形美观的第三代车型中也能看到。[
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
What's interesting about this car is that the bodywork was penned
by a young Giugiaro, who was then the chief designer at Ghia.
It seems so simple, it looks to drawn by a single brush stroke,
thus the shape consists of simple lines and surfaces.
A half century later,
the car still looks fresh and alluring.
It shares the same backbone chassis technology as
the original Vallelunga, with a Ford V-8 housed within.
Access to the mid-mounted engine comes
via a butterfly-type rear hatch.
This detail is also particularly interesting and fun. I like it.
unmatched.zh:
这辆车最令人着迷之处全在于它的车身，
这是由车身制造公司吉亚后来的首席设计师，
当时才初出茅庐的乔盖托·乔治亚罗执笔设计的。
它的外形如此简洁、仿佛是一笔而就，
因此其形状都为简单的线、面所构成。
在半个世纪后的今天，依然有新鲜感和吸引力。
它采用了与其原型瓦莱伦加相同的脊骨式车架技术，
搭载福特V8引擎。
掀开鸥翼式的后备箱盖，就可以看到这台中置引擎。
这个细节特别有趣味。我很喜欢。
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
The 308 can be considered the progenitor of all modern
8-cylinder Ferraris, and the most popular of them all.
And, perhaps it was also the longest-lasting.
 Its production run spanned from 1975 to 1989,
including the derivative version, the 328.
Besides its technical aspects, the car's success came
from an extremely balanced and pure design.
It's almost timeless.
It serves as a perfect example of Pininfarina’s design
philosophy applied tothe cars of the Cavallino.
In fact, it takes up some classical themes from the Dino
246, such as the progressive wave on the two-wheel arches...
...and the iconic side air intake,
but also the dynamic rear pillars.
And, of course, the truncated tail with
four round taillights.
However, all of it was transformed into a very essential
and modern shaping for the time.
unmatched.zh:
308不仅是所有现代8缸法拉利跑车的鼻祖，
而且无疑是所有车款当中最受欢迎的一款。
它可能也是持续量产最久的一款法拉利。
如果将328版本也算进去，
其生产时间足足从1975年延续到1989年。
这都要归功于它纯粹且经得起时代考验的设计。
在评论家口中，它的平衡性同样首屈一指……
还完美诠释了宾尼法利纳的设计理念。
它甚至复兴了Dino 246的经典元素，如外扩的轮拱……
标志性的侧面进气口，动态的C柱……
还包括带有四个圆形尾灯的截断式尾部。
当然，所有这些元素都经过改良，
以适应更加现代化的设计理念。*
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
The C7 Corvette was inspired by the rich history
of Stingray designs.
That said, it expressed more athleticism in its execution
of those designs.
The entire body is like that of a stingray fish, with its
undulating surfaces and instantly recognizable slope.
And don't forget that piercing front end.
Its bold hood is shrink-wrapped
around a powerful V-8.
Also, its many air intakes and vents manage the flow of
air throughout its incredibly sleek design.?
unmatched.zh:
C7科尔维特的设计从Stingray过往车型的丰富历史中
获取了灵感，
并且在运动感方面取得了突破。
整台车的造型好像一条魔鬼鱼，
有着棱角分明的前脸设计……
以及起伏的车身表面和令人过目不忘的倾斜线条。
在隆起的引擎盖下包裹着一台强大的V8引擎，
而无处不在的进气口和风道则巧妙地将气流
导向纤细流畅的车身四周。
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
About Pagani's design...
...its approach is quite different
from other traditional car makers from Modena.
Ferrari, Lamborghini, Maserati...
...most of their designs are born from
historic cars that were on sale in the 1960s and 1970s...
...with body styles that were designed by a carrozzeria in Turin.
When the Zonda was introduced, at the end of the 1990s, the era
of designs that shined30 years before in Turin had concluded...
...thus, Pagani adopted its own unique design language.
It wasn't as if it was leaving all of its rivals in the
past at once...
...but it sought to wrap sophisticated mechanisms
with an attractive body, without being too flamboyant.
That kind of balance is what defines Pagani, I feel.
unmatched.zh:
帕加尼的设计方法……
和来自摩德纳的其他传统汽车制造商大相径庭。
以法拉利、兰博基尼、玛莎拉蒂等为例，
他们的大部分设计都来自于在20世纪60年代和70年代
亮相的历史名车……
这些车的车身大多是交给都灵的车身制造商设计的。
当Zonda于20世纪90年代末期发布时，
持续30余年的都灵设计(代已经告一段落……
所以帕加尼首次采用了自己的设计语言。
倒不是说它将过去的对手彻底甩在了身后，
但它确实做出了创新尝试，将复杂的机械构造
装入具有吸引力、同时又不会过于喧宾夺主的车身当中。
这也造就了帕加尼设计特有的平衡感。
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
Look at this MR2, and you're likely to notice its modest, understated design.
In Italy, you'll find fierce beasts like the Urraco,
named after a fighting bull, and the Merak.
These are flashy cars that really stand out, but they're
not for the faint-hearted.
Let's just say that even when you handle them the
right way, they can still bite back.
This MR2 is pretty domesticated in that respect,
and does exactly wha you tell it to do.
But that doesn't mean it's tame by any means. Put the pedal
to the metal and you won't know what hit you!
Still, for a carefree driving experience,
you can't go too wrong with this car.
It's one you'll want to make a place for
in your heart and in your home.
You can recognize some elements inspired by Ferrari here
and there, but all in all, it retains a certain modesty.
Perhaps this reflects he belief of the Japanese designers
that they weren't quite ready for the world stage...
...just yet.
unmatched.zh:
看看这辆MR2，它是如此地谦逊、低调。
在意大利，有着像Urraco这样的猛兽，以公牛的名字命
名，或是同样出名的Merak。
这些姿色出众的好车需要你拥有强大的气场才能驾驭。
这样说吧，就算你知道如何伺候好它们，还是会冷不防
地被它们回咬上一口。
这辆MR2相比之下就服帖多了。你说什么，它就做什么。
当了，服帖不代表盲从，踩下油门的那一刻，你会瞬
间飞入云端！
拥有如此体贴入微的驾驶体验，怎么的驾驶方法都不会
出错。
这样的它，会让你想将之迎入家中，也迎入你的心里。
你可以在这里或那里瞥见一些与法拉利类似的元素
……但骨子里仍是日本人的谦逊有礼。
也许这反映出了当时的日本设计师的理解，认_自己的
设计还没有达到世界级的水平
……但是只是暂时没有而已。,
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
Oh boy, this is just crazy!
That "5" I loved so much, what happened?
Just because it wanted to go fast in rallies,
it didn't have to sell its soul to the devil!
It has become wider, and if you look at it from the
rear, it looks like a laughing Cheshire Cat.
And because the engine is mounted at the rear,
it only seats two now.
But wait...
...upon closer examination, aside from th bulging fenders and
bumpers, oh my, much of the original 5 is still there, as is.
Aside from the cheeks, the car has a gentle face,
which means, it's more Clark Kent than the Hulk.
I mean, what kind of magic is this?
The interior of the Turbo 1
features a super modern Mario Bellini design.
This thing would be stylish, even in Paris!
Oh my! I think I've fallen in love with this crazy 5
Somebody, anybody, gimme some of this magic on my own 5.
unmatched.zh:
这真是太疯狂了！
他们对我熟悉的那台可爱的小“5”做了什么？
为了让它在拉力赛中有所建树，就非得
把它的灵魂出卖给魔鬼吗？
你看，它的车身整整变宽了。
从背后看过去，就像一只咧嘴笑的柴郡猫。
由于搭载了一台后置引擎，它现在只剩下两个座位了。
等一下……
细看下来，除了起的挡泥板和保险杠以外——
哦，原版小“5”的大部分特征基本还是保留了！
不看侧面的话，它的前脸还是和原来一样，
所以还是更像肌肉分明的超人，而不是大块头绿巨人。
他们这是施展了什么样的巫术啊？
Turbo 1的内饰采用了马里奥·贝里尼设计的超现代风格。
就算走上巴黎的T台都不会显得格格不入！
哦，天呐！我想我已经爱上了这辆疯狂的小“5”。
事实上，我愿意接受它的一切！
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
I got a call one day from my protégé at Mazda Design asking
for my thoughts on the design of the fourth-gen Miata.
I told him that I wrote a scenario for the first three
generations at the beginning of the NA project.
I normally look forward 20-25 years ahead
from the start of a project.
Therefore, I had no ideas for the fourth-gen car,
except the following:
 If it was to be mecanically similar,
then the design should...
...differ more from the NA to NB, and NB to NC.
If the car was to be mechanically new...
...with an innovative layout or different type of
powertrain, then it should be evolutionary.
 I never got to see the design of the
fourth-gen development at any stage.
When I asked the designers how things were going?
Their answer was always...
“Don’t worry, you guided us
to do the right thing.”
 They actually didn't want to show me the car...
...even on the night before
the world premiere event.
Enough was enough, so I made my stand.
 I told them that
“You know that I can't keep a poker face.”
"Whatever I see or feel shows on my face.
I can't help it."
"Can you risk that happening tomorrow?”
They thought about that for a moment,
and they came to the correct conclusion.
They finally showed me the car, and do you know
what I thught?
The fourth-generation car was designed in the right
direction, indeed.
unmatched.zh:
有一天，我接到来自在马自达设计工作的一位弟子的电话。
他询问我是否为第四代Miata Roadster做过类似的设计规划。
我有个习惯，每当我开启一个项目时，
我都会尝试想象它在之后20年里的演变。
所以我是这样告诉他的。
我说，我在NA项目启动的时候，就已经
为前三代都写好了方案……
但对于第四代而言……
我暂时没有什么具体的想法。
不过我又补充了一句，
如果机械结构上没有太大变化的话，那么设计方面……
相较于从NA到NB以及从NB到NC的演化，
应该体现出更大的变化。
此外……
如果这辆车在机械结构上是全新的，
应用了创新的布局或不同的传动系统……
那么在外观方面也应该体现出充分的演化。
在此之后，我直没机会参与到第四代Roadster的开发当中。
每当我询问设计师们事情进展如何时，他们都会叫我放心。
“不用担心，”他们总是这样说。
“您给我们指出了一条正确的道路。”
事实上，直到新车全球首发的前一天晚上，
他们都还在想方设法对我保密。
我后来忍不住了。
我对他们说：“我是个藏不住事的人。
万一明天我一不小心当众露7失望表情，你们打算怎么办？”
他们这才让我看到了新车，你猜怎么着？
第四代的设计方向走得很踏实。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
You know, I used to drive my friend's
PGC10 GT-R a lot.
That’s what got me into sports sedans, which I consider to be
a "wolf in sheep’s clothing".
Now, this here is the model that set the basic formula
for the modern GT-R.
At first glance, it evokes a clear sense of volume.
And by weighing down the rear fender, the designers
made the car look like it was in motion even when stnding still.
This allowed the GT-R to strike a more aggressive stance
than the base GT model.
Also...
...it marked the beginning of the era of sensor-controlled
vehicle dynamics and other high-performance technologies.
All of this makes the current GT-R the rightful heir
to this R32 GTR.
unmatched.zh:
我过去常常开我朋友的PGC10 GT-R，所以对它非常熟悉。
运动型轿车给人一种“披着羊皮的狼”的感觉，
这正是这种车型最吸引我的地方。
我现在要介绍的这款车为现代GT-R确立了基本范式。
首先，它表现出一种清晰的体积感。
然后，设计师通过压低后挡板的重心，
让此车有一种蹲伏起跑、跃v欲试的感觉。
从而赋予了GT-R超越GT的定位。
此外……
从这个型号开始，由传感器来控制车辆动力
和其他高性能附加套件的时代揭开了序幕。
这一切都足以证明这台R32 GT-R正是当代GT-R系列的鼻祖。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
This is a race car version of Mercedes-Benz's luxury sedan,
the 300 SEL.
The 300 SEL caught the eye of Mercedes-Benz tuner, AMG...
Who tweaked it to racing spec by increasing the engine
displacement to 6.8L.
It made its race debut in July 1971...
...in a European Touring Car Championship race at Spa-
Francorchamps in Belgium.
It won its class there, and finished in avery impressive
2nd place overall.
Pretty amazing for a large, 4-door sedan!
This result put AMG on the map, and gave it worldwide
prominence.
AMG would go on to play a key role in Mecedes-Benz's
race teams at the DTM and elsewhere.
unmatched.zh:
这是梅赛德斯-奔驰的豪华轿车300 SEL的赛车版本。
梅赛德斯-奔驰的改装商AMG慧眼发掘了300 SEL。
AMG将其调整为赛车规格，引擎排量增加到了6.8升。
它于1971年7月首次在比赛中亮相……
在比利时斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道举行的欧洲房车锦标赛中，
它不仅赢得了本级别的比赛，并获得了总绩第二名，
令人印象深刻。
对于一辆大型四门轿车来说，这是很了不起的成就。
这一成就也使AMG声名鹊起，并在全世界范围内为人所知。
在那之后，他们在梅赛德斯-奔驰旗下的各支赛车队伍中、
在包括德国房车大师赛的各项赛事中发挥了关键作用。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
The V12 Vantage GT3 made its first appearance
in 2012 at the British GT Championships.
The car was totally at home running races in its native
country, leaving the competition behind.
In more than 67 races in seven seasons,
the V12 Vantage found the podium nearly every time!
What’s more, in more than 30 percent of its races,
it took the checkered flag.
Needless to say, it will beremembered as a legendary
race car in the annals of GT3 history.
Up until 2019, when it passed the baton
to its V-8-powered successor...
...this incredible car consistently enjoyed life at the
forefront of GT racing.
unmatched.zh:
V12 Vantage GT3在2012年的
英国GT锦标赛上初露峥嵘。
你来猜猜它的主场表现如何？
在七个赛季的67场比赛中，它几乎每次都能登上领奖台。
更夸张的是，它在超过三成的比赛中
站上了最高领奖台！
毋庸置疑，这是一台
值得被铭记在GT3历史中的传奇赛车。
事实上，直到2019年，它才把接力棒
传给它的V8车型继任者……
这辆了不起的赛车将其漫长的职业生涯都献给了GT赛事
的最前线。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This is a fifth-generation Corvette, called the C5
from 2001.
It was a truly unforgettable chapter in the Corvette's legacy.
It was when a C5-based GT racer known as the "C5-R"...
...achieved a stunning overall victory at the 24 Hours
of Daytona.
Just a few months later, it secured a class
win at Le Mans...
...followed by yet another triumph in 2002.
Beloved by many, the C5-R is still considered
among the fastest GT cars in the world!
unmatched.zh:
这是一辆第五代科尔维特——
尽管是一辆2001款的C5。
对于科尔维特而言，这是载入史册的年份。
基于C5打造的超级跑车“C5-R”
不仅在戴通纳24小时耐力赛斩获全场总冠军，
数月后更在勒芒赛场摘得本组别桂冠，
并在2002年成功卫冕！
这台深受车迷爱戴的C5-R，至今仍是
全球最快的超级跑车之一。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This is the car every car designer dreams of doing!
It’s gorgeous!
Its influence is, of course, the 917!
The cabin is low and sleek, with extreme cab-forward
architecture, like that of the original 917.
The windshield shape is like a visor wrapping
around the sides...
...while the front has a bit of 918 DNA.
A slightly restrained low, narrow mouth...
..and four headlamps seem to forecast the new Porsche
headlight DNA of the 919, raced at Le Mans.
The wheels are similar to the 918.
The rear spoiler is interesting, as it connects the fender
forms and has the taillamp integrated flush below.
The paint scheme is inspired by the Le-Mans-winning
"Porsche-Salzburg" 917K...
...run by the Porsche-Piech family team in Austria.
unmatched.zh:
这是一款所有汽车设计师都梦寐以求想要打造的车型！
它简直太漂亮了！
这也是理所当然的，毕竟参照的基础车型可是917！
和原版917一样，它的驾驶舱高度较低，呈流线型设计，
并采用了驾驶舱极度前置的结构。
挡风玻璃的形状更像是一副包裹住侧面的面罩……
前脸略微透露出918的血统。
其略显克制且低窄的进气口……
和四盏大灯则预言了随后在勒芒参赛的919
所引领的保时捷大灯设计理念。
它的轮毂与918类似。
其后扰流板与挡泥板直接相连，从而将尾灯顺畅地
整合在下方，显得趣味十足。
它的涂装方案灵感来源于由奥地利的保时捷·皮耶希家族
车队经营，并在勒芒取得胜利的……
“保时捷·萨尔茨堡&917K。
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
It is really a clever design in that it is larger
than the original but scaled up perfectly!
 If you put an original next to it, you won't
believe the difference in size.
The original car was really quite small.
The shut-lines play a key part and play an important role
in modernizing the GT40.
The larger size allows larger and taller people to fit
comfortably and allows them get in and out easily.
This is truly an iconic "daily driver" super car
with Ford reliability and parts access.
The styling inside and out has proven to be timeless.
A true collector's car for the serious enthusiast.
unmatched.zh:
他们采取了非常巧妙的设计手法：
扩大车身尺寸，然后完美复刻原车比例！
将两辆车停在一起时，你甚至很难发现它们的差别。
而实际上，GT40要小上一号。
在打造现代版GT40时，
精准化镶板的工艺发挥了重要的作用。
“大号”的新福特GT为身材更高大的驾驶者带来了便利。
这是一款真正能满足日常驾驶的经典超级跑车，
并拥有福特的可靠品质和零部件供应支持。
无论是内饰还是外观，
这辆车的设计都经受得起时间的考验。
这是一辆真正的车迷会选择收藏的好车。<next id=2400808 typ=9A
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
The RX-VISION is a car in which I placed
my car designer life on the line.
I worked on it from the standpoint of really making
the dream sports car I have in my mind.
And one of the most important things for a sports car
is its fundamental structure.
Historic cars that are still popular and beautiful to look at
today all have exceptionally great proportions.
So the first thing we worked on for the RX-VISION
was also the sructure.
A textbook FR (Front Engine Rear Drive) with a long nose,
and the ability to place proper load on the rear wheels.
In the final stages, we extended the front nose about 150mm
from the structure we had originally designed,
the part from the front doors up to the front wheel center.
In the very end we made it a slightly unbalanced proportion...
But at that moment we got a lot of traction on the rear wheels,
andthought "This will work!"
That slight unbalance is the hook. It's the secret
to making someone go "Hmm".
The other secret is the reflection of light.
If you look at the RX-VISION as you circle it, I think you'll
notice that the light's reflection moves around like a creature.
Cars are like family or friends to those who are into them.
And it's a very rare industrial product
that runs around on its own.
That makes cars have the same type of existence as animals running
around in the wild, or an athlete running on a field.
And when you think of it that way, I also want cars to be
something that looks beautiful and truly alive in nature.
And for that you need a "sense of life."
So when thinking about what is the sense of life,
that will put cars at one with nature,
we tried to express life in the car with the light's reflections
6nd their beauty on the car's body.
And those are the type of shapes
that are instilled in the RX-VISION.
unmatched.zh:
说到RX-VISION，那可是我赌上专业设计师的身份，
倾注全部心血的作品。
我想通过它，把我脑海中理想跑车的样子变成现实。
设计跑车，最关键的就是定好基本结构。
你看那些经典车型，哪个不是比例优美？
所以我设计RX-VISION时，第一步就是确定它的结构。
我先是采用了教科书般经典的前置引擎后#驱动
设计——就是那种前脸很长，重心偏后的布局。
然后，在定稿前的最后一刻，我又把前鼻加长了150mm。

具体来说，就是加在了从前门到前轮中心那一段。
这么一改，车身比例看起来有点不太协调……但是这样
做能让后轮抓地力更强。
当时我就想：“嘿，没准这主意不错！”
就这样，一个小小的设计巧思成了这辆车的独特之处。
RX-VISION还有另一个让人惊喜的地方——光影效果。
只要绕着车子转一圈，你就会觉得它像个有生命的东西。
对于车迷来说，汽车就跟家人朋友一样亲密。
跟一般的工业产品不同，汽车是为了奔跑而生的。
它们有点像在野外奔驰的动物，或是在赛场上飞奔的运
动员。
当我生出这个念头时，我就W道我不仅要让RX-VISION
美，还要让它“活”起来。
为了达到这个效果，我得给它注入“生命感”。
在思考怎么才能让它看起来更自然时……
我开始实验光线在车身上的反射效果。
就这样，RX-VISION活灵活现地呈现在了大家面前！
unmatched.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
unmatched.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
unmatched.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计

unmatched.en:
The plexiglass headlights on the early models and...
...design elements such as the orange indicator lights that
extend on the side...
...are defining symbols of this car.
Also, the grooves that flow in a straight line on the side
of the car are...
...implemented on most Ferraris that followed this car.
The star-shaped 5-spoke aluminum wheels are also important
symbols of Ferrari's design.
Yes, yes. This wheel originated from a sports prototype car
from the 1960s...
...and was first used on the Daytona.
unmatched.zh:
早期车型上的有机玻璃大灯和……
侧面的橙色指示灯
之类的设计元素……
都是这款车的主要特征之一。
此外，请注意那些直线形的凹槽……
在此之后被应用到了大多数法拉利上。
星形的五辐铝制车轮也是法拉利设计的重要标志。
事实上，这种轮毂样式源于20世纪60年代设计……
并在戴通纳比赛中投入使用的一台原型跑车。
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
The C4 Corvette had plenty of innovation, both on
the inside and outside.
Its design was a marked departure from the curvier C3,
being more angular and wedged-shaped.
This was evident in the clamshell hood
and in the headlamp construction.
Under the hood was a powerful 4-valve DOHC engine.
The ZR-1 also came equipped with wider rear tires and fenders.
The interior was inspired by aircraft design.
Some people say that the C4 lacked
the "soul" of a Corvette.
But I happen to like it plenty.
unmatched.zh:
C4科尔维特在内部和外部加入了很多创新点。
它有着楔型的车身，更加有棱有角，与C3科尔维特的
波浪状线条相去甚远。
其掀盖式的引擎盖和头灯的结构就是最好的证明。
ZR-1配备了更宽的后胎和后挡泥板……
以便驯服动力强劲的双顶置凸轮轴 4气门引擎。
其内饰的灵感很大程度来源于飞机。
很多人评论说C4科尔维特缺少了一点科尔维特的魂。
但我恰好挺喜欢这款车的。
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
In the 1980s, in the midst of a bubble economy, Japan became
the biggest auto producer in the world.
Becoming the leader in the automotive industry requires a lot
of thought about what kind of products should be offered.
It was a time of ambition and decision.
There were lots of discussion of what made
Japanese automotive design distinctive.
Japanese cars from around this time were
embraced by people around the orld.
When I first saw the white flowing lines of the Celica, or
the A80 Supra, on the cobblestoned streets of Europe,
it was as a mind-blowing experience, reminding me when I first
saw giant tail fins of a Chrysler in Azabu in Tokyo.<next id=2000206 type=9p
unmatched.zh:
日本在20世纪80年代经济蓬勃发展时期，曾短暂地为了世
界上最大的汽车生产国。
在汽车行业的领导地位使其自然而然地产生了许多想法，
希望决定汽车发展的方向……
你可以把它视作一种野心或反思。
在那一时期产生了大量的讨论，探讨日本汽车设计独树
一帜的缘由。
撇开理念不谈，这一时期的日本车确实受{了全球车迷
的喜爱。
当我真正遇到白色流线造型的赛利卡，或是在欧洲古城的
鹅卵石街道邂逅A80 Supra时，
那种心灵的震撼和耳目一新的感觉就和我小时候在东京
麻布区看到一辆有巨大尾鳍的克莱斯勒时几乎一模一样。
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
The Tour de Corse?
It's a famous rally event that takes place on the
French island of Corsica.
The 1964 Tour de Corse was particularly a classic.
Only eight cars out of 79 managed to complete the race!
What's more, Renault's R8 Gordini claimed 1st, 3rd,
4th and 5th place!
It was quite the remarkable achievement.
Gordini was an engine manufacturer, originally established
by the Italian driver and engineer Amedeo Gordini.
The R8 Gordini came about through a collaboration with
Renault.
unmatched.zh:
科西嘉岛拉力赛？
嗯，这是一项著名的拉力赛事，在法国的科西嘉岛上
举行。
1964年的科西嘉岛拉力赛特别经典。
79辆参赛汽车中只有8辆成功完成了比赛！
而雷诺的R8 Gordini就囊括了第一、第三、第四和第五名！
这是相当了不起的成就。
戈迪尼是一家引擎制造商，由意大利车手和工程师阿
梅戴·戈迪尼一手创办。
R8 Gordini就是其与雷诺合作的产物。;
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This is one of my favorite Skylines—the R31, and a Group A
homologation GTS-R!
Who could forget its performance at the Japanese Touring Car
Championship, Japan’s top touring car series in the 1980s?
It's no doubt best known for its performance
in the 1989 JTC season.
That year saw three Skyline GTS-Rs competing on the track.
Masahiro Hasemi and Anders Olofsson’s
No. 50 car won three of six races!
What a way to clinch the series title!
And the way it stood up to those mighty European cars...it was a sight to behold!
unmatched.zh:
这是我最爱的一辆Skyline——R31，而且这辆GTS-R
还获得了A组别认证！
它在1980年代日本顶级房车赛事——日本房车锦标赛上
的优异表现实在让人过目难忘！
它最亮眼的一次表现无疑是在1989年日本房车锦标赛系列赛上。
就在这一年，三辆Skyline GTS-R在比赛中同台竞技……
其中长谷见昌弘和安德斯·奥洛夫松驾驶的50号赛车
赢下了六场比赛中的半数！
这是多么震撼人心的夺冠过程啊！
更不必说它勇敢挑战那些强大欧洲赛车的英姿——
真是太酷了！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
When it comes to R35 GT-R race cars, the Nissan MOTUL
AUTECH GT-R is perhaps the best of them all!
It won two consecutive Super GT championships in the GT500
class, starting in 2014.
It also began the 2016 season in unbelievable
form.
It took the first two races, at Okayama and the
Fuji International Speedway, respectively.
These victories made it the odds-on favorite to win its
tird series champion in a row.
The car was atop the rankings going into the final race...
However, because of the ballast it was required to carry,
it could only manage a 7th-place finish in the race.
This meant that it ended the season in
3rd place for the series.
The MOTUL Autech team did give it all it had,
but just came up a little short.
The drivers were Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie uintarelli.
They showed amazing speed all season long, and today,
they're still at it and still winning races!
unmatched.zh:
说起R35 GT-R赛车的话，
日产MOTUL AUTECH GT-R绝对是其中的王者。
从2014年开始，这辆车已经在GT500级别的
Super GT锦标赛中连续获胜了两次。
它在2016赛季中的开局也是势不可挡……
在冈山的第一场和富士赛道的第二场中接连获胜！
在当时看来，这辆车拿下第三个锦标赛冠军已经是板上钉钉的事了
在赛事进行到最后一场时，它在排名中依然名列前茅……
但是沉重的压舱物使它在这场比赛中惜败，只获得了第七名。
这意味着，这辆车在这个季度中仅以第三名完赛。
他们没能上演帽子戏法，真是太可惜了！
不过，松田次生和罗尼·昆塔雷利的老司机团队无疑是非常快的！
他们俩现在8已步入四十，但却依然没有一丝慢下来的迹象！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Have you ever heard of the German ADAC GT Masters?
It's a race where each car has a pair of drivers,
one amateur and one pro.
For the 2016 ADAC Masters, Chevrolet entered a
Corvette C7 FIA-GT3.
The following year, they claimed both driver and
team championships.
This is a car that an amateur can handle, but which can
also withstand any punishment a pro can throw at it.
Yep, in terms of performance, this Corvette C7 Gr.3
machine is quite something.
unmatched.zh:
你听说过全德汽车协会超跑大师赛？
这是一场需要两位车手：一位新人车手、一位资深车手
交替参赛的比赛。
在2016年的全德汽车协会大师赛中，雪佛兰派出了科尔维特C7 国际汽联-GT3。
在之后一年，他们同时拿下了车手和车队总冠军。
这台车不仅操控平易近人，适合新手，又能经受住专业
选手的“折磨”。
可以肯定，科尔维特C7组别3在性能方面很有一套。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This is the 1997 winner of the All Japan GT Championships.
It's a truly valuable race car indeed.
It's also famed for being the first car to take the title from the
Nissan teams, which were dominating the GT Championships.
The Tom's Supra first appeared in 1994, which means
it took four years for them to reach this point.
With a glorious race history and historical value,
this is a treasure for sure.
unmatched.zh:
这款赛车是1997年全日本房车锦标赛的冠军车，是一辆
真正有价值的赛车。
它也是第一辆从一直统治该项锦标赛的
日产手中夺走冠军头衔的赛车。
这款TOM's Supra于1994年亮相，花费了整整四年时间
才取得了如此殊荣。
兼具辉煌的赛史和极高的历史价值，这辆车必定是一笔
珍贵财富。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
Now, there's a beauty! This isn’t just any Supra, you know.
It's known as a "homologation model," meaning
it was developed primarily as a race car.
Toyota's reason for creating it was to win the Group A
title in the Japanese Touring Car Championship.
To ensure it was battle-ready, the engineers performed
various mechanical upgrades.
These included a turbine and intercooler, as well as parts
or naturally-aspirated and turbocharged engines.
As a result, the Turbo A produced more
than the base model.
With production capped at 500 units, this homologation model
sold out in the blink of an eye.
Aside from the wheel color and bumper shape, it doesn’t
look too different from its forebear.
However, those in the know will instantly
recognize its worth.
unmatched.zh:
天啊！这可不是一辆普通的Supra……
这是一辆为竞赛而生的“赛事认证”型。
丰田当时想用这辆车夺得日本房车锦标赛的A组别桂冠。
为了准备这项赛事，这辆车得到了多处机械升级。
这些升级包括一台涡轮机和中冷器，以及
自然吸气和涡轮增压发动机的部件。
这些升级使v辆车的马力比基础车型提高了。
由于生产上限是500辆，“赛事认证”型转眼间就卖光了。
除了轮毂颜色和保险杠形状之外，
它的外形与基本型完全一样。
然而，有眼光的人
肯定一眼就能看出它的价值！
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The original 2001 996 based GT3 is
one of the best kept "insider" Porsche secrets!
Technically and mechanically,
it's the most raw of all the GT3s!
It featured a naturally aspirated GT1/Mezger flat-6 in a
reinforced chassis geared towards motorsports.
The success of the GT3 was unexpected with
demand exceeding the limited production runs!
Pure magic!;
unmatched.zh:
2001款996 GT3是保时捷最大的秘密武器之一！
无论是技术方面，还是机械方面，
这款车型的凶悍程度都冠绝保时捷所推出的所有GT3！
它搭载了来自GT1/梅茨格的自然进气水平对置六缸引擎
以及赛车级的强化悬挂。
GT3的成功来得如此突然，订单纷至沓来，
远超原有的限量发售数！
这辆车简直像有魔力一般！>
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
With more mid-engine cars from Ford and Ferrari winning
in LM-GTE, WEC and American IMSA events...
...Porsche needed to do something.
Styled by Gran Larson in 2017...
...this mid-engine 911 RSR was a bold move.
Back in 1996, Porsche tried something similar,
getting Tony Hatter to design...
...a mid-engine 911 GT1 based on the 933.
The 2017 RSR silhouette hides...
...its mid-engine architecture, making it look
like a rear-engine 991.
That said, it is wider and more aggressive.
As the saying goes in the automobile industry...
..."Win on Sunday, sell on Monday!"
unmatched.zh:
当越来越多的中置引擎福特和法拉利赛车在勒芒房车耐力赛、
世界耐力锦标赛和美国国际赛车运动协会等赛事中取得成功……
保时捷也必须要设法迎头赶上！
这辆中置引擎的911 RSR由格兰·拉尔森在2017设计……
算是保时捷相当激进的一步！
早在1996年，保时捷就已经进行过类似的尝试，
让托尼·哈特尔设计出……
一款基$933的中置引擎911 GT1。
这辆2017 RSR的外形轮廓巧妙掩饰了……
它的中置引擎架构，让它看上去像一辆引擎后置的991。
尽管如此，它的车身相对更宽，整体外形也更具侵略性！
就像是汽车行业内一句俗话说的那样……
“周日一胜，周一大卖！”
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
There is simply no pure racecar
more stylish and appealing than the 250 P.
There hasn't been one before it or after it.
Even if this car was designed strictly for racing,
it doesn't feel that the priority was placed on winning races.
You can say that the 250 P is the ultimate expression of
Ferrari's 1960s-era mid-engine racecar styling.
In terms of design, the fender lines and surfaces
nflect strong emotional expressions...
... and that's what gives this car its Italian flavor.
After this car, even Ferrari's racecars became a bit visually dry,
with the priorities placed on performance and function.
This masterpiece symbolizes an era when racecars were beautiful.
unmatched.zh:
我的观点是，330 P4是最时尚、最具魅力的纯血赛车，
前无古人，后无来者。
尽管这辆车是严格按照竞赛标准设计的，
但如果你只看外观，赢得比赛似乎并不是它的最高设计准则。
可以说330 P4就是法拉利在1960年代
中置引擎赛车设计的终极体现。
从设计美学的角度分析，它的侧面线条和轮廓
既流畅"又充满力量感……
……呈现出独有的意大利风貌。
在它之后，就连法拉利的赛车都开始变得
不那么重视美感，而是将优先级放在性能和功能上。
这款杰作代表了那个赛车也可以很美的时代。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
The Testarossa recalls the exuberance of the 1980s—
teen posters and American TV.
In fact, its design was spectacular and ostentatious,
totally the opposite of the 512 BB it replaced.
First of all, the Testarossa impressed with its size.
Note the imposing S-shaped volume of its tail
and huge, iconic air inlets.
This was copied by tuners and coachbuilders the world over
and was reflcted in modified, banal city cars.
That’s how innovative it was!
Of particular note was the black grille, which hid
the rectangular rear lights...
...that replaced, for the first time, the signature round
taillights of previous Ferraris.
Another memorable oddity...
...was the single side-mirror suspended in the middle of the
pillar, which was present in the very first versions.
unmatched.zh:
Testarossa令人回想起80年代的狂热——
就好像当时的青少年海报和美国电视剧的张扬风格。
它的设计与前辈512 BB迥然不同，抢眼而张扬。
首先，Testarossa以其庞大的尺寸给人留下深刻的印象。
其巨大的楔形车尾和侧面巨大的标志性进气口也同样令人瞩目。
这一设计引得世界各地的改装者和车身制w商纷纷效仿
——许多普通的城市车辆都被改装成这个样子，
成为了开创一代潮流的鼻祖！
特别值得一提的是，黑色的进气格栅内其实
隐藏了矩形尾灯……
这是法拉利首次摒弃之前车型经典的圆形尾灯。
另一个令人过目不忘的奇特设计……
是最早期版本中悬挂在A柱中央的单个侧后视镜。
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
The design is modified with larger grilles and sporty bumpers,
side skirts and 17-inch alloy wheels.
It also reflects the original vintage livery with red stripes and
other colored elements like the mirrors and brake calipers.
And the two large, enameled badges on the front and rear
show the original colors of the famous Scorpio logo.
But the most exciting thing...
...is the fantastic “sound design” coming from the
rear dual exhausts!
unmatched.zh:
在升级方面，阿巴斯500的设计采用了更大的格栅、运动型保
险杠、侧裙和17英寸铝合金轮毂。
而且还引入了象征原版复古涂装的红色条纹以及应用于
后视镜和刹车卡钳的其他色彩元素。
车前和车后两个精美无比的大型珐琅徽章展示了品牌原
版配色的著名天蝎座标志。
但最激动人心的……
当属来自后段双出排气管的美妙的“声音设计”！?
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
In the transition of automotive design, fenders were originally
just mud flaps that attached to the tires.
Just before and after World War II, fenders started to be
integrated into the bodies.
And eventually the body sides came to be
cut out in the shape of the tires.
In relation to this, the rear fenders of the Viper...
...is structured as a large volume that completely
integrates the fender and doors.
And t shows the enormous traction to accommodate
the 8.0-liter V-10 engine.
It changed the flow and direction of car design, which was
moving towards abstract, multiple surfaces in the 1980s.
The soul of the American car guy is jam packed in these
glamorous fenders.
This is how an American Sports car should be!
unmatched.zh:
在汽车设计的漫长历史中，
挡泥板最初只是用于阻挡掀起的泥土的轮胎挡板。
但到了二战前后，设计师开始将挡泥板与车身融为一体。
为此，车身的侧面被切割出了轮胎的形状。
不过拿那种设计对照一下Viper的后挡泥板！
它们变成了车门的一部分，
更加突出了它相当大的体积……
以此展示出8升V10引擎无比强:的牵引力。
这项设计给80年代原本抽象、几何形的车身设计带来了
新的变化。
Viper在这些迷人的巨型挡泥板里灌注了美国汽车人的灵魂e
这才是美国跑车应该有的样子！
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
Usually, when using the elements of
an existing car to create a variant...
...you usually hit it with a completely design to differentiate
it from the original, so they don't occupy the same market.
This is done to avoid cannibalism.
That's why, from the designer's point of view, although in
theory it may be possible, you dare not just carry over a design.
It's like you're not doing your job.
But considering the playful spirit and freedom of will of
car guys, this act can't be ignored.
Nope. These days, just about anything goes!
In North America, when the merging of auto makers and their
brands happened early on, this sort of thing was very common.
Things like customization and the diversification
and maturity of the autotmotive culture...
...it all comes down to the passion of the customers.
unmatched.zh:
通常情况下，在设计一款当前车款的衍生车型时……
你会想应用一些新的设计，使其与基础车型作出区分。
换句话说，你会希望避免与原车型发生直接竞争。
所以对于设计师而言，借鉴设计元素通常是业界大忌，
会让人觉得设计师根本没有尽职尽责地去设计。
但是对于追求玩趣、想象力z富的怪咖设计师来说，
这种手法却是不可或缺的。
事实上，现在的汽车设计已经是百无禁忌！
在北美，随着汽车厂商及其品牌的并购，
这种做法已经变得司空见惯。
这种风潮代表了定制和汽车文化的多样性和成熟化……
它是以消费者的热情为第一驱动力的。
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
The Skyline GT-R is an icon of the
Japanese automotive industry.
But there may be no other car in Japan
where its history and tradition...
...weighs so heavily on a designer.
In that respect, designing a GT-R today is not so different
than designing a Porsche or a Ferrari.
Back when this R33 was built, a normal mid-size sporty sedan
was the base.
So there was probably a lot of difficulties in its design.
Based on a three-box shape, the 4-seat production car...
...strictly adhered to its underlying philosophy
as a "Wolf in Sheep's Clothing."
Also, because the beginning of the R33 development overlapped
with the tail end of the economic bubble in Japan...
...the body of the R33 was large, heavy, and its style
was stocky, but it was elegant in overall style.
unmatched.zh:
Skyline GT-R品牌是日本汽车工业的一个标志。
但也没有哪辆日本汽车的历史和传统会像这辆车一般……
对设计师产生如此大的压力。
有鉴于此，设计一辆GT-R的压力其实无异于设计一辆
保时捷或法拉利。
这辆R33在设计时以普通的中型运动型轿车为基础……
遇到很多设计上的难题也就无可避免。
在对这台四座三厢量产车进行改造时，
基本的理念是打造出了一匹“披着羊皮的狼”。
而且，由于R33的开发初期正好撞上了日本经济泡沫的
尾声，
因此，R33的车身既大且重，但气度优雅，与当时的时代
背景相吻合。
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
I was also involved with the design of the “FD."
I thought that this FR layout sports car at $30K range above
the MX-5 would be the last model as the RX-7 as we knew it.
If Mazda were to develop a next-generation
RX model...
...I expected that it would have to have a mid-engine layout
at a much higher price point.
Then, when the FD replacement project started.
 I was torn because we were going to replace the
timeless design of the FD...
...with a completely new one.
Luckily, it became 4-seater and a totally different concept.
unmatched.zh:
我确实参与了“FD”的一部分工作。
当时，我们都以为它会是我们挚爱的RX-7系车型
的最后一款……
而且，如果要开发下一代的话……
应该会采用中置引擎布局，还要调高售价。
再后来，FD的替换项目启动了。
一开始我有点纠结，因为我们不得不把我心目中
永不过时的设计……
替换成一个全新的设计。
幸好，最终的4座车车型
成功展现出了完全不同的概念。'
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
So, this is the GR Supra that entered the Nürburgring 24 Hour
race just a month after it went on sale?
Did you know that the President of Toyota Motor Company himself,
Akio "Morizo" Toyoda drove the first stint in the final race?
He was the guy who brought this GR Supra to life!
The car was basically stock, with just minimal
safety equipment necessary to race.
But it still managed to place 41st overall and 3rd in class.
It showcased the solid reliability and performance
of the GR Supra.
unmatched.zh:
所以这就是刚刚上市一个月就去参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛
的GR Supra……
你知道在决赛中驾驶第一赛段的车手不是别人，
正是丰田的总裁丰田章男吗？
事实上，就是他让这辆GR Supra复活的！
这辆参赛的Supra基本上就是一台零售车型，只配备了
比赛所需的最低限度安全设备，
但它还是获得了第41名的总成绩，并在同级车中排名第3。
这样的成绩完全显示出了
GR Supra的卓越性能。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Renault is famous for its minivans, especially the Espace.
This Avantime may resemble a minivan, but it
was really intended to be a two-door coupe.
A truly unique car, if I may say so.
It was designed by none other than Patrick le Quément,
chief designer at Renault from the 1980s to the 2000s.
Released in 2001, it had a remarkably brief production run
of wo short years.
A shame, really, as it’s a car overflowing with character,
inside and out. Indeed, I feel there’s nothing quite like it.
No wonder it continues to attract fans all over the world.
It’s another shiing achievement in Renault’s long history.
unmatched.zh:
雷诺以其打造的多功能乘用车而闻名，特别是Espace。
虽然这款Avantime看起来像多功能乘用车，但实际上
它是按照双门轿跑车的标准打造的。
实话实说，这确实是一款独一无二的车。
它的设计师正是帕特里克·勒·奎芒，
他在1980年代至2000年代期间担任雷诺的首席设计师。
v车于2001年发布，生产周期却异常短暂，
仅仅持续了两年时间。
这实在令人惋惜，因为这是一款由内到外都充满个性
的汽车。说真的，我觉得再也找不到如此特立独行的车型了。
难怪它至今仍吸引着世界各地的车迷。
这又是雷诺悠久历史中的一项辉煌成就。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
This is the successor to the legendary original Skyline GT-R,
or "Hakosuka," as it was affectionately known in Japan.
This car earned its nickname from an ad campaign featuring a
charming young couple known as “Ken” and “Mary.”
Among Skyline fans, it has forever been remembered by that name
—the “Kenmeri GT-R.”
The Hakosuka rose to prominence in Japanese touring car racing,
earning a fearsome reputation for bein nearly unstoppable.
Naturally, the Kenmeri was expected to carry the torch passed
down by its proud predecessor. But fate had other plans.
The 1970s ushered in a new era of strict emissions regulations,
cutting short the Kenmeri’s racing legacy before it began.
Because of these regulations, building cars with high-performance
engines like the GT-R became impossible.
And so, just four months after the Kenmeri went on sale,
production ended, leaving behind only 197 units ever built.
Although it never had a chance to compete in any races...
...its tragic fate and small production run have made
it—in the eyes of enthusiasts—a legend all its own.,
unmatched.zh:
此车是传奇初代天际线GT-R的继承者，
后者在日本被亲切地称为“箱型”……
而本车的昵称则源自一则流行广告，在广告中出现了
一对名为“肯”与“玛丽”的可爱年轻情侣。
因此，在天际线车迷圈中，如今人们都称这款车为
“肯·玛丽GT-R”。
前辈“箱型”在日本房车赛事中声名鹊起，
赢得了不可战胜的美誉。
按理1，“肯·玛丽”本应延续其前辈铸就的辉煌……
然而时运不济，1970年代恰逢严格的排放法规
开始实施的时代。
这些法规导致GT-R这类搭载高性能引擎的车型
无法继续生产。
因此，“肯·玛丽”在上市仅四个月后便宣告停产，
最终产量定格在197台。
虽然它从未有机会踏上赛场……
但悲情的命运与有的产量，反而成就了
其独特的传奇地位。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
When the Mini was born in 1959, it revolutionized the world
of compact front-wheel-drive cars.
Designed by the English engineer Alec Issigonis...
...it sported a uniquely positioned engine and gearbox.
This maximized the space-saving potential of its
front-wheel-drive layout.
The result was a small and fast car with a roomy interior.
The Mini's historic front-wheel drive layout is now
widely referred to as an "Issigonis" layout.
And why shouldn't it be? It was designed by the
brilliant engineer after all.
unmatched.zh:
当MINI于1959年诞生时，它彻底改变了小型前轮驱动汽车的世界。
此车由英国工程师亚历克·伊斯戈尼斯设计……
它的引擎和变速箱安装的位置非常独特，
最大限度地发挥了前轮驱动布局节省空间的潜力。
因此造就了一辆小而快的汽车，具有宽敞的内部空间。
MINI的历史性前轮驱动布局现在被广泛称为“伊斯戈尼斯”布局。
这并不奇怪。毕竟它就是由这位杰出的工程师设计的！
unmatched.speaker: Stella
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 紧凑型车

unmatched.en:
In the Japanese Super Endurance Series,
I myself race in the MAZDA3 race car.
Lots of effort went into the MAZDA3 as a production model
of course, but it was also drawn with the racing scene in mind.
In this racing modified version as well, I tried to maintain
the original shape of the MAZDA3 as much as possible.
The modification including the livery is something that doesn't
disrupt the beauty and silhouette of the car.
Another point of focus was how good it looks when running.
Like how the rear tread sticks out like
a proper Super Endurance race car.
When you're overtaken by this car, I think you'll really notice
how good it looks from the back...
...so on the track, I'd appreciate if you would let me pass!
unmatched.zh:
我跟你讲，我在日本超级耐力系列赛中可是真开过这辆
马自达3赛车哦！
马自达3本身是款普通的量产车型，不过我们设计的时候
就已经考虑到了它未来可能会上赛道。
所以在打造赛车版本的时候，我们尽量保留了原版的帅
气造型。
不光是车身轮廓线条，连车身涂装我们都精心设计，
就是想让它保持原车的美感。
当然啦，我们也得让它在赛道上看起来够劲儿。
怎么做到的？我们给它装上了更宽的后轮轴，也是超级
耐力赛车的标配。
效果太棒了，尤其是超车的时候，那叫一个帅气！
所以呢，要是哪天你在赛道上碰到我，可得乖乖让道。
然后你就知道它的超车有多帅气了！
unmatched.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
unmatched.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
unmatched.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计

unmatched.en:
When comparing it to the classic design of its predecessor...
...the 250 GTO adopted a longer nose, lower stance,
 and a "coda tronca" rear.
Thus, it was designed with aerodynamics strongly in mind.
The front and rear fenders give the car a great sense
of energy and vigor.
The view from the rear-quarter angle is just exquisite.
The car's distinguishing features include...
...te three air intakes on the hood and air outlets
on the fenders.
In staying true to Ferrari’s established design language,
while adapting to the rigors of racing...
...the 250 GTO achieved a rare and remarkable equilibrium.
It is precisely this harmony that has made it one of
the more popular Ferrari cars ever created.
unmatched.zh:
与之前的经典短轴距车型相比……
250 GTO不仅采用了更长的车鼻，压低了车身高度，还引入了
被称为断尾的后部设计。
在设计时，空气动力学性能也是其重点考量。
宽大的前后挡泥板营造出了
无与伦比的动感氛围。
从侧后方角度看过去，特别华贵高雅。
无论是引擎盖正前方的三个进气口"
还是后保险杠上突出的排气管，
都让人记忆犹新。
可以说，250 GTO的设计既保留了法拉利的底蕴，
又满足了赛车运动的需求……
实现了难能可贵的平衡。
也正是这份平衡感让这款经典法拉利车型充满魅力，
人气爆棚。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
This car really shows off its proportional balance.
Aside from the retrofitted detail parts,
I feel that it is an elegant looking car.
Design elements such as the retractable headlamps...
...the area around the rear where the glass hatch blacks out the
B-pillar...
...they seem to be a response to cars in the American market
at the time.
Looking at it now, it lacks boldness,
but it's a look that exudes positive emotions.
unmatched.zh:
这辆车淋漓尽致地展现了设计师对车身比例均衡的把握。
这辆车的车身细节部件进行了全面的翻新升级，
给人以优雅的印象。
其他的一些设计元素，例如上翻式车头灯……
……玻璃后背和B柱的衔接……
……似乎都是为了响应当时美国市场的需求。
现在看来，这种设计欠缺些魄力，
不过的确传达出积极求变的信息。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
I'm totally taken with the wraparound cabin
and the flawless balance of the low body.
From just its presence,
you can almost hear the car's exhaust note, right?
I've seen Gandini's original sketch of the car...
...while the design theme is the same,
I was surprised in the difference of the ambience.
In fact, "car design" is something that can't
be accomplished by just one persn.
The collaboration of engineers, who are themselves
craftsmen, and modelers is essential.
In those terms...
...I think it's correct in saying that
the Stratos is "Bertone designed."
I would seriously love to add this car to my collection,
but it has become too expensive.
unmatched.zh:
我完全被这辆车的环绕式座舱和其低矮车身的
完美平衡给折服了。
你仔细听，是不是几乎听不到它的排气声？
我看过甘迪尼为这辆车创作的设计草图原稿。
虽然设计主题相同，但传达的情绪感受却明显不同。
事实上，“汽车设计”并不是一个人就能完成的作品。
它需要工程技师和模{师之间的通力合作。
因此……
我觉得更准确的说法应该是——
Stratos由“博通设计打造”。
我是真的很想把这辆车纳入我的收藏，
不过恐怕它现在已经是我负担不起的天价了。<
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
This is a car that tried to break away from
the previous design language of BMW.
The shapes created by my former classmate
Chris Bangle when he was at BMW...
...were interesting and exciting in the eyes of a designer.
This M3 also began moving away from the authentic
proportions of an FR vehicle.
However, the surface treatment is fresh and interesting.
Even seeing it now, it's not bad at all.
This is one of the cars that represented
the change in flow of BMW design.
unmatched.zh:
这辆车的设计在尝试摆脱宝马之前的设计语言，带来革新。
它是由我从前的同学
克里斯·班戈在宝马工作时所设计的……
在设计师眼中，这些设计元素非常有趣，非常激动人心。
此外，这辆M3开始从车身配比上与传统前置后驱车分道扬镳。
其车身外观的处理也非常新颖有趣。
即便从现在的眼光来看也丝毫不过时。
可以说，这是一台反映了宝马设计思路演变的车。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
And the high-performance version of that Golf I is the GTI.
Considered wide at the time, its 175/70R13 tires were covered
 by a special black plastic lip.
Red molding inside the front grille, the GTI had subtle hints
identifying its true nature...
...which made it all the more stylish.
When it comes to hot hatches,
this is a car that I still would like to own.
unmatched.zh:
而高尔夫I的高性能版本就是这款GTi，
高尔夫I GTi采用的175/70 R13轮胎在当时被视作宽胎。
设计师特意在轮胎上方增加了一道别致的黑色塑料轮眉，
配合环绕前格栅一周的红色条纹设计，
隐约透露着GTi的本质……
令其更显风采卓然。
在高性能掀背车中，
这是我一直想要收藏的一辆车。
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
The 458 Italia is one of Pininfarina's
recent masterpieces for the Cavallino.
It is probably the most beautiful mid-engine
Ferrari since the 308...
Inheriting the sportiness, purity and elegance
of the 308...
It would influence the design language and proportions
of all subsequent models.
Its style is characterized by...
...sinuous yet extremely pure and fluid lines,
with no visible air inlets on the sides.
The front is sharp, with the new "scimitar" headlights.
The rear can be recognized by single round lights...
...embedded in the bodywork...
...and by the three round central exhausts inspired by the F40.
 If perfection in design is achieved when nothing
can be removed from a shape without ruining it...
...then the 458 it comes really close.&
unmatched.zh:
458 Italia是宾尼法利纳最近为跃马品牌设计的杰作之一。
它可能是自308以来外型最优美的中置引擎法拉利……
……同时也继承了308的运动性、纯粹性和优雅……
……并影响到了后续多款车型的设计语言和比例。
其风格特点可以用几点归纳：
极致纯粹、流动的连续车身线条，侧面没有任何明显的进气口。
犀利的前脸采用了新的“弯刀”头灯。显得杀气腾腾。
车尾的辨识度也很高……
……嵌入车身框架的单个圆形后灯……
……以及与F40师出同门的三联中置圆形排气管。
如果完美的设计是增之则长，减之则短……
……那么458已经非常接近于这个境界了。
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
This is the legendary 1963 Corvette
Sting Ray “Split Window” coupe.
Split Window comes from the
very cool division post in the rear window.
This post is not only distinct...
...it allows the profile of the car
to remain uninterrupted in its flow.
I also love the fender shapes,
which were inspired by Italian streamliner cars of the 1950s.
This car is so well balanced from top tobottom,
and from end to end.
It is indeed a timeless design.
When I look at the sleek undulating shapes of
the 1963 Sting Ray...
...it really does remind me of a sleek creature
that lives underwater.
Yes, that's right. I'm referring to the
the car's namesake, the stingray.
unmatched.zh:
这是传说中的1963款科尔维特Sting Ray
“Split Window”双门跑车。
“Split Window”这个绰号的由来是指它的后车窗被一根立柱一分为二。
这根独树一帜的立柱……
……让车辆的整体轮廓更加连贯和流畅。
我还特别喜爱它的挡泥板的形状，
其灵感应该来源于1950年代意大利汽车的流线型车身。
这辆车z头到尾、从上到下都充满平衡感，
堪称永恒的经典设计。
每次看到那起伏流畅的车身外形……
……我就不由想起那条生活在水底的流线型生物。
没错，那就是这辆车名字的来源，魔鬼鱼。
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
I’ll never forget the first time I saw a Lamborghini
Countach on the street.
The LP400 is a very fine car indeed.
It is a modern classic and the very definition
of a supercar.
One doesn’t even need to open its scissor doors
to feel its striking presence.
It has an extremely wedge-shaped profile
with a steep windscreen and high tail.
And the bold crease that runs the length of the car
is complimented by well-executed surfaces.
unmatched.zh:
我永远忘不了第一次在街上看到兰博基尼Countach
的情景。
LP400确实是一辆非常出色的车。
它是一款现代经典车，也是超级跑车的绝佳代表。
即使不打开它的剪刀式车门，
也能感受到它令人惊叹的存在感。
它的车身像是一个压到极致的倒梯形，
挡风玻璃斜度很大，尾翼则高高耸起。
一条让人无法忽视的折痕线贯穿整个
侧面车身，夺人眼球。
这条折痕线来自于车身表面的高差——
每个表面都经过精心设计，呈现不同程度的拱起。
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
The Camaro ZL1 is a weapon on wheels.
Everything about its design says speed and power.
From its overall stance to its many functional splitters,
wings, and air intakes, this car is track ready!
And, the ZL1 Camaro has a wider track
than other Camaros.
Its dark hood, grille, headlamps, and full-width splitter
give this car a wide, sinister appearance.
With two-tone colors, it's all business. Period!
unmatched.zh:
这辆科迈罗ZL1的一切设计目的都是为了速度和力量，
它简直就是一件安上了轮子的武器！
从它的整体姿态到各种功能性的定风翼、尾翼和进气口，
都在告诉你——这辆车完全是为赛道打造的！
这辆科迈罗ZL1拥有比其他的科迈罗型号更宽的轮距。
涂黑的引擎盖、格栅、车头灯和车身等宽定风翼，
让它显得更狰狞、更具威胁性。
它还通过这种撞色设计表明了态度——不废话，只为胜利！
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
This is my car!
Seriously, it’s actually in my garage right now.
The 1969 Camaro is a true classic
American muscle car.
The unique grille shape gives the design a wide stance...
... and the character lines on the side of the car gives
this Camaro a feeling of speed.
The most dated area of the design are the wheels.
On my '69 Camaro, I ditched the 14-inch Rally wheels
and installed 17-inch wheels.
It’s a great car to modify, enhance, and race. Trust me, I know.'
unmatched.zh:
它就是我的梦中情车！
不开玩笑，我的车库里现在就停着一辆。
这么说吧，1969科迈罗是纯正血统的美式肌肉车。
其独特的进气格栅设计赋予了它宽阔的车身姿态……
艺术化的腰线设计带来了速度感。
如果说它的设计有什么过时的地方，那就是车轮了。
比如我个人就放弃了14英寸的拉力轮毂，
换成了17英寸的。
这是一辆改装潜力巨大，甚至能
提升到赛车水准的好车。
相信我，我知道自己在说什么。
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
Now, this is what I call a British sports car!
The hardcore radical quality here is expressed throughout,
from the interior to its exterior appearance.
The car's spirit is hardly diplomatic.
It's as if this vehicle is saying,
"I have no desire to be a star to the public."
And, at the same time, it exemplifies the pure and naive love
that we feel for sports cars.
On the sexy body, which its extremely low for a front-engine
car, there's a cold round detail that totally lacks emotion.
The hood, sculpted and low other than around the engine,
and the corresponding trunk lid...
...express a powerful driving force.
In this regard, the styling goes well beyond what
many would accept, for love sees no fault.
This design generates indifferent feelings,
captivating only those who understand it.
unmatched.zh:
看啊，这才是我眼中真正的英国跑车！
从内饰到外观，这辆车浑身都散发着不羁和激进。
摒弃圆滑和世故，展现永不妥协的精神。
实际上，它似乎完全无意迎合大众口味。
与此同时，它也向我们表达了对一款纯血、直击本质的
跑车的热爱。
对于一辆前置引擎车来说，它的车身异常低矮流畅，
弧的车身细节也显得极度冷漠，不带一丝感情。
引擎盖深深下凹，只有引擎位置高高隆起，
行李箱盖处也采用了同样的设计……
……露出一副动力充盈、跃跃欲试的模样。
其外观设计已经远超大众能够接受的审美范围，
唯有真正的爱好者方能欣赏。
这是一款必然引发争议的设计，只对那些懂它的人
散发无穷魅力。
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
It all goes back some 90 years,
to the Eifel race of 1934.
Back then, the all-white Mercedes F1 was deemed
 too heavy for competition.
To reduce its weight, a mechanic scraped off the car's
paint, exposing its aluminum body.
It was this silver-colored car
that ended up winning the race.
This car was dubbed the "Silver Arrow," instantly becoming
a symbol for racing excellence.
Sinc then, silver has been Germany’s national
racing color.
Of course, sponsorship liveries are much
more common today.
And race cars painted in their national colors
are very much a thing of the past.
But if you’re interested in racing history, you should
look into the national race colors of other countries.
unmatched.zh:
这个故事要说回到90多年前，那是1934年的埃菲尔比赛……
当时的那辆全白色梅赛德斯F1赛车因为超重，无法参加比赛。
为了减重，一名机械师直接刮掉了喷漆，露出了铝制的
赛车车身。
最终，这辆原色梅赛德斯赛车还赢下了比赛！
于是赛车运动历史上最传奇的名称之一“银箭”便诞生了！
4那之后，银色就成为了德国的赛车运动主色调！
当然，今天的赛车运动中赞助商涂装已经非常普及。
采用国家官方配色的赛车已经成为了历史。
不过，如果你对F1的历史感兴趣，
不妨多了解一下其他国家的官方配色！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This SF19 was built for Japan’s top formula racing series,
the Super Formula Championship.
The Super Formula is the preeminent formula racing event
in all of Asia…
And is considered the quickest motorsport after F1.
In Super Formula races, drivers tend to show their skill
through overtaking manoeuvres.
By the way, are you familiar with overtaking systems?
It is a system that allows a driver momentarily increass
the flow of fuel to the engine for increased speed!
It requires plenty of control and the utmost technique!
This Honda-powered SF19 conjures up memories
of Alex Palou’s record victory.
Palou later went on to compete in the IndyCar series,
a formula racing series held in the USA.
unmatched.zh:
这辆SF19是为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛
——超级方程式锦标赛而开发的。
放眼整个亚洲，超级方程式都是最卓越的方程式比赛……
也被视为是仅次于F1的最快汽车赛事。
在超级方程式比赛中，车手们倾向于
通过超车来展现个人技巧。
顺带问一句，你对超级方程式的超车系统有了解吗？
它可以通过短暂提高注入引擎y燃料量，以提升车速！
同时也需要车手大量的操控和纯熟的技巧才能驾驭！
这辆本田出品的SF19见证了亚历克斯·帕卢
创下纪录的胜利。
在那之后，帕卢又转战印地系列赛，
那是在美国举办的另一项方程式赛车系列赛。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This here’s a legend of American stock car racing.
In stock car racing, production-model cars are raced
pretty much as-is.
The Superbird’s large rear wing and long front nose
were essential tools...
...for winning NASCAR races, the top tier of stock
car racing in the United States.
Basically, they were special racing parts
for a production car.
In its effort to meet NASCAR hoologation,
the Superbird was sold for but one year...
...and few were ever produced.
Afterwards, stock car races began to feature more
and more pure race cars.
Indeed, this car is from an age when street cars
an race cars greatly resembled each other.
unmatched.zh:
这一辆是美国改装赛车比赛中的传奇。
在改装赛车比赛中，量产型的车辆通常是以原始的出厂配置的状态直接参与竞速。
这辆Superbird的大号后翼和长车鼻都是竞速利器……
能够帮助它赢得美国的顶级改装赛车赛事——纳斯卡赛车。
事实上，这些车身部件都是专门服务于量产型车辆的特殊竞速部件。
为了满足纳斯卡赛车的赛事资格认证条件，
Superbird仅对外销售一年……
总产量也不多。
在那之后，改装赛车比赛开始涌入越来越多种类的赛车。
的确，这款车来自于那个公路车和赛车
相似度极高的时代。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The Type 930 911 Turbo was Porsche's first
true super car.
It appealed to a new kind of Porsche customer.
Indeed, the "Turbo" added another element.
Somewhere inside those Superman fender flares
and that big rear wing was...
...the humbleness of Clark Kent.
It was a success story from the time it made its debut
at the 1973 Frankfurt Motor Show.
The 911 truly presented the 190s for Porsche.
But did you know it was scheduled to be replaced?
That was before the Type 930 911 Turbo breathed new life
into the model.
Of course, we know this now in hindsight.
The original 930 had a long and strong production run
from 1975 to 1989...
...with an update to the new 964/965 platform in 1990.
Also of note was the "Turbo" script that became iconic
unto itself.
In fact, this script is still being used byPorsche today
on all subsequent Turbos.
unmatched.zh:
这辆Type 930 911 Turbo是保时捷第一款
真正意义上的超级跑车！
它还吸引来一批性格张扬的保时捷新车迷。
毫无疑问，这台“Turbo”树立起了一代传奇的形象！
这辆谦逊、简约的911就好比汽车领域的“克拉克·肯特”——
它的挡泥板和巨大的尾翼闪耀着如同超人般充满力量感的光泽。
自从在197法兰克福车展上惊艳亮相的那一刻起，
这款车就迎来了巨大成功。
911成为了保时捷在70年代最闪耀的代言人。
不过你知道吗？如果不是Type 930 911 Turbo又为911系列
注入了全新的生命力。
这个系列原本将迎来被替换的命运。
当然，我们现在这么说也是事后诸葛亮罢了。
初代930在1975年到1989年之间持续生产了
很长的时间，产量也很庞大……
然后3在1990年升级到了964/965平台。
另外值得一提的是，“Turbo”名称本身也成为了一代传奇。
事实上，保时捷直到今天还在沿用，
并推出了许多款后续的“Turbo”车型！
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
There are some subtle visual differences between this car
and the R8 LMS: It's cleaner, with fewer graphics.
The aggressive look of the red taillights and flat red
bumper lines remain very much in place.
It's still a classically German look, in other words.
The front is also more visually striking, and the spoiler
is now at a reverse angle.
Some hae also noted that the red winglets look a little bit
like whiskers.
This is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, hence the "Evo"
name. It's certainly had a visual overhaul!
Truth be told, it's getting closer and close to being my
perfect car!
unmatched.zh:
与之前2015年的R8勒芒系列赛相比，这款R8只有一些外观
上细微差别。它的车身比较干净，没有那么多繁琐的图形，
但红色的尾灯和横向的红色保险杠线条让它保留了应有
的侵略性。
换句话说，这就是经典的日耳曼风格！
它的正面也变得更引人瞩目。还有扰流板被设置成了反角。
有人还开玩笑说，红色的侧翼就像两撇胡须一样。
名称中包含的“进化”一词代表它是R8勒芒系列赛的进
化版，整体视觉效果发生了天翻地覆的变化。
说句真心话，它离我j目中的完美汽车越来越近了！
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
It's hard to believe the car is nearly two decades old!
Stylistically, the Carrera GT was ahead of its time.
It became the future DNA for Porsche...
...especially for the Boxster and Cayman,
and I would say, influenced the 918.
It has a lot of innovative details,
such as the double hump mesh rear screen...
...with the stylized aero roll bars hovering above.
I also love the rar diffuser
with the integrated exhausts.
Also inspiring was the interior
with the center console bridge.
 If I were to make one criticism...
...then it would have be
the visually long bodyside.
The front fender outlet and rear fender inlet...
...connected by the horizontal lines accentuate this.
The clever details continue
with the center-lock wheels.
...and the aero supported mirrors.
 I would sa the styling of the Carrera GT
is truly timeless...
...and a masterpiece of modern Porsche design!
unmatched.zh:
Carrera GT是永不过时的艺术品。
我认为它是保时捷现代设计中的杰作！
你甚至很难想象这辆车已经问世这么多个年头了！
从造型上，Carrera GT完全领先了它的时代……
它的设计元素影响到了后续几乎所有保时捷车型……
比如Boxster和Cayman，甚至还包括918。
它蕴含了大量的创新细节……
x如双峰式的后置透明引擎罩，
以及悬在引擎上、造型独具的空力防倾杆。
集成在保险杠上的排气管
和后扩散器也是我喜欢的设计。
同样令人耳目一新的还有内饰的中控台。
不过呢，如果要我提意见的话……
我觉得长度有些太长了。
尤其是侧面的水平线条，显得拖沓……
因为它把前挡泥板的出风口
和后挡泥板进风口连起来了……
保时捷在这台车上还加入了很多巧思……
例如中央锁止轮毂和空气动力学后视镜等等。
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
Now, this is one aggressive Beetle!
It's a car that proves the motorsports potential
of the good ol’ bug.
Take note of its extremely low stance, wide
motorsport fenders...
...and the exhaust pipe jutting out from its front
arch!
Its large five-spoke wheels are typical of Volkswagen’s
expert design team.
And, its body is simply brimming with confidence.
Indeed, it exudes the luxury that only a top-tier
design studio can deliver.
And the bright graphics contribute nicely to the overall
look of the car.
unmatched.zh:
哇，这可真是一辆外观凶悍的甲壳虫啊！
它的存在证明了平日的小可爱
也具有赛场竞速的巨大潜力！
请注意它极低的车身姿态，宽大的
赛车级挡泥板……
以及顺着前轮拱突出的排气管！
它采用了大号五轮辐轮毂，这也是
大众专业设计团队的专属。
它的车身也从头到尾彰显着一股自信。
这份自信源自它所呈现出的奢华品质
——只有顶级的设计工作室能够实现。
车身上各种鲜艳显眼的几何图案更是为
整体外观锦上添花！
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
This is a car for which I was the Chief designer.
I also owned this RX-8 for quite a while.
Actually my children were born in the year
that the RX-8 was announced.
They were twin boys, but in our house it was already decided
from the very beginning that our family car would be an RX-8.
The RX-8 was perfect for raising twins.
One reason is that the RX-8 is a 4 door, but you can't
open the rear oors without opening the front doors.
So even when they were at a rambunctious age, I could drive
without worrying about them accidentally opening the doors
To make a silhouette that looks like a sports car with 4 doors
and with proper space for 4 people,
is actually very difficult.
There's not many cars in the world that have accomplished this.
It would be great to design something again
with this package and engine one day.
There was a Mazda Fan Festa event the other day,
at a circuit in Okayama.
There were a lot of RX-8 owners there. I really appreciate the
fact that they are taking great care of these cars even today.
unmatched.zh:
说起这款RX-8，我可是它的首席设计师。不仅如此，
我自己也有一辆RX-8，开了相当长一段时间。
实际上，我家的双胞胎恰好就出生在RX-8发布的那一年。
我生的是一对男孩，但在他们出生之前，我就打定主意
要把RX-8作为家里的家用车。
RX-8简直就是为带双胞胎量身定做的。
虽然它是一辆四门车的，但有z特别之处：前门得先打
开，后门才能开。
这可就省心了，我再也不用担心那两个调皮蛋在我开车
时不小心把门拉开了。
说实话，要设计一辆既有跑车范儿，还能舒舒服服坐四
个人的四门车……
不是件容易事。
能做到这一点的车真不多。
有朝一日要是我能再设计一款这种配置和引擎的车型
就好了。
前几天，我'冈山参加了个马自达车迷聚会……
我看到好多人都是开着RX-8来的。这么多年过去了，这
款车还是很有人气，真令人开心。
unmatched.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
unmatched.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
unmatched.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计

unmatched.en:
This 400R is the complete car, not the GT-R that was based
on the R33.
It’s a car for connoisseurs.
With new bumpers, air outlets,
and overfenders...
...it’s practically a different car, and yet it’s
incredibly sleek all the same.
unmatched.zh:
这辆400R是一辆“完全体”的车，而不仅仅是脱胎于R33的GT-R。
这是一辆为鉴赏家们设计的车。
它采用了新的保险杠、出气口和轮眉……
实际上可以算成一辆完全不同的车了。
尽管如此，它的外观依然是那么的流畅和优美。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
There seems to be a reason behind every detail of this design,
a design with the spirit of rationality.
Yet it possesses irresistible charm.
This is the W194, also known as the 300SL.
It won the Mille Miglia, Grand Prix of Bern,
and the Carrera Panamericana in 1952.
On top of that, it placed 1-2 at Le Mans.
The doors of this car swing upward in
what is known as "gullwing" types.
That term also serves as the nickname for this car.
This design is the result of avoiding the bottom portion
 of the structure of the space frame./
unmatched.zh:
这款车的每一处设计细节似乎皆有所本，既具有理性精神，
又有令人无法抵挡的魅力。
它就是W194，也被称为300SL。
它不仅于1952年的意大利一千英里耐力赛、伯尔尼大奖赛和
Carrera泛美公路拉力赛上豪迈地拿下了冠军头衔，
还在勒芒24小时耐力赛中包揽了前二。
此车的上翻式车门被称作“鸥翼”车门，
由此，“鸥翼”也成为了本车的绰号。
其实，如此设计是为了避免车门与空间车架结构的底部发生冲突。
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
The Ferrari Enzo, named after Ferrari’s founder, marked
a radical stylistic change in Ferrari’s history.
It was certainly one of the most iconic sports cars of the 2000s.
Directly inspired by the aerodynamic shapes
of contemporary Formula 1 machines...
...it made a lasting impression with its pointed nose.
Like a jetfighter, driven by functionality and performance,
its intersecting blockscreated space for its air intakes.
The cabin was also clearly inspired by aeronautical shapes.
At the rear, there appeared, for the first time,
dual circular taillights...
...which would later be found on the F43
and other subsequent Ferraris.*
unmatched.zh:
以法拉利的创始人命名的法拉利Enzo标志着
法拉利史上的一次激进的设计变革。
它无疑是2000年代最具标志性的跑车之一。
此车的设计直接受到了当代F1赛车的
空气动力学造型启发……
以其尖锐的车鼻给人留下了“凶猛”的印象。
它就像一架喷气式战斗机，注重功能和性能，
互相交错的矩形表面为进气口创造了空间。
车厢设计也明显受到航空器的启发。
在车尾，两侧的双圆形尾灯首次亮相……
这种设计后来也出现在F430及其他后续车型上。<next id=2202009 type=9׾
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
The C7 ZR1 Corvette is the ultimate expression of a
front-engine Corvette's power and bold design.
The ZR1 is sometimes known as “The Widebody."
It's significantly wider than a standard Corvette Stingray
in order to accommodate its massive tires.
The ZR1 has very significant air intakes and air exits.
These manage the flow of air and feed the many coolers
in the nose and tail of the car.
Most people love the rear wing.
But I prefer the smaller rear spoiler that was also
available.
unmatched.zh:
这辆C7 ZR1科尔维特是前置引擎科尔维特那强大性能
和粗犷设计的终极例证。
这辆ZR1有时也被爱称为“宽车身”。
为了容纳那套巨大的轮胎，它比
标准款科尔维特Stingray要宽出许多。
ZR1同样还配备了巨大的进气口和出气口……
用于引导气流，为车头和车尾的散热器提供风冷降温。
许多人都很喜欢它的尾翼。
不过我个人更喜欢配备尺寸更小的后扰流板。
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
From its GP machines to the Royales, Bugatti pushed the
automobile horizon in many directions in the pre-war era.
Especially in regard to design, Jean Bugatti
of the Bugatti family...
Ensured that the company's cars were dynamic in nature and
possessed originality that was recognizable at a glance.
However, at the same time, the cars also combined a certain
sublimeness and acceptance of classic aesthetics.
Even te Veyron's styling suggested that it was one
level apart from its rivals from Modena, Italy.
The traditional wedge-shaped formula was
completely discarded...
While the roofline and fenders were presented in natural
harmony, flowing down to the rear of the car.
The car's elegant lines are uninterrupted, running smoothly
around its body—a joy to trace with your eyes.
The styling expresses a euphoric art nouveau expression
It makes me respect Jean Bugatti all the more.
unmatched.zh:
从GP赛车再到皇家，布加迪在二战前
就将汽车的边界向各个方向大幅扩展。
特别是在设计上，布加迪家族的让·布加迪……
负责确保这家公司的所有汽车都拥有动感的本质和
一目了然的原创性。
与此同时，布加迪推出的车也结合了威严感
以及对传统美学的接纳。
这辆布加迪Veryron的风格设计就表现出了它与
来自大利摩德纳的竞争对手的截然不同。
它彻底地弃用了传统的楔形车身设计……
从车顶到挡泥板的线条自然而和谐，
流泻到车尾。
从一而终的优雅线条沿车身顺滑地向后延伸，
带动你的眼神去追寻，赏心悦目。
这种造型风格表达了一种幸福、陶醉感的新艺术派理念。
也让我对让·布加迪更加肃然起敬。
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
The AMG GT3 is renowned for its reliable strength
at FIA GT3 races around the world.
It is doubtless the star player among GT3 machines.
In 2016, when the second-generation AMG GT3 was
handed over to private teams...
It showed off its strength and speed, dominating the top
positions at the 24 Hours Nürburgring in its debut year.
Also, while road-going AMG GTs
were powered by a 4L twin-turbo V8...
This was not always the case with
their racing counterparts.
For the SLS AMG GT3 was the first to be equipped
with a race-tested 6.3L naturally-aspirated model.
unmatched.zh:
AMG GT3以其在世界各地的国际汽联GT3比赛中表现出的
可靠性而在业界闻名。
在GT3组别的参赛车辆当中，它无疑是一位明星选手。
2016年，是第二代AMG GT3交付给私人车队使用的第一年……
在出道当年，它就表现出无与伦比的实力和速度，
成为纽博格林24小时耐力赛的顶流。
AMG GT的公路版本通常配备4升的双涡轮V8引擎……
但该引擎并未被应用到赛车版本上。
SLS AMG GT3是首款配备了一台经过比赛考验的
6.3升自然吸气引擎的车型。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Well, if it isn’t an SF19, built for Japan’s top formula
race series, the Super Formula Championship.
Pop quiz! Do you know who supplies the SF19's
engines?
The answer is: Toyota and Honda.
This machine here is powered by a Toyota engine, and it was
raced by Kazuki Nakajima and Kamui Kobayashi.
That’s right, two racers that Toyota trained
for the F1 Grand Prix!
Although it produces abot half the power of an F1 car,
it’s small, light, and possesses great aerodynamics.
Thanks to their F1 experience, the drivers were able
to push the car to its limits.
Nick Cassidy was the series champion when tis machine
made its debut in 2019.
unmatched.zh:
哎呀，这不是SF19，专门为日本顶尖的方程式系列赛，
超级方程式锦标赛而打造的赛车吗！
突击小测验！你知道为SF19提供引擎的是哪个厂家吗？
答案就是……丰田和本田！
这一台车里用的是丰田的引擎，
而驾驶它参加比赛的分别是中岛一贵和小林可梦伟。
没错，这两位可都是丰田旗下参加过F1大奖赛的车手！
虽然SF19的动力只有F1赛车的一半，但它也更小巧而轻量，
并且空气动力学性能相当不赖。
得益于两位车手的F1经验，能将此车的潜能发挥到极限。
在SF19亮相的2019年，尼克·卡西迪赢得了当年的系列赛冠军。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This is the SF23, a car developed for the Super Formula series,
Japan's top-level formula race competition.
All teams participating in Super Formula must use
a race car with the same chassis.
Teams are also restricted to a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine
built by either Toyota or Honda.
That effectively makes Super Formula
a one-make race series.
In such a contest, victory is largel decided by a combination
of individual skill and team strategy.
This is one of the major draws of Japanese
Super Formula races.
Super Formula machines are distinguished by their
aerodynamic design...
...which is meant to limit air resistance at the rear
and sides of the body.
Because these machines are so similar in capability,
the race becomes a test of a driver’s skill.
The SF23 pushes this concept to new heights,
promising more dramatic wheel-to-wheel action!
unmatched.zh:
这辆SF23是专为日本的顶级方程式系列赛事
——超级方程式所打造的赛车。
所有参与超级方程式的车队都必须
使用同一款底盘开发的赛车。
并且，所有车队也只允许采用由丰田或本田所开发的
两款规格一致的2升4缸涡轮增压引擎之一。
因此超级方程式本质上也是一项单一车种方程式赛事。
在这样比赛中，胜利在很大程度上是由
车手个人和车队策略所共同决定的。
这也是日本超级方程式系列赛的主要魅力之一。
超级方程式赛车拥有非常独特的空气动力学设计……
致力于尽量降低车身两侧和后部的空气阻力。
由于赛车的性能旗鼓相当，因此这项赛事
也成为了车手操控技术的比拼。
到了今年，这款SF23又将这一理^拔高到了全新高度，
保证可以为车迷们带来更激动人心的白刃战场面！"
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
With a body as compact as the S13 two generations earlier...
...this car combined sharp styling with excellent balance.
Equipped with a turbocharged engine, it produced a respectable .
It also competed in Japan’s GT Championship series.
It proved to be an ideal base for drifting builds, offering
strong performance value for enthusiasts.
unmatched.zh:
随着Silvia重新回归两代之前，S13时期的紧凑车身设计，
整体造型变得集造型优美和完美匀称于一身。
涡轮增压则使这款车能够输出令人惊叹的。
这辆车不仅作为赛车参加了全日本房车锦标赛，
同时也是漂移改装车的绝佳基础车型。可以这么说，
你付出的每一分价格都能带来无上的乐趣。
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
This car is based on the RX-VISION that was introduced at the
2015 Tokyo Motor Show.
It's powered by a 4-rotor engine, and you can immediately tell
from its shape that it's a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive car.
This was the future vision of the rotary sports car.
And now, this RX-VISION was made into a race car.
The engine is a naturally-aspirated 4-rotor
rotary called the SKYACTIV-R.
The weight of the car is , and it
produces .
It truly feels like the return of the legendary 787B
as a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive model!$
unmatched.zh:
这辆车是基于2015年在东京车展上推出的一款名为
“RX-VISION”的汽车。
它由一部四转子引擎提供动力，而且你可以从车的外形
上看出来，这是一款前置引擎后轮驱动的汽车。
在当时，这是对转子发动机跑车的未来展望。
而如今，这款RX-VISION终于被改成了一辆赛车。
引擎是被命名为创驰蓝天-R的四转子自然进气引擎。
整车重量为，引擎功率为。
看到它，就让人觉得传奇的787B跑车以前置引擎、后轮
驱动的形式王者归来了！
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
The 918 was designed as the flagship...
...to showcase Porsche's
latest styling DNA and advanced technology for the future.
The styling forecasted Porsche's next generation of vehicles.
The dual rear exhausts exiting through...
...the rear upper cooling grille
looks like a jet pack...
...and is really exciting!
You can also see the production version of
the four element ED headlights and the rear taillamp LED frame.
Along with the form vocabulary, you can also see
these elements showing up into the next generation of Porsches
Another favorite area of mine was...
...the interior design with the high bridge center console.
This was first seen in the 2003 Carrera GT but newly imagined.
The design language and style
has worn well over the years.
A bit quiet and estrained to the eyes
compared to other competitors.
But still well received and
a popular edition to a super car collection!
unmatched.zh:
918是作为保时捷的旗舰型号来设计的……
是为了充分展现
这家公司最新的设计基因和未来将采用的先进科技。
其设计风格预示了保时捷之后几代车型的设计路线。
穿过车尾上部冷却格栅的……
两根排气管，
整体看起来就像背着一个喷气背包……
令人感觉很酷！
此车还采用了量产的四点式LED大灯和LED框架式尾灯。
这些元素和形状设计语汇，都在下一代保时捷车型中得到了沿袭。
918还有一点是我非常钟爱的……
就是内饰设计中如引桥般高高矗立的中控台。
这项设计早在2003年的Carrera GT上就出现过，
但这次经过了重新构思。
这些设计语言和风格随着时间的打磨已经变得圆熟，
尽管和竞品相比可能显得有一些平静内敛。
但爱好者们对918的接受度从未减少分毫。它永远是
所有超级跑车收藏者心目中的人气之选。
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
The Type R is an aggressively styled 4-door
hatchback coupe.
This segment was popularized by the original VW Golf GTI.
What sets this one apart is like an action movie with lots
of special effects!
First you notice the big rear wing...
...then the aggressive front flares.
The front is emphasized by huge side nostrils
and a NACA duct on the hood!
The great stance is set up by the tires set out to the
edges and special suspension.
You'll also spot the big red Brembo brake calipers
behind the glossy black wheels.
unmatched.zh:
Type R是一款风格激进的四门掀背轿跑车。
这款车的特别之处
在于它就像一部充满特效的动作电影！
你会首先被巨大的尾翼吸引，
然后是战斗力十足的前轮宽体。
巨大的侧裙和引擎盖上的NACA导管映衬前脸！
