外突的轮胎和特殊的悬挂让其拥有出色的车身姿态。
你还会注意到闪亮黑色轮毂后的大红色
布雷博刹车卡钳。它一点也不适合那些想低调的人！_
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Honda Civic Type R Limited Edition (FK8) '20
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Honda Civic Type R Limited Edition (FK8) '20
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
In my mid 20's I was assigned to a position in the US,
and the FD was a car from that time.
It was when Matano-san was in the US studio, and the clay model
for this car was being made in the design studio.
It isn't a car that I worked on myself, but I remember
thinking that the shape of this car is really great.
The greatness of this car is in the relationship
between the tires and the body.
The body is thin verticaly, and the tires have a sense of presence,
and it is a honed 3 dimensional shape with no excess anywhere.
That's why this car still doesn't look old.
Its beautiful.
The original idea came from a designer named Wu-Huang Chin.
He draws surfaces like this just with a marker. He's
a design genius who is really good at drawing.
I think you could say that the FD and NA Roadster of this era
are at the pinnacle of the Mazda design istory.
Their ability to work 3 dimensional shapes at the time
was truly world class
and this is a product from the time when the foundations of
Mazda design was formed.
unmatched.zh:
说起这款FD，那可得追溯到我20多岁的时候了，那会儿
我还在美国工作呢。
那时俣野努先生也在美国工作室任职，这辆车的黏土模
型就是在那儿做的。
虽然不是我个人参与设计的，但我记得当时就觉得这辆
车的造型很独到。
这车最棒的地方就是轮胎和车身的比例关系。
车身压低变薄，让轮胎显得特别醒目，整体看上{给人
一种精雕细琢的感觉，一点儿多余的东西都没有。
正是这种设计，让它成为了经典。美，真的太美了。
这车最初的创意图来自一位叫秦无荒的设计师。
这位老兄可是个设计天才，画功了得。你敢信吗？
他就用一支马克笔就把这车给设计出来了。
要我说，这个年代的FD和NA Roadster绝对是马自达
历史上最杰出的两个设。
当时马自达处理三维形状的能力确实是世界一流的。
正好也赶上了马自达的设计理念刚开始成型的时候。
unmatched.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Mazda RX-7 Spirit R Type A (FD) '02
unmatched.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
unmatched.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计

unmatched.en:
A company that’s known to pivot hard, Suzuki sometimes
offers products that really take you by surprise.
The Wagon R was one such example. And so
 was this Swift Sport.
The four corners of its chunky body are fit with relatively
large wheels that speak to its excellent maneuverability.
A small car, it’s equipped with everything it needs
and nothing else.
If you were to see it driving down an Italian street, you’d
think the car was designed by Italians.
unmatched.zh:
铃木是一家出了名的“推陈出新”的公司，有时会拿出一些
出人意料的产品。
比如瓦罐R轻型车，又比如这款速翼特运动版。
这款车的外形方正，在四个轮位安装了大一号的轮毂，
体现出它优异的操控性。
这是一辆麻雀虽小，五脏俱全的小型车，
不少一分，也不多一分。
如果在狭窄的意大利街道看到它驶过，你可能
会觉得它和当地的环境浑然一体。\
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
In the Japanese automobile world, executing a model change
without dramatically altering the car's design is rare.
But it is carried out quite well here.
The way the windshield blends into the side glass
gives the impression of a full-face helmet.
This car possesses the same basic design theme
as its predecessor.
What has noticeably changed is...
...a more powerful looking one-frame front end
and air intakes on either side.
However, these aren't exaggerated changes,
just effective._
unmatched.zh:
在日本汽车界，在车辆改款时不对原设计进行大幅更新
是非常少见的情况。
不过这款新车的整体感觉非常不错。
它的挡风玻璃与侧面车窗融为一体，
给人一种全罩式头盔的感觉。
新车采用了与前代车型相同的基础设计主题。
最明显的改变在于……
更凸显力量感的单条前格栅
以及车头两侧的进气口。
这些改动不追求夸张的造型变化，只追求效率。.
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
Aspiring to tone down the D-Type racer somewhat,
car designer Malcolm Sayer...
...gave Jaguar something that was aerodynamic, modern,
and dynamic.
That was this E-Type.
Although its engine was from a XK150 of the previous decade,
this monocoque racer was thoroughly modern.
It’s truly a thing of beauty!
unmatched.zh:
为了推出一辆能与D-Type赛车争辉的新赛车，
汽车设计师马尔科姆·塞尔……
为捷豹带来了极其富有空气动力学、现代感
和动态感的设计理念。
促成了E-type的诞生。
虽然搭载了一台十多年前的XK150的引擎，这台单体车壳赛车
仍然是一台彻头彻尾的现代赛车。
它真是一件无与伦比美丽的造物！`
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
Very Italian in improvisation,
I'm quite taken by...
....the high degree of precision displayed here.
One of the things the Maserati brothers, who sold Maserati
and started OSCA, left behind was...
...the sohc 6-cylinder engine.
The car that used this engine was their grand prix machine.
With that at the foundation, the A6GCS was born.
The car's four driven wheels and various other mechaical parts
are covered by a body that seems to be made of soft cloth.
The volume here is minimal.
This body was the work of the famous
Modena craftsman Fantuzzi.
You can feel the presence of the design language
of the Type 61 Birdcage in this car.
It really excites the soul, this design.
unmatched.zh:
这是非常有意大利风格的即兴演绎，
尤其令我着迷的是……
整台车体现出的高精细度。
当玛莎拉蒂兄弟最终离开公司，创建奥斯卡时，
他们为玛莎拉蒂留下了一件宝藏，
就是这台直列六缸单顶置凸轮轴引擎。
使用这台引擎的是他们的一款大奖赛赛车。
在此基础上，他们开发了A6GCS。
宛若薄绸v轻盈的车身用顺滑的曲线
包覆车轮和其他机械部件……
同时也将车身体积控制在了最低限度。
这正是莫德纳的著名车身制造商凡图奇的手笔。
你可以明显看到它的设计语言和Type 61鸟笼一脉相承。
看到这样的设计，让人从内心深处受到震撼！
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
This is the high-performance version of the F430, developed
with the help of Michael Schumacher.
Stylistically, it is distinguished by a sharp front, large
air intakes, and enhanced brake cooling ducts.
However, the biggest difference is in the rear.
Here we have a large engine grille...
...and a big diffuser framed by a band with two large, round
exhausts on either side of the license plate.
To emphasize its sportiness, the side mirrors have been done
in carbon fiber...
And a two-tone livery is available as an option.
unmatched.zh:
这是在迈克尔·舒马赫的协助下开发的F430高性能版本。
在外观设计上，它以更锐利的前脸线条、更大的进气口
和优化后的刹车冷却导风口与其他版本区分开来。
然而，最显著的区别在于车尾设计。
这里我们可以看到一个大尺寸的引擎舱散热格栅……
以及一个大型的底部扩散器，由一条装饰带围，
两个大型圆形排气管则位于车牌的两侧。
为了突出其赛车基因，后视镜采用了碳纤维材质……
此外，还提供了双色条纹涂装作为可选项k
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
Imagine transforming a little French city car
into a mid-engine racer!
Ah, but such is the transgressive spirit of the R5 Turbo's
direct descendant.
Its sportiness is dynamically expressed through
widened flanks and central dual exhausts.
Interestingly, these aggressive elements are balanced
with those typical of Renault cars from the '90s.
This is most evident in the way the side edge line
"rolls" around the rear wheel...
...and in the use of a geometric design
for the front and rear grilles.
unmatched.zh:
你能想象将一辆小型法式城市用车改造成
一辆中置引擎赛车是什么样子吗？
这辆R5 Turbo的后继车型就承载了这样叛逆不羁的精神。
它的运动形态通过加宽的侧面裙边
和居中的双排气管得到了动态的展现。
有趣的是，这些激进的设计元素却通过90年代经典雷诺风格
的中和，取得了完美的平衡。
后轮的“管装”风道线条……
和前后格栅采用的几何分割设计就是最显而易见的证明！
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
In the 1980s, there was a very unique phenomenon in the history
of automotive design. It was a time when the "boxy" style...
...was surely at its peak.
Blister fenders were the result of an attempt to marry
round tires to a square body design.
This style is one of the defining symbols of this era.
The polyhedron body of the car here is minimalistic.
But despite its abstract form, its intonation is limited,
and the exterior styling exudes extreme passion and excitement.
And because the car is seemingly pressed into an inorganic shape,
the end effect is one that's relatively prominent.<next id=2001706 type
unmatched.zh:
在1980年代，汽车设计的历史上掀起了一股非常独特的浪潮。
“四四方方”的设计理念在当时大行其道。
这部分微微鼓起的挡泥板就是这种思路的产物
——设计师们试图将轮胎的圆形和车身的方形轮廓融合起来。
这样的造型代表了那个年代的显著象征之一。
多边形车身非常抽象、简约。
虽然发出的音浪不大，
但成功通过外立面表达出了强烈的热情和兴奋感。
粗看下，这台车像是一团被捏合而成的无机物，
呈现出相对抢眼的最终效果。~
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
The soul of a creator reaches out to unknown horizons.
At the point of arrival, new footprints
erase what was there before.
This creative passion will forever be engraved into
people's hearts and never disappear.
These extraordinary creators...their visions have
profoundly shaped the automotive world.
They grab hold of the distant future and pull it in.
They fly in the skies where technology and design arefree,
then safely land where their completed car becomes legend.
And the creator becomes a hero.
The designer of the 1955 DS was the Italian,
 Flaminio Bertoni.
Unfortunately, his existence ecame
widely known only after his passing.]
unmatched.zh:
这是创作者的灵魂在向着未知的边界进行探索。
在抵达之时，新的足迹便抹去了原先的痕迹。
然而，这份创作的激情将永远铭刻在人们心中，
永远不会消失。
这些非凡的创作者，他们的愿景深刻地塑造了汽车世界。
他们抓住遥远的未来，将其带到人们的眼前。
他们自由飞翔在技术和设计的天空中，随着他们安落下，
因之而生的汽车便成为了传奇。
而创作者则成为了英雄。
1955 DS的设计师是一位意大利人，弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼。
令人扼腕的是，他的声名在故去之后才广泛地为人所知。
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
This 300 SEL may have been big for a sedan, but
I consider it a sports sedan all the same.
The best image of this car that I can recall is a head-on
shot of it coming out of a corner at speed.
It must have been intimidating for other drivers
to see this machine in their rear-view mirrors.
This car is a great example of good visual weight balance.
It also showcases great dynamic weight distribution
in full racing trim.
unmatched.zh:
作为一辆轿车，这辆300 SEL也许有点尺寸过大，
不过我依然认为它是一辆很棒的运动型轿车。
我印象中这辆车最美的姿态就是
站在正前方看着它以高速驶出弯道。
其他车手从后视镜里看着这辆猛兽步步逼近时
心里一定非常紧张。
它拥有恰到好处的车身比例。
全套赛车饰条与配件加身后，更显动态十足。:
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
The Pikes Peak Hill Climb is a race held in
Colorado, USA.
It is a race in which drivers compete for the fastest time
up a long and treacherous mountain road.
The course measures , climbing to the finish
at —higher than Mount Fuji in Japan!
This Audi S1 shattered records with its victory at
the storied event.
Based on a WRC mahine, it featured large wings at the
front and rear, ensuring maximum downforce.
But who was the driver behind the wheel on that winding
“Race to the Clouds?"
Why, it was none other than WRC champion
Walter Röhrl!
unmatched.zh:
派克峰爬坡赛是在美国科罗拉多州举办的比赛。
这是一场车手们需要在漫长而险峻的山路上
达成最快时间记录的赛事。
这条赛道长达，海拔始于，终于——比日本的富士山还要高！
这辆奥迪S1以破纪录的成绩在这场著名赛事中获得了胜利。
基于一辆世y拉力锦标赛赛车，这辆车前后
都配备了巨大的定风翼，以获得最大的下压力。
那么驾驶这辆车，沿着蜿蜒的山路，
勇敢地“冲上云霄”的人是谁呢？
这个人正是界拉力锦标赛的冠军沃尔特·罗尔！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Ever since it was introduced, the Mercedes AMG GT3
has been hailed as one of the fastest and fiercest GT3 race cars.
The original AMG GT3 made its debut in 2016.
At its first Nürburgring 24 Hours race, it did the
unthinkable, achieving an amazing 1-2-3 finish!
This machine is the updated AMG GT3,
which was introduced in 2019.
It featured aerodynamic improvements that generated
greater downfoce than before.
Also, an all-new braking system placed less stress
on the tires.
While these performance upgrades resulted in
faster lap times...
...a more durable engine gave the AMG GT3 increased reliability.
And, a vastly improved parts management system...
...as well as several other tweaks made setting up and servicing the car easier for race mechanics.
unmatched.zh:
自初代型号发布以来，梅赛德斯AMG GT3一直被誉为
最强最速GT3赛车。
初代AMG GT3在2016年首次登上赛车舞台。
在参加的第一场纽博格林24小时耐力赛里，
它令人震惊地包揽了前三名，创下了永垂史册的壮举！
我们面前的这款赛车是升级后的AMG GT3，
于2019年首次亮相。
经过全面强化的空气动力性能
确可以提供超强的下压力！
而全新的刹车技术则有效降低了轮胎磨损的压力。
除了这些性能升级带来的更出色的单圈时间外……
这辆AMG GT3还配备了更耐用的引擎、
一套大幅升级的零部件管理系统……
以及多项精细调整，从而帮助车队在赛道上更加风驰电掣。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
Lancia of Italy had long been a dominant force
in the World Rally Championship.
This Group A rally version of the Delta stands
as a testament to Lancia’s many triumphs.
From 1987 to 1992, the marque secured six
consecutive manufacturers’ championships.
It was a legendary achievement—one that remains unmatched
in the history of the world’s premier rally series.
This Group A Delta rally car stands as an undeniable testament
to Lancia’s dominance in the sport.
Even the production car version, built for Group B
homologation...
...is the envy of car collectors everywhere!~
unmatched.zh:
意大利蓝旗亚作为第一个赢得
世界拉力锦标赛年度冠军的车厂被人们铭记。
这款Delta Group A拉力赛版本正是其众多杰作中的瑰宝。
从1987年到1992年，蓝旗亚豪取六连车厂冠军头衔……
这项传奇成就在世界顶级拉力赛事中至今无人能复刻。
这台Delta Group A拉力赛车无疑是蓝旗亚成功的见证。
即便只是作为为了满足B组别认证而打造的
量产版车型……
也令全球汽车藏家艳羡不已！
unmatched.resolvedCar: DELTA HF Integrale WRC Group A (1992)
unmatched.speaker: Chris
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 公路车鉴赏

unmatched.en:
At first glance, it appears to be a normal sedan, but look
inside, and you'll realize that this car was created for speed.
This is the category that's referred to as "muscle cars."
This Challenger R/T is like the Barracuda
because it's smaller in size.
However, the large front opening
and the kicked-up rear quarter...
...are aggressive design cues that match the car's character.
Power is provided by a HEMI engin.
On the hood is a protruding air scoop
called the "Shaker."
When it shakes, it declares the enormous power it possesses.
If you include the optional rear spoiler, the Challenger R/T
is a muscle car that's sure to catch anyone's eye.
unmatched.zh:
如果不仔细看，你会以为它是一辆普通的轿车。
但坐进驾驶舱之后，你就会明白这是一台速度机器。
这个类别的车通常归类为“肌肉车”。
这辆Challenger R/T很像梭鱼，只是尺寸小一号。
不过它那宽大的前脸开口和
拱起的后侧围板……
无不在体现该车极富侵略性的特征。
此车的动力来自一台HEMI引擎。
引擎盖上的进气口又被车迷们戏称为“抖动器”
这个称号来源于它工作时的抖动噪声，
就像在宣告自己的澎湃动力。
如果再装配上车尾扰流板，
Chalenger R/T必定会吸引所有人的目光。
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
This is the new "electric" expression of Porsche design.
The design of this eco-sustainable evolution adopts
the soft and clean language of the Stuttgart house.
The proportions, while similar to those of the Panamera,
are more compact and lower to the ground...
...with a typical fast-back tail and a traversing strip
of LED rear lights.
However, the front expresses its new identity with
the headlights "slashed" directly onto the surface...
...with the four daytime running lights, but also with the
aerodynamic outlet behind the front wheel.
unmatched.zh:
这款车是对保时捷设计的全新“电气化”表达。
这辆可持续环保升级车型的设计采用
斯图加特品牌那柔和又利落的设计语言。
Taycan的车身比与Panamera类似，
但要比后者更加紧凑、更贴近地面……
还采用了典型的斜背车尾和
由LED灯带构成的横条车尾灯。
不过它的前脸充分体现了全新个性，
两盏大灯和四盏日间行车灯连在一起，直接“下切”向路面……
此外，前轮后方还设计了空气动力学排气口。
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
Designed by Pininfarina together with Ferrari Design,
the F12 was awarded the Compasso d'Oro 2014.
As you can see, it represents a huge change in
design from the previous 599.
Its sculptural forms are extremely compact and "dense."
The front is very aggressive, with the large central grille
and two active air intakes for brake cooling...
...while the back is recogized by the "T" theme, visually
separating the extractor into two parts.
But the most characteristic elements
are the Aero Bridges...
Channelling the air from the hood towards the flanks,
improving the overall aerodyamic efficiency.
unmatched.zh:
这辆F12是由宾尼法利纳和法拉利设计合作设计的，
荣获了2014年度的金圆规工业设计奖。
如你所见，相比之前的599，它的设计发生了巨大的变化。
它那雕塑般的形状非常的紧凑和“凝实”。
前脸配备了庞大的中央格栅和两侧冷却刹车用的主动进风口……
攻击性十足，
而后部则v清晰辨认出“T”型元素，在视觉上将排气管
分为左右两组。
但最具特征的元素还是“气动桥”……
它将引擎盖上的空气引导到车身侧面，从而提高了
整体的空气动力学效率。
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
The Baby Lambo was added to broaden the market reach
of Lamborghini as a brand.
Unlike its super-car counterparts, the "Babies"...
...are known for their sharper surfaces, tighter dimensions,
and overall efficiency.
The Gallardo is a great example, exhibiting no excess
from any angle.
unmatched.zh:
宝贝兰博”系列的推出旨在拓宽兰博基尼品牌
的市场。
与其超级跑车的兄弟相比，这些“小型”车型……
以更锐利的车身线条、更紧凑的车身尺寸
和整体上的高效设计而著称。
Gallard就是一个很好的例子，从任何角度看都能展现
出简洁而精致的设计，没有任何多余的元素。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
This car reminds me of a happy little rabbit in the way
it sits slightly inclined towards the front.
It looks more like a fun runabout than a typical
commuter econobox.
Unlike retro-modern cars, such as the current Mini
and FIAT 500...
...this car is a modern interpretation of the original
FIAT 500 with Topolino character.
unmatched.zh:
这辆车的车头弧度略微下滑，看上去
就像是一只快乐的小兔子。
与其说它是一款典型的经济型通勤车，
不如说更像一辆提供愉悦驾乘体验的轻便汽车。
和其他的复古现代风格汽车，
例如当前版本的MINI和菲亚特500不同……
这辆车就好比是以“米老鼠”角色特点对
初代菲亚特500的现代化演绎。`
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
The main role of the Z33, introduced in 2001, was to resurrect
the Z, and serve as a symbol of the revival of Nissan itself.
Therefore, it was a car that had to succeed.
Because the Z has been a defining symbol for Nissan through the
years, it naturally embraced the design heritage of the company.
That said, we couldn't give it a retro look.
We needed to retain the essence and spirit
of notabe Nissans of the past...
...while giving it a thoroughly modern character.
The inspiration for the car's design language was
the S30 and the CSP first-generation Silvia.
And, it may be difficult to notice, but there are hints
of the SP Fairlady in the body section.
All of this made the Z33 more modern
and possess different proportions than the S30...
...but I feel it's still instantly
recognizable as a Z from any angle.
unmatched.zh:
Z33于2001年首次亮相，
它的使命是复活Z系列，并成为日产复兴的象征。
因此，这是一款不许失败的汽车。
作为日产的代表车型，Z33必须体现出公司的设计传统……
但又不能太“复古”。
因此，我们必须保留过去成就的精髓和精神……
再以完善的现代特征进行展现。
它的设计v言可以追溯到S30和第一代Silvia CSP。
而且，容易被人忽略的一个点是
——其车身部分还有些Fairlady SP的影子。
这些设计元素都使得Z33在比例和主题方面较S30更加现代。
但你还是一眼就能看出，这是一辆Z系车。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
This rare S model was built by British coachbuilder Barker,
best known for its work with Rolls-Royce cars.
In fact, you’ll notice that its body greatly resembles
that of a Rolls-Royce.
Designed by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche during his stint as
chief engineer at Daimler-Benz...
...the S-type showed its potential when it won the opening race
at the Nürburgring in 1927.
Powered by an inline-6 mounted id-wheelbase,
it is distinguished by its massive hood.
This feature gives the car very sporty proportions.
In addition to a factory body by Mercedes-Benz, the "S" also had bodies
by French and Italian coachbuilders.
unmatched.zh:
这款极其罕见的S系列是由因为与劳斯莱斯合作而闻名的
英国车身制造厂巴克所打造的。
其实你可以看出，它的车身与劳斯莱斯非常相似。

这辆S型的设计者是当时仍在戴姆勒-奔驰担任
首席工程师的斐迪南·保时捷博士……
并在1927年纽博格林赛道的开幕赛事上获胜，
向世人展现出了巨大的潜力。
它
一部中置直列六缸引擎提供动力，
其巨大的引擎盖尤为吸睛，
也赋予了这辆车极具运动感的比例。
除了由梅赛德斯-奔驰打造的原厂车身外，这辆S型还可以采用
法国和意大利车身制造厂推出的车身。
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
This second-generation NSX-GT race car appeared in 2014.
Does that sound odd to you?
It should, because the second-generation NSX production
car was released two years later in 2016.
There's simple explanation to this.
The race NSX wasn't based on the production NSX, but on
the NSX Concept...
...which was unveiled ahead of the production version
in 2014.
And, it was this concept car that took
the GT name.
In mid-2016, the second-generation NSX production car
was officially released.
Because of this, the competition car was also called
the NSX-GT.
This car came in 3rd place in Round Five of the
Super GT in Japan.
unmatched.zh:
这台第二代NSX-GT于2014年首次亮相。
听起来不觉得有些奇怪吗？
毕竟，它的基本车型，第二代NSX，在2016年才开始销售。
实际上，这辆车既是NSX，也不是NSX。
这是因为，它的原型车是一辆叫做NSX Concept的车……
那辆车是在本田于2014年，在其生产型出现前公布的。
然而，继xGT名号的依然是一辆赛车！
2016年中，第二代NSX正式发布。
因此，这款赛车也被称为NSX-GT。
作为概念时代的最后一款特规车型，
这款车在日本Super GT第五轮比赛中获得了第三名。
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
This is a masterpiece of Japanese car design.
To be honest, the S30 was developed as a hatchback coupe,
rather than a sports car.
There's plenty of cabin space.
Overall headroom is generous for a pure sports car.
Still, it looks very sporty,
meaning it is a very special design.
Take the proportion, line, and surface...
...in many ways, the design of this car says
"it can only be done this way.
But what is most impressive is...
...is its purity.
It exudes a high sense of Japanese beauty.
The look of the nose is modern.
It's a design that's distinctly Japanese,
unlike any other car from the U.S. or Europe.
The S30 is unmistakably a design that represents Japan.
From the latter half of the 1960s and on,
more than a few amazing sports-car designs were created in Japan.
In that day, there were man motivated
and talented young designers inside Japanese car companies.
They borrowed the best parts of Western design elements,
while keeping their own unique character.
I pay respect to the achievements of all of them, especially
Yoshihiko Matsuo-san, who recently passed away.
unmatched.zh:
这辆车可是日本汽车设计的杰作之一！
严格来讲，S30是作为一款掀背式双门轿跑车开发的，
而不是一款跑车。
如你所见，这辆车的车厢空间很大……
而且与纯粹的跑车相比，头顶空间更富裕。
不过，得益于其卓越的设计，它看起来还是动力十足。
此车的一切——车身比例、线条和外观表面……
无不{显着“纯正”二字。
但最为出众的……
还是其体现着日式设计美学的优雅和精致。
以其现代化的车头设计为例。
与美式或欧洲的设计都不相同，极具日本车特色。
S30就是一台纯粹的日系车。
从六十年代晚期开始，日本设计出了无数台跑车杰作。
当时的日本汽车公司汇聚了许多位
热忱且有才华的年轻设计3。
他们从西方设计中汲取精华，
但又保留了自己独特的感受力。
这些设计师都值得我们尊敬。
尤其值得一提的一位，便是最近去世的松尾良彦。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
In some ways, the Z34 is more classic in overall styling
than the Z33.
The wheelbase has been shortened by ...
...giving it long-nose proportions.
The shape of the roof,
and the window graphics with the peak at the very front...
...also adopt the S30's design basic theme.
In contrast, the massive rear fender that squeezes the shape
of the body from front to rear...
...aims to gve this car a level of aggressiveness never
before seen on a Z.
There were challenges on how to evolve the Z33's styling.
If the Z33 represented a modern and more
elegant design theme...
...then the Z34's look is one that's a more authentic of an
FR sports car with added aggressiveness.
unmatched.zh:
从设计上看，Z34比Z33的外观更回归经典。
首先，轴距缩短了……
显得车头相对更长。
其车顶的形状以及最前面的车窗贴花……
则特意延续了S30的设计风格。
相比之下，巨大的后挡泥板让车身的重心从前向后挪……
令它看上去更具有攻击性。
这是之前的Z系列中所罕见的。
当然了，对Z33的外型进行迭代并非易事。
简而言之，如果Z33给人以现代的优雅感……
Z34则更像是一款地道的前置后驱跑车，
而且更具攻击性。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
You might say that Porsche is Volkswagen-inspired not only
in the architecture of its cars but also in overall design…
...which some attribute to the genius of Erwin Komenda,
Ferry Porsche’s main engineer.
Yet it was Ferry’s son Butzi who would work this theme
into the modern 911.
With headlamps set at the end of its elongated front wings...
...a sloping rear, and elliptical side windows...
...it's a basic example of the "Jaray-style."
unmatched.zh:
很多人认为保时捷不仅在其汽车的架构上
受到大众的启发，整体设计理念方面也是如此……
并将之归功于艾尔文·柯曼达的天才头脑，
这位工程师同时也是费利·保时捷的得力助手。
但将这一设计理念真正融入到现代911车型中的
其实是费利的儿子（绰号“布奇”）。
在前翼子板顶端设置的头灯……
后溜背的车尾和椭圆形侧窗……
这些都是典型的“贾雷式气动设计”风格的体现。_
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
This car probably has the most dramatic profile
of a modern front-engine sports car.
The hood is long and low, and the cabin is placed well back
on the chassis, right over the rear wheels.
One of my favorite design features is how the front fender
vents are linked to the shape of the door opening.
Overall, the SLR McLaren has the look of speed,
grace, and elegance.
unmatched.zh:
在现代前置引擎跑车中，这款车可能是车身比例
最吸睛的车型之一。
它的引擎盖修长而低矮，车厢后移置于底盘后部，
正好位于后轮上方。
前挡泥板通风口与车门门缝衔接的神来之笔
绝对是我最喜欢的特色设计之一。
总体而言，SLR迈凯伦展现出了速度、优雅
和风度兼具的外观。
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
Today, the WRX STI has grown into a model
with its own distinct identity...
...representing Subaru’s engineering capability, technical
efficiency and focus on high performance.
But the second-generation WRX STI remained closely
tied to the Impreza.
And that connection gave its character a unique appeal.
It effectively reflected the idea of an everyday sedan
transformed into a serious performance machine.
With the newer WRX, however, the base model already carried a more
aggressive character, making the contrast less pronounced.
If you’re drawn to that sense of transformation—like
Peter Parker becoming Spider-Man...
...then this second-generation model, with its clean, understated
cabin and simpler window design, may be just right for you.~
unmatched.zh:
时至今日，WRX STi已经……
拥有了自己独立的品牌价值和存在意义，它代表着
斯巴鲁的技术实力与热情。
有鉴于第二代WRX STi是翼豹的改款版本之一……
使得它的设计完美体现了我们常用来打趣的那句俗语……
“文能出门买菜，武可拉力比赛。”
相比之下，新一代WRX的出厂版本就已经颇具攻性，
所以新型号上的文武之分就没有那么鲜明了。
因此，如果你想看到的是彼得·帕克
变身成为蜘蛛侠那种迥然相异的反差……
那么内饰朴实简洁，且没有配备`角形后车窗的
第二代WRX将是你的不二选择。
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
This car brings back the spirit of the original Skyline GT-R.
When you compare this car to the R33, the overall design has
become compact and solid.
Looking at the abruptly cut-off front end, you get a sense of
a modernized version of the C10 "Hakosuka."
The side glass graphics at the C-pillar
are also reminiscent of the C10.
You can say that the different front and rear overfenders
are tose from the Hakosuka, too.
And while the enlarged round taillights are an homage to the
C110, dubbed the "Ken-Meri..."
...this car is characterized by an uncommon Japanese design
that's simple and powerful.
It's undeniable that the Nissan designers wanted to express
the story of the Skyline GT-R through this car.

After all, the growth of a brand stems from love.
unmatched.zh:
这辆车再现了原版Skyline GT-R的风采。
与R33相比，它显得紧凑而又结实。
修整过的车头仿佛是C10 “Hakosuka”的
现代版诠释……
C柱处的侧窗玻璃贴花是如此，
甚至连前后不同尺寸的挡泥板也与C10有着深厚的渊源。
那对又大又圆的尾灯
则是对绰号“Ken-Meri”的C110的致敬……p/>
其简约而有力的设计是在日本车中十分罕见的。
毫无疑问，日产的设计师希望通过这款车
展现出Skyline GT-R的背景故事。
我只能说，这绝对是真爱了。@
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
This was a very unique car in the sense that Toyota’s
designers had to create an original design style for it.
It feels expertly sculpted.
In order to fit a 6-cylinder engine, the Supra’s nose
had to be extended, both physically and visually.
As a result, it looks like a powerful grand tourer.
unmatched.zh:
这是一款非常独特的车型，丰田的设计师们
注入了完全原创的设计风格。
它的车身给人以精雕细琢的感觉。
为了塞入一台6缸引擎，这辆Supra的车头不得不
横向加宽，也呈现出更豪迈的视觉风格。
最终的造型也更接近一辆性能强大的豪华旅行车。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
I love compact sports models from Germany.
They all have wide tires, twice as wide as
Japanese compact cars.
Those wide tires are among the most significant
components of this car.
They give the car its personality.
And the resulting wide stance makes the car look stable,
as well as possessing performance.
They distinguish the base C coupe from the AMG version
for those who have keen eyes.
unmatched.zh:
我非常喜爱德国产的紧凑型跑车。
这些车型都采用了宽胎，
其宽度足有日本紧凑型车的两倍。
宽胎正是这辆车最重要的组成部分之一。
赋予了这辆车鲜明的个性。
而这种设计让车身显得又宽又低，看上去非常稳定，
性能也同样卓越。
在懂行的人眼里，这些特点让AMG版本与
基础的C级双门跑车有了明显的区分。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
The GR Supra Racing Concept was revealed at the
Geneva Motor Show in March 2018.
When I saw it, I immediately thought to myself,
"The Supra is back at the track!"
Truly, Toyota is an incredible company!
Prior to the GR Supra’s release in 2019...
They had developed models built to LMGTE and
FIA GT-4 specifications.
Its debut race on Japanese soil was the first round
of the 2020 Super GT, at Fuji Speedway.
And of the six Supras that apparently competed,
five swept the top finishing positions!
unmatched.zh:
GR Supra Racing Concept是于2018年3月在日内瓦车展上亮相的。
当我看到它的时候，
我就在心里对自己说，“Supra又回来比赛了！”
丰田真的是一家让人惊艳的公司！
在2019年，GR Supra还没推出之前……
他们就开发过LMGTE和国际汽联GT-4级别规格的Supra。
此车在日本本土的出道首战是在富士赛车场
举行的2020 Super GT第一轮。
六辆参赛的Supra中，就有五辆车包揽了完赛前五名的名次！
unmatched.speaker: Jeremy
unmatched.roleZh: 咖啡屋常客 · 赛车史

unmatched.en:
The 964-based RS is one of my favorite models.
Because it retains the original "Ur" 911 shape
and air-cooled flat-6!
I'm thrilled it is visually pure and doesn't have
any add-ons like a fixed rear wing.
Also, it's Porsche's first Cup Car.
A true successor to the '73 RS and the '74 RS 3.0.
You can immediately tell a 964 RS from a normal 964 by
just looking at the stance and the wheels.
The 17-inch wheels on the 964 were made from aluminum.
On the 964 RS, they were visually the same, but were wider
and made from lighter magnesium.
Today, they fall into the "unobtanium" category!
unmatched.zh:
这款964 RS版本是我最喜欢的车型之一。
为什么？因为它保留了911原汁原味的“Ur-911”型外形和风
冷水平对置六缸发动机！
它带来的纯粹感令我兴奋不已，比如说，它就没有添加
固定尾翼之类的部件。
而且，它是保时捷的第一辆“奖杯赛车”。
我认为它是73版RS和74版RS 3.0真正的继承者。
只需看一下车辆的姿态和车轮，你就能立即分辨出
964 RS和普通964的差异。
964使用的17寸车轮杯型1是铝制的，
而964 RS虽然使用了同尺寸的车轮，但显得更宽，而
且使用更轻的镁合金材料制造。
镁现在已经被归为“超导矿石”类目，价格不菲！
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
It could be ordered in standard colors, along with
Rubystone, Signal Green or Maritime Blue.
The sparse interiors came in black as standard.
Then there were the one-piece composite Recaros,
with central trimmings in two-tone leathers.
There was the "M001" Carrera Cup Version, the "M002"
RS Touring Version, or the "M003" N/GT1 Carrera RS.
This is a must-have for the 911 air-cooled purist!
unmatched.zh:
这辆车的标准车身配色包括了红宝石色，信号绿，海洋
蓝。
内饰倒是标准且朴素的黑色，
外加中间包边的Recaro运动桶椅，可选双色皮革，
还分成了“M001”Carrera杯版本、“M002” RS Touring版本
和“M003” N/GT1 Carrera RS。
对于追求纯粹的风冷引擎911爱好者来说，这是一台必须
拥有的车！
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
The lovable Bug continues with the 1966 VW 1200 Beetle.
This version has enlarged front and rear windows.
The first-generation Pretzel's split rear window
changed in 1953 to a larger oval rear window.
In 1958, the rear window changed again
and became even larger.
With this model...
...the demand for better visibility, lighting, power, and
safety caused the three-arch silhouette to evove again.
But the original character and charm remained.
The last production air-cooled Beetle came in 2003.
Just think, 21,529,464 units built since 1945! That’s quite
a run, an it’s still popular!<
unmatched.zh:
1966大众1200甲壳虫延续了甲壳虫的可爱风格！
这个车型加大了前后车窗。
第一代“椒盐卷饼”的分块式后窗于1953款更换为了
更大片的椭圆形后窗。
在1958款中，后窗又经历了改进，尺寸进一步增大。
而到了这个车型中……
出于更好的可视性、轻盈感、动力和安全的需求，
引擎盖3个拱的形状#廓又一次发生了进化，
但原先的特色和魅力得到了保留。
最后一款风冷引擎的甲壳虫一直生产到2003年。
你想象一下，从1945年起到现在，这款车一共造了21529464辆！
这是多么漫长的生命周期啊。而且直到现在，
甲壳虫都还很有人气！%
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
The Raptor is an aggressive and capable beast.
I love this truck!
It has a solid overall design and possesses plenty of Ford’s
unique DNA.
The wide stance and large tires result in great
handling character and tremendous height.
Its capable 4WD system allows it to excel
on rough off-road terrain.
This first-generation Raptor had a V-8 that matched
its aggressive character.=
unmatched.zh:
猛禽的外形充盈着侵略性和力量感！
这就是我爱这辆卡车的原因！
它不仅拥有福特血统的优点，还有许多独到之处！
形成了一套性能全面的设计方案。
它拥有宽大的车架和大外径尺寸的轮胎，
因此获得了出色的操控性和充分的离地间隙。
极大的上坡角增大了车架前后部分与地面的空间，
使其能够轻松搞定起伏坎坷的地形。
另外，这辆初代猛禽搭载的可是一台V8引擎，
无论是个性还是侵略性，都更上一层楼！
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
In a way this Atenza is my debut work. There were a lot of
obstacles, and it brings back a lot of memories.
I was appointed the general manager of the design division
in 2009, to be the leader of Mazda design,
but I was told about my new position just 2 weeks before, so
I became general manager without any time to be ready.
And the first production car that I worked on,
was this Atenza.
Giventhis major role and responsibility,
this was a state of emergency for me,
but it was just as much a chance as it was a crisis.
It was a time in which the design theme for the next generation of
Mazda's were being considered from almost scratch,
and I thought to make design the major
pillar of Mazda from here and now.
And actually, the development of this car had already progressed
quite a bit under the previous design manager already,
but after thnking that we need to create the philosophy of Mazda
for the next age, and make design itself one of the pillars,
I made the decision to completely change the design
that was already in motion.
To do this it was necessary to redesign things that normally
should not be touched in terms of the development schedules.
As a result, the final design schedule for the production car
was delayed about 10 months...
And I was really scolded badly by the managing drector
of development at the time. A LOT.
At the time I was working on the "SHINARI" concept car
that would be the vision model for the next era,
and I translated the design theme of SHINARI to the production car
because it was a car made alongside the SHINARI.
It's a car that I personally care for a lot, I was
even still driving it until very recently.
Its been over 10 years now, but I think
its a design that doesn't feel old.
The more you work onwstandard cars, the more you understand
the power of design.
And saloons are difficult to design, because
they are the base for all cars.
I think timeless cars of an orthodox category is where
the ability of designers are truly tested.
unmatched.zh:
阿特兹可以说是我的设计生涯的开端，说起来，这个项
目真是苦乐自知，回忆满满啊。
2009年，我突然被任命为马自达设计部门的部长。
事情非常突然，我只有两周时间来适应这个新职位。
我接手后参与的第一款量产车就是阿特兹。
说实话，那会儿真是责任重大，差点儿没把我压垮。
不过，我硬是x这个危机扭转成了成功的机遇。
当时，马自达正在为下一代车型寻找新的设计主题。
我的想法是把“设计哲学”作为马自达未来发展的支柱。
老实说，前任部长在阿特兹上已经下了不少功夫。
但为了实现我的新一代设计理念……
我决定把这个已经在顺畅推进的项目推倒重来。
也就是说，一些通常在生产后期不会再改动的部分，我
们也^重新设计。
结果就是这款量产车设计进度整整推迟了10个月左右。
这下可把上司们气得不轻——他们当时大发雷霆。
与此同时，我还在筹备一款叫“靱”的概念赛车，它将成为
马自达下一代的前瞻性参考车型。
有意思的是，因为“靱”和阿特兹的开发是同期进行，
它们俩最后用上了同一个设计主题。
说真的，阿特兹U我来说意义非凡。事实上，直到前不
久我还在开这车呢。
虽然这款车已经面世十多年了，但它的设计仍然经得住
时间的考验。
你知道吗？你在标准车型上花的功夫越多，就越能体会
到设计的魔力。
尤其是轿车，看起来再普通不过，设计起来反而最难。
所以，要评估一位设计师的水平，关键在于他能否为正
统车型设计出经久不衰的作品。
unmatched.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
unmatched.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
unmatched.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计

unmatched.en:
I think the MAZDA3 is one of the top 5 cars
in my career as a car designer.
The design of the MAZDA3 also trails back to the RX-VISION.
In the RX-VISION, I created a form that expresses
a sense of life in the beauty of its reflections.
And the design of the MAZDA3 is an achievement of that form
created in the RX-VISION, in the C segment.
It's one of my personal favorites, and I think its a car
that will mark its name in history.
unmatched.zh:
马自达3可以说是我的职业生涯中最有代表性的五款车之一。
它的设计其实和RX-VISION挺有渊源的。
我在设计RX-VISION的时候，创造了一种通过漂亮的光
影折射效果让车身“活”过来的造型。
而马自达3呢，就是把这种设计应用到了C级车上。
我个人很喜欢马自达3。我敢打包票，这款车绝对会成为
汽车设计史上的一个亮点！
unmatched.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
unmatched.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
unmatched.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计

unmatched.en:
No doubt about it, the S30 has a sports-car design
that is quintessentially Japanese.
I might even go so far as to say that its proportions and
lines are just about perfect.
The over-fenders and long nose, which were added
to the ZG variant...
...actually balance the car quite nicely, giving it a more
"aggressive" charm, so to speak.
Just remember to give it some wide-rim wheels!
unmatched.zh:
毫无疑问，日产S30的跑车设计带有典型的日本风格。
我甚至可以毫不夸张地说，它的比例和线条都堪称完美。
它在ZG车型的基础上增加了宽挡泥板和长车头……
在外形上实现了平衡的观感，更为它赋予了
一种更具“攻击性”的魅力，
同时也没有忘记为它配上一套更宽的车轮！
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
The Lexus SC is a grand tourer series.
The second-generation model, the SC430, was a hardtop convertible
powered by a mighty V-8 engine.
You see them quite often in the U.S.
The first-generation model was designed at Calty, a Toyota design
studio located in California.
However, this SC430 was mainly conceived
at design studios in Europe.
A competitor at Japanese GT races, it received aerodynamic
upgrades for the 2008 season...
...during which it tore up the high-speed tracks.
unmatched.zh:
雷克萨斯SC属于品牌的豪华旅行车系列车型。
其二代车型SC430是由一台强力的V8引擎所驱动的硬顶敞篷车。
在美国，这辆车相对比较常见。
该系列的第一代车型由位于加利福尼亚的
丰田设计工作室Calty所设计。
然而，这一辆SC430主要是在欧洲的设计工作室中构思完成。
作为日本超跑比赛的参赛车辆之一，
其在2008赛季得到了空气动力学升级……
也因此，它在高速赛道上交出了极其出色的答卷。|
unmatched.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
unmatched.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师

unmatched.en:
This car has a dynamic and elegant design.
Called the Atenza, it incorporates the 4-door sedan-coupe layout,
and the style inspired by Mazda Design's "Kodo" philosophy.
In my eyes this design reinterprets the classic sensuality
of Italian sports cars from the 1960s...
...with a typically Japanese sensitivity of surfaces and details.
Soft and fluid shapes with evolving urfaces are enhanced
by specially developed metallic colors.
It is not by chance that in Mazda’s communication campaigns,
the cars are often shown in red...
...thus reviving a somewhat "Latin" sporting imagery,
made up of emotions and movement.
unmatched.zh:
阿特兹兼具动感和优雅的设计。
它重新诠释了20世纪60年代意大利跑车的经典性感……
又同时具备日本车典型的对于表面和细节的敏感。
这款车采用四门轿跑车的布局，
并融入了马自达设计部提出的“魂动”设计理念。
柔和的流畅线条与不断演变的表面
被专门开发的金属色车x进一步增强。
在马自达的不同广告宣传中，经常以红车示人。>
这并非偶然，红色唤起了某种充满情绪和动感的极致激情意象。@
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
This is a genuine American muscle car that cuts
a distinctive figure on the track.
A mid-size sedan with a super-high horsepower engine...
...it’s more European in its aero parts and suspension
than the first-gen model.
This car is a celebration of American "inclusive design."
It offers supercar-level performance
at an affordable price.
I once drove a Chrysler 300 SRT at Laguna Seca Raceway.
A dream to drive, its wide torque range allowed me to take
the course without frequent gear shifts.
unmatched.zh:
这辆车是一款真正的美式肌肉车，在赛道上
展现出独特的魅力。
作为一辆中型轿车，它搭载着一颗超高马力的引擎……
在空气动力学和悬挂方面比第一代车型融入了
更多欧洲风格，
从而体现了美国“包容性设计”的理念……
以实惠的价格提供了超级跑车级别的性能体验。
我曾在拉古纳-塞卡赛道上驾驶过一辆克莱斯勒300 SRT。
宽广的扭矩范围让我能够在赛道上畅快驾驶而无需频繁换挡。
那种驾驶体验如同梦幻。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
The VW Sambabus is truly a design icon, with a design
language that’s whimsical and endearing.
It literally makes you smile.
It’s basically a functional box with rounded
corners full of character.
This "23" Window Sambabus has a fully-opening
pull-back cloth sunroof...
...windows that go round to the back corners,
and "panorama" windows on top.
Its color palette greatly adds to its visual charm.
unmatched.zh:
大众的“Sambabus”是一款真正的设计代表作，它的设计语言
充满奇思妙想，同时又惹人喜爱！
不夸张地说，看到它你就会不由自主地露出微笑！
它的车身可以用长方体盒子来概括，再加上特征鲜明
的圆润边角。
这款“23”窗的Sambabus拥有可完全打开的
后拉式布制天窗……
以及从前一直环绕延伸到后方边角的大量侧窗，
顶上还有“全景式”的一圈边窗。
而丰富的车漆色系也为它的视觉魅力增色不少！
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
If I’m not mistaken, this car was preceded by
the more radical Gallardo.
And yet the Huracán represented an evolution
in Lamborghini’s identity and design language.
Its use of hexagonal forms continues to be seen
in today’s Lamborghinis.
unmatched.zh:
如果我没记错的话，这辆车的前款应该是
更加激进的“Gallard”。
然而，Huracán很好地展现了兰博基尼在品牌认同
和设计语言上的革命。
它采用的六角形元素至今可以在现款兰博基尼上看到。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
The Audi Quattro was a landmark achievement
in the history of automotive design.
Introduced in 1981, it revolutionized the world
of rally racing.
And, it has remained a benchmark for production-car
technology ever since.
Most of its outer panels are crafted from a blend of
resin and Kevlar.
And its steeply raked windshield provides better visibility
than many of its peers.
With wide fenders, a short wheelbase, and somewhat awkward
proportions, it may not have been the prettiest machine.
But as a purpose-built competition car,
it delivered outstanding results.
unmatched.zh:
奥迪quattro是汽车设计史上的一个里程碑。
它于1981年首次亮相，便彻底改变了拉力赛的世界……
并从此成为赛车技术下放量产车的典范。
其大部分外部面板是由树脂和凯夫拉混合材料制成……
挡风玻璃的角度经过调整，相比原型车
可提供更大的可视范围。
它的挡泥板宽大，轴距短，显得比例很不协调。
然而，作为一款专为比赛设计的汽车，
它以极其出色的成绩做出了回应。
unmatched.speaker: Kunihisa Ito
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
unmatched.roleZh: 通用/欧宝/福特汽车设计师

unmatched.en:
The Cayman has gone through a few cycles now.
The mid-engine layout here has made it sleeker
in both its roof line and overall proportions.
Indeed, the Cayman has taken on a more serious look
with each evolution.
With the GT4 trim, it is no longer positioned beneath
the 911.
Holding its own with great presence, tough looks and
beefy footwork...
...it has graduated from a casual racer to one that can
take on much bigger competition.\
unmatched.zh:
迄今为止，Cayman已经历了数次更新换代。
中置引擎的布局强化了车顶线条和整体比例的流线感。
事实上，Cayman的每次进化都让其更加凌厉。
升级到GT4版本后，它不再被定位在911之下。
凭借其强大的气场、富有侵略性的外观
和稳健的操控性能……
它已经从一款休闲性能车升级为能够与更高级别对手
竞争的真正赛道利器。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
At the risk of sounding crass by compliment our own designs...
...I always felt that the GT-R in the Super GT Series was
"oh so cool" when watching it in races.
The racecar is modified by NISMO every year...
...and the original image of the GT-R is carefully retained in
the grille and the shape of the lights.
When watching a race, it's important to be able to
recognize a car when seeing it from a distance.
For that to happen, the front and rear of
the base production car must be distinctive.
Also, while race cars may be modified for aerodynamics,
GT regulations prohibit changes to the cabin.
In fact, when I was watching a GT race at Suzuka...
...I said to myself, "The racecars painted in their
sponsor colors all look the same."　
That's when I decided that the shape of
the R35 GT-R's cabin must abolutely remain distinctive!
unmatched.zh:
虽然这样说感觉像是在自卖自夸……
……不过我坚信当你在Super GT系列赛中
看到这辆GT-R时，你一定会觉得“哇，太酷了”。
每年，我们都会将赛车交由NISMO进行改装……
……而GT-R原本的外观，如格栅和车灯形状等
都精心地保留了下来。
我认为在观看比赛时，能让观众远远地
就把赛车辨认出来很有必要。
要达到这个目标，
基础量产车的前后外观必须要有独到之处。
为了增强空气动力学性能，赛车的车身通常会接受
大量的改装，但GT系列赛又规定
驾驶舱必须与原版量产车保持一致。
我过去在铃鹿赛道观看超跑比赛的时候……
……就觉得“除了赞助商的涂装，这些赛车
看上去都一个样。”
所以，我才会在S计R35 GT-R的时候赋予驾驶舱独特的风格！
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
This is a car that I had a hand in
styling when I was with Renault Design!
When I designed
the Mégane III series with my team...
...we decided right from the start to make
the coupe version with the RS variant in mind.
Thus, the original design is already very compact...
...and extreme for a 3-door hatchback, with a sloping rear
window and a bold and dynamic rear pillar.
Obviously, the large alloy wheels, modfied bumpers...
...and the big rear central exhaust
contribute to making it even more aggressive.
But the most successful detail is...
...undoubtedly the F1-inspired suspended wing in the
front grille, which integates the daytime running lights.*
unmatched.zh:
这辆车的造型还是我在雷诺设计工作时经手设计的！
当我和我的团队一起设计梅甘娜III系列时……
从一开始就决定追加设计一个RS版本。
这是一辆紧凑到极致的三门小钢炮，有着大坡度后窗
和动态十足的C柱，
以及显著改造过的后保险杠……
还有汇集到尾部正中的大号排气管，让它更显侵略性。
但最成功的细节……
无疑是前格栅里受F1赛车启发的悬浮翼片，
我们将它直接与日间行车灯整合到了一起。
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini
unmatched.roleZh: 前宾尼法利纳设计总监

unmatched.en:
The Corvette Stingray Racer had a big influence
on every Corvette that came after it.
It was not designed as a production or concept car,
but as a very serious racecar.
Its design was a radical departure from that of
previous Corvettes.
Many of its shapes, like those characterized by
its beautiful fenders, were inspired by Italian streamliners.
The strong crease that defines the car contributes to
its evocation of speed.
unmatched.zh:
科尔维特Stingray Racer的诞生对后世每一台科尔维特
都带来了重大影响。
自设计伊始，它的定位就不是一台量产车或概念赛车，
而是彻彻底底的赛车。
大刀阔斧的设计改动使其与
之前的科尔维特大相径庭。
车身多处的造型设计都明显受到早期意大利流线型车身
的启发，尤其是那堪称精雕细琢的前后挡泥板。
另外，得益于围绕车身一周的“折缝线”设计，
令它多出了几分速度感。.
unmatched.speaker: Ed Welburn
unmatched.roleEn: Former GM global design vice president
unmatched.roleZh: 前通用汽车全球设计副总裁

unmatched.en:
The Evo’s history is marked by constant improvements
and functional expansions.
This MR version was the final model of the third-gen Evo IX,
and is said to be one of the best Evos ever.The third-generation car was based on the Lancer Cedia,
which, in turn, was a serious and practical family sedan.
Compared to the second-generation model, it was larger overall.
The nose took on a rounded sape, while blister fenders were adopted.
Not quite the battle machine it used to be...
...the large iconic fog lights, reminiscent of rally cars,
were done away with.
It was a sign that the Evo was expanding its sphere of competition
to include endurance races and the like.
At the same time, the car's upscale nature grew.
Multi-purpose cars like the Evo tend to adapt
to their surroundings.
In this sense, they evolve like living things.
And hat is just one of the many reasons that
fans continue to love the Evo.
unmatched.zh:
在翼豪陆神的发展史上，充斥着持续不断的改进和功能拓展。
这款MR版本是第三代翼豪陆神IX的终极车型，
也被公认为最卓越的翼豪陆神之一。
第三代翼豪陆神的开发基于蓝瑟西迪亚，
一款普通而实用的家庭轿车。
相较于第二代，它的车身整体更大，车头被重新设计得
更加圆润，同时加入了引$注目的凸起轮拱。
它不再保持曾经的战斗机器风格……
标志性的硕大雾灯，以及那些让人联想到
拉力赛车的元素，也不复存在……
这暗示着翼豪陆神正在将其竞争领域从耐力赛扩大到
更多不同领域。
与此同时，车辆的高端进阶属性也更为凸显。
像翼豪陆神这样的多功能车型往往能够灵活
适应不同的环境。
从这个意义上说，它们就像生物一样在不断演变进化。
这正是车迷们一直对翼豪陆神怀有深厚感情的众多原因之一。
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR GSR '06
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution IX MR GSR '06
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
I think that the Fugu Z is a very appealing car.
The interior is especially cool because it's so carefully
stripped down.
Only the bare minimum parts have been added,
which match the car's power output that has nearly doubled.
The original 240Z was straightforward and had
beautiful proportions...
...and this car is respectful of that with its
minimal customization.
Look at te original fender mirrors, they're in the
original Kilimanjaro White color.
It was as if a young person from California came upon
a Z that was a bit rough around the edges...
...and polished it with the admiration he had of the car
in the past.
And now...
...the raw pureness of the spirit of the
1973 Z shines brightly in the Fugu Z.
Thank you, Sung Kang!
unmatched.zh:
我觉得Fugu Z是一辆充满魅力的车。
内饰经过了非常细致的精简，显得尤其炫酷。
这款车只最低限度地安装了必要的改装件，
与之相对的是几乎翻倍的动力输出。
原始车型240Z的设计本身就很简约，
但有着优美的车身比例……
……这台车很好地延续了这一风格，只进行了极少量的改装。
你瞧这原版的挡泥板上装后视镜，
连油漆都是原版的乞力马扎罗白。
就好像是有个加州的年轻人遇上了一辆老爷车Z，
感怀它的破旧不堪……
……就抱着自己对这辆车的情怀对它进行了打磨。
而现在……
……1973 Z那最纯粹、最原始的精神
在Fugu Z的身上得到了灿烂重现。
姜成镐，谢谢你的付出！)
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
The A80 Supra...
...is a coupe with very traditional sports-car proportions
that's kind of rare in Japanese cars.
With a windshield that wraps all around the cabin,
it has a proper greenhouse.
And this car takes the classic, beautiful coupe and drops the
ride height further and widens the track...
...turning it into a race car that looks like it could really
deliver on the track!
The car's shape is simple, so the Castrol livery suits it well.
The lights, which look too close together in the original model,
are camouflaged and don't get in the way of the design.
The A80 Supra had lots of tuning parts available for it, so
it's no wonder it was so popular with the younger crowd.
unmatched.zh:
该怎么描述A80 Supra呢……
这是一款采用传统跑车比例的双门跑车，在日本车当中
相当罕见。
环绕式的挡风玻璃仿若一个倒置的温室。
这辆经典、优美的双门跑车进一步降低了离地间隙，加
宽了胎面，
变成了一辆仿佛随时可以一飞冲天的赛车。
简洁的车型与嘉实多的涂装相得益彰。
原版车中看起来相距太近的头灯经过涂装的遮掩后也不
那么碍眼了。
再加上A80 Supra有很多可供选择的调校件，难怪它在年
轻人中有如此大的魅力了！
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
There were a few Lamborghini models that succeeded
the Countach.
However, none of them defined the Lamborghini style
since that car made its debut in 1970.
In my opinion, the Aventador finally achieved it.
Or perhaps it even surpassed it.
It took key design cues of the Countach and added
new surface and detail languages.
And it carried the quintessential Lamborghini style
into the next generation.
unmatched.zh:
在1970年发布Countach之后，
兰博基尼推出过若干款后续车型。
但没有哪一款能像它那样定义兰博基尼的风格。
在我看来，Aventador终于做到了再造经典，
甚至可以说全面超越了前者。
它继承了Countach的关键设计要素，
并加入了全新的外观和细节设计语言……
将鲜明的兰博基尼风格带入了全新的时代。
unmatched.speaker: Tom Matano
unmatched.roleZh: 马自达设计师 · MX-5 设计参与者

unmatched.en:
Unlike the 993 Carrera RS, the 993 RS Clubsport
was built with racing as its sole purpose.
It featured a distinctive rear wing with integrated air inlets.
The downforce generated at the rear was balanced
by an extended front spoiler.
The wheels were a three-piece design,
with staggered offsets front and rear.
A single glance at the exterior details made it clear
this was the work of Styl Porsche...
...the in-house design studio at Porsche Weissach.
Inside, the cabin was defined by a spartan layout
and a reinforced roll cage.
Like other 911-based race cars of its era,
the Clubsport channeled its forebears.
I almost feel for the owner attempting to persuade
the authorities to license it for road use!
A formidable challenge, though not an impossible one![
unmatched.zh:
基于993打造的RS Clubsport版本
是比993 Carrera RS更加纯粹的赛道机器。
尾翼产生的巨大下压力需要通过狭长的前端扰流板来平衡。
轮毂采用3片式锻造设计，而且前后采用不同的偏距值。
从外观细节中不难看出，它的设计来自品牌自有的
保时捷-魏斯萨赫设计工作室——“保时捷设计”。
内饰采用赛车专用的朴素黑色，并安装了全面焊接加固的防滚架。
在这一代基于保时捷911打造的赛车上，
你仍然可以看到一些原版911的元素。
我可以想象，某些有追求的车主可能会尝试
为这辆车注册登记，获得上路许可……
……想必这位车主需要和车管部门费好大一番口舌了。
不过我“听说”还真的有人成功了！
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
The long-named Evo VIII MR GSR is a really special machine.
A true sports sedan with rallying pedigree.
The Evo's styling is sober and restrained, but set off
by its large functional rear wing.
The sober theme is continued on the inside.
The main difference is a thick steering wheel
and high-bolstered Recaro seats.
Did you know that the name "Recaro" is short for
"Reutter Carosserie?"
This is where Porsche handmade many of its car bodies
in the 1960s.
The body manufacturing division was sold to Porsche
and "Reutter" went off to make seats under Recaro!
A small bit of triva!!.
unmatched.zh:
拥有长串名字的翼豪陆神VIII MR GSR车型是一款非常特别
的座驾。它是一辆具有拉力赛血统的运动型轿车。
翼豪陆神的外观设计简洁而内敛，但实用的大型尾翼
为其增添了亮点。
这种简洁风格在内饰中得以延续。
主要的区别在于厚实的方向盘和
高包裹性的Recaro赛车座椅。
你知道吗？“Recaro”这个名字实是
“Reutter Carosserie”的缩写。
在20世纪60年代，保时捷的许多车身就是
在这里手工打造的。
后来，车身制造部门被出售给了保时捷，
而“瑞特”则以“Recaro”的名义专门生产座椅！
这是个有趣的小知识！
unmatched.resolvedCar: Lancer GSR Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.resolvedCarNameEn: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
unmatched.resolvedCarNameZh: Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII MR GSR '04
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
The '32 is the quintessential hot rod!
It was nicknamed "Deuce" because of the 2 in "32."
It was visually simple but complex in its execution.
Look closely and
you'll not find a flat line anywhere!
It possesses a powerfully aggressive package,
that's all about proportion,
balance, stance and form.
The shape tapers in every view.
 The stance is set up
 ith just the right amount of rake.
The back tires taller than the fronts.
The '32 also signals the beginning of
the iconic Ford V-8!
In a '32 Hot Rod, the motor becomes
an emotional part of the whole.]
unmatched.zh:
这款'32可以被视作是改装车中的标杆！
玩家们还将“32”中的“2”变成了这辆车的昵称：“二点”。
看似平平无奇的外观下，其实内有乾坤。
仔细观察后，你会发现整个车身上找不到一条平直的线条！
它的整体设计充满了力量和冲劲……
这也是车身比例、平衡、姿态和整体轮廓巧妙结合的成果。
前倾角的角度设置得恰到好处，
后轮比前轮高一些，就形成了现在这攻击型的姿态。
此外，这辆'32还标志着福特首次引入其招牌V8引擎！
对于'32 而言，
这台引擎是其浑然天成的整体中的神来之笔。
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
Look at the tight cabin and the position of the rear engine.
It's stunning.
The front fascia is particularly eye-catching.
The ridge that runs down the hood...
...really provides the vehicle with a unique feel.
It's so very French.
But then, it has large fog lamps for rallying...
...and air scoops at the rear have been flawlessly incorporated.
These details that sugges it's a competition vehicle
give it its exquisite character.
In terms of design, there are places where the balance is not
good, but when seeing the car up close, you don't mind at all.
In fact, it's those things that give this car visual impact.
This type of visual allure,
you can't achieve in today's cars.
This car is a true masterpiece, one that I would love to
add to my collection.
unmatched.zh:
这辆车确实令人叹为观止，请关注紧凑的车厢和
后置引擎的位置。
从正前方看时尤其如此，
因为沿着引擎盖向下延伸的中脊线很有时尚感。
我觉得它非常有“法式风情”。
不过，它同时还配备了用于拉力赛的大雾灯……
以及精心布置的进气口。
这些赛车的美学设计都为它赋予了精的特征。
从设计角度来看，有些部件似乎不那么平衡，
但凑近看时不仅不会让人这么觉得，
甚至是为这辆车带来了某种视觉冲击感。
它的许多设计在现今的汽车中确实已经不多见了。
这是一项真正的大师之作，我很想把它纳入我的收藏。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
For a car that came two generations
after the S30, this one has rediscovered its "Z-ness."
Three-dimensional undulations of the body are restrained,
and the design theme is simple yet bold.
The flush surface of the side glass and body around
the door section was an American design trend at the time.
You coud say that the Z32
is more of a coupe in design than a sport car,
but he super wide-and-low body proportion
makes the overall look amazingly sporty.
If you look at the design flow it does deviate
from the "Z story",
but the level of refinement of its design
is truly outstanding.
That's why the car is still so popular.
And here's an interesting fact:
The area around the opening line of the rear hatch,
 was carried over to the Z33.
unmatched.zh:
自S30推出又过了两代之后，
这款新车终于重新找回了“Z”系列的特色。
车身的起伏曲线十分克制，
用于展现简洁而又大胆的设计主旨。
侧面车窗底部与车门周围的车身齐平于同一平面……
体现了当时美国汽车设计领域的主流趋势。
与其说Z32是跑车，它更像是一台双门轿跑……
但那宽体低趴的姿态像是匍匐在地，
使整体外观充满了动感。
如果从设计流线上看，确实有些偏离Z系列的传统要素，
但其设计的精致程度无疑令人赞许。
这也解释了它为何至今仍然受到车迷们的追捧。
另外，后备箱盖开合线附近区域的设计在
后续车型Z33中也得到了沿用。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
This is the original GT-R, a sports coupe
Japan proudly offered to the world in the 1960s.
It has the famous "Surfin' Line" as the disctinct design feature,
but the other parts are also well executed.
Despite being passenger car-based, its proportions are rather
sporty, and the main design theme is powerful yet simple.
It's an excellent design with a bit of American-car flavor, from
the solid door sections to the overal sense of volume.
But it does lack the four round taillights.
When we were designing the R35 GT-R, we were, of course,
inspired by the Hakosuka's overall ambience and details.
In truth, a key thing about traditional GT-Rs is that they
aren’t fastbacks, but are shaped by the C Pillar.
At first glance, the R35 may look like a fastback...
...but you'll notice that when compared to the KPGC,
the window line of the C-illar is set at the same angle.
unmatched.zh:
这辆初代GT-R是日本在1960年代
呈现给全世界的骄傲——一台双门跑车。
久负盛名的“冲浪线条”是它的专属特色。
当然，其他部位的设计也同样可圈可点。
首先，原车型的定位是轿车，但GT-R将车身比例改得更偏向运动。
其主要的设计主旨就是“简单但性能强大”。
从方正、结实的车门到整车的廓形，
这款杰出的设计多少带着一些美国车的影子。
唯一缺少的，是后续车型中加入的四盏标志性圆形车尾灯。
我们在设计R35 GT-R的时候，从Hakosuka的
整体氛围和细节上汲取了不少灵感。
事实上，有个重要设计点值得一提——GT-R并没有采用溜背设计，
溜背的视觉效果来自于直接与下部车身相接的C柱。
粗看之下，R35很像是一台溜背车……
…但与KPGC进行比较之后你就会发现
两者C柱窗户的线条呈现的角度其实是一模一样的。
unmatched.speaker: Shiro Nakamura
unmatched.roleZh: 前日产首席创意官

unmatched.en:
The classical proportions and simple shape without needless
frills make this car essentially a sculpture.
Until then, carrozzerias such as Vignale, Ghia
and Zagato produced Ferrari bodies.
In the mid-1950s, the association with Pininfarina deepened,
and their work together increased.
This is a product from that time period.
It's powered by a 4-cylinder engine,
which is mounted backwards,
allowing for a long hood and the cabin's placement right
in front of the rear wheels.
unmatched.zh:
经典的比例和简单的形状，无需多余的装饰，
这辆车简直就像是一座雕塑。
在此之前，法拉利的车身交由维格耐、吉亚
和扎加托等车身制造商打造。
从1950年代中期起，法拉利与宾尼法利纳深化了合作，
二者联合打造的作品也越来越多。
这辆车就是来自那个时代的产品。
它由一部后置安装的4缸引擎提供动力……
因此可以采用更长的引擎罩，
座舱则恰到好处地位于后轮的前方。
unmatched.speaker: Hideo Kodama
unmatched.roleZh: 前欧宝设计师

unmatched.en:
The Renault Clio RS is an icon of Europe’s
"Supermini" segment.
The Williams version of the original series is remembered
with particular fondness.
Like its forebears, this RS version of the fourth-series model
combined extreme sportiness with quiet urbanity.
In terms of design, this car has sportiness in its DNA.
Its muscular shapes, aggressive front, and the concealed
rear-door hadles in its C-pillars...
...give one the impression of a two-door coupe.
Thanks to this, the sportier bumpers, aero details, and low
stance with 18-inch wheels and red calipers...
...are sufficient to visually transform it into a little
racing "weapon."
unmatched.zh:
雷诺Clio RS是欧洲“超迷你”类型
中的标志性车型。
第1代中的Williams版本尤其受到
广大车迷们的喜爱和铭记。
和前代车型一样，这款第4代的RS版本也完美综合了
极致的运动性能和安静的都市驾乘体验。
从设计上讲，这款车的确具备运动的基因。
它采用了充满肌肉感的外形、极富侵略性的前&，
并将后门的把手隐藏在C柱之中……
给人以双门跑车的观感。
基于这种设计，再加上运动感十足的保险杠、空气动力学细节
以及应用了18寸轮毂和红色卡钳的超低姿态车身……
足以在视觉上将它充分改造成一款赛道小钢炮！
unmatched.speaker: Fabio Filippini

unmatched.en:
This is such an exciting car!
From an angle, it seems to begin with a tire and end with a
tire, and the cabin takes up about half the body.
The height of its shoulder is determined by the suspension,
and the rear half of the cabin sits on the driven wheels.
This produces a lot of traction, and that raw power is
reflected in the clean lines of the car's sides.
And, it's channeledto propel the long nose forward!
The clean design features classically Japanese inspirations
such as flowing rivers and split bamboo.
You could even go far as to say it combines an angelic boldness
with a devilish level of detail.
It really is the epitome of "Kodo" design!
Incidentally, the fact that a race version was produced,
seemingly out of the blue...
...is probably related to the fact that the design boss
in Hiroshima is a race driver himsef.
I really can't wait to hear that rotary engine roar!
unmatched.zh:
这是一辆让人热血沸腾的车！
当你从某个特定角度看它的时候，它的线条以一颗轮胎
为始，以另一颗轮胎为终。它的座舱占据了大约车身的1/2。
车辆肩线的高度完全由悬挂的行程决定……座舱后半部
分的重量正落在驱动轮上，
产生大量的牵引力……这股动力沿着展现车辆亮点的侧
面弧线流动……
带着庞大的推力径直冲向长长的车头！
它有破竹的清澈，更有清溪的纯净，简洁的设计带有经
典的日本风韵。
仿佛结合了天使的大胆以及魔鬼的邪恶细节。
“魂动”设计的巅峰，就在此刻，此处！
像这样横空出世般的赛车版本……
可能与广岛工厂的设计总监本身就是一名赛车手有关。
噢，我已经迫不及待想听听它的转子引(轰鸣的声音了！
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
Whoa, now this is most impressive!　
The GT1 Turbo specs, brought on by some powerful tuning,
has separated this automobile from the base model.
Because of that, the design of the original automobile...
...has been engulfed by the almost violent nature of the
added-on parts...
...greatly changing its essence.
The S2000 was originally designed to make the front
overhangs appear short...
...but the contrasting proportion of the nose,
with its wedged shape design on this car...
...was only possible because of the front mid-engine layout
of the S2000.
There's a lot of room for the intervention of design,
especially in the details.
And, one can say that its taste comes from a perceived
absence of design, making this car a lovable monster.\
unmatched.zh:
这辆车令人非常印象深刻！
在接受了大量强化调校后，这辆GT1 Turbo spec已经变得
与基础车型截然不同。
你可以明显看出，几乎称得上是“暴力”的改装件
彻底颠覆了原车的模样，
可以说已经是台完全不同的车了！
虽说S2000的设计初衷是缩短前悬距……
但Amuse的最终成果却有悖常理地造就了GT1的长车头比例！
不得不说，它在细节和其他设计元素方面都有
长足的改进空间……
但这些“简陋”的呈现反而成了萌点，
使它成为了一头可爱的怪兽。<next id=2001006 type
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
The 1956 GS Carrera Coupe was the most powerful
and most luxurious Porsche available in its day.
This year marked the first time we saw the improved "A" model.
It was visually similar to the "pre-A,"
except it had the 15-inch wheels...
...with larger rear-wheel openings and non-rolled rocker sills.
The GS had the same sill and bumper trim as the lower
line models, but there really wasn't a visual ifference...
...except for the fact that the rear sat a bit lower due to
the heavier 4-cam Carrera engine.
The interior was the same as well, except there were two
push-pull switches above the instrumentation.
This was to control the dual coils specific
to the Carrera engine.
When you opened up the rear lid, you saw the real difference between the A and pre-A.
The 4-cam Carrera engine was an artistic masterpiece!
The fan shroud and assembly were gogeous too!=
unmatched.zh:
‘56 ‘GS’ Carrera Coupe是保时捷史上最强劲、最豪华的一款。
名称中的56代表经过大刀阔斧改进的365A新款
问世的首个年份。
在外观上，它与之前的“pre-A”车型非常相似，
唯一不同之处在于采用了新款15英寸车轮……
后轮轮拱更大，侧裙没有滚边。
由于GS车型与低端车型都采用同款侧裙和保险杠装饰，
所以外观上并无差异……
只是因为搭载了更重的四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎，
车尾被压得更低。
内饰也几乎一模一样，只在
仪表板上方多了两个推拉按钮，
那是用来控制“Carrera”引擎独有的两个点火线圈的。
只有当你打开后引擎盖时，才能发现真正的差别所在！
你会发现，四凸轮轴“Carrera”引擎简直是一件美妙的艺术品！
连风扇罩和总成打造得异常精美！
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
The Genesis Coupé was a true sports car with RWD
and a 3.8-liter V-6.
The exterior styling was inspired by its RWD proportions.
This resulted in a long dash-to-front axle, a long hood with
a short front-overhang...
...and a cabin set rearward.
The styling lines and graphics were unique, inspired
by an East Asian ink-wash painting process.
This proces started with abstract black ink-brush strokes
to find the right facial and styling expressions.
The idea of the artistic process was to create a unique
character and interest.
In a way, this was an extension of the classical theme
of sketching...
...with the added bonus of allowing the brush strokes
to create unexpected graphics.
unmatched.zh:
捷尼赛思Coupe是一款真正的后驱跑车，搭载一台
输出的3.8升V6引擎。
外观设计为了着重凸显后驱车的比例，
带来长轴距的前舱（从仪表盘到车头）、修长的引擎盖
和较短的前悬挂……
以及向后移置的车厢。
其造型的线条和样式均十分独特，是从东亚水墨画的
绘制过程中汲取了灵感。
在水墨绘画中，往往会用毛笔以抽象的墨色笔触
勾勒出准确的面部和造型表达。
其内核是追求独特的个性和审美趣味。
在某种程度上，它是素描这一经典画技的延伸……
并加入了以毛笔笔触带来的、意想不到的视觉效果。
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
This was a car that was produced with the concept:
"if Mazda was to compete in the top category of the Le Mans,
what would be a great design."
The LM55 name stands for "Car Number 55 of Le Mans,"
and is taken from the legendary racing car of Mazda.
I remember that we did a full aerodynamic simulation, and really
went through a thorough development process for this car.
We had engineers knowledgeable about racing ars
also become involved in the development.
There is a full scale model as well, and its on display
in the Mazda Museum.
And actually, my name is on the car as the driver.
It is from the wish that if this car appears, and it runs
on the Le Mans, that I want to be the driver.
The Le Mans hyper car class regulations allow
a fair amount of design freedom...
and if we make a car like this and compete,
that would be a huge opportnity!
unmatched.zh:
这辆车回答了这样一个问题：“马自达要怎样设计，
才能在勒芒顶级组别的赛事中一争高下？”
LM55这个名字中，“LM”是“勒芒”的缩写，
“55”则是“55号赛车”，是向马自达的一位传奇赛车手致敬。
设计这辆车的时候，我记得我们进行了多项测试，
还包括全面的空气动力学模拟。
而且还特意请来了对赛车有深入解的工程师支援……
我们甚至还做了个1:1的实物模型，现在就摆在
马自达博物馆里呢。
哦对了，你可能会发现车手名单里有我的名字。为什么？
因为要是有朝一日它真的能征战勒芒，我想亲自开上它！
勒芒超级跑车组别的规则给了设计师很大的发挥空间……
所以，要是我们真能造出这样一辆车去参赛，嘿，说不
定真能捧回^军奖杯呢！
unmatched.speaker: Ikuo Maeda
unmatched.roleEn: Former Mazda design lead; Kodo design
unmatched.roleZh: 前马自达设计负责人 · 魂动设计

unmatched.en:
The Lancer Evo is a mundane Japanese family
sedan that's been transformed into a racing beast.
...a mild-mannered nobody transformed into a superhero...
...the kind typically found in comic books and action flicks.
So, what might the superpowers of this car be
from a design perspective?
Why, they are expressed by its sharp spoilers, bumpers
and grille!
All of this brings to mind the imposing image
of a samurai’s suit of armor.,
unmatched.zh:
Lancer Evo是由日本最平淡的轿车产品
族系之一改造而来的比赛野兽。
它就像是漫画或者动作电影中常见的那种……
不显山露水的平凡人变成的超级英雄。
那么从设计角度来说，这款车的“超能力”是什么呢？
还用问吗，它那犀利的扰流板、保险杠和
前格栅就能充分回答这个问题了！
所有这一切都让人不由得联想到日本武士的盔甲。\

unmatched.en:
The goal of J Mays and his team...
...was to make this car more of a European sports car
while not losing its American pony-car heritage.
It was truly a tough undertaking!
The resulting car is the quintessential Mustang...
...which looked like it went to finishing school in Europe.
The new side DLO with rear quarter window
was initially controversial...
...because the previous Musangs had a B-pillar separating
a scoop, window, or a clean panel.
The new DLO made the Mustang visually more sophisticated
and provided better visibility.
The front-end looked aggressive, with its thin, angled eyes
and aggressive grille!
The rear-end took the three-bar iconic taillights
to a new level.
It had a sequential blinker inspired by the '67/'68 Shelby.
And, did it ever look ean, especially with optional big
wheels spaced-out to the edges!
unmatched.zh:
梅斯及其团队的目标……
是使这款车更贴近一辆欧洲跑车，同时不失
其美式小马车的传统。
这确实是一个艰巨的任务！
他们最终的成果是一款典型的Mustang……
但跑去欧洲的商场采购装扮了一番。
新的后侧窗设计起初引发了不少争议……
前款Mustang的B柱非常宽厚，在后侧只隔出了一个气口、
以及一扇小窗，或者叫它一块平整的玻璃更合适。
相比之下，新侧窗使这款Mustang在视觉上更加精致，
并提供了更好的侧后方视野。
前脸部分的设计更为激进
——细长而倾斜的大灯和狰狞的进气口极具攻击性！
经典的三道杠式尾灯设计被提升到了一个新的高度……
并采用了受到'67/'68 Shely启发的顺序闪灯效果。
在选配了几乎占满全部轮拱的大尺寸轮圈之后，
整车的姿态近乎完美，更显卓尔不凡！
unmatched.speaker: Freeman Thomas
unmatched.roleEn: Former Ford design director; Porsche, Audi
unmatched.roleZh: 前福特设计总监 · 保时捷/奥迪

unmatched.en:
There are a variety of ways to express your passion for cars.
This machine is a 1951 Ford.
Not only has it been lowered, the roof has been left intact,
and the body itself has been made thinner.
The engine is from a Lincoln of the same era.
The car creators pulled off in real life what designers
today would only attempt on a computer screen.
Cars from this era were simple to tune, having the ptential
for customization unlike those of today.
Find a basic design that you fancy, and then inject your
own sense of beauty and experience into it...
...and you have your own one-of-a-kind masterpiece.
Every detail of this car is a 100-percent reflection of the
tastes and experiences of the car owner and creator.
Compare it with today’s exotic cars that await customers in the
showrooms, which one do you think stands ou more?
unmatched.zh:
表达对爱车的热情的方式可谓五花八门。
这是一辆1951年的福特。
它的全车车身经过了降低，没有锯掉车顶，
但整车外壳接受了打薄处理。
它的引擎来自于一辆同时期的林肯。
这辆车的创造者赤手空拳就做到了如今的汽车设计师们
只敢借助电脑才能完成的事。
与今天的车不同，来自那个时代的车 易于调校，
也有很大的改装潜力。
找一辆你中意的基础车型，然后将你的美学与经验
倾注其中……
就能拥有一辆独一无二的杰作。
这辆车上的每个细节都100%体现了它的所有者
与创造者的品味与经验。
与如今静静地在展厅中等待着买家的豪车相比，
你更喜欢哪一辆呢？"
unmatched.speaker: Hikonori Kagurazaka
unmatched.roleZh: 高性能车设计师

unmatched.en:
The 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster takes the most
spartan model in the Porsche lineup...
...and pushes it into the level of "unobtanium."
The Speedster shape and form are an extension
of the other 356A models, but more extreme.
With its low wrap-around windshield, tall shoulder...
...and longer rear deck...
...the Speedster has attitude.
Both James Dean and Steve McQueen had Speedsters.
Unique to the Carrera GT are the deletion of
the side spears and sill deco.
The bumpers do away with the bumper horns and the deco
is replaced with aluminum trim.
You can also see the front leather tie-down straps
and GT roll bar.
The GT eventually received aluminum opening panels.
And even the normal-looking wheels are specially
constructed of steel and aluminum.
As with all Porches, you really need to take a close look at
each model to know all the variations.
unmatched.zh:
356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster是基于保时捷产品线中
最简约的车型开发的……
又将其推向了“无法企及”的境界！
Speedster的外形沿袭了其他356A车型的设计，
但更加的极致……
低矮的环绕式挡风玻璃、高耸的轮眉……
还有更长的后部，
无不彰显其自成一派的风范！
詹姆斯·迪恩和史蒂夫·麦奎因都曾
将Speedster作为他们的$驾。
这个Carrera GT版本的独特之处在于
取消了侧面装饰条和侧裙装饰。
前保险杠取消了撞角，用铝制饰条取代了装饰件。
你还可以看到前盖的皮革固定带和后座的GT防护杆。
GT车型最终采用了铝制板材……
甚至看起来平平无奇的轮圈也是
钢铝混合材质的特殊结构。
保]捷的车总是需要你仔细观察才能分辨出它与
普通“推杆”车型的各种差异！这一台也不例外。
